Wilds are able to substitute for any regular paying symbol or dish wins worth up to 125 times the bet for a five wild winning line.Flaming Tiki: Slot FeaturesFlaming Tiki slot - free spinsDon't forget to be on the lookout for the Tiki symbol, as this is how cash prizes from the ladder may be won. When 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, or 9 Tiki symbols are in view on the reels, players collect a payout worth 1x, 5x, 15x, 40x, 100x, 500x, or 2,000x the bet, respectively. This can occur in the base game or in free spins.Free SpinsLanding 3 Free Spins symbols triggers a spin on the Free Spins Wheel, plus a payout of 1 times the bet. Free Spins symbols appear on reels 2, 3, and 4. The Free Spins Wheel determines how many free spins are awarded, as well as a win multiplier value. The win multiplier applies to all wins during free spins except Tiki Symbol wins. The initially awarded number of free spins is awarded again when the feature is retriggered.Flaming Tiki slotFlaming Tiki: Slot VerdictBy the end of the test run, while on the whole okay, so-so, not the worst thing since unsliced bread, Flaming Tiki didn't exactly do a whole lot to quicken the pulse, whiten the knuckles, or produce much desire to come rushing back for a round two. It felt like an early release from a budding online slot maker that hadn't quite found their niche, or their feet, or had the confidence to smash expectations by doing something extraordinary. Flaming Tiki doesn't actually do much original of anything either, really, as it's such a close copy of Gameburger Studios' online slot 9 Masks of Fire; in fact, it's basically a clone. Makes sense since 9 Masks has gone on to garner popular acclaim, and a ton of casino game makers have attempted to cash in on the popularity since then. However, Flaming Tikis has been made so carefully close that it's as if High Limit Studio was fearful of upsetting the apple cart.So close, there's not much to say about the gameplay part of Flaming Tikis that hasn't been said before. Perhaps the most noticeable thing, and it might have been because our luck just wasn't running hot on the day, but the scatter/instant prize feature didn't seem to trigger all that often. Just an observation, like the way Flaming Tiki's max win of 2,000x might not sound impressive, yet is on a par with the game which inspired it, so, eh.Like an up-and-coming actor who is yet to make their mark in their chosen profession so has to take any old paying gig, similar to Joey from Friends doing the STD advert gig, you can kind of look the other way. However, a name like High Limit Studio set lofty expectations which Flaming Tiki struggled to meet. It might make a suitable substitute for players looking for a similar hit to 9 Masks of Fire but are also Fire-d out. Otherwise, it felt a little too half done to leave much of a mark. Then again, the market or certain segments of the market seem to lap these sorts of games up, so maybe Flaming Tiki will wind up being a hit?

title: Bali Vacation Infinity Reels
structured_summary: Bali Vacation Infinity Reels is themed around a Bali travel and airport setting, blending island vibes with airport visuals. The game features the Infinity Reels mechanic, a No Poker feature removing low pays, and a free spins bonus with increasing multipliers. The reviewer finds it a decent but not standout slot, best suited for mobile play with some fun escapism. Aesthetically, it has a blurry beach background and an upbeat soundtrack that doesn’t strongly evoke Bali but adds an enjoyable groove.
review: Bali Vacation Infinity Reels: Slot OverviewWhen you think of the Indonesian island of Bali, gambling might not be the first thing that springs to mind. The island is famous for surfing, sunning, and sure, there’s bound to be plenty of partying going on there too. It’s also renowned as a deeply spiritual location, known as the Land of the Gods, due to its outstanding natural beauty, multi-cultural population, and strong Hindu influence. It is to this colourful batik of a destination the mobile slot guys, PG Soft, turn to for their third Infinity Reels title, Bali Vacation Infinity Reels.Well, it’s certainly a colourful game, utilising a travel/airport theme as much as a Bali one. A game grid, which starts each spin in a 3-reel, 4-row configuration, hangs between a couple of poles above an announcement board and a baggage carousel. Bags are also used as dead symbols to block positions on the reels as well - one of those big metal cases designed to withstand the most vigorous airport baggage handler. There are a few Bali inspired symbols on the reels, but other than them, PG Soft hasn’t gone nuts with the theme. There is a big blurry background image of a beach if you’re playing on a desktop, yet it could be anywhere. Aurally, the game’s soundtrack doesn’t intimately tie to the Indonesian island either; again, we could be anywhere. To its credit, the track is an infectiously good groove and one of the most enjoyable aspects of the game.While PG Soft focuses on the mobile segment of the market, Bali Vacation Infinity Reels can be played on any device. Whether you’d want to play a slot that squeezes its active area into the size of a mobile phone on your screen is a pertinent question. If so, then bets from 20 p/c to $/€200 can be set. Statistically, Bali Vacation Infinity Reels comes out pretty rosy, in large part due to a decent RTP value of 96.71%. As to volatility, PG Soft uses three ratings – Entertaining, Engaging, and Exciting, with Bali Vacation Infinity Reels scoring the latter. In layman’s terms, Exciting equates to ‘highly volatile’, so factor in that setting if deciding to give Bali Vacation Infinity Reels a go.As to symbols, there are 10 regular pays in the base game, whittling down to 5 in the bonus. Low pays are 10-A ‘poker symbols’, as the game calls them, and 5 island images. These are coconut drinks, sunhats, something by the sea (it is quite small to make out), a surfer girl, and a lady in traditional garb. Winning combinations are worth the number of symbols multiplied by their individual value. As an example, 5 of a kind premium wins pay out 1.5 to 2.5 times the stake. Lastly, a presumably Balinese mask wild assists in this endeavour by replacing any pay symbol.Bali Vacation Infinity Reels: Slot FeaturesAs far as Infinity Reels go, Bali Vacation Infinity Reels does not come with a long list of extra features beyond the standard reel expansion/multiplier deal. The base game gets the occasional No Poker feature, while free spins take the concept one step further.Central to the action is the Infinity Reels mechanic. Any combination of 5 or more matching symbols from the leftmost reel results in a winner. When a win hits, which includes the third reel, an extra reel is added to the right, and this process continues to occur as long as the new reel improves the win – hence the Infinity Reels name. At the same time, a win multiplier is used. The multiplier starts each main game spin on x1 and increases by 1 for every reel added.Triggered randomly on any spin during the base game, the No Poker feature removes all poker symbols (10-A) from the reels before they stop spinning, thus increasing the chance of landing a big win combo.Your ticket to the free spins is a scatter symbol that literally displays tickets and a passport. Landing 3 scatters in a spin cycle awards 8 free spins, and each additional scatter provides +2 more. The bonus round is essentially an extended No Poker feature, as low pay symbols are removed from the reels for the full round. There is one additional benefit; the win multiplier does not reset between free spins.Bali Vacation Infinity Reels: Slot VerdictSo, is it all a virtual vacation on the reels for those who can’t make a long haul flight to the real Bali? Well, not really, but it’s not a bad wee getaway for players up for some Infinity Reels fun on their mobile device. Desktop users will have to get used to squinting at a reduced game area which is off-putting. Despite larger device users not being PG Soft’s target audience, it does feel like they continue to shoot themselves in the foot by not catering to them. The blurry background beach image just doesn’t cut it, making playing Bali Vacation Infinity Reels on anything larger than a 6-inch screen a bit of a waste of time; it’s definitely a waste of space.Hey, that’s PG Soft’s business model and all power to them. Moving on from that point, Bali Vacation Infinity Reels turns out to be an okay slot, not hugely better or worse than any other powered by ReelPlay’s mechanic, just different. As in, a little different to be sure, mainly due to the No Poker feature/ royal removal system.The massive advertised potential of 100,000x the bet is an eye-catcher, but, be aware, this is no San Quentin xWays. Tellingly, the best result PG Soft achieved in one billion simulated spins was 3,560x the bet. Obviously, this is a much more down to earth figure and sure to influence whether Bali Vacation Infinity Reels is the right choice for your gambling bucks.The rest of the stats are well respectable, and removing low-value symbols from free spins is usually an approach that tends to work well. Yet, after adding everything up, Bali Vacation Infinity Reels doesn’t offer a lot that hasn’t been done elsewhere with this mechanic. However, it does so amidst a cheerful party atmosphere, providing the chance for a bit of escapism.

review: Detroit Red Wings Winged Reelers: Slot OverviewDetroit Red Wings Winged Reelers from Play'n GO is a branded PokerStars Michigan exclusive that isn't just tailor-made for fans of the iconic Detroit-based NHL team, it's also a clear shot at captivating the US market. Or a few ice hockey fanatics who are thrilled by the idea of seeing their sport on the reels and are dreaming about a day when Play'n GO picks their team to be glorified in a slot. title: Prism of Gems
structured_summary: Prism of Gems is a gem-themed slot set in a museum-like Greco-Roman environment, continuing Play'n GO's sparkling precious stones series. review: Prism of Gems: Slot OverviewDeveloper Play'n GO continues their fixation with all things sparkly in Prism of Gems, another in their dynamically expanding precious stones range. Like others that preceded it, Prism of Gems utilises splitting symbols to expand reels and ways, while powering up multipliers in the process to boost wins. It is similar to Frozen Gems and Perfect Gems, but Play'n GO has dialled up the winning potential in an attempt to make Prism of Gems the most tempting of the bunch.The aforementioned Gem games were attractive without being particularly stunning from a visual standpoint - Prism of Gems continues this trend. Not one of the majors like the Louvre or the British Museum, but one of those smaller elegant buildings hidden deep in a travel book that only locals know about. It might not house anything as impressive as a Rosetta Stone, yet its eclectic collection is nevertheless full of quirky surprises. Anyway, it’s a pleasant place to be and makes Prism of Gems warmer than Frozen Gems in almost every regard.Spinning gems once again is possible on any device, where bets from 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin can be set. Ways to win are variable as well, starting at 576, rising to 3,087 at full strength. In all grid states, wins are awarded when 3 to 5 matching symbols land adjacently from the leftmost reel. The symbols themselves are split into low pay card icons 9-A and higher value gems. There are 4 of the latter higher-paying lot, where a combination of 5 gems is worth 1.4 to 3 times the stake. Factor in the number of ways plus some impressive multipliers, and those values quickly blossom.Prism of Gems: Slot FeaturesPrism of Gems - free spinsCentral to these gem-themed games is a cascade feature, working in tandem with splitting symbols and multipliers. Every win triggers the cascade mechanic, which removes the combination from the game grid so non-winning symbols can drop down to plug the gaps. Cascades roll on until no new winning combinations appear.The top row, sitting on reels 2-4, is called the multiplier reel, and each of its positions has a multiplier attached to it – starting at x1. Every time the corresponding reel cascades, the multiplier increases by +1 up to x7. Any wins with symbols present on the top row are affected by the multiplier, which can accumulate up to x343. In addition, if a symbol matches the one in the multiplier reel above it, it splits into 2 up to 7 positions high at most. In addition, wilds split all symbols below them, except scatters. Wilds substitute for any symbol except scatters, by the way.Scatters land on any row to award 10, 15, or 20 free spins when 3, 4, or 5 of them are in view. All active multipliers from the base game are carried over to the bonus round, where they build progressively until the end of the feature, not resetting between free spins. During the feature, each scatter awards +2 additional free spins.Prism of Gems: Slot VerdictPrism of Gems takes elements of the previous two games, then builds on them to create a higher-performing slot. So far, all have used splitting symbols of some description, while Prism of Gems' multiplier system is more sophisticated than Perfect Gems. That one incremented its multiplier following cascades, some might say to cash in Bonanza's success. The result shrugs off the kid's movie connotations Frozen Gems had while putting extra distance between itself and Bonanza. Prism of Gems is definitely not a complete standalone game but an evolution of the series.For whatever reason, Play'n GO's gem range is still to knock it out of the park. If winning potential is one reason, then the team has gone a long way to destroying that argument. Prism of Gems might have lopped off a reel compared to Perfect Gems, yet it has significantly increased payout possibilities, where wins of up to 30,000 times the bet are now possible – much higher this time around. Will it be enough to make up for the perceived shortcomings in other areas? Possibly for players whose overriding concern is to go as large as possible. Having said that, don't stare yourself blind on PnG's advertised max wins as it seems extremely rare to hit even anything near it in most of their slots - as is evident if you keep track of big wins shared on social media.Setting the radically higher max win figure to one side, its business as usual with the rest of Prism of Gems. Splitting symbols open up the game board, yet not as dramatically as PopWins games do if you're after a contemporary comparison. So while it is similar to the two games that preceded it, Prism of Gems uses larger amounts of just about everything to push the range to a higher level. Play'n GO has thrown in the proverbial kitchen sink in the form of massively increased potential, which is a bonus, though the core gaming remains more or less the same as what came before.

title: Gates of Troy

review: Gates of Troy: Slot OverviewGet all sword-and-sandals with software provider Play'n GO in the historically or mythologically minded online slot Gates of Troy. The features in Gates of Troy, by comparison, aren't anywhere near as innovative and include Guaranteed Scatters and free spins with wild frames.Guaranteed ScattersWhen this feature is randomly triggered in the base game, 2 scatters will be placed on the reels in the hope of landing at least the third, thereby triggering free spins.Free SpinsLanding 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols awards 10 free spins plus a payout of 1x, 10x, or 100x the bet. The artwork is nice, particularly the background scenery, but the rest is forgettably prosaic.For one, the base game is pretty pedestrian. There are multiplier wilds, fair dues; who's going to say no to those? Yet, the other feature, Guaranteed Scatters, is not the most rousing addition since other games manage to land two scatters on a single spin without having to do a song and dance about it. Guaranteed Scatters came across as unnecessary hoopla rather than something exciting to look forward to. Moreover, landing more than three scatters does not award extra free spins, making the availability of scatters on all five reels redundant.Then there are free spins themselves, with wilds framing the positions they land in, then turning all wild on the final free spin. title: Strolling Staxx: Cubic Fruits

review: Strolling Staxx IntroductionThe third instalment of NetEnt's Staxx series has arrived, which, to be honest, came as a bit of a surprise seeing the lukewarm response from the casino community the other games received. title: Purr Power

review: Purr Power: Slot OverviewIn these hectic lives we seem to get caught up in, have you ever wished you could push all the stressors away to feel the same level of contentment cats display when they are in full purr mode? Say, stretched out on a rug being patted by an adoring owner next to a roaring fire in the depths of a cold winter. Even a fraction of that mindless bliss would be appreciated every now and then. The game title logo font looks similar, the dreamy, cloudy background looks similar, as do the symbols dropping in on the gaming grid. However, Purr Power's game world is not as developed as Moon Princess. There are no princesses or any other characters accompanying players on screen in the base game, which gets lonely, and a feeling of adequate yet underdone permeates much of the experience.Purr Power slot - base gamePurr Power's gaming grid is a 5-reel, 6-row space that uses a scatter-pays mechanism to create wins. Landing 8 or more identical pay symbols in any position on the matrix creates a winning combination. The winning symbols get removed, allowing symbols to cascade downwards, thereby providing another chance to win. Consecutive wins like this occur until no new combination is formed after a drop. A highly volatile math model is on offer, producing a default RTP of 95.68% while laying out stake options of 20 c to $/€20 per spin.Nine pay symbols (though no wilds) land on the reels in the base game. It starts with 3 spins, where each symbol that hits resets the spin count to 3. Multiplier symbols and activator symbols may land and interact with feature symbols, which appear as cards above the grid. Multiplier symbols land with values of 1x to 5x the bet.Activator Symbols & Special CardsRed, green or purple activator symbols may land, triggering the ability of matching coloured cards located above the grid. There are 7 different special cards, each with its own feature:The Payer - takes one of the multipliers from the reels and adds it to all multiplier symbols.The Booster - increases the value of one of the multiplier symbols.The Collector - collects all multiplier values from the reels and adds them to its activator.The Doubler - doubles all multiplier values on the reels.The Gunner - doubles the value of up to 4 symbols, 1 to 3 times each.The Mentalist - multiplies the lowest and the highest multiplier values together.The X-er - reveals a multiplier of x2 to x10 and multiplies up to 3 symbols with it.If a multiplier symbol is placed in every position on the reels, the feature ends and awards an additional 1,000x the bet. Otherwise, the round ends after 3 dead spins or the win cap is reached. Purr Power may provide a feature buy option in which the bonus round can be bought for a set cost.Purr Power slot - free spinsPure Power: Slot VerdictPurr Power is a game where not a lot happens in the base game since Max Win Gaming has decided to leave any sort of modifier or bonus feature out, aside from cascades. Therefore, the bulk of Purr Power is spent watching faux Moon Princess symbols fall into a faux Moon Princess world (minus princesses), occasionally creating wins and triggering tumbles. The scatter system, while perfectly adequate, is a bit of a bandwagon mechanic at the time of writing, lacking the individual finesse of Moon Princess, where wins cross horizontally and vertically into each other like a slot symbol crossword puzzle, dropping in order to hopefully clear the screen, helped by regular blasts of various princess linked feature powers. In Purr Power, it is a case of scatter, tumble, scatter, tumble, and so on.A definite, clear cut exists between base and bonus round then, and when free spins finally come around, Purr Power gets the chance to display some personality of its own. This comes in the form of character-laced cards that sit above the reels, waiting to pop their power on the board when matching coloured activator symbols land. It works pretty well. There's nothing unmissable from a hold 'n win perspective, but a win cap of 5,000x means impressive results might theoretically be possible. Multiplier symbols don't have the greatest starting values, though, so they'll likely need significant boosting from special cards to really throw up something shocking.Nowadays, players have access to a fair few anime slots. Play'n GO is going about filling any gaps with Moon Princess variants, as is Pragmatic Play with its range of Princess games. For something more fighty, Octoplay's Eternal Clash might be an option as well. Purr Power sits at best on the same level as those games, though arguably at a lower rung on the ladder. An anime-styled hold 'n win might be of interest, but a drab base game holds Purr Power back.

This is possible in either the base game or free spins.If buying the bonus is an option, players pay 75x the total stake to land at least 3 scatters symbols on the next spin. Once triggered, you can gamble them if you choose.Vikings Go Berzerk Reloaded: Slot VerdictVikings Go Berzerk Reloaded is a very different ball game compared to the original. Another major difference is Vikings Go Berzerk Reloaded's limit is way higher than it ever was in previous games, where it is possible to now win up to 25,000 times the stake.All these changes mean Reloaded is by far the most berzerk game in the 'Vikings Go' range to date. For gung-ho players, this will be music to their ears, though for others, ironically, it might be a little too berzerk for their tastes. To get the most out of Vikings Go Berzerk Reloaded, it seems you have to be willing to go the extra mile, where greater rewards may be found for sure, but which can mercilessly punish the slightest misstep.

When a bonus symbol hits, it is also locked in place and resets the Respins counter back to 3. As to prizes, bonus symbols are allocated values of 1x to 20x the stake, or they might display the Mini Jackpot (worth 30x the bet) or the Major Jackpot (worth 100x). If you manage to fill each of the 15 positions with bonus symbols, then the 2,500x Mega Jackpot is awarded.Serengeti Gold: Slot VerdictIf Just For The Win's 'Gold' games are designed for players who want to win big, then Serengeti Gold is easily the least appealing of the trio. As a comparison, Emerald Gold's 25,000x top prize helped overcome any aversion you might have for the leprechaun thing. However, Serengeti Gold has neither a major jackpot nor anything else to get worked up over. Its most positive aspect is the charming view of Tanzania and its cheerful soundtrack. If it takes more than bubbly aesthetics to make you want to play a game, then Serengeti Gold's got nothing else going on to back them up.Like a communal bag of Lays, the Hyperhold feature continues to do the rounds amongst Microgaming's partner studios, and it's pretty much the same thing each time. It's just your standard hold-and-win feature, without any of the sort of innovation studios like Relax Gaming or Nolimit City are injecting into their games. Instead, Serengeti Gold is happy just coasting along, riding the coattails of mediocrity, neither bringing major thrills nor rocking the boat in any way whatsoever.The problem of aiming for the middle ground is that while Serengeti Gold might not offend or shock anybody, it doesn't make a strong impression either. The game is an unnecessary step sideways for Just For The Win, who was forging ahead producing rather volatile, big win games. Ah well, they can't all be red hot raging gambling novelties that appeal to hardcore gamers, and players who like the idea of hunting Africa's big five from the safety of their desktop or mobile device might be sold on Serengeti Gold's concept. That's might be a bit generous, however, since there is very little about Serengeti Gold screaming 'you must play me'.

title: Epic Fish Adventure
structured_summary: Epic Fish Adventure offers a warm, Caribbean fishing theme where players embark on a virtual ocean charter to catch valuable fish symbols. The game features wilds that collect fish money values, multiple free spin modes with escalating bonuses, and a special Golden Fish symbol with up to 5,000x prizes. The reviewer finds it a pleasant and innovative take on fishing slots, with engaging mechanics but some complexity in reaching the top rewards. Visually, the slot is bright and inviting, enhanced by sunny, tropical graphics and smooth transitions, creating a relaxing seaside atmosphere.
review: Epic Fish Adventure: Slot OverviewReel up, players; we're about to get a taste of warm air on our faces, a salt tang in the air, and the spray of the sea as we virtually fire up the dinghy to head out on the ocean to attempt hauling in fish. Running this charter boat is Swedish software developer Quickspin in the online slot Epic Fish Adventure. A bit of a boast in the name, huh? But, with money symbol collecting available at all times and a special Golden Fish symbol that can hit values of 5,000x on its own, who knows, maybe it will be epic. Let's see.If fishing games are a way of taking a pretend sun-filled holiday, then Epic Fish Adventure provides sweet eye candy to fuel the fantasy. A 5-reel, 3-row gaming grid bubbles away in a warm blue ocean beneath palm tree-covered islands in a sparkling dream destination. Take a moment if you like to gaze at the screen, and let Epic Fish Adventure evaporate the stressors of work, bills, and obligations into oblivion to help pretend you're soaking up the sunlight in a romantic Caribbean paradise. Something like that.Epic Fish Adventure slot - base gameAlong Epic Fish Adventure's game grid, run 10 paylines, awarding regular symbol wins from the leftmost reel onwards. However, as a fishing game, line wins do play second fiddle to collecting cash money from fish symbols. Money collecting occurs in the base game, and the free spins round in this medium-high volatile slot, which is available in several RTP configurations, the highest being a 96% version. Players may wager 20 c to $/€100 per spin or pick any of the three bonus buys on offer.Turning to the pay symbols, what Quickspin classes as medium pays are a fish, a compass, a message in a bottle, a star, and a pearl in an oyster, worth 10 to 75 times the bet for 5 OAK. It is important to note that the fish symbol is also the money symbol, displaying cash values. The lows are 10 to A playing card ranks worth 2 to 7.5 times the stake for a winning combination of 5 matching symbols.Epic Fish Adventure: Slot FeaturesEpic Fish Adventure slot - free spinsEpic Fish Adventure's features include a wild symbol collecting fish money values component, which is available in the base game and in free spins. Free spins come in 3 forms, triggered by certain numbers of scatters or bought.Wilds and Fish Collection FeatureWild symbols substitute for all symbols except the scatter and land on all reels. An all wild symbol win pays up to 150x. When fish symbols are in view, each wild on the reels collects the cash values of all fish symbols. Possible fish symbol money values are 1x, 3x, 5x, 8x, 10x, 15x, and 25x.Golden Fish SymbolThe Golden Fish symbol only lands during the Golden Marlin bonus game. It increases its prize each time it lands and can be caught by the wild symbol like a regular fish symbol. The Golden Fish starting prize value is 50x and increases in a set order up to a maximum of 5,000x.Free SpinsLanding 3 scatters triggers the Sunrise Spins bonus, 4 scatters trigger Hold the Line, and 5 scatters trigger the Golden Marlin bonus. For each bonus round, 12 free spins are awarded, and wilds are collected when they land.Sunrise Spins - during this bonus, +1 extra free spin is awarded for every 4 wild symbols collected.Hold The Line - this bonus awards +2 extra free spins for every 4 wilds collected. Each wild on the reels triggers the Fortified Wilds feature, sticking the wilds on the reels in their positions for one extra spin, counting twice towards the wild collection meter.Golden Marlin - +3 extra spins are awarded for every 4 wild symbols collected. Each wild on the screen also triggers the Fortified Wilds feature. This is the feature where the Golden Fish may land.Feature BuyFrom the base game, players have access to three bonus buys - 40x the bet triggers the bonus with at least 3 scatter symbols, 95x the bet triggers the bonus with at least 4 scatter symbols, and 250x the bet buys a 5 scatter trigger of the Golden Marlin round.Epic Fish Adventure slot - feature buy menuEpic Fish Adventure: Slot VerdictFor the most part, Epic Fish Adventure does the Big Bass Bonanza collection of fish symbol money values thing quite well. In addition, Quickspin has fiddled around with some of the rules to give fishing fans something new to digest. Some of the graphical touches Quickspin has worked into Epic Fish Adventure are good, too. This includes the sun glare when transitioning to free spins, the plane ride to the bonus round destination, and the overall look, which is warm, sunny, and inviting. These are three key elements for attracting armchair anglers into yet another fishing slot when there are so many others on the market vying for their attention.On the mechanical side of things, Epic Fish Adventure attempts to mix things up as well. It succeeds, too, though it will be interesting to see how the innovations are received. It's not unusual for slots to deploy more powerful weaponry when more scatters trigger a bonus round, and Epic Fish Adventure is one of these. Its 5-scatter Golden Marlin round is by far the most sought-after part of the game. Additional free spin awards from collected wild symbols are greater, but more critically, that's where the Golden Fish symbol may make an appearance. It's an interesting system, but you need a few parts to come together at the same time to reach Epic Fish Adventure's peak epicness. It might have been heartening if there was a way to upgrade free spins rounds from lower levels to higher ones.So, epic? Debatable, but Epic Fish Adventure provides a picturesque spot for gamblers to get their money symbol collecting going, and there's a twist to the usual ways these games function for players to figure out whether it is actually epic or average.

title: Warrior Graveyard
structured_summary: Warrior Graveyard is a dark, somber slot themed around fallen warriors and the aftermath of battle. It features xNudge Tombstone Wilds, multipliers, two distinct free spin rounds, and high-volatility gameplay with feature buy options. The reviewer finds it a compelling follow-up to Barbarian Fury, rewarding patience with thrilling mechanics and big win potential. The game’s cold blue-grey visuals and unsettling soundtrack create a haunting, atmospheric experience.
review: Warrior Graveyard: Slot OverviewWhile developer Nolimit City has built up a stack of blinders in their back catalogue, few hit quite so hard as Barbarian Fury. The game was an instant hit with players due to its brilliant blending of features and gameplay in a highly atmospheric environment. The studio has built on the success of Barbarian Fury, pushing aspects while creating a spookier vibe for the follow-up Warrior Graveyard. As well as bigger potential, Warrior Graveyard incorporates a few new tricks along with some truly heroic feature buy options.Warrior Graveyard xNudge - base gameWhere Barbarian Fury was all about taking on enemies, Warrior Graveyard deals with the more sombre aftermath. The less-celebrated tales of those that weren't successful on the day, succumbing to the victor's axe and ending up in a box. Some warrior cultures claim nothing is more glorious than dying on the battlefield, yet most people nowadays would question the belief. As such, it can take a bit more effort to fall for the cold blue-grey palette of Warrior Graveyard's scene than Barbarian Fury. Chains, rails, and graves surround a mist heavy 6-reel, 25-payline grid, while a rather unsettling soundtrack haunts the background.Players take on Warrior Graveyard by selecting bets from 25 p/c to $/€100 per spin, across any device. Nolimit City is one developer which helpfully provides all the info players need upfront to determine whether a slot is right for them. One way is by displaying volatility on the home screen; in this case, it's high. The other key stat is the default RTP which is perfectly respectable on 96.16%. Some operators might drop that to 94.14% though, so make sure to check you're playing the best version before braving the boneyard.Warrior Graveyard provides 10 pay symbols to work with, 5 low pay single position icons, and 5 full reel premiums. On the low side, we find hammers, axes, helms, shields and swords worth up to 3x the bet for six. Next, are five grim corpses buried in their battle gear in black, blue, green, brown, and red tones worth 3.3x to 6x the bet for six of a kind.Warrior Graveyard: Slot Features﻿Warrior Graveyard offers similar features to those seen in Barbarian Fury but with several key upgrades. First up is xNudge Tombstone Wilds which are 3 position high symbols, appearing on reels 2 to 5. When they land partially in view, they are nudged to cover the whole reel. Each nudge increases a multiplier they carry by +1. More than one wild can land meaning a multiplier up to x12 is possible for wins as high as 1,800x on a single spin.Warrior Graveyard takes the xNudge concept one step further in the Warrior Attack feature. This one occurs when three of the same premium symbols land either fully or partially in view. If partial, like the Tombstone Wilds, they are nudged into view increasing their win multiplier by +1 for each nudge. When all are completely in view, they shift to the leftmost reels for a win evaluation. xNudge Tombstone Wilds can also be present at the same time.Like previous Nolimit slots, Warrior Graveyard packs two different free spin bonus games, one more hair raising than the other. The lesser one is Graveyard Spins, triggered when 3, 4, or 5 scatters land awarding 8, 10, or 12 free spins. Graveyard Spins use a win multiplier starting at x1 and increasing by +1 for every Tombstone Wild nudge. The multiplier does not reset between spins.The second bonus is the ominously titled Death Spins, triggered when 6 scatters land. Here you get 14 free spins with a win multiplier starting at x1, increasing when Tombstone Wilds nudge as before. The difference now is Tombstone Wilds are locked in position for the duration of the round. Neither bonus game can be retriggered, though any scatter that lands adds +1 free spin.Both free spins games are tantalising proposals, so Nolimit City has included a bonus buy option where these things are available. Shelling out 72x the bet gets you 3-5 scatters on the next spin awarding Graveyard Spins, or Death Spins can be had for a substantial outlay of 666x the stake.Warrior Graveyard: Slot VerdictBarbarian Fury's mix of attitude, theme treatment and gameplay was like a war hammer to the face, in a good way. If anything, Warrior Graveyard is even better, but it might take a little longer to warm to than the first. Testing started with a serious bout of very little going on, and the theme, especially the music, was downright disturbing. It was a different story once the game warmed up and found its rhythm, unleashing all sorts of thrills. The first eyebrow raising moment came during the Warrior Attack feature. The way premium symbols are rammed against the leftmost reel is one of those great ideas that seems obvious in hindsight.From there things get even more intense. xNudges proved to be just as effective as before, plus the two bonus games provide all sort of ups and downs. They might take time to trigger naturally, so if you're in the mood for a punt, there's always the feature buy, if available in your jurisdiction that is. The massive all-in option of Death Spins might not be living quite as dangerously as Deadwood's Shoot Out Free Spins' infamous 750x price tag. Yet, there's no denying it takes a lot of nerve to activate, being just as controversial for many. One compensator perhaps is wins of up to 9,797 times the bet are now possible, more than the first slot, though it kind of has to be in follow-ups.As mentioned, Warrior Graveyard might not instantly grab you like Barbarian Fury's brutal assault right out of the gate. Due to a theme so intimately concerned with death (and glory), it might take a few extra spins for Warrior Graveyard's charm to become apparent. Once it's got its hooks in though, Warrior Graveyard provides highly entertaining gaming, and picking up the challenge is every bit the shield wall its predecessor was. Both are moody, volatile machines that are tough to vanquish but hugely satisfying when successful.

title: Fat Rabbit
structured_summary: Fat Rabbit is a farm-themed slot featuring a growing wild rabbit as its main character. The game includes features like the Harvest Feature and expanding wilds during free spins that increase in size and award extra spins. The reviewer praises its friendly vibe and entertaining gameplay, despite a moderate max win of 10,000x the bet. Visually, it boasts chunky, sprite-style graphics with a cheerful soundtrack of birds chirping and gentle jangling.
review: Fat Rabbit: Slot OverviewIf you're after a bit of clean country air to go with your online slot gaming, it doesn't get much fresher than it does in Fat Rabbit from developer Push Gaming. Not just an amusing name, Fat Rabbit describes the game's main character and his physical transformation during the bonus round. There, weight concerns go out the window as a wild rabbit symbol takes over the screen, literally in some cases, converting plenty of thrills and wins in the process. For a light-hearted examination of life on the farm, let's take a look at Fat Rabbit.Fat Rabbit's corn fed gaming takes place on a 5x5 sized grid, providing players with 50 fixed paylines to land winning combinations across. Push Gaming has done a great job of giving Fat Rabbit several video game touches, such as symbol representation, particularly the characters, plus the way winning totals appear on the screen and count up. The rest of the view is of a pleasing quality as well, while birds chirp and a gently jangling soundtrack reinforces the amiability. Maybe it's the game's sunny weather, but Fat Rabbit has an outrageous feel-good factor before even hitting the spin button to see what it can do.Also before hitting spin is the matter of bet selection where Fat Rabbit allows stakes from 25 p/c to $/€100 to be set. Any device is suitable for playing Fat Rabbit, too, whether it be desktop, tablet or mobile phone. Being a Push Gaming release, two things you can rely on behind the scenes are a solid RTP, in this case, 96.45%, and a highly volatile math model. Decent wins are possible, too, though they aren't anywhere near as impressive as what Push Gaming slots are capable of since. The good part is that chasing the game's potential is as fun in Fat Rabbit as it is just about anywhere.Throughout the game, the symbols you'll bump into include eight normal pays and a couple of wilds. Pay symbols are divided into lower-paying card suits, so clubs, diamonds, hearts, and spades, that look like whittled wood. These are followed by higher value haystacks, buckets of water, a vicious looking dog, and a stern farmer. Landing a full line of five premium symbols will get you a payout worth 6 to 20 times your stake. The rabbit symbol is worth the same as the farmer. It is also one of the wilds, so it substitutes for all other paying symbols while being the key to many of the features.Fat Rabbit: Slot FeaturesFat Rabbit comes with three features - one is the Harvest Feature, another is free spins, where the Expanding Wild Rabbit extra comes into play. The Harvest feature triggers randomly while the reels are spinning. When activated, a tractor drives from top to bottom over the game grid, leaving Wild Carrot Symbols in random positions on the board. Wins are calculated with the wilds in place once the reels stop spinning.If carrot symbols are in view at the same time as a rabbit symbol, then free spins are triggered. Players start with 5 free spins, which can be extended at certain points. Free spins start with a 1x1 sized rabbit wild who remains on the reels but jumps to a new position in between free spins.That's not all he does, though. Now, when carrot symbols land, the rabbit bounders over and eats them. After he has consumed a specific number, he grows in size, and each time he levels up, additional free spins are awarded as well, like so:Level 1 - 1x1 size, 4 carrots to collect.Level 2 - grows to 2x2 size and awards +3 free spins, 5 carrots to collect.Level 3 - grows to 3x3 size and awards +2 free spins, 5 carrots to collect.Level 4 - grows to 4x4 size and awards +2 free spins, 3 carrots to collect.Level 5 - grows to 5x5 size and awards +1 free spin.Fat Rabbit: Slot VerdictFat Rabbit is one of those games that is very easy to fall for. Its friendly vibe draws you in, with chunky graphics that nod towards earlier sprite-based video games. The kind that didn't have as many pixels to work with so had to make every single one count to paint relatable characters. There are several of those in Fat Rabbit, none more so than the big white bunny himself.Unlike the current trend for slimming down and pumping iron to get a Baywatch body, you'll want to feed this Rabbit up Hansel and Gretel style. Not to eat him, this time, but to get him linking as many symbols as possible during free spins in his larger forms. And yes, it is possible to grow the Rabbit symbol to full size before the bonus game is over. Do so, and you collect 1,000 times the bet payouts on every single remaining free spin - not easy to accomplish but a treat to witness. These capabilities give Fat Rabbit a theoretical max win of 10,000x the bet, though the highest payout observed during simulated spins was 3,844 times the stake.That might not sound like a whole lot of winnings now, compared to what Push Gaming has done since in games like Dinopolis or Razor Shark. However, the relatively low potential doesn't lessen the thrill of getting an expanding wild rabbit on a carrot binge during free spins, leaping from one position to another adjoining win lines. He's not going to feast on carrots every time free spins trigger. In fact, it can seem he denies himself calories of any type at times. Get him on a great carrot binge, though, and you can see why Fat Rabbit remains one of Push Gaming's lasting favourites.Don't MissIf this type of gameplay is your cup of tea, be sure to check out the third entry in the Fat series. Titled Fat Drac, the game utilises a cartoon style vampire theme, offering massive potential of up to 50,000 times your stake!

title: Hot Dog Heist
structured_summary: Hot Dog Heist is an urban-themed slot where dogs chase hot dogs across seven diverse bonus rounds. The game features a 5x4 reel layout with 40 paylines, multiple wilds, and a feature wheel offering varied free spin modes. The reviewer finds it moderately entertaining but lacks wow factor, with a max win of 2,500x feeling underwhelming. The aesthetics depict a pleasant suburban BBQ setting, complementing the casual, laid-back audio atmosphere.
review: Hot Dog Heist: Slot OverviewHot Dog Heist from Play'n GO closely mirrors the structure of Play'n GO's 2015 release, Wild North, a game that gained attention for its diverse bonus features and appealing design. In Hot Dog Heist, the setting shifts from the wild outdoors to an urban environment where a cast of dogs pursues hot dogs across 7 bonus rounds, maintaining the variety that defined its predecessor.The Dog House with sausages was one early thought triggered when viewing Hot Dog Heist. Like its Prag-built neighbour, Hot Dog Heist's action takes place in a well-tended suburban location, where there's a BBQ burning to feed the crew, a picket fence to keep out ruffians, and a swimming pool complete with deck chairs and ice box. It really is a most pleasant environment to while away a lazy summer afternoon, maybe mow the lawn or trim the hedges, or just laze about before Monday morning rolls around and the cruel reality of exchanging your time for money in a dead-end job that's lost all meaning comes crashing in to destroy the bourgeois fantasy.Hot Dog Heist slot - base gameThe hot dog loving dogs and other symbols appear on a 5-reel matrix, with 4 symbol positions per reel and 40 paylines for win evaluations.
