What kills any hint of a boner, however, is the 1 in 1 billion max exposure probability, which is much worse than the other LG slots. Legion Gold Victory does build on previous Legion Gold slots, but if this was what the Roman army was fielding back in the day, there is no way it would have conquered anywhere near as much of the ancient world as it did.

title: Banana Odyssey
structured_summary: Banana Odyssey is a space-themed slot featuring two astronaut chimps on a journey to a banana-filled planet. It offers expanding wild re-spins and sticky wild free spins across a 5-reel, 10-payline setup with 96.31% RTP. Despite impressive visuals and sound, the reviewer criticizes its low payout potential and max win of only 400x stake. The game boasts slick graphics and a funky soundtrack, delivering a visually appealing cosmic experience.
review: Banana Odyssey (Microgaming): OverviewOfficially announced and showcased during the all-important London iGaming conference earlier this year, Banana Odyssey was hyped as one of Microgaming's upcoming flagship titles. Overall, the Microgaming stand was as depressing as ever, and with big money spent on trying to build hype for its line of ridiculously weak games, it became painfully clear that the company had learned nothing from its past mistakes.Reviewing slots from Microgaming and its partnering studios is usually as tedious as it is playing them, but booting up Banana Odyssey actually proved to be an awe-inspiring moment. As it turns out, this is one of the best looking online slots we've seen this year, and it's got an excellent soundtrack and rhythm supporting the superb design. Being a slot machine, however, there's another dimension to take into consideration other than what you see on the surface. After all, it's your money on the line.Produced by Slingshot Studios and powered by the Microgaming Quickfire platform, Banana Odyssey is slot that centres around two astronaut chimps, Buck and Chip, that have been sent on an intergalactic journey to Banana planet where the sweet yellow fruit grows in abundance. As you're likely already aware of, primates in space is not all fiction. In 1948, Albert, a rhesus macaque, became the first primate astronaut when, carried by a V2 rocket, he rode to over 63 km above earth's surface. Unfortunately, Albert never made it back alive as he died of suffocation. Since then, many more primates have been sent into space, the last one as late as 2013, when Iran launched two Rhesus macaques into space and safely returned them.The setup of the slot is quite standard with its 5-reel, 10-payline reel set and 96.31% RTP. It comes with an expanding wild re-spin feature that can turn the whole reel set wild in the main game, and a free spins game with sticky wild reels. You can join the two astro-chimps on their odyssey on all devices, including iOS and Android, from 10 cents to 400€ per spin.Visually, Banana Odyssey is undoubtedly a pretty experience through which Slingshot Studios designers get to show off their impressive skills. Floating through space and with an excellent funky soundtrack playing, symbols on the reels include the usual lower value A, K, Q and J card suits. You'll also see more lucrative zap guns, Astro Nuts as well as the two Astro-chimps, Buck and Chip. The latter two are the most rewarding, giving you 10 times your stake for a combination of 5. Winning combinations can be formed from both directions, left to right and right to left, which essentially doubles your chances.Banana Odyssey (Microgaming): FeaturesFree spins feature in actionThe Banana planet represents the wild symbol, which only appears on the three middle reels. When it hits, the Expanding Wilds feature is activated, leading the wild to expand to fully cover the reel. Moreover, while held in place, a re-spin is then played. If yet another wild hits, the same cycle repeats. At most, you can get three fully stacked wild reels as a result of the Expanding Wilds feature in the main game.You get more of the same in the Free Spins feature which comes into play when you land three scatter symbols on reels 2, 3 and 4. With 10 free spins awarded, any wild symbol that appears in view will expand here as well. Not only that, it will also remain locked in place throughout the feature round. Unfortunately, it's not possible to retrigger the free spins game.Banana Odyssey (Microgaming): VerdictBanana Odyssey is an exceptional looking slot, but slick graphics cannot cover up shockingly low payouts. The popularity of simple retro slots like Book of Ra is making it perfectly clear that the visual appearance of a slot machine is of secondary importance. If we want to play video games, we'll play video games. It's the thrill of winning big that motivates most gamblers.In Banana Odyssey, even a 10x win is celebrated as a "big win", which says it all really. Even more disturbing is that the game has a max win of around 400 times your stake. It makes one question if Microgaming and its partners have joined Buck and Chip to live on Banana planet. Banana Odyssey could have been a great slot if the mathematical designers knew what they were doing, but as it stands, this game is all hype and no bite.

title: Drop 'Em
structured_summary: Drop 'Em is a charming online slot featuring Canny the Can and Mona the Mouse, continuing Hacksaw Gaming's 'Em range with a unique gameplay twist. The game offers a medium-high volatility model with 7,776 ways to win, featuring a Drop mechanic that removes symbols and multiple free spin bonuses with symbol pool upgrades. The reviewer praises its engaging risk-reward balance and explosive potential, especially through the feature buy options. Visually, it presents a stylized, affable charm consistent with Hacksaw Gaming’s signature cute and quirky aesthetic.
review: Drop 'Em: Slot OverviewIn the words of Canny the Can, 'We are back', and by we, Canny's not only referring to himself but his wee pal Mona the Mouse. The occasion is Drop 'Em, an online slot from developer Hacksaw Gaming and a continuation of the studio's 'Em range. So far, this has included games like Stick 'Em, Stack 'Em, and now Drop 'Em. In fact, here's a piece of gambling history: Stick 'Em was Hacksaw Gaming's very first online slot, a fairly unassuming release that would pave the way for some of the most devastating gambling machines available on the market. Why not come see if Drop 'Em will be one of those Hacksaw Gaming face-melters or something more mellow?Despite wedging itself into the 'Em range of slots, Drop 'Em actually looks closer in appearance to another Canny the Cat and Mona the Mouse slot titled Canny the Can and the Book of Time. As you might have guessed, that one was the studio's take on the venerable 'Book of' style of gaming, though presented in a highly stylized way with a number of extra bells and whistles attached. Drop 'Em, by contrast, has nothing to do with books. It's actually got some rather unique gameplay to offer, covered in more detail below. And so, Canny's here, as is his rodent pal, meaning Drop 'Em has the sort of affable charm Hacksaw Gaming is good at injecting into their cutie pie games.Drop 'Em slot - base gameAs usual, it's not so cutie pie when examining Drop 'Em's inner workings, where we find a medium-high volatile math model, producing a default RTP of 96.21%. Lower models may be available, and the return does change when buying features, as discussed below. When picking a base bet, the options are 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin, and when hitting the play button, a 5-reel, 6-row gaming area springs to life, providing 7,776 ways to win.That's a lot of ways for a Hacksaw Gaming slot, which tend to stick to a modest number of paylines. Here, as long as matching symbols land on at least 3 adjacent reels from the left-hand side, you've got a winner. Pay symbols have a wooden block appearance, and start with 10-A card royals, then are followed by a leaf, a bird, a skull, a snake head, and a hand holding a lightning bolt. Quite the random selection of pictures. As for payouts, landing a 5 OAK royal win awards 0.5 times the bet, while 5 matching picture symbols pay 1.5 to 5 times the bet. Wilds appear on all reels to replace any of the regular paying symbols. If a five-wild winning way manages to hit, the payout value for this is 20 times the stake.Drop 'Em: Slot FeaturesDrop 'Em slot - free spinsTwo more symbols that play important roles in Drop 'Em are the Drop symbol triggering a removal modifier, and the FS symbol, needed to trigger free spins.Drop SymbolWhen at least 1 Drop symbol is in view, the Drop mechanic will trigger after any wins on the initial grid have been awarded. Each Drop symbol falls down and off the grid, removing all symbols below it. Any symbols above the Drop symbol fall to the bottom of the reel. The empty spaces on each reel are filled with the same randomly selected symbol for a chance to win. In the base game, this will be any pay symbol or the wild.Drop Spins BonusLanding 3 FS symbols in the base game awards 10 free spins. The bonus starts with all pay symbols and the wild symbol in a pool of possible symbols, which may be chosen by the Drop mechanic. When an FS symbol hits, it may reveal +1, +2, or +3 extra free spins and/or an Upgrade. When an Upgrade is revealed, it removes 1 to 10 paying symbols from the choice pool. Wilds can never be removed.High Drop Spins BonusLanding 4 FS symbols in the base game awards this feature with 10 free spins. This round starts with only high-pay symbols and the wild in the choice pool. As before, landing an FS symbol reveals +1, +2, or +3 free spins and/or an Upgrade which removes 1 to 5 symbols from the choice pool. As before, wilds can never be removed from the pool.Wild Drop Spins BonusGetting 5 FS symbols in the base game triggers the Wild Drop Spins bonus with 10 free spins. For this one, only the wild symbol may be used by the Drop mechanic. Landing an FS symbol awards +1, +2, or +3 free spins.Buy BonusOpening up the feature buy menu gives players the opportunity to select these features:BonusHunt FeatureSpins - 3x the bet where each spin is 5 times more likely to trigger a bonus game. Very highly volatile, with a default RTP of 96.32%.Big Drop FeatureSpins - 40x the bet where each spin guarantees at least 3 Drop symbols land. Very highly volatile, with a default RTP of 96.16%.Mega Drop FeatureSpins - 150x the bet where each spin guarantees 5 Drop symbols land. Highly volatile with a default RTP of 96.34%.Drop Spins - 10 free spins for 100x the bet with all possible symbols in the choice pool. Highly volatile with a default RTP of 96.23%.High Drop Spins - 10 free spins for 200x the bet with high pays and wilds as replacing symbols. Very highly volatile, with a default RTP of 96.29%.Drop 'Em slot - feature buy optionsDrop 'Em: Slot VerdictNice to see Canny the Can back, as he usually shows up in an entertaining show put on by the team over at Hacksaw Gaming. Drop 'Em is no exception, and it possesses all the traits a Hacksaw Gaming fan might expect - charm, clever features, edge-of-your-seat gaming, brutality, and potential reward. Players who've liked Canny's past performances or Hacksaw Gaming's unique brand of risk and reward would do well to check out the new Drop mechanic to see what it's capable of.Whilst fairly simple, the Drop mechanic has a few things going for it that mean it is able to explode in the right circumstances. One of these things is the number of ways to win. This makes a huge difference and can catapult what might have been a so-so Drop mechanic win had it used paylines into something eye-bulging with all those ways on hand. Or not, the pendulum can easily swing the other way. While the Drop mechanic has its moments in free spins, it was at its most explosive when experimenting with Mega Drop FeatureSpins from the bonus buy. Obviously, at 150x the bet for a single spin, they aren't cheap, and boy, the results swung wildly from meh to astonishing and everything in between. Not to be treated lightly, in other words, but the fact you know Drop symbols will land on every single reel, thereby guaranteeing a win, made them a temptation. What might also have been tempting for some is the chance to buy their way to the Wild Drop Spins bonus. Having only wild symbols in the choice pool is quite a prospect and not likely to be triggered super often organically.Never mind, it's nice to have goals in life, and Drop 'Em caps it all off with a max win of 10,000x the bet. After seeing Drop 'Em do its thing, that figure certainly feels achievable for the lucky punter. Not many players are going to crack the max win, of course, but Drop 'Em delivers explosive action via a relatively simple yet potentially dramatic feature.

title: Samurai Code
structured_summary: Samurai Code is a Japanese samurai-themed slot by Pragmatic Play and Reel Kingdom, blending traditional warrior motifs with familiar Big Bass series mechanics. The game features a 5-reel, 4-row grid with 12 paylines, free spins triggered by scatters, wilds that collect Money symbol values, and multipliers on retriggers. The reviewer finds the game repetitive, largely reusing Big Bass Blizzard’s features with a moderate 4,000x max win, appealing mainly to fans of the series. Visually, the slot offers decent but unremarkable graphics and audio, lacking the artistry of fine Japanese prints.
review: Samurai Code: Slot OverviewSamurai Code is an online slot created by Pragmatic Play and compadre Reel Kingdom that involves a wild symbol collecting fish Money symbols in a free spins round where wilds are also collected to grant multipliers in retriggered batches of spins. Sound familiar? Gotcha, cos the game in question is not a continuation of the two studios' monstrously reproductive Big Bass series. However, you know what? It kind of is a continuation, for Samurai Code, despite the obvious theme change is a clone of Bigger Bass Blizzard with an Asian twist, though it still involves collecting fish.Bigger Bass Blizzard (and the slot it forked from Bigger Bass Bonanza) built on the original Big Bass Bonanza slot in a number of ways. One was the introduction of a larger gaming area, which grew by an extra reel, and 2, yes 2, extra paylines. The same setup has returned for Samurai Code, which plays out on a 5-reel, 4-row grid where the 12 paylines make bet levels a little awkward. Naturally, players' eyes get to rest on different optics since Samurai Code is all about Japanese noble warriors instead of woolly-capped, sunglassed-up, puffer jacket-wearing anglers. The visuals are okay; it's Reel Kingdom so we probably shouldn't be expecting the slot equivalent of a fine Japanese woodblock print.Samurai Code slot - base gameWe can expect a wide range of betting options, though, from a low of 12 c per spin up to a maximum of $/€240. Or you can click the ante bet, which provides a higher chance of winning the feature for an extra 50% on the stake. The RTP for using the ante bet or not is the same, at the default level of 96.08%, while the volatility is high.Fishing references are absent from the paytable, which lists 10-A card ranks as the low pays, then dragonflies, swords, a coffer of money, and a lady character as the highs. Lines of 5 matching royals pay 10 times the bet; lines of 5 matching highs are worth 50 to 200 times the bet. The Fish symbols also land on the reels, and if 5 of them create a winning line, they award the money values they display. Wilds appear only in free spins where one thing they can do is substitute for all symbols except the scatter.Samurai Code: Slot FeaturesSamurai Code slot - free spinsThere is something eerily familiar about Samurai Code's features since they've been ripped right out of the Big Bass range's playbook. Namely, free spins where wild symbols collect Money symbol values, which in turn get collected themselves, leading to Money symbol multipliers.Money SymbolThe fish are the Money symbol. On each spin, the Money symbols show a random value of 2x to 4,000 times the bet. The cash values on fish Money symbols can be won during free spins.Free SpinsHitting 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols anywhere on the reels awards 10, 15, or 20 free spins, respectively. When 2 scatter symbols only are in view in the base game, there is a chance a sword appears and brings the third scatter onto the screen. During free spins, each wild symbol collects the values of Money symbols on the reels. All wild symbols that hit are also collected. Every fourth collected wild symbol retriggers the feature, awarding +10 free spins and a multiplier for Money symbol collection. The multiplier is x2 for the first retrigger, x3 for the second retrigger, and x10 for the third retrigger.At random, when there are only 1 or 2 wilds on the screen, at the end of a free spin, Money symbols may appear in random positions. In addition, randomly, 1 or 2 swords may appear at the end of a spin and pull the reels upwards to reveal wild and Money symbols.Buy Free SpinsThe free spins round can be bought for 100x the current total bet. When buying the round, 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols randomly land on the triggering spin, and the RTP is 96.07%.Samurai Code slot - free spinsSamurai Code: Slot VerdictEerily similar or just getting boring at this point? What's funny about Samurai Code is that Bigger Bass Blizzard was a close, though not totally exact, copy of Bigger Bass Bonanza already, with minor changes and a lower RTP. This thing is unstoppable. The Big Bass range as it stands now brought back memories of the scene in the TV show Chernobyl, where the scientists are conducting a test which got out of control, and, well, we all know how that turned out.Fortunately, the Big Bass phenomenon isn't as dangerous, but it is getting a little tedious. There is nothing wrong with what each individual slot can do; it's just the endless twists, turns, and innovations are hard to keep up with, not to mention somewhat repetitive. No issues when the innovations led somewhere interesting, like Big Bass Amazon Xtreme, all good. Questionable reskins make it harder to stifle a yawn. Putting an end to the negativity for a moment, if you do like the cut of Samurai Code's jib, then its 4,000x the bet win cap is a fairly mid/standard figure to aim for in a BB-related slot.Prag, Reel Kingdom and Big Bass Bonanza, it's like an addiction by this point, but if it's working out for the two studios, then great for them. No doubt there are a bunch of gamblers happy with the continuation of the series/set of features, while others are surely getting sick of the endless repetition. Oh well, at least Samurai Code is a copy of Bigger Bass Blizzard and not the dire Star Pirates Code.

title: Super Cash Drop
structured_summary: Super Cash Drop is a flashy wealth-themed slot combining money symbols with a game show vibe. It features a flexible win system, stacked multipliers, locked wild respins, and a challenging free spins bonus. The reviewer finds it thrilling but highly volatile with a slow bonus trigger and a lucrative capped max win. The game boasts neon pink and gold visuals, flashing lights, and a vibrant, over-the-top aesthetic.
review: Super Cash Drop: Slot OverviewWealth is an interesting one. Few people would object to having more, but many choose to keep it under wraps by not flashing it around. Think of Mark Zuckerberg's wardrobe of grey t-shirts and blue jeans, or IKEA founder Ingvar Kamprad's 1993 Volvo. Some like to hide in plain sight with their riches; others like to flaunt it. Those in the latter camp would do well to take a look at Super Cash Drop by independent developer Bang Bang Games. Powered by Yggdrasil Gaming, Super Cash Drop is one of those bare naked money-centric slots that unashamedly basis everything around riches and getting your hands on some.These wealth themed games have appeared, pretty much, since the dawn of slots. Bang Bang has captured the look by making Super Cash Drop part money grab, part game show. The action occurs over a 5-reel slot, oozing stacks of banknotes, coins, and general symbols of accumulation. Flashing lights, neon pink, and gold trim make up the background, so if you adore the feel of an overstuffed wallet in your back pocket, it's likely you'll be drawn to Super Cash Drop, too.Statistically, Super Cash Drop produces a set of respectable numbers, starting with an RTP of 96.6% and a hit rate of 32%. It'll favour dedicated gamblers up for some challenging, highly volatile gameplay, with big potential on top. Available to play on any device, stakes from 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin may be set.Super Cash Drop uses what they call a 'Flexi-line' system that pays when three or more symbols are adjacent to each other. It's not exactly a pay all-ways system as adjacent symbols must be in the same row, or in one above, or one below. This provides 178 ways to win when the grid is in its default 5x4 size and up to 502 win ways when maxed out. Most symbols are money related, with the exception of the low pay card suits – diamonds, clubs, hearts, and spades. For the mid to high pays, we get silver coins, piggy banks, cash bulging wallets, gold bars, and dollar signs. These symbols are worth 1 to 4 times the bet for wins of five of a kind. Green or gold wild symbols appear on any reel, substituting any pay symbol to complete a win. They are also worth 4x the bet for five of a kind and have a couple of win enhancing abilities covered next.Super Cash Drop: Slot FeaturesSuper Cash Drop - free spinsSuper Cash Drop blends random base game modifiers like Super Reel Expand, Super Stretch Wilds, and Locked Wild Respins, with triggered rounds of Super Free Spins. Randomly, at any moment, the grid may alter its size from the standard 5x4 level. You could get anything from 5x5, 5x6, 5x7, or 5x8, increasing win ways in the process to 259, 340, 421, or 502.A lot rides on wild symbols in Super Cash Drop. One reason is that they are stacked on the reels. When one or more wilds land, all symbols on the reel are replaced by a wild as part of the Super Stretch Wild feature. In addition, the number of wilds which initially hit produces a multiplier of equal value. So 2 initial wilds, for example, would create a wild stacked reel bearing a x2 multiplier. If more than one reel of multipliers is used in a win, their values are added before being applied.As well as green coloured Super Stretch Wilds, there are golden Locked Super Stretch Wilds. These act in the same way as previously mentioned, meaning they cover all positions on a reel while creating multipliers. However, as the name implies, Locked Super Stretch Wilds also lock to the grid for one respin while retaining their multiplier. If another Locked Wild lands, another respin triggers, repeating the process until no new locked wilds land or all five reels are filled.To trigger Super Free Spins, you'll need 3 bonus vault door symbols on reels 1, 3, and 5. Once in, 10 free spins are awarded where Super Stretch Wilds always lock for a respin. Also, low pay symbols are removed from the reels, plus there is a higher chance of landing wild symbols. The game will award a further 10 free spins if three bonus scatters land during the feature.Super Cash Drop: Slot VerdictWealth themed slots are common, but Bang Bang has worked it by incorporating a set of useful features that create a satisfying level of thrills and dollars. Features regularly drop, triggering respins, locking wilds are quite common, as are their multipliers. Super Cash Drop is highly volatile, though, and it's easy to be dazzled by the bright lights while not noticing your balance being punished in the process.One of the issues is the length of time it takes to trigger the bonus game. Like the last Bang Bang game we reviewed, Ancient Eclipse, Super Free Spins are a mission to activate. In their defence, when they do go off they can be rather lucrative. With so many 'Super' endowed features on board, it's good to know they can produce impressive wins. The game has a win capped, so it doesn't go totally mental, at 20,000 times the bet. It would be interesting to know just how high Super Cash Drop could go because the cap was struck 44 times within the space of one billion simulated spins, which is relatively numerous in the grand scheme of things.Since slots are so intimately tied to making money, these cash themed slots will never completely fade out of fashion. Bang Bang has made one of the more playable ones we've seen of late, which manages to be as gaudy as you like but might still appeal to players who prefer to keep their income a closely guarded secret. Gear up for a possible grind if you take Super Cash Drop on, as it can be tough to plunder, yet there are tangible rewards if you manage to crack its vault.

title: Fruit Duel
structured_summary: Fruit Duel is a casual fruit-themed slot set on a sunny farm with a 3x3 grid. It features DuelReels with full reel wild multipliers, free spins, and a bonus buy option. The reviewer finds it a friendly, less volatile game offering moderate wins up to 3,333x the bet. review: Fruit Duel: Slot OverviewSince its early days' software developer Hacksaw Gaming has had a preoccupation with making games with food and all things edible, including plenty of fresh produce. From the comfort food style of Om Nom to the health-conscious selection of snacks in King Carrot. For Fruit Duel (initially titled Fruityplier), the studio has gone full-blown fruit, and they've chosen to do so in a 3x3 modelled game with a simpler range of features and a more modest max win than we are used to seeing from the team. Fruit Duel caters to a different segment of the market compared to the studio's menacingly elaborate releases, so to find out if you happen to be in the game's scope or not, please read on.Fruit Duel opens on a sunshiny day at a farm, which could well be the same location used in Hop'n'Pop from a slightly different angle. This time, players view the action on a 3-reel, 3-row game panel, peeking out from between thick, green foliage. Red barns sit blurred in the background, while a relaxed soundtrack brings on a hanging-at-the-beach-in-the-Caribbean sensation. There's not a heck of a lot going on. Fruit Duel paints a fruity picture of rural living on a pleasant summer's day.Fruit Duel slot - base gamePlayable on tablets, mobiles, and desktop devices, Fruit Duel takes bets of 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin and offers two bonus modes for applicable players. These include blueberries, lemons, grapes, oranges, apples, bananas, cherries, and strawberries, paying 0.1 to 5 times the stake for a three-symbol hit. Finishing off this section is the wild symbol, landing on any reel to replace all fruit symbols. Wilds pay the same as strawberries if making wins of themselves.Fruit Duel: Slot FeaturesFruit Duel slot - free spinsFruit Duel touts a feature called DuelReels, which is triggered when the VS symbol lands on any of the reels. When the VS symbol activates, becoming a full reel wild. In addition, when landing 2 fruit symbols with multipliers on the reel they will duel. The winner adds its multiplier value to the full reel wild similar to what you may have seen in games such as Gladiator Legends. One thing to note is the reel only expands if it will be used in a win when it expands - 'book of' style. If more than one wild reel is used in a win, the multiplier values are added before being applied. Possible multiplier values are x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x15, x20, x25, x50, x75, or x100.Free SpinsLanding 3 free spins symbols in view awards 10 free spins. During this feature, there is an increased chance of landing VS symbols compared to the base game, and players are more likely to get higher multipliers from the duel.Buy BonusOpen up the Bonus Buy menu to peruse two different choices. One is FeatureSpins which cost 10x the bet where each spin is guaranteed to land at least 1 VS symbol (96.35% RTP). The other choice is free spins for 80x the bet (96.36% RTP).Fruit Duel slot - bonus buy optionsFruit Duel: Slot VerdictIf you happen to misread the DuelReels feature name at first, you might be expecting some sort of double grid action to arise. Instead, what Fruit Duel has is simpler and boils down to full reel wild multipliers when triggered by the VS symbol (and a win can be formed). These aren't new, having appeared in past Hacksaw games such as Gladiator Legends and Warrior Ways. The difference now is fruits duke it out to see which one gets to use its multiplier instead of martial artists or helmed warriors. You might not think the fighting angle suits fruit, but it gave Hacksaw the chance to apply some splattering juice effects when the losing fruit is vanquished. Not quite as dramatic as beheadings and blood spatters, though.But hey, surely that's the point. To create a carefree fruit slot using DuelReels that comes across as approachably friendly rather than a berserk maniac. Fruit Duel's math model would tend to suggest that, too, being less volatile than Hacksaw slots often are while reeling back the max win. In Fruit Duel, when the duelling, splatting, and winning reach their pinnacle, players can win up to 3,333x the bet. Not majorly exciting, yet not terrible for a 3-reel fruit slot. The odd number of paylines and the multipliers, which can technically be quite large, can help, especially when two or more DuelReels are working in tandem.With Fruit Duel, if you're not super keen on basic fruit slots, then the rest of what's on offer probably won't make up the shortfall. The DuelReel feature was arguably more satisfying in the previous DuelReel slots since they possessed stronger atmospheres, creating more immersive experiences than kicking around a farm squishing fruit. On the other hand, players sifting through game line-ups for a basic fruit slot with some expanding wild multiplier action on board should find a level of satiation from what they find in Fruit Duel.

title: Saint Nicked
structured_summary:

review: Saint Nicked: Slot OverviewEver had a job where you just couldn't wait for knock-off time so you could get the gosh darn heck out of there to breathe and feel alive? If so, you're in good company because it appears Santa and sidekick Rudolph do, too, as witnessed in an online slot from Lucksome titled Saint Nicked. review: Sonic Links: Slot OverviewPlayers! Are you in the market for a game so outrageous it transcends the label 'online slot' and is closer to high art with a gambling element? title: Christmas Tree

title: Ghost Glyph

review: Ghost Glyph: OverviewDeveloper Quickspin deepens their crush on the grid slot format with the spooky(ish) game Ghost Glyph. Like Wild Cauldron, Ghost Glyph has a charm that is easy to warm to; partly from its inhabitants, partly from the atmosphere Quickspin has created.As alluded to, the main showstoppers for the harder-edged gambler will be the game engine and potential. If you identify with this group, then hearing the words ‘balanced math model’ in the blurb will probably give you pause. It is certainly balanced, no objections there, it’s just balanced in favour of those who like a fright, but not too much of a fright. Say, those who prefer Slimer from Ghostbusters to the head-spinning scene in The Exorcist.That’s all good though, some people like to sleep soundly at night rather than worry about what’s lurking under the bed. Bottom line, if you’re happy with the math model and stats, then there is no reason why you won’t enjoy what Ghost Glyph has to offer.

title: Age of Asgard

review: Age of Asgard (Yggdrasil Gaming): OverviewIt's not by chance that Swedish developers named themselves Yggdrasil Gaming. The word itself means Odin's Horse and is the tree that binds the ancient Nordic cosmos. This is serious stuff, and those are big boots to fill. Fortunately for the gaming community, Yggdrasil has proven time and again that they are more than capable of producing ground breaking slots. Epic action from the extras bails out the game like a swipe from Thor's hammer.Age of Asgard (Yggdrasil Gaming): FeaturesRagnarok free spins in actionThis is where the game gets surprisingly good. Many slots have extras that build on top of each other - free spins that open up multipliers for example. Yet, not many we’ve seen recently work as well together as they do with Age of Asgard. It all starts with the wilds. During the base game, both grids get their own wild, a good golden warrior, and a mean golden beast.Two things make them special. One, they are 1x3 tiles in size, and two, if they don't cover a reel when they land, they can nudge themselves up or down to do so. When they do cover a reel, they lock into place and trigger an extra respin. If both grids have full wilds opposite each other they Clash, knocking together and causing a bunch of random 1x1 wilds to scatter the grid. If a small wild lands on a high pay symbol that whole symbol becomes wild.If 3 scatters land on the top or 3 on the bottom grid they both merge to form one super grid using the symbols from that part of the game for 10 Free Spins. However, if 3 scatters land on both sides at the same time, then Ragnarok Spins are launched. Here the grids merge as before, but the player gets 20 free spins populated only by the high paying symbols, and large wilds always nudge.Lastly, if 3 scatters land on one side and 2 on the other, then the Randomiser is launched. This wheel results in either 10 free spins, or a consolation prize of 50 times your stake, or it launches the Ragnarok free spins.Age of Asgard (Yggdrasil Gaming): VerdictAge if Asgard is a game that really grows on you. At first, it can be easy to dismiss it on the grounds of medium volatility and its so-so top prize, especially if you don't get many early wins in. However, we found the spins seriously fly by once the momentum began to ramp up. The secret to Age of Asgard's magic, and the reason you may stick with it, is the interplay between the extra features.On their own they are great, but together they work like a well-oiled machine. When the game gets into its stride, then free spins can lead into giant wilds, into wild clashes, into random 1x1 wilds, electrifying wins and on it goes. To defeat evil, you need team work. To rack up serious wins you need the extras working in tandem, and this happened thrillingly often during testing and really won us over.If you want big powerful characters in a big powerful setting you have come to the right place. Few do mythology as well as the Swedes. The double reel setup also deserves mention. The split setup gels and interacts so well it is easy to overlook just how unique it is. Its design compliments the super wilds and clashes perfectly, and the separation and coming together of the high pay symbols is a wonderful concept.Let us preface our final point by saying that Age of Asgard is a great game. However, due to the company's name and country of origin, it does feel ever so slightly that Yggdrasil could have pulled the stops out and made this one a classic. Again, it sounds like we are complaining, but we are not. It's just that with a bit of tinkering, Age of Asgard could have been a real contender.Perhaps by upping its top prize, or tweaking the volatility Age of Asgard could have been worthy of Valhalla. As it is, it remains a supremely playable mythological slot with gorgeous graphics and a brilliant interplay of extras. But hey, this is Yggdrasil, and we've come to expect nothing less.

title: Fruitopolis Fortune Play

review: Fruitopolis Fortune Play: Slot OverviewAdding to the countless number of fruit slots available pretty much everywhere comes another one from Blueprint Gaming titled Fruitopolis. It's the sort of name which may well elicit frissons of delight amongst fans of the format, or fearful cold sweats, depending on your thoughts on these sorts of games. As the name suggests, Fruitopolis is an online slot dripping with fruity icons that splits itself into two game modes. One is Standard Play; the other is Fortune Play, which is radically different in terms of rules and spin cost. As well as two game modes, players can enjoy a pay adjacent system, Golden Chip mystery symbols, and Money Spins.Typical, boring, magnificently traditional, all are terms that could be used to describe Fruitopolis depending on the sort of mood you are in. In Standard Mode, a single 5-reel, 4-row game grid sits front and centre before a crimson, diamond-patterned background, like a thickly padded wall in a club. There's not much to say about Fruitopolis from an aesthetic standpoint. It's a seen one you've seen them all type deal.Fruitopolis is playable on any device, and when it comes to bet selection, there are a few considerations to make. The first is whether you wish to play the game in Standard Play mode, where bets range from 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin. Or flip it over to Fortune Play mode by clicking the colourful square button sitting below the reels. This is a big bet style option, ratcheting stakes up to $/€2 to $/€200, and the exact details of what it entails are covered in the following section. Before we go, be aware that Fruitopolis is a highly volatile slot, while RTP swings between 95.06% and 95.38%.In total, 20 fixed paylines are attached to the game grid, creating winning combinations when at least three matching symbols land in adjacent reels across them. However, unlike most games, winning combinations can begin from any reel, not just the first. In ascending order from the least valuable side of the paytable, we find 10-A playing card symbols, cherries, lemons, plums, and 7s. Card rank wins are worth 5-10 times the stake for five of a kind, rising to 15-25 times the bet for the remaining premium symbols. Fruitopolis might have plenty of fruit, but it does not use wild symbols at any time.Fruitopolis Fortune Play: Slot FeaturesThere are a couple of other special symbols to look out for, though; these are diamond scatters which trigger Money Spins and Golden Chip mystery symbols.Money SpinsThe Money Spins bonus round is triggered when any number of diamond scatter symbols hit. Once in, 3 respins are awarded in what is a rather basic hold and win game. Diamond scatters are sticky, so they lock into position and reveal a cash prize. When new diamonds hit, they reset the spin counter back to three. At the end of the round, all cash prizes in view are added up and awarded.Golden ChipsWhen Golden Chip symbols land, they all transform into the same pay symbol type. Then a win evaluation takes place. Golden Chips can also transform into Money Spins symbols.Fortune PlayFortune Play is possibly the most intriguing thing about Fruitopolis as, so far, it has been pretty standard. Flicking the switch below the grid activates this game mode. Roughly speaking, Fortune Spins cost 20 times what regular spins cost. So, on a €20 Fortune Play spin, pay symbols have the same value they would have at a €1 Standard Play spin. So what do you get for the extra cash? For one, this mode is played on four grid sets rather than just one. Each grid has a turn of spinning before the next one does. Once all four matrices have been activated, the Fortune Play spin is over.Where Fortune Play gets interesting is when Golden Chip mystery symbols land, they are transferred to the remaining grids. For example, mystery symbols landing on reel set 1 are added to the same position on reel sets 2, 3, and 4. If on the same spin, more mystery symbols land on reel set 2, they are added to reel sets 3 and 4.Fruitopolis Fortune Play: Slot VerdictFor much of the test round, playing Fruitopolis was a tug of war battle between trying to stay focused on the reel-based action and the desire to do pretty much anything else. Maybe action is too strong a word. Anyway, the adjacent pays system is something, and it works with mystery symbols to create the odd thrill. For instance, a bunch of mystery symbols might land stacked on reels 3, 4, and 5 to create a win, which it wouldn't ordinarily do with a regular pay from the first reel setup. That's something, we guess.What made the struggle real is the fact Fruitopolis is basically a straight clone of Luck o' the Irish 2 Fortune Spins. Why the transition from one generic-looking slot to another, you might be wondering? We're not sure either, but the impression we got is that since the quad grid system hasn't quite taken off yet, Blueprint is hesitant to squander their really good thematic ideas on it. This is conjecture, of course, and it makes things tough for the Fortune Spins concept, which has merits, yet often flounders in a sea of thematic mediocrity.Winning potential is a funny one, too. As usual, Fruitopolis comes with the standard 50,000x or $250,000 win cap disclaimer (Blueprint really needs to be more transparent here), but it's unlikely the game will climb anywhere near such lofty levels. If the unspeakable occurred, and all four grids in a monumental Fortune Spin were covered in 7s, the result would be 2,000x the bet. Then again, not really, since 2,000x the regular bet equates to 100x the Fortune Spin cost. However you cut it, Fruitopolis isn't a massive xbet machine.In the end, we were left with the impression that Fruitopolis was a sort of beta tester for future slots. The way adjacent pays and mystery symbols gel together could see further use somewhere down the line, as could the Fortune Pays big bet idea. Heck, what are we saying? This is Blueprint Gaming, the masters of tweak, so players are sure to get a bunch of different iterations of these concepts in the future when they're squeezed into new games or merged with previous works. Mashing them into something with a more exciting theme wouldn't hurt.

Highly volatile (rated 4 out of 5), Diamonds of Egypt has a default theoretical return value of 96.49%.Symbol time now and Diamonds of Egypt has 11 regular pays split into 9-A low pay card royals, and higher value scarab jewellery, a cup, a ring, bracelets, and a Pharaoh mask. This amounts to 10x, 20x, 100x, or 1,000x the bet for getting the Mini, Minor, Major, or Grand Jackpot, respectively.Free SpinsLanding 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols awards 5, 10, or 50 times the bet, respectively, as well as triggering 8 free spins. For the round, low-pay royal symbols are removed from the reel strips.Diamonds Of Egypt slot - free spinsDiamonds of Egypt: Slot VerdictFor a game about adventuring in the spirit of, say, Indiana Jones, Diamonds of Egypt feels pretty darn tame. It's like Pragmatic Play set out to make a game that would cater to the widest bunch of gamblers it possibly could. There's nothing offensive, nothing unusually unique, nothing that stands out from the crowd in any way. Ancient Egypt is about as safe a slot genre as they come. A significant number of gamblers are familiar with the scene or likely will be sooner or later, and Diamonds of Egypt is packed with the usual visuals. Agreeable visuals, to be sure, with the glossy quasi-land-based effect common in a Pragmatic Play slot, but nothing particularly noteworthy.The same goes for Diamonds of Egypt when it's in action. title: Cat Clans
structured_summary: Cat Clans is a charming slot set in the Scottish Highlands featuring clannish cats as premium symbols. It offers two main bonus rounds: sticky wild multiplier Cat-a-pult Free Spins and the Clan Battle Bonus with competitive prize awards. The reviewer praises its engaging features and potential wins up to 20,000x stake, highlighting it as a well-designed, exciting game. The game sports warm, cartoonish visuals with a friendly Highland backdrop and accompanying audio that complements its cute, inviting theme.
review: Cat Clans: Slot OverviewCat Clans is an adorable yet surprisingly potent game from Stockholm and Helsinki based studio Snowborn Games. After dropping their debut slot, The Vault, like some sort of iGaming Jack Reacher, their games seemed to have been on an ever-cuter trajectory ever since. Cat Clans is the apex of this journey to date; a feline filled slot set in the Scottish Highlands. Why cats, you might be asking? Well, your guess is as good as ours, but if we were going to hazard a very tenuous speculation, it might be because the team has been bashing Relax Gaming's Top Dawg$, and it was on the back of their minds. Hear us out. As well as domesticated animals, Cat Clans has a Top Dawg$ style sticky wild multiplier free spins round, as well as Clan Battle Bonus Spins.A game called Cat Clans could only be designed using a cartoonish approach, so there are no disappointments in that regard. There is a faint echo of Peter & Sons going on here, not as individually stylistic as the Armenian studio, but the scene is warm and friendly. It depicts the hills and mountains of the Highland location, with a Camelot type castle nestled to the right of the game grid. Other noteworthy sights are a glowing treasure chest, which feeds into the Clan Battle Bonus, plus a buy free spins button, for those in applicable territories.Taking bets from 20 c/p to €/$25 per spin, the game is played on a 5-reel, 3-row game panel, users score coins when three or more identical symbols land across one of the 20 fixed paylines. Offering wins of up to 20,000 times your stake, Cat Clans is Snowborn's biggest slot to date from a potential perspective, and its big top prize has been matched with a highly volatile math model. The RTP comes in a trio of forms, the most attractive one being a figure of 96% while a hit rate of 33.29% keeps the game ticking along.The clannish cats in question appear as the game's premium symbols, where there are four of them worth 10 to 12.5 times the stake for five of a kind. From there, J-A royals, fishbones, and Mac Milky bottles make up the lower pays. Wilds appear on all reels and pay out up to 111x the bet if five wilds line up. In addition, each wild lands with a multiplier of x1-x5 attached, which is applied to any wins, the wild is involved in. If there is more than wild included in a winning line, the multiplier values are all multiplied together.Cat Clans: Slot FeaturesCat Clans comes with two separate bonus rounds. One is called Cat-a-pult Free Spins, which can be triggered naturally or bought if the option is available. The second bonus feature is the Clan Battle Bonus.Cat-a-pult Free SpinsLanding 3 scatter symbols on reels 1, 3, and 5 awards 1.5x the bet, as well as 3 Cat-a-pult Free Spins. While this feature is active, when wild symbols land, they reset the number of free spins and become Sticky Wilds. Sticky Wild symbols remain in their position for the duration of free spins. On each remaining spin, the catapult shoots at one of the sticky wilds, increasing its multiplier value by +1. The maximum multiplier a Sticky Wild can have is x9.Clan Battle BonusGolden paw symbols can appear over any of the premium cat symbols. When they appear, they zoom to the treasure chest at the bottom left of the screen and may randomly trigger the Clan Battle Bonus. Each of the 4 cat symbols - Clan Mac Cattus, Clan Mac Whiskers, Clan Mac Feline, and Clan Mac Tabby, is allocated a prize of at least 10x the bet. Over the next 5 spins, the cat symbol that lands the most often awards its respective prize to the player. If there is a draw between the symbols, an extra spin will be awarded until a winner is found.Buy Free SpinsIf available in your jurisdiction, players can buy Cat-a-pult free spins and instantly trigger them for 50x the total bet.Cat Clans: Slot VerdictIf you're looking around for a cute slot that has a sting in its tail, Cat Clans might be one to try. The game certainly has a charming look, and being located up in the Highlands gives it a unique setting. In reality, it's not totally unique, as Cat Clans does look a bit like one of Snowborn's previous games, Legend of the Sword, all castles, and mountains, except this one stars kitties instead of Kings.Cat Clans is arguably a more individual experience than Legend of the Sword due to its duo of bonus games. Both are pretty good features, too. There isn't as much battling going on in the Clan Battle Bonus as you might expect, yet it can get pretty exciting if a substantial prize is on the line, and it looks as though you might be able to win it. Since you get just five spins, what follows can be surprisingly intense. While we weren't quite lucky enough to do so, it is possible to win 10,000 times your stake from this feature.Snowborn could have called it a day there, but it's actually possible to win more from Cat-a-pult Free Spins. Sticky wild multipliers with the ability to multiply each other are well-known slot performers, as we've seen in games like Top Dawg$, as alluded to above, and they can do so in Cat Clans. Increasing the value of one sticky wild per spin is a nice touch, and should it blow up, wins as high as 20,000x the bet are possible. Being able to buy them for the reasonable price tag of 50x the bet is sure to appeal to certain players as well.All in all, Cat Clans is a competently designed slot from Snowborn. Disarming looks have been bolstered by a couple of bonus games that can be as lucrative as they are exciting, all neatly packaged with plenty of feline charm.

title: Legion X
structured_summary: Legion X is a Roman army-themed slot that explores primal, barbarian elements amid a dark, post-battle atmosphere. The game features a unique 5-reel 2-3-2-3-2 layout with multiple special symbols, four distinct free spin modes, and high volatility. The reviewer finds it complex but accessible, praising its blend of classic Nolimit City features and balanced max win potential. Visually, the slot presents a grim, grey battlefield setting with a moody ambiance that complements its intense gameplay.
review: Legion X: Slot OverviewAfter one or two delays, it's here, folks, hot off the Nolimit City press rolls Legion X, a Roman army themed slot decked out in all manner of x-prefaced features, and more – a whole lot more. Students of Roman history are probably well acquainted with the concept of decimation as a form of punishment. That's when every tenth man in a group of soldiers was arbitrarily selected from a line-up and slaughtered. This method was a quick way of dealing with serious infractions amongst a large number of offenders. Legion X is like the opposite to decimation since it is rammed to the gills with features, all set amidst the sort of darkly atmospheric slot the studio is famous for.We say darkly, but before squeamish players have flashbacks of Mental, just know Legion X isn't quite so grim. There's a definite edge to the game, though, as the action takes place on a dismal grey day, perhaps either in the aftermath of a battle or in the nervous moments before one kicks off. In their ever-creative manner, Nolimit has ingeniously tapped into a more primal vein than a lot of Roman-themed slots do by exploring some of the 'barbarian' elements the Romans brushed up against. Legion X might not have the lurk of Das xBoot or the menace of Mental, yet there's a definite creep that mixes well with the initial excitement of putting a new Nolimit City slot through its paces.The studio does like to experiment with reel setups, here utilising a 5-reel game grid laid out in a 2-3-2-3-2 formation. In the beginning, this arrangement provides 72 ways to win, though both ways and reels expand at later stages of the game. The RTP comes in a variety of settings as well, starting with a max default value of 96.04%, increasing as the bonus buys increase in cost. We probably don't need to mention this, but volatility is rated at 10 out of 10, or 'Extreme' to use the studio's own words. After what we've seen Nolimit City slots do this year, such a setting can be a blessing or a curse depending on which side of the math model a player falls. The last few numbers, for now, are stakes which range from 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin, while the game may be played on any device.Winning combinations are formed in Legion X when matching symbols land on the grid from the leftmost side on adjacent reels. Making up the regular paying symbols are five stone cut 10-A card royals worth 1-1.1x the bet for five of a kind, then four menacing-looking barbarian characters and a Roman legionary as the five premiums. Landing a full five of a kind premium combination is worth a payout of 1.2 to 2.5x the bet.Legion X: Slot Features﻿﻿If you're tooling around looking for a feature-rich game, then be sure to put Legion X on the list. Its base game benefits from several special modifying symbols while boasting no less than four different free spin bonus rounds.xNudge WildsWilds are where the first 'x' feature comes into play, this one being xNudge Wilds. Wilds are stacked and always nudge to become fully visible when landing partly in view. Each time a wild nudges, it increases its multiplier by +1. If more than one xNudge Wild is used in a win, the applicable multipliers are added together first before being applied to any prize money.Infections WildThese wilds land only on the first or last reel. When an Infectious Wild lands, it converts all instances of a randomly chosen low pay symbol into wilds on the three middle reels. Landing 2 Infections Wilds converts all low symbols into wilds on the three middle reels.xWaysThese symbols also only appear on the first or last reel. xWays symbols transform into 2-4 instances of the same pay symbol type, increasing the number of win ways in the process. Landing 2 xWays symbols triggers Infectious xWays. Symbols on the middle three reels that are the same as the revealed xWays symbol also expand to the same size.xWays and Infectious WildLanding an xWays symbol and an Infectious Wild symbol triggers both modifiers so the middle three reels are converted into Infectious xWays and wilds.Legion X SpinsThis feature is triggered when 3 bonus symbols land on the three middle reels, awarding 8 free spins. Firstly, reels 1 and 5 are given an extra row, and any win multiplier created by xNudge Wilds persists for the duration of the feature. When landing an xWays or Infectious Wild, an additional free spin is awarded. Or, if 2 special symbols land on reels 1 and 5, the feature is upgraded to an enhanced bonus mode.Legion X Equestris SpinsShould 3 bonus symbols land at the same time as 2 xWays symbols, then 10 free spins are awarded. For this one, reels 1 and 5 expand to 4 symbols in height, creating an X shape. Again, xNudge multipliers do not reset between free spins, except this time, xWays symbols are sticky, meaning Infectious xWays on each spin.Legion X Fretensis SpinsThis feature is triggered when 3 bonus symbols land along with 2 Infectious Wilds. The rules are the same as Equestris Spins except that the Infectious Wilds are sticky, meaning they convert all low symbols to wilds on each spin.Legion X Gemina SpinsTriggered when 3 bonus symbols land in conjunction with 1 Infectious Wild symbol and 1 xWays symbol - 10 free spins are awarded on the expanded game grid with a persistent win multiplier built by xNudge Wilds. Here, the 2 special symbols on the outer two reels are sticky, so players benefit from low symbols to wild conversions and Infectious xWays on each spin.Feature BuyThere is a lot to experience in Legion X, and Nolimit City allows players to go straight to each of the bonus rounds if they cough up the dough. The feature buy options are 8 Legion Spins, 10 Equestris Spins, 10 Fretensis Spins, or 10 Gemina Spins for the cost of 70x, 300x, 750x, or 1,200 times their stake, respectively.Legion X: Slot VerdictAfter the complexity of slots like Das xBoot, or even Evil Goblins to an extent, Legion X came across as a rather straightforward game. Well, straightforward for Nolimit City, which still means it's worth spending a bit of extra time on the paytable to digest everything. However, it's also possible to just dive right in and pick things up as you go along, unlike Mental, which had some players scratching their heads after extended research into the rules and a solid playthrough. Legion X, by contrast, is like fighting a battle for the legions - chaotic to be sure, but with a measure of control that the Romans were famous for.Features-wise, Legion X might be a slight overload in the beginning, yet it doesn't take long to clock which symbols land where and what their functions are so you can sit back to enjoy the carnage. Nolimit City has proven masters of reusing older features, making slight adjustments to them, combining them with others and coming out the other side in an intensely new experience. Legion X is a real who's who of some of the studio's classic hit features, having shown up in games like those previously mentioned, as well as Barbarian Fury, San Quentin and East Coast vs West Coast, to name a few. In Legion X, they fire off as spectacularly as ever and scoring special sticky symbols in free spins can create some supremely satisfying mayhem.As to payouts, Nolimit City has pulled the max win figure closer to earth than some others they've done recently, and to be honest, this is no bad thing. The most you can squeeze from Legion X is an impressive 31,000x your stake, and it's nice to see the studio doesn't feel the need to outdo themselves with each new release. The positive corollary is that the theoretical chance of hitting the max win is 1 in 36 million spins.At the time of testing, few if any providers provoked as much anticipation and excitement over a new slot as Nolimit City. They must feel a ton of pressure on their shoulders to keep this going, surely? Anyway, somehow, someway, the studio manages to knock it out of the park just about every time, and Legion X is no exception. It's got the mood, the 'tude, and most importantly, the gameplay to entertain players up for a volatile Roman Empire themed challenge.

title: Viking Runes
structured_summary: Viking Runes is a large 9x9 grid slot themed around magical Viking runes set in a mystical mountainous landscape. The game features cluster pays, cascading wins, Lightning Wilds, random modifiers, and a free spins round with progressive multipliers. The reviewer finds it simpler but rewarding, with big win potential capped at 25,000x the stake. The graphics are somewhat dated but complemented by an eerie, atmospheric audio-visual design highlighting glowing auroras and spirit-like rock faces.
review: Viking Runes: Slot OverviewViking Runes is a grid slot designed by independent studio TrueLab. The first thing you notice about Viking Runes is just how big it is. Its 9x9, 81 symbol grid is much larger than you usually find in these sorts of games. Having all the extra space to play with does help juice Viking Runes' potential, so that's a bonus right away for big win chasers. The supersized grid also helps distance itself from its nearest competitor which appears to be Play'n GO's Viking Runecraft – more on that later.According to the sagas, runes had inherent magical properties, and Viking Runes' background imagery enhances this idea. The grid is found in a rocky mountainous region, dappled in snow turned purple by the glowing Aurora Borealis lighting up the screen's upper section. It produces an eerie glow, made eerier by the faces in the rock peering out like spirits of the earth. Extra life is injected by the horn-helmed warrior next to the grid, ready to slam it with his Warhammer at any moment.Viking Runes uses a cluster pays system, where 6 more identical symbols connecting either horizontally or vertically award a win. More than one cluster can land simultaneously, and if so happens, they all award wins. Winning clusters are then removed from the grid, allowing new symbols to drop down to fill the empty positions. This can lead to consecutive wins from single spins, only ending when no more winning clusters appear.Runic popping fun is available on any device, where bets from 40 p/c to $/€40 per spin may be selected. Big potential is matched by volatility measured at '2065', which doesn't mean much on its own, but translated into plain language equates to 'very high'. Symbols cluster up regularly, keeping the action going, as borne out by a total hit frequency of 31.8%. RTP is rather high as well, where we find a value of 96.2%.Runes certainly rule the paytable, where three are used as the low pays, four as the mids, while two gem-encrusted items of jewellery make up the high symbols. TrueLab has given each individual cluster of 6 to 42 symbols different values, making the paytable exceptionally lengthy. At the top end, a cluster of 42 low symbols are worth 100x, mids 200-300x, and highs 500x to 800x the bet. Players are assisted in clustering up symbols by 2 wild symbols. One is Lightning Wilds, covered below, the other a regular wild. This one substitute for all symbols in the game, except Lightning Wilds.Viking Runes: Slot FeaturesLightning Wilds are central to much of the action and are joined by 3 random modifiers, plus a round of free spins. There are 4 Lightning Wilds, stored on a bar to the right of the grid. When a winning cascade occurs, one Lightning Wild is activated and placed in a random position. Up to 4 Lightning Wilds in a sequence are possible, and each one moves to a different position after each winning cascade. Lightning Wilds remain on the board until cascades end; then they are removed for the next new spin.The 3 random modifiers are available during the base or bonus game. They trigger at various points, keeping in mind only one can activate on a cascade:Runic Shuffle – reshuffles symbols on random losing spin to guarantee one or more winning clusters.Spell of Ancestor – when no new winners appear, this may trigger to transform low pays into the top high pay symbol.Viking Sorcery – when no new winning clusters appear, 3 to 9 wilds may be added in random positions.If you manage to score 5 consecutive winning cascades or more, then 6 free spins are awarded (alternatively you can use the bonus buy option if allowed in your jurisdiction). In free spins, all 4 Lightning Wilds come into play for the duration, moving to new positions after every cascade. The major difference now is they also come with a progressive multiplier that increases by +1 whenever used in a winning cluster. Snowballing cascades is the name of the game here since free spins cannot be retriggered.Viking Runes - wild featureViking Runes: Slot VerdictViking Runes might be inspired by Viking Runecraft, even the name is pretty much the same, yet TrueLab's manages to be the bigger game. It's not as complex, where the main concern is just landing consecutive cascades to work your way up to free spins. Sure, there are random modifiers, but on the whole, Viking Runes is the simpler game. For a comparison, reading Viking Runecraft's paytable is like deciphering the rules of a roleplaying module. In short, the two games probably offer enough variety to set them far enough apart to avoid too much finger-wagging.Size kings and queens will no doubt be curious to know where all of this XXL grid slot gaming can lead them. Quite far indeed. To prevent things from getting too crazy, TrueLab has slapped on a 25,000x the stake win cap. As in an interesting aside, the win cap was hit 1,506 times in a billion simulated game rounds which works out at around 1 in 664,000. Not exactly easy odds, yet in some ways quite heartening when compared to much of the competition.To sum up, Viking Runes is a big grid slot with big rewards. Graphics are a little dated, though easy to overlook when you're knee-deep in the action. Viking Runes doesn't come with a huge amount of features, but its modifiers plus cascade/Lightning Wild system can create those solid win chains grid slots are renowned for. While it is close to Play'n GO's release, if you think of Viking Runes as picking up where Viking Runecraft left off, there is plenty for aficionados to enjoy.

title: Dragon's Luck Deluxe
structured_summary: Dragon's Luck Deluxe is an Asian-themed slot from Red Tiger, blending exotic visuals with traditional gameplay. It features Dragon Coin mystery symbols, Dragon's Help upgrades, free spins, and rare colossal Mega Coins for engaging win potential. The reviewer finds it entertaining with modest to moderate payouts, improved over the original but less volatile than the Megaways version. Visually, the game offers subtle 3D enhancements, a serene mountain backdrop, ornate pagoda framing, and a calming Eastern-inspired soundtrack.
review: Dragon's Luck Deluxe: Slot OverviewDragon's Luck Deluxe is the third installation in a series of slots from Red Tiger that gave us Dragon's Luck, a Megaways version, and now a deluxe version. The deluxe is closely related to the first one, being incapable of the type of reel gymnastics Megaways brings. In any case, Red Tiger has created an atmospheric slot, offering plenty of exoticism for players keen on some Asian flavoured gaming.Graphically, a subtle upgrade to Dragon's Luck Deluxe makes it the most pleasing one visually so far. It's not a huge difference, but there is something about the hazy mountain background, rich pagoda frame for the 5 reel, 20-payline grid, and the dragons wrapped around the columns that make Dragon's Luck Deluxe easy on the eyes. It brings to mind 3D Realms' classic first-person shooter Shadow Warrior, the 1997 classic, though sadly we don't get Lo Wang's hilarious commentary. Instead, a standard Eastern-inspired soundtrack wafts away in the background rounding off the experience.Taking a trip to the Orient is possible on any device where bets from 10 p/c to $/€20 per spin may be set. Red Tiger has made significant statistical changes between this game and the original. Volatility for one has been wound up from low to medium/high, while going hand in hand with this change potential is nearly triple what it was in the non-deluxe. The only stat to take a hit is RTP, which now comes in at 95.77%.Another critical attribute Dragon's Luck Deluxe retains is the pay from any reel mechanic. As long as 3 or more symbols land adjacently on a payline, starting on any reel, you have a winner. For example, this could be three fish on reels 2, 3, and 4. Symbols have largely remained the same, too, though with a slight graphical enhancement. Starting with the low pays, we find 10-A calligraphically styled royals, followed by more lucrative flowers, fish, dolls, and the '138' symbol. As to values, a line of 5 premiums symbols is worth a payout of 12.5 to 69 times your stake. There are no wilds symbols, yet pay anywhere mechanic and the features involved negate the need for one.Dragon's Luck Deluxe: Slot FeaturesDragon's Luck Deluxe - free spinsFar and away the most common feature is the Dragon Coin mystery symbol. It lands often, so is central to the Dragon's Luck Deluxe experience. Other extras are Dragon's Help, free spins, and the elusive colossal Mega Coins.Dragon Coins can appear on all reels, in any position, completely at random. All coins in view spin simultaneously, to reveal an identical symbol type. While they spin, they display a few different symbols before finally revealing the chosen one and making a win evaluation.Mega Coins are pretty rare, though they can land on either paid or free spins. These are 3x3 in size, and like the smaller Dragon Coins, they flip to reveal identical symbols for a win. Due to their size, plus the pay in any position mechanic, you are guaranteed to collect a payout when a Mega Coin lands.The Dragon's Help feature is not super common, but it is quite helpful when activated. You'll know when it is because the dragons on either side of the reels blow fire onto the grid. By doing so, they upgrade symbols revealed by Dragon Coins, potentially leading to better results.Finally, free spins are triggered when 5 or more free spins symbols are in view. Free spins symbols do not land like normal pay symbols – they only appear when Dragon Coins reveal them. The number of free spins symbols on the reels equates to the number of free spins awarded. It may be a bit of an anti-climax when you realise nothing new occurs during free spins compared to the base game. However, whenever a free spins symbol lands, 1 additional free spin is added to the remaining amount.Dragon's Luck Deluxe: Slot VerdictYou can see why Red Tiger is squeezing all they can get out of the Dragon's Luck franchise. There is something about the way the Dragon Coin mystery symbols operate, which makes them quite entertaining. They can certainly tantalise, tease, torment, whatever you want to call it when they're spinning between low and high pay symbols. Sometimes you're simply crossing your fingers for the highest pay symbols, at other times, you’re calculating what will link up best with what is already on the board. Around they spin, alternating between glory and a sweet, sweet nothing.More often than not, Dragon Coins result in a modest win, yet, at other times, they surprise by flipping to just the right symbols. Better is when Dragon Coins create a win, then Dragon's Help lights up the grid, upgrading the win to something better. It means the features have a hook, even if Asian gaming isn't really your area of interest. It's also possible for a full grid of mystery symbols to land, which is a nice moment. You know you're going to get something special, the question is how special is it going to be?Whatever you do win won't be outrageously high, yet Dragon's Luck Deluxe packs a bigger payoff than Dragon's Luck did. This time around, wins as high as 3,888 times the bet are possible compared to the 1,380x of the first one. Of course, both pale in comparison to what their Megaways sibling is capable of, though that one is a completely different kettle of koi.For good, wholesome, Asian gaming, Dragon's Luck Deluxe is a pretty good choice. It's not a high adrenaline ride, pumping out eye-watering stats, but its features are a nice mix of tease and reward, which should please both fans of the original as well as general Asian enthusiasts.

title: Lion Saga Odyssey
structured_summary: Lion Saga Odyssey is an African wildlife-themed slot inspired by Play'n GO’s classic 'Book of' mechanics and spirit-guided quest motifs. The game features 5 reels, up to 10 adjustable paylines, high volatility, a wild/scatter Spirit symbol, multiple expanding symbols in free spins, and a Gamble feature. The reviewer finds it familiar and less surprising compared to earlier titles but appreciates its flexible paylines and potential for big wins at low stakes. Visually, it offers a natural, Disney’s The Lion King-like aesthetic with nicely rendered wildlife and atmospheric spirit lion audio elements.
review: Lion Saga Odyssey: Slot OverviewTwo things developer Play'n GO hold dear to its heart are the Arthurian legend and expanding symbol 'Book of' mechanics. Both of these beloved concepts came together in the 2019 release Rise of Merlin, which was also able to add additional expanding symbols to its bonus round when it was retriggered. This set-up worked so well for Rise of Merlin that the developer wheeled out much but the skin again for Legacy of Dead and has done so once more in the African wildlife slot Lion Saga Odyssey.Lion Saga Odyssey might be a long way from Arthurian England, but it resides on the same continent as Legacy of Dead. That continent is Africa, and Play'n GO has painted an attractive, if a bit dry in the base game, version of it. Some might say in the spirit of Disney's The Lion King. The natural world is nicely rendered in the game, which also touches on ideas beyond the physical realm via a glowing blue spirit lion that appears to guide, lead or inspire the lion character to embark on some sort of journey or quest. At a guess, the quest involves leading the animals from dry thirst to watery paradise.Lion Saga Odyssey slot - base gameSticking with a classic 'Book of' set-up, Lion Saga Odyssey drops symbols on a 5-reel, 10 payline reelset. However, players may set the number of active paylines from 1 to 10. This means wagers range from 1 c per spin up to $/€100. So much so it feels like players might elect to play Wild Unicorns for its theme as much, if not more, than anything else.
