The aesthetics include mid-90s style graphics with a starry night backdrop and basic, brightly drawn symbols, complemented by straightforward audio.
review: Star Wild Blaster: Slot OverviewProgress is a funny old thing. You can't stop it; someone is always trying to innovate, change things, upgrade them, make everything modern. Arguably, for the most part, progress is generally a good thing. It makes our lives easier, richer, and more convenient, supposedly. For a multitude of reasons, change butts up against people who refuse to accept it. One example is that despite the ongoing advancement in online slots, there's a tendency for many to continue playing games of yore, say, Rainbow Riches, for example. For these sorts of players, Stakelogic partner Hurricane Games has stepped up with Star Wild Blaster – a slot to scratch the old school itch.You almost feel like you've gone through a time warp when Star Wild Blaster hits the screen. This is the kind of thing that might have been high tech several decades ago, say, blasted on a 19-inch tv monitor set in a chunky old cabinet in a corner of the Las Vegas Hilton Hotel. The action occurs on a 5-reel, 3-row game grid, displaying the number of paylines it has on either side. In this instance, there are 10 fixed ways to win. The background is slightly more interesting than the stock symbols covering the grid, depicting a starry night sky overlaid with purple lines reminiscent of the Van Halen logo. Star Wild Blaster is designed for a specific audience, and it doesn't take a New York minute to suss whether it is to your taste or not.The target audience includes players who prefer mid-level volatility, Hurricane having rated this part of the math model at 3 out of 5. Default RTP is a smidgen under 96% on 95.91%, though the theoretical return can be much lower than this depending on setting or market – be sure to check the version you're getting. One of Star Wild Blaster's plus points is its potential, which isn't record-breaking, though it is surprisingly high for this style. Not high enough to win over players who detest these sorts of games, but a nice cherry on top for those into them.The rules are simple. Pick a stake from 10 p/c to $/€40 per spin and try to line up winning combinations. These are formed when three to five matching symbols land adjacently from the left-hand side onwards. All symbols are generic slot images, brightly, basically drawn. From bottom to top, we find diamonds, cherries, lemons, oranges, plums, double bars, stars, and 7s. The 7s are best at 250x the bet for five of a kind, while the remaining symbols payout 8 to 50x for a line of five. A wild symbol leads to the game's main feature, so we'll cover it in the next section.Star Wild Blaster: Slot FeaturesStar wild symbols appear on reels 2, 3, and 4 to substitute all other symbols. Wild symbols expand when they hit, triggering the Wild Multiplier feature. Then, a multiplier of 1x, 2x, 4x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, or 10x is randomly selected and applied to any applicable wins. It is possible for more than one Wild Multiplier to be present at the same time. In this scenario, the multipliers are added together.The only other extra is an optional gamble feature, triggered after each win. The game presents a face-down card, and it is the player's job to guess the correct colour for double or nothing, or the correct suit for quadruple or nothing. You can collect winnings to skip this step, or just disable the gamble feature altogether if it doesn't suit.Star Wild Blaster: Slot VerdictPlaying Star Wild Blaster is akin to loading up a horse and cart for a trot down the Autobahn. Kind of liberating for a while until high performance German-engineered rides start shooting past and you realise what you're missing out on. The game just feels out of place. Partly due to the mid-90s graphics, partly to the rudimentary gameplay. What makes Star Wild Blaster even stranger is it's basically a clone of Super Wild Blaster. This is a slightly earlier game from Hurricane that does the exact same thing as Star Wild Blaster. So the point of Star Wild Blaster is..? Your guess is as good as ours.Viewed in a vacuum, Star Wild Blaster can technically produce some crazy spins due to the Wild Multiplier feature. Get a couple of decent multipliers on screen at the same time as the upper symbols, and good things can happen. Monetarily speaking, wins of around 10,000 times the stake are possible this way.Despite the few positive things targeted players can enjoy, Star Wild Blaster is a game with a very limited shelf life. The problems are it looks like scores of other similarly designed slots, and once you've digested its one trick, there's little left over to keep you engaged. Then the urge to try the next classic slot kicks in. And that's for players who dig this type of game. If you are not into it, your mind quickly moves past aversion into a sort of bafflement, especially when considering the clone element. But hey, some players must be keen on the style, so more power to them; they've just got another anachronistic slot to take for a whirl.

title: Gates of Xibalba
structured_summary: Gates of Xibalba is a Central American-themed slot inspired by the Mayan underworld, offering a unique twist on Pragmatic Play’s previous titles. It features multiplier symbols, progressive free spins with leveling, and a tumble mechanic on a 6x5 grid with scatter pays. The reviewer sees it as a polished but unoriginal clone, delivering solid gameplay without much excitement. Visually, it boasts high-quality artwork with stone carvings, swirling lightning, and a driving chant-filled soundtrack.
review: Gates of Xibalba: Slot OverviewHear the word 'Gate' in the same sentence as the name Pragmatic Play, and first thoughts instantly turned to the hit slot Gates of Olympus. Not only because of the word repetition but also because the game has been cloned, copied, or formed the basis for numerous offshoots by now. In a surprise move, Gates of Xibalba is not a clone of Gates of Olympus. However, it is a copy of Forge of Olympus, which was built off the bones of GOO but had a progressive feature in free spins that returns again in Gates of Xibalba, as do multiplier symbols.If you're an admirer of Peter & Sons' work, then the name 'Xibalba' might be familiar as well since it is the title of one of the Armenian developer's slots. If not, then Xibalba is the name the Mayans gave to the underworld, the 'place of fright' where death gods such as One Death and Seven Death could be found, as well as other Lords like Flying Scab, Pus Demon, and Stabbing Demon (info from Wikipedia). Not the most cheerful place to end up, in other words, but it is a location that provides good material for an online slot. Pragmatic Play has taken the opportunity to fill Gates of Xibalba's view with stone, a swirling lightning, tornado-like entity, carved snakes, and a driving tune full of chanting. A pretty decent reskin on the outside then.Gates of Xibalba slot - base gameThe rest of Gates of Xibalba has been copied straight over, meaning players get a highly volatile math model with an RTP of 96.25%. This drops a notch to 96.23% when using the ante bet. Base bets go from 20 c to $/€100 per spin, and when the ante bet is turned on, the stake increases by 25%, doubling the chance of winning the feature. Played on a 6-reel, 5-row gaming panel, Gates of Xibalba has a scatter pays system to evaluate wins. When 8 or more of the same pay symbol land on the reels in any position on the grid, a win is created.The tumble mechanic removes winning symbols from the grid and drops symbols on the reels down from above to fill empty spaces. Runs of tumble wins continue like this, adding money to the payout until no new win appears. Nine Mayan-inspired objects make up Gates of Xibalba's regular pay symbols. These are 4 circular objects as the low pays and 5 mask-like objects as the highs. Hitting an 8-matching symbol scatter win pays 0.25 to 10 times the bet, while a 12+ sized scatter win is worth 2 to 50 times the bet. In Gates of Xibalba, you will not find wild symbols.Gates of Xibalba: Slot FeaturesGates of Xibalba slot - free spinsLike Forge of Olympus, Gates of Xibalba has as its features multiplier symbols, free spins with a progressive feature, and free spins buys.Multiplier SymbolsMultiplier symbols may land randomly on spins or tumbles in the base game as well as in free spins. When multiplier symbols hit, they carry a value of x2 to x100. At the end of a tumble sequence, all multiplier values in view on the reels are added together and applied to the total win.Free SpinsThe free spins round is activated when 4, 5, or 6 scatters land to award 10, 15, or 20 free spins, plus a payout of 3x, 5x, or 100x the bet, respectively. Free spins function with the use of a progressive feature that starts at Level 1. Whenever multiplier symbols land, they are collected by a meter. The round levels up when the meter reaches certain thresholds.Level 1 – in the beginning, multiplier symbols may have values of x2 to x100.Level 2 – reached after 6 multiplier symbols are collected. Multiplier symbols now get values of x8 to x100.Level 3 – reached after 5 further multiplier symbols are collected. Multiplier symbols now get values of x15 to x100.Level 4 – reached after another 4 multiplier symbols are collected. Multiplier symbols get values of x50 to x100.The round does not level up once reaching Level 4. However, landing 3 or more scatter symbols at any time during the round adds an extra +5 free spins to the remaining amount.Buy Free SpinsWhen buying free spins, players can pay 100x to start the round from Level 1, 200x the bet to guarantee starting from Level 2, 400x the bet to guarantee starting from Level 3, or 500x the bet to guarantee starting from Level 4. When buying free spins, a random number of scatters will land to trigger it for any of the options.Gates of Xibalba slot - bonus buy menuGates of Xibalba: Slot VerdictHey ho, and with Gates of Xibalba, another Pragmatic Play clone falls into players' laps. Being as burdened by a hugely demanding release schedule as the one Pragmatic Play is labouring under appears to mean reskins and remakes are a requirement for keeping up. As far as clones go, Gates of Xibalba is hard to critique. It has the same sort of playability found in Forge of Olympus or even Gates of Olympus, really, and doesn't look half bad on the skin side of things. The game's win cap is 5,000x the bet, the same as before, and levelling up through free spins may work out well if you can make it to the upper levels. Mechanically, Gates of Xibalba functions like a scatter-paying charm.On the other hand, a cloned slot with a Central American theme isn't massively excitingly, skin tingling stuff, no matter how it looks. The opposite, in fact, but Pragmatic Play has pulled everything together into the sort of polished package the studio is famous for producing. There are no qualms with the execution, the artwork and sounds are of a high quality, so yeah, whatever, Gates of Xibalba is another compelling scatter pays alternative, just don't expect much originality.

title: Squealin' Riches
structured_summary: Squealin' Riches is a money-themed slot with a jazzy, New York vibe centered around wealth symbols and piggy banks. review: Squealin' Riches: Slot OverviewMicrogaming partner Pear Fiction Studios takes on one of the more enduring themes in the slots arena, the one where everything overflows in status symbols and dollar bills. A dime a dozen slot genre, yet to its credit Squealin' Riches has a fun, 'New York, New York' Frank Sinatra thing going on that's pretty catchy. The game looks like it's located in Scrooge McDuck's bank vault, the one filled with gold coins he dives into and swims around in. Dipping into its vault of coins is possible on any device, where stakes of 20 p/c to $/€20 may be set.One of Squealin' Riches positives is its 1,024 win-all-ways system. Hits occur when at least three matching symbols land left to right on adjacent reels from the left side of the grid. Eight symbols make up the regular pays on the table – four are J-A icons, the others are a stack of banknotes, a purse of gold, a bag of gold, and a safe. The latter premium symbols will pay out a reward of 3 to 10 times the stake when a line of five of a kind lands. Lending a hand is the wild, substituting for all symbols except bonus symbols or scatters.Squealin' Riches: Slot FeaturesSquealin' Riches - Lock N Win featureSquealin' Riches likes to dazzle players with a host of collectable, hold-and-win, triggerable, and wheel-based features. Let's look at the gold coin bonus symbols first, which award jackpots or cash prizes. Bonus symbols land on all reels and 6 or more in view trigger the Locknwin feature, starting with 3 respins. If new bonus symbols land, they are locked in place and reset the spin counter back to 3. When spins run out or the screen is full, all prizes in view are paid. Several types of symbols may land during the Holdnwin:Cash symbols are worth 1-25x the bet.Multiplier upgrade symbols multiply all coins onscreen by up to x10.Jackpot upgrade symbols increase the jackpot amounts by 1 tier.Jackpot symbol awards the Mini, Minor, Major, Grand, or Epic prizes, worth 50, 100, 250, 1,000, or 5,000 times the bet at their default value, respectively.In addition, whenever bonus symbols land in the base game, they are collected, filling the Bonus Wheel Progress Bar. When the bar is full, players spin the Bonus Wheel to win a Jackpot, an instant cash prize, or free spins.Another way of accessing free spins is when 3 scatter symbols land in the main game. First, players spin the Free Spins Wheel to win anywhere from 10 to 30 free spins. Next, you can gamble the awarded free spins to potentially win more. If you lose the gamble, a Mystery Wheel spins to award an instant cash prize instead of playing the feature. Free spins can be retriggered and operate like normal paid spins.One more extra before moving on is the feature buy option. If available, players can buy a spin of the Bonus Wheel for the cost of 33.24x your bet or have a turn on the Free Spins Wheel for 55.02x the stake.Squealin' Riches: Slot VerdictThere are loads of these wealth/piggy bank themed slots floating around, and Squealin' Riches fits effortlessly in with the clique. It's one of the jazzier, upbeat entries into the genre, so players up for some money-centric gaming might be intrigued. Squealin' Riches might not offer anything revolutionary from a feature standpoint, but there is a lot happening on the grid, like, all the time, accentuated by the sound effects, which highlight every single action, no matter how small. The flurry of activity can be distracting, and after being immersed in a session, it can be a surprise to cast your eye on the balance to see it's been clobbered.Of course, any slot can do this, yet Squealin' Riches is good at diverting attention away from your cash, ironic given the theme. It does this via a constant stream of hits, roughly a third of the time, coin collections, near misses, and a highly positive attitude. Filling the Bonus Wheel Progress Bar gives you something to look forward to as well, though it didn't amount to anything more than 10x the bet instant cash prizes during testing. Not saying this wheel can't lead to jackpots or free spins, just don't count on it. Players with luck on their side can find lucrative returns from Squealin' Riches, though – up to 13,512x the bet. Since the default Epic Jackpot is 5,000x, you'll most likely need a few tier upgrades to maximise returns.Despite the trademarked Holdnwin feature, the extras in Squealin' Riches are all pretty standard, so there are no major innovations to try out. It is rammed to the gills with jackpots, wheels, collectables, and meters, though, so if you need to be dazzled during every moment of game time, it might scratch the itch. Squealin' Riches doesn't have quite the personality of competitor slots like Piggy Riches Megaways for example, but it does offer plenty of money-themed gameplay in one of the more chipper environments.

title: Book of 99
structured_summary: Book of 99 is an Ancient Greece-themed slot that follows the classic 'book of' style. It features a 99% RTP, expanding special symbols in free spins, and a unique wild collection system to trigger bonuses. The reviewer praises its high RTP and rewarding gameplay, making it a standout despite a familiar formula. Visually, it offers a sunlit Arcadian bonus game with cartoonish heroes and a throbbing, exotic soundtrack.
review: Book of 99: Slot OverviewTo stand out in the unstoppable deluge of slots, designers really have to do something special. Maybe pick an unusual theme, jack the potential, or put thinking caps on to come up with trailblazing features no one has seen before. Developer Relax Gaming has chosen to do none of these things. As you can deduct from the title, Book of 99 is another 'book of' style game – this time set in Ancient Greece. Even potential is pretty standard for this type of game. What they've done, though, is attach an eye-catching RTP value that relates to the title, as well as add a generous collection system.Book of 99 is also a nice game to look at, maybe not quite so much in the base game, but the bonus game plays in a sun-drenched easy on the eyes arcadia. There's a definite Relax feel to the rest of the game too via the cartoonishly designed symbols depicting various heroes and villains from the old glory days. Some are downright creepy (looking at you scary lady). The music is nice too, composed of a throbbing beat and a melody which adds a touch of exoticism to the proceedings.Highly volatile, the Greco action takes place on a classic 'book of' reel set made out of 5 reels and 10 fixed paylines. Stakes may be set from 10 p/c at the lower end, rising to $/€100 for higher rollers, on any device. The unique selling point around here is the game's RTP configuration. Rarely do we see figures so high, and Relax bucks the downward trend by blessing Book of 99 with 99% RTP. Call it what you like – a gimmick, a trick to pull in punters; at the end of the day, it's a stellar value, making Book of 99 head and shoulders more desirable than many in the 'book' category.Starting from reel 1, winning combinations are formed when matching symbols sit adjacently to each other on a payline. In this Greek odyssey, you'll find a group of attractive 10-A symbols at the lower end of things and higher-paying symbols, including a child-eating monster named Lamia, a cyclops, plus female and male leads. Low pays need at least 3 to make a winning combo, while high pays dish out coins for 2 or more. Should a line of 5 premium symbols line up, players collect a win worth 75 to 500 times their stake, making full screen wins particularly thrilling.Book of 99: Slot FeaturesBook fans will certainly know the drill by now and Book of 99 sticks close to the template laid down many moons ago by Book of Ra. The central feature is expanding symbols in free spins, yet Relax Gaming has added a collection system you rarely find in these types of games.As ever, the book symbol is the one you need to open up the game's best moments. It is wild, replacing pay symbols to complete win lines and the scatter - 3 or more in view award 10 free spins but no side payment, which is a little unusual. Before free spins launch, one of the pay symbols is randomly selected to be the special expanding symbol throughout the whole feature.On each spin, special symbols expand to cover all of the positions on their respective reel after any regular wins have been paid. Expanded symbols pay-all-ways, from any reel, so they do not need to be next to each other or sit on reel one. Full-screen wins are the ultimate goal here - the more valuable the symbol, the better. One last point about free spins is they are retriggered when 3 or more book symbols land.Lastly, let's look at the less orthodox feature - a wild collection system. For every wild symbol landed in the main game, a collection meter on the side of the screen increases by 1 step. Filling the meter with 99 collected wilds awards 10 free spins. Triggering the bonus round this way operates under the same rules, so those all-important expanding symbols come into play.Book of 99: Slot VerdictBook slots might be a dime a dozen, but Relax's contribution to this preeminent slot category comes with several convincing reasons why you would choose this over its competitors. RTP is obviously one of the main reasons, making Book of 99 one of the most generous slots out there. As a go-to for powering through a wagering requirement, it's hard to think of a better option. Book of 99 would be a great way to maximise your chances of getting returns in this situation - whether operators will play ball and offer it up for this purpose will be interesting to see.Aside from its unusually high RTP, Book of 99 is a high quality 'book of' slot in its own right. For one, it looks nice, and the wild collection system is an extra sweetener on top. It adds a sense of purpose as well as a reward for persistent players. Even if getting 3 scatters to appear simultaneously is a chore, eventually, 99 of them will pass by, leading to free spins. That also raises the question, how much of that RTP is allocated to the base game and free spins respectively? Is the exceptionally high RTP a blessing or a curse? There's always a risk that wading through long base game sessions will eventually start turning into a chore. Part of what has made Book of Dead so successful, is its perfectly balanced math model.At the end of the day, higher than normal RTP, plus a wild collection feature, makes Book of 99 a well-designed, attractive entry in the bloated 'book' market. Once again, it seems reinventing the wheel isn't a requirement for making a decent slot – provided there is an expanding special symbol in there somewhere.

title: Santa's Stack
structured_summary: Santa's Stack is a Christmas-themed slot with a retro 8-bit style, delivering a nostalgic festive vibe. The reviewer praises its originality and charm but warns of its high volatility and tough gameplay. review: Santa's Stack: Slot OverviewIf you find yourself tooling around on Christmas day for something sweet on the outside, a bit harder-edged on the inside, here comes Santa's Stack courtesy of Relax Gaming. Something of an anomaly for a Christmas slot, Santa's Stack is an original game built around a couple of simple features, enormous symbol values, and uncomplicated yet volatile as blazes gaming. This is a game that doesn't muck around, so in we go.Santa's Stack is a cluster paying grid slot played on a game panel made up of 8 rows and 8 columns. Winning clusters are formed when at least 5 identical symbols sit adjacently to one another, which trigger a cascade feature when they hit. Part of Santa's Stack charm lies in the way Relax Gaming has gone for an 8-bit approach, so everything has a slightly blocky, pixelated look to it. The game doesn't quite throw back as far as Hellcatraz did in this regard, but there's a nice old-fashioned look to the game that blends with the Xmas subject matter to create a pleasant overall feel. Is a wise move, as the combined sentimental value of Christmas and retro gaming is likely to hit its target audience right in the feels.As mentioned, Santa's Stack is a highly volatile game, so hold on to your stockings if you're planning to tackle the beast. Seriously, tangle with this thing on a bad day, and it'll feel like Santa has deemed you naughty rather than nice. The upside with Relax Gaming is the reliability of the RTP offered, which here comes in two versions - one is when playing the game in regular mode, which produces a return value of 96.27%, the other is when buying the bonus, where it increases to 97%. On the less exciting side are blue, green and red decorative lights as the low pays, then Rudolph, Elves, Mrs Claus, and Santa as the four premiums. When it comes to max payout values, grid slots typically top out at, say, 20-30+ symbols. Cluster values at this size aren't overly impressive in Santa's Stack, but when it creates larger clusters, the values are massive. Hit a cluster of 60 Santa symbols, and it really would be the most wonderful time of the year; we'll reveal how much this is worth down below.Santa's Stack: Slot FeaturesThere's not a lot of features to be found in Santa's Stack, but they are snappy and can spark adrenaline when they're performing. These are Secret Santa Respin feature, free spins and a bonus buy.Secret Santa RespinsThis feature is triggered whenever a wild symbol is used as part of a winning cluster. The winning cluster in question converts into mystery symbols and locks in place for a respin. If a win occurs on a respin that is adjacent to the locked mystery symbols, the new winning cluster converts to mystery symbols as well, and another respin is awarded. When no new winning clusters adjacent to mystery symbols hit, all mystery symbols transform to reveal the same symbol type.Free SpinsWhen at least 3 scatter symbols land, 5 free spins are awarded, plus 1 additional free spin for every extra scatter in view. In free spins, wild symbols are guaranteed to land at the start of every spin, helping to trigger the Secret Santa Respin feature. The number of wilds guaranteed to land increases by 1 on every spin, starting with 1 wild on the initial free spin. When scatter symbols land during the feature, players win either an extra free spin or the win multiplier increases by 1 - or both of these things.Buy FeatureIf this feature is available in your jurisdiction, then it is possible to buy free spins for the cost of 100x the reference bet size, which also bumps up the RTP to 97%.Santa's Stack - free spins with mystery symbolsSanta's Stack: Slot VerdictWith a casual flex, Relax Gaming has turned out a highly intriguing Christmas slot. The studio has declined to tart an old game up in Xmas garb to cash in on the season the quick and easy way. Instead, they've designed a slot so playable some users might be tempted to do the unthinkable and play it on Boxing day, or even beyond.Several factors contribute to Santa's Stack's allure, and its looks are one of them. The old school angle is hot and works like a charm in Santa's Stack. All those beguiling little sprites on the grid, the cute Sim City angle, the cosy snow-covered, Christmas tree-filled square paints an idyllic portrait of the season. No doubt, if this was real life, the scene would be full of frantic shoppers doing a mad dash for the shops, having left everything to the last minute, for the umpteenth year in a row.Try not to fall too far for the charm, though, because Santa's Stack was ruthless during testing. Bonus buys struggled to end up in the black, and repeated use of the feature buy led to bankroll decimations. This game is not here to make friends, so handle it with care. Like we've seen in previous Relax Gaming releases, Santa's Stack does have the goods to blow its metaphorical stack when the stars align. For players who like a grid slot with massive upper-level cluster values, then Santa's Stack should fit the bill. Land the largest cluster of 60 Santa's and a colossal 10,000x the bet is heading your way. Doing that twice, or with an x2 multiplier or higher on board, means you've hit the game's full potential, which is capped at 20,000x. You do get the impression that a lot of Santa's Stack's payout capabilities have been rammed into these big clusters though, because without landing them it is tough to get much forward momentum.Up for a uniquely styled, simple yet savage grid slot loaded with Christmas charm for the special day? You might want to check out what Santa's Stack can do. Just be aware playing this Christmas themed game is far from kicking back with eggnog and a mince pie as it can bite.

title: Hades Gigablox

The first is that winning combinations are formed when three or more matching symbols land on one of the 50 paylines. Eight regular pay symbols are available, split in to high and low pay groupings. Low pays are four well-designed card suits – hearts, clubs, spades, and diamonds, while the high pays are four nightmarish denizens of the Underworld. These are called monster symbols, worth 4 to 8 times the stake for six of a kind.Hades Gigablox: FeaturesThere might not be a huge number of features, but the transformative qualities of the Gigablox mechanic appear on every spin. Gigablox is partnered by the Hades Wild Hunt and a triggered round of free spins.If you haven't played a Gigablox powered game before, or if you're new to slots, it might seem a little confusing at first. How it works is that symbols can land as a block from 2x2 to 6x6 in size. Sounds basic, but in action it's rather effective since it means reels are in essence connected. For example, you might have reels 1 and 2 landing 2x2 sized symbols, while reels 4-6 have 3x3 sized symbols. The Gigablox feature changes on every spin, producing a huge variety of reel and symbol configurations.Veteran players might experience a bit of Viking's Go To Hell déjà vu when hearing about the next feature. At random, Hades may decide to fight monster symbols in the Hades Wild Hunt feature. When the reels stop spinning, he leaps into action and all defeated monster symbols turn wild. This applies to standard size monster symbols as well as the Gigablox versions. Wilds of all sizes are able to substitute for any regular pay symbol.Landing 5 or more scatter symbols triggers free spins. Players are awarded as many free spins as there are scatters in view. Scatters are always calculated as individual blocks, so for example, landing a 3x3 scatter block equates to 9 scatters.Once in, the Hades Wild Hunt is activated on every spin. The key here is to see Hades defeat as many monsters as possible as each defeated monster adds +1 point to the Multiplier Bar. Filling the bar not only increases the win multiplier, but also adds +2 free spins. The multiplier, which never resets during the round, starts on x1, moving up to x2, x3, x5, and finally x10. As before, monster blocks are calculated by symbol size, so a 2x2 block is worth 4 points. On a final note, each scatter you land during the round adds +1 extra spin.Hades Gigablox: VerdictLike the popular Vikings range, Hades is another darkly enjoyable Yggdrasil slot, heavy in atmosphere, irreverent humour, and with a huge fun factor. Each element of Hades Gigablox has been expertly designed, interlacing seamlessly into an outrageously playable slot.As well as features, Hades himself is an extra piece of the entertainment puzzle. His constant callouts are amusing and the chap has loads of personality. He comes across as a loveable rogue, a little bit like Lucifer Morningstar from the tv show Lucifer. The only time you kind of feel like punching him in the face is during a weak bonus game count up as he smirks from his throne, surrounded by piles of gold coins.Interestingly, when you head back to the base game, facing down a possible 400 spins for the next crack doesn't feel so daunting. Part of the reason is that the Gigablox feature has come out swinging. It did a decent enough job in Lucky Neko, but it didn't shine there as it does in Hades. Surrounded by epic graphics, the mechanic has a better chance to show what it can do, and it is impressive. There is a Megaways-ish feel, though Gigablox adds an additional level of unpredictability.You never know what will happen on a spin, in any game, yet Gigablox amplifies that effect. How many symbols will land on a reel, will reels connect, how big will they be? The mystery keeps you on your toes, making the base game a lot more engaging.The free spins frequency is low, but it doesn't feel like the brutal slog it could have been. For one, volatility isn't massive, and Gigablox's ever-changing nature keeps it fresh while dishing out a good number of wins along the way. Multi-line combos are common, plus Hades dives in during the Wild Hunt from time to time. It adds up to an insane 'just one more spin' compulsion.Yggdrasil Gaming has done an outstanding job with Hades Gigablox and playing it brings back memories of the first time an Yggdrasil slot blew you away. Few do dark mythology like the Swedish developer and Hades Gigablox is without any doubt one of their best.

title: Slugger Time
structured_summary:
Slugger Time is a subway gang warfare-themed slot featuring quirky masked hooligans and odd objects.  
Key features include sticky multiplier wilds, four free spin fight modes, and a buy feature option.  
The reviewer finds it a solid, entertaining clone of Cabin Crashers with familiar gameplay and strong win potential.  
The game sports a comic book style with humorous, slightly dark visuals and fitting audio that balances toughness with fun.
review: Slugger Time: Slot OverviewChickens, rabbits, nunchucks, broken bottles, and clowns don't make a whole lot of sense out of context. It's as if each employee at software provider Quickspin had to think of one random object, and no matter what it was, it got tossed in to make online slot Slugger Time. However, with an overarching theme of gang warfare in a subway station, the pieces start to come into focus. Slugger Time pairs a unique violent-ish subject matter with features such as sticky wild multipliers that worked to good effect in the previous 2021 slasher slot Cabin Crashers.Let's not beat around the bush; Slugger Time is basically an out and out clone of Cabin Crashers, so you'll be hard-pressed to find any differences beneath the surface. While not a shining beacon of originality in the gameplay department, this is no terrible thing since Cabin Crashers had some simple yet sweet features. Slugger Time puts its theme to good use to set it apart from its zombie-filled predecessor but is no less peculiar. The game takes place underground in a subway station called Slugger St, where gangs get all bolshy with each other, wearing peculiar masks at the same time. It's a bit like the poster for Joaquin Phoenix' 'The Animal People', with knuckle dusters. Is Slugger Time humorous, is it violent? Well, it's sort of a mixture of both, without pushing too hard in the latter direction. Slugger Time plays at being tough, but there's not really anything here that would cause much offence, even for the squeamish.Playable offering stakes of 20 p/c to $/€100, stats come rolling in pretty much exactly as they did in Cabin Crashers. That means an RTP value of 96.18% - 96.19% rising to 96.49%-96.52% when buying free spins. The math model runs in a highly volatile manner, while base and bonus game rules are kept to an easily manageable minimum. Basically, you want to hit as many multiplier wilds as possible in both game phases, where they pick up an extra ability in free spins.Zagging across the game's 5-reel, 3-row panel are 20 fixed paylines to land winning combinations of 3-5 matching symbols on. Low pay symbols include graffiti-style 10-A card ranks worth 1.25 to 2.5x the bet for five, then nunchucks, broken bottles, knuckle dusters, clown masks, chicken masks, and bunny masks are the medium win symbols. Landing five of them creates payouts worth 5 to 40 times your stake. Take note - multiplier wilds are one of Slugger Time's cornerstones. They land on reels 2, 3, or 4 in the base or bonus game and substitute any pay symbol. Multiplier wilds are given random values of x2-x5 in the base game, and if more than one wild is used in a win, the values are added before being applied.Slugger Time: Slot FeaturesSlugger Time reaches its climax during Chicken Siege Free Spins, triggered when 3 Fight scatter symbols land on reels 1, 3, and 5. This initiates the Fight Picker, where players pick the bonus round that suits them best. There are four options, and Fights with fewer free spins have a higher risk but a higher win potential. Here they are:Fight 1 – 12 free spins where multiplier wilds have values of x2 or x3.Fight 2 – 9 free spins where multiplier wilds have values of x3 or x4.Fight 3 – 6 free spins where multiplier wilds have values of x4 or x5.Fight 4 – randomly awards 6-20 free spins and random multipliers of x2-x5.What makes Chicken Siege Free Spins better is the fact that multiplier wilds are sticky, so they remain in position for the remainder of the feature once they hit.Buy FeatureIf you reside in an appropriate market, you may be able to buy the feature instead of waiting for it to trigger naturally. The cost is 75x the bet, and once bought, players are presented with the same four choices as covered above.Slugger Time: Slot VerdictThere was a lot to like about the previous slot, Cabin Crashers, so if that one tickled your fancy, Slugger Time is sure to as well. Among other things, the vibe has more or less remained the same, despite going from B-Grade horror to oddly masked hooligans terrorising a subway station and causing a general ruckus. The violence is only really hinted at though, more a veiled threat, making Slugger Time suitable for a general audience rather than homing in on users particularly intrigued by gang warfare.A similar vibe gets exactly the same features, and, in some ways, it feels strange that Quickspin has left everything beneath the skin completely the same. Not knocking them for it or anything, just expressing the sensation of surprise which arose when first perusing the paytable. It might have been nice if something new had been added, yet no major worries since what's here works. As for the Chicken Siege Free Spins, it was a case of getting comfy on the first three reels. Having Multiplier Wilds on reels 2 and 3 was a fairly common occurrence but having at least one present on all three middle reels was rare. Obviously, the more wilds, the merrier, and if you can stack 'em up, Slugger Time produces wins of up to 22,144x the bet.Despite all the masked gang posturing, the real star of the show remains the thrills produced by the straightforward features. Like Bruce Lee swinging a set of nunchucks, sticky wild multipliers are as entertaining as ever, should you manage to get a few of them working together. So, to experience a somewhat darkly humorous theme, in an unusual setting, presented in comic book style, then Slugger Time is well worth a spin or two to see what it can do.

title: Big Bad Wolf: Pigs of Steel
structured_summary: Big Bad Wolf: Pigs of Steel is a slot themed around the classic Three Little Pigs tale, set in a picturesque countryside with a steel-constructed gaming grid. It features Tumbling Reels, Piggy Wild transformations, protected symbols, and three escalating bonus rounds with multipliers and free spins. The reviewer praises its engaging gameplay flow, successful blend of old and new mechanics, and high max win potential of 18,081x the bet. The game boasts charming, peaceful visuals and fitting audio that maintain the series' warm, porky atmosphere.
review: Big Bad Wolf: Pigs of Steel: Slot OverviewThe famous children's story The Three Little Pigs is a classic tale of putting in hard work first, then enjoying the fruits of your labour after, rather than slacking off from the get-go. The story has offered sound advice for youngsters (as well as not-so-youngsters) for years and has served software provider Quickspin well in other ways, too. The Swedish casino games designer first garnered success with Big Bad Wolf in the early/mid-2010s, followed by Big Bad Wolf Christmas Special about eight years later, Big Bad Wolf Megaways after that, and a Big Bad Wolf Live edition. Proving there's more to huff 'n' puff to blow out of the tale comes the next instalment - Big Bad Wolf: Pigs of Steel.If you're going to build something that lasts, steel is a pretty smart material to use. Without steel, we wouldn't have skyscrapers all over the place, which, when you think about it, might not be so bad, in some ways. The world would probably look a lot closer to the scene players are presented with in Big Bad Wolf: Pigs of Steel. Here, the pig vs wolf showdown occurs in a green scene of rolling hills, an old-fashioned windmill, and quaint cottages dotted about the place. It's not the exact same view as in previous Big Bad Wolf games, but the atmosphere is the same: picturesque, peaceful, and… porky.Big Bad Wolf: Pigs of Steel slot - base gameSet within a structure made of straw is Big Bad Wolf: Pigs of Steel's gaming grid, constructed of 5 reels, each holding 3 rows, and crossed by 25 paylines, awarding wins left to right from the first reel onwards. Available in four RTP models, the default return value is 96.14%, and at all return levels, the volatility is high (5 out of 5), while bets of 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin may be locked in.The three little piggies of the tale are used as the 3 high-paying symbols. After them are an axe and a trowel as the mids, then 10 to A card ranks as the lows. Hitting a 5 OAK winning line triggers a payout of 1 to 2 times the bet for the royals, 5 times the bet for the mids, and 15 to 25 times the bet for the highs. Wilds appear on all five reels, and Piggy Wilds can appear through one of the features, as we will see. Wilds of all kinds substitute any normal pay symbols, and 5 of the regular wilds pay 40x the bet, while wild versions of the pig symbols have the same value as their non-wild counterpart.Big Bad Wolf: Pigs of Steel: Slot FeaturesBig Bad Wolf: Pigs of Steel slot - free spinsBig Bad Wolf: Pigs of Steel's features are a mix of old and new, quite a lot of new, too. Here's how this one works.Tumbling ReelsThe Tumbling Reels mechanic removes winning symbols from the reels when they have formed winning combinations. Symbols tumble top to bottom, creating another chance to win. Tumble sessions end when no new win hits.Piggy WildAfter tumble 2, 4, and 6 in a sequence, the red, green, and blue piggy pay symbols, respectively, become Piggy Wilds.Pigs of SteelPig symbols receive protection when tumbles create wins and are removed. After 3 piggy symbols have been removed, protection level 1 is achieved, and after 6 piggy symbols have been removed, protection level 2 is achieved. Protected symbols lose a level of protection during a tumble instead of being removed from the board. A symbol is no longer protected when it loses all of its levels of protection.Bonus GamesLanding 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols awards 10 free spins in the Bonus Game, Super Bonus Game, or Ultra Bonus Game, respectively. Each bonus round has a win multiplier, starting on x1, x2, or x3, respectively, for the Bonus Game, Super Bonus Game, or Ultra Bounce Game. Scatters only appear in the base game. In all 3 bonus rounds, collecting Moon symbols triggers a reward. Collecting 3 Moon symbols awards +2 free spins and doubles the win multiplier, while collecting 6 Moon symbols awards +2 free spins and doubles the win multiplier again. In the Bonus Game, the Pigs of Steel and Piggy Wild meters reset between spins. In the Super Bonus Game, the Pigs of Steel meter does not reset between spins, but the Piggy Wild meter does, and in the Ultra Bonus Game, the Pigs of Steel and Piggy Wild meters do not reset between spins.Buy FeatureBy paying 60 times the bet, players can buy 3+ scatter symbols to trigger the feature (96.41%) or 240x the bet to buy 4+ scatter symbols to trigger the feature (RTP 96.78%).Big Bad Wolf: Pigs of Steel slot - bonus buy optionsBig Bad Wolf: Pigs of Steel: Slot VerdictBig Bad Wolf is a fine example of a sequel that mixes just the right amount of old and new. Doing so both honours its elders and caters to fans of earlier games while also being a follow-up which doesn't feel forced, pointless, or overshadowed by the past. The series has undergone graphical changes as the slots have progressed, but it's the evolution of the gameplay that really sticks out, and Big Bad Wolf: Pigs of Steel is one of the most playable of the lot. Some may find it the most playable.For starters, the game has a great flow to it, with action popping from numerous directions - tumbles, Piggy Wild transformations, and the protected symbols element. On their own, they function well enough to keep the base game busy, wins ticking over, and engagement levels buoyant. Then you've got the three bonus rounds, each higher tier round that bit better than the lower ones. The only sort of furrowed brow moment was realising it was not possible to guarantee buying the Ultra Bonus Game or being able to upgrade to it from the Super Bonus Game. If you don't get 5 scatters to trigger the feature organically or get lucky with a bonus buy, it might be pretty elusive, like catching flies with chopsticks. Never mind, all three bonus rounds are capable of huffin' n' puffin' moments, and Big Bad Wolf: Pigs of Steel's max win of 18,081 times the bet is worth brushing up on construction skills for.Considering how popular Big Bad Wolf became, it is surprising how long it took Quickspin to come up with another one. The studio is certainly making up for lost time now, though, but the good news is Big Bad Wolf: Pigs of Steel is a highly playable game that evolves the series while also catering to fans of past work.

title: Wild Fishin Wild Ways
structured_summary: Wild Fishin' Wild Ways is a fishing-themed slot set in a seaside town with an evolving reel grid and aquatic adventure vibe. It features a unique Wild Fishin' money symbol collect mechanic, expanding reels, and a Wild Ways activation, alongside free spins with growing win ways. The reviewer finds the game offers a distinctive twist on fishing slots with solid gameplay but notes its high volatility and modest max win of 2,000x bet. Visually, the game boasts a Pixar-like, vibrant seaside and underwater aesthetic with immersive audio enhancing the angling atmosphere.
review: Wild Fishin' Wild Ways: Slot OverviewHow times change, huh? It wasn't long ago when it seemed like every other game hitting the shelves was Irish, Egyptian-themed or 'book' mechanised. Now it kind of feels like it's the time of the fishing (or fishin' as it's usually written) themed slot. However you feel about that, here comes another piscine-based option from software provider Jelly in association with Yggdrasil called Wild Fishin' Wild Ways. Going hand in glove with the theme is a money symbol collect feature which Wild Fishin' Wild Ways has, but to mix things up, Jelly has tinkered with the method of collection while dropping in an expanded ways, and reels feature in the process.Wild Fishin' Wild Ways is rife with little (and larger) things which break the normal fishin' slot rules. Okay, maybe not break the rules, but how about bending them? One is that the base game takes place above water, near a quaint seaside town as the sun rises on a pleasant-looking day. A seaweed-coated 5-reel, 3-row game grid takes centre stage, and a counter on top indicates a starting value of 243 ways which grows when the panel expands. Jelly has painted an inviting picture to host the fishin' action, giving the game a vaguely Pixar, Finding Nemo quality - more so when free spins trigger and play moves beneath the waves.Wild Fishin Wild Ways slotThe angling antics begin by picking a stake of 25 p/c to $/€100 per spin and casting off on any device. Be aware Wild Fishin' Wild Ways has a variety of RTP versions, where the highest one is 95.1%. The volatility is high, though max win not so much, while hit frequency comes in at around 1 in 4 or 5 spins depending on the RTP model.Hooking fish might be more exciting, but normal ways wins are made up of three to five matching symbols. The lower portion of the paytable has four wooden J-A card ranks; then, there are fishing rods, worms, boats, and birds as the four high pays. Landing a five of a kind winning way is worth 0.5-1x the bet for the lower paying symbols and 2.5-10x the bet for five high pays. Wilds display a fisherman on them and can substitute for any symbol except the Bonus symbol.Wild Fishin' Wild Ways: Slot FeaturesWild Fishin Wild Ways slotAnother thing the wild can do is trigger the Wild Fishin' feature. This occurs when 2 wild symbols land on reels 1 and 2. During the Wild Fishin' feature, any fish on reel 3 are caught, and if a fish is caught on reel 3, reel 4 becomes eligible to catch fish on. If fish land on reels 3 and 4, then they can then be caught on reel 5. This left-to-right reel activation is called Wild Ways. Fish on reel three have prizes worth 0.5-4x, those on reel 4 have values of 4-15x, while fish on reel 5 have cash prizes of 15-250x.Free SpinsThere are two ways of winning free spins. One is to land a bonus symbol on reels 3, 4, or 5 while the Wild Fishin' feature is active. The other is by landing 3 bonus symbols on reels 3, 4, and 5. In both scenarios, 10 free spins are awarded. During free spins, when the Wild Fishin' feature is activated, reels 3, 4, and 5 can expand up to 6 rows high, creating up to 1,944 ways to win. Expanded reels reset for the next free spin. Lastly, when the feature is retriggered by landing a bonus symbol during a Wild Fishin' sequence, +5 additional free spins are awarded.Wild Fishin Wild Ways slot - splash screenWild Fishin' Wild Ways: Slot VerdictJelly's an interesting one. Since they burst on the scene with Savanna Roar, they've tended to flirt with conventionality while adding individual touches throughout their games. Wild Fishin' Wild Ways is another example. Being a fishing game, there's a fish symbol/money collect thing going on, but the way it functions with the Wild Ways element and the growing grid is unusual. The mechanics aren't entirely unique, as we saw a similar system used in Gold Coin Studios' slot Cairo Link & Win where two Eye of Ra symbols on the first two reels expanded the other three reels if you're interested in an Egyptian-themed version.Back to fish, and for the most part, Wild Fishin' Wild Ways meets or exceeds what you'd hope to find in an angling themed slot. The atmosphere is sea-going, the fisherman looks the part, and there are opportunities to haul in prize-bearing fish. If you're used to collect symbols pulling in money symbols whenever they land might need a few spins to acclimate to the Wild Fishin' method. One reason is that Wild Fishin'/Wild Ways didn't trigger a whole lot in the base game, though as the rules state, it does theoretically occur more in free spins. Then again, some fishin' slots only offer a collect feature during free spins. Doing things this way can create a snowball effect when consecutively collecting prizes off reels 3-5 and is probably a contributing factor in Wild Fishin' Wild Ways' high volatility. It doesn't exactly have high potential, though, topping out at 2,000x the bet. A while ago, that relatively low figure would've been less of a possible issue, but fishing slot potential has been inching up lately, and one wonders whether Wild Fishin' Wild Ways would have benefited from a more enticing top prize.If fishing-minded players are cool with that number, though, then taking Wild Fishin' Wild Ways for a spin should be worth their time. It's got the requisite fish/money collect activity, a salty situation to experience it in, and conducts itself in a rather unique way.

title: Treasure Rain
structured_summary: Treasure Rain is an Asian-themed slot by NetEnt, featuring a clichéd Chinese motif centered around the God of Wealth, Caishen. The game includes Avalanche mechanics, increasing multipliers, and free spins with enhanced multipliers for bigger wins. The reviewer finds it enjoyable for fans of Gonzo’s Quest or Asian slots but ultimately uninspired and repetitive. Visually, it uses traditional red and gold colors with simple symbols and a modest background, matched by straightforward audio.
review: Treasure Rain (NetEnt): OverviewIt is time to chalk up another NetEnt entry into the Asian themed slot market. And if you’ve seen the screenshots, yes, this is another Gonzo’s Quest styled reskin. The last one we reviewed, Magic Maid Café, was a bizarre anime-styled Japanese affair full of cartoon maids and cupcakes. Treasure Rain moves the action a bit further east to give it an additional Chinese flavour. It’s also a bit more conventional that Magic Maid Café was. Alright, it’s more than conventional, it flirts with being one of the most clichéd Asian themed slots around.Surrounding the gird is a lot of red and gold styling with a couple of lanterns and bamboo screens to lay the scene. As symbols tumble into the 5x3 grid, clouds and cliffs bathed in golden light can be seen in the background. The user interface is handily laid out along the bottom of the screen where players can select a bet level from 1-5, and coin levels from 0.01 to 0.5. Fiddling with these settings provides total stakes worth 20 p/c to $/€50 per spin. From the total stake, bets are spread out over 20 fixed paylines to calculate wins.Main gameThe paytable consists of 7 main game symbols. Four are card icons, J, Q, K and Ace, while the remaining three are bonsai trees, frogs, and Caishen symbols. Different parts of China refer to Caishen as the God of Wealth, or money, or valuables, treasures, luck, profitability, or gambling. No wonder this guy is so popular in the slots world. Given his reputation, he is obviously the most valuable symbol in Treasure Rain and the one you want to fall.There is also a wild symbol on hand to help out by substituting for any of the base game pay symbols. Hit frequency is steady at around 4.1/10, and with its medium/high volatility, juicy wins are possible, though Treasure Rain is not a slot with huge potential. RTP sits at 95.97% like its parent slot, and the game’s extra features have remained basically the same. So far, so Gonzo.Treasure Rain (NetEnt): FeaturesFree spins game in actionWins form when three or more of the same symbols land on a payline. When a winning combination lands it triggers the Avalanche feature. For new players, it means that the symbols that made up the winner are removed from the grid to let new ones tumble into place. If more winning combinations land, as a result, this process continues, and will keep going until no more winners appear. The kicker is not just producing consecutive combos on one spin. But each win causes the multiplier above the reels to increase from x1 to x2, x3, and max out at x5.Along with Avalanche wins there is one extra feature. If three scatter symbols land, they award 10 Free Falls (free spins essentially). These free spins can be retriggered again to provide players with up to 20 spins in total. Free spin rounds are played using the same rules as the base game with one significant difference. Each initial win comes with a x3 multiplier rather than x1, and with Avalanche wins it moves up to x6, x9, and x15 at the most. As you can see, all wins are worth three times as much during free spins as in the main game.Treasure Rain (NetEnt): VerdictStrip away Gonzo’s graphics, fill in the gaps with some Asian clichés, and you have nailed Treasure Rain. This mean that players who liked Gonzo’s Quest and are partial to Asian themed games will be in slots heaven. Most other players will struggle to get too excited about Treasure Rain. There is nothing here that we haven’t seen before. That will either be music to your ears or cause steam to come pouring out of them. The 7 base game symbols are tried and true classics of the genre, some might say boring. As is the uninspired red and gold trim around the grid, and the background imagery. That’s not to say the gameplay is dull; it’s no fluke that Gonzo’s Quest was and is so popular. It’s simple, relentless, and can open up satisfying wins when the multipliers are factored in.At the end of the day this slot is for either hardcore Asian theme fans who are compelled to try them all or curious Gonzo diehards. If we invoke a self-induced memory blank for a moment and treat it as a standalone slot it is enjoyable, if you’re into this sort of thing. The gameplay is fun, well-paced and has a good hit rate. Potential isn’t amazing, but it has its moments. A full payline of Caishen symbols, will get you 125 times the total stake; add in the maximum x15 multiplier and you are looking at 1,875 times the stake on a single free spin.Yet, we can’t delude ourselves in that manner for long. As far as reskinning their back catalogue for the Asian market is going, Treasure Rain ranks as one of NetEnt’s most uninspired yet. Symbols and imagery lack imagination, to say the least, and the gameplay is good but we’ve seen it all before. Overall, Treasure Rain is a mildly entertaining, yet completely forgettable experience.

title: Return of the Dead
structured_summary: Return of the Dead is a classic Egyptian-themed slot closely resembling the popular Book of Ra style. It features a 5-reel, 10-payline setup with high volatility, free spins triggered by a special expanding symbol, and a notably high RTP of 96.71%. The reviewer finds it a straightforward, nostalgic game with solid free spin potential but lacking innovation among numerous similar slots. The game sports a vintage land-based aesthetic with an Arabic-Western soundtrack and simple, old-school sound effects.
review: Return of the Dead: Slot OverviewIs it possible for something to return if it never really went away? Produced by developer Reel Kingdom and powered by Pragmatic Play, Return of the Dead is another in a long line of seemingly endless Book of Ra clones. This one stays particularly close to the original too, in more ways than one. As well as gameplay and features, the overall look has a strong classic slot vibe going on. Despite the similarities, there might be one or two reasons fans of Ra may wish to choose Return of the Dead over the competition. Yes, it's undoubtedly what most would consider a rip off, but that's a headache for the companies involved. From a players perspective, let's see if it's worth a go.If there is any vista that returns again and again to slots, it’s the sun rising over the Giza Plateau. Camels travel over desert sands while pyramids stand majestically over the scene on the horizon. Pleasant, enough, with the old school looking 5-reel, 10-payline grid helps awaken a few nostalgic yearnings. Pepper on the Arabic soundtrack, which has a slightly Western feel to it, as well as the typical Indiana Jones colour palette, and you’re done.Return of the Dead can be played on any device, and your feelings towards the main character might influence how you play. Landscape mode on a mobile or desktop might be your best option if you don’t want Rich Wilde's long lost brother watching your every move. Bets can be set from 10 p/c to €250 per spin, then off we go.Hard core gamers who like basic, to the point gaming, will appreciate Return of the Dead’s high volatility. Free spins are where it’s at, but occasionally the odd high value commination drops from nowhere to make up for the numerous dead spins. The default RTP on the other hand will satisfy pretty much any player with a great rating of 96.71% - possibly the highest of any 'Book of' slot to date. More on this in our verdict, so keep on reading.There are no surprises when it comes to gameplay. Two or three of a kind from the leftmost reel onwards trigger a payout. Three is needed for the 10 to A royals, just two for the scarab, Horus, Pharaoh, or the stock image of a smiling man symbol. Values are good; they’re at the higher end of the ‘book of’ scale. Get lines of five premiums to pick up rewards from 75 to 500 times the stake.Return of the Dead: Slot FeaturesReturn of the Dead - free spins with special expanded symbolNo surprises here either, the centrepiece is a triggered round of free spins. The key, as ever, is the book symbol which is both scatter and wild. As a wild, the book replaces any other symbol to make a combination. Also, as a wild, it is worth up to 500x for a line of five.As a scatter, 3, 4, or 5 in view award 2x, 20x, or 200x the total bet, plus 10 free spins. Before the round begins, one pay symbol is randomly chosen to be the special expanding symbol. During free spins, after any wins have been paid, the special symbol expands vertically to cover all three positions on the reel. These expanded symbols pay even if they are in non-adjacent positions.Note, special symbols only expand if enough are in view to form a win. Books remain in the bonus as wild and scatter. If three simultaneously land, 10 more free spins are awarded. There is no limit to the number of retriggers that may occur.Return of the Dead: Slot VerdictHaving tested a few pretty complicated slots lately, Return of the Dead sort of made an appropriate palette cleanser. Its simplistic rules, not to mention familiar gameplay, made it easy to kick back, relax, and watch a few spins fly by. Free spins are about as good as they get in these types of games, which is still pretty darn good when high-value symbols become the chosen one and expand in numbers. Then again, he’s a dead ringer for Rich Wilde, or even John Hunter if he traded in the hat and went wild with the teeth whitener. Other than the 96.71% RTP, there’s little to distinguish Return of the Dead from the 700 others like it.Still, at least Reel Kingdom hasn’t fluffed it, so Return of the King is a pretty enjoyable game to play however hard it can be to admit for any purists given its clone status. Book slots tend to have more modern looks as time goes by due to graphic advancements. Players who feel like a trip back in time might appreciate Return of the King’s classic, land-based look.
