Another tick in the right column is that Reel Kingdom has used symbol values on the higher end of the spectrum, meaning it is possible to hit 5,000 times the bet on a single spin when smiley guy covers the reels.In the end, it’s hard to get too worked up about yet another one of these. Return of the Dead is an okay example of a ‘book of’ slot, and the default RTP is a positive, but there’s nothing new to see. Unless you find a version with the highest RTP setting, there is no real reason to play Return of the Dead, something that also make a slot like this incredibly hard to rate.

title: Panda's Fortune 2
structured_summary:
1. Panda's Fortune 2 is an Asian-themed slot featuring gentle giant pandas set against a mountainous backdrop with traditional Chinese elements.  
2. The game offers 5 reels, 25 fixed paylines, golden symbol prizes, and a free spins feature with sticky golden symbols for enhanced winning potential.  
3. The reviewer finds it a decent sequel with improved winning possibilities but overall familiar and targeted mainly at fans of Asian slots or the original game.  
4. Visually, it boasts high-definition symbols and a soothing traditional Chinese soundtrack, creating a rich and calming atmosphere.
review: Panda's Fortune 2: Slot OverviewWith their mild demeanour and cute looks, it's easy to forget Pandas are part of the wider bear family. Well, black and white giant pandas are; the red ones apparently have more in common with racoons. It's the giant version we focus on in Pragmatic Play's follow up slot Panda's Fortune 2. You know the type, they're the ones covered in handfuls of soft fur, which look like someone's gone overboard with the mascara. These gentle giants are a symbol of peace and friendship in China, so it makes sense they would be put to use in an Asian themed slot.Obviously, this isn't the first time the bamboo gobblers have appeared on the reels. Panda's Fortune 2 is the sequel to a slot released back in 2017, and the two games share more similarities than differences. For starters, both employ a 5-reel game grid with 3 rows and 25 fixed paylines to land winning combinations across. Visually, part two has a higher definition look to its symbols, and the game has moved from bamboo forests to one more commonly found in slots. That is, on the side of a mountain, all dreamy peaks, forests, and pagodas, layered over by a traditional Chinese soundtrack. If you've played one of these sorts of games before, you'll no doubt know the drill.Panda's Fortune 2 is playable on any device from smartphone to desktop, offering a range of bets as low as 25 p/c and as high as $/€125. Along with most aspects of the game, the default RTP is bigger than before, coming in at the generous value of 96.51%. Volatility is high, too, rated 5 out of 5, so don't expect a blizzard of wins, though when golden frames start to stick during free spins, the action can get pretty interesting.Three to five matching symbols on a payline from the first reel constitute a winner and trigger a payout. On the lower side of the paytable are calligraphically styled 9-A card royals, while high pays are bonsai trees, fish, frogs, lions, and interestingly, butterflies. All have a rich Asian appearance and look quite nice. Values aren't huge, where a five of a kind premium hit is worth a payout of 4 to 8 times the stake. Our panda pal is used as the wild symbol, appearing on reels 2, 3, 4, or 5. Panda wilds substitute for all symbols except the scatter.Panda's Fortune 2: Slot FeaturesPanda's Fortune 2 - free spinsIn the base game and during free spins, all pay symbols except the bonus have a special golden version that can land on any reel. They have the same value as regular symbols and form combinations as normal. Where they differ is when a golden symbol is used in a winning combination, an extra prize may be awarded.For any golden symbol in a five of a kind win, a random prize worth 5x to 4,998x the bet is awarded. For each golden wild in a 3 or 4 of a kind win, a 3x the bet prize is won. Or, each golden high-value symbol in a 3 or 4 symbol combo awards 2x the bet, while each golden low-value tile in 3 or 4 symbol combo awards a 1x the bet prize. All prizes are awarded in addition to the total win of the spin.Keep an eye out for the scatter yin yang symbol as 3, 4, or 5 on the reels award 12 free spin plus a payout of 2x, 15x, or 100x the total bet. During free spins, every time a golden symbol hits, the spot it landed on is highlighted in gold and stays that way until the end. From then on, only golden symbols land in marked positions. Hitting three or more bonus symbols during the round awards +8 extra free spins.Panda's Fortune 2: Slot VerdictPanda's Fortune 2 is one of those sequels that players wouldn't have missed out too much if Pragmatic Play hadn't decided to do a follow-up. The exception, of course, is Panda's Fortune fanatics (if there are any), then the bigger prizes and extra ways to win them will be A-okay. As far as these Asian-centric games go, Panda's Fortune 2 is alright. It's got the green, gold, and red trim; the location is comfortingly familiar, as are the creatures on the reels. Pandas aren't hugely common, so there is a certain level of individuality if we are being generous.To its credit, Panda's Fortune 2 also has greater winning potential than before, and the upper echelon of prizes available from golden symbol combinations aren't bad. If you are going to spend any amount of time playing Panda's Fortune 2, it is worth memorising how the golden symbols affect the various winning combinations. If not, it can feel like the game misses a few prizes if you aren't fully clued up. However, when odd larger wins slip in out of the blue, they cause the occasional happy surprise.The top prize is a little oddly valued. Presumably, Pragmatic Play cut the figure from 5,000x to 4,998x to squeeze a numeral '8' in there, which, as most players probably know, is an auspicious number in Chinese culture. From a purely materialistic standpoint, the sequel is a more appealing game to play, as its max win figure of 5,000x surpasses what was available in the first Panda's Fortune game.Like many, if not all of these sorts of games from Pragmatic Play, Panda's Fortune 2 is a custom-built slot for a custom made audience. As with any precision engineered game, if you're not in its crosshairs, it'll be nigh on impossible to get enthusiastic about what it does. In short, if you have a soft spot for cute lumbering bears or are sifting around for an updated Asian themed slot, then Panda's Fortune 2 gets the job done. If not, it's more of the same from the Asian slots menu.

title: USA Flip
structured_summary: USA Flip is a stunt-themed slot featuring a patriotic eagle performing bike tricks in a lively American arena. It offers free spins with flipped reels, near-win re-spins, and walking wilds that move across the reels. The reviewer finds it a fun but modestly rewarding game with a medium volatility and a max 1,000x stake payout. The game sports bold red, white, and blue visuals with a dynamic stadium atmosphere, matching its energetic theme.
review: USA Flip: Slot OverviewAccording to stuntman Lance Murdoch on the Simpsons, 'Bones heal, chicks dig scars, and the United States of America has the best doctor-to-daredevil ratio in the world.' It's probably not the best 'advice' to give a kid thinking about jumping over Springfield Gorge on his skateboard, but it's this dicing-with-danger mentality that leads us into USA Flip, an online slot from Swedish developer Play'n GO. USA Flip is a celebration of doing stunts on bikes in full view of thousands of spectators – muck it up, and there are plenty of witnesses with mobile phones filming the booboo. Get it right, and arena glory is there for the taking. Which side of the divide will USA Flip the slot fall on?To push the US of A theme a little further, it's not some young whippersnapper on a bike looking for glory. No, riding the dirt bike around this track is a sunglassed eagle with arms, legs, and a cape, dolled up in red, white, and blue. His domain is the arena, filled with more red, white, and blue, plus the aforementioned spectators. Sitting at the centre of the stadium sits a partly see-through game grid, in what is thematically at least, a loud, bold, brash looking game.USA Flip slot - base gameStatistically speaking, USA Flip isn't exactly the loudest, boldest, brashest game on the market, however. In fact, it is one of the least volatile games to come our way from Play'n GO in a while. The math model is rated 4 out of 10, or medium, for volatility which may or may not be your exact cup of chai mocha latte. The RTP, meanwhile, comes in a variety of configurations, depending on the market, topping out at 96.2%, plus a number of lower settings besides so it pays to check. Stakes vary from a budget-stretching 1 p/c per spin up to $/€100 at the most, all available on any device.The reason players can penny bet on this thing is because paylines are adjustable, from 1 up to 20 at the most. The game utilises a 5-reel, 3-row game grid, which triggers payouts when matching symbols land across them on adjacent reels, starting from the leftmost side. Appearing on the panel are J-A card ranks, then gloves, fireworks, helmets, wheels, and bike pay symbols. Five-of-a-kind wins are worth 20 coins for the card royals or 40 to 250 coins for the premiums. High-paying symbols can land stacked on the last two reels in the base game or the first two reels in free spins. Lastly, wilds have the same value as the top-paying motorbike tile and can also substitute for any normal pay symbol.USA Flip: Slot FeaturesUSA Flip slot - walking wildsHere's where the flip part of USA Flip comes into play, and the game's features include free spins, near-win Re-spins, and walking wilds.Free SpinsThe free spins round is awarded when 3 or more Star Bonus Scatter symbols land anywhere on the grid. Once triggered, 12 free spins are awarded with the reels flipped, reversing the order. Landing 3 or more scatters during the feature awards an additional +12 free spins, up to a maximum of 120.Re-SpinA near-win Re-spin is triggered on a losing spin when a full stack of the same symbol lands on the first and second reels. This includes wild symbols. Then, the middle reel re-spins with all other reels locked in place. Free spins can be triggered by a re-spin.Walking WildAfter a re-spin is triggered, stacked wild symbols can land on the middle reel. This stack of wilds becomes a walking wild symbol which moves one position to the right for each re-spin until it lands on the last reel. One more re-spin occurs on all reels when the walking wild stops on the final reel. During free spins, the walking wild moves to the left by 1 position on each respin instead of to the right. When the walking wild is active, scatter symbols cannot land.USA Flip slot - paytable infoUSA Flip: Slot VerdictWhatever else it might or might not do, USA Flip is a game that lives up to its name. For one, there are loads of US of A references, flags, eagles and so on, to go along with the flipping function. Not to sound negative, but the flipping thing wasn't super ingenuitive. It basically means high-pay stacks can land on the opposite side of the board in free spins compared to the base game, and the walking stack walks in the other direction, too. Not exactly monstrously complex, but it does add an element of flip, making it theoretically more likely to link wins with stacked high pays when they're on the left than when they're on the right. You'd also tend to expect there to be more action from a walking wild stack if it's heading towards the first reel than the last one.When it comes to payouts, though, the action is fairly limited. At max bet, with all lines active, the most USA Flip can coax up is unusually trivial for Play'n GO at 1,000x the stake. When playing around with paylines and bet sizes, a higher bet multiplier might be coaxed out, perhaps? However, in a game revolving around stacked symbols and stacked wilds, lessening the lines is going to stunt the feature's effectiveness. Still, penny slots aren't super common, though Play'n GO has added to the list in the past, Pimped being one that instantly sprang to mind as a higher potential alternative.So, a raucously themed slot has been paired with a less-than-raucous math model and relatively modest winning possibilities, but there are good times to be found here by the right player. If bike games like Dead Rider's Trail were a tad too rough going, a tad too finicky, then USA Flip's simpler root beer and hot dog at a stadium vibe might be a better fit. The opposite is true, though, where games like Dead Rider's Trail leave the likes of USA Flip chewing dust in terms of innovation, depth, winning possibilities and potential thrills and spills.

title: Buffalo King Megaways
structured_summary: Buffalo King Megaways features a North American wildlife theme with iconic beasts like buffalo and eagles set against rugged outdoor landscapes. The game offers up to 200,704 ways to win, cascading tumbles, an Ante Bet for increased free spin chances, and multipliers attached to wilds during free spins. The reviewer finds it a faithful, solid remake with a unique multiplier system but notes the max win of 5,000x is modest compared to the original's exaggerated figures. A rustic visual style and outdoorsy soundtrack maintain the original’s atmospheric charm without drastic changes.
review: Buffalo King Megaways: Slot OverviewNorth American nature slots blow through the lobby like tumbleweeds these days, and one example helping to define the genre was Pragmatic Play's 2019 release Buffalo King. One of Buffalo King's calling cards was its high advertised potential, or should that be insanely unachievable potential? Whatever the case, it ended up being a hit and a benchmark for others to be judged by ever since. It was also another game ripe for a Megaways conversion – partly due to its classic status, partly because hey, why not? Everything else seems to be getting the makeover. With that, let's get in touch with our spirit guides as we tramp through America's backyard alongside its biggest beasts.The first noticeable difference is the drastically enlarged, albeit technically unremarkable, Megaways setup. Lashed wooden beams prop up 6 main reels holding 2-7 symbols each as well as an up top horisontal reel holding 4 symbols. At full whack, a massive 200,704 ways to win are in play, compared to 4,096 ways of the original. The rest of the view, what you can make out at least, is essentially the same rocks and canyons as before. An outdoorsy soundtrack completes the scene, and fans of the first Buffalo King won't be scared away by anything too radical, aesthetically, at least.Numerically, Buffalo King Megaways starts to diverge, starting with an improved default RTP configuration of 96.52%. If nothing else, you can count on Pragmatic Play to deliver solid return values - beware though as this provider uses flexible RTP which may be lower depending on where you play. Always make sure to check the paytable. The highly volatile gaming is available on any device and allows bets ranging from 20 p/c to $/€125 per spin. This is the base bet level, at least. Buffalo King Megaways lets players up the ante, literally via an Ante Bet feature. For an additional 25% spin cost, players double their chances of triggering free spins. Keep in mind the Ante Bet does not affect symbol values.Even though Megaways provides a shed load more ways to win, symbol values have actually increased as well. Starting on the lower side of the paytable, we find 10 to A card icons spinning amidst moose, wolves, cougars, eagles, and buffalo. All are North American staples, topping out with a line of buffalos worth 20 times your stake. The game also includes a wild symbol that appears on reels 2, 3, or 4 to replace any standard pay symbols.Buffalo King Megaways: Slot FeaturesLike most Megaways slots, Buffalo King Megaways utilises a cascading mechanic, here referred to as the tumble feature. It kicks in after every win to remove winning symbols from the reels. New tiles drop down to fill the empty spaces, which can trigger another win. Tumbles keep on coming as long as wins keep on lining up.What you also really want to see is 4 or more scatter symbols hitting the reels. When this happens, you're handed 12, 17, or 22 free spins as well as a win of 5x, 20x, or 100x, for 4, 5, or 6 scatter symbols in view. Free spins make use of a win multiplier, though interestingly, it's not the progressive type normally found in a Megaways game. Instead, wilds now appear with x2, x3, or x5 multipliers attached to them. These values accrue on single spins, meaning you might get an x2 on the initial win, then an x3 appearing on the next tumble. The total amount won from that spin sequence is then increased by x6. Multipliers do not increase forever; instead, they reset between free spins. Finally, the bonus round may be extended by +5 free spins each time 3 bonus symbols hit - without limits.Last up is a feature buy option, where you can trigger free spins for a cost of 100x the total bet - where available.Buffalo King Megaways: Slot VerdictFans of the older game should be pretty happy with what Pragmatic Play has done in the remake. Wistful cartoon majesty made up much of the first's magic, and this has been faithfully recreated here. Juicy multipliers were another key draw, which Pragmatic Play has both altered and retained at the same time. Buffalo King Megaways' headlining numbers are nowhere near as impressive as its predecessors, but how realistic were they anyway? As the community has slowly come to realise over the years, the advertised potential in many of Pragmatic Play's releases has been ridiculously overexaggerated to entice players.When putting features under the microscope, it has to be said the multiplier system is similar to the one used in Sweet Bonanza. However, introducing multipliers via wild symbols makes a change from the standard progressive system following cascades that might intrigue Megaways connoisseurs. There are pros of cons to using this method, of course. It is great when several wilds appear throughout a spin cycle, though it can mean an absence of multipliers if wilds don't hit, even if you're powering through cascades like there's no tomorrow.Moving onto max win, and despite the extra ammo Megaways brings, potential has taken a major nosedive. In short, Buffalo King Megaways commands the princely sum of 5,000x the bet – an increasingly common amount from Pragmatic Play at the time of review. In contrast, the originally touted figure of 93,750x kind of felt like it was dreamt up by a boffin with a calculator, eyeballs deep on a desert-based mescaline trip. For a Megaways powered slot, the rather low potential undoubtedly comes across as a bit odd. However, being honest about what may be realistically achievable rather than making up some dream figure to lure players in is likely a better decision if you wish to remain in good standing with the regulators (and your customers).All in all, the Buffalo King Megaways makeover can, by and large, be counted as a decent slot. The stats might not be as sexy, and it doesn't really bring much new to the table, but everything else has been enlarged during the conversion process. As well as buffalo fans, players interested in seeing a slightly different use of multipliers in a Megaways game might be tempted for a look.

title: Narcos Mexico
structured_summary: Narcos Mexico is a Red Tiger slot based on the Netflix series, continuing the Narcos franchise with a cartel war theme. It features a 5x3 grid with 243 ways to win, random base game modifiers, and a unique 10x10 Cartel Spins bonus involving territory battles and multipliers. The reviewer praises its improved winning potential and engaging bonus mechanics, though finds it less thrilling than the original. The game maintains a neat cartoon-realistic style with atmospheric visuals of cartel life and fitting audio that supports its serious yet stylized vibe.
review: Narcos Mexico: Slot OverviewHold onto your margaritas, folks, the Narcos franchise is back in another branded slot titled Narcos Mexico. This one comes from Red Tiger and is based on the Netflix series Narcos: Mexico, which was penned to be the fourth season of Narcos but forked off on its own path. A similar thing has happened in the slots world. The original game, Narcos, was released by sister company NetEnt after more than a year of build-up. Unfortunately, reality didn't quite match the hype, and while Narcos looked fantastic, it ultimately lacked a knock-out punch, being disappointingly low in terms of potential. The good news is Red Tiger has seriously addressed winning potential in a follow-up slot that offers a brand-new bonus game based around cartel wars.Two things the games have in common is a similar look and vibe. Narcos Mexico has the same neat cartoon realism the first one had, representing a deadly serious theme, but in a somewhat safe way. Five bosses grace the load screen between bullet-ridden cars, palm trees, and mansions, setting the mood. Exotic, yet it makes one wonder how or why some people are willing to put up with all the danger to live in a big house by the beach, and would it really be worth it?Anyhoo, Narcos Mexico has the same setup as before, the action occurring on a 5x3, 243 ways to win game grid. Wins hit when at least three matching symbols land in any row, starting from the leftmost side. Highly volatile, the return to player value has taken a dip, now coming in at 95.7%. Stake range is much reduced as well, to the chagrin of high rollers perhaps, maxing at $/€10, or going as low as 10 p/c per spin.Hit spin, and nine different pay symbols appear throughout the base game. These are five low-value tiles depicting 9-A card ranks in front of things like skulls and dynamite. Hit five of them for a payout of 0.4 to 1 times your stake. Premium symbols are the four cartel leaders, paying out 2-5x the bet for a line of five of a kind. Slabs of dope with a scorpion on top are the wild symbol, appearing on reels 2-4 to replace any of the regular paying symbols.Narcos Mexico: Slot Features﻿In the base game, a couple of random modifiers pop up from time to time, called Supply Drop and Double Cash. When the Supply Drop is activated, an aeroplane passes above the game and leaves wild symbols on the reels. Double Cash randomly triggers after a winning spin, and the prize amount is doubled in value.Win ExchangeIn Narcos Mexico, when you win 100x your stake or more, you can exchange an amount equal to 100x the bet for 3 Cartel Spins while pocketing the remaining amount. Alternatively, when you win 30x to 100x the bet, you can gamble the lot for the chance to win 3 Cartel Spins. The gamble takes place on a bonus wheel divided into red or green segments. Land in green to win, red to lose.Cartel SpinsCartel Spins are the main bonus game, triggered when 3 Cartel Spins symbols hit on reels 1, 3, and 5 in the base game or from the Win Exchange. This round takes place on a completely different game board 10x10 in size. In the four corners are four cartel leaders, while on each spin, the remaining cells display blank spaces, Mystery Territory symbols, Phones, or Planes. If these symbols land next to a leader, they are activated, lock in place, and reset spins back to 3. Activated symbols act like so:Mystery Territory – reveals a bet multiplier value.Phone Symbol – doubles all multiplier values in the territory or territories it is adjacent to.Plane Symbol – increases the multiplier values in adjacent territories by between 1 and 5On following spins, if new symbols land next to activated symbols, they are activated as well. In this way, each cartel leaders' territory grows in size. When activated symbols touch, the leaders battle, and the stronger leader captures the other one's turf. Cartel Spins end when all spaces are filled, you run out of spins, or the win cap is reached.Narcos Mexico: Slot VerdictKudos to Red Tiger for taking the series in a new direction, and Narcos Mexico is a different experience compared to the previous Narcos game. Well, maybe not 100% new, as the look and feel are similar, in a good way, creating a positive continuity from one slot to the other. The presentation is arguably not quite as good as the original Narcos, although that impression might have been because the impact was less on a second viewing. Not taking anything away from Narcos Mexico, though. It looks good and is a nice addition to the series; it just didn't feel quite as 'dangerous' as before.However, the good news is there are elements of Narcos Mexico that leave Narcos in the dust. The most obvious one is potential. Max win let the last game down, and Red Tiger has ensured that won't happen again by pushing payouts out to a much more respectable 10,486x the bet. Winning that amount or attempting to in Cartel Spins is fairly enjoyable too. The bonus game kind of fell a bit flat at first, after some weak results. But after settling in, it started to make more sense. What seemed to work well was when cartel leaders took over other cartel leaders' territories then landing Phone and/or Plane symbols to boost the values of large swathes of the board. It might not be as viscerally exciting as the Drive-by feature, yet the turf war can certainly heat up. Having said all of that, if you're not into hold&win type games, it's possible Narcos Mexico won't float your boat either.In the end, Narcos Mexico has the sort of numbers that should appease players disappointed by the first one. Cartel Spins might not be slinging bullets around with reckless abandon all the time, but Red Tiger has progressed the series from foot soldier to a higher-ranking member of the cartel.

title: Boilin' Pots

review: Boilin' Pots: Slot OverviewIt's funny to think how back in the day, there wasn't the inundation of cooking shows that people have access to now. These days, they're everywhere, from tv to YouTube, not to mention the modern tendency to share pictures of food on social media. Okay, it's not really crafting a tasty dish for consumption, yet it involves a pot bubbling with ingredients over an open flame, so let's call it close enough for now.Boilin' Pots' brew isn't prepared in a kitchen but outdoors, in a misty forest at night. There's a Fantasma Games feel to the enterprise, and while Boilin' Pots looks a little plain when the grid is in its smallest state, it becomes quite a visual feast when reels expand or when the feature phases are active.If Boilin' Pots looks enticing, then you can pick stakes of 10 p/c to $/€40 per spin and play the game on any device. So, from a technical standpoint, Boilin' Pots is probably not the best game for some casual lols. Winning potential is suitably high to match, though, so there are sizeable rewards up for grabs for lucky brewers.At the default grid size, there are 243 ways to win, creating a payout when at least three identical symbols land left to right from the first reel onwards. Expanding the grid to its full 7-row high height means 16,807 ways to win become available. As for the paytable, symbols begin with mandrake roots, claws, eyeballs, wings, and potion bottles as the low pays, before four gem tiles and a book make up the highs. Landing a five low pay symbol way is worth a payout of 0.5x the bet rising to 1.5-10x the bet for five high pays. Toadstools are wild and can substitute for any normal paying symbols. Don't expect to see them much, however, as they only appear on the reels during the Wild Respins feature detailed next.Boilin' Pots: Slot FeaturesAs well as the wild symbol, another one of Boilin' Pots' potentially game-changing symbols is the arrow. When one of these hits, an extra row is added to the game panel, going as high as 7 rows high if enough arrow symbols hit.Wild RespinShould you be lucky enough to land 4 arrow symbols on a single spin sequence, then the Wild Respin feature is triggered. For this, respins continue to be awarded as long as winning combinations are formed. Also, respins are where wild symbols appear on the reels, possibly stacked up to three positions high. When no win appears, respins end and the game returns to its default layout.Rising Reels Bonus GameLanding 3 or 4 scatter symbols awards a payout of 10x or 100x the bet respectively and activates the bonus round. This feature is played on a 5x7 sized grid, where Cash Symbols or Win Symbols may land. Cash Symbols appear with values of 1x, 2x, 3x, 5x, 25x, or 50x the bet, while Win Symbols are worth 100x, 200x, 500x, 1,000x, or 5,000x the bet. Despite all the real estate, only the middle row is an active payline, so you only win when symbols land there.Now, 3 spins are awarded, and whenever a Cash or Win Symbol lands on the payline row, the number resets. The feature ends when spins run out, and the total win is paid. Or not, as the Rising Reels Bonus Game comes with a bonus guarantee of 5x the bet. If this much is not won during the feature, the round will continue until a win of 5x or more is achieved. As well as triggering the bonus round naturally, it may be possible to buy it as well for the cost of 50 times the total stake.Boilin' Pots: Slot VerdictLike getting a pot of soup up to its optimal temperature, it took time for Boilin' Pots to really warm-up, too. For a while, the cauldron bubbled away at mid-heat, landing one or maybe two arrow symbols to build a few extra rows - not for nought did Yggdrasil class this as 'super highly' volatile, and it took time for the game to flex. Due to the expansion mechanic, Boilin' Pots felt a little like an AvatarUX game, and once the reels were built to their full height, anticipation moved up a notch when the Wild Respins feature activated. This didn't happen super frequently in the playthrough, but Wild Respins occurred often enough to keep the game going.Boilin' Pots also brought up memories of Yggdrasil's Easter Island games, though with several major differences. The studio has swapped the knee-slapping antics of its two boisterous Moai for something less charismatic on the surface yet much more serious underneath. As such, you might want to mentally prepare for seeing all sorts of prizes torturously go to waste when they land outside the payline. It was sort of hilarious in the base game, too, when reaching 7 rows high, triggering Wild Respins, then getting nothing on the first respin, practically ending the feature before it had even begun.Presumably, putting together a potion is a delicate process of measuring ingredients and following each instruction to the letter. So it is in Boilin' Pots, a game that can easily blow up on your face if the concoction goes sour but can also reward if the mix is just right.

title: Rainbow Riches Pots of Gold
structured_summary:
Rainbow Riches Pots of Gold centers on a classic Irish leprechaun theme, popular in UK pubs and arcades.

The reviewer sees it as a nostalgic classic appealing to fans but outdated and unoriginal for others.

review: Rainbow Riches Pots of Gold: OverviewMost players outside of the UK might not get what all the fuss is about, but Rainbow Riches is an iconic brand that has gained massive popularity as a physical slot machine played in pubs and arcades across the UK. There are more variations of the game that we can keep track of, and there's even a Megaways version simply titled Rainbow Riches Megaways.Developed by Barcrest, Rainbow Riches Pots of Gold sees the lucky leprechaun join SG Digital's Mega Drop jackpot system. Each game in the network is connected to three progressive jackpots. They don't exactly boast million-dollar rewards, but they do drop fairly regularly, and often come with decent stats for a jackpot slot. For old time's sake, or because we have to, let's fire up one of the most popular series of all time in a game which will have fans rejoicing, while haters head for the rolling green hills.It might have a new jackpot, but that's about all that is new. Since Barcrest has opted for familiarity rather than modernity, Rainbow Riches Pots of Gold can't help but look hopelessly dated. But for many, the old world feels are half the charm. Players find themselves firmly on Irish ground thanks to an in-theme soundtrack, set in a peacefully pastoral scene.The game is played on a 5 reel, 3 row grid set between a Celtic weaved frame, using 20 paylines. Players set bets from 20 p/c to $/€50, with 2% feeding the jackpots. Hit play to hear a strangely soothing discordant noise on each spin, like the sound of magic, or dropping a piano down a flight of stairs. On the mathematical side, RTP is decent, especially with a jackpot involved at 96.4%, while volatility weighs in at a high level.Winning combinations occur when three or more matching symbols land left to right on a payline. Most symbols sit against a white background, hearkening back to a more classical era from whence Rainbow Riches began.On the low side, we find 10 –A royals in an unusual cracked stone design, with little Celtic touches here and there. The high pays consist of one solitary premium, which is the games logo, worth 12.5x for a line of five. The wild is worth double at 25 times the stake while substituting for anything except the Pot of Gold symbol.Rainbow Riches Pots of Gold: FeaturesRainbow Riches Pots of Gold - bonus gameSticking to the simple gameplay, Rainbow Riches Pots of Gold doesn't have much in the way of features. The two available are the Pots of Gold Bonus (plus a Super version) and the Mega Drop Jackpots.The Pots of Gold Bonus is unlocked by landing Pot of Gold Bonus symbols. The more in view, the better the prizes in the bonus game are; 3 bonus symbols award bronze prizes of 30x - 1,000x, whilst 4 bonus symbols unlock silver prizes of 40x - 2,000x. Get really lucky by landing 5 bonus symbols to trigger the Pots of Gold Super Bonus feature. Here players can win prizes of 50x to  5,000 times their stake.In both Pots of Gold Bonus rounds, a leprechaun dances a jig in the middle of a spinning wheel of prizes. Whichever prize the wheel comes to rest on is paid out, and the feature ends. One spin of the wheel is awarded each time the bonus is triggered.The second feature comes with membership in the Mega Drop network. Mega Drop is a progressive jackpot that spits out modest rewards when hitting certain thresholds. The maximum award for the Minor, Major, and Epic jackpots are €/$1,500, €/$5,000, or €/$15,000 respectively.The jackpots can be won from any wager, on any base game spin. When a jackpot is won, everyone playing receives a notification; then the jackpot is reset to a seed amount roughly 25% of the winning total.Rainbow Riches Pots of Gold: VerdictIt appears Rainbow Riches Pots of Gold sole purpose is to add its weight to the Mega Drop range of slots. And why not? Rainbow Riches has proven an incredibly successful series that holds fast against a current of ever-improving graphics, features, and effects. Like a father in law who stubbornly, yet proudly, continues to polish his old Austin Princess when he should have brought something sensible like a new Toyota years ago.Still, old cars become classics, and it doesn't get much more classic than Rainbow Riches, which still has plenty of life left in it, for some. In fact, Rainbow Riches is still to this very day one of the most played online slots in the UK.Rainbow Riches Pots of Gold is one of those slots where most people's minds will already be made up. What we say here probably won't get too many players to shift sides in the debate. On the one hand, many love the series and will lap up Pots of Gold like a dehydrated Labrador. It's got the old charm, the same look, the familiar feel as the rest of the leprechaun infested slots in the series. Whack the Mega Drop jackpots on top and what's not to like?Then there are those on the other side of the fence who will be scratching their heads wondering just how much longer this dead horse can be flogged. The basic graphics, zero originality, plus old fashioned gameplay can feel like a knitting needle in the ear. It's unlikely the Mega Drop inclusion or the decent prizes or RTP will entice anyone over from this camp.

title: Diablo Reels
structured_summary: Diablo Reels is a Dia De Muertos-themed slot with a devilish twist, featuring a vibrant Mexican festival atmosphere. Key features include Nudging Wilds, Wild Stack Respins, and free spins with dual reel sets and up to 10 paylines. The reviewer praises it as possibly the best in the ELK Classic Series, noting its stylish design and engaging but straightforward gameplay. The game boasts colorful visuals with skulls and sombreros, complemented by a lively Latin soundtrack that intensifies during free spins.
review: Diablo Reels: OverviewThe ELK Classic Series rolls on strong with a seventh entry in the popular line-up. This time the series goes all Dia De Muertos thanks to a Mexican festival makeover. Actually, ELK Studios goes a step further than usual with this sort of genre, doing a 'deal with the devil' himself in their words. The result is a diabolically themed slot, where the simple gaming is augmented by respins, free spins, stacked, sticky, and multiplying wilds.The Dia De Muertos concept isn't uncommon in the slots world, but ELK has pulled it off well using a whole lot of colour, skulls, sombreros, cigars, flowers, and potions. It wouldn't be overly controversial to claim that Diablo Reels is the best designed and most stylish slot in the series so far.The soundtrack is spot on too, as a sexy Latin track adds the final touch, launching into full Mariachi mode during free spins. The reels rotate to old fashion bleeping noises, interspersed by heavy blow sounds of winning combos. Simple in some ways, yet aesthetically pleasing all the same, the game has a physical slot feel making it a fitting member of the series.Playable from the usual bet range of 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin, the math model powering the game has some obvious similarities to Hit It Hard which means it could possibly even be a clone. This means fairly high volatility rated 8/10 combined with a solid RTP of 96.3%. Being more or less a shinier than usual fruit slot, don't expect to be showered in wins due to a slightly modest hit rate of 18.1%.By default, the action is played out on a standard 3x3 grid with 5 paylines. However, you will instantly note 3 more rows above the main section. This extra grid is unlocked during certain features, where both reel sets become available.Clicking our way to the paytable reveals a symbol collection that would make a pretty good accompaniment to shots and tacos in a Mexican restaurant. From low to high, players get chillies, limes, watermelons, bars, horseshoes, bells, sevens, and diamonds. The 8 regular symbols might have shown up in countless games, but ELK has done a pretty good job of making them look fresh for Diablo Reels. To an extent - we are talking about rather generic symbols after all.The ever-helpful wild symbol is on hand to string a few winners together, in more ways than one. Its core role is substituting for any other symbol to make a combo, but it also has a couple of auxiliary roles that are covered below in the features section. Before then, know that a payline of wilds is worth the same amount as a payline of diamonds.Diablo Reels: FeaturesDiablo Reels - Wild Stack + Nudging Wild features at playDespite being a classic slot, there are several features boosting the win rate. These come in the form of Nudging Wilds, Wild Stack Respins, and a triggered round of free spins.Nudging Wilds distinguish themselves from regular wilds by an imprinted arrow. When a Nudging Wild lands it nudges the reel upwards, awarding respins until it leaves from the top of the screen. A Nudging Wild on the top reel may also come with an x2 or x5 multiplier.When a full stack of wilds appears on one reel the Wild Stack Respin is triggered. This feature awards a respin on both sets of reels – the upper and lower. Also, one reel is completely stacked in wilds for this respin. When both reel sets are in action, paylines are doubled to 10. Better yet, if you land both wilds simultaneously, the Stacked Wilds become sticky which can help pep up a few wins.Mr Diablo is who you want to see for the final feature as his horned skull graces the scatter symbol - 3 of them view trigger the bonus game awarding 10 free spins. Once triggered, both the upper and lower reel sets are active, with the full 10 paylines in play. A sweetener during this round is that no low-value symbols appear on the upper reel set. There is also a chance to extend the feature by landing three scatter symbols.Diablo Reels: VerdictIf you've made it this far through the series you'll know what to expect by now. The good news for fans is that Diablo Reels is an excellent example of this type of slot and possibly even the best to date. The theme has been utilised well and the attractive audio/visual package blends seamlessly together.The base game isn't exactly awash in wins and can be quite brutal due to the lowish hit frequency, but Nudging or Stacked Wilds do well to stave off monotony. Of course, the gameplay does tend to the simple side, which may put off those after a more sophisticated session.Perhaps a greater sticking point for some players will be the potential, a not uncommon complaint with some ELK slots. Diablo Reels' max win of 2,500 times the stake isn't a total deal-breaker, but it's hardly awe-inspiring either. If you're looking for a game in the series offering higher potential, Win Win is the slot to go for with a max win potential of 5,000x. ELK slots often waver between these two amounts, the team being a little unsure of which one to settle on. Ah well, players' choice after all and they do get to vote with their coins.All in all, Diablo Reels is a top contender in the series with impressive looks and thrilling features. Of course, if the 3x3 fruit thing isn't your forte, or you're after all-time wins, then it is unlikely Diablo Reels will scratch the itch. However, for a night of classic slots action with a couple of cheeky tequilas on the side, you could do a lot worse than put Diablo Reels through its paces.

Naughty Nick's Book's finishing touch is a max win figure of 7,500x the bet, that sixth reel giving the winning potential a chance to breathe a bit deeper than more famous examples like Book of Dead.Like Scroll of Dead, Naughty Nick's Book isn't a totally vanilla 'Book of' game, thanks to things like the sixth reel and other rule changes. However, Naughty Nick's Book doesn't deviate so far from the norm that it is likely to upset too many Ra purists. So, if a bit of expanding symbol action in a Christmas setting is on the menu, Naughty Nick's Book is as good a choice as most for players who like this method.

title: Mafia Clash

review: Mafia Clash: Slot OverviewHacksaw Gaming's partner in crime, well partner in making slots, Bullshark Games, takes a walk on the Cosa Nostra side with the release of Mafia Clash. This bullet-ridden, crime-laden gambling device sees three rival gangs beef it out in a battle for control of the street and 'untold riches'. The three types of wilds are Thugs, Triad, and Wise guys. When the Shootout activates, the wilds reveal a multiplier, and the bullets start flying. Additive multiplier values can be x2 to x100, while the multiplicative multiplier values are x2 to x10.Hideout Free SpinsHitting 3, 4, or 5 FS scatters in the base game awards 6, 8, or 12 free spins, respectively. Filling the balance back up occurred at times, and the Shootout could be useful for this. Hitting a bunch of non-multiplying wilds could be okay in rare moments, too. It never really did during the test session, though, which felt like watching numbers tick inexorably downwards like a protection racket gone into overdrive. title: Diamond Symphony DoubleMax
structured_summary: Diamond Symphony DoubleMax is a neon-lit musical-themed slot blending 80s vibes with symphony motifs. review: Diamond Symphony DoubleMax: Slot OverviewThe DoubleMax mechanic is really starting to do the rounds now. As well as several contributions and offshoots from its creator Yggdrasil Gaming, it has also ended up in the hands of a number of partner studios. However, the neon stylings Bulletproof Gaming has gone for isn't a million kilometres away from an earlier Yggdrasil Gaming release titled Neon Villains DoubleMax. An okay game, yet one that didn't make a colossal statement. Neither does Diamond Symphony DoubleMax either, though it is quite unique. Whether its uniqueness will find widespread appeal is a pertinent question, though if you like things neon-charged and noisy, Diamond Symphony DoubleMax might be the one.Diamond Symphony DoubleMax slot - base gameIt'll help if you prefer your games medium-high volatile which Diamond Symphony DoubleMax is, and it powers out a default RTP value of 96%, though lower models are available, too. Bet range varies from 20 p/c on the lower side to $/€100 at the upper, and players have the option of engaging Encore Mode if they prefer. With Engage Mode switched on, the stake increases by 50%, but the chance of triggering free spins is more than doubled. Otherwise, buying free spins outright is a possibility, too, at a cost of 100x the bet for 7-15 free spins or 200x the bet for 12-15 free spins.Diamond Symphony DoubleMax is held on a 5-reel gaming panel with 3 rows and 20 fixed paylines, where winning combinations of 3 to 5 of a kind are possible. For pay symbols, Diamond Symphony DoubleMax has four musical note symbols and a treble clef worth 1-2 times the bet for 5 OAK, then a saxophone, a cello, a piano, and a diamond paying 2.5 to 10 times the bet for 5-of-a-kind. The conductor symbol is wild and appears on all five reels. Wilds replace any pay symbols and have the same value as the diamond if making their own wins.Diamond Symphony DoubleMax: Slot FeaturesDiamond Symphony DoubleMax slot - free spins gambleBreaking this symphony up into its individual parts, we find the Cascade+, the DoubleMax, the free spins trail, free spins, and a free spins gamble.Cascade+After wins have been paid, the winning symbols pop from the board and symbols above them drop down to replace them. Before the drop occurs, though, one of the popped symbols has a wild symbol placed in its position. If another win then hits, the process is repeated.DoubleMaxWhenever a pop occurs, the DoubleMax multiplier is doubled, and its value will be applied to the next cascade if there is one. The DoubleMax multiplier resets for each new base game spin.Free Spins TrailPops also progress the free spins trail by one step showing players where they need to reach to trigger free spins. In the base game, ending up in positions 5, 6, 7, or 8 awards 7, 10, 12, or 15 free spins, respectively. The free spins trail resets between paid spins. If Encore mode is engaged, then positions 3 and 4 become Encore positions. If the trail ends on one of these positions, a respin is awarded, giving players another chance to progress. A subsequent respin may be awarded when landing on the second Encore.Free SpinsWhen no more pops occur, and the free spins trail has lit one of the free spins positions, then the bonus round activates. Before free spins start, players may be given the chance to gamble what they have won for more free spins (up to a maximum of 15) or collect and go straight to the round. During this bonus round, the DoubleMax persists across free spins, and additional free spins can be won from the free spins trail.Diamond Symphony DoubleMax slot - free spinsDiamond Symphony DoubleMax: Slot VerdictFrom a technical perspective, Diamond Symphony DoubleMax doesn't do a ton of things that previous DoubleMax games haven't already done before. Bulletproof Games (or Yggdrasil Gaming) might have come up with a new name, Cascade+, to describe the process, but in action, Diamond Symphony DoubleMax functions a lot like most of the others. One exception is the free spins trail which offers an alternative way of triggering the free spins bonus round. It paves the way for the use of Encore Mode, which might help players move from base to bonus game a bit quicker. No guarantees, though, of course.Other than some side mechanics, Diamond Symphony DoubleMax is basically business as usual, which is no bad thing. Hit winning combinations, pop in a wild, advance the DoubleMax multiplier, hit more wins, repeat. This can be a highly potent system, especially in the bonus round, because the multiplier persists between free spins. Phenomenal results have been produced by past DoubleMax games, most memorably Raptor DoubleMax – the original. With a max win of 20,000x the bet, there is no technical reason why the same won't occur with Diamond Symphony DoubleMax either, should fortune be on lucky players' side.Even considering the newer (for DoubleMax) bits, it feels like Diamond Symphony DoubleMax's theme might be the make-or-break factor. If the unusual neon 80s meets a symphony idea gets your gears cranking, then Diamond Symphony DoubleMax might play out like an epic Yanni and Falco-type fusion. If not, then Diamond Symphony DoubleMax might well feel like you've walked into the last cocktail lounge/classical music joint still open at 4.30 in the morning that reeks of Jägerbombs and desperation.

title: Crab Trap
structured_summary: Crab Trap is a mid-volatility online slot centered around a relaxed crab-catching seaside theme. Key features include Trap frames added by Blue Boats, Respins triggered by Red Boats, colossal Crab symbols, free spins, and a bonus buy option. review: Crab Trap: Slot OverviewCrabs, the aquatic sea creature kind, not the itchy kind, are one sort of creature which pops up in online slots every so often. Not so often as big-name beasts like bison, perhaps, but often enough to have carved out some sort of niche in the gambling world. They don't tend to star in big-hitting, monstrous slots very often, and NetEnt's Crab Trap is unlikely to upset that trend either. Crab Trap is a classic example, really. Full of charm, fairly simple, mid-volatile, has a crab collect feature and caps it all off with a modest max win. If this sounds appetising, let's get to hauling in a different seafood group than fish for a change.Since crabs are typically caught from the sea, it makes sense that Crab Trap's base game takes place near it, where a sizable fish hangs from a beam next to a structure which houses a 6-reel gaming panel. Each reel holds 4 rows and uses a scatter pays system to calculate wins rather than paylines or ways. As these sorts of slots tend to be, whether it's fish or crabs in the leading role, Crab Trap is presented in a positive, upbeat way, brightly graphiced, with a cheerful soundtrack providing extra bounce.The math model powering Crab Trap is medium volatile, producing a default return to player of 96.07%. Being a scatter pays slot, players collect a win when at least 7 identical low pays, 6 identical mids, or 5 identical high pays land in view on any position of the board. Pays are awarded when this occurs, yet no cascading or tumbling occurs at any point. To get the crab nippin', players start by picking a bet of 10 p/c to $/€400 or by using the bonus buy should you wish to jump straight into the crab pond. When changing the bet, any Trap frames on the reels are removed but reappear if returning to the previous bet (more on this below).What Crab Trap considers low pays are J to A card ranks, its medium pays are starfish and a bucket of water, while the high pays are a float and a boot. Not the most exciting symbols but fine enough. As for values, a 7 low pay symbol cluster is worth 1 times the bet, up to 8 times the bet for a 10+ cluster, a 6 OAK mid pay cluster is worth 1 times the bet, up to 8 times the bet for a 9+ cluster, while a 5 OAK high pay cluster awards 0.4x the bet, up to 10 times the bet for a 9+ cluster. Crab Trap does not have wilds, but it does have boats and crabs as its remaining symbols.Crab Trap: Slot FeaturesCrab Trap slot - free spinsTo be precise, Crab Trap has two types of boat symbols, Red and Blue, which led to Trap frames being placed and respins being triggered. As well as this, be on the lookout for free spins and the buy feature.RespinsThe Blue Boat symbol appears on all reels in the base game and in free spins. Each Blue Boat adds a Trap frame to its own position and 1 to 5 Trap frames on random positions that do not already have Trap frames on them. The Red Boat symbol appears in the base game on reel 4 and in free spins on reel 3. It may appear in the base game when there are at least 5 Trap frames on the reels and awards a Respin. A Respin can also be awarded whenever there is a Blue Boat and Trap frames added to all reels. When a Blue Boat and Red Boat land at the same time, Trap frames are added before a Respin is triggered. During Respins, scatter winning combinations cannot appear, only wins from Crab symbols are awarded.Single Crab symbols can land anywhere on the reels, 2x2 colossal Crab symbols may land on reels 1-2 and 4-5, while 3x3 colossal Crab symbols can appear on reels 1-3 and 4-6. Colossal Crab symbols may land fully or partially in view. Single Crabs have values of 1, 2, 5, or 10 times the bet, 2x2 colossal Crabs have values of 10x, 20x, 50x, or 100x the bet, while 3x3 colossal Crabs have values of 100x, 200x, 500x, or 1,000 times the bet.If a Crab symbol lands on a position with a Trap during a Respin or on the spins which triggered a Respin, it locks in place. Another Respin is awarded if this occurs on a Respin. Colossal Crabs lock in place, even if Trap frames do not cover them entirely. Respins end when no new Crabs land on positions with a Trap frame. Then, all Crab symbols in positions with Trap frames award wins according to their values. If Colossal Crabs are not completely framed, they break into single Crabs possessing values of 1 to 10 times the bet each. Partially visible colossal Crabs transform into 2, 3, or 6 single Crab symbols. All Trap frames with captured Crabs in them are removed from the reels. Trap frames without Crabs remain on the grid.Free SpinsLanding 3, 4, 5, or 6+ scatter symbols in the main game awards 5, 7, 10, or 15 free spins, respectively. Scatter symbols are collected in the free spins round, and for every 3 scatters collected, players are awarded +1 extra free spin. Any Trap frames from the triggering spin are carried over to free spins. Repsins will play before free spins if both are activated on the same spin. In free spins, a Respin is awarded whenever a Red Boat appears, and Traps are not removed after a Respin. Repsin play before the next free spin. When free spins end, all Trap frames disappear from the reels, and when returning to the base game, 4 Trap frames are added to the grid.Buy FeaturePlayers are able to buy 6 free spins for the cost of 50 times the bet. When buying free spins, the RTP remains the same, and all Trap frames from the main game are saved. Ten new Trap frames are randomly added to the reels, and when free spins end, the saved Trap frames return to the reels.Crab Trap slot - free spinsCrab Trap: Slot VerdictPhew, that was quite a lot of rules for what is a fairly straightforward crab-catching slot. To boil it all down, what you want to happen is for the Blue Boat to add as many Trap frames to the reels as possible, then hit a Red Boat to trigger the Respin feature. Then it's a case of hitting as many Crab symbols (the bigger, the better) in positions framed by Traps. When Respins end, players collect loot should Crabs be caught, of course. The same goes for free spins, too, but there you've got the added benefit of Trap frames not being removed from the reels following a Respins sequence. Within this framework are various rules and fine print to govern how the game goes. One of the most important rules to be aware of is that colossal Crabs will not pay their full potential unless they are completely in view and completely covered by Trap frames. If they are not, then they break down to the single 1x1 Crab symbols to award lesser values.This does make it harder to bag big Crabs, and really, Crab Trap is not a big potential slot in general. With a max win of 1,191 times the bet, it would seem this is not the most lucrative crab fishing business on the waters. If you've ever seen the show 'Deadliest Catch', there is no way those hardy individuals would be braving the dangerous Bering Sea for rewards like that. Of course, Crab Trap doesn't compare to real-life rough-seas crab fishing. It feels like Crab Trap is pitched at players with a certain risk/reward taste, gamblers who prefer things on the 'lighter' side of things, let's say.One mental image which came to mind was of a barefooted fisherman sleeping next to the water, a line of string tied to their big toe to catch fish from. Laid back, keeping things easy, that sort of thing. If the gambling equivalent, with crabs, sounds appealing, then Crab Trap might suffice. Otherwise, to keep things crabby but upping the potential rewards, maybe something like Lobster Bob's Crazy Crab Shack from Pragmatic Play and Reel Kingdom might be a better suit.

title: Tomb of Nefertiti

review: Tomb of Nefertiti (Nolimit City): OverviewYet again players are immersed in an ancient Egyptian theme while they spin reels for treasure. Whether the owners of that franchise are aware of the resemblance and will let it go remains to be seen. Let's fire up the game and see what it can do, while we can.Apparently, the Tomb of Nefertiti was a real thing. It was located in a side chamber in the larger Akhenaten complex when it was unearthed. It's said that Nefertiti was a real looker, the most beautiful in all of Egypt. Being the Queen, people kind of had to say though that for fear of insulting someone who had the power over life and death.Nolimit City has captured the spirit of her beauty in Tomb of Nefertiti, which is also a bit of a looker. Lining the reels are numbers indicating the 20 paylines which add further emphasis to the physical slot feel. Paylines expand during the Raider Spins feature which we will see shortly. Like the looks, RTP is above average on 96.19% and has been coupled with medium to high volatility. So far it sounds like any other modern ancient Egyptian slot. However, Nolimit City has added few original features that inject a healthy dose of originality.Tomb of Nefertiti (Nolimit City): FeaturesFree spins roundWhen a winning combination lands, the tiles involved in the win Re-Spin and more combos are possible. Wilds and bonus symbols remain Sticky through all re-spins. Re-spins are limited to two in the main game and come with multipliers of x2 and x3 respectively.One of the random features is the Wild Raider which can appear at any time. When it does, the middle three reels are highlighted, and up to 9 wilds can drop onto these tiles. Another random extra is Nefertiti's Curse. When this one drops, all tiles on the middle three reels synchronise with the same symbol which can be anything except the bonus symbol.The Nefertiti bonus symbol can appear on any reel. Land 3 of them to trigger 10 Raider Spins. During this round, paylines are doubled from 20 to 40, and the Wild Raider feature is present on each Raider Spin, providing at least 1-9 wilds every time. Not only that, but the re-spins feature mentioned above has no limit and continues to re-spin as long as winners continue to land. There is technically no limit to how high the multiplier can go.Tomb of Nefertiti (Nolimit City): VerdictAny 5-reel Egyptian themed slot runs the risk of drowning in a sea of similar slots. Nolimit City has managed to avoid mediocrity by tweaking the extras to provide a fresh slot experience. Tomb of Nefertiti shows that just a few additions can avoid complete anonymity. And they don't have to be huge changes either. The tweaks that Nolimit City has introduced are subtle, but save Tomb of Nefertiti from being an all-out clone. That's not to say that Tomb of Nefertiti has revolutionised the genre in any way, but fans of the theme will generally be intrigued by the gameplay on offer.Nolimit City further cements the playability by giving the game a decent top payout as well. Get the features working to their full potential, and the game is capable of wins of up to 3,768 times the stake. What might frustrate people though is the game's volatility and symbol values. With its medium to high setting, you do get a steady rain of wins and feature drops, but they tend to be on the low side. Symbols offer okay value - but only if five of a kind land, anything less and the values drop off steeply. And after a solid test run, five of a kind was a rare occurrence indeed.Tomb of Nefertiti is more likely to appeal to the casual set. Those looking for an intense game will find it lacking. That’s a shame and it feels like a missed opportunity. As it is, it's quite entertaining, and what Nolimit City has done with the extra features is interesting. However, hardcore players will be put off by its limp math model and win mechanic.Don't Miss...A follow-up was released by Nolimit City in 2020 titled Tomb of Akhenaten. Played using a 5x3, 243 win ways format, it comes bundled with several new features and considerably higher potential.

title: Tales of Asgard Freya's Wedding

review: Tales of Asgard Freya's Wedding: Slot OverviewPlayers, if you're used to the mighty Thor, flexing his divine muscles, swinging hammers, and cracking heads, here's a story for you. In the base game, five premiums are worth 5 to 10x the bet, rising to 10 to 20x the bet in free spins.Tales of Asgard Freya's Wedding: Slot FeaturesWildsWilds are central to most of the best moments in Tales of Asgard Freya's Wedding, appearing in a variety of forms to substitute any pay symbol. On any base game spin, Here Comes Freya may trigger, where an expanded 1x4 sized Freya Wild with an x2 multiplier can appear, guaranteeing a win.Free SpinsScatters appear on reels 1, 3, or 5 and landing 3 of them triggers free spins. In free spins, Freya Wilds are replaced by Thor Wilds, and at the start of the bonus round, an expanded Thor Wild symbol starts on reel 5. After each free spin, the expanded wild moves one reel to the left, increasing its multiplier each time by 1, from x1 up to x10.As long as an expanded Thor Wild is in view on the reels, free spins will continue. When a spin occurs, and no expanded Thor Wild appears, a respin is awarded. If an Expanded Thor Wild lands on the respin, the current multiplier value is carried over, and the feature will continue up to a maximum of 30 free spins.Tales of Asgard Freya's Wedding: Slot VerdictOne of the more humorous Norse sagas gets a relatively light slot to match. Well, it's a potentially humorous story for all involved except perhaps Thrym, who thought he'd bagged Freya but who ended up copping a walloping from Thor instead. You might have thought those massive shoulders would have given Thor away, yet Thrym was a giant, so maybe we can forgive him for missing that detail. In this one, when wilds land in the highlighted area which is made up of the two central reels, they expand to cover the whole reel, plus a respin is awarded. If expanding wilds sit on both middle reels, their multipliers are multiplied. When no new wins occur, respins end and wilds are cleared for the next free spin.The third option is the highly volatile (4/5) Multiplier Collect game, awarding 12 free spins. Here, coconut crates land on reels 2-5 increasing a multiplier displayed on the reel above them. When 2 crates are collected the respective multiplier increases by +1 and one bar on their meter is lit. Lighting all three bars awards 3 extra spins. When a wild lands, any multiplier present on that reel is applied to it. More than one wild multiplier in a win has their values multiplied.It wouldn’t be a slot made by streamers without a feature buy. Where this is available, players can pay 100 times the bet to trigger the bonus and choose which of the three games they’d like a crack at. The look is a fairly good one, the slick mix of dreamy exoticism and cartoon frivolity is just the right foil for the lethal math model lurking beneath.Iron Bank comes overloaded with features, so perhaps not one for the old-school hardcores who prefer less convolution. Others will appreciate the busy gameplay and fast-paced action in combination with a chance to score potentially life-changing wins.Iron Bank isn't a particularly sophisticated slot and certainly not about innovation. It's more of a mix tape made by a group of slots enthusiasts containing bits and pieces from other slots they likely prefer playing. Results were decent during testing, though dwarfed by the advertised max potential of 49,998.8 times the bet. We’ve seen Money Train 2 smash its 50,000x win cap, so any doubts about Iron Bank doing the same are softened.Relax Gaming and Casinogrounds have pulled in all the right elements to ensure Iron Bank pops up on plenty of highlight reels in the future. It won’t suit everyone of course, but Iron Bank’s projected demographic should be well entertained.Don't MissIf you're a fan of the gameplay and visual art in Iron Bank, be sure to also try Relax Gaming's and Casinoground's second collaboration titled Beast Mode. It comes with three different free spins features and a free spins gamble option.

To date, Neko Games has focused on video bingo, and while their catchphrase might be 'Online Gaming with a Latin flavor', two out of the three games in their portfolio are distinctly Asian. And, while Immortal Romance Video Bingo doesn't have a strong Latin flavor either, it could well be the game that helps put Neko on the map.The reason, as eagle-eyed readers have no doubt deduced, is because Neko has teamed up with Games Global to create a video bingo version of the mega-hit Immortal Romance. There's precedence for this, too, as the popular vampire romance slot has been transformed into a vehicle for Mega Moolah as well as a scratch card version. Of all the various types, Immortal Romance Video Bingo is certainly the most intricate, though it's not overly complicated once you've got the hang of things.At first, though, there is a lot of stuff happening on screen. Compared to the slots or scratch card, this is like a non-pilot looking at the cockpit controls of an Airbus A380. Up to four bingo cards are displayed on the screen, beneath jackpot values, a row of winning patterns, and the UI. Despite the extra information, the game retains an Immortal Romance spirit due to the dramatic soundtrack and gothic imagery. Also, by clicking on the character, you can pick Amber, Troy, Michael, or Sarah to keep you company.There are two things to do first. One is to select how many tickets you would like to buy per game round from 1-4 and choose the cost of each ticket from 1 c/p to $/€10 each. Just to be clear, you will have to buy 4 tickets per game round to be eligible to win jackpot prizes. The hit rate sounds massive if you're used to playing online slots, at 55.93%, though it's no money printer, producing an RTP of 95.13%. While players have a level of control over how the action unfolds, it does so in a highly volatile manner.Immortal Romance Video Bingo: FeaturesThe fundamental way of winning is by landing patterns on the game tickets you have bought. Once you're happy with the number of tickets and the bet, hitting the play button releases a random batch of 30 balls. If the numbers on the tickets create a predefined pattern, the associated prize is awarded. There are 15 possible pattern types, ranging in value from 2x to 2,250x the individual ticket price.Extra Ball StageIf after the initial 30 ball draw, there is a chance of winning 8x the ticket or higher, the Extra Ball Stage is activated. A gong sounds and a bunch of extra question mark icons appear on the screen. Players have the option of pressing the play button to reveal one question mark at a time. The cost for doing so is clearly displayed, and newly revealed balls may create new wins on the game tickets. Revealed balls may also contain coins which are collected in the Lion Door Knocker. When the Lion Door Knocker is filled with coins, The Chamber of Jackpots feature is awarded.Chamber of JackpotsWhen triggered, players match 3 characters to win their associated prize – Amber, Troy, Michael, and Sarah, worth 50x, 250x, 2,500x, and 10,000x the ticket price, respectively. You will need to play with four tickets to enable this feature.Eternal ChambersWhen Bonus Pattern 1 is awarded, the Eternal Chambers bonus begins. This is a five-level bonus game where players select items. If the item reveals a prize, players win the amount and move to the next level to repeat the process. If the clicked item reveals a collect message or there are no more items left to select, you return to the base game.Immortal PickerThis feature is triggered when Bonus Pattern 2 is achieved. Like the previous bonus game, players click items to win prizes or reveal the collect message. When there are no more items to click or the collect message is revealed, players go back to the base game.Wild BallsOccasionally, an Extra Ball will be wild. These are highly useful because they allow players to pick the number not already called on a ticket.Immortal Romance Video Bingo: VerdictImmortal Romance Video Bingo is a game that has something to offer all sorts of gamblers into video bingo. For one, players looking to stretch a bankroll can do so with the low-ticket costs and rely on the regular batch of balls to create winning patterns. Or, for those who prefer to live on the edge a bit more, they can go to town on the Extra Balls when the Extra Ball Stage triggers. It can be tempting to smash away at the extra balls when just one or two numbers are needed to complete a juicy pattern type. However, the cost of revealing individual balls during this feature can get quite steep, so buyers beware.So yes, it can be punishing when repeatedly buying extra balls in an attempt to create a better pattern or trigger the jackpot. Yet, one good thing about Immortal Romance Video Bingo is that players have a measure of control over the game. Extra ball buying is totally optional, and players have a lot of choice in terms of expenditure – bets and ticket number. The only slight arm twister is that you need to buy four tickets per round to be eligible for the Chamber of Jackpots. Of course, even on one ticket, there is a chance to win Bonus Round 1 or 2, where solid prizes can be found. However, since you'll need to cover all but 1 or 2 numbers on a ticket to do so, it won't be easy.So, with the ability to cater to a wide variety of gambling requirements, solid top prizes, plenty of options, brand recognition, and familiar faces, it's hard to see Immortal Romance Video Bingo not making a splash in the bingo segment of the market.

title: Stars of Orion
structured_summary: Stars of Orion is a space-themed slot centered around the Orion constellation and a Stonehenge-like setting. It features cluster pays, avalanches, a Magic Meter with multipliers, Super Symbols, and multiple bonus rounds including free drops and X-iter buy-in modes. The reviewer finds it a solid evolution in ELK’s gravity series with fairer cluster mechanics and a high max win of 10,000x the bet, though the theme and symbols feel somewhat incongruous. Visually, the game combines ancient monolith aesthetics with bright, contrasting symbols, but the audio and overall presentation are less emphasized.
review: Stars of Orion: Slot OverviewOne of the most well-known constellations in the night sky is Orion, the huntsman, who can be seen from any point on earth. So conspicuous is Orion that humans have been staring up from their campfires at it for at least 32-38,000 years. We know this because a depiction of Orion dating to that time was found in the West German Ach valley, his likeness carved out of mammoth ivory. As well as Europe, people across the globe have left records to Orion in some form or another. Now, though not for the first time, the galactic huntsman appears in an online slot from ELK Studios titled Stars of Orion. This is a game melding ELK's gravity mechanic, X-iter modes, with cluster wins, a Magic Meter, and a bunch of other extras.While Orion lights up the sky, back on earth, ELK has located their game in a Stonehenge type of environment, all standing monoliths topped with lintel stones and the like. The sort of place people descend upon during events like solstices to see the sunrise or set in specific locations. So, were these places celestial stone calendars, elaborate burial sites, religious sites, or a way for local rulers to display power? It's unlikely we will know for certain. Now, sites like Stonehenge are major drawcards for millions of tourists to wander around in bewilderment at a safe distance.Highly volatile and playable on any device from between 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin, Stars of Orion hosts its action on a grid that has 6 columns holding 8 symbols each. In a first for the gravity series, Stars of Orion pays when clusters of at least 5 matching symbols are connected to each other, anywhere on the panel. This opens up the grid to possibilities not experienced in previous gravity games. Wins trigger an avalanche mechanism while also filling the Magic Meter. The last thing to mention when it comes to the fine technical details is the 95.0% RTP.Like IO, the symbols in Stars of Orion are a little incongruous with their surroundings. There's just something about them that makes them stick out like sore thumbs, and not necessarily in the most pleasing way. Anyway, four coloured orbs make up the low pays, while birds, wolves, deer, and 7s are the higher value symbols. Clusters max out at 15 or more matching symbols, and premiums at this level are worth 35 to 200 times the stake. Moreover, wilds land anywhere substituting for all pay symbols, and should a cluster of wilds form; they are worth the same as the top premium.Stars of Orion: Slot FeaturesStars of Orion - The "Orion" modifier triggeredStars of Orion boasts quite a few features, so let's work our way through the lot, which includes avalanches, Super Symbols, the Magic Meter, Magic features, two bonus games, and five X-iter modes.AvalanchesEach winning cluster is removed from the grid by the avalanche feature, which triggers the gravity mechanic. New or existing symbols tumble down left or right into the gaps, potentially causing additional clusters to form. Avalanches continue until no new wins appear.Super SymbolsAny paying symbol can appear as a Super Symbol. You can tell because they have blue frames wrapped around them. When Super Symbols are used in a win, if they connect with another winning cluster, all winning symbols turn into the most valuable included symbol type.Magic MeterAs well as triggering avalanches, winning symbols are collected in the Magic Meter set on the right side of the game grid. At set points, win multipliers of x2 to x64 are activated, as well as additional Magic features, such as:Symbol Swap – swaps adjacent symbols to create winning clusters.Orion's Belt – extra drop with 3 wild symbols formed as Orion's belt.Orion's Club – extra drop with 6 wild symbols formed as Orion's club.Orion's Shield – extra drop with 8 wild symbols formed as Orion's shield.Orion – extra drop with 13 wild symbols formed as the full Orion constellation.Free DropsLanding 3 bonus symbols triggers 10 free drops. In free drops, the Magic Meter's progress is persistent; it does not reset between spins. There is a chance bonus symbols appear with a red frame around them. These are super bonus symbols. If all triggering bonus symbols are the super kind, the super bonus round is triggered, awarding 10 free drops where Super Symbols have a higher rate of appearing.X-iter ModeThe X-iter menu allows players to buy in to five alternative game modes.Guaranteed Win – costs 5x the bet to buy a game round with a guaranteed winning combination of some sort.Super Symbols – buy a game round with a higher rate of Super Symbols for 10x the bet.Symbol Swap - buy a game round with 3 extra Symbol Swap features. Swaps are activated when no more wins appear in an avalanche sequence.Buy Bonus – 100x the bet buys you a game round with three bonus symbols to trigger the bonus game.Super Bonus – buy a game round with three super bonus symbols to trigger the super bonus round.Stars of Orion - high values paytable based on a 1 Eur bet.Stars of Orion: Slot VerdictStars of Orion didn't immediately grab us by the scruff of the neck like previous gravity games have done. Something about it looked a little off. Maybe it was a reaction to the Druidic theme juxtaposed with the out of place looking symbols. We shouldn't judge a book, or a slot, by its cover, and digging deeper reveals the fact ELK has made a number of welcome additions to Stars of Orion, which make it one of the better gravity games so far.First of all, we get cluster pays rather than ways to win, which flips the dynamic. It doesn't necessarily mean you win more, but it lessens the chance of having a bunch of epic symbols in latter columns that just don't link up with anything, no matter how many symbols tumble down the grid. It feels fairer, if fair is the right word. If you haven't read the rules of the game first so are unaware, this change to clusters makes a pleasant surprise.Collecting winning symbols in a charge meter is a common cluster pays device, so Stars of Orion might not come across as original as the previous one Bompers was. It's certainly not without innovative charms, though. Super Symbols can be useful when they transform a bunch of lesser clusters into one higher value monster, for one. Clusters also play right into other features like symbol swaps, the Orion drops with those added wilds, and the Magic Meter, everything really. Don't expect fireworks on every drop, of course, far from it. When it does pop, though, Stars of Orion performs like a well-greased machine that pulls in all of its parts to function at an optimal level. Here is where Stars of Orion shines brighter than its siblings, too, as it has a max win of 10,000x the bet – double what the other three can do.After Bompers, Stars of Orion brings the gravity range back to its universe setting. The core gameplay remains recognisable, but the lowered RTP somewhat lessens the appeal even if the new bits bring a new dimension while it goes about the business of evolving the series.

title: Anubis 2 DoubleMax
structured_summary: Anubis 2 DoubleMax is an ancient Egypt-themed slot centered on the jackal-headed god Anubis, offering a fresh take from its predecessor.
