review: Desperate Dawgs 2 Gigablox slot - Gunslinger featureDesperate Dawgs 2 Gigablox: Slot OverviewWell, hot diggity dog y'all, Yggdrasil Gaming pardner Reflex Gaming has returned to the West in a sequel slot titled Desperate Dawgs 2 Gigablox. This time around, the three pooches are armed with the Gigablox mechanic, and the game has had a refurbishment. The original Desperate Dawgs released in 2021 wasn't exactly the biggest, meanest canine in town, but hey, let's keep an open mind and see what the team has cooked up for part two.The first surprise when viewing Desperate Dawgs 2 Gigablox was the overhauled UI. Past Reflex Gaming slots' menu systems have tended to have a dated Windows 93 thing going on. For Desperate Dawgs 2 Gigablox, the studio has cleaned things up, modernised it, and made it more pleasant to look at and, hopefully, for players, better to use. A small thing perhaps, yet details matter, and this was a positive one. Desperate Dawgs 2 Gigablox isn't angling for the gritty end of the Western market, like Dead or Alive 2, for example; even the buzzard looks huggable. It's cuter, cuddlier, and doggier, though still serious when it comes to the actual gambling part.Taking the Dawgs on requires picking a bet from 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin on a tablet, desktop, or mobile device. This time around, the medium-high volatile action occurs on a game board that can grow in size but starts with 6-reels, each holding four symbols and crossed with 40 paylines. Max RTP is higher than last time, tipping the scales at 95.5%, though lower models may be available.Since the game uses Gigablox, reels can randomly unite to create symbols from 2x2 to 6x6 in size. On the lower side of the paytable are the card suits - clubs, spades, diamonds, and hearts, then four premiums – hats, pistols, badges, and the game's logo. Each wagon can hold Gold, Silver, Notes, Dynamite, or a blank space. Gold, Silver, or Notes award 10x, 5x, or 2x the bet, respectively, while Dynamites are added to the Dynamite Trail. Once a Dynamite Trail is completed, one of the 4 Silver Safes or the Gold Safe awards its prize. Silver Safes need two dynamites to pay out up to 30x the bet; the Gold Safe needs 5 dynamites to award up to 200x the bet.Gunslinger BonusLanding 6 or more yellow scatters are needed to trigger the Gunslinger Bonus. The number of triggering scatters awards an equal number of Shots. First, players pick between a lower or higher volatile gun. The first option has multipliers of 1x, 2x, 2x, 3x, 3x, or 4x, while the second one has five 1xs and a 10x. Each Shot selects one value and one multiplier, which gets applied to the value. All prizes during the feature are accumulated.Bad Boy BonusLanding 6+ scatters in view leads to the Bad Boy Bonus – the number of scatters awards the same number of free spins. When a win occurs, 1 extra row and 15 extra paylines are added to the game grid. If new wins are formed on the expanded game board, they are paid, and +2 free spins are awarded. Reels can grow to a maximum of 6x8 in size with 100 paylines. At least one Giga reel will appear on each free spin.Golden BetLastly, if the Golden Bet button is present, players have the option of increasing the stake by 50%, thereby increasing the chance of triggering one of the bonuses.Desperate Dawgs 2 Gigablox slot - free spinsDesperate Dawgs 2 Gigablox: Slot VerdictMaybe the updated UI influenced the way we processed the rest of Desperate Dawgs 2 Gigablox's visuals because they seemed like a step up from what we've come to expect in a Reflex Gaming slot. Not always, there were times when the 2000s felt like they were trying to push their way in, yet in general, Desperate Dawgs 2 Gigablox is a pleasanter-looking slot, all things considered. It's hardly an unmissable celebration of the Wild West spirit where anything can happen, and people are tarring and feathering anyone who dares step foot in town. However, it feels like a move in a positive direction, and Desperate Dawgs 2 Gigablox should have enough to entertain players enticed by the thought of a Western Gigablox game with doggies in hats.

title: Funky Buddha
structured_summary: Funky Buddha is a slot game themed around a groovy, poolside summer vibe with a playful take on Buddha. It features a 5x3 reel setup with 10 paylines, Cash Collect symbols, and free spins that unlock multipliers and jackpots. The reviewer found it a fun but familiar cash collector-style game, essentially a reskin of Blueprint Gaming’s earlier release. Visually, it offers a relaxing seaside aesthetic paired with loungey, trance-inspired music enhancing the chill atmosphere.
review: Funky Buddha: Slot OverviewBuddha might be famous for teaching humanity the 'Three Universal Truths and Four Noble Truths' (amongst other things), but apparently, he was a bit of a funk master, as well. Well, maybe not really, yet through the magic of creative thought, developer Blueprint Gaming has come up with Funky Buddha, an online slot displaying another (arguably made-up) side of the famous religious teacher. In one of those wonderful slot ironies, Funky Buddha isn't super creative since when you dig beneath the skin, it reuses most of the innards found in The Goonies Hey You Guys, also by Blueprint Gaming released barely a blink or two before Funky Buddha.Visually reminiscent of Fantasma Games' Fortune Llama, Funky Buddha lets players pretend they're poolside somewhere swanky lined by palm trees, speakers, and a cocktail area, while boats lie at anchor on the sea. Funky Buddha has picked a very nice track to accompany the visuals with, though have to say - loungey, groovy, trancey at points, an ideal poolside track, in other words. Funky Buddha might lack some of the warm characterisation of Sloth and The Goonies, but for a pretend summer getaway, it's not bad.Funky Buddha slot - base gameFunky Buddha is played using 5-reels, 3 rows of symbols in combination with 10 paylines. Along paylines, winning combinations of at least 3 OAK may land, as long as they do so on consecutive reels from the leftmost reel onwards. With its medium/high volatile math model, RTP is available at two levels with a higher default feature of 95%. The game foregoes any sort of bonus buy or ante bet, so all players have to do is pick a stake of 10 p/c to $/€100 and tap away on the play button. Tapping a foot is optional.There aren't a whole lot of paylines, but the symbol values aren't bad. Not quite 'book of' value, yet hitting a line of 5 cocktails, glasses, headphones, or bottles will award players 10 to 100 times their bet. The four card royals, J-A, aren't as thrilling, naturally, pulling in 5 to 7.5 times the bet for a 5 OAK hit. Gold turntable wilds help in this process since they substitute all symbols except scatters or cash symbols.Funky Buddha: Slot FeaturesFunky Buddha slot - the drop winThe four prize values sitting next to the game grid are tied to the Cash Collect feature and are joined by Funky Free Spins.Cash CollectWhen a session begins, the first Buddha Collect symbol is active, which may land on the rightmost reel. If 1 or more Cash symbols land on reels 1 to 4 and a Buddha Collect symbol lands on reel 5, the Buddha Collect symbol expands to cover the whole reel, and the Cash symbol values are collected.Once this occurs, the next type of Buddha Collect symbol is unlocked so it may land on the grid. When the next type of Buddha Collect symbol hits, and it collects Cash symbols, the next Buddha Collect symbol is unlocked, and so on, until all 4 Buddha Collect symbols are unlocked. From then on, all 4 will be available in the base game and in free spins. The first Buddha Collect symbol just collects Cash symbols; the other three behave like so:Respin – collects Cash symbols then locks in place while reels 1 to 4 respin for another chance to land Cash symbols.Boost – collects Cash symbols and awards a cash boost to the total.Super Collect – collects Cash symbols up to 10 times.As well as normal Cash symbols are jackpot versions, such as the Mini, Minor, Major, and Mega, worth 10x, 25x, 100x, and 2,000x the bet, respectively.Funky SpinsHit 3 scatter symbols on reels 2, 3, and 4 to win yourself 10 free spins. Free spins benefit from the Cash Collect system as in the base game, but when a Buddha Collect symbol hits, it is collected on a meter. Collecting 3, 6, 9, or 12 Buddha Collect symbols activates a multiplier of x2, x3, x5, or x10, respectively. At each collection point, +5 free spins are also awarded. Multipliers are used to increase the value of collected Cash symbols.Funky Buddha slot - free spinsFunky Buddha: Slot VerdictIt's questionable how beneficial gambling online is for breaking free from the wheel of Samsara, so Funky Buddha's links to Buddhism are a little dubious, but it is a pretty funky game. Well, the tunes have a groove, and some players may appreciate the allusions to wealth and relaxation the theme presents. On a less materialistic note, it might be worth putting this here cos it sounds pretty neat; from Wikipedia: 'Samsara ends if a person attains nirvana, the "blowing out" of the desires and the gaining of true insight into impermanence and non-self reality.'Back in the more mundane physical realm, we've got Funky Buddha, and if you caught Goonies Hey You Guys a few weeks prior to this one, then you'll know what's up. Funky Buddha is a coin collector-style game with a twist or two, one twist being there are 4 Buddha Collector symbols to unlock to see what they can do. As before, Funky Buddha runs similarly to D10S Maradona with a Big Bass Bonanza element injected in the bonus round. Perhaps Goonies Hey You Guys didn't get the insta-success Blueprint Gaming was aiming for, or the company just thought hey, why do one iteration of this when we can do two? Who knows, but the two games could not be much different thematically if they are very close mechanically. As before, the win cap is whichever comes first - 50,000x the bet or $250,000 (or the currency equivalent). As often is the case with Blueprint, you can't help but feel this is a tad optimistic.If you've ever wondered what a Buddha/Mammon mashup on the reels might look like, then Funky Buddha might be able to satisfy some of your curiosity. Beyond that, it wasn't the most thrilling session, reviewing what amounts to a reskin, really, so soon after the original dropped. The beats aren't bad, though, and one bright side is those that dig what Blueprint Gaming's doing with these cash collector games get another one to add to the list.

title: Star Clusters Megaclusters
structured_summary: Star Clusters Megaclusters is a cosmic-themed slot featuring jewel clusters and a space warp backdrop. It introduces the innovative Megaclusters mechanic where winning clusters split into smaller symbols, plus a lucrative free spins round on an expanding grid with multiplier wilds. The reviewer praises its unique gameplay and balanced volatility, noting it grows on players despite a minimalist style. The game boasts retro-futuristic visuals and a synth-heavy audio soundtrack with nostalgic gaming references, creating an immersive sensory experience.
review: Star Clusters Megaclusters: OverviewIt's always a huge deal when Aussie developer Big Time Gaming pull back the curtain on a new release. You may want to pay extra attention, for this release might very well be the biggest thing since the introduction of Megaways. Most would probably agree, Big Time Gaming have built a reputation for innovative brilliance, and players have come to expect (if not demand) something special each time.Big Time Gaming get respect for not being one to coast on prior success. Heck, the team could probably sit back and let the royalty cheques from Megaways licenses roll in. Instead, the team has been busy in their studio cooking up new ways to entertain a gambling crowd voracious for novelty. Well, hold on folks, because not only do we get the first-ever cluster pays slot from Big Time Gaming, but a brand new game engine called Megaclusters driving the action.The first view of the game reveals a new, yet familiar design full of jewels along with a classic menu area to set options. The simple background gives the game a cosmic flying-through-the-warp-at light-speed effect. If you've ever seen the old sci-fi comedy Spaceballs, it's a lot like when the baddies pass from light speed to hit ludicrous speed.Star Clusters Megaclusters - free spins featureThe audio requires a special shout out too as it was something of a passion project for CEO Nik Robinson who busted out the Moog synth to create the music whilst layering a bunch of fun samples over the top. Keep an ear out for references to Street Fighter, Pac Man, Metal Gear, Bonanza, and a couple of casino streamers, among others. Make sure your headphones or speakers can handle bass to get the most out of the house/psytrance track that assists the visuals in creating quite a sensory feast.Booting up the game brings on a 4x4 grid that appears to be set within some sort of classy looking retro device. This is purely a cluster pays slot (albeit with a twist as you will see), which means there are no paylines to keep track of. Instead, winners occur when 5 matching symbols connect either vertically or horizontally.Taking a look at the paytable reveals an assortment of gems of various hues – aqua, yellow, orange, green, blue, red, and purple. Values range from 10x to 50x when 25+ symbols are involved in a cluster. Helping pull clusters together are two wild symbols; a regular wild and a special Gold Wild.Both of these wilds can substitute for any regular pay symbol. The difference is that when a Gold Wild is part of a cluster, a multiplier is applied to the win. The multiplier starts at x1, rising by +1 whenever a Gold Wild is used in a cluster - with no limit. The multiplier resets again on each new spin, unless free spins are triggered.Playable from 20 p/c up to $/€20 per spin, Star Clusters Megaclusters is undoubtedly a volatile game, but not quite as volatile as some of the other offerings in the Big Time Gaming portfolio. Those stung by previous highly volatile Big Time Gaming slots will be pleased to see they have aimed for a slightly more lenient math model. RTP, meanwhile, remains consistent at 96.54%, which is a figure most players can get behind.Star Clusters Megaclusters: Features﻿When a winner hits, that's when the Megaclusters mechanic kicks in, and it's as simple as it is genius. Each symbol that forms part of a winning combo will split into 4 smaller symbols to create even more Megaclusters.When wins occur with these smaller symbols are removed to let new ones fall into the spaces until no more winning combinations appear. All of this means that in the base game, each of the 16 tiles on the 4x4 grid can break up into 4 smaller tiles when part of a win, subsequently bringing the total number of Megacluster up to a maximum of 64.The show piece is a round of Free Spins which are triggered when 5 or more consecutive reactions occur in the base game - 2 free spins are awarded +1 spin for any extra reaction past the 5th. Moreover, any Gold Wild Multiplier attained in the base game is carried over from the triggering spins to the free spins.The free spins round is played on an expanded 8x8 grid. As in the base game, should a cluster form, each of the winning symbols splits into 4 smaller ones. This means that the grid can technically reach 16x16 in size, filling with 256 Megaclusters should it max out. Gold Wilds act as they do in the base game, and when the Gold Wild Multiplier reaches a multiplier of x10, +2 free spins are awarded - with no limits.Star Clusters Megaclusters: VerdictAs with any Big Time Gaming release, the magnifying glass comes out for some close inspection. Let's deal to the outer wrapper before dissecting the brand new mechanic. The game may come across as a little basic at first, but Star Clusters is one of those slots that grows on you.After a few sessions, it can even become a bit of a sport trying to quickly identify any winning clusters before highlighted by the game. It's stupid, but quite entertaining, and particularly challenging when you have what looks like a million tiny symbols in front of you breaking up into even smaller symbols. It can be quite a sight.Big Time Gaming has carved out a unique world that is easy, and fun, to lose yourself in. At the same time, the minimalist approach can feel like one of those Sensation raves where everyone comes dressed in white. Fun for sure, but lacking a little personality.But then again, with something as ingenious as Megaclusters, you don't need all the extra bells and whistles. The game engine carries the game just fine. The game is well balanced too, and can keep you occupied for long stretches of time whilst hovering around your starting balance. The base game can be quite lucrative with potential for wins of up to 1,300x, but the biggest payouts will occur in the free spins game where there is a chance to pocket wins of up to 23,000 times your stake.Fans who might be wary of another eye-wateringly volatile slot, or a tough collection system, will appreciate the different dynamic at play here. Overall, Star Clusters might not be perfect, but it's hard to fault. The Aussie team has burst out of the woodwork with another innovative title, putting a clever twist on their Megaways mechanic. Whether Megaclusters blows up like its sibling remains to be seen, but there is a good chance that we'll never look at cluster pays slots the way we have in the past.Don't Miss...Interested in trying other Big Time Gaming slots utilizing the Megaclusters mechanic? Have a look at Big Time Gaming's next slot in the Megaclusters series titled Cyberslot Megaclusters or Kluster Krystals Megaclusters from Relax Gaming. Alternatively, check out Diamond Fruits Megaclusters which is a continuation on Star Clusters with Bonanza type elements mixed in.

title: Clover Fortunes
structured_summary: Clover Fortunes offers a fresh Irish-themed slot experience featuring magical fairies instead of typical leprechauns. review: Clover Fortunes: Slot OverviewYour first reaction to a name like Clover Fortunes might be, oh great, more Irish themed gaming, just what we need. And while there are Celtic overtures, Clover Fortunes presents a different side of the story than the usual beer mugs, top hats, and leprechauns. Four Leaf Gaming was formed in 2021 by Andy Hollis and John Quinn, a couple of ex-Microgaming execs, who led their previous employer's product and content strategy. They've now poured over two decades of collective experience into 'putting players at the heart of the design and development process.' Let's see how that goal has been conveyed in their debut slot.The first reaction was positive because, while there is a strong Irish influence, the studio has appreciably avoided a lot of the cliches associated with the genre. Instead of Leprechauns, Clover Fortunes populates its reels with four fairy characters in a sort of Sisters of Oz style. This highly volatile slot may be played on any device, where players select stakes of 10 p/c to $/€50 per spin from a Relax Gaming style UI.Clover Fortunes is certainly not short of features or additional betting options, but the core rule is landing matching symbols from the leftmost side to create wins. It starts with optional stake increases, bonus rounds, and feature buys.Lucky SpinActivating the Lucky Spin increases the base bet by 50%, whilst also increasing the number of Fortune Coins, Clovers, and free spin symbols on the reels. Note that this does not increase the value of winning combinations.Game & FortuneThis is one of Clover Fortunes' signature features. Fortune Coins appear overlaid on regular symbols at random, and when they hit, they are collected by the Fortune Wheel next to the reels. The Fortune Wheel is triggered either by random coin collections or when 500 coins have been accrued. From the wheel, players win a cash prize of 20 to 5,000 times their stake or 8-14 free spins.Clover CollectionNext to the game grid on the left-hand side is a prize ladder made up of doors displaying bet multiplier prizes called Clover Wins. Landing 3 or more clover symbols awards a respective prize, of which there are three tiers. The number of clover symbols determines how far players progress along the Cover Wins prize ladder. For example, 10 clovers are needed to win the top prize. These are the tiers:Bronze door prizes are worth 1x to 4,000x.Silver Door Prizes are 2x to 6,000xGold Door Prizes are worth 4x to 10,000x the bet.Clover RespinIn the base game, players can randomly be awarded a respin level of 3 to 7. If the required number of clover symbols hit, all clovers in view stick in place, while the rest of the symbols respin.Clover Fortunes Free SpinsFree spin symbols appear on all reels, and having 3, 4, or 5 in view awards 10, 12, or 14 free spins. If 2 free spins symbols hit, the reels lock in place and award a free respin as an extra chance type thing. Before the feature starts, players can gamble for more free spins. By moving a slider, you can adjust how many free spins you would like to stake. Next, a red and green wheel spins, the green section dependent on the number of free spins staked. Landing on green awards 1, 2, or 3 extra spins, while red loses the free spins you gambled.During free spins, a Clover Respin level is active on every spin, and Clover Wins start at the Bronze level. When Clover symbols land, they can upgrade one of the Clover Win tiers or award up to +5 additional free spins. When the feature ends, players have the choice of gambling their winnings for a chance to replay free spins. Win to begin free spins again, or lose, and you're back to the base game empty-handed.Buy FeaturePayers have two options here. One is buying 10 free spins for 80x the stake or buying one spin of the Fortune Wheel. The base cost of spinning the Fortune Wheel is 60x the bet, but if you have collected some coins already, they can be used to reduce the cost.Clover Fortunes: Slot VerdictThere's a real Lucksome feel to Clover Fortunes and not just because it was started by a couple of veterans from one of the most established studios in the business. Like Lucksome games tend to do, Clover Fortunes also puts players firmly in the driver seat, furnishes them with a wealth of stats and gives them plenty of extra opportunities to gamble. From feature buys, ante bets, free spin gambles, free spins replays, you can barely turn your head without bumping in to yet another way of trying your luck. The good thing is, all of the extras are completely optional, so players are not penalised in any way if they prefer to sample the rainbow drenched delights of the forest, letting fortune unfold in an organic way.When it comes to winning, there are several paths to scoring potentially impressive payouts. The ever-present Clover Collection is one way, as is the Fortune Wheel, both of which can trump up sizeable wins for when luck is running hot. Free spins are also tossed in the mix, and on the whole, Clover Fortune's max coinciding win is 10,008x the bet, though 24,030x was produced during simulated spins. It doesn't say how much additional betting was required to achieve these sorts of numbers, if any, but solid returns are on the cards, no matter how players approach the game.To sum up, Clover Fortunes is a solid debut from Four Leaf Gaming. It wouldn't have hurt if RTP was higher, but the rest of the game has been well thought out and is a bubbling pot of various ideas. Like Print Studios, who debuted with a game that mixed new and familiar elements, there's more than enough going on in Clover Fortunes to whet the appetite over Four Leaf Gaming's next move.

title: Stolen Treasures
structured_summary: Stolen Treasures is a museum-themed slot featuring a collection of ancient artefacts with a subtle nod to cultural controversies. The reviewer finds the base game plain and the bonus round simple but acknowledges the potential for big wins up to 10,428.4x the bet. review: Stolen Treasures: Slot OverviewSoftware provider Red Tiger might not be known for being controversial; the studio generally sticks to subject material, which is unlikely to cause much of a reaction. Well, there was Joe Exotic, but for the most part, Red Tiger slots rarely rock the proverbial boat. For the low-paying symbols, clubs, diamonds, hearts, and spades have been used, while the high pays are five various valuable-looking items. When landing a five-of-a-kind win, the payout values range from 0.8-1.6x the bet for the card suits and 2 to 12 times the stake for the premiums. Crown wilds appear on the reels also, substituting for all paying symbols.Stolen Treasures: Slot FeaturesStolen Treasures slot - hold & spin featureWhen it comes to features, Stolen Treasures keeps things simple, with the extra bits branching off the treasure box symbols. Land 2 of the treasure boxes anywhere on the reels, and they both reveal an instant win which is awarded to the player. Land 3 or more boxes on a spin, and the Hold & Respin round is triggered.For the bonus round, 3, 4, or 5 respins are awarded when 3, 4, or 5 boxes trigger the feature, respectively. The triggering boxes reveal a prize value and become locked onto their positions. During respins, only treasure boxes or blank spaces appear. When boxes land on an empty position, they reveal a value, lock into position, and reset the respin count. If a box lands on a position which already has a box, it doubles the revealed prize – these boxes do not reset the spin count, though. If all positions become filled, the remaining respins simply play out, and any boxes which land double the corresponding prize. When respins run to zero, the total value of the prizes in view is awarded. If the screen is full at the end, the total accumulated prize is doubled.Stolen Treasures slot - hold & spin featureStolen Treasures: Slot VerdictIt's probably a good thing Stolen Treasures alludes to the controversy surrounding museums and some of the items they house. Without it, Stolen Treasures would be pretty dull. Its featureless base game is like wandering into a section of a museum that's being redecorated and has had most of its exhibits removed. Then there's the bonus round, which is pretty plain from a technical standpoint. Hit boxes, accumulate prizes, and collect at the end. There are no special symbols nipping in to get pulses racing and jacking up box values, so it is very straightforward. The twist is landing boxes on boxes to thereby double the values or fill in all the positions to double the winning total. Not bad ideas in themselves, but hardly mind-bendingly innovative unmissable stuff.When it comes to winning potential, though, Stolen Treasures pretty much lives up to its name. Not the stolen part, but there is actually quite a bit of treasure for players to possibly get their hands on. If you can manage to get a whole stack of doubling going on in the bonus game, Stolen Treasures is capable of dishing out wins of up to 10,428.4x the bet. Why the studio went so large on this game is all part of Stolen Treasures' mystery, we guess.There you have it. Anyone interested in traipsing around a virtual museum while the reels spin might find value in Stolen Treasures. The visuals are nice, as is the soundtrack, so no one's eyes or ears are likely to suffer while playing the game. If you like a bit of spice in your hold 'n wins, however, some variety, something that might leap into a bonus round and flip everything on its head, Stolen Treasures might struggle to deliver.

title: Hound Hotel
structured_summary: Hound Hotel is a canine-themed slot set in a luxurious dog-staffed hotel, inspired by classic dog portraits. Key features include Dashing Wilds, a free spins bonus with multipliers, and five special wild modifiers revealed through a door-picking bonus. The reviewer praises its balanced math model, steady wins, and engaging bonus, calling it a charming and fun game despite a slightly dated look. Aesthetically, it offers classy visuals with subtle café hums in the base game and jazzy tunes during bonuses.
review: Hound Hotel: OverviewHound Hotel is part of a classic Microgaming duo, celebrating everyone’s two favourite domestic animals, cats and dogs. The other one, Kitty Cabana, was based on felines, while Hound Hotel is all about canines. If you like those old Coolidge paintings of dogs playing poker, you’ll love what Microgaming has done here. The doggy heroes of this tale reside in a luxury hotel, serving up Dashing Wilds and a nifty bout of free spins which include multipliers plus one of five wild features.As the name implies, Hound Hotel is set in a swanky upmarket hotel full of maids, butlers, and so on. The twist is that the staff and guests are all canines of different breeds, brought to life as if they were people. Action takes place over a 5-reel, 25-payline game area, surrounded by classy columns, while the hotel glitters away in the background. For the most part, the soundtrack is subdued, with a sort of low-level café hum during the base game. Hit the bonus though, and things get all jazzy as the drama heats up.Offering bets of 25 p/c to $/€37.50 per spin, players get an agreeable math model that ensures a steady stream of hits, running on medium volatility. Wins certainly aren’t shy, coming at a rate of nearly 1 in 2, or between 48%-49%. There is almost always some reward on its way, big or small. The return to player rate is another highlight, with a respectable figure of 96.25%.Symbols start with J-A royals, which are utterly generic but the premiums have a ton more personality. Here you’ll find 5 hotel guests, all dogs of various guises. Five of a kind premiums payout 6 to 18 times the stake – double in one of the features detailed below.Wilds are another one of Hound Hotel’s key attributes, during free spins at least. In the base game they aren’t quite so exciting, though they can land stacked. When wilds appear, they substitute for any pay symbol and are also worth up to 20 times the stake for a line of five.Hound Hotel: Features﻿There aren’t too many extras during the base game, though players do get Dashing Wilds. On any non-winning base game spin, this feature may activate, adding 3 Dashing Wilds to the reels in random positions for another chance to win.It’s during the bonus game that Hound Hotel turns up the gas. Firstly, the band kicks into action as soon as 3 or more butler scatters land to trigger the Hound Hotel Bonus. Scatters also payout from any position to the tune of 1x, 2x, 20x, to 100x the stake for 2, 3, 4, or 5 in view.Before getting to the free spins, players are presented with a three-storied view inside the hotel. Clicking on a level 1 door reveals one of five special wild features, a level 2 door for a multiplier up to x6, and a level 3 door to reveal how many free spins are awarded –up to 30. Hopefully the doggy pals perform during the awarded number of free spins because they cannot be retriggered.Doors on floor 2 or 3 may randomly award an extra pick. Free spins and multipliers are self-explanatory, so here is a breakdown of the five wild modifiers:Super stacked wilds – wilds are stacked 20 high on reels 2 and 4.Expanding wilds – wilds expand to cover the full reel when they land.Wilds reels – reels 1 and 5 are permanently wild.Split wilds – wilds split into two, allowing 6 of a kind combinations which are worth double the 5 of kind wins.Super wilds reels – reel 2, 3, or 4 turns wild on each spin. Scatters on reels 1 or 5 also turn them wild as well.Hound Hotel: VerdictMicrogaming hit on just the right formula when they designed Hound Hotel. It’s no fluke dogs are popular pets, and plenty of their charisma flows into the slot. It may look a bit dated today, but the charming theme is accentuated by the human-like qualities, adding to the allure, and creating a fun-filled atmosphere to play in.It’s not all light-hearted moments though. While the base game is nothing overly special, things get pretty intense in the Hound Hotel bonus. It starts with the three nail-biting choices, the outcomes of which have a major impact on how the bonus game turns out. Beneath the bright exterior, the math model is also well balanced in favour of players who like regular winners while waiting for the bonus to trigger. While the stream of hits and Dashing Wilds might not cough up major payouts most of the time, they do help keep spirits bright.Best returns naturally come via the Hound Hotel Bonus, where you want the helpful wee butler to open the door on the biggest multipliers and free spins as possible. As to the best wild feature, they are quite similar, all being based around landing full reel wilds. Scratch just the right spot on this pup for wins of up to 2,933 times the stake.Microgaming struck furry brown gold with Hound Hotel. It might not be the biggest, most vicious Pitbull in the pen, but for some feel-good gaming plus a great bonus game and bags of charm, Hound Hotel remains a firm favourite.

title: Hola Frutas
structured_summary: Hola Frutas is a tropical beach-themed fruit slot from Stakelogic, set on a 6x6 grid with a relaxing island vibe. The game features scatter pays, cascading wins, waves that clear symbols, multiplier symbols with Super Stake, and sticky frozen symbols during free spins. The reviewer finds it a pleasant and engaging scatter pay slot with interesting mechanics, especially enjoying the synergy between frozen symbols and multipliers. Visually, it offers a colorful, sunny beach atmosphere with soothing background sounds transitioning from daytime to sunset scenes.
review: Hola Frutas: Slot OverviewHola players, if you're interested in sampling fruit on the beach through your device and a bit of imagination, here is Hola Frutas from Stakelogic. Hola Frutas is a scatter-paying slot that is in some ways related to Fruit Storm, serving up lashings of fruit in a sunnier location alongside a new set of features. In this game, the main goal is to land sticky symbols in free spins to potentially build solid winning combinations.Slather on a bit of sunscreen because we're heading to the beach for this one. The gaming takes place on a 6x6 game panel, while around it is everything needed for a spot of relaxation. Players who fantasise about an island getaway should be able to picture it – palm trees, colourful flowers, a gentle breeze, sun, sand, sea, waterfalls, and a boat. The base game bakes under the daytime sun, while free spins take place at sunset, where an overwater chalet sits to enjoy the view from. There's not much that beachgoers won't have seen in a slot before, but there is a reason millions of people flock to the sea in summer, and Hola Frutas' view is an agreeable one.Just as the beach is for all, well, public beaches at least, so is Hola Frutas available to play on all device types. It's a medium/high volatile game, with several ways of playing it, generating an RTP of 95.8% seemingly with all of them. Regular bets range from 10 p/c to $/€10 per spin, or you can double the wager by hitting the Super Stake button. With Super Stake active, multiplier symbols can land in the base game, and there is an increased chance of triggering free spins.Made popular by the likes of Sweet Bonanza, Hola Frutas uses a scatter-paying system to generate wins. As long as at least 8 identical symbols are in view, anywhere on the grid, players collect a payout. Values vary from 0.25x to 10x the bet when 8 or 9 lemons, oranges, plums, grapes, bananas, watermelons, strawberries, coconuts, or pineapples hit, rising to a maximum of 2 to 50x the bet when 12+ are in view. As is usually the case when using scatter wins, Hola Frutas does not have a wild symbol.Hola Frutas: Slot FeaturesIn the base game, keep an eye out for extras such as cascades, waves, and multipliers (if Super Stake is active), while waiting for the free spins bonus round to launch.CascadesAfter a winning collection of symbols has paid out, it is removed from the board, and new or remaining symbols fall down into the gaps. If another scatter win occurs after the cascade, the same thing happens again until there are no more new wins.WaveOn random losing spins, a happy fruit chap may surf past on a wave, clearing the bottom three rows of symbols away. This triggers a cascade and provides another chance to possibly win something.Multiplier SymbolsThese only appear on the reels in the base game when Super Stake is active. When they hit, multiplier symbols reveal a random value which is applied to the total win on the current spin.Free SpinsMoving from the base game to the bonus round happens when at least three bonus symbols land. Before free spins begin, one random pay symbol is chosen to be a special frozen symbol. When this special symbol lands, it turns sticky and stays on the grid. If, on the next spin, new chosen symbols land, they become frozen as well and can build into tidy repeat winners. Frozen symbols fall off the grid when a spin occurs that does not contain any new special symbols. Multiplier symbols also appear in free spins whether Super Stake is active or not. If the multiplier is used to increase a frozen symbol win, the frozen symbol may unfreeze and fall off the grid for the next spin.Buy BonusTo dip your toes straight into the water, and the opportunity is available, players can click the Buy Bonus button to go straight to free spins. Here there are three choices – Normal Bonus for 100x the bet, which picks any of the pay symbols to be the sticky one or the Deluxe Bonus, where one of the top four symbols will be selected as the sticky symbol. The third option randomly assigns either the Normal or Deluxe for 125x the bet.Hola Frutas: Slot VerdictHola Frutas turned out to be quite a neat surprise. It opened warmly to a classic tropical island location and steadily heated up as the review went on. Stakelogic has created a pleasant place to chill for a bit and has come up with a few interesting game mechanics to try while you're there. At first, the prospect of ploughing through another fruit-filled grid slot wasn't hugely exciting, yet Hola Frutas has several points of interest worth discovering.Perhaps not so much in the base game, which is pretty elementary. Hit scatters, collect wins, and occasionally score a wave clearance on non-winning spins. It might be tempting to hit the Super Stake to add the potential thrills that random multiplier symbols can bring. What's good is that multipliers can appear in free spins whether you've paid extra for the Super Stake or not.Multipliers proved to be the difference between a so-so bonus round result and a good one during test runs. Part of the reason is that scatter values max out at the 12+ symbol tier. So, even if a lot more frozen symbols are stacking up, true, you get repeat wins, but they are limited to the 12+ payout value. If you're stuck with the lemon, it means 2x the bet even if the grid is full of them. This is where the multipliers can be hugely beneficial.The focus in free spins was often on hitting frozen symbols almost to the exclusion of all others. Sticky frozen symbols can block other symbols from possibly making wins of their own, though using scatter pays rather than cluster pays helps sidestep this issue to an extent. Getting as high a value sticky symbol for free spins as possible is desirable, though there are those multipliers floating around if you get stuck with one of the lower ones.To wrap up, Hola Frutas proved to be a satisfying fruit by the beach game. Scatter pay slots aren't new, but they aren't exactly bursting at the seams with options either. With Hola Frutas, Stakelogic has provided something that fans of the format should be entertained with, especially when the frozen symbol feature manages to team up with a solid multiplier or two.

title: Juicy Fruits
structured_summary: Juicy Fruits is a classic fruit-themed slot set inside a vibrant cocktail glass, inspired by Push Gaming's Fat Rabbit. It features a 5x5 grid with 50 paylines, an Ante Bet option, and a free spins round where collecting scatter diamonds upgrades a roaming wild symbol from 1x1 up to 5x5. The reviewer finds the game volatile and challenging, with entertaining free spins if the wild grows large, but overall lacking originality. A soothing, underwater-inspired soundtrack and bright, bubbly visuals create a pleasant yet generic atmosphere.
review: Juicy Fruits: Slot OverviewFinding inspiration from Push Gaming's 2018 farming slot Fat Rabbit comes a fruity-themed version from Pragmatic Play titled Juicy Fruits. What connects the two games is a scatter collection feature during free spins, which grows a roaming wild symbol. Aside from that, the two games aren't hugely similar. Of the two, Push's game is clearly the more creative, though the fruit market is insatiable, so players partial to classic looks now have a Fat Rabbit version to plough through while getting their five-a-day fix.A slinky backing track eases you into the cocktail lounge atmosphere of Juicy Fruits the moment the 5x5 grid, 50-payline hits the screen. The reels are an explosion of fruit and classic slot icons of all descriptions, from berries to bells. On the edges of the game area, bubbles float upwards, and ice cubes bob around, making it seem like the game is set inside a bright cocktail glass. There's a somewhat generic feel to it, but it's a generally pleasant view overall nonetheless, ideal for those into this sort of thing.Juicy Fruits gets its groove on any device from mobile to desktop, offering a selection of bets which start at 25 p/c and rise to $/€125 per spin. Pragmatic Play has included their optional Ante Bet feature that increases the cost of each spin by 20% without affecting symbol values. The benefit of activating this feature is extra scatter symbols are present on the reels, effectively doubling the chance of triggering free spins naturally.Don't expect too many wins during the base game, or even during the bonus, without assistance from an engorged wild symbol. Juicy Fruits was quite content piling on dead or low-value spins like it was no one's business –reflecting its highly volatile nature, rated 5 out of 5. Max win stats are decent, as is the default RTP which comes in at 96.52%.As for the symbols, Juicy Fruits supplies 11 regular pays to pull together wins with. From low to high, there are limes, cherries, lemons, oranges, apricots, strawberries, kiwifruits, raspberries, watermelons, and fiery 7s - 5 of a kind wins range from 2x to 24x the bet. A wild crown symbol completes the picture, appearing on all reels. In the base game, the wild symbol can hit in 1x1, 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, or 5x5 sizes to replace any pay symbol.Juicy Fruits: Slot FeaturesDiamonds are used as scatter symbols and appear on any reel. Landing 3 or more in view trigger the free spins round, starting with 6 free spins. The progressive feature during free spins is based on collecting diamond scatter symbols. Each diamond that lands is collected and fills a meter located above the reels. For every 3 scatters collected, a random number of 1-3 additional free spins are awarded, and the wild symbol is upgraded.Free spins start with a 1x1 wild symbol always present on the grid, moving randomly to a new random position on the board between spins. When upgraded, the wild increases in size from 1x1 to 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, and then finally 5x5. After the fourth retrigger, free spins cannot be retriggered any more. If free spins are initially triggered by 4 or 5 scatters, the round starts with 1 or 2 scatter symbols already collected on the meter.If the feature buy is available, free spins can be bought from the base game for 100x the total bet. To trigger free spins this way, make sure the Ante Bet is switched off; otherwise, it is not possible to do so.Juicy Fruits: Slot VerdictFor a start, Juicy Fruits' title gives players a clear indication of what to expect theme-wise. In a quick summation, Pragmatic Play has basically swapped the more original farming imagery and characters of Fat Rabbit for a traditional setup in Juicy Fruits. In doing so, they've rammed the game to the gills with fruits of all sorts and added a soothing soundtrack that creates an almost underwater feeling - apt given the action takes place in a cocktail glass. However, the relaxing environment quickly takes a backseat once you're a few spins in; then, the game's volatile nature becomes apparent.Pragmatic Play possibly made the game feel as tranquil as possible to take the focus off what can be a tough main game due to the low win count. The key is building an outsized wild symbol. Unless the wild symbol progresses to at least 3x3 in size, it can be tricky extracting much out of free spins. Hit that level, though, and the big wild coughs up winners on nearly every spin. Activating a 4x4 wild or bigger takes some luck, yet it is a thrill because it means juicy wins on each spin from then on out. You might not be awarded a huge number of free spins, but they can be entertaining should scatters quickly be collected. At best, Pragmatic Plays state wins of up to 5,000x the bet are possible.Due to the rather underwhelmingly generic theme and the borrowing of ideas from elsewhere, Juicy Fruits doesn't score highly in the originality stakes. However, if you can crank the scatter collection during free spins, Juicy Fruits can be a bit of a roller coaster ride. Anything outside that scenario can be tough going though, so be prepared for a challenge if the game looks enticing.

title: Emberfall
structured_summary:
Emberfall is a fiery, lava-themed fantasy slot set in a dangerous, dragon-filled world inspired by Norse battle motifs.  
It features scatter pays, Avalanche wins, a progressive doubling win multiplier up to x65,536, Giant symbols, free and super free spins, and a Fast Track bonus buy menu.  
The reviewer sees Emberfall as a powerful, high-volatility slot that combines familiar features in a brutal, entertaining way with potential for big wins.  
Its aesthetics showcase a gloomy, volcanic landscape with epic fantasy elements, complemented by a sweeping, dramatic musical score.
review: Emberfall: Slot OverviewBy all accounts, 2024 was a strong year for software provider Slotmill, kicking off when the Brew Brothers came ambling onto the picture before spilling over into goodies like Tyrant's Fall and Coins and Cannons. One of the biggest standouts for the provider, if not the biggest, was Norse battle hammer Ragnarok, a cluster pays slot that slammed down a meaty combination of doubling win multiplier, Giant symbols and free spins where the multiplier was persistent. Most of these goodies return for Emberfall, which rejigs the blueprint by swapping out the cluster pays system for scatter pays instead - scatter pays being so hot right now.That heat is reflected in Emberfall, which is situated in a fiery, lava-filled fantasy world with a base game which looks like Morder, all grey, gloomy, and dangerous. The reels sit in front of what could be Mt Doom. By the way, no Lord of the Rings link is ever implied; just flexing some slot reviewing creative licence here. Emberfall provides plenty of fire to fuel fantasy thoughts in its make-believe world of dragon, warrior, and epic, sweeping musical score.Emberfall slot - base gameFor grid, Emberfall adds an extra row and an extra reel compared to Ragnarok to forge a 6x6 aligned gaming space. Volatility is labeled 'very high' while base game betting of 20 c to $/€60 per spin attracts a default RTP of 96.1%. One way of possibly barging into the free spins round quicker is by activating the Xtra-Bet. This feature raises the stake by 50% to increase the chance of triggering free spins by 2.7x. Creating a win involves landing at least matching symbols anywhere on the reels.Since Emberfall features a double-up win multiplier with an astronomical cap, its symbol values have taken a bit of a knock. The symbols themselves are blue, green, red, and purple gems, as well as helms, shields, axes, swords, and a character. Scatter wins of 8 OAK award payouts of 0.1 to 0.4 times the bet, topping out at 3 to 10 times the bet for 16+ OAK. Emberfall does not land wild symbols, nor are any created during the Avalanche process.Emberfall: Slot FeaturesEmberfall slot - free spinsEmberfall is equipped with such features as Avalanche wins, a progressive win multiplier, a Multiplier Boost, Giant symbols, free spins, super free spins, and Fast Track bonus buys.FeaturesProgressive Win Multiplier - The progressive win multiplier starts each base game spin at x1. Each Avalanche doubles the win multiplier up to a cap of x65,536.Multiplier Boost - The Multiplier Boost feature may activate at the start of each game round. When activated, the win multiplier increases a random number of steps.Giant symbols - At the start of each new game round, or at the end of a game round where no more wins are present, giant symbols of 2x2, 3x3, or 4x4 may randomly land on the reels. Giant symbols count as the number of 1x1 symbols making them up.Free Spins & Super Free SpinsLanding 3 scatter symbols in the main game awards 8 free spins. During free spins, the benefit is that the win multiplier does not reset until the round ends. The win multiplier starts on x1, and scatters do not land in the feature. Hitting 2 scatter symbols and a super scatter symbol, meanwhile, triggers 8 super free sins. During super free spins, a Giant symbol is guaranteed to hit on every spin. The mechanics of regular free spins apply to super free spins, as well.Fast TrackFast Track is Slotmill's name for their bonus buy menu, where players can access these: Gamble (250x the bet) - A gamble occurs that is 50/50 likely to trigger either super free spins or nothing, Super Free Spins (500x the bet), Free Spins (100x the bet), Multiplier Boost (40x the bet) - Guarantees the Multiplier Boost triggers, or Super Bonus Hunt (5x the bet) - If free spins trigger, they will be super free spins.Emberfall slot - free spinsEmberfall: Slot VerdictLike Ragnarok, Emberfall is not a delicately constructed slot with elaborate intricacies that piece themselves together just so. Rather, Slotmill took beefy slabs of features and slapped them together to create a barbarian of a game which just wants to punch things. The progressive win multiplier is one such device, and whether the studio was inspired by Yggdrasil Gaming's DoubleMax mechanic or not takes nothing away from its potency. Pound down a win, double the multiplier; it's as simple as that. What's new, and could very well be a first, is that the doubling multiplier works with a scatter-pays win system instead of the win lines or ways we are used to seeing. For fans of scatter wins, and this would appear to be a growing crowd if the proliferation of scatter-paying slots is any guide, Emberfall is essentially a must-see.The game's supporting features are just as uncomplicatedly brutal and work hand in glove with the scatter win, Avalanche, win multiplier trio. Due to the larger (than Ragnarok's) grid size, Giant symbols are even more giant than before, maxing out at 4x4 (or 16 symbols), and having a Multiplier Boost in a double-up multiplier game is always a plus. The review, at times, unfolded much like the features themselves - brutally, and returning positive results from bonus buys wasn't always the easiest task. Then again, Emberfall is very highly volatile, and slots where the multiplier doubles on each Avalanche, the good ones, can go boom in a very distinct and hugely entertaining way. No doubt Emberfall has the ability to do so, and it's able to reward lucky players with up to 15,000 times their bet if they can manage to go all the way.Just for the sake of having a nag, aside from the scatter pays element, there isn't a huge amount of Emberfall that's white-hot original, per se. But it's not hard to put those notions aside for a moment and immerse yourself in a chunky fantasy unreality for a bit and attempt to witness a scatter wins mechanic butt heads with a doubling up multiplier feature and see what sort of fireworks potentially result.

title: Office Party
structured_summary: Office Party is a wild, irreverent slot themed around chaotic office parties and workplace antics. It features multiple wild types, a unique piñata-severance bonus with weapon hits, cascade mechanics, and optional modes like Gimp Mode and bonus buys. The reviewer praises its bold humor and originality, though notes it may feel rough compared to more polished titles, offering a max win potential of 20,000x. The game sports funky 80s/90s-inspired audio and quirky office visuals, including a swinging boss piñata and lively decorations.
review: Office Party: Slot OverviewFew things divide workplace opinion like the dreaded or joyful office party. Some people avoid them like the plague; others can't wait to roll up their sleeves, get trolleyed and say all the things they've been aching to say to their colleagues throughout the year but can't due to office decorum, social convention, and sobriety. For the team's fourth release, it's this workplace minefield that developer Shady Lady hasn't so much walked into than leapt off a desk and belly busted into, all profanities and irreverent humour guns blazing.Baxter & Carlson Stationaries is the company's name, and management is either doing its best to keep a lid on costs or it hasn't been a stellar year for sales. For one, the party is held in the office, where decorations include pennants hanging from the ceiling, some dubious snacks, and a piñata, which looks alarmingly alive. It'll pretty soon become clear that the employees aren't big fans of the boss because, at certain points, he hangs from the hook in place of the donkey as a human beat target, swinging about while a funky 80s/90s inspired soundtrack bass lines away.Office Party slot - base gameOffice Party drops 20 symbols onto a 5x4 gaming area, while a highly volatile math model provides the shindig's behind-the-scenes engine. When betting 10 c to $/€100 per spin, the RTP comes in at 96.28%, though this may change when taking up the multitude of optional betting choices - Gimp Mode and so on, as detailed below.A ways to win system means Office Party has 1,024 ways to win, left to right from the leftmost reel, and there are eight regular paying symbols. They are a 'Kick Me!' Post-it note, smiley meme guy, dice, a stapler embedded in a pudding, and four character symbols. Non-character symbols pay 0.5 times the bet for a 5-of-a-kind combination, while 5 matching character symbol winning combinations pay 1.5x to 2x the bet. Wilds substitute any paying symbol and have the same payout values as the top character symbol.Office Party: Slot FeaturesOffice Party slot - free spins intro screenWhoever arranged this office party has ordered in three wild features, Weapon Lockers, Pinatas, a Severance Bonus, Gimp Mode, and various bonus buys. There is also a cascade mechanic that removes winning symbols and fills gaps by dropping symbols down from above.Wild FeaturesOffice Party comes with these three wild modifiers:Splashin' Wilds - reels 2 to 4 can randomly be stacked with Splashing Wilds. If the right part of the stack lands and creates a win, players can expect more wilds.Smashin' Wilds - randomly triggers in the base game, throwing 1 to 4 beer bottles at random positions on the grid. Beer runs down, covering the affected position and all positions below with wilds. One beer bottle may land per reel.Flashin' Wilds - randomly triggers in the base game, where up to 4 streakers move by, each streaker placing 1 to 4 wilds to random positions on the grid.Weapon Lockers and the PinataIf a weapon locker falls down, it awards one hit of the piñata with a random weapon. Each hit provides the chance to knock the head off the piñata and trigger the bonus. Multiple weapon lockers may land on the same spin.Severance BonusIf the piñata's head is knocked off, the Severance Bonus is triggered, which has four levels. At Level 1, four weapon types are available - Laptop, Trash Can, Office Chair, and Printer. Each one is assigned a multiplier. During the round, coin jars and weapon lockers drop onto the grid. If a weapon locker lands on a coin jar or a stack of coin jars, it crushes them and collects the coins inside. The total is multiplied by the weapon's multiplier.Whether a weapon locker crushes a jar or not, when it reaches the bottom of the grid, it delivers one hit to the Manager and upgrades the multiplier of all higher-class weapons. Each time the Manager is hit, there is a chance he is knocked down, and the bonus progresses to the next level. Each time the level upgrades, the lowest class weapon is removed from the rest of the round, and any stacks of jars collapse, collecting all coins in one jar at the bottom. The bonus continues till the grid is filled with jars, and no more symbols can land.Gimp Mode, Bonus Boosters & Bonus BuysWhen Gimp Mode is enabled, the probability of a weapon hit knocking the head off the piñata is halved, but if the bonus is triggered in Gimp mode, all weapons start with an x2 multiplier. Players are able to buy bonus round entry for 80x the bet (or 160x if in Gimp Mode), the best 3 results from 100, 300, or 500 spins for 66x, 162x, or 236x the bet, respectively, or Loot Boxes.Office Party slot - free spinsOffice Party: Slot VerdictApple and Samsung, Coke and Pepsi, Boeing and Airbus, the business world is full of rivalries, and one might argue a friendly rivalry is starting to brew between Shady Lady and long-standing tricksters of the gambling world Nolimit City. title: Frank's Farm

review: Frank's Farm: Slot OverviewWith the world's population predicted by the UN to hit 11.2 billion in the year 2100, human beings may have to assess our ways of producing food to feed all those hungry mouths. Potential problem solvers are conserving water, reducing food waste, and even using robots. To our knowledge, one method which hasn't been suggested is putting food production in the hands of sloths. Huh, you might be asking, how would that work? Well, it probably wouldn't since sloths aren't exactly known for their dynamic, high-output personalities. In fact, they're usually portrayed as taking it easy, living their best lives. However, for Hacksaw Gaming's online slot Frank's Farm, players get to test the theory – how would a farm run by a sloth perform?Frank, you see, is a sloth, and this is his farm. And what a charming plot of land it is as well. Hacksaw Gaming has proven once again it is as adept at creating friendly, chipper-looking games as they are at dragging players into some of the dankest, most terrifying slot environments on the market. Frank's Farm is also an all-business gambling machine, running on a medium volatile math model, pushing out a variety of RTPs depending on the setting and whether you're playing the game through its bonus buys. On the highest setting, players can expect a theoretical return value of 96.31% when playing normally and a hit rate of 36.1%. Any device is suitable for use, and bets of 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin may be selected.Rather unusually for a Hacksaw Gaming slot, Frank's Farm is a scatter-paying game, which awards a win when at least 8 matching symbols are in view anywhere on its 6x6 game grid. The most valuable scatter wins consist of 15+ symbols and pay 15 to 25 times the bet for the 10-A card royals or 37.5 to 75 times the bet for bees, fish, chickens, pigs, or cow symbols. On top, where available, players get three ways of tackling the game from the bonus buy menu.Market MultipliersMarket Multipliers, as the name suggests, are multipliers that multiply all wins while they are on the reels. If more than one Market Multiplier is in view, their values get multiplied together before being applied to any win. Possible Market Multiplier values are x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, or x10.Order Rush Bous GameLanding 3 FS symbols in the base game triggers 10 free spins in the Order Rush bonus game. Each FS symbol landing in the feature awards an additional free spin. During Order Rush, players are given orders to complete. Orders are displayed next to the reels and consist of 1 to 3 symbol types. Each symbol type on the order consists of 10 to 24 symbols, and each time an order is completed, the difficulty of the next order increases and the minimum value of Market Multipliers increases by +1. Whenever a required symbol type lands on the reels, it is collected in the order – it does not have to be a winning symbol.Diner Dash Bonus GameLanding 4 FS symbols in the base game triggers the Diner Dash bonus game with 10 free spins. Maximum RTP is 96.28%.Order Rush – costs 100x the bet, max RTP is 96.39%.Diner Dash – costs 200x the bet, max RTP is 96.34%.Frank's Farm slot - feature buy menuFrank's Farm: Slot VerdictScatter pays is one of Frank's Farm's focal points, and the studio has put it to good use. As has often been the case with other studios in the past, most noticeably Pragmatic Play, Hacksaw Gaming has paired it with a multiplier feature. Still, even on its own, a Market Multiplier can be handy when linked with a juicy cluster win.As for the bonus rounds, the Order Rush proved to be the most enjoyable of the two during testing. title: Peaky Pigs

review: Peaky Pigs: Slot OverviewScandinavian software provider Snowborn Games continues its march of the anthropomorphic animal-themed slots with a release comically titled Peaky Pigs. Piggy banks showed up in a previous slot from Snowborn Games titled Coin Bash, but the slot which relates most closely to Peaky Pigs is Cat Clans. The animalistic connection between the two games isn't strong, but Peaky Pigs is, for the most part, a reskin of Cat Clans with one or two adjustments. Peaky Pigs is about 'goofy pig gangsters fighting for rule of the gritty streets', in which Pork&Sons searches for a new head of the family. Its location is a dimly lit, grey city street sporting Tommy Guns, smoking chimney stacks, and plenty of gang-related paraphernalia. Peaky Pigs is done in the name of fun, though, and keeps things playful, as has been Snowborn Games' tendency in the animal-based slots they have made so far.Peaky Pigs slot - base gameUnder the bonnet, it's a slightly different story as Peaky Pigs is a highly volatile slot which comes in several RTP settings. In addition, wild symbols land with multipliers of x1 to x5, and if a win includes more than one multiplier wild, the values are multiplied together.Peaky Pigs: Slot FeaturesPeaky Pigs slot - bonus gamePeaky Pigs' two showpiece features are free spins and a Piggy Pots Bonus. Free spins may trigger organically or be bought in certain situations.Piggy Pots BonusCoin symbols can appear on top of any Pig symbol and are collected when they hit. When Coins are collected, there is a chance the Piggy Pots Bonus is triggered. When it is, 5 free spins are awarded, and each of the pigs is associated with one of the four Piggy Pots prizes. During the free spins, when Pig symbols land, they are collected. At the end of the round, the pig that has been collected the most awards the prize they have been assigned to. Prizes are worth 15x, 20x, 200, or 5,000x the bet.Free SpinsLanding 3 pocket watch scatter symbols on reels 1, 3, and 5 triggers 3 free spins. If a wild symbol lands on a free spin, it becomes a sticky wild, meaning it is held in position for the rest of the feature - and the spin count is reset to 3. On each spin, 1 random sticky wild in view has its multiplier value increased by +1. The highest a single sticky wild multiplier can reach is x9. On a last note, if the opportunity is there, players can buy free spins for the cost of 50x the bet.Peaky Pigs slot - free spinsPeaky Pigs: Slot VerdictLike its predecessor, there's good stuff happening in Peaky Pigs. Whether the gameplay suits pigs or cats better is a personal choice, but putting preference aside for a moment, it has to be said that the features are just as entertaining now as they were in the previous game. The only majorly noticeable difference is the top prize in the Piggy Pots bonus is half of what was possible in Cat Clans' Clan Battle Bonus – 5,000x vs 10,000x. RTP is slightly higher this time around, but for most intents and purposes, Peaky Pigs offers the same level of thrills as its feline counterpart, but with gangster pigs in the driving seat instead.As before, Peaky Pigs has a nice blend of extras with multiplier wilds livening the base game alongside Coin symbols, which help keep you on your toes whenever they are collected. In testing, bonus rounds triggered fairly regularly, and if available, buying them for 50x the bet feels almost quaint in an era where they can cost up to 3,000x in other games. You get quite a good bonus for that too, where those sticky multiplier wilds, potentially multiplying each other, get a chance to flex. At full whack, Peaky Pigs posts a max win figure all the way up to 20,000x the bet.After playing through several of these now, it seems that Snowborn Games do like their animal-driven slots. The good thing is the studio has built up a solid level of expertise, and Peaky Pigs is another example of the type of cute animals mixed with potent features experience we've come to expect from the team. Sure, it helps that Peaky Pigs had help by being built on a tried and tested format. However, if you liked Cat Clans, you will probably like Peaky Pigs as well, and if you happen to prefer pigs to cats, as well, then this will be tantamount to a porcine celebration. The question now is what member of the animal kingdom might Snowborn Games use next – dogs, bees, buffalo, or something more obscure?

title: Midnight Marauder
structured_summary: Midnight Marauder is a night-time gem theft-themed slot featuring a cartoonish, playful burglar. It offers a Collect & Multiplier feature with cluster wins, respins, and free spins, plus a buy feature for free spins. The reviewer found the gameplay engaging once the multiplier mechanics clicked, praising its high win potential despite a plain base game. The aesthetics are simple with drab reels, but the charming burglar and lively soundtrack add lightheartedness.
review: Midnight Marauder: Slot OverviewAccording to Oxford Languages, the word marauding means 'going about in search of things to steal or people to attack'. If one was to engage in a spot of marauding (not encouraged, by the way), then doing so at midnight would be as good a time to do so as any. This is the premise of Midnight Marauder from developer Relax Gaming, where players join a dastardly crook as he attempts to nab gems at night in an online slot built around an ingenious Collect & Multiplier feature.Midnight Marauder is played on a 6x6 sized game grid that uses clusters of matching symbols to form wins. The grid itself is a bit plain and can come off as somewhat generic due to the humdrum nature of the symbols, while the rest of the screen shows a building at night as a sneaky burglar constantly tiptoes around during play. Obviously, actual marauding in real life is pretty lame, so Relax has used a cartoonish, jokey, loveable burglar type approach to keep things light and breezy. If you've ever played the Microgaming classic Bust the Bank, that's the sort of vibe that's going on. It works, too, giving Midnight Marauder an agreeable feel, though, again, the game panel and symbols do look somewhat plain, which can be a deal-breaker for picky players.Those who wish to try their hand at some pretend marauding can do so on any device, selecting bets of 10 p/c to $/€30 per spin in the process. A highly volatile game, Midnight Marauder has a default RTP value of 96.19%, rising to 96.87% when buying free spins. Kudos for the increase, but there is little separating the base and bonus game, so players don't miss much (as you will see) if they remain stuck in the main game for extended periods of time. It's also worth noting that there is a jackpot version available titled Midnight Marauder Dream Drop. It's connected to Relax Gaming's progressive jackpot and comes with an RTP of 94.0% (includes 12% jackpot contribution).Winning clusters are formed when at least five matching symbols land in adjacent positions, vertically or horizontally. All regular pays are gems of varying shape and colour and have individual values of 0.1 to 2 times the stake. The number of symbols in a winning cluster is simply multiplied by the individual symbol value to calculate payouts. No wild symbol appears at any time in Midnight Marauders, so the only other symbol is the scatter.Midnight Marauder: Slot FeaturesThe main way players will be able to pull off a successful maraud is with the Collect & Multiplier feature – available in the base game and in free spins. Here's how it works. Whenever a winning cluster hits, the win is collected and stored on the grid in a single symbol position, represented by a swag bag icon. A respin is then awarded. During the respin, if a winning symbol lands in a position adjacent to the bag collection symbol, it is added, and another respin is awarded. Also, if a new winning cluster hits, it is also transformed into a single bag symbol and a respin awarded.When respins end, the multiplier value on the bags (the total number of collected winning symbols) is applied to the symbol's value and awarded. Where it gets interesting is when there's more than one bag of the same symbol type in view. In this case, all matching bag types are multiplied together before being applied to the individual symbol value.Free SpinsLanding 3 scatter symbols awards 8 free spins, plus you get 2 additional free spins for any additional triggering bonus symbol. Free spins operate under the same rules as the base game, and each scatter symbol that lands in view during the round awards an extra free spin.Buy FeatureIf available in your jurisdiction, players can buy free spins for the cost of 100x their bet to guarantee a game round with a free spins activation.Midnight Marauder: Slot VerdictWell, it wasn't quite love at first sight. There was something sparsely half-finished about the gameboard that held us back from letting go for a while. The way the board is all just gems against plain reels combined with the difficulty of assessing their values took time to adjust to. After settling in and witnessing the Collect & Multiplier feature do its thing a few times, however, the game quickly warmed up. Again, initially, just how exponential the multiplying process could be wasn't apparent. A few minor symbol wins hit, respins pulled in a few symbols to build a modest prize pot; all pretty humdrum and made more so by the drab looking reel set and nondescript gems. The slapstick burglar added charm, as did the playful soundtrack, in what was shaping up to be a so-so experience.Then, multi clusters started hitting, and just how exponential they could be was revealed. Suddenly, Midnight Marauder came alive with possibilities, and our eyes were drawn to the symbols as they fell, scouting for potential cluster adds to swell swag bags. Then, when no more winning symbols hit, each individual bag could occasionally multiply each other into something special. The main thing to keep in mind, if you're going to leap right into the action, is that bag values are not bet multipliers. They multiply the symbol's value, which might disappoint if you weren't clear on the point.Even then, winning clusters applied to each other can be shockingly effective. During the test round, some pretty spectacular results were achieved, keeping in mind Midnight Marauder has a max win of 30,000x the bet. With so much potential multiplying going on, that figure definitely felt achievable. Not easy mind you, Midnight Marauder can also tease, but achievable.Like some other games Relax has done, Plunderland comes to mind here, Midnight Marauder is fairly simple, but it has a challenge factor which is hard to back down from. The way new symbols boost bags, then get applied to other matching bag types can skyrocket values in a moment, making each symbol drop highly absorbing. Eyes were constantly darting about the board in an attempt to spot potential wins, which, when it all goes to plan, can be absolutely righteous, in a Bill & Ted sense of the word. As always from Relax, Midnight Marauder is a well-built slot possessing some decent numbers, though you can't help but feel something is missing. Premiums with a bit more personality, something extra added to the base game as well as a bonus round that stands out more from the rest of the gameplay would probably have helped push Midnight Marauder beyond 8/10.

title: Annihilator
structured_summary: Annihilator is a heavy metal-themed slot inspired by the Canadian thrash metal band of the same name. review: Annihilator Slot: OverviewBrace your eardrums people, the 6th slot in Play’n GO's heavy metal series is poised to drop. Based around the Canadian thrash metal band of the same name, Annihilator features a full playlist for fans of the band to scroll through. For those of you who may not have heard of Annihilator, don't be too surprised. Despite being in the game for 35+ years and churning out 17 records over that time, they never quite cracked the big leagues.Perhaps partly due to the group being more or less a one-man band in Jeff Waters who has been there since the beginning. The rest of the group has been a revolving door of musical stand-ins doing their best to rival Spinal Tap. From in and out band members to spinning reels, let's see what one of the old hands of thrash metal can bring to the table.After the extravagance of Testament, Annihilator feels like a step-down. It's a nice-looking slot, but doesn't have the in your face, kick to the nuts, look that Testament had. It's more restrained, and comes across as quite an average slot at first glance.That might be way off the mark, but that's the impression Annihilator gives off. Still, visually it's up to the task of entertaining musos and slots fans with its dark and spooky nature. The vibe is created by the creepy gated property in the background, as well as the blood-spattered symbols. If you're feeling brave, set stakes from 10 p/c up to $/€100 and enter the Fun Palace.Beneath the creep, the game is straightforward. It uses 5 reels, 3 rows, and 10 paylines to line up winners on. This happens when at least three or more matching symbols hit consecutively on a payline.It starts with the 10-A metallic royals designed in the band logo's font. The premiums pick up on the eerie theme and depict a cracked mirror, a guitar, and Alice clutching her teddy bear. Alice is worth the most from the regular symbols at 30 times the stake for a line of five. Jeff Waters pops up as the wild and can substitute for any other pay symbol. Wild Jeff also pays out 40 times the stake, should five wilds line-up.Underneath all of the blood-soaked fanfare, the stats pouring forth from the math model are pretty standard Play’n GO fare. On the return to player side, the default RTP is 96.2%, though that can be found at 94.2% or lower depending on casino and market. When it comes to volatility, the beast isn't as wild as it could be, though at 8/10 it's still in the high range - which leads us to the features.Annihilator Slot: FeaturesAnnihilator mobile viewTwo more symbols finish off the paytable and activate a couple of the extras. One is the doll bonus scatter which appears on reels 2, 3, and 4 - when 3 land, they trigger the Fun Palace pick bonus feature. Here, players pick doll symbols to reveal instant prizes. If rewards of 1x, 2x, 3x, or 5x the bet is selected, then players can choose another doll, and the win is accumulated. If it reveals rewards of 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, or 50x the win is collected and the feature comes to an end. Alternatively, if a pick reveals the free spins scatter symbol, then the Set the World on Fire feature is launched.The other way to access Set the World on Fire Free Spins is when 3 free spins scatters land anywhere in view during the base game. Either way, 8 free spins are awarded with an expanded Jeff Waters wild symbol in view at all times. Before each free spin, the expanded wild moves left or right a random number of reels. In doing so, the moving wild highlights certain positions in a fiery trail that can be 1 or 3 symbols in height.If a wild symbol lands in any of the highlighted positions, it turns the whole trail wild. The bonus symbol does not land during this round, but scatters do, and each one adds 2 more free spins up to a maximum of 50.The last extra, the In Command feature, randomly pops up at any time during the base game. When triggered, any visible wild symbol expands to cover a reel. If no wins show, then a respin occurs with the expanded wilds held in place. Respins continue until a win eventually hits.Annihilator Slot: VerdictPerhaps the developers at Play’n GO needed to rest their ears after the Testament onslaught. That one blew the doors off in every regard. Being one of Play'n GO's highest potential slots, Testament took the series way over the top and set expectations sky-high for the next.Unfortunately, the foot has come off the gas for Annihilator and the result is a toned-down, more restrained game. Fans of the band will probably love it though. Their man Jeff is all over the place and the playlist will give them something to head-bang along to while spinning for glory.How much glory? Well, not a patch on its predecessor. Annihilator's potential of up to 5,000 times the stake is a quarter of what Testament can offer. It doesn't help that single spin wins max out at 400 times the stake and without a multiplier in sight you'll definitely need a lot of luck during free spins to crack massive amounts. Worth mentioning is that the free spins frequency is low due to the inclusion of the pick bonus and base game expanding wilds.Perhaps because Annihilator is an older band, the team felt inspired to create an older kind of slot. After the all firing, crowd surfing mayhem of Testament, it felt like the series could go anywhere next. Now, with a picking game and simple mechanics, the Annihilator slot feels like a warm-up act of a band you kind of know, but never really fell for.All up though, Play’n GO has once again produced another decent, above-average slot. Stats are respectable, the potential is good, and the features certainly contain some promise. Annihilator the slot might be restricted to local club bookings rather than stadiums, but it has its moments.Don't MissPlay'n GO has created several branded slots based on various iconic rock bands. If these sort of games floats your boat you might want to check out ZZ Top Roadside Riches, a 5-reel, 1024 payways slot offering wins of up to 40,000 times your stake.

Both wilds substitute for any paying symbols.Folsom Prison: Slot Features﻿If you don't like creepy crawlies, take a deep breath before continuing because Folsom Prison is lousy with them.
