review: Cursed Treasure: Slot OverviewCursed Treasure is an online slot from developer NetEnt that takes players on an adventure in a thick, jungly location where they have the chance to get their hands on treasure via such features as Cash Prize symbols, Mystery Prize symbols, and a hold 'n win bonus round. While not a Kong game, Cursed Treasure does give off a Skull Island vibe, where the bush is dense, looks hard to traverse, and wouldn't be surprising if it was full of dangerous creatures.The game also gives off a 1930s to 1950s-era B-movie feel not a million miles away from former NetEnt slots such as The Invisible Man or Creature From The Black Lagoon, with a dash of an Indiana Jones adventure featuring heroes, villains, mysteries, and exotic locations thrown in. However the rest of Cursed Treasure manages to play out, NetEnt has done a swell job building the game world, making good use of the background imagery, panning camera, and aural effects.Cursed Treasure slot - base gameTo board the adventure, players pick a stake of 20 c to $/€80, keeping in mind that Cursed Treasure collection progress is saved per bet level. Behind the B-movie scene, Cursed Treasure chugs along with a low/medium volatile math model and default RTP of 95.99%, or 96.1%, when buying the free spins bonus round. Across its 5-reel, 4-row grid matrix, 20 paylines are built in for evaluating line wins and, in some instances, Cash Prize symbol wins.The paytable lists 10 to A card ranks as the low-win symbols, then a map, a book, and three further characters as the high-win batch. Hitting a line of 5 royals pays 1 times the bet, no matter the winning combination type, while a line of 5 matching high pays awards 2 to 8 times the bet. In the main game, wilds appear on reels 2, 3, and 4 to substitute for anything except scatters or Cursed Treasure symbols.Cursed Treasure: Slot FeaturesCursed Treasure slot - free spinsCursed Treasure is essentially a hold 'n win style game with a few twists, one being that Cash Prize symbols award their displayed values in the main game when they create winning lines of themselves.Cash Prize SymbolsIn the base game, landing 3 or more Cash Prize symbols on a bet line from the leftmost to the rightmost reel without gaps awards a win equal to the sum of their values. Cash Prize symbols appear on all reels in the main game, showing values of 0.5 to 20 times the bet. Each Cash Prize symbol can pay only once per spin. Wilds may substitute for Cash Prize symbols, but they have a value of 0.Cursed Treasure FeatureCursed Treasure symbols appear on all reels and are collected whenever they land. The meter starts at 5 and each collected Cursed Treasure symbol increases it by +1. The Cursed Treasure feature can randomly trigger in the base game when a Cursed Treasure symbol is collected, or it automatically activates when the meter reaches 20. Now, when the Cursed Treasure feature is activated, a number of Cash Prize symbols equal to the number on the meter are placed on the reels. If the collection number is less than 20 in the main game, the Cash Prize symbols placed on the reels have values of 0.5 to 5 times the bet. If the collection has 20 or more, the values are 0.5 to 20 times the bet. If Cash Prize symbols are added to the same position as another Cash Prize symbol, the values are added together. After placement, wins are awarded, and the meter resets to 5.Mystery Cash Prize SymbolsDuring free spins, Mystery Cash Prize symbols may appear on the reels with a random value of 50 to 5,000 times the bet. Their prize is revealed at the end of free spins.Free SpinsA total of 3 free spins are awarded when 3 or more scatters land in the base game. During free spins, landing Cash Prize symbols (with values of 0.5x to 10x), Cursed Treasure symbols, or Mystery Cash Prize will resets the spin count to 3. These are the only symbols which appear in the free spins bonus round. Cash Prize symbols and Mystery Cash Prize symbols also stick in place when they hit. Cursed Treasure symbols are collected in a new meter that starts at 5, increasing by +1 for each collected symbol. When spins run out, the Cursed Treasure collection places a number of Cash Prize symbols on the reels equal to the number collected on the meter. Cash Prizes cannot be placed on Mystery Cash Prizes. Following this, the total prize value is awarded. Free spins end when the free spins counter goes to 0, all positions are full, or there are 15 Mystery Cash Prize symbols in view.Feature BuyFree spins can be triggered by using the feature buy, which costs 100 times the bet. When bought, free spins are immediately activated.Cursed Treasure slot - free spinsCursed Treasure: Slot VerdictCursed Treasure goes to show that when NetEnt wants to flex its game world construction skills, it can still do a solid job. The Skull Island/Indiana Jones thing is a little cliched, but that's okay; NetEnt has made nice use of it anywhere in a slot which hearkens back to the studio's earlier days. Maybe not quite Relic Raiders days, yet an earlier time when NetEnt was one of the towering powerhouses of slot design. This isn't to say Cursed Treasure is a powerhouse of a game, but for an uncomplicated hold 'n win slot in an exotic location with a lashing of adventure, it's not bad.The gameplay wasn't as striking as the audiovisuals, yet it has its moments. Winning Cash Prize values when they fall along a payline isn't wholly unique; 4ThePlayer, for example, has used this idea in its '4 Fantastic' slots, yet it's not a very common method. Nor is collecting Cursed Treasure symbols, which can end up adding Cash Prize symbols back onto the board at later points. The Cursed Treasure feature is a welcome addition to the base game, and it's able to add a positive end to a free spins bonus, as well, adding tension as the round progresses. Mystery Cash symbols are able to contribute to the anticipation, as well, since a single revealed 5,000x prize gets lucky players well on the way to the game's 5,064x max win.Cursed Treasure probably isn't the sort of slot that's going to thrust NetEnt back into the spotlight and have its competitors shaking in their boots. However, it's one of the better slots the studio has released of late, not only looking and feeling like a wholly NetEnt product (rather than seeming like a joint venture with Red Tiger) but also having a decent level of entertainment to offer the right gambler.

title: Book of Toro
structured_summary:

review: Book of Toro: Slot OverviewIf you missed the news, ELK Studio is celebrating the fifth anniversary of their smash hit Wild Toro with a three-stop world tour. Each event on the calendar sees the release of a new Wild Toro styled game, and Book of Toro is the second on the schedule. The first was Wild Toro 2, which successfully took the characters, gameplay, and features players loved about the original, then significantly expanded it. Speaking of expanding, number two slot on the world tour, Book of Toro, uses the special expanding symbols characteristic of these sorts of games that fans no doubt want to see. However, this isn't a simple matador themed 'book of' slot. ELK has done a number on the format, somehow squeezing in a host of Toro elements to produce a very unique 'book of' game.You might not get this impression at the beginning since the game is located in a generic Egyptian location decorated with sarcophagi and hieroglyph covered pillars. The 10 numbered paylines are even listed on the sides of the 5-reel game grid. This is more a respectful acknowledgement of the classic nature of these games though since the rest is wholly modern. Special mention needs to go out to ELK's sound team, once again providing an indulgent serving of ear candy. The music has an Egyptian touch, but it's not a chilling on the banks of the Nile sketching pyramids vibe, but rather closer to something you'd crank with the ragtop down while cruising the streets of modern Cairo.Book of Toro is playable on any device, offering a range of bets from 20 p/c to $/€100 a pop. As can be expected, volatility is high, yet not the highest, rated as 7 out of 10. The RTP, meanwhile, isn't exactly the highest either on 95%, though the game uses only one universal RTP, so you always know what you get. Regular wins occur when at least two highs or three low pay symbols land from the leftmost side at a frequency of 23% - unfortunately, there is no mention of bonus frequency.Symbols, for the most part, are typical Egyptian icons, but ELK has brought some individual flair to them. From bottom to top are 10-A royals, scarabs, bird adorned jewellery, Eyes of Horus, and the matador as the most valuable symbol. Interestingly, the matador doesn't feature in Book of Toro anywhere near as much as previous games. There is a lot going on in Book of Toro, and as a counterbalance, symbol values aren't as high as they are usually, where five premiums are worth a payout of 20 to 250 times the stake. This doesn't dampen the game's overall potential, it has to be said. Three wilds pop up at various times – a wild book scatter, a walking wild and a regular wild. All substitute any pay symbol to help complete wins.Book of Toro: Slot FeaturesBook of Toro has a lot going on. As well as free spins with expanding symbols are Toro Goes Wild, Mummy Respins, and five X-iter bonus buy options, where available.Toro Goes WildToro the bull is a walking wild, which only appears on the last reel. When Toro hits, he moves one reel to the left until he falls off the grid, generating a respin for each step. If a Mummy Symbol lands at the same time Toro is in view, the Toro Goes Wild feature is triggered. With this one, Toro moves vertically, then horizontally to knock all mummy symbols off, leaving a trail of regular wild symbols behind him. On a side note, book symbols are sticky during Toro Goes Wild.Mummy RespinsLanding 2 or more mummy symbols in view triggers Mummy Respins. Mummy symbols lock into position for the following respin, and any new mummy symbols also lock and award respins. If Toro hits, the Toro Goes Wild feature is immediately triggered.Free SpinsThe book symbol is wild, but it is also the scatter. Landing 3, 4, or 5 books awards 10, 15, or 20 free spins. At the beginning of free spins, a pay symbol is randomly chosen for expansion. If they can create a win, expanding symbols grow to cover all positions on their reels after any regular wins have been paid. Expanded symbols pay all lines and do not have to be adjacent to each other. If at least 3 books land during the feature, free spins are retriggered, and an additional symbol is selected to be an expanding symbol. It is possible to have up to 3 expanding symbols at once.In a twist, Toro substitutes for expanding symbols if he is present on the reels. In addition, if Toro covers an expanding symbol as he walks, it can still expand for a win evaluation. Keep in mind Mummy Respins and Toro Goes Wild can be triggered during free spins as well.X-iterUsers are able to play Book of Toro in regular mode or bonus mode. X-iter is the bonus mode and comes with 5 options:Mummy Respins (5x the bet) - one spin with guaranteed Mummy Respin.Toro (25x the bet) - one spin with a guaranteed Toro. Any book symbols that land on respins become sticky.Mini bonus (50x the bet) - 3 spins with a randomly selected expansion symbol.Bonus (100x the bet) - entry to the regular version of free spins.Super bonus (500x the bet) - gets you the bonus game, plus all book symbols are sticky. Also, expanding symbols are kept sticky as long as one additional expansion symbol lands or until there are expansion symbols on all five reels.Book of Toro - Mummy respins in actionBook of Toro: Slot VerdictBook of Toro's first surprise is that it appears to be the first 'book' slot ELK has done. The studio seems to have gotten by without needing any Ra in their lives up until this point. However, many developers succumb eventually, and the temptation to make their individual stamp on the genre must have proved irresistible. Individual is a good word for Book of Toro which does a bunch of stuff you won't find elsewhere. To squeeze so many features that are capable of blowing the game apart at any moment is a mathematical feat not to be sneered at. The other admirable thing is how Book of Toro retains such strong roots to two different games, and it is tough to think how ELK could have melded Wild Toro with 'book of' gaming any better.Turning to features, it's hard to know where to begin; there is so much going on. Let's start on a positive note by saying if you can get free spins on a good roll, they almost feel unstoppable. Factoring in respins, retriggers, multiple expanding symbol evaluations, plus Toro Goes Wild means bonus games can stretch, elongate, and run for a real long time. Sticky expansion symbols are a stroke of genius, and it's impressive how ELK has managed to incorporate so many different elements while still making everything work. Wild Toro's personality shines through the 'book of' format at all times, and the amalgamation of the two gaming forms is outstanding.Another talent ELK has is letting loose moments of unbridled chaos on the reels. Nitropolis or Nitropolis 2 are prime examples here, and players can get a taste of this in Book of Toro when all cylinders are firing and the game is throwing everything into the mix. Buying the Super Bonus is probably your best bet of experiencing the full-blown roller coaster effect. It's not cheap, yet an offshoot of all this mayhem is that winning potential is double the standard figure at 10,000x the bet.We've gushed on about the highlights but don't get the impression Book of Toro is some sort of cash cannon. ELK also knows how to control the chaos, and not every bonus round was a blinder. There's also the RTP concern, which might irritate some players. Setting that to the side, fans of Wild Toro and 'book of' style games owe it to themselves to give Book of Toro a whirl. It's got everything you might expect from a meeting between Toro and 'book' gaming, plus a whole lot more.

In addition, the base game has a couple of special modifier symbols:Compressor – removes all symbols from the screen except wilds or scatters, causing a tumble. That would be Cash Truck Xmas Delivery, which, as the title makes clear, was a Christmassy makeover for players who were keen on some lorry-chasing action during the holiday season. Quickspin has revived the thrilling spirit of the original Cash Truck, creating another immersive game world for players to lose themselves in while the studio tinkered around with the figures and features. title: Hercules & Pegasus

review: Hercules & Pegasus (Pragmatic Play): OverviewGreek mythology themed slots abound, but few have the winged horse Pegasus amongst their ranks. The player chooses one to reveal a random feature:Hercules Wild – a random number of Hercules Wild symbols are sprinkled over the reels for the following spin.Pegasus Wild – several Pegasus Wild symbols are added to the reels for the next spin. If winning combinations land, they may also have a x2 multiplier applied.Bolts of Zeus – a random number of stacked Zeus reels are selected. When the reels stop spinning these reels are all transformed into a common symbol.The golden Bonus symbol works in conjunction with the Hercules Bonus symbol and the Pegasus Bonus symbol. This might sound a little confusing and requires a fair amount of squinting at the paytable to fully understand, but here we go.Get the Golden Bonus symbols on reels 1 and 3, and the Hercules Bonus on reel 5 to trigger the Hercules Free Spins. There is no limit to the number of free spins during this round. A new flask symbol can appear on the 5th reel. When it does land, it awards extra wilds, but when it lands for the fifth time the free spins come to an end.Land the Golden Bonus symbols on reels 1 and 3, along with the Pegasus Bonus symbol on the fifth reel to unlock the Pegasus Free Spins. Again, there are unlimited free spins which come to an end when the fifth flask lands. Until then, the flask increases a win multiplier from x1 up to x5.Finally, if Golden Bonus symbols land on reels 1 and 3, and a Hercules Bonus and a Pegasus Bonus land on reel 5, the Hercules & Pegasus Free Spins are triggered. This time the two types of flasks can add Hercules wilds and win multipliers at the same time. As before, if five of the same flask lands the round is over.Hercules & Pegasus (Pragmatic Play): VerdictIt sounds like a lot is going on, and there is, but there can also be a fair amount of dead spins and downtime. Hercules & Pegasus is one of those games that is a lot less cute than it looks. Lurking beneath the cartoon graphics and the smiling characters is a ruthless mathematical model that can punish and reward in equal measure. Yes, it can work in your favour, but at times it can feel like Hercules’ last task which was wrestling Cerberus with his bare hands.Hercules was famous for his 12 tasks. With theoretically unlimited free spins on tap, wins likely have the potential to rack up, but as no max win cap has been stated by Pragmatic nothing can be said for sure.Hercules & Pegasus has its moments and is an entertaining game, and one that could easily sting casual gamers lured in by its cute looks. As far as Mythology themed slots go, it is okay, but there are far better options out there such as Blueprint's Gods of Olympus or Rise of Olympus from Play'n GO.

title: Good Luck & Good Fortune

review: Good Luck & Good Fortune: Slot OverviewTwo desirable things when embarking on any endeavour, including online gambling, are good luck and good fortune. This just happens to be the name of today's slot, Good Luck & Good Fortune, from developer Pragmatic Play's quirkier younger sibling, Reel Kingdom. For Good Luck & Good Fortune, the studio has taken a walk on the; well, it's a little hard to discern at times exactly what the Reel Kingdom was getting at here; something to do with magic or luck? There's also a crystal ball motif running through what came across as a game, which wasn't completely sure what it was meant to be. Perhaps Good Luck & Good Fortune is one of those things that people in the know, or are intrigued by, just get while everyone else scratches their head perplexedly.Good Luck & Good Fortune slot - base gameEnough with the head-scratching, time to turn our focus to some of Good Luck & Good Fortune's inner workings. Also, hitting a 5 wild winning line pays 900x the bet, but wilds do not multiply wins that include only wilds.Good Luck & Good Fortune: Slot FeaturesGood Luck & Good Fortune slot - free spinsThe other features on tap here are scatter symbol wins, free spins, and a bonus buy.ScatterThe crystal ball-type object is Good Luck & Good Fortune's scatter. When 2 scatters hit, they pay a random amount of 0.1x to 1,000x the total bet.Free SpinsHitting 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols awards 10, 15, or 20 free spins, respectively. Before free spins start, a random multiplier of x2, x3, x5, or x10 is selected to be applied to all wins in the round. Each wild symbol landing in the feature awards +1 free spin, whereas hitting 3, 4, or 5 scatters awards a further 10, 15, or 20 free spins, respectively. In free spins, when a wild appears on the middle position, +3 free spins are awarded, or 3, 4, or 5 scatters on the screen, including one in the middle position, awards 20, 30, or 40 additional free spins, respectively. Other than the win multiplier and the chance for masses of extra spins, that's it.Buy Free SpinsGamblers may fork out 100x the bet to land 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols, triggering free spins.Good Luck & Good Fortune slot - free spinsGood Luck & Good Fortune: Slot VerdictGood Luck & Good Fortune was different, fair dues, though not necessarily in a good way. The 'luck' theme felt half done, as if the game wanted to break out of what it was meant to be doing to try something else, yet was unsure exactly what that something else might be. Like a hormonal teenager ready to rebel but lacking a cause to channel their energy into, so they lash out through 'unruly' behaviour, maybe listen to Rage Against the Machine's 'Killing in the Name' at obnoxious volumes in their bedroom, or pierce their nose to get a reaction out of parents that do care about them but are so busy they don't even notice their darling's minor act of rebellion.As for Good Luck & Good Fortune, you won't find much fortune here, restricted as it is by a 2,100x the bet win cap. Within this boundary, you may encounter some pretty odd stuff, including wild win values that seem wildly out of place, coupled with double scatter prizes of up to 1,000x the bet, which feel like two of Good Luck & Good Fortune's best ways of drumming up sizable results. Free spins are just odd, and not only because of the peculiar way symbols are cleared and conjured back as if by magic on each spin. The free spins round felt as if its main concern was triggering ever more free spins via wilds and scatters rather than actually attempting to land wins on them.And so ends an unusual review of an unusual game. Reel Kingdom are no stranger to creating odd games. See Tic Tac Take or Star Pirates Code for a stab of unorthodoxy, if you will. The studio is also more than capable of turning out superstars such as Big Bass Bonanza and its brothers and sisters, so who knows? Still, when rubbing a virtual crystal ball and peering into its misty depths, it's hard to see Good Luck & Good Fortune going on to find dazzling success.

title: Nitro Circus
structured_summary: Nitro Circus is an adrenaline-fueled slot themed around the action sports collective led by Travis Pastrana, showcasing extreme stunts and vehicles. It features 5 reels, 25 paylines, free spins, a Nitro Jump bonus with collectible vehicles, and a Nitro-Blast minigame offering multipliers and coin wins. The visuals are busy and action-packed, capturing the show's chaotic energy, while the audio complements the high-octane atmosphere.
review:
Nitro Circus IntroductionIf you're not familiar with Nitro Circus, don't worry. It's an American thing like Wrestling or Baseball, so no need to feel like an old fossil. Those of you who do know about it likely caught the show while it ran on MTV for four seasons between 2012 and 2014.Nitro Circus is an "action sports collective" led by Travis Pastrana. The show features him and his buddies travelling around the globe riding dirtbikes, base jumping and performing stunts. It's a little bit like Jackass in a way, albeit involving more talent. For unclear reasons, Yggdrasil Gaming decided Nitro Circus would be the best choice for their first branded slot.When it comes to branded slots, there's really only one developer that has managed to consistently pull it off well in the past - Microgaming. NetEnt has produced some decent branded games too, such as Guns n' Roses, South Park (now pulled from the market) and Creature from the Black Lagoon, although the most recent ones have been extremely disappointing (Planet of the Apes to name one).It may or may not be a coincidence that branded slots often fail to impress due to low payouts, but there's a very real possibility that providers feel the need to flatten the variance or lower the RTP to make players pay for the expensive license.Nitro Circus is a 5-reel, 4-row, 25 payline slot with a bet range between 0.10 - 125. This adrenaline-fuelled slot features some of Nitro Circus’s biggest stars, greatest stunts, and craziest vehicles. The game comes with a free spins mode and the Nitro Jump bonus game where players can fly through the air on one of 7 vehicles and collect multipliers, coin wins and other bonuses on the way, to maximise wins. Players can reach the bonus games through both scatters and collections, plus choose between three different risk levels.Nitro Circus PaytableThe game has a total of 7 regular symbols. On the reels, you will find three low-value symbols in the form of helmets - skate helmets, air force helmets and motocross helmets, as well as four high-value symbols represented by the guys from the show. The lead character, Travis Pastrana is the top guy and returns 20 times the stake should he land on across a full payline.Aside from the regular symbols, there is also a Wild symbol, a Nitro Bomb symbol and N I T R O letters which we will go into in more detail below. It should be noted that none of the symbols appears stacked and that both the Nitro Bomb and NITRO letter symbols obviously can work for you, but also against you in the form as blockers.Nitro-Blast MinigameLand exactly 2 Nitro Bomb symbols in the base game to activate the Nitro-Blast minigame. In this minigame, players choose 1 of 5 bombs to reveal one of the prizes below.Free Spin mode - With 10-30 Free SpinsAdd 1 Vehicle to the player's collection – Add a couch, wheelchair, toy car or bathtubNitro Wild – Upon returning to the main game the Nitro Bomb symbols explode turning 2-9 slot positions within the blast radius into wilds.Free Spin Multiplier - increase the total Free Spin multiplier by 1,2 or 3. (only available in Free Spins)Extra Free Spins - +1,+2,+3 Free Spins(only available in Free Spins)Nitro Free SpinsLand 3+ Nitro Bomb symbols in the base game to trigger Nitro Free Spins + The Nitro-Blast minigame with 1-3 feature picks.Landing 3 Nitro Bombs awards: 10 symbols + 1 Feature pickLanding 4 Nitro Bombs awards: 20 symbols + 2 Feature pickLanding 5 Nitro Bombs awards: 30 symbols + 3 Feature pickVehicle CollectionCollect 5 identical vehicles to trigger the Nitro Jump Feature with the collected vehicle. Vehicles appear in the Nitro minigame as well as in the Nitro Jump feature. Each vehicle (Bath Tub, Armchair, Toy Car, Rocking Horse) has its own sets of features and benefits (tricks, size and boost).Better tricks award more coins from the judges for the first 3 jumps.Bigger vehicles collect more coins from the air.More boost awards a higher multiplier on the final jump.The Nitro Jump FeatureThe Nitro Jump feature in actionThe Nitro Jump feature is activated by collecting 5 vehicles as stated above or by landing all the ‘N I T R O’ letters in 1 spin. If this feature is triggered by collecting NITRO, the player can then choose one of the following vehicles - FMX Bike, BMW Bike or Kick Bike.The Nitro Jump feature is made up of 3 stunt jumps and 1 final Boost Jump.
The 3 stunt jumps are scored by judges and awarded 5-625 coins depending on the tricks performed. Players can also collect 0-6 of the following features in the 3 stunt jumps.25 coin prizeSpeed boost for the final jumpFinal Jump Multiplier10 Free SpinsAfter completing the 3 stunt jumps, the rider approaches the final Nitro Boost jump. During the approach, players can add manual speed boost which will result in a better landing multiplier. However, adding manual boost increases the chance of the rider crashing out and losing all multipliers. The vehicle’s built-in boost and the boost collected during the 3 stunts does not influence the chance of landing the final Jump.Nitro Circus ConclusionNitro Circus is undoubtedly an ambitious project and a massive undertaking. However, Yggdrasil might have overcomplicated things here, unfortunately. Until you start to know the game, which might take a few sessions and some reading, it comes across as a bit of mess, and we're not convinced that players will have the patience required. To be fair though, reading about it here does make it seem even more complicated than it really is.Moreover, we understand that, just like the show, it's supposed to be action-packed and crazy, but when converted to an online slot it just feels too stressful. The busy action might appeal to fans of the show, but for the rest of us it might be somewhat of an annoyance. Also, what's up with the Nitro Jump feature? Is it a video game or an online slot? Hard to tell really. Some might like it but we don't. We prefer our slots to appeal to adults rather than kids.We can picture how Yggdrasil wanted this slot to be a true representation of the All-American entertainment that Nitro Circus is and in that sense they didn't disappoint. But as an online slot, we can't help to feel it's all over the place, confusing and over-complicated which ultimately is a turn-off for us at least.There is a 2000 times the stake max win potential in the game which can be achieved with the help of collecting some multipliers and retriggers in the free spins or by having a really good run in the Nitro Jump feature. While the free spins feature seemed a bit harder to trigger, the Nitro Jump featured was dropping quite often for us during our test session. The payouts, however, were abysmal.

title: Muertos Multiplier Megaways

review: Muertos Multiplier Megaways: Slot OverviewIn its English translation, Muertos Multiplier Megaways by developer Pragmatic Play more or less equates to Dead Ones Multiplier Megaways. That might sound a bit grim until we remember Muertos Multiplier Megaways refers to the famous Day of the Dead celebration. Highly volatile, Muertos Multiplier Megaways comes with a range of RTP settings, with 96.03% being the preferred one - it drops a titch to 96% when buying free spins. Then, symbols remaining on the reel strip fall down to fill in all of the empty spaces. If the tumbling symbols create a new winning way, the tumble feature triggers again. When no new win appears, the next spin can occur.Wild MultipliersWhen wild symbols hit, they are allocated a multiplier of x2 or x3. This multiplier is stored to the side of the reels on a meter and applies to the current tumble as well as any future tumbles on the same spin. When new wilds hit, their multiplier values multiply the value already stored in the meter. The multiplier is reset to x1 at the start of each base game spin.Muertos Multiplier Megaways slot - free spinsFree SpinsThe chilli-covered symbol is the scatter, and landing at least 3 of them triggers the free spins round. Before the round begins, a random amount of free spins is generated. This could be 5-14, 6-14, 7-14, or 8-14 if triggered by 3, 4, 5, or 6 bonus symbols, respectively. If less than 14 free spins are displayed, players have the option of gambling for more on a wheel. If the gamble is successful, +1 free spin is awarded, up to a maximum of 14. Landing 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6 scatters in the feature triggers an additional 1, 2, 3, 4, or 6 free spins with no limits to the number of retriggers.Buy Free SpinsIf available, players may be able to buy free spins, randomly triggered by 3, 4, 5, or 6 scatter symbols for the cost of 100x the bet.Muertos Multiplier Megaways slot - bonus buyMuertos Multiplier Megaways: Slot VerdictIn a growing crowd of Day of the Dead-themed slots, Muertos Multiplier Megaways manages to stand out for a number of reasons. For one, interestingly, it's a bit more restrained, a bit more tasteful than these sorts of slots can sometimes be. Not always, of course, but the opportunity is there and leads to max win capabilities capped at 10,000x the bet.If you're looking for a Day of the Dead slot that overwhelms you with visuals and a smorgasbord of features, Muertos Multiplier Megaways might not be quite the right match. Don't worry, though; Muertos Multiplier Megaways is no bashful wallflower. There are plenty of lively cultural artefacts here to experience, or cliches, depending on your point of view. However, for a well put together, relatively tastefully made slot, it might be just the right combination of Day of the Dead atmosphere and smart features to hit the spot.
