Volatility has moved from a low to a medium setting, and players have further influence over this when they choose which free spins bonus round they would prefer. Roughly one in three spins results in a win, while the overall default return value is 96%. Players who have bought into the Max Volume concept, whatever it may be, can play this Agent Jane game on any device, selecting bets from 25 p/c to $/€25 per spin.Landing three or more matching symbols left to right from the first reel triggers a payout, and there are eight regular paying symbols on the table. Four are low pay card suits; the remaining four are high pay gadgets, cocktails, necklaces, and cars – premiums are worth 3.2 to 6 times the stake for a five-symbol winning way. The logo is wild, appearing on reels 2-5 to replace any paying symbol. Wilds can also be stacked on reel 3.Agent Jane Blonde Max Volume: Slot FeaturesThe features in Agent Jane Blonde Max Volume are a mix of Microgaming familiars such as Rolling Reels, free spins with a multiplier trail, and three jackpots.Rolling ReelsRolling Reels triggers on every ways win. It removes winning symbols from the game grid, making way for the remaining symbols to roll in. If this creates a new win, the feature will continue until wins no longer appear.Free SpinsLanding at least 1 scatter on all 5 reels triggers the free spins selection sequence. There are three choices here:15 free spins with an initial x1 multiplier which rises by +1 with each spin.10 free spins with an initial x2 multiplier which rises by +2 with each spin.5 free spins with an initial x5 multiplier which rises by +5 with each spin.Free spins are retriggered if the Jane scatter symbol lands on all five reels, however, the multiplier is capped at x100.JackpotsThe jackpot feature has a chance to trigger when at least 5 scatters appear anywhere on the screen. When it activates, one of three jackpots will be awarded - Gold, Silver, or Bronze, worth 100x, 25x, or 5x the bet, respectively. If won during free spins, the jackpot is increased by the current free spins multiplier.Agent Jane Blonde Max Volume: Slot VerdictThis slot and the previous Agent Jane game might look and sound the same, but there the similarities end. Agent Jane Blonde Returns was a classic case of all-flash, little substance, whereas Max Volume has at least dialled up some substance. The question remains - what's up with 'Max Volume'? A playthrough provided no further illumination, so by the end of our test sessions the title still didn't make sense. Also, Jane continues to feel slightly miscast. She looks like she'd kill it in a corporate environment, yet there are questions as to whether she's too conspicuous to be a secret agent.But hey, let's not judgmentally cast aspersions on Jane's fieldwork; agents no doubt come in all shapes and sizes. Despite possible plot holes, Agent Blonde Max Volume is a lot better than JB Returns was. One of the most striking differences is max win, which has increased from the sad 300x of JB Returns to the 10,000x available in Max Volume. Another improvement is the fact players get a full-blown bonus round this time. Even better, you can pick the bonus game with the risk/reward ratio which suits your temperament best.Another nice touch is the way the multiplier grows the jackpots in free spins to juicier levels than their starting values. It must be said none of the features here is particularly new. Max Volume feels like it might be a clone, yet there are so many similar games it's hard to pinpoint the one. Anyway, the features we get in Max Volume are an improvement on the weak respins thing the previous one had.So yes, Max Volume is better, but it would have been an extraordinary feat of design fudge uppery to make it worse than Agent Jane Blonde Returns. It's still not the greatest game since it looks so much like the last one, and the extra bits have been borrowed from elsewhere. Still, Max Volume functions okay, and the potential is decent, so for a bit of spy-themed gaming with the sort of features that have stood the test of time, why not.

title: Monopoly Grand Hotel
structured_summary: Monopoly Grand Hotel is a classic Monopoly-themed 5-reel slot capturing the iconic board game's familiar elements. It features 50 paylines, a GO feature with cash prizes and jackpots, plus free spins with retriggers and a Free Parking Bonus. The reviewer finds the gameplay basic and somewhat dated, offering medium variance and moderate win potential but lacking innovation. The visuals are traditional with a post-war feel, accented by golden coins, classic symbols, and a recognizable brand logo, though not revolutionary.
review: Monopoly Grand Hotel (Shuffle Master): ReviewAfter over 80 years as one of the most popular and timeless board game designs in the world, Monopoly is a game that is instantly familiar to most. Having become part of international popular culture and licensed in over 100 countries as well as being available in close to 40 languages, it's rare to find someone who's never, at least once, rolled the dice to send their token hopping past Go.Needless to say, Monopoly is a game that strikes a chord with a lot of people, something the video game industry, as well as the iGaming industry, has tapped into. There have been many slot machine adaptations of Parker Brothers' highly successful board game, both land-based and online, and just recently Evolution Gaming launched Monopoly Live, an all-new special edition of the popular Dream Catcher wheel.The very latest addition to the family of Monopoly slots, however, comes from SG Digital partners Shuffle Master and is called Monopoly Grand Hotel. This 5-reel, 50-payline slot is playable across all devices from 25 cents to 200 Euros per spin and comes with a GO feature where you can land cash rewards, access to the free spins or jackpots up to 1000x. In the Free Spins round, there's up to 240 spins up for grabs as well as a Free Parking Bonus game each time you land the required symbol.Visually, there's nothing revolutionary about Monopoly Grand Hotel and unless you're a super fan of the series, you may even have a hard time telling some of them apart. With golden Rich Uncle Pennybags coins and banknotes in the background, along with the world-famous logo in the top left corner, there's no mistaking the brand. With a post-war feel, symbols on the reels include the usual A to J card values as well as dice, cruise ships, propeller planes, classic cars, dogs and free parking symbols. The dog and the parking symbols are the most valuable with 5 of a kind giving you 5 times your stake.Uncle Pennybags represents the wild and replaces all standard symbols bar the house, hotel and GO. The wild appears on reels 2, 3, 4 and 5 only. You'll also come across house and hotel symbols which we will get to later on. There is yet another symbol to look out for - the GO symbol which only appears on the three middle reels.Monopoly Grand Hotel (Shuffle Master): FeaturesFree spins gameWhen the GO symbol appears on the three middle reels, you'll trigger the GO feature. It gives you 1 spin on the GO reel and prizes include access to the Free Spins feature, cash prizes ranging from 2x to 20x total stake as well as Mini, Minor, Major and Grand jackpots where you can win 10, 25, 100 or 1000 times your stake respectively.The alternative way to trigger the Free Spins is by landing 6 or more hotel and/or house symbols. You'll also win the cash prizes associated with each house and hotel symbol which can be up to 25 times your stake per symbol. The number of spins you get is decided by how many houses/hotels you landed to trigger the feature - this can range from 6 to 15 free spins. During the feature, 6 or more house/hotel symbols will give you a retrigger with potential for up to 240 free spins in total.Now, the combined value of the hotel/house symbols that activated the free spins feature will be attached to the Free Parking Bonus symbol. When it appears in view, the total you won when triggering the feature will be added to your winnings. For example, if the combined value of the houses/hotels was 40 times your stake when activating the feature, that is what you will win each time you land the Free Parking Bonus symbol.Monopoly Grand Hotel (Shuffle Master): VerdictWe enjoy a round of the Monopoly board game as much as anyone. Unfortunately, your experience with Monopoly Grand Hotel will be limited and could end up boring you before very long. The presentation is rather basic and the gameplay lacks any sort of innovation or twist which means you're left with a slot that comes across as a bit dated. Medium variance, don't expect any explosive hits (except for the Grand jackpot of course), although there is potential to accumulate quite decent wins in the Free Spins game.Monopoly Grand Hotel is an ok slot with decent potential that relies too heavily on its brand. If you're specifically on the lookout for a Monopoly-themed slot, Big Event is still the best version in our opinion.

title: Arctic Sorcerer Gigablox
structured_summary: Arctic Sorcerer Gigablox is a wintery, fantasy-themed slot set in a magical Arctic landscape featuring a sorcerer and northern wildlife. The game includes ReelPlay’s Gigablox mechanic with random reel mergings, wild multipliers, Arctic Blasts, and free spins with a Wild Collection Counter. The reviewer finds the game underwhelming and lacking innovation, delivering a mediocre experience compared to stronger Gigablox titles. Visually, it features colorful but cheap graphics and dated, chintzy sound effects that resemble low-budget mobile games.
review: Arctic Sorcerer Gigablox: Slot OverviewGames developer ReelPlay leads players to some chilly northern latitudes in an online slot titled Arctic Sorcerer Gigablox - a wintery, fantasy-themed slot powered by partner Yggdrasil Gaming's Gigablox mechanic. Alongside random reel mergings, which create these larger than normal Gigablox symbols, other features in Arctic Sorcerer Gigablox include wild multipliers, Arctic Blasts, and free spins.The Arctic, in pictures at least, is quite an enchanting looking place of wind-swept snowy plains, icebergs, and craggy mountains. Technically speaking, the Arctic is the northern polar region and includes land masses such as Canada, Greenland, and Scandinavia. In Arctic Sorcerer Gigablox, ReelPlay has pushed the magic angle to create a white-outed world of colourful skies, snow, clouds, jagged peaks, with a castle nestled upon one of them. Graphically, the game is a collection of okay bits and cheap effects, the latter particularly so on the reels. The same goes for the chinkly sound effects, where Arctic Sorcerer Gigablox winds up feeling like a dated video game or one of those mobile games that's been cobbled together on the quick to make a few bucks through video advertising pop-ups.Arctic Sorcerer Gigablox slot - base gameArctic Sorcerer Gigablox is a medium volatile slot, played on a 6-reel, 5-row game grid with 50 fixed paylines. On each spin, reels randomly merge together to create larger than normal Gigablox symbols. Gigablox can be anything from 2x2 to 5x5 in size, and any symbol can be a Gigablox symbol. When evaluating wins, Gigablox symbols are broken down into 1x1 size tiles to calculate the payout value. Playable on any device, RTP varies with a maximum value of 96.1%, while bets of 50 p/c to $/€50 may be selected.Along paylines, winning combinations occur when three to six matching symbols land from the leftmost side over adjacent reels. Gems start the symbols off in purple, blue, red, green and gold colours as the low pays, while deer, owls, wolves, and polar bears are the high pay tiles. Landing a six-of-a-kind winning line gets you 1x the bet for the gems or 1.5 to 5 times the stake for the animals. Lastly, wild symbols appear in the base and bonus game, whereas x2 wilds appear only in the bonus. Both may land on reels 2-6 to substitute any regular pay symbol to assist with complete winning lines.Arctic Sorcerer Gigablox: Slot FeaturesArctic Sorcerer Gigablox slot - Arctic BlastOne more feature to look out for in the base and bonus game is the Arctic Blast. When one or more Mystery Gigablox symbols lands on the reels, the Sorcerer changes them into one of these – Polar Bear, Wolf, Gold Gem, Blue Gem, Purple Gem, scatter, or wild. The Arctic Blast reveal occurs before any wins are evaluated or features trigger.Free SpinsLanding the equivalent of 5 1x1 sized scatter symbols triggers the free spins round. When scatter Gigablox symbols hit, they are broken down into the 1x1 size scatters that form them. Each triggering 1x1 scatter awards 1, 2, or 3 free spins. During free spins is where the x2 wild symbol appears, doubling all wins when substituting in a winning line. When wild Gigablox symbols appear from the Arctic Blast, the Sorcerer splits it into 1x1 wilds and 1x1 x2 wilds. Both wild types are collected after wins have been evaluated – wilds are worth one point, and x2 wilds are worth two points on the Wild Collection Counter. When the Wild Collection Counter reaches 5, 10, 15, or 20, +2 free spins are awarded. When the round ends, the Wild Collection Counter resets to zero.Arctic Sorcerer Gigablox slot - free spinsArctic Sorcerer Gigablox: Slot VerdictGigablox slots continue to be a mixed bag of good and not-so-good games. Some studios have taken to the mechanic and run with it; others appear to have just whacked it on a project with little to no interest in really doing something new or remarkable with its functionality. So it seemed in Megapearl Gigablox, and so it seems with Arctic Sorcerer Gigablox, too. ReelPlay has demonstrated artistic flair in both aesthetics and gameplay in the past - it invented the popular Infinity Reels mechanic, after all. Money Mariachi Infinity Reels or Odin Infinity Reels are two examples, yet they've also got another side that turns out games like Arctic Sorcerer Gigablox, which is lacking in a number of areas.Suspicions were invoked by the artwork and sound effects. The fantasy Arctic idea kind of works, yet it also comes across as underdeveloped as well. The random no-name wizard is passable as a character, but he just doesn't strike one as being an extraordinarily powerful mage. All he really seems to do a lot of the time is raise his staff when Mystery Blocks land to reveal their symbol. On a side note, it's a little unclear why a fairly standard Mystery Symbol reveal had to be called The Arctic Blast. Funnily enough, free spins are arguably less imaginative than the naming of the Mystery Symbol feature. There it's a simple case of landing wilds or x2 wilds in an attempt to win up to 8 extra free spins in the process. Max win is surprisingly okay, at 4,720.74x the bet, but it does feel like some pretty funky sorcery would be required to leap to those levels.All up, Arctic Sorcerer Gigablox was a pretty low-key game to review. During testing, it didn't get anywhere particularly special and cruised at a leisurely pace while doing so. Simply put, there are stronger Gigablox games out there compared to Arctic Sorcerer Gigablox, which leaned closer to a cheap saw someone in half trick than full-blown green lightning sorcery.

title: Curse of Ra
structured_summary: Curse of Ra is an Ancient Egyptian-themed slot centered around the sun god Ra's curse. It features a 5-reel setup with 20 paylines, including unique elements like Guaranteed Win reshuffles, free spins with roaming multiplier wilds, and the Super Spinner bonus. The reviewer finds the game functional with solid features but lacking in originality and thematic depth. Visually, it offers a pleasant but uninspired Egyptian setting with minimal atmosphere and basic audio effects.
review: Curse of Ra: Slot OverviewSince, as veteran Ancient Egyptian slot enthusiasts can probably tell you, Ra was the god of the sun, any curse he conjured would probably be a rather nasty one for those on the receiving end. In this case, though, Curse of Ra is more likely just a snappy title developer Four Leaf Gaming has come up with for an Ancient Egyptian-themed online slot. The studio has used the occasion to roll out things like its Super Spinner and other favoured features in an Ancient Egyptian setting, though to provide individuality; the provider has included a Guaranteed Win effect and a free spins round where roaming wilds with multipliers may accrue on the board.Two statues stand on guard next to Curse of Ra's gaming grid, while above it, the Super Spinner wheel slowly rotates. Whilst a totally adequate looking location for gamblers in the mood for an Ancient Egyptian-flavoured slot, Curse of Ra wasn't the most inspiring one to look at. There is no sweeping romantic view of a Giza Plateau-style scene, no steampunk twist, and no heavy ancient atmosphere. Curse of Ra puts on a pleasant view; that is about it.Curse of Ra slot - base gamePlayed on a 5-reel, 3-row gaming matrix, players get 20 paylines for landing winning combinations of symbols along, left to right, from the leftmost reel onwards. A medium-high volatile slot with an RTP of 96%, players may select a stake of 20 c to $/€100 per spin, with several optional betting extras covered below. When using the Activate feature buy, the RTP stays at 96%.Jack to Ace card ranks with little carvings upon them are Curse of Ra's low pay symbols, while its highs are an Ankh, an Eye of Horus, the jackal God Anubis, and the bird God Horus as the highs. Landing a 5 OAK low pay win awards 5 to 10 times the bet, increasing to 25 to 100x for hitting 5 matching premiums along a payline. Colourful scarab wilds may appear on all reels. Wilds substitute for any regular pay symbols and have the same value as the highest picture symbol when making wins of themselves.Curse of Ra: Slot FeaturesCurse of Ra slot - free spins gambleCurse of Ra's 'newer' parts are its Guaranteed Win feature and free spins, where it is possible to add Flying Scarab Wilds to the screen with multipliers. The rest of the extras are things like the Bonus Booster, Bonus Replay, Super Spinner, and Nitro Spins.Guaranteed Win FeatureOccasionally, on a non-winning spin, the symbols are rearranged to create a guaranteed win.Free SpinsLanding 3, 4, or 5 scatters in the base game triggers 10, 15, or 20 free spins, respectively. Free spins can be activated for 750 coins or 75x the bet. Flying Scarab Wilds move position each spin. Free spins start with 1 Flying Scarab Wild, and scatters are collected in free spins. Every 3 collected scatters grants a new Flying Scarab Wild and awards +3 free spins. Any additional Wild Flying Scarabs have multipliers of x2, x3, x5, and x10.Bonus BoosterThe Bonus Booster may be used to gamble all or some free spins for a chance to win 1, 2, or 3 extra free spins. The more spins gambled, the higher the chance of winning. The gamble can be repeated, and the maximum number of free spins available is 25.Bonus ReplayThis feature lets players gamble their free spins winnings for a chance to replay the round by spinning a win or lose wheel - if the free spins win was under a threshold. A winning spin awards a new free spins round starting from the Round Booster but the previous winnings are not carried over. A losing spin returns you to the base game.Super SpinnerAny time a coin overlay appears on a low-pay symbol, it is collected. The Super Spinner can be triggered whenever a coin is collected. When triggered, the Super Spinner awards 80x-5,000x the bet, 10-25 free spins, or 10-25 Nitro Spins. The Super Spinner can be bought for 500 coins or 75x the bet or combined with collected coins to reduce the cost.Nitro SpinsActivating Nitro Spins increases the bet by 50% or costs 4 coins per spin. When Nitro Spins are active, scatters are increased to trigger the bonus more frequently, there is an increased chance of the Guaranteed Win feature occurring, coins are collected more frequently, and the Super Spinner triggers more often. The RTP when using Nitro Spins is 96.14%-96.16%.Curse of Ra slot - free spinsCurse of Ra: Slot VerdictSince launching, Four Leaf Gaming has bounced between common and not-so-common slot themes from the icy realms of Everest to the well-trod underground caverns of Gold Rush Frenzy Megaways. Curse of Ra's so-so handling of more common subject matter was part of the reason why the game failed to impress much. It felt like a case of the studio simply wanting an Ancient Egyptian slot to attach its regular features to, such as Nitro Spins, the Super Spinner, and the additional gambling options. It's not a bad set of features by any means, and players who like a ton of options at their fingertips are catered for, but the whole set-up can feel a tad repetitively formulaic after a while.These repeat gameplay extras must be in demand, though, if Four Leaf Gaming keeps releasing slots with them. Furthermore, the gameplay elements that have been tailor-made for Curse of Ra are potentially useful. The minor one, Guaranteed Win shuffles, might be helpful for giving engagement levels a boost when it triggers. Roaming multiplier wilds are generally a positive inclusion in a game, too - Slotmill's Tyrant's Fall is an excellent example. The Bonus Booster might be tempting here since one would assume the more free spins, the greater the chance of adding extra Flying Wild Scarabs. Since the game has a win cap of 10,000x, there is room here for Flying Scarab Wilds to do good things.Despite the pluses, Curse of Ra wasn't a game with a major 'ooh' factor. One issue was that it didn't seem like a game the developer had a huge amount of interest in. Whereas some slots feel like their makers got totally into the theme and took the opportunity for a fun, deep dive, Flying Scarab Wilds felt like a surface skim of the topic, as if Four Leaf Gaming simply wanted to wrap an Ancient Egyptian covering over its regular collection of features. Maybe not, but that's the impression formed during the review.

title: Thor Infinity Reels
structured_summary: Thor Infinity Reels features a Norse mythology theme centered on Thor, set against a grim, misty mountain backdrop. The game highlights the Infinity Reels mechanic with respins and symbol multipliers, plus a hold-and-win Jackpot Respins bonus triggered by Mjolnir scatters. The reviewer finds the gameplay intense and versatile but notes the hold-and-win style may not appeal to all, with a max win of 6,055x stake. Visually, it offers attractive, atmospheric graphics with a dark, cold tone, though mobile play limits some imagery detail.
review: Thor Infinity Reels: Slot OverviewIn ReelPlay's Odin Infinity Reels Megaways it was the one-eyed All-Father Odin who received all the attention. Now fans of all things infinite can witness his son Thor in action. To help expand ReelPlay’s market, Thor Infinity Reels is released via Yggdrasil’s Masters Program while also getting access to GATI technology, a software developing company based in India. If you haven’t checked out ReelPlay’s Odin slot, it squeezed Megaways onto its reels, proving nowhere is safe from BTG’s popular game engine. This time, the action revolves around a more traditional streak respins bonus round.A forbidding location greets players when Thor Infinity Reels graces the screen. In the middle sits a 3x4 sized grid, built into a stone frame, inducing a feeling of permanency. Discarded swords litter the rest of the scene, accompanied by mist, pine trees, mountains, and a starry night sky. Attractive graphics present a scene that not only looks cold, but grim, as if Thor recently laid waste to a band of giants, or an army that did something to tick the deity off. Whatever just happened, it was pretty intense.The math model continues the intensity, producing highly volatile gameplay and an RTP of 96.2%. Keep in mind this is the regular, default value, which rises to 96.6% when the bonus buy is activated. While Thor Infinity Reels is playable on any device, offering bets from 20 p/c to $/€40 per spin, you do lose much of the visuals on a mobile since it puts the grid centre stage to the detriment of the rest of the imagery.One nice thing about ReelPlay is their comprehensive game sheets. Not only do they let us dive into just about every stat we could ever want, they also feature some pretty cool art. Alongside some rough game sketches, we find a hit rate of 1 in 3.64 spins, which isn’t bad given that wins trigger Infinity Reels’ key function and are formed of five matching symbols landing on adjacent reels.As to symbols, there are ten regular pays as well as a scatter and wild. Muscular J-A card royals make up the low pay symbols, backed by higher-paying horns, shields, helmets, and axes - each premium symbol worth 0.15 to 0.25 times the stake. In more meaningful terms, five of a kind premium wins are worth a payout of 0.75 to 2.5x the stake. Numbers like this might not sound overly exciting, though when Infinity Reels fire, values can mushroom.Thor Infinity Reels: Slot FeaturesThor Infinity Reels - free spinsCentral to the action is the Infinity Reels mechanic which adds reels and symbol multipliers when wins occur. Winning spins add a reel to the right side of the grid, and if any new symbols can improve the win, the process is repeated. As the name suggests, reels only stop being added when no new winning symbols land.Also, each new reel increases the symbol win multiplier. This multiplier starts at x1, increasing by +1 for each new reel added – without a set limit. When it comes time to calculate the winning payout, symbol values are multiplied by the symbol multiplier. One final motivator for adding reels is the Infinity Bonus. Should 12 reels be added to the grid in a spin sequence, an extra 888x jackpot is the reward.You can’t have Thor without his hammer Mjolnir lurking somewhere, and in Thor Infinity Reels it is used as the scatter. When 6 or more Mjolnirs are in view at the end of a spin sequence, they trigger Jackpot Respins. The game shifts into hold-and-win mode, locking the grid at its triggering size. Triggering hammer symbols are also held, each displaying a prize value of 1x to 100x the bet. As well as regular hammer symbols, it is possible to land 4 jackpot scatters. These are coloured green, blue, red, or gold and are worth 10x, 50x, 250x, or 2,000x the bet.Here, 3 respins start the round, resetting when any new hammer symbols land. If reels are filled, an extra reel is added to the right-hand side Money Train 2 style. In this way, you can rack up even more prize symbols, and also, if lucky, win the Infinity Bonus.Jackpot Respins theoretically trigger every 166.09 spins, but players may be able to skip past that using the feature buy. If you do, then laying out 100x the total stake produces a triggering spin from 6 to 15 reels in length, holding 7 to 24 scatters to start Jackpot Respins.Thor Infinity Reels: Slot VerdictSo far pairing Infinity Reels with classic features, or Norse gods, has resulted in a couple of decent games. Book of Ultimate Infinity by SG Digital, for example, cleverly incorporated 'Book of' style expanding symbols, and the streak respin device used here works surprisingly well. Triggering the feature is neatly done, spreading out reels to provide space for landing as many hammer symbols as possible. Retaining the ability to add new reels (which can trigger the Infinity Bonus) during the feature, bolsters the experience, and its four jackpots only sweeten the deal.Of course, much rests on how you feel about hold-and-win features, which can be quite the deal-breaker for players who prefer more traditional free spins features or at least something a bit more original. Having said that, Thor Infinity Reels proves anything you can do on regular reels; you can accomplish on Infinity Reels. Satisfying payouts are possible as well, where wins max out at 6,055 times the bet. Decent enough, but it’s hard not to think the figure might have been higher given all of the references to the word ‘infinity’. At the same time, a respectable total for this sort of feature.Thor Infinity Reels continues to show how versatile ReelPlay’s mechanic can be, even though the core gaming remains the same. Hold & wins are something of an old school device, so proponents interested in seeing them in an updated form would do well to have a whirl. However, if streak respins aren’t your jam or potential isn’t tempting enough, it might be best to stick to the billion other Thor slots out there.

title: Hope Diamond
structured_summary: Hope Diamond features an eccentric mix of diamonds, mining, and ponies, creating a quirky and unusual slot theme. The game includes several random modifiers, two bonus rounds with Money Scatter mechanics, and a Diamond Trail feature for added engagement. The reviewer finds the theme odd and the features unoriginal, calling it a strange but potentially rewarding slot for open-minded players. Visually, the game offers a pastel, cartoonish diamond mine setting with an old-fashioned, homely feel, complemented by pulsating diamond accents around the reels.
review: Hope Diamond: Slot OverviewFor players who like to leap out of their comfort zones and experience new things, developer Blueprint Gaming has got something unusual to try. Combining diamonds, horses, mines, and miner-ettes, Hope Diamond feels like one of those milkshake slots where everything’s been thrown at it in an attempt to stick, anything. Some may love the eccentricities; others will be head scratchingly mystified. It might not make much sense now, but by the end of the review, well, it probably won’t make much sense then either. With that, we might as well just burrow right in.Hope Diamond is played out using a basic 5-reel, 20-payline game area, located in a luminescent diamond mine - one of those cartoon mines where precious stones poke out of the walls, so all miners have to do is yank them out and toss them into the cart. At least, that’s the view on the home screen. During the actual game, all you can see is a pastel blur around the reels, while the reel frame is encrusted in stacks of pulsating diamonds. The view is basic, but not devoid of a homely old fashioned feel which some people might enjoy.Playable on any mobile, tablet or desktop device, Hope Diamond offers stakes as low as 20 p/c per spin, rising as high as $/€500 in some cases. While the theme might not suit everyone, the game’s RTP rating of 96.51% will have few detractors. Volatility will suit those who like a bit of edge to their gaming, though not too much. A medium/high rating means the dips and dives aren’t too extreme.To win in the diamond mine, you’ll need to land three or more of a kind of all symbols, except the top premium which only needs two to pay out. In regards to symbols, there are 9 pays – four J-A royals, and five highs. The premiums, in ascending order of value, are lanterns, mine carts, ponies, miner ladies, and the logo. Hit full lines of high pays for rewards of 10 – 25 times the stake.The burning bundle of dynamite sticks is the wild, possessing the same payout value as the highest premium. It replaces any symbol in the game except for scatters or Money Symbols to complete a combination.Hope Diamond: Slot FeaturesHope Diamond - Diamonds Forever feature in actionHope Diamond has a surprising number of features to augment play. This includes several modifiers, a collection system and two bonus games which are pretty similar. At any moment during the base game, one of four modifiers may randomly flick to life. When active, three diamonds appear on the screen for players to reveal one of them. The resulting modifier is then applied on the next spin:Big Bang Dynamite Wilds – a random number of wilds land on the reels.Colossal Dynamite Wilds – a giant-sized wild will land in a random position turning up to 9 tiles wild.Explosive Dynamite Wilds – when wilds land on the next spin they explode turning more symbols wild.Diamonds Forever Bonus – 6 Money Scatter Symbols are added to the reels, guaranteeing the Diamonds Forever feature is triggered.Alternatively, Money Scatter Symbols can land at any time during the base game - 6 or more in view trigger the Diamonds Forever feature. When it starts, the triggering Money Scatters are held in place. All other positions spin individually, where only Money Scatter Symbols are active. The round starts with 3 spins, and any new Money Scatter that lands, is locked in place while resetting spins back to 3. The bonus ends when all positions are filled or spins run out, then, the values on each Money Scatter Symbol is added up and paid.The final feature is the Diamond Trail. In the base game, any Bonus symbol landing in view partly fills the bottom cart on the Diamond Trial located on the left of the reels. Collecting 100 Bonus symbols fills all the carts on the Diamond Trail, triggering Diamond Spins. This feature also starts with three spins, though they cannot be reset. On each spin, only Money Scatters are active but are not held when they land. Each one instantly adds their value to the prize pot, which is paid at the end.Hope Diamond: Slot VerdictHope Diamond starts by sounding like the character from a daytime TV show and doesn’t do much to improve on the first impression. The theme certainly won’t be everyone’s cup of tea, and it isn’t easy to pinpoint who is the target audience here. Bronies perhaps? No one’s judging by the way. Hope Diamond manages to be one of Blueprint’s strangest slots, mixing a My Little Pony feel with a more classily slot friendly mining one. The result is as odd as that probably sounds.It’s not just the odd theme as evidence of possible creative rut, but the features are rather unoriginal as well. Diamonds Forever is a standard symbol hold feature, and Diamond Spins are quite similar. During testing, Diamond Spins tended to pay the most of the two, yet the most thrilling moment actually came from the Colossal Wild. The fine print in the help docs mentions a win cap of 50,000x, which feels a tad overkill.Players after a classically inclined slot, with an unusual theme, might find a something of value here, provided they are open-minded. There are quite a few features, though none to get super excited over. Overall, it might be best to file this one in the miscellaneous category. Theme wise, Hope Diamond is unique, you have to give it that, but it teeters more towards straight-up weird rather than quirky. Overall, the RTP is on the friendlier side as is the potential, so it's not all bad. If the dull theme and unimaginative gameplay doesn't instantly turn you off, it may be well worth a try.

title: Gorilla Madness
structured_summary: Gorilla Madness is a jungle-themed slot featuring cartoonish gorillas with prehistoric jungle and volcanic backdrops. The game offers 243 ways to win, free spins with low pay symbols removed, and a jackpot feature triggered by wilds for four possible jackpots. The reviewer finds it a well-made but fairly standard slot with modest max win potential and straightforward gameplay. Its bright, quirky graphics and tribal drum soundtrack create a fun yet slightly mismatched atmosphere.
review: Gorilla Madness - OverviewWhenever we think of gorillas, our minds automatically wander to the majestic gentle giants we know today, who spend their days in lush jungles and rainforests with thick vegetation, birds chirping, and idyllic imagery. Only going into chest-beating mode when provoked or showing off the alpha male status. Then along came Gorilla Madness from developers Light & Wonder, who forever changed that image for us. We had no idea that gorillas were around in prehistoric times, but according to sources we found online, there was indeed a gorilla-like ape called Gigantopithecus who lived approximately 2 million years ago. The gorillas we see in Gorilla Madness are, thankfully, the modern-day variety with larger-than-life personalities.Graphically, the design is quirky and fun, with large cartoon-like graphics. Players will find themselves in prehistoric times in a jungle with a bubbling molten lava river flowing by and an erupting volcano in the background, almost waiting for someone to shout Jumanji! Or for the ominous drum beating to start. Instead, as the game loads, we hear the tribal rhythmic drums that beat along in time with a xylophone. While the tune itself is decent, it sounds a bit more like a tropical vacation than Gorilla Madness.Gorilla Madness slot - base gameAvailable to play from 0.18 p/c to $/€88.00 per spin (yes, a rather odd range), Gorilla Madness is a medium to high variance game that can be played on most desktops, mobile phones, or tablets. As far as the layout goes, it's fairly standard and consists of 5 reels, 3 rows combined with 243 win ways that pay on adjacent reels from the leftmost reel to the right by landing three or more matching symbols. According to official stats supplied by Light & Wonder, the game comes with three RTP models, with 96% being the highest, while the maximum win amount clocks in at 2,761x.For symbols, the grouchy-looking male and eye-rolling female gorilla will pay 0.5x to 11.3x the stake, whilst the three dinosaurs are worth 0.1x to 4.5x your wager. The coloured gems doubling as A-9 card ranks pay 0.05x to 0.5x the bet, and the gold gorilla statue, which is also the scatter symbol, will award 5x to 50x the bet. Do note, scatter wins are paid in addition to ways wins. The Gorilla Madness wild symbol can substitute for all symbols, including the scatter symbol. This wild symbol can appear on reels 2, 3, and 4 in both the base game and free spins round.Gorilla Madness: Slot FeaturesGorilla Madness slot - free spinsFree SpinsAs mentioned before, the gold gorilla statue is also the scatter symbol. It can appear in both the base game and the free spins round. Land 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols on adjacent reels to be awarded 10 free spins. During the free spins round, the low pay symbols do not appear, leaving the opportunity for bigger wins. Moreover, the Gorilla Madness Jackpot feature can be triggered during free spins. On a last note, free spins can be re-triggered during this round.Jackpot GameA big drawing card to Light & Wonder's Gorilla Madness is the Gorilla Madness Jackpot feature. This feature may be randomly triggered when one or more wild symbols land on the reels. When the jackpot feature is triggered, a screen will display 12 coins. Here, players pick to reveal symbols. If 3 matching symbols are revealed, the corresponding jackpot is awarded, ending this feature. There are four jackpots, a Mini paying 27x the stake, a Minor awarding 44x the bet, a Major paying 833x your stake and the Grand, which pays a respectable 2,222x the bet.Gorilla Madness slot - jackpot gameGorilla Madness: Slot VerdictGorilla Madness was a tough slot to review, not because it's bad or unlikeable, but mainly due to it not having anything new or overly exciting to offer. Graphically, it's well made. The change of scenery at the start of the free spins round is a testament to that, and the big cartoonish graphics along with the bright-coloured animations are welcoming. We can't fault it unless we nitpick at things like, gorillas in a prehistoric setting? Admittedly, the pink, full-of-attitude headband-wearing ape did throw us off a little bit (lol) - though that could be the 'Madness' part of the title. The music, one could argue, is a bit out there as well, sounding more like something you would associate with a visit to the spa rather than flesh-eating dinosaurs. It's all fun though, we get that.Overall, the gaming session is vanilla with sprinkles. It is easy to play, and the features are far from complicated. During the test run, free spins were not super frequent though a few decent hits did land. As far as the top prize is concerned, 2,761x the stake isn't overly exciting, though the target audience isn't necessarily the hardcore gamer type. While it's not terrible, Light & Wonder could probably have bumped it up a bit for a wider appeal. So, at the end of the day, are there any good reasons to play Gorilla Madness? Well, it depends on your preferences. If you are into high volatility and big potential, then probably no. If you're the type of player who enjoys trying new games and just wants to escape for a bit, it's not likely you'll find Gorilla Madness to be a charming, easy-to-play, and light-hearted slot.

title: Big Bite
structured_summary: Big Bite is an ocean-themed slot centered around a majestic orca, blending fishing slot motifs with a cooler, marine vibe. It features fish and jackpot symbols, Orca multipliers, free spins on an expanded grid, and a bonus buy option. The reviewer praises its accessibility, high production values, and solid top prize of 10,000x, making it a strong choice for fans of the genre. The game boasts distinctive art and ambient sounds that reflect Push Gaming’s polished, immersive style.
review: Big Bite: Slot OverviewProving the saying 'there's plenty more fish in the sea' comes Push Gaming's oceanic online slot Big Bite. Of course, that saying is typically used as a metaphor to encourage people to get back into the dating game or something along those lines, but it is a rather apt way of describing the fishing slot genre, too. Simply because there are so many of them to choose from. However, few studios have such a stellar track record of making sea-borne slots as Push Gaming does, as evidenced by Razor Shark and Razor Returns. However, where those two games are pointy tooth behemoths of the deep, ready to strip flesh from the bone, Big Bite takes aim at a different segment of the gambling market, easing back the volatility while incorporating gameplay from certain famous fishing slot ranges.Okay, it won't take long to clock the fact Big Bite shares many similarities with one of the biggest slots of this kind out there, Big Bass Bonanza and its buds. Not to mention Fishin' Frenzy, by extension. Might as well get that out of the way. But, Push being Push, the studio has stamped its personality all over Big Bite regardless. The setting in Big Bite, for one, is on the chillier side than usual, and the main character here is not a bass fish (#gasp) but something much larger and many may argue more majestic. That is, the mighty orca, or killer whale as they are also known, all streamlined black and white bodied, sporting a formidable set of gnashers. Interestingly, for their size, killer whales have just 40 to 56 teeth (according to Internet sources), which are designed for tearing and ripping, not for chewing. Instead, orcas apparently consume their food whole or in chunks.Big Bite slot - base gameFingers crossed that isn't a metaphor for how Big Bite is going to perform. Getting started involves picking a stake of 10 c to $/€100 and deciding whether or not to use the Push Bet. Activating the Push Bet increases the chance of winning the feature by 58%, increasing the stake by 20%, too. Unlike its Razor-y brethren, Big Bite is a low-medium volatile slot, with a default RTP of 96.33%, or 96.4% when using the Push Bet.In the base game, Big Bite plays out on a 5-reel, 3-row gaming panel with 10 paylines. Ten regular pay symbols appear throughout, divided into 4 card suit lows, a boot, a bottle, and a compass mids, then 3 character symbol high pays. Landing a winning combination of 5 matching symbols pays 5x the bet for the lows, 35-50x for the mids, or 100-200x the bet for the high pays. The symbol with a boat on it is wild, and it appears on all reels. These boat wilds substitute all regular paying symbols and pay the same as the most valuable high-pay symbol if making winning wild lines.Big Bite: Slot FeaturesBig Bite slot - free spinsTime to cast off to see what features we dredge in where the possibilities include Fish symbol prizes, Jackpot symbols, Orca symbols, free spins, and bonus buys.Special SymbolsFish symbols have instant prize values attached to them of 1x to 1,000x the bet and appear on reels 2, 3, and 4. Fish symbols are present in the base game and in free spins.Jackpot symbols are present in the base game and free spins on the middle three reels. The Jackpot symbols are the Mini, Minor, Major, Mega, and Grand, worth 15x, 75x, 350x, 1,500x, and 10,000x the bet, respectively.The Orca symbol is a collector symbol present on the leftmost and rightmost reels in both phases of the game. When an Orca symbol lands at the same time as Fish or Jackpot symbols, it collects all of their values except the Grand Jackpot. When Orca symbols land with multipliers attached, the multiplier value is applied to the collected value. In the base game, the possible multiplier values are x1, x2, x3, x5, or x10. When the Orca lands at the same time as the Grand Jackpot, the game's max win is awarded. If 2 Orca symbols land, they each collect any Fish or Jackpot symbols in view, applying multipliers if applicable.Free SpinsHitting 3, 4, or 5 scatters triggers 10 free spins with a starting Orca Multiplier of x1, x3, or x10 respectively. Free spins are played on an expanded 5x5 grid with 20 paylines. When Orca symbols land during the round, they are collected by the progression meter. When a new level is reached on the meter, extra free spins and an Orca symbol multiplier are awarded. The Orca Multiplier multiplies any instant prize value attached to Fish or Jackpot symbols except for the Grand.Level 1 – awards +5 free spins and an x2 Orca Multiplier.Level 2 – awards +5 free spins and an x3 Orca Multiplier.Level 3 – awards +5 free spins and an x5 Orca Multiplier.Level 4 – awards +5 free spins and an x10 Orca Multiplier.Bonus BuyAt the bonus buy, players can get 10 free spins with an x1 (RTP 96.69%), x3 (RTP 96.81%), or x10 (RTP 96.77%) Orca Multiplier for 43x, 93x, or 212x the bet, respectively. Or, 75x the bet buys a random free spins trigger (RTP 96.74%).Big Bite slot - free spinsBig Bite: Slot VerdictIt's interesting how big-time innovative heavy-height studios are finding 'inspiration' in slot ranges like Big Bass Bonanza and Fishin' Frenzy all these years later. What's even more interesting is seeing the different directions they take. Where the Nolimit City team stuck to the, let's say, irreverent attitude it's famous for when making Ugliest Catch, Push Gaming, by contrast, has gone more mainstream (even more so than Fish 'n' Nudge) for Big Bite, aiming it at a wide potential market, something the team did earlier with 10 Swords - incorporating popular gaming mechanics finished with a Push touch while aiming it at a mass audience.Not to say Big Bite can't be enjoyed by roughnecks who favour the choppy surface of slots like Razor Shark. As noted, Push Gaming has stamped its personality on Big Bite, through the individual art style and ambient sounds. When it comes to gaming, Big Bite is less complicated than they can be from Push, but that could partly be because this style of play is so ubiquitously familiar - land Fish (or Jackpot) symbols at the same time as an Orca symbol and collect. It's as simple as that. Push Gaming has seen no reason to tamper hard with such a winning blueprint.So, you're casting around the fish slot scene looking for modern Fishin' Frenzy action, why pick Big Bite? A few reasons. One is the top-tier production values we've come to expect from a studio like Push Gaming that regularly turns out slots at the higher end of the quality spectrum. Another is winning potential of 10,000x the bet, which is, again, on the higher end of the fish slot scale, not to mention bonus buyers may be tempted by the opportunity to buy their way straight to the x10 Orca Multiplier. Chuck everything in the chum bucket, and Big Bite might not be a paradigm shift in Fishin' Frenzy style gaming, but it's a top-notch option for a wide variety of players in the mood for this sort of thing.

title: Wild Turkey
structured_summary: Wild Turkey is an Aztec-themed slot featuring a unique anthropomorphic turkey village setting. The game offers free spins triggered by wilds, including stacked wilds and unlimited retriggers, enhancing winning potential. The reviewer finds it a charming, quirky slot with solid but modest payouts and enduring appeal despite its age. Visually sharp with playful graphics and ambient drum and bush sounds, it delivers a lighthearted, humorous atmosphere.
review: Wild Turkey: Slot OverviewAztec themed slots might be a dime a dozen, yet how many feature anthropomorphic turkeys at the same time? Very few, just one actually, from the creative minds at NetEnt, who spotted a gap in the market and plugged it with their classic slot, Wild Turkey. Getting on in years but ageing well, Wild Turkey offers bright, humorous gameplay, making use of free spins and full reel wilds to power out enjoyable winning potential.Wild Turkey is set high up in a mountainous region, in a village not only populated with turkeys but where their homes are shaped like them. You can tell because the 5-reel, 3-row game grid is see-through and bordered by intertwining trees displaying the game's 20 paylines. Deepening the turkey society experience is a mysterious drum track accompanied by ambient sounds of the bush. The theme is all a bit silly and shouldn't be taken seriously, yet therein lies much of Wild Turkey's charm. It's a game that's a little wacky on the outside while remaining a fully functioning gambling machine within.Part of the reason is due to a medium-high volatile math model, producing a default RTP value of 96.6%. Players can enjoy a win every three spins or so, at 31.14% in the base game, rising to 44.8% during the free spins bonus round. Wild Turkey is now playable on any device, providing stakes from 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin.Adding character to the paytable is five high-value turkey pay symbols representing various members of the community. Premium values max out at the turkey in the red hat, perhaps a priest, that triggers a payout worth 200 times the bet when five land on a payline. Beneath the premiums, 10-A stone card symbols make up the low-value section of the paytable. In all cases, at least three matching symbols are needed, sitting adjacent to each other from the left-hand side to form a winning combination.Wild Turkey: Slot FeaturesWild symbols are the boss around here, literally, since the village of turkeys worships them. During the base game, wilds appear on any reel to substitute for all other symbols. If 3 or more wilds land anywhere on the reels, free spins are activated.The number awarded increases with the number of wilds in view, so 3, 4, or 5 wilds on screen award 15, 30, or a massive 60 free spins. The sun drops for free spins, and the turkeys gather around a bonfire in the hopes that the wild symbols will work their magic. Wilds are assisted in this task because in free spins, they may appear as a stack of 2 of 3 symbols, possibly covering all positions on a reel. If a stacked wild symbol does cover a full reel, +2 additional free spins are awarded. No limit has been placed on the number of free spins that may be retriggered.Wild Turkey: Slot VerdictOriginally released in 2013, then made available on tablet or mobile devices in 2019, Wild Turkey is a game that does not look its age. While they won't exactly blow your mind, the graphics have retained a sharp clarity and compare favourably with more current releases. As well as the graphical quality, what helps provide appeal is the peculiar subject matter, as a band of turkeys living in the mountains is not one you see every day. By choosing such a unique topic, NetEnt has stuffed Wild Turkey with personality to make a slot that hasn't really been replicated. So for a break from mythology, or western, or any number of serious-minded games, Wild Turkey is a relaxed breath of fresh airThere's a similar thing going on when we get to Wild Turkey's gameplay. No, it's not cutting edge, but it is a satisfying experience all the same. The base game isn't the most exciting, and an interest in turkeys might well help players push through until the required three or more wild symbols hit to lead into free spins. In the bonus round, with the help of full reel wilds, the game switches from funny to business mode. Rewards aren't huge when compared to what the competition is doing now, and during simulated game rounds, Wild Turkey was maxing out at around 1,000x the bet consistently. Though technically speaking, a full screen of wilds in free spins would be worth 4,000x right there.For low key gaming with so-so winning potential, Wild Turkey isn't a bad option at all. The gameplay is uncomplicated, some might say basic, but its individual quirks means Wild Turkey is still capable after all these years of conjuring up a bit of fun gaming.

title: Evil Goblins xBomb
structured_summary: Evil Goblins xBomb is a fantasy-themed slot featuring mischievous goblins in an underground cave setting. The game offers multiple features including Goblin Sacrifice wilds, xBomb explosions that expand the grid, and various free spin modes with escalating multipliers. The reviewer finds it less complex and intense than some Nolimit City titles but still highly volatile with a good hit rate to keep gameplay engaging. Aesthetically, it has a standard 6x3 grid with somewhat muted visuals and a plodding soundtrack reminiscent of its predecessor, Fire in the Hole xBomb.
review: Evil Goblins xBomb: Slot OverviewIn many, if not most fantasy games, Goblins are fairly low in the monster hierarchy, possessing little real threat but useful for levelling up. They are also rarely depicted as good creatures, an exception being Harry Potter, where they run the wizard bank Gringotts, though they were pretty mean to that dragon. Nolimit City doesn't beat around the bush; their little green guys are decidedly malicious and star in a slot titled Evil Goblins xBomb. However, these goblins do come in handy and are responsible for triggering many of the game's most effective features.In a lot of ways, Evil Goblins xBomb is a follow on from Fire in the Hole xBomb, sharing more than just the last word in their titles. The soundtrack, for starters, bears heavy resemblance to said game and, once again, the action takes place underground, this time in a goblin cave, where burning torches cast their light over copious gold coins. After Mental, then Das xBoot, Evil Goblins comes across as almost conventional. The gaming occurs on a fairly standard 6-reel, 3-row game grid, yet the xBomb feature can expand it up to 7 rows high. To be frank, Evil Goblins isn't the most exciting work Nolimit City has produced from an aesthetic standpoint, though this assessment lessens in importance somewhat when the gameplay kicks in.Evil Goblins is available on any device from mobile to desktop and has a stake range of 20 p/c top $/€100 per spin, and being highly volatile, apologies, 'extremely' highly volatile, the game comes with a couple of RTP configurations. If looking for the most generous version, the highest return value is 96.14%. This also changes when buying features, which are all clearly labelled in the help docs, hovering between 96.03% and 96.81%.Landing three or more adjacent matching symbols from the left-hand side of the grid forms a winning combination. Winning symbols are then removed and replaced by new ones via the avalanche feature, potentially leading to consecutive payouts until no new wins hit. The game uses 10 regular paying symbols – five of those are low pay stone backed 10-A card royals, while the five premiums are five goblin characters worth 1 to 3 times the stake for six of a kind. The goblins appearing on the premium symbols also appear above the reels, triggering certain features.Evil Goblins xBomb: Slot FeaturesWhile maybe not quite as complicated as NLC's most recent releases, there is nevertheless a lot to get to grips with in Evil Goblins, including numerous bonus rounds, modifiers, and feature buys.Goblin SacrificeOn each spin, 4 of the goblins used on the premium symbols appear above the middle 4 reels. If a matching symbol lands on the reel below, the goblin throws a grenade at it, turning it wild. Once a goblin has thrown a grenade, it disappears, and a new random goblin takes its place.WildsIn Evil Goblin, 3 wilds may appear on reels 2-6. These are regular, Dead, and Resurrection wilds:Regular wilds land naturally or are created by the Goblin Sacrifice feature (mentioned above) to substitute any pay symbol.Dead Wilds do nothing but get in the way of linking winning combinations and are not removed by the xBomb.Landing 3 or more Dead Wilds turns them into Resurrection Wilds, which do substitute regular pays. When they transform, the last Resurrection Wild turns into a multiplier. If 3, 4, or 5 Resurrection Wilds are created, then the multiplier value is x11, x33, or x55, respectively.xBombxBombs remove adjacent symbols except scatters, Dead Wilds, or Resurrection Wilds, and increase the win multiplier by +1 when they explode. Each xBomb also adds an extra row to the grid up to 7 rows high at the most. xBombs explode before the next cascade, whether there was a win or not.Evil 4If all 4 goblins on top of the reels are the same type, the Evil 4 feature is triggered. The winning goblin then appears above the first reel, holding a multiplier of x4. If a matching goblin symbol lands on reel 1, it is counted as 4 instances of that symbol type. Every time a new matching goblin appears on the top reel, the multiplier increases by +1.Fresh Meat SpinsLanding 3 or 4 scatters awards 8 or 9 Fresh Meat Spins, where Dead Wilds are guaranteed on each spin, plus there is a much higher chance of triggering Goblin Sacrifice and xBombs. Each scatter landing during this feature awards an additional free spin. If the Evil 4 triggers during this round, the bonus round is upgraded to Goblins Feast Spins, and any collected multiplier is carried over.If the triggering 3-4 scatters land at the same time as 2 xBombs in the base game, Explosive Fresh Meat Spins are awarded instead. These are the same as Fresh Meat Spins, but xBombs are guaranteed on every new spin.Goblins Feast SpinsIf upgraded from Fresh Meat Spins or bought using the bonus buy option, the Goblins Feast Spins will give you 4 spins with the Evil 4 multiplier activated. Whenever a matching goblin appears on top of the reels, the multiplier increases by 1, that goblin stays in position for the rest of the feature and spins reset back to 4. This may happen up to 4 times in total. If Goblins Feast Spins are triggered from Fresh Meat Spins, and there are more than 5 free spins remaining, the number of spins is allocated as the Evil 4 multiplier.If 2 xBombs were in view when Goblins Feast Spins were triggered, Explosive Goblins Feast Spins are awarded. During this bonus, xBombs are guaranteed on each spin.Feature buyEvil Goblins has a full list of feature buy options, where available. The cost for buying Fresh Meat Spins, Explosive Fresh Meat Spins, Goblins Feast Spins, or Explosive Goblins Feast Spins is 60, 150, 300, or 666 times the stake, respectively. Or you can pay 181x the bet for a Lucky Draw, which could award either of the four previous options. Finally, for 32x the bet, players can buy 3 spins with 2 xBombs on each.Evil Goblins xBomb: Slot VerdictAfter a playthrough, Evil Goblins felt like Fire in the Hole xBomb's quieter, less dynamic sibling. We're back underground, with a similar plodding soundtrack, blowing things up from the reels. This one has a stronger fantasy element, which may or may not be your cup of tea, but it brings a Dragon Tribe element into the picture. If the rules of Mental or Das xBoot taxed the neurons, you'll be glad to know Evil Goblins isn't quite as complicated or confusing when in action. This does not mean Evil Goblins is a simple game, though – far from it, let's not forget who we are dealing with here. As well as rules being slightly toned down, the rest of the game isn't as wildly brutal as a slot like Mental either. The hit rate is high though, meaning plenty of avalanches and Goblin Sacrifices triggering regularly as well. This combination of features keeps the pace up, the game flowing and should help players who need a few fireworks to stay engaged.Don't let your guard down though, Evil Goblins' volatility still has the 'extreme' label. The result of its hit rate/volatility setup meant we often went straight to buying bonuses rather than hang around and wait for things to unfold naturally. It's not that there is an unusually long wait time; bonus games have a hit frequency of 1 in 191 spins. Yet, triggering the upper bonuses wasn't a cakewalk, and getting guaranteed xBombs in free spins does significantly open up the grid to more possibilities. As such, some players might appreciate the 3 spin xBomb bonus buy option as it provides a chance to land scatters alongside the two xBombs.The other thing you really want to see when playing Evil Goblins is the All Hail the King sequence. This triggers when the game's win cap of 31,969x the bet has been reached. Obviously, this is not the biggest total from NLC, but impressive regardless, and after the spate of big win clips we've had this year from the studio's games, there's a chance we'll see Evil Goblins strut its stuff, too.Let's end by saying when dealing with Nolimit City, there is an expectation each new release will blow the windowpanes off your dwelling. Since Evil Goblins doesn't have that feel to it, some may be quick to write it off. Evil Goblins might not be one of NLC's triple-A titles, yet there's still plenty to get stuck into. The interplay of features is clever, and the gaming can heat up; just don't expect another slot of the year contender.

title: Wild Wild Bison
structured_summary: Wild Wild Bison is a bison-themed slot set in a North American wilderness with dry plains and mountains. It features a 6-reel grid with expanding reels during the Wild Rush, cash-collect Bison Coins, Gold Rush multiplier spins, mystery symbols, and bonus buys. The reviewer finds it an enjoyable but unoriginal cash-collect slot, closely resembling previous titles by Stakelogic and Pragmatic Play. The game offers pleasant visuals and sounds reflecting its wild plains theme, though nothing particularly memorable.
review: Wild Wild Bison: Slot OverviewHere's a thought-provoking stat for you folks. According to an article at Our World in Data, when measured by biomass, wild mammals account for just 4% of the mammal kingdom. The rest is made up of 62% livestock, such as pigs and cattle, and 34% is us, humans. We haven't been around long in the grand scheme of things, but already, humans have dramatically altered life on Earth. Not sure what to say about that other than, hey, here's Wild Wild Bison from developer Stakelogic, a slot so wild they had to name it twice? That and the fact it is more or less a clone of Wild Wild Bass 2, which in turn was similar to Pragmatic Play's slot Wild Wild Riches. And so, like the circle of life, the circle of slots continues to turn.When entering a bison slot, you're very likely to be entering a North American game world, which appears to be where we're at for Wild Wild Bison. A pretty world it is, too, of dry yellow plains, swaying trees, and towering mountains. A few bison linger about the place, looking 'wild' in the free sense of the word rather than the raging one. Eh, it's a bison slot; there's not much else to say about the presentation other than all pleasant so far.Wild Wild Bison slot - base gameWild Wild Bison's gaming side of things takes place on a 6-reel grid with reels holding 3-3-4-4-4-4 symbols each – increasing when the Wild Rush feature triggers to 3-3-5-5-5-5. Before then, let's pick a stake where the options are 10 c to $/€50. Wild Wild Bison doesn't have a Super Stake ante bet, but it does have two feature buys. It seems that no matter how players take to the game, the default RTP is 96.07%, and volatility high.On the smaller grid size, 2,304 ways to win are available, which grows to 5,625 with the extra symbols during the Wild Rush feature. Wins pay left to right, from the first reel onwards, and 3 to 6-of-a-kind wins are possible. Hitting a 6-matching symbol win made up of the 9 to A card ranks pays out 1 to 2 times the bet, rising to 2.5 to 15 times the bet for landing a way of 6 eagles, wolves, cougars, black bears, or brown bears. Our bison buddy is printed on the wild symbol, which lands on reels 1 and 2. Wilds' basic duty is to substitute for any pay symbol.Wild Wild Bison: Slot FeaturesWild Wild Bison slot - insane hunt featureWild symbols are also needed to trigger the Wild Rush feature, which stampedes alongside Bison Coins, the Gold Rush feature, mystery symbols, and bonus buys.Wild RushLanding wild symbols on both reels 1 and 2 triggers the Wild Rush. Reels 3, 4, 5, and 6 gain an extra position. Bison Coins may land on reels 3 to 6, displaying a random money value as a multiplier of the bet. Any Bison Coins landing during the Wild Rush award their values. Should a Gold Rush symbol land on reel 6 during the Wild Rush feature, then Gold Rush is triggered.Gold RushGold Rush symbols only appear on reel 6, and landing one at the same time as 2 wild symbols triggers the Gold Rush feature. Then, 2, 3, or 5 Gold Rush spins are awarded. For Gold Rush spins, reels 1 and 2 merge into a single multiplier reel. On each spin, the multiplier displays a value between x1 and x10. Reels 3, 4, 5, and 6 change into 20 independent reels, landing only Bison Coins, Gold Rush symbols, mystery symbols, or blanks. On each Gold Rush spin, any Bison Coins are awarded, and the multiplier is applied. At the start of each spin, the grid is cleared. Landing Gold Rush symbols adds extra Gold Rush spins.Mystery SymbolsMystery symbols may land anywhere during Gold Rush spins, revealing a random multiplier value of x2, x3, x4, or x5, which is used to multiply any in view Bison Coins.Bonus BuyFrom the bonus buy, players can get the Wild Rush feature for 50 times the bet or go larger and buy the Gold Rush for 100 times the bet.Wild Wild Bison slot - insane hunt featureWild Wild Bison: Slot VerdictIt would be hard to call Wild Wild Bison a game full of surprises. In fact, the most surprising thing about it was how soon it was released after Wild Wild Bass 2, the game it is structured on. Great news for players who go all weak at the knees at the thought of another cash symbol collection game, about as exciting as waiting for a lift to arrive otherwise. Not to downplay Wild Wild Bison's positives, it provided a pleasant, if unmemorable, review session after all. But it just came along so soon after the game it's built from, which in turn closely resembled Wild Wild Riches, as mentioned.To be fair, Stakelogic's two Wild Wild games are bigger and arguably do more unusual things. For instance, the 10,000x max win isn't half bad, and the grid contains a lot more ways to win. Wild Rush can be a bit so-so and was the least attractive of the two bonus buys. However, the Gold Rush feature should be right up the street for certain cash collector aficionados. It's nice the way symbols are cleared on each spin, and having an ever-present multiplier (even if it can be x1) throughout the round is handy as well. title: Riches of Midgard: Land and Expand
structured_summary: Riches of Midgard: Land and Expand is a Norse mythology-themed slot featuring Odin, Thor, and Freya in a cartoon-style Midgard setting. Its key features include Hot Spot Reels triggering expanding respins and a free spins mode with increasing rows and paylines. The reviewer finds it a modest, somewhat frustrating game with decent RTP but less thrilling wins compared to other Norse slots. The game offers a cute cartoon aesthetic with rickety reel sounds and powerful effects, creating a unique yet less intense atmosphere.
review: Riches of Midgard: Land and Expand - Slot OverviewRiches of Midgard: Land and Expand is a reminder that NetEnt is one Swedish studio which rarely delves into its Nordic heritage for inspiration. A flick through their back catalogue turns up more druids or Egyptian gods than Norse deities. Perhaps after what Hall of Gods accomplished, the team felt that not much else needed doing in the genre. However, mythology fans can again thank NetEnt for returning Odin, Thor, and Freya to the reels, swinging hammers and bringing the lightning in Riches of Midgard: Land and Expand.The game starts well, due to the big, bizarre wooden contraption housing the reels in the middle of the screen. Set in an idyllic Midgardian landscape, the 3-reel, 9-payline grid is surrounded by the fertile fields and mountains of Scandinavia. Just a quick note for those unfamiliar with Norse mythology. Midgard is one of the Nine Worlds, the one where humans live, surrounded by a giant serpent. It was created when the all-father Odin plus siblings Ve and Vili took down the giant Ymir. There are great stories there, so it’s easy to see why they continue to make a huge impression on pop culture, slots especially.NetEnt has done it quite well, going for a cartoon look rather than the heavy treatment this theme often gets - cute rather than raw power. The results are similar to what we often see in Relax Gaming slots such as Ramses Revenge, or Marching Legions. The soundtrack is a bit of anomaly. The rickety reels clunk and grind as they spin, while grunt is provided by the powerful sound effects.Riches of Midgard is available across all devices, giving players a range of betting options from 10 p/c to $/€200 per spin. The math model proved to be a rather tricky wee beast during test runs, requiring perseverance to see what the game was capable of. That didn’t turn out to be anything extraordinary once fired up, though a decent enough RTP rating of 96.03% would suggest things should even out to an extent in the long run.A little unusually for a three-reel slot, the symbols pay out in combinations of two or three. The high pays do at least; the lows still need a full line of three to payout. There are 10 pay symbols altogether, 10-A making up the bottom end of the table followed by, a hunk of meat, a horn, Freya, Thor and Odin. Landing three premiums on a line returns a reward of 1-15 times the stake.Riches of Midgard: Land and Expand - Slot FeaturesWhat starts as a modestly sized slot gets engorged during the features – it doesn’t have ‘Expand’ in the tile just for fun. Gameplay centres largely on the Hot Spot Reels which can lead to respins, in the base and bonus game.The single position reels bolted to the side of the wooden device are the Hot Spots. Hot Spots spin at the same time as regular reels but do not contribute to line wins. Their job is to activate Respins. If matching symbols land in the two Hot Spots, as well as on two or more regular reels, the Land and Expand feature is triggered and a Respin is awarded. The symbols which activated the respins expand to cover all positions on the reel and are locked in place for the respin. If a matching symbol lands on the respin, it too expands to cover the full reel. If all three reels display the matching symbol from the start, there is no respin; an expanded reward is instantly paid. Only high-value symbols or blanks appear in Hot Spots during the base game, shifting to high and low symbols in the bonus.It couldn’t be a Thor slot without his trusty hammer somewhere. In Riches of Midgard, Mjolnir is the scatter symbol, where 3 of them on the reels activate 8 free spins. When free spins are in play, each Mjolnir scatter on reel three awards two more free spins (without limit) and adds a new row at the top or bottom of the reels. The expanded grid also increases the number of bet lines. When the reels reach their full 7 row height, 29 bet lines are activated. A wild symbol also enters the game during free spins. It appears on the left Hot Spot to substitute for any symbol landing on the right Hot Spot.Riches of Midgard: Land and Expand - Slot VerdictRiches of Midgard is quite a singular experience, wrapping up a bunch of features that work in an intriguing way. In saying so, there are recognisable elements, such as the expanding symbols which draws the mind to Book of Ra. Hot Spots trigger respins quite frequently to keep the base game going, and their presentation on the tottering wooden frame is well designed. Free spins are a lot tougher to trigger of course, where the extra rows are a welcome addition, expanding not only reel but the game’s potential.However, the irregularity of free spins didn’t seem to have much positive effect on their value, which tended to the low side most of the time. It’s certainly no Hall of Gods. Where the older jackpot game has a track record as one of the highest playing slots of all time, Riches of Midgard is a lot more modest. Single spin wins max at out 435 times the bet when the grid is fully expanded during the bonus. So, this Midgard isn’t super-rich, though the game is set before corporate-led governments fuelled the capitalist gangbang we find ourselves in today. So maybe NetEnt went for a level of historical accuracy.To sum up, Riches of Midgard contains a dose of originality, yet its cartoon looks blunt the edge Norse slots often provide. That’s not a deal-breaker in itself, but when combined with the patience required to trigger the features’ best bits, Riches of Midgard can be more frustrating than exciting.

title: Atlantis
structured_summary: Atlantis is a mythically themed underwater slot exploring the lost city and ancient riches. review: Atlantis slot: OverviewCome head into salty sea water with Red Tiger’s mythically themed slot Atlantis. The title might sound like it is missing another word, but players get a clear indication of what they can expect - namely, an underwater search for ancient riches. The good news is that there are a few surprises ahead that might not be so obvious from the title and screenshots. Volatility, meanwhile, has been rated a solid 5/5 by Red Tiger, which just happens to be the same score given to the hit rate (5/5). Testing confirmed a fairly steady stream of smaller wins, augmented by the features, though hitting the bonus game proved a challenge and a half.Atlantis is a cascading slot that utilises 30 paylines. The first time that happened was a little surprising as Atlantis didn’t automatically come across as the kind of slot. The classic vibe it successfully exudes sees to that - no complaints though.Aquatic imagery livens up the paytable symbols. Well, the high pays at least. Payouts range from 0.5x for 5 clubs up to 5 times the stake for 5 Atlantis symbols. Values might not be huge on their own, but get significant boosts from cascades and the multipliers included with the extra features.Atlantis slot: FeaturesAtlantis - free spins featureIf there is one thing all deep-sea explorers want to find, it’s a chest full of treasure. Atlantis proves the rule with the desirable Treasure Chest icon which can appear in the base game and bonus feature. When a Treasure Chest appears on the reels it expands to create a full wild reel. It only does so, however, once it reaches the bottom row. If it doesn't directly appear on the bottom row, it's held over for the next spin. Only one chest can appear at a time and they can also come with a multiplier of up to x5.The main event in the Atlantis slot is the Gold Spins free spins feature. This is triggered when 3 Gold Spins scatters land to award 10 free spins. During the bonus game, wild reels appear as before, but now their multiplier does not reset between spin. This means consecutive instances of the wild reel add their multiplier to the previous total. Each can add up to an additional x5 - with no limit to how high the multiplier can go. Whenever a Gold Spins symbol lands during the bonus game, each one adds one additional free spin to the remaining total.Atlantis slot: VerdictAtlantis might not be super exciting a lot of the time, but the Gold Spins feature is a potential saving grace and makes all the difference to a session. Trigger it, and Atlantis becomes a pretty good game. If not, and it is possible to have a bonus-free session, Atlantis can be hard going. To be fair, it’s generally not one of those beasts that devour unlucky bankrolls in an eye blink. Wild reels pop up frequently enough to help keep bankrolls afloat, but getting deep into the black depends on getting that elusive third bonus symbol to surface.Atlantis isn't looking to reinvent iGaming and it's not a title that will have a particularly long shelf life. Still, it's simple, superbly designed, and actually quite entertaining. The potential isn't all that bad either, which makes it all the better. How much you ask? Red Tiger advertises wins of over 5,202 times your stake and racking up a substantial multiplier during Gold Spins will get you well on the way. The tricky part, the banana peel on the fishing boat, so to speak, is getting Gold Spins to trigger in the first place.If we haven’t mentioned it enough, Atlantis is one of those games where everything resides on the bonus game. Sure, you could say a lot of slots are like that, it’s just that the progressive multiplier is so effective that the math model can make them tough to access. When Gold Spins are cracked open like a stubborn clam, the game switches from battle to reward mode and Atlantis can be a real delight. If you are okay patiently dog-paddling in one spot for a potentially remarkable bonus game result Atlantis might be worth a look.

title: Legend of the Sword
structured_summary: Legend of the Sword is an Arthurian-themed slot centered on King Arthur and the legendary Excalibur sword.
