The same can be said about Bull In A China Shop from a mathematical standpoint as well. It’s far from being a Play’n GO’s rager due to its medium volatility that has been rated 5 out of 10. RTP hovers above average at 96.20% on the default level, though it drops off quickly if the operator has lowered the setting. Hence, a quick look over the help files is a must before smashing a few plates.Despite a fair number of modifiers and bonus games, Bull in a China Shop is quite a simple game. Offering bets between 10 p/c to $/€100 a spin, the game makes use of nine pay symbols, starting with low pay clubs, diamonds, hearts, and spades, patterned in Ming designs. High pays are theme-based too, where we find four delicate porcelain pieces and an older lady who is presumably the nervous owner of the establishment. Should you land a line of five premium symbols you’ll pick up a payout from 5 to 25 times the stake.Bull In A China Shop: Slot FeaturesBull In A China Shop - free spins splash screenHaving a bull in the title means the snorting ring nosed beast stars in most of the features. This includes a number of random modifiers and three types of free spins bonus games. Whenever the wild bull symbol lands in the base game, he not only replaces pay symbols to form winning combinations, he also triggers one of three random effects:The happy bull places 2 to 6 wild symbols in random positions.The proud bull transforms up to 5 reels completely wild.The angry bull sprinkles between 2 to 6 x2 multiplier wilds onto the reels. If there is more than one multiplier wild on a payline, their values are not added or multiplied together.The golden bull statue is the scatter, appearing on reels 1, 3, and 5. When three are in view, 10 free spins are awarded as part of the bonus. There are three options for players to choose one that suits best:Happy free spins – each time the bull wild appears, extra non-sticky wilds are added in arbitrary positions, in increasing numbers. The first time he pops up, you get 2, then 3 on the next trigger, and so on up to 14 at the most.Proud free spins – whenever bull wild symbols land, 1 to 5 stacked wild reels are created.Angry free spins – when the wild lands in this game, between 2 to 14 multiplier wilds are created. These multipliers carry values of x2, x3, x5, or x10, randomly chosen to be applied to all wilds.It is possible to retrigger each of the bonus games, only once though, meaning a total of 20 free spins at the most.Bull In A China Shop: Slot VerdictBull In A China Shop is one of those games that could have easily been dismissed amongst the tide of endless slot releases. Where Play’n GO avoids this dismissal process, to an extent, is in the shrewd theme choice and treatment. Most people are aware of the ‘bull in a China shop’ saying, referring to someone carelessly smashing everything around them, mentally or emotionally, as much as physically. In doing so, everything else about the game makes sense, rather than being just a pretty standard 20 payline game the same modifiers in the base game being reused in the bonus.The features aren’t hugely original, though the theme is more so. This makes Bull In A China Shop as a whole quite distinctive if a little straight forward. Then again, you can’t complain too much. Bull In A China Shop looks alright, plays well for what it is and offers wins of up to 5,000 times the stake. No qualms about the rewards then, though the medium volatility will be off putting for some given the high volatile/high potential trend that's been around for a few years now. On the other hand, its Pixar looks might very well fit the math model like a charm for players not interested in waving a metaphorical red flag at a raging bull of a game, in a China shop.Play’n GO might sling out a slot every other day it seems, but darn it if they aren’t half clever about it. Bull In A China Shop is another dependable game with personality and potential on top, and there's no particular reasons why it wont entertain.

title: Miner Donkey Trouble
structured_summary: Miner Donkey Trouble is a gold mining-themed slot featuring a comedic duo of a grumpy donkey and an optimistic miner. The game offers cluster pays, cascading wins, a Donkey Destruction meter, Pick-axe Wilds, Mega Symbols, and free spins with multipliers. The reviewer praises its entertaining gameplay, strong feature set, and high win potential despite a somewhat familiar theme. Visually, it boasts high-quality graphics and humorous character design, complemented by engaging effects.
review: Miner Donkey Trouble: Slot OverviewYou don’t need us to tell you gold mining is one of the more populous categories of slot. To help set theirs apart from the rest, Swedish developer Play’n GO pulls out one of the most successful tropes in comedy to inject some personality. Think Jay and Silent Bob, Rogan and Franco, Wilder and Pryor, Stiller and Owen, or the insanity of Will Farrell & John C. Reilly. We are talking of course about the madcap antics of the comedic duo. Play’n GO has taken this one step further by making it interspecial, personifying a donkey and teaming him up with a frazzled, yet optimistic old-time gold miner in a cluster pays slot titled Miner Donkey Trouble.﻿The pair are found deep underground next to a 5x7 sized grid dumping a load of 35 gems, nuggets or special symbols on each spin. Both characters look familiar. The miner because his sort turns up in just about every mining themed slot ever released wearing more or less the same outfit. Picture blue jeans, overalls, a neckerchief, upturned brim on his cowboy hat, plus a bushy fireman’s moustache. He seems pretty ticked off at his partner, standing defiantly on the other side of the screen, looking like Donkey from Shrek - except an angry version. Don’t expect too many waffles from this guy.Sparking up the nugget hunt can be conducted on any device, from smartphones to desktops. Play’n GO are masters of the grid slot format, and part of their success is designing math models that match the features. In Miner Donkey Trouble we get a highly volatile one, rated 8 out of 10, yet slightly more balanced compared to some of their other offerings to ensure nice long runs of consecutive wins in between dead/low thrill drops. Play’n GO does variable RTPs, where the default in Miner Donkey Trouble clocks in at 96.27%. Since RTP can be dropped, be sure to check the docs before picking a stake from 10 p/c to $/€100, and embarking down the shaft.Wins occur in Miner Donkey Trouble when five or more matching symbols are adjacently connected, forming a cluster. Doing so awards a payout, triggers the cascading wins system, and contributes to the Donkey Destruction feature as you will see. When it comes to the symbols, you’ll find four low pay rocks alongside four high pay gems. The largest paying clusters groups are made up of 18+ symbols which are worth 10 to 250 times your stake for the premium group. It couldn’t be a mining game without diamonds somewhere - here one appears on the wild. Wilds have no value of their own but can be used to replace any regular pay symbol to complete a cluster.Miner Donkey Trouble: Slot FeaturesHere’s where things get more complex, with a stack of extra features adding depth to the gameplay. Perhaps the donkey’s miffed because he got fed up trying to explain them to the miner? Anyway, what we’ll cover here is cascading wins, a Donkey Destruction Meter, a Pick-axe Wild feature, Mega Symbols, and free spins.Cascades are standard. They kick in after every win, removing the winning cluster, so that other symbols can drop down into the gaps, potentially causing consecutive wins off a single spin until no new wins cluster up.Each win also contributes to the Donkey Destruction meter, marking your progress on the left-hand side of the grid. The number collected triggers modifiers when it reaches certain levels:18 symbols activate Donkey Destruction 1 - destroys all rock symbols on the grid.40 symbols activate Donkey Destruction 2 – destroys all gem and rock symbols on the grid.50 symbols activate Donkey Destruction 3 – destroys all symbols on the grid except Golden Nuggets and guarantees up to 5 extra Golden Nuggets.Keep an eye out for Golden Nuggets which have no value so are not part of clusters. However, when Golden Nuggets appear on or reach the bottom row of the grid, they are removed, increasing the win multiplier by +1 each. This multiplier applies to any further wins, then resets at the start of each new paid spin.Another special symbol is the Miner’s Pick-axe which has no value either and only appears as part of new symbols in a cascade. When removed, they are collected as part of the Pick-axe Wild feature. This feature is activated when the win sequence ends, adding 4-10 wilds to the grid in random positions.Then we get the Mega Symbol feature, randomly triggered on non-winning spins, or when win sequences have concluded. When active, up to 2 rock, gem, or wild symbols overlay the grid in sizes of 2x2, 3x3, or 4x4.Finally we come to free spins. Dynamite scatters enter the game only from cascades, and detonate when all wins have concluded. Detonate 3 of them to be awarded 5 free spins which can be retriggered up to 20 at the most. The action here is similar to the base game, although comes with the benefit of the win multiplier not resetting between spins.Miner Donkey Trouble: Slot VerdictThat’s quite a lot to get through, but Play’n GO has cleverly designed Miner Donkey Trouble so it doesn’t overwhelm or get bogged down. In fine grid slot tradition, cascades flow into features, activating other extras, ultimately leading to free spins. The theme is arguably overused, yet Play’n Go makes the most of it via high-quality visuals, effects, and a dash of humour.If you’re a fan of grid slots in general, Miner Donkey Trouble’s has pretty much everything you could ask for. Where it wins out over hits like Reactoonz is in its rewards. Lately, Play'n GO has been in the habit of raising the max potential on their slots, and Miner Donkey Trouble is another example of this trend. The riches down this mine can reach as high as 10,000x the bet, significantly more than most of the studio’s previous releases in this category. However, due to its medium volatility and high hit rate it can sometimes feel as one those games where you seem to be getting nowhere. Bonuses are relatively rare, and once you trigger them they typically just sort of pay back some of your base game losses, leaving you where you started.Combine everything though, and you’ve got another solid grid slot from the Play'n GO team. It doesn’t have the individuality of the Reactoonz series - picking a gold mining theme will do that. However, the entertaining gameplay, phenomenal design, a bundle of great features, and big win potential make it a compelling option.

title: Dragons Playground
structured_summary: Dragon's Playground features a cozy fantasy theme with two interactive dragons and a flame motif. review: Dragon's Playground: Slot OverviewIt's been said that you're never more than 6 feet away from a rat in New York City, and in the online slots business, you're never more than, say, 7 or 8 feet away from a dragon game. Okay, that dragon 'stat' is a made-up number, but dragons are a popular entity, commonly found in slots, often appearing in traditional Asian-themed games since they possess a major cultural significance. Dragon's Playground from developer NetEnt isn't one of those sorts of slots. Instead, it makes its home amongst the fantasy dragon trope, breathing Avalanches, wild transformations, Cycle Rounds, as well as free spins into participating draco fans' lives.Two dragons drape themselves about Dragon's Playground's screen, a red-scaled one on the left and a green one to the right. The dragons aren't only for show, as they interact with the gaming grid every so often, and flames play an important role in general. Dragon's Playground's base game unfolds in batches of 10 spins, where the final spin of a cycle triggers a wild symbol conversion feature. A spin count on the top right corner of the gaming grid helps gamblers keep track of the cycle's progress. With a cartoon style and a helpful dragon duo, Dragon's Playground rustles up a good amount of cosy warmth to invite players in for a go.Dragons Playground slot - base gameTo actually have a go of trying your luck in Dragon's Playground, you'll need to pick a stake, and the range on offer here varies from a low of 10 c to a high of $/€10 per paid game round. Wedged between the two on-screen wyverns is a 6-reel, 4-row play area, which supplies no less than 4,096 ways to win, requiring all wins to start from the leftmost reel. Further statistics include gamblers getting a maximum RTP of 96% and a medium-high volatile math model to go with it.Fantasy items such as shields, rings, crowns, and treasure chests (poking tongues) are Dragon's Playground's high pays. Its low pays are common 10-A card royals. Should you manage to hit a 6 OAK high pay combination, the reward is 3 to 10 times the bet, dropping to 1x-2.5x for a low pay 6-of-a-kind win. Wild symbols only appear on the reels from Cycle Rounds or Dragon's Breath features, substituting for all symbols except the scatter.Dragon's Playground: Slot FeaturesDragons Playground slot - free spinsDragon's Playground's features begin with Avalanches, aka a tumbling, cascading win mechanic. As per usual, symbols in winning combinations disappear, making way on the reels for other symbols to avalanche down to replace them, bringing in new symbols up top as needs be. Avalanches repeat in this manner until a win no longer appears.FlamesPay symbols may appear with a flame attached to them. Symbols with flames that are destroyed form a frame at their position. If their position is already framed, a frame is added to a random position.Cycle RoundsSpins in the base game are played in cycles of 10. On the 10th spin of a cycle, all framed positions transform into wild symbols.Dragon's BreathThe dragons can randomly activate to add wild symbols to the reels. This can occur on any spin except the tenth spin in a Cycle Round.Free SpinsGetting 3 scatter symbols on the reels in the base game awards 10 free spins plus 4 free spins for each extra scatter in view. In the free spins session, landing 3 scatter symbols awards +5 additional free spins, plus 2 free spins for each extra scatter on the grid. During the feature, on each free spin, when the Avalanche feature ends, all remaining flames are removed, and formed frames in the current spin transform into wilds. A winning way of 6 wilds awards 10x the bet.Dragons Playground slot - free spinsDragon's Playground: Slot VerdictDragon's Playground was a slot that was as cute to play as it was to look at. It's one of those games where not much about it is especially innovative, but any lack of mechanical originality didn't feel like a major issue. A cosy fantasy gaming environment pulls you in, and rotations of the Cycle Rounds feature play their part in holding attention. A simple set of rules makes Dragon's Playground easy to learn, quite well-paced, and only adds to the replayability instead of detracting from it.Cycle Round-style slots appear every so often; NetEnt's Babylon Riches and Red Tiger's Buffalo Collector are two contemporaries, and dropping wilds at the end of a cycle is an oft-seen move. This approach makes sticking around for the next 10 spins compelling since, who knows, maybe this cycle is the one that gets smothered in marked positions. Upping the anticipation is the fact Dragon's Playground has thousands of ways to win in place of a reduced number of paylines, so, in theory, it doesn't take a huge number of wild symbols on the grid to link winning combinations together. This can happen both at the end of Cycle Round or when dragons blast the reels. Or, at the end of free spins. It's a simple yet sweet system that is able to smoulder its way to 10,000x the bet when the flames are appropriately fanned.It's always nice to get a game from NetEnt which wraps an amiable personality around a warm inner core rather than disgorging a painful travesty that sullies the developer's hard-won reputation. Dragon's Playground was one of the studio's positive releases, which, while offering little in the way of white-hot, unmissable avant-garde action, was simply fun to play.

title: Whispering Winds
structured_summary: Whispering Winds is an Asian-themed slot from Play'n GO, presenting a poetic yet familiar atmosphere. It features a 5x3 grid with 25 paylines, a Hold 'n Win Gold Respins bonus, and Mega Free Spins with 3x3 Mega symbols. The reviewer finds it a mediocre reskin of Legion Gold, with simple gameplay and modest winning potential. Visually, it offers an okay, misty courtyard backdrop with dragons and warriors, paired with generic but pleasant audio.
review: Whispering Winds: Slot OverviewWho says casino game makers lack a soul and are only consumed with crafting cold, heartless devices which are literally designed to take peoples' money? The title of this game, Whispering Winds, from developer Play'n GO would suggest otherwise. Whispering Winds. It's quite poetic, isn't it? Maybe the name is a window into the soul of Play'n GO, where secrets, romance, and mystery abound. Or not, since Whispering Winds is an Asian themed reskin of the mediocre slot Legion Gold, putting a major kibosh on the project's creative spark.As an Asian-themed slot, Whispering Winds is okay looking, nothing special, nothing disgustingly hideous. It's got a traditional structure holding the gaming grid, a misty courtyard scene in the background, and miscellaneous items like dragons, swords, and warriors. As mentioned, Whispering Winds makes an okay visual impression; the sonics aren't bad, either. Generic, but that's kind of how it is with these sorts of slots.Whispering Winds slot - base gameThose who wish to partake can click the plus and minus buttons to choose a stake as low as 5 c per spin or as high as $/€100, with various levels in between. For math model volatility, Whispering Winds sits right in the middle of the scale, earning a 5 out of 10 medium rating. The RTP values, as always, may differ depending on the market, with the most preferable figure being the 96.23% one. If that sounds good, then hitting the spin button sets in motion a 5-reel gaming grid, holding 3 rows on each reel and making use of 25 paylines to work out the wins.On the symbol side, Whispering Winds has 8 regular pays, a wild, and a scatter. The regular pays are split into lower value J-A royals and higher value mirrors, gems, swords, and warriors. Getting a winning combination consisting of 5 matching royals is worth 2x the bet for all kinds of them or 8 to 20 times the bet for 5 matching premiums in a win. Wilds help complete combinations by substituting for any regular pay symbol. Wilds hit on all reels and have the same value as the warrior premium if making their own wins.Whispering Winds: Slot FeaturesWhispering Winds slot - hold & win bonusLike Legion Gold, Whispering Winds' features are a hold 'n win Gold Respins round and Mega Free Spins where a Mega symbol appears.Gold RespinsLanding 6 Gold Coins triggers 3 Gold Respins, where only Gold Coins may land and are sticky. When a Gold Coin lands, the remaining number of Gold Respins is reset back to 3. When the Gold Respins round ends, all values of the Gold Coins in view are paid out. Each Gold Coin randomly has a value of 1x to 1,000x the bet. If Gold Coins fill all of the positions on the reels, a 1,000x the stake Golden Prize is awarded on top of the Gold Coin values.Mega Free SpinsIn the base game, landing 3 scatter symbols triggers 5 Mega Free Spins. A 3x3 sized Mega symbol lands in random positions on each free spin. Mega Free Spins can be retriggered by landing the Mega scatter up to a cap of 45 spins. Moreover, Gold Respins can be triggered during Mega Free Spins by landing the Mega Gold Coin. Should this happen, the Mega Gold Coin breaks down into 9 Gold Coins carrying random values. Once Gold Respins play out, the game returns to the free spin where the Gold Respin round was triggered.Whispering Winds slot - free spinsWhispering Winds: Slot VerdictYep, that went about as well as expected. After reading through the game sheet at the start of the review and realising we had a Legion Gold clone on the agenda, excitement wasn't passionately bubbling over. The reason is that Legion Gold's mashed-together mix of old-school gameplay, weak stats, and overall low-energy entertainment didn't light many fires the first time around. Pretty much all of that stuff has returned for Whispering Winds, except its recycled innards have been adorned in an arguably even more commonplace skin than Ancient Rome.On the plus side? Some may appreciate that Whispering Winds is a simple game, with a whiff of Wolf Gold to it, in regards to the big symbol free spins bonus, coupled with a rudimentary hold 'n win round. Free spins, okay, there's a roaming 3x3 Mega symbol, fair enough. There's not much to Gold Respins, though - land Gold Coins, get Gold Coin values, full stop. No collector, no special symbols? Oh well. Suppose the 1,000x Golden Prize would be a decent cherry on top of filling all positions with Gold Coin symbols, though Whispering Winds' 2,000x the bet maximum winning potential is hardly the stuff of legends.And so, by extension, Whispering Winds is hardly the stuff of legends either. The opposite, really, as it sits next to its Legion Gold buddy on the less exciting shelf of the Play'n GO collection. Still, Legion Gold must have garnered enough attention to warrant a reskin, so players who were thrilled by the Roman version may achieve the same levels of thrill from Whispering Winds.

title: Medusa Megaways
structured_summary: Medusa Megaways revives the mythological Medusa theme with ancient Greek ruins and a creepy atmosphere. The game features up to 117,649 Megaways, cascading symbols, growing multipliers, and unique bonuses like Medusa's Gaze and Snake Strike. The reviewer praises its engaging gameplay, especially the free spins and Temptation feature, calling it a high variance slot that exceeded expectations. Visually, it combines intentionally dated graphics with a haunting soundtrack true to the original Medusa slot.
review: Medusa Megaways: ReviewAs a consequence of the Megaways trend, new life has been brought into many of the old classics, allowing us to experience them in a more relevant format. Of course, there might be some grumpy old conservative players out there that don't agree, but the success speaks for itself! The latest classic to get the Megaways treatment is Medusa, a NextGen Gaming creation that has been released in two instalments, out of which the second became one of NextGen's biggest hits to date.Fundamentally, what you get here is Bonanza type gameplay - you have your typical 6 reels + the extra reel, the random variation of between 3 to 7 symbols per spin and reel (which is really the heart of the Megaways game engine), up to 117,649 Megaways and, of course, cascading symbols and growing multipliers in the free spins. But that's where the similarities end as Medusa Megaways comes with a new set of unique features as you will see. You can play this bad boy from between 0.25 to 25 Eur per spin across all devices, and also worth a mention is that it comes with two RTP-settings, one when triggering the bonus "organically", where you'll play with a 96.28% RTP, and one when you buy the bonus, where it's set to 97.63%.As fans of Medusa, we're happy to see that the developers have made sure to stay true to the original, both visually and by sticking to the same creepy soundtrack as before. With a mythological theme based on the legend of Medusa, a gorgon described as a winged female with venomous snakes in place of hair, in the backdrop you'll see ancient Greek stone ruins and pink skies. It's a rather unsettling scene that transitions to the inside of a temple when you trigger the free spins. The graphics have intentionally made to look a bit dated as a homage to Medusa which we love in this case.The symbol set includes A to 10 royals as well as talaria sandals, silver rings, golden snakes, trojan shields and pegasus horses, the latter being the most lucrative, coming in at 30 times your stake if you land 6 on a payline. The daunting Medusa herself is the wild, substituting for all symbols bar the scatter and the special Soldier symbol* which only appears on the extra reel during the free spins feature - more on that latter!Just as in most Megaways slots, the slot is played using cascading symbols where all symbols part of a winning combination are removed and replaced by a new set of symbols - a chain reaction that repeats until no more winning combinations appear on the reels.Medusa Megaways: FeaturesMedusa Megaways is a slot rich in features. When one or more wilds appear on the extra reel there's a chance that the Medusa's Gaze feature might activate. When so happens, Medusa appears to cover the full reel directly below the wilds, revealing one or more wild symbols as she disappears again.Though offering satisfying potential in the main game, it all comes down to the Free Spins feature which activates to give you 10 free spins when you land 3 or more scatter symbols anywhere on the reels (optionally, you can Buy the feature for a cost of 100 times your stake). Furthermore, each additional scatter symbol that lands on the reels will give you 5 extra free spins. It's also possible to retrigger the free spins feature by landing 3 or more scatters with no limit to how many times it can retrigger.Once granted access, you will benefit from the Unlimited Win Multiplier feature - kicking off at 2x, every chain reaction win increases the multiplier by 1. Also, aside from the Medusa's Gaze feature, which applies here as well, to further help you win in the free spins the Snake Strike feature may come into play. Pay attention to the two snakes on both sides of the extra reel. When one or more *soldiers land on this reel, the snakes lash out to attack them - if the snake on the left attacks, the symbol transforms into a wild. If the snake on the right attacks instead, the symbol transforms into a scatter.Finally, when the feature ends, the Temptation feature gives you the opportunity to choose one of two options - to walk away with your winnings or to play the feature again in hope for more significant wins. Of course, it's quite likely that you'll end up with an even worse feature so choose wisely.Medusa Megaways: VerdictAs you've seen, Medusa Megaways is a rather busy slot that comes packed with features. If it seems confusing, don't worry. It's actually quite simple once you get going. Though a reasonably well-balanced slot, as these Bonanza-type slots usually are, most of the action is concentrated to the free spins bonus. Though we enjoyed all of the features included, we have to say that the Temptation concept is the most interesting. If anything, it's great knowing you'll get a second chance if you experience a dreadful bonus.Medusa Megaways is a high variance slot with a max win potential of 50,000x but is likely capped relative to the stake. Either way, we thoroughly enjoyed it and are of the opinion that it, not only lived up to, but exceeded our expectations! With the help of Big Time Gaming's excellent invention, the curse of Medusa lives on, more powerful than ever before.

title: Gems of Egypt Connecta Ways
structured_summary: Gems of Egypt Connecta Ways offers an Egyptian-themed slot with a unique manga-style Cleopatra and an unconventional panpipe-shaped reel layout. Its standout features include the Dynamic Reels mechanic with shifting reel heights and a Connecta Ways system providing up to 961 ways to win, plus free spins with stacked wilds. The reviewer finds the game original but somewhat inconsistent, praising its novelty but noting it may not appeal to all Egypt slot fans. Visually, it combines familiar Egyptian motifs with striking, anime-inspired character design and a temple backdrop, accompanied by thematic audio enhancing the immersive experience.
review: Gems of Egypt Connecta Ways: OverviewWhile the look is familiar, Boomerang Studios has been brave by test running a couple of things you don’t often see in the egyptian themed category. One is the unusual slot layout found in Gems of Egypt, made even more unorthodox by the new and ever-shifting in-house developed Dynamic Reels feature.Boomerang place emphasis on designing games for the Asian market which might explain the wide-eyed Manga Cleopatra that greets players when the game loads. Typically, Cleopatra is presented in an aloof, regal manner. Here she’s all leggy and chesty, with a sort of Asuna Yuuki look about her. No matter, this is gambling, not Gibbon so no need to get all academic about it.Once in the game there is no doubt where we’ve landed. The unusual, panpipes shaped slot sits outside a temple or palace, guarded by two handsome Sphinx-like characters. The background image is a good one, familiar for Egypt fans to feel at home, yet individual enough to make a striking first impression. To the top left is the logo which Boomerang has styled using the Pricedown font borrowed straight from Grand Theft Auto. Once you’ve seen it, you can’t unsee it.Playable from 25 p/c to $/€35 per spin, Gems of Egypt’s math model produces a bunch of solid and not so solid numbers. One of the not so great is an RTP of 95.6% which might be enough to give players pause. The medium-high volatility favours harder-edged gamblers perhaps, but wins and bonuses appear more often than you might expect. Free spins, for example, have a hit frequency of once in 112 spins, theoretically.Boomerang has trundled out their Connecta Ways mechanic to score wins on. This isn’t the first time we’ve come across it. A previous game, Wild Joker Stacks, used the mechanic as well. Where that one maxed out at 99 Connecta Ways, Gems of Egypt provides up to 961 ways to win when fully expanded. Connecta is a system where winning symbols can land in any row, as long as they are adjacent and connecting.The symbols used in the game are not your typical Egyptian slot icons. There are no card royals or gods, which feels a little odd at first. On the low side are 4 stones of various colours – all with the same value, followed by four polished gems set in gold bands. Each symbol type pays out when at least three of a kind land, except the big diamond which only needs two. If a line of six diamonds land, players pick up a reward of 10x the stake. There is a wild symbol, the doe-eyed Cleopatra, appearing on reels 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6. It isn’t worth anything on its own. Instead, it substitutes for all symbols except the scatter.Gems of Egypt Connecta Ways: FeaturesGems of Egpyt - free spinsAs well as the scatter symbol triggering free spins, players get Dynamic Reels jazzing up a session. Dynamic Reels are active on every single spin, where each reel grows or shrinks to a different height. Each reel will always be 1 symbol bigger or smaller than the reel on the left.As you can see from the screenshot, reels all have different maximum heights ranging from 2 to 10 – from left to right. In many ways, Dynamic Reels is similar to what WMS did with the shifting curtain feature in Spartacus Megaways. Except, on a smaller scale and less annoying during the bonus game.The bonus game in Gems of Egypt is a round of free spins triggered when 3 or more scarab scatter symbols are in view. As well as 8 free spins, players get a payout of 5x, 20x, 75x, or 100x when 3, 4, 5, or 6 scarabs land.Not much changes during free spins except wilds are stacked on reels 2 to 6. Also, free spins can be won again during the bonus game. The final point is that free spins may be randomly awarded on any paid spin without the need for scatters.Gems of Egypt Connecta Ways: VerdictThis is the first time Boomerang has taken on the venerable Egyptian theme and have brought a measure of originality to it. Gems of Egypt might not be to everyone’s taste, but kudos for not going straight to Book of Ra for inspiration. Egypt fans looking for something with a touch of originality in the scorching sands might be up for a spin. Other than that, Gems of Egypt isn’t a must-see, despite the new Dynamic Reels feature.Dynamic Reels does provide some suspense, changing on every spin as they do. However, they are often more frustrating because of what they deny than exciting by what they reveal. At least you aren’t teased by what’s going on underneath the reel covers which happens in some games.Occasionally they’ll open the board, lighting up a decent hit when the extra win ways and symbols are accessible. More often than not, you’ll have to wait for free spins for that to happen - helped by a stack of Cleopatra wilds. Free spins are where you’ll also have the chance of hitting the games full potential of 4,818 times the stake. Another positive is the reasonable frequency of free spins.All up, Gems of Egypt kind of ends up missing more than it hits. Still, Boomerang has made something different for the crowded Egyptian slot genre, so it’s hard to knock them too hard for that.

title: Bounty Belles
structured_summary: Bounty Belles is a Wild West-themed slot featuring three female cowgirls, offering a fresh take on the classic Western stereotype. Key features include Wild Bounties with expanding reels, Most Wanted Bounties jackpots, free spins, and a Deadman’s Draw multiplier. The reviewer praises its unique all-female cast and solid gameplay but notes it may appeal mainly to fans of the theme rather than general players. The game sports cartoonish visuals and a fitting Western soundtrack that enhances the immersive atmosphere.
review: Bounty Belles: Slot OverviewWhen you picture the Wild West, one of the first things that springs to mind is a weather-beaten cowboy bobbing into town on his trusty steed, ready to shoot up anyone who accidentally spills moonshine on his boots at the saloon. Developer iSoftBet turns this stereotype on its head in their slot Bounty Belles which stars not one lady cowgirl, but three, alongside features such as Wild Bounties, Most Wanted Bounties, free spins and multipliers.While the leading ladies might be somewhat original, the game’s setting is pretty standard. Here we find a 5-reel, 243 win way grid out in the desert, a setting sun casting purple rays over a saloon surrounded by canyons and cactuses. Due to the isolation and subject matter, there is a sort of Salinas, East of Eden thing going on, though nothing as untoward happens here as it does in the Steinbeck novel. Accompanying the stock imagery is a typical Western soundtrack plinking away in the background. Despite being a tad generic, the audio-visuals manage to imbue a satisfying Western atmosphere, making sinking into the game to see what happens next an enjoyable prospect.Bounty Belles is playable on any device, offering the usual range of iSoftBet stakes from 20 p/c to $/€20 per spin. The game may look a little cartoonish at first, but its math model runs on a high volatility, capable of producing sizeable wins. Hits are frequent too, coming at a rate of roughly 1 in 3 spins, or 32.61% to be exact. The all-important RTP is 95.99%, so all in all, Bounty Belles is pretty dependable from a mathematical standpoint.As mentioned above, the game starts by providing 243 ways to win, though this figure is increased when certain features kick in, up to a maximum of 1,125. Wins are formed of three or more matching symbols left to right from the first reel, regardless of row height. The symbols themselves consist of 10-A card royals in a standard Western font, followed by Stetsons, horseshoes, bags of cash, a safe, and crossed revolvers. As to values, five premiums of a kind are worth payouts of 3.75 to 10 times your stake. Last, is a sheriff badge wild, replacing any symbol in a winning combination, except the bonus symbol. It also plays a pivotal role in one of the features covered next.Bounty Belles: Slot FeaturesBounty Belles - free spinsWild symbols appearing on reels 1 and 2, start Wild Bounty Mode. Here, reels 3 to 5 can expand by up to 2 rows. Landing bounty symbols (the three character symbols) on reels 3, 4 or 5 during Bounty Mode awards whatever prizes they display. This could be cash values of 2x to 8x the bet, or, Minor, Major or Grand Jackpots worth 30x, 50x, or 100x the stake. These last three only appear on the fifth reel.Bounty Belles might not be a game you play for big jackpots, though things can turn out positively during free spins. These are triggered when 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols land to award 10, 12, or 15 free spins. Wild Bounty Mode may activate on any free spin, and the round can be retriggered once.One more extra has the chance of showing up in free spins - the Deadman’s Draw. At random, a bunch of cards are dealt, then shot until there is one left standing. Whatever multiplier this card carries is applied to the next winning spin.Bounty Belles: Slot VerdictIt’s nice to see iSoftBet, in a rare and bold move, go all Ocean’s 8 and cast an all-female line-up. You don’t see that every day in a Western slot. You might find one token female on the paytable, yet rarely is there an all-star cast of lady gunslingers. Good on iSoftBet for addressing the gender imbalance. They should also be commended for not making them busty wenches popping cleavage all over the place which is not uncommon in a female-led game. Obviously, it makes no difference to the gameplay, but the reversal is a pretty woke move on their part. It might have been even better if the three lassies had been paired with a massive game that tore shreds out of some players while rewarding the chaps off others. Ah well, gender parity happens in stages.In its favour, Bounty Belles is a well-made slot. It looks nice, transitions to free spins are cool, the commentary adds an extra feminine touch, plus its country soundtrack is the right fit. It all makes Bounty Belles come across as a solid Western slot, though one that’s not exactly unmissable for players not besotted with the theme. Other than the three female leads, there isn’t much overly new to check out, aside from perhaps the expanding reels during Wild Bounty Mode, or Deadman’s Draw. Landing a Grand jackpot symbol, or two, does provoke an adrenaline spike, yet they don’t tend to be worth masses of coins - definitely not as much as the exciting soundtrack accompanying them in free spins might suggest. Seriously, it’s like someone pointed shooters at the band and told them to pick up the pace. At best, potential maxes out at 10,877 times the stake.To sum up, Bounty Belles was an enjoyable game to test run, with several things of note. It did come across as a little light yet provided fun, laid back cowgirl gaming all the same. It’ll help if players are really into the theme, or girl power perhaps, but Bounty Belles stops short of being a huge Western-themed slot that general players will be lining up to crack.

title: Wild Bandolier
structured_summary:
Wild Bandolier is a Wild West-themed slot set in a dusty frontier town, inspired by classic Western imagery.  
Features include Wild Bullets randomly added on reels, free spins with guaranteed wilds and multipliers, and a Bandit-triggered bonus round.  
The reviewer finds the game competent but lacking originality, with modest winning potential and familiar mechanics.  
The slot offers solid Western-themed visuals and sound effects, though overall it feels somewhat generic and uninspired.
review: Wild Bandolier: Slot OverviewWild Bandolier is a Wild West slot from software developer Play'n GO that had us busting out the online dictionary to find out exactly what a 'bandolier' was. Apparently, it is one of those belts which is worn over the shoulder, across the chest, holding a bunch of bullets. Think of something like Red Dead Redemption 2, for example. It seems that badasses who need a real shedload of bullets wear two of them slung over each shoulder in an 'X' formation. In other words, Wild Bandolier's name has the ability to conjure up some pretty strong imagery before even getting properly into the game. Can it follow through?The setting for Wild Bandolier is a typical centre of a town in the middle of nowhere circa the 19th-century type location. You might have thought slot makers have visited every town on the frontier by now. But anyways, in the middle of the street, it is, with rows of buildings on either side of the game grid, while free spins are held inside a dusty saloon instead. It's the Wild West alright, and Play'n GO has made a nice looking, not to mention nice sounding example of this sort of slot if a tad generic by some measures.Wild Bandolier slot - base gamePlayers load up ammunition of their own by picking a wager of 10 p/c to $/€50 per spin; the lower than usual upper limit is perhaps a reflection of the odds of hitting Wild Bandolier's modest max win. It's a medium volatile slot, and while RTP wasn't available at the time of writing, this being a Play'n GO game, players can expect an upper value of 96%+, with several lesser returns possible in various other markets. Playable on any device, the action is displayed on a 5-reel, 3-row gaming grid.Along the board, 20 fixed paylines have been embedded for landing winning combinations of 3 to 5 of a kind across. As for the pay symbols, the lower value lot are 10-A card ranks, awarding 2 to 5 times the bet for 5 of a kind, then a boot, glass and bottle, a pistol, and two characters are the high paying symbols. Landing a 5 OAK premium winning line pays 8 to 25 times the stake. Wild Bullets are critical to much of Wild Bandolier's biggest thrills, and they may be seen on all reels. Wilds substitute for all symbols except the scatter and pay 100 times the bet for a line of 5 of them.Wild Bandolier: Slot FeaturesWild Bandolier slot - Wild Bullet featureWild Bandolier keeps things pretty simple extras-wise, packing a Wild Bullet feature, free spins with a win multiplier plus guaranteed wilds, and the Bandit Free Spin Trigger.Wild Bullet FeatureOn any spin, up to 6 Wild Bullets may be fired onto the reels in random positions. This feature may trigger in the base game and free spins.Free SpinsLanding 3 scatter symbols triggers the bonus round, where players are awarded 10 free spins. Before they begin, three wanted posters appear on the screen, and players pick one. This reveals how many Bullet Wilds are guaranteed to land in the free spins round – 10, 25, or 40. As well as the guaranteed Wild Bullets, free spins also benefit from a win multiplier. On each spin, a multiplier value of up to x5 is applied to any win. To wrap up, the last thing to be aware of is the Bandit Free Spin Trigger. On any spin, The Bandit may appear to trigger the free spins round.Wild Bandolier slot - free spinsWild Bandolier: Slot VerdictOne of the most original things about Wild Bandolier was its name. It's not every day you come across the word 'bandolier' in connection with an online slot or in connection with anything really. From the intriguing name, however, there was a steep drop off in creativity. Don't want to be mean or anything, but if the slot-making equivalent of ChatGPT existed, this is sort of what you might expect it to manufacture. Whilst Wild Bandolier is a competent game in some ways – the artwork and sound effects are pretty much on par, if not slightly above, it's got wilds and free spins, yet there remains a paucity of major creativity. It felt like AI scraping what's out there in the Western slot category, picking a few generic things and ramming them into a game.Possible plus points were the way free spins seemed to trigger relatively often-ish for a Play'n GO game, and to be fair, the guaranteed Buller Wilds could cook up decent results during the bonus round. In the grander scheme of things, Wild Bandolier will never go supersonic, though, due to maximum winning potential of 2,000x the bet. Therefore, it might not be the sort of Western slot players looking for legendary heroics will be drawn to.Play'n GO has immense experience designing slots and has gone and made some of the most popular on the market. The team clearly possess bags of talent, making Wild Bandolier even more disappointing than it might have been had it come from a less well-established studio. There are plenty of bullets being fired around, the atmosphere is solidly Western, and free spins elicited the odd reluctant smile despite ourselves. review: Coin Bash: Slot OverviewDesigned exclusively for Microgaming, Coin Bash from Stockholm based developer Snowborn Games is all about taking your hammer to a piggy bank for the chance of letting a few coins flow. As well as the Gameburger hit, Just For The Win has fired off a few in their 'Gold' range if you are looking for the same style with bigger volatility and max win. Then, when bonus features trigger, the music dials up the funk even further, like accidentally ending up at an underground bar in New York City, the kind you don't find in the guide books. Visually there's not a lot going on, but thanks to the bouncy audio, Coin Bash scores a bit higher on the entertainment meter, making it easier to go along with everything else it has to offer.As to Coin Bash's gameplay, there's not much setting it apart from others doing the same thing. It's basically a case of enjoying the high hit rate while waiting for as many scatters to hit as possible. Coin Bash maxes out at 5,000 times the stake via max scatter wins, though consolation prizes are possible during free spins when multipliers are active. Coin Spins are about the only minor novelty regarding features. Despite not being much of an innovation they do add tension as scatters are added to the reels and you know you are going to collect something.Though Coin Bash does the same thing as several others of this type do, it's still a fun option for players who enjoy this style of gambling. The top prize isn't bad, and it doesn't take itself too seriously, adding up to a game that's easy to have a bit of a laugh with.

title: Dwarf Mine

review: Dwarf Mine (Yggdrasil): ReviewWhat's the thing with dwarfs and mines? title: Cornelius
structured_summary: Cornelius is a cat-themed slot set in a charming cartoon kitchen, featuring a playful feline protagonist. review: ﻿Cornelius: Slot OverviewCats are notoriously picky eaters, and one moggy with certain wants is Cornelius, a four-legged 'treat freak' who stars in his very own casino game. Cornelius is an online slot from Evolution owned software developer NetEnt about a kitty with 'eyes wide open to big prizes', who's all about 'filling his food bowl with goodies.' What that means for players tempted to try their luck alongside a charismatic cat is a slot with Cash Drops, free spins, and a Buy feature. Cats are known for their personalities, so let's find out if Cornelius is the kind that will curl up on your lap or tear your legs to shreds for the lols.Cornelius, the slot, is set in a classic cartoon kitchen setting with a refrigerator, a sink, and chequered flooring all in the picture. Allusions to Garfield are hard to avoid, but Cornelius is largely his own cat, and he spends much of the time next to the game grid, like a feline Gonzo, sniffing food, donning meme sunglasses, and just generally being one of those adorable kitties people can't help but fall for – including his enemies, if he has any. Mice maybe.Cornelius slot - base gameNetEnt's been around the block a few times, and part of the reason for its success has to be its ability to cater to a wide range of player types. Cornelius is largely an open book – what you see is what you get. This isn't some cutey slot that belies a spiteful math model and brutal mechanics. Quite the opposite, in fact. Exhibit A is the low volatile math model and low max payout value coming in at the rather sad number of 1051 times your stake. The default RTP sits around average on 96.04%, though it can be found lower depending on the market. Playable on a tablet, mobile, or desktop device, Cornelius accepts bets of 20 p/c to $/€400 per paid game round.The active gaming area here consists of 5-reels, 4-rows and provides 1,024 ways to win. Regular wins happen when at least three identical symbols land on adjacent reels, starting from the first reel onwards. For the lows, we get 10-A thready card royals, while the highs are fish-shaped toys, tins of food, milk bottles, and pictures of Cornelius the cat.Cornelius: Slot FeaturesCornelius slot - free spinsAs you may have deduced, wild symbols do not appear in the game, but there are a few features to go over. These are the Cash Drop, free spins, and a bonus buy.Cash DropGetting at least 3 Cash Drop symbols in view activates the Cash Drop feature. From the base game, Cash Drop symbols have values of 0.25 to 3 times the bet. Once underway, 3 respins are awarded, and each new Cash Drop symbol that lands reset the count to 3. On each spin, Cash Drop symbols move down one row, and their prize values are collected in Cornelius' bowl after each spin.Free SpinsLanding 3 or more scatter symbols anywhere on the grid triggers free spins. A total of 3 spins are awarded, and whenever a new symbol lands, the counter is reset. The symbols which may appear in free spins are:Cash Drop Symbol – display values of 0.1-0.5x the bet.Up – this moves all of the Multiplier symbols and Cash Drop symbols up one row, keeping them on the reels a bit longer.Golden Up – moves all of the Cash Drop symbols and Multiplier symbols to the highest empty cell possible on the row.Adder – displays a value of 0.1x to 0.3x, which is added to all Cash Drop symbols in view. These symbols remain on the reels until free spins end, so Cash Drop symbols jump them when moving up or down the reels.Multiplier – multiplies all Cash Drop symbols and Adder symbols in view by x2.Like the Cash Drop feature, Cash Drop symbols fall down a position on each spin, adding their values to Cornelius' bowl as they do so.Bonus BuyIf you want to cut straight to free spins, it may be possible to buy your way to them. The cost for buying the free spins feature is 100 times the stake.Cornelius slot - free spinsCornelius: Slot VerdictWhen it comes to picking a pet, the choices are as varied as potential owners' preferences. Some want a strapping great Doberman to keep unwanted visitors off the property, while others prefer snuggling up to a playful ball of fluff. After reading the review, it'll be little wonder which definition better suits Cornelius. Yep, Cornelius is the sort of game that wants to leap up on your lap and watch rom coms with you, perhaps something with Tom Hanks in it or reruns of Thirty Something. Whatever, it's a benign game more concerned with being cute than hugely thrilling.That being the case, if cute (or childish) is what you're after, then Cornelius' gameplay has been finely balanced to match. It's never going to really blow up, but the features integrate well with the Saturday morning cartoon vibe, and Cornelius' pawprints can be found all over everything. The Cash Drop mechanic is catchy and has the ability to pile up consecutive wins in the food bowl from the base game. Then there is free spins, which is a souped-up version of the Cash Drop, with the added benefit of a collection of booster symbols. It's never going to take off, though, not really, and the most a lucky punter is likely to win is, sorry to say, a paltry 1,051x the bet. This was the max achieved in 50 million spins for a clearer idea of the odds.It can sometimes seem like studios are locked in a battle to produce the biggest, meanest, most ruthless slot on the planet. Amidst this arms race, Cornelius might come across as something of a quaint anomaly. Roughriders might not want to touch Cornelius with a ten-foot barge pole, but for those in the mood for a charming game they can metaphorically nestle on the couch with, Cornelius could well be it.

review: Master of Atlantis (Blueprint Gaming): ReviewCancelledMaster of Atlantis is something as unusual as a non-Megaways slot from Blueprint Gaming. title: Lilith's Inferno

review: Lilith's Inferno (Yggdrasil Gaming): OverviewIf you are a player who has ever dreamed of descending into the inferno and battling baddies, then your wish has been granted by Avatar UX Studios. Or does it all sounds a bit too niche? Never fear, Lilith's Inferno has the goods to entertain a wide variety of players.Our hero Lilith is actually kind of cute. Collect 3, and you receive 4 additional free spins and a 3x multiplier for the rest of the round. Collect less than 3, and they turn into random wilds on the final spin.Lilith's Inferno (Yggdrasil Gaming): VerdictIt is clear with so much going on during the bonus rounds, with so many avenues for winning why the base game feels like a hard slog at times. Players who like an all or nothing, high volatile approach will enjoy Lilith's Inferno. Those who prefer smaller, ongoing wins might struggle. And it has the ability do so for a good long while with up to 50 free spins up for grabs.Combining slots with video game-style action isn't completely new, but it isn't exactly common either. Battling during free spins is by far the main event and is a major reason to give Lilith’s Inferno a spin if you are curious. It might feel like an odyssey by the time they launch, but that only makes them all the more desirable. Lilith's Inferno might not be the best slot we've seen, but there it's a decent game nonetheless. It combines good graphics and animations, with an good top prize. title: The Alter Ego

As stated, reading it is not a requirement, though, and gamblers who like their slots hard and volatile should be able to find all of that crammed within the confines of The Alter Ego.The Alter Ego is a slot that lived up to its name, too. It's a round where you want to land as many red serum scatter symbols as possible. A spin count of 3 does not provide a wide margin of error, and scatters help keep the bonus alive longer, regularly amounting to 20+ spins in the review, as an indicator. The longer, the better, too, in order to have time to build the grid into 5 towering stacks of 10 symbols each in the dream scenario, thereby opening up the full 100,000 ways to win, in a similar fashion to the Extending Reels feature in Big Time Gaming's iconic White Rabbit slot. title: Mystic Panther Treasures of the Wild

review: Mystic Panther Treasures of the Wild: Slot OverviewMystic Panther Treasures of the Wild is an online slot from a software provider called Infinity Dragon Studios, working in association with Microgaming. Infinity Dragon is a relatively new studio with a limited number of releases to date. Aside from having a pretty cool logo of a dragon coiled in the shape of an infinity symbol, there's scant information online about the studio. As such, we went into Mystic Panther unsure of quite what to expect. What we found, though, was a run of the mill game, packing free spins with full reel wilds and a standard Link&Win feature.The background picture is kind of nice; let's give Mystic Panther that. The game is situated in a murky, jungle location, its foreboding visuals clashing sharply with the incredibly upbeat music. It might've been interesting if the studio had built on the dank background and created something uniquely heavy. But that's not Mystic Panther's MO, where feeling chipper appears to be the core goal. This is achieved by the aforementioned upbeat music, bright symbols, and a selection of classic slot wild animals. To sum up, Mystic Panther has a Mega Moolah in the jingle vibe, without the tremendous progressive attached.Turning to the numbers side of the game, Mystic Panther stacks up quite well. Be aware there is a trio of RTP configurations, and the highest value is 96.52%. All are highly volatile while firing off wins at a rate of 30.33%, or 1 in 3 spins more or less. Playable from 20 p/c to $/€20 per spin, Mystic Panther is available to play on desktop computers as well as handheld devices.Mystic Panther is played on a 6-reel, 3-row game grid, which provides 729 ways to win. This happens when at least two of the top premium or three of any other symbol type lands on adjacent reels, starting from the left-hand side. For the lows, we get 10-A card ranks, paying out 1.25 to 4 times the stake for six of a kind, whereas six high-value meerkats, zebras, elephants, or the indigenous lady symbol pay 5x to 10x the bet. Where the panther comes into play is as the wild symbol. Panther wilds appear on reels 2, 3, 4, or 5 and substitute for all symbols except free spins or Link&Win symbols.Mystic Panther Treasures of the Wild: Slot FeaturesIt's all about the two bonus games in Mystic Panther – free spins and the Link&Win since there are no extras to be had in its main game.Free SpinsWhen 3 gold mask scatters land on reels 1, 3 and 5, 10 free spins are awarded, plus a cash prize worth 1 times the bet. During free spins, there is a random chance full reels become wild. That's pretty much the only selling point of the bonus. On the last note, players are able to retrigger the round as well by landing 3 scatters.Hold&WinLanding at least 6 Link&Win symbols triggers the Link&Win bonus game. The triggering symbols are held in place at the start of the feature, and 3 respins are awarded. If new Link&Win symbols hit, they lock in place too, and respins are set back to 3. When each position is filled or respins go to zero, the feature ends, and the symbols in view are awarded. Link&Win symbols display a value of 1-5x the bet, or the Mini, Minor, or Major bonus prize, worth 10x, 25x, or 500x the bet, respectively. If 18 Link&Win symbols land, the Grand prize of 5,000x the bet is awarded.Mystic Panther Treasures of the Wild: Slot VerdictWhether you're a big hold-and-win fan or not, it's unlikely Mystic Panther has much you haven't seen before. Initially, one point of interest was the use of a 6-reel, 729 ways to win game panel. A few spins later and the lack of creativity was apparent, quickly shrivelling enthusiasm. From the vanilla base game to a couple of standard bonus rounds, this is a slot that blends a common theme with equally common features.As mentioned above, the background imagery isn't so bad. If Infinity Dragon had kept pushing in an original direction with it, they might have ended up somewhere a lot more interesting. Just thinking out loud here, but imagine something like Mental, in a jungle full of dangerous beasts and savage inhabitants. Too outside the box? Clearly so for Infinity Dragon, which has clung to conventionality like a baby sloth to its mum. If players do like the look and basic features, then Mystic Panther can deliver rewards, it should be said. As well as the 5,000x Grand prize, potential as a whole can reach 14,000x the bet (though it's hard to see how it would be achievable). If big numbers trump innovation, then maybe Mystic Panther might be okey-dokey.Mystic Panther started on the back foot after we quickly clocked there wasn't a whole lot of mysticism going on, and it floundered in mediocrity from there. The main issue is pretty much everything here has been seen before, and in most cases, there are more interesting counterparts elsewhere. It's not just the big things, but the smaller details as well. For example, the screen barely bothers to change when the Hold&Win feature triggers. Lack of imagination like this means the game's numbers might be solid, yet there's more to a good game than a decent win figure, and Mystic Panther is lacking in that regard.

title: Bee Hive Bonanza
structured_summary: Bee Hive Bonanza is a bee-themed slot set in a medieval flower meadow with bees as jesters and kings. It features Avalanches, a Money Bee instant cash win mechanic, and free spins with a progressive multiplier meter. review: ﻿Bee Hive Bonanza: Slot OverviewYou know, the more you delve into the world of bees, the easier it is to fall for those busy, furry little guys. For instance, bees are the only insects that make food for humans, and to produce one pound of honey, a bee colony has to collect nectar from around 2 million flowers, flying over 88,000 km in the process. This flurry of activity equates to the lifetimes' work of roughly 800 bees. Perhaps not quite so busy but potentially lucrative are the bees in developer NetEnt's online slot Bee Hive Bonanza which is a scatter paying slot with Avalanches, a Money Bee instant cash win feature and free spins with a progressive multiplier meter.Bees might be willing to sting humans when they feel threatened, but in online slots, they're pretty darn cute. They also tend to appear in bright, inviting games, much like the one NetEnt has made here, which is set on a flower-blanketed meadow in a gorgeous mountainous region. The game has a Medieval bent, with castle references, and where bees appear in roles such as jesters or kings. In all, Bee Hive Bonanza presents a pleasant idyll, with a strong Sound of Music with bees vibe - until you reach the bonus, then things go bonkers.Bee Hive Bonanza slot - base gameBees are industrious creatures, and Bee Hive Bonanza gets to work, too, running on a highly volatile math model, producing a theoretical return value of 96.09%, though this figure can be lower depending on the market. Bee Hive Bonanza can be played on a tablet, mobile, or desktop device and takes bets of 10 p/c to $/€200 per spin. The action itself occurs on a 5x5 game board, creating payouts when at least 6 instances of the same pay symbol type are in view anywhere on the grid.The pay symbols consist of 7 variously shaped and coloured tokens, which can be a little difficult to gauge at first. There are four low win symbols, paying 0.2-0.3x the bet for six of a kind, rising to 5-6x the bet for 22-24 in view, while the remaining three high win symbols pay 0.4x for six of a kind or 7-8x the bet when 22-24 of a kind hit. As is often the case in a scatter pay slot, Bee Hive Bonanza does not have a wild symbol.Bee Hive Bonanza: Slot FeaturesBee Hive Bonanza slot - base gameIn terms of features, Bee Hive Bonanza comes with several interplaying extras such as Avalanches, Money Bee cash collects, and free spins with a progressive multiplier.AvalanchesAll pay symbols in a scatter win - plus Bee symbols in the Money Bee extra, and scatter symbols collected by the meter in free spins - are removed by the Avalanche feature when they hit. Symbols drop down to fill the gaps, which can produce new wins, Bee symbols or scatters.Money Bee FeatureOn base game spins or free spins, Bee symbols possessing values of 1, 2, 5, or 10 times the stake may randomly appear on the grid. Their values are collected by each Beehive, Adder Beehive, or Multiplier Beehive symbol in view at the same time. Bee symbols vanish after their values have been collected. Collector symbols behave like so:Beehive – collects the face value of all Bee symbols in view.Multiplier Beehive – multiplies the values of all Bee symbols by x2 before they are added to the Beehive, Multiplier Beehive, of Adder Beehives on the grid.Adder Beehive – increases the values of all Bee symbols in view by the bet value before they are collected by the Beehive, Multiplier Beehive, of Adder Beehives on the grid.Free SpinsLanding 3, 4, or 5 Honey Pot scatter symbols in the main game triggers 10, 15, or 20 free spins, respectively. The Money Bee feature is active throughout the free spins bonus round. In addition, whenever a scatter symbol lands, it is collected on the meter next to the reels. Collecting 3, 6, 9, or 12 scatters creates a multiplier of x2, x3, x4, or x5, respectively. Also, reaching a new multiplier level adds +2 free spins to the total.Buy FeatureIf available, players can buy the free spins feature. The cost is 100x the bet to randomly activate 10, 15, or 20 free spins.Bee Hive Bonanza - free spinsBee Hive Bonanza: Slot VerdictWhat is it about bees that makes people warm to them so much? Is it their cutely industrious nature, snuffling about flowers, collecting pollen with their little bee hands, most partially covered in fur? Or is it simply the utilitarian fact we get honey from them? Maybe it's a mixture of all of these things which have created this unique relationship between people and insect. We definitely don't see many beetles, flies, or termites in online slots, even though they have important roles to play in the biosphere. Cockroaches did star in Folsom Prison, but that was made by Nolimit City, and you know, they're on a different tangent.Back to bees, and NetEnt has expertly incorporated them in Bee Hive Bonanza to create a neatly playable game. Scatter pay slots tend to be the domain of Pragmatic Play and their Sweet Bonanza-style games, but Bee Hive Bonanza gives them a run for the money. It does this in several ways. For one, Avalanche runs can be lengthy indeed. On a good roll, it's not so much scatter wins that are the star. Instead, it's possible to hit solid sequences of repeat Bee symbol cash collects, and while the multiplier values might not seem high (x2 from the Multiplier Beehive and x5 max from the scatter collect meter), they can work well together to build decent wins. In a similar spirit to Relax Gaming's Cluster Tumble, Bee Hive Bonanza's repeat win/Avalanche triggers could be surprisingly lengthy. Collect a bunch of pollen, and you're looking at a maximum win of 5,000x the bet.The NetEnt hive has teamed up to produce a well-designed scatter paying slot alternative, with a nice interaction of Avalanches, cash prize collects with adders or multipliers, and free spins. It might not happen every time, but when Bee Hive Bonanza comes together just so, the consecutive wins and cash collects flow like warm honey over toast.

title: Gates of Olympus
structured_summary:
1. Gates of Olympus is an Ancient Greek mythology-themed slot featuring Zeus and the gods at Olympus.  
2. It offers a unique pay-anywhere system, cascading wins, multipliers up to 500x, free spins with a global multiplier, and an Ante Bet option.  
3. The reviewer finds it a more grounded, volatile evolution of Sweet Bonanza with realistic win potential and engaging gameplay.  
4. The game combines a serious mythological atmosphere with striking visuals of Olympus and electrifying audio effects enhancing the experience.
review: Gates of Olympus: Slot OverviewImagine making it to the Gates of Olympus only to find one ticked off looking Zeus with glowing blue eyes, ready to rain lightning bolts down on your head. The Ancient Greek gods were famously fickle, many saying they were more or less human-like, just blessed with the power to do whatever they wanted. Mortals had to keep their heads down, provide enough deference and hope they didn't catch the gods on one of their off days. However, after reading the classics, it can seem even sacrificing the right number of bulls was no guarantee of not being turned into a linden tree.Games of Olympus - base gameMoving on, and there is no doubt many players might claim you can find this fickle spirit when it comes to gambling, running hot one moment, cold the other. If so, then Ancient Greek themed slots are doubly apt. That leads us to Gates of Olympus from increasingly busy developer Pragmatic Play. It might use a common theme, but the studio has used it to reintroduce a rather unusual pay-anywhere system. We're used to pay-all-ways, yet rarely are regular symbols essentially scatters, paying from any position – providing the right number are in view. Combining this function with cascades, and multipliers (should Zeus be in a giving mood) means all sorts of mayhem is possible.Olympus and the Greek gods don't automatically bring to mind thoughts of candy, but they might after learning this is a follow-up, of sorts, to Sweet Bonanza, which was a hit for the studio on account of its (supposedly) huge potential, crackable via some epic multipliers. All of this returns for Gates of Olympus as well as several changes, both large and small.The action occurs on a 6-reel, 5-row grid located in Olympus, where Zeus stands off to the side, ready to strike at any moment. This is a far cry from Sweet Bonanza, and the whole experience feels magnitudes heavier than staring at a swirling pink candy land. The default RTP is roughly the same on 96.50%, while volatility has been boosted and thus getting the full 5 out of 5 rating from Pragmatic Play. Unusually, potential has gone in the opposite direction, taking a huge hit, down from 21,100x to a mere 5,000x. This, however, could be a sign that the criticism voiced in regard to their sometimes over-exaggerated advertised potential has reached Pragmatic and thus adjusted the numbers to correlate better with what is actually realistically achievable.Playable from 20 p/c to $/€125 per spin on any device, you win in Gate of Olympus when 8 or more matching symbols land anywhere on the grid. Winning symbols are removed from the board to allow new and existing ones cascade down to fill in the blank positions, possibly leading to new wins. As usual, the cascade systems trundles on until no new winning batches of symbols appear. There are nine regular pays to knock together wins with - five are gems of various colours, the rest are cups, rings, egg timers, and crowns. As to values, should you manage to land 12 or more of the four higher value picture symbols, you will pick up a win of 12 to 50 times your bet. As you'd imagine with this type of pay system, there is no wild symbol, that'd be mental.Gates of Olympus: Slot FeaturesWhen multiplier symbols land, they display a random value of 2x to 500x. If a multiplier is present, then its value is applied to the total win at the end of a cascade sequence. If there is more than one multiplier, their values are added together before being applied.Landing 4, 5, or 6 scatters at once is worth of payout of 3, 5, or 100 times the bet, and awards 15 free spins. If a free spin produces a win, any visible multiplier symbols have their values added to a global multiplier. This multiplier does not reset; it can only remain the same or rise throughout the round. The round can be extended as well as 5 additional free spins are awarded when 3 scatters hit – without limitation.Gates of Olympus is another Pragmatic Play slot to offer the Ante Bet. Engaging this increases the stake cost by 25%, and adds extra scatters to the reels, doubling your chance of triggering free spins. In some cases, a bonus buy option may be available for the cost of 100x the bet.Gates of Olympus: Slot VerdictIn a plot twist, Pragmatic Play might have moved the action to the heavens, but Gates of Olympus comes across as more grounded than Sweet Bonanza. Potential especially, feels both more representative and more achievable at the same time. Fortunately, the signature pay-anywhere feature has remained. It’s an entertaining system too, and slightly unusual it doesn’t get rolled out more often. Crazy win chains spark at times, using a lot more of the grid than usual in a regular slot. Pragmatic Play has enhanced the experience by tweaking the previous one’s features, thereby evolving Gates of Olympus into a brand new, more volatile, experience.One of Sweet Bonanza’s main highlights were its rainbow bomb multipliers which could drop from a fluffy cloud to power up a payout. However, they were only available in free spins. In Gates of Olympus, they reach near-mythical status of up to x500 which can seriously juice a regular win – in all phases of the game. Naturally, free spins are where the action comes to a head, and the way the global multiplier doesn’t reset is a great twist. Again, this is something its predecessor did not do. Regular wins are pretty decent for clusters of ten or more, so there is a major incentive for triggering free spins. It’s worth noting that despite the vastly enhanced capabilities of the multipliers here, Pragmatic has left cluster values exactly the same as before.In many ways, Gates of Olympus is a much more attractive option for hardened gamblers than the candy game. As well as being more thematically serious, volatility is up, and while the advertised top win is down, the more realistic figure actually boosts Gates of Olympus’ appeal rather than retards it.

title: Mars Attacks!
structured_summary: Mars Attacks! is a sci-fi slot themed on Tim Burton's cult classic movie featuring a Martian invasion of Earth. It offers 5 reels, 20 paylines, and multiple bonus features including free spins with expanding wilds and random base game modifiers. The reviewer finds it visually impressive with smooth gameplay, though somewhat similar to other Blueprint titles, recommending it for its entertaining features and winning potential.
