review: Slot Vegas Megaquads: OverviewInfamous gambling hotspot Sin City is the location for Big Time Gaming's quad powered game Slot Vegas. Quad, since players get to experience the new Megaquads mechanic which runs four reel sets at the same time. The result is a lot of on-screen action, yet it never gets too overwhelming. Like Star Clusters, Slot Vegas keeps a handle on all of those symbols, while producing several eye-watering stats in the process. So, Vegas is where the game is located, well, a gambling town of the past full of old wide-bodied cars parked beneath an equally wide blue sky. Glitzy motels line the boulevard, a far cry from the modern corporate monoliths tourists flock to nowadays.In more ways than one it feels like a direct continuation of the Donuts slot, or as the CEO himself put it - "as if you stopped at that donut shop just outside Reno to fill up before the final destination". There are still plenty of gaudy flashy lights in the game as well as a happy-go-lucky or, depending on your mood, super annoying soundtrack with a Bonanza-dipped-in-Vegas feel. Amongst others, you get an instrumental of "She'll Be Coming Around the Mountain", so prepare for plenty of banjo action while you spin.Playable on any device from 20 p/c to $/€20 per spin, the eye-catcher here are the four individual reel sets dominating the screen - each one 4x4 in size during the base game whilst merging together during the features. During regular play, each reel set can produce 256 win ways, but with the help of the features the game is capable of expanding this number to a mind-bending 16,777,216 ways to win.Mathematically, Big Time Gaming remains as reliable as always as they're one of few game studios left still offering their games with fixed RTP. In this particular case, RTP is a healthy 96.59% while volatility is as high as they come. There can be lengthy waits between free spins, yet due to the way the Symbol Multipliers work, this downtime can actually work in your favour.Taking a look at the paytable reveals 6 low pay royals and 4 high pays. The high pays consist of green, blue and red rhinestone encrusted Lucky Seven symbols topped by a big purple diamond. The four premium symbols are worth 0.3x to 1x the stake for four of a kind. When grids combine, their values increase to a possible 0.7x to 2x the stake for eight of a kind.Slot Vegas Megaquads provides two types of wilds to help pull together winners. One is the standard wild appearing on reels 2, 3, and 4 to substitute for any symbol except the scatter or the Rainbow Wild. The Rainbow Wild appears on reels 2 and 3 to substitute for anything except the scatter.Slot Vegas Megaquads: Features﻿When it comes to features, some elements have popped up in previous games, while some are fresh, providing a nice mix of familiar and new. The features list includes Symbol Multipliers, the Rainbow Wild Bonuses, and free spins.Central to the game is the Symbol Multiplier system. To the left of the reels you'll find a symbol counter. This counter keeps track of Symbol Multipliers which come into play in both the base and bonus game as well.Now, whenever you land a 4 of a kind premium symbol, the multiplier for the respective symbol is increased by x1 and does not reset. So for example, if you land 4 purple diamonds, the purple diamond counter increases from x1 to x2 and so on. During the base game, Symbol Multipliers are applied to any corresponding Diamond or Lucky Seven win.Keep an eye out for the Rainbow Wilds. If they appear on 2 reel sets side by side, then the Rainbow Wild Bonus comes into play. As well as getting a blast of 'Somewhere over the Rainbow', the two reel sets merge into one 8 reel grid before any wins are paid.Not only does this merging of the reel sets expand the paylines to 65,536 win ways, it also adds a regular wild at random to reels 4 and 5 of the expanded slot. Moreover, when Diamond or Lucky seven wins of 5, 6, 7, or 8 of a kind occur on the expanded slot, their corresponding multiplier is increased by 2, 3, 4, or 5 respectively.As strange as it may sound to some, you don't want to trigger the free spins too soon in this game which is triggered when 4 or more gold VIP token scatters land in view anywhere on the reels. Landing 4 scatters award 6 free spins while 3 extra spins are awarded for each scatter beyond four.Before the feature starts, all Symbol Multipliers are collected and added together to give you one free spins win multiplier. Once in, the round is played using two giant 4x8 sized reel sets, each providing 4,096 win ways to help you increase the hit rate.Each four of a kind Diamond or Lucky Seven win increases the win multiplier by +1. Also, if four or more scatters land in the feature, then free spins are retriggered in the same way as mentioned above.Finally, should Rainbow Wilds land on both slots at the same time, they merge before wins are calculated, creating an 8x8 grid packing a breath-taking 16,777,216 ways to win.Slot Vegas Megaquads - free spinsSlot Vegas Megaquads: VerdictBig Time Gaming has clearly paid close attention to every aspect of Slot Vegas. Each element affects the other, yet it's all rolled up into one seamless package. Unusually, Slot Vegas is a game you don't want to hit the bonus round too early on. Do so, and you miss maximising free spins with a big starting win multiplier. No one wants to get bored in a base game while waiting for the best bets to trigger though. To counteract this, the win rate is high. Few spins go by without a payout, whether that's a four symbol combo adding to the multipliers or not.Naturally, most of the time, these tokenistic wins are pretty insignificant due to the low symbol values. Yet they do combat the base game blues and keep engagement levels up. As does the multiplier collection system itself. Not exactly brand new as a similar type of collection feature has been used previously in Kingmaker, but the new Rainbow Wild feature, as well as little adrenaline hits from frequent wins, keeps the game ticking along.As you might expect from an exceedingly volatile game, Slot Vegas Megaquads can be quite capricious. During testing, the bonus game triggered early on, which meant starting free spins with a meek x4 multiplier. Then a lengthy wait for the second trigger saw a tantalising amount of symbol multipliers build up.The wait does increase anticipation for free spins, but it also kind of locks you in for the long haul too. It is hard to walk away when you have a bunch of juicy symbol multipliers hanging there. When the next bonus game did trigger, several hundred spins later, the round started on an x43 multiplier. The icing on top is that rewards are there for the lucky and the patient to the tune of 45,000 times the stake.The Megaquads game engine isn't totally ground-breaking. Still, it's easy to like, or at least appreciate what Big Time Gaming has crafted. Will Megaquads be the game changer Megaways is, or Megaclusters is shaping up to be? It seems unlikely, but there certainly are possibilities. For one, you can imagine the damage 16 million+ win ways coupled with a solid win multiplier could do.Slot Vegas oozes personality too. The flashing golden age of gambling scenery reinforces the old-Vegas vibe, while the subtle sound effects inject a level of character that was kind of missing from Star Clusters. All up, Slot Vegas is another Big Time Gaming banger with a high fun-factor, choice features, a well-oiled math model, backed by massive potential.Don't Miss...There is also a "Fully Loaded" version of this game simply titled Slot Vegas Megaquads Fully Loaded. At its core, it's the same game but utilises random multipliers on every spin.

title: Vegas Diamonds

A wheel will appear on the animation screen above the reel set that consists of three levels - Bronze, Silver and Golden Wheel with increasing win amounts. Due to the less volatile math model, and drastically less winning potential, it sits on a different ledge from Starburst XXXtreme. No bad thing, necessarily, as it gives players a chance to dabble with XXXtreme spins in a theoretically more user-friendly environment (if they're careful) than its cosmic cousin.

title: Mystic Staxx

review: Mystic Staxx: Slot OverviewAs NetEnt has acquired Red Tiger, you'd be forgiven for thinking Mystic Staxx is some sort of follow on to the Staxx range of slots. However, aside from the name, it bears no resemblance – certainly, the set-up and features are completely different. Mystic Staxx is a simple Asian-themed game that starts small and grows, provided players are willing to stick around to build the requisite columns of symbols.First impressions were positive due to a relatively tasteful design. The background, especially, is coloured in the deep crimson tones associated with Asian slots, while a dragon pattern twinkles during low moments, lighting up in a mystical way when the action increases. Next to the dragon design, gold decorations give Mystic Staxx an upmarket feel, like a high rollers room or a private booth at an expensive Chinese restaurant. Contrasting the ritz of the background image is the symbols on the 8x6 sized grid, which are theme-based but a teeny bit tacky. Slow-moving, Eastern-inspired music helps offsets that impression, and the overall effect is a pleasing one.The big grid is a bit daunting, especially since there are just 40 fixed paylines to land winners along. The hit rate did come across as quite low, and with the way players have to build the symbol stacks, this can lead to a lot of tedious gaming until later on down the track. Default RTP isn't a concern at 95.69%, and the math model has been classified as highly volatile. Potential isn't bad either, though there are question marks over how it might be achieved.Playable across tablets, smartphones and desktops, Mystic Staxx furnishes players with stakes ranging from 10 p/c to $/€20 per spin. Wins occur when three to eight identical symbols land left to right from the very first reel. In total, 11 symbols pop up in the game, a wild, a scatter, and 9 paying tiles. The first 5 pay symbols are coins on strings, while the remaining higher value symbols are increasingly intricate lanterns. Landing an eight of a kind line of lanterns triggers a payout of 10 to 20 times the stake. Combinations of wild symbols pay as well, up to 50x the bet for an eighth of a kind line. In addition, wilds substitute any symbol in Mystic Staxx, except the Expand symbol.Mystic Staxx: Slot FeaturesMystic Staxx - Fat Tile featureDespite the name, the features found in Mystic Staxx are completely different from those used in NetEnt's Staxx games, so don't be on the lookout for respins with walking symbol stacks. Mystic Staxx is less complicated than most since it has no bonus game to speak of. Instead, the goal is to land special Expand tiles, thereby growing symbols stacks on each reel.At the start of the game, symbols appear on all reels in stacks of 2 high. At random, 3x3 sized expand symbols may land anywhere on the board. When these symbols are fully in view, all symbol stacks on the reels increase by +1 symbol. Every time the Expand symbol lands, the procedure is repeated, adding 1 symbol at a time until the maximum stack size of 20 is reached. For the record, symbol stacks of the same type cannot land one right above the other on the same reel.When stacks reach 20 symbols high per reel, the Expand symbols transforms into a 3x3 size wild symbol. Like the regular sized wild, the big wild tile can land in any position to substitute for all pay symbols.Mystic Staxx: Slot VerdictThere are thrills of a sort to be found in Mystic Staxx when columns of symbols align to fire off a decent win. It is a slot you have to put in a bit of work to get the best out of, though. Don't expect too much in the beginning when symbol stacks are just 2 rows in height. However, it doesn't take an eternity to build around half a dozen or so, which is when things started to get more interesting. Real stamina is required to hit the full 20 symbol stacks, thereby triggering the large wild symbol. Players who don't mind a wait, or a highly repetitive game, might enjoy the challenge. Occasionally, decent rewards are to be had, yet Mystic Staxx isn't what you'd class a hugely profitable game.Turning to the subject of potential is where things get a bit puzzling. The help files claims wins as high as 4,473 times the stake are achievable when playing Mystic Staxx. Yet when busting out the abacus and flicking a few counters, it's hard to see how this is possible. For instance, a dream spin landing wild symbols on every grid position is worth 2,000x the bet - a decent return from a single spin, but less than half of the claimed max win. Since there is no bonus game, that appears to be as good as it gets.Perhaps players with the perseverance to sit through a significant number of spins to build 20 symbols stacks won't be overly concerned about the numerical discrepancies. The rest of the game isn't bad if you like the idea, but Mystic Staxx does get monotonous if you're not fully sold on the concept.

title: Mine & Melt

review: ﻿Mine & Melt: Slot OverviewHowdy y'all, if y'all are in the mood for cracking rocks, diggin' dirt, maybe shaking the old pan around in a river in hopes of uncovering some of the sparkling yellow stuff we like to call gold, come join the Quickspin team in the online slot Mine & Melt. Mine & Melt's soundtrack is equally in-theme, being a banjo tinkling Western-styled tune that deepens the gold rush scene. It might not be eye-poppingly striking, but Mine & Melt manages to set a mood, nicely teeing itself up for users to experience the action to come.Mine & Melt slot - base gameGetting the search on means picking a stake of 20 p/c to $/€100 per individual paid spin, though eligible players also have the choice of buying two bonus rounds. Playing the regular way comes with a maximum return to player value of 96.09%, ramping up to 96.35% when buying the bonus game or 96.59% for the super bonus game. Lower return models are available, so checking the paytable will confirm which version you've got. Volatility also varies depending on the RTP model, decreasing as the return value decreases. On the 96.09% one, Quickspin has rated the volatility as 5 out of 5.Set in the middle of Mine & Melt's idyllic location is a 4x4 gaming panel, where 16 symbols land on each spin, offering up 256 ways to win. Simply hit matching symbols across three or four consecutive reels from the left triggers a payout. Payouts amount to 0.5 to 1 times the bet for four royal symbol wins or 2.5 to 5 times the bet for four hats, lanterns, picks, or pan mids, climaxing with 15 times the bet for 4 of the high-pay gold bars.Mine & Melt: Slot FeaturesMine & Melt slot - free spinsAs you can see, Mine & Melt does not possess a regular 1x1 wild symbol, but it does have Three Lucky Swedes instead. In the base game, while the grid is spinning, reels 2-4 may randomly convert to Wild Miner symbols. Wild Miner symbols land fully stacked they land on, and not only do they substitute for all regular pay symbols, but they also have multipliers of x2 to x4 on them.Bonus Game and Super Bonus GameBonus symbols appear on all four reels. Hitting 3 of them in the base game shimmies players onto Mine & Melt's bonus game. It starts with 3 lives, displayed on the right side of the grid. The only symbols that can land in the bonus game are Collector symbols which hold a bet multiplier (starting at x2), or Smeltdown symbols.When either of the above symbols land, lives are reset to 3, the feature ending when lives run out. Any time two Collector symbols of equal value are next to each other on the grid, a random such pair is selected to be Merged, combining the values into one symbol, freeing up a position on the board. Smeltdown symbols also land with multiplier values - x2 in the bouns game, and x4 in the Super bonus game. This multiplier multiplies the values of all Collectors in view. One is the 3 bonus symbol triggered round for 60x the bet, while the second is the 4 bonus symbol round for the cost of 330x the bet.Mine & Melt: Slot VerdictIf you've played the puzzle game 2048, Mine & Melt's bonus rounds might feel familiar. 2048 is a game where you merge tiles displaying the same number value, doubling them with the goal of eventually creating a tile with the number 2048 on it. Someone at Quickspin might be a fan because Mine & Melt's bonus round felt like a mix of 2048 with good old hold 'n win gambling. Quickspin has proven it is more than capable of blowing the socks off players into these sorts of bonus rounds with Cash Truck, a juggernaut of a slot that holds its head up proud amongst the best-in-class slots like those from the Money Train franchise. Well, Money Train 3 arguably steamrolled it, though it was released later in the piece.Mine & Melt is a slot that occupies a different space on the xylophone of hold 'n win style slots. Certainly not the bottom end or anything like that. With a max win of 5,504 times the bet, Mine & Melt sits comfortably in a more middle zone. Like getting 2048 on a roll, witnessing Collectors merge into the sort of ever-larger tiles needed to reach its upper limits would no doubt be hugely satisfying as well. Mine & Melt never quite reached stratospheric levels in the review, but even lower levels could be fun, too, and while the bonus rounds are somewhat reminiscent of those in ReelPlay's Big Bucks Buffalo Gigablox/Mega Pearl Gigablox, Mine & Melt offers its own brand of entertainment.It's not a huge brand, though, so the novelty will probably wear off sooner or later. On the flip side, it never felt like we were going to war the way it can do in bigger games like the aforementioned Money Train 3. Mine & Melt was lighter and less confrontational while remaining well-equipped to amuse players looking for a fairly compelling hold 'n win type of slot.

review: Hypernova 10K Ways: Slot OverviewAussie studio ReelPlay returns to the stars to expand their Hypernova range of slots with a different ways version. At 5,662x the bet this isn't exactly a barren planetoid devoid of resources floating through the void, yet it is less than Hypernova Megaways and around a quarter of the Radial Ways one, which is unusual for a follow-up slot. Interestingly the two games offer the same bonus game and jackpots.To sum up, we weren't exactly huge fans of Hypernova Megaways, and the 10K version doesn't do enough to alter a repeat of the same opinion either. In fact, Hypernova 10K Ways is kind of superfluous to requirements since it gives nothing that the other one doesn't, making it hard to find a reason for a return voyage.

review: Gods of Olympus 3 Megaways: Slot OverviewOne cute attribute of online casino game makers is their tendency to honour the past. In a way. Each one triggers a different modifier onto the board:Hera – transforms 2-4 symbols on reels 2-4 into wilds.Apollo – transforms 2-4 symbols on reels 1-4 into a random symbol picked from reel 1.Poseidon – turns 3-4 symbols on reels 1-3 into the highest value symbol.Zeus – turns 2 symbols on reels 2-3 into multiplier wilds. In addition, the round has a win multiplier that starts at x1 and increases by +1 following tumble wins.Buy FeatureGods of Olympus 3 Megaways' buy feature menu lets players buy 6, 8, 12, or 20 free spins for 60x, 90x, 160x, or 360x the bet, respectively.Gods of Olympus 3 Megaways slot - free spinsGods of Olympus 3 Megaways: Slot VerdictThe first Gods of Olympus slot came out in the noughties, which is basically the Stone Age in technological terms, and it does look its age. Gods of Olympus 2, meanwhile, received a spruce up when it hit casinos in 2023, and here we are with the third installment, a Megaways one to boot. Now, each God is assigned a modifier, which it brings to the party when landing on the grid.All powers are linked to transformations in some way, and as always, the more you can get in view, the more transformations occur, the better the result may well be. All modifiers have their merits, so that's nice, from the wild transformations to the common symbol transformation to Zeus' multiplier wilds. As noted above, the Zeus multiplier value increases in free spins, which is handy, as is the rising win multiplier, a common add-on in a Megaways game. By the end, Gods of Olympus 3 Megaways felt like a typical Iron Dog Studio Megaways slot and is basically an offshoot/redo of Rock The Reels Megaways. As such, it's hard not to feel the studio has stagnated a bit, struggling to move forward.What's mentioned in the game info is Gods of Olympus 3 Megaways' 25,000x the bet max win, making for a hearty ending to a fairly hearty Greek God game. So, to wrap things up. Gods of Olympus 3 Megaways sits amongst a large number of similarly themed online slots, but it does enough, some may argue even more than enough, to earn the attention of enthusiasts.

No doubt that win clip inspired gamblers keen to replicate the success, and Print Studios will likely be hoping to replicate the success it found with Pine of Plinko, as well. The Plinko Bonus round is back, the cuteness factor, too, as are one or two adjustments to how the game functions.After a first look at Pine of Plinko 2, there was a guess we were heading into an Xmas clone of the original. Triggers for this were the abundance of snow and the slightly muzak in a department store at Christmas time vibed soundtrack. But no, after a few spins and bonus rounds, Pine of Plinko 2 is not so much a Christmas slot as much as one which simply takes place at winter time with snow blanketing a cute wee village up in the trees. The charming atmosphere of the original, as if everyone lives in a cuckoo clock, is back, as strong as ever.Pine of Plinko 2 slot - base gamePine of Plinko 2's base game and bonus round could hardly be more different from each other. In the base game, the highly volatile gaming occurs on a 5-reel, 3-row action area in combination with 10 paylines provided for evaluating wins along. The bonus round removes the game grid altogether and drops balls into a Plinko machine - as you will see. Bets of 10 c to $/€50 per spin may be selected, and by switching the Scatter Boost on, players get more scatters on the reels, though the bet doubles when activated. Alternatively, the bonus can be bought for 92x the base bet. This means the regular RTP is 96.32%-96.49%, when the Scatter Boost is on, it's 96.42-96.53%, and when buying free spins, it comes out as 96.5%-96.56%.A relatively low number of paylines is compensated for by relatively high symbol values. Not so much the low pays called green, yellow, and purple, which pay 2-3x the bet for a 5 OAK win but hit a line of 5 Waleys, Coneys, Kinglys, or Pineys, and the payouts are 10x to 200x the bet. Interestingly, no wild symbol is provided to help link winning lines.Pine of Plinko 2: Slot FeaturesPine of Plinko 2 slot - scatter re-roll featureLanding 3 or more scatters triggers the Plinko Bonus. Each scatter displays a number, and when added up, the total represents the number of starting ball drops in the Plinko Bonus. However, if you are not happy with the number on any of the scatters, it is possible to re-roll them for the cost displayed on the individual scatter. Re-rolling is disabled if the number is too high.Pine of Plinko 2: Plinko BonusThe player's job in the bonus round is to release balls into a gaming area by clicking the Drop Button. Balls fall down into 15 gaps at the bottom, awarding a corresponding prize value. Each ball pays up to 1,000x. As balls hit the bumpers in the middle of the area, a meter is gradually filled. Completely filling the meter activates the bonus round's next stage. Not filling the meter means the round ends when the Drops at the current stage have been used. Each new stage awards 10 drops and doubles the amount of balls per click up to 256.Pine of Plinko 2: Bumper Buckets & Golden Ball PocketsBumper Buckets may activate randomly at the start of any stage. Balls hitting the Bumper Buckets bounce back up onto the gaming board. Golden Ball Pockets may also activate randomly at the start of any stage. Landing a ball in a Golden Bucket triggers a Golden Ball Drop at the end of the current stage with the chance of winning up to 10,000x. One ball is dropped where more lucrative prizes are available, though bumpers are removed. When the Golden Drop concludes, the Plinko Bonus resumes.Pine of Plinko 2 slot - Plinko bonusPine of Plinko 2: Slot VerdictThe original Pine of Plinko slot was one of those games that swept in like a gasp of fresh air on a dusty, smoggy day. The sheer joy of watching masses of balls bounce down a Plinko board, landing in prize gaps, hitting bumpers, filling the meter until a little dude levelled the round up by smacking something with his hammer. When levelling up, the huge number of balls raining down the board could produce smile-inducing giddiness. The presentation was outstanding, the ideas fresh, and the whole experience excitingly new. As a sequel, Pine of Plinko 2 isn't as blazingly new, that's natural, but all of the other praise heaped on part 1 now seamlessly shifts over to the sequel as well.Not only do players get another chance to burrow deeper into Pine of Plinko's world, but Pine of Plinko 2 offers several new add-ons which enhance the experience as a whole. This can absolutely be game-changing, flipping a 5 into a 63 (or thereabouts), for example, can make all the difference in the world when there are so many extra balls to drop. There are no guarantees, of course. Gamble features aren't exactly renowned for being generous or even merciful, but this one is an intriguing tool for gamblers to experiment with. The new parts in the bonus round are both hugely positive as well. Bumper Buckets proved exceedingly valuable for spitting balls back onto the board to rack up extra bumper hits. You really notice the difference between stages with Bumper Buckets and those that do not have them. The Golden Ball Drop is likely to be a less frequent occurrence than Bumper Buckets but has the makings of an intense ride when triggered.Last but not least is potential, where we find double the previous game's max win, bringing the current figure up to 20,000x the bet, providing the final layer of icing on an excellent sequel that takes all the joyful playability found in the original and levels it up.

title: Ruff Heist
structured_summary: Ruff Heist is a heist-themed slot featuring mischievous doggy criminals set in a British urban and vault backdrop. The game offers unique features like three types of Dog Collect symbols that upgrade and collect Diamond Cash prizes, alongside free spins with a progressive Cash Vault bonus. The reviewer finds it a humorous, well-designed game with fresh mechanics, though unlikely to rival top titles in big win potential. Its playful visuals, British motifs, and lighthearted audio create an entertaining, upbeat atmosphere.
review: Ruff Heist: Slot OverviewAfter taking a moment to reflect, it's funny, if not a little scary, how many heist slots are floating about the place. It's almost as if providers weren't making casino games; they'd be… robbing banks? Wait, let's not cast aspersions. Maybe they'd be writing crime novels or screenplays for movies. Indulging in another crime spree fantasy is developer Play'n GO with the slot Ruff Heist. To lighten the mood, Ruff Heist has doggies as its bad guys rather than human villains and sets them loose amongst a cash symbol collection feature, three types of collectors, and free spins with an additional cash prize.It would appear that the great doggy heist is taking place in the British Isles somewhere, thanks to the British flag being displayed in one or two places. One is the roof of the vehicle housing Ruff Heist's game grid. Another is a sticker stating, 'Keep calm and woofing on.' Apparently, the British flag is referred to as the Union Flag when used on land, and the Union Jack only when used at sea. And we're on firm ground for Ruff Heist, which splits its time between an urban street scene for its base game and a loot-laden vault for free spins. Regardless of location, the game emphasises a humorous element provided by bank-robbing canines and keeps the mood light throughout.Ruff Heist slot - base gameWhat's not light is Ruff Heist's math model, rated high and getting a score from its maker of 8 out of 10. Available in five RTP configurations, depending on the market, the default return value players can theoretically expect is 96.19%. Ruff Heist doesn't offer a lot of ways to win, in regards to hitting winning combinations of regular symbols, that is. Just 10 paylines cross its 5x3 gaming panel, available for play with bets ranging from 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin.Along Ruff Heist's 10 paylines, players are able to land winning combinations of 3 to 5 of a kind in length - 2 in the case of the most valuable premium symbol. For its lows, the game uses 5 dog collar attachments in various colours, all worth 10 times the bet when landing 5-of-a-kind. Then, as highs, there are any combination of Diamond Cash symbols, a collar, a pocket watch, a kitty bank, and a Faberge Egg, worth 20 to 200 times the stake for 5 OAK.Ruff Heist: Slot FeaturesRuff Heist slot - free spins splash screenThere's a whole lot of collecting going on in Ruff Heist. Well, there is if the going's good - in the base game as well as in its free spins bonus round. Look out for the Cash Vault in free spins, too, achieved when players make it all the way along the free spins trail for an additional payout.Dog Collect FeatureLanding a Dog Collect symbol awards any Diamond Cash symbols simultaneously in view. Diamond Cash symbols have prize values of 2x-4x, 6x, 8x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 30x, and 5,000x the bet. In the base game, Dog Collect symbols land only on reel 5, whereas in free spins, Dog Collect symbols are present on all five reels. It is possible to hit a Dog Collect but no Diamond Cash symbols. Sad face. Ruff Heist has three types of Dog Collect symbols, each possessing a different ability:Badge – collects all Diamond Cash symbols.T-Bone – upgrades all Diamond Cash symbols before collecting.Archie – upgrades all Diamond Cash symbols before collecting. The collection may repeat between 1 and 5 times.When upgrading Diamond Cash symbols with multiple Collectors present, the upgrade happens once before each Dog Collecter collects. As a final point, Dog Collectors are wild, too, so they substitute for any regular pay symbol.Free SpinsPimped cats are Ruff Heist's scatter symbol. Landing 3, 4, or 5 scatters awards 10, 15, or 20 free spins, respectively. When a Dog Collect symbol hits, it highlights a position on the free spins trail. At every fourth position on the trail, the Dog Collect is upgraded (Badge - T-Bone - Archie) with 10 extra free spins awarded each time. The trail position is evaluated at the end of a spin, and upgrades are applied to the next spin.On each spin, a random cash value is added to the Cash Vault. Values can be 1x, 2x, 5x, or 10x the bet. If players make it to the end of the trail and there are no more free spins, then they are awarded the Cash Vault value. If the trail is reached before free spins have ended, the Cash Vault keeps incrementing on each spin till the round ends.Ruff Heist slot - free spinsRuff Heist: Slot VerdictCash symbol collection games are one of the hottest segments of the market, and anyone looking for one which doesn't involve water sports might be interested by the going's on in Ruff Heist. What could make Ruff Heist more palatable for some is that it has felines instead of fish, though this might be a deal breaker for players who prefer to feel a virtual sea breeze on their face while plucking cash symbols from the reels. For others who couldn't care less what species graces the game or who like cats, Ruff Heist has a few switch-ups which might reel them in for a look.One of those switch-ups is the fact that three types of collectors can appear in the base game, or one type at a time, depending on the upgrade level in free spins. Keeps you on your toes, kinda, never knowing exactly how the next Diamond Cash collect sequence might play out. Free spins are more predictable, in a good way, since the trail lets you know exactly which Collector symbol is active. It also alerts players to the current value of the Cash Vault, which helps with emotional investment in a free spins session, providing a nice sweetener for completing the trail. Even when completing the trail during the test session, the returns weren't massive, and it's a little puzzling as to how Ruff Heist will get anywhere near hitting its 5,000x the bet max win without being really lucky and collecting the highest value Diamond Cash symbol.To sum up, Ruff Heist is a humorous game designed to a pleasing standard and sprinkled with relatively new touches, mechanically speaking. It didn't feel destined to shake up the money symbol collection space like a Big Bass Bonanza, but it might make for an appreciable change from fish.

title: Rex The Hunt
structured_summary: Rex The Hunt is a dinosaur-themed slot set in a glowing green forest with a B-movie vibe. Its main features include stacked mystery symbols and a free spins bonus with sticky mystery reveals. The visuals are typical Thunderkick quality, combining easy-on-the-eyes graphics with atmospheric audio.
review: Rex the Hunt: Slot OverviewOnline slots are one space where dinos and humans sometimes bump up against each other, and while this didn't happen in the real world the way it's often depicted in TV or movies, imagine if it did. Imagine strolling through your local park, beach, or forest as some ruddy great lizard with massive teeth emerges from the shadows looking for a feast. Hopefully, if that scenario ever came to fruition, we'd have characters around like the one in Rex the Hunt, an online slot from Swedes Thunderkick. This guy, and it's not clear whether his name is Rex or not, doesn't take any dino funny business but looks like he actually hunts them. Players can join him as he does so if they like, in a slot with a large focus on mystery symbols in both its base game and free spins bonus round.Thunderkick has used a variety of settings in the past, yet one they have returned to a few times is the foresty/jungley one. This sort of location cropped up in previous games like Beat the Beast Quetzalcoatl's Trial, Phoenix Paradise, and Crystal Quest Deep Jungle, and the studio has brought back the dank for Rex the Hunt too. Actually, Rex the Hunt's outdoor space isn't all that dank, but glows green with a vaguely B-movie atmosphere and felt a little like Raptor DoubleMax. All in all, the view has been crafted with typical Thunderkick flair, so it is easy on the eyes.Rex The Hunt slot - base gameThis particular hunt may take place on any device, with players picking a stake of 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin. Be on the lookout for four RTP configurations, maxing out at 96.16% before dropping as low as 90.15%, depending on the market. In the centre of the screen rests the gaming area, which utilises 6-reels lined up in a 3-4-4-4-4-3 formation. Whilst well versed in the use of a 4,096-ways-to-win format, Rex the Hunt actually makes due with only 178 connecting pay ways, so wins are created when matching symbols start from the leftmost grid and are connected across at least three consecutive reels.For symbols, Rex the Hunt has ten regular pays, divided into low pay 9-A card icons, four mids called the blue dinosaur, yellow dinosaur, silver dinosaur, and the red dinosaur, while the hunter is the sole high pay. A six-of-a-kind royal win awards 0.7 to 1.5 times the stake, whereas the other symbols award 2 to 10 times the bet. Lastly, wild symbols appear on all reels, too, and can replace any normal pay symbol to complete a win or pay 10x the bet for six connected wilds.Rex the Hunt: Slot FeaturesRex The Hunt slot - free spins triggeredRex the Hunt sticks to a few fairly basic tricks when it comes to features. These are stacked mystery symbols and a bonus Game.Stacked Mystery SymbolsMystery symbols can appear on reels 2, 3, 4, or 5. At the end of a spin, if there are mystery symbols in view, they all reveal the same matching symbol, which can be anything except the scatter.Bonus GameScatter symbols are present only on reels 1 and 6. When scatter symbols hit on both reels, 10 free spins are awarded. While the bonus game is active, landing scatter symbols on reels 1 and 6 awards an additional +5 free spins. In the bonus game, when mystery symbols hit, they become sticky for the rest of the feature. Any mystery symbols in the triggering base game spin carry over to the bonus game.Rex The Hunt slot - free spinsRex the Hunt: Slot VerdictThere you go, short and sweet. Thunderkick has hardly pushed itself out of many comfort zones when the team made Rex the Hunt. It's a little like a Beat the Beast slot, being simple, straightforward, and having zilch in the way of complex rules, nor are there many innovative new features. All it has really is mystery symbols in the base game or sticky mystery symbols in the bonus game. Despite the attractive presentation, if mystery symbol reveals, don't float your boat; there's not much left about Rex the Hunt that will make you change your mind.On the other hand, players partial to some mystery reveals get plenty of those in Rex the Hunt. That's all there is, really, yet the way they remain on screen in free spins has some potential. Having said that, the game comes with a maximum win figure of 4,000x the bet, which is definitely lower than expected for a Thunderkick game. With the simple rule set and modest max win, Rex the Hunt came across, maybe not as filler as such, but not a game the studio really poured its heart into. There's entertainment to be had in Rex the Hunt if the subject matter and gameplay appeal, though questions arose over the shelf life and just how replayable Rex the Hunt might be.It does go to show that studios have plenty of mileage to squeeze out of mystery symbols. Similar-ish concepts were put to good use in games like Beast Mode and Horror Hotel, for example, proving the enduring popularity of the mystery symbol. When stacked against those two games, Rex the Hunt feels like a fun, if lighter alternative, being limited in what it can do and how far it can go while doing it, by comparison.

title: Brood of Gods
structured_summary: Brood of Gods is a Polynesian-themed slot featuring three gods with unique reel-modifying powers inspired by anime-style gameplay. It offers a 5x5 grid, cascading wins, modifier gods, multiplier coins, free spins, and a bonus buy option. The reviewer found it visually unique but criticized its slow pace, modest max win of 1,789x, and lack of engagement compared to similar titles. The game boasts neat visuals and mystical audio that evoke a captivating atmosphere but lacks the excitement of its inspirations.
review: Brood of Gods: Slot OverviewHumans vary widely from country to country in customs, traditions, and beliefs. But one thing we all tend to share, broadly speaking, is a desire to work out how we got here and, in many instances, explain why we're here. A massive part of tackling these existential questions has been the inclusion of powerful deities, and these come in a wide range of forms as well. In online slots, experienced players are well-versed in Ancient Egyptian, Greek, and Norse gods (amongst others), having graced the reels in loads of games. For Brood of Gods, an online slot from Light & Wonder, the studio has left the usual deities behind and moved their focus to those of Polynesian origins. Three appear in Brood of Gods, as does gameplay which will be familiar to players with anime tastes.Might as well come clean now and say that if Brood of Gods wasn't inspired by Play'n GO's smash hit Moon Princess, then we're talking about titanic levels of coincidence. Each of its three gods chills out beside the game grid, one at a time, possessing a specific reel modifying ability, swapping up when their modifier triggers. As the god changes, so does the background imagery. After some internet searching, it appears that Papa is Mother Earth, so in the game, she resides in a fecund green environment; Rangi is Father Sky, so he can be found in a celestial setting, while Whiro is like the lord of the underworld, so you can imagine how his domain might be. The visuals are quite good, and the mystical quality they evoke is similar to the one found in games like Spirit of the River and Yanaha's Rite – both from the Light & Wonder production line.Brood of Gods slot - base gameThe brood is made possible on any device, furnishing players with a stake range of 10 p/ to $/€20 per spin. With a medium-high volatile math model, numerous RTP versions of the game are planned - a 96% model is the highest. On the front end, Brood of Gods has a 5x5 game grid, shooting off wins at a frequency of 1 in 3.71 spins.Normal wins occur when at least three matching symbols land in a horizontal or vertical line, starting from any position on the board. Wins trigger a cascade system which removes them, letting symbols fall into the gaps. However, new symbols do not appear from above when this happens, and clearing the entire grid adds an additional reward of 1,000x the bet. With seven types of pay symbols, four intricately designed shapes have been used as the low pays, worth 2 to 3 times the bet for five-of-a-kind, while five high pay deity symbols are worth 10x the bet. Also, mixtures of any god symbol type pay up to 5x the bet for a line of five of them.Brood of Gods: Slot FeaturesBrood of Gods slot - free spinsAfter winning symbols have been removed, but before other symbols drop, a wild symbol appears in the middle of the empty spaces if the win is 3 or 5 symbols in size. If more than one win shares the same middle space, only one wild is added. Wilds replace any regular pay symbol.Modifier GodsOne of the three gods is always active and can randomly award a specific modifier on any non-winning spin. Once the modifier has triggered, the next god appears on the screen. In this order, they are:Papa – a random number of symbols are transformed into a random paytable symbol.Rangi – adds a 2x2 block of a random symbol type to the board.Whiro – all instances of one random symbol on the board are selected, and all other symbols are removed. This causes the chosen type to cascade to the bottom of the grid, and new symbols drop from above.Multiplier CoinsA Multiplier Coin is generated when a 4 or 5 winning symbol combo is removed from the board. Collecting 4 Multiplier Coins in the base game triggers 5 free spins. Even if free spins are not awarded, collected Multiplier Coins award their value at the end of the spin. Bronze Coins are worth 0.1-0.5x the bet, Silver Coins are worth 0.6-0.9x the bet, while Gold Coins are worth 1-5x the bet.Free GamesPlayers pick one of the gods before free games begin – bearing in mind the max RTP is only possible by picking Rangi. This god remains active for the full duration of the feature and triggers on every non-winning free game. Now, during the round, collecting 4 Multiplier Coins awards +1 free game, up to a maximum total of 10 free games. At the start, an x1 Multiplier Coin is added above the collection meter. As new Multiplier Coins are collected, their values accumulate. This starting Coin does not count towards getting extra free games, though. Moreover, in free games, the Bronze, Silver, and Gold Coin is worth 1x, 2x, or 3x the bet, respectively. Also to add, coins have no monetary value, but each win is multiplied by the total value of the Multiplier Coins.The last feature is the Buy Pass which is where players may have the chance of buying the free games round for 50x the bet.Brood of Gods slot - free spinsBrood of Gods: Slot VerdictIf you can't beat 'em, copy 'em, huh? Or if not outright copy 'em, at least borrow a whole bunch of stuff and use it to springboard somewhere else instead. That seems to be what's going on in Brood of Gods which did a good job at the beginning of deflecting attention away through its creative theme choice. The visuals are certainly unique, and it's not often that Polynesian culture serves as inspiration for an online slot and makes for a refreshing change from the usual popular choices such as Norse, Greek, or Egyptian.Moving on past the theme, Brood of Gods did have a slight treacly sluggishness that held the pace up. It's not exactly off-putting, but it didn't have the same pacey flow found in, well, a game like Moon Princess, even with turbo mode engaged. If that isn't a distracting deal breaker, however, then there are elements of Brood of Gods which may appeal. For one, it uses some of the best parts of Moon Princess while adding new bits of its own. The bonus buy is relatively thrifty, for one, the visuals are neat, and the Multiplier Coins are something new to try. What might be a deal breaker is that when it comes to winning potential, Brood of Gods is pretty weak, with a ceiling value of 1,789.2 times the bet. The Multiplier Coin feature in free games is one of Brood of Gods' highlights, though, with limited potential, it doesn't feel like it's going to get too far.At times, Brood of Gods put up a good fight, Light & Wonder's out-of-the-box subject matter choice is commendable, but its engagement levels failed to match those possible in Moon Princess. Even putting the 'imitation' part aside for a moment, Brood of Gods' listless pace, the glacial cycling through the three gods, and knockoff feel, capped with a disappointing max win, were enough to have us pining for the slickly pulled-off anime thrills of the original.

title: Fishin' Pots of Gold Gold Blitz
structured_summary: Fishin' Pots of Gold Gold Blitz combines fishing and leprechaun themes but lacks originality, being a direct clone of another slot. review: Fishin' Pots of Gold Gold Blitz: Slot OverviewIf you're the sort of player who's had a gut full of fishing and/or leprechaun-themed slots, now would be a good time to look away. The reason why is Game Global associates Gameburger Studios has mashed both things, leprechaun and fishing, together into one outrageously unoriginal place. And we're not just saying unoriginal because of battling through a stack of fishing slots recently. No, even when ignoring the game's outer wrapper Fishin' Pots of Gold Gold Blitz is utterly devoid of any creative originality whatsoever as it's a digit-for-digit clone of fellow developer Fortune Factory Studios' slot Gold Blitz (by extension linking it to Mask of Amun and Blazing Bison Gold Blitz).Hey, some gamblers might be enthused by that prospect, so let's reel up and head in to see what we can find. For starters, Fishin' Pots of Gold Gold Blitz is held in a green green part of the woods, next to a wee stream where the fish are caught. Visually, there's nothing of particular note to report back on. This doesn't stop Fishin' Pots of Gold Gold Blitz from being a sparkly, bright, colourful, leprechauny-looking slot, though, that sits comfortably within the Emerald Isle gaming category. Moving on.Fishin' Pots of Gold Gold Blitz slot - base gameNext on the agenda is the mathematical side of Fishin' Pots of Gold Gold Blitz. As mentioned, it's a digit-for-digit reskin of Gold Blitz, so all the same stats apply. That means a highly volatile online slot with a default RTP of 96.25%. These are the return values when betting 20 p/c to $/€50 on individual spins; the return increases to 96.95% when buying the bonus round.Fishin' Pots of Gold: Gold Blitz's gaming setup consists of 6 reels holding 4 symbols each, providing 4,096 ways to win. Regular ways wins occur when matching symbols land on adjacent reels from the left-hand side of the matrix onwards. The paytable is a real mix of the two themes as well, where on the low side are Celtic-ish designed 9-A card royals, then a dragonfly, a lure, a fishing jacket, a tackle box, and a top-hatted fish as the high pays. A low pay 6 symbol win will get you 1 to 1.5 times the bet, whereas a 6 premium symbol win awards 2 to 5 times the bet. Mushroom-adorned wild symbols help out here by substituting for any regular pay symbol. In the base game, wilds appear on reels 2 to 6. In free spins, they land on reels 2, 3, and 4.Fishin' Pots of Gold Gold Blitz: Slot FeaturesFishin' Pots of Gold Gold Blitz slot - Gold Blitz featureFishin' Pots of Gold Gold Blitz is capable of triggering the Collect feature in the base game and the Gold Blitz. The other features to look out for are free spins and a bonus buy.Collect FeatureThe Collect symbol appears on all reels in the base game and the Gold Blitz. When a Collect symbol hits, any Cash symbols or Jackpot symbols in view are collected. The three Jackpots are the minor, major, and mega, worth 25x, 250x, and 2,500x the bet, respectively.Scatter SymbolLanding at least 3 scatter symbols on the reels triggers a payout, plus players get to choose one of the two bonus rounds:3 scatter symbols – 1x the bet, and either 8 free spins or 2 Gold Blitz spins.4 scatter symbols – 2x the bet, and either 12 free spins or 3 Gold Blitz spins.5 scatter symbols – 3x the bet, and either 20 free spins or 5 Gold Blitz spins.6 scatter symbols – 5x the bet, and either 30 free spins or 7 Gold Blitz spins.Free SpinsIn free spins, an x2, x3, or x5 multiplier is randomly awarded for every wild in a way win. Each wild multiplier will multiply the win awarded on the applicable way. Hitting 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6 scatters awards an additional 5, 8, 12, 20, or 30 free spins, respectively.Gold BlitzDuring the Gold Blitz, only Collect, Cash, and Jackpot symbols land in the feature. At least one Collect symbol will land on each spin, meaning a win is guaranteed on each spin. Gold Blitz cannot be retriggered.Bonus BuyBy using the bonus buy, players can trigger the bonus round with 4, 5, or 6 scatters for 75x, 120x, or 150x the bet, respectively. Once triggered, it is possible to choose free spins or Gold Blitz spins as if they were triggered naturally. When buying 4 or 5 scatters, a chance exists for extra scatters to land.Fishin' Pots of Gold Gold Blitz slot - free spinsFishin' Pots of Gold Gold Blitz: Slot VerdictGameburger Studios is starting to feel like that kid in class who said something hilariously witty on the first day, which got everyone's sides splitting but hasn't really spoken up since. 9 Masks of Fire was the team's breakthrough, adding a significant amount of fuel to the scatter symbol/instant prize win style of play, which has seriously blossomed over the following years. Games like 9 Pots of Gold and its ilk have found success too, yet it feels like the provider has peaked, or at least is yet to repeat the same level of success it had in the past.Fishin' Pots of Gold Gold Blitz doesn't do the studio a lot of favours either. Being a clone, not just of a previous slot, but someone else's previous slot doesn't exactly scream raging originality. Maybe if it wasn't a leprechaun game, or a fishing game, or a mashup of both, and an inventively new thematic concept had been used, it might have freshened the whole experience up. But no, as if we didn't have enough leprechaun or fishing slots bobbing about the place, here's another soulless clone to add to the heap.Still, humans thrive on familiarity, so perhaps Fishin' Pots of Gold Gold Blitz will be a hit? Stranger things have happened in the gambling sphere, and it's 5,000x the bet top prize isn't shabby. On a less positive note, let's wrap up by saying all of these multi-layers of recycling meant that for our money, Milli Vanilli lip-syncing live had more artistic merit than Fishin' Pots of Gold Gold Blitz does.

title: Bass Boss Megaways

review: Bass Boss Megaways: Slot OverviewArm yourself with reel and rod, folks; we're hitting the water for a spot of angling with Evolution-owned Red Tiger chartering the boat. review: Wild Wild Riches Megaways: Slot OverviewWild Wild Riches Megaways is an online slot from developer Pragmatic Play and a follow-up to one of the studio's previous Irish-themed games. To be precise, it's a Megaways remake of an earlier slot called Wild Wild Riches released in the latter part of 2020, which, at the time, didn't exactly rock our world. It must have rocked a few worlds, though, because Wild Wild Bananas followed, and now we've got a Megaways version. Is it any better?One of the first things eagle-eyed readers might notice is that Wild Wild Riches Megaways has a much flusher game grid than the two Wild Wild games which preceded it. Classic or cliched? You be the judge.Wild Wild Riches Megaways: Slot FeaturesWild Wild Riches Megaways slot - free spins gambleNow for the features, which rely on three more symbol types – wilds, bonus symbols, and Money symbols. They lead players to the Money Collect feature, and the free spins round when they land in the required manner. Wilds are up first; they appear on the first and second reels and can replace any regular pay symbol. The bonus symbol can land only on the third reel.Money Collect FeatureMoney symbols appear on reels 3, 4, 5, and 6. Whenever 2 wilds land on reels 1 and 2, as well as adjacent Money symbols, making a left to right way, the Money symbol values are collected. They may award:Cash prizes worth 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 10x, 12x, 15x, or 20x the bet.The Mini, Minor, Mega, or Maxi Jackpot, worth 25x, 50x, 100x, or 250x the bet, respectively.Multipliers of x2, x3, or x5 that get applied to the total collect feature win.Free Spins FeatureHitting wilds on reels 1 and 2 plus a bonus symbol on reel 3 triggers the free spins round. Successful gambles increase the awarded number of spins (up to 20 max), while unsuccessful gambles lose the lot. Now, during free spins, more wild and Money symbols are present on the reels. He put forward the notion that the term arose during the gold and silver rushes of the later part of the 19th century. Since some of the most successful miners were apparently of Irish or American Irish origins, it led to the saying 'luck of the Irish', though it was not always said in a positive way.Players who take on Wild Wild Riches Megaways will no doubt be hoping luck is on their side, too. One of the main reasons is that Pragmatic Play has seen fit to extend the winning potential to match the grid expansion between this and the last game. title: A Flight of Fortune

review: A Flight of Fortune: Slot OverviewHold on to your feathers, folks; we're about to let our imaginations take flight with one of the more creative units around, Games Global partner Crazy Tooth Studios. The game, in this instance, is A Flight of Fortune and makes use of the developer's CoinVerge winning mechanic. If you haven't caught the CoinVerge before, it offers a completely different way of trying your luck on a set of reels. The question is, is it cringe new like some train wreck fashion, or is it going to be something all the bandwagoners are doing soon?Crazy Tooth does like its birds, huh, and A Flight of Fortune is stuffed with a fair few of them, like its brother or sister slots Lucky Clucks or Lucky Clucks 2. This time, the birds you want to see in A Flight of Fortune are toucan brackets because they're able to award wins. Following this, players will quickly spot that A Flight of Fortune does not use regular symbols like a regular online slot. No royals, gems, fruit, or anything like that. Instead, the key goal is to collect symbols, with the help of those previously mentioned toucan brackets, while basking in its tropical plant-populated game world, which the info sheet states is the lush Amazonian jungle. Eh, why not?A Flight of Fortune slot - base gameA Flight of Fortune might function a bit differently, but gamblers still have to choose a bet to participate, and the options range from 25 c to $/€30 per spin. Statistically, A Flight of Fortune is a highly volatile slot producing a default RTP of 96.03%, with two lower return value models also available. It's played on a regular-looking gameboard, but there are no paylines, ways, or anything like that. Instead, to win, you'll need the help of toucan collection brackets. When a matching opening bracket and closing bracket land on the same rows (there are different kinds of brackets), they create a collection area, and the coins in between these brackets award the total of their displayed values to the player. The regular paying coins come in three types - low, medium, and high credit coins. Multiple collection areas can be present on a single spin, too.A Flight of Fortune: Slot FeaturesA Flight of Fortune slot - free spinsSpecial symbols may also appear on the grid awarding respins, jungle prizes, or modifiers and are accompanied by a nudge feature.Special SymbolsSpecial symbols collected in brackets help boost A Flight of Fortune's entertainment and payout values and include:Multiplier Coins - collecting these coins multiplies prizes in the collection areas by 2, 3, 4, or 5.Upgrade Coin - collecting this coin upgrades all low and medium coins to high coins while awarding an additional high credit coin.Collect Column Coin - collecting this coin adds all coins within its column to the active collection area for the current spin.Collect All Coin - collecting this coin adds all coins within the gameboard to the active collection area for the current spin.Respin Coin - triggers the respin feature mentioned below when collected.Jungle PrizesJungle prize overlay symbols may appear on the grid but not during respins. When 3 or more Jungle Prize Overlay symbols are in view in a collection area, the active Jungle Prize is awarded. The prizes are the Major, Minor, and Mini, and once their prize has been awarded, its value is reset. Flitting about the place is a Jungle Prize Increment symbol in the form of a bird. Landing this symbol increases one of the Jungle Prizes. It is not available during respins.Nudge FeatureThe Nudge feature triggers at random. When it does activate, it nudges a closing bracket up or down to match the row of a like opening bracket to create a collection area.A Flight of Fortune RespinsRespin coins showing values of 2, 3, or 5 are present in the game. When a Respin coin is collected in a collection area, respins are awarded. Respins can be retriggered for up to a maximum of 8 respins. Coins inside the collection areas are collected and repopulated with new coins for the given number of respins.A Flight of Fortune slot - free spinsA Flight of Fortune: Slot VerdictOne of the good things about Crazy Tooth Studios is its consistency. Consistently, um, unusual. The studio's slots never fail to produce some sort of emotional response. That doesn't necessarily mean the response involves white knuckles from gripping onto the latest immersive thrill fest. Often, those emotions run along the lines of what on earth have these guys cooked up this time? And so it was in A Flight of Fortune, which, yes, dares to be different but at the same time felt like it just missed the mark again.Weak values are one of A Flight of Fortune's major boner killers. From memory, the first time a hit occurred, the toucans had highlighted a total value of something like '8'. Okay, 8 bucks, not a bad start, but no, that actually equated to 8 cents. Huh. Shouldn't be surprised, given Crazy Tooth's track record for filling past games with low-value prizes and such, but still, it was a surprise. And not a good one. Technically, A Flight of Fortune can produce wins as high as 8,000x the bet, putting it into a fairly hefty weight division. But still, it was hard to see how this would ever occur due to the sorts of tools players have to work with. Happy to see it eventuate, but.A Flight of Fortune might not have blown much hair back, but here's hoping Crazy Tooth Studios keeps banging away in its workshop, turning out oddball slots like this one. They might not be crafting slot-of-the-year contenders, but at least they're happy doing their thing. It'd be a sad day if some heartless, soulless conglomerate bought the studio out and transformed it into a commercial cookie-cutter outfit, releasing bland slots that triggered zero emotional responses.

Grim Reaper Supermatch was not as smack you in the face original as Rome Supermatch was, but in a good way. What we mean is the shock has lessened, letting us sit back and take in what Grim Reaper Supermatch can do without being overwhelmed by novelty. The base Supermatch function, land matching symbols on rows from the bottom all the way to the top remains, yet every other new feature and adjustment the studio poured into Grim Reaper Supermatch made it an arguably superior experience over the original. Not saying Rome Supermatch was a poor debut, but Grim Reaper Supermatch just felt more rounded, more fun, and the engaging interplay of features more impactful.As well, there's the theme, and it was heartening to see Nailed It! Games pick something a bit more out of the ordinary than it usually does. Not only is the Grim Reaper here, but she's a she by the looks, and she rules over a delightfully spooky realm.
