There are plenty of links to the two previous games, helping embed Pirates Plenty Megaways deep in the series. Simultaneously, the new bits gel well with Megaways, though the free spins are pretty standard unless the bonus reel has been unlocked. For the most part, it works. While Pirates Plenty Megaways doesn’t feel quite as piraty as Battle for Gold (there’s no burning bearded captain lobbing bombs everywhere), everything else has been dialled up.Much of the increase in potency is due to Megaways, but Red Tiger hasn’t just bunged a bigger grid on then left it at that. The treasure map feature integrates with Wild Ways and the Lady Anne Wild feature to create thrilling moments when it all comes together. Treasure map collecting also creates a spirit of adventure, or at least an incentive to keep on hitting spin, when you know there is a reward at the end of it for being patient. Along the way, the cheeky monkey fellow who has been around since the start is there to keep you company and toss the odd win your way when he sticks to the reels.As for the main event, in some ways, the free spins feature isn’t as exciting as free spins in the previous one. They don’t typically get as manic, with all those sticky wilds and explosives flying about the place as before. Free spins can certainly perform though, as progressive multiplier Megaways features do, to the tune of 10,489x the bet.In all, everything is a bit bigger, a bit louder, a bit saltier, making Pirates Plenty Megaways a logical evolution in the Pirates Plenty series, building on what came before as it sails off in its own direction.

title: Three Star Fortune
structured_summary: Three Star Fortune is an Asian-themed slot featuring the three star gods Fu, Lu, and Shou symbolizing wealth, status, and longevity. The game’s main feature is expanding wilds on reels 2, 3, and 4 that trigger respins when they appear. The reviewer finds it appealing for fans of the genre but notes its repetitive gameplay and limited features reduce long-term appeal. Visually, it offers a dreamy, traditional Chinese landscape with rich red and gold tones, complemented by a calm, thematic audio backdrop.
review: Three Star Fortune: OverviewDeveloper Pragmatic Play plant themselves firmly on familiar ground with the Asian styled slot Three Star Fortune. The three stars in the title refer to the three jolly star gods Fu, Lu, and Shou, who represent wealth, status, and longevity. Most people would be happy with abundance of those three things, and in Chinese culture, these attributes traditionally denoted a good life. As such, the trio turns up regularly in the slot world. In Three Star Fortune they trigger the only feature, so yeah, they are just as desirable, if not more so in when spinning its Eastern-themed reels.Pragmatic Play has certainly created a game world for fans of the genre to feel comfortable in. Depending on how you feel about this style, Three Star Fortune will come across as generic and clichéd or familiar and homely. For the background, Pragmatic has practically recreated the Zhangjiajie National Forest with its misty mountains and covered them in traditional buildings, bridges, and waterfalls. It's dreamy, and it has been used in dozens of other similarly themed slots, but yeah, if you like the subject matter, you'll love the look.Reels dominate the view and are located in a green-tiled structure with the obligatory peaked corners. Their deep red tone helps contrast the bold colours of the symbols, which includes plenty of gold for good measure. Three Star Fortune uses a conventional 5 reel, 3 row set up with 10 paylines on which all symbols pay right to left, as well as left to right. The good thing about the pay both way dynamic is that it actually comes in quite handy with the way the feature works.Before delving in too deep is the matter of setting stakes. This can be done by altering the number of coins per line, and their value, and boils down to total bets of 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin. To understand what you're up against, it might be good to know that Three Star Fortune is a highly volatile slot with a industry standard RTP of 96.27%. The RTP, however, is adjustable, which means operators can set a lower number if they feel like it.Pragmatic Play has squeezed the theme hard when it came to designing the symbols too. On the low side, the three names Fu, Lu, and Shou have been used and appear in the form of Chinese characters. Then, we get a gourd that looks like Egg Shen's potion bottle, a scroll, and something that looks like a pink fruit. The premium symbol is one of those gold sycees that is worth 25 times the stake for a line of five. All symbols need at least three of a kind to trigger a payout. Another nice touch is that 5 of a kind wins are paid twice - once for each direction.Three Star Fortune: FeaturesThree Star Fortune - free spins featureThree Star Fortune keeps it ultra-simple with little in the way of features to interrupt the game’s flow. The one it does possess involves all three gods as expanding wilds. Each god has their own reel with Lu on reel 2, Fu on reel 3, and Shou on reel 4.Known as the Expanding Wilds feature, when one of the wilds appears, it expands to cover the reel and wins are paid out. Then, it is held for a free Respins in its expanded form. If another wild lands on a respin, it expands and triggers another respin. When respins have concluded the wilds are removed for the next new spin.Three Star Fortune: VerdictIf you are looking for some straightforward slots action in a well presented, attractive environment, Three Star Fortune can be quite good. For a while, at least. Ironically, despite featuring the god of longevity, the shelf life is likely quite short due to the repetitive and stripped down nature of this slot. Once you've seen the expanding wilds do their thing a few times, that's pretty much it. If you can get on a good roll, you'd be forgiven for sticking with it. If not, there isn't much else to keep grinding Three Star Fortune out long term.Still, for those with a deep affinity for Asian slots, Three Star Fortune is quite a good example with a ton of exotic imagery throw in for good measure. With a back catalogue bulging with Asian themed slots, Pragmatic Play certainly knows a thing or two about crafting them. Players that are into dreamy, cloud swirled mountains, a bit of divine presence, and gold and burgundy style, will probably be all over it.Without bonus games or free spins, however, it's just the three wild gods keeping players company and the wins ticking along. They can be quite effective when working together and Pragmatic Play has claimed potential of up to 5,000 times the stake. Yet, it is a little hard to see how that is possible. With pay both ways doubling full lines, a grid of wilds and sycees is worth 500 times the stake. Even in the unlikely event of landing that on consecutive respins, it will be nearly impossible to even come close to hitting the stated figure.In the end, Three Star Fortune is really one for fans of the genre. It has a good pace and the pay both ways mechanic has been paired perfectly with the expanding wilds feature. But its lack of originality, low payouts, and repetitive nature will make it hard to win over those that don't love this style.

title: Holiday Spirits
structured_summary: Holiday Spirits is a Christmas-themed slot featuring a rendition of A Christmas Carol with festive symbols and a cozy holiday atmosphere. The game offers a 3x3 grid, 5 paylines, and features like random multipliers, Ebenezer’s Gift, and Win Spins with three themed respin modes. The reviewer finds it an appealing seasonal slot with solid gameplay, though notes it is a reskinned clone of Chronos Joker with only cosmetic changes. The game boasts warm, inviting visuals of a decorated hearth and tree, complemented by classic Christmas icons and a comforting audio backdrop.
review: Holiday Spirits: Slot OverviewIf you are one of those people who wrenches the Christmas tree out of the attic mid-September, while others are making the most of the last of summer, Play’n GO might just have the slot for you. Getting in before the seasonal slot deluge begins in earnest is Holiday Spirits. Not only do we get plenty of festive cheer, but players are also treated to a rendition of Charles Dickens’ classic story A Christmas Carol.Holiday Spirits is laid out on a 3x3 grid, providing 5 paylines to land wins on. This isn’t the first time Scrooge and his three life-altering apparitions have appeared in a slot, though it is one of the more pleasant to look at. There’s a warm, homely feel, created by the roaring hearth, a richly decorated Christmas tree, and a smattering of snow on the window panes. Old Ebenezer was famous for being a tightwad, but he’s generously loosened the purse strings to brighten up this house in preparation for the silly season.Holiday Spirits is playable on a mobile, tablet, or desktop device, offering bets from 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin. The default math model is typically Play'n GO solid, though configurable, producing a default RTP of 96.54%. Don’t expect super frequent wins on what is basically a Christmas fruit slot, although the game is more forgiving than others in the Play’n GO fruit range. It won’t batter players like, say, Inferno Joker, thanks to less-lethal volatility, rated as 6/10. It’s not ultra-intense gaming, which might make it appeal to a broader audience looking for a Christmas punt.All symbols included here are custom made for the game, consisting of snow globes, candy canes, bulging stockings, and wreaths. All heart-warming Christmas icons make up the low pays. From there, we move onto the four ghosts of the tale – the ghosts of past, present, future, and the last one is Jacob Marley. Marley was Scrooge’s dead business partner, doomed to shuffle through the afterlife in chains to atone for a life of greedy selfishness. Premium values range from 1.4x for the golden ghost up to 4x for three Jacobs on a line.Scrooge appears sporting epic mutton chops as the game’s wild, on any reel. Not only does he replace all other symbols, he is also worth 16 times the stake in a line of three. Critically, all symbols can land stacked three high, including the wild.Holiday Spirits: Slot FeaturesPlay'n GO's Holiday Spirits slotThe gravy at this Christmas feast consists of helpings of Ebenezer’s Clock multipliers, Ebenezer’s Gift alongside a Win Spins feature.Keep an eye on the clock sitting on top of the reels which may activate at any random moment in the base game or on Win Spins. When it does, a multiplier of x2, x3, x4, x5, or x10 is applied to any win. Next to the clock is Ebenezer’s Gift, increasing the effect. If it happens to light up at the same time as the clock, it doubles the multiplier up to x20 max.Next is Win Spins, which is the principle feature of this game. When two reels are stacked in the same symbols on a non-winning spin at the same time as an active multiplier, Win Spins are triggered. The stacked reels are locked in place, while one of three types of Win Spins occur:Win Spins of Christmas Future are activated by the x2 multiplier. Here, Respins continue to be awarded until a win hits. Each non-winning respin increases the multiplier through x2 to x3, x4, x5, maxing at x10. When reaching x10, a win is guaranteed.Wins of Christmas Present are activated by an x3, x4, or x5 multiplier. A respin occurs guaranteeing a win at the present, unchanged multiplier.Wins of Christmas Past are activated by the x10 multiplier. Respins occur until a win hits. On each non-winning spin, the multiplier decreases from x10 to x5, x4, x3, ending up on x2. A guaranteed win is awarded when the lowest multiplier is reached.Holiday Spirits: Slot VerdictEvery year without fail hordes of people leave their shopping to the last minute. Then it’s a Christmas eve battle with the rest of the belated shoppers for the final dregs left on the shelves. Not so Play’n GO who is in quick smart. Yet, while Holiday Spirit is one of the earliest Christmas themed slots of the year, some could claim Play’n GO cheated by cloning Chronos Joker to short cut the production time. The math model and features are more or less identical, so all it took was a bit of Dickens inspired reskinning to complete the process. In fairness, this is an approach used by many providers.The outer wrapper is an attractive one, rarely does Play’n GO release an outright ugly slot. Leaving the cloning issue aside for a moment, in some ways it's clever the way Play’n GO has tied the past, present, and future features from the original game into the Christmas Carol version via the three respective ghosts.Other highlights are Win Spins, a feature that has worked incredibly well in games like Pimped. They can be quite effective too when the right symbol/multiplier combo lands. The only real change, apart from looks, is branding Super Spins as Ebenezer’s gift. Like the rest of the game, it’s only a change in name really. The slight alteration doesn’t have an impact on the max win, which remains 1,600 times the stake.If you’re after what is essentially a Christmas punch bowl of a fruit slot, with a dash of complexity, you might enjoy Holiday Spirits’ reworked gameplay. The bright seasonal veneer and excellent use of theme almost makes you forget you’re playing a clone.

title: Hot Spin Deluxe
structured_summary: Hot Spin Deluxe is a retro Las Vegas-style slot with a classic fruit theme enhanced by flashy gold accents. It features a Hot Spin Wheel triggering six random bonus features plus new Deluxe features including a random multiplier up to x10. The reviewer praises it as a worthwhile upgrade with higher max wins and exciting random extras, outshining the original. The game boasts groovy 70s disco EDM soundtrack and bright, shimmering visuals that complement its retro-modern vibe.
review: Hot Spin Deluxe (iSoftBet): OverviewThe original Hot Spin isn't exactly an old slot, but developers iSoftBet felt it was time to jazz it up and release a deluxe version. Not a lot has changed; we still get the same flashing lights and classic symbols of a retro Las Vegas-style slot - with a few extras. In fact, take a quick glance at a screenshot, and you would be forgiven for thinking you were looking at the original Hot Spin. Two key additions have been made, however, and they have drastically improved the game's potential for larger wins.The soundtrack can't be described as anything other than groovy. It's a sweet 70s disco flavoured piece of EDM and suits the game well - old school gaming with a modern twist. The visuals are nice, with a lot of bright gold, and touches of shimmer along the trim. Sticking with the retro theme, the gameplay is fast and simple, in the base game at least. When it comes to extras, there are a whole lot more than you would find on a fruit slot back in the day.The setup is the same as before, with 5 reels, 3 rows and 20 fixed paylines which flow fast. Located above the grid is the Hot Spin Reel turning lazily, just waiting for the right moment to completely flip the game. The overall sensory effect is pleasant and produces a mellow, relaxed state, conducive for a solid gaming session. The first thing to do is slink a bit lower into your chair and pick a bet level from 20 c/p up to $/€20 per spin.Symbols come straight from the fruit slot manual with cherries, lemons, plums, and watermelons starting off the paytable. Next up are the high pay symbols – bells, stars, 7, and the diamond as the most valuable base symbol at 25 times the stake for a five of a kind combination. The big gold 'W' is the wild which can replace any of the paytable symbols except the Bonus Symbol to form winning combinations. Stats are also similar to the first Hot Spin, with medium-high volatility and an RTP rate of 96.0%. Without doubt, what made the original slot interesting was its Hot Spin Wheel and the 6 features it was able to bestow. Fortunately, we get that, and then some, with the Deluxe version.Hot Spin Deluxe (iSoftBet): FeaturesBonus wheelThe bonus symbol appears on reels 1, 3, and 5 and when 3 land the Hot Spin Wheel springs to life. When the Hot Spin Wheel comes to a stop, it awards up to 15 Free Spins which includes one of these special features:Mystery Symbols - a golden question mark appears on the reels in 6, 8, or 12 positions. When the reels stop spinning they all turn to reveal the same symbol.Random Wilds - as the name suggests 5, 7, or 10 tiles are turned into Wild symbols.Mega Reel - this feature turns either reels 1-3 or 2-4 into one mega-sized symbol.In-Sync Reels - no, not a Justin Timberlake throwback, unfortunately. Instead, 2 or 3 reels will synchronise and land the same symbols on each one. Super In-Sync Reels can drop which synchronises either 3 or 4 reels at once.Wild Reels - the feature turns up to 3 reels completely stacked with Wilds. Again, Super Wild Reels can also land to provide 3 – 5 reels stacked with Wilds.Ultra Reel - turns the entire grid into one ultra-symbol.Now to the two features which added the word 'Deluxe' onto the title and warranted a remake; the first is Hot Spin Deluxe. This triggers the Hot Spin Reel at random during any normal spin to bring in one of the features mentioned above. The second upgrade is the Hot Spin Deluxe Multiplier. This is the one that will light player’s fire as it reveals a multiplier of up to x10 which can applies to any Hot Spin feature.Hot Spin Deluxe (iSoftBet): VerdictHot Spin Deluxe is what the first one could have, or should have been. The original was alright, and the Hot Spin Wheel with its set of features was a draw for many players no doubt. What it lacked was decent payouts to really set it up as a favourite. Perhaps iSoftBet has been out canvassing the gaming community for opinions and ideas? However the inspiration arose; they spotted an opportunity for a quick and easy remake. The upgrade will draw in both fans of the original and new players for several reasons. Hot Spin Deluxe is certainly a more enticing slot, and a lot of that is down to the new max potential. It is now capable of hitting 5,000 times the stake thanks to the inclusion of those extra multipliers.So no, Hot Spin Deluxe is not hugely different, but it is a step up from its predecessor. These minor tweak upgrades can be a double edged sword though. Hopefully, this doesn't turn into a major trend, with other developers taking an older game, bolting on one or two additional features and flooding the market with ‘Deluxe’ versions. Ah well, as long as prizes drastically increase along with the renovations then it is hard to complain too loudly about things like unoriginality.All in all, Hot Spin Deluxe is a compelling slot that is made all the more exciting by the random features. Knowing that they can drop at any time keeps the game fresh and your finger poised on the spin button. This game will inevitable spell the end of the original Hot Spin slot - why would anyone bother to play that anymore? Anyone in the mood for some retro-themed gaming with a bunch of extras thrown in for good measure will find plenty to be satisfied with here.

title: Cursed Crypt
structured_summary: Cursed Crypt is a dark, Egyptian-themed slot with a spooky, ominous atmosphere distinct from typical Ancient Egypt games. It features spreading Curse symbols that transform reel positions into random symbols, two free spin bonus rounds, and multiple bonus buy options. The reviewer praises its high production values, unique mechanics, and strong winning potential, calling it a solid addition to Hacksaw Gaming's portfolio. The game’s aesthetics combine gloomy visuals with glowing green hues, delivering a haunting and immersive audio-visual experience.
review: Cursed Crypt: Slot OverviewIf you're going to go tooling around in a crypt, maybe do a bit of raiding, or what have you, it might pay to do so in a crypt which is not cursed. But, some people can't help themselves, huh, because here we are, gripping a torch alongside software provider Hacksaw Gaming as we descend into the online slot Cursed Crypt, an Egyptian-themed adventure that spreads random symbols along reels while looking spooky as it does so.If Cursed Crypt has a family member it is related to in the Hacksaw Gaming lineup, it has to be the dread fest that was Hand of Anubis. Both have a dark, dark feel to them, shunning the stereotypical Ancient Egypt vibe often served up in slots to craft one which looks like the robotic species Necrons from the Warhammer 40K universe landed on planet Earth. A gloomy, ominous spirit dominates, split through with glowing green hues, to create a deliciously dark gaming world.Cursed Crypt slot - base gameClicking those up and down buttons next to the spin button is how players can pick a stake of 10 c to $/€100 per spin, while further along to the left is where the bonus buy can be found. When gambling in the normal manner, Cursed Crypt's default RTP is 96.22%, while its volatility is medium-high, rated by its maker as 4 out of 5. To make winning combinations, matching symbols must land from the leftmost side of the grid on at least 3 consecutive reels, and 1,024 ways to win blast the 5-reel, 4-row matrix.If you haven't been scared away yet, here are the pay symbols. The lower values are a set of 5 hieroglyph-style symbols, whereas the higher pays are 5 character/animal symbols. All low pays award 1 times the bet for a 5 OAK result, boosting up to 3-15x the bet for a 5 OAK high pay win. Wilds are present on all reels. They substitute for all regular pays and sling out 20 times the bet for landing a 5 wild winning line.Cursed Crypt: Slot FeaturesCursed Crypt slot - free spinsThere is a ring of familiarity to Cursed Crypt's features as certain symbols spread along reels, bestowing goodness when they go your way. However, instead of springing multipliers or anything like that, the spread brings random symbols instead, both in the base game and in the two bonus rounds. A suite of bonus buys are also available for players who prefer skipping to their favourite parts.Cursed ReelsWhen the Curse symbol lands, it spreads the Curse upwards to the top of the grid, creating Cursed Positions. Cursed Positions are replaced with a random symbol.Wrath of SobekIn the base game, landing 3 FS symbols triggers this feature with 10 free spins. In the Wrath of Sobek round, there is an increased chance of landing Curse symbols. Hitting 2 FS symbols awards +2 free spins while hitting 3 FS symbols awards +4 free spins.Tomb of TutankhamunIndulge your Howard Carter fantasies by landing 4 FS symbols in the base game to trigger 10 free spins in the Tomb of Tutankhamun bonus. In this bonus round, the Curse symbols will only fill Cursed Positions with high-pay symbols or wild symbols. Hitting 2 FS symbols awards +2 free spins while hitting 3 FS symbols awards +4 free spins.Bonus BuysCursed Crypt furnishes players with these bonus buys:BonusHunt FeatureSpins - 3x the bet, each spin is 5 times more likely to trigger a bonus game. RTP 96.35%, very highly volatile.Curse of Three FeatureSpins - 40x the bet, each spin guarantees at least 3 Curse symbols land. RTP 96.34%, highly volatile.Curse of Five FeatureSpins - 150x the bet, each spin guarantees at least 5 Curse symbols land. RTP 96.34%, very highly volatile.Wrath of Sobek - 100x the bet, highly volatile. RTP 96.3%.Tomb of Tutankhamun - 200x the bet, very highly volatile. RTP 96.34%.Cursed Crypt slot - bonus buy menuCursed Crypt: Slot VerdictA twisty, turny path was trodden down before reaching a conclusion on Cursed Crypt. Spoiler alert: the final impression was favourable. In the beginning, reading about special symbols that spread upwards to the top of the reels, dumping identical symbols, just sounded too close to other Hacksaw Gaming slots that perform a similar role, like, oh, dunno, how about Beast Below? Admittedly, from memory, previous slots tended to do so with wild multipliers, so it is tough to accuse Cursed Crypt of doing the exact same thing. However, the spreading upwards effect was close enough to elicit a jaded wee sigh of 'here we go again' before plunging into the action.Good we did, though, because Cursed Crypt's action turned out to be not bad at all. Rather good, actually, for several reasons. The first reason is the high production values and the heavier, spookier, more menacing interpretation of Ancient Egypt than the vast majority of slots making up this genre have. We know Hacksaw Gaming can do light-as-a-feather slots like Om Nom, but it can certainly pull off haunting thrillers like this one. Secondly, the spreading symbols effect might not sound as exciting as spreading wild multipliers, but the potential power play was the way Hacksaw Gaming has jammed a ways to win system into Cursed Crypt instead of going for the usual paylines setup. Like Beam Boys, significant damage can ensue when Curse symbols really do their thing. Demoing Curse of Five FeatureSpins was one fun way of seeing what Curse symbols could do.The features are such that 10,000x the bet winning potential is achievable in all of Cursed Crypt's game modes. There is not much else to say other than Hacksaw Gaming has done it again, pooling its design skills to make another moody, tightly wound slot which stands proudly on the games that preceded it.

title: Cat Wilde in the Eclipse of the Sun God
structured_summary: Cat Wilde in the Eclipse of the Sun God is an adventure-themed slot set in Central America, reminiscent of Gonzo's Quest. The game features cascades, progressive multipliers up to x70, and free spins with scatter collection for extra rewards. The reviewer finds it visually appealing with solid stats but notes it can be slow and lacks engaging energy or personality. A jungle backdrop and rhythmic audio complement the well-crafted graphics and thematic design.
review: Cat Wilde in the Eclipse of the Sun God: Slot OverviewThe intrepid explorer, Cat Wilde, is back for another adventure in a slot with a real mouthful of a name. Cat Wilde in the Eclipse of the Sun God takes the adventurous lady to Central America to find fortune and glory. It’s not the most original of locations to set a slot, and to be honest, a lack of originality permeates many aspects of the game. As you can see, there is a strong whiff of Gonzo's Quest about the venture – the original more so than the Red Tiger Megaways reboot. Still, Gonzo didn't become a classic for nought, so with Play'n GO's dependably high graphic standard accompanied by an attractive leading lady, expectations were running high.The connections to NetEnt's classic are apparent the moment the game lights up. Above the 5-reel, 20-payline game area are the familiar progressive multipliers which spring to life when wins hit – larger than before it should be added. A step pyramid looms over a thick verdant rainforest behind the reels, while a jungle rhythm jams in the background. Pay close attention to the sun in the centre of the sky; you'll be hoping the moon comes to blot it out, signifying a shift into free spins.Since we are dealing with Play'n GO, players can expect a well-built math model, generating an RTP value of 96.22%. This is the default value, of course, so make sure to check the version you plan to fire up as it can be found at lower levels. Bushwhackers should be prepared for medium volatility which can be experienced on any device offering stakes from 20 p/c to $/€100.Big chunky symbols make up the paytable, divided between low pay 10 to Aces, followed by high pay sundials, keys, skulls, and Cat as the most valuable. Five of a kind wins are worth 6 to 37.5x the bet for premium combinations, though values drop sharply for four of a kind. At least three adjacent symbols from the first reel are needed to form a winning combination. Sun God wilds are handy for this, landing on reels 2, 3, and 4 in the base game to substitute for any symbol except the scatter. They are also worth 100x the bet for five of a kind – the only length of combination they pay out on by the way.Cat Wilde in the Eclipse of the Sun God: Slot Features﻿Gonzo on roids is a pretty accurate description of Cat Wilde in the Eclipse of the Sun God, and that assessment is a fair one of the features. They start with cascades, lead to progressive multipliers, and both get a boost when free spins trigger.Starting with cascades, which activate after every win, removing winning symbols so new ones can drop in, potentially leading to more combinations. This mechanic is available in all phases of the game with the cascading effect continuing until no new winners appear.While this is going on a win multiplier is in play. It starts at x1 for the initial win, then rises through x2, x4, x6 then x10 following consecutive winning cascades. When a sequence ends, the multiplier drops back to x1.Keep an eye out for the Moon Goddess scatter symbols - 10 free spins are awarded when they appear on reels 1, 3, and 5 simultaneously. The multiplier remains in use in free spins, only this time the top-level becomes x70. Scatters also become wild as well and are collected whenever they land. Collecting 5 scatters awards 5 extra spins, up to a maximum of 40. Also, the win multiplier is upgraded when 5 scatters are collected, though the highest remains x70. A final point is that wilds land on any reel during the bonus round.Cat Wilde in the Eclipse of the Sun God: Slot VerdictAs mentioned, expectations were high and the game is fun, but it can also get kind of bogged down and struggle to find the energy to recover. It doesn't stop Cat Wilde in the Eclipse of the Sun God from being a reliably good looking Play'n GO release that produces a strong set of stats. The gameplay isn't bad either - of course being lifted out of the Gonzo playbook helps. Play'n GO has expanded multipliers which make a huge difference. Yet, despite its many positive points, unless you get it to go off, Cat Wilde in the Eclipse of the Sun God isn't an all-around exciting game.The main problem is how slow it can be. It's like the game expects you to provide the energy rather than be a high-octane, or even medium-octane slot that gets you pumped. If it were any more laid back, it'd be lain flat, fast asleep. There's certainly none of Gonzo's amiable antics. In his place, we get Cat, who is easier on the eyes than Gonzo (sorry bud), yet she's such a non-event in this slot as to be virtually absent giving the game an almost generic feel. If Play'n GO had dropped Cat altogether and replaced her symbol with a can of paint, it wouldn't have made any difference. Here, she comes across as someone who has gotten by just fine on their looks so never needed to develop a personality or a sense of humour. It’s as if she thinks her smile is enough to deactivate booby traps in a hidden tomb or make the locals lower their bows.For a different take on the Gonzo thing, it's worth a look. Potential is up thanks to bigger multipliers and free spins which can go mental to produce significant wins. However, while Cat Wilde in the Eclipse of the Sun God is capable of satisfying moments, and hosts a bonus round that can go nuts, it is also noticeably lacklustre a lot of the time.

title: Ivory Citadel
structured_summary: Ivory Citadel is a Western Asian-themed slot set in an exotic, wild world inspired by western India. The game features 20 paylines, medium volatility, a Mystery Symbol, stacked sticky wilds, and a free spins bonus round. The reviewer finds it visually appealing with solid bonus features but overall a safe, middle-of-the-road slot lacking high excitement or big win potential. The aesthetics include muscular stone-style symbols, spirit-like wild beasts, a misty jungle backdrop, and a fitting jungle beat soundtrack.
review: Ivory Citadel (Just For The Win): OverviewJust for the Win’s latest slot Ivory Citadel is located in a part of the world that doesn’t usually get much slot traffic - Western Asia. Asian themed slots abound but are usually set in China, Japan, or somewhere in the East. A quick Google search revealed that Western Asia includes countries such as Iran, Iraq, Pakistan and India. Not exactly countries that are used as slot themes too often. Judging by the scenery and the symbols involved, it feels like Ivory Citadel is based in the western parts of India perhaps? Wherever it is, Just for the Win has put a heavy emphasis on just how wild, and exotic this slot world is.It’s always nice to try something new, and Western Asia possesses its fair share of exotic locations to be sure. We get one as the background to the game which looks like the flying mountains from the movie Avatar. Rocky outcrops thrust into the sky surrounding the Ivory Tower with an entrance guarded by stone elephants. Throw in some mist and a jungle beat and the mood is set.Intrepid explorers can take on the wildlife with bets from 10 c/p to $/€100 per spin of its 5 reels. The gameplay favours the more laid back player with 20 paylines, and a decent RTP of 96.03% combined with medium volatility. With a low max potential and a hit rate of 1/4.45, wins are steady if a tad on the lower side, generally speaking.The 8 base game symbols are made up of J, Q, K and A Royals crafted in a muscular stone style. Next are three wilds beasts that do not look happy to see people on their patch - a snake, a buffalo, and a tiger. title: Piggy Luck
structured_summary: Piggy Luck is a bright, pig-themed slot centered on positive vibes and simple gameplay. review: Piggy Luck: Slot OverviewDid you know that saying the word 'pig' on a boat is considered by some people to be bad luck on account of pigs not being able to swim? Dropping the p-word on a boat could lead to a smack on the nose since drawing blood is believed by some to be one way of reversing the curse. In the gambling world, it's quite the opposite, where pigs are commonly associated with cash and high living. Hopefully, our porky pals are lucky as they take centre stage in an online slot from Microgaming partner and independent developer Gong Gaming Technologies, titled Piggy Luck.Pigs are no strangers to the reels and are often portrayed as upper-class members of society. Piggy Bank Bills and Piggy Riches Megaways are two examples of pigs living it up in mansions, surrounded by the finer things in life. Piggy Luck isn't like that. It's more about bright colours, simply laid out to exude a positive attitude. Sad to say, a few spins in, our positivity crumbled fast. Essentially, players get a 5x3 grid matrix, a glowing logo down below, plus three pigs with meters up top.Possibly to help distract players from the lack of visual cues, Piggy Luck has a high hit rate of 49.19%, so nearly every second spin will theoretically be a winner. This flurry of hits is combined with a low volatile math model and a maximum return to player value of 95.12%, with 58.62% allocated to the base game and the rest to the features. Piggy Luck is available to play on any device and has bet choices of 20 p/c to $/€25 per spin.In the spirit of minimalism, just six pay symbols are used in the game, forming wins when matching tiles land on one of the 20 paylines, beginning from the left side of the panel. The three lower pay symbols are Q, K, and A, while the higher pays are crowns, stars, and diamonds. Landing five of a kind awards players 5x the bet for the low pays, or 7.5-12.5x the bet for the three high pays. Wilds are worth even more, up to 50x the bet for a line of five of them, plus they can be used to replace any normal pay symbol to complete a winning line.Piggy Luck: Slot FeaturesThe three piggy personalities displayed above the reels represent the features triggerable in Piggy Luck – Golden Path, free spins, and Cash Collect. In addition, players can activate a Wheel of Luck feature to gamble their way to the three bonus rounds.Golden PathLanding 3 Piggy King symbols on reels 2, 3, and 4 triggers the Golden Path feature. A ladder of prizes appears, as does a 6-segment wheel with the numbers 1-6 on each segment. The wheel spins, showing players how many steps they move along the prize ladder. After every spin, the lowest number on the wheel turns to Collect. The feature ends when the arrow on the ladder lands on Collect. Where players are on the ladder is the prize amount awarded.Free SpinsA total of 3 Piggy Queen symbols in view on reels 3, 4, and 5 awards 15 free spins. While the feature is active, landing 3 Piggy Queen symbols retriggers an additional +15 free spins. That's pretty much all there is to the free spins game.Cash CollectHit 3 Piggy Joker symbols on reels 1, 2, and 3 to trigger the Cash Collect feature. Here, 20 coins are placed on the screen. Players pick them one by one to reveal multipliers of the bet. The feature ends when a picked coin reveals a cash value and a tick. Then the sum of all multipliers is awarded.Wheel of LuckOn top of the grid in the base game are 3 wheels, each one corresponding to the free spins, Cash Collect, and Golden Path features. Each wheel has 2 segments – a trigger area and a non-feature area. Players collect Joker, King, and Piggy Queen symbols to increase the respective trigger area on the wheel. Each wheel can be spun for the cost of 10x the bet, and if the wheel arrow stops in the trigger area of the wheel, the feature will begin. Filling in the trigger area of a Wheel automatically starts the feature. One more thing to look out for is the wolf's paw symbol. This symbol resets the trigger area of the wheel it lands beneath.Piggy Luck: Slot VerdictPiggy Luck looked kind of brightly fun, to begin with, but this perception quickly morphed into one of exasperated tedium in a short space of time. The low volatile math model and low bonus round award values meant relatively fast feature triggers that tended to go nowhere. In some cases, not nowhere fast. For example, the first free spins trigger produced three further retriggers, and the total was 60 of the dullest free spins we'd ploughed through in a while. The end result wasn't exactly a kick in the teeth, but 60 spins to mount a 79.6x the bet win felt more like work than fun. As mentioned in the game sheet, free spins can theoretically be retriggered 'infinitely', which is a frightening thought.The Cash Collect felt just as pointless. You do know you are going to win something; however, you also know you are going to win something small. Go all the way to max The Cash Collect out by successfully picking all of the coins, and you're looking at a top prize of 39x the bet.Lastly, we've got the Golden Path, which does have a decent top prize. Yet, something doesn't sit right when you do the maths. The ladder has 36 steps, yet when adding all the numbers on the wheel, the total comes to 21. Perhaps filling the Golden Path meter in the base game helps players progress, but this wasn't the way the demo functioned, and by then, it was sort of a moot point anyway.Have you ever been driving along a straight piece of road and felt like you were going backwards when the car was, in reality, moving forwards? There was a similar sense produced while playing Piggy Luck. If you don't like its light, frequent style, it's hard to throw off the impression Piggy Luck is a waste of time.

Here, Relax Gaming has deviated from the scatter pays system of Banana Town by using a connected ways pay system instead. However, one of the main goals remains collecting winning symbol types to increment the respective multiplier in the hopes of getting further wins with the same kind of symbols in order to trigger a snowballing sequence of events.Not a super common occurrence, perhaps, but it can happen, and the max multipliers in Totem Guardians Dream Drop are potentially higher than they are able to get in Banana Town. That'd buy a lot of woodland retreats.As for gamblers who don't win the big one, which means the vast majority, Totem Guardians Dream Drop offers some decent action to accompany any DD-induced anticipation. Totem Guardians Dream Drop isn't one of Relax Gaming's biggies, but it evolves the symbol multiplier feature, this time with connected ways, and the totem, spirit, guardian angle has been presented quite nicely.

title: Beheaded
structured_summary: Beheaded is a dark, soul-filled slot themed around a shipwreck survivor facing a soul-devouring Tzantza collector. review: Beheaded: Slot OverviewShipwrecks, ay? There are a lot of reasons why you wouldn't want to find yourself in that situation. For example, one nightmare shipwreck scenario plays out in software provider Nolimit City's online slot Beheaded. After this particular ship went down, a single survivor washed ashore on a tropical island, but there was no lounging about in a hammock drinking coconut juice through a bamboo straw until they were rescued. Beheaded is not a comedy, then, in other words. It's actually a very dark, soul-filled world where danger dwells around every corner. It's also an offshoot of Nolimit City's slot Blood & Shadow, which appeared to produce polarising reactions amongst certain gamblers when it was released. In such a case, Blood & Shadow is then, to an extent, a litmus test as to how you'll respond to Beheaded, too. Not 100%, though, since the gameplay found in the two games is far from being totally the same.One thing that is the same is the 10 out of 10, 'Insane', 'Extreme' volatility. Beheaded ain't no Sunday stroll through the park consuming an ice cream-type slot, as you might imagine. The maximum RTP comes in at 95.99%-96.03% when betting 20 c to $/€100 per spin, or 96%-96.04% when using the xBet. The xBet doubles the stake when activated, making it three times more likely to trigger Tzantza Spins - it always starts at Level 1. Beheaded's setup is 4 rows of symbols on a 5-reel grid, with up to 178 connected ways to win. Winning combinations and the symbols below them on each reel fall down, allowing new symbols to fall in.Bony 10-A card royals are Beheaded's low-pay symbols, worth 0.15 to 0.75 times the bet for 5 OAK. Then there are 5 head/skull medium symbols, paying 0.9-1.5x for five-of-a-kind, as well as 5 blue, glowing high-pay heads/skull, worth up to 3 to 9 times the bet. Wilds may be present on any reel, substituting for all regular paying symbols.Beheaded: Slot FeaturesBeheaded slot - normal spinsBeheaded's first important feature to get to grips with is its Progression bar. The bar has 5 levels of progression. The bar resets for each level up, and any exceeding collections are carried over. Falling down wild, high, or medium pay symbols advance the Progression bar: Level 1 - 15, Level 2 - 25, Level 3 - 50, Level 4 - 80, Level 5 - 110. A wild symbol is worth +3 per winning symbol, high pays are worth +2 per winning symbol, and medium pays are worth +1 per winning symbol. Each level converts medium pay symbols to high pay symbols.Landing 3 dropped scatter symbols progress the player to Tzantza Spins, awarding +6 spins. For each skipped level, players win +2 free spins. The Progression bar resets for each new game round.Soul WildsThere are 3 Soul Wilds with individual Soul Collectors that collect the Souls from dropped high-pay symbols after a win. The Soul Wild feature is enabled in the following order:Level 1 - Happy Soul Wild, requires a total of 4 souls to be activated.Level 3 - Sad Soul Wild, requires a total of 10 souls to be activated.Level 5 - Angry Soul Wild, requires a total of 18 souls to be activated.Soul Wilds are only activated if no more Souls can be collected and its collector has been filled. The number of activated Soul Wilds determines the size of the Wild Zone - 1x1, 2x2, or 3x3, and multiplies the general multiplier by 1, 2, or 3, respectively. The general multiplier resets after this event. All scatters in Wild Zones award +1 free spin each. The Soul Wilds Collector is reset when it does not collect enough Souls or is activated, until the next spin.Beheaded slot - Pick-A-PotionAyahuasca SpinsReaching a new Progression bar level awards +2 free spins till level 4 or +6 free spins when advancing to Tzantza Spins. However, buying Ayahuasca Spins instantly progresses the Progression bar to level 3 and awards +6 Ayahuasca Spins. Three of the medium pay symbols are replaced with 3 high pay symbols.Tzantza SpinsBuying Tzantza Spins instantly progresses the Progression bar to level 5 and awards +10 Tzantza Spins. All medium-paying symbols are replaced with high-pay symbols.Pick A PotionWhen Tzantza Spins end without achieving the max win, players are presented with 2 choices. One is the Butterfly Bottle, guaranteeing a win of 5 to 8,000 times the base bet. The other is the Skull Bottle, which gambles the accumulated win for a chance of winning the max win or losing it all. The higher the accumulated win, the better the chance of winning the max win.Nolimit BonusNot so many choices this time, where alongside the xBet, Beheaded's Nolimit Bonus offers these:6 Ayahuasca Spins - 100x the bet. RTP 96%-06.03%.10 Tzantza Spins - 500x the bet. RTP 95.94%-96.08%.Lucky Draw - 225x the bet. RTP 95.99%-96.17%.Beheaded slot - Tzantza SpinsBeheaded: Slot VerdictNolimit City had a blinder of a run through the first half of 2024, dropping big swinging slots such as Fire in the Hole 2, Brick Snake 2000, Loner, and others. Beheaded, whilst a very clever game, felt at points like it tugged the average quality, or at least the average enjoyment level, down a notch or two. The main reason is that, initially, it just wasn't as fun to play as others have been this year. Beheaded brought back strong memories of Blood & Shadow, not great ones, a little scary ones, actually, though the game did improve as time passed and understanding of what was going on increased. Make no bones about it: Beheaded is a slot that wants nothing more than to rip the head off anyone brave enough to take it on, boil the noggin in a big pot, shrink it down to size, then display the new trophy in a collection of others it has managed to gauge out of the gambling community.Jesting? A little bit, not entirely, though, since Beheaded is happy inhabiting the more brutal segment of the online slot scale. Its theme perfectly matches the mechanics in this case. Like Blood & Shadow, organically progressing through to the upper levels is not the easiest task ever set and might even evoke feelings of frustration should users get caught in a loop, like a treadmill stuck on the wrong speed. It might be worth considering using the xBet when taking on Beheaded. The cost is double the bet, fair enough, but the entertainment levels during the test session were far greater than 2x. In part, this was because unenhanced betting was a little dry a lot of the time. Collections didn't seem to go far; big features also felt few and far between, causing a very noticeable difference between xBet off and xBet on.No doubt, anything is possible no matter the mode, and who knows? Patience might be rewarded no matter how someone chooses to play Beheaded. Might not, though. It helps when you've got a handle on the features so you know more or less what to expect. At best, this means expecting a pretty sweet combo of mechanics such as symbol drops, big wild symbols, collections, free spins, and win multiplier, pushing out wins as high as 15,950x the bet. Risk your winnings for the chance of hitting max win at the end of Tzantza Spins, or pick the guaranteed win of the Butterfly Bottle? Just to be clear, any wins from the Butterfly Bottle are added to those accumulated during the free spins round, making it the far 'safer' choice. So while the max win frequency looks quite decent on paper, this particular gamble option will undoubtedly burn a lot of players.As is often the case from Nolimit City, Beheaded is chock full of clever ideas, throws out confrontational subject matter, and is jam-packed with smart gameplay. It was harder to warm to than much of what Nolimit City had released earlier in the year and before, but some gamblers might relish the challenge Beheaded presents and look forward to taking some (virtual) heads of their own.

title: The Trolls' Treasure

review: The Trolls' Treasure: Slot OverviewIf you've ever been tooling around the Norse folklore section in your local slot line-up and had a craving for something that doesn't involve divinities or heroes, The Trolls' Treasure from ReelPlay might be an alternative. Both trigger naturally or may be bought.Wheel BonusThis feature is awarded when 3 Wheel Bonus symbols land on reels 2, 3, and 4. Played on a barrel type object with 4 wheels split into segments, each segment displays a bet multiplier, and on the first three wheels, each segment has an arrow pointing left or right. When a wheel stops spinning, the bet multiplier is collected, and players move one wheel to the left or right depending on which way the arrow points. Moving off the wheel to the left ends the feature, and the total bet multiplier is awarded. Making it to the rightmost wheel ends the feature - after the wheel spins once more and adds its value to the total bet multiplier. Prizes on the wheels can be 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 10, 20x, 50x, or 1,000x.Free SpinsLanding 3 scatters in view on reels 1, 3, and 5 awards 15 free spins. It is possible to win the Wheel Bonus from a free spin.Buy BonusIf available, players can opt to buy either of the bonus rounds. The Trolls' Treasure looks so disarmingly nice it's hard to get cross with it. The features aren't red hot wonders, though they do the job and suit the overall cheeky vibe. Also, bonus buy players hunting around for a bargain might be enticed by the relatively thrifty price tags. After being stunned by the 3,000x feature buy in Tombstone RIP (as an extreme example), the 17x for the Wheel or 31.2x for 15 free spins feels positively quaint. For anyone interested in experiencing an aspect of Norse mythology other than gods, goddesses, or muscle-bound warriors, or are looking for something chilled with solids stats, The Trolls' Treasure makes a certain amount of sense.

Picking held reels can be kind of fun, and you don't have to pay extra like you do with features such as HyperSpins from Triple Edge/Microgaming, where repeated use can get pricey. Here, it's free. title: Lucy Luck and the Crimson Diamond
structured_summary:
1. Lucy Luck and the Crimson Diamond is an Amazon jungle exploration slot featuring the adventurous character Lucy Luck hunting for the Crimson Diamond.  
2. The game offers a 6x6 grid with scatter pays, Avalanches, treasure chests with bet multipliers, bonus Bomb symbols, free spins, and optional Fast Track and Burst Mode bonus buys.

review: Lucy Luck and the Crimson Diamond: Slot OverviewConsidering the masses and masses… and masses of online slots milling about the market, it's kind of interesting there aren't more superstar slot characters. A few exist, like John Hunter, Gonzo, Kane and Rich Wilde, for example, but maybe not as many as there could be. Seeking to rectify this imbalance is software designer Slotmill, with its new explorer, Lucy Luck. The first game in the series is Lucy Luck and the Crimson Diamond, which sees the plucky protagonist venturing forth into the Amazonian jungle to hunt for the Crimson Diamond.Lucy strikes a valiant, take no crap pose on the home page, and comes across as part Lara Croft, Cat Wilde, Indiana Jones, part Jinx. From the splash screen, players plunge into a jungle where a fairly regular though pleasant view of the Amazon hits the screen. Bush, carved stone blocks, that's about it, really making Lucy Luck and the Crimson Diamond closer in vibe to Coin Quest rather than Coin Quest 2, which was arguably the more atmospheric of the two CQ games. Not being Slotmill's first trip to this part of the world means there were expectations of more visually arresting artwork, but Lucy Luck and the Crimson Diamonds looks pleasing. Gets the job done.Lucy Luck and the Crimson Diamond slot - base gameOperating behind the scenes to ensure tasks are accomplished is Lucy Luck's highly volatile math model, which generates an RTP of 95.5%. The gaming takes place on a 6x6 grid, which utilises a scatter pays mechanic to create regular wins. When at least 8 matching symbols are in view, anywhere on the reels, then a win is created. Players are able to select a stake of 20 p/c to $/€60, plus there are three bonus buys available from the Fast Track, as well as Burst Mode.The symbols players encounter when hunting for the Crimson Diamond are 9 regular pays, a Bonus, and a Super Bonus symbol. The pays are a book, a grappling hook, a compass, binoculars, 4 different gemstones, then Lucy is the highest value one. Hitting a scatter win made up of 8 symbols awards 0.3 to 1 times the bet, while the biggest 16+ scatter wins award 20 to 250 times the bet. Wilds do not exist in this part of the bush.Lucy Luck and the Crimson Diamond: Slot FeaturesLucy Luck and the Crimson Diamond slot - free spinsGetting lucky in this game means features like Avalanches, treasure chests, bonus Bomb symbols, super bonus Bomb symbols, and free spins are popping. As well as the in-game extras are optional Fast Track bonus modes and Burst Mode.AvalancheAll symbols part of a win explode, removing any blocks beneath them, and making way for new or existing symbols to fall downwards to fill the grid. This provides another chance to win on the same spin, and runs of Avalanches end when no new winning scatter appears.Treasure ChestsTreasure Chests of varying sizes are placed in random positions beneath the symbols on the reels. When winning symbols explode, part or all of a treasure chest may be revealed by destroying the blocks that cover them. When a treasure chest is completely revealed, it awards the prize it holds within. This will either be coins or a diamond possessing a bet multiplier. There are three tiers of treasure chests, and the more valuable and larger the treasure chest, the more valuable its contents. The size of the chest determines how many coins are awarded, and if a chest has a diamond, only one diamond will be awarded regardless of how big the chest is. The blue diamond pays between 50x - 200x while the Crimson Diamond pays between 500x - 10,000x.Bonus Symbol BombIf a Bomb symbol is on the reels, when no more wins appear, it explodes, removing itself and adjacent symbols revealing any treasure chests beneath them. The bonus Bomb symbol removes 4 adjacent symbols – up, down, left, and right, while the super bonus Bomb symbol clears direct neighbouring symbol locations. After exploding, the bonus Bomb symbol is added to the Bonus collect meter.Free SpinsCollecting 3 bonus Bomb symbols awards 10 free spins. During free spins, cleared blocks carry over between free spins. After all treasure chests have been revealed, the grid reset with new blocks and chests, plus 1 free spin is awarded. A multiplier symbol may land during free spins. When one hits, it explodes, removing the block beneath it and adding +1 to the multiplier meter. The multiplier is applied to prizes from revealed treasure chests and is persistent till the round ends.Super Free SpinsA total of 10 super free spins are awarded when 2 bonus Bomb symbols plus 1 super bonus Bomb symbol is collected. The rules are the same, except only Tier 3 treasure chests are hidden beneath the blocks.Burst Mode & Fast TrackBurst Mode is a super fast way of playing Lucy Luck and the Crimson Diamond, where players pick a bet and a number of spins, then the math model plays out with little graphical overlay. From the Fast Track, players are able to buy:Bonus Boost – 4x the bet for a spin with at least 1 guaranteed Bonus symbol. Very highly volatile with an RTP of 96.02%.Bonus – buy the bonus round for 100x the bet. Highly volatile with an RTP of 96.15%.Super Bonus – buy a super bonus round for 400x the bet. Very highly volatile with an RTP of 96.29%.Lucy Luck and the Crimson Diamond slot - free spinsLucy Luck and the Crimson Diamond: Slot VerdictAs a first outing for a potential future slot superstar, Lucy Luck and the Crimson Diamond is an interesting debut. One of the curious things about the game is the way it resembles NetEnt's Lost Relics slots. If Lucy Luck and the Crimson Diamond had been released a bit earlier, it would have beaten Lost Relics 2 to market, and the comparisons might have been lessened. As it is, either Slotmill really took a liking to Lost Relics' revealing treasure chest concept, or it's just a coincidence – which is a tad hard to believe. Either way, Lucy's already stirring controversy, and it's only her first game.Suffice to say, if unearthing treasure chests in those other games brought a smile to your face, then Lucy Luck and the Crimson Diamond is likely to do so as well. The scatter pays awards system brings a new dimension to the smashing of blocks procedure as your eye wanders over the grid, teeing up spots where you want wins to occur - without the need for matching symbols to be near them since scatter wins can hit anywhere. Treasure chest awards are limited in some ways, since they only award bet multipliers, though the values can potentially be rather high indeed. For example, the most sought-after chunk of stone is the Crimson Diamond itself, worth up to a cool 10,000x the bet right there, which incidentally is Lucy Luck and the Crimson Diamond max win figure.While there are no complaints about the way Lucy Luck and the Crimson Diamond performs, it feels like something might be missing. The game does have a fair amount of features, but not so much variety, if that's the right word? Maybe it's because the chests in Lost Relics 2 could award a bunch of different things, not just bet multiplier prizes. Again, no major complaints. Lucy Luck performed admirably on her debut and all that, but there was a sneaky suspicion Slotmill already has its eye on sequels for which they've held back some of the really good stuff.

title: Vampires vs Wolves
structured_summary: Vampires vs Wolves is a gothic-themed slot set in misty Victorian London, featuring a vampire versus werewolf rivalry. The game centers on a free spins feature where players choose between two volatile modes, with no base game bonuses. The reviewer found the gameplay thrilling at times but criticized the low maximum win and lack of features, making it feel somewhat tedious. review: Vampires vs Wolves (Pragmatic Play): OverviewMany online slot themes are so strongly associated with individual games that players will automatically hold new releases to the high standards of these classics. When it comes to the supernatural world of vampires, it's hard not to think of Microgaming's 2011 super hit Immortal Romance which, in large part, thanks to its legendary soundtrack and unique narrative, is considered one of the truly greatest online slots ever released. Due to this, it's not unlikely to think that players have certain expectations when faced with themes they might be familiar with from before. With the soundtrack in Vampire vs Wolves being good enough to please most cork sniffers, we're off to a promising start.Powered by Pragmatic Play, Vampire vs Wolves is a fairly simple 5 reel slot with 10 paylines that can be played across all devices from 10 cents up to 50€ per spin. With no base game features, all focus is on the free spins game where you'll be forced to make a decision - fight alongside the vampires or join the werewolves. Ultimately, it'll come down to whether you're a risk taker or someone who likes to play it more safe.Set in what could very well be Victorian London on a hauntingly misty night, you get a chance to encounter Pragmatic's stylishly fashionable gothic-looking vampires. Having slagged the studio lately for its rather generic material, it's refreshing to finally see a slot of decent quality. With a spooky, but equally superb, soundtrack to set the mood, symbols on the reels include traditional card suit symbols in gemstone design. More rewarding are the picture symbols which are represented by the lead antagonists, of which the white-haired bloke is the most valuable, giving you 80 times your stake for 5 of a kind. There's also the all-important wild symbol which substitutes for all regular symbols - 5 of them on a full payline will add a 100 times your stake payout to your win collection.Vampires vs Wolves (Pragmatic Play): FeaturesFree spins round in actionTriggering the Free Spins feature here is a bit unusual as it only comes with two scatters, albeit stacked. If the howling wolf scatter appears to fully cover reel 1 in combination with the haunted mansion on reel 5, the free spins round will come into play where you'll get to pick either the Wolf Free Spins or Vampire Free Spins.The Wolf Free Spins round is the slightly less volatile option and will let you play a total of 14 spins that cannot be re-triggered. Here, three of the vampire symbols transform into werewolves, which effectively means they're turned into the same symbol, thus increasing your chance of landing a wild line since they all share the same value as the wild.The Vampire Free Spins round is a little bit more volatile and will set you off with only 8 spins which are also not possible to re-trigger. During this feature, when a vampire symbol with a red border (there are three of them) appears on the reels, it can randomly turn into a sticky wild and remain locked in place throughout the feature.Vampires vs Wolves (Pragmatic Play): VerdictMerely a few minutes into our session, we managed to drop our first bonus and, being the degenerates that we are, opted for the more volatile option. Watching the screen fill up with sticky wilds was, of course, a thrilling experience and walking away with an 800 xbet win undoubtedly warmed up our hearts to the game. However, during our later sessions, we also got to experience the blood-sucking side of the slot.There are some downsides to this game, in our opinion at least. First of all, the potential is too low to really make it worthwhile - 1000 times your stake doesn't really cut it, especially given the fact that it's quite volatile. A few of our testers also felt that the main game was a bit tedious and that the lack of features made it pretty much an all or nothing slot, resembling classic Novomatic in that sense. If you enjoy the music and excellent design as much as we did, you'll be fine. If not, Vampires vs Wolves will probably be a real pain in the neck for you.

title: Sweet Gummy
structured_summary: Sweet Gummy is a pastel candy-themed slot featuring cute monster characters set in a dreamy pink sweet shop. It offers a unique Wild Reel with multipliers and cloning wilds, plus free spins where wilds stick or move down the grid. review: Sweet Gummy: Slot OverviewSoftware provider AvatarUX has indulged its candy fantasies and come up with the sugar-encrusted online slot Sweet Gummy. For a studio that has explored the cuter side of life in a number of its games (Critter Pop, Kitty POPpins, Worms of Valor, for example), you have to go back to 2022's PopWins slot LolliPop to find the last sweet slot of theirs we reviewed. For today's game, Sweet Gummy, the sweets are back, but PopWins are not. In its place are cute monster characters and a Wild Reel, which is able to add multipliers to wild symbols and clone wild symbols.Sweet Gummy is set in a blurry, pink sweet shop as if seen through the eyes of someone who has overdone the gummy bears and is about to pass over from full consciousness into a blissed-out gelatine haze where everything feels right with the world. Just kidding, of course, it pays not to overdo the candy. Sweet Gummy doesn't really overdo the candy either, in that it's not one of those slots which takes place in an all-you-can-eat sugar land. The inclusion of monster character symbols adds a tangent, but Sweet Gummy remains a cute, pastel candy game, no doubt.Sweet Gummy slot - base gameA 5x5 grid is the main gaming area, while next to it is a special Wild Reel covered in blank spaces and/or reward symbols. Across the reels, 40 paylines are what Sweet Gummy uses to calculate winning combinations of 3 to 5 of a kind. Beneath the outer shell, in the heart of this lolly, is a medium volatile math model, generating a theoretical RTP of 96%. Wins in Sweet Gummy begin from the leftmost reel, paying left to right.Sweet Gummy: Slot FeaturesSweet Gummy slot - free spinsThe goal of Sweet Gummy is to get wilds on the main reels, then affect them with added multipliers, as well as a cloning process via rewards from the Wild Reel. In free spins, wilds stay on the screen, either moving down a position or being sticky for a spin, which can be bought or naturally triggered.Wild ReelTo the left of the main grid is a Reward Reel. On each spin, the Wild Reel lands reward symbols or blank spaces. Each reward applies to wild symbols on the same row as it on the main grid. Rewards are applied from the bottom of the Wild Reel up. The Wild Reel Rewards are:Multiplier Wild - all wilds on the row get a multiplier as shown on the symbol.Clone Wild - each wild on the row is cloned a number of times, as shown on the symbol.Multiplier and Clone Wild - all wilds on the row get a Multiplier and are cloned to random positions across the reels.WildsWilds may land on any reel, substituting for any regular pay symbols. If a wild has a multiplier, it applies to the total win of each payline it is part of. When more than one wild is part of the same win, the multiplier values are added together. During the clone process, if a wild lands on an existing wild, they merge, and any multiplier values are added.Free SpinsFree spins are triggered by collecting at least 2 scatter symbols. When free spins are triggered, the scatter symbols transform into wilds. On each spin, wild symbols on the reels move down one position until they leave from the bottom row. New wilds can still hit. Randomly, any number of wilds can become sticky for the spin, retaining their current position. When scatter symbols hit, each one awards +1 free spin.XpressThe Xpress is where users are able to activate four bonus buys, plus the ante bet: Bonus - 60x the bet for 5 free spins and 2 starting wilds. Bonus Plus - 120x the bet for 7 free spins and 3 starting wilds. Bonus Ultra - 250x the bet for 9 free spins and 4 starting wilds. Bonus Max - 500x the bet for 12 free spins and 5 starting wilds.Sweet Gummy slot - free spinsSweet Gummy: Slot VerdictHere is something you don't see every day: a non-PopWins AvatarUX slot that does not have the Mr Wu stamp on it. And the result? Well, despite having used the word twenty or so times already, Sweet Gummy is actually a rather sweet game, with a handful of delights for candy-minded players to sink their gnashers into. In the past, AvatarUX has treated gamblers to a rewards reel concept in the form of the ZapReel, as seen in LooneyPop, for example. However, the two reward reel mechanisms are quite different to each other in various ways, and this variety, having two separate systems to choose from, is no bad thing.The positives of the Wild Reel in Sweet Gummy are apparent at times in the base game. When you manage to line a reward symbol up with a wild or two, tastes of the potential are hinted at. When free spins are activated, the game steps up several notches, and on a side note, natural triggers occurred relatively often during the review, which was appreciated. What made the bonus round interesting was the way wild symbols drop a position (or stick) on each spin, so they are able to stack their multiplier values on their journey down the grid. Since new wilds may also land, or existing wilds can be cloned, it is possible to have a substantial number of multiplier wilds on the board. Okay, Sweet Gummy doesn't have a ways to win pay system, which AvatarUX usually favours, but 40 paylines turned out to be a useful amount, and the max win is 10,000x the bet.There was a hint of Pragmatic Play's Candy Blitz Bomb to Sweet Gummy, but only a hint, never a feeling that AvatarUX was out to steal ideas like Arthur Slugworth ripping off recipes from Willy Wonka. Having conquered the PopWins, replacing winning symbols with two to grow the reels space, AvatarUX has again shown its talent for injecting excitement into a slot via a separate rewards reel.

title: Megaways Jack Frost

review: Megaways Jack Frost: Slot OverviewIf you like things that are cold, or snow, or ice, or winter in general, then maybe you'd be best buds with Jack Frost, who is/was said to be the personification of all those things, and more. He's also the star in Megaways Jack Frost, an online slot from developer Iron Dog Studio. It's funny… Megaways Jack Frost sounds very close to Megaways Jack, one of Iron Dog Studios' early Megaways slots, and given the developer's track record, imagine our surprise to realise this wasn't a clone of that game. Hol' up though, after inspecting the next candidate on the list, yep, Megaways Jack Frost is indeed a reskin of another Jack and the Beanstalk slot from Iron Dog, namely, Megaways Jack And The Magic Beans.Where the previous Jack game was held in a fecund green field with a massive beanstalk reaching up to the sky, Megaways Jack Frost takes place in an icy land of falling snow, snow-covered trees, mountains, clouds, and a snow-covered house. In other words, there's a lot of snow about the place. Like Megaways Jack And The Magic Beans, this game's got a charming feel to it, and according to Wikipedia, Jack Frost may have roots in Anglo-Saxon and Norse customs of winter. He was named in literature in 'Round About Our Coal Fire', published in 1734, and from then… oh, sorry, there won't be a test on this later. It's just that some games encourage deeper investigation. At times, it's because the topic is so fascinating. Other times, it's because there's not much else to say. In the case of Megaways Jack Frost, it was a little bit of both.Megaways Jack Frost slot - base gameIf you can handle the on-screen cold temperatures, taking part in Megaways Jack Frost means picking a stake of 10 c to $/€20 per paid game round. Like its predecessor, this is a highly volatile gambling machine, producing an RTP of 96.14% by default, rising up to as high as 96.5% when buying free spins. Run by Megaways under licence from Big Time Gaming, Megaways Jack Frost's grid lands 2 to 7 symbols on each of its 6 reels, translating to win ways of up to 117,649.Whenever a way win pays out, the winning symbols are destroyed, and other symbols drop down to replace them. They are 10 through A card ranks as the lows, then a snowflake, frozen fruit, a bird with a bowtie, reindeer, and a boy as the high pays. Filling the grid from one side to the other with a 6 OAK winning way pays 0.6 to 1 times the bet when achieved by the low pays or 2 to 25 times the bet for the picture symbols. In the base game, wilds appear on reels 2-5, while in the bonus game, they land on reels 2-6. The wild's job is to substitute for any of the regular pay symbols to help create wins.Megaways Jack Frost: Slot FeaturesMegaways Jack Frost slot - splash screenGoing hand in hand with Megaways is a tumble feature, as well as a special Jack Frost symbol, Jack Frost features, free spins, and buy options.Special Jack Frost SymbolThe special Jack Frost symbol can trigger features in the base game and in free spins. In the base game, it guarantees a win by creating a winline made of low pays, high pays, or wilds. In free spins, it can trigger a random feature from the Jack Frost Feature list.Jack Frost FeaturesThe possible features from the Jack Frost Features list are these, triggered per symbol if it lands on the reels:Additional free spins are awarded.An additional multiplier is awarded.An additional locked reel is awarded.An additional reel for the Jack Frost symbol to land on is awarded, progressing left to right from reels 2 to 5.Awards high pay symbols on the reels.Awards high pay symbols in place of low pay symbols on the reels.After the feature has occurred, any special Jack Frost symbols still on the reels are turned into wilds.Free SpinsLanding 4 scatter symbols triggers the free spins feature. Scatters are present on reels 2 to 5 and only once per reel. When the round triggers, the number of free spins, the multiplier, the amount of locked reels, and the Jack Frost frequency are chosen at random. Getting 4 consecutive tumbles awards +2 free spins, and each winning tumble increases the multiplier by +1.Buy Free SpinsThe three choices here are 100x the bet (RTP 96.5%) to buy free spins with a random number of spins, multipliers, locked reels, and Jack Frost frequency, or 160x the bet (RTP 96.3%) for at least 8 free spins with random multipliers, locked reels, and Jack Frost frequency, or 200x the bet adding at least an x4 multiplier on top of the previous buy option.Megaways Jack Frost slot - feature buy menuMegaways Jack Frost: Slot VerdictStudios are in some ways like regular individual people, each one with its own personality, ways, habits, wants, and dreams. While some studios would rather slide down a rusty razor blade using their crotch as a braking system than release the same thing twice, others have no qualms recycling, recycling, and recycling some more. Obviously, Iron Dog Studio is one of those developers that has no issues using the same stuff again and again. Not saying one method is inherently better than the other, but you know, how many firsts in life are as good the second time around?Actually, maybe good isn't the right word, but there's something special about a first that can be missing the second time. So it threatens to be with Megaways Jack Frost, which was a repeat performance of Megaways Jack And The Magic Beans, just with snow and stuff. Magic Beans zealots might be grinning ear to ear with the knowledge, but we'd have to say Megaways Jack Frost was no better the second time around. Don't get us wrong, there is decent enough Megaways gaming to be had here if being cold is your thing. One standout in these games, for example, is the random way free spins components are awarded at the start of a bonus round. Likely just as neat here as it was in the Magic Beans game.Naturally, the more free spins components awarded, the neater it may be, as they might well come in handy for getting within striking distance of Megaways Jack Frost's substantial 25,000x the bet max win. It feels a bit bad admitting this, but Megaways Jack Frost pretty much ended up the way it was suspected to at the beginning of the review. Not a bad game, but it was another Iron Dog Studio reskin that didn't make a major impression when the curtains had closed.

title: Blue Wizard

review: Blue Wizard: Slot OverviewBlue Wizard was originally released by Quickspin owned company Playtech, then relaunched in 2019 by Rarestone Gaming, and was later followed on by a Megaways upgrade. From the playthrough, it did seem the new Blue Wizard was more balanced in terms of dealing out fewer dead spins, though we might have coasted through a lucky patch that would even out over long time periods. Playable from 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin, this Blue Wizard version can be played on any device, but only at casinos not already offering the live Rarestone version.Now for a bit of paytable info, starting with regular symbols. On the low side are gold and jewelled encrusted 10-A royals, followed by medium pay rings, books, cauldrons and owls. Wilds are where we find the Blue Wizard displayed, landing on reels 2, 3, 4, or 5. Wilds replace any normal pay symbol and expand if they can help form a win.Blue Wizard: Slot FeaturesKeep an eye out for two more special symbols when playing Blue Wizard. Scatters trigger free spins, while landing enough of the crystal ball symbols activates the Fire Blaze Respin feature.Free SpinsThe castle embossed symbol is the scatter, and landing 3, 4, or 5 of them awards 1x, 10x, or 50x the stake, plus 6 free spins. Free spins can be retrigged again when the feature is active.Fire Blaze Respin FeatureThis feature can be triggered from the main game or free spins when at least 6 crystal ball symbols are in view. Each crystal ball displays a cash value of 1 to 50 times the bet or a star icon. Star icons reveal Mini, Minor, or Major jackpot prizes worth 20x, 100x, or 500x the bet, respectively.The feature starts with the triggering crystal balls locked in position and 3 respins are awarded, which reset when new crystal ball symbols hit and also lock into position. The feature ends when no respins remain or when all positions are filled.
