title: Razor Ways
structured_summary: Razor Ways is a shark-themed underwater slot that updates the series with a ways-to-win system and a deep-sea exploration vibe. It features cascading wins, expanding rows, Mystery symbols, Expanding Wilds, a unique Razor Reveal bonus, and multiple free spin options with multipliers. The reviewer praises its rich feature set and betting options, calling it a well-stocked and engaging slot despite a slightly toned-down volatility. The game boasts clean, cartoon-style graphics and atmospheric, murky underwater music with a James Bond-esque feel.
review: ﻿Razor Ways: Slot OverviewThe Razor series has been huge for developer Push Gaming, beginning with 2019's monster of the deep Razor Shark before coming back in the even more monstrous form of Razor Returns in 2023. The studio has returned to the water once again and given the series a significant overhaul. The third instalment is Razor Ways, and as well as switching from paylines to ways, the game boldly drops the Nudge and Reveal feature, which was one of the cornerstones of the previous slots' success. There is no need for fans to get all uppity, though, as Razor Ways absolutely bulges with features, revamped gameplay, and a seafloor containing a ton of stuff to discover.Razor Ways links to the slots that came before it by retaining familiar shark faces on the symbols, as it plumbs the ocean depths with the help of a rickety metal contraption framing the reel matrix. Razor Ways has a cartoon cosiness (as much as shark-filled waters are able to be cosy) while feeling like an upgraded, more modern version. The artwork has a cleanly defined appearance, and the music provides a murky underwater, almost James Bond effect, causing Razor Ways to be as enticing as any that preceded it after a first look.Razor Ways slot - base gameAs the name says, Razor Ways is indeed a ways-paying game, in contrast to the bet line systems used in the previous two instalments. At the start of the base game, 729 ways are active on the 3 unlocked rows, but this can be increased up to 46,656 when all 6 rows are unlocked. As for the setup, 6 reels make up the gaming area. Razor Ways eases the volatility back a notch to be medium-high volatile, and its highest RTP when betting a straight 10 c to $/€100 per spin is 96.36%.Blue, green, purple, and orange plants of the sea are Razor Ways' 4 low pay symbols, worth 0.5x the bet for a 6 OAK hit. From there, we get into a compass, flippers, a diving helmet, and 4 sharks as the higher-paying symbols. Hitting ways of 6 OAK of these symbols pays 1 to 5 times the bet. Wilds substitute for all regular paying symbols. They're the shark with the golden teeth symbol.Razor Ways: Slot FeaturesRazor Ways slot - Razor Reveal feature in playRazor Ways has a lot of features, gadgets, and gizmos to cover, so why not start with the cascading wins mechanic? When matching symbols create a win, they disappear off the grid after paying out. The remaining symbols cascade downwards, and new symbols drop in to fill the gaps. Cascades keep triggering as long as new wins appear.Expanding RowsBy default, the 3 bottom rows of the reels start unlocked, while the top 3 rows are locked. When a cascade or Instant Prize win occurs, the grid expands by +1 row. All three rows can be unlocked, but at the start of each new game round, the top three rows lock again.Mystery SymbolsMystery symbols land anywhere in the base game or free spins. When they hit Mystery symbols reveal: Pay symbols, Wild symbols, Expanding Wild symbols, Converter into Wild symbols, or Golden Shark symbols.Expanding WildExpanding Wilds can land or be revealed by Mystery symbols. All positions covered by Expanding Wild symbols become wild symbols. In the base game, Expanding Wild symbols expand to cover the unlocked rows. When the reel the Expanding Wild is on contains a scatter or Golden Shark, these symbols cascade down after combinations are created. When the Expanding Wild lands in free spins, it unlocks rows and expands to cover the whole reel. Expanding wilds can have a multiplier of x2-x5, and if it does not take part in a win, it returns to its initial state.Razor Ways slot - expanding wild in viewConverter into Wild SymbolConverter into Wild symbols can land or be revealed by Mystery symbols. When on the reels, it spins through paying symbols on the unlocked rows. When one is picked, all instances of the picked symbol are converted into wilds, as is the Convertor into Wild symbol. When Mystery symbols land, up to 2 may reveal Convertor into Wild symbols; the rest reveal the same pay symbol.Razor Reveal FeatureWhen Mystery symbols land on at least 3 consecutive reels in the base or bonus game, they turn into Golden Shark symbols, triggering the Razor Reveal feature. Mystery symbols may randomly do this even when not on consecutive reels. Each Golden Shark position spins to reveal:Instant Prize symbol - bet multipliers of 1x to 5,000x the bet.Multiplier symbol - multiples Instant Prize and Collector symbols on the reels by x2 to x10, then gets removed. The empty positions spin through the prizes.Collector symbol - collects the values of all Instant Prize and Collector symbols. All Instant Prize symbols are removed when collected. The empty positions spin through the prizes. Collectors stay on the reels for the duration of Razor Reveals.Converter symbol - spins through regular pay symbols on unlocked reels. When one lands, all instances of the symbols convert to Golden Shark symbols, including the Convertor symbol. The Razor Reveal feature will continue.Scatter symbol (in the base game).Row Unlocker symbol (only in the bonus buy) - unlocks a row, then is removed. The empty position spins through the prizes.Free SpinsLanding 3 or more scatter symbols in the base game or during the Razor Reveal feature triggers free spins.3 scatters - triggers 6 free spins on an initial 3x6 grid with an initial x1 multiplier.4 scatters - triggers 8 free spins on an initial 4x6 grid with an initial x3 multiplier.5 scatters - triggers 10 free spins on an initial 5x6 grid with an initial x5 multiplier.6 scatters - triggers 10 free spins on an initial 6x6 grid with an initial x10 multiplier.During free spins, Glowing Mystery symbols may land. They operate in the same way as Mystery symbols, except each Glowing Mystery symbol that lands fills the Total Multiplier Level meter. It takes 5 symbols to get to the next level. Progressing levels increases the total multiplier (x1-x3-x5-x10) and opens up the gaming grid (3x6-4x6-5x6-6x6). Players get +4 free spins for reaching level 2, +3 free spins for reaching level 3, and +2 free spins for reaching level 4.Bonus BuyAt the bonus buy menu, these buys are available:A guaranteed Converter into Wild symbol for 67x the bet.A Razor Reveal feature with 6 positions guaranteed filled with Golden Shark symbols for 50x the bet.A Grand Razor Reveal with 18 guaranteed positions filled with Golden Shark symbols and the possibility of unlocking an additional row with a Row Unlocker symbol for 150x the bet.1x multiplier with 6 free spins for 73x the bet.3x multiplier with 8 free spins for 81.5x the bet.5x multiplier with 10 free spins for 164x the bet.10x multiplier with 10 free spins for 466x the bet.Random multiplier with corresponding free spins for 150x the bet.Push BetLast but not least are Push Bet options. Activating the Scatter Push Bet increases the chance of landing scatters for an increased stake of 1.4x. The Mystery Push Bet increases the bet to 3x, guaranteeing 2 Mystery symbols on unlocked rows on each spin. The Mystery and Scatter Push Bet increases the bet to 4x, guaranteeing 2 Mystery symbols on unlocked rows and increasing the chance of getting scatters.Razor Ways slot - free spinsRazor Ways: Slot VerdictIn the Jaws films, sequels always had to have a bigger shark. In the Razor range, Push Gaming goes to show this doesn't have to be the case. Fair enough, Razor Returns overshadowed the original slot with extra bulk, but Razor Ways pulls certain things back as if this shark has been dieting. Razor Ways remains rammed to the gills with features, however. That's one of the larger feature sections knocked out in a while, as there is a lot to cover. From in-game features, Push Bets, feature buys, Razor Ways is a well-stocked gambling machine brimming with betting options, free spin buy choices, and in-game discoveries to make.Though the bet line system of the last two slots never felt like a hindrance, the switch to ways works well in Razor Ways. Push Gaming has combined this with an unlockable gaming grid, adding to the potential snowballing effect when the game is coasting through choppy waters. Interestingly, the lack of the Mystery symbol stack Nudge and Reveal feature was not as missed as it was initially suspected to be. The reason being Razor Ways has a load of other ways of entertaining gamblers without a feature that was so critical in the past. Also, whilst the nudging stacks might be gone, many of the past features are back anyway, such as the Razor Reveal, Instant Prize wins and so on. Just now, they're running alongside ways, an expanding grid, and a level-up bonus round triggering a set number of free spins.With a win cap of 25,000x the bet, Razor Ways is not a sequel which pushes potential through the roof. This, coupled with the reduced volatility and the absence of the nudging multiplier, might have some of the more radical Razor masochists tut-tutting. But that's okay; Razor Ways has more than enough going on to thrill hardcore Razor enthusiasts as well as players who are newer to the series.

title: FloridaMan
structured_summary: FloridaMan is a pop-culture themed slot inspired by the viral "Florida Man" meme, featuring quirky US Florida-related imagery. Its gameplay includes a 6x3 reel grid with an upper Zap Reel, cascades, multipliers, Mystery Splits, FloridaMan Attack, Jailed Wilds, free spins, and feature buys. The reviewer finds it a smart, original, and moderately volatile slot with unique mechanics, offering a fresh alternative to typical themes. Visually, the game has a stylized Florida vibe with alligators, flamingos, pastel skies, and a relentless downbeat soundtrack that adds to its cool, experimental feel.
review: FloridaMan: Slot Overview'Florida Man' is a meme which first bubbled up around 2013, built on collections of unusual news stories from the US state of Florida which started with or included the words 'Florida man…' such as, 'Florida Man Accused of Attacking Girlfriend With Banana (NBC 6 South Florida). The way the meme evolved, it was as if a single person, the elusive Florida Man, perpetrated all of these headlines. It's into this murky world of memes that developer AvatarUX and partner game creator Mr Wu have stepped in to design FloridaMan, a pop-culture style slot, following a technical path laid down by slots such as DonKey & the Goats, and Nugget.Palms, an alligator, flamingos, a pastel sky, high-rise buildings, yeah, we are in Florida for this one, alright. From the stylized presentation of the graphical objects to the relentless downbeat soundtrack, FloridaMan oozes cool. It doesn't have the overload factor of GOATS but is more experimental than Nuggets, and right away, it feels like no other slot out there. If AvatarUX were looking for an outlet to take a break from churning out PopWins slots, then working with Mr Wu has certainly provided one, and the team up appears to be paying dividends.FloridaMan slot - base gameSo far, one thing that these Mr Wu-involved games have in common is a lower regular reel set and an upper Zap Reel. The main grid makes use of 6 reels, and 3 rows by default, providing 2,304 ways to win when including the available Zap Reel positions into the equation. It might seem downbeat, low key to begin with, but FloridaMan is a medium volatile slot, with a default 96% RTP value, and where the bet selection is 20 c $/€100. Note that any current rewards on the screen, such as saved FloridaMan Wilds, are saved at stake levels. Activating the Ante Bet from the Xpress screen doubles the chance of entering free spins for an extra 25% tacked onto the stake.FloridaMan's cascade system removes winning symbols from the reels, dropping in new symbols to replace them. If a new win appears on the reels following the symbol cascade, the process triggers again. FloridaMan's pay symbols are divided into low, medium, and highs. The lows are 10 to King card ranks, paying 2x the bet for 6 OAK, while the mediums are a sea creature, a flamingo, and a wild cat, worth 3x the bet for 6 OAK. That leaves 3 city scenes as the 3 high pay symbols, awarding 4 times the bet for a 6-of-a-kind winning way. Florida man appears on the wild symbol, and is he a cheeky nod to a certain ex-president? Not sure, but wilds substitute for all symbols on the reels except scatters.FloridaMan: Slot FeaturesFloridaMan slot - free spins gamble wheelZap Reels are a hallmark of a Mr Wu/AvatarUX game, and FloridaMan has one of those. It also has cascades, multipliers, Mystery Splits, FloridaMan Attack, Jailed Wilds, free spins, Swamp Fever!, and feature buys.Base Game FeaturesZap Reel - The Zap Reel is the reel that runs on top of the main grid. It can display regular symbols which are able to connect to form wins with the symbols on the regular reels. In addition, the middle 2 positions on the Zap Reel do not hold symbols but are what is called the Wild Jail, where unused wilds are collected. As well as regular symbols, multiplier symbols may appear on the Zap Reel, applying a multiplier to triggered wins. Multipliers are additive when 2 or more appear on the same winning line.Mystery Splits - At random at any time in the base or bonus game, Mystery Splits may land. Mystery Splits expand the reel by 2 or 3 symbol positions, then reveal the same random symbol in those spots. The expanded reels reset between spins.FloridaMan Attack - This feature can be activated at any time. At the end of the spin, a random amount of high-pay symbols transform into FloridaMan Wilds for the following spin. If this occurs in the base game, players get a respin. If a FloridaMan Wild does not form a win, it is collected from the reels by the Wild Jail.Jailed Wilds - All unused FloridaMan Wilds are collected by the Wild Jail. In the base game, at random, on any following paid spin, the collected wilds may be released onto the reels.Free SpinsThe free spins round is triggered by landing at least 3 scatter symbols. Before entering free spins, players may pick the Collect Wheel or the Gamble Wheel. The Collect Wheel awards a random number of free spins and starting ways. The Gamble Wheel offers the chance to upgrade free spins to higher tiers with a bigger number of free spins and higher starting ways. However, it also has the chance to lose the free spins. There is a 50/50 chance of winning or losing.During the free spins round, all collected wilds are released once from the Wild Jail on the final spin. Moreover, randomly during free spins, a Swamp Fever mode can trigger to grant +2 extra free spins as well as increases the chance of triggering the FloridaMan Attack during each following spin.XpressAt the Xpress, players can buy these bonuses:Bonus - 50x the bet for up to 8 free spins, up to 6,400 ways or gamble for more.Bonus Plus - 100x the bet for up to 10 free spins, up to 10,000 ways or gamble for more.Bonus Premium - 150x the bet for up to 12 free spins, up to 20,736 ways or gamble for more.Bonus Ultra - 200x the bet for up to 14 free spins, up to 32,400 ways or gamble for more.Bonus Max - 500x the bet for 16 free spins, 46,656 ways.FloridaMan slot - free spinsFloridaMan: Slot VerdictNews headlines linked to Florida Man allegedly include such eye grabbers as 'Florida man steals chain saw by sticking it in his pants' (Tampa Bay Times), 'Florida man charged with DUI after driving scooter into Walmart shelves' (New York Post), and 'Florida Man Attempting to Time Travel Crashes Into Strip Mall' (Miami New Times), clearly Florida Man has been busy. It might be argued that these AvatarUX/Mr Wu meetups could be shaping up, in some ways, as a Nolimit City competitor. Kind of a hint, let's say. FloridaMan and DonKey & the GOATS have a similarly irreverent feel, a little out there, a little offbeat. This one more so than the other, perhaps showcasing the two studios' growing confidence and willingness to take a risk. FloridaMan is no Rock Bottom or Walk of Shame, but it is still early days, and a studio combo looking to take on NLC at their own game could be an interesting setup.Not saying FloridaMan reaches shock levels, yet it's smartly done, and any studio willing to avoid the usual cliches by using an original topic to theme a slot is always a welcome move. The features on offer in FloridaMan aren't as wild as the subject matter, but they have their moments. The Zap Reel keeps it easy by delivering only multiplier symbols in addition to regular pay symbols, though the Wild Jail might feel like a bit of a hindrance when it's empty. The FloridaMan Attack can help fill the Jail, as can any wilds that go unused, and when FloridaMan Wilds are ejected back onto the reels, they might be good for creating pulse-racing results. Swamp Fever links in there, too, and the final free spin of a bonus round when the Wild Jail is emptied could be exciting.The more ways and rows are active when the final spin is in motion, the better, and FloridaMan is governed by a sizable 20,000x the bet win cap. Whilst there are links to previous Mr Wu collabs, FloridaMan is very different from what AvatarUX usually releases, as PopWins slots are the bulk of its output. As such, we could be poised at the start of a very interesting journey should the studio continue to expand down this sort of road.

title: Chronos Joker
structured_summary: Chronos Joker is a classic 3x3 fruit slot with a futuristic cosmic theme featuring star clusters and alien-like symbols. The game offers re-spin mechanics with stacked symbols and multiple escalating win multipliers, including Bonus and Super Spins features. The reviewer finds it a straightforward, moderately rewarding slot appealing mainly to fruit slot enthusiasts but less so for players seeking bigger wins or complex gameplay. Visually, it combines cosmic backgrounds with fridge magnet-style fruit and timepiece symbols, complemented by a spacey, futuristic atmosphere.
review: Chronos Joker (Play’n GO): OverviewIf you're in the market for classic fruit slots with a contemporary feel, Play'n GO will have you covered. Slots like Inferno Joker, and the more recent Big Win 777 slot, are both decent options for those players that are into the fast paced action that these type of games have to offer. What we have in front of us here is a classic 3x3 reel matrix on which wins can be formed across a total of 5 fixed paylines.Whereas the other two previously mentioned titles were of maximum volatility, this one is a bit more forgiving in its mathematical design. The medium volatility in combination with a superb default 96.54% RTP should offer more value when counting spins, but in turn, of course, the returns will be considerably lower, for most part at least. You can play Chronos Joker across all devices from only 0.05 c/p up to €/$100 which should make it accessible for all players.Set in the cosmos with star clusters and nebula's in the backdrop, Chronos Joker has a futuristic feel to it. The symbols fit the theme well and are almost made to look like fridge magnets (yes we have vivid imagination). On the lower end of the paytable you'll see an assortment of classic fruit symbols - cherries, lemons, plums, and grapes. More rewarding are the sundials, hourglasses, pocket watches, and digital watches. The latter is the most lucrative, giving you 16 times your stake for a three of a kind combination. The smirking Chronos Joker is the wild - it appears on all reels and substitutes for all symbols on the reels. All symbols can appear fully stacked on the reels.Chronos Joker (Play’n GO): FeaturesIn terms of features, Chronos Joker has a lot going on for something that initially looks like a simple 3-reel slot. At the core of the game is Re-Spin feature which activates when stacks of 3 matching symbols land on any 2 reels. The re-spin will only ever spin the reel that does not contain a stack of 3 matching symbols. If there is the possibility of 2 different reels to re-spin, then the reel of the lowest value symbol will re-spin. A re-spin will trigger on the remaining reel if no multiplier is active.There's also a range of win multipliers available which can activate randomly on any spin (2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, or 10x). Now, depending on what multiplier is active during a re-spin, 1 of 6 bonus features can come into play as a result of the re-spins. Here's what you can get:The Spins of the Future will trigger if the multiplier is x2. With each subsequent re-spin, the multiplier will increase to a maximum of x10, in the following order: x3, x4, x5, x10. Re-spins will continue until there is a win.The Spins of the Present will trigger if the multiplier is x3, x4, or x5. Re-spins will continue until there is a win.The Spins of the Past will trigger if the multiplier is x10. With each subsequent re-spin, the multiplier will decrease to a maximum of X2, in the following order: x5, x4, x3, x2. Re-spins will continue until there is a win.The random win multipliers may also double at the start of a spin or a re-spin. If that happens, there is a chance to trigger the Super Spins features:The Super Spins of the Future will trigger if the multiplier is x4. With each subsequent re-spin, the multiplier will increase to a maximum of x20, in the following order: x6, x8, x10, x20. Re-spins will continue until there is a win.The Super Spins of the Present will trigger if the multiplier is x6, x8, or x10. Re-Spins will continue until there is a win.The Super Spins of the Past will trigger if the multiplier is x20. With each subsequent re-spin, the multiplier will decrease to a maximum of x4, in the following order: x10, x8, x6, x4. Re-spins will continue until there is a win.Chronos Joker (Play’n GO): VerdictAlthough there are some typical fruit slot elements to Chronos Joker, it's anything but conventional as you have seen. If it seems confusing to you in writing, don't worry. It's actually quite straightforward once you get going and you're likely to get the hang of it after only a couple of minutes of gameplay.The key to winning big is to get to get the Bonus Spins upgraded to Super Spins which can lead to maximum payouts of 1,600 times your stake. Far from the standard 5,000x Play'n GO potential in other words, but quite typical of fruit slots in general. For what it is, Chronos Joker is an ok game that is likely to appeal to those who are into the fruit slot genre. If you're not into 3-reelers, however, this one won't win you over.

title: Blademaster
structured_summary:
Blademaster is a fantasy combat-themed slot featuring orcs and a mountain village setting with a Warhammer/World of Warcraft vibe.  
Key features include the Blademaster wild multipliers, free spins with a global multiplier up to x50, and a bonus buy option.  
The reviewer finds the game thematically fresh but notes the gameplay can feel repetitive, with rare feature triggers and potentially long waits for big wins.  
Visually, the slot showcases a rugged, wooden village with metal-on-wood styled symbols and immersive fantasy audio enhancing the combat atmosphere.
review: Blademaster: Slot OverviewBlademaster comes from Hacksaw Gaming buds Backseat Gaming; a new provider with four games under its belt at the time of writing. This particular title focuses on combat with a fantasy flavour and boasts features such as the Blademaster, free spins with a global multiplier as well as a bonus buy option.A fantasy, stabby, swords 'n axes type slot is what Backseat Gaming has created for Blademaster to populate. The base game is a mountain village scene where huts are built from lashed-together bits of wood with horns about the place. Orcs appear to be the main inhabitants around here, and there don't seem to be any humans attacking or being attacked by them, surprisingly. Blademaster has a Warhammer/World of Warcraft vibe going on that gamblers who are also into fantasy gaming may appreciate. Or anyone thrilled by the prospect of trying an orc slot.Blademaster slot - base gameBackseat Gaming does like their 5x5 reel and row combinations, which Blademaster possesses, crossed by 19 paylines. Winning combinations are made when matching symbols land left to right from the leftmost side of the grid. Behind the scenes lies a medium volatile math model (rated 3 out of 5), producing a default RTP of 96.29%. Players may stake 10 c to $/€100 on each spin, and there is a buy bonus should anyone want to skip the base game.For pay symbols, Blademaster has 10 through Ace card ranks made to look like metal on wood as the low pays, and 4 orcish character symbols as the high pays. When landing winning combinations of 5 matching royals, the payout will be 1 times the bet, no matter the symbol type or 10 to 15 times the bet for the high pay symbols. Wilds pay more at 20 times the bet for a 5 OAK hit and a present on all reels, able to substitute for any regular pay symbol.Blademaster: Slot FeaturesBlademaster slot - free spinsIn this arena, Blademaster arms itself with the Blademaster feature, free spins with a global multiplier, and a buy feature.BlademasterThe Blademaster feature can occur at random in the base game and in free spins. When triggered, 2 to 5 wild multipliers appear on the reel – 1 per reel at the most. In the base game, the multiplier values can be x2, x3, x4, x5, or x10. If the Blademaster triggers in free spins, the sum of the wild multipliers is equal to the total of the Global Multiplier. Wild multipliers multiply any winning combinations they are part of. Should a winning combination have more than one wild multiplier in it, the values are multiplied by each other then applied to the win.Free SpinsPlayers win 10, 12, or 14 free spins when 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols land at the same time in the base game. Landing blue flags during the round boosts the Global Multiplier by +2, +3, +4, +5, or +10. The Global Multiplier starts at x2 and can be increased up to a maximum of x50. Each free spin has a wild multiplier equal to the Global Multiplier appearing on one random reel unless the Blademaster feature triggers. When the Blademaster feature is activated, the Global Multiplier is split into 2 to 5 wild multipliers – their combined value is equal to the Global Multiplier. Hitting 3 scatter symbols in the round awards +5 extra free spins.Buy BonusPlayers may buy access to the free spins round for the cost of 100 times the bet. When buying free spins, the RTP is slightly higher at 96.3%.Blademaster slot - free spinsBlademaster: Slot VerdictOne cool thing about Backseat Gaming so far is that the studio has proven willing to swing from theme to theme without showing a major preference nor clinging to tried-and-true cliches. From Sleepy Grandpa to the snakes of Lord Venom, and now fantasy orcs. No subject matter appears to be off the table, for now at least, which is an appreciable trait. The same doesn't quite go for the features and gameplay to the same extent. Whilst Backseat Gaming has striven to offer different gameplay experiences, the features they've come up with so far haven't been the most exciting in the grand scheme of things. Not writing them off or anything, but Blademaster is another one that struggles to stand out of the towering shade Hacksaw Gaming casts over it.The base game, for one, could wallow in a repetitive drag. The Blademaster feature is technically available in the main game, but it was rare, at least, it was in the review, so maybe incorporating FeatureSpins the way Hacksaw Gaming slots often do might have lifted the enjoyment levels. A portion of each bet goes to feed the jackpots, where stake levels of 10 p/c to $/€10 can be selected, and as the paytable puts it, the chance of triggering the jackpot scales with the bet.A total of 20 paylines line the 5x3 game grid where winning combinations land left to right from the leftmost reel. The triggering respin wild and any regular wilds in view mark the positions they were in with a green frame called a Returning Wild. During respins, the respin wild is the only wild symbol that appears, and when no more land, the Final Repins occurs. For the Final Respin, wilds are added to any green framed positions.Free Spins With Returning WildLanding 3 scatter symbols on reels 1, 3, and 5, award 10 free spins – 9 free spins plus 1 Final Free Spin, which cannot be triggered (triggers 1 in 177 spins). During the first 9 free spins, Paddy's wild is the only wild which may land. When it does, it marks its position with a green frame. On the Final Free Spin, all framed positions turn wild.Progressive JackpotLanding 3 jackpot symbols on reels 2, 3, and 4 triggers the Mega Moolah Progressive Jackpot Wheel (triggers 1 in 92 spins). A wheel spins to award a cash prize of 1x, 2x, or 3x, the bet, or one of the four Mega Moolah Jackpots. A 2x the bet payout is also made on top of whatever else is won.Paddy's Pot Mega Moolah slot - jackpot wheelPaddy's Pot Mega Moolah: Slot VerdictIs the Games Global family plum out of ideas at the moment? After what feels like reviewing back-to-back clones, reskins, or remakes (one from Just For The Win, no less), here comes another one with a pretty unimaginative theme to it as well. title: Mega Moolah The Witch's Moon

review: Mega Moolah The Witch's Moon: Slot OverviewIf you've played online slots for longer than 0.5 nanoseconds, the half-life of beryllium-13, there's a good chance you've come across the Mega Moolah phenomenon. As well as this one is three lesser jackpots and a set of free spins.Witch symbol scatters are needed to trigger free spins, awarding 15 of them when 3 or more land. As well as free spins, players collect a win of 3, 20, or 100 times their stake for 3, 4, or 5 scatters in view. During free spins, all wins are tripled in value, and the bonus round can be retriggered.At any time during the base game, the jackpot feature can randomly activate. When it does, players spin the jackpot wheel once. The wheel is divided into segments displaying the 4 different prizes. The lower the amount, the more segments it has and vice versa – there is just one segment for the Mega. If free spins and the jackpot bonus are won at the same time, free spins play out first, building anticipation for the wheel spin.As to prize values, because the jackpots are progressive, they can grow to eye-watering proportions. Seed values, though, are set. So, the Mini, Minor, Major, and Mega jackpots start at €10, €100, €10,000, and €1,000,000, respectively.Mega Moolah The Witch's Moon: Slot VerdictThree of any one game type is a decent run, though Aurum has cut corners by basically copying what the original did. So aside from theme changes, the features are exactly the same as what the first Mega Moolah game offered. Working smarter or just being lazy? The main drawcard is still here in the form of the Mega Jackpot. To date, the largest jackpot was €19,430,723, won in April 2021 by a lucky Belgian player. This record hit was achieved on Triple Edge Studio's release Absolootly Mad Mega Moolah, an Alice in Wonderland themed version. For players who like stats, clicking on the trophy icon above the menu button displays a list of wins over the previous two years.In the end, what's there to say? Mega Moolah The Witch's Moon does the bare minimum of what players would expect, which is provide a gateway to the Mega Moolah network. Other than that, it's best summed up as Mega Moolah with a witchy makeover. For something more entertaining but no less potentially lucrative, it's hard to pass up Immortal Romance Mega Moolah instead.

title: Reel Keeper

review: Reel Keeper: OverviewFrom independent studio R7 we get Reel Keeper, a 5-reel, 10-payline dragon-filled, classically styled slot powered by Red Tiger that may, or may not, be found as part of Red Tiger's progressive jackpot network. In this way, it is possible to stack all five reels in Dragon Wilds. If that happens, a full screen is worth 1,000 times the stake.For those who like to lay it on the line, after any win of at least 10p, the Gamble feature* can be activated (*may or may not be available). If the needle on the reel lands on green, players win the gamble. The good news is the feature seems to be relatively generous once you do trigger it (not guaranteed of course). Dragon Wilds ended up locked on reels one and two, leading to an overall positive result.Another positive is that all of the premiums pay on two of a kinds, which helps. Just be prepared for some third-degree burns from those dragons if you don't trigger the bonus game though. That's the gameplay side of things. title: Romanov Riches

review: Romanov Riches IntroductionJust when we thought these cringy Microgaming collaborations couldn't get any worse, we're slapped in the face by yet another one. title: Anubis Wild Megaways
structured_summary:
Anubis Wild Megaways is an Egyptian-themed slot by Inspired Gaming, utilizing the Megaways mechanic with a temple backdrop.  
Key features include cascading wins in the base game, a Free Spins bonus with locking, multiplying wilds, and a unique Spin Chance feature.  
The reviewer finds it a solid but less impressive follow-up to Desperadoes Wild, citing a more limited bonus round and lower overall excitement.  
Visuals are clear but unoriginal, with standard Egyptian symbols and atmospheric torch-lit temple audio enhancing the mood.
review: Anubis Wild Megaways Slot: OverviewMaking the most of their Megaways license, developer Inspired Gaming is poised to release their second slot to use the popular device. Their first, Desperados Wild, was pretty standard fare at first – until it got to the bonus round where those stacked, multiplier wilds could cause all sorts of mayhem. It’s nice to see that some of that magic has returned with the follow-up, but they have brought with them some rather strange changes. First a Western, now an Egyptian slot, it appears that theme choice to go with Megaways might not be too inspired. Still, it’s the gameplay that counts so let’s not be too hasty with the judgements and give it a whirl.Prepare to not have your socks blown off when Anubis Wild Megaways loads. The graphic standard is good; there is nothing wrong with it as such. But it leans towards the unoriginal with staple symbols from the genre on the reels and a background comprised of a torch-lit temple. It’s no biggie though; the visuals are clear and create something of a mood. Players hit the coin arrows to pick the appropriate stake which can be anything from 20 p/c to $/€20 per spin.Selecting manual or auto spin sets the Megaways machine in motion with 6 main reels and an extra 4x1 horizontal reel along the top. The main reels can hold 2-7 symbols each, which change with each spin, and can provide up to 117,649 ways to win - in other words, a standard Megaways setup. Players receive a payout when combinations of 2 or 3 of a kind land consecutively on any row. When that happens, the cascade feature removes the winning combination and drops new symbols into the gaps. New combos get a chance to form, and cascades continue as long as new winners keep landing.Players make use of 10 regular pay symbols split into 6 low and 4 high pay lots. The low pays are standard 9-A royals placed against a papyrus like background, while the high pays are an Eye of Horus, Pharaoh’s Mask, a Cleopatra lookalike, and a scarab. All need at least three for an payout, except the scarab who only needs two of a kind. He is also the most valuable of the lot at 50 times the stake for six of a kind.Two special symbols complete the picture – wilds and mystery symbols. Wilds appear only on the top horizontal reel during the base game whilst they only appear on reels 2-5 during free spins. As per usual, wilds can substitute for any symbol except the bonus. When the Mystery Symbols land, all in view change to reveal the same matching regular pay symbol which helps increase the chance of scoring big wins.Behind the scenes, the stats coming out of the medium volatile math model goes from 95.9% RTP in standard mode, to between 95.81%-95.95% RTP with the Bonus Top Up feature is engaged. More on that further below so keep on reading.Anubis Wild Megaways Slot: FeaturesFree spins round in action with locking wildsDesperadoes Wild let players choose from two possible bonus games whereas Anubis Wild Megaways has just the one. Fortunately, it’s a copy of the one that made Desperadoes shine - the Jail House Spins. The bonus game doesn’t get a special name this time around, it’s simply referred to as Free Spins and is triggered when 3 or more bonus symbols land anywhere in view. No, not a typo, Anubis Wild only needs 3 scatters (as opposed to 4 in most other Megaways creations) and any extra scatter in view awards 2 additional spins up to a maximum of 82.Before free spins begin, players are presented with Bonus Top Up screen. Here, players can choose to gamble the free spins they have been awarded or collect. With successful gambles, more spins are added to the tally. If not, spins are forfeit, and players receive a mystery prize which comes as a multiplier of the total bet amount. Usually around x4 during testing, so you really don’t want to lose that one.The free spins round is quite different from the usual Megaways bonus game. For starters, the bonus reel is removed, and there is no unlimited win multiplier on hand. There isn’t even a cascade feature any more. Instead, it’s all about the wilds. When wilds land now, they drop to the bottom of the reel and remain locked in place for the duration. The wild also locks the Megaways on that reel so rows don’t change around from spin to spin. Should more wilds land on the reel, they merge, stack, and receive a multiplier equal to the number of wilds that have merged. If a reel gets covered with a merged wild, free spins are added equal to the number of wilds that merged.The final feature is a technical addition that you would hope not to use. It’s called the Spin Chance and activates when there is credit in an account, but it is less than the current spin cost. Players can choose to use the Spin Chance and if they do, a needle spins around a wheel awarding another spin if it lands on a green segment, or forfeiting the credit if it lands on red.Anubis Wild Megaways Slot: VerdictAnubis Wild is a solid enough Egyptian themed Megaways slot, but it does feel like a step back from Desperadoes Wild. Things have changed, added and been taken away. But overall, it’s a somewhat inferior game. It's hard to understand why Inspired made some of the changes they did with Anubis Wild because none of them really enhance the experience. One is the more limited bonus round. What we get is good - the sticky/multiplying wilds can be just as thrilling when they do their thing in an Egyptian environment. Yet, some players might prefer a more conventional win multiplier over the more volatile wild option, but, it’s gone. And it is hard to think of a convincing reason why. Oh well, Anubis Wild only requires 3 scatters to trigger the round, so that’s a positive point, though a drop in RTP sort of erases that pro.Inspired’s debut Megaways slot Desperadoes Wild had a wow factor due to its excellently novel Jail House Spins feature. It’s nice to see that return, but like anything, it loses a bit of impact on its second viewing. Anubis Wild is a competent use of Megaways, but it’s not a standout, and its changes have made it a somewhat lesser slot than its older sibling.

In the base game, the Soldier symbol appears only on the top reel. The Soldier is wild, so it substitutes for all symbols except scatters. Winning symbols explode off the grid by the cascade mechanic, which drops symbols down on the main reels or from the side on the top reel to replace them, providing another chance to win on the same spin.Armageddon 10K Ways: Slot FeaturesArmageddon 10k Ways slot - respinsArmageddon 10K Ways' main feature is its bonus respins round. It is triggered from the base game when at least 6 scatter symbols appear. In this feature, 3 respins are awarded with all scatter symbols held while the remaining positions spin. What may land are scatters, Soldiers, Demon symbols, or blanks. Demons and scatters display prize or bonus prize values. Only a single Soldier may appear on a respin, only if there are Demon symbols on the screen.Demon symbols have life values. The Red, Purple, Green, and Blue Demon have starting lives of 4, 3, 2, and 1, respectively. When a Soldier appears, its value is determined by collecting the prize/bonus values of all Demon symbols in view that have a life value greater than 0. All visible Demon symbols' life values are reduced by 1 to a minimum of 0.When a new prize symbol (scatter, Demon, or Soldier) appears, it is held and respins are reset to 3. When all positions are filled or no more respins remain, the round ends, and each prize symbol awards a prize or bonus prize. Non-bonus prizes on scatters or Demons range from 1x to 100x the bet. The bonus prizes are the Mini, Minor, Major, and Grand, worth 10x, 50x, 250x, or 2,000x the stake, respectively.Armageddon 10k Ways slot - respinsArmageddon 10K Ways: Slot VerdictWe mentioned Armageddon 10K Ways' rich story in the opening paragraph, and while the game world has been well designed, it is a slot which fell flat fairly fast. There's just not a lot going on action-wise for much of the time. The base game is without features or modifiers (aside from cascades if they count), just hit winning ways, and get teased when less than 6 scatter symbols hit about the place. Armageddon 10K Ways inhabits a captivating world of the future, one ripped apart by unbridled scientific ambition and hubris, but there's a lot of sitting around waiting while nothing really happens before getting to the more exciting stuff.That would be Armageddon 10K Ways' respins bonus, and again, it's pretty light-going. Okay, Demon symbols have life countdowns, and Soldiers collect their values, but that's about it. Gamblers can chase the Grand Prize, yet outside this one ray of hope, the rest of the prize values are generally quite meagre. The max win is not, though, marked as 10,338.5x the bet by the ReelPlay team, which was surprising. Clearly, Armageddon 10K Ways has the technical capabilities to perform. One of the game's main highlights is the Soldier collecting symbol values in the bonus respins round, provided there are some juicy Demon values in view for him to collect.ReelPlay's 10K range continues to chug along, and Armageddon 10K Ways was one of the more satisfying examples to review. There are limitations; the lack of secondary features is noticeable, and the bonus respins round is pretty basic, for example. But, the world-building, the thought patterns the theme evoked, and the Soldier collector symbol possesses a level of intrigue that pushes Armageddon 10K Ways above a few of its 10K Ways contemporaries.

title: Triple Royal Gold
structured_summary: Triple Royal Gold offers a classic 3x3 slot experience with a sleek, upscale casino theme. It features Avalanches, a bonus token collection system, free spins, and a progressive multiplier, enhancing gameplay depth. The reviewer sees it as a modest yet well-executed slot that stands out quietly in a crowded market. Visually, it shines with green and gold accents, shimmering lights, and a polished, inviting atmosphere.
review: Triple Royal Gold: Slot OverviewSwedish developer Thunderkick takes a break from dabbling in mythology and fantastical ideas to design a more down-to-earth online slot. The result is Triple Royal Gold, a 3x3 number drenched in classic slot iconography and one or two simple features. Not too simple, though. There's an interplay of gaming elements at work in Triple Royal Gold that may well spark a higher level of interest than initially suspected.These are Avalanches, bonus token collects, and free spins with a progressive multiplier. Triple Royal Gold is a shiny slot which has a faintly land-based feel to it, though not just any physical gambling establishment, but a swanky upmarket joint with a strict dress code. Light shimmers off the three-reel gaming area, surrounded by lights and other flashy, green, and gold bits. Other than that, there's not a whole lot else to mention. The overall effect is pleasant and inviting enough to encourage further investigation.Triple Royal Gold slot - base gamePlayable on any device, Triple Royal Gold provides bet levels of 10 p/c to $/€100 per paid game round. It comes with a default theoretical return to player value of 96.12% when playing normally, rising to 96.42% when buying the bonus game. Driving the action is a highly volatile math model, and 27 paylines make their way across the game board for landing two or three-of-a-kind wins. Cracking open the paytable we find five regular pay symbols – horseshoes, bells, bars, lucky 7s, and crowns. Values vary from 1x to 5x the bet for three of a kind; with one extra addition, the crown pays 1x the bet for landing a two-of-a-kind win. Diamond wilds appear on the reels, too, substituting for all other symbols except the scatter.Triple Royal Gold: Slot FeaturesTriple Royal Gold slot - free spinsTriple Royal Gold keeps things fairly simple, as you might expect in a 3x3-styled game. Extras here include Avalanches with a symbol collection system that can lead to a free spins bonus game which has a progressive multiplier.Avalanche FeatureSymbols in winning ways or collected bonus tokens are removed from the game board and replaced with symbols falling down from above. If new wins occur or more tokens are collected after the dropdown, the process repeats all over again.Bonus GameWhen any of the bonus tokens in the base game (B, O, N, U, S) appear in a winning combination, the respective token beneath the reels is lit up. That token then no longer appears for the remainder of the game round. If all 5 bonus tokens manage to be lit, the bonus game is activated, and 8 free spins are awarded. In the bonus game, when the horseshoe, bell, bar, lucky 7s, or crown create a winning combination, the respective symbol beneath the reels is lit up. When all five symbols are lit, +2 free spins are awarded, and the win multiplier is increased by a level. The win multiplier can reach as high as x27.Feature BuyThe feature buy option may or may not be available depending on your jurisdiction. If it is, players can buy access to the bonus game for the cost of 120x the bet.Triple Royal Gold slot - free spinsTriple Royal Gold: Slot VerdictJust spitballing here, but is creating a 3-reel Vegasy fruity slot a bit like crafting electronic music? Wait, hear us out. Presumably, it's fairly easy these days to make a so-so EDM track but tough to make something excellent that stands out from the sea of other songs - so it is with these sorts of games. In all fairness, Thunderkick has done a good job designing Triple Royal Gold. Triple Royal Gold is by no means a raging inferno of innovation, yet for this gaming style, Triple Royal Gold carves out its own niche, a modest one, and makes itself comfy and cosy there.First off, there's the inclusion of the Avalanche feature, which doesn't show up in slots like Triple Royal Gold overly often. Again, not a major breakthrough, but it's a bit different and performs a couple of roles. Not only is it able to string together consecutive wins off a single spin as normal, but it kind of ties into the way the bonus round is triggered when B, O, N, U, S tokens have been collected. The collection carries on in the bonus round, this time increasing a win multiplier as a result when successful. It's all rather neatly efficient when things are running well. Triple Royal Gold is not terrible in terms of winning potential, either, maxing out at 5,000x the bet; such is the ability of multipliers to boost regular payout values when hitting in great numbers.It's unlikely Triple Royal Gold is going to set the industry on fire, but it's also unlikely this was Thunderkick's objective when it was making the game. Instead, Triple Royal Gold goes about setting itself up as a playable, 3-reel online slot with Avalanches and a progressive multiplier that can lead to good things when it's going swimmingly.

title: Big Bass Splash
structured_summary: Big Bass Splash is a fishing-themed slot featuring a Mega-truck and shoreline setting for a fresh twist on the series. Key features include a new scatter assist mechanic, free spins with wild fisherman symbols, multipliers, and a bonus buy option. The reviewer sees it as a modest update with bigger max win potential (up to 5,000x) but largely similar gameplay to previous titles. Visually, it retains the aquatic, Fishin’ Frenzy-like vibe with minor changes and an underwater grid, accompanied by fitting sounds evoking a fishing adventure.
review: Big Bass Splash: Slot OverviewIf a studio has designed a couple of highly successful fishing themed slots, what could they do to differentiate a new release from those that preceded it? If you're Pragmatic Play, you pull out the highest paying float symbol and replace it with a big-wheeled truck. That might sound odd at first, yet it kind of makes sense as the slot in question, Big Bass Splash, is all about loading your gear into a Mega-truck and heading to the water's edge to cast off. What it means for players is a chance to relive Big Bass Bonanza, with monster trucks, a new scatter assist feature, and greatly enhanced potential.There have been a few visual alterations as well while we're at it. Thalassophobics will be happier to note the action does not take place way out at sea but nearer the shoreline. Well, you can see the shoreline in the upper part of the screen, a short paddle away, at least. The game grid remains underwater and, as before, consists of 5-reels, 3-rows, and 10 paylines for landing regular line wins across. There have been a few minor visual shifts, yet the game shares the same angling, Fishin' Frenzy-like atmos as previous games in the Big Bass range.It also has the same default RTP as the non-Megaways versions, which is a good thing, as the highest level is a healthy 96.71%. In regards to the math model, Big Bass Splash gets a 4/5 rating for volatility and comes with the biggest potential of the lot – surpassing even Big Bass Bonanza Megaways. The stake range has remained the same, so players can choose bets of 10 p/c to $/€250 per spin and use any device they prefer to reel in some pixelated fish.Normal wins occur when matching symbols land left to right, starting from the leftmost reel. For the most part, the symbols are the same, with the exception of the highest value one. This time it's a Mega-truck, worth 200x the bet for five of a kind, followed by fishing rods, dragonflies, tackle boxes, and any set of fish money symbols, paying 100 down to 20 times the stake for five. Rounding out the bottom of the paytable are the 10-A playing card symbols, and landing five of these triggers a payout of 5-10x the bet. Don't expect any help from the wild in the base game, as it can only appear when the bonus round is active.Big Bass Splash: Slot FeaturesLine win values are pretty decent, yet the action in Big Bass Splash really kicks off when the bonus round is triggered. This occurs when 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols are in view, awarding 10, 15, or 20 free spins, respectively. In a new move, when 2 scatters are in view, there is a chance a random feature brings another scatter onto the reels. If the 2 scatters can move down a position without falling off the grid, they do so, and non-scatter bearing reels respin. Alternatively, a hook may pull one of the reels up for a chance to land the third scatter.Free SpinsDuring free spins, the wild fisherman symbol can appear on all reels. One thing he does is substitute pay symbols to help link winning lines. Secondly, if the wild lands at the same time as fish symbols, he collects their cash value and awards them to the player. Wilds are also collected above the reels. Every time 4 wilds are collected, then +10 extra free spins are awarded and a multiplier is introduced. The multiplier is applied to any cash values won from the fish money symbols. The multiplier is x2, x3, and x10 for levels 2, 3, and 4, respectively. Once reaching level 4, free spins cannot be triggered again.Two more random features complete the bonus round. If a wild lands with no fish money symbols in view, there is a chance fish symbols appear in random cells on the reels. Vice versa when there are fish symbols present but no wild. In this instance, a wild symbol may randomly appear to collect their values. Lastly, applicable players may be able to buy the free spins round for the cost of 100x their bet.Big Bass Splash: Slot VerdictIf you're under the impression Pragmatic Play is milking the daylights out of Big Bass/Bigger Bass Bonanza for all its worth, you're not alone. Fair dues, though. The formula has proven hugely successful, and there can't be a much quicker turnaround time than doing a samey reskin, tinkering with a feature or two, and zing, you've got a 'new' slot to sling out. We're not trying to be facetious here, as most of the changes in Big Bass Splash are slight. There is the new two scatter feature, but like swapping the highest paying float symbol for a Mega-truck, it's hardly a major overhaul.So if you're not interested in big-wheeled vehicles or fishing from the shore rather than out at sea, what's Big Bass Splash got going for it? For one, there is now a bonus buy option available, yet the biggest draw here is definitely the max win. Not that the 2,100x available in the original slot was a deal-breaker for the many players drawn in by the opportunity to catch fish money symbols. We were also expecting more than the 4,000x offered in the Megaways version as well. This time, Pragmatic has eased off the win cap, letting it go as high as 5,000x the stake, pushing Big Bass Splash into more alluring territory than ever before. What's up for grabs might not be astonishing in the grand scheme of things, but BBS's max win is sort of like Croesus by Big Bass Bonanza Standards.Other than the chance to score a larger catch than any of its predecessors, Big Bass Splash is business as usual. No getting around that. As such, players thrilled by the idea of another fishing themed money symbol collection slot with larger potential should be intrigued. On the other hand, those queasy at the thought of yet another one of these sorts of games might be prone to a virtual form of Big Bass seasickness.

title: Book of Sheba
structured_summary:
Book of Sheba is an ancient-themed slot centered on the wealthy Queen of Sheba, set in her opulent palace.  
Key features include dual-role book symbols, expanding special symbols during free spins, a Golden Book reel, retriggers, and the Ultra Bet bonus enhancing RTP and win potential.  
The reviewer finds it a solid, slightly fresh take on the familiar 'Book of' slot formula with worthwhile new twists.  
The game boasts gold-adorned, regal visuals and thematic audio that complement its luxurious ancient setting.
review: Book of Sheba: OverviewThe cat has long since left the bag when it comes to 'Book of' imitators. How many developers have made their versions of the classic slot now? Who knows, but the figure is bound to be impressive. It's time to chalk up another in a long list of imitators with iSoftBet's historically themed slot Book of Sheba.It's not their first time to do so either, that honour goes to Book of Immortals which they populated with Ancient Egyptian deities. Book of Sheba remains set in the ancient past, though new imagery bases the game around the infamous Queen of Sheba.The Queen of Sheba owes much of her fame to biblical references, with plenty of mystery surrounding the story. We could join in the speculation, but for the sake of a review, let's stick to one aspect of her fame - being ultra-wealthy. The 5-reel, 3-row grid is located in her opulent palace, surrounded by gold pillars, gold pots, and some decorated archways.Playable from between 10 p/c and $/€10 per spin, the core rules haven't changed much in over a decade. Once again, winners are hit by landing at least 3 or more low pays, or 2 or more high pays on one of the 10 paylines. The theoretical return to player in this game comes in at 96.0%, which is far better than the 95.1% you get in Book of Ra Deluxe from Novomatic, but slightly less than Book of Dead from Play'n GO if you play it on a casino that offers the default setting of 96.21%.Highly volatile, the symbols themselves are a nod to the past while looking to the future. For example, the 10-A royals have been designed in a similar style to the original Book of Ra font. Not exactly the same, but there is a touch. The high pays are brand new, made up of a gold broach, a gold mask, a lion, and the Queen who resides at the top. Values for five of a kind premiums range from 75 to 500 times the stake, with full grids certainly possible.Book of Sheba: FeaturesBook of Sheba - free spins with special expanding symbolFree spins are where 'Book of' slots naturally shine and as you may already know, it's all about the Books. The book symbol that appears during the base game has dual roles of wild and scatter. As a wild, it can replace any other symbol to form winning combinations. As a scatter, 3, 4, or 5 payout 2x, 20x, or 200x the total bet respectively, plus awarding 10 free spins.Before Free Spins begin, a book is flipped open and a special symbol is selected at random. However, players can reject the first symbol in hope to be awarded a more valuable one. However, the second special symbol must be accepted, so it's a gamble.During free spins, if the special symbol appears as part of a win, it expands to cover the full reel. Magically, these symbols do not need to be adjacent to do so. For example, if a special 10 lands on reels 1, 3, and 5, the symbols will still expand to cover those reels and create a payout.Interestingly, there's a twist to this particular book slot. A second book wild known as The Golden Book comes into force during free spins, appearing on reels 2, 3, or 4. Whenever it lands, it turns its respective reel into a golden reel. When a reel is gold, it will transform into a special expanding symbol if a win with that chosen symbol is possible. As a wild, the golden book can substitute for any pay symbol whilst also doubling as a scatter like the other book symbol.Another thing that has made these book slots so popular is the chance of getting one or more retriggers. This is accomplished by landing at least 3 book symbols anywhere on the reels which will then add 10 more spins to your total.The final feature is the Ultra Bet. Hit the Ultra Bet button to play 50 games for a cost of 50 times the stake. During Ultra Bet spins, stars may appear layered on top of regular symbols to be collected. At the end of the 50 spins, if at least 5 stars have been collected a multiplier prize from x5 to 1,000x the individual bet is awarded. Moreover, with the Ultra Bet activated, the RTP goes up from 96.0% to 96.5%.Book of Sheba: VerdictWell, it's another 'Book of' slot, what else is there to say really? If you've played one, you have kind of played them all, to an extent. There are usually one or two tweaks to set them apart, and Book of Sheba has a few to give players something to check out. For the most part, they work pretty well too in setting Book of Sheba somewhat apart from the rest of the Book bunch.First is the Ultra Bet option that debuted in iSoftBet's football-themed slot Hot Shots 2. The peculiar thing about this feature is that it doesn't cost any extra to activate than 50 regular spins, yet it provides an additional chance to win. On the other hand, since players are locked to 50 spins it does help the developer make more predictable calculations in the mathematical model.If you are going to be powering through 50 spins anyway, activating it could be of some benefit since there's a chance to pocket up to 1,000x in extra winnings. The bonus game can still be triggered when the Ultra Bet is in motion, so it's a win-win really.Although not a new feature, the ability to reject the first special symbol offered is a welcomed addition. Better is the gold book, and gold reels, which can come in handy in expanding all 5 reels. Do so using the Queen, and wins of 5,000 times the stake are possible on a single spin.All the new elements don't exactly cover up the fact Book of Sheba is at heart, an attempt to cash in on a hugely popular slot format. However, the new bits are quite good and make Book of Sheba an interesting proposal for 'Book of' fans, or those looking for massive single spin opportunities in an exotic setting.

title: Mutant Trawlers
structured_summary: Mutant Trawlers is a fishing-themed slot set in a post-apocalyptic, polluted lake with mutant fish, offering a unique environmental twist. The game features 243 ways to win, Mutant Cash symbols, Trawler Respins with increasing multipliers, free spins with gamble options, and bonus buys. The reviewer praises its humorous, light-hearted approach and distinctiveness but notes moderate winning potential capped at 3,069x the bet. The aesthetics combine eerie, grotesque visuals with a quirky, humorous tone, enhancing the game's unique atmosphere.
review: Mutant Trawlers: Slot OverviewImagine if all the talk of global warming, carbon loading the atmosphere and mass extinctions created a sort of environmental fatigue where human beings as a whole just gave up and said, 'fudge it, let's just do whatever', leading to unbounded pollution, exploitation, and rape of the natural world. Some might say we've already reached that point, but anyway, such a world might look like the nightmare landscape presented in Yggdrasil partner Bang Bang Games' fishing-themed slot Mutant Trawlers.Entering this game is entering a world which is, as Bang Bang Games puts it, 'set against the eerie backdrop of a once-serene lake, now transformed by the leaking influence of a neighbouring nuclear plant.' This has transformed the denizens of these waters into bizarre mutant fish. Kudos to Bang Bang for not simply making another fishing slot set on sunny blue sea waters or on a pristine river by virgin forest. Instead, Mutant Trawlers draws parallels with Nolimit City's fish slot Ugliest Catch, both using grotesque humour to differentiate themselves from the multitude. The fundamentals, however, have been borrowed from Big Time Gaming's Golden Catch a game that's also inspired slots like Boat Bonanza and Boat Bonanza Colossal Catch by Play'n GO.Mutant Trawlers slot - base gameMechanically, Mutant Trawlers is a bit different compared to the games mentioned. As for its math model, the volatility is medium-high, while from the four available RTP configurations, 96% is the default figure. A 243 ways, 5x3 game panel is the active gaming area, awarding regular wins when landing matching pays symbols on adjacent reels from the leftmost side. With Bonus Boost and bonus buys available, the stake range is 20 c to $/€40. Activating the Bonus Boost doubles the chances of triggering free spins for an increase to the stake of 50%.Jack to Ace card ranks are Mutant Trawlers' regular low-pay symbols, and its highs are goggles, a barrel, a radiation detector, and a glowing green thing. Hitting 5 identical low pays in a way awards 0.6 to 0.8 times the bet, or players get 1 to 5 times the bet when landing 5 identical highs. The radiation sign wild substitutes for all symbols except scatters or Mutant Cash.Mutant Trawlers: Slot FeaturesMutant Trawlers slot - free spins gambleCash collecting is Mutant Trawlers' focus, it being a fish-themed slot and all. This comes in the form of Mutant Cash symbols and Trawler Respins, with free spins, a free spins gamble, and bonus buys thrown in for good measure.Mutant CashOn each spin, Mutant Cash symbols may appear on the reels. Fishing boats may also appear above any reel. If a boat appears above a reel containing Mutant Cash, the cash on the reel is collected. The boat then gets upgraded to a Trawler, and a Trawler Respin is awarded.Trawler RespinAfter being upgraded, Trawlers get an x2 multiplier. Each Trawler collects all cash prizes appearing in the entire reel set. The Trawler Multiplier increases by +1 on each subsequent respin. New boats may appear on respins. If a boat collects Mutant Cash, it also gets upgraded to a Trawler. Boats that become Trawlers on respins get the same Trawler Multiplier as existing Trawlers. Respins continue until no more Mutant Cash gets collected. Ways wins pay during respins, but they are not affected by the Trawler Multiplier.Meltdown Free SpinsIn the base game, landing 3, 4, or 5 mushroom cloud scatter symbols awards 12, 15, or 20 free spins, respectively. Upon entering free spins, players are given the option to gamble for extra spins up to a maximum of 20. Landing on the green segment of the wheel means more spins, landing on the red segment means returning to the base game with no free spins. During Meltdown Free Spins, the Trawler Multiplier does not reset between spins. Free spins cannot be retriggered.Buy BonusIt is possible to buy entrance to Meltdown Free Spins, triggered by 3, 4, or 5 scatters for 65 times the bet. Otherwise, players may buy free spins guaranteed to be triggered by 5 scatters for 120x the bet.Mutant Trawlers slot - free spinsMutant Trawlers: Slot VerdictFish slots, oh boy, there are a lot of them, huh? Quick clap then for Bang Bang Games for making one which doesn't blur seamlessly into 10,000 others. A trip to a lake heavily polluted by nuclear runoff, full of mutant fish that'll turn your skin unhealthy colours, might not sound like fun in real life, but in a fish slot, it makes a welcome change. The humorous angle taken in Mutant Trawlers makes it a light-hearted game that aims to appeal to keyboard anglers looking for a humorously light slot in general.For one thing, winning potential isn't huge, so at 3,069x the bet, Mutant Trawlers isn't taking aim at the Golden Catches or the 4 Fantastic slots in the market. It's closer to something like Play'n GO's Boat Bonanza Colossal Catch. Mutant Cash values tended to be on the low side, for example, though they do get a leg up from Trawlers. Triggering Trawler Respins was quite enjoyable, too, particularly in free spins, as they not only keep the round going by not consuming free spins but getting a persistent multiplier, is always good news. As stated, Mutant Trawlers isn't a monster, yet it's easy to see certain piscine-minded gamblers getting a thrill out of the way it functions.Mutant Trawlers might not become a major player in the fish slot market; however, it does manage to stand out from the bunch, which is an achievement in itself due to the phenomenal amount of fish slots crowding the shelves. It's similar in atmosphere to Ugliest Catch while delivering an alternative set of maths, features, and gameplay that may appeal to players who liked the style of the Nolimit City game but would prefer something more user-friendly, let's say. Or just fish fans on the trawl for a less generic game.

title: The Library
structured_summary: The Library is a slot themed around a cozy, book-filled library featuring literary figures and a quiet, contemplative atmosphere. It highlights the Stackways mechanic with symbol stacking and free spins, including Special symbols that can stack up to 20 high, plus a bonus buy option. The reviewer finds it a solid debut with impressive win potential but notes some thematic inconsistencies and less polished visuals. The game’s aesthetics blend cozy library imagery with AI-styled portraits, while the reel animations feel somewhat out of place in the setting.
review: The Library: Slot OverviewIn its quest for world domination, or so it might seem, software provider Hacksaw Gaming has added another games studio to the fold. This one is Kitsune (Japanese for fox) Studios, and its first slot, The Library, has landed on the dissection bench. For its debut, Kitsune Studios has been handed Hacksaw Gaming's Stackways mechanic, as seen in Mayan Stackways (2023) and Ronin Stackways (2023), to name a couple of prior examples. It's a mechanic that can literally stack a lot of symbols on a reel, like wedging a bunch of books on a shelf, and Kitsune Studios has paired it with a slight 'Book of' touch during the free spins bonus rounds.The humble library might not seem like an obvious place to host a gambling event due in part to the need to be quiet, but Push Gaming rocked Mystery Museum, so maybe Kitsune Studios will rock a book repository, too. When you think about it, libraries do rock in their own quiet way. They're literal stores of knowledge, gateways to adventure, and borrowing a book is usually free. Incredible. They're often found in amazing buildings as well, and the bookish room Kitsune Studios has set up for The Library looks like a cosy place to sit down, relax, and turn a page or two. Not content with just books, The Library also reinvents several famous names from literature. More on them in the symbol section.The Library slot - base gameThe Library's 5x4 gaming area provides an enormous number of ways to win, from up to 100,000 in the base game to a whopping 3.2 million during free spins. Course, you'll need the Stackways feature to go absolutely bananas to hit those sorts of numbers. Users are able to select a stake of 10 c to $/€100 to play the game, which is highly volatile and has a maximum RTP of 96.34%.The Library's symbols are 10 to A card rank lows, then four what look like AI-generated versions of Lewis Carrol, Dante Alighieri, Edgar Allan Poe, and Beatrix Potter. A 5 OAK royal win pays 0.5-0.6 times the bet, while a 5 OAK premium win is worth 1.5-3 times the bet. Wild symbols are not part of the game.The Library: Slot FeaturesThe Library slot - free spins with special expanding symbolsStackways are The Library's main feature, available in the base game as well as in Stack the Shelves Spins and Super Stack the Shelves Spins.StackwaysA landed Stackways symbol stacks 2 to 10 symbols on its respective reel. There are two types of them. Normal Stackways have values of 2, 3, or 4, while Revealing Stackways reveal values of 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, or 10. The stacked symbol is chosen by the symbol that would give the longest winning combination out of the symbols on the grid when the Stackways symbol activates. If there is more than one option, the choice amongst the possible options is made randomly. Stacking only occurs if the result creates a win.Stack the Shelves SpinsIn the base game, landing 3 book scatters triggers this feature with 10 free spins. Players are randomly assigned 1 symbol to be the Special symbol. The Special symbol stacks and pays if it lands on 3 or more reels. Indicators below the respective reels reveal a number of 2 to 10, indicating the number of symbols that will be stacked.In addition, the Stackways symbol may appear on the grid. When it lands, it acts as the Special symbol, further increasing the stacking on the reel by the value it displays. Stackways merge their displayed value with the value displayed beneath their reel to increase the total stacking amount for that reel. In this way, up to 20 symbols may be stacked on a reel. Stackways symbols only activate when a Special symbol is part of a winning stack on its reel.It is possible to win +2 or +4 extra free spins by landing 2 or 3 scatters, respectively. If 4 scatters hit, the round upgrades to Super Stack the Shelves Spins and grants +4 free spins.Super Stack the Shelves Spins10 Super Stack the Shelves Spins are awarded from the base game when 4 scatters hit. This is the same as the regular Stack the Shelves Spins feature, except players are assigned 2 Special symbols at the start of the round.Bonus BuyClicking the bonus buy button reveals the following options: BonusHunt FeatureSpins mode costs 3x per spin to make each spin 5 times more likely to trigger a bonus game, while Stackways FeatureSpins cost 50x, and they guarantee at least 2 Stackways symbols land. Lastly, players can buy Stack the Shelves Spins for 150 times their bet.The Library slot - free spinsThe Library: Slot VerdictHacksaw Gaming is a studio that hammers the daylights out of a feature it likes, bending, moulding, and reshaping it into various forms for use in various slots. Is it telling, then, that the studio hasn't put a ton of effort into reshaping its Stackways mechanic? Mayan Stackways wasn't bad, nor was Ronin Stackways, but Hacksaw Gaming, for whatever reason, hasn't done a lot else with the idea since then. On its first outing, Kitsune Studios has picked up the feature and created a game with eye-catching figures, predominantly the huge number of possible ways to win, though winning potential of 10,000x is enticing, too.Obviously, numbers aren't everything, and The Library is able to deliver positive moments which aren't solely figures-based. title: Book of Power

A pay symbol is selected at the start of the round to be the special expanding symbol. During free spins, on top of any normal line wins, if they can form a win, expanding symbols expand to cover all positions on their reels, paying all ways from any position. Should 2 Book symbols land in free spins, an additional expanding symbol is chosen, plus 5 extra free spins are awarded. If the new random symbol is already an active expanding symbol, it gets a +1 to its multiplier, up to 9.Power Free SpinsIf one of the 3, 4, or 5 triggering Book symbols is a Power Book symbol, players win 10, 15, or 20 Power Free Spins along with a payout of 10x, 100x, or 500x the bet, respectively. When 2 Book symbols hit, the current expanding symbol is upgraded by one step as well as +5 free spins are awarded. If reaching the highest paying symbol, any retriggers award +1 multiplier for the expanded symbol – up to 9. Also, landing a Power Book on reels 2, 3, or 4 makes that reel golden, where the expanding symbol expands even if no expanding symbol actually landed on the reel.Lucky BoostLucky Boost is available in both free spins features. Lucky Boost may trigger randomly at the start of a free spin, increasing the chance of hitting something big.Feature BuyBook of Power supplies two feature buys. One is regular free spins for the cost of 100x the bet, and the other is Power Free Spins, costing 200x the bet.Book of Power slot - free spinsBook of Power: Slot VerdictThis Relax Gaming/Casinogrounds meetup is getting to be a regular occurrence, and for a lot of gamblers, that can only be a good thing. Net Gains, Beast Mode, and Iron Bank all being strong slots. Book of Power is a bit different from them. For starters, it is a more conventional game. However, sticking to upgrading one expanding symbol with the introduction of multipliers, which is unlikely to be a frighteningly frequent occurrence, stirs the pot. Perhaps there are players who prefer expanding royals since they presumably have a tendency to hit more often, yet for those who lean towards the higher end of the paytable, the desirability of the top symbol as the expander has been boosted by the chance of it also having a multiplier attached. Doing things this way has also boosted Book of Power's winning potential, up to a maximum of 15,000 times the bet.To our knowledge, no one has recently accused the 'book of' category of being short on options, but their appeal is pretty self-evident. review: Splendour Forest (Max Win Gaming): OverviewMax Win Gaming is another one of those small independent studios that has been recruited by a bigger one to make it possible for them to churn out a larger quantity of titles, a market strategy that has become increasingly common and that has swamped the market with countless of mediocre games. The second game to be released by the studio, Splendour Forest, looks slightly more promising. If upon booting up the game, things look somewhat familiar to you, it's because Relax Gaming has been allowed to borrow the old Red Tiger user interface. The game itself, however, is entirely unique. Or, as much as it can be considering the fact that it is another take on the classic 'Book' game.Powered by Relax Gaming's Silver Bullet platform, Splendour Forest is a 5-reel, 10-payline slot with a fantasy theme and a tranquil feel. A take on the classic 'Book' game, it comes with the usual scatter wilds and a free spins game with special expanding symbols, but there's also a bit of a twist to it that we will get to later in the review. Highly volatile and with a fixed RTP setting of 95.04%, Splendour Forest can be played from 0.20 to $/€100 per spin across all devices.Visually, this psychedelic game offers few surprises, but the design is no less well executed. If it comes up, you simply get to pick yet another symbol which essentially means you could head into the bonus game with several expanding symbols in play. While the feature can be retriggered, you cannot activate additional expanding symbols (as is the case in Book of Ra Magic or Rise of Merlin for example) once the free spins game is underway.Splendour Forest (Max Win Gaming): VerdictIf you're willing to put Book of Ra or Book of Dead on hold for a while, you'll likely discover that Splendour Forest is a decent slot that is competent enough to keep you engaged for a while. With that said, there's a significant drawback to it that you need to consider.
