review: Arctic Valor (Crazy Tooth Studio): ReviewArctic Valor is a Microgaming powered slot developed by Crazy Tooth Studio, an independent Nevada-based software developing company that appears to have been producing slots mainly for the American market. Our background research came up pretty much empty handed and Microgaming themselves are yet to give Crazy Tooth Studio a proper introduction, though with a motto that reads "Quality Always Wins", what could possibly go wrong?Ok, so this is a relatively small studio and it would be unfair to compare them to the big established giants we usually feature here on Bigwinboard. We also know that these guys are enormously proud of their work, so we'll try to be gentle even though we don't think too highly of Microgaming, a company that has completely lost touch with reality. Speaking of Microgaming - it was equally depressing as it was absurd to witness their futile attempts at the recent London iGaming conference, where they tried to hype their sad titles that would barely have been relevant 10 years ago, let alone in 2019. Anyways...Arctic Valor is a 6 reel, 4096 ways slot that can be played from 0.15€ to 150€ a spin across all compatible devices. It features adjacent pays mechanics that allows you to win regardless of where on the reel set the winning combination appears as long as you land 3 or more matching symbols on adjacent reels. For example, land matching symbols on reels 4, 5 and 6 and the win is yours to collect.In this slot you get to embark on an arctic adventure with a randomly triggered Icicle feature and Arctic Valor free spins. Similar to ELK Studios 2018 release Valkyrie, there's a Norse mythology theme going on here. Set in a heavenly arctic temple, you will see an animation of the northern lights putting on a show in the backdrop as snowflakes gently fall onto the reels. On the ice-cracked reels you'll come across fully stacked low-value pink, blue and snow crystals as well as medium-value shields, winged helmets, crossbows and swords. The top symbols are represented by 4 valkyrie warriors - all of equal value, giving you 0.66 times your stake for 6 across a payline. There are no special symbols included aside from the wild which substitutes for all symbols bar the scatter.Arctic Valor (Crazy Tooth Studio): FeaturesFree Spins BonusIn the main game, the Icicle feature may randomly trigger on any spin. 1 or more icicles fall onto the reels and can appear up to 3 symbols high on each reel. You are then asked to click on the icicles to reveal cash prizes or wild symbols. This feature triggers quite regularly but can also tease you without actually activating.3 or more scatter symbols anywhere on the reels trigger the Arctic Valor bonus with 7 free spins on offer. In the bonus, the Icicle feature triggers on every spin to award you wild symbols. A set of Valkyrie symbols also comes into play here that are 3 symbols high. When Valkyrie symbols appear on the reels, the Icicles will specifically target them.Arctic Valor (Crazy Tooth Studio): VerdictThough Arctic Valor has a few things going for it, such as the 6-reel engine, the 4096 win all ways mechanics and fully stacked symbols, it ends up falling flat as a pancake due to the painfully dated visual design and the frustratingly low payouts. With that said, it does have a max win potential of 2700x per single spin should you land a full screen top symbol but with 38x wins being celebrated as a "huge win" here, it kind of gives you an idea what you're in for.Aside from the somewhat choppy spins and not so impressive visuals (except for the intro which looks quite nice) we also came across a small annoyance. When the Icicle feature triggers, you manually have to click the icicles to reveal the prizes, rendering the auto spin function a bit useless since the feature triggers quite frequently.The free spins don't make much sense either. The fully stacked Valkyrie symbols are removed to make way for 3 symbols high Valkyries instead. Furthermore, why make the Icicles automatically target the Valkyrie stacks when it should target the reels next to them to increase the chances of winning big. With the current setup it basically just adds premiums on top of premiums (please do correct us if we're wrong).Microgaming seems to have made it into their life's mission to support independent studios. Whether its an act of kindness, laziness or a way to profit on them is hard to say but as gamblers, we could care less. All we expect is good games that don't rob us blind and that offer the thrill of knowing there's a chance to land massive wins, something Microgaming and its posse of studios repeatedly fail to deliver.

title: Wild Trigger
structured_summary: Wild Trigger is a Western-themed slot featuring a showdown between two bandits in a dusty, desolate town. The game includes Walkdown Respins and Duel Free Spins with sticky wilds on reels 1 and 5, paying both ways during special features. The reviewer finds it a laid-back, simpler slot with modest max wins and sparse features, lacking high excitement. Visually, it boasts a sizzling heat haze effect, sepia tones, and atmospheric dust, creating one of the hottest-looking slots on the market.
review: Wild Trigger: Slot OverviewAy caramba players - looks like we're heading out West in a shoot 'em up styled slot from developer Play'n GO called Wild Trigger. The West was indeed a pretty wild place, hence the name, but that doesn’t mean it couldn’t produce comedic moments. Actually, in Wild Trigger, ironic might be a better word than comedic. In this Western, a couple of bandits called Clint McGraw and Dottie Fields have ripped off a bank in one of the biggest heists ever seen in the West. However, now they've got their hands on the loot, they don't want to share it. To settle the matter, the two criminals face off across the reels alongside features such as Walkdown Re-spins and Duel Free Spins.Birds circle ominously overheard when Wild Trigger loads, before the camera pans down to rest on a dusty middle of nowhere town, characteristic of the Wild West. Whatever your thoughts on the rest of the game are, Play'n GO has designed what has got to be one of the hottest looking slots on the market. Now, we don't mean hot the way Paris Hilton uses the word, but in regard to temperature. Thanks to the heat haze effect, the sepia tones, the sheer amount of dust, the screen fair sizzles when Wild Trigger lights it up.Melting in the middle of it all is Wild Trigger's 5x4 game panel, which has 20 paylines that usually pay left to right, though occasionally they pay both ways. If you look to the side of the reels, arrows are handily provided to alert you to the active direction. Slight overkill since they only pay both ways when respins or free spins are active, but still, handy. A medium volatile game, Wild Trigger's most optimal return to player value is the 96.2% version, offering a real range of stakes from a minimum of 2 p/c per spin up to a maximum of $/€100.Lining up the paytable, we come across 10-A symbols as the lower value symbols, paying out a reward of 5-7.5x the bet for a five-symbol line. Next are bourbon bottles, hats' n boots, pistols, dynamite, and sacks of gold, worth 12.5 to 50 times the stake for five of a kind. Two wild symbols make their way onto the reels as well, substituting for all symbols, and are integral to Wild Trigger's features.Wild Trigger: Slot FeaturesWilds appear on reels 1 and/or 5 only and always land stacked, covering all positions on their respective reel. Landing 1 of them triggers a Walkdown Respin where the wild is sticky, and paylines shift to paying both ways. When both of the wilds hit at the same time, then 10 Duel Free Spins are awarded. For the full duration of the free spins bonus round, both wilds are sticky, and the grid pays both ways.Wild Trigger: Slot VerdictWild Trigger takes place in one of the most desolate locations ever seen in an online Western-themed slot. The heat haze, the dust, the confrontation between two former partners, the buzzards, it all adds up to a pretty bleak scene. However, this is a bit of a front, in a way, because when drilling down into the details, Wild Trigger is actually one of the 'softer' Westerns we've come across in a while. This by no means makes it a bad game, as such, but if you're gunning for legendary status, it's unlikely to happen in these parts, muchacho.The reason is that while a lot of other developers are arming their Western slots with the biggest sidearms they can find, Wild Trigger takes aim at a different batch of gunslingers. Supposedly, players who like their Western slots a little more laid back, who aren't too fussed about chasing down the biggest rewards out there. Anyone in this group might be cool with what Wild Trigger does then. Actually, what it does is quite close to a Red Tiger's rap slot, Hustling. The two games share a pay both ways, wilds at both ends dynamic, though if anything, Wild Trigger is the simpler choice. It's is not a massively lucrative slot either, as its max win figure stretches to 2,000x the bet at most. Hardly the level of swag you'd want to stiff a partner out of, surely.Well, it doesn't get much shorter or sweeter than that, really. Wild Trigger is not a game which comes out guns blazing from the get-go, nor does it ever really do so. The features are pretty sparse, with just sticky wilds to look out for, so the action does get a bit repetitive after a while. Maybe if wilds walked during respins, or a multiplier feature was introduced at some point, or anything really, the game might have found it easier to shift up a gear. The 2c bets might be useful, but it's almost as if the onscreen heat has induced a level of lethargy Wild Trigger struggles to shake off.

title: Genie's Arabian Riches
structured_summary: Genie's Arabian Riches is an Arabian-themed slot featuring a genie granting wishes, set on a 6x5 grid with scatter pays replacing traditional paylines. Its key features include Rolling Reels, MultiChase Rolling Multipliers, free spins with a growing multiplier, and a feature buy option. The reviewer finds it a solid but unoriginal game, borrowing heavily from Gates of Olympus while adding minor enhancements. The game showcases a sparkling, golden Arabian aesthetic with enchanting visuals and a fitting audio backdrop.
review: Genie's Arabian Riches: Slot OverviewAh, the old question: what would you ask for if you rubbed a lamp and a genie popped out to grant 3 wishes? Eternal life, riches, health, peace, Don Juan-level powers of seduction, infinite wishes? It's fun to fantasise but pointless, too, since, you know, genies don't exist and all. Or do they…? A question for another day as we turn to Genie's Arabian Riches, a slot by Games Global partner Neon Valley Studios. If a genie-themed scatter-paying slot would be one of your wishes, then consider it granted. For this is what Genie's Arabian Riches is in a nutshell, and if multiplier symbols and Rolling Reels are further wishes, then this really is your lucky day.When you think scatter pays these days (at least, when Genie's Arabian Riches was reviewed), it's often nigh on impossible not to draw comparisons to Pragmatic Play's hit Gates of Olympus. It would appear that Neon Valley Studios might have been thinking the same thing because Genie's Arabian Riches has a number of commonalities. For one, we're dealing with a powerful entity, this time a genie, who, like Zeus in Gates, hovers in the air next to the gaming grid. For two, Genie's Arabian Riches has multiplier symbols here, too, tied to the MultiChase element. For the view, Genie's Arabian Riches puts on a sparkling, golden-hued, enchanting vision of its Arabian setting. Even the gold bars framing the 6x5 gaming grid are Arabian influenced, and instead of using paylines or ways, it uses a scatter pays mechanic to land wins. When 8 or more matching symbols are on the grid in any position, a winning scatter combination is formed. The winning symbols are taken off the board, and others drop down to replace them. The hit rate on all models, including the default 96% RTP model, is 24%, and the volatility is high. Players may choose a stake of 20 c up to $/€120 per spin and are also able to buy the free spins round if they so choose.A moon and 4 other gem-like shapes are the lower-value symbols, while the higher-value ones are a cup, a pair of shoes, a dagger, and a carpet. Hitting a winning scatter containing 8 identical symbols pays 0.2 to 3 times the bet, going up to 2 to 50 times the bet when 12+ identical symbols are in view. One thing to say, Genie's Arabian Riches doesn't offer up wilds in the base game or in free spins. The Rolling Reels mechanic removes winning symbols from the grid and drops symbols down to replace them. As long as a new win appears after symbols have dropped, this feature will continue to consecutively trigger.Genie's Arabian Riches: Slot FeaturesGenie's Arabian Riches slot - free spinsThe lineup of features in Genie's Arabian Riches are Rolling Reels, MultiChase Rolling Multipliers, free spins, a Rising Rewards free spins multiplier, and feature buys.MultiChase Rolling MultipliersA multiplier of x2 to x100 is randomly awarded for each multiplier symbol that lands on a winning spin. Multiplier symbols remain on the grid until the Rolling Reels process has finished and may randomly be upgraded. In the base game, all present multiplier symbols are added together, and the total is used to multiply the spin's win.ScattersLanding 3 scatter symbols in the base game increases the free spins multiplier by +1, up to a maximum of x20. When 4, 5, or 6 scatters hit, they award 10 free spins plus a prize of 1x, 20x, or 200x the bet. While free spins are active, hitting 3 scatters triggers an additional +5 free spins. The free spins multiplier does not apply to scatter retrigger wins.Free SpinsWhen free spins are triggered, the current value on the free spins multiplier is carried over, which persists till the round ends. However, when a win occurs, and there is at least one multiplier symbol in view, the multiplier value is added to the total multiplier and applied to the win on that spin. The total multiplier keeps the updated value. Note that the total multiplier does not apply to wins if a multiplier symbol is not in view on the spin, and a multiplier symbol will not add its value to the total multiplier unless a win occurs on the spin. At the end of the round, the free spins multiplier resets to x1, though it can randomly reset to x2, x3, or x4.Feature BuyIt is possible to buy free spins with an x1 multiplier for 50x the bet. Alternatively, if the free spins multiplier is higher than x1, then players can buy free spins with the higher multiplier value at the cost indicated on the screen.Genie's Arabian Riches slot - feature buy optionsGenie's Arabian Riches: Slot VerdictOfficially, we haven't seen much of the MultiChase feature since Thunderstruck Stormchaser and Sugar Craze Bonanza from Stormcraft Studios and Hammertime, respectively. In reality, since MultiChase appears to boil down to multiplier symbols hitting the reels, pssh, that happens all the time. It's a bit odd when studios give names to a general feature or mechanic, like the Nobleways thing All For One used once upon a time to name the 15,625 ways to win system in Mayan Eagle, for example. Nah, multiplier symbols in scatter-paying slots are common stuff, having reared up in, well, Pragmatic Play's Gates of Olympus as an obvious example, which seems to have served as a template for Genie's Arabian Riches in general.In other words, if you like what Pragmatic Play's been doing in the scatter-paying space, there's a chance you'll like Neon Valley Studios' effort as well – provided raging originality isn't a key marker of a good slot. Genie's Arabian Riches advertises a max win potential of up to 15,000x the bet and uses many of the same tools as the previously mentioned slot to try and crack it or attempt to at any rate. Scatter wins, Rolling Reels, multipliers, it's a combo that's hard to beat and, apparently, hard to improve on.That might not be completely fair, actually. Neon Valley Studio has spiced up the mix, added an extra squeeze of lemon juice to the hummus, if you will, by adding a growable starting free spins multiplier, fed when hitting exactly 3 scatters in the main game. Plus, the base free spins buy is quite cheap (relatively speaking), so when tallying up all the parts, Genie's Arabian Riches is pretty decent as far as copycat wannabes with a couple of tweaks go.

title: Chicken Drop
structured_summary: Chicken Drop is a farm-themed slot by Pragmatic Play featuring a 7x7 grid with cluster pays and tumble mechanics. Key features include progressive symbol size and multiplier upgrades, free spins with carried-over bonuses, and a feature buy option. The reviewer finds it exciting and well-designed but somewhat generic compared to similar grid slots. The game boasts bright, cheerful farm visuals with big red barns, lush fields, and quirky bulging-eyed chickens, complemented by a light, fun atmosphere.
review: Chicken Drop: Slot OverviewPlayers, bust out your denim overalls and plaid shirts for Chicken Drop, a farmyard themed slot designed by provider Pragmatic Play. Utilising a cluster pays/ tumble wins combination to link together wins, the game also benefits from a couple of progressive features in the form of symbol size upgrades and multiplier upgrades. Topping it all off is a round of free spins, where decent potential wins are possible.Like other grid slots Pragmatic Play has produced, the studio has gone for an ultra-bright, cheerful presentation, ramming the view with big red barns, lush green fields, trees, and bulging-eyed chickens. In real life, things occur during food production that might be a little tough for non-farm constitutions to handle. Not this farm, though. Chicken Drop is set in the sort of place where chicken wings and drumsticks are grown in Petri dishes rather than off animals themselves. The gaming takes place on a 7x7 sized panel, dropping in 49 colourful symbols on each spin.Played using a 7x7 sized panel while allowing bets from 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin to be set, the game caters to players after something a bit more volatile, as the game comes shipped with a volatility rating of 5 out of 5. The RTP is one area where Pragmatic Play games usually rank quite highly, with Chicken Drop generating a theoretical return value of 96.5% in its default form. Be aware though RTP can be found at lower levels, so always have a quick check. The game completes a cheery set of figures with a respectable max win cap, revealed below.Dropping 49 colourful symbols on each spin, the aim of Chicken Drop is to land clusters made up of 5 or more matching symbols for a win and to trigger the tumble feature. Most symbols in the game are farm-related, well, aside from the card suits, followed by mushrooms, acorns, corn, blueberries, and strawberries. This final symbol is the most profitable, and if you can land a cluster of 37+ strawberries, a coin win worth a massive 1,000x the stake is coming your way.Chicken Drop: Slot FeaturesOne thing Pragmatic Play is to be commended on in regards to their grid slots is they generally fork off in their own direction rather than use a standard collect winning clusters to trigger features approach. What you want to look out for here are tumbles, a couple of progressive modifiers, free spins, and a feature buy option.Central to the action is the tumble feature which removes winning clusters from the game board, dropping new symbols down into the gaps. This can lead to repeat wins from single spins, only ending when no new winning clusters hit.The progressive features launch when the watering can or 4 leaf clover symbols appear. Watering cans land first, highlighting an area of the grid. The more cans, the bigger the area can be from 2x2 to 6x6. When 4 Leaf Clovers hit, they accrue a multiplier starting at x2, rising to x10. When there are no more upgrades or clusters in view, an egg symbols is dropped on the grid, turning all symbols in the highlighted area into the same matching pay symbol – triggering the tumble mechanic again.The main event is a round of free games, triggered when 4, 5, or 6 scatter symbols land to award 10, 15, or 20 free spins. If there are any upgrades in place when the feature triggers, they are carried over and do not reset for the duration of the feature. On every single free spin, when tumbles have completed, a new symbols type and space is selected on the grid for an egg drop to occur - functioning in the same way as described above, including size upgrades and progressive multipliers. The feature may be retriggered indefinitely as well, when 4 or 5 scatter symbols land, adding +5 additional spins to the remaining total.As mentioned, Chicken Drop ships with a feature buy button, in jurisdictions where available. Paying 100x the total stake guarantees entrance to free spins.Chicken Drop: Slot VerdictLike an actual chicken farm, Chicken Drop gets pretty manic at times, fuelled by features that help boost each other to produce exciting moments. There are no qualms with what Chicken Drop does. Pragmatic Play has come up with an interesting interplay of egg drops and progressive features to ramp up potential wins. It's nice to get a taste of them in the base game occasionally, but knowing an egg drop will land on each free spin provides extra incentive to stick it out for the bonus round.Where Chicken Drop falls a little flat is in its generic nature. The concern is that it looks and feels a lot like other grid slots Pragmatic Play has done, such as the Fruit Party duo - though features are completely different. In regards to extras, Chicken Drop has more in common with Fat Santa in some ways though it is far from being an imitator as such. Chicken Drop also shares the same win cap as the two Fruit Party games as well, maxing out at 5,000 times the stake. For players interested in the odds, Chicken Drop compares quite favourably in general but is by far the least likely of the three to hit its top payout with a likelihood of 1 in 4,166,667.Chicken Drop ends up being another Pragmatic Play game with the means of delivering gaming that does get the pulse racing at times. However, it lacks an unnameable something to make it really stick in your mind and stand out from the dozens of other grid slots out there. There is an enjoyable lightness to it; the big-eyed rubber chicken thing is always good for a laugh or two, yet once the gaming's done, it lacks a killer dynamic to have you rushing back to the farmyard for more.

title: Pilgrim of Dead
structured_summary: Pilgrim of Dead is an Ancient Egyptian-themed slot inspired by the popular "Book of Dead" style, focusing on immortality and Pharaonic culture. Its key features include a 5x3 grid, 10 paylines, a tomb wild/scatter, and free spins with a unique sticky expanding symbol mechanic. The reviewer praises Play'n GO's execution and twist on the classic formula, noting it offers exciting gameplay though the bonus can feel tight and volatile. The game boasts rich temple and tomb visuals with atmospheric audio, maintaining a heavy, immersive Egyptian vibe.
review: Pilgrim of Dead: Slot OverviewThe abundance of 'book of' slots is pretty common knowledge, but there is also a significant number of 'of Dead' games as well. The vast majority have come off the Play'n GO production line with Book of Dead being perhaps the best-known and most beloved of the lot. Here's another to add to the growing list going by the name of Pilgrim of Dead. Like a lot of its kin, Pilgrim of Dead largely sticks to a well-used blueprint while injecting one or two tweaks to give fans something a little different to try out. In Pilgrim of Dead, that means free spins where a randomly chosen symbol expands and pays from anywhere with an unusual sticky element.While some people have looked at cryonics to provide a possible future resurrection, for the Ancient Egyptians, death was simply a temporary event on an eternal journey. For them, when the physical body ceased to be, it wasn't the end but the beginning of the next phase of a person's voyage through immortality. There's something deeply reassuring about that viewpoint, and the culture it came from also created some of the most striking art, architecture, and literature the world has ever seen. Some of it manages to work its way into Pilgrim of Dead, which has a heavy vibe, not quite Hand of Anubis heavy, yet thick with a Pharaonic/temple/tomb atmosphere. It still retains clear visual links to Book of Dead, so fans of Play'n GO's 'book of' style should feel right at home.Pilgrim of Dead slot - base gameAnother one of the links is Pilgrim of Dead's set-up, as it's played on a 5-reel game grid, each reel holding 3 symbols and crossed with 10 fixed paylines. Players can expect a highly volatile session with a maximum theoretical return to player maxing out at 96%. Just like in the old days of Play'n GO, the provider insists on using coins to represent a lot of its values; which is either quirkily old school or kinda annoying. This means users can pick coin values and coin numbers when it comes to stake selection, with monetary values of 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin.Along the 10 paylines, if at least two premiums or three low pays land left to right from the first reel onwards, wins are formed. For five symbol winning lines, payouts equate to 4 to 6 times the bet for the 10-A card ranks or 12.5 to 100 times the stake for the scarab, scales, Anubis statue, or Pharaoh symbols. Lower than normal, perhaps, though the sticky symbol aspect in free spins helps tip the scales back.Pilgrim of Dead: Slot FeaturesPilgrim of Dead slot - free spins with special expanding symbolPilgrim of Dead doesn't have a book as its wild/scatter symbol (the book was removed from Book of Dead, likely due to legal reasons), but a tomb instead. The tomb symbol lands anywhere and can replace all paying symbols to help complete winning lines – with the exception of expanding symbols. It also pays out, having the same value as the Pharaoh top premium. When 3 or more tomb scatters land, 5 free spins are awarded.The first part of the bonus round involves a pay symbol randomly being selected to be the special expanding symbol. When the symbol is revealed, players can reject it, and another one will randomly be picked. Players must accept the second symbol; it cannot be rejected.In free spins, when the chosen symbol lands on at least two reels if it's a high pay, or three reels if it's a low pay, it expands to cover all positions on its reel. This occurs after any regular line wins have been awarded. Expanded symbols pay all lines from any position. What's different is that the first chosen symbol to land on each reel becomes sticky. So after it has expanded and paid, it reverts to 1x1 size and is locked in position until the round ends, capable of creating another win on the next spin. Should 3 tomb scatters hit, additional spins are granted, up to 30 at the most.Pilgrim of Dead slot - free spinsPilgrim of Dead: Slot VerdictIf anyone knows how to pull off one of these 'book of' type slots with a twist, it's the team over at Play'n GO. The studio has a good number of them stashed away under its belt already, and they don't seem keen to quit any time soon. For fans of this style of play, that's a positive thing because Play'n GO are pretty darn good at making them. Pilgrim of Dead is a prime example. It looks the business, comes from a respectable line of previous slots, and most importantly, its twist is a good one.There is a case of checks and balances going on, however, which may not sit right with some. You can take quite a beating trying to trigger free spins, and to make sure the sticky symbols don't go too wild and crazy during the bonus, Play'n GO has reigned in the symbol values and decimated the number of initially awarded free spins. This tightens the bonus round-up, making it a tad more frantic than usual, as the race is on to get as many sticky expanders in place before the free spins run out. Retriggers are a technical possibility, of course. Being able to reject the first chosen symbol can be a blessing or a curse depending on what the second one might be. Great when it's an upgrade but you gotta laugh when turning down the King to get the Queen instead, as happened in one of the earlier triggers.Then there's the other side of the coin. When Pilgrim of Dead is on a repeat win run, with sticky symbols in place, expanding on every spin from then on out, it can be hella fun. Add everything together, and it's time to chalk up another entertaining Play'n GO 'book of' style slot. Pilgrim of Dead is probably different enough to put off some fans as much as it excites others, but well worth investigating if this style of gameplay is of interest.

title: Bison Bonanza
structured_summary: Bison Bonanza is a nature-themed slot set in an American rocky canyon featuring wildlife like bison and bears. It offers scatter pays, cascades, free spins with huge multipliers, and a bonus buy option for faster access to features. The reviewer finds it unoriginal but well-executed, with strong gameplay and solid winning potential. The game boasts a traditional, polished look with fitting ambient sounds that complement its wildlife theme.
review: Bison Bonanza: Slot OverviewOne age-old division splitting people into opposing groups is the salty vs sweet question. Some people prefer a bit of sugary goodness in their lives, while others desire a salt hit. Of course, there's the third category of gastronomes who are happy chowing down on either food group. For players with savoury preferences, here is Bison Bonanza, a slot from Blueprint Gaming which undeniably has taken one or two cues from Pragmatic Play's popular release, Sweet Bonanza.To be honest, aside from a theme change, the two games are very similar indeed. One thing uniting them is they are both played on a 6-column, 5-row game panel, using a scatter pays system. There are also colossal multiplying symbols in free spins. However, the appearance of the two slots could not be any more different. The name gives it away - Bison Bonanza is an American nature-themed slot situated in a rocky canyon, with wildlife and cacti to keep players company. These sorts of slots are pretty common, with this particular theme having worked exceptionally well for Blueprint in the past with titles such as Buffalo Rising Megaways and Wolf Legend Megaways. Here, Blueprint has gone for a standard look rather than try something more unique, so traditionalists should be happy with the polished presentation.Bison Bonanza is a big beefy game, running highly volatile as it powers its way to a return value of 96.5%. Players can select base bets of 20 p/c to $/€10 per spin or trigger the Bison Bet, which increases the stake by 25% and doubles the chance of triggering the bonus game (RTP remains the same). Bison Bonanza does not use paylines or ways to create wins. Instead, as long as 8 or more matching symbols are in view, anywhere on the board, booyah, there's a bunch of coins coming your way.On to the symbols then, where there are nine regular pays – four are lower value card suits, five are higher value lynxes, wolves, eagles, bears, and bison. Having 8-9 matching premiums in view is worth 1-10x the bet, going up to 10-50x when 12+ are in view. Lows payout 0.25-0.8x for 8-9, rising to 2-8x the bet for 12+ in view.Bison Bonanza: Slot FeaturesBison Bonanza borrows much of its action from outside sources, so alongside scatter pays are things like cascades, free spins with multiplier symbols, and a bonus buy for applicable players.CascadesWhen a scatter win hits, it is taken off the board, and the symbols still on the reels drop into the vacated spaces. If this creates another scatter win with the new symbols, the process is repeated.Free SpinsPlayers enticed by the prospect of massive multipliers, the chance to indulge occurs when at least 4 bonus symbols land in view, thereby triggering free spins. This is where the special multiplier symbols can appear. First, though, players pick which form the free spins will come, from these options:12 free spins with multipliers of x2 to x100.8 free spins with multipliers of x4 to x200.5 free spins with multipliers of x8 to x500.Mystery choice which awards random spins and multiplier limits from a pick 'n click screen.In free spins, if a multiplier symbol lands in view during a cascade win sequence, it awards a multiplier based on the limitations mentioned above. When cascades finish, the total prize value is increased by the multiplier. If more than one multiplier is in view, the values are added together first, then applied to the win.Bonus BuyJump right into the stampede if you so choose by buying the bonus round instead of waiting for it to happen on its own. There are two choices. One costs 100x the bet, has an RTP of 96.6% and is the same as landing at least 4 bonus symbols, as detailed above. The second is to buy a blast on the Bison Wheel for 248x the bet. This latter option spins a three-tier wheel to award 10-20 spins, an x2 to x10 minimum multiplier and x100 to x500 maximum multiplier. The RTP for this is 96.82%.Bison Bonanza: Slot VerdictOkay, fair enough, what we are dealing with here is essentially Sweet Bonanza with critters instead of candy. That's an inescapable fact, so if these similarities are a hard no for you, then Bison Bonanza is as guilty of being an ersatz impersonation as any other. We've seen Hacksaw do this as well with Joker Bombs and The Bowery Boys, and Blueprint themselves have even used the format before in Deal or No Deal Banker's Bonanza, so the trend is well established. It could even be argued Blueprint hasn't been particularly imaginative in its choice of theme. You don't need us to tell you how many North American wildlife slots dot the marketplace already, particularly those fronted with buffalo. If you can overlook these things or just couldn't care less anyway, Bison Bonanza is a real stampede of a game, with plenty to get stuck into.Naturally, if you've played Sweet Bonanza or one of its offshoots, you'll know what to expect from Bison Bonanza. If not, it's worth checking out how a scatter pays system functions, with Bison Bonanza being a good example to experiment with. What helps it compete with its direct competitors are things like the slick execution, the huge multipliers, and the Bison Wheel.Sure, sure, there's not a great deal of revolutionary gaming to be found here by any stretch of the imagination. However, that doesn't stop Bison Bonanza from being a strong choice for players after a new scatter win game. As to potential, it's funny, after seeing Blueprint Gaming toss around their 50,000x max win clause so often in other games, Bison Bonanza's 10,000x ceiling doesn't feel small by comparison. What with the chance of boosting wins with multipliers of up to x500, the 10,000x feels somewhat achievable.As we said, the theme and features are far from fresh; no way to deny that. However, cliches didn't become cliches by chance, so for ground shaking gameplay you can rely on, Bison Bonanza's blend of scatter pays, and colossal multipliers along with favourable RTP and decent potential make it a solid option.

title: Ultra Rich
structured_summary: Ultra Rich immerses players in a lavish theme centered on the extravagant lifestyle of the ultra-wealthy elite. The game features a multi-tiered wheel bonus system with progress bar upgrades, offering escalating cash prizes and multipliers across three prize wheels. The reviewer finds the base game dull and the progression to bigger wins slow and luck-dependent, though the potential 10,000x max win adds some appeal. Visually, the slot is flashy and glitzy with game-show style lights and rich-themed symbols, complementing its luxurious audio-visual presentation.
review: Ultra Rich: Slot OverviewIf you don't happen to already be in the group, why not take a moment to pretend you're part of the uber-rich, the 1%, the elite, or, as Red Tiger has put it, the Ultra Rich? Imagine money isn't even an issue anymore. Whatever you desire, you get. Bugattis, gold toilets, nothing is unobtainable anymore. Now, back in the real world, most adults have to put in some sort of work to get rewards. So it is with the online slot Ultra Rich where the goal is to patiently spin away in order to upgrade better prize wheels to gain access to bigger and bigger potential rewards.Ultra Rich prize wheel spins throughout the base game, above the main gaming area, to provide an incentive to keep ploughing on. To be honest, the prizes on the Base Wheel aren't exactly major motivators, topping out at 15x the bet. Big whoop. But, possible rewards do get bigger as progress unfolds, culminating in the Mega Wheel's 1,000x (keeping in mind multipliers are able to boost prizes on the two unlocked wheels further). The rest of the scene is all flashing lights and glitz, sort of game-showy, with several references to riches strewn about the place.Ultra Rich slot - base gameThe main play area feels like a formality rather than something to really get excited about and holds 5 reels and 25 win lines. Clicking the Stake button brings up a list of betting options from a low of 10 c to at the most $/€10 per spin. The default RTP for the game is right at 96%, while its volatility is medium-high.Regular symbols in Ultra Rich pay left to right on consecutive reels, beginning from the leftmost reel. Goldeny metallic 10-A card ranks are the low pays, awarding 4 to 6 times the bet for 5 OAK winning combinations. Then there are banknotes, cars, a lady singer, and a James Bond type of chap as the premium symbols, worth 12 to 40 times the bet for 5-of-a-kind. Next is the wild that substitutes for all of the pay symbols. When a wheel symbol hits, play moves to the bonus phase, and a wheel spins to award a cash prize. Or, as the game info calls it, an awesome cash prize. Basically, a segmented wheel spins, and where it ends, the corresponding prize is awarded. Some sectors on the wheel have a respin icon in addition to a prize. Landing on a sector with a respin awards one more spin on the same wheel, on top of the awarded prize.Wheel UpgradesA 2-stage progress bar is located above the reels, each stage holding 3 lights. Triggering the wheel bonus game activates one of the lights. Lighting up all 3 lights of a stage unlocks a new extra wheel in the bonus game. When the Mega Wheel is unlocked, Upgrade sectors also appear on the Super Wheel, granting an extra spin on the Mega Wheel when an Upgrade is landed on.Base Wheel Prizes - 5x, 10x, 15x.Super Wheel Prizes - 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 30x, 40x, 50x.Mega Wheel Prizes - 30x, 40x, 50x, 60x, 80x, 100x, 200x, 300x, 500x, 1,000x.Prize Multiplier ReelThe Super Wheel and the Mega Wheel also have a multiplier reel above them. The multiplier reel spins random multiplier values of x2 to x20, or a diamond-shaped value-less position. The multiplier reel spins as well as the wheel. Landing a multiplier multiplies the prize won from the wheel.Ultra Rich slot - wheel upgradesUltra Rich: Slot VerdictNot sure if you caught this already, but it was reported that the Sultan of Brunei, one of the richest people on the planet, paid something like $24,000 to have his hair cut by a barber flown in from London. If that's not eye-bulging enough, the Sultan is said to own over 7,000 cars. If he drove a different car each day, it would take around 20 years to get through the lot. There's a chance he buys cars faster than he can actually drive them all. Why so many? Ah well, who's to judge what other people do with their dosh, provided it's all legal, of course.Ultra Rich, on the other hand, yeah, why don't we judge it a bit. Let's start by saying Ultra Rich isn't the most enthralling slot Red Tiger has ever done. There's just too much sitting around, twiddling of thumbs in a feature-less base game, despite all the upmarket glitz on show. Otherwise, not landing 1 DD symbol in each reel means players continue in the base game.In the Dream Drop Bonus, it is possible to win 1 of 5 jackpots. To do so, you click DD symbols one at a time until 3 of the same jackpot is revealed – then the corresponding prize is awarded. title: Diamond Duke
structured_summary: Diamond Duke is a 1950s-themed slot evoking classic American diners, vintage cars, and a retro rock 'n' roll atmosphere. Its features include two bonus wheels offering multipliers and a three-stage Pick & Click bonus game for enhanced wins. The reviewer finds it charming and simple, praising the soundtrack and solid math model despite modest visuals. The game’s aesthetics blend vintage style with smooth jazz audio, creating a relaxed, nostalgic vibe.
review: Diamond Duke: OverviewIt's time to rewind the clock to the rock 'n' roll 1950s. Diamond Duke is set in a time when cars were huge and handled like boats, when Peggy Sue was yet to marry, and Sandy and Danny were trying to work out whether they liked each other. It was also the era of chrome, big lashings of the shiny stuff in diners, cars, and anything that could be bolted down. Being set in a less tech-driven era might make Diamond Duke look like a pared-back slot at first. However, it does have a couple of interesting features that can improve wins and produce a rather high potential.This ultra-retro slot places the grid within an old-school style one-arm bandit that's bathing in spotlights. Sitting on top of the machine are two intriguing bonus wheels. It's all scaled down and it feels like Billie Holiday could wrap her hand around one of those vintage microphones at any moment and start crooning. The soundtrack reinforces the vibe with a smooth, laid back old jazz track. All up, Quickspin has done a nice job of creating a relaxed scene to insert quarters and spin.The 1950s were supposedly a simpler time, so players get a simple 3x3 slot to relive it. And gone all out with the classic approach they have indeed. This applies to the symbols which are familiar favourites, (or despised generic), tiles of the genre. In ascending order, there are cherries, grapes, melons, bells, sevens, and diamonds. Values range from 3 cherries at 1x the stake, to 3 diamonds worth a sweet 160 times the stake. There are 5 fixed paylines in total, and with the symbols being stacked on the reels, a grid of diamonds will net you 800 times your stake right there. This is enhanced further by the features as we shall see.Before getting to the best parts, the underlying math model warrants an inspection. Fortunately, the old fashioned outer shell reveals a bunch of thoroughly modern stats running the show. First up is the always important RTP which has been rated at the wholesome level of 96.23%. Quickspin's volatility is measured from 1-5, and Diamond Duke musters up the full 5, so it's a highly volatile game. So far, two thumbs up from the Fonz. Getting in on this sock hop is ideal for low rollers who can select bets from just 5 p/c per spin, or, ratchet that up to $/€100 should the mood strike.Diamond Duke: FeaturesPick and click bonusIn keeping with the multiples of three angle, Diamond Duke comes with three additional features. Each one is tied to the bonus wheel which can dole out some sizeable multipliers or crack open the bonus Pick & Click feature.The key to the Bonus Wheel is the wheel scatter symbol - 2 of these symbols in view awards you 4 times your bet plus 1 spin of the bonus wheel. The bonus wheel then awards either a multiplier of x2, x3, x5, x7, or x10, or the Pick & Click Bonus game. Any multipliers won are applied to the total win.The Pick & Click game is a simple choosing game with 3 stages containing coin wins based on your stake. Players continues making picks until they reveal either the upgrade symbol, which moves them up a level, or the collect symbol which ends the feature. The stages are set up like so:Stage 1 offers prizes between x2 and x7 the bet.Stage 2 offers prized between x3 and x15 the bet.Stage 3 offers prizes between x5 and x100 the bet.Should you manage to land 3 wheel symbols, then you are rewarded with 8x the stake, one spin on the bonus wheel, and one spin of the Multiplier Wheel. When this happens, players first go through the steps mentioned above. Once that is complete, they take a spin on the multiplier wheel to apply an extra multiplier of x2, x3, x5, x7, or 10x to the total win. In this way, substantial wins are capable of building up on top of each other before heading back to the base game.Diamond Duke: VerdictFor what it is, Diamond Duke is a rather charming wee game. If you happen to be in the mood for a simple 3 reel slot, it might be worth a look. The soundtrack is a standout and alternates agreeably between laid back during the base game, and up-tempo during features or big payouts. Diamond Duke is not the most striking game visually. Still, it achieves Quickspin's stated goal of transporting players back to the 'heyday of American diners and classic cars with chrome and wings.' After playing, you do get a hankering for some pancakes and a milkshake as the developer suggests.Not only has Quickspin done a nice job of recreating the 1950s, to a degree, but the math model and stats produced by the game are rather good too. For one, RTP and volatility are decent, but even better is the max potential which is surprisingly high and has been clocked at 8,000 times the stake. Perhaps one slight drizzle on the parade, is that this particular figure arose during 100 billion simulated spins. In other words, there is a chance Doc Brown will invent time travel before some lucky punter picks it up. Then again, you just never know, and the dual multipliers and the Click & Pick are technically capable of juicing up wins.Overall, Diamond Duke is quite a good example of a basic slot with a few useful extras. You don't always see multiplier action on this scale with a game like this, so if you are after some 3x3+ gameplay, Diamond Duke might fit the bill.

title: Extra Chilli Megaways
structured_summary: Extra Chilli Megaways is a Mexican food market-themed slot and a follow-up to the popular Bonanza, featuring a miner-turned-chilli vendor storyline. review: Extra Chilli Slot: OverviewBonanza 2 Extra Chilli, is the follow up to one of the most popular online slots ever to be released - Bonanza. Big Time Gaming dropped the bomb during the London iGaming conference earlier this year, announcing the upcoming release of Extra Chilli. More on that further down, so keep reading.The title seemed a bit awkward when first announced and didn't make any sense being a follow up to Bonanza, but it turns out the miner quit his job to pursue his lifelong dream opening a Chilli stand (makes perfect sense actually). Any extra golden H.O.T symbols will award the player 4 extra free spins.During the bonus, a win multiplier increases by 1 on every win cascade - with no limit. When the re-trigger hits, players can gamble (V-gamble system) to try and win more free spins. A successful spin on the gamble wheel can award you with up to 24 free spins. All in all, Extra Chilli proves to be one of the better slots ever made, in particular for hard-core gamers looking for a rush of adrenaline.

title: Beastly Burglars

review: Beastly Burglars: Slot OverviewSoftware provider AvatarUX, yeah, the PopWins guys, have once again joined forces with the mysterious Mr Wu in order to release the breaking-the-law-themed online slot Beastly Burglars. One might argue that all burglars are beastly, but in Beastly Burglars, the crims are actually played by animals rather than people. Realistic elements are juxtaposed with the game grid, where cartoon animals land about the place. Various species have come together to pull off this job of heisting priceless artefacts. The problem with that is selling the gear on, presumably. Maybe not if the stolen items were lesser known, yet still desirable historical trinkets. Imagine trying to fence the Mona Lisa or the Rosetta Stone. Sooner or later, someone would blab to the authorities, wouldn't they?Beastly Burglars slot - base gameBase game spins start with the 5-reel matrix dropping active symbols in a 1-3-5-3-1 pattern where there are 45 ways to win. Reels may be unlocked up to a 5x5 configuration where there are 3,125 ways to win. To join these jolly criminals as they attempt to rob a museum, players select stakes of 10 c to $/€100 and have access to an ante bet as well as feature buys. This happens in the base game and in free spins, where a special multiplier symbol joins the heist.Changing Grid and Vaults & Reel MultipliersEach win triggers a respin, and for each respin, one random Vault adjacent to an already unlocked position is unlocked. Vaults are the blocking positions on the grid. Every reel has a reel multiplier on top of it in a locked state. For the middle reel, the multiplier is unlocked by the first win on a spin, as well as a random Vault. The other reel multipliers are unlocked when all of the Vaults on the same reel are cleared. In the base game, reel multipliers are fixed at x2. In free spins, reel multipliers always start at x2.Free SpinsEach time a scatter symbol appears, it is collected by the Bonus Collector between respins. If 3 scatters are collected, 8 free spins are awarded. Otherwise, the Bonus Collector resets.When triggered, free spins start with the final base game board, including the reel multipliers that were available before moving to the bonus game. If the entire grid is unlocked in free spins by removing all Vaults, +2 free spins are awarded, and all following spins start with the grid fully unlocked. During free spins, a special Multiplier symbol may land. If there is a win on the same reel as the Multiplier symbol, its value is added to the Reel Multiplier above it. The value of a single Multiplier symbol can be up to x50.Gamble WheelBefore playing the bonus round, players can increase the number of free spins on a Gamble Wheel. Losing the gamble takes players straight back to the base game. 8 free spins are initially awarded. Winning the first gamble awards 10 free spins, and winning the next gamble awards 12 free spins. Or, landing on a golden segment of the wheel awards 12 on the first gamble or 15 free spins on the second gamble. Hitting the golden segment starts the feature straight away.XpressAt the Xpress section, players can activate these features. Random numbers of Vaults are removed at the start of free spins: Gamble Wheel - 60x to win up to 15 free spins, Bonus - 8 free spins for 60x the bet, Bonus Plus - 12 free spins for 240x the bet, or Bonus Max - 15 free spins for 500x the bet.Beastly Burglars slot - free spinsBeastly Burglars: Slot VerdictHey, if you're going to knock off a major museum and fill your swag bag with cultural items of inestimable value, who wouldn't want a bunch of animal crooks at their side while doing so? Putting aside the animals for a moment, this is a serious slot, as AvatarUX and Mr Wu have again linked up to get down to the task of crafting a quality gambling tool to entertain and challenge players.And maybe reward them - to the tune of up to 10,000x the bet. So a tidy sum awaits the luckiest of heisty gamblers, and not a bad set of features to attempt the job with either. Win frequency was not available, but a question mark arose as to whether having a single symbol on the leftmost reel affects this stat. Dead spins certainly weren't a rarity. AvatarUX has dropped in a few compensators for this, though. Getting respins on every single win helps stir the pot along, aided by Vault unlocking, leading to more space on the reels and, of course, coveted reel multipliers. Slight Multifly! memories were produced while testing running the game, yet Beastly Burglars does more than enough to ensure that it's its own beast, or menagerie of beasts.AvatarUX and Mr Wu continue to forge a fruitful partnership, having turned out a bunch of highly enjoyable slots so far. Beastly Burglars might not have FloridaMan's dreamy thematic flair or DonKey & the GOATS' visual complexity, but it's a solid heist slot with a strong bag of tricks to employ.

title: Mahjong Wins

review: Mahjong Wins: Slot OverviewFor those who may be unfamiliar, mahjong is a tile-based game of strategy, luck, and skill that originated in China before spreading to other parts of the world. Adding to its collection of Asian-themed slots, developer Pragmatic Play has decided to use the popular game of mahjong, and not for the first time, to create Mahjong Wins -  a game full of tradition, tumbles, Gold symbols, tumble multipliers, and free spins with greater than base game multipliers.You know how there were (or still are?) internet cafes where gamers would pay to play games like Counter Strike over the net? Suffice it to say, there are 8 regular paying symbols worth 0.5 to 5 times the bet for a 5-matching symbol winning combination. When winning combinations hit, they are removed from the gaming grid by the tumble feature. Empty spaces are filled by symbols dropping down from above, and a tumble sequence continues until no new win hits on the board. Helping create winning ways is Mahjong Wins' wild symbol. Possible on reels 2, 3, and 4, wilds substitute for all symbols except the scatter.Mahjong Wins: Slot FeaturesMahjong Wins slot - free spinsWorking hand in hand with Mahjong Wins' tumble feature is a rising win multiplier feature, available in both the base game and in the free spins round. The other extra to be aware of is Gold symbols.Gold SymbolsAt random on any spin, regular pay symbols marked in gold may land on reels 2, 3, and 4. When winning combinations are formed with gold symbols, the gold symbols transform into wilds for the next tumble.Tumble MultipliersRunning along the top of the reels is a group of multiplier values. In the base game, the win multiplier starts at x1 and, after consecutive tumbles, increases to x2, x3, and x5, where it will stay for any following tumbles. The win multiplier resets at the end of a tumble sequence.Free SpinsLanding at least 3 scatter symbols awards 12 free spins. In free spins, the multiplier starts at x2 and increases following consecutive tumbles to x4, x6, and x10, where it will stay for the following tumbles. The multiplier resets to x2 for the start of the next free spin. Hitting at least 3 scatter symbols during the round triggers an extra 10 free spins.Mahjong Wins slot - free spinsMahjong Wins: Slot VerdictWhile it won't be everyone's cup of green tea, as far as mahjong-themed online slots go, it's hard to visualise a slicker production than Mahjong Wins. If it feels familiar, that might be because you've played another Pragmatic Play mahjong slot called Mahjong Panda, of which Mahjong Wins is more or less a reskin, having the same features, stats, and gameplay. Any improvements made to the grid during the base game are retained for the round of free spins. Also, the reel, or reels, that triggered the bonus game are further enhanced with additional x2 bonus wild symbols.If the ‘Hot 1’ part of the game titled seemed a little out of place, all will make sense now. It is wild and roams on every spin. Lastly, filling in the level 4 trail awards 5,000 times the bet.Piranha Pays slot - free spinsPiranha Pays: Slot VerdictPiranha Pays is a slot that is bursting with personality, which helps attract attention while triggering curiosity as to what else it might have going on. The set-up is great and makes for a creatively intriguing alternative use of fish instead of slapping the word 'bass' on everything for a change. Then, it's a race to collect scatters as quickly as the game will allow to level up. As well as growing the roaming wild piranha, the game grid grows, which is kind of a double-edged sword. Max win is 5,000x the bet, and the probability of maximum exposure according to the game sheet is 1 in 50,629, which could be a typo, but if not, it is quite extraordinary. For every 3 epic FS symbols that land at the same time, +1 free spin is awarded.Bonus BuyOcto Attack's bonus buy section offers these:BonusHunt FeatureSpins - each spin is 5x more likely to trigger a bonus for 3x the bet.Tentacular FeatureSpins - each spin guarantees at least 1 win, and 1 landed Eye of Otto symbol for 50x the bet.Eighth Arm Is The Charm - 100x the bet.Give Me Eight - 300x the bet. The Tenta-Grab grabs only wilds, wild multipliers, or FS symbols.Octo Attack slot - free spinsOcto Attack: Slot VerdictThey're a clever lot, Hacksaw Gaming, aren't they? Masters of throwing together a bunch of oddly selected items and turning out a fiendishly good game. Not always. Some are pretty logical. Chaos Crew 2, RIP City, Beam Boys, that sort of thing. Like finding an amazing ensemble at the thrift shop you can't wait to show off to your friends, Octo Attack makes its unusual collection of thematic objects, character, and a hint of a story work exceptionally well. title: Nightmaker
structured_summary: Nightmaker is a dark horror-themed slot by ELK Studios, immersing players in a creepy, eldritch environment. It features a complex 5-reel layout with cascading wins, big symbols, multipliers, wilds, free spins, and bonus buy options. The reviewer praises its high volatility and explosive potential, awarding it as a well-crafted, thrilling horror slot with massive win possibilities. The game’s eerie, Giger-inspired visuals and forlorn music enhance its unsettling atmosphere.
review: Nightmaker: Slot OverviewPeople tend to naturally find their tolerable sector of the broad spectrum of horror, from light, giggle-inducing nothingness to catatonic terror, turning away from topics which are just a little too much. So it is in slots, which are very rarely, if ever, actually scary but do occasionally dip into darker subject material. One studio that's not particularly famous for picking spooky topics is Swedish software provider ELK Studios, but the team has, for whatever reason, thrown on thick, heavy robes to have a dabble via the online slot Nightmaker.An Iron Throne without all the swords greets players as the game loads before plunging them into a rather creepy place. If, when you hear the words 'ELK Studios', you think of pirate birds or snorting cartoon bulls, you might need to make a perception adjustment because Nightmaker is a dark place indeed. The gaming grid sits within a bizarre tunnel of ridged objects, like something H. R. Giger might have designed to use in an Alien movie while possessing a number of fiendish references. The music is just as eerie, too, forlorn even, as if a battle has been lost before it's even begun, and vultures are already circling overhead.Nightmaker slot - base gameNightmaker's gaming area is pretty interesting too. It consists of 5 columns of symbols, landing by default in a 3-5-5-5-3 configuration with a feature row sitting on the top. This alignment produces 1,125 ways to win, rising to 3,125 when the four corner positions are unlocked and even higher when symbols are split - up to 25,000. A monster potential slot is driven by a highly volatile math model pushing out ELK Studios' go-to RTP of 94%. If that's not an issue, players are able to wager 20 c to $/€100 on each base game round.Four esoteric markings are Nightmaker's low pay symbols, awarding 0.4x the bet for 5 OAK, and its high pays are three odd objects and a skull face symbol, paying 0.8x to 10x the bet for 5-of-a-kind. Wild symbols substitute any paying symbol, and a winning combination of only wilds has the same value as the top-paying symbol. Wilds are indestructible till they reach the bottom of the grid, then they are moved with the next win, including any wilds stacked on top of them. Winning symbols are removed from the grid after they have paid. Gravity drops symbols down to fill the gaps, and any used feature symbols respin. The game will repeat this process as long as new wins appear.Nightmaker: Slot FeaturesNightmaker slot - free spinsThe features to spin for in Nightmaker are cascades, big symbols, a feature row, a bonus game, a super bonus game, Beast Spins, and X-iter bonus buys.Big SymbolsAny pay symbol can appear as a big 3x5 symbol on the middle three reels. Big symbols split into 15 1x1 symbols, and features apply to their respective columns. The rattle feature can trigger on any initial base game spin, awarding 1 to 3 big symbols.Feature RowFeatures on the feature row activate immediately and affect symbols in the affected column.Wild Spirit - effects 1-3 symbol positions, which can result in 1-6 wild symbols on the top positions of the affected columns. If there are already wilds or scatters in top positions, wilds are added to the next available positions from the top and spawned wilds get the multiplier of the symbol they replace. Wild Spirit keeps wild symbols indestructible for 1 additional win.Symbol Multiplier - adds a multiplier value to all symbols of the indicated type in the affected column. Wild symbol multipliers do not affect the jumping wild.Wildfire - triggers if there is a wild in the affected column, replacing all symbols on the column except scatters with wilds. The highest wild multiplier on the column will be added to all wild symbols on the column. A symbol with a higher multiplier will give that specific wild the higher multiplier value. Wildfire keeps wild symbols indestructible for 1 additional win.Split Symbols - splits all symbols except scatters on the affected column. Symbols can only be split once, and the maximum number of symbols on a column is 10.Bonus GameLanding 3 scatters in the base game awards 8 free spins. In the bonus game, one pay symbol is chosen to have a persistent multiplier attached to it. The four corners of the grid unlock for the round, increasing the number of ways to win. Landing a scatter in one of the corners awards +2 free spins, and the corner turns into a blocker.Super Bonus GameIf one of the 3 triggering scatters is a super scatter, the super bonus is awarded instead. In this feature, the super bonus symbol becomes a jumping wild that moves to a new position after each win and between free spins. The jumping wild temporarily gets the current multiplier of the position it covers. Landing a super bonus symbol in one of the corners in the bonus game or super bonus game generates an extra jumping wild.Beast SpinsBeast Spins are activated when scatters land in all four corners in the bonus game. During Beast Spins, only big symbols spin on the middle three reels.X-iterThe X-iter allows players to buy into different game modes. Bonus Hunt costs 3x the bet and buys a game round with more than triple the chance of triggering the bonus game. Wild Spins at 10x the bet buy a game round landing at least 1 wild symbol, and a game round with guaranteed Beast Spins costs 100x. The bonus can be bought for 100x or the super bonus for 500x.Nightmaker slot - free spinsNightmaker: Slot VerdictA number of studios have produced gloomy, heavy slots such as Print Studios' Darkness, Red Tiger's Judgement Day Megaways, Bullshark Games' Empress of the Shadows, as well as numerous releases from Hacksaw Gaming. Now, ELK Studios has turned its attention to the dark side, and not a bad job it's done either if you like slots grim, heavy, and perilous. Not just thematically either, as the highly volatile math model isn't exactly here to be everyone's best chum, and despite packing a lot of bells and whistles, play can technically go in any direction.This can be a good thing, though, because Nightmaker is a slot which feels like it's been wound tight, as if it's about to unleash at any moment. Any slot can, of course, but the particular combination of features, like splitting symbols and multipliers, combined with a lot of ways to win, produces an explosively on-edge feel. Exacerbating this effect is that lurking back there, in the shadows, getting up to all sorts of eldritch mischief is monstrous winning potential of 50,000x the bet. There are no max coins in this game either, so if, repeat if, the max win is ever achieved, it's going to be when Nightmaker pulls off straight reel-based trickery rather than dropping a jackpot-like symbol onto the board. One assumes Beast Spins have a part to play because of the way they can link so much of the gaming area, a bit like Dreadworks' Big Jack.It all makes for rather compelling viewing, and ELK Studios' foray into bleaker-than-usual subject matter has paid off. Don't want to be that one guy, but it does help that a lot of what's here feels like it might have been inspired by some of Nolimit City's output - the splits, symbol multipliers, jumping wilds, the darkness, etc. Of course, NLC doesn't have a monopoly on that stuff, but blending it together the way Nightmaker has done so made it hard not to draw parallels. If it's not obvious by now, Nightmaker triggered memories of a number of prior slots from a variety of studios. But the positive thing to note is that most memories were from rock solid slots, of which Nightmaker can stand proudly amongst, being a well-made, spookily exciting horror(ish) game that can jump scare with the big, freaky hitters.

title: Flower Fortunes Supreme
structured_summary: Flower Fortunes Supreme features a nature-inspired theme with a floral valley setting, continuing the style of its predecessor but dropping the Megaways branding. The game revolves around collecting orbs to level up, unlocking features like respins, expanding wilds with multipliers, bonus games, and both-ways wins. The reviewer finds it a puzzling sequel with reduced RTP, hit frequency, and max win potential compared to the original, making it less appealing. Aesthetically, it retains its naturalistic visuals with a new, oddly neat soundtrack, though it lacks the original's voice commentary.
review: Flower Fortunes Supreme: Slot OverviewIn 2019, Swedish designer Fantasma Games released Flower Fortunes Megaways, the studio's first use of Big Time Gaming's Megaways game engine. They did it in a way that was so unusual that at a glance, you'd be forgiven for not recognising it as a Megaways game at all. It wasn't just the distinctive way the studio had presented the reel-set but the collecting orbs to level up and unlock features system provided a brand new Megaways experience. Its unorthodoxies might have made it tricky to identify with at first, yet given the chance; its charms could bloom like a well-cared-for sunflower. Such was the creativity shown in Flower Fortunes Megaways, the thought of a supreme version was an exciting prospect indeed – what would Fantasma have in store this time around? Like the original Flower Fortunes slot, the studio has packed Flower Fortunes Supreme with surprises, but they are unlikely to be the sort of things fans were hoping for.Flower Fortunes Supreme slot - base gameThe first eyebrow-raiser was the fact the word 'Megaways' appears nowhere in the game, nor on the game sheet, or in the paytable. Flower Fortunes Supreme's grid continues to function more or less in the same way as the original so make of that what you will. Surrounding the reels is the same naturalistic view of steep valley walls, sleeping flowers, and grassy mounds. Two changes which stood out are the new or altered features on the collection metre and the bizarrely neat new soundtrack. Other than those, for now, it's business as usual.Flower Fortunes Supreme's numbers tell quite a different story, though, where just about everything is down. This includes an average RTP drop to 95.88% (this can increase depending on the level reached), volatility in the medium range of the scale, and a hit frequency decrease to 35.94%. Players expecting positive max win news are going to be sorely disappointed, but we'll refrain from dropping that bombshell for now.At its base level, the game panel has 6-reels, each 5 positions high. As you collect orbs, this can increase to 9 positions high at the most. Its symbols are like Cuisenaire rods which can land in three different sizes – 1x1, 1x2, or 1x3. The five pattern-less symbols are the low pays, worth 1-1.5 times the stake for six of a kind, whereas the high pays are four patterned tiles paying 2.5-10x the bet for a six of a kind win. Normal wilds always appear in 1x1 size on reels 2, 3, 4, or 5 to substitute all paying symbols.Flower Fortunes Supreme: Slot FeaturesFlower Fortunes Supreme - expanded wildsThe aim of Flower Fortunes Supreme is to collect orbs which are stored on the level bar next to the reels. The level bar starts with 0 steps. Orbs add one step while landing a leaf icon removes a step. Reaching higher levels on the bar adds rows to the grid and unlocks different features:Level 0 – 5 rows (RTP 95.32%).Level 1 – 6 rows, Respins are unlocked (RTP 95.56%).Level 2 – 7 rows, Respins and Expanding Wilds are unlocked (RTP 95.94%).Level 3 – 8 rows, Respins, Expanding Wilds, and Bonus are unlocked (RTP 96.15%).Level 4 – 9 rows, Respins, Expanding Wild, Bonus, and Both Ways are unlocked (RTP 96.41%).RespinsWhen unlocked, landing a Respins symbol on reels 2-5 triggers this feature. The Respins symbol removes itself and 5-12 random non-winning pay symbols. New symbols then fall down to create new chances to win.Expanding WildWhen wild symbols land from level 2 onwards, they expand to cover the full reel and get a random multiplier of x1 to x9. If more than one wild is part of a win, the multiplier values are multiplied.Bonus GameLanding 3 or more bonus symbols from level 3 and above activates the Bonus Game, which is played at the end of the spin - 5 flowers appear on the screen, and a random number of picks are awarded. Each pick awards a prize of 0.25x to 100x the bet.Both WaysReach this level, and winning combinations can be formed of matching symbols landing left to right, as well as right to left.Flower Fortunes Supreme slot - bonus gameFlower Fortunes Supreme: Slot VerdictFlower Fortunes Supreme is quite a puzzling release. For a sequel, let alone a supposed 'supreme' sequel, it's tough to think of why players might want to select this one over the original. Flower Fortunes Supreme is not a badly made game, but there's just so much less to it than Flower Fortunes Megaways. Wherever you look, practically everything has been dropped to a lower setting as if this was the actual beta version that should have come out before Flower Fortunes Megaways. The fact you need to level up in order to benefit from higher RTP is a bit strange too although, to be fair, the default RTP is not terrible.It can be enjoyable for sure, collecting orbs, activating extra features and so on, though the voice that used to commentate the action is conspicuous by its absence. The levelling up idea is a clever one, and the combination of bigger reels with extra features can blow up the tension. There is a feeling you're missing out when playing Flower Fortunes Supreme, though, and one of the main reasons is the severe drop in potential. Now, the most to be had is 5,000x the bet, which is less than a third of the 18,480x found in the Megaways version (we're yet to see proof of that potential though). Fantasma no doubt has its reasons, but they will probably be hard-pressed to find many players who would call that number slash 'supreme'.If we were to speculate, it feels like the hushing up of Megaways is in some way a motivating factor for Flower Fortunes Supreme's existence – though we could be way off the mark, of course. Whether you want to class this release as a sideways step or a backwards stumble, Flower Fortunes Supreme doesn't feel like forward progression. Since the first one was such a positive step-up for Fantasma, it is a shame. Unless Flower Fortunes Megaways is phased out, so there is no other option; there aren't many other reasons to pick Flower Fortunes Supreme instead of the chunkier version that preceded it.

title: That's Rich
structured_summary: That's Rich is a glam-themed slot centered around luxury fashion, designer goods, and an ostentatious lifestyle. Its features include expanding wilds and a Win Spins bonus with guaranteed wins and increasing multipliers up to x20. The reviewer finds it a fun, fast-paced game with solid win potential but notes its polarizing theme and limited feature set. The aesthetics boast a cartoony, elegant look with neutral tones and a seaside backdrop, complemented by a stylish, upbeat atmosphere.
review: That’s Rich Slot: OverviewThere are a ton of these ostentatious show of wealth slots floating around that were popular a few years ago. It felt like this style had fallen out of favour, but the genre has just received a reboot from Play’n GO with the That's Rich video slot. The title is a bit of a giveaway of a slot drenched in glam and luxurious consumer goods. It's not quite as in your face as its wealth saturated 2015 predecessor Pimped, with its Snoop Dogg lookalike lead and his ladies, but it's still pretty out there. Where Pimped was aimed at hip gangster wannabes, That's Rich appears aimed at the female gamblers in the house. Or, anyone into fashion mags, high heels, and designer bags, we don't judge. For some gaudy good times, read on.That's Rich - free spins featureThat's Rich uses a transparent grid comprised of 5 reels, 3 rows, and 10 paylines that are fixed this time around. It's a simple setup and one that lets the glowing background shine through. The backdrop looks like the Arabian Gulf, or the Mediterranean sea through drawn hotel curtains. Without doubt, an overpriced room, perfect for posting a few hundred snaps for ‘friends’ back in colder parts of the world to make them jealous. Natch. The UI has been elegantly designed with super-in neutral beige tones, and bets are set there from 10 p/c to $/€100 a pop. Hit the big green button for single spins, or select the mustard hued button for autoplay options. Settle in like a new pair of Manolo Blahniks and enjoy the show.A simple set up gets a simple set of rules and the name of the game is landing combinations of three or more matching symbols left to right. Symbols come with expensive price tags as you'd expect, except the low pays which are a tastefully designed set of 10-A royals. High pays step it up with a bag and shoes, fancy house, yacht, banknotes, and the fashion mag as the most valuable. Land 5 magazines on a line and be rewarded with 40 times the stake for the trouble, though the wild is a bit better at 50 times the stake for five. A busty lady wearing a scrap of a white dress that the game sheet simply refers to as 'Famous Woman' is the wild symbol. The Famous Woman comes in two forms, the common 1x1 tile, and an expanded version we will look at in the features. In both cases the wild substitutes for any of the symbols except the scatter.The glitzy sheen of the game's exterior belies a rougher edged interior. Firstly, the volatility is rated fairly high at 8 out of 10 on Play’n GO's meter. RTP, on the other hand, can vary from 96.27% in best-case scenarios, down to 84.25% at certain non-MGA licensed operators. Clearly makes sense to read the label before diving in.That’s Rich Slot: FeaturesSpeaking of rich, one thing that is not particularity rich is the feature list that only really includes expanding wilds and Win Spins. Speaking of expanding wilds, the wild symbol may expand to fill the whole reel on any spin. During the Win Spins feature, that happens every time the wild symbol lands in view.Win Spins are pretty interesting and are triggered by the golden trophy scatter symbol. What the trophy is for is a little unclear. Supermodel of the year? Best actor/actress? There are no clues so players can make up whatever scenario suits them best. This is a slot all about fantasy lives after all. Well, Instagram fantasy lives at least.Anyway, scatters land anywhere, and when 3 or more are in view they trigger 5 Win Spins. Each Win Spin comes with at least one guaranteed winning combination. Win Spins can also be retriggered up to a maximum of 20 in total - this is achieved when a scatters lands, it awards 2 additional Win Spins. The only exception is if you have 19 Win Spins lined up already, then 1 scatter awards just the one Win Spin.But that's not all; each wild during the feature comes with a win multiplier attached. Every time a wild lands, it increases the Wild Win Multiplier by +1 up to a maximum of x20. The final touch is that x20 Wild Win Multipliers may be activated on the final Win Spin regardless of how many were collected during the round.That’s Rich Slot: VerdictThat's Rich initially stands out due to its cartoony, glam, Club Med feel. It's like reading a Jackie Collins novel by the pool in Corfu before scrubbing up for cocktails with girls and a night of dancing. Apologies for the pigeonholing, but judging by the symbols and imagery it appears that Play’n GO is making a play for the female crowd with this one. It would be interesting to get a females opinion so don't hesitate to leave a comment below! Are all these symbols of glam and wealth fun, or are they just stereotypical?Either way, it’s probably all meant to be good-natured fun from the developers. Besides, it's got a pretty hefty potential of 10,000 times your stake which gives it some bite. The max payout has an exposure probability of less than 1 in 100 million, which is a big number no doubt. But it is a lot less than the billion(s) to one odds that often crop up - when they are mentioned at all, rather than kept secret.That openness is one key to That's Rich's possible appeal. It's a slot that isn't afraid to be what it is and if wealth and shopping is your thing, then join in on the fun. If not, well, ta-ta darling. The math model and potential might be enough to tempt general slots players on board, but the theme is rather polarising. Along with the theme, the other main drawback is the shortlist of features. Aside from win spins, there isn't a whole lot leftover to see and do. In saying that, knowing that every single Win Spin is going to pay something, and in some cases award up to 20 in a row is quite a tempting proposal.To surmise, there are good things here to uncover. That's Rich is a fast-paced, no nonsense slot that will cater to all types of players, from old-school fans of Pimped to the latte-moms just getting into slots.

title: Dragon Gold 88
structured_summary: Dragon Gold 88 is an Asian-themed slot by Pragmatic Play and Reel Kingdom, blending classic dragon motifs with a fishing slot concept.
