The game offers warm, attractive Asian-inspired visuals and smooth gameplay, though it lacks originality in theme.
review: Dragon Gold 88: Slot OverviewDragon… Gold… 88, this has got to be an Asian-themed slot, right? Yip, you are correct, and it has been designed by Pragmatic Play and their buddies, Reel Kingdom. Not a Big Bass game for a change, then, you may be saying. Well, technically, no, Dragon Gold 88 does not have fisherman symbols catching fish money symbols at any time. However, Dragon Gold 88 appears to be a reskin of Big Bass Splash, so yeah, it is part of the wider fishing family, for good or for ill.Good if your idea of a fun time is collecting money symbols in an elaborate Asian setting. Gone are the bubbles, weed, and water of a fishing game; hello to the dragons and mountains of a classically presented Asian slot. Classically or generically presented, because Dragon Gold 88 does look like a ton of other slots found in this genre. Ah well, if that's what enthusiasts want to see, that's what they want to see, and Dragon Gold 88 blasts warm familiarity. Though familiarity breeds contempt, as they say. Moving along.Dragon Gold 88 slot - base gameA glowing golden 5x3 game grid is where the symbols drop, creating regular winning combinations along 10 paylines. A wide 10 c to $/€250 stake range is available, as is an ante bet and a feature buy. The ante bet adds 50% to the stake to give players a higher chance of triggering free spins. Other features are free spin modifiers and random in-feature actions.Money SymbolsThe Dragon Ball is also the Money symbol. On each spin, Dragon Balls have prize values of 2x to 5,000x the bet, which can be collected in free spins only.ScattersIn the base game, when 2 scatters hit, there is a chance the third one is brought onto the screen by a claw or by respins when the scatters on the screen can move down a position without falling off the grid.Free SpinsWhen 3, 4, or 5 scatters are in view, players win 10, 15, or 20 free spins, respectively. Before the free spins feature starts, 0-5 modifiers are randomly selected. They could be:More Dragon Balls are present on the reels.More Dragon symbols are present on the reels.More Dynamites, Claws, and Firecrackers in the round.Level Up - the progressive feature starts at level 2.Extra Free Spins - the round starts with 2 extra free spins and any retrigger benefits from +2 spins.During the free spins feature, each wild symbol collects the values of all Money symbols in view. Wild symbols are collected, as well. Every 4th wild collected awards +10 free spins and a multiplier, which is applied to the Money symbol values collected. The multiplier is x2 for the second level, x3 for the third level, and x10 for the fourth level. The bonus round also has these modifiers:Randomly, when there are Dragon symbols on screen but no Dragon Balls, at the end of a free spin, Money symbols may appear in random positions.Randomly, when there are Dragon Ball symbols but no Dragons in view, at the end of a spin, a claw may appear to pull Dragon symbols onto the screen.Randomly, when there are Dragon symbols present but no Dragon Balls, at the end of the spin, the firecracker can transform all symbols except Dragons into something else.Buy Free SpinsPaying 100x the bet at the feature buy gets you a game round that lands 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols. The RTP remains the same, doing things this way.Dragon Gold 88 slot - free spinsDragon Gold 88: Slot VerdictScraping the fishy scales off a Big Bass slot and adding an Asian skin is hardly the most inventive concept a studio ever had. Mental images arose of the Reel Kingdom team kicking around ideas to keep the Big Bass train motoring along yet struggling to come up with anything interesting and falling back on a cliched reskin. Has Big Bass Bonanza finally, finally, run out of steam? Some might be tempted to say yes after sampling Dragon Gold 88, but something tells us the bushy, facial-haired fisherman isn't done just yet. The cash cow is just too good to stop squeezing milk from. Also, after playing Big Bass Secrets Of The Golden Lake, there is a galaxy of genres Big Bass can plough into and dominate like an invasive alien fish species.Fair dues, Prag and RK have crossed Dragon Gold 88 over quite well. It's not hard to envisage Asian slot fans in the mood for Money symbol collection action being all over this. Dragon Gold 88 actually looks quite attractive for a Reel Kingdom slot, not trying to be mean, and it has, after all, proven features. Proven on many, many occasions, in fact. Coupling the pleasant Asian-inspired graphics with a 5,000x win cap and well-oiled gameplay means Dragon Gold 88 might be a hit in certain sectors. In other sectors, well, the slot industry already overflows with traditional Asian slots and Big Bass iterations, so the hooking up of the two might be formidably hard to bear.

title: Crabbin for Christmas

review: Crabbin' for Christmas: Slot OverviewPlayers keen on enjoying crabs for the holiday season, and not of the itchy crotch kind, would do well to join in as we trawl for marine life in Blueprint Gaming's slot Crabbin' for Christmas. title: Sleeping Dragon

review: Sleeping Dragon: Slot OverviewMonsters guarding treasure is a motif that has been with us for a long, long time, and one of the most pervasive and visually arresting is the idea of a big ol' dragon jealously guarding its horde. Thanks in part to the popularity of The Hobbit movie trilogy, Smaug, deep-voiced by Benedict Cumberbatch, sleeping on a mountain of loot is one of the most recognisable iterations of this idea. Getting past an annoying guardian to lay hands on loot has a certain gambling connotation, so it's no wonder dragon horde games are quite numerous. In this instance, developer Pragmatic Play contributes to the scene with Sleeping Dragon, a slot that takes an old-fashioned idea and pairs it with relatively old-fashioned gaming concepts.Sleeping Dragon is not the most original slot in the world, and this applies to its presentation as much as to its gameplay. For your eyes, a big reddy-orange dragon dozes on a pile of coins and gems, much like a thousand or so other dragons in books, movies, and slots have done for years. He, she or it wakes up from time to time, such as when free spins are active or when triggering a random Money symbol assist, giving the game an extra blast of life. Hitting at least 6 Money symbols triggers the Respin Bonus. However, if at least one Money symbol hits, there is a random chance the dragon wakes up, and 5 Money symbols are added to the grid to trigger the feature.3 respins are awarded, and only the triggering Money symbols remain stuck on the screen. Respins land only Money symbols or blanks, and if a new Money symbol lands, it sticks till the feature ends and resets the respin count back to 3. The round ends when there are no more respins, or all positions are filled, then the values of all Money symbols in view are awarded. In the base game, if 15 Money symbols hit, their total value and the 7,000x Mega bonus are paid.Free SpinsHitting 3, 4, or 5 scatters awards players 6, 9, or 50 free spins, respectively. On the other hand, there's nothing much new here to see from any perspective, so while some of the stats hold up pretty well, Sleeping Dragon was just too sleepy to get wildly fired up about.

review: ﻿Mystery Mission to the Moon: Slot OverviewUsing data provided by the Kepler space telescope and the Drake Equation, it has been estimated that there could be upwards of 300 million possibly habitable planets in our galaxy alone. Never mind the rest of the universe, which is much, much larger. Like Arthur C. Clark said, 'either we are alone in the universe, or we are not. Both are equally terrifying.' After shaking off a frisson of existential dread, let's turn our attention to Mystery Mission to the Moon from software provider Push Gaming. When a winning combination is paid, they then reveal the same pay symbol and pay along all 20 paylines, no matter their position on the grid. During testing, if matching symbols sat between Golden Mystery Stack symbols on regular reels, they'd be included in the win, too.Wild Moon SymbolsAnother important tile is the Wild Moon symbol. For one, Wild Moons substitute for all other symbols except the Mystery Stack symbol. It lands on all reels and has the same value as the highest-paying symbol. In addition, landing 3, 4, 5, or 6 Wild Moon symbols awards 8, 10, 12, or 14 free spins, respectively.Free SpinsDuring free spins, when Mystery Stacks land, they nudge to fill their reel and remain locked in place until the feature ends. Mystery Stacks reveal the same pay symbol on each spin. When there are 3 or more Mystery Stacks on the grid, they turn gold. Gold Mystery Stacks reveal a matching symbol for the remainder of the feature, awarding wins along all 20 paylines, no matter their position on the grid. Here it is possible to buy free spins triggered by 3, 4, 5, or 6 Wild Moon symbols for 102x, 161x, 237x, or 332x the base bet. The last option costs 200x to land a random number of at least 3 Wild Moon symbols. RTPs are displayed in the Game Info screen and range from 96.3% to 96.65% at the highest available setting.Mystery Mission to the Moon slot - feature buy optionsMystery Mission to the Moon: Slot VerdictMystery Mission to the Moon was a game that got its pincers in from the beginning and didn't let up until the session drew to a close. The core gaming is reminiscent of Mystery Museum, but Push Gaming has pushed a number of the elements to branch it off into new territory. The larger grid and number of paylines has been done, in Push Gaming's words, for the purposes of 'ramping up the volatility.' For the review, bonus round results varied from hundreds of times the base bet to sad and lonely returns. Mystery Mission to the Moon was perhaps not as brutal as Mad Cars, but still, bumpy rides are a possibility.Nested amongst the bumps is the potential from some exhilarating moments as well. Max thrills occurred during the bonus game when three or more Mystery Stack symbols were plastered in place, each free spin piling on the tension as they all spun to reveal a matching pay symbol. It's an outstanding upgrade on the 'Book of' style pay-all-lines mechanic, which has been immensely popular for years. Seen from that angle, a full screen of the Mystery Martian at 10,000x is twice the single spin win available in games like, say, Book of Dead.One thing possibly putting a slight damper on the excitement for some is that winning potential is actually lower than it was in Mystery Museum. A Mystery Martian full-screen win is actually the most which can be won due to the 10,000x win cap. For the record, the probability of hitting the win cap is 1 in 1,216,101.8 with the Ante Bet switched on or 1 in 1,778,410.1 with it switched off. However, unless chasing the biggest prizes on the planet, or off, is a must, then Mystery Mission to the Moon's top prize is a sizable figure to shoot for. And all up, Mystery Mission to the Moon is a classy release that should thrill the socks off players looking for a superb 'Book of' alternative or those who were enthralled by what Mystery Museum had on tap.

review: Temple Tumble 2 Dream Drop: Slot OverviewIt's interesting how one day we can be firmly committed to goals or values that seem unassailable, only to find the need to reassess them as time drifts by. If all blocks are destroyed in a game round, then 6 free spins are awarded. During the feature, if all blocks and symbols are removed, +3 extra spins are awarded. For the bonus round, players can pick one of three modes:Multipliers & Extra Spins – Multiplier Blocks contain multipliers of x1-x3 which increase the win multiplier when destroyed. Spin Blocks add 1, 2, or 3 additional spins when destroyed.Persistent Wild & Fire Transform – Persistent Wild Blocks become wild symbols with five lives when destroyed. Fire Transform Blocks become a pay symbol that then transforms 1 symbol type in the next cascade into its type.Combined – contains Multiplier Blocks, Extra Spin Blocks, Persistent Wilds, and Fire Transform Blocks.Dream Drop JackpotsOne any base game spin, players can randomly be awarded a Dream Drop Jackpot Entry Spin. Every two times the Mega is won, its upper limit increases by €500,000 until it reaches €10,000,000, where it will stay from then on.Temple Tumble 2 Dream Drop: Slot VerdictAfter the theatrics of Cluster Tumble, Temple Tumble 2 felt more restrained by comparison. Cluster Tumble had a way of knocking together obscenely long sequences of cascades to a level rarely before seen. We're talking full-on Can-Can at the Moulin Rouge levels of flamboyance. If you've seen the big win videos, you'll know how lengthy they can be. Temple Tumble 2 isn't so much like that. Solid cascade runs are possible, but this is a faster-paced game with a completely different focus altogether. It looks good, though perhaps not quite as good as the moveable feasts Cluster Tumble or Temple Tumble Megaways were. Relax hasn't skimped on the effects as such; it just shifted the focus.That focus is obviously the Dream Drop, and during testing, it triggered quite frequently. Naturally, the lower consolation prizes are far more likely to be won as a result, but you just never know. And some players may need a level of hopeful optimism to turn a blind eye to Temple Tumble 2 Dream Drop's potential shortcomings. It's nothing new to see less than optimal return values in a jackpot slot, and when a game has been custom-made for the job, it's no real biggie. It will be interesting to see if grumbling ensues if Relax starts hooking up Dream Drop to their classic, beloved slots and slashing RTPs, though. Most likely, there won't be too many complaints, but Book of 87, anyone?Then again, how much time do lottery ticket buyers spend pondering the odds of winning? Just like the clever name, Dream Drop is all about scoring that one dream drop and having a few thrills on the way. This is something Temple Tumble 2 can certainly provide with its huge prizes, with their enticing must-win element and entertaining side features.

A wheel divided into red and green segments spins. Win, and the bonus plays again. Lose, and you head back to the base game without any winnings.Wild Buccaneers Megaways slot - free spinsFortune FinderWhen free spins end and the win is not less than 80x the bet, players are able to gamble all or a part of their winnings in the Fortune Finder feature - or collect. To play the Fortune Finder, 16 chests appear on the screen with a ladder of ascending prize values displayed on the side. Prize values go from 1.3x the gambled amount up to 1,800x at the top. Players then pick chests one at a time. Revealing a four-leaf clover moves players up the prize ladder while revealing a skull 'n crossbones ends the feature, and players lose all they have gambled. After moving up the ladder, players can collect or pick another chest.Super SpinnerOn top of normal symbols, little coins can appear which are collected. Any time a coin is collected, there is a chance the Super Spinner is triggered, awarding cash prizes of 80-5,000x the bet, 8-14 free spins, the Fortune Finder with 10-25x starting values, or 10-25 Lucky Spins (Nitro Spins).Game & FortuneHitting the Game & Fortune button brings up several different options. This is where you can activate Nitro Spins, buy free spins for 90x the bet or a blast on the Super Spinner for 60x the bet. Collected coins can be used to buy Nitro Spins or contribute to the other two feature buys, reducing the cost of buying them outright.Wild Buccaneers Megaways slot - feature buy optionsWild Buccaneers Megaways: Slot VerdictFor those who appreciate trying their luck at every other turn, Wild Buccaneers Megaways might come across like one of those assorted chocolate boxes where you don't know where to start munching. Furthering the chocolate box analogy, players are free to take their time, sampling one here and there, or just gorge themselves. In some ways, much of the core on-reels gaming is pretty standard stuff – Megaways plus cascades is nothing new, though the progressive Treasure Trail is an intriguing addition. However, there is so much extra stuff loaded onto Wild Buccaneers Megaways that it's hard to think of many slots offering the same level of utility. For the target audience (slot streamers likely being among them), having so many ways to tackle the game and try their luck is a bit like being at an amusement park after hours and going hog wild with the rides.Still, this is gambling and not a fun park, so not every ride will have positive results. What's good, though, is Four Leaf Gaming has provided a sliding scale for the optional gambling. So instead of having to risk all of your awarded free spins, you can risk a few to possibly gain more. Speaking of potential, the biggest win noted by the game's maker is 50,000x the bet, so there is plenty to play for and perhaps, gamble for.Wild Buccaneers Megaways is quite close to Clover Fortunes in some ways, but it manages to move the progression needle along a few notches. Bringing Megaways on board provides extra clout, and the studio has upped its game to match the star power the mechanic offers. As a sophomore release, Wild Buccaneers Megaways is a chunkier slot with wilder features, bigger potential, and is just as multifaceted a gambling tool as before, if not more so.

title: 1 Million Fortunes Megaways
structured_summary: 1 Million Fortunes Megaways is an Asian-themed slot by Iron Dog Studio, reworking their prehistoric original into a sleek, upscale setting. It features cascades, free spins with a Pillar Reel, locking reels, sticky wilds, and progressive multipliers for high volatility gameplay. The reviewer sees it as a by-the-book clone with solid winning potential but limited innovation, mainly appealing to fans of Asian aesthetics. The game sports a burgundy and gold palette with elegant patterns and ambient sounds, creating a tasteful yet somewhat bland atmosphere.
review: 1 Million Fortunes Megaways: Slot OverviewMost people would probably be happy with one fortune, but one doesn't appear to be enough in this game called 1 Million Fortunes Megaways from developer Iron Dog Studio. In actuality, the 'million' in the title alludes to the huge number of Megaways it is possible to have during free spins via several innovations. Well, they were innovative in the original game, the prehistorically themed 1 Million Megaways BC. Now, not so much, since this is essentially a straight clone for the Asian market or any player who likes a bit of Asian influence in their games. If you're familiar with 1 Million Megaways BC, is there much else we need to add than that? Let's take a look.The biggest changes are the audio-visual ones. Gone are the caves, prehistoric people, wild animals, and ice of the previous game to be replaced with a much more traditional view. For the reskin, Iron Dog has chosen a swanky look that makes you feel like you're checking into an upmarket hotel or club. We get a burgundy and gold-coloured background, flowing patterns, lanterns, and a couple of bamboo struts holding up the 6-reel game panel. 1 Million Fortunes Megaways follows a formula, so it comes off as tasteful if a bit bland.The same engine appears to be driving things behind the scenes, which means a highly volatile math model and a return value of 96.2%. Paid spins cost 20 p/c to $/€20 each, while tablets, mobiles, or desktop devices may be used to play 1 Million Fortunes Megaways on. Base game spins see up to 7 symbols land on the mains reels, producing up to 117,649 ways to win, though this can increase in free spins when an extra reel is added to the grid.Iron Dog stuck with tradition when they designed the symbols, too. On the low side are brush stroke-styled 10-A card symbols, paying 0.5x the bet for 6 or 1x the bet for 7 of a kind. Following them are lotus flowers, gold coins, turtles, junk boats, and birds. Landing a 6 premium winning way pays out 1-5x the bet, increasing to 2-7x the bet for a seven-symbol combo. Regular wilds appear on reels 2 and 6 in the base game, or 2 and 7 in free spins, substituting for any normal pay symbol. Extra wilds can land on the extra reel in free spins, explained next.1 Million Fortunes Megaways: Slot FeaturesThe scenery couldn't be more different, but features-wise, 1 Million Fortunes Megaways has the same gadgets and gizmos as those found in 1 Million Megaways BC. These are cascades, free spins with a Pillar Reel, locking reels, sticky wilds, and progressive multipliers.Cascades and MultipliersA classic Megaways extra, the cascade mechanic removes winning symbols from the reels and replaces them with new symbols. If the new symbols link into a new win, another cascade triggers. This will keep happening until no new win hits. After a winning cascade has occurred in the base game, the win multiplier increases by +2 and is limited to x8 in the base game. Base game multipliers reset between spins.Free SpinsA golden bowl with the numbers 1, 2, 3, and 4 sits at the top of the reels, tracking the number of consecutive cascades. Lighting up all 4 numbers in one cascade sequence awards players with 8 free spins. If more than 4 consecutive cascades occur, each extra cascade awards +2 free spins, up to 14.When free spins are active, the reels split, and a new Pillar Reel appears in the middle, holding up to 9 symbols. Now, when the reels are filled with symbols, 1,058,841 ways to win are provided. One of Iron Dog's signature moves is that when normal reels display 7 symbols or 9 on the Pillar Reel in free spins, they lock at this size for the rest of the feature. Regular locked reels add +1 free spin while locking the Pillar Reel awards +5 free spins. Free spins also benefit from a progressive win multiplier, starting at x1 and increasing by +1 following winning cascades or when a reel is locked at its full height. This multiplier does not reset between free spins. Lastly, whenever a wild lands on the Pillar Wild, it turns sticky and sits at the bottom of the reel until the feature ends. Technically it is possible to stack 9 sticky wilds on the Pillar Reel in this manner.Buy BonusWhere bonus buys are permitted, players can buy the feature rather than let it trigger naturally. The cost for buying 6, 8, 10, 12, or 14 free spins is 50x, 85x, 135x, 200x, or 270x the reference bet. All buy options have a return to layer value of 96.1%.1 Million Fortunes Megaways: Slot VerdictIf you've played 1 Million Megaways BC before, you'll see little has changed in the way of gameplay or stats. For fans of Asian-themed games, this is fairly positive news since there is stuff going on here that is unique for Megaways. At the time 1 Million Megaways BC was released, there was no telling where Iron Dog was going to go next. Later came clones and concepts like Branded Megaways and the fecund imagination shown in the prehistoric slot cooled somewhat, solidifying into to a type of private ice age, rather than melting to keep the creative juices pouring forth in quite the same way.It's a bit of a stretch to use the word 'imagination' in the same sentence as 1 Million Fortunes Megaways. It's a by-the-book clone job that uses bog-standard graphics to ensure entry into the Asian gaming category. Players into the look with Megaways powering the action should be okay with the outcome. For the rest, well, it's unlikely to be a game that is going to convince many others to sign up. Like its predecessor, winning potential is a high point, though, weighing in at 45,000x the bet, reflecting what the extra Pillar Reel and stack of extra ways bring to the table.1 Million Fortunes Megaways is a successful port for what it is, bringing what was ancient into a more modern setting. All the bits work okay, and the features included here aren't available in many other Megaways games, so there is a desirability factor, provided you're partial to the Asian stylings 1 Million Fortunes Megaways is embedded in.

title: Wolf Howl
structured_summary: Wolf Howl is a North American nature-themed slot featuring wolves and forest wildlife. The game offers high volatility, wild multipliers, a Scatter Adder feature, and a rewarding free spins bonus with the Wild Call mechanic. The reviewer highlights its strong potential payouts, straightforward gameplay, and exciting bonus rounds. Visually, it boasts a modern look with golden frames and immersive forest sounds, creating an engaging atmosphere.
review: Wolf Howl: OverviewMicrogaming partners Just for the Win ‘leave this stressful world behind’ in their North American nature slot Wolf Howl. The last game we reviewed from JFTW was the Olympics themed Immortal Glory which went onto become fairly successful for the studio. One of the reasons is that during the Jackpot feature, players are just one click away from an instant 10,000x win. Those after massive payouts take note, Wolf Howl’s potential makes Immortal Glory’s look like spare change down the back of a couch.Let’s leave the jackpot chasers hanging to check out how the game works. Wolf Howl is pretty conventional in many ways, built using 5 reels and 10 fixed paylines. The stats involved here point to a game suited to players who like a potentially rewarding challenge. It starts with a highly volatile math model and a hit frequency of 22.46% coupled with a solid RTP of 96.15%.Wolf Howl’s golden framed grid has been plonked in a snow-filled forest, also glowing golden; from the aurora borealis or a forest fire? It’s not exactly clear. What is clear is that when it comes to looks, Just for the Win took one or two cues from Pragmatic Play’s insanely successful slot Wolf Gold as many others have done before them - the wolf and moon symbols provide a direct link between the two games. Other than that they are quite different, though the core rules are similar. Namely, three or more identical symbols on a payline, left to right from the first reel triggers a payout.Playable from c/p 10 to €10 per spin, the regular pay symbols are a blend of low pay card icons and wild animals. From low to high, there are Jack – Ace symbols, a bunny, an eagle, a bear (with a mullet), and a moose. For a game that can turn into a wild multiplier fest, symbol values aren’t bad. Premiums vary from 6x for five bunnies, up to 20x the stake for a line of moose.As mentioned, there are a bunch of wilds, and in the base game, they come with multipliers of 1x, 2x, or 3x. A line of five wilds is worth 30 times the stake, and if there is more than one multiplier on a payline, their values are multiplied.Wolf Howl: FeaturesWolf Howl - free spinsThe base game is pretty dry when it comes to features, so it might be good to know you get some help in unlocking the bonus game from the Scatter Adder feature which appears at random during the base game. When the Scatter Adder is triggered, then 2 to 4 random scatter symbols are placed on the reels.Needless to say, Wolf Howl is all about its bonus game which comes into play when 3, 4, or 5 moon scatters land anywhere on a single spin. Doing so awards 8, 15, or 30 free spins respectively. As they say, this is when things get real. For one, scatters continue to appear during the bonus game, providing a chance to retrigger the feature - 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 scatters in view award 2, 5, 8, 15, or 30 additional free spins respectively.What separates free spins from the main game is the Wild Call feature. Each moon scatter in view turns all adjacent pay symbols into 1x multiplier wilds. If a wild was next to the scatter, it has +1 added to its multiplier - up to x5 at the most. Symbols can be upgraded more than once if they are adjacent to more than one scatter.There is one critical element to this feature that is crucial to know. Any wins are calculated and paid before the Wild Call feature is triggered. This means the new or upgraded wild multipliers are added to the reels where they can be used in future spins. They are not applied to the spin they were created on.If the base game gets too dull, players are able to sidestep it altogether using the bonus buy option. The three options available are 8, 15, or 30 free spins for 90x, 159x, or 314x the current bet respectively. Doing so also raises the RTP to 96.42%.Wolf Howl: VerdictHow does the Ella Fitzgerald song go? You say Wolf Howl and I say Wolf Gold? Okay, there is a bit of similarity, visually at least, but wolf fans will be happy to know the two offer distinctly different gaming experiences. For one, Just for the Win opened the flood gates when it comes to potential. Wolf Howl tops out at 25,000 times the stake which makes Wolf Gold look pointless if money-making opportunities are your primary concern.Whether size matters or not, it’ll help if you’re into straight forward gaming and volatility since not a lot happens in the base game. Wild multipliers are there for the odd adrenaline spike, and the Scatter Adder injects some nail-biting moments. Graphically, Wolf Howl is quite good too, managing a modern look with a bunch of physical slot elements such as the sound effects.The bonus game is where Wolf Howl goes nuts though. During testing, scatters turned up in abundance during free spins. It wasn’t unusual to double (or more) the number of initial free spins awarded. There was a tinge of disappointment when we realised the Wild Call adds wilds to the reels for future spins rather than apply them to the current spin. Still, wilds rack up and do come in handy later on in the feature.All up, if you’re not fussed by reel modifiers or tons of features, Wolf Howl is a stand-up option. It looks good, sounds good, plays well and creates the type of long drawn-out bonus games that end up on highlight reels.

title: Diamonds Up
structured_summary: Diamonds Up is a classic fruit-themed slot featuring familiar symbols like cherries and sevens with a diamond wild upgrade mechanic. The game includes a unique 30-spin cycle progression ladder, free spins, and a feature buy option enhancing symbol upgrades. The reviewer finds it better than typical fruit slots, highlighting its high 20,000x max win and engaging gameplay. Visually and audibly, it offers plain, generic graphics and a simple tune, fitting a traditional slot aesthetic.
review: Diamonds Up: Slot OverviewFans of gambling fruit salads are spoiled for choice with a countless galaxy of options available that gets ever larger as the years power by. The fruit thing's been around since virtually the dawn of slot machines, and Evolution-owned Red Tiger has made another contribution to the long-standing genre. It's not the first time, we might add, and today's game goes by the name of Diamonds Up, using as it does Diamond Wild symbols to level up a progression feature to upgrade lower-paying symbols on its reels.Diamonds Up inhabits a fairly plain, generic domain, a 'seen it many, many times before' domain, of classic slot symbols, cheap and cheerful background decor, as well as a cheap and cheerful tune. So common are the audiovisuals it might be easy to overlook Diamonds Up entirely if old-school fruit is not your jam. But let's stay hopeful for now. That 1/30 counter above the ladder of symbols is mildly intriguing, and Diamonds Up does conceal a big win number beneath the generic veneer.Diamonds Up slot - base game25 paylines are built into Diamonds Up's gaming grid, evaluating winning combinations from the leftmost reel. There are 5 reels in total, equipped with 3 rows of symbols on each. Winning potential is surprisingly large (on paper, at least), which might explain a stake range of just 10 c to $/€4 per spin in what is a medium-high volatile slot. The default RTP comes in at 95.69%, or a smidge higher at 95.7% when buying free spins.You've very probably seen this lot before, more than once. Diamonds Up's pay symbols are cherries, plums, oranges, grapes, watermelons, Bars, horseshoes, bells, and sevens, paying 2x the bet for hitting 5 of the fruit, 4 to 40 times the bet for 5 of the 4 most valuable symbols. Diamond Wild symbols land on reels 2, 3, and 4, substituting all of the regular paying symbols.Diamonds Up: Slot FeaturesDiamonds Up slot - free spinsIn Diamonds Up, Diamond Wilds are used as the progression symbol to progress along the symbol upgrade ladder, upgrading the lowest symbols on the reels.Symbol Upgrade LadderSpins in Diamonds Up runs in cycles from 1 to 30, and a counter beside the reels keeps track. Landing Diamond Wild symbols during the cycle progresses the symbol upgrade ladder. The ladder displays symbols from the lowest paying at the bottom to the highest paying at the top. Each level has 3 steps to complete, each step is filled by a landed wild. Filling a level upgrades all the current lower-paying symbols to the symbol that has just been filled. Upgrades continue till the end of the 30 spins cycle when it resets. The ladder resets when 30 spins are complete.Free SpinsIn the base game, hitting 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols awards 9, 12, or 20 free spins, respectively. Scatters pay 5x, 20x, or 100x when 3, 4, or 5 of them land, respectively. Symbol upgrading is active during free spins, and landing any Diamond Wild progresses the upgrade ladder as it does in the base game. The round can be retriggered in the same manner as triggering the bonus. At the end of free spins, the state reached on the upgrade ladder transfers over to the base game, where the spin cycle continues where it left off before free spins were triggered.Feature BuyDiamonds Up comes with a larger feature buy selection than usual in a Red Tiger slot. Players can get free spins triggered by 3 or more scatters with the second level filled at 20x the bet, the third level filled at 120x the bet, the fourth level filled at 200x the bet, or the fifth level filled at 800x the bet. The saved base game state is restored after completing the bonus round.Diamonds Up slot - free spinsDiamonds Up: Slot VerdictFruit slots are a dime a dozen, so it can be hard to sift through the morass to find the gems. Or, at least, find better examples of this kind of gaming. Not that Diamonds Up is a gem as such, but it turned out to be better than expected. Not only was the 20,000x max win a big ol', eyebrow-raising surprise, but the accompanying gameplay was fairly interesting as well for what it is. Spin cycle slots drop every so often, partner studio NetEnt doing one not too long ago before this in the form of Babylon Riches, for example, and Diamonds Up offers things few, if any, of the others do.You don't really see batches of 30 spins, for instance. Usually, it's around 10 or so. With luck, 30 spins will turn out to be enough to get some decent levelling up happening and ensure higher paying symbols land in place of the levelled out lower value ones. During testing, playing with the upper levels of the upgrade ladder could be enjoyable due to hitting almost full screens or even completely full screens of matching symbol wins. A full screen of seven symbols would put 1,000x in your pocket, so you can kind of see how 20,000x might be possible.Diamonds Up didn't do enough to reach next big thing status; however, in the right player's hands, its strong max win number and particular modus operandi might be just the fruit fiesta they've been looking for.

title: Holy Diver
structured_summary: Holy Diver is a dark ages-themed slot inspired by the 1983 Heavy Metal hit, featuring video game-style animations and a 6-reel Megaways setup. Its standout feature is the Reel Adventure™ mechanic, letting players upgrade gameplay and choose their volatility through chest-triggered modifiers and a multi-level free spins bonus. The reviewer praises its innovative design and engaging player involvement, though notes it lacks the full dynamism of traditional Megaways slots. Visually classic Big Time Gaming with vibrant colors and energizing audio, the iconic Holy Diver song enhances the bonus round excitement.
review: Holy Diver Slot: OverviewFormerly best known as a 1983 Heavy Metal super-hit, Holy Diver will now forever be intertwined with Big Time Gaming's latest and greatest creation. For the first time, players are introduced to the Reel Adventure™ mechanics, a new way of taking on the slots that makes it a truly unique experience. Played on a 6-reel engine (slaps roof of car), this bad boy can fit so many Megaways and, as usually is the case with these guys, it comes packed with potential.Holy Diver is a fusion of many things, but most obviously it's an online slot with video game type animations set in the dark ages, although the sunny blue skies do make it appear anything but dark. As we've been told, Holy Diver actually dates back to the time of Bonanza but work on it was not completed until now. Visually, it does look like a classic Big Time Gaming slot and bears some resemblance to Dragon Born (2016) in our opinion.Known for their high potential and ultra high variance slots, it's the first thing most of us want to know more about when we hear of a new BTG release. Well, in terms of volatility it's not nearly as brutal as some of the other titles, making it slightly more wager friendly as it seems but the potential is there nonetheless.On the reels you'll find low-value A, K, Q, J, 10 and 9 royals as well as 4 gems - the purple one being the most valuable giving you 15 times the stake for 6 across a full payline. If you're used to playing Bonanza, you will likely be able to tell that the symbols are not nearly of the same value here. It doesn't mean that the game lacks potential, it's just delivered in a unique way as you will see.Holy Diver Slot: FeaturesIt is the newly introduced Reel Adventure™ concept that gives the game its unique structure where players are given the opportunity to upgrade their game, thus allowing more chances to win as well as increasing the potential. Below the reel set, which can fit up to 7 symbols per reel and expand up to 117k win ways in the base game, an animated knight moves along a path and when coming across a treasure chest, which he does roughly every 1 to 5 spins, he kicks it to reveal 1 of 4 reel modifiers:Standard Symbol Bonus - One of the low-value symbols is randomly chosen and converted into a wild.Sword Bonus - In true Danger! High Voltage fashion, it adds up to 3 full wild reels with a multiplier up to x7.Fireball Bonus - Shoots up to 4 wild symbols onto the reels.Gem Symbol Bonus* - Awards one or more Gems which are then transformed into wilds. The wilds can come as x2 or x3 multipliers as you push your way through the levels.Holy Diver does not include a traditional scatter symbol. Instead, players need to collect gems revealed in the chests. It takes 4 of them, one of each colour (you can land all 4 at once), to trigger the bonus feature. However, there's a twist to it. Instead of playing the free spin feature at progression level 1, you can decline to play the bonus and upgrade to level 2 instead. This will then take you back to the base game where you will play with an upgraded x2 wild multiplier.Triggering the bonus at level 2 will once again give you the opportunity to either head into the free spins (playing with an x2 multiplier) or upgrade to level 3 which is the final stage. Triggering the bonus at level 3 will leave you no choice but to initiate the free spins now playing with an x3 multiplier. In effect, you actually get to choose your own volatility this way.10 free spins are awarded when you opt to activate the free spins. It may now dawn on you where the title of the game came from as the 1983 Heavy Metal super-hit Holy Diver kicks in. Oh yeah, baby! In the bonus game, you will have to look out for gems appearing on reels 2 through 5 as these will transform into wilds with multipliers based on your current level. At level 2 and 3, they turn into x2 and x3 wild multipliers respectively.The heroic knight is with you here as well. Instead of kicking open chests, he battles mystical figures standing in his way. When defeated, these will either leave you empty handed or reveal shiny diamonds. The first 4 diamonds give you +1 spin each and the 5th re-triggers the feature with 8 additional free spins. With every re-trigger, the win ways are increased up to a maximum 586k Megaways. It's a brilliant design as the the re-trigger is within reach until the very last spin.Holy Diver Slot: VerdictHoly Diver delivers a truly unique and innovative experience, and it's something completely different from what we've seen before. The way the game is designed, allowing you to make decisions, whether to level up or go for the bonus, is outstanding and makes you feel involved and as being part of the chain of events. The Reel Adventure™ mechanic, is undoubtedly an interesting concept, but lacks the dynamic greatness of the Megaways engine that has made it so popular.Whether Holy Diver will be a hit or miss is of course up to the players, but we feel strongly for this game and had a lot of fun playing it in demo mode. You most definitely don't have to be a Metal Head to enjoy Holy Diver and man, when that song starts blasting in the bonus, we crank the volume to 11 and hope for it to never end.Don't Miss...If you like Holy Diver we suggest you check out Kingmaker which is another Megaways title from Big Time Gaming built around a similar theme.

title: Atlantis Crush
structured_summary: Atlantis Crush is a mythologically themed cascading slot set in an exotic Atlantis-inspired island with dual reel sets. It features unique Block symbols with various effects, two free spins rounds, and a high volatility model with 96.09% RTP. The reviewer praises its inventive gameplay, engaging cascades, and potential for big wins up to 10,000x the bet. The game boasts high-quality graphics and tense, atmospheric audio that enhance the immersive experience.
review: Atlantis Crush: Slot OverviewWhen Relax Gaming decides to start tumbling stuff around the place, gamblers do well to sit up and take notice. The studio has dropped some exceptional tumble/cascading driven slots, climaxing in the phenomenal Ancient Tumble. Coming fairly hot on its heels is the cascading slot Atlantis Crush. For this mythologically minded release, Relax Gaming has spun the action off in a different direction, designing an inventive scatter-paying slot like no other. Putting significant distance between itself and the top dogs in the scatter scene like Gates of Olympus 1000, Atlantis Crush makes use of two separate yet interacting gaming spaces, a chonk load of special Block symbols, two free spins rounds, and more.According to some, the island of Atlantis was located in the Atlantic Ocean west of the Strait of Gibraltar, and Atlantis Crush has a Canary Islands look about it, being mountainous, palm-treed, blue-skied, exotic, warm, and inviting. Stone statues stand guard over the active gaming area, which is made up of a 5-reel, 2-row block symbol-only space and a 5-reel, 3-row pay symbol or wild-only space. Free spins rounds move indoors, and no matter the phase, Atlantis Crush's graphical quality is high, the audio tensely atmospheric.Atlantis Crush slot - base gameA 5x3 play area might not seem very big for a scatter-paying slot, but as compensation, combinations only require 4 matching symbols, in any positions, to create a win, plus wild symbols land on the reels as well, potentially helping matters. Winning symbols are removed from the matrix, and symbols cascade downwards to replace them. A highly volatile math model producing an RTP of 96.09% runs the game, and players are able to select a wager of 10 c to $/€100 per paid round.Atlantis Crush's pay symbols are grouped into fire (red), water (blue), and plant (green) types. They are further divided into 3 low-pay droplet type symbols, 3 mid-pay representations of water, plant, and fire, plus 3 higher-value face/mask symbols. Landing 4 matching symbols pays 0.1 to 0.3 times the bet, while full-screen 15 OAKs pay 3 to 16 times the bet. Wild symbols substitute for all pay symbols on the grid.Atlantis Crush: Slot FeaturesAtlantis Crush slot - super free spinsSitting above the pay symbol area is the two-row Block symbol space. Block symbols are activated or destroyed when a winning pay symbol appears directly under them or by the effect of another activated Block symbol. Appearing on the upper area are the following symbols:Empty Block - has no effect.Horizontal Destroyer - activates and destroys all symbols in its row.Vertical Destroyer - activates and destroys all symbols in its column.Diagonal Destroyer - activates and destroys its corner symbols.Bonus Block - the free spins counter is increased by the number displayed on the Block.Multiplier Block - increases the win multiplier by the number displayed. Possible values are x2 to x500. Any win multiplier greater than x0 applies to wins in the current cascade.Fire Gem Block - all fire class symbols (red) on the grid are destroyed, and only the same kind of symbols drop in on the cascade.Water Gem Block - all water class symbols (blue) on the grid are destroyed, and only the same kind of symbols drop in on the cascade.Plant Gem Block - all plant class symbols (green) on the grid are destroyed, and only the same kind of symbols drop in on the cascade.Destroy All Paying Symbols & Destroy All BlocksIf all pay symbols are destroyed in the same cascade, then all pay symbols dropping in on the following cascade will be of the same matching type. Landing a full screen of the same kind of symbol from this feature clears the symbols again but does not trigger an infinite loop of same-of-a-kind cascades. If all Block symbols are destroyed in the same cascade, then for the rest of the round, only Multiplier, Bonus, or Gem Blocks appear.Free SpinsActivating 3 or more Bonus Blocks triggers free spins. The number of awarded free spins is the sum of the numbers on the activated Bonus Blocks in that round. The win multiplier transfers from the base game to the free spins round and does not reset between free spins. When Bonus Blocks are activated, their value increases the free spins count.Super Free SpinsWhen free spins are triggered, there is a chance Super Free Spins are played. For Super Free Spins, players benefit from having only Multiplier, Bonus, or Gem Blocks in the Blocks area.Feature BuyBuying free spins is possible for the cost of 70 times the bet and starts a round with 3 to 10 free spins. For 250x the bet, players can buy 5 Super Free Spins. The feature buy RTP is 96.48%.Atlantis Crush slot - super free spinsAtlantis Crush: Slot VerdictOne mark of a successful cascading slot is the urge to hit the spin button one more time, like a little voice on your shoulder, just in case the next game-round kick starts a chain of consecutive wins, tumbles, and thrills. Atlantis Crush is able to produce this feeling in a variety of compelling ways. One is the way pay symbols have their own reel set down below while Block symbols have their area up top, and cascading wins don't just provide an extra chance to win - adjacent winning symbols also blast Block symbols to unlock the goodies they contain. The effect is a little like ELK Studios' Tropicool slots but is by no means the same. There's quite a variety of special Block symbols, too, though the better effects are likely to be harder to obtain than the lesser stuff.But, the chance is there of linking winning combinations with tasty modifiers, such as the win multiplier (some of the Block multiplier values can technically be rather chunky), and fire, plant, or water removals might turn out to be handy as well. Basically, Relax Gaming has thought up a bunch of smart elements and mixed them nicely together. For Atlantis Crush, the studio has once again put its thinking cap on to conjure up a clever blend of gameplay elements to entertain gamblers who have an interest in cascading scatter win slots. title: African Legends
structured_summary: African Legends is an Africa-themed slot set atop a mountain with a wilderness backdrop, focusing on the Wow Major progressive jackpot. The game features Rolling Reels, Wild Blasts, Multiplier Trails, free spins, and a jackpot bonus, with a 37.16% hit rate and medium volatility. The reviewer finds it appealing mainly for the jackpot chase, as the RTP is low and non-jackpot wins limited. Visually, it offers a clean, rock-carved symbol design with a rhythmic drum soundtrack, creating a pleasant but simple atmosphere.
review: African Legends: OverviewMicrogaming partners Slingshot Studios throw their hat into the jackpot arena with their Africa themed slot African Legends. Despite a bunch of familiar looks and features, there is really only one reason why you’d want to spin this one. That is the progressive Wow Major Jackpot, which starts at a $/€50,000 and continues to rise until a lucky punter hits the big one. Just how you can win is tied directly to the game’s features, so let’s take a look.The game takes place at the top of a mountain range, looking over the vast wilderness of Africa. Behind the 5-reel, 243 win ways game area, a fertile valley lays spread out, full of grasslands, trees, rivers, and clouds about to pop with rain. It’s an impressive site, slightly different from what players usually get when spinning in this part of the world. There are no sunsets, sunrises, and very few animal references. There is a familiar soundtrack though, a rhythmical drum beat which does the job in a fairly nondescript way.African Legends can be played on any device, offering bets of 25 p/c to $/€25 per spin. Keeping jackpot chasers pumped while they spin for the big payday is a relatively high hit rate of 37.16%, which means you can expect frequent low to medium wins. Less exciting is an RTP rating of 94.92%, albeit not unusually low for a progressive jackpot slot. It does feel as though it’s working with the medium volatility against you after a while as the account slowly drains away alongside your hopes of the Wow Major.The reels are familiar, having a strong Gonzo's Quest look about them. Thick rock-cut symbols, 4 low pay and 5 high pay make up the regulars. Low pays are the card suits, diamonds, hearts, clubs, and spades, all carved from weighty stone. Then, the high pays consist of beasts from the African countryside such as warthogs, hippos, rhinos, elephants, and lions. Slingshot has presented the animals in an interesting way, like those close up black and white headshots of famous people. Land five premiums in a row for a payout of 3.2 to 6 times the stake.The golden statue wilds are worth a bit more at 10 times the stake for five of a kind. Wilds can substitute for any other symbol in the game and may land stacked on the third reel.African Legends: FeaturesAfrican Legends - free spinsThere are plenty of features in African Legends to keep the game moving along. Don’t expect novelty, all have appeared before, in one guise or another. We get Microgaming's trademarked Rolling Reels along with Wild Blasts, Multiplier Trails, Free Spins, and of course, the Progressive Jackpot Bonus.The Wild Blast feature triggers completely at random during the base game. When active, up to 5 positions turn wild. The Wild Blast does not trigger during or at the end of a Rolling Reels sequence.Rolling Reels are triggered after every win in the base or bonus game. Winning symbols are removed, making way for new symbols to fall into the gaps. This can lead to consecutive winning combinations from a single spin, as long as winners continue to land. Consecutive wins also increase the Multiplier Trail. The first roll in a sequence awards an x2 multiplier, while roll 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, or 7 awards a multiplier of x3, x4, x5, x6, x8, and x10 respectivelyIn addition, 4 or more rolls award free spins with a set multiplier (it will not increase during the round as it does in the base game). The exact reward depends on the number of rolls:4 rolls = 12 free spins plus an x5 multiplier.5 rolls = 15 free spins plus an x6 multiplier.6 rolls = 18 free spins plus an x8 multiplier.7 rolls = 20 free spins plus an x10 multiplier.Should 8 consecutive rolls occur, players win the progressive jackpot. High rollers take note, the bigger your bet, the higher your chance of winning the jackpot.African Legends: VerdictAfrican Legends has playable moments when Rolling Reels and Multipliers combine. Yet, it’s the Wow Major Jackpot providing the bulk of the allure. Remove the chance of winning €50,000+ on any spin and what’s leftover makes for dismal reading. RTP is low, though not obscenely so for a progressive jackpot. So is the non-jackpot potential for winning though. Without the Wow Major, the most you can hope for is 1,200 times your stake. That’s less than a third of what its cousin Jungle Jim offers.So what about jackpot chasers? Well, if you’re okay with all of that, then yeah sure, why not. From an aesthetic standpoint, African Legends is nice to look at and Rolling Reels in combination with Multiplier Trails is a well proven concept by now. Of course, beauty is only skin deep, but it does help. The hit frequency is high enough to keep your spirits up for a while, even if the bankroll steadily chips away on the chase. There’s always the Wild Blast, popping up the odd win here and there, though it doesn’t do near enough to stem the steady downward creep.All up, African Legends is a game which looks nice but can be painful to play. Unless you’ve set yourself a personal mission to track down the Wow Major Jackpot no matter what, there aren’t many other reasons for braving the African sun.

title: Blitz Super Wheel
structured_summary: Blitz Super Wheel is an electrified fruit-themed slot blending a spinning prize wheel with classic slot elements. Key features include a Super Wheel awarding wilds, multipliers, synced reels, free spins, and a top Pot Prize of 10,000x the bet. The reviewer finds it a straightforward, familiar game lacking innovation but offers solid entertainment through its high volatility and potential big wins. Its neon-lit visuals and trance-like EDM soundtrack create a vibrant, club-like gaming atmosphere.
review: Blitz Super Wheel: Slot OverviewYou might need comfy shoes for this one, folks, as software provider Pragmatic Play invites players to dance to the beat in Blitz Super Wheel, an online slot where a spinning prize wheel meets fruit and electricity. From said wheel, various reel multipliers may be awarded, such as wilds placed on the reels, wild multis, synced reels, and so on, though Blitz Super Wheel's main monetary draw is its top Pot Prize, cha-chinging to the tune of 10,000x the bet when hit.If electric fruit was the brief, then this is what Pragmatic Play has achieved when designing Blitz Super Wheel. The background surges with neon lights, and if you're lucky, actual 'Electric Surges' will flare up in abundance, signalling the activation of the Super Wheel. If you take a look at the left-hand side of the gaming grid, you can see the edge of the wheel, which creeps out further to spin when triggered. Players who like to pretend they're clubbing while gambling might do well to have a turn on Blitz Super Wheel because, as well as the bright light show, the game boasts a rather trancey soundtrack.Blitz Super Wheel slot - base gameBlitz Super Wheel spins away on a 5x3 matrix with 20 paylines where winning combinations are formed left to right from the leftmost reel. It is possible to stake 20 c to $/€240 per round, with many options in between, and gamblers may buy the free spins bonus round for a set multiplier of the total bet. Mathematically, this is a highly volatile slot with a highest of 96.5% as its RTP value, applicable either when buying the feature or not.The electric 10-A card ranks pay 0.5x to 1x the bet for hitting a 5-of-a-kind combination, and a line of 5 cherries, lemons, grapes, watermelons, or bells award 1.5 to 5 times the bet. Wilds substitute for all symbols except scatters and appear on all reels. Wilds have the same payout values as the bell symbols.Blitz Super Wheel: Slot FeaturesBlitz Super Wheel slot - free spinsKeeping Blitz Super Wheel turning is a prize-giving Super Wheel, a free spins bonus round, and a feature buy.Super WheelOn any spin, the Blitz Super Wheel may randomly activate and award one of these prizes:5, 7, or 10 wild symbols hit on random positions.Supercharged Wilds - 5, 6, 7, or 8 wild symbols are added to random positions with an x2 multiplier applying to all wins on the spin.Super Wild Reels - 2, 3, or 4 reels are stacked with wild symbols.8, 10, or 12 Mystery symbols land in random positions that all reveal the same paying symbol or wild.In Sync Reels - 2 or more adjacent reels land the same symbols.Pot Prize - the 50x Mini, 100x Minor, 500x Major, 2,500x Mega, or the 10,000x Blitz prize is awarded.Free spins are triggered.Free SpinsScatters appear on the leftmost, middle, and rightmost reels. Hitting 3 scatter symbols awards 5, 6, or 8 free spins at random. Free spins may also be won from the Super Wheel in the base game. During free spins, the Super Wheel can randomly activate on any spin, and it appears to do so more frequently than the base game, though this is not stated in the rules. If free spins are awarded from the Super Wheel during the round, +5 free spins are granted.Feature BuyBy paying 100 times their bet, players can buy the free spins bonus round.Blitz Super Wheel slot - free spinsBlitz Super Wheel: Slot VerdictDespite the significant amount of glitzy shine that went into its production, Blitz Super Wheel doesn't seem like the sort of game which Pragmatic Play had to really reach deep into its creative stores to make. From a title that contains three of the more commonly found words in slots, 'blitz', 'super', and 'wheel', to features and appearance, Blitz Super Wheel is the type of slot a studio like Pragmatic Play could excrete in its sleep. Hot innovation takes a back seat to classic slot design, electrified fruit takes the place of originality, and high-tempo EDM energy provides the impetus to keep the game rolling rather than a desire to see mechanical mysteries unfold.Instead, Blitz Super Wheel is a what you see is what you get type of game with little in the way of mystery. It's similar in many ways to iSoftBet's Hot Spin Deluxe/Hot Spin Megaways, what with the retro appearance and wheel of prizes. In both developers' slots, this is a wheel that is able to modify the playing area in various ways. Some are quite entertaining ways, too. However, a good chunk of the wheel's effects lack the ability to lead to massive rewards since the most valuable pay symbol is worth 5x for 5 OAK on a 20-payline grid.Supercharged Wilds with multis do exist, but it seems a lot of hope rests on hitting the upper Pot Prizes. Well, the top Pot Prize, mostly, and its 10,000x payout equals Blitz Super Wheel's win cap. A decent cap, but it is hard to imagine it being whacked outside the local jackpot Pot Prize feature, so hopefully, the crackling visuals and shape-throwing tunes are enough to entertain players interested in attempting to crack the top prize.

title: Cygnus 5
structured_summary:
Cygnus 5 returns to an Ancient Egyptian star-themed slot, continuing ELK Studios' mystical Cygnus series.  
Key features include Avalanche wins with expanding rows, prism and multiplier symbols, Meteor Strikes, and free spins with persistent multipliers.  
The reviewer finds Cygnus 5 enjoyable yet somewhat overfamiliar, offering solid gameplay but lacking major innovation.  
Aesthetics are attractive with strong audiovisuals typical of ELK Studios, though the visual impact is less striking than earlier series entries.
review: Cygnus 5: Slot OverviewPeople have been looking up to the stars for an awful long time. The earliest astronomical records we have come from 30,000 year old cave paintings, and it feels fairly safe to say mankind was looking up in wonder long before that time. Since then, we humans and our inquisitive minds have tapped into some of the universe's mysteries, but plenty more remain unanswered. Maybe some of the questions we'll never be able to answer? Before we get lost in a rabbit hole of hypotheticals, however, let's grip onto the physical realm and take a leap into the online slot Cygnus 5, the fifth release in provider ELK Studios' mystical Cygnus range.The Cygnus series has passed through a number of theme changes, from astronomy, ancient arena, to the Tower of London. Cygnus 5 cycles back to the original slot, being an Ancient Egyptian-themed number with a focus on the stars. A narrow focus this time, as a small section of the night sky can be glimpsed above and behind a gaming grid housed in some sort of temple space. The visual impact isn't as great as earlier Cygnus slots - this is the fifth time around the block, after all, but it is otherwise tough to fault the game's sounds and sights too harshly.Cygnus 5 slot - base gameAs they have done so far, Cygnus 5 is played on a lopsided 6-reel gaming grid. Hitting spin drops 4 rows of symbols into play with the aim of getting at least 3 matching symbols on consecutive reels starting from the leftmost side. At 4 rows high, 4,096 ways to win are available, increasing when extra rows are added to the board via the Avalanching wins mechanic. For part 5, ELK has included a medium/high volatile math model, where the RTP is 94% at best or 87% for specific markets. The stake range is 20 c to $/€100 a game round.Seven pay symbols land in Cygnus 5. They are triangle, diamond, and hexagonal shapes as the low pays, then a bird, a snake, a cat, and a sun-moon symbol as the highs. Low pays award 0.2 times the bet for 6 OAK, while the high pays award up to 0.3 to 5 times the bet. To help link winning combinations together, the wild symbol substitutes for all regular paying symbols.Cygnus 5: Slot FeaturesCygnus 5 slot - free spinsWinning combinations in Cygnus 5 trigger the Avalanche feature, which removes the corresponding symbols, and the remaining symbols drop downwards. Next, an additional row is added (up to 8 high), and symbols drop to fill the reels. Extra rows mean extra ways to win; at its full size, there are 262,144 ways to win. Avalanches repeat like this until no new win appears on the grid.Prism SymbolThe prism symbol activates when it reaches the bottom of the grid. After the next symbol drop or immediately if placed by a Meteor Strike, it turns all symbols along lines in a random number of directions into matching symbols or wilds. A prism symbol hitting a prism symbol with its beam of light triggers a chain reaction, and all symbols along the selected lines also transform into the same pay symbol or wild. Symbols in crossings become wilds. Multipliers, scatters, or super scatters along a direction selected by a prism temporarily transform into the selected symbol. These feature symbols return after the win calculation.Multiplier SymbolA multiplier symbol that reaches the bottom of the reels or the leftmost column increases the current active win multiplier before transforming into a wild symbol. Multiplier increases, and symbol transitions occur before the payout. The win multiplier is applied to all subsequent wins in the game round. Reaching the top of the multiplier pillar pays the remaining amount needed to reach the max win. The win multiplier resets before the start of the next game round.Meteor StrikeThe Meteor Strike is randomly triggered after a drop or after a symbol refill. When triggered, a number of randomly selected pay symbols on the grid are replaced by feature symbols.Free SpinsA scatter symbol or a super scatter symbol that reaches the leftmost column triggers 7 free spins, and the current win multiplier is carried over to the bonus round. If a scatter or super scatter ends up on the bottom row in columns 2 to 6, it is removed and dropped again in the column, 1 step to the left if possible. This movement occurs at the end of an Avalanche cycle, once per cycle.During free spins, the win multiplier is persistent throughout the round, and each new drop starts with 4 rows. If super spins were triggered, a Meteor Strike is guaranteed on every drop. When a scatter reaches the leftmost column, additional free spins are granted. Or, if a super scatter reaches the leftmost reel in regular free spins, the round is upgraded to super free spins.X-iterCygnus 5's X-iter bonus buys include these 5 choices: Bonus Hunt (2x the bet) for 1 drop, which is more than 3 times more likely to trigger a bonus or super bonus game, Meteors (10x the bet) for a game round that guarantees a Meteor Strike on the first drop, Prisms (25x the bet) for a game round with at least 2 prism symbols, Bonus Game (100x the bet), and Super Bonus (500x the bet).Cygnus 5 slot - free spinsCygnus 5: Slot VerdictNot long before this, another one of ELK Studios' big series, Nitropolis, reached five slots in length (not including the four clan spin-offs), so there is a certain poetry in seeing Cygnus reach the number 5 mark as well. The first two, Cygnus and Cygnus 2, were high-scoring slots that wowed through a combination of unique form and function. Cygnus 3, meanwhile, dropped the score, partly on account of its odd Cygnus Wheel, while Cygnus 4 was good but not exactly great. The same goes for Cygnus 5, really. It supplies the sort of attractive audiovisuals these games are known for, and the blend of Avalanche wins, expanding rows, plus increasing ways to win have proven to be a highly dependable mix for ELK Studios, not just here but also in the successful 'Gold' series. The core gameplay is a little overdone by now but is still dependably enjoyable when consecutive wins are stacking up, ballooning the board.Peripheral features help set these games apart, and in Cygnus 5's case, one of the main innovators is the prism symbol. It's no paradigm shift, but it is a nice add-on. Like the multiplier symbol, you want those prisms dropping as low (or to the left for the multi symbols) as possible to activate their transformative powers. A grid that can grow to 8 rows in height provides a lot of space to transform symbols, too. Multiplier symbols are multiplier symbols - the more they grow the win multiplier, the better. But, like Cygnus 4, the way they can bestow the 50,000x max win if the top of the pillar is reached is a double-edged sword, provoking a mixed emotional reaction to the quasi-jackpot element.Unless ELK Studios goes massive on the next game's mechanics, there isn't a huge amount of excitement at the thought of a Cygnus 6. That's not to say release number 5 is a dud. Far from it. The game functioned well enough, weaving in some newer elements to go with familiar ones. All in all, Cygnus 5 put on a decent show, but a feeling of diminishing returns has set to a degree.

title: 4 Fantastic Fish Amazon Adventure
structured_summary: 4 Fantastic Fish Amazon Adventure brings the fish slot series to a South American river theme set on the Amazon River. It features Money Ways wins, Piranha Frenzy, Giant Anaconda, Amazon Respins, Temple Pick-A-Win, and feature buys with high volatility and a max win of 11,340x. The reviewer finds it a competent but uninspired addition, recycling familiar mechanics without major innovation. Visually, it offers a surface-level river view with natural scenery, presenting a less bold but still vibrant aesthetic.
review: 4 Fantastic Fish Amazon Adventure: Slot OverviewOne casino game maker committed to marking out territory in the unstoppable fish slot category is UK-head-quartered studio 4ThePlayer. This it has done through its 4 Fantastic Fish range which has so far gone through, amongst other things, Viking, Dream Drop, Gigablox, and Egyptian iterations. This time, the franchise has voyaged to South America to do a spot of river-based angling in 4 Fantastic Fish Amazon Adventure, a slot which carries a bunch of familiar mechanics as well as a newer (for the series) pick 'n click feature.At 6,800 km in length, the Amazon River is the longest river in the world, and players get to experience a tiny segment of it in 4 Fantastic Fish Amazon Adventure. The camera view is situated at about the water's surface level, affording a view of trees, hills, and whatnot on top, with weeds, and so on below. The series is renowned for its bright, bold visuals, and while 4 Fantastic Fish Amazon Adventure might not be as bright nor as bold as some others in the range, it's certainly no dour winter angling trip either.4 Fantastic Fish Amazon Adventure slot - base gameLashed together with rope is 4 Fantastic Fish Amazon Adventure's 6x4 gaming grid, which has 4,096 ways to win on it. Winning combinations begin on the leftmost reel, and matching symbols must land on adjacent reels. The highest RTP is 94%, while a lower 90.5% version is available, as well, and the volatility is high. Bets of 20 c to $/€80 may be placed on each spin, with several of the main bonuses available in the feature buy menu.The lower paying symbols in the game are 10 through A card icons, awarding 1.5x to 2.5x for 6 OAK, then hats, buckets, frogs, birds, and a fisherman, awarding 3x to 10x the bet for 6 OAK. Wilds substitute all regular pay symbols but cannot simultaneously land on the leftmost and second reel.4 Fantastic Fish Amazon Adventure: Slot Features4 Fantastic Fish Amazon Adventure slot - Anaconda featureThe features available in 4 Fantastic Fish Amazon Adventure are its Money Ways wins, Piranha Frenzy, Giant Anaconda, Amazon Respins, Temple Pick-A-Win, and feature buys.Money WaysPiranha symbols land with money values that can get bigger from left to right, with Big Game Prizes - the Big 50x, Super 200x, Mega 1,000x, and Ultra 10,000x present on the rightmost reel. Landing a winning way of Piranha symbols awards their displayed value, including Big Game Prizes, part of Piranha symbol way wins.Piranha Frenzy & Giant AnacondaIn the base game, the Piranha Frenzy is able to create or improve wins with Piranha symbols. In the respins bonus, it can move sideways to lock on open reels. The Giant Anaconda, meanwhile, can swap symbols to create or improve Piranha symbol wins in the base game or move Piranha symbols from closed to open reels in the respins bonus.Amazon Respin BonusLanding 3 or more Respins scatters triggers the Amazon Respins bonus. The reels that landed scatters are opened while the rest are closed. Piranha symbols that land on open reels are locked in place, awarding their value. Piranhas that hit on the triggering spin lock to reels whether open or not, but new Piranha symbols cannot lock to closed reels.The round starts with 3 respins, which reset when Piranha symbols land on open reels. If a Respins scatter lands on a closed reel, it opens for the rest of the round. If an open reel is covered in Piranha symbols, a Gator collects the prizes from it and doubles the total value, creating space for new Piranha symbols to land. However, the 10,000x Ultra will not be collected by the Gator. When the respins count runs out, the feature ends.Temple Pick-A-Win BonusThis feature is triggered by landing 3 or more Pick-A-Win scatters. The number of picks awarded is equal to the number of triggering scatters. Players click step pyramids on the screen to reveal cash prizes.Feature BuyPlayers can buy Amazon Respins, Temple Pick-A-Win, or Piranha Frenzy, costing 75x, 150x, or 30x the bet, respectively.4 Fantastic Fish Amazon Adventure slot - adventure pick bonus4 Fantastic Fish Amazon Adventure: Slot VerdictIt was hard not to shrug off a feeling of diminishing returns when reviewing 4 Fantastic Fish Amazon Adventure. It's fine for what it is, but aside from the riverside setting, it remains very close to what preceded it and doesn't do a heck of a lot that its brothers or sister slots do. There are no major issues with the features, which remain a compelling competitor to the Fishin' Frenzies and the Big Bass Bonanzas out there - using Money Ways instead of a collector symbol to gather prizes makes a nice change, and hunting for Big Game Prizes on the rightmost reel adds to the suspense. The problem is we've been here on several occasions before, and 4 Fantastic Fish Amazon Adventure's features recycle plus a poor max RTP don't do it many favours.The new feature is fairly unexciting as well. The Temple Pick-A-Win bonus might let players step away from the river for a moment to take in more of the surrounding area, but it's a basic feature that's been kicking around for an age. Pick, click, and win. It might suit adherents of the old school, and having alternative ways in a game to win cash is no bad thing, but it doesn't significantly enhance what was already here. Max win is nothing to be sniffed at, though, at 11,340x the bet, putting it about on par with the rest of the series bar the Dream Drop version. All in all, 4 Fantastic Fish Amazon Adventure is an okay addition to the franchise that might not take anything away from it, but it doesn't exactly add a whole bunch either.

title: Wheel of Wishes
structured_summary:
Wheel of Wishes features an Arabian Nights-inspired desert theme with mystical symbols and a genie lamp centerpiece.  
Its main attractions are four progressive jackpots, triggered via scatter symbols or an optional Power Mode that increases jackpot chances at a higher cost.  
The reviewer finds the base game dull with very low volatility and questions the value of Power Mode given the low RTP and high stakes.  
Aesthetically, the game presents swirling sands and towering rocks with thematic symbols, though audio details were not highlighted.
review: Wheel of Wishes (Alchemy Gaming): OverviewWe all know Microgaming is no stranger to the progressive jackpot world. Their ultra-popular Mega Moolah has paid out more in winnings than just about any other slot. It is getting on in years, and someone must have thought it's time for a new game to join their progressive jackpot network. Enter Wheel of Wishes from partner studio Alchemy Gaming. This new developer keeps their cards close to their chest. Apart from being self-proclaimed ‘gaming alchemists’ little information can be gleaned about them from their site. So far, no meet the team section or even address. It is early days though so perhaps more info will be eked out later. Being a brand new studio, Wheel of Wishes is their first and only slot so far. Talk about going large right off the starting block. So has it got what it takes to attract players to the jackpot network?The title Wheel of Wishes is the name of a feature in the game and gives few clues as to what the game is about. To clarify, it has a desert setting with swirling sands and towering columns of rock. It’s not Egyptian, though it is set in the desert with symbols that have an Arabian Nights flair. One of the key concerns when taking on a progressive jackpot is what bet level to go for. As is usually the case with jackpot slots, the game is upfront about the fact that larger stakes have a greater chance of triggering the Jackpot Bonus. So factoring that in, stakes begin at 20 c/p per spin and can be increased to $/€20. Both stakes and chances can be increased further by the Power Mode feature we will detail below.Once stakes are set, players hit spin to bring the 5 reel, 3 row game to life. Criss-crossing the reels are 10 paylines where three or more matching symbols cause a payout. Low pay symbols are four colourful card suits as well as a random pink circle tossed in for fun. Better are the premiums which are comprised of a purple amulet, blue potions, a green and gold book, and a chest overflowing with treasure. Topping the table is the mythical genie lamp with returns 10 times the stake for five of a kind. The wild is better, and offers 50 times the stake for a full line, as well as substituting for any symbol except the scatter.When it comes to figures, there is only one that most people are concerned with – the jackpot! But, let’s take a look at the stats driving the game machine. Firstly, RTP is on the low side but not unusually so for this type of slot. In standard mode, it sits at 93.34%, or 92.24% when Power Mode is active. Both cases include the Progressive Jackpot contributions. Volatility is not just low, but officially ‘very low’ according to the developer. This means patience is required to get anywhere, particularly since there are so few features on board.Wheel of Wishes (Alchemy Gaming): FeaturesPowerspin feature in actionAlright, let’s start this section off with the headline attraction. Here are Wheel of Wishes’ four Progressive Jackpots and their seed values:Mini starts at €10.Minor starts at €100.Major starts at €50,000.Wowpot! starts at €2,000,000.There are two ways of winning the jackpots. The standard way is by landing two or more scatters anywhere on the reels to trigger a Power Spin (the scatter also pays out 5x, 50x, or 500x the stake when 3, 4, or 5 land respectively). During Power Spins, giant 3x3 symbols take over the middle 3 reels. This includes the new Bonus Wheel symbol. If a full Bonus Wheel lands in view then it awards a spin of the Wheel of Wishes Jackpot Bonus. Like Mega Moolah, the wheel is divided into segments, the smaller the jackpot, the more segments it has. There is one segment for the Wowpot.The second way of winning the jackpot is to activate Power Mode. With this mode engaged, every spin is a Power Spin which drastically increases the chance of landing a full Bonus Wheel symbol. Obviously, there is a cost involved to do so, and in this case, it is a hefty 10 times the stake on every spin.Wheel of Wishes (Alchemy Gaming): VerdictPicking a gambling strategy is not usually as tough as it is with Wheel of Wishes. Confusing the situation is the Power Mode and the increased chances you get with bigger bets. Power Mode makes a significant impact on the chance of triggering full Bonus Wheels, but you can see why the RTP with it is less. When it is activated, the jackpot wheel gets spun more; however, it usually falls on the Mini Jackpot. If you are betting large, especially at max level, then up to 200 credits a pop for a €10 return doesn’t add up. At that rate bankrolls evaporate quicker than drops of moisture in the desert. Of course, it could lead to nabbing over €2 million, and therein lies the allure and risk of progressive jackpots which need to be weighed up. In the case of Wheel of Wishes, when you crunch the numbers, it can feel a little cynical.Another concern is that if you leave the jackpots out, the rest of the game isn’t that much fun. There are no free spins here like you get with Mega Moolah for instance. When it comes to potential, aside from the jackpot, the best result is landing a full screen of premium symbols. This means single spin wins of 500 times the stake from stacked wilds. Or, far more likely is a screen of lesser symbols. Even the next one down is the lamp which is worth a mere 100 times your bet for a full screen. Combine these possibilities with the game’s very low volatility, and the result is a rather dull base game indeed.

title: Brew Brothers

review: Brew Brothers: Slot OverviewWell golla gee, chew on the dawg y'all, we headin' up north courtesy of developer Slotmill to catch up with two hillbilly siblings in the online slot Brew Brothers. Most of all, however, we're stoked to see that the company has finally started its Megaways journey and we can't wait to see what's to come. After all, Red Tiger is a developer with insane momentum right now, producing online slots that are bigger, better and more beautiful than ever before.
