review: Beetlejuice Megaways: OverviewBeetlejuice, Beetlejuice, Beetlejuice… Say that out loud at your peril because if you do, there is a chance that actor Michael Keaton will show up looking like a sun-starved European in the middle of winter, lashed in a ton of eyeshadow. We are of course talking about the 1988 cult classic film Beetlejuice which has been given the online slots treatment by developer Barcrest. This is not the first time that Beetlejuice has starred in a slot, but it is the first non-physical version.If you are a fan of the movie you might be forgiven for thinking ‘really, they got Barcrest to do the crossover?’ Fortunately, the slot gets a helping hand from a Megaways license to help flesh out the gameplay. And interestingly, the tweaks Barcrest has made to the engine aren’t completely dire. The Maitlands came to regret calling Beetlejuice into their lives, so how does the slot version fare?Beetlejuice is a bit of an old movie, so if you haven’t seen it here is a quick catch up. Basically, it depicts a recently deceased couple (the Maitlands) who enlist the help of Beetlejuice to remove some unwanted newcomers from their house. Hilarity ensues in a movie that is more camp than horror, with more than a little eccentricity dashed in. It’s worth checking out if you want a bit of humour tinged weirdness in your life. Here's the trailer in case you want to see what it's all about:﻿Being a Megaways game, Beetlejuice Megaways is somewhat unconventional with 5 reels as opposed to the more common 6 reel setup. At the core of the gameplay is a reel expansion mechanic that unlocks additional paylines. By default you'll see that the top half of the reels are covered and inactive. Now, if a win occurs, then the cover is removed and the full grid can be used. Initially, each reel can hold between 2-6 symbols, and when uncovered that increases to between 4-12 symbols. This boosts Megaways too, and when the full grid is active, then there can be as many as 248,832 win ways in play. Winning combinations also trigger the cascade feature. Here, winning symbols are removed to let new ones drop into the gaps, which can result in multiple winners from one spin.Say Beetlejuice’s name three times or just select a bet to get the action started. Stakes start at 0.10 c/p or can be moved up as high as 500 €/$ per spin – much higher than you usually get with Megaways. On the technical side, volatility comes in the medium to high spectrum, though the game proved to pay out quite frequently during testing. Overall, RTP is far from being an undead nightmare either on 96%, which is pretty much bang on average.Crack up open the Beetlejuice Megaways paytable to reveal a mix of 10-A royals and 5 character symbols from the film. We don’t get all of the characters, the two leads played by Geena Davis and Alec Baldwin are conspicuous with their absence. Perhaps their fee would have blown the budget sideways? We do get Winona Rider though, who looked really young in that film. That was before she transitioned into 90s slacker pin-up for the alternative crowd and dabbled in some casual shoplifting.Either way, Winona is one of the premium symbols along with the head shrinker, Miss Argentina, Serpent Beetlejuice, and of course Beetlejuice himself as the most valuable tile. Value is a relative term, and symbol payouts across the board are quite low. For example, 5 Beetlejuice symbols are worth a modest 5 times the stake. Beetlejuice is the only symbol that pays out with 2 of a kind, while the rest of the symbols need at least 3 to trigger a payout. Assisting players is a wild which substitutes for any of the regular pay symbols.Beetlejuice Megaways: FeaturesFree spins feature in actionBeetlejuice the movie might have been eccentrically original, but the slot version offers a bunch of standard Megaways features. First up is the Mystery Ghost Symbol which can land anywhere during the base game or free spins. When in view, all Ghosts transform into matching symbols which can be anything except the wild or the scatter.The scatter symbol resembles a movie ticket stub with the word Beetlejuice printed on it twice. When 3, 4, or 5 of these symbols land in view, they award 8, 12, or 16 Free Spins respectively. A couple of things pop up during the bonus round. For one, the background image changes. More importantly, a win multiplier is injected into the game. This multiplier starts at x1 and increases by +1 after each cascade with no limit to how high it can go. Moreover, scatters remain in the bonus game too, and 3, 4, or 5 of them award an additional 4, 6, or 8 free spins respectively.Beetlejuice Megaways: VerdictLike a lot of branded slots, Beetlejuice Megaways' appeal relies heavily on its subject matter. The game is okay, but mystery symbols and free spins with a progressive multiplier is pretty standard fare for a Megaways game. The most unusual aspect is the 5 reel, expandable row arrangement. This setup has its ups and downs, but it is nice to see Barcrest doing something different with the Megaways formula. One nice result is that rather lengthy cascades weren’t uncommon and were improved by the expanded row feature. There is no official word on hit rate, but during testing, the win frequency was quite high. That could have a lot to do with luck of course, but there did seem to be a lower than expected number of dead spins.There are a couple of trade-offs to be aware of though. One is that win values aren’t phenomenal when limited to 5 rather than 6 of a kind. Quite often, a run of consecutive cascades occurred, building some sweet anticipation, only to find the overall total didn’t quite live up to the dream. The second trade-off is that landing 3 scatters can take a serious amount of time and patience. There is a scene in the movie when Beetlejuice is sitting in a waiting room that is currently serving customer number 4. He looks at his ticket and sees he is number 9,998,383,750,000 in the queue. His expression of exasperation is not far off the mark.But you know what, this actually feels more like nit-picking instead of confessing to feelings of personal violation that often arise after playing a Barcrest title. Beetlejuice Megaways the slot makes a lot more sense if you’ve seen the film, and it's far from being a great Megaways title, but it isn’t too bad either.

title: Rainbow Reels
structured_summary: Rainbow Reels is an Irish folklore-themed slot featuring leprechauns, rainbows, and pots of gold. It offers a unique Seven Layers mechanic with cascading wins and a free spins bonus where wilds with usage counters enhance gameplay. The reviewer finds the base game underwhelming but praises the bonus rounds for exciting, repeat-win potential and a max win of 5,000x the bet. The game sports lush green visuals and a jaunty Irish tune, creating a cheerful and immersive atmosphere.
review: Rainbow Reels: Slot OverviewIn the mood for some leprechaun-istic flavoured action? If the answer to that question is yes, then here is an online slot from developer Pragmatic Play which might fit the bill. It's called Rainbow Reels and transports players to a magical part of the planet where leprechauns, rainbows, and maybe metaphorical pots of gold abound. It also uses an unusual Seven Layers feature which may sound a little bizarre at first, but if you can manage to get it to pop during the free spins bonus round, then it starts to make a whole lot more sense. Here's how it all works.For the base game, players are treated to a very green-looking land full of plants and sunshine. Well, it can't possibly always be sunny here; there must be a good share of rain to keep the flora looking so lush and healthy. Anyway, a cheerful leprechaun chap stands next to the reels to the right of the screen, also appearing on one of Rainbow Reels' high-pay symbols. The jaunty vibes are accentuated by a jaunty tune to produce an Irish folklore-inspired slot that's, well, jaunty.Rainbow Reels slot - base gameRainbow Reel's gaming occurs on a 5x4 grid with 40 paylines, and 7 layers. The layers aspect probably won't make much sense at the moment but will be covered shortly in the features section. Run by a highly volatile math model, Rainbow Reels produces a default return to player value of 96.07% when betting 20 p/c to $/€240 per spin or 96.05% when buying free spins, which costs 100 times the bet to do so. Winning combinations are created by landing matching symbols along a payline from the leftmost side of the grid on consecutive reels.A bunch of classic/generic/familiar symbols appear on Rainbow Reels' paytable. These are 10 to A card ranks as the low pays, then a pipe, a mug of beer, a horseshoe, some boots, a top hat, and a leprechaun as the high pays. Landing a 5 OAK winning line will get you 1.25x to 2.5x the bet when formed of low-pay royals or 3 to 10 times the stake when formed of premium picture symbols. Wilds hit on all reels as well, paying out up to 10x the bet for a 5 wild win, or they may substitute for all symbols in the game except the scatter.Rainbow Reels: Slot FeaturesRainbow Reels slot - free spinsRainbow Reels uses a repeat wins style feature with an unusual Seven Layer limit, free spins, and a bonus buy as its features.Seven LayersIn Rainbow Reels, all positions on the reels have up to 7 layers. The initial spin shows the topmost layer. Whenever a symbol is part of a winning combination, it is removed from the board and reveals the next layer, containing a random symbol beneath it. This process continues when consecutive wins occur until reaching the final layer. After the symbol on the final layer has been removed, the position will remain empty.Free SpinsScatters appear on reels 1, 3 and 5, and hitting 3, 4, or 5+ of them awards 2x, 10x, or 100x the bet, respectively, plus 12 free spins. Free spins use the same 7 layer system as in the base game, except when reaching the last layer of every position, wild symbols are guaranteed to appear. These wild symbols display a counter showing how many times they can be used in a winning combination until they disappear. The counter can show anything from 3 to a maximum of 13. Hitting 3 or more scatters during the feature awards players 6 additional free spins.Rainbow Reels slot - free spinsRainbow Reels: Slot VerdictThe term 'a game of two halves' crops up in sports when one team outplays the other in the first half only to end up getting dominated in the second. To borrow the phrase, Rainbow Reels was a real game of two halves. At first, the idea of limiting what is kind of like a tumbling wins style feature (where symbols are replaced rather than tumble downwards) felt a bit dumb. If you manage to reach 7 layers down in the base game, positions just turn blank, meaning they contribute nothing going forward. What is the point, one wondered - at first.The second half of Rainbow Reels kicked in when free spins bonus rounds started flaring up and producing thrilling results. There, having wilds with counters as the final layer made a huge difference, and free spins could morph into ridiculous wild fests, with wilds smothering the reels, leading to loads of repeat wins as their counters ticked down to zero and their positions were shut down. It's a feature which might sound so-so on paper but really has to be seen in action to get the full effect. So mesmerising were some of the consecutive win runs that any negativity produced by reviewing yet another leprechaun-themed slot was washed away in a tidal wave of good vibes. Of course, Rainbow Reels is hardly going to deliver big wins all the time, but when it does, it is quite a sight to behold.At best, Rainbow Reels is capable of producing wins up to a cap of 5,000x the bet, which came across as pretty realistic, relatively speaking, after seeing the 7 layers and wilds do their thing. Once again, Pragmatic Play has managed to come up with a compelling new idea that is fairly simple but potentially rather exciting. Even players fed up, lukewarm, or fatigued by the idea of another leprechaun slot may find Rainbow Reels' 7 layers concept of interest, in the bonus round at least.

title: Mutagenes
structured_summary: Mutagenes is a sci-fi themed slot set in a futuristic lab where genetic mutations create next-gen humanoids. It features cascades with increasing multipliers, Infection and Mutation random upgrades, free spins with expanding wilds, and a buy-in option. The reviewer finds it thought-provoking with solid gameplay and up to 12,000x max wins, though not the most innovative. The game boasts quirky visuals, retro-inspired sounds, and lively animations that enrich its unique scientific atmosphere.
review: Mutagenes: Slot OverviewImagine a world where genetic manipulation has been perfected and is completely safe; is that something humanity really wants to get into? Okay, the health benefits might seem worth it if we could manipulate genes to cure all manner of ills, maybe even stop the process of ageing - for those who can afford it. But the cosmetic side of things is more debatable. Imagine editing our genetics to create a race of perfect-looking specimens. Will there be different definitions of beauty, or will we all look the same, perfectly sculptured, blemish-free, never sick, living forever, like a race of marble statues? Fortunately, or unfortunately, humanity is a long way away from that level of editing, but we do have creative endeavours like Peter & Sons' slot Mutagenes to kick start the mental thought processes.Mutagenes finds itself out in the galactic void, where scientists are racing against the clock to create next-gen humanoids, like a futuristic Victor Frankenstein, with far more advanced technology at their command. A wacky workshop is Mutagenes' on-screen setting, displaying specimens in vats, monitors, and other lab-related items. The finishing touch is supplied by a snappy backing tune and various visual effects that bring Mutagenes to life like a test tube marvel.Mutagenes slot - base gameSitting amidst this nest of horrors lies Mutagenes' 6-reel 4-row gaming area, which uses a 4,096 ways to win pay system. Winning combinations consist of matching symbols landing on at least three adjacent reels, beginning from the leftmost reel on the grid. With volatility set to high, Mutagenes is available in several RTP configurations, where the highest, default value is 96.3%. Base bets are 10 c to $/€50 per spin, but activating the Golden Bet increases the stake by 50% to have a greater chance of triggering free spins.On the paytable, Mutagenes coughs up the four card suits as its low pays; all are worth 0.5x the bet for a 6 OAK winning combinations, while the mids are syringes, hands, eyes in bottles, and brains in jars, paying 0.8 to 0.9 times the bet for a 6-of-a-kind win. The last two pay symbols, two character symbols, are the high pays, worth 3 to 4 times the stake for a 6-matching symbol win. Wild symbols appear on all reels except the leftmost reel, in the base game and in free spins. Wild symbols substitute for all symbols except the scatter.Mutagenes: Slot FeaturesMutagenes slot - free spinsMutagenes hums along with a cascade feature, which explodes winning symbols off the reels, making spaces that are filled by symbols cascading down from above. Each new cascade increases the total win multiplier by +1. The multiplier resets to x1 when there are no more cascading wins. Other features to look out for are a free spins round, Infection, Mutation, and the free spins buy.Infection & MutationInfection may occur randomly in the base game or in free spins. When activated, any mid or low-pay symbol on the grid is replaced by a high-pay symbol. The Mutation feature also occurs at random in the base game or in free spins. When mutation triggers, 2 or more reels are randomly selected, and a random number of high symbols is placed on them; after them, the rest of the symbols are revealed.Free SpinsHitting 3, 4, 5, or 6 scatters awards 10, 12, 14, or 15 free spins, respectively. Free spins use the same cascade, increasing win multiplier mechanic as found in the base game, except during free spins, the multiplier does not reset until the bonus round has been completed. Also, in free spins, expanding wild symbols may land, then expand to cover the whole reel. Expanding wilds can occur on all reels except the leftmost reel. Scatter symbols do not appear in the bonus, so free spins cannot be retriggered.Free Spins BuyPlayers can buy into free spins for the cost of 120x the bet. Once bought, 7 to 12 free spins are randomly awarded, and the RTP for doing so is 96.7%.Mutagenes slot - free spinsMutagenes: Slot VerdictTo start off, Peter & Sons has crafted an interesting game world for Mutagenes that got the mind pondering. It would appear the scientists here are so caught up in the act of creation (or mutation) that they haven't stopped to consider whether what they're doing is moral or an abominable crime against nature. Who gets to decide these things? Future generations, perhaps, depending on the outcome. Or maybe it's like what Nietzsche said, 'There is no such thing as moral phenomena, but only a moral interpretation of phenomena.' Then again, maybe there is.Part of getting the mind ticking over wasn't just the interesting backstory but the engaging sights and sounds. Mutagenes might not have the uber-quintessential Peter & Sons look, like, say, Johnan Legendarian, for example, yet it oozes personality and cute little touches, such as the wriggly hands and so on. The sounds are neat, too, exuding a retro charm which helps draw players into the odd, scientific world. Mutagenes' features, whilst not as cutting edge as gene editing carried out by scientists who have thrown off their moral compass to conduct experimental perversions of nature in the cold dark of space where prying eyes are unable to judge them, are solid - cascades, a growing total multiplier, and expanding wilds on a ways to win pay system and 12,000x max win potential. Hard to go too wrong with that combo.Add it all together, and Mutagenes is a fun Peter & Sons-styled game, maybe not as cutting edge as its thematic makeup but delivering a solid set of features to go with sizable winning potential and entertaining gaming.

title: Black River Gold
structured_summary: Black River Gold is a frontier-themed slot featuring Kane Steel’s gold rush adventure with a mysterious Black River setting. It offers expanding reels with Avalanche mechanics, big symbol alterations via the Revolver feature, Compass wilds, and a bonus free spins game with sticky wilds. The reviewer finds it a solid but slightly less thrilling continuation of the series, appealing mainly to established fans. The game sports a rugged, misty wilderness aesthetic with thematic symbols and fitting audio that complements the frontier vibe.
review: Black River Gold: OverviewPlayers, your man Kane is back in a new adventure and is looking more dapper than ever. It seems like the man who previously used to fall backwards into success came upon hard times during the gold rush and didn't quite make his fortune. Now he's tossed legality to the wind in a last-ditch effort (until next time) to secure some riches.This time it's the Black River where he hopes to get lucky. Though exactly what that entails is not made entirely clear. Salmon farming? Riverboat gambling? A kayak guide? Player's choice this time around as we head off into the wild frontier in the fourth instalment of ELK Studio's popular Gold Series.Unlike the previous three, Black River Gold is a difficult location to place. You would presume it to be in North America, but there are dozens of Black Rivers in that vast stretch of land. There are some clues, though. The first is a towering mountain range in the background, with metal framing, foregrounding a misty tree-filled valley. As before, 24 symbols drop into the grid in a 6-reel, 4-row arrangement which can expand through the Avalanche mechanic and features.Winning combinations are formed of three or more matching symbols left to right. There are no paylines as such; instead, winning symbols can land in any position providing 4,096 win ways with the default 4 rows in play. Then, winning symbols are removed to let new ones fall into place, which not only fills the gaps, but adds an extra row to the grid. At maximum, the game can be expanded to 8 rows high, increasing the number of win ways in the process from 5 rows and 15,625 ways to win, all the way up to a maximum of 8 rows and 262,144 ways to win.Joining the spruced up new Kane Steel requires setting stakes and/or a betting strategy. Bets are available from 20 p/c per spin or all the way up to $/€100 should the need arise. RTP remains the same as before at 96.1% along with high volatility, whilst hit frequency comes in at 24.1%. One stat conspicuous by its absence is the bonus game frequency. So far there has been a tendency to get less frequent as the series has progressed, so what the official rate is in the Black River Gold version is anyone's guess. A qualified guess is that it's likely in the region of 1 in 300-400 spins.Firing up the paytable makes you wonder whether Kane is playing sheriff with all those badges on screen. Or is he dodging the law? Either way, the symbols are made up of J-A royals that actually look like playing cards, a choker, a badge, a whiskey glass, and a gun make up the low and mid pays. On the higher side, we get an emerald, a gold nugget, a diamond, and Kane as the most valuable.Due to the mechanics and features, symbol values are relatively low with five of a kinds ranging from 0.3 to 3 times the stake. On their own, they aren't much to get excited over, but as in previous Kane incarnations, things take a turn for the mental when the features take over.Black River Gold: FeaturesBlack River Gold - Revolver featureIf it isn't broken don't fix it right? The mark of a great series is often how strongly that maxim holds. It is certainly the case with the Gold series where the features remain more or less the same, along with the odd tweak or two. For one, those jungus big symbols make a return and can appear in 2x2, 3x3, or 4x4 epic size. They might stick out like a sore thumb when they don't line up, but are super helpful when dragged into a winning combo.A new alteration has also been made to the big symbols. This time around, if a big symbol has an empty space beneath, it turns into a gun cylinder symbol (the part that holds the bullets). Known as the Revolver feature, when the revolver appears, symbols beneath it are loaded up making the revolver a big version of the symbols it holds. If all 6 bullet spaces are filled, then the revolver just turns into a big wild symbol.The next special symbol is the Compass. When it lands, matching symbols across it become wild. So, if the needle is pointing east-west, then matching symbols on its left and right become wild. Also, if the compass reaches the bottom row, it turns wild too. Wilds can substitute for any other symbol except compasses and scatters.Finally, what it all comes down to - the Bonus Game. Land 3, 4, 5, or 6 scatter symbols anywhere in view to trigger 10, 15, 20, or 25 free drops respectively. During the bonus game, the Safety Level comes into play, so each win adds another row (up to 8) as during the base game, but now they don't fall back to 4 rows on new drops. Wilds that appear are stored at the bottom of the grid and remain sticky until they are used in a win. Finally, free drops can be retriggered by landing three or more scatters.Black River Gold: VerdictSo, how does the dressed up Kane Steel fare in Black River Gold? The new setting is a nice choice, less dangerous than before though - Kane has grown up and gone respectable if you will, sort of, The tweaks are there too, so the game isn't a clone, but the impact has lessened since early instalments in the series. It's not as atmospheric or gritty as the earlier ones either. This is older Kane, and life does tend to become less adventurous as people mature.There are no major complaints though; if you've played the other Gold slots, you will know what to expect. When it comes to potential, the max wins remain in the region of 5,000 times the stake for those keeping score. There have been a few changes, but no major overhauls, so it might feel like more of the same for some players. That will either illicit responses of joy from fans of the series or groans from those who need something brand spanking new to get excited about.To sum up, there is no doubt Black River Gold is a solid slot with decent gameplay and stats which provide decent gaming. It might be slightly underwhelming for those of us who were hoping for more, but there is undoubtedly still plenty here to enjoy.

title: Ramses’ Revenge
structured_summary:
Ramses’ Revenge is an Egyptian-themed slot featuring the Pharaoh Ramses seeking payback in a 5x5 grid setting.  
Key features include 4,096 ways to win, Mystery Sandstorms, and free spins with roaming multiplier wild mummies that can multiply wins.  
The reviewer finds the game challenging and volatile but rewarding during free spins, praising its dynamic bonus rounds despite a slow base game.  
Aesthetically, it offers a familiar Relax Gaming style with a crumbling courtyard backdrop and a relaxing Arabic soundtrack enhancing the atmosphere.
review: Ramses’ Revenge: Slot OverviewRelax Gaming don't explicitly state this in the game, but the name Ramses usually refers to Ramses II, the third Pharaoh of the Nineteenth Dynasty. He was also known as Ramses the Great on account of being considered the greatest Pharaoh of all time. In between hammering Syria and North Africa, the guy kept busy building some of the most incredible structures of ancient times. Statues of Ramses have survived remarkably intact down to modern times; his impressively goateed visage recreated countless times over.Ramses' Revenge - free spinsThis time he stars in Relax Gaming's Egyptian themed slot Ramses’ Revenge. The mummified royal is seeking payback on a hapless explorer for ransacking his tomb. When you see the wee sprites populating the 5x5 grid, you might think the name is just a catchy title. However, Ramses’ Revenge is no walk in the park. It might appear sweet, but the game can bite, or in this case, get revenge. The saving grace is the free spins, which are a lot more potent than they might first appear.On the topic of appearance, Ramses’ Revenge has a strongly familiar Relax Gaming look to it. Titles like Snake Arena and Marching Legions with its bird's eye view of the action come to mind. In this case, the grid sits in a crumbing courtyard surrounded by columns, stone flooring, and smatterings of hieroglyphics. A sleepy Arabic soundtrack meanders away producing a relaxing feel, as the onscreen exploits unfold.Ramses gets his revenge on any device, offering bets from 10 p/c to $/€20 per spin. While RTP is slightly above average on 96.15%, in the short term the high volatility ensures anything can happen. From base game grinds to bonus games that occasionally fire off a big one out of nowhere, the game can swing in all directions.Relax made the agreeable choice of using a 4,096 win ways system for players to form combinations. Rows are irrelevant, so as long as three or more identical symbols are adjacent from the leftmost reel you’ve got a winner. In another nice touch, when symbols start to line up, they become indented by sinking into the floor, so you can see exactly which ones are winning or not. A small thing, but handy nonetheless and much cleaner than the way Red Tiger handle things for example, who completely clutter the screen with their payline count-ups.The symbols used have a compact icon-y look reminiscent of collectable game tokens. There are eight regular pay symbols, split into four low pay patterns, and high pay gods. The high pays include Anubis, Sobek, Horus, and Ramses at the top. This four are worth payouts of 1.5 to 4 times the bet in combinations of six of a kind. Not huge, yet the pay mechanic helps, as do wild multipliers during the bonus.Ramses’ Revenge: Slot FeaturesFor the majority of the time, not a whole lot happens in regards to features. Mystery Sandstorms punctuate the base game, but the jewel of the Nile is far and away free spins with their roaming multiplier wilds.On any base game spin, the Mystery Sandstorm feature may randomly trigger. If it does, 2-6 waves occur, where 1-4 mystery symbols per wave are dumped on the reels. All mystery symbols change to reveal the same matching symbol type.The most exciting moments are reserved for the round of free spins. The explorer symbols are what you want here and it takes 2 in view trigger 6 free spins. Before free spins begin, two mummies wander out of the tomb and take the place of the two triggering explorers. These mummies are wild, replacing any other symbol to make a combination. Note that wilds only ever appear during free spins.When new explorers wilds land, the closest mummy moves to take its place. In doing so, one extra spin is awarded, and the multiplier of the respective mummy increases by 1. If more explorers land than there are mummies in view, additional mummies are added to the reels. Also, if more than one mummy is used in a win, the values are multiplied rather than added. There can be, at most, four active mummies on the reels at once.Players not in the mood to wait through the base game for the bonus to hit, may have the option to skip them altogether. Where available, Relax has bolted on feature buy functionality, costing 80 times the stake. When activated, two scatters land on the next spin, triggering the free spins feature. On a technical note, the RTP remains the same this way is as in the default mode.Ramses’ Revenge: Slot VerdictRamses’ Revenge is a game that contains few surprises. The first is how rough the game can be, belying its cute sprite-based appearance. It can be tough going, requiring patience to get to the good parts, or you can leap into the bonus buy to fast track things along - though this is no guarantee of success.Not a lot happened for the first 300 spins or so. There were a couple of circa 30x wins to help stay alive, yet the rest was pretty so-so for a while. The first bonus game was an eye-opener though. Even just two wandering multiplier wilds proved to be quite effective, providing they wandered into the right positions. Overall, bonus rounds proved to be as temperamental as the rest of the game. Some were weak; some were unexpectedly good. During one of our bonus buys, however, we managed to score a win of almost 1,000x.What makes the free spins round particularly interesting is the way mummies multiply each other, giving it a strong resemblance to Jammin' Jars in a strange way. An x4 and an x6 for example, in the midst of several high pays, can cause some serious mayhem. Drop a third wild multiplier in and things can really get hectic. This dynamic well suits the 4,096 ways to win system. Ramses’ Revenge can be unforgiving enough as it is, with fixed paylines, it might have been heart-breaking.In some ways, Ramses’ Revenge ended up playing out like Relax Gaming's Marching Legions. Like that one, free spins can go nuts, piling on multipliers and wins like there's no tomorrow. Then again, it can be equally as frustrating. Ramses’ Revenge is an enjoyable game, a little different, provoking emotional responses which seem out of odds with its lightweight looks.

title: The Catfather
structured_summary: The Catfather is a quirky slot themed around gangster-styled cats engaging in playful crime antics. It features 5 reels, 9 paylines paying both ways, random wild stacks, and free spins with a fixed 4x multiplier. The reviewer finds it charming for cat lovers and fans of simple gameplay but notes its modest max win and gentle volatility limit broader appeal. The game’s aesthetics showcase distinctively dressed cats with a homely, understated background, complemented by a 70s Bond-style bass soundtrack.
review: The Catfather: Slot OverviewIn the spirit of a Coolidge painting depicting dogs playing poker is The Catfather from developer Pragmatic Play. Not only do players get a slot dripping in the flea-ridden beasts, but they also get them dressed like gangsters ready to do a bit of crime. Anyone care to wager what these dastardly mousers might be up to - scratching the rug, or just peeing on it? Anything is possible in a game run by cats impersonating criminals. Then again, perhaps not exactly anything, since The Catfather is about as lethal as a big sleeping furry feline stretched out by the heater on a cold winter’s morning – that thing isn’t going anywhere. Still, put this many cats in one place, and wacky things are bound to happen, right?The Catfather - base gameLet’s start by saying The Catfather isn’t a complicated game, made up as it is of 5 reels, 3 rows, and 9 fixed paylines. For a slot at least partly mob-related, the background is as strangely humdrum as it gets. Instead of some speakeasy, or hideout, we get a couple of lamps and drapes next to the grid - an image of staid homely domestication if ever there was one. Clearly, these cats are gangstas in thought rather than deed. For your listening pleasure, a wicked bass lead 70s Bond era soundtrack adds some much-needed drama.The most remarkable thing about The Catfather, aside from its bonkers theme, is a whopping default RTP value of 98.1%. As equally mystifying, for other reasons, is an absence of a volatility rating, usually prominently displayed in a Pragmatic Play slot. Here one can speculate, but judging by the rest of the game, don’t expect a highly volatile machine, quite the opposite. Due to the number of paylines, bets can be placed from 9 p/c per spin up to $/€45 for the higher rollers.On the topic of paylines, The Catfather pays both ways as long as three or more symbols line up from reel 1 or 5. Symbols are made up of sparkling Q-A royals, then five kitties with distinctive looks and get-ups from Zorro style masks to monocles plus Bowler Hats. As to values, five of a kind premium wins are worth payouts of 3.33x to 22.22x the stake. Everything is ever so slightly unusual in this game. Take wilds, for example. They substitute for regular pay symbols like normal but pay out when just one lands (1.11x the bet), up to 555x the bet for five of a kind. Wilds gain an extra ability during one of the base game features too.The Catfather: Slot FeaturesThe Catfather - It's a Wild Night feature in actionNestled in with the multitude of cat pimps, crooks, and goodness only knows what else, are two bonus features. One is random wild stacks, the other free spins where all wins are subject to a fixed multiplier.Wild reels pop up completely at random on any base spin. Well, not all reels, only reels 2, 3, and 4 are eligible for this effect, but since the game pays both ways they can be surprisingly alright. Don’t expect to retire after playing The Catfather under the best of circumstances though; it’s not a dream maker of a slot.The other feature, free spins, is triggered when 3 or more mouse scatters land anywhere on the reels. Players pick up a payout of 0.22, 0.56, or 2.22 times their stake as well as 10, 15, or 25 free spins, when 3, 4, or 5 scatters are in view. Like the rest of The Catfather, free spins keep things simple. There are no convoluted rule changes or anything innovative either really. Basically, all wins have their values multiplied by 4. Scatters continue to show during the bonus game too, so free spins can be retriggered up to 50 at the most.The Catfather: Slot VerdictThe Catfather is one of those ludicrous games a small segment of the population will utterly fall for while everyone else shakes their head in disbelief. Cat devotees may well love the playfully mesmerising bunch of oddball felines in various guises all over the reels. Players who find entertainment value in animals pretending to be humans might find The Catfather amusing at a push as well. Okay, we are clutching at straws here, but there is a bit of an old school charm to the features, if you want to put a positive spin on it. Wild reels and free spins with a multiplier is about as old school as it gets, and a little beguiling with their simplicity.Beneath the plain, cat-filled exterior is a pretty domesticated math model hacking up modest wins like annoying hairballs. Those who like wallowing around on the spot might appreciate the gentler volatility, yet what lies beneath the fleabag exterior might appeal to a wider range of players in the right circumstance. For instance, the higher than average RTP might come in handy for working through wagering requirements perhaps. It’s actually hard to think of another game that comes close to such a figure for a good long while. Of course, RTP isn’t enough to make you look past the rest of The Catfather’s shortcomings though. Not least is a max win of 2,251x the stake, which suits the cuddly gaming, yet is hardly exciting.Add it all up, and you’ve got a game which might suit certain situations due to a high return to player value, but little outside of that - unless you live in a house where you can’t take a step without putting a foot on a fur ball. In that case, The Catfather’s abundance of felines will extend its furry little paws to draw you in. If you’re more of a dog person, then The Catfather ‘s math model and rewards have about as much drive as a spayed moggy.

title: Dragon Hopper
structured_summary: Dragon Hopper immerses players in an Oriental-themed grid slot inspired by Asian architecture and festive lanterns. Key features include cascading clusters, Instant Prize symbols, and unique Dragon, Bubble, and Mystic Flare mechanics enhancing multiplier potential and win opportunities. The reviewer finds it a polished yet familiar Push Gaming title that, while fun and engaging, lacks distinct innovation. The game boasts tranquil cloud-high visuals with soft glowing lights and a soothing Asian-inspired soundtrack, creating a calming, mystical ambiance.
review: Dragon Hopper: Slot OverviewPush Gaming's Dragon Hopper takes players on a journey to the Orient, blending familiar mechanics with inventive features designed to add depth and unpredictability. Following in the footsteps of the 2021 release Fire Hopper and borrowing inspiration from titles like Crystal Catcher, Dragon Hopper looks to evolve the grid slot experience. While it doesn't shy away from using proven elements, it introduces new features, such as the Dragon feature and the Bubble feature, as well as the Mystic Flare feature.Visually, Dragon Hopper captures a tranquil, almost dreamlike atmosphere, with the reels suspended high up in the clouds. Traditional Asian architecture and vibrant lanterns dot the background, while soft, glowing lights add a touch of mysticism to the setting. The audio complements the visuals with a laid-back, classic Asian-inspired soundtrack that leans into soothing melodies and subtle tones. It's a relaxing backdrop that avoids being overly dramatic, adding a sense of calm to the gameplay while maintaining the thematic consistency Push Gaming is known for.Dragon Hopper slot - base gameDragon Hopper operates on a 7x7 grid and employs a Cluster Link mechanic where wins occur by landing clusters of at least five matching symbols, connected either horizontally or vertically. Cascading symbols follow every win, clearing successful clusters and allowing new symbols to drop into the empty spaces for potential chain reactions. It's a highly volatile experience, backed by a configurable RTP of up to 96.33% at its optimal setting, with a minimum bet starting at €/$0.10 and climbing to a hefty $/€100 for high rollers.On the paytable, the symbols are split into higher and lower-paying categories, all thematically styled as colorful lanterns befitting the festive vibe of the game. The top-tier symbols include red, gold, and pink lanterns, offering payouts up to 50x the bet for clusters of 17 or more. Meanwhile, the low-paying symbols, represented by hues of blue, green, and purple, cap out at a more modest 10x the bet for equivalent cluster sizes.  As a cluster slot, winning clusters are removed via the cascade mechanic, allowing new symbols to drop in and potentially create additional wins.Dragon Hopper: Slot FeaturesDragon Hopper slot - Mystic Flare featureThe features in Dragon Hopper showcase a mix of familiar mechanics and fresh ideas. Push Gaming has included some of its signature elements, such as the Instant Prize symbols, while introducing new concepts like the Bubble feature and the Dragon feature. Here's a detailed breakdown.Wild symbols and Dragon featureThe Dragon and Golden Dragon symbols serve as wilds, substituting for all symbols except the Fire Cloud and Bonus symbols. These wilds come with an initial multiplier ranging from x1 to x10, which increases by +1 whenever the Dragon moves during the Dragon feature. When a Dragon symbol is in view alongside a Fire Cloud symbol, the Dragon Feature is triggered. The Dragon symbol flies to the nearest Fire Cloud, leaving a Golden Dragon behind with its multiplier intact, creating new win opportunities.Instant Prize SymbolsA Push Gaming hallmark, these symbols act as bet multipliers, with values ranging from x1 to x1,000. Clusters of 5 or more Instant Prize Symbols trigger payouts. These symbols can appear in both the base game and free spins.Mystic Flare FeatureTriggered randomly on non-winning cascades, this feature introduces Mystic symbols onto the grid in sizes ranging from 2x2 to 4x4. These symbols then break down into 1x1 symbols, which can transform into regular symbols, Instant Prize symbols, or even bonus or Dragon symbols.Free Spins FeatureWhen 3, 4 or 5 bonus symbols land on the reels, 6, 9 or 12 free spins are awarded, respectively. Once in, the Dragon, Golden Dragon, Fire Cloud and Instant Prize symbols from the base game will remain in the same position and carry over to the free spins feature with the respective values. During the round, each empty symbol position will spin through to land either Fire Cloud, Instant Prize, Extra Spin or Blank symbols. Each Instant Prize symbol that lands will remain in its position throughout the feature. All instant prize symbol clusters are evaluated at the end of the round.Bubble FeatureDuring the free spins feature, Bubble symbols randomly appear on the grid before the first spin begins and remain in place until the next spin. These symbols are non-paying but come with assigned values of 1, 2, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, or 500. The Bubble symbol moves one grid space per spin, either vertically or diagonally. These symbols can appear individually or as stacks of up to five and interact with key game elements such as the Golden Dragon symbol, Fire Cloudsymbol, and Instant Prize symbol.When a Bubble symbol lands on the Golden Dragon symbol, it activates and adds its value to the Golden Dragon symbol's multiplier. If a Fire Cloud symbol lands beneath a Bubble symbol, the Bubble activates and transfers its value to the Fire Cloud symbol. The Golden Dragon symbol then follows the Dragon feature, transferring the Bubble's value to its multiplier. When an Instant Prize symbol lands beneath a Bubble symbol, the Bubble activates, adding its value to the Instant Prize symbol. Similarly, if a Bubble lands on an Instant Prize symbol, it activates and transfers its value to the Instant Prize symbol.Dragon Hopper slot - free spinsDragon Hopper: Slot VerdictPush Gaming has a well-established reputation for delivering vibrant, feature-packed games, and Dragon Hopper feels like a continuation of this ethos - though with a sense of déjà vu that's hard to ignore. The game borrows heavily from Push's playbook, layering classic mechanics like cascading reels and Instant Prize symbols with fresh elements such as the Dragon and Bubble features. The result is a slot that delivers pretty much what you would expect of a new Push Gaming release. Nothing more, nothing less.The Instant Prize symbol feature, a staple for Push Gaming since its debut around 2019, once again takes center stage. While it's undeniably effective at driving gameplay and engagement, its ubiquity across recent titles like Big Bamboo, Razor Returns, and Boss Bear has started to feel overly familiar. In Dragon Hopper, it's once again been integrated well, but just like the Dragon feature, with its hopping multipliers, it doesn't quite elevate the experience beyond what we've seen before.Ultimately, Dragon Hopper is a polished addition to Push Gaming's library, but it doesn't quite have the bite or originality to stand out among their more innovative offerings. For fans of the studio's formula, it's a dependable choice, but for those looking for something groundbreaking, it might feel like hopping on well-trodden ground. Solid, fun, but not unforgettable.

title: Arthur's Gold
structured_summary: Arthur’s Gold is a medieval-themed slot centered on King Arthur, his knights, and their treasure-filled adventures. The game features double premium symbols, two types of wilds, a free spins bonus with expanding wilds and respins, plus a Double Up gamble feature. The reviewer finds it a solid first release with engaging mechanics, decent volatility, and potential wins over 4,000x stake but slightly modest max payouts. Visually, it offers a classic slot feel with an old hall backdrop and animated characters, complemented by thematic audio enhancing the medieval atmosphere.
review: Arthur’s Gold: OverviewLaunched in mid-2018, Gold Coin Studios release their first slot, Arthur’s Gold, in partnership with one of the titans of the industry Microgaming. Led by an ex-IGT Vice President, this Reno-based studio brings with it plenty of experience, though details are still light. For now, let’s content ourselves with their new slot based on the old tales of Arthur, his knights, the round table, and apparently, his bags of gold.Scribes of yore must have glossed over this, but Arthur was pretty cashed up as evidenced by the mountain of coins onscreen. Most people will probably recall Arthur’s search for the Holy Grail rather than amassing a fortune, but that’s okay, coins it is. Someone at Gold Coin Studios clearly has a thing for them so let’s roll with it.The influence of land-based slots at IGT appears to have leaked into the development of Arthur’s Gold which has a slightly classic vibe to it. Booting up the slot instantly made us think of Edict’s Dragon’s Treasure. The rest of the background is taken up by an old hall which can be seen on the edges of the 5-reel, 3-row grid. The user interface is kept neatly out of the way, where stakes can be set by hitting the +/- buttons for spin costs of 20 p/c to $/€50.You never feel lonely playing Arthur’s Gold because so many characters appear on the grid. Double premium symbols amplify the effect, so instead of having one Arthur on a symbol, you can have two like a twin or a doppelganger. Along with Arthur, players spin Merlin, Guinevere, Lancelot, and Viviane as the high pays, with J-A royals as the low pays. All symbols need to land least three of a kind on one of the 20 paylines to trigger a payout.As mentioned, the high pays can appear doubled up which has a dramatic effect on the value of a win. For example, all of the high pays are worth 2.5x the stake for a line of five. However, when doubled to 10 of a kind, their values increase to 50x - 125x the stake. It is similar to the effect Just for the Win used with Tweethearts and the clone Double Lucky Line, but in Arthur’s Gold, double symbols can land in any position.The game also comes with two wilds - a standard wild and a special wild that only appears in the bonus game. Wilds not only substitute for any regular pay symbol, but 2, 3, 4, or 5 of them on a payline are worth 2x, 6x, 30x, or 500x the stake. Critically, wilds count as double symbols when they substitute for the high pay symbols.Some positive numbers are called forth from the math model to do Arthur’s handiwork starting with an RTP of 96.19%. Hit frequency is quite high, at 30.21%, or a little shy of 1 in 3, so wins do turn up on frequent basis. You’ll need them to do so since the majority of winning combinations are low value unless double symbols are involved. The math model is highly volatile and the game is capable of dealing sizeable wins when it’s on, which generally happens during the features.Arthur’s Gold: FeaturesArthur's Gold - free spins featureThe best way to get your hands on some of those coins is by triggering the Arthur’s Gold Free Spins Bonus. This occurs when 3, 4, or 5 treasure chest scatters land to award 2x, 5x, or 10x the stake plus 10 free spins. During free spins, a new special wild enters the game which may land on reels 2, 3, or 4. When it does, it expands to cover a full reel and triggers a respin.If another special wild lands on a respin, it expands and is locked for another respin. Up to 3 consecutive respins are technically possible and do not reduce the number of free spins. The final rule is Scatters appear only in the base game, so it is not possible to extend or retrigger the bonus game.Last is the Double Up feature where players can guess the result of a coin toss to double (or nothing) any base game win or the total amount won during free spins. The Double Up is available once for each win as long as the current win does not exceed $/€5,000.Arthur’s Gold: VerdictSo does Arthur’s cup runneth over to reward those he deems worthy? To an extent, it does. Expanding wilds aren’t exactly new, but they work well with the double symbols to produce larger than usual combinations for agreeable results. Thankfully, since wilds count for two high pay symbols they are convenient for not only putting together 5+ combinations, but knocking out plenty 3 or 4 symbol combos that keep the action and bankroll ticking along.Casting your eye to the immense pile of treasure onscreen leads to one question - what’s the potential in Arthur’s Gold? At over 4,000 times the stake, decent wins are possible, though not quite the hall of gold coins alluded to.All told, Arthur’s Gold is a fairly solid first release to be featured here from Gold Coin Studios. Effort has gone into most aspects of the game without the developer explicitly favouring one element over another. One possible sticking point could be the target audience not getting too exciting about the potential.Those that identify as ‘high volatility players’, as Gold Coin calls them in their sales pitch of the game, might give pause to max wins some may perceive as modest, although the volatile swings are undoubtedly there to offer both thrill and excitement.

title: Ashoka
structured_summary: Ashoka is a historically themed slot centered on Ashoka the Great and ancient Asian mysticism. It features a 6x8 grid with scatter pays, Avalanche mechanics, multiple wild types, multipliers, a bonus game, and an X-iter buy menu for bonus modes. The reviewer praises its originality and engaging gameplay but notes the low 94% RTP and high volatility as drawbacks. The game’s aesthetics include a mystical natural world setting with a rhythmic chanting soundtrack, creating an exotic and secretive atmosphere.
review: Ashoka: Slot OverviewTime for a history lesson team. Cast your minds back a few thousand years to the 3rd century BCE when a chap called Ashoka, otherwise known as Ashoka the Great, ruled a significant portion of Asia and is said to have played an important role in helping spread Buddhism back in the day. Hey, who said online gambling is all fruit and flaming sevens, huh? That brings us to Ashoka, an online slot from developer ELK Studios, a scatter-paying game incorporating several mechanical tricks into one exotic place.Exotic might not be a strong enough word to describe Ashoka. With its many armed statue, rhythmic chanting soundtrack, and secretive atmosphere, Ashoka has a sort of mystical vibe going on. Its thick, heavy natural world setting possesses echoes of some of the Gold slots, such as Voodoo Gold, Ecuador Gold, or Pacific Gold, for example. It's like one of those places people don't go to much or haven't been to in a long while, which plants have reclaimed, and the spirit of the natural world is almost tangible as if visiting the spot at a certain time on a certain day would allow communion between the noumenal world and the one that resides unseen behind the veil. Something like that.Ashoka slot - base gameFlanked by a skull and statue is Ashoka's gaming grid made up of 6 columns holding 8 positions each. On each spin, not all positions on the reels are filled with active symbols; some spaces are taken up by valueless blocker symbols. Should 8 or more matching pay symbols be in view anywhere on the grid, a win is formed, and the respective symbols are cleared from the grid. Vertically adjacent blocker symbols are removed as well. After the symbol removal, new symbols Avalanche down to fill the gaps. Highly volatile, players select a base bet of 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin and may choose to activate bonus modes from the X-iter menu. No matter how Ashoka is played, its theoretical return to player value is 94%.For symbols, Ashoka has J-A ranks displayed on stone blocks as its lows, then a blue gem, green gem, orange gem, red gem, and a white tiger as its highs. Landing an 8-matching scatter win pays 0.1 to 5 times the bet, while a 15+ matching scatter win is worth 3 to 100 times the bet. Ashoka also makes use of several kinds of wild symbols, all of which can replace any regular pay symbol. These are regular wilds, Big Wilds of up to 3x3 in size, and charged wilds. Charged wilds stay on the reels for up to three wins, and if spaces appear beneath a big wild, they are filled with 1x1-sized wilds.Ashoka: Slot FeaturesAshoka slot - free spins triggeredAs well as the wild variety and Avalanche mechanic, Ashoka also has a multiplier symbol, super multiplier symbol, Bonus Game, and the X-iter.Multiplier and Super MultiplierMultiplier symbols add their values to the win multiplier when there is a winning scatter in view. The win multiplier multiplies all wins when it is active. The multiplier symbol is removed along with winning symbols by Avalanches. The super multiplier also adds its value to the win multiplier when there is a winning scatter in view. However, the super multiplier stays on the grid, reactivating for each Avalanche. It is removed when no more wins appear.Bonus GameSkull bonus symbols may land amongst the blockers. These inactive bonus symbols become active when they are vertically adjacent to a winning symbol, and getting 3 active bonus symbols in the base game triggers 10 free drops in the bonus game. Any super multiplier symbols carry over to the bonus game and persist between free drops. Extra free drops are awarded where having 2 or 3 active bonus symbols awards +5 or +10 free drops, respectively.X-iterThe X-iter feature buy menu gives players the chance to buy various game modes. These are:Bonus Hunt – 3x the bet to buy a game round with a greater chance of triggering a bonus.Charged Wilds – 10x the bet to buy a game round where all wild symbols are charged wild symbols.Super Multiplier – 25x the bet to buy a game round with a guaranteed super multiplier symbol.Buy Bonus – 100x the bet to buy the bonus game.Super Bonus – 500x the bet to buy the bonus game with a guaranteed super multiplier.Ashoka slot - free spinsAshoka: Slot VerdictBy no means a simple game, Ashoka didn't produce the same sensation of overflowing features or rules as they sometimes do when reviewing an ELK Studios game. Often, by now, it can feel like the typing version of a 10K jog just to get everything down. Anyway, we made it to the final section, so how did Ashoka fare? For the most part pretty positively, and while we are used to seeing slots from ELK Studios boasting mind-bending numbers in terms of ways to win, i.e. the Nitropolis range with its millions and millions of ways, maybe billions, scatter paying systems are much rarer. In fact, Ashoka might well be the studio's first. Being the creative team they are, ELK Studios has avoided following in the success of other pay-anywhere slots like Sweet Bonanza or Pragmatic Play's Gates games and has done something more original with it. The result felt like a mix of the previously mentioned Kane slots, a bit of Dropz, a dash of Cluster Tumble, and plenty of its own magic.Like Cluster Tumble, one of the primary base game goals is smashing blocker symbols to enter the bonus game. Flicking on the Bonus Hunt turned out to be a highly enjoyable way to take on this quest, as drops turned into a tantalising skull chase. Pricey, though, at 3 times the regular bet. Multiplier and super multiplier symbols were not exactly plentiful, but wilds popped up every so often, so kudos to the ELK Studios math team for incorporating them into a scatter-paying slot which often isn't the way.No surprise that the super bonus round was the more exciting of the two. The persistent win multiplier and persistent super multiplier have the ability to jack the game's excitement levels. Again, pricey, though, when bought from the X-iter, perhaps. At full charge, Ashoka can produce wins of up to 25,000 times the bet. There will no doubt be things that players aren't overly fond of here; no need to bang on about the sub-95% RTP which is practically ELk Studios' MO by now, and Ashoka can be tough going. Had the RTP been upped a notch it would have been a top scorer by any standards. Having said that, Ashoka is undoubtedly another high-quality ELK Studios release that takes the scatter-paying online slot format in an exciting direction.

title: Fruity Treats
structured_summary: Fruity Treats is a fruit-themed cluster pays slot blending candy and fruit motifs in a semi-cosmic setting. It features tumbles, rising multiplier spots, free spins with persistent multipliers, and optional feature buys. The reviewer finds it a solid, if not groundbreaking, Pragmatic Play release with engaging multiplier mechanics and a 5,000x max win. Visually simple with purple/red cosmic animations, the soundtrack is described as unusual.
review: Fruity Treats: Slot OverviewIn this day and age of overconsumption, where obesity is more of a global health problem than hunger, one wonders how many people consider fruit as a treat anymore. Fruit is all good, but there is a lot of competition from the sugary snack industry, and it can sometimes feel like a chore to reach the 5-a-day goal or whatever the recommended intake of healthy food is. In the slot biz, despite the influx of candy games, fruit (arguably) still reigns supreme as the most popular food type. One developer with a foot in both food groups is Pragmatic Play, releasing both sweety-filled slots as well as fruitier ones like this one here, Fruity Treats.What's interesting is that Fruity Treats has links to less thematically healthy counterparts, such as Sugar Rush 1000, since both games make use of marked spots and rising multipliers. The studio has eased off on the set design when making Fruity Treats, though, as visually, it throws up a gaming grid backed by some simplistic purple/red stuff animated to make users feel like they are travelling somewhere semi-cosmic at speed. The soundtrack is, uh, odd? Let's leave it at that.Fruity Treats slot - base gamePlayed on a 7x7 sized grid matrix, Fruity Treats is a cluster pays slot, awarding wins when 5 matching symbols are connected to each other in horizontal or vertical directions. When betting 20 c to $/€240 per spin, the default RTP is 96.05%, and two feature buys are available. As for volatility, the studio has given the math model a high 5 out of 5 rating.After winning combinations pay, the symbols in them disappear from the reels. Remaining symbols and new symbols from above tumble down to replace them. If a new win occurs after the tumble, then the procedure activates again. A total of seven regular paying symbols land on the reels. They are heart, triangle, and circular-shaped candies, as well as cherries, lemons, oranges, and apples. A cluster containing 5 matching symbols is worth 0.2 to 1 times the bet, whereas a 15+ matching symbol cluster pays 20 to 150 times the bet. Fruity Treats does not have wild symbols in the base or bonus game.Fruity Treats: Slot FeaturesFruity Treats slot - free spinsFruity Treats comes with a set of fairly unadventurous features, let's say, but they can turn on the thrills when they come together. The features include tumbles, multiplier spots with rising values, free spins where multiplier values do not reset, plus feature buys.Multiplier Spots FeatureFour differently coloured spots are present on the reels on every spin and tumble. They sit below regular symbols and move to a new position at the beginning of every spin. When winning combinations are formed on top of a marked spot for the first time, the spot activates and gets a multiplier. Future winning combinations on top of an active marked spot are multiplied by the multiplier. If winning combinations sit above more than 1 marked spot, the applicable multipliers are added together before being used. After the tumble, the multipliers of marked spots that had wins above them increase by their initial value. The initial values for the red, purple, teal, and blue spots are x5, x10, x15, or x20, respectively. At the end of a base game spin, any multiplier values reset.Free SpinsHitting 3, 4, 5, 6, or 7+ scatters awards 10 free spins plus win of 2x, 10x, 50x, 200x, or 1,000x the bet, respectively. During free spins, activated marked spots and their multipliers do not reset for the whole duration of the round. Hitting 3 or more scatters awards +5 free spins.Buy Free SpinsThe free spins round can be bought, and there are two options. One is 100x to trigger the regular round (RTP 96.08%), the other is 200x for super free spins where the initial multiplier value of all spots is x20 (RTP 96.06%).Fruity Treats slot - free spinsFruity Treats: Slot VerdictFruity Treats is like the love child of several different slots, and players are free to guess who the dad might have been. There are shades of the Sugar Rush collection happening here, and with a bit of imagination, some of that Jammin' Jars action, too, due to the jumping about the place antics of the marked spots. On paper, this might sound a little blah, a little too repetitive or low imagination to be any good, but darn it, Pragmatic Play has managed to wave its magic slot-making wand to ensure Fruity Treats was a playable game.Okay, maybe not a classic Prag release, yet once you've seen a few marked spots grow multipliers to exciting levels, then bring them to bear on a winning combination to produce tidy results, you might see Fruity Treats' potential. As usual, Pragmatic Play offers tastes of this in the base game, though free spins, and more especially, the 200x super free spins round were where the pulse rate started to climb. Pragmatic Play has a real knack for thinking of a few clever ideas, whether they are very original ideas or not doesn't always matter, then making a compelling, if not always an amazing, game out of them. Fruity Treats is a classic example, being somewhat average in many ways yet compelling in others as well. Apologies for going over the same ground again, but the super free spins buy being a popular choice for some gamblers wasn't hard to envisage.The cherry on top of Fruity Treats is its 5,000x the bet win cap, cementing its status as a solid mid-tier-ish performer. It did smack of filler at times, but as far as filler slots go, Pragmatic Play is well equipped to release decent ones like Fruity Treats, which are worth a look, maybe two.

title: Eternal Dusk
structured_summary: Eternal Dusk is a mysterious slot set in the twilight realm between day and night, featuring a porcelain-skinned heroine in an arcane, misty world. The game offers high volatility with Wild Surges, roaming wilds, multipliers, and progressive free spins with a multiplier meter. The reviewer praises its polished, playable design and engaging wild features, though it lacks explosive potential or deep thematic storytelling. Visually, the slot is handsomely presented with a subtle, atmospheric aesthetic and non-intrusive audio.
review: Eternal Dusk: Slot OverviewNo doubt this has been said before, but eternity is a really, really long time. Whatever big number you can attempt to mentally wrap your head around, a Googolplex, Graham's number, pales in comparison to eternity. As such, being stuck in one state forever might get a teensy stale after a while. Depending on the state, of course. Such was one question posed by Swedish developer Slotmill's Eternal Dusk, a slot wedged in that time period between day and night, a 'realm of mystery', where, hopefully, some roaming, multiplying, wild action will apparate.The heroine of Eternal Dusk is a porcelain-skinned, jet-black-haired lady, who it was at first assumed possessed blood-sucking powers, though no reference to vampirism arose during the review. Never mind, mysterious she is, and she inhabits a misty, columned world of arcane delights. It might have been nice if Slotmill had elaborated on the back story more, not that doing so would have made any difference to the gameplay, and besides, leaving a big question mark lets players fill in the dark blanks as they happen to see fit.Eternal Dusk slot - base gameEternal Dusk's gaming zone is a 5x4 matrix, with 30 paylines calculating winning combinations. Mathematically, the slot is a highly volatile one, and it accepts bets of 20 c to $/€60 per base game round. A default RTP of 96.06% is generated when gambling this way, but the game also has three feature buy options: the ultra-swift Burst Mode, and an Xtra-Bet. Activating Xtra-Bet ups the bet by 50%, increasing the chance of triggering free spins by 3 times.Spiky J, Q, K, and A symbols are Eternal Dusk's low pays, awarding 3 to 4 times the bet for a 5-of-a-kind winning combination. You get more, 5x to 20x, when landing 5 matching flowers, skulls, lamps, vases, or female character symbols. Wild symbols have the same value as the lady, with the added benefit of being able to substitute any regular paying symbol.Eternal Dusk: Slot FeaturesEternal Dusk slot - free spinsWild Surges add drama to Eternal Dusk's base game before players trigger or buy its free spins feature or the super free spins round, which both benefit from Golden Roaming Wilds, multipliers, and a progressive element.Wild SurgeOn any base game spin, the Wild Surge feature may randomly trigger, adding 3 to 10 wild symbols to the grid. Wild symbols may appear with a multiplier of x2, x3, x4, x5, or x10, which applies to any win the wild is involved in.Free SpinsPlayers win 5 free spins when 3 or more scatters land in the base game. Free spins have a Golden Roaming Wild symbol that moves to a random position before each spin. During the feature, landing 3 or more scatters awards an additional +5 spins at that stage. Any wild symbol that lands in the bonus becomes a Roaming Wild, moving position but not carrying a multiplier.A Multiplier Meter tracks free spin progression through various stages. Initially triggering the feature with 3, 4, or 5 scatters starts the round's collection feature at 3, 4, or 5 collected scatter symbols, respectively. Collected scatter symbols award +5 free spins and upgraded multipliers when reaching certain stages on the meter.Stage 2 - collect 6 scatter symbols for +5 free spins with an x2 stage multiplier.Stage 3 - collect 9 scatter symbols for +5 free spins with an x4 stage multiplier.Stage 4 - collect 13 scatter symbols for +5 free spins with an x8 stage multiplier.Stage 5 - collect 17 scatter symbols for +5 free spins with an x16 stage multiplier.The Golden Roaming Wild symbol collects all regular Roaming Wilds on the reels, and for each Roaming Wild collected, the Stage Multiplier is added to the Golden Roaming Wild's multiplier. All of the Roaming Wilds are then removed, while the combined multiplier of the Golden Roaming Wilds carries over to the next stage. Landing a super scatter during free spins adds +2 free spins and awards an additional Golden Roaming Wild.Super Free SpinsSuper free spins are awarded when a super scatter symbol is part of the triggering scatters in the base game or by upgrading the free spins round. In super free spins, 2 Golden Roaming Wild symbols move positions before each spin. title: Barrel Bonanza

review: Barrel Bonanza: Slot OverviewYou could say this about any year, really, but 1981 was a rather eventful one. However, it was not all doom and gloom. Not only did Prince Charles marry Lady Diana, but in July of that year, Donkey Kong was released, which would become Nintendo's first success internationally, totally altering the video gaming landscape while introducing the world to a certain Italian plumber going by the name of Mario.Since then, the influence of Mario and Kong has been felt far and wide for decades in a wide variety of ways. This influence has filtered down to the online gambling world, too. One example is the online slot Barrel Bonanza from Hacksaw Gaming partner Backseat Gaming. It features a muscled simian who throws barrels onto a gaming grid in order to produce wilds/wild multipliers. In this tropical paradise, you won't find Mario, though; that would have been too much of a copyright assault, while a gorilla is a more generic character, one presumes. In this reconstructed nod to video game royalty, palm trees move in the breeze, Kong hangs to the side with his huge hands, and upbeat music adds to the feeling good by the sea factor.Barrel Bonanza slot - base gameFor Barrel Bonanza, Backseat Gaming has built a gaming grid out of bamboo and filled it with 5 reels, 4 rows, and 14 paylines. Other values are listed below.The pay symbols used in Barrel Bonanza are a simple set of card royals and fruit. The low pays are where the 10 to A royals come in, while the highs are cherries, watermelons, pineapples, and bananas. Hitting 5 matching card symbols pays 1-2 times the bet, or 4-10 times the bet when landing 5 matching fruit. Wilds substitute for any regular pay symbols and appear on all reels. A winning line of 5 wilds pays the same as the bananas do.Barrel Bonanza: Slot FeaturesBarrel Bonanza slot - free spins splash screenMario might not have enjoyed having barrels being thrown at him, but barrels are a boon in Barrel Bonanza since they produce wilds/wild multipliers. These wilds become sticky in the free spins bonus round, while all features are triggerable for a cost from the bonus buy.Going BananasWhen the Going Bananas feature activates, Kong throws 1 to 5 wild barrels onto random reel positions, usually revealing a multiplier when they land. There are 3 tiers of barrels – low, medium, and high. Low-tier barrels are Wild (no multiplier) to x10, medium is x5 to x50, and high is x30 to x100. If a barrel lands on a barrel already on the reels, it bounces and duplicates, so 2 barrels fly to new positions on the grid. If either of those barrels hit another barrel, the bouncing and duplicating repeats until all barrels land on a position that is not already occupied by one.Bonus GamePlayers win 10, 12, or 14 free spins when landing 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols in the base game. During the bonus game, all barrels remain sticky and reveal a new random value from their tier on each spin. The Going Bananas feature triggers more frequently during the bonus game. Scatter symbols do not appear during free spins.Bonus BuyBarrel Bonanza gives players the chance to buy features from the buy bonus section. The options are these; all are highly volatile:BonusHunt FeatureSpins – 3x the bet for a spin that is 5 times more likely to trigger the bonus game. RTP 96.36%.Kong FeatureSpins – 25x the bet for a spin that guarantees to activate Going Bananas. RTP 96.29%.Bonus Game – 100x the bet to receive 10, 12, or 14 free spins. RTP 96.26%.Barrel Bonanza slot - free spinsBarrel Bonanza: Slot VerdictBarrel Bonanza didn't feel destined to disrupt the iGaming scene the way Donkey Kong exploded over the video gaming one, but it's a positive slot on the whole. It did get a little slow in the base game in between Going Bananas features which weren't very frequent. Those in-between times were filled with dead spins, or typically low-value wins, with few to no extras padding them out. Round they go, till Kong feels the urge to start lobbing barrels into the game. Outside of BonusHunt FeatureSpins, which could get manically exciting, Barrel Bonanza was not like Donkey Kong, where barrels roll down in annoyingly high abundance, yet there are moments.These moments can really kick off when Kong throws barrels on top of other barrels, causing them to bounce and duplicate, which may then go on to bounce then duplicate some more if they land on barrels again. The process is similar to the scene in Harry Potter, when Harry and his chums break into Bellatrix Lestrange's vault at Gringotts Wizarding Bank, and the treasure starts multiplying like crazy. Those parts of Barrel Bonanza were rare but neat. If you can get a solid bounce going in the free spins round, it'd be even neater since wilds are sticky there, and we know how useful that trait can be.What's good to know is that Barrel Bonanza's max win of 10,000x the bet is not dependent on stacking the grid with sticky wilds during a free spins session. The reason why is the top prize is technically achievable in all game modes, the info page makes this clear. In conclusion, what we've got here is an enjoyable game with the potential to go bananas when our pal Kong is playing it fast and loose with the barrels.

title: Legend of Athena

review: Legend of Athena: Slot OverviewIf there is one highly sought after goddess in the slots world, it is definitely the Ancient Greek deity of wisdom and warfare Athena. So far, we've witnessed a large variation of slots taking on the theme. Now, thanks to a Red Tiger/R7 collaboration we get yet another one titled Legend of Athena. Armchair historians will be disappointed to learn that what her legend entails is not expounded on in any great detail. Three or more are needed for the low pay 10-A card symbols, while premiums pay out when at least two land. For the high pays, you'll come across objects such as horn cups, pots, harps, and helmets - all possess good value. Landing full lines of five premiums is worth 24 to 200 times your stake.Legend of Athena: Slot FeaturesLegend of Athena - free spins with x3 multiplierDon't expect a treasure of features when playing Legend of Athena, it's not that sort of game. R7 has included just two - a multiplier wild, and a triggered round of free spins, which do work quite effectively when combined.Our leading lady of the show makes her appearance on the Spear of Athena Wild. When this symbol participates in a win line, a multiplier of x3 is applied to the value of the payout.The other symbol to be aware of is the crossed swords scatter, appearing on reels 1, 3, and 5. When all 3 land on the reels, 12 free Battle Spins are the prize. Pretty easy this, during Battle Spins an x3 multiplier will be applied to all combinations. If winning lines include the Spear of Athena Wild as well, the win has both multipliers applied for a total of x9. In addition, scatters appearing anywhere during Battle spins award 3 more spins to the reaming amount.Legend of Athena: Slot VerdictThe title might allude to a legend, but we don't get much of a story here in what is a Spartan game in most regards. If you like variety or innovation, best to give Legend of Athena a pass. On the other hand, the style could very well entice players who like it straight forward. Legend of Athena is a bit like playing games of yore where the sorts of features it has were common. Sessions boil down to bashing play in the hope of landing free spins to take advantage of triple value line wins. Along the way, premiums values are quite high, augmented by those x3 wild multipliers. The basic formula has worked well enough in the past, though it's hard-pressed to make an impression when competing against vastly more complex contemporary games.That's not to say Legend of Athena is a bad game at all, due to a couple of favourable factors. The first is the Athena symbol, tripling wins on its own, then getting a boost when free spins kick in. Like the rest of the game, Spear of Athena Wilds aren’t exactly sophisticated, yet they add an extra thrill here and there. The other thing Legend of Athena has going for it is its potential. Get the triple on triple action going, where wins have been clocked as high as 6,549 times the bet. A figure high enough to possibly tip the balance in its favour for anyone unsure if Legend of Athena is a good fit.Legend of Athena isn't the most exciting game to play from a visual or innovative standpoint, but it has its moments. For old fashioned Greek god themed gaming where you're not expecting anything new to pop out, Legend of Athena could be the right choice. Then again, it’s not very memorable either, and after a session, there's little pulling you back for a second go.

title: Elemental Princess
structured_summary: Elemental Princess is an Asian-themed slot featuring four princesses, each with unique powers influencing gameplay. review: Elemental Princess: OverviewYggdrasil Gaming partner studio Dreamtech journeys to their favoured corner of the slot market – the Asian theme section. This latter method can trigger the Free Games feature from the base game, or retrigger it if it's already active.After the trigger, a selection screen chooses one of the four Princess features. Each one starts with 10 free spins and can be retriggered when 3 or more scatters land, or the Lucky Feature Retrigger occurs. Depending on which Princess feature is triggered, this is what you can look forward to:Earth Princess free spins use Spreading Wilds. Wilds become Earth Princess Wilds, which then turn any adjacent high pay symbols into Earth Princess Wilds as well.Water Princess free spins come with Held Wilds. Any Water Princess Wilds appearing are locked and remain in position for the remainder of the feature.Next are Fire Princess free spins which use a Win Multiplier. The steady win rate could be enough to keep the dopamine hits kicking along for casual gamers while they spin for the big bucks, but the main problem is the bucks just aren’t that big. Even when the princesses work their magic, the most you’ll be able to tap from the game is 1,666 times the stake - an ok number should it happen, but more realistic are wins in the range of 100-500x.Despite four different free games, including one with an increasing win multiplier, Elemental Princess is not a high potential slot. It isn’t bad looking though, and the four princesses might be doe-eyed enough to pull in players heavily into Asian culture. Following on from the point, Elemental Princess is a lot like a Japanese tea ceremony. Precise, ordered, harmonious, a bit slow. That’s great for relaxing with a cup of green chai, not the best option for hardcore gamers ready to cut loose on the reels.

title: Savanna Roar
structured_summary: Savanna Roar is an African savanna-themed slot featuring wildlife like buffalo, rhinos, leopards, and elephants.
