The game boasts vibrant urban visuals with energetic hip-hop audio enhancing its lively, street-style atmosphere.
review: Fly Cats Dream Drop: Slot OverviewIf you're wearing a cap, you best be turning it backwards for this one, folks. The reason for getting all 'with it' and 'hip' is Fly Cats Dream Drop from Relax Gaming. It's a hip-hop-themed addition to the studio's expanding range of Dream Drop jackpot slots (a non-Dream Drop version is also available), so jackpots are the name of the game around here. Oh, and cats. Yes, lotsa cats are going to be accompanying hopeful players as they spin their way through a progressive jackpot slot with a planned top prize of €10 million.With the Statue of Liberty in the background, New York City appears to be the setting for Fly Cats Dream Drop, which some have called the birthplace of hip-hop music. In fact, history.com pinpoints the time to August 11, 1973, in the Bronx at a birthday party. If you wish to dispute that assertion, please feel free, but whenever it was birthed, hip-hop has thrived in the decades since to become one of the most popular forms of music on the planet. Despite its popularity, it came relatively late to the online slot world, though it has recently gained significant traction. Fly Cats Dream Drop makes a solid case for hip-hop's use. The game's urban world setting bursts with life and attitude, even if (or because) its protagonists are of the feline variety.Fly Cats slots - base gameJust as cats have their moods, so does Fly Cats Dream Drop, which is a highly volatile online slot producing two RTP models depending on the version you take on. The Fly Cats Dream Drop version has a default return to player figure of 94%, rising to 96.17% on the non-jackpot version. Buy either of the bonus rounds, and the figure increases further, and all stats can be verified in the info section. Bet selection on both games starts at 20 p/c per spin and goes as high as $/€100.The gaming takes place on a 5-reel, 4-row grid set-up with 40 fixed paylines for the regular line wins to land across. On the less profitable side of the paytable are the four card suits, while at the upper end are four kitty characters. Landing a 5-of-a-kind win pays 1 times the bet for all of the card suits or 6 to 15 times the bet for the cat premiums. Wu-Tang-looking 'W' wild symbols land on all reels and can substitute for any pay symbols or award up to 15 times the bet for a five wild winning line.Fly Cats Dream Drop: Slot FeaturesFly Cats slot - free spins with sticky wildsWhilst the Dream Drop is no doubt the top cat around here, other features to get to grips with in Fly Cats Dream Drop are the Mystery Respins feature, free spins, and, in the non-DD version 2, feature buys.Mystery RespinsHitting a question mark Mystery symbol in the base game triggers the Mystery Respin feature. Mystery symbols become sticky while all other positions respin. Only blanks or Mystery symbols can land, and hitting new Mystery symbols locks them while awarding further respins. When the feature ends, the Mystery symbols in view all reveal the same pay symbol for a win evaluation.Free SpinsLanding 3, 4, or 5 scatters in the base game awards 6, 8, or 10 free spins, respectively. Wilds from the triggering spins are carried over to the bonus round. Wilds in free spins lock in place on the grid until the round ends. In addition, each time a bonus scatter lands, an extra free spin is awarded, plus the multiplier on each sticky wild increases by +1, up to x3.Bonus BuyWhen playing Fly Cats without the Dream Drop attached, it is possible to buy two features. These are the Sticky Wild Free Spins (RTP 96.55%) for 45 times the bet or the Mystery Respin Feature (RTP 96.5%) for 10x the bet.Dream DropOn any spin, at random, a basketball may be tossed at a basketball hoop. If the ball goes in the hoop, the Dream Drop feature activates. Once in, 15 cans of paint then appear on the screen for players to click, one at a time. Clicked paint cans reveal a jackpot, and when 3 of the same jackpot is revealed, the associated prize is awarded. Seed values for the Rapid, Midi, Maxi, Major, or Mega jackpots are €1, €5, €100, €25,000, or €500,000, respectively.Fly Cats slot - free spins with mystery symbolsFly Cats Dream Drop: Slot VerdictHip hop cats might sound weird, but Fly Cats Dream Drop does have precedence. Not too long before Fly Cats Dream Drop hit the desk, Relax Gaming had merged animals and funky tunes in an earlier game called Top Dawg$, which meant business with a high-performance sticky multiplier wild bonus round as its main event. Top Dawg$ could go ballistic in the right circumstances, with a circa 25,000x the bet win cap in place to stop it going right mental.Leaving the jackpots aside for a moment, Fly Cats Dream Drop or its non-Dream Drop counterpart will never get to those levels of mental. A much reduced 5,000x the bet win cap sees to that. The bonus round, as a whole, felt a lot tamer than Top Dawg$'s did, and while sticky wilds with multipliers are the main attraction, it doesn't mean they will land in great numbers, nor that their multipliers will be increased, or that they will even land at all. No doubt, exciting stuff is technically possible from the free spins feature, but it just didn't have the same dangerous, anything-goes atmosphere of its canine counterpart. It's as if Relax Gaming is shooting for a broader audience with Fly Cats, perhaps, one which would prefer a relatively dialled-back experience.It feels funny to say that about a jackpot slot of Dream Drop's magnitude, though, and as a vehicle for the studio's progressive network, Fly Cats Dream Drop brings something new to the table. While hip-hop slots have spiked since Nolimit City dazzled with East Coast vs West Coast, they haven't really been associated with major jackpots. Well, that gap in the market has effectively been filled by Fly Cats Dream Drop. It's not the most hair-raising, white-knuckle exciting hip-hop slot around; the previously two mentioned games outdo it for sheer joyful gaming. But, Fly Cats Dream Drop has something they don't, namely monstrous jackpot winning potential, where, if all goes well, up to the tune of €10 million. Ten million big ones would sure buy a whole lot of kitty litter.

title: Lock A Luck
structured_summary: Lock A Luck is a medium variance slot themed as a clone of NetEnt’s Twin Spin, focusing on locked reels and classic lucky symbols. Its main feature is the Locked Reels mechanic, where adjacent reels lock and synchronize to boost winning potential up to 1,333x the stake. The reviewer finds it technically comparable to Twin Spin but visually and aesthetically inferior, recommending the original over this version. review: Lock A Luck (All41Studios/Microgaming): OverviewRemember the Le Kaffee Bar slot? If you do, it's probably for the wrong reasons. The reality is, Le Kaffee Bar wasn't a very good slot. Those with less developed taste buds might have accepted its weak aroma, but we just couldn't get past it. The studio responsible for this roastfest is called All41Studios an ally of Microgaming. To be fair, they did better with their second slot, Magic of Sahara, although we decided to skip it due to its generic gameplay.Lock A Luck is their third release and could be their worst or best, depending on how you look at it. Veteran gamers have probably already figured out what it's all about so we might as well say it right away. It's pretty much a clone of NetEnt's Twin Spin slot. There's really no other way to put it. Locked reels per se is not a NetEnt invention, but the overall look and feel of this game just makes it come across as a Chinese knockoff. In any case, Lock A Luck is a medium variance slot that is built using 5 reels, 3 rows and 243 ways to win. Just like Twin Spin, there are no free spins to trigger so it all comes down to locking those reels to land as many matching symbols as possible in one spin. Playable from 0.20 to €/$60 per spin, you can play it across all devices.Visually, Lock A Luck is extremely basic and lacks the refined look and sophistication of Twin Spin. This is what you expect pirated software to look like at some rogue Curacao casino. We don't enjoy pointing it out and we hate to be mean, but it has to be said. The music too has got the same type of funky lounge beat going on. They did at least bother to change some of the symbols, albeit not the top ones. In order of value are the 9 to A royals, followed by charries, clovers, horseshoes, lucky sevens, and diamonds. The latter is, of course, the most rewarding, giving you 50 times your stake for a five of a kind combination.Lock A Luck (All41Studios/Microgaming): FeaturesFree spins feature with locked reels in actionIn terms of extras, there isn't a whole lot to it. In fact, it's all about one single feature - the Locked Reels feature. It's in play for every spin with two random adjacent reels locking in synchronization and displaying the same symbols.Locked reels can expand and lock additional adjacent reels which is the key to winning big. In fact, you can lock all five of them which can lead to a total payout of 1,333 times your stake (you can't land a full screen of diamonds). And that, ladies and gentlemen, sums it all up.Lock A Luck (All41Studios/Microgaming): VerdictThere really isn't a whole lot to say about Lock A Luck. NetEnt for sure is going to be uncomfortable seeing this, but there's probably not a whole lot they can do about it given the fact that it's built using a unique mathematical model and is carefully navigated its way around any infringement issues. But then again, we're no experts when it comes to that sort of stuff.So is Lock A Luck worth playing then? Actually it is. If you enjoyed Twin Spin, chances are you will like this one too. Sure, it looks a bit bland and all, but technically it's not worse (or better) than Twin Spin. The best thing you can do is simply to give it a try and decide for yourself. If you ask us, however, we'll stick to the original as it so much better looking and significantly more appealing in every way possible. But then again, maybe we're just being shallow.

title: Age of Beasts Infinity Reels
structured_summary: Age of Beasts Infinity Reels immerses players in a mythological fantasy world featuring creatures like Centaurs and Griffins. The game offers Infinity Reels with increasing multipliers, a Wheel feature, free spins, jackpots, and an 888x Infinity Reels Bonus. The reviewer finds it enjoyable with solid build quality but notes it lacks originality and has a moderate max win of 3,953x the bet. The aesthetics combine dramatic, oil painting-style backgrounds with a suitably epic soundtrack, balancing bleak landscapes and powerful beasts.
review: Age of Beasts Infinity Reels: Slot OverviewIf they're not touring the cosmos in Hypernova slots, Australian developer Reelplay has a tendency to explore the possibilities afforded by mythological themes. Another example of the studio's interest in the fantasy side of life is Age of Beasts Infinity Reels. In this game, players spin amongst a bunch of imposing creatures, while features such as free spins, a Bonus Wheel, jackpots, and an Infinity Reels Bonus are on hand to bestow modest rewards on lucky adventurers.The first thoughts of Age of Beasts were, 'Oh, it's like Thor Infinity Reels', what with the four prizes listed to the left and the oil painting-like quality of the background image. Age of Beasts' scenery isn't as bleak as Thor's was, though. In Thor, it felt like we'd just arrived at the aftermath of Ragnarök, the ground littered with the detritus of an epic battle. Age of Beasts, by contrast, is like one of those landscape paintings where the artist has tried to capture the sublime side of nature. Age of Beasts' windswept crags inspired a feeling of lonely despair over the immensity of nature and our place in it, a bit like Caspar Friedrich's 'Wanderer Above Sea Fog'. Something along those lines, at least. Once the premium symbols start hitting, however, players' solitude is ruptured by all manner of beasts.Oh wait, this is an online slot review, not art appreciation hour, and so, Age of Beasts Infinity Reels is a game that may be played on any device, sporting a bet range of 25 p/c to $/€50. It's a highly volatile game which can be pretty neat when you're on the winning side of a long reel addition sequence. At the start of each spin, the grid is made up of 3 reels holding 4 symbols each. When a win occurs involving all 3 reels, a new reel is added to the right side of the game area. If this reel improves the win, another reel is added, and on it goes until the new reel contributes nothing to the win. This system adds up to a hit frequency of 29.94%, while the overall theoretical return value is 95.57%.In addition, whenever a new reel is added, a win multiplier increases by +1, which gets applied to the winning combinations at the end of a spin. As to symbols, the payable includes orange gems, blue gems, then red, green, purple, and orange vials. Higher value symbols are beasts such as Centaurs, Hydras, Minotaurs, and Griffins. Wild symbols help complete wins by substituting any normal pay symbol and also trigger the Infinity Reels mechanic when they land in the rightmost reel.Age of Beasts Infinity Reels: Slot FeaturesAlong with added reels and symbol multipliers, Age of Beasts has an Infinity Reels bonus, a Wheel feature, plus free spins.Infinity Reels BonusSimple one this one. If you manage to add 13 new reels to the grid on a single spin, an extra prize worth 888x the stake is awarded. The Infinity Reel bonus can be won in the base game or in free spins.Wheel FeatureLanding a win made up of special chest symbols in the base game awards 8 free spins with a starting win multiplier increment of 1. However, before free spins begin, players take part in the Wheel feature. This is a five-tier prize wheel covered in instant wins of 2x to 15x the bet, extra spins, or increased win multiplier increments. Landing on a cash prize or jackpot awards the coins and starts the free spins feature. Landing on the other segments awards the respective prize then moves the wheel up a tier. Make it all the way to the final tier to win one of the 4 jackpots – Mini, Minor, Major, or Grand, worth 10x, 25x, 100x, or 1,000x the bet.Free SpinsPlayers enter this bonus round with whatever free spins and symbol increment value was won from the wheel. It means the win multiplier increases by the applicable increment value whenever a new reel is added. Any chest symbol win during the feature extends the round by awarding +4 extra free spins.Age of Beasts Infinity Reels: Slot VerdictDue to the build quality, any player who enjoys the Infinity Reels mechanic should find Age of Beasts fairly enjoyable. There's a solid mythological look and feel going on, backed by a suitably dramatic soundtrack. Reelplay can paint pretty pictures when they put their mind to it, and Age of Beasts nudges itself into this category. The background is a bit bleak on its own, but the quartet of beasts muscling their way onto the reels provide an ideal counterbalance. The theme treatment adds up to being more than satisfactory for players up for a dab of fantasy.The gameplay is classic Infinity Reels, so that should let you know if Age of Beasts will thrill or not. There's nothing overly original going on, though the Wheel feature tries to add something new. And fair dues, the wheel process can be pretty exciting if you move through tiers increasing free spins, improving the symbol multiplier increment, or just collecting a side win before the bonus round kicks off. However you cut it, Age of Beasts Infinity Reels is not a massively paying slot, with a max win of 3,953x the bet. When you consider the jackpots, Infinity Reels bonus, and the fact that an infinite number of additional reels can supposedly be added, you might think the win figure would be higher. Raising it might have attracted more attention from the hardcore gamer community, but there you go.Aside from a couple of statistical niggles surrounding potential and possibly RTP, Age of Beasts Infinity Reels produces few major gripes. In fact, the theme has been presented well, features can fire at times, and the wins are okay. For something sort of similar yet gruntier, Odin Infinity Reels remains the daddy with its raging math model and Megaways incorporation. However, Age of Beasts Infinity Reels might be a better fit for players who want a fantasy slot but would rather hang around the middle ground in the company of a few beasts rather than be pummelled by the Allfather.

title: Lady Earth
structured_summary:
1. Lady Earth is a calm, space-themed slot featuring a mystical mother nature figure guiding players through a cosmic setting.  
2. The game includes the Respin Insanity feature, triggering respins on winning symbols, and a multi-level Picking Game bonus with multipliers and tokens.  
3. The reviewer finds the game a missed opportunity due to frequent blocking passive symbols and low win potential capped at 450x stake.  
4. Visually, Lady Earth boasts original elemental symbols and a dark blue universe backdrop, complemented by a relaxing, new age atmosphere.
review: Lady Earth Slot: OverviewOne of the burdens of having the word 'crazy' in your name is that people develop certain expectations. For the most part, Microgaming partners Crazy Tooth Studios usually live up to the moniker by turning out some rather wackily original titles. They can be a bit hit and miss though, with some games working out better than others. In the case of Lady Earth, they tone down the zaniness and comes across quite calm, relaxing even – at first. Set in space, the game drifts peacefully through the cosmos, with a mother nature figure at the helm. You can't always depend on first impressions to give you the complete picture. So will players remain relaxed by the end of the journey, or will the ambitiously named Respins Insanity feature launch them into orbit?Laying the scene is a semi-transparent game grid made up of 5 reels, 5 rows, and 51 paylines. Surrounding the grid we get a dark blue universe with a mystical lady watching proceedings. She has an expression not un-like the Mona Lisa's where it’s hard to tell if she is smiling with us or at us. Time will tell. For now, let's ante up - Lady Earth offers a wide array of bets starting at 20 p/c up to $/€300 per spin. RTP, meanwhile, is highly generous at 96.80% which is unusual to see these days. Coupled with a medium volatile math model it makes for some good value gameplay. The game's hit rate, however, is on the lower end at 13.68%, but because respins trigger on every win you can understand why it might be low.The symbols used throughout the game are all original and have an elemental, new age, runic feel to them. Starting things off are 4 low pays styled in stone – a lizard, a fish, a scorpion, and a rabbit. The high pays add a dash more colour and look like a purple mountain, green plant life, red fire, and a blue water symbol. The last two on the list are worth the most at 2.75 times the stake for five of a kind. All pay symbol values are low, due to the way features modify wins. There are no wilds, but there is a passive symbol which is a placeholder tile that has no value, or any special properties other than preventing wins.Lady Earth Slot: FeaturesLady Earth comes with two additional features, the Respin Insanity and Lady Earth Bonus. The Respin Insanity feature is triggered on any winning spin. When activated, all positions that contain the winning symbol are respun. If the respin lands and matches any new symbol outside the zone, those symbols are absorbed into the respin area, and another respin is triggered. This feature continues until no new symbols outside the zone can be added.The second feature is the Lady Earth Bonus which is triggered when 3 scatter symbols land. When that happens the action shifts away from spinning reels to a 5 round Picking Game. Players choose manually, or automatically, from 9 options on a 3x3 grid. Each choice reveals either credits, skulls, x2 multipliers, or tokens. Credits are added to the bonus game total, and x2 multipliers double the current level win.Tokens are saved, and when 4 are collected players move to the next level of the bonus game. Before starting the next level, a multiplier of x2, x3, or x4 is applied to the level win. The Lady Earth Bonus ends when 3 skulls are revealed, or players make it to the end of the fifth level.Lady Earth Slot: VerdictLady Earth feels like somewhat of a missed opportunity for Crazy Tooth Studio. The graphics are good, the symbols are original, as are some aspects of the features. Lady Earth has a nice vibe in the beginning but goodwill starts to fade after a few spins and is obliterated after perusing the game's stats.First under the microscope is the Respin Insanity feature which promises more than it delivers. The game might hype the feature as a chance to 'grow your win to galactic proportions!' But, that pesky passive symbol pops up too often to destroy your chances. Occasionally, you can find yourself on an okay roll of respins if there aren't too many passive symbols on screen. But most of the time, they’re just there, blocking combinations, and retarding the ability of the Respins Insanity from really cutting loose.Moreover, they seem to be strategically placed to completely impede the action (and wins) from happening or put a damper on the party just when things start kicking off like a couple of killjoy parentals. The bonus picking game suffers a similar fate thanks to that annoying skull. Okay sure, these bonus games can't run forever, they need limitations. It's just that when you have irritating symbols in both the main and base game, their annoyances are amplified and become more apparent.The final nail in the coffin for most players is the game’s potential. Crazy Tooth Studio has clocked max wins in the region of just 450 times your stake. That figure is bad enough on its own, but when you discover that it was generated after running 10 billion simulated spins the result is extra un-inspiring. What might save Lady Earth for certain casual players is the low key math model, a rather high RTP rating and a nice game world, perhaps, at a stretch. For those looking for something that will give them a bit extra play time, or those being smart and looking to complete wagering, Lady Earth might be a decent alternative.It’s too bad because the overall concept isn’t awful and the features could have been more successful if Crazy Tooth hadn't jammed the hand brake on them so hard. Ah well, when you add up the pointless passive symbols with the low potential, it is very hard to think of a reason to play Lady Earth.

title: Joker Troupe
structured_summary: Joker Troupe is a vibrant slot blending classic fruit themes with modern gameplay and jokers. It features three unique Joker-triggered bonuses, including respins, a multipliers wheel, and a timed Hypermode™ free spins round. The reviewer praises its rewarding complexity, frequent bonuses, and a max payout of 25,000x stake. Visually bright with a modern fruit slot look, it pairs perfectly with a house/trance soundtrack that enhances the immersive experience.
review: Joker Troupe (Push Gaming): OverviewJoker Troupe is a bright and colourful fusion of classic looks and modern gameplay from the creative team at Push Gaming. Famous for mixing elements of the old and new, their latest is a deviously simple looking slot that hides a complex blend of features and high payouts. It is tough to convey everything that Joker Troupe has to offer, but it is well worth diving in deep. Let’s do it.At first glance, Joker Troupe appears pretty straight forward with just 4 reels and 3 rows - but looks can be deceiving. The background glistens nicely, and the overall visual effect is of a modern fruit slot with jokers. Then, the audio kicks in and you are instantly taken somewhere. Where? How about an early morning set at Café del Mar as the sun rises? Perhaps that is overdoing it, but it is a sweet soundtrack, and one that tees up a solid gaming session nicely.Bonus Wheel FeatureDuring the base game 10 paylines come into play, though this expands during one of the extra features. Players of all types will find a bet that suits their bankroll from 20 c/p up to $/€200 per spin. Push Gaming have programmed Joker Troupe with a generous RTP of 96.68% and a volatility level that appears to be slightly more gentle compared to some of the other recent releases, and which allows for nicely timed feature drops and satisfying payouts.A trip to the paytable reveals just 6 base game symbols which are unique but retain a touch of their fruit slot origins. Moving up from the lower end we get a couple of red and blue orbs, star fruit, dragon fruit, and some dice. The bright red and gold infinity symbol is the most valuable base game symbol worth 100 times the stake for four of a kind. Already, Joker Troupe is looking good with these symbol returns, but pour on the features, and the game gets absolutely bonkers.Joker Troupe (Push Gaming): FeaturesYou know those reviews where they say that the slot in question is jam-packed with features that need to be seen first-hand to comprehend? Well, buckle in because it's going to be one of those rides. It all revolves around the troupe of jokers that give the slot its name. There are three of them - Green, Blue, and Red which all possess their own unique feature and which will come into play when you land 3 of the respective joker scatters on reels 2, 3, and 4.The Blue Joker feature starts with 3 respins that contain Blue Hats and Red Joker symbols. Three might not sound like much, but they can be reset again and again to extend the round. The goal of this bonus game is to land as many hats as possible, and three of them, or three Red Joker symbols add another reel to the grid and increase the multiplier. The multiplier starts at x1, and can go as high as x25. When the respins come to an end, the blue hats on the reels reveal values that have the multiplier applied to them and paid out. At the end of the feature the grid returns to its standard 4x3 size. If however, the feature ends with three Red Joker symbols on the reels, then the Red Joker Free Spins are launched (more on that later).The Green Joker Wheel is triggered when three Green Joker Symbols land. The wheel is split into 14 segments - 2 booster wedges and 12 number wedges. If the wheel stops on a number wedge, the player is awarded that number multiplied by their stake, and the wedge goes dark. If the wheel stops on a darkened wedge, the game comes to an end. If the wheel lands on a Booster wedge, players earn a x2 multiplier, or a 5x multiplier, or a ticket to the Red Joker Free Spins feature. The great thing is that multipliers are not added but multiplied together. So, for example, if it is currently on x4 and a x5 lands the total comes to x20 rather than x9.Some people like to slow down at the end of a ride, others want to inject the nitrous oxide. Joker Troupe goes for the latter option by arming the Red Joker Free Spins feature with Hypermode™ spins. This bonus game starts with a timer and 20 seconds on the clock. Reels spin at a blistering speed, and the goal is to land as many combos as possible. Any Red Joker symbols that land fill a meter and award 10 more seconds when it is full. With each reset, the speed is cranked up further, and more infinity symbols are added to the reels. The clock is able to reset endlessly.Joker Troupe (Push Gaming): VerdictApologies if your head is spinning right now. It's a lot to take in and best seen in the flesh to fully absorb everything. title: Wild Yield
structured_summary: Wild Yield is a farm-themed slot that explores the challenges and rewards of agriculture. It features cascades, Weather symbols that turn reels wild, free spins, and a risky Extra Free Spin buy option. The reviewer finds it thrilling with high volatility and potential for big wins, praising its depth and excitement. Visually, it boasts rich, vibrant farm scenery with a playful scarecrow and a lively banjo soundtrack.
review: Wild Yield: Slot OverviewWell golly gee folks, software provider Relax Gaming's taking us on a trip to the countryside to see where food comes from. Sometimes it's easy to forget that produce doesn't just appear on supermarket shelves, but much of it is actually grown in the earth. Add seeds, a sprinkling of water and some sunshine, and in time, you've got a bountiful harvest. Or not, if the elements aren't playing ball and drought or flood or natural disaster spoils the crops. This is precisely what is covered in Wild Yield, an online slot exploring the highs and lows of supplying food in an attempt to turn a profit from the effort.Farm slots are a growing games category, not overly numerous, though there are some solid options to choose from if getting back to basics is on the cards. Of them, Wild Yield is a particularly handsome example, with a deep richness to the visuals that make them simply pop from the screen. There's a playful exuberance about the way the hills and mountains have been drawn while making way for some classic agricultural imagery – a red barn, a lazily turning windmill, and rows of crops. Wild Yield also sneaks a scarecrow in there too, who sleeps while the reels are idle, watches when the reels are spinning and celebrates the exciting moments. A wicked banjo track provides the finishing touches on a lushly inviting farm scene.Wild Yield slot - base gameMake no mistake, Wild Yield might look like the sort of place where food conveniently grows itself before leaping into trucks destined for the market, but it is a no-nonsense, straight-up gambling tool. We'll get into exactly why shortly. First, let's get our hands dirty with some of the nitty-gritty details, such as the fact Wild Yield operates a highly volatile math model with a theoretical return to player of 96.12%. Any device may be used to play Wild Yield which offers bet levels of 10 p/c to $/€20 per spin.The gaming occurs on a 5-reel, 5-column panel with 259 connected ways to win. To win, matching symbols must land left to right from the first reel and be connecting either vertically, horizontally, or diagonally. Wooden J-A royals make up the low pays, worth 1x the bet for five of a kind, while the high pays are aubergines, lettuces, tomatoes, and pumpkins, awarding 1.5 to 3 times the stake for five-of-a-kind. With a name like Wild Yield, it's no surprise that wild symbols play a prominent role. Their key function is to substitute for any pay symbols. They are worth 3x the bet for a five wild win and are used extensively in the features.Wild Yield: Slot FeaturesWild Yield slot - free spins with Lightning symbol in viewWild Yield mixes things up with features such as a cascade mechanic, Weather symbols, free spins, an Extra Free Spin buy option, and a feature buy where available.CascadesAll winning symbols, weather symbols or bonus symbols in view are destroyed and removed from the grid. Wild symbols with a counter on them do not, but the counter decreases by -1. Symbols fall into the gaps, and new wins may be created. This process continues until there are no more symbols in view that can be removed.Weather SymbolsWild symbols may appear in greater numbers when Weather symbols hit. They come in several types called Tornado, Rain, Lightning, Earthquake, Frost, and Fire (Fire appears only in free spins). Now, each Weather symbol awards one or two patterns from its group when it hits, transforming symbols in the pattern on the grid into wilds. If a Weather symbol transforms a symbol which is already wild, the wild gets a counter which increases by +1 each time this happens. The counter acts as a multiplier for any connected ways wins passing through it, as well as indicating how many times it can be used before it is removed.Wild Yield slot - free spins with Fire feature activatedFree SpinsCollecting 3 scatter symbols on a single base game spin awards 6 free spins. Should extra scatter symbols appear on the spin, they each award +1 free spin. During free spins, any positions that are transformed into wild symbols are marked on a side board next to the reels. The first Weather symbol to land on a free spin activates all marked positions on the board, transforming the corresponding positions on the reels into wilds. Positions on the board which are marked more than once get multipliers. Landing a bonus symbol adds +1 free spin.Extra Free SpinWhen the bonus round ends, if less than 10 Weather symbols landed, players may buy 1 extra free spin for the indicated price. The marked side board carries over to the extra spin if bought, and if symbols are transformed to wilds on this spin, their positions are marked on the sideboard. Players can choose to keep buying extra free spins until 10 Weather symbols in total have landed. The RTP for this feature is increased to 96.5%. For players in a buying mood, they are also able to buy free spins for the cost of 90x the regular bet. The RTP for buying free spins is also 96.5%.Wild Yield slot - extra free spins optionWild Yield: Slot VerdictIf Wild Yield is anything to go by, farming might look like a bunch of belly laughs, but it can be extraordinarily tough going as well - or rewarding when everything's playing ball. The good thing is players have some measure of control over what can be an insanely bumpy ride. Playing naturally, letting the elements do their thing is arguably the 'safest' way of experiencing Wild Yield's brand of farm-grown entertainment. On the other hand, playing that way might not be the most efficient way of squeezing out everything Wild Yield has to offer. It's an extremely thrilling feature, one must admit, as the stakes increase along with the risk for each buy the player heads into.What makes it so is having a stack of marked positions on the side board can be a real temptation to hit the buy button for another go. However, you need to land a Weather symbol on the extra spin to activate all of those symbols to wild transformations, and that's not guaranteed to happen. It was by no means uncommon to shell out hundreds of times the stake for an extra spin, which pulled in a 1x the bet win, or even less. Adding to the temptation is the fact Wild Yield comes with winning potential of 50,000 times the stake, and since Relax Gaming slots have a reputation for pulverising their win caps, there's a chance Wild Yield will eventually as well. And that is one of the beauties of Relax Gaming, there is no need for anyone to guess whether the advertised max potential is actually achievable or not.In Wild Yield, players have plenty of space to tackle this expertly designed game as they see fit. From letting things unfold organically to pushing luck to its limit via buying free spins and/or hammering away at the Extra Free Spin button. It might pay to keep in mind Wild Yield might look about as innocuous as a smiling scarecrow in a field of crops can get, but beneath the surface, this thing doesn't mess around. It's got the goods to deliver, though, not to mention tremendous potential, so talk about rolling the dice, responsibly, of course.

title: Pub Kings
structured_summary: Pub Kings is a Viking-themed slot celebrating the convivial pub life of fierce warriors. It features a 5x4 grid, 20 paylines, Random Awards with scatter-triggered prizes, and a free spins round focused on collecting and leveling up high-pay symbols. The reviewer finds it a fun, fast-paced game with clever features and engaging tension, though not overly complex. The game boasts bright, cheerful visuals and a warm atmosphere reminiscent of enjoying a favorite drink on a sunny day.
review: Pub Kings: Slot OverviewWould becoming crowned king of a pub be something of a dubious honour? Presumably, it requires consuming a potentially unhealthy amount of alcohol, or barroom brawling to the top of the ladder, or something along those lines. In Pub Kings from developer Pragmatic Play it could very well allude to both of those things and more. You see, Pub Kings is a Viking-themed slot which celebrates what Vikings (some of them, at least) probably did when they weren't sailing across the sea to ransack villages or grab priceless artefacts from the clergy. That is, hoisting a few cold ones at the pub after a hard day of being some of the most feared warriors of the Middle Ages.Pub Kings is no historical documentary, though. Instead, it's a brightly lit game depicting an exceedingly pleasant part of Viking territory on an exceptionally nice day. The sun's out, the skies are mainly clear, and a sturdy stone-built Viking Pub rests invitingly on top of a windswept crag. If you were already thirsty, then Pub Kings' load screen, where a progress bar fills with bubbly amber fluid, might just tip you over the edge. Basically, a warm, feel-good vibe settled in like enjoying a favourite tipple on the weekend with friends when Pub Kings hit the screen. All in all, Pragmatic Play has designed one of the higher-spirited games we've reviewed for them in a while.Pub Kings slot - base gamePrising open Pub Kings like a stubborn bottle cap, we come to its inner workings. Here you'll find a highly volatile math model running the show, generating 96.08% return to player, or 96.05%, when buying free spins. Lower RTP models are available too, as typically is the case with Pragmatic. Bet selection varies from 20 p/c to $/€240 per spin, and if buying the bonus round, the cost is 100 times the stake.Pub Kings is played on a 5x4 grid with 20 paylines. Wins pay from left to right and must start on the leftmost grid to do so. Ten pay symbols appear on the reels – 5 are lower value card ranks (10-A), and 5 are Viking character symbols as the high pays. Hitting a 5-symbol winning line gets you 5 to 15 times the bet when made up of royals or 25 to 150 times the bet when made up of picture symbols. Pub Kings does not have a wild symbol, but it does have a scatter, appearing on reels 1, 3, and 5.Pub Kings: Slot FeaturesPub Kings slot - free spinsThe scatter is not only needed to trigger free spins, but it is also used as part of the Random Awards feature. When exactly 2 scatters land on the reels, a random award from levels 1 to 5 may be won. The paytable says whenever 2 scatters hit, but in the demo, it was random rather than guaranteed to occur. When it does activate, the 2 scatters will pick a reel, and each reel has a different list of possible rewards:Reel 1 – Level 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, or 7 awards 10x, 25x, 125x, 250x, 600x, 1,000x, or 5,000x the bet, respectively.Reel 2 – Level 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, or 7 awards 6x, 15x, 45x, 200x, 400x, 800x, or 2,5000x the bet, respectively.Reel 3 – Level 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, or 7 awards 4x, 10x, 30x, 150x, 300x, 600x, or 1,500x the bet, respectively.Reel 4 – Level 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, or 7 awards 3x, 8x, 25x, 60x, 150x, 300x, or 750x the bet, respectively.Reel 5 – Level 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, or 7 awards 2x, 6x, 20x, 50x, 125x, 250x, or 500x the bet, respectively.Free SpinsWhen 3 scatters hit, players are awarded 10 free spins. During free spins, each of the 5 high pay symbols is associated with a reel. After each free spin, all instances of the high-pay symbols are collected on their associated reel. Collecting 6 of the same symbol enables Level 1 on the respective reel, and collecting 3 more of the same symbol from then on increases the Level up to 7.At the end of the round, the symbol that has the most collected beers pays out the award it has accrued during the round. If there is a tie, the highest value is awarded. Free spins cannot be retriggered.Pub Kings slot - free spinsPub Kings: Slot VerdictPragmatic Play has a reputation for firing off slots at a frightening rate of knots. Seriously, it sometimes feels like every other game we cross paths with comes from the Pragmatic Play production line. It could be tempting to say the studio is sacrificing quality for quantity, but the two traits aren't necessarily mutually exclusive. Pub Kings proves the point. While it's not exactly a hugely complex game full of Gordian Knots that have to be prised open to grasp what's going on, Pub Kings nevertheless supplies a set of clever features in both phases of play, giving the game pace as well as the ability to create a bit of nail-biting tension.Nail-biting tension is more likely to occur in free spins, yet solid prizes in the base game from the Random Awards feature mean that when 2 scatters hit, should they activate, the process of selecting a reel and revealing a prize award might be quite exciting. But it's in free spins where Pub Kings transforms into a real collector's paradise. There's a dual race going on here, between collecting as many high-pay symbols as possible to level up while scooping beers to see which reel will be the overall winner. You just never know who will win till the final spin. Until then, free spins can be a real back-and-forward tussle as characters level up and their rewards increase as the game pours its way towards a win cap of 5,000x the bet.Whilst Pub Kings might lack the firepower and sophistication to make it a slot of vital importance, it was a fun game to test drive. There's definite entertainment value to be had here for the right player in what was a joyous celebration of collection mechanics, Vikings, and sparkling amber liquid.

title: Beach Invaders
structured_summary: Beach Invaders is a beach-themed slot where aliens party by the sea instead of invading Earth. The game features expanding and shifting wilds, a locked wild progress bar, and free spins with increasing multipliers. The reviewer finds it charming and engaging but not as feature-rich or high-potential as some NetEnt classics. The aesthetics include a vibrant seaside setting with upbeat, tropical audio enhancing the relaxing beach vibe.
review: ﻿Beach Invaders: Slot OverviewYou've likely heard of Space Invaders (there is an online slot as well), a video game first released back in 1978 where players shoot rows of space invaders as they move ever closer towards the bottom of the screen, to Earth presumably. But have you heard of aliens invading the seaside? Well, you have now, thanks to veteran provider NetEnt and its online slot Beach Invaders. Beach Invaders is an upbeat game where instead of blasting alien spacecraft as they seek to invade the planet, the call to action around here is 'Let's party, earthling.'The aliens haven't picked a bad spot to do a bit of partying in either. They've set up at a thatch-roofed bar by a lovely turquoise sea, all golden sands, and warm blue skies. On the home screen, a seagull holds what looks to be a three-cupped bikini in its beak, could be wrong, bringing back memories of one of the 'mutant' scenes in the Arnie film Total Recall, 'Baby, you make me wish I had three hands.' Hey, we didn't say, though we will say the aliens have picked a nice beach to invade, and if they're keen on sharing the spot, we're all for it at this stage. A chilling by a pool sipping Singapore Slings Dick Dale-esque tune helps set the scene, too.Beach Invaders slot - base gamePick a bet time, and in Beach Invaders, the options vary from 10 p/c up to $/€10 per spin. Not a huge range for a NetEnt slot, but a sizable max win is apparently one of the positive results of the constrained upper betting limit. Choose wisely, too, because Beach Invaders has a Progress bar which is locked at each bet. Noted as highly volatile, despite not feeling particularly so on an anecdotal level, players can expect a theoretical return of 96.17%, though no feature buys or ante bets this time around.Green alien-ish 10 to A card ranks makeup Beach Invaders' low pay symbols, while its high pays are 4 alien-ish looking cocktails of varying degrees of humorous grossness. Along Beach Invaders' 5x4 gaming grid, run 30 paylines, awarding wins when landing matching symbols left to right from the leftmost side. Hit a complete 5-of-a-kind winning line, and you'll collect 1.5 to 10 times the bet for the low pays or 20 to 50 times the bet for the highs. Since wilds land on all reels, they can create wins of themselves worth up to 100x the bet for 5 OAK, or wilds may be used to replace any regular pay symbol.Beach Invaders: Slot FeaturesBeach Invaders slot - free spinsWild symbols are actually one of Beach Invaders' main events, and there are a couple of handy things they can do in the base game and in free spins, such as expand, shift, and multiply.Expanding WildWhenever a wild symbol lands on the reels, it expands to cover all positions on its reel. As mentioned, wilds may hit on any of the five reels.Locked Wild Progress BarA progress bar sits next to the reels with 4 milestones on it. Each milestone represents the number of spins wilds will lock on to the reels for when they land and expand. When ice cube patches appear on regular pay symbols, the ice cubes are collected to help fill the progress bar. Fill the whole bar, and on the next spin, at least 1 expanded wild is guaranteed to land and will be locked for 4 spins. The progress bar resets after this happens.Free SpinsLanding 3 scatter symbols in view triggers 10 free spins where Shifting Wilds with Increasing Multipliers are a possibility. In free spins, Expanded Wilds shift to the reel on the left and one position up or down at random on each next spin, scaling down its height by one position size. When a wild reaches 1x1, it disappears on the next spin. After the first shift, an Increasing Multiplier is activated, which grows by +1 on each next shift. If a new wild lands on top of a shifting wild, it inherits the multiplier when it expands. When more than one multiplier is included in a win, the highest value will be applied.Beach Invaders slot - free spinsBeach Invaders: Slot VerdictWith the intense heat wave incinerating parts of Europe at the time of writing, it's no major surprise to see even aliens have headed to the beach to cool off. They seem like a pretty chill group to hang out with, too, giving Beach Invaders a charming, come kick your shoes off and dip your toes in the sand vibe. Extraterrestrials are a topic fairly dear to NetEnt's heart, too, if you recall games like Space Wars and the more experimental feature-rich slot Space Wars 2 Powerpoints (no, not Microsoft PowerPoint), though the off-world life forms this time seem more benevolent. There's no talk of war, at least.Beach Invaders might not be as overflowing with features as Space Wars 2, but there are positive things here to consider. Expanding Wilds are generally a good thing, despite the way they seemed to favour the right side of the gaming grid at times. What's handy is the progress bar does not reset until it has been filled, meaning you can land a number of Expanding Wilds while the bar is on 2 or 3, get that number of spins with sticky Expanded Wilds, and the bar will still not reset. This helps keep the base game ticking over, upping the engagement levels and all if/when free spins finally roll around. So, you've got an Expanded Wild shifting about the please; the next best thing is to whack a rising multiplier on there, which is what Beach Invaders has done. It might be a shame that wilds eventually shrink out of existence, and it's a bit hard to imagine this slot having higher potential than 500x at times, even though it boasts potential as high as 10,500 times the bet.Imagine lying down at the pool at a resort. One of the staff members comes over to ask what sort of drink you'd like, and after perusing the menu realise your favourite mocktail isn't there, so you have to settle for something good, but not the one you really really wanted. Beach Invaders is a bit like that. The game didn't feel destined to become a NetEnt classic, yet it's not bad, and after all the remakes and whatnot the studio's been up to of late, it was kinda fresh.

title: Raiders of Fortune
structured_summary: Raiders of Fortune is an adventure-themed slot inspired by Indiana Jones, set in a forest with temple backdrops. The game features a 6x4 grid with cascading wins and a Trailways Trail that awards wilds, multipliers, free spins, and grid expansions as players progress. The reviewer finds it a more accessible, modest alternative to similar slots, with frequent rewards but lower maximum potential. Visually, the slot offers decent but unremarkable temple scenery and soundtrack, with some elements feeling slightly out of place.
review: Raiders of Fortune slot - base gameRaiders of Fortune: Slot OverviewEditor's note: It appears this game might have been cancelled.Up for a bit of virtual raiding players? If so, come take a look at Raiders of Fortune, an online slot from software outfit Light & Wonder. If the name Raiders of Fortune sounds a little bit like Raiders of the Lost Ark, it might not be a major coincidence since the main character in this game looks a lot like adventurer-archaeologist Indiana Jones. Well, Indiana Jones with a bit of Crocodile Dundee thrown in. Anyhoo, strap up, load up, do whatever you have to do to brace for some forest-themed action, and let's see what sort of fortune Light & Wonder had in mind when it made Raiders of Fortune.The first thing to know is Raiders of Fortune follows in the footsteps of Cluedo Mightyways, so there are some similarities between the two games. In practice, there are a lot more differences than similarities, but one crossover is the Trailways Trail sitting next to the reel-set, which players can win things from depending on how many consecutive cascading wins take place. The rest of the view isn't bad; pretty stock, where temple-like structures sit in the background, and a waterfall cascades on the right. It's a decent scene, nothing hugely special or unique for this particular slot category, though the tiki-esque face at the top of the Trailways Trail looks a little out of place.Raiders of Fortune's action starts on a 6-reel, 4-row game board with 40 fixed paylines, which can grow when reaching the right spot on the Trailways Trail. The RTP comes in three possible forms, from a high of 96% to a low of 92%, while the math model runs medium-high volatile. When ready to set a bet, the options range from 40 p/c to $/€20 per spin, which might make the game a bit unfriendly for some of the low rollers.Wins occur when three to six matching symbols land from the leftmost reel on adjacent reels across a payline. Symbols start with 10-A card royals worth 3-5x the bet for six of a kind, increasing to 8 to 20x the bet for landing five premium guns, maps, watches, adventurers, or amulets. Wild symbols appear on the reels to replace any normal pay symbol to help complete winning lines.Raiders of Fortune: Slot FeaturesRaiders of Fortune slot - free spins triggeredCascading wins are the launching pad for the bulk of the features in Raiders of Fortune, if not all of them. When a winning line hits, the payout is calculated then all of the symbols in the win are removed from the grid. New symbols cascade to fill the gaps, and if a new win is formed, the cascade feature triggers again. When no new wins are created, the total prize amount is paid.TrailwaysSitting next to the reels is the Trailways Trail displaying a list of prizes or modifiers, which players move along following winning cascades. When no more cascades occur, the Trail and the grid are reset. Positions on the Trail award:Position 1 - 1 Wild: 1 wild is added to the reels.Position 2 - 3x Wild: 3 wilds are randomly added to the reels.Position 3 - Free Expand: two rows are added to the grid, and win lines increase to 60.Position 4 - Colossal Wild: a 2x2 or 3x3 sized wild is randomly added to the grid.Position 5 - 5x + 1 Wild: an x5 multiplier is applied to all wins and one wild symbol is randomly added to the reels.Position 6 - Random Wilds: between 2 and 5 wilds are randomly added to the grid.Position 7 - 7 Free Games: 7 free spins are triggered, plus 1 free spin for each further cascade.Free GamesDuring free games, the awards on the Trailways Trails continue to be activated by consecutive cascades, but the positions now offer:Position 1 - 3 Wilds: 3 wilds are randomly added to the reels.Position 2 - +1x +1 Wild: the win multiplier increases by 1, and 1 wild is randomly added to the reels.Position 3 - 6x6 +1 Wild: two rows are added to the grid, win lines increase to 60, and one wild is randomly placed on the reels.Position 4 - Colossal Wild: a 2x2 or 3x3 sized wild is randomly added to the grid. One wild is randomly added to the reels.Position 5 - +3x: the win multiplier is increased by +3.Position 6 - Random Wilds: between 2 and 5 wilds are randomly added to the grid.Position 7 - +2 Spins +1x: 2 free spins are awarded, and the win multiplier increases by +1.Any cascades beyond 7 each award an additional 1 free spin and increase the win multiplier by +1. Between free spins, the Trail and the grid size are reset.Raiders of Fortune slot - free spinsRaiders of Fortune: Slot VerdictSuffice to say, if you like the idea of cascades not only leading to repeat wins but triggering a different modifier each time they progress along a Trail, there might be value in Raiders of Fortune to be had. While Raiders of Fortune might be built on the back of Cluedo Mightyways, it's been set-up to operate quite differently and might appeal to players who possibly aren't as patient as those who would prefer the Cluedo Mightyways game.The reason being is the modifiers on the Trail start being slung from the very first cascade win. Sure, it's just a wild symbol to start with, likely not game-changing, perhaps, but players don't have to wait until the fifth cascade like they did in Cluedo Mightyways to start getting stuff. Raiders of Fortune is the 'smaller' game, for want of a better word, in many regards. For starters, the game grid doesn't reach anywhere the size it could in the previous game – 60 max ways to win compared to 262,144 is one such example. Potential, too, is like night and day, Raiders of Fortune coming in at a much more down-to-earth figure of 4,493x the bet, compared to the other's 50,000x (which we are yet to see proof of).To sum up, Raiders of Fortune takes the Trailways Trail/cascade combo idea in a new direction, loosening it up, technically making it easier to win stuff from. Players who would prefer prizes or modifiers to appear rather often might find joy in it. Other than that, the theme's a bit hackneyed, if nicely presented, and the final destination isn't overly impressive, making Raiders of Fortune closer to a trek in a city park than a machete hack through thick bush.

title: Wolf Blaze Megaways

These are wooden designed 9-A card ranks as the lows, then a bear, cougar, eagle, and wolf as the highs. Wilds substitute for all symbols except scatters.Wolf Blaze Megaways: Slot FeaturesWolf Blaze Megaways slot - free spinsWilds are also collected when they land, linking them to the Jackpot Pick Game, whereas the other bonus round is free spins with a progressive multiplier.Jackpot Pick GameWhen wilds are collected at the end of a free spin or base game spin, there is a chance the Jackpot Pick Game is triggered. The more wilds collected, the higher the chance of activating the feature. When active, the Jackpot Pick Game shows 12 facedown tokens on the screen, and players pick them one at a time. Picked tokens turn up a jackpot token until 3 matching jackpot tokens have been revealed. The four possible jackpots are the Mini, Minor, Major, or Mega, worth a prize of 15x, 50x, 100x, or 5,000x the bet, respectively.Free SpinsScatter symbols in Wolf Blaze Megaways display the letters W, O, L, F, or +5. After each Rolling Reels roll, the multiplier increases by +1 until the feature ends. The round is extended by +5 or +10 free spins when 3 or 4 paw scatters land on the top reel, respectively.Wolf Blaze Megaways slot - pick bonusWolf Blaze Megaways: Slot VerdictAfter a playthrough, Wolf Blaze Megaways didn't exactly feel like it was going to end up being Fortune Factory Studios' breakout slot just yet.
