The reviewer finds it a straightforward, mainstream game targeting players who enjoy familiar features and a neighborly atmosphere. The game sports a wide prairie backdrop, buffalo imagery, and a honky-tonk Country & Western soundtrack enhancing its rustic vibe.
review: Raging Riches: Slot OverviewOnline slot Raging Riches is the debut release in developer Slotmill's 'Legends' series, a set of games 'where classic-style slots meet modern excitement.' A mix of old and new then and a way for Slotmill to reach out to a different audience. First on the block is Raging Riches, which uses about as tired and true a theme as it possibly gets, being a game set in the North American prairies. Joining the tumbleweeds and the buffalo out here are two bonus rounds - a free spins feature with wild multipliers and growing reels, plus a hold 'n win sticky Coin symbol round.First, the setting, and it's hard to imagine Raging Riches being any more 'good ol' boy' than this. The sun's a-shining, the vista is big, wide, brown, and buffalo display their dominance by stampeding their way onto the home screen. A toe-tapping honky-tonk Country & Western tune completes the picture along with a beige-coloured set of reels, in a slot players should be able to work out real quick if it's for them or not. Prepare for a severe gear change when the Fortune Frenzy Bonus triggers, though, as it takes place miles and miles away from any prairie.Raging Riches slot - base gameWhilst the 5-reel game grid can expand during free spins, it spends the base game in its default 4-5-5-5-4 configuration, where there are 2,000 ways to win. Raging Riches comes in two variants: one has a 96.08% RTP, the other a lower 94.11% return value. Both are medium-high volatile and take bets of 20 c to $/€100 per round.Raging Riches' list of pay symbols is made up of 9-A card ranks on the low side, then a wolf, a cougar, a bear, an eagle, and a buffalo on the high. Winning combinations formed of 5 matching low-pay symbols are worth 1.25x to 1.5x, while the premium animal symbols pay up to 2.5x to 3.5x. Wild symbols may land on reels 2, 3, and 4 to substitute for anything except scatters and coins.Raging Riches: Slot FeaturesRaging Riches slot - bonus gameThere are a few ways players may rage their way to riches around here. One is by landing enough scatters to trigger the free spins round, the other is hitting enough Coin symbols to activate the hold 'n win Fortune Frenzy Bonus.Free Spins BonusIn the base game, landing 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols gives players 8, 10, or 12 free spins, respectively. During free spins, hitting 2, 3, 4, or 5 scatters awards a further 3, 4, 5, or 6 free spins, respectively. Wild symbols in the free spins round have a random multiplier of x2 or x3. The multiplier on a wild symbol multiplies the number of winning combinations passing through that symbol location. Landing an UP symbol in the free spins round increases the reel height by +1 row, also increasing the number of ways to win (up to 5,488). The UP symbol may land twice on a reel, increasing it to 7 rows high. When a reel fully expands, players get +2 free spins. The UP symbol appears on reels 2, 3, and 4. Coin symbols are not present in the free spins bonus.Fortune Frenzy BonusHitting 6 or more Coin symbols triggers the Fortune Frenzy Bonus. In this feature, 3 spins are awarded. If any new Coins land, they stick to the reels and reset the spins back to 3. Regular Coin symbols have values of 0.5 to 10 times the bet. It is also possible to land the 20x Mini Coin, the 50x Minor Coin, or the 250x Major Coin. When the bonus ends, the values of all Coins in view are awarded. Filling all 25 positions with Coins triggers the 5,000x the bet Grand prize - on top of the total sum of Coin symbols on the screen.Xtra-Bet and Burst ModeSwitching on the Xtra-Bet increases the stake by 50%, increasing the chance of triggering either bonus rounds by 2x. Burst Mode is a hyper-fast way of powering through a set number of spins using the game engine and little visual representation.Raging Riches slot - free spinsRaging Riches: Slot VerdictThere are modern touches here, sure, such as the reel setup, the large number of win ways, and the growable grid, but they're firmly embedded in warm fuzzy familiarity. However, Raging Riches doesn't feel like a familiar Slotmill slot. It's more conventionally mainstream than we're used to seeing from this studio. Therein lies the point, though, because with the 'Legends' range, Slotmill is reaching out to a different audience than the one that typically falls for its 'regular' games (Tyrant's Fall and Coin Quest 2, for example). Instead, Raging Riches lines up gamblers who have a greater appetite for things like on-screen jackpots and streak respin rounds. Players for which prairie game worlds aren't as exotic since vast, rocky, buffalo-populated scenes can be found on the back doorstep.Gamblers in the US, in other words, or just those who like relatively straightforward gameplay unfolding in a neighbourly setting, like downing suds amongst friends at the local bar. You largely know what to expect from Raging Riches' features, alternating between the wild multiplier, growing reeled free spins, and the sticky Coin symbol Fortune Frenzy Bonus. There are few curve balls here to keep a lookout for, though the modernising touches add a certain amount of depth. A certain amount. The Xtra-Bet proved its worth during the review, triggering free spins on the very first base game spin. The Fortune Frenzy Bonus followed not long after, so it's a betting option to consider using.Not sure that the sort of players looking for a buffalo on the range slot will be as jazzed by Burst Mode, but it's there to move things along if time is of the essence. Based on 25 billion test rounds, a 5,533x the bet max win is here also, and those stats might not hugely excite gamblers with a keen eye on numbers. Raging Riches isn't really made with customers like that in mind; Slotmill has plenty of other games in its portfolio which would be a better match. But if lightning link stuff with wild American animals in nature appeal, then Raging Riches has you covered.

title: Space Zoo
structured_summary: Space Zoo is a quirky outer space-themed slot featuring astronaut animals collected in a cosmic menagerie. Key features include a Wheel of Fortune symbol triggering wilds, multipliers, cash prizes, and a free spins bonus with persistent benefits. The reviewer found the game moderately engaging with a unique personality, but noted some slow pacing and limited max win potential outside bonus features. The aesthetics combine a futuristic metal frame with playful animal astronauts and subtle space sounds, creating a distinctive though not awe-inspiring atmosphere.
review: Space Zoo: Slot OverviewAccording to the net, between 1947 and 1969, more than 12,000 sightings of Unidentified Flying Objects were reported to the United States Air Force's Project Blue Book. Apparently, 701 of them remain 'unidentified'. Let's pretend for a moment that at least 1 of those sightings was of a galactic big game hunter travelling the universe collecting lifeforms from different planets to display in a cosmic menagerie. That might go some way to explain Hacksaw Gaming buddies Backseat Gaming's slot Space Zoo, a game where players can 'share the vacuum with some kooky animal astronaut friends' while trying their luck in the outer reaches of space.Kooky is a good word to describe Space Zoo in general. Backseat Gaming hasn't created the most awe-inspiring view of the cosmos ever seen in an online slot, lacking the ethericism of a Euphoria game, for example, but it does admittedly pack in the kook in a similar manner to Blue Guru Games' Octopus Armada. For the base game, objects hover about the sky, and distant random noises of space flitter through the speaker before players board a starship heading to who knows where for the free spins bonus round.Space Zoo slot - base gameLocked within a futuristic metal frame is Space Zoo's gaming grid, made up of 5 reels, 4 rows of symbols, and where 14 paylines have been inlaid for evaluating winning combinations. Its volatility sits in the middle of the spectrum, literally, with a 3 out of 5 medium rating, while its RTP on the default setting is 96.22%. Three bonus buy features are available, as is a stake range of 10 c to $/€100.Space Zoo's pay symbols have lower value 10 to A card ranks, worth 1 times the bet for a 5 OAK winning combination, as well as higher value giraffes, lions, elephants, and zebras, worth 10-12.5 times the bet for landing a 5 symbol winning line. Wilds help by substituting for all regular pay symbols and appearing on all reels. A winning line of 5 wild symbols pays 20 times the stake.Space Zoo: Slot FeaturesSpace Zoo slot - free spinsYou'll want to see the Wheel of Fortune symbol hit as often as possible, as it is the gateway to many of Space Zoo's added features. It is available in the base game as well as in free spins, where its effects are amplified.Wheel of FortuneLanding a Wheel of Fortune symbol triggers the Wheel of Fortune with 1 to 3 spins. Each spin awards various modifiers which are applied to the board. When the modifier is complete, the Wheel of Fortune symbol turns into a wild symbol. In the base game, the Wheel of Fortune can:Randomly spawns 2 to 10 wilds.Upgrade low pay symbols to a high pay symbol for the current spin.Award a Global Multiplier of x2, x3, or x5 for the current spin. If multiple Global Multipliers are awarded, they are combined. In the bonus game, the Global Multiplier remains till the end of the round.Add Cash Prizes ranging from 2x to 1,000x. These are added behind symbols and are collected when a winning combination occurs in the positions that hold Cash Prizes. Cash Prizes are sticky in free spins till the end of the round. Cash Prizes are applied to unoccupied spots so they do not overlap or replace existing prizes.In the free spins bonus game, 2 to 5 extra free spins may be awarded.Bonus GamePlayers win 10, 12, or 14 free spins by respectively landing 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols at the same time in the base game. During free spins, the Wheel of Fortune feature triggers more frequently. The Global Multiplier and Cash Prizes persist through the bonus game. Cash Prizes vanish after being collected. Scatter symbols do not appear in free spins.Bonus BuyHere is where players can activate these bonus features. All are highly volatile:BonusHunt FeatureSpins - 2x the bet. Each spin is 3 times more likely to trigger a bonus game. RTP 96.27%.Wheel of Fortune FeatureSpins - 50x the bet. Each spin guarantees the Wheel of Fortune feature activates. RTP 96.29%.Bonus Game - 100x the bet for 10, 12, or 14 free spins. RTP 96.3%.Space Zoo slot - free spinsSpace Zoo: Slot VerdictSpace Zoo was okay, pretty good in parts, a bit slow in others. In the base game, you might sort of end up on the lookout for two things. One is enough scatters to transport you into the bonus round. The other is the Wheel of Fortune symbol, which then leads to features being ejected onto the gaming grid where, hopefully, a tidy outcome will result, fuelling the balance to keep the trip through the vacuum going. As stated above, Space Zoo doesn't present the most enthralling journey to the cosmos, but it has animals in space suits, which aren't often found beyond the confines of planet Earth, so the game's in possession of a dash of personality.Players won't be hitting Space Zoo's 10,000x the bet max win in the base game, though. The paytable makes it clear the top prize is only achievable via Wheel of Fortune FeatureSpins and in the bonus game. Since partner studio Hacksaw Gaming's slots regularly make the max win available in all phases of play, this was a slight downer, especially since at 50x a pop, Wheel of Fortune FeatureSpins are hardly chump change. You can see how the free spins bonus round is where the action is at, too, since there, any Global Multiplier and/or uncollected Cash Prizes persist till the round ends.Grandpa napping on the farm, poisonous snakes, powerful underwater entities, a Donkey Kong homage, and now animals in space, Backseat Gaming are certainly hard to predict in terms of subject matter. The slots they make, while generally of a well-built quality, are yet to really light the scene on fire, but with each one, Backseat Gaming shows it is willing to take players all over the universe via its relatively small (for now) yet diverse range of slots.

title: Devil's Crossroad
structured_summary: Devil's Crossroad is a dark-themed slot centered on supernatural crossroads where deals with the devil are made. The game features a unique 4-cross grid, cascading wins, multipliers, scatter-triggered Redemption Spins with various modifiers, and a bonus buy option. The reviewer finds it an interesting but somewhat underwhelming Nolimit City release, lacking the shock and excitement of previous titles. Aesthetically, it offers eerie visuals like a 4-eyed cat and a menacing devil at the center, paired with a moody, unsettling atmosphere.
review: Devil's Crossroad: Slot OverviewIt's said by certain Internet sources (Wikipedia, i.e.) that crossroads can represent a place between worlds where people can make contact with supernatural entities. One famous example is the story of American blues musician Robert Johson, who, according to legend, sold his soul to the devil in exchange for guitar mastery. For today's review, it appears that developer Nolimit City has been dabbling in the arcane in order to conjure Devil's Crossroad, an online slot of diabolical delights.It's no secret that Nolimit City has dabbled in the darker side of life in the past. Before Devil's Crossroad, we've had such devious slots as Book of Shadows, Blood & Shadow, True Kult, and a number of others that might not be directly related but are dark in their own particular ways. Devil's Crossroad expresses darkness through the use of the devil, who sits in the middle of a base game reel set, which sits in a hole ringed by jagged teeth as if teetering over a chasm to the underworld, at the place where two roads meet. One thought provoked by Devil's Crossroad was that no matter how sweet the deal, no matter how attractive a shortcut to fame, glory, or whatever it is, the id desires might be, think twice cos eventually the debt has to be settled, and that might not be fun.Devil's Crossroad slot - base gameBack in the physical realm is where Devil's Crossroad the game resides, though, and it's played on an usual grid divided into 4 cross sections, each section containing 4 symbols connected in the middle position by a Devil Wild. Winning combinations are removed when they hit, and symbols fall towards the centre. New symbols appear to fill any empty spaces this process causes. Instead of staking souls, players can instead stake 20 c to $/€200 per game round in what is an extremely volatile slot with a default RTP of 96.06%, or 96.04% to 96.1% when buying features.Grimy road sign symbols with 10 to A printed on them are Devil's Crossroad's low pays, awarding 0.4 to 1.2 times the bet for a 5 OAK hit. Five characters, each with their own story and motivation for doing deals, are Devil's Crossroad's 5 high pay symbols, paying 2 to 10 times the bet for a 5-matching symbol result. The middle devil symbol is wild, and any paying symbol next to the centre position may randomly become a wild symbol called Cross Wilds. All wilds substitute for any regular pay symbol.Devil's Crossroad: Slot FeaturesDevil's Crossroad slot - bonus gameDevil's Crossroad's base game is arguably more unorthodox than its hold 'n win bonus rounds, though both Redemption Spins and Upgraded Redemption Spins contain a lengthy list of special symbols which may add pep to the ride.Cross MultiplierWhen a win happens, the same kind of symbol is removed from other cross sections if they are not a part of the win. Each symbol removed in this way increases its cross section multiplier by +1. Wins get multiplied by their respective cross section multiplier.ScattersScatter symbols can appear in the centre row or column of their cross section. When a scatter symbol lands next to the centre position, the remaining symbols in its cross section become inactive, and symbols of the same type are removed from other cross sections. Removed symbols no longer appear for remaining cascades. Each symbol removed this way increases its cross section multiplier by +1.Redemption SpinsLanding 4 scatter symbols triggers Redemption Spins. This feature begins with 3 spins and resets to 3 each time a coin lands on the reels. Coins display a bet multiplier number. When a column is completely filled with coins a modifier is awarded for that column on each following spin. The triggered feature affects the coins on the column it is on. These are the modifiers:Gluttony - add its value to all applicable coins.Wrath - multiplies the value of a randomly selected coin on its row/column.Lust - progresses a level towards upgrading Redemption Spins.Greed - selects a random coin from its row/column, which gets all the coin values from its column/row respectively.Envy - transforms a randomly selected coin's value into a copy of the highest coin value on the reels.Pride - selects a random coin from its row/column and adds its value to all other coins on its column/row, respectively.Redemption Spins can be upgraded by collecting 4 levels on the upgrade bar or when all 4 scatter symbols land next to the centre position in the base game. The upgrade bar collects 1 level for each Lust feature triggered or for each scatter landing next to the centre position in the base game. Upgraded Redemption Spins trigger a feature for filling rows as well as for filling columns. The devil coin is a special coin that may land during Redemption Spins, unlocking a modifier on its column. If Redemption Spins are upgraded, then it also triggers a modifier for its row.Nolimit Bonus BuyAt the Nolimit Bonus screen, players can buy Redemption Spins for 80x the bet (96.04%), Upgraded Redemption Spins for 500x the bet (RTP 96.05%), or a 50/50 Lucky Draw for 250x the bet (96.1%).Devil's Crossroad slot - bonus gameDevil's Crossroad: Slot VerdictDevil's Crossroad was Nolimit City's first release of 2024, and if it is anything to go by, then the year should be another interesting one for gamblers partial to the studio's particular way of doing things. Devil's Crossroad didn't kick the year off with anywhere near the same level of bang as, say, San Quentin did back in 2021, by comparison. But, Devil's Crossroad is nevertheless worth taking the time to explore for followers of Nolimit City's work or those intrigued by the doing deals at crossroads with supernatural beings idea.Funny though, Devil's Crossroad doesn't explore its subject matter as thoroughly as a slot like Blood & Shadow did. The game, on the whole, is less controversial than they often are from this casino game maker, which was surprising. Nolimit City could have dived into all sorts of diabolical imagery to create a shocking experience, but Devil's Crossroad instead felt somewhat limited in this regard, besides the eerie 4-eyed cat in the bonus rounds and interesting win-count stories. The gameplay is a mix of limited and free-thinking, too. For starters, the sectional quality of the base game is clever, possibly putting players in the mind of slots like Gluttony or The Cage, yet the system is easy to follow and shouldn't provide much, if any, head-scratching confusion. It can be fun to watch combinations being formed in unusual ways, and the max win of 13,180x, theoretically hitting in around 1 in 3.9 million spins, is solid, if not astounding.And yet, Devil's Crossroad failed to really impress. There's nothing bad as such, but the theme use felt a bit lacklustre for Nolimit City, the pace a tad sluggish, and the bonus rounds, while capable of decent results, seemed pedestrian, especially compared to, say, Fire in the Hole xBomb or Dead Canary. Whilst Devil's Crossroad easily stands out amongst the bulk of generic fruit or joker, etc. slots, it's almost as if the burning fire to shock and break exhilarating new ground has dimmed compared to the Nolimit City of old, and there's a feeling NLC enthusiasts will have been expecting more from Devil's Crossroad.

title: Triple Fruit Deluxe Megaways
structured_summary: Triple Fruit Deluxe Megaways is a vibrant fruit-themed slot with a disco vibe, replacing Moriarty Megaways' detective theme. It features cascading wins, Mega Max Megaways, Mega Mystery Symbols, and an uncapped win multiplier during free spins. The reviewer finds it well-made but unoriginal, appealing mostly to fans of bright, flashy slots rather than novelty seekers. The game boasts classic slot aesthetics with flashy lights and upbeat music, delivering a lively, toe-tapping atmosphere.
review: Triple Fruit Deluxe Megaways: Slot OverviewTake a break from Victorian or Edwardian England to get all jiggy on the dance floor with iSoftBet in their online slot Triple Fruit Deluxe Megaways. If you haven't played Moriarty Megaways, that previous sentence might not make much sense. If you have, you'll probably clock the fact Triple Fruit Deluxe Megaways is a clone of Moriarty Megaways, trading in the previous game's mysterious Sherlock Holmes outer garb for something groovier, more fruity. Yet while the view has changed, the stats, massive potential and unique bonus round have largely been retained.As alluded to, bopping at the disco is a far cry from sleuthing it up on Baker Street. By contrast, Triple Fruit Deluxe Megaways isn't a game where you piece together scraps of evidence to solve crimes. Instead, this is the sort of place to unwind and let the music take control. Perhaps not hugely famous for making fruit slots, iSoftBet has found success in their Hot Spin range of games, so going all Vegas isn't foreign to them. Then again, it's kind of hard to get these games too wrong aesthetically, though some do manage it. As long as there are bright flashing lights, a toe-tapping beat and plenty of old school symbols, you're set. Triple Fruit Deluxe Megaways certainly delivers all of that.Moving beneath the surface, we find pretty much the same game engine running things. This means a highly volatile math model and a return to player value of 96%. Any device is suitable, and like before if you're playing on a mobile, you'll have to flip it to landscape mode to fit in the extra reel sets. Potential, on paper at least, remains enormous, and players are able to select stakes which suit from 20 p/c to $/€20 per spin.Played on a 6-reel Megaways game panel; each main reel holds up to 6 or 7 symbols each. Factor in the 4-position top tracker reel, and it is possible to have up to 117,649 ways to win. Landing matching symbols from the left-hand side of the panel form wins, which then go on to trigger a cascade feature. Pay symbols are pretty predictable, made up of lower value cherries, lemons, oranges, grapes, plums, and watermelons. These are worth the unimpressive total of 0.2 to 0.5x the bet for a six of a kind win. After them come bells, BARs, sevens, and dollar signs where six of a kind gets you 0.75 to 10 times your stake. Lastly, appearing only on the top tracker reel, disco ball wilds substitute for all regular pay symbols.Triple Fruit Deluxe Megaways: Slot FeaturesTriple Fruit Deluxe Megaways supplies several features and modifiers that are available in both game phases. These are cascading wins, Mega Max Megaways, Mega Mystery Symbols, while an unlimited multiplier is used during free spins.Cascading WinsA Megaways staple, the cascade feature explodes winning symbols off the grids and replaces them with new symbols. This can create sequences of consecutive wins from a single spin as cascades continue to function until no new win appears.Mega Max MegawaysThis feature can trigger randomly on any spin. When awarded, it forces the reels to produce the max 117,649 Megaways outcome. A win multiplier accompanies it, starting at x1 and increasing by +1 following winning cascades. Reels reset to normal when any wins end.Mega Mystery SymbolsMega Mystery Symbols can also trigger randomly on any spin. This one lands mystery symbols which all transform into the same pay symbol. Like the previous feature, it also injects a win multiplier that starts at x1 and goes up by +1 after cascade wins.Free SpinsHaving 3 diamond symbols in view awards 15 free spins, plus you get 5 extra free spins for each additional diamond up to a maximum of 30 free spins. In the bonus game, three individual reel sets are used. One is the larger main reel area which is always active. The other two are activated when certain symbols are collected. Each time 3 red star symbols are collected, players unlock the Mega Mystery Symbols reel for 1 spin with the modifier active. Moreover, collecting 3 yellow stars awards 1 spin of the Mega Max Megaways reel set with the modifier active.A win multiplier comes into play for the whole free spin round, too. It begins at x1, rises by +1 after cascade wins, and is uncapped. Finally, free spins can be retriggered when 3 diamond symbols land on the top tracker reel.Bonus ActiveBy paying out 150x the total bet, it is possible to trigger the Free Spins Super Bonus feature with 3, 4, 5, or 6 diamond symbols. The Free Spins Super Bonus feature has more Mega Max Megaways and Mega Mystery Symbols triggers than normal free spins. In addition, when you buy the bonus and the winning total is less than 10x the standard stake, the Bonus Guarantee awards 5 extra free spins. This can happen more than once if needs be.Triple Fruit Deluxe Megaways: Slot VerdictWell, Triple Fruit Deluxe Megaways certainly didn't conjure up the same level of mystery Moriarty Megaways did at first. There was no frisson of intrigue when its bright bolshiness splashed across our screen when it loaded up. It was a case of fruit again, in a Megaways setting, with recycled features and gameplay. If you're not in the mood for its jazzy ways, Triple Fruit Deluxe Megaways may well struggle to entice.On a brighter note, there remains a thriving market for this style of play, and Triple Fruit Deluxe Megaways is a well-made, high stakes contribution to the genre. It's not original in any way, but that doesn't really matter for players who place greater emphasis on bright lights and slick production than major novelty. Having Mega Max Megaways and Mega Mystery Symbols available in the base game is a welcome addition, though they didn't trigger a whole lot during the review. However, in free spins, at least one of them would generally be awarded, sometimes more, and Mega Max Megaways generally turned out to be a more exciting feature of the two. Masses of ways combined with a solid win multiplier can be a lethal combination. In fact, Triple Fruit Deluxe Megaways comes with an eye-popping win cap of 50,000x the bet, which might just be the arm twisting encouragement some players need. Having said that, it's very rare to find iSoftbet wins of that magnitude on social media, so take the figure with a grain of salt.Another good thing about Triple Fruit Deluxe Megaways is that anyone who likes the features but isn't down for the generic theme can always switch over to the Holmes one, Moriarty Megaways. However, if you're in the mood for a chipper Megaways game full of classic slot iconography with a few innovative twists, then Triple Fruit Deluxe Megaways is well worth a test run.

title: Napoleon Megaways

review: Napoleon Megaways: Slot OverviewNapoleon, that naughty (or nice, depending on your views) chap who carved up Europe and bits of the Middle East in the 18th and 19th centuries, is back for more. title: Darkness
structured_summary: Darkness is a genuinely spooky Halloween-themed slot set in a sinister, musty old house with an Eldritch horror atmosphere. The game features adjustable darkness settings, SuperSpinners multipliers, Giant symbols, and a Dark Ritual Bonus with free spins and locking wilds. The reviewer praises its immersive, unsettling theme combined with solid gameplay and potential wins up to 20,000x the bet. Visually dark and eerie with fitting audio, Darkness creates a chilling, atmospheric experience unlike typical Halloween slots.
review: Darkness: Slot OverviewYou know, it wasn't long ago we were musing about how Halloween slots are generally more cute than scary. It might have been during the review of NetEnt's Don't Eat the Candy, but this assessment could apply to a whole raft of games. Well, put a pin in those thoughts because developer Print Studios has completely crucified that theory. The team has done so in the online slot Darkness, described by its maker as 'Halloween gaming beyond the expected.' Yeah, yeah, they all say stuff like that, right, before delivering a game full of cuddly cats, candles, and maybe a pointy-toothed pumpkin or two. Not so Darkness, which is so unsettling that its climactic moment during free spins is so, well, dark, skittish players might hesitate wanting to trigger it.Before descending into the inferno, players are required to use a slider to adjust the literal darkness of their display. This can be altered once the game has begun if it all ends up a bit too dark… or not dark enough. The setting is some sort of musty old house, where it looks like the ritual has gone wrong already, letting loose an Eldritch horror into a dimension it was never meant to inhabit, coalescing everything it touches into a biological mess of branches and bones. It's all a bit spooky, like actually spooky, not regular slot spooky. 'Pleasure to me is wonder—the unexplored, the unexpected, the thing that is hidden and the changeless thing that lurks behind superficial mutability.' If that H. P. Lovecraft quote resonates, then you might possess the right sort of curiosity to continue into Darkness to see what sort of horror lurks beneath an already terrifying exterior.Darkness slot - base gameThere are three ways of kickstarting Darkness' horror. One is the normal way - picking a stake of 20 p/ to $/€50 and slamming the play button. The second is activating the Scatter Boost, which increases the stake by 50%. The benefit of switching the Scatter Boost on is that the free spins hit frequency shifts from 1 in 300.38 spins to 1 in 122.19 spins. The third method is buying free spins for the cost of 100x the bet. The RTP is different in each mode, from 96.14% when regularly betting, 96.4% with the Scatter Boost on, and 96.79% for the feature buy. Volatility is medium-high, or 4 out of, numerically speaking.In the middle of the scene is a 5-reel, 4-row gaming panel. It is indeed rather dark, even with the game's brightness setting set to maximum, but the unorthodox approach does fit the whole experience. The grid is covered in 26 paylines, awarding wins left to right from the first reel onwards. Fortunately, Print Studios has named each symbol so we know exactly what we are dealing with – Light Wiccan Twigs, Vibrant Wiccan Twigs, Noble Wiccan Twigs, Eldritch Wiccan Twigs, a vial, a dagger, a chalice, Isadora, and Agatha as the normal pay symbols. These symbols award wins of 0.2 to 25 times the bet for hitting a 5 OAK winning line. The Dirge Wild is the most valuable symbol at 50x the bet for five, and it can be used to substitute any regular pay symbol.Darkness: Slot FeaturesDarkness slot - free spinsPerforming a ritual requires gathering the right components, one supposes, and in Darkness, that means bringing together features such as SuperSpinners, Giant symbols, and free spins known around here as the Dark Ritual Bonus.SuperSpinnersA Print Studios trademark, SuperSpinners are the numbers you can see displayed between the columns of symbols on the game grid. There are 14 of them in total, and if a winline passes through an active SuperSpinner and the SuperSpinner is on the left of a winning symbol, the number multiplies the win. Multiple SuperSpinners on the same winning line apply their number one at a time.Giant SymbolsGiant symbols may land on any spin. They hit in sizes of 3x2 to 5x4, and each position covered by a giant symbol counts as one instance of a regular-sized symbol.Dark Ritual BonusHitting 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols awards 10, 12, or 14 free spins. The shape of a pentagram marks the gaming grid at the start of the round. When a Dirge wild lands on one of the five points of the pentagram, it locks in position till the round finishes and awards +2 free spins. If all 5 positions are filled with locked chanting Dirge Wilds, Lucifer is summoned, making reels 2, 3, and 4 wild for the rest of the bonus round.Darkness slot - free spinsDarkness: Slot VerdictIf the online slot market was a high school, Darkness would be the kid who keeps to themselves, always wears black, and listens to music which shocks and kind of saddens their grandparents. Seriously, so malign is the theme the subject matter on its own might be enough to put some players off. Imagine playing this thing at 2 a.m. on a dark and stormy night; the wind whistling through the trees, rain pattering against the window, a random door starts banging, and you're about to trigger the Lucifer section of the bonus round. Hashtag shiver. Nah, maybe if you're a little squeamish, maybe stick to spinning Darkness in the daylight, in public so there are loads of people around should a portal to the nether regions open up on your device, letting in something disturbing and its accompanying wizards.Yeah, okay, we might have gone a little overboard there, but such is Darkness' uniqueness it got those sorts of thoughts swirling around. Print Studios has proven well adept at creating engaging game worlds in the past, as seen in slots like Royal Potato, Royal Potato 2, Pine of Plinko, Cash Defense, and Reapers. Most of its games, really, and Darkness is another one that gets under your skin. Not just the insidious outer shell either, but the features and gameplay are critical factors in Darkness' immersion. On their own, stripped away from each other and the game they inhabit, some of the features on an individual basis might not be super original. But after melding together with the terrifying robes they're dressed up in, they present a formidable, if slightly frightening, whole.Should the ritual all go according to plan, Darkness can conjure up wins as high as 20,000x the bet. A solid reward for players daring enough to take on what is by far the spookiest slot (so far) in Print Studios collection, one which joins games like True Kult or Blood & Shadow infesting the more unsettling edge of the online gambling realm.

title: 4 Fantastic Fish Gold Dream Drop
structured_summary:

review: Four Fantastic Fish Gold Dream Drop: Slot OverviewMarching alongside mega fish franchises like Fishin' Frenzy or Big Bass Bonanza is software provider 4ThePlayer's 4 Fantastic range. While it features Fish money symbols, 4 Fantastic Fish differs from its competitors by not using a fisherman symbol to collect them, opting for a completely different method entirely, thereby giving piscine-minded gamblers a distinctively different option. So far the 4 Fantastic range has also gone to Egypt, done a Gigabblox version, as well as branched off into lobsters. Now, it sees one of its biggest revisions to date, as the series joins Relax Gaming's monster progressive jackpot network in 4 Fantastic Fish Gold Dream Drop.As is often the case with a Dream Drop makeover/revamp, a lot about the original experience has been brought over, and at a cursory glance, it might be hard to tell the difference. However, are differences there, and one can be spotted right away, as 4ThePlayer has removed the four jackpot fish values from the screen and replaced them with a rotating jackpot-laden Fortune Wheel, displaying the Dream Drop prize names. For players chasing 'the big one', swapping a 10,000x top prize symbol for a system that is capable of reaching into the millions of Euros can surely only be a greater temptation.4 Fantastic Fish Gold Dream Drop slot - base gameStatistically, RTP has taken a knock, which is normal for a jackpot game like this, the return value now coming in at 94%. The reel a Fish symbol lands on determines the limits of its prize value offer increasing cash prizes, starting from up to 1.8x on reel 1 to 10x-50x on reel 6.Giant Squid BonusOn any spin, the Giant Squid might appear and rearrange Fish symbols. In the main game, symbols may be swapped to improve a Fish win. In the Respin Bonus, the Squid might move a Fish symbol from a closed reel to an open reel to lock it in place.Respin BonusLanding 3 or more Respin scatters triggers the Respin Bonus game. Scatters land on all reels. Each reel holding a triggering scatter is opened while all others are closed. Any Fish symbols on the triggering spin are locked to the reels if they're on an open reel. When the reels spin, any new Fish symbol is locked in place if it is on an unlocked reel. If a Respin scatter lands on a closed reel, that reel is opened for subsequent respins. The Respin scatter cannot land on already open reels. The round starts with 3 respins. If a new Fish is locked in place or a Respin scatter opens up a closed reel, the number of respins is reset to 3. When respins run out, the bonus ends, and the cash prizes from all locked Fish symbols on open reels are awarded.Shark FeatureDuring the Respin Bonus, if an open reel is totally filled with locked Fish symbols, a shark swims up the reel and collects the cash prizes from all the Fish symbols. The total prize is multiplied by 2x and held in the top position of the reel. This opens the other reel positions for new Fish symbols to land.Dream Drop Jackpot SystemAlso, on any spin, players may be awarded a Dream Drop jackpot. A Fortune Wheel spins to award the Rapid, Midi, Maxi, Major, or Mega prize with starting values of €1, €5, €100, €25,000, or €500,000, respectively. However, because the Dream Drop Jackpot is progressive, prizes can be much higher.4 Fantastic Fish Gold Dream Drop - Dream Drop jackpot feature4 Fantastic Fish Gold Dream Drop: Slot VerdictAs mentioned, 4 Fantastic Fish Gold Dream Drop is close in several regards to the original 4 Fantastic Fish slot. It looks as bright as ever; it's got an upbeat, angling attitude, and hitting winning combinations of Fish symbols to collect their values is still one of the main thrills of the game. The Respin Bonus round, too, hasn't changed much, though one of the game's significant changes is the dropping of big jackpot Fish symbols, which used to be worth from 100x to 10,000x. This alteration has had a huge effect on non-jackpot winning potential, plummeting from the original's 15,000x figure to a more down to earth, or beneath it, 2,298.7x the bet. Moreover, don't expect bonuses to trigger too often here due to the extremely low hit frequency. This is typical for Dream Drop slots to compensate for the frequent rapid and mini jackpot rewards.But yeah, so what, right? Who's going to be playing 4 Fantastic Fish Gold Dream Drop to chase non-jackpot wins? It's the Dream Drop that's the big attraction here, and since the Mega can technically progress into the millions, a reduction in regular winning potential is likely to be a virtual non-issue. It's all eyes on the Fortune Wheel, willing it to trigger, and then… who knows? What is good is the complimentary gameplay isn't bad, such as the Respin Bonus, and it really is refreshing to be able to collect wins from Fish symbols without the need for a fisherman symbol, as is often the way. And that's 4 Fantastic Fish Gold Dream Drop, really. A game that takes away certain elements while adding in others to provide an upbeat, fishing-themed environment in which to spin for the chance to trigger Dream Drop prizes.

title: Fruit Snap
structured_summary: Fruit Snap is a classic fruit-themed slot featuring an 8x8 grid with familiar symbols and a neon-pink disco ball backdrop. review: Fruit Snap (Red Tiger): OverviewA massive 8x8 grid packed with classic fruit slot symbols is what you'll see when you fire up Red Tiger's latest creation Fruit Snap. By itself, it doesn't exactly stand out as avant-garde, but there's a symbol bar positioned above the game area which tells us there's likely more to it than what meets the eye - and we're intrigued to find out exactly what. Going through the introductory welcome screen gives us a bit more information. There, we learn that Fruit Snap is capable of delivering wins of over 3,000 times your stake. It also tells us that there's a fruit removal feature included in the game as well as a double win upgrade feature, both of which are directly linked to the symbol bar. What it doesn't tell you is that Fruit Snap is a highly volatile game with a relatively high hit rate that can be played from 0.10 to €/$20 per spin across all devices.On the audiovisual side of things, Fruit Snap doesn't steer too far of course when compared to other modern fruit slots available on the market. There's the usual funky lounge music playing on repeat and a not so surprising neon-pink disco ball backdrop which stands in stark contrast to the colourful symbols. With a luxurious feel, it all comes together quite well, and it undoubtedly makes you want to explore what the game has to offer.When it comes to the symbols, the reel grid is made up of a selection of classic fruit machine symbols. You have the low-paying strawberries, oranges, cherries, lemons, and watermelons that cascade alongside the more valuable bronze stars, diamonds, dice, bells, and lucky pink 7s. The latter is the most rewarding, giving you 777 times your stake for a cluster of 30+ symbols.Fruit Snap (Red Tiger): FeaturesFree spins in action.In Fruit Snap, wins are formed when 5 or more matching symbols appear in clusters either horizontally or vertically. Winning clusters are then removed to allow the above symbols to fall into place while new ones are added to fill the empty tiles. Known as the Winning Clusters feature, this gives you a chance to win repeatedly from a single spin.Remember that symbol bar we mentioned? As it turns out, these are actually individual Symbol Meters. As you'll be able to tell, each symbol has a corresponding meter positioned above the grid. Now, whenever a winning cluster is formed, the winning symbol will contribute to filling up its corresponding meter. When the meter is full, the game will fire off one of the following two features depending on whether it's a low-paying symbol or a high-paying symbol (it will only remain active during the current spin/chain-reaction):Fruit Removal - When a low-paying symbol meter has been filled, the symbol is completely removed from the grid and will no longer appear during the current spin.Double Win Upgrade - When a premium symbol meter has been filled, the value of the symbol is doubled. This means that instead of the standard 777x reward, a cluster of 30+ lucky pink 7s will give you 1,554x.A Meter Bonus may also trigger randomly on a non-winning spin. When activated, one or more symbol types will be randomly chosen and added to their respective meters.Things get considerably more interesting in the Free Spins feature which comes into play when you land 3 bonus symbols anywhere on the reels on the same spin. Here, the meters will never reset which means that any lower-symbol removed will not come back into play again and upgraded premiums will remain upgraded until the end of the round. Furthermore, you can also retrigger the free spins with 5 extra spins if you land another 3 bonus symbols during the round.Fruit Snap (Red Tiger): VerdictFruit Snap is a middle of the road kind of slot and one that avoids the extremes. That goes for all aspects of it, from the moderate winning potential and generic theme to the lack of creative effort invested into it. Overall, there's a lot of work to be done before Red Tiger can become a serious contender in the grid slot category which, for now, is dominated mainly by Play'n GO and Push Gaming. Rather than churning out more fruit themed slots, it would be fun to see Red Tiger putting more focus on becoming better at building some narrative, designing unique characters and give the slots some more personality. Another thing that cannot be ignored is the reduction in RTP which has dropped below the 96% mark in this as well as several other recent Red Tiger releases.So, to summarize. Fruit Snap is a solid product has what it takes to keep you entertained for a good while. But you really have to be into this particular category of slots to keep coming back for more because, honestly speaking, as far as grid slots go, there are far more appealing alternatives out there to choose from.

title: Pearl Harbor
structured_summary: Pearl Harbor is a WWII-themed slot focusing on the 1941 Japanese attack on the US base, immersing players in the Pacific battle. review: ﻿Pearl Harbor: Slot OverviewDecember 7, 1941, "a date which will live in infamy." So said President Franklin Roosevelt, after the deadly attack against the US military base in Hawaii by Japan, leading to the United States entering World War 2. In the short term, the attack reduced the American presence in the Pacific, but it didn't prevent the Japanese from surrendering after four years or so of vicious battles. The day was brought to the silver screen in the 2001 film Pearl Harbor starring Ben Affleck and Kate Beckinsale. Now, it appears in an online slot from the creative team at Nolimit City.Nolimit City are no strangers to Second World War slots, having raised periscopes for Das xBoot a while back, which was located in a very different theatre than the one players find themselves in for Pearl Harbor. Like Das xBoot, the game takes an Axis-eyed view of the conflict, this time concentrating on the Japanese. Doing so has let the studio use a load of related imagery such as 'circle of the sun' flags, kana style writing, Kamikaze, steely-eyed gunners, and plenty of Tora Tora Tora. Like Das xBoot, Pearl Harbor is presented as if you're taking part in the battle when playing. For instance, the base game displays a sort of targeting system, with dials littered about the place. The two bonus games take to the air, and at one point, you literally get a view of ships about to be bombed, as if playing a video game as much as a slot. Well, maybe not so much, but there is a higher level of immersion in Pearl Harbor than is found in most online slots. You definitely don't feel like you're cranking a one-armed bandit, that's for sure.Pearl Harbor slot by Nolimit CityTo begin the assault, players choose a base bet of 20 p/c to $/€100 and tap away on the play button, or, where possible, switch on the xBet Banzai or pick one of the bonus buy options. Playing in the normal mode comes with a top RTP of 96.06%. Unsurprisingly, the volatility is high, and so is winning potential, should it all come together. A dynamic game gets a dynamic game board hosting the action, which is 7x7 in size but starts each spin with a 3x3 square active. How the rest of the grid is activated will be covered soon.Focusing the scope on symbols now, Pearl Harbor has 9 pay symbols, creating a win when at least five matching symbols land horizontally or vertically adjacent to each other in the active gaming area. Winning clusters are removed from the grid, allowing new symbols to avalanche in, potentially creating a new win, repeating until no new win hits. Japanese writing-style 10-A symbols make up the low pays, and four military characters are the highs. Creating a five-of-a-kind cluster pays 0.15 to 1x the bet, while at the top of the scale, a 40+ sized cluster win is worth 30 to 625 times the bet.Pearl Harbor: Slot FeaturesPearl Harbor slot by Nolimit CityThis section is pretty extensive. While the game is easy to understand when it's in motion, there are a lot of intricacies, and most of them will be detailed here.ScattersScatters can land on any reel in the base game but only count when they are in the active area. If a scatter is split, and a bonus round is triggered, the scatter's multiplier value becomes an x-Mutlpier in the first bonus round multiplier addition.xBet BanzaiActivating the xBet Banzai lets players increase the stake by 50% to guarantee one scatter in the active area, increasing the chance of entering the Dog Fight bonus by x3 (max RTP 96.06%). Or, increasing the stake by 100% guarantees 2 scatters to the active area, thus also increasing the chance of entering the Tora! Tora! Tora! bonus by x10 (max RTP 96.11%).xBomb Wild MultiplierxBombs only explode when within the active area, blowing away up to 10 surrounding symbols. They increase the active area size if the xBomb is on the border or in the corner of it. If xBombs are split, they get an x2 multiplier for the first split, then are doubled for each following split. Exploding xBombs also increase the win multiplier for the next avalanche with +1 or the x-multiplier value it has been split into. xBombs explode before the next avalanche, and scatters or transformed wilds not part of a win are not blown away.TargetTarget symbols can land anywhere on the reels. When one lands, the active area expands to include the Target symbol. When part of the active area, it transforms into a wild.xSplitxSplit symbols land in the form of a sword and split all symbols in the direction of the sword's handle. They activate when they are inside the active area after the avalanche has finished. xSplits have 1 or 2 swords, initially pointing horizontally or vertically, in one direction per sword. If an xSplit is split, it gets another sword pointing in a new direction. If it already has 4 swords, a split will add an x2 multiplier. If an xSplit has a multiplier when activated, all symbols it splits get the multiplier or have their current multipliers increased by the xSplit multiplier value. Scatters, Targets, and xBombs get an x2 multiplier when hit by an xSplit. Consecutive xSplits on multiplier symbols double their value, and xSplits become wilds after the splitting action with a multiplier equal to the number of swords it had.Pearl Harbor slot by Nolimit CityColossal SymbolColossal symbols have sizes of 2x2 or 3x3, and when they land, the active area expands, so they become a part of it. Despite their size, they initially count as one in a cluster win. If a 3x3 symbol is split, it first splits into 3 symbols depending on the direction of the split. A second split splits it in the other direction, a third split splits all 9 symbols into 18 symbols, and a fourth split either gives each symbol an x2 multiplier or multiplies the individual multipliers by 2. The same sort of rules applies to the 2x2 symbol.DogfightLanding 3 scatter symbols trigger the Dogfight bonus mode. For this one, 3 spins are awarded inside an aircraft cockpit. Dials spin to reveal x-multipliers, + multipliers, or nothing. Landing multipliers reset the spin count. Landed + multipliers are added together then any x-multipliers are applied to them. x-multipliers remain active until a + multiplier lands. If the round ends with active x-multipliers, they are converted to + multipliers and contribute to the total. Filling up a column of dials triggers a Dogfight Attack. All multipliers in the column are activated, and if the plane is hit in the dogfight sequence, the prize value is awarded. Lastly, if all 18 dials are filled, a Kamikaze Attack is launched after any Dogfights. In the Kamikaze Attack sequence, a multiplier from a wheel with 10 possibilities, including misses, is generated. If the ship is hit, the multiplier is applied to the total round multiplier.Tora! Tora! Tora!This feature is triggered when 4 scatter symbols land. It's the same as the Dogfight bonus, with the addition of Midway Pop and Bomb Drop features.Midway Pop activates when a multiplier lands on a dial on the mid-row. The value pops up to the top row of the column. If no value was in that spot, one is randomly placed there - an x-multiplier or + multiplier. If a value is already there, the mid-row value is added to it, and the type remains.The Bomb Drop activates when a full row of dials is filled. A bomb gets dropped on a ship, and if it hits, all + multipliers on the row are added and multiplied by all x-multipliers on the row. Extra rules for when the row has only x-multipliers include turning them into a value added to the round total and leaving them active. Full details are in the paytable.Nolimit BonusHitting the Nolimit Bonus button allows applicable players to buy three bonuses. One is the Dogfight mode for 60x the bet (max RTP of 96.24% ), whereas 712x the bet buys the Tora! Tora! Tora! mode (max RTP 96.33%). Or, paying 73x the bet provides a random awarding of either bonus for 73x the bet (max RTP 96.25%).Pearl Harbor slot by Nolimit CityPearl Harbor: Slot VerdictWith a focus on the Japanese side of the conflict, Pearl Harbor borrows more from the Axis side of things than the Allied one, and players might need a dash of Kamikaze spirit going into the game. Nolimit City slots generally aren't for the faint-hearted, and Pearl Harbor can count itself as another one of these. As the game sheet warns – 'Wreaking havoc is the only way. There's NO holding back.' That ethos seemed to rule in Pearl Harbor, which was pretty much as ruthless as anything else Nolimit City has created. A sense of all or nothing often pervades the studio's games, and this feeling certainly was experienced during our test sessions.Cluster-paying grid slots often have a poppin', cascadin', firin' off a sequence of seemingly unstoppable consecutive wins effect. Cluster Tumble from Relax Gaming is a classic example of this. Pearl Harbor could be the opposite. At times it was difficult to get it off the ground, like a Kamikaze pilot who had a last-minute change of heart. While unique, the base game had a vague cross between The Border and Misery Mining thing going on. It rolls, expands, contracts, explodes and slices. Perhaps bed in for a siege rather than a quick hit-and-run attack. Colossal symbols are interesting, and it's worth reiterating that they initially count as one symbol because they might be a tease when they first start landing on the board. Slice them up, though, which didn't happen a whole lot, and they can quickly become more valuable, though.Better value wins were produced during the two bonus rounds, which like Das xBoot merged gameplay right into the theme. The two rounds might have sounded complicated on paper, but the general gist is adding up + multipliers and applying x-multipliers to them. What makes them more interesting are the numerous extra bits, such as the dogfights and bombing runs when you're lucky. title: Kingdom Below
structured_summary: Kingdom Below is a fiery, underworld-themed slot by Play'n GO featuring a unique abyss setting. The game boasts cute, flaming visuals and haunting, dramatic music that enhance its immersive atmosphere.
review: Kingdom Below: Slot OverviewIf money symbol collection games are hot, and let's face it, they are extremely popular, wait till you get a load of Kingdom Below designed by provider Play'n GO. For one thing, this is not a slot that uses a bearded fisherman symbol to reel in cash. Instead, Kingdom Below is a fiery slot that takes place somewhere very warm indeed. Maybe the abyss, but it's a cutely rendered form of the abyss if so. While avoiding getting stabbed by a trident, players are aided by a floating Beast who collects cash symbols, and can look forward to a progressive free spins round that just might have taken cues from slots like Blueprint Gaming's Fishin' Frenzy The Big Splash.Obviously, we aren't on clear blue water for this one, but rather somewhere all, rocks, chains and flames. It's a nicely designed spot, with music that imbues Kingdom Below with haunting dramatics. In a good way. Buzzing about above the 5-reel, 4-row game grid is a floating Beast who is needed to collect cash symbols, or as they are referred to in Kingdom Below, grab symbols or grab prizes.Kingdom Below slot - base gamePlay'n GO's horizontal plus and minus bar is where players can choose a stake of 10 c to $/€50 per game round. Rated 7 out of 10, Kingdom Below is a medium-high volatile game, where the highest RTP gamblers may find is 96.25%. Four lower return models can also be found. Collecting cash symbols might be more exciting, but line wins also pay when matching symbols land on adjacent reels, starting from the leftmost reel, across 12 paylines.Flaming stone 10-A card ranks are Kingdom Below's low pays, awarding 10 times the bet for a line of 5 matching symbols. Flames follow on the flaming sword, flaming ring, flaming trident, and flaming crown high pays, awarding 50 to 200 times the bet for 5 OAK. Wilds do not appear in Kingdom Below; perhaps they were not flammable enough.Kingdom Below: Slot FeaturesKingdom Below slot - free spins triggeredOne thing you'll likely notice quickly is the floating Beast drifting above the reels. When it activates, one of these effects occurs:Grab Feature - collects all prizes on the reels beneath the Beast.Slide n Grab - the Beast collects all prizes on the reels. A multiplier equal to the number of reels containing prizes is applied to the total win.Under Reel - a mystery grab prize is pulled from beneath the reel. These prizes can be either a grab prize, a valueless dud, or, in free spins, a scatter symbol that progresses the free spins trail.Grab prizes have values of 1x to 50 times the current bet. They also pay up to 40x for 5 OAK when forming winning lines. The Grab Feature and the Under Reel features can trigger simultaneously, but the Slide n Grab cannot trigger at the same round as the Grab Feature and/or Under Reel collection features.Free SpinsScatters appear on all reels, and hitting 3+ scatters awards 10 free spins. At the start of the free spins round, a Pick a Fire feature commences that awards 1 of 8 possible modifiers. Modifiers come in regular or upgraded forms. The regular modifiers are: 5 additional free spins, More Grab triggers, More Slide n Grab triggers, More grab symbols, Lowest pay symbol is removed, At least 1 grab symbol on every free spin. Wins are not guaranteed, Grab multiplier increases to x2, and 1 random grab symbol is sticky for 1 spin.Upgraded modifiers are: 10 additional free spins, More Grab triggers at x2 multiplier, More Slide n Grab triggers at x2 multiplier, More grab symbols and 2 lowest paying grab symbols removed, The 3 lowest pay symbols are removed, At least 3 grab symbols on every free spin. Wins are not guaranteed, Grab multiplier increases to x5, and Up to 2 random grab symbols are sticky for 1 spin.Only 4 modifiers can be active throughout free spins - one type of each specific modifier, so you can't have regular and upgraded versions of modifiers at the same time. When multipliers are combined, their values are added, keeping in mind some multipliers are feature specific.For the free spins feature, a 12-position trail is used. Collecting scatter symbols progresses the trail. Scatters are only collected if they are on the same reel as the Beast during the Slide n Grab or Under Reel collection. Reaching positions 2, 6, and 10 triggers extra picks, while reaching positions 4, 8, and 12 triggers +10 free spins. Win multipliers for each retrigger step are x2, x3, and x10. Multipliers are applied to grab wins only. After reaching position 12, no more free spins may be awarded. The maximum number of free spins possible is 50.Kingdom Below slot - free spinsKingdom Below: Slot VerdictKingdom Below does well to disguise the winding family tree that lies behind its existence. No one is saying Play'n GO set out to copy what has gone before it, but the links to slots like Pragmatic Play's Big Bass Bonanza and Blueprint Gaming's Fishin' Frenzy The Big Splash (and a bunch of related slots) are clear to see. For better or for worse, Play'n GO has forgone fish and used an Underworld-style theme instead. Sad for gamblers who are absolutely besotted with fish slots, smile-inducing for others who are sick to death of the sea but want to collect cash symbols using a fresher format.Fresher is debatable in some ways since much of Kingdom Below's core mechanics are recognisable, but there are newer elements here, as well. The floating Beast is one such innovation, not doing a lot to help out a lot of the time in the base game, but occasionally activating and slinging a bit of cash players' way. Having three different ways of collecting awards is a nice feature as well. As mentioned, the Beast took it pretty easy in the base game before it put in a bit of extra work when free spins triggered. The bonus round is quite well done, with pre-game picks adding suspense and a progress feature that gets better the further you are able to move along it. Hey, this sort of system has worked well in several previous games, and it works well here, too, with a variety of effects on offer.Kingdom Below's max win is 6,000 times the bet, which is not too shabby, though it has a 1 in 868,685,581 probability of occurring. When comparing this figure to Bigger Bass Bonanza for a similar in some ways example, where the probability is 1 in 981,884, choosing King Below might make certain players pause. Otherwise, if odds be darned, Kingdom Below is an interesting take on cash symbol collecting, which dares to be different.

title: Temple of Wealth
structured_summary: Temple of Wealth is an Asian-themed progressive jackpot slot by Play’n GO, rich in traditional Chinese symbols and cultural motifs. It features a free spins round with six selectable options involving sticky mystery symbols, plus a jackpot game triggered by wilds on Gold Reels. The reviewer finds it well-made and thrilling, especially for fans of the theme, though not highly original and best suited for jackpot chasers. Visually, it boasts a vibrant, gold-lit temple setting with classic Asian imagery, complemented by fitting audio that enhances the immersive experience.
review: Temple of Wealth: OverviewThey say good things come in threes, and developer Play’n GO has set out to prove the veracity of that statement. Temple of Wealth is one of three titles in the studio’s trio of progressive jackpot slots which also includes Celebration of Wealth and Beast of Wealth, all deeply dipped in an Asian theme. Why three? It’s a little unclear, but jackpot hunters probably won’t be complaining by the wider range of choice. The format is basically the same as the others, meaning a straight forward base game complemented by two features – free spins and of course, jackpots.Asian fans will be right in their element playing this one. It looks like Play’n GO bought up a souvenir shop and shook out the contents into the game. Temple of Wealth has a strong traditional vibe. Heavy on the green, red and gold, plus bursting with smiling divinities, leaping fish statues – it’s a full Chinese smorgasbord. So much so, that Temple of Wealth is possibly the most polarising slot of the three. Either you absolutely can’t get enough of this style, or the clichés make you slightly nauseous. It’s been quite nicely designed though. The 5-reel, 243 win ways grid is placed inside the temple of the title, surrounded by solid pillars bathed in a warm golden light.Temple of Wealth may be played on any device, by choosing bets of 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin. Each stake has 1.5% trimmed off to grow the jackpot. When selecting a bet, know that the bigger the wager, the better the chances are of triggering the jackpot feature.When it comes to the math model, Temple of Wealth is most closely related to Celebration of Wealth. The two have the same return to player rating of 96.2%, and a fairly high volatile math model rated 8/10. As before, RTP is alterable, so make sure you’re getting the best version before joining the chase.Ten symbols make up the paytable here - 5 low pay royals, and 5 high pay premiums. The premiums are made up of coins, a sycee, a golden fish, a Fu baby, and the smiling Caishen, worth from 2 to 10 times the stake for five of a kind. The mysterious red door is the wild, appearing anywhere to substitute for all symbols except the scatter.Temple of Wealth: FeaturesTemple of Wealth - free spins explainedLike the two progressives before it, Temple of Wealth has two features to get to grips with. One is a triggered batch of free spins; the second is the headlining progressive jackpot feature.The harmoniously balanced Yin & Yang symbol is the scatter symbol, landing on any reel - 3, 4 of 5 of them in view payout 5, 10, or 50 times the stake while simultaneously triggering free spins. Like before, players get to choose the format of the feature, though this time there is 6 choices to mull over. Each one determines how many spins you get and how many mystery symbols are added to the reels. The options are 8, 10, 12 15, or 20 free spins with 48, 38, 28, 18, or 8 mystery symbols respectively.Heavy on the number 8, which as you probably know if you’ve read a few Asian slot reviews, is the most auspicious number in Chinese culture, meaning fortune, high status, wealth, etc. The 6th option is a lucky dip which assigns a random number of spins and mystery symbols from the available pool.When mystery symbols appear, they stick to the reels and spread 1 position up or down between spins. Eventually, they cover the full reel before disappearing. Every mystery symbol in view reveals the same pay symbol before wins are evaluated.Unlike the previous two games in the range, additional free spins cannot be won. That’s possibly a good thing because the next feature, the jackpot, can only be awarded from a paid spin. At any stage during the base game, 1 to 5 reels may randomly become Gold Reels. If you are lucky enough for a wild symbol to land on a Gold Reel, the progressive jackpot feature is awarded and players are guaranteed to win at least one of the prizes.In this feature, 12 coins cover the screen in a 4x3 formation. Players pick them one by one until three matching jackpot animal symbols are revealed. You’ll find turtles, phoenixes, tigers, or dragons associated to the Mini, Minor, Major, or Grand jackpot.Temple of Wealth: VerdictSo completes Play’n GO’s trio of Asian themed progressive jackpots. There isn’t a massive difference between them, but they are diverse enough in looks and bonus game to set them apart on a certain level. Math models are more or less similar, and the point of all three is going after the Grand jackpot. Without the progressive bolted on, none would be hugely attractive games to play except for those enamoured by the theme.Yet they are well made, and the free spins feature is capable of thrills in its own right. Potentially lucrative thrills too since wins of up to 5,000 times the stake are possible. In Temple of Wealth, they aren’t retriggerable though, so you’ll need sticky mystery symbols to land as thickly as Beijing smog to get the most out of them. Mystery symbols appear in a ton of other games, yet the sticky spreading ability is interesting.To sum up, Temple of Wealth is the most specifically designed slot of the jackpot trio, aimed right at players into this particular look. As with the other two, you will be hard-pressed to find anything overly original in Temple of Wealth, yet, for a well-made jackpot slot offering decent features and potential, it’s not a bad option.

title: The Golden Pot & Pints
structured_summary: The Golden Pot & Pints is a leprechaun-themed slot set in a cozy Irish pub atmosphere. review: The Golden Pot & Pints: Slot OverviewAs far as pub names go, The Golden Pot & Pints would be a pretty good one. It rolls off the tongue well, elicits a warm vibe, and leaves no doubt about its business of serving beverages. The Golden Pot & Pints' Avalanche mechanic removes the symbols in winning clusters from the grid before performing a symbol drop to fill all of the empty spaces. This process continues as long as new wins hit.The Golden Pot & Pints: Slot FeaturesThe Golden Pot & Pints slot - free spinsJoining the Avalanche mechanic, The Golden Pot & Pints serves up wild multipliers, a bonus game with a progressive Global Multiplier, Bet+ options, and a bonus buy.Wild MultiplierEach cluster win generates a wild symbol carrying a random multiplier of x2 to x100. In the main game, multipliers that are part of a win are added together and applied to all cluster wins in that spin. This process repeats with each new win in an Avalanche sequence.Bonus GamePlayers are awarded 10 free spins when 3 scatter symbols land. Any additional triggering scatter symbol awards an extra +2 free spins. In the bonus round, a Global Multiplier starting at x1 applies to all wins. Before payouts occur, multipliers from winning wilds are added to the Global Multiplier, which persists until the bonus ends without resetting. Hitting 3 scatter symbols in the feature grants +3 free spins with a further +2 free spins for each additional scatter.Bet+ and Bonus BuyThe Bet+ is where players can activate the Bonus Boost for 1.5x the bet where each spin is 2 times more likely to trigger the bonus game, the Bonus Boost Plus for 2.5x the bet where each spin is 5 times more likely to trigger the bonus game, Wild Mode for 3.5x the bet which guarantees a win with a wild and triples the chance of triggering the bonus game, or the Bonus Boost Extreme for 10x the bet which triggers the bonus game once every 10 spins on average. To just buy the bonus round, this costs 100x the bet.The Golden Pot & Pints slot - free spinsThe Golden Pot & Pints: Slot VerdictThat was surprisingly easy to digest for a Thunderkick game. The studio doesn't make overly complicated slots to begin with, but The Golden Pot & Pints is rather light on rules. Rather light on features, too. Initial thoughts were that The Golden Pot & Pints would be closer to Archie O'Loggins and the Enchanted Masks or Hot Potato, maybe springboarding further into cluster paying complexity. However, instead of wading deeper into cluster territory, Thunderkick has eased the dial back to craft an engaging yet somewhat shallow slot in some ways, though not bad ways.Shallow does not automatically translate to a negative trait, though, and The Golden Pot & Pints is able to elevate the pulse rate. What helps is each and every cluster win in the base game generates a wild multiplier of up to x100, though lower values are probably going to be more common, combining multipliers when more than 1 wild is part of a win. Strong, no-nonsense stuff, like a goto heady brew. Free spins flip the rules in that winning wild multipliers toss their values right to the Global Multiplier, which persists throughout the feature. Again, no-nonsense stuff that gets to the point without mucking around.Once you've seen The Golden Pot & Pints do its thing a few times, that's about it, though. This isn't a slot with masses of depth or hidden nooks and crannies to discover. Perhaps given the ubiquitous nature of the slot's theme, the Thunderkick team didn't want to throw away their best ideas on it. Ah well, as it stands, The Golden Pot & Pints can generate wins of up to 10,000x and is a solid enough, if a tad superficial, leprechaun-filled cluster pays slot.

As noted, scatters remain on the reels to be collected during free spins, helping you progress through the 4 levels. The levels look like this:Level 1: The scatters triggering the free spins round are added to the collection meter.Level 2: Collect 5 scatters in total.Level 3: Collect 11 scatters in total.Level 4: Collect 18 scatters in total.Every level is played until completed before moving to the next one should you collect enough scatters to do so. With such rich subject matter, Play'n GO could have taken players on a real mind-bender of a slot, but they have kept much of it a pretty mainstream Day of the Dead style slot most of the time. That is until free spins trigger, then the imagery takes on a trippy, swirling aspect, and the game goes full Coco.You'll want the trip to kick in as soon as possible, too, because aside from the random multiplier, which is pretty modest outside free spins, there's not much going on in the base game. The mariachi blasts to celebrate wins keeps the party spirit up to a degree, yet everything steps up several notches when free spins trigger. The bonus game is a sharp volatile blast, as five initial free spins aren't a heck of a lot of room to manoeuvre. Having four wild features to choose from is another positive aspect as players get to pick their favourites or potentially experiment with something new.You might expect features to build on top of each other as you move up levels instead of getting one at a time. However, imagine the mayhem of wilds Level 4 would've been if you had all four features firing. And to be honest, the game doesn't really need to stack features to be highly effective. Multipliers can make a huge impact, and the game has an impressive (in theory at least) max win figure of 10,000 times the stake as it is.All up, a fairly entertaining and well-produced game, plus players get to experience a side of Aztec culture rarely explored in a slot. We mentioned in the intro that some spirits ended up going to other destinations. One was for those who passed away from events linked to the rain god Tlaloc - a paradise called Tlalocan. Might make a pleasant sequel?"
