review: "January 27, 2022",7,"The G.O.A.T: Slot OverviewBack in the day, being called a 'Goat' in sports was not a great thing. The word was sometimes used to describe athletes messing up at the worst time in a game, typically contributing to their team losing. Then in 1992, Lonnie Ali established Greatest of All Time Incorporated, or GOAT Inc, to license superstar Muhammad Ali's intellectual properties. In 2000, LL Cool J dropped an album titled G.O.A.T., inspired by the boxing legend. The term was further cemented in the public consciousness after American Football star Tom Brady appeared in GQ magazine holding a baby goat, and the word entered the Merriam Webster dictionary.That leads us to The G.O.A.T from Blueprint Gaming, which is not sports-related. Instead, The G.O.A.T has an unusual blend of wealth iconography, snow, and of course, goats. One goat really, who appears in a variety of forms on the game board and appears to own the property where the game is located. The clue here is the big 'G' he's put on the roof of his chalet, which can be seen to the left of the screen, while the rest of the view is a winter scene on a mountainside, as snow falls, covering the surrounding trees. It's a weird mix of different things, but The G.O.A.T has the right amount of sass and gameplay to make it all work.The G.O.A.T also has a Big Time Gaming feel about it as well, in part due to the layout of the game grid, which uses 6 reels, displaying 4 symbols each, and an upper bonus reel holding 4 silver or gold multiplier symbols. Unlike the Megaways mechanic, however, the number of symbols on the reels never changes, so players get a fixed 4,096 ways to win at all times. Medium to high volatile, any device is suitable for getting your GOAT on, where stakes of 10 p/c to $/€100 may be set.At least three matching symbols in adjacent reels from the left-hand side creates a winning way, and there are ten pay symbols on hand. The first six are 9-A card ranks, paying 0.4-0.8x the bet for six of a kind, whereas the four premium symbols are gold watches, sports cars, jet planes, and the goat as the top symbol. Landing a full line win of six high-value symbols gets you a payout of 1 to 10 times your stake. One more regular symbol to close this section is the regular wild, which substitutes for any of the normal pay symbols to help complete wins.The G.O.A.T: Slot FeaturesThe G.O.A.T keeps players busy with a bunch of features, including The G.O.A.T Symbol, three special symbols, a Bonus Activation collection feature, a bonus gamble, and two free spin rounds to choose from.The G.O.A.T SymbolThe G.O.A.T symbol appears on reels 2, 3, 4, or 5 and reveals either X Wilds, X Wins, or Diamond symbols. The multiplier value above these symbols on the top reel is added to them. On the main grid, X Wilds expand to become full reel multiplier wilds, whilst X Wins multiply any wins in view, and the value attached to any Diamonds is added to the Bonus collection meter.Bonus ActivationCollecting 100 or more Diamond symbol values allows players to pick one of 2 bonus games, which comes with 10 free spins. However, before the meter is full, hitting certain collection points lets players gamble what they have collected. Successful gambles trigger free spins, while unsuccessful gambles start the meter from zero again. The two bonus games on offer are:X Wild Free Spins - If the golden X Wild symbol is revealed during this feature, it expands to cover the whole reel and is locked in place for the remaining free spins. Each golden X Wild revealed also adds +1 extra spin. Free spins can be retriggered by filling the diamond meter.X Wins Free Spins - During this bonus round, when X Wins symbols are revealed, they multiply any wins in view and add their value to a global win multiplier for the remainder of the feature. Any revealed golden X Win symbol awards +1 spin, and the bonus is retriggered when the Diamond meter is filled.G.O.A.T BetThese will be jurisdiction dependent, and where available, give players two betting options. Activating the Increased G.O.A.T Chance option increases the stake by 25%, whilst also increasing the chance of hitting G.O.A.T symbols. The second option is buying free spins. The cost of doing so depends on how many Diamonds have been collected in the meter. If the meter is empty, the cost to fill it is 81x the base bet.The G.O.A.T: Slot VerdictThe G.O.A.T was a little bit like playing Relax Gaming's Iron Bank and, by extension, Beast Mode, though not so much the latter. The reason why is the colourful goat character and the stack of features Blueprint Gaming has added in. Speaking of which, it feels like Blueprint might have turned a corner in game design recently, or at least, they're going through a sort of modernising experimental phase. The G.O.A.T and the one before it, Viking Fall, are two examples of the studio deviating away from the more 'regular' Blueprint experiences we've come to expect. However, Viking Fall was an obvious copy of ELK's Gold range of slots, but hey, change often occurs in small increments.The G.O.A.T is more of its own beast and a thoroughly enjoyable one at that. There's a Megaways vibe going on, though, as an evolution of the format rather than an imitation of it. The features have been nicely balanced as well, the Diamond collection system provides a visual goal to work towards, and The G.O.A.T symbol keeps the base game alive. More so, theoretically, if you're okay with spending a bit extra per spin via the G.O.A.T Chance. Even buying free spins to sidestep the collection process comes with a reasonable price tag. Both bonus games have their merits for sure. The X Win growing multiplier can reach impressive proportions, and the sticky wild multiplier, while rare, can certainly be useful. Wins are capped at $250,000 or 50,000x the bet (whichever comes first). While you can likely forget about landing anything even remotely close to 50,000x, The G.O.A.T does pack the sort of features that can perform.The G.O.A.T might not be the actual GOAT, but there is plenty to commend it. As well as the absorbing gameplay, the confident alpha-goat in designer label lederhosen-ish apparel gives the game a charming individuality, all adding up to a neatly playable slot."

title: Camelot Cash
structured_summary: Camelot Cash is an Arthurian-themed slot presented as a stage play, offering a fresh take on the classic legend. It features expanding symbols, a Cash symbol side feature, free spins with up to three expanding symbols, and a feature buy option. The reviewer finds it a pleasant, unique twist on the popular 'book' slot format with solid winning potential up to 5,000x. The game boasts charming paper craft visuals and enchanting stage props, complemented by subtle animations for an engaging audio-visual experience.
review: 2025",7,"Camelot Cash: Slot OverviewJust as the sun is likely to rise tomorrow, barring a catastrophic cosmic event, a software provider somewhere is likely to release another expanding symbol, aka 'book of' slot, sooner or later. This time, it is developer Relax Gaming which has taken on the baton and run with it. The slot is Camelot Cash, and as well as expanding, pay from any reel position symbols in free spins, it drops in a Cash symbol side feature while treating users' eyes to a unique way of viewing the Arthurian legends on the reels.Subtly clever is the way Camelot Cash has been presented. Instead of a pretend trip back in time to the world of Arthur, Merlin, and magic, players instead join an audience for a night of onstage entertainment. Live drama being a sort of magic of its own. Utilising a charming paper craft graphical style, Relax Gaming has layered props on the stage to create a pop-out Camelot, soaking up the sun's rays as clouds on strings move about the sky. The effect is quite enchanting, and it gets better the more you look, making for a refreshing change from the way the Arthurian legends are usually viewed in a slot.Camelot Cash slot - base gameA total of 10 paylines are included with Camelot Cash's 5-reel, 3-row gaming grid. Most of the time, winning combinations begin from the leftmost reel and winning symbols must be in adjacent reels, except in free spins when evaluating expanded symbol wins. The game offers a wide array of bets starting from 10 c per spin and going up to a possible $/€200 a game round. RTP sits at 96.1%, or higher, when buying free spins, while the math model runs highly volatile.Ten to Ace playing card ranks are the low pays, filling players' pockets with 5 to 7 times their bet for a 5 OAK winning line. Filling it further, at 20 to 100 times the bet for a line of 5 matching symbols when made of the higher paying knight, queen, wizard, and king. A sword in the stone is Camelot Cash's wild symbol, paying 100x for a line of 5 of them or substituting for any regular pay symbol.Camelot Cash: Slot FeaturesCamelot Cash slot - special expanding symbol randomizerAnother symbol to be aware of is the Cash symbol. Cash symbols in a winning line award the values they display multiplied by the bet. Possible Cash symbol values range from 1 to 100.Free SpinsThe wild symbol is also the free spins scatter symbol. Landing 3, 4, or 5 scatters awards 8, 16, or 24 free spins plus 1, 2, or 3 expanding symbols, respectively. During free spins, at least one symbol will be an expanding symbol - depending on how many scatter triggers the feature. Expanding symbols can expand to cover the reel and pay even if they are not connected left to right. Hitting 3 or more scatter symbols during free spins awards additional free spins and expanding symbols.Feature BuyCamelot Cash's feature buy costs 60 times the bet and triggers the free spins bonus round when bought.Camelot Cash slot - free spinsCamelot Cash: Slot VerdictOnline gamblers have no shortage of 'book' style games or King Arthur/Merlin slots to choose from. The expanding symbols mechanic has been one of the most popularly used tools by software providers for years, and Merlin, King Arthur, and his merry knights are popular subject matter in their own right. Play'n GO, for example, is a studio that has really taken to the topic and the expanding symbols feature, but many other game makers have gotten in on the action in order to tap into a ready-formed audience.Relax Gaming has as well, but instead of breaking out the cookie cutter, it was gone for a more unique angle, and the sitting amongst an audience approach is a neat touch. Camelot Cash is no revolution, but it brings something new to the 'book' table. Pleasantly new, it should be said, as the graphics draw you in so the gameplay can go to work doing its familiar thing. Another neat touch is the addition of Cash symbols, adding an extra layer of activity. This helps prevent the base game from turning into a complete scatter hunt exercise. Especially since pay symbol values are less than what they are in a 'regular' book slot where the top pay symbol is 500x for a full line rather than Camelot Cash's 100x.Camelot Cash's winning potential has not suffered as a consequence of the decrease, however, as it is able to reach 5,000x, which is about the benchmark figure for these sorts of games. Another little helper is the way players can get up to 3 expanding symbols from the start of a free spins round, depending on the number of triggering scatters. Never a bad thing. Nor is it a bad thing when game makers reuse common mechanics or ideas but manage to pull them together into something fresh and fun like Relax Gaming has done in Camelot Cash."

title: Jaguar SuperWays
structured_summary: Jaguar SuperWays is a jungle-themed slot set in a Central American rainforest, developed by Bad Dingo with a unique grid mechanic. The game features the innovative SuperWays system that expands the grid up to 9x9, creating over 387 million ways to win, alongside cascades and free spins. The reviewer finds it an intriguing debut with solid potential but criticizes the very low 94.3% RTP and mismatched EDM soundtrack. Visually, the game offers a shaded jungle grid with detailed symbols, though the audio feels out of place in the setting.
review: 0.40/10,Out Now,5.5,"Jaguar Super Ways : Slot OverviewNewcomer to the scene, Bad Dingo, quickly teamed up with Yggdrasil to release their debut slot Jaguar SuperWays via the YGS Masters Program. The studio hasn't half-heartedly dipped their toe in the scene for a first release either. The Sydney-based studio has designed a brand new mechanism capable of producing a mind-bending number of win ways. Potential is high as well, though maybe not as high as you might expect given the extraordinary number of ways. If it all sounds tempting, let's step into the jungle and find out more.Judging by the UI, it appears fellow countrymen ReelPlay had a hand in helping with the design as well. It makes sense as both studios are based down under in sunny Sydney. The weather in Jaguar SuperWays' Central American rainforest is probably equally sunny, but a thick canopy of trees keeps much of the light out. Sitting in the warm sticking shade is a grid that starts each new spin in a 5-reel, 3-row default configuration, providing 243 ways to win. A somewhat incongruous thumping EDM track feels a little out of place in this environment, though 'bush doofs' are popular in Australia, so maybe they were an influence.Jaguar SuperWays is available on any device, but it can get a little squeezed on a mobile due to some extreme grid enlargement. One aspect that's a little harder to be positive about is the game's theoretical return value. At 94.3%, it's the lowest non-jackpot figure we've seen in a while. So low to be a possible show-stopper, no matter how exciting the features might be. Volatility has been set to medium, and hits occur 41.28% of the time on average, which is high compared to most slots.The pay symbols consist of 10 tiles, 6 low-pay, 9 to A card royals, and 4 high-pays. These include a gem, a frog, a snake, and a vulture. Values vary depending on how many reels are currently active, ranging from 0.375x to 1.25x the bet for 5 premiums of a kind, rising to 3.75x to 12.5x for 6 of a kind. Jaguars have been put to use as the wild symbols, replacing everything except the temple scatters.Jaguar SuperWays : Slot FeaturesJaguar SuperWays - free spinsThe most interesting part of Jaguar SuperWays is the SuperWays system itself which transforms the grid in all sorts of interesting ways. It's joined by a less interesting round of free spins in comparison to the main feature.Central to the gameplay here is the cascade mechanic. When wins hit, the winning symbols are removed to let new symbols drop into the gaps. On an interesting side note, for players who like to digest every single stat as possible, cascades are limited to 15 at the most or until no new wins are delivered.SuperWays are triggered by little paw icons randomly appearing overlaid on regular pay symbols. If the specific paw carrying symbol is used in a win, a 3x3 sized mega paw print tile is stamped on top of the icon. Symbols beneath it are removed along with the winning combinations, and the 3x3 block becomes active, meaning new symbols cascade into it as well. This extra space remains available for the remainder of the cascade sequence. When no more wins hit, the grid resets back to its default size.While SuperWays expand the space available for new symbols to land, win ways increase exponentially as well. At most, the grid can reach 9x9 in dimension, and at that size, a positively mental 387,420,489 ways to win are in play.The free spins round is triggered when 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, or 8 scatters land to award 7, 10, 12, 15, 18, or 20 free spins, respectively. The main change is the default grid switches to 5x4 in size; otherwise, all of the rules are the same as the base game. Scatters land on all reels except the first reel in the base game only, meaning free spins cannot be retriggered.Jaguar SuperWays: Slot VerdictJaguar SuperWays throws up some pretty impressive numbers, and in practice, good things can happen. When they're not happening, the game’s slight flaky feel becomes apparent, as if a strong wind could blow the whole grid down. The audio-visual mismatch might be enough to irritate some players as well. And though the music is reminiscent of a sweet 80s martial arts-style movie soundtrack, it doesn't fit the jungle scenery. Sure, this isn't the Academy Awards, but details still matter.Overall, though, Jaguar SuperWays is an intriguing first release from Bad Dingo. They've bravely come up with a new mechanic rather than play it cautious, and it is an eye-catching feature too, serving up a huge number of possibilities. Potential isn't quite as impressive as the 380 million+ figure, yet solid all the same as players have the chance to collect up to 22,457 times their stake. How likely that is to happen, however, we do not know, so it's probably best taken with a grain of salt.As to the features, the SuperWays mechanic is a clever one. It’s pretty unique and makes a refreshing break from studios trying to emulate other systems without being too brazen or developers just trademarking a set number of pay ways - as if no one else can use them. Even if you don't manage to crack the full 9x9 size grid, Jaguar SuperWays can reach ludicrous proportions. Similar to ELK's Nitropolis, which also offered a staggering number of ways, you might very well question whether quite so many are needed when the max win can 'only' reach 22,457x.While potential might be considerable, less desirable is the irksome RTP configuration which lets the side down. Why Bad Dingo went so low is anyone's guess, but it's a shame because it taints everything else the game does and may make Jaguar SuperWays off-limits for players who feel they deserve more."

title: Pirots 3
structured_summary: Pirots 3 transports players to a Wild West theme park setting featuring four colorful parrot bandits in a lively, non-traditional Western environment. The game boasts a complex 6x7 grid with multiple innovative features including collecting birds, a bandit escape, a coin game, Showdown duels, train heists, and various upgrade and transform symbols. The reviewer praises the slot for its abundance of extras and engaging gameplay, recommending it especially for fans of feature-rich slots. Visually, the game is bright and dynamic with a playful audio backdrop complementing the vibrant theme and hectic action.
review: 0.20/100,"June 25, 2024",7,"Pirots 3: Slot OverviewIf there is one casino game designer that knows a thing or two about creating a successful series of slots, it is Swedish outfit ELK Studios. The developer has dazzled players through series such as Kane's Gold range, Nitropolis, Toro, and more. Now we learn ELK's range of Fearsome Four parrots has morphed into a trilogy with the release of Pirots 3. A noticeable shift existed from Pirots to Pirots 2, so the expectation was that Pirots 3 would step up by doing things the previous instalments did not. Suffice it to say innovations are on the way.So far, each Pirots slot has been held in completely different environments. The original was a piraty (hence the name) swashbuckling affair; Pirots 2 went to a dinosaur age, while Pirots 3 is a good 'ol Wild Western number. Although, is it the actual Wild West or a theme park version? Only asking because behind the transparent gaming grid, you can see amusement rides, while some of the stores on the street look like tourist stop-offs rather than dank, dingy saloons. That would make sense because the four parrot characters, its bandit, the train, not to mention crazy hectic gameplay contribute to making Pirots 3 about as far from being a dank, dingy slot as it gets.Pirots 3 slot - base gameEach base game spin sees symbols and parrots drop into a 6-reel, 7-row matrix, which is neither cluster, scatterpays, ways, or payline driven. In a twist, the four birds that drop on the grid are primarily how pay symbols are collected. They are powered by a highly volatile math model, producing the usual ELK RTP of 94%, and take bets of 20 c to $/€100 per base game drop. As well as regular betting, Pirots 3 has the usual five X-iter bonus buy options.Pirots 3 drops 4 regular paying gem symbols onto the reels, coloured blue, green, purple, and red. Each gem may be collected by a bird of the same colour. Gems can also be upgraded, so while they begin with payout values of 0.05 to 0.1 times the bet each, they go up to 7.5 to 30 times the bet.Pirots 3: Slot FeaturesPirots 3 slot - super free spinsPirots 3 has four collecting bird symbols that move around the grid. Birds take turns collecting gems of the same colour as they are, and all feature symbols by moving to horizontally or vertically connected adjacent symbols. Birds keep collecting till they cant collect any more, and may move more than once before a symbol refill. There is also a locked-up bandit. When released, the bandit moves around the grid, collecting gems of any colour and all feature symbols.Collection MeterAbove the grid is a symbol collection meter, keeping track of the collected symbols. Only gems or wild symbols collected by any birds except the bandit count. The collection meter is disabled for the bandit escape feature. When the symbol collection meter is full, one pending feature symbol release is added. Up to 3 feature symbol releases can be stacked at the same time, and all are awarded simultaneously. A feature symbol release occurs before dynamite explodes, as part of the first free drop in the bonus game, or when birds cannot collect any more symbols. A feature symbol release converts a number of random gems on the grid into random feature symbols.Feature SymbolsThe feature symbols in Pirots 3 are bonus scatters, wilds, coins, upgrades, transforms, peanuts, keys, and dynamite. A feature symbol's effect is triggered when it is collected.Collected Upgrade Symbol - upgrades the payout level of gems of the same colour as the bird that collected the upgrade symbol by 1-3 steps up to a maximum of level 7.Collected Upgrade All - upgrades all gems by 1-3 steps to a maximum of level 7.Key - when collected, the bandit's escape feature triggers when birds can't collect any more symbols. When released, the bandit is able to collect symbols like other birds. The bandit duels adjacent birds, and if all 4 are defeated, the bandit coin game triggers, and the bandit's escape ends. If the bandit is defeated, the bandit's escape ends.Transform Symbol - when collected, a cluster of gems next to the collector bird are transformed into the bird's colour. A random number of gems may also be converted to feature symbols.Peanut Symbol - when collected, a peanut is placed in empty grid spaces. This makes birds able to cross empty spaces one time each to reach more symbols.Dynamite - explodes when collected, and birds are unable to collect any more symbols. The explosion removes birds from the grid and all symbols except feature symbols, causing a redrop. It also expands the grid to 8-rows and 7-columns. Dynamite comes in two sizes - one that explodes a close proximity area, another that explodes the whole grid.Wild - substitutes for any gem at the current level. Black bandit wilds represent the current highest-paying gem.Coin - a collected coin pays its value times the bet. The Max Win coin pays the remaining amount needed to reach the maximum win. Pirots 3 slot - coin gameCoin GameThe coin game is triggered when the entire grid is cleared by birds or the bandit. Once started, coin bags and scorpions drop onto random grid positions, and the train arrives - Either the bandit or birds get off the train. The symbol collection meter is replaced by a coin game win counter. Birds or the bandit throw lassos to try to collect coin bags. When catching a scorpion, the bird or bandit is out of the game. The coin game ends when no bird is remaining. When the coin game ends in normal mode, new symbols and the 4 birds drop in again.Showdown FeatureTwo adjacent birds may perform a Switcharoo when they can't collect any more symbols, so they swap places. Alternatively, two adjacent birds may trigger the Showdown feature, while 3 or more birds next to each other will always trigger it. For the Showdown, birds move away from each other, removing symbols, then randomly shoot in a number of directions. Symbols in the shooting direction are affected in various ways. Gems are removed. Bonus scatters, super bonus scatters, keys and coins are collected. Dynamite symbols ignite. Other feature symbols are unaffected. After the duel, birds are redropped, and a symbol refill occurs.Train Heist2 or 4 symbol positions on the left and right sides of the grid are marked with a train backdrop. If a bird collects a symbol on a train backdrop and can collect any of the symbols on top of a train backdrop on the opposite side of the game grid, the train heist triggers. The train heist does not trigger in case the bird can reach the opposite side symbols from its current position. When triggered, after the active bird finishes collecting, a train arrives, and the bird gets on. The train travels around the grid, awarding 1 to 3 random feature symbols. The train stops on the opposite side, and the bird gets off to continue collecting.Bonus GameA total of 5 free drops are awarded if the birds collect 3 bonus scatter symbols in a game round. Collecting a bonus scatter in bonus mode awards +1 free spin. The regular bonus game starts with the current rows and columns, whereas the super bonus starts on an 8x7 matrix. The progress on the symbol collection meter and the payout level of gems are persistent in bonus mode.X-iterPirots 3's X-iter options are these:Bonus Hunt - 3x the bet for one drop with quadruple the chance of triggering the bonus.Bandit Jailbreak - 25x the bet for one drop where the bandit's escape is triggered.Coin Game - 50x the bet.Bonus Game - 100x the bet.Super Bonus Game - 500 the bet.Pirots 3 slot - super free spinsPirots 3: Slot VerdictWhether you consider Pirots 3 to be the best thing since sliced bread or a mouldy old bag of apples, we can probably all agree it is absolutely stacked to the rafters with extras. Even more so than the last two games, which were already rich feature-filled slots. Much of the core gaming in Pirots 3 is the same or at least close to Pirots 2, but there is plenty of new stuff here to encourage a look, especially if you liked what came before. It may take time for the birds to do more than pick up a few low-value gems, but when they do, and you can get on the positive side of the game's volatility, then Pirots 3 is able to set up lengthy sequences of events, that might, if lucky, lead to a sizeable monetary result.It is interesting, in a way, though, how much activity can occur on the reels yet still yield a surprisingly low payout. The peanut symbol is good for avoiding this situation since peanuts allow birds to connect to more gem symbols - and feature symbols, which can be game changers. Duels might help keep a spin alive at times, and the longer a spin is able to keep going, the better the chance of something exciting happening. Although, in this regard, Pirots 3 wasn't quite as captivating as initially supposed. Thoughts kept drifting back to ELK's slot Dam Beavers, where those beavers could boogie, break through different levels while looking utterly adorable, and which ultimately gripped the imagination harder. If you missed it, like Pirots 3, Dam Beavers is also a four-character/gem collector game with a lot of add-ons.To sum up, whilst reviewing Pirots 3 was a satisfying experience, there was a hint, out there, on the sun-blazed emotional horizon, of diminishing returns. Again, Pirots 3 was totally fine; it appears to be capable of getting as wild as any other Pirots slot and has the same 10,000x the bet max win. Something held it back from feeling like a major advancement, however. Maybe it was the theme, or, not sure. Anyway, Pirots 3 is a smile-inducing number three in the series, just maybe not as unmissable as the previous two."

title: 1K Yeti

review: 2023 (TBC)",4.5,"1K Yeti: Slot OverviewWhen software provider 4ThePLayer first appeared on the scene, it did so through the debut of 9K Yeti. Or more. The two things to look out for are Yeti Rush free spins and a bonus buy.Yeti Rush Free SpinsYeti footprints in the snow are the free spins scatter symbol, appearing on all reels. Landing at least 3 scatters triggers Yeti Rush free spins. The number of scatters in view, when this occurs, determines the number of free spins awarded. During free spins, one reel is covered by a stacked wild symbol, counting as 1 wild symbol on each of the 3 reel positions. On the first free spin, the stacked wild covers the rightmost reel. On each following free spin, the stacked wild moves one position to the left. If the stacked wild is on the leftmost reel and there is at least 1 free spin remaining, it moves back to the rightmost reel.Buy FeatureThe buy feature is where players can buy the free spins round for 50 times the bet. Instead, 1K Yeti turned out to be closer to a grumpy squirrel than a monstrous mythical beast terrorising explorers tramping mountain ranges on the roof of the world.What does not help 1K Yeti's cause is the weak, limited list of features. The base game is drab; there's nothing to touch on there, and even the free spins round was disappointing. Maybe, and here's a conspiracy theory for the moon landing deniers out there (not judging), maybe 1K Yeti was actually the studio's first slot, like, the beta version of what went on to become 9K Yeti. Now, for the lols, the studio decided to release it anyway. Not in any way saying this is the case, but it would be one way of explaining why it felt like 4ThePlayer took about 10 steps back with this one.Winning potential certainly doesn't haul 1K Yeti from the dustbin, either. Its 1,000x the bet top prize is like a rounding error compared to what is possible in 9K and 90K Yeti. Okay, okay, this game is for players looking for a different kind of gambling experience. Fair enough, fill your boots. Yet even when accounting for that, it was hard not to walk away without feeling 1K Yeti was small and kinda pointless compared to the two games which preceded it."

title: A Dark Matter
structured_summary: A Dark Matter is a horror-themed slot set in Victorian-era Wraith Manor, exploring the uncanny and supernatural. It features a 5x3 reel layout with 5 paylines (winning both ways), three types of wilds, and a free spins round with Super Stacked wilds and win multipliers. The reviewer praises the immersive backstory and design but notes the gameplay is overshadowed by low mid-tier payouts and capped max wins, limiting long-term appeal. The game’s aesthetics evoke a sinister, atmospheric vibe with a solid narrative, though audio details are not highlighted.
review: 6,"A Dark Matter (Slingshot Studios): OverviewSlingshot Studio's A Dark Matter slot bears no relation to the book by Peter Straub of the same name. What it does share with that twisted tale is its place in the horror genre. However, the horror of A Dark Matter slot comes in a more subtle form, what Freud called the uncanny. The uncanny is an event or occurrence that is seemingly ordinary until something unnatural happens to send a shiver up your spine. The Victorians were obsessed with the uncanny and the supernatural, and explored it through mediums, séances, and spiritualism. This is exactly the era that Slingshot Studios has recreated in their latest slot A Dark Matter, set in sinister Wraith Manor where all sorts of odd things can occur.Yes, the house has a name and Slingshot have developed an extensive back story to give the game more depth. Apparently, the town of Stonehurst has been afflicted by troubles at Wraith Manor which is ruled by Lady Eleanor Wraith. Her deceased husband amassed a fortune through shipping and dealt with strange and unusual artifacts. Now, after a series of mysterious disappearances, the town has called in help. It has arrived in the enigmatic Nathan Highmore who is here to get to the bottom of the trouble.With all that going on behind the scenes, Wraith Manor and its plain 5-reel, 3-row setup is a little underwhelming when it first loads. Surprises can happen though, and begin with a trip to the paytable. The first thing that stands out is the fact that the game is limited to 5 paylines, which is a bit odd for a 5-reel slot. Winning combinations can be formed both ways however which, in a way, doubles the paylines.Then there are the combination values which are surprisingly good. Even the 10 - A card suit symbols return a high 0.6x to 14x the stake. From there, it just skyrockets further. The five high pay symbols, in ascending order, are represented by the main characters in the narrative of the Wraith Manor drama, namely Silas Brewer, Molly Perkins, Bertram Lynch, Eleanor Wraith, and Nathan Highmore. The last character is worth a whopping 600 times your stake for five a kind. High variance and with a solid 96.18% RTP, you can play A Dark Matter on all devices from only 0.05 up to €/$50 per spin.A Dark Matter (Slingshot Studios): FeaturesThe free spins round in action with the 2x payout triggeredA Dark Matter is a little light on features as you will discover. At the core of it all are the wilds which come in three different forms. First there's the standard wild which only appears on the three central reels. Like all wilds in this game, it substitutes for all symbols except scatters. Then you have the Stacked Wilds which can land on reels 2 and 4 in the base game. Finally, you also get Microgaming's trademarked Invading Wilds - a full wild stack on reels 2 or 4 will duplicate itself to an adjacent reel and turn it wild. Moreover, a full wild stack on reels 2 and 4 will turn reel 3 wild.During the Free Spins you get all the above mentioned wild features, but with some extra benefits. To trigger it, you have to land 3 scatter symbols on reels 2, 3 and 4 - this will award 12 free spins. You can extend that number, however. Each scatter that lands in view will add 1 extra free spin to your total. What about those benefits then? Well, during the free spins game, the wild stacks are now Super Stacked. It's not actually explained what Super Stacked means, but a qualified guess is that there are probably more of them and that it can appear on any reel. Moreover, a full wild stack on reels 2 and 4 will not only turn reel 3 wild, it will also double your wins.A Dark Matter (Slingshot Studios): VerdictA lot of thought has gone into creating A Dark Matter - not just building a slot but a whole world to go with it. The whole venture feels like it could be an executive’s passion project because a lot of thought has been poured into crafting a holistic experience. Slingshot has even set up a website dedicated to telling the story of A Dark Matter and its five main characters. The danger with focusing too much on the outer layers of a slot is that sometimes it can smother the actual game itself. This isn’t entirely the case with A Dark Matter, but it walks a fine line.It's not only Wraith Manor that is haunted by strange events, the paytable reveals some odd things too. The symbol value may seem great at first glance, but as you start to play the game you become painfully aware of how useless they are. While the five of a kind payouts are excellent, the three and four symbol combinations are significantly lower almost to the point that it becomes a bit ridiculous. Take the top four premiums for example - four of a kind of these will pay 7x, 8x, 12x, 16x, and 20x respectively while a five of a kind combination will give you 60x, 80x, 120x, 160x, and 600x. That is Slingshot Studio's idea of designing volatility it seems. Now, three and even four of a kind combinations are abundant, but too see five premiums appear on a payline is extremely rare. Ultimately, the payouts experienced here are for most part disappointingly low. What's even worse is that the max win seems capped at 2,400 times the stake.Putting wins aside, where A Dark Matter missed an opportunity is ironically with its story. A lot of interest and tension is built via the website, the characters, and the atmosphere. It’s just a shame that there is no real climax. What would have been exciting is if the scatters also launched a showdown between good and evil. Maybe some Cthulhu-esque creature all winged tendrils and slime came bursting Alien style out of Lady Wraith’s chest for an epic battle with Nathan in the basement, perhaps? As it is, A Dark Matter is an oddly unique game, worthy of a test run. Will dedicated players stick around long term? Probably not, but it could quite well be a hit with the casual crowd."

title: Fortuna Gold
structured_summary: Fortuna Gold is a Roman mythology-themed slot featuring the goddess Fortuna and symbols reflecting ancient architecture and culture. It offers multiple features including Coin Collect, Coin Avalanche, jackpot prizes, free spins, Scatter Boost, and feature buys. The reviewer finds it a pleasant, mid-volatile slot with solid max win potential, appealing to a broad audience rather than high-risk gamblers. review: "February 18, 2024",6,"Fortuna Gold: Slot OverviewFor an industry with such a focus on fortune and so reliant on luck, it's surprising we don't bump into the goddess Fortuna more often. According to Wikipedia, Fortuna is the personification of luck, and the goddess of fortune from Roman belief, who retains a presence in Italian culture through phrases such as 'La [dea] fortuna è cieca', 'Luck [goddess] is blind'. This brings us to Fortuna Gold, an online slot from Fantasma Games that shines a spotlight on the Roman Goddess as she is accompanied by a coin collect feature, a coin avalanche feature which sounds intriguing, jackpot prizes, and a free spins round.As a Roman mythology-type slot, players probably expect to see columns, marble, and cloudy spaces of the kind which Fortuna Gold provides. It has a look similar to Thunderkick's Midas Golden Touch, which makes sense since there was a lot of crossover between Ancient Greek and Ancient Roman beliefs. Architecture, too, and Fortuna Gold lays on a pleasant scene, harmonious in its arrangement of visual items.Fortuna Gold slot - base gameReflecting the ideal of symmetry further, Fortuna Gold's 6-reel game grid is arranged in a 4-5-5-5-5-4 symbol pattern. It does not use paylines but rather a ways-to-win system, where winning symbols can land in any row as long as they land on consecutive reels from the leftmost side of the grid onwards. This system creates 10,000 ways to win in what is a medium volatile slot, with an RTP of 96%. When picking a stake, the options are 20 c to $/€1,000 a pop.From the top of the paytable downwards, Fortuna Gold has 3 character symbols as its high pays, 3 gems as its medium pays, and Q, K, A as its low pays. Hitting a 6-matching symbol combination awards 1x the bet for the lows, 1.5x for the mids, and 2.5 to 5x the bet for the high-pay symbols. In the base game, wilds may land on reels 2, 3, 4, and 5, substituting for all regular symbols in win evaluations.Fortuna Gold: Slot FeaturesFortuna Gold slot - Fortuna Coin Avalanche featureAs for features, it's time to inspect Fortuna Gold's Coin Collect feature, jackpot prizes, Fortuna Coin Avalanche, free spins, Scatter Boost bet mode and feature buys.Coin CollectCoin symbols land on reels 2 to 5 in the base game and in the Fortuna Coin Avalanche, carrying values of 0.25 to 25 times the bet. Coins can land on all reels in free spins. Collect symbols may land on the leftmost and rightmost reel in the base game. When Coin symbols and a Collect symbol are in view at the same time, the Coin values are awarded.Jackpot PrizesJackpots can be won from the free spins round or the Furtuna Coin Avalanche. The values are 10x, 50x, 200x, 1,000x, or 5,000x for the Mini, Minor, Major, Mega, or Grand, respectively.Fortuna Coin AvalancheLanding 2 Collect symbols in the base game triggers the Fortuna Coin Avalanche feature. The feature is played on reels 2, 3, 4, and 5, with the other outer 2 reels removed. Non-Coin symbols are also removed, and the round starts. Only Coin symbols or blanks may land, and blanks are removed between Avalanches. The feature continues until no new Coin symbol Avalanches in or when all positions are filled. Filling a row with Coin symbols unlocks the corresponding Jackpot. At the end of the feature, Coin values and the highest achieved Jackpot are paid out.Free SpinsLanding 4 scatter symbols on reels 2-5 in the base game triggers 10 free spins. Each position becomes an individual spinning reel, landing only blanks, Coins, Jackpot symbols, or Thunder symbols. Each position has a persistent multiplier that starts at x1 and can be increased up to x5. The value of Coins is multiplied by the position multiplier before being paid out. The multiplier of a position where a Coin landed is increased by +1 at the end of the spin. Should a Thunder symbol hit, the multipliers of a random number of positions are increased.Hitting 4 scatter symbols on reels 2-5 awards +5 extra free spins, and free spins can be reactivated up to 4 times. To get your hands on the Jackpots in free spins requires landing the Jackpot symbol. The first Jackpot symbol unlocks the Mini, and each Jackpot symbol after that unlocks the next Jackpot Prize. At the end of free spins, the biggest achieved Jackpot is paid out.Scatter Boost Bet Mode and Feature BuysActivating the Scatter Boost mode increases the chance of triggering free spins by a factor of 2.06. Doing so increases the bet by 25% and has an RTP of 96.19%. Players can also buy the Fortuna Coin Avalanche for 40x the bet or free spins for 80x the bet. Both have an RTP of 96.36%.Fortuna Gold slot - free spinsFortuna Gold: Slot VerdictSo, does playing a slot featuring a pixelated version of a fortune goddess provide more luck? Hmm, the cold steel of mathematics no doubt cuts through all that, but it was good to see an unfamiliar character up on the screen. It makes a nice change from the ongoing Hades or Zeus slots, which continually pour forth onto the gambling market. On the subject of market, it feels like Fortuna Gold aims itself at the masses rather than looking to cater to gamblers who prefer tightly wound, massive potential, and prickly-to-the-touch coin collect-type slots. It also feels like it should do quite well amongst its target audience, too, thanks to its pleasant artwork and varied selection of features.Other plus points for those in Fortuna Gold's scope are the relatively reasonably priced bonus buys. They should come in handy for those struggling to patiently keep a lid on their excitement, too, since free spins have a hit frequency of 1 in 320, which isn't super frequent. Not sure about the frequency of the Fortuna Coin Avalanche feature, though. This Fantasma Games has not provided. Max win has been, however, and the 5,542x the bet figure should be enough of a plump red cherry on top to satisfy prospective punters.In wrapping up, Fortuna Coin Avalanche was an alright game to test run (yeap, that was the third time the word 'pleasant' has been used in the review), which might not light the scene on fire like Vulcan's forge, but it's got some decent ideas in it for gamblers in the mood to take on a mid-tier coin collect slot."

title: Rumble Ratz Megaways
structured_summary: Rumble Ratz Megaways features a medieval rodent theme set in a warm, candle-lit kitchen with a curious cat. The game offers unique features like K-Cash collections, progressive multipliers, free spins, and HyperBonus purchases, deviating from typical Megaways mechanics. The reviewer finds it distinctive but somewhat restrictive, with modest win potential despite a max payout around 5,000x the bet. review: 0.25/37.50,"August 10, 2022",6.5,"Rumble Ratz Megaways: Slot OverviewWhile software provider Kalamba Games was quick to the Megaways licensing party, the studio certainly hasn't gone hog wild with it. Quite the opposite, really, and since Machina Megaways was released, we haven't heard many peeps. That is until now, as Kalamba has dusted off BTG's engine for use in an online slot called Rumble Ratz Megaways. One thing Kalamba Games often does is make online slots which deviate from the norm. Rumble Ratz Megaways is one of these, which shuns the usual features adorning a typical Megaways game, instead offering devices like K-Cash collections and free spins with a K-Cash progressive multiplier.K-Cash symbols appear in the form of cheese, and Rumble Ratz Megaways is a game based around rodents in the Middle Ages. Interestingly, rats apparently prefer a number of foods over cheese, with research revealing peanut butter to be their favourite. The cheese story is said to have originated in the Middle Ages when cheese was one of the few food types that could be stored outside of jars back then. When rats broke into storage spaces, they naturally went for the food left out in the open, which tended to be meat and cheese. Apparently, they don't actually like the smell; go figure.Rumble Ratz Megaways slot - base gameRumble Ratz Megaways is set in an olde kitchen full of hanging pans, glowing heat sources, barrels, pumpkins, and a curious cat poking its head around a six-reel game panel. It has a warm, candle-lit look, and a magically minded soundtrack, with further sound effects that integrate with the reels. Piles of K-Cash cheese line the top of the game grid and the scene is set to try and get some paws on them.A highly volatile game, Rumble Ratz Megaways has a theoretical return value of 96.21%, which can increase when buying certain HyperBounses. Each of the 6 reels on the grid holds 4-6 symbols, providing anything from 4,096 to 46,656 ways to win. Regular wins are awarded when matching symbols land on adjacent reels, starting from the left-hand side. Any device can be used to play Rumble Ratz Megaways, which takes bets of 25 p/c to $/€37.50 per spin.Onto the paytable, where low pays are card royals 9 to A and high pays are five cute rat character symbols. Landing six-of-a-kind wins are worth payouts of 2 to 2.6x the bet when made up of the low pays, or 3-5x the bet for six premiums. Helping link wins together is a cheesy-looking wild symbol, which substitutes any regular pay symbol. Wilds appear on reels 2-5 in the base game and reels 2-6 in free spins.Rumble Ratz Megaways: Slot FeaturesRumble Ratz Megaways slot - free spinsIn your regular Megaways game, the number of symbols on each reel randomly changes on each spin. Rumble Ratz Megaways isn't quite like that. Instead, at the start of a session or when changing bet sizes, positions on each reel are covered by blocker tiles that have no value – keeping in mind there will always be at least 4,096 ways to win. When K-Cash symbols land, they add their value to the specific K-Cash meter located above them, and there is a chance one blocked position on the reel is unlocked. When a reel is 6 symbols high and a K-Cash reset symbol lands, the cash is awarded, and the reel resets to four positions.Free SpinsLanding 3, 4, 5, or 6 scatter symbols awards 2.5x, 6.25x, 12.5x, or 18.75x the bet, plus 3 free spins. For free spins, the reels are set to 4 positions high, and multiples of the bet are placed in each K-Cash meter. When K-Cash symbols land, their values are added to the respective meter, and if the reel is less than 6 symbols high, they remove one blocker. Each time a blocker is removed, free spins are reset to 3. Also, when a reel reaches 6 symbols high, it progresses the win multiplier. At the end of free spins, the K-Cash meters are added, and the multiplier is applied to the total.HyperBonusPlayers can choose from three HyperBonus options, where possible. Paying 60x, 100.4x, or 140.6x the bet buys you three free spins with K-Cash multipliers up to x4, x7, or x10, respectively.Rumble Ratz Megaways slot - bonus buy optionsRumble Ratz Megaways: Slot VerdictWell, it's hard to accuse Kalamba of being Megaways band waggoners, and like Machina, Rumble Ratz Megaways avoids any Bonanza-clone accusations. It's actually quite unique for a Megaways slot in just about every regard. It doesn't have varying symbols and ways on each spin, there's no reaction feature, and while there is a progressive multiplier, it is not tied to cascades or ways wins in any way. In fact, if Kalamba had left off the word 'Megaways' from the title, Rumble Ratz Megaways could easily pass for a slot unassociated with the popular game engine.So Rumble Ratz Megaways is unique, is it any good? In the right hands, players may enjoy the cute Mediaeval atmosphere, avoiding cats, piling on cheese to increase K-Cash meters and opening up the game grid. It did feel quite restrictive, though, for want of a better word. K-Cash values tend to be low, as are symbol values, making it hard to gain major traction and build something remarkable. Even in free spins, when a multiplier is added to the mix, the results were rarely impressive. While the max win might be respectable enough at around 5,000x the bet, it's hard to see Rumble Ratz Megaways firing off enough cheese to get there. Not saying it's impossible, but inbuilt inhibitors like blocker tiles and free spin/multiplier limits would suggest doing so would be tough.Perhaps if Ratatouille on the reels appeals, then it might be possible to get a few smiles out of Rumble Ratz Megaways. It does go about business in its own way, so good on Kalamba for being different and not following the Megaways herd. However, Rumble Ratz Megaways' rebellious spirit did seem like it was being held in check. So instead of feeling like the game could break loose and soar at any moment, it came off as restrained, a little boxed in, a bit like the caged cat during the free spins bonus round."

title: Jin Ji Bao Xi: Endless Treasure
structured_summary: Jin Ji Bao Xi: Endless Treasure is a Chinese-themed slot centered on luck and traditional symbolism. review: "Jin Ji Bao Xi: Endless Treasure: ReviewIs it just us or do Chinese-themed slots have a tendency to look as exciting as a bowl of rice, forcing you to endure a steady diet of tacky symbolism and traditional background music? This Scientific Games powered slot developed by Shuffle Master even comes with a translation page where we get to learn that the title, Jin Ji Bao Xi, carries the meaning of good luck and good news. Nothing makes you as happy as learning a bit of Chinese while frantically scrolling through the help file in search of actual useful information such as RTP, win potential and volatility.As you can tell, it's with agony of mind and utter disgust we're taking on the task of reviewing Jin Ji Bao Xi. In all honesty, it's not just because of the god awful generic visuals, the slot is a complicated mess too. But what if there is a golden nugget hidden deep within? It's our job to find out.A land-based conversion, Jin Ji Bao Xi comes with 5 reels and 243 ways to win and as can be expected from a jackpot slot, the 95.65% RTP is slightly lower than what we usually see in online slots. The animals are all of the same value, giving you 20 times your stake for a 5 symbol combination. With the highest level activated you'll win 250 times your stake should you land 5 dragons across a full payline.Jin Ji Bao Xi: Endless Treasure: FeaturesShou bonus in actionJin Ji Bao Xi is a slot rich in features - this is what's on offer:Golden Chance feature - can transform any standard premium symbol into its golden equivalent if you land a wild symbol on the middle reel. Winning combinations also benefit from a multiplier of 2x.Fu Value feature - comes into play in the bonus feature. There's a coin value attached to the bonus symbol that is randomly chosen from a set of pre-defined Fu values. When they these bonus symbols land on the reels, the values are added to the pot above the reels.Bonus feature - triggered when at least 6 bonus symbols appear anywhere on the reels simultaneously. Starting with 6 free spins you'll get 6 options, adding extra golden symbols to the reels during the bonus feature. There's also a golden coin in play here which acts as a wild and only appears on reels 2, 3 and 4. Also, above the reels you'll see a pot where all the Fu Value hits are collected. When the round is over, the pot is awarded to you.Top Up feature - basically a streak spin game, available as a 6th option when you trigger the bonus. The bonus symbols, complete with their Fu value, remain on the reels as respins ensue. What you want is for additional bonus symbols or yellow or green coins to land. When the yellow coin appears, it will give you the total amount from the Fu value bonus coins from that triggering spin. Even better is the green coin, awarding the accumulated totals from it all - the Fu value bonus symbols as well as the yellow coins. The Top Up feature can pay up to 2304 times your stake (Grand Jackpot).Jin Ji Bao Xi feature - the jackpot feature can also be randomly triggered. There are 4 jackpots on offer here - Mini, Minor, Major and Grand.Jin Ji Bao Xi: Endless Treasure: VerdictJin Ji Bao Xi is not a slot you simply just fire up and start spinning - we recommend you try it out in demo mode first. Initially, we had no idea what was going on and just looking at this cluttered mess gave us a headache. Even writing this review was somewhat a challenge. We appreciate when developers try to come up with new twists and plots, but it gets a tad bit overwhelming here unfortunately.Boredom sets in quickly partly because the recycled theme. A slot suggests that there's some sort of meaning to the proceedings, some type of reward for trudging through this nonsense. The only reward you'll get is the realisation a few minutes in that no one is forcing you to play this dreck, and that you can simply move on. We're not exactly sure what the max win potential is but as stated in the help file there is a cap of 250 000€ on max bet which equals to 2,800 times your stake.Don't MissThere is a Megaways version available utilizing the highly popular Megaways engine simply titled Jin Ji Bao Xi Megaways."

title: Dragon Match Megaways

review: Out Now,7.5,"Dragon Match Megaways: OverviewiSoftBet move away from the African savannah of Majestic Megaways and back onto familiar ground with their third Megaways powered slot, Dragon Match Megaways. Also, 2 Dragon Match scatter symbols in view in the horizontal reel add 5 additional free spins.Dragon Match Megaways: VerdictiSoftBet has racked up a large number of frequent flyer miles to the Far East, but they still manage to mix up their latest Megaways slot to a degree. The Dragon Match feature is also a welcome touch, though not super effective a lot of the time. And on that subject, premium symbols are a tad shy as well. Despite all that, Dragon Match Megaways offers something a little different. You don’t come across too many 4 reel slots which aren’t choking on fruit symbols, so a Megaways option might appeal to certain players.Where Majestic Megaways was a textbook example of a standard Megaways slot, Dragon Match Megaways changes up the format so it gains a point or two for trying something diverse. At the end of the day, one of the biggest winners here is Megaways itself. By dropping a couple of reels and changing up combo lengths and values, Dragon Match Megaways is another example of how versatile the famed engine can be.Then again, Megaways purists may judge iSoftBet guilty of underutilising its capabilities, while players not smitten with the engine in general, still won’t be convinced. Although, packing potential in the region of 10,000x+ will help plead its case with the general slots playing public. All up, Dragon Match Megaways isn’t a bad game and we can't help but feel somewhat impressed by iSoftBet's new change in direction as of late."

title: Big Bass Floats My Boat
