A wild symbol is present on all three reels, as well, substituting for all paying symbol types. Wilds count as a paying symbol variation should 3 of them be in a winning line.Gladiator Clash: Slot FeaturesGladiator Clash slot - base gameThe features in Gladiator Clash mostly revolve around winning prizes from the prize reel and various boosts players can get to do so. There's also a Lion Bonus round, which triggers after a certain number of scatter symbols have been collected, or it can be bought.Base Game FeaturesPrize Reel - The prize reel sits to the left of the 3x3 regular symbol landing grid. Possible prize values which can appear on the prize reel vary from 1x to 500x the bet. When three matching symbols land along a payline, the prize on the prize reel associated with them is awarded.Reel Respin - At random, when 2 reels are filled with 1 paying symbol type, they lock together with the prize reel, and the third reel respins.Prize Respin - At random, when the prize reel contains a value of 50x or higher, there is a chance it locks and a respin is awarded.Prize-Up! - Randomly, when a winning line is formed, the prize for the line is increased, and the winning combination pays again.Lion BonusLanding 1 lion scatter symbol on the reels progresses the collection bar by +1 point. The bar takes 20 points to fill, and when it is filled, the Lion Bonus is awarded. For the Lion Bonus, players pick n' click lion symbols to reveal prizes or Thumbs-Up symbols. Revealing 3 instances of the same prize awards its value. Should a Thumbs-Up symbol be revealed 3 times, the bonus upgrades to the next level. The levels in the Lion Bonus are:Level 1: contains three of each of these - 3x, 5x, 10x, 20x, and the Thumbs-Up symbol.Level 2: contains three of each of these - 5x, 10x, 20x, 50x, and the Thumbs-Up symbol.Level 3: contains three of each of these - 10x, 20x, 100x, 500x, and 1,000x.Feature BuyFor 25 times the total bet, players can buy the Lion Bonus. It plays the same as if triggered organically and has an RTP of 96.16%.Gladiator Clash slot - bonus gameGladiator Clash: Slot VerdictA funny one, this one. Gladiator Clash does a lot of good and/or interesting things that make checking it out a non-waste of time. The game's appearance, for one thing, is a credit, as NetEnt has brought the thrill of the arena to a gambling game really nicely, and its surrounding visuals have a pleasing weight to them. Even so, it's hard to imagine what the roller coaster of emotions triggered by rushing out onto the sand to do battle against trained warriors would have been like. Doing so before thousands of cheering people who probably couldn't care less if you lived or died so long as you put on a good show must have produced a raging cocktail of fear, excitement and adrenaline. And imagine winning; there'd be a whole, different suite of emotions throbbing through your body.Imagine winning in Gladiator Clash, and the emotions will probably be nowhere near extreme. This is because, despite being a highly volatile slot, Gladiator Clash taps out at 1,006x the bet. There are mixed feelings about this. On the one hand, it's not much, is it, especially considering it's a highly volatile game with high risk and low rewards. On the other hand, for a 3x3 slot with limited prizes on offer, 1,006x feels like a fitting amount as well, in some ways.Aside from a possible lack of interest caused by the low max win, the rest of Gladiator Clash has been neatly done. As well as the high-quality artwork, the gameplay is quite unique, which makes a nice change, and the bonus buy is 'cheaply' priced comparatively speaking; as such, certain gamblers may be totally on board with what Gladiator Clash has to offer."

title: Bounty Raid
structured_summary: Bounty Raid is a Western-themed slot featuring a rare female bounty hunter as the protagonist. The game offers a single main feature: a respin bonus triggered by the bounty hunter scatter, with bandits and gold coins boosting prizes. review: 6,"Bounty Raid: OverviewDeveloper Red Tiger lines up to release another one of them thar’ Western-themed slots. This time, the focus is on a less popular gaming character – the mysterious bounty hunter.In an even bigger twist, we get a female bounty hunter as the hero of the show. However, other than a slight character shakeup, and an okay feature, there isn’t much else to get super jazzed over. After delving into its world of goodies, baddies, and badasses, we can all be the judge.It has to be said that Bounty Raid is a pleasing game to look at. Whatever else you might think of Red Tiger’s products, they are rarely hard on the eyes. The standard 5-reel, 10-payline reel set is bordered by some nice cowboy styling, all skulls on curved framing which would sit perfectly in any Saloon from here to Santa Fe. The background is an all-action chase scene from a bounty hunter’s eye view. It’s a bit different and coupled with the soundtrack provokes a nice first impression.From there it’s onto bet selection where players can take part in the Western action from 10 p/c to $/€100 a pop. Hit rate and volatility share the same score at 3 out of 5, so when mixing in the low potential, you don’t exactly have a hardcore bounty hunt on your hands.Simplicity is the name of the game when it comes to rules, starting with an easy to follow 10 paylines on which to land winners. Combinations are formed by 3 or more matching symbols on one of the paylines, left to right, from the first reel as you’d probably expect.There is something about the Wild West that makes it ideal for basing slots around, and symbol options are a particularly fertile area. Bounty Raid’s paytable starts with a bunch of steel-rimmed card suits – diamonds, hearts, clubs, and spades leading the paytable off. These are supplemented by the high pays – boots, hats, saddles, pistols, and a big ‘ole chest of gold coins. Five of a kind payouts range from 1x for the clubs, up to 8x for a line of gold chests. Interestingly, Red Tiger has decided to omit a wild symbol, but there are a bunch of special symbols to cover in the next section which help boost payouts.Bounty Raid: FeaturesBounty Raid - free spinsThe rough-riding bounty hunter is the star of Bounty Raid and the key to its only feature. This chesty dame, who you wouldn’t want to mess with, appears as a non-paying 1x2 sized scatter symbol on the third reel only. When she does land, all bandits in view on the reels are locked for the Bounty Hunter respin feature.Now, if a new bandit symbol or gold coin symbol lands, the respin feature is retriggered. Each bandit displays a prize which gets collected as the feature progresses, offering individual values of up to x50 at the most. If no new symbols appear, the combined total of the bandit values are tallied up and paid out.Two more symbols may appear during respins – the Sheriff, and the Gold Coin. Whenever a gold coin lands, it increases the value of all visible bandit symbols. The Sheriff is also useful, because if he lands, he rounds up the bandits, combining all of their values. Only one Sheriff can appear at a time, on any reel, except the middle one.Bounty Raid: VerdictThe initial impression of Bounty Raid was quite good thanks to the decent audio and visuals, an area where Red Tiger often shines. But, a few spins later, Bounty Raid was like swigging too hard on pappy’s moonshine – the situation quickly slid downhill.One of the main issues is a lack of motivation. Other than the pleasant Wild West atmosphere, Bounty Raid lags in just about every other department. Low on features, low on thrills, low on potential. No doubt, there will be players who will sign up for a casual raid, dazzled by the premise. But it is a puzzler when you consider how many more appealing Western-themed slots there are to choose from.Aside from Domino Harvey, you don’t often hear about female bounty hunters, so kudos for the girl power shout out perhaps. Apart from that, there is little else to get excited about when playing Bounty Raid. Potential is a major drawback for one. At 1,000 times the stake, few real-life bounty hunters would bother picking up the contract. It just wouldn’t be worth their while. Especially when there are far bigger prizes in the iGaming West along with higher RTPs and more exciting features. To be fair, the respin bonus can be alright when it gets a good momentum going. But respins are all there is, so when you’ve seen them once, well, that’s all folks as Daffy would say.In summation, perhaps Bounty Raid will suit those dipping a tentative toe in the Western genre for the first time and don’t want too wild a ride. Not everyone wants to bareback the roughest bronco in the stable after all. Still, most want some bang for their buck which will be tough to find playing Bounty Raid."

title: Aquanauts

title: Sweetopia Royale

review: 2024",7.5,"Sweetopia Royale: Slot OverviewSoftware provider Relax Gaming's decided it's their turn to virtually assault your ivories with the release of the candy-themed game Sweetopia Royale. Respins continue as long as the cluster grows. When no more respins occur, the win is paid out. Additional feature symbols may land on respins awarding modifiers, which may improve and enlarge clusters. When modifier symbols hit and more than 1 cluster is preset, it acts upon a randomly chosen symbol.Candy Cannon – 2 to 8 symbols matching a cluster are added to the reels.Sweet Upgrade – upgrades the cluster and all matching symbols to the next higher value symbol.Candy Cluster – symbols matching the cluster on the same reels or rows are attracted to the cluster.Random FeatureAt the start or end of a game round, a random feature may be awarded. If the random feature forms a win or enlarges a cluster, the game round continues.Sweet Surprise - a 2x2, 3x3, or 4x4 sized mystery symbol is added to the reels, revealing a pay symbol or a coin symbol.Lucky Respin - when a game round ends, a lucky respin may be awarded, respinning all symbol positions adjacent to an active cluster.Cluster ComboClusters of different symbols that are vertically or horizontally adjacent to each other combine to form larger clusters. The Candy Cannon, Sweet Upgrade, and Candy Custer modifiers can be upgraded during free spins. A modifier is randomly upgraded, and +1 extra free spin is awarded every 5 respins. When all modifiers reach their max level, +1 additional free spin is awarded every 5 respins.Candy Cannon – 2 to 8 symbols matching a cluster are added to the game area for each level reached. It starts at level 1 and goes up to level 5.Sweet Upgrade – upgrades the cluster and all matching symbols to a higher value symbol based on the level. It starts at level 1 and goes up to level 5.Candy Cluster – symbols matching the cluster on the same reels or rows are attracted to the cluster. When upgraded all symbols between the cluster and matching symbols on the same reels or rows convert to the same symbol as the cluster. It starts at level 1 and can go to level 2.Buy FeatureThe cost for buying free spins is 60x the bet, or 50x the bet to buy Candy Coin Respin. The RTP when buying features is 96.5%, regardless of the option chosen.Sweetopia Royale slot - free spinsSweetopia Royale: Slot VerdictCandy slots are by their very nature sweety pie events, but Relax Gaming has taken things to the next level with Sweetopia Royale. So much so that the saccharine voiceovers and cute-as-a-button character might be a little too much for some players to stomach. It's not a cluster pay slot with a cascading system that leads to modifiers when certain numbers of winning symbols have been collected, though, which may surprise. There can be times when little to nothing is really taking place on the reels, yet the extras muscle in now and then, as well as smatterings of coin action, which is a popular addition at the moment with a studio like Push Gaming being one strong proponent of the coin.Sweetopia Royale's cherry on top is a modest for Relax Gaming max win of 5,000x the bet, the same amount as hitting a full screen of the highest paying cake symbol, just to reiterate. It seems that Relax Gaming is aiming at a more middle-ground audience with Sweetopia Royale, one that appreciates sickly sweet cluster slots with loads of features rather than the keyboard bandits drawn to the studio's heavy hitters."

title: Druids' Dream

review: "Druids’ Dream (NetEnt): OverviewDruids’ Dream is the latest Celtic themed slot from Swedish developers NetEnt. title: Golden Glyph
structured_summary: Golden Glyph is an Ancient Egypt-themed slot featuring a 7x7 grid and cluster pays system. review: 8,"Golden Glyph (Quickspin): OverviewQuickspin is taking players on another trip back to Ancient Egypt in this feature-rich slot. It’s not the first time Quickspin has used the Egyptian theme, but they haven’t made it as unique or so lucrative as in other Egypt slots previously. Even in stills and thumbnails, the beauty of Golden Glyph is immediately apparent. Quickspin’s graphic design team have done an amazing job both with the symbols, and the magnificent background. It just takes you there. It conjures up the otherworldly nature of the land of the Pharaohs. Somewhere achingly mystical to spin its 7x7 grid packed with an array of intriguing features that includes power wilds and a collection of power-up modifiers among other things.In a first for Quickspin, winning combinations are formed when similar symbols land in clusters, rather than paylines. Golden Glyph also uses a tumbling reels mechanic where winning clusters are removed from the board to let others tumble into place which can lead to consecutive winners from just one spin - at least five symbols are needed to form a cluster. A popular genre at the moment, and one that works perfectly with the 7x7 grid format. Medium variance, wagers can be had for as low as 20c/p or set as high as $/€100 per spin. For that, players get an above-average RTP of 96.19% and quite decent maximum payout possibilities.In terms of symbols, four Egyptian hieroglyphs make up the lower end of the paytable and offer decent value from 0.1x to 18x the stake for clusters of be between 5 and 15+ symbols. The top three symbols are represented by Tutankhamun, Cleopatra, and Horus the falcon god. The latter is the most rewarding, giving you 250 times your stake for a cluster of 15+ symbols. The golden wild marked by a ""W"" is the standard wild - it substitutes for all regular symbols.Golden Glyph (Quickspin): FeaturesFree spins bonus in actionQuickspin have paired the 7x7 grid with a suite of extras that complement it nicely. Frequently, players will come across the Power Wild as it appears in one of the empty spaces following a cluster win. Only one is awarded per tumble, and it appears during both the base game and free spins. If it's used as part of a winning cluster, then it also activates one of the Power-Ups.There are also 4 different Power-Up modifiers available in the game. At the start of each spin, five Power-Ups are chosen at random and displayed on the golden wheel to the left of the grid. The fifth will always be the Free Spins Power Up. When a winning cluster contains a Power Wild, it charges these Power-Ups in successive order until Free Spins are triggered, or a tumble results in no win. If that happens, all live Power-Ups are activated in the order of the wheel.Golden Scarab Power Up: distributes 4 – 10 wilds at random over the grid.Eye of Horus Power Up: picks a low pay symbol and removes all occurrences of it from the gird and triggers an additional tumble. Players receive 1/20th of their stake for each symbol removed.Blaze of Fire Power Up: is placed at a random position on the board and incinerates all base game pay symbols horizontally and vertically and also triggers another tumble. As before, each symbol removed is worth 1/20th of the stake.Free Spins Bonus Power Up: awards 9 free spins.Free Spins cannot be re-triggered, but if the Fee Spins Power Up is activated during this round, then 3 more spins are added to the total every time it does. On the first free spin, the fabled Golden Glyph Wild is placed on the reels in a random space. The game’s namesake is the golden method for obtaining some truly epic wins. Not only does it act like a wild, but it also possesses a progressive multiplier that increases by 1 every time it forms part of a winning cluster. It moves to a new location with every spin, and is capable of reaching the top of the pyramid with a 99x multiplier. In other words, the Golden Glyph Wild is the key to the biggest payouts in the game.Golden Glyph: VerdictWe have to say, Quickspin has successfully blended just the right elements to create their best Egyptian themed slot to date. It is the first time they have gone with a cluster pays system, and it works like a charm, particularly with the 7x7 layout. It’s not quite the first time Quickspin have used a tumble mechanic - we saw a similar device used in Big Bad Wolf with swooping reels, but it has certainly been fine-tuned and carried out in a more modern and sophisticated way with Golden Glyph. Along with top gameplay, Golden Glyph deserves a shout out for its looks. It's a truly gorgeous game that makes playing it all the more fun.At the end of the day, what makes Golden Glyph so compelling is the interplay of its extras and the potential chain of events that are possible. The inclusion of Power Wilds after a win is a brilliant concept, and the way Power-Ups play off each other is a joy when it happens – especially when they are unleashed on the grid. Add a free spins feature capable of providing a multiplier of x99 with wins of up to 13,185 times the stake to that and you have one of Quickspin's best releases of 2019."

title: Treasures of Ra
structured_summary:
1. Treasures of Ra is an Ancient Egypt-themed slot from Stakelogic, featuring familiar motifs like statues, hieroglyphs, and classic Egyptian deities.

review: 2023",7,"Treasures of Ra: Slot OverviewHave you ever repeated what was a pleasant activity so many times it ended up losing its lustre? Watching the same beloved movie one too many times, eating too much of your favourite snack, bouncing on the trampoline too long, could be anything. In the realm of online slots, the repetition of the same theme can make it hard to get really amped up over a new release. Much of this sort of thing we find in Treasures of Ra, which is a handsome enough game, but not the sort of beauty that is likely to halt players in their tracks.Treasures of Ra slot - base gameTreasures of Ra is played on a conventional 5-reel, 3-row gaming panel with 10 fixed betways. Hit a five-symbol winning line, and the rewards are 10-15 times the bet for the 10 to A card royals or 30 to 100 times the bet for representations of Bastet, Anubis, a Pharaoh, and a Fedora-wearing adventurer.Treasures of Ra: Slot FeaturesTreasures of Ra slot - splash screenThe serious-looking bird symbol, not sure if it refers to an Ancient Egyptian deity or not, is Treasures of Ra's Countdown Wild, which appears on all reels and have the same value as the adventurer symbol when creating their own line wins. Alternately, Countdown Wilds are able to substitute for any regular paying symbol and also have two special abilities. When they hit, they may display a number overlay. This number reflects how many spins the Countdown Wild symbol will stick to the reels for. In addition, Countdown Wilds symbols may also land with multiplier values displayed in the lower left to help bolster payouts.Another important symbol to be on the lookout for is the golden question mark symbol, which may land on any reel. When one of these hits, it randomly selects a pay symbol, then stacks its reel and all reels to the left of it with the chosen symbol. Hit a golden question mark on the rightmost reel means the whole grid will be filled with the same pay symbol. However, chosen symbols do not cover any wilds in view.Lastly, scarab scatter symbols offer a way to enter Treasures of Ra's bonus round. This may occur organically, or applicable players can buy 10, 15, or 20 free spins for the cost of 100x, 250x, or 500x the bet. A fourth bonus buy option lets players pay 225x the bet to randomly win 10, 15, or 20 free spins.Treasures of Ra slot - free spinsTreasures of Ra: Slot VerdictLooping back to the first paragraph, while Treasures of Ra might not be one of those unmissable slots that demands to be played at least once, it's still a sturdy Ancient Egypt alternative with one or two tricks up its sleeve to be unleashed. However, stepping back a bit to see the full picture, Treasures of Ra actually boasts a much higher winning potential of up to 20,000x the bet, possibly making it a more tempting proposal for players with a bigger is better mentality. Getting there would be fun, too, not only due to the expanding symbols but chucking in semi-sticky multiplier Countdown Wilds adds a new dimension to the regular expansion procedure.Add it all up, and there is a definite level of entertainment to be uncovered in Treasures of Ra for the right player. It's not a game that is likely to shock prospective users with outrageous visuals nor drag them into highly atmospheric environments like Hand of Anubis did, for example. Instead, it brings together a selection of features which have the ability to be quite potent, while acknowledging the past and looking to the future, a bit like a piece of uncontroversial historical revisionism."

title: Guns N' Roses
structured_summary:
Guns N' Roses slot by NetEnt captures the iconic LA rock band's concert vibe with a 5-reel, 20-payline setup.

review: 8.5,"Guns N’ Roses: OverviewIf there was one band that was guaranteed to fill stadiums in the late 80s/90s big hair era, it was LA rockers Guns N' Roses. Swedish developer NetEnt has taken all of the excitement of their tight jeaned music and crammed it into their branded slot of the same name. The result is the most successful title in NetEnt’s popular trilogy of rock series.At the time of writing, the band still tours, but if you can't make it to a gig, why not get a taste of one with the slot version which comes with a bunch of GNR tracks. Ready to be welcomed to the jungle? Let's sample NetEnt's sweet child of a slot and see how hard it rocks.Hey, we didn't use the concert idea just as a metaphor. The Guns N' Roses 5-reel, 3-row game grid is set at a gig with a crowd that literally leaps around and cheers during the game. Flashing lights against a cloudy sky complete the outdoor concert visuals, and if you squint a bit, use some imagination - you're there, sort of. Get started with stakes that favour a wide variety of betting requirements from 20 p/c up to the rock star level of $/€200 per spin.The game has 20 paylines on which to land combinations of three or more matching symbols for a win. GNR features heavily throughout the paytable with the golden 10-A royals adorned in roses, while the premiums are two album cover guitar picks, Duff, Slash, and frontman Axel Rose.Values for premiums are pretty high and range from 7.5x for the blue pick up to 37.5x for five Axels. The infamous band logo makes an appearance as the wild which substitutes for any of the pay symbols, and can land in 1x1 size or cover full reels which we will see in a moment.Like the wide variety of bets there is a wide variety of RTP settings so make sure to keep an eye out for that before firing up the lads. On the insanely low side it may found at 90.05% all the way up to the insanely high 99.05% depending on the operator settings. GNR will most likely be found at the default RTP of 96.98% which is a pretty generous figure indeed. The math model, meanwhile, has been tuned to a low/medium setting, with a hit rate which varies from 28.33% - 28.49% depending on RTP version.Guns N’ Roses: Features﻿You want features? You'll find plenty here during both the base and bonus game. The main game has three random features - Legend Spins, Appetite for Destruction Wild, and the Solo multiplier to look out for.Legend Spins are activated at random and award 1 stacked wild for the first spin, then 2 respins with 2 stacked wild reels. The Appetite for Destruction Wild feature randomly overlays the reels with the shape of a cross in one of three positions when activated. This cross-shaped wild can substitute for anything except the bonus symbols. Finally, the Solo Multiplier is a random multiplier of x4-x10 that may randomly appear when there is a win on the first three reels.Keeping up with the triple motif, when 3 scatter symbols appear on reels 1, 3, and 5 during the base game, a spin on the Bonus Wheel is awarded which results in one of three things – Encore Free Spins, the Crowd-Pleaser Bonus, or a coin win.Encore Free Spins awards 10 free spins that are not retriggerable. With each free spin, one of the band members lands as a stacked wild on reels 2, 3, or 4. If any matching band member symbols appear on that spin, they also turn wild.The Crowd Pleaser feature is a picking bonus game with three levels. Players choose from 8 musical icons such as instruments, to reveal coin wins, free spins, or +1 pick symbols. On level 1, players start with three picks, with the goal of colleting 60 coins which move them to level 2. On level 2, players get more picks and need to collect 240 more coins to make it to level 3 for more picks. Should players rack up 800 coins or more in level 3, then the total win from the Crowd Pleaser Bonus is doubled. Alternatively, free spins are awarded if players pick at least 3 free spins icons throughout the feature.Last, and kind of least, should the Bonus Wheel stop on the coin win prize, players win from a minimum of 200 up to a maximum of 600 coins.Guns N’ Roses: VerdictSome branded slots can feel like the developer took an old math model, pasted a few familiar images over the top and fired it at players looking for an easy buck. Not so Guns N' Roses, which comes across as a labour of love for fans of the band. The look, vibe and most importantly, the sound has been expertly captured to make players feel like they have standing access at one of GNR's concerts. You can virtually hear every one of Axel's vocals, with Slash's blurred fingers darting across the fretboard.So NetEnt nailed the vibe, how about the gameplay? The good news is that the mechanics and features are just as enjoyable as any other aspect of the game, if not better. The only let down, is the rather truncated potential, though with the lower volatility, wins land theoretically more frequently than a high variance beast which will suit gamblers who like a steady stream of hits.To sum up, NetEnt's Guns N' Roses is a slot that rocks hard. The band's ethos has been captured well and the game overflows with effective features. Guns N' Roses is definitely one for fans of the group, or any player looking for a gentler, feature-rich slot with plenty going on."

title: Alien Antix

review: 2020",6,"Alien Antix (Blueprint Gaming): OverviewCancelledMerely a few weeks have passed since Blueprint Gaming dropped their first-ever grid slot on the betting community. In the background galaxies swirl and energy blasts strike the purple alien planet below. The soundtrack is a sort of futuristic Samuel J Hoffman Theremin sounding tune that fits the visuals nicely. All are new to the game, and all are cute wee space monsters. They are more Monster Inc. style creatures than HR Geiger. There is no official word on volatility, but expect it to be on the medium/high side. Dragonfall was famously Blueprint’s most volatile slot to date, and the two share similar characteristics. However, a change to the bonus round has shaken up the payout rate and the high intensity rides that Dragonfall could produce. Other than that, the two slots come bundled with familiar features.Alien Antix (Blueprint Gaming): FeaturesLike Dragonfall, the wild symbol is the key to a lot of Alien Antix’s best moments. The wild symbol looks like a swirling atom and can land anywhere on the grid. It can substitute for any other symbol. When it is used to help form a win, it remains on the grid and moves to one of the empty adjacent spaces before the next cascade. Wilds also possess a Win Multiplier that starts at x1. After a win has been processed the win multipliers increases by +1. More than one wild can boost a winning cluster with their combined multiplier for better returns. There is technically no limit to how win multipliers can go.Colossal Symbols is a feature that can appear randomly at any moment of the game. After a tumble, the screen starts to shake, and huge symbols are added to the grid. All of the positions that they cover are converted into the alien on the colossal symbol. The one exception is that they do not convert wild symbols.There is no separate scatter symbol, so this role is also taken up by the wild. When 3 or more appear on the grid, they trigger the Colossal Capers Free Spins feature. This time we get 8 Win Fall free spins. Two more than Dragonfall had and with altered rules. This time there are no sticky wilds for the duration of the feature. Instead, every free spin is guaranteed Colossal Symbols. This change means the free spins round is totally unlike the one seen in Dragonfall.Alien Antix (Blueprint Gaming): VerdictPicture Dragonfall with aliens and nebula's rather than dragons and eggs, and you’ll have a good idea of what to expect. However, the two key changes to the free spins round make them quite different. First off, there are two more of them. Second, wilds are not sticky. You don’t get those endless chains of wandering wilds and multipliers in Alien Antix that are possible with Dragonfall. Nor do you get the frustration when that doesn’t quite happen. On the other hand, Colossal Symbols means wins, of varying sizes, on just about every free spin.These change help separate the two slot. Which is the more preferable comes down to how you would like the free spins to play out. Dragonfall is the more volatile, more all or nothing beast. Alien Antix is a gentler, more rounded slot. Potentially, the game has a win cap of $250,000 or 50,000 times the bet – whichever comes first. Obviously, that’s rather high. But it will be very difficult to threaten that cap unless you are high stakes betting. Realistically, land 25+ of the red guy plus a few wild multipliers and you might crack a 500 – 1,000 times the stake. Without sticky wilds during free spins, it is much harder to build epic chains of multiplying wins than with Dragonfall.All up, Alien Antix may not be as sophisticated and refined as other grid slots on the market, but is nevertheless another decent offering from Blueprint with fun symbols and theme. The overall gaming experience is akin to Dragonfall, yet its differences set it apart from its more volatile sibling."

title: Starz Megaways

review: High (5/5),0.20/100,Out Now,7.5,"Starz Megaways: OverviewHead to the outer rim with Pragmatic Play's slot Starz Megaways, their second to be driven by the popular Megaways engine. In saying that, symbol values are pretty low right across the board. On the low pay side of the paytable are six planet/atom symbols of various colours and shapes. They are followed by 6 precious gems – pink, blue, red, purple, and green with values of 1.2 to 5 times the stake for six of a kind.Assisting players is the red and yellow bursting star which is wild and appears on reels 2, 3, 4, and 5. Whenever a wild hits in the base game, it expands vertically to fill the whole reel. This effect is handy in the main game, yet even better during the bonus.Starz Megaways: FeaturesStarz Megaways - free spins feature with sticky stacked wildsThe saying 'it's not rocket science' seems a rather appropriate way to describe Starz Megaways with just one extra to go over. That doesn't make it bad though, as Starz does have its entertaining moments. It's not your typical Megaways slot either, making it a viable alternative in a sea of Big Time Gaming licensed titles. title: Cleopatra 2
structured_summary:

review: 7.5,"Cleopatra 2: Slot OverviewThe next time you find yourself at the desert, grab a handful of sand and carefully loosen your grip to release the grains. Clichéd, but hey, they are the most prized photo spot in Egypt - a title they've held for several millennia. The acid jazz soundtrack of the original is gone, replaced with something almost as non-traditional. This means, at most, an x50 multiplier will be waiting should players make it to the very end.Cleopatra 2: Slot VerdictAs most will know, we don't review a lot of IGT games here, yet Cleopatra 2 popped up due to the pedigree and popularity of the original slot. However, the original was hugely popular, so there's bound to be a substantial crowd of curious players who might feel drawn to fire up the sequel, if nothing else, just to see what's new. On that front, not a lot, really, which is probably a good thing. It would have been tantamount to the slots form of sacrilege if IGT had decided to give an old classic an uber-modern overhaul.Fortunately for fans, they haven't, but there are a few new things to discover in a game with a palpable physical feel. As mentioned, the music in free spins is absolutely nuts, so when combined with a sizeable hit, it is a strangely exhilarating moment.Combining big potential with familiar looks and feels is almost a guaranteed recipe for success. IGT will be banking on nostalgia to pull in a few return punters and a 50k win number to help others overlook its confusing RTP value."

review: 5,"The 3 Bears: Slot OverviewIn one of the most commonly told versions of 'Goldilocks and the Three Bears', a little girl called Goldilocks enters a bear family's home, eats porridge, sits in chairs and smashes one of them, then falls asleep in just the right bed - before the bears return and wake her up. It's an odd tale of thievery, vandalism, and trespassing, told, presumably in part at least, to put children off engaging in these illegal activities. The story's retelling has made its way into books, film, even opera, as well as online gambling, with one example being The 3 Bears from software provider Four Leaf Gaming.The bears' house, as depicted in The 3 Bears slot, is so charming anyone might be tempted to knock on the door and say hello. Not break in and ransack, of course, but just politely knock and be sociable. The house is nestled into a great tree in a wooded realm that looks ideal for a fairy tale. A gaming matrix built of lashed-together bits of wood holds symbols made of lashed-together bits of wood on its 5-reel, 3-row space, with 15 paylines as indicated by a dripping honeycomb. Very enchanting.The 3 Bears slot - base gameWhen venturing forth into the bears' domain, players are able to stake 10 c to $/€15 per base game spin, and numerous in-game betting opportunities, as well as an ante bet function and a feature buy, are available as well. Theoretically, this highly volatile slot produces an RTP value of 96%, though a lower 94% figure version has also been designed.The bear family, aka Baby Bear, Mama Bear, and Papa Bear, take the place as the game's 3 high-paying symbols, joined by 10-A royals as the low pays. A line of 5 matching royals gets you 2 to 4.5 times the bet; a line of 5 premium symbols pays 10x to 50x. Wilds, when they're on board, substitute for any of the regular paying symbols.The 3 Bears: Slot FeaturesThe 3 Bears slot - free spins gambleLinked cascades in The 3 Bears sequentially transform bear symbols into ever more potent wild symbols. This feature is active in all phases of play - the base game and the bonus game. Other add-ons are the Bonus Booster, the Bonus Replay, and Fortune Features.Wild Bears FeatureThe 3 Bears runs on a cascading reels mechanic where winning symbols disappear from the reels, causing symbols to drop down and replace them. After 2 cascades, all existing and future Baby Bear symbols turn wild. After 4 cascades, all existing and future Mama Bear symbols turn wild with an x2 multiplier, then after 6 cascades, all existing and future Papa Bear symbols turn wild with an x2 multiplier, which roams left or right and moves one reel every spin. If a walking wild ends up on a reel with another wild, it adds that wild's multiplier to its own and becomes a full reel roaming wild. If 2 roaming wilds combine, the direction of the uppermost is the direction the walking wild will move. Transformation progress resets between base game spins.Free SpinsLanding 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols in the base game awards 10, 12, or 15 free spins, respectively. In free spins, cascades turn bears wild as described above, and progress is not reset between free spins.Bonus Booster & Bonus ReplayThe Bonus Booster lets players gamble all or some of their free spins for a chance to win 1, 2, or 3 extra free spins. The more free spins gambled, the higher the chance of winning. The gamble can be repeated, and up to 25 free spins can be won in this way. The Bonus Replay lets players gamble their entire free spins winnings for the chance to replay them on a wheel if the win amount is under a certain threshold. Winning spins replay the free spins feature, but the previous winnings are not carried over. Losing spin returns players to the base game.Fortune FeaturesClicking the green clover button in the bottom left corner is where players can activate Fast Fortunes, which increases the chance of triggering free spins by adding 50% to the stake, or buy 10 free spins for 62x the bet.The 3 Bears slot - free spinsThe 3 Bears: Slot VerdictOne of the first thoughts when assessing The 3 Bears was how closely it resembles Quickspin's classic slot Big Bad Wolf (with a hint of Quickspin's 2012 release Goldilocks as well). Both are steeped in fairytale lore for one thing, for better or for worse, and some of the main features felt like echoes of each other - mainly the pay symbol to wild effect. If you're familiar with Big Bad Wolf, then it will go without saying The 3 Bears system isn't exactly bang on the same, but there are enough connections to cause one to say hmm. As a recap, in Big Bad Wolf, every second consecutive cascading win turns a pig symbol wild until it is possible to have all 3 wild. The same goes for The 3 Bears, though bear symbols don't just turn wild; two have multipliers, and one can roam. Maybe Quickspin will be watching and taking notes for the next BBW instalment.As it stands, powering through consecutive cascades in The 3 Bears can lead to some neat wee toys on the reels. Multipliers are always a welcome addition to any game, and the roaming effect adds a sprinkle of extra icing. The rest of the features are fairly standard add-ons for a Four Leaf Gaming slot, a studio that likes to furnish players with a bundle of extra betting options. The sort that is able to boost the chances of getting a decent bonus round (or repeating a lousy one) or rip undies when the gamble goes pear-shaped. Partaking is optional, of course.The 3 Bears does what it does okay, and avoids doing anything off-putting like spit in your porridge or ruin your favourite armchair. However, it's hard to envisage The 3 Bears lighting up the gambling community's heart the way Big Bad Wolf did."

title: Reel King Megaways
structured_summary: Reel King Megaways revitalizes the classic UK slot with a royal fruit theme blended with Megaways mechanics. review: Out Now,6.5,"Reel King Megaways: OverviewNearly all iconic slots are bound to receive the Megaways treatment it seems. The darling of the UK slot scene, Reel King, has now received one too. Spend more than five minutes playing online slots, and you are bound to run into the series in some shape or form. Players can thank, or blame, Barcrest/Novomatic for the birth of the series all those years ago in what seems like an Edwardian era of gaming. It proved a hit, since spawning a bunch of follow-ups.Red Tiger had a crack at modernisation in Reel King Mega (they came so close there, just missing the ""ways"") which lit up fans, but little else. It took Inspired Gaming to go all way in a two-pronged attack. First, an acquisition of Novomatic’s Gaming Technology outfit, the second, ramming on the licensed Megaways engine from Big Time Gaming. The result is quite the hybrid you’d expect it to be. The classic elements are there, but so are a large number of new features shaking up the gameplay. Overkill or overdue? You’ll know the answer very shortly.Driving the action is, of course, the Megaways apparatus. For Reel King Megaways, that means 6 rows with 2 to 7 symbols on each. Every spin turns up a different number of symbols, resulting in win ways as ‘low’ as 324 or as high as 117,649. Keeping track of combinations is relatively easy though since three or more matching symbols left to right in any row form a winner (from the leftmost reel).Visually, Inspired Gaming has done a good job of reproducing the spirit of the older series. A rather plain blue wall sits quietly in the distance while the symbols sit on all white tiles, conjuring up the gaming days of yore. Yet, cast your eyes to the left to the multi-sectioned meter, and you know the King’s got a trick or two up his sleeve. One detail they got wrong, however, is the aspect ratio of the Megaways logo. Not a big issue, but yeah.There isn’t much audio happening during the base game, apart from a hypnotic ditty each time the reels spin. Other than that, it’s pretty peaceful. It all changes when the features are triggered though. Then you’ll feel like you’ve stepped right into an upper-class ball, with some of the jolliest Back inspired harpsichord action you are likely to hear on a slot.Playable from 20 p/c to $/€20 per spin, and with a solid 96.23% RTP, Reel King Megaways is not particularity volatile by default, but with the gambling options on offer, it can be extremely volatile if you want it to be. Brutally so actually.The pay symbols are those familiar cherries, plums, watermelons, 9-A royals, and bags of coins. Coin bags are best since only 2 are required to pay a reward, while 6 of them are worth 50 times the stake. Up above the main reel area is a horizontal 4 position reel. Here is where the jester hat wilds may land, substituting for any other pay symbol when they do.Reel King Megaways: FeaturesReel King Megaways - free spinsReel King Megaways’ features are a mix of old and new, including Cascades, Lit Reels, the Reel King Feature, and Free Spins. Cascades are your standard Megaways mechanic. Every combo triggers a cascade which removes the winning symbols from the reels. New ones fall into the spaces for more chances to win. The cascade feature continues to run as long as winners keep falling.A staple Reel King feature is the Lit Reels. During the base game, 0 to 6 reels may be lit yellow, accompanied by a familiar ‘Ding!’ sound. One extra reel is lit yellow for each subsequent cascade. If all reels turn yellow, players advance to the Reel King feature. Score another cascade to open up the Super King feature. Or, one or more cascade after that to trigger the Mega King feature.Each Reel King feature offers a different Free Spins trail and number of Reel Kings, like so:Reel King – 8 to 12 free spins + 1 to 2 Reel Kings.Super King – 8 to 20 free spins + 2 to 3 Reel Kings.Reel King – 8 to 25 free spins + 3 to 6 Reel Kings.Reel Kings appear over the reels, spinning their own one-line mini slot. Players can win 1x, 2x, 5x, or 10x for mixed, blue, yellow, or red ‘Seven’ symbols. If reels in the mini-slot are yellow, the player moves along the Free Spin Trail. When a Reel King lands a losing combination and has less than 3 lit reels, he is removed from the game. The feature ends when all Reel Kings have been removed. If players end the round on a Free Spins trail position displaying a number, that amount of Free Spins are awarded.Before Free Spins begin, players have the chance to collect or gamble their free spins. A wheel spins, and if it lands on a green segment, players win the indicated amount of free spins. If it lands on red, free spins decrease, possibly lost. Up to 25 Free Spins in total can be won from the Gamble option.Free Spins benefit from a win multiplier starting at x1, increasing by +1 with each cascade. There is no limit to how high the multiplier can go, and it does not reset. Cascades also light the reels red, one at a time, starting from the leftmost reel. Reels remain red until the sixth reel is lit. When this happens, the Reel King appears on the reels to increase Free Spins by 1-3, and the win multiplier by 0-3x.Reel King Megaways: VerdictQuite cleverly, Inspired Gaming has found a way to delicately tread the middle ground with Reel King Megaways. On the other hand, it’s still Reel King through and through, from the Spartan (yet crisp) visuals to the local pub sound effects.Small touches help add charm as well, such as the pile of coins at the bottom of the screen, creating a physical arcade vibe. Not to mention, the myriad ways the original has been brought back to life such as the lit reels. The icing are the features, which are intuitively integrated with the Reel King/royal theme.Unless you are completely sick to death of the King, it’s not a bad Megaways slot. The Reel King series is a bona fide classic some may have felt overdue for a bit of Megaways magic. On the other hand, there may be purists baulking at the prospect of their favourite Humpty Dumpty character being violated by such modern nonsense.In some ways, the polarising effect of Reel King Megaways mirrors the range of Reel King slots themselves. For some players, Reel King is it, a classic game that will never die. Other players would be keen for a slot voodoo ritual to bring about the franchise’s demise.At the end of the day, Reel King Megaways is a pretty enjoyable slot and a well made, modern-day edition of one of the most iconic land-based machines ever made. If ever anything was going to push Reel King out of its retro niche into a broader mainstream audience, it is the Megaways engine."

title: Atlantean Treasures Mega Moolah

review: "Atlantean Treasures Mega Moolah: OverviewMicrogaming partners Neon Valley Studios has the task of designing the latest slot to be part of the Mega Moolah progressive jackpot network. This juggernaut of a franchise is one of the most popular jackpot networks online, and when you look at the numbers, it’s not hard to detect why. With payouts so far totaling around €1 billion, scores of instant millionaires and jackpots that regularly exceed €10 million, the appeal is obvious. It might seem that whatever slot is hooked up to the machine cranking out those results wouldn’t really matter. That might be true up to a point. Most players still want to spin something half decent while having a crack at the mega jackpots on offer. After all, not everyone can win the top prize. Neon Valley’s latest has washed up on shore to offer players a new opportunity to take on the jackpot. Let’s knife it open like an oyster and find out if a pearl resides within.No doubt the first thing that draws the eye when Atlantean Treasures Mega Moolah loads is the jackpot amounts on the side of the screen. There are 4 whose values vary wildly, but all constant tick upwards. That is until lucky punters win them and they are reset to their seed value and begin the climb again. This being an Atlantean adventure, the game is located at the bottom of the seafloor, amid murky ruins of the old city. Despite the name, this is another one of those legends no one can agree on. Some say the city was in the Atlantic, some in the Mediterranean near Greece or Spain. Others think it was as far away as Antarctica. Not that that has any bearing on the game, but it is kind of interesting.So, Neon Valley has chosen to keep things simple by incorporating 5 reels, 3 rows, and 10 paylines. Players can stake from 10 p/c to $/€200 per spin, bearing in mind that the chances of triggering the bonus wheel increase the larger the bet size. Leaving aside the progressive, the volatility of the game is on a medium setting, with a hit rate of 21.69%. The RTP, meanwhile, as you would imagine, is far lower than usual on 92.08%, but still significantly better than the original. Considering the size of the jackpots that are possible and how frequently they trigger (relatively speaking), such a low RTP sort of makes sense.The base game is easy - just match three or more symbols for a payout. One thing to note is that the game has bi-directional paylines. So it pays both ways – left to right, and right to left, effectively doubling the win ways. The paytable is comprised of mainly new symbols, with a couple of classics at the high end. These are the BAR and ‘7’ symbols which are worth 25x and 12x the stake for five of a kind. The rest of the symbols in descending order are a pink fish, purple koi, seahorse, fluffy seaweed, and an orange starfish. Quite an eclectic bunch of symbols right helped out by the multirole wild.Atlantean Treasures Mega Moolah: FeaturesJackpot Wheel triggeredThe ultimate goal of Atlantean Treasures Mega Moolah is triggering the Jackpot Wheel for a chance of landing the big one. To do so, players collect pearls which are called Progressive Trigger Symbols. These pearls land at random on top of any symbol (except the wild) on reels 2, 3, and 4. When they appear, they are picked up and stored in the giant clam that sits next to the reels. Collect enough of these pearls and you will eventually trigger a chance to spin the Progressive Wheel. There is no mention of how many pearls need to be collected to do so, and chances are affected by the size of the bet.Once triggered, the Progressive Wheel guarantees a prize – one of the four progressive jackpots. There is no telling what the amount will be at the time, but here are the seed values.The Mini starts at 10.The Minor starts at 100.The Major starts at 10,000The Mega starts at 1,000,000While waiting for that to (hopefully) happen, the base game also has another feature to stir in a thrill or two. This feature is based on the flowing pink-haired mermaid wild. The wild’s most basic function is to substitute for any other symbol in the game except the Progressive Jackpot Symbol. If the wild appears on reels 2, 3, or 4, then it also Expands to fill the whole reel. Once line wins have been calculated, a Respin is then triggered. During this re-spin, the expanded wild is locked while the remaining reels spin for another chance to win. If another wild lands on the middle three reels it triggers another respin, and up to three successive respins are possible.Atlantean Treasures Mega Moolah: VerdictAs far as slots associated with the Mega Moolah jackpot are concerned, Atlantean Treasures holds its own to an extent. It’s not as fun as the original Mega Moolah slot was but offers a new fresh alternative for those who get tired of chasing that dream hit playing the original. Mathematically, there are a couple of things to consider when comparing the two games. The RTP of the original is 4% lower, which is a significant number that will have a huge impact on your session. However, the potential is also far greater (excluding the jackpot) so at least it has that going for it.Would you play Atlantean Treasures Mega Moolah if it wasn’t part of the jackpot network? Absolutely not. The game is extremely dull and little effort has been invested into the regular gameplay. Sure, there are a few nice touches. Symbols appear in bubbles, and when they form a winning combination, there is a pleasing little animation as they are popped. Overall, it's not the most fun jackpot slot we've played, but being connected to the Moolah network and carried by Microgaming does save the day."

During the round, a free spins scatter may land, awarding an additional 1 to 7 free spins.Alexander The Great World Conqueror slot - free spinsAlexander The Great World Conqueror: Slot VerdictAlexander is one of those phenomena that may make one wonder if objectivity exists in the world. If you're on his 'side', let's say, then yeah, his blistering conquest across vast swathes of the planet might be considered great. If you're on the other 'side', he might be seen as a warmongering annoyance, or as the BBC put it, Alexander the not so Great. His achievements might be impressive, but it's kind of nice that nowadays, alphas can conduct their battles in the boardroom, in business, or in any number of competitive arenas which don't involve leading hordes of soldiers into battle against a defending army that would probably rather be at home ploughing fields or reading a book.For some make-believe battling and conquering, players also have the option of taking on Alexander The Great World Conqueror as well. Maybe we just lucked out, but triggering free spins was one of the toughest skirmishes encountered while playing Alexander The Great World Conqueror.A fair amount of treasure lies in wait for successful conquerors, too, to the tune of 10,467.5 times the bet. However, Alexander The Great World Conqueror's biggest USP is arguably the chance to progress through its 4 stages, charting the progress of Alexander's battles, some of them anyway. title: Secrets of Cleopatra Infinity Reels

The golden pyramid symbol is wild, substituting for any of the regular pays. It does not have a value of its own and appears on any reel except the first.Secrets of Cleopatra Infinity Reels: Slot FeaturesSecrets of Cleopatra Infinity Reels - free spinsThe central feature in Secrets of Cleopatra is the Infinity Reels system, which works in conjunction with win multipliers, and is capped off by triggered free spins. title: Jurassic Park Gold
structured_summary: Jurassic Park Gold slots bring the iconic dinosaur adventure theme to life, featuring characters and creatures from the Jurassic Park franchise. review: 2022",7,"Jurassic Park Gold: Slot OverviewSince 1993, the multi-movie Jurassic Park franchise has grossed billions at the box office. With those thoughts in mind, let's head back to Isla Nublar and see what this dino filled slot is made of.Things get off to a relatively calm start, all things considered. Humans make up the highs, including John Hammond, Sarah Harding, Ian Malcolm, Ellie Sattler, and Alan Grant. Landing a full line of five premiums will fire off a reward worth 4 to 10x the bet, while lows are worth 1 to 2 times the stake. The most valuable symbol is the game logo, which is wild as well. It lands anywhere to replace any normal pay symbol and is worth up to 125x the bet for five of a kind. Wilds pay 2x or 5x when used in a win in the base game.Jurassic Park Gold: Slot FeaturesLike the Gallimimus' 'flocking this way' in the original movie, Jurassic Park Gold is overrun with features. Let's break them down.Link&WinThese trademarked Link&Wins are popping up with increasing regularity, though they often come with slight variations, so not all are the same. To trigger it, you'll need to land at least 6 bonus Powerball symbols in the base game. Powerball symbols lock to the reels, and each has a cash value or a jackpot and resets spins back to 3 whenever a new one lands. Also, landing 15, 20, 25, or 30 Powerballs unlocks rows 5, 6, 7, and 8 for extra chances to possibly win.JackpotsProminently displayed at all times on the left, jackpots can only be won from the Link&Win feature. Each Powerball that lands may reveal the Mini, Minor, or Major prize, worth 15x, 30x, or 100x the bet, respectively. The fourth jackpot, the Mega pays out a reward of 8,000x the stake and is won if all positions on the panel are filled with Powerballs.Free SpinsLanding at least 3 scatter symbols activates the free spins bonus rounds, which are unlocked after a set amount of free spins triggers have been achieved. The first three are Dilophosaurus, Velociraptor, and Spinosaurus, offering 12, 9, and 6 retriggerable free spins, respectively, where wild win multipliers of x2, x5, or x8 may appear. Max win varies in each bonus round from 3,600 to 4,000x.The fourth is a Tyrannosaurus Rex Free Spin which is unlocked when the scatter collector is filled in the base game. Landing 15 pairs of scatters fills the meter. In this feature, 1 spin occurs with a guaranteed Wild Storm feature where up to 5 reels may turn fully wild.Wild ChaseThis feature is present in the non-T-Rex free spins rounds. When a wild symbol lands, it highlights the position it appeared in. If another wild lands in an already marked position, it expands to cover all positions on the reel for that spin. In Dilophosaurus, this could be reel 3; in Velociraptor, this could be reels 2 or 4; and in Spinosaurus, this could be reels 2, 3, or 4. Filling a whole reel with marked cells awards +4 free spins.Jurassic Park Gold: Slot VerdictJurassic Park branded slots have proven hugely popular in the past, and it's easy to envisage Jurassic Park Gold being popular as well. It looks lively and jams many of the main stars of the 1993 box office smash film. When reading that, it's hard to believe the original movie is nearly 30 years old, a testament to the ongoing wonder dinosaurs have in the popular imagination and the impressive quality of the CGI at the time. It might also have something to do with Microgaming and Co. wanting to squeeze extra mileage out of the JP license, but whatever prompted a Gold version, dino-fanatics probably won't be complaining.Those who were expecting a suite of new extras might be disappointed, though, since Jurassic Park Gold provides more or less the same gameplay as Thunderstruck Wild Lightning did – with a lower max win. Players who enjoy bonus round unlocking quests or the heroics provided by the single Tyrannosaurus Rex spin where 5,000x is possible might be satiated. The rest might not be so much. While Jurassic Park Gold offers a level of entertainment, it feels better suited to hardcore dino fans.Strip the gloss off, weed out the dinos, and you're left with a less potentially profitable version of Thunderstruck Wild Lightning which in turn was a shadow of the iconic Microgaming version. But novelty probably wasn't the main point. Jurassic Park Gold's objective of cashing in on the dinosaur craze will no doubt pay off in attracting players who can't get enough massive, extinct reptiles in their lives. And if it doesn't pull in the punters? No biggie, it's unlikely massive amounts of effort went into developing the gameplay since it was largely recycled anyway."

title: Good Luck Clusterbuster

Any device can be used for playing Good Luck Clusterbuster, where bet levels start at 10 p/c per spin and top put at $/€4 - the limited betting range being a clear RT indicator of the relatively high winning potential.Good Luck Clusterbuster is a cluster pays slot where wins are awarded when five or more matching symbols land, connecting vertically or horizontally. When winning clusters land, they are removed from the grid, making space for symbols to fall down and fill the gaps. If a new cluster is created by the symbol drop, the process is repeated. As for the paytable, four mushrooms, coloured green, purple, red, and yellow are the lower paying symbols, while horseshoes, pipes, beer mugs, and golden clovers are the higher value bunch. At the upper end, a 20+ of a kind winning cluster awards 2x the bet for the mushrooms or 3 to 25 times the stake for the higher value symbols.Good Luck Clusterbuster: Slot FeaturesGood Luck Clusterbuster slot - Leprechaun WildsWhilst fairly basic a lot of the time for a cluster paying grid slot, the features in Good Luck Clusterbuster include Chain Reactions, Leprechaun Wilds, Clusterbuster, free spins, and the Lucky Wind Blow.Leprechaun WildsPay attention to the 4 Leprechaun Wilds sitting in the four spots around the game board. Wilds substitute for any pay symbols and are not removed when used in a winning cluster.ClusterbusterThe 3x3 Pot of Gold block in the middle of the board is a cluster of 9 inactive, valueless tiles. When a winning cluster is next to the Pot of Gold, any of its adjacent tiles are removed.Free SpinsBusting all outer tiles of the inner 3x3 Pot of Gold awards 5 free spins. One of the main base game goals is cracking the outer tiles of the central 3x3 Pot of Gold, and the game gets close a lot. Often, 8 outer tiles will be destroyed, leaving that pesky last one in its original greyed-out non-removed state. Having the four static Leprechaun Wilds means hits are fairly regular, as are repeat clusters from the Chain Reaction feature, meaning getting close to hitting free spins yet not quite making it a fairly regular occurrence. Some might like the close but no cigar tension; others might be frustrated. Worth a look if you're interested.Patiently chipping away at the Pot of Gold and finally making it into free spins can be worth the wait, though. That's where the game slips into Jammin' Jars with leprechauns mode, and the results could be quite eye-opening. Having a quartet of wandering wilds with individual progressive multipliers is quite a thought, and it has the ability to do good stuff in practice. For a Red Tiger slot, it means eye-catching winning potential, reaching as high as 19,995.7x the bet. An impressive figure which blows away Dragons Clusterbuster and Thor's Lightning, as well as a large portion of Red Tiger's back catalogue, in fact.Add it all up, and you've got a bonus round which has a bunch of positives to it, though much came from elsewhere. Some players may have appreciated the chance to buy their way straight to the bonus round rather than sit through what can be a stack of teasing spins in a base that can get a little tedious. If you're feeling patient, however, or in the mood to be tantalised, Good Luck Clusterbuster has the technical capability to deliver some serious action."
