title: Rome The Golden Age
structured_summary: Rome: The Golden Age immerses players in the brutal yet grand world of Ancient Rome, blending civilization with violence. The game features a unique 3-4-5-4-3 layout, Frame Collection mechanics, multipliers, and free spins with progressively increasing multipliers. The reviewer finds it a volatile but engaging slot with potential for massive wins, though hitting top jackpots is extremely rare. Visually, the game offers a marble terrace view with classical Roman statues, complemented by thematic audio that enhances the arena atmosphere.
review: 2021",7.5,"Rome: The Golden Age: Slot OverviewIf there is one civilisation that exhibited contradictions hard for modern minds to fathom, it’s the Ancient Romans. One side of their psyche was all about morals and values, leaving behind some of the most beautiful architecture, literature, and art the world has ever seen. On the other side of the coin, amphitheaters across the ancient world attest to violence levels hard to comprehend by contemporary standards. To the typical Roman, this was just a way of life, no big deal. It’s into this world of blood and battle we turn to in Rome: The Golden Age, an equally dangerous slot designed by developer NetEnt.The main game plays in what is essentially a corporate box of the ancient world. That is, a marble-floored, marble columned terrace offering the best view of the brutal action taking place in the arena. A reel set arrayed in a 3-4-5-4-3 layout is surrounded by more marble in the form of statues, tastefully covering their naughty parts. It’s a nice view without being exceptional, and betrays little of the big numbers to come.Gladiator wannabes can suit up on any device, selecting bets from 10 p/c to $/€50 per spin. A full suite of figures are available, starting with a default RTP of 96.06%, keeping in mind this can be set to lower levels so be sure to check. Volatility weighs in at medium/high, while hits come at a frequency of 17.60%. It might seem lower than usual, but the Frame Collection feature helps balance this out as you will experience. Players’ main goal is racking up as high a multiplier as possible before entering free spins, which occurs around once every 195 spins or so.Across the unusually laid grid, players make use of 20 fixed paylines to land wins of three or more of a kind on. At the lower end of the scale, we find 10-A symbols, before moving on to more rewarding swords, golden helmets, rings, eagles, and tigers. Values aren’t spectacular where five of a kind premium wins are worth 1.2 to 5 times the stake. The wilds pay out as well, though only for five of a kind, worth 5x the bet whilst also replacing regular pays to complete combinations.Rome: The Golden Age: Slot FeaturesNetEnt has designed several features in Rome: The Golden Age that work okay on their own but are amplified when working in tandem. This includes a Frame Collection system, multipliers, and free spins.Whenever Golden Age symbols appear, a frame marks their position. At random, one of the Golden Age symbols may turn into a Rome symbol, activating its frame. The position with the Rome symbol becomes a wild on the next spin, turning all adjacent positions with frames wild as well. These new wilds also turn adjacent positions wild, up to five times. When the wilds have been used in a win, the frames are removed.Golden Age symbols also bring another benefit. Whenever one lands, 1-4 points are added to a progress bar located above the reels. When 200 points have been collected, the Free Spins Multiplier increases progressively in the following order: x1, x2, x3, x5, x7, x10, x12, x15, x20, x30, x40, x50, x75, x100, x200, x300, x500, x750, x1000. This multiplier plays no part in the base game, but is applied at the end of free spins.Triggering free spins requires landing three scatter symbols on reels 2, 3, and 4. When transitioning to free spins, all positions with frames or active frames that did not turn wild on the triggering spin, stick to the reels and take a random value of 0.5 to 50x the bet.During free spins, remaining empty positions spin individually and any new Rome symbol is locked in place. The round starts with 3 free spins, which reset whenever new symbols land. At the end, locked Rome symbols reveal wins of 0.5 to 50x each. Values are tallied, and the current Free Spins Multiplier applied to the total. It then resets back to x1 to begin the process all over again in the base game. On a last, but significant note, filling all positions during the feature doubles the symbol values.Rome: The Golden Age: Slot VerdictIt’s been some time since NetEnt uncaged a slot like Rome: The Golden Age. While it might use the same layout as Jumanji, Rome: The Golden Age is a completely different experience altogether. Where the branded slot was a low volatile tramp through the jungle, Rome: The Golden Age is the sort of slot that happily hacks the unwary into bloody pieces like an unarmed slave up against Rome’s finest. On the flip side, when your stars align it is also capable of firing off huge wins. Like a whimsical emperor, there’s just no way of telling if you’ll get a thumbs up or down.Earning the former will take hard work. Since the multiplier resets after every round of free spins, it will take immense amounts of luck for it to reach 1,000x, or anywhere near it really. NetEnt’s numbers bear this out as well. Starting with some encouraging news; Rome: The Golden Age is capable of wins of over 100,000 times the bet - putting it alongside NetEnt’s heaviest of hitters such as Dead or Alive 2. However, considering that in simulations the max win was hit once every 166 billion spins or so, does dent confidence.Getting there is quite an enjoyable, albeit volatile journey though. The task is made harder by low symbol values, which ensures even full-screen wins are kept low. The Frame Collection system goes some way to filling in the gaps, and the feature triggers often enough to help keep you buoyant. While framed positions turning wild has been used in the past, the way they spread here is rather unique and does create an enjoyable tension as they leap one to the other, piling up around a common symbol to build a win.Going for a 'collection' mechanic similarly to what we've seen from Big Time Gaming in games like Holy Diver and Kingmaker, Rome: The Golden Age doesn’t have the same ‘go for you guns’ attitude of a game like Dead or Alive 2 in spite of the epic potential shared by both. NetEnt hasn’t brought the theme roaring to life in quite the same way. On the surface, Rome: The Golden Age comes across as pretty civilised, barely hinting at the lethal gaming, or crazy figures it coughs up. Like stepping onto the sandy floor of the Colosseum amidst a sea of gore, don’t let your guard down though. This game has no problems snaring players in a metaphorical weighted net and battering them senseless with a three-pronged trident."

title: Boat Bonanza
structured_summary: Boat Bonanza is a fishing-themed slot set against a seaside backdrop, featuring boats that play a key role in gameplay. The game offers Cash Symbol collections, active boats that collect symbols, free spins with multipliers, and respins for added excitement. The reviewer finds it a simple yet engaging slot with respectable potential rewards, especially during free spins. Visually, it’s modest with calm seaside elements and unintrusive audio, creating a laid-back gaming atmosphere.
review: 2022",7.5,"Boat Bonanza: Slot OverviewDust off the rod and tackle and take to the waters in Play'n GO's fishing-themed online slot Boat Bonanza. You don't need us to tell you fishing slots are popular, there are loads of them, and the collection is only getting bigger. Partly due to the saturation, and the stampede by developers to get in on the action, there is quite a lot of crossover going on. What we mean is the copying, borrowing, imitating of ideas, or whatever you would like to call it. Boat Bonanza appears to have a little bit of that going on. Is it enough to toss it back overboard like an undersize minnow, or let it slide?One word used to describe Boat Bonanza that kept cropping up was 'simplicity'. This applied to the gameplay, and it also applied to the visuals. In Boat Bonanza, players get the usual view of a game grid floating beneath the water's surface, with a ribbon of the horizon in the upper part of the screen. Busting out a magnifying glass, or just squinting, reveals a tower, pier, and Ferris wheel, suggesting the game has been set in Blackpool, UK? Darting about above the five reels are a couple of boats which aren't just there for show but play an integral part in the game. It'd be hard to class Boat Bonanza as being an impressive game graphically, though it's not harsh on the eyes, either.Boat Bonanza slot - baseFrom a more technical standpoint, Boat Bonanza is played on a 5-reel, 3-row game board, which supplies 12 paylines for landing winning combinations across. The RTP was not available at the time of testing, yet judging by Play'n GO's usual standards, players can expect a maximum value circa 96.2%, dropping to lower values when playing alternative models. Volatility is high, and players are able to select bets of 20 p/c to $/€50 to bait up and cast out with.Boat Bonanza's main thrills are its Cash Symbol collections, but regular line wins are there too. They occur when matching symbols land across a payline on consecutive reels, starting from the first reel onwards. All pay symbols need at least three to form a win, except for the most valuable symbol, which pays out for two or more. On the lower side are 10-J card symbols, worth 10x the bet for five of a kind, while the higher side has nets, seagulls, reels, and buoys, paying 50 to 200 times the stake for five of a kind. Boat Bonanza does not have a wild.Boat Bonanza: Slot FeaturesBoat Bonanza slot - free spinsWhat it does have, though, is Catch Symbols, which appear on all reels displaying different denizens of the sea and different prize values – up to 1,000x. As an aside, Catch Symbols can also crate winning lines worth up to 40x the bet for five of a kind. To collect Catch Symbols, you'll need the boats above the reels to do so on your behalf. When the boats appear greyed out, they are considered to be inactive; when they are coloured, they are active. When Catch Symbols land on the reels beneath an active boat, the boat will collect all of them and award their values. Should two active boats happen to be above one reel, they trigger the Mega Catch, which collects all Catch Symbols appearing on the reels.Free SpinsLanding 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols in the base game triggers 10, 15, or 20 free spins, respectively. In free spins, 2 multiplier boats are always active, catching symbols which award additional free spins, symbols that add multipliers to the boats, or Catch Symbols. Boats with multipliers multiply their catches, and if 2 boats are on the same reel, their multipliers are combined for the Mega Catch.One key difference between the base game and free spins is that when boats collect Cash Symbols in the bonus round, respins are awarded. For the respins, only Catch Symbols appear on the reels and paylines are deactivated. As long as boats collect Cash Symbols, respins will continue. When no catch occurs, play moves back to regular free spins.Boat Bonanza slot - Respin feature activated in free spinsBoat Bonanza: Slot VerdictOkay, we said simple at the start, but Boat Bonanza has a bit more going on than first meets the eye. At least it does when free spins are triggered, which can then branch off into respins, and produce multipliers. When paddling through the main game, Boat Bonanza is about as laid back and undemanding as you could ask for in a fishing slot. Hit spin, land Catch Symbols, and hopefully, activated boats appear above them so they can be collected. Line wins are there too, yet they sort of faded out of the picture after a while, as it was easy to home in on the Catch Symbols and track boats, almost to the exclusion of all else.Free spins are bolstered by two things, multipliers and respins. Whilst we never managed to haul in the catch of the day, you could see how it might be possible, for instance, if both boats had a decent multiplier on board and combined their powers for a Mega Catch or two. Potential is quite respectable for a mid-range fishing slot, coming in at 5,000x the bet, comparing favourably to many games in the Big Bass range, for comparison, when it comes to max win.Gaming-wise, Play'n GO chose not to do the collect symbol accumulation system in free spins that Big Bass Bonanza and its ilk are famous for. However, what it has is not exactly a brand-new experience. Much of it may feel familiar to players who have had a crack at Big Time Gaming's piscine-populated slot Golden Catch. Boat Bonanza uses a similar concept which, on the whole, came across as a 'lighter' game for want of a better word. The potential rewards aren't as impressive as Golden Catch, but it's a game that triggers its features quite often and has a more laid-back feel to it. So, for players who enjoy a spot of fishing on the reels, and there is apparently quite a lot out there; Boat Bonanza is another option to try."

title: Gorilla Gold Megaways
structured_summary: Gorilla Gold Megaways features a jungle adventure theme with four Megaways reels powered by Blueprint Gaming's unique Power 4 Play mechanic. The game includes cascading reels, mystery symbols, free spins, and a Super Spins feature unlocking additional reels for massive win potential. The reviewer praises its high-quality build, smooth gameplay, and explosive bonus rounds, calling it a wild, next-level slot. Visually rich with dense jungle graphics and crisp sound effects, the game delivers a polished and immersive audio-visual experience.
review: "March 27, 2020",7,"Gorilla Gold Megaways: OverviewIf you've ever thought that playing one Megaways slot at full power isn't quite enough, then rest assured you aren't alone. The creative chaps at Blueprint Gaming are in full agreement with that sentiment and have crammed not one, or two, or even three, but four Megaways reels into their new game. Utilising a game mechanic cheekily titled Power 4 Play, this Megaways extravaganza will excite fans the randomized win ways system whilst possibly even intrigue the naysayers. Gorilla Gold Megaways might appear a little gimmicky at first, but once you see how Blueprint uses the four slots to maximise a phenomenal bonus game, it all makes perfect sense.Booting up the game, it instantly becomes clear that the game oozes quality and that no corners have been cut. The spinning of the reels is smooth as silk, the sound effects are on point and the rich, dense visual presentation is just phenomenal. There is a jungle background to the game dominated by a vines and a bit of dank greenery, although the screen is overwhelmingly occupied by the four game areas.Each of the game areas, or slots if you will, have 6 main reels, up to 7 symbols high with the standard 1x4 horizontal reel running along the top of each slot. Get ready for a win way overload, because with four Megaways running at full power there are a colossal 470,596 win ways possible on a single spin. Each slot comes with the cascade feature too. This feature causes a chain reaction, where winning symbols explode off the reels to let fresh symbols cascade into the empty spots for more chances to win.All four slots can land winners simultaneously and when that happens, the game cycles through each slot one by one as they play out their cascades. It can be quite a lengthy procedure at times, but when the wins rack up it makes the wait sweeter. If it's too slow for you, then below the play button are a couple of arrows which can increase the speed of the gameplay.To get the reels rollin', players select bets using the up and down buttons to select between 0.10 c/p and 10 $/€. Keep in mind though, that this is multiplied by five – x4 for the four reels plus x1 for the Super Bet. When these elements are factored in they create total wagers of 50 p/c to $/€50 per spin. Mathematically, the high volatility of Gorilla Gold Megaways is expected. The exceptionally generous 97% RTP, however, is not. Even better, since Blueprint Gaming does not utilise flexible RTP this is what you can expect to see across all casinos.The rules of the base game follow the typical Megaways pattern. To start with, the 10-A royals need at least three of a kind consecutively in view to trigger a payout. The high pays are a bit more generous, and need three of a kind as well, except the Gorilla which only requires two. There are four high pays, all creatures of the jungle - a purple snake, a crocodile, a tiger, and of course the Gorilla - six of him are worth 50 times the stake which is much better than the other premiums that pay x2-x5 for six of a kind. Rounding off the symbols is a plain old wild which substitutes for any pay symbol and lands only above reels 2, 3, 4, and 5.Gorilla Gold Megaways: FeaturesFree spins feature in actionIn some ways, the features you get with Gorilla Gold Megaways are your standard Megaways extras, but Blueprint has used the four slots to greatly amplify their potential. Let's start with a more mundane feature and work our way up. Leading off is the Mystery Symbol which lands at random and changes into any one matching symbol, except the scatter or the wild, when revealed.More importantly, the diamond symbol is the scatter and 4 or more on a single slot trigger the Gorilla Gold Bonus. This feature begins by spinning a wheel with these following awards:4 scatters – up to 20 free spins or 15 Super Spins.5 scatters – up to 25 free spins or 20 super spins.6 scatters – up to 30 free spins or 25 super spins.7 scatters – up to 35 free spins or 30 super spins.Next, players can use the Gamble feature for more free spins or super spins by spinning a wheel split into red and green segments. Land on green and receive an upgrade, land on red, and you receive less or even no free spins. Or, skip the gambling and hit collect to head straight to the bonus game.The standard Free Spins round is played in the traditional way - it comes with a win multiplier that starts at x1 and increases by +1 with each cascade. The diamond scatter can appear on the bonus reel and landing 3 or 4 awards 5 or 10 more free spins.Trigger the Super Spins bonus on the other hand and it’s time to buckle up for some straight up mayhem. Super free spins start with one slot active, but by collecting monkey tokens, players can unlock the remaining slots one at a time. Collect 5, 15, or 30 golden monkeys to unlock the 2nd, 3rd and 4th slot. Whenever a new slot is unlocked, 5+ spins are added to the tally.Interestingly, there will be a Bonus Guarantee waiting for you should your Super Spins bonus round turn out to be a real bummer. If the total winnings during Supers Spins fall below 100x the super spin bet, 5 additional spins are awarded.Gorilla Gold Megaways: VerdictIf Gorilla Gold Megaways was a vehicle, it would be one of those American Muscle Cars with a huge engine poking out of the bonnet. That is, completely over the top, yet surprisingly graceful, with a ludicrous amount of horsepower. There could have been issues with animation, symbol size, or lag, but Blueprint has done a stellar job of not letting the pace or action get bogged down and muddied up by the sheer amount of activity taking place on screen.With any slot, the bonus game is where the hottest action usually takes place. Think of what one Megaways slot can do during free spins, now picture what that can turn out to be when multiplied by four. One of the biggest beneficiaries is the unlimited win multiplier, which can go ballistic with four sets of cascading slots feeding into it.If Gorilla Gold Megaways had only served up one slot it would have been a pretty good game in its own right. Sure, a little unoriginal, a tad regular perhaps, but not too bad. With four slots in action, it's next level. Okay, so the concept isn't totally original as the quad slot format has shown up in slots like Cash Pump, 4 Reel Kings, and Arizona Diamonds Quattro to name a few. In fact, it's not even the first Megaways slot to make use of the idea as we've seen in Blueprint's own Luck O' The Irish Megaways slot.All that's left to consider is potential, and Gorilla Gold Megaways doesn't disappoint in that regard either. When this gorilla powered slot beats its chest at full power, wins of up to 20,000 times the stake are on the cards, or $250,000 - whichever comes first. Factor potential in with the excellent build quality, the super spins bedlam that Gorilla Gold Megaways can produce and you have one wild slot on your hands."

title: Delicious Candy PopWins

review: "November 3, 2022",7,"Delicious Candy PopWins: Slot OverviewGet your toothbrushes ready, folks, software provider Stakelogic is dipping its choppers into a sugar-coated world named Delicious Candy PopWins - its third slot powered by the PopWins mechanic. Let's find out.Visually, Delicious Candy PopWins crosses the necessary visual ingredients off the list, but little more than that. The action takes place in a sweetie paradise full of cotton candy clouds, swirling lollipops, and various other belt-busting delights. This number is achieved because winning combinations pay both left to right from the leftmost side, and right to left, from the rightmost side.Delicious Candy PopWins slot - base gameDigging deeper into this cavity-threatening world, we find a highly volatile math model, cranking out a default return to player value of 96.50%. The benefit of doing so is that multiplier symbols are added to the base game with values of x2 to x100. Multipliers are applied to the win of the spin they appear on, and if more than one is in view, the values are added first.No second guesses for the sort of symbols used in Delicious Candy PopWins. All look like hard candies in various shapes, with values ranging from 1.5x the bet for five of the orange oval one up to 12.5x the bet for the golden crown. Note that five-of-a-kind wins count just once. Not assisting players this time is any form of wild symbols; they are entirely absent from Delicious Candy PopWins.Delicious Candy PopWins: Slot FeaturesDelicious Candy PopWins slot - feature buy optionsThe first feature to get a handle on is the PopWins mechanic. When a winning way hits, the symbols involved in it pop from the board and are replaced by 2 new ones. If a new win is formed, the process is repeated again. In the base game, each reel has a maximum height of 6 positions high, while in free spins, they can grow to 9 high. When at full height, winning symbols are replaced by just 1 new symbol.Free SpinsShould all reels reach 6 rows high in the base game, then free spins are triggered. Before they begin, a number of free spins of 5 to 15 is awarded, and 1 of 3 bonus wheels spins to award the starting win multiplier. The precise wheel is randomly selected. Wheel 1 awards multipliers of x2 to x10, wheel 2 has x5 to x15, and wheel 3 has x10 to x25. During free spins, the grid has a starting size of 6 reels high and a win multiplier, which increases by +1 following each win or +2 if all the reels reach 9 positions in height. Whilst not stated in the rules, it appears if all reels reach 7, 8, or 9 positions high on the same free spin, they start the next spin and onwards from that height. In other words, if all reels make it to 9 rows high, they stay like that for the remainder of the feature, for example.Delicious Candy PopWins slot - free spins wheelBonus BuyDepending on the jurisdiction, some players may be able to buy the free spins bonus round. There are four possible options, where 80x the bet buys up to 15 free spins with up to an x10 starting multiplier, 150x the bet buys up to 15 free spins with up to an x15 starting multiplier, and 400x the bet buys up to 15 free spins with up to an x25 starting multiplier. The fourth option costs 200x the bet to get a totally random outcome within the usual parameters.Gamble FeatureLastly, when winning combinations are awarded, players may be able to gamble the winnings. To do so, picking the correct colour or suit of a face-down card pays x2 or x4 the amount, respectively. Getting the pick wrong loses the lot.Delicious Candy PopWins slot - free spinsDelicious Candy PopWins: Slot VerdictAround the time of this review, there'd been a number of candy-related releases, as if some game makers could not get sweet stuff off their minds. Naturally, there's no issue with fads and preferences, but repeated use of the same imagery and atmosphere can blunt the impact after a while. So it was with Delicious Candy PopWins. It didn't help that the game also came across as somewhat half-baked. Closed-door meetings between Stakelogic and AvatarUX sparked by the copycat slot Mystery Drop resulted in Stakelogic licensing the PopWins mechanic. With Delicious Candy PopWins, it felt like Stakelogic phoned it in due to some sort of contractual obligation rather than desiring to pour its heart and soul into a sugar-coated PopWins wonderland. To be sure, this is pure conjecture, just thinking out loud why Delicious Candy PopWins failed to provoke much excitement.Along with the run-of-the-mill visuals, the studio has done little with the features as well. The PopWins mechanic is there popping away, doing its thing, building rows and ways, but not much else apart from the basics. Free spins benefit from the win multiplier, though it's pretty safe stuff. Add a multiplier to the bonus round, and increase it after wins or reaching max reel height. Job done, paint by numbers, whatever you want to call it. No one's questioning the power this combo of mechanics has; max win tops out at 10,000x the bet, after all, it's just that, in the world of PopWins, there are a number of more enthralling choices to go for.And so concludes Stakelogic's third official PopWins outing, and so far, the results have been fairly uninspiring, paling in comparison to what the originator of the mechanic is doing. This really is AvatarUX's baby, and the studio has clearly fallen for the mechanic, pushing it out with just about every new release, testing new themes, twisting features, and just getting straight-up experimental with the whole concept, so far overshadowing Stakelogic's utilisation of it."

title: Donny Dough
structured_summary: Donny Dough is a money-themed slot styled like a game show, featuring a character obsessed with cash. The game offers unique Lootlines, Sticky Dough and Strike Gold bonus rounds, plus multiple bonus buy options. The reviewer praises its suspenseful, feature-rich gameplay with potential for big wins despite a somewhat childish look. Visually, it presents a stage show vibe with lighting, curtains, and retro TV-style backgrounds, complemented by fitting audio effects.
review: 2024",7,"Donny Dough: Slot OverviewThe word 'dough' as slang for 'money' is said to have stemmed from the word bread (which was also used to mean money) because bread and money are necessities for living. Or at least this was one of the explanations gleaned from an Internet search. The relevance is due to the title of Hacksaw Gaming's slot, Donny Dough, a classic example of the studio's hit it or, like, don't MO.Donny's definitely into dough; no arguments there. The guy's got dollar signs for eyes, so it's fair to say he is a money-motivated individual. Donny is the leading man in a slot that's been done up like a game show or a stage show, as evidenced by the lighting, curtains, and audio effects. The end production came across as a slightly more serious version of Dork Unit, the background looking like it was projected on an old cathode-ray tube television.Donny Dough slot - base gamePotential dough accumulation (or loss) occurs on a 5-reel, 4-row matrix, lining up winning combinations on 14 paylines. Rated 3 out of 5, Donny Dough's volatility is in the medium range, while its maximum RTP is 96.23%, though this figure decreases when playing on the three lower return configurations that are also available. To partake, players choose a bet of 10 c to $/€100 and may pick from four bonus buys should they so choose.Objects of wealth and card suits comprise Donny Dough's regular pay symbols. Clubs, diamonds, spades, and hearts all award 2.5 times the stake for a line of 5 OAK landing on the reels. Next come coins, banknotes and coins, a bag of coins, a safe, and diamonds, paying 5 to 10 times the bet for a 5-of-a-kind combination. Interestingly, no wilds grace the game, but several further special symbols do.Donny Dough: Slot FeaturesDonny Dough slot - free spinsDonny Dough features the new Lootlines mechanic, as well as the Sticky Dough Bonus, the Strike Gold Bonus, and bonus buys.LootlinesDonny's head is the Multi-Dough symbol. There are four versions of Multi-Dough symbols, landing with one of these values:Adding Multi-Dough symbol - has values of 1x to 10x.Revealing Adding Multi-Dough symbol - has values of 15x to 500x.Multiplying Multi-Dough symbol - has values of x2 to x5.Revealing Multiplying Multi-Dough symbol - has values of x6 to x25.Revealing versions have a question mark before revealing their value. When there is a winning payline of Multi-Dough symbols on the reels, the payout value is determined by the values on the Multi-Dough symbols included in the win. Values are applied from left to right. If the first value is a multiplying multiplier, it is treated as an adding value.Sticky Dough BonusPlayers activate this bonus round and 10 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols in the base game. In the Sticky Dough Bonus, Multi-Dough symbols are sticky until they are part of a winning payline. Winning Multi-Dough symbols are removed on the next spin. An extra +2 free spins are awarded when 2 FS symbols hit, or +4 free spins are awarded if 3 FS symbols hit.Strike Gold BonusThe Strike Gold Bonus and 10 free spins are activated by landing 4 FS scatter symbols in the base game. When there is a winning payline of Multi-Dough symbols, a light bulb above all the reels that were part of the win is lit. One light bulb is lit on each reel for each Multi-Dough symbol on the reel that was part of a win. A maximum of 4 lightbulbs can be lit on a reel at the same time. When a Donny's Hat symbol lands on the reels, it triggers a respin if any of the light bulbs are lit. For the respin, a number of Multi-Dough symbols equal to the number of lit light bulbs appear in random positions on the respective reels. A Donny's Hat symbol is guaranteed to land on the final spin. An extra +2 free spins are awarded when 2 FS symbols hit, or +4 free spins are awarded if 3 FS symbols hit.Bonus BuyThese four choices are present in Donny Dough's bonus buy section:BonusHunt FeatureSpins - 3x the bet, each spin is 5 times more likely to trigger a bonus game.Ka-Ching FeatureSpins - 50x the bet, each spin guarantees at least 5 Multi-Dough symbols land.Sticky Dough Bonus - 90x the bet.Strike Gold Bonus - 200x the bet.Donny Dough slot - free spinsDonny Dough: Slot VerdictIf Donny Dough was someone's first exposure to a Hacksaw Gaming slot, they might be tempted to wonder what this silly billy dollar sign cartoon verging on childish game is all about. However, gamblers well acquainted with the studio's work will be aware that no matter how cutely Hacksaw tries to dress its games up, serious mathematics lurk beneath the surface, expressing themselves in fiendish ways on the reels. Donny Dough is no exception, possessing gameplay and features that can really shine or annoy, depending on the outcome.Technically, it is possible to achieve Donny Dough's 10,000x max win in any game mode, but bonus rounds arguably offer the best chances for doing so. The two bonus rounds share common elements, but they're actually, on the whole, quite different. The 'lesser' 3 FS scatter triggered round, the Sticky Dough Bonus, is where you want to stack sticky Donny Dough symbols on the screen without winning too early on. Meaning, the game dumping Donny Dough symbols all over reels 2 to 5, then linking them later on with Donny Doughs on the first reel is the ideal scenario. Might happen. The Strike Gold Bonus was the more suspenseful feature. There is nothing quite like knowing something positive is going to occur in the not-too-distant future, and in the Strike Gold Bonus' case, this may occur when having a bunch of lit light bulbs on connected reels before the final spin guarantees a Donny's Hat symbol.If memory serves, one of the highlights of the review was getting 4 lit light bulbs on the leftmost 4 reels and a couple of lit bulbs on the rightmost reel. That was alright. You might have to put in a bit of work or get lucky to find yourself in this sort of situation, though. Hacksaw Gaming slots don't just hand out cash to all, despite an abundance of dollar signs hanging about the place. In Donny Dough, the studio has once again shown why it is one of the masters of making suspenseful slots with cunning features and explosive gameplay."

title: Amazon Island Megaways
structured_summary:
Amazon Island Megaways offers a vibrant jungle escape with a playful Aztec theme.  
It features cascades, a unique free spins bonus with a Jungle Wheel setting minimum Megaways, and a progressive win multiplier.  
The reviewer appreciates its cheerful design and innovative free spins but notes the high volatility and niche appeal.  
The game boasts bright, cartoonish visuals with smiling characters and a light, friendly jungle atmosphere.
review: Out Now,7.5,"Amazon Island Megaways: Slot OverviewThe last time we caught up with Red Tiger partner studio Max Win Gaming was in their cash appreciation slot, Dream Destiny - a slot that whisked players off to a beachside destination to kick back and count dollar bills. Amazon Island Megaways is the complete opposite. In this colourful game, players flee the rat race in an idyllic escape to a jungle environment, packing features like cascades and free spins governed by a somewhat uncommon set of rules.The jungle is one of those destinations that's easy to romanticise but which can be exceptionally unforgiving if you're not prepared for what it throws at you. Well, in real life, that is, the one in Amazon Island Megaways is a squeamish friendly zone. There are no creepy crawlies blanketing the jungle floor, and everyone around here has fixed perma-smiles, even the so-called wildlife. Though it is a light one, there's also an Aztec touch, confined mainly to a couple of masks above the game grid and a bit of stonework around it. The game panel itself is standard Megaways stuff, made up of 6 main reels holding 2 to 7 symbols each, plus a 4-position horizontal reel right above it. A different symbol configuration lands on each spin, providing up to 117,649 ways to win.Played offering bets from 20 p/c to $/€8 per spin, Amazon Island Megaways might look cute, yet it's all business behind the toothy grins. A highly volatile math model sees to that, producing a default theoretical return value of 96.07% (though this number can be lower, so be sure to check the paytable).Wins are awarded when matching symbols land left to right, where the first symbol in the combination sits on the leftmost reel. 10 symbols make up the paytable, divided first into 9-A low pay card symbols, paying out up to 1.5x the bet for six of a kind. Next are 4 cheerful high pay character symbols displaying parrots, monkeys, leopards, and an Aztec Chief looking chap. If a six symbol winning combination of high pays hits, players collect a reward worth 2 to 50 times their stake. Another monkey is on hand to help players in their endeavour on the island. This is the wild, which is made out of gold and has blue jewels for eyes. Put simply, the wild substitutes for all paying symbols.Amazon Island Megaways: Slot FeaturesAs expected of a Megaways slot, Amazon Island Megaways utilises cascades. Following each win, the reaction feature comes into play. This removes the successful combo from the reels, and new symbols tumble down to fill the empty spaces. This system allows consecutive reactions to continue accumulating coins until no new wins take place.Amazon Island Megaways' bonus game of free spins with a progressive win multiplier is nothing new, but the number awarded and the way they retrigger is a little different. Free spins are initially awarded when 3 or 4 treasure chest scatter symbols land. Next, a Jungle Wheel spins to set a minimum number of Megaways for the entire free spins bonus. The segments on the Jungle Wheel award anything from 1,000 to 25,000 Megaways.Once that step's complete, the bonus commences. It starts with 3 free spins, and the number remaining is represented by jewels on one of the masks above the reels. Each winning spin resets the counter back to 3, the round ending after three consecutive non-winning spins occur.A win multiplier is used during free spins, starting at x1 if 3 scatters triggered the feature or x5 if 4 scatters activated it. Following each reaction, the win multiplier increases by 1 with no stated limit to its upper value.Amazon Island Megaways: Slot VerdictIf you ever wondered what slots might look like if Walt Disney stepped into the game, Amazon Island Megaways might well be a clue. It's one of the most cheerfully presented Megaways games we've come across in a while, its look bound to delight some players as much as nauseate others. Before Amazon Island Megaways, we'd just reviewed a hardcore Norse mythology driven game, and Amazon Island Megaways brightened up the room as soon as it hit the screen - a sort of palette cleanser of sorts. As always, looks don't always relate to gameplay, and Amazon Island Megaways flips easily from give to take as you'd expect any highly volatile slot to do.While there is a level of innovation going on here, you won't find it in the base game, which relies solely on chain reactions to entertain you. When free spins trigger, Amazon Island Megaways quickly gets real once you realise you've only got three spins to conjure something up. The good thing is bonus rounds, rarely if ever, ended after three measly spins due to wins resetting the counter, adding more time to build up a respectable total. Having a minimum number of Megaways throughout the feature is a nice and, at times, very useful addition, too. Amazon Island Megaways never quite got out of control during testing, but there is a chance of collecting as much as 10,918 times your stake should it come together just so.The way free spins have been set up means they are less mainstream than just winning a set number of them, and away you go. Essentially, free spins are still a case of locking in as many reactions as possible to build the win multiplier, creating a classic Megaways snowball effect. However, by designing the game in this manner, Max Win has given players a slightly different way of attacking the game. Like the ultra-cute characters that inhabit it, Amazon Island Megaways free spins won't be to everyone's taste, but they are interesting, and it won't be a major shock if this system pops up again in future releases."

title: Playboy Fortunes
structured_summary: Playboy Fortunes is a reskinned version of 9 Masks of Fire with a Playboy bunny theme. It features 5 reels, 20 paylines, instant scatter wins, and free spins with multipliers. The reviewer finds it a mediocre but fun clone, balancing branding with familiar gameplay. The game sports a red and gold Asian-inspired design, a funky soundtrack, and a gentleman’s club vibe.
review: 2020",5.5,"Playboy Fortunes: OverviewLads, prepare to get all hot under the collar in a bunny filled extravagance from Microgaming partner Gameburger Studios. The developer has taken their hit 9 Masks of Fire (or 9 Pots of Gold for that matter), stripped away the tribal graphics, slipped what’s left into a thong, and repackaged it as Playboy Fortunes. Apologies if that was a rather long-winded way of saying Playboy Fortunes is merely a reskin, but there we go. The original had a pretty heated theme already, so you might think the game could only get steamier by dropping in a few scantily clad ladies. Only one way to find out.Playboy might be famous for its media, especially its iconic magazine which has been enlightening the predominantly male mind since its inception in 1953. Fast forward to the modern era and around half of Playboy’s revenues now come from the licensing of consumer goods. This includes penetration of the slots market in part by Microgaming in Playboy and its follow-up, Playboy Gold Jackpots from Triple Edge Studios. The original was excellent, the other ones not so much, which goes to show that jamming on a pair of bunny ears is no guarantee of quality.Playboy Fortunes is built using a classic layout of 5 reels and 20 paylines with the grid located next to a scatter win prize ladder. As you would expect, the colour palette is heavy on the red and gold. When you combine the tones with the pattern on the background, the game has a palpable Asian touch, whether that was intentional or not is unclear. In any case, the action on the reels is accompanied by a funky soundtrack and a bunch of young ladies who appear at certain moments of the game. Playboy Fortunes gives off a gentleman’s club vibe, though not a strip club, which Gameburger has wisely avoided.Players can spin Playboy Fortunes on any device, setting bets from 20 p/c to $/€60 in the process. The math model stats are spot on the same as 9 Masks, providing an RTP of 96.24% coupled with medium volatility. Wins come just as frequently as before, thanks to a higher than normal hit rate of 39.75% contributing to the game’s positive flow.If there is one thing that has changed, it is the symbols. From the lows to the highs players get BARs, cocktails, keys, bow tie/cufflinks, sevens, double sevens, and triple sevens. As a value indicator, triple sevens are worth 37.5 times the stake for five of a kind. One thing about symbol combos is a mixture of sevens, such as 7+77+777, will also pay out, albeit at a reduced amount. Look out for the casino chips symbol; this is the wild. Five of them are worth 125 times the stake while being able to substitute for any regular pay symbol.Playboy Fortunes: FeaturesPlayboy Fortunes - free spinsThe jewel in Playboy Fortunes crown is the instant scatter win prizes, backed up by a round of free spins with a win multiplier on the side.Keep an eye out for the free spins scatter symbol which only appears on the middle three reels, as 3 in view awards a blast on the free spin wheel. The wheel awards 10 to 30 free spins, plus a multiplier of 2x or 3x. Multipliers are applied to any win during the feature except Playboy scatter wins. Free spins can also be retriggered with the amount of free spins awarded being the same as the initial trigger.We said to look out for the wild too, but it’s the Playboy scatter you really want - 3 or more of these anywhere in view award an instant cash prize. The amount up for grabs is f 1x, 5x, 15x, 40x, 100x, 500x, or 2,000 times the stake when 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, or 9 scatters land respectively.Playboy Fortunes: VerdictIn spite of the rather lukewarm response from the casino community, 9 Masks of Fire proved to be quite successful for Gameburger. There was something in its mix of simple gaming, fiery/tribal theme, and instant 2,000x prize potential that struck a chord with many. So much so that Playboy Fortunes is the third clone of the original, which means the project comes off as an exercise in recycling. So, whilst Gameburger gets to recycle its well-proven game mechanics, Microgaming slings them an old Playboy license. It’s a win-win for the studios.And for players? Is Playboy Fortunes any good? Is it a worthy successor to 9 Masks? The answer kind of depends on your mood. In some ways, the game is a shameless bit of branding; a quick and easy reskin to cash in on past success. If you can’t see past the objectification of women issue, or the repetitive gameplay and modest potential, Playboy Fortunes is not quite so rosy.If you take it in good humour though, then the game can be a bit of fun. It strides off the mould more confidently than its predecessors did. The styling works quite well, the bunnies do their thing, and the gameplay is everything the first one was. All in all, sprinkling the latest one with Playboy bunnies is either the best thing ever or the most desperate, depending on your viewpoint.Usually, life is about middle grounds rather than extremes though, which is pretty much where Playboy Fortunes sits - smack bang mediocre. It has much of what players liked about 9 Masks and 9 Pots - the high hit rate, the chance for hitting 2,000x at any point, and nice design. There was a strong case of diminishing returns with the 9 Pots of Gold clone, yet Playboy Fortunes manages to pull things back into positive territory, to an extent.Still, Playboy Fortunes doesn’t have the innocent charm 9 Masks had, and the whole bunny thing will grate with some players - in which case it’s best sticking to the original. Overall, it feels like a lesser slot than 9 Masks was, yet Playboy Fortunes might be alright for a few laughs if you enjoyed what the original had to offer."

title: BountyPop
structured_summary: BountyPop is an Asian heritage-themed slot in Yggdrasil and Avatar UX's PopWins series, featuring a Northern Lights backdrop. The game highlights the PopWins mechanic with expanding reels, free spins, and multiplier wheels, offering up to 59,049 ways to win. The reviewer finds it less innovative and engaging than previous entries, appealing mainly to dedicated PopWins fans. Visually, it is simpler and less sophisticated, accompanied by a fantasy soundtrack.
review: Out Now,7.5,"BountyPop: Slot OverviewYggdrasil Gaming partners Avatar UX sure know when they are onto a good thing. Their PopWins range reaches number four with the release of BountyPop, and the series seems to be humming along nicely. The mix of PopWins mechanic plus snowball features and big potential appears to have hit a note with a growing number of players. Where the last one, CherryPop, pushed the franchise closer to the mainstream due to its fruit styling, BountyPop returns to Avatar UX's Asian heritage for inspiration.At first, it will be hard to see what all the PopWins fuss is about. Upon firing the slot up, a basic 5-reel, 3-row grid sitting against a Northern Lights type image meets the eye, while a fantasy soundtrack drifts about in the background. It's functional, but pretty plain compared to what Avatar UX has done in the past.Playable from 20 p/c to $/€20 per spin, like others in the range, expect a highly volatile gaming experience which can go from nothing to prolonged sequences of pops with huge potential on offer. When spinning for the big one, wins come on average at a rate of 1 every 5 spins, while an RTP rating of 96% is right on average. The game uses a win-all-ways, pay-both-ways system meaning combinations from left to right as well as right to left are possible. This effectively doubles the 243 win ways possible in the default 5x3 mode. As the reels expand from the PopWins feature (covered below), so do the number of ways to win up to a maximum of 59,049.The paytable begins with four florescent card royals (J-A) designed in a flowing Gothic script, followed by a bunch of cartoon characters. Seven characters make up the high pays, capped by a mysterious masked man in white as the lone super high - five of him on a payline yields 10 times the stake. There are no wild symbols, not even from pops, as they were in previous PopWins incarnations. Surprisingly, their exclusion doesn't seem to have much impact on the way the game operates.BountyPop: Slot FeaturesBountyPop - free spins wheelAs you'd expect, the PopWins mechanic is the showpiece, and all features are built around what it does. The extras in BountyPop include free spins, and Mystery Wheel Multipliers.When a winning combination lands, each winning symbol pops to be replaced with two new symbols. This increases the size of the respective reels while boosting the number of ways to win. During the base game, reels max out at 6 positions high. When no more wins land, reels reset to their normal size.If all reels hit 6 rows high in the base game at the end of the win sequence, the Mystery Wheel feature is triggered. On the wheel's outer part, x2-x3, or x5 multipliers and arrows are present. Landing on an arrow spins the inner wheel which awards multipliers of x3-x5, or x10. Multipliers are then applied once to the current win.Landing 3 or more scatter symbols in view trigger the bonus game. Specifically, 3, 4, 5 scatters award 6, 9, or 12 free spins respectively. In the bonus game, reels can now expand to 9 rows in height producing up to 59,049 ways to win. Expanded rows do not reset to the base level between free spins either, but drop down to the lowest reel height.If all 5 reels reach 7 rows or higher a multiplier wheel is unlocked. This wheel spins when free spins are complete, applying a multiplier to the total round win:Bronze wheel (all reels 7 symbols tall): outer ring has Arrow, x2-3, x5. Inner ring has x3-5, x10.Silver wheel (all reels 8 symbols tall): outer ring has Arrow, x2-5, x7. Inner ring has x3-5, x7, x10.Gold wheel (all reels 9 symbols tall): outer ring has Arrow, x3-5, x7, x10. Inner ring has x3-5, x7, x10, x100.For the record, it takes 300 spins on average to trigger free spins. Where available, players can avoid the struggle by activating the bonus buy option, costing 100 times the bet to do so. Before the bonus starts players have the option of spinning a wheel to either win more free spins or lose the lot.BountyPop: Slot VerdictAfter reaching four deep in the PopWins range, players will have a sound idea of what to expect. Namely, getting winning symbols to pop, expand reels, and trigger multipliers. So far, each PopWins slot has used variations of these same components while playing around with the peripheral functions. BountyPop is the same, not doing anything out of the ordinary to put off fans or win over those not enamoured by the mechanic.After the slick styling of CherryPop, slightly more was expected from the follow-up. In fact, BountyPop comes across as less sophisticated too, as if less creativity went into the design than its predecessors. There just doesn't seem to be much new this time around. Unlocking reels on extended runs of pops is fun, yet the impact is watered down on the fourth run through. PopWins is a clever feature, but to keep using it requires pairing it with ever better themes, and features.BountyPop kind of misses the mark in that regard. The theme isn't very engaging, and the game boils down to hitting max rows to pull in a multiplier - fun when it happens, but it feels more repetitive than before. The bonus buy has never been quite so tempting, especially considering you need 300 spins on average to trigger free spins organically. Free spins can be quite a trip where everything gets bigger – reels, win ways and multipliers. It's here the game's eye-watering potential of 55,000 times the bet has a chance to be cracked. A big number, though none have trumped the 70,000x found in the original PopRocks slot yet.There was a feeling of progression in the last three PopWins slots, or they at least made sense from a business perspective. BountyPop, on the other hand, is neither as mainstream as CherryPop, nor does it push the series far along. BountyPop ends up being one for hardcore PopWins fans to enjoy, but it might not be the best entry point if you are new to the mechanic.Don't MissIf you like the PopWin series of slots, be sure to check out the next instalment titled TikiPop. It's played using a 96.10% RTP and offers wins of up to 32,000 times your bet."

title: Fire Strike 2

Moreover, if the screen is covered in exactly 15 Firestrike Wilds, players win the jackpot value of 25,000x the bet.Free SpinsDiamonds are scatter symbols, and having 3 of them on reels 1, 3, and 5 awards 12 free spins. This time, players can win 1x 2x, 8x, 25x, 50x, 150x, 500x, 1,000x, 2,500x, or 5,000x when just 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, or 14 Firestrike or Firestrike Wilds are in view. On a final note, if 3 scatters land during the bonus, players are awarded +12 extra free spins.Fire Strike 2: Slot VerdictIf flaming fruit machines are a personal interest, then prepare to be blown away by Fire Strike 2. It's obvious Pragmatic Play has extensive experience in creating these sorts of slots, as Fire Strike 2 is a shining example of 'funky' fruit machine gaming. The razor-sharp graphics and ear poundingly good tunes could make even a flame hater do a double-take. Since Fire Strike 1 was released, money symbol/instant prize win slots have poured onto the market. Despite this, Pragmatic Play has injected enough brazen attitude into Fire Strike 2 to give it relevance.A large part of the charm is its impressive jackpot. Back when Fire Strike part one hit the shelves, Pragmatic Play was in the habit of throwing around some eye-watering, if dubious, max win numbers in their games. In this new reformed age of Pragmatic Play attaching more down to earth potential to their slots, Fire Strike 2 bucks the trend by sticking with the original's 25,000x top prize. The difference now is that players have a couple of tools they can utilise to potentially, just maybe, hit it. We're talking, of course, about the sticky nature of Firestrike symbols in free spins. With this assistance, and the fact both Firestrike or Firestrike Wilds can be used to score the Jackpot during the bonus, hitting the game's max win feels just that little bit more realistic than before.So, when all is said and done, Fire Strike 2 has pretty much made the first game obsolete. Why pick part one when part two has everything the first one had, plus the added benefit of sticky symbols – not to mention an epic trancey track to listen to while attempting to stack them in a brand new free spins bonus round. title: Happy Riches
structured_summary: Happy Riches is an Asian-themed reskin of NetEnt’s older slot Flowers, featuring traditional symbols like koi fish and waving cats. The game includes double symbols, stacked wilds, and a free spins round with multipliers to boost wins. The reviewer finds it a basic but decent remake with a solid RTP and steady hit rate, suitable for casual players. review: 0.30/75,Out Now,7,"Happy Riches Slot (NetEnt): OverviewWell, the NetEnt reskin machine continues to chug on and churn out more and more rehashed slots for the Asian market. This time, NetEnt has dug up a cheerful older title called Flowers (2013) from their back catalogue for a remake. The aesthetics have been stripped away, they’ve kept the features and mechanics, and tarted it up with plenty of Asian imagery. It must be a formula for success because these types of slots are starting to pile up. No doubt it’s quicker and easier than designing a brand new slot from scratch. It’s easy to get cynical about these sorts of things when they happen often enough. But we’ll try and leave judgements till the end and see how Happy Riches fairs.The game is played using 5 reels, 3 rows, and is a rather simple looking slot. Reels are a plain purple/blue colour and are framed by a standard Chinese pagoda type structure. Clouds make up the background, and are topped off with a suitable in-theme soundtrack. Whilst the original slot displayed payline numbers beside the reels, the remake reduces that to a sign that simply says ’30 Lines’ on each pillar. Aside from that little detail, players get the same menu bar along the bottom of the screen as the original, which is a nice nod to the past. On there you can select bet levels from 1 to 5, and coin values of 0.01 – 0.5. Combinations of these options provide total stake values of 30 p/c to $/€75 per spin, and away we go.The stats that come out of the math model tell an interesting story. First is a solid RTP rate of 96.32% and a medium/high volatility. Where the game might make friends is with its hit rate, which at 44.69% sends out a steady stream of wins.Visually, Happy Riches is a lot less original than its predecessor and lacks some of the charm of Flowers’ symbols. The premiums from Flowers smiled, or frowned, or displayed some emotion which provided a dash of personality. This time around we get J-A royals that start the paytable off with a touch of Eastern design on them. Things get more interesting with the higher paying symbols which can land in singles or doubles. In both cases, they are the same 1x1 size, but if a tile has two of the same image on it then it counts as two symbols. In this category we get oranges, cymbals, lanterns, koi fish, and those waving cat things.Three or more matching symbols are needed on a payline to trigger a reward as usual. But, due to the double symbols, it means there can be up combinations of up to 10 on a payline. The most valuable is the waving cat, and 10 of a kind are worth around 66 times the stake. Rounding off the paytable is a wild symbol in the form of a golden dragon. This wild can substitute for any symbol except scatters. It is also the highest paying symbol in the game with five of a kind paying out 166 times the bet - it also receives an extra ability during the features as you will see below.Happy Riches Slot (NetEnt): FeaturesFree spins feature in action with stacked wildsRunning alongside the double symbols, the key feature is a round of Free Spins. The Free Spin symbol is the scatter and 3 or more result in a payout of 2-10x the stake. Get 4 or more, though, and they trigger a round of free spins. The scatter can also land in a single or double form which means that 4, 5, 6, 7, or 8 scatters award 10, 15, 20, 25, or 30 free spins respectively.During free spins, two things happen to help boost win rates and returns. The first is that the wild symbol can now appear in stacks of 2 or 3, meaning they can cover full reels. Also, all coin wins that occur have a x3 multiplier applied to them. Scatters continue to appear during free spins and the feature is extended when 4 or more of them are in view.Happy Riches Slot (NetEnt): VerdictHappy Riches is pretty much what you would expect to find from this type of reskin/remake. Visually, it's basic but not bad looking, and its features are quite nifty when they go your way. It’s probably got the goods to entertain certain players looking for light-hearted Asian gaming with gentler gameplay. The original was immensely popular back in the days and actually remains one of NetEnt's best slots to this day, so you really can't go wrong with this remake either.Its drawcard could have been potential perhaps, but things are not quite what they seem. Those bashing away on calculators might have worked out that mathematically, a full screen of wilds on a free spin is worth around 15,000 times the stake right there. However keep in mind that during simulations of millions of spins, the game produced rewards of around 2,000 times the stake at the most. It's best to choose whether Happy Riches is worth playing by using that realistic figure to base decisions on. With that, Happy Riches loses a little of whatever appeal it might have already had.All up, the high hit rate in combination with the double symbols might appeal to some players who can’t get enough from this genre. Otherwise, it’s a generic, cheap and cheerful Asian knock off that fails to create much excitement."

title: Stone Gaze of Medusa 2
structured_summary: Stone Gaze of Medusa 2 is an ancient Greek mythology-themed slot featuring Medusa with a serpent lower body, set against a classical backdrop. The game offers dynamic reel heights with 4-7 symbols per reel, multiplier symbols, upgraded Power symbols that remove clusters, free spins with a global win multiplier, and a feature buy option. review: 2025",6,"Stone Gaze of Medusa 2: Slot OverviewSuch is the enormous number of slots flooding the market, the effective use of even the slightest gimmick, innovation, or evolution could be just the thing to set one software provider's products apart from the herd. Developer Stakelogic put its thinking cap on when designing the 2024 release Stone Gaze of Medusa, a scatter pays slot with multiplier symbols by injecting an interesting symbol removal feature. It has since gone back to the drawing board to come up with Stone Gaze of Medusa 2, a game which does just about everything the original release did, but on a game board that alternates the number of symbols landing on each reel, Megaways style.She of the turning people into stone with her eyes, Medusa, is back, and as before, she doesn't just have snakes for hair, but her entire lower body is one enormous serpent. Instead, 4 to 7 symbols land on each reel, creating winning combinations when 8 or more matching symbols land anywhere in view. Winning symbols are blasted off the board and are replaced by other symbols tumbling into the gaps as part of a process that repeats as long as new winning combinations land. With a default RTP sitting on 96.03%, Stone Gaze of Medusa 2's math model is medium-high volatile. Players can bet 20 c to $/€100 per spin or switch on the Super Stake, which adds 25% onto the bet to double the chance of triggering free spins.Five gems set in stone are the low-pay symbols, while the highs are daggers, helmets, cups, and shields. Winning combinations made up of 8-9 matching symbols are worth 0.3 to 5 times the bet, whereas a 15+ combo pays 2.5 to 50 times the bet.Stone Gaze of Medusa 2: Slot FeaturesStone Gaze of Medusa 2 slot - free spinsStakelogic has largely left the features as they were, meaning Stone Gaze of Medusa 2 delivers Multiplier symbols, Power symbols (which have been upgraded), free spins with a global win multiplier, and a feature buy.Multiplier SymbolsMultiplier symbols have values of x2 to x1,000, and they multiply the total win. If more than one Multiplier symbol lands, their multipliers are added together.Power SymbolsPower symbols may land anywhere on the grid to turn to stone and remove paying symbols. When more than one Power symbol lands, the higher-level ones activate first. The first level Power symbol destroys all symbols on the reels that are 1 or 2 of a kind, the second level Power symbol destroys 1, 2, and 3 of a kind, while the third level Power Stone destroys 1, 2, 3, and 4 of a kind.Free SpinsHitting 4, 5, or 6 scatters awards 10, 15, or 30 free spins, respectively. It is possible to win +5 more free spins while the round is active by landing 3+ scatter symbols. During free spins, Multiplier symbols add their values to a global win multiplier. The win multiplier applies to any wins and does not reset during the feature.Feature BuyFree spin entry can instantly be bought for 100 times the base bet.Stone Gaze of Medusa 2 slot - free spinsStone Gaze of Medusa 2: Slot VerdictAll in all, Stone Gaze of Medusa 2 isn't enormously different to the slot it follows on from, yet there are alterations. Stakelogic might have played with the number of symbols landing on each reel, in effect giving the game a semi-Megaways quality, but the rest of the slot is more or less the same as it was in the original. It does raise thoughts about a full-blown scatter paying slot on a genuine Megaways game engine - two enormously popular devices brought together in one spot could be lethal. At the very least, such an amalgamation would create quite an attention-grabbing headline, just saying.Stone Gaze of Medusa 2 is arguably less headline-worthy, but it gives scatter-paying folk something they might not have seen before. Alternating the number of symbols on the reels works about as well as you might expect. Potentially better when there are more of them, perhaps less so when the number of symbols is thinner. The concept might not be a game changer, but it's something new, and this effect helps push Stone Gaze of Medusa 2 even further away from Gates of Olympus than the first Stone Gaze of Medusa slot did - though the much slower-paced gameplay might turn some players off. Maybe if winning potential had increased, the sequel would have gained a greater oomph, but the top number has remained the same as before, at 10,000x the bet.As well as the dynamic reel height, there are other reasons why a scatter pays fan might want to pick this over, say, Gates. One is that Power symbols are able to remove more symbols than ever. Another is that the multiplier system is enjoyably straightforward. For instance, in free spins, Multiplier symbols always increase the win multiplier, and the win multiplier applies to all wins, whether a Multiplier symbol was present or not. So, while much of this was available in the previous game, the faux-Megaways effect is something you don't really see in a scatter pays slot, making Stone Gaze of Medusa 2 one for the completists to tick off their list."

title: Forging Wilds

review: 0.20/240,"August 26, 2024",7,"Forging Wilds: Slot OverviewThe act of heating metal till it's glowing hot then physically beating it into a desired shape might be less common than it was in the past, but the activity is apparently experiencing a revival due to a demand for bespoke metal art. Most likely, reaching the top probably ain't going to be easy, and Old Gun wasn't an easy-going slot in many regards. Bonus buys could be tough on the balance, and while FeatureSpins guarantee at least one Dynamite symbol, they sure as heck don't guarantee a win. title: Sleepy Grandpa
structured_summary: Sleepy Grandpa is a farm-themed slot centered around a nap-loving grandpa who digs up valuable Coin symbols. review: 2023",7,"Sleepy Grandpa: Slot OverviewYou know, despite the huge amount of things to do on this planet, watch telly, read a book, ride a bike, drink a beverage, wingsuit flying, it's hard to beat a good old nap. When it's warm and cosy inside, there's nothing on your schedule, and your eyelids are getting heavy, what could be better than letting go of the waking world and drifting away to the land of nod? If you're a fan of slumbering, you're not alone because the main character of Backseat Gaming's slot Sleepy Grandpa, is partial to naps, too. Fortunately, he doesn't spend the whole game in siesta mode. He also takes part in digging up Coin symbols worth up to 1,000x each, potentially boosted in the bonus round where a Global Multiplier of up to x10 increases any win.If there is one location that almost always looks like a nice place to be in an online slot, it's down on the farm. Providers are keen to portray this side of life as sunnily as possible, almost as if there's no hard work involved, it never rains, food grows itself, and everything exists in wonderful pastoral harmony (Rabbit Royale from ELK Studios is one possible exception). So it is in Sleepy Grandpa, which packs in a red barn, some green green grass, happy animals, a windmill, and a cheerfully cloudy sky. The soundtrack is equally cheerful, and the finishing touch is Grandpa himself, happily snoozing on a bench with a mud-covered shovel in hand. So content does this man look, we might have to join him for a few zzz's…Sleepy Grandpa slot - base gameHmm, maybe later. For now, let's pick a bet instead where the options vary from 10 p/c to $/€100. Alternatively, players can choose the bonus buy, which provides one option – free spins for the cost of 100 times the bet. Playing in the usual mode attracts a default RTP of 96.23%, or when buying free spins, the return increases to 96.39%. With a medium volatile math model, no matter how you play, Sleepy Grandpa has a hit frequency of 37.5% and takes place on a 5-reel, 4-row grid matrix with 26 paylines.For symbol payout info, Sleepy Grandpa has nine regular paying symbols. The low-value lot are 10 to A card ranks, worth up to 1.2 to 1.8 times the bet for 5 OAK, while the high pay bunch are a chicken, a sheep, a pig, and a cow paying 6 to 10 times the bet for a 5 OAK win. Sleepy Grandpa doesn't have wild symbols in its base or bonus game, but it has a couple more special symbols to help inject excitement.Sleepy Grandpa: Slot FeaturesSleepy Grandpa slot - free spins intro screenSleepy Grandpa's features also revolve around aspects of farming and include the Dig feature, the Tractor feature, and a bonus game.Dig FeatureWhen at least 1 Farmer symbol and at least 1 Dirt symbol land at the same time, the Farmer digs up the Dirt. This reveals a Coin symbol bearing a value of 1x-3x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 250x, 500x, or 1,000x and is added to the Farmer. One Farmer symbol per reel can land at the same time. If more than 1 Farmer symbol lands, each Farmer will dig up each Dirt symbol one time. When all Dirt symbols have been dug up, all Farmer symbol values are added together and awarded.Tractor FeatureIf a Farmer symbol or a Golden Farmer land on the reels but no Dirt symbols land at the same time, there is a chance the Tractor feature triggers. When it activates, the Tractor ploughs the field and removes all symbols except scatter symbols or Farmer/Golden Farmer symbols already present. The Tractor will leave 1 to 10 Dirt symbols behind it, triggering the Dig feature. Tractors are present in the base and bonus game.Bonus GameLanding 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols in the base game awards 10, 12, or 15 free spins, respectively. Only one scatter symbol can land on each reel. In the bonus game, there is a chance the Gold Farmer symbol lands – only one can appear in a bonus game. The Golden Farmer is sticky, so it stays on the reels till the bonus game ends, triggering the Dig feature whenever Dirt symbols land.The bonus game also has a Global Multiplier with levels of x2, x3, x5, and x10. Each level has 4 empty slots that are filled by landing Farmer symbols. If a Golden Farmer is on the grid, it fills one slot on each spin. When 4 slots are filled, the Global Multiplier levels up to the next multiplier level. Each time the Global Multiplier levels up, +3 free spins are awarded. The Global Multiplier applies to all wins and to all Coins that are dug up.Sleepy Grandpa slot - free spinsSleepy Grandpa: Slot VerdictSo far, the partnership between Backseat Gaming and Hacksaw Gaming has been a rather fruitful one, as the slots the younger studio has been turning out haven't been bad at all. A bit on the simple side compared with its more established, dare we say more competent partner, but there's nothing wrong with starting somewhere modest, and finding your feet, before really going haywire. Sleepy Grandpa is a good example. It's a pleasant-looking and sounding slot with one or two interesting gaming elements to help you and Grandpa keep your eyelids open and stave off sleep.Not saying Sleepy Grandpa is a sleep-inducing game. It's a sort of mix of Fat Rabbit since tractors can turn up useful symbols in a similar vein to the Harvest feature and Fishin' Frenzy/Big Bass Bonanza. Really, it's like a farmyard version of a classic fish-themed money symbol collection game, so let's thank Backseat Gaming for using a different topic rather than sending players out to sea, again, for the millionth time. As such, for players in the frame of mind for a game that delivers Coin symbols, with rather large potential values, alongside a collection system but have had a gutful of fish, then Sleepy Grandpa could be the remedy. What makes triggering the bonus game attractive is not just the Global Multiplier (which applies to all wins, not just Coin collects) is the chance to hit a Golden Farmer, increasing the game's originality.If one was needed, the final incentive might be Sleepy Grandpa's winning potential of 10,000x the bet. Not a major eye-popping number in this day and age, but for a money collection game of this style, it's quite high. Certainly high enough to keep even the sleepiest gambler wide awake if they won it, or at least give them something to dream about achieving while dozing."

review: 6,"Sweet Alchemy IntroductionSweet Alchemy is a video slot produced by Play'n GO and is played on a cascading 5x5 grid. The game has 1 fixed payline and players can bet from 0.10 to 100 EUR. It works much in the same way as the meter in Moon Princess just to take an example. Every winning symbol will contribute to the Sugar Rush Meter, which resets at the end of each game round. As you fill the meter, special Wilds will be created on the reels.One interesting aspect of this game is that it features 3 types of Wild symbols.Regular Wild replaces any symbol like a traditional wild.Striped Wilds remove the entire row or column when part of a win.Dotted Wilds remove all instances of a random symbol when part of a win.There are 4 high paying symbols represented by a star (only available in the free round), heart, nut (?) and a pastille. Every 3 additional symbols collected after this in a game round will award an additional Candy Spell for the free round, up to a maximum of 7 Candy Spells.The Mix the Elixir free round is played on a 9x9 grid. The aim of the free round is to complete the collection to trigger the Elixir of Power bonus and win along the way. The Alchemist will conjure Candy Spells that will help players achieve this. Symbols will drop in and wins/cascades will occur as normal. When no more wins are present, the first Candy Spell will play out. The sequence of cascades will then play out again, before the second Candy Spell occurs. The free round concludes when all Candy Spells have played out. The Candy Spells consist of:Mixed Candy – The symbols on the grid are shuffled to potentially create new wins.Sweet Surprise – 7-12 wild symbols (of any kind) appear on random positions. Even if the wild symbols are not part of winning combinations, their remove effect is still triggered.Sugar Bombs – 7-15 normal symbols are randomly selected and destroyed.During the Free Round, players will be challenged to collect a certain quantity of 2 different symbols. There are 3 levels to the collection. Completing the first Level will trigger the Elixir of Power Bonus when the free round ends. Completing Level 2 will improve the prizes available in the Elixir of Power bonus. Completing Level 3 will improve the prizes again. In the Elixir of Power bonus game players must uncover chocolate squares to reveal magic elixirs until they find 3 that match. The available prizes depend on the Collection Level achieved in the Mix the Elixir Free Round and include:LEVEL 1LEVEL 2LEVEL 32x Total Bet3x Total Bet5x Total Bet3x Total Bet5x Total Bet10x Total Bet5x Total Bet10x Total Bet3x Total Win2x Total Win3x Total Win5x Total Win3x Total Win5x Total Win10x Total WinIf players complete the Free Round collection they will progress along the Map when the bonus concludes. Players will be awarded a treasure chest every 3 levels on the Map, which contains a cash prize. The cash prize in the Treasure Chest is equivalent to 15% of the player’s base game winnings since the previous Chest was opened.The Mix the Elixir free roundSweet Alchemy ConclusionVisually, Sweet Alchemy looks great and reminds us more of a video game than a slot machine, something that can be a bit deceiving though, if you lose yourself in the game and forget about the fact that it's being played with your hard-earned money. Something we did find a bit annoying was the constant moaning and cheering of the animated girl, but it might just be a personal thing. The game has a max exposure of 3000x, which is not bad, so there is definitely some good potential.Play'n GO is a developer with great momentum at the moment and they have managed to climb to the very top to challenge both Microgaming and NetEnt. We didn't really embrace Reactoonz when it was first released but have since learned to love it. This one seems too complicated at first glance but hopefully the pieces will fall into place after a few sessions. There's also a risk, however, that Play'n GO might have pushed it a bit too far here.If you enjoy this slot, be sure to try the follow-up release Sweet Alchemy 2 as well."

title: Fruity Megaways

Visually, Fruity Megaways is a warm game, too; its grid is flanked by smiling bananas, a fruit juice smiles up in the right-hand corner, and the reels are smothered in happy fruit, which, yes, are also smiling or looking friendly. Basically, if you want a quick positive snap from a slot in your life, fire up Fruity Megaways for a moment to soak in the amiable ambience.Fruity Megaways slot - base gameDespite the appearance, Fruity Megaways is a no-nonsense gambling machine, with a medium-high volatile math model producing a return to player of 96.06%. Wilds substitute for all non-special symbols.Fruity Megaways: Slot FeaturesFruity Megaways slot - pick me featureTumbles and scatters are the stepping stones to Fruity Megaways' features, such as the Pick Me feature, free spins, and Bonus Builder.TumblesEach symbol used in a win is removed from the board by the tumble mechanic. All removed symbols are replaced by symbols falling down from above. Following the tumble, if a new win is created, then the tumble feature triggers again until no new win appears.Pick Me FeatureIn the base game, five consecutive winning tumbles awards the Pick Me feature. For this, 5 fruits are presented on the screen for players to pick one. The picked fruit will reveal a cash prize of 5, 10, 15, or 20 times the bet, or 10 free spins.Free SpinsOtherwise, landing 3, 4, 5, or 6 scatter symbols awards 10, 15, 20, or 25 free spins, respectively. When free spins end, the highest level achieved on the Bonus Builder awards its prize.Fruity Megaways slot - free spinsFruity Megaways: Slot VerdictIf you ever feel a bit down, a bit mopey, life's getting to you, and you'd like a slot-based pick me up, then it might be worth putting Fruity Megaways on for a while. Even if you don't end up playing it, the game has one of the most charmingly upbeat songs we've heard in a slot for a good long time. Not a lot happened in between, which meant quite a lot of downtime. Once free spins trigger, again, it's largely a case of trying to get as many consecutive tumbles to occur to progress through the Bonus Builder feature.It means if you're gaga for games which perk up when enough tumbles have occurred, then Fruity Megaways might be right up your street. One slightly disappointing aspect, though, is Fruity Megaways' meagre (for a Megaways game) winning potential of 5,000x the bet.
