When Coin Symbols land at the same time as the magnet Collect Symbol, the Coin values are multiplied by the Coin Booster and awarded. Once this occurs, the Coin Booster multiplier returns to x1.Free SpinsFlower free spins symbols appear on reels 1, 3, and 5, and landing all three of them at once awards 9 free spins plus a cash payout of 1.5x the bet. The current Coin Booster multiplier is carried over. During free spins, landing 2 or 3 scatters awards an additional +3 or +9 free spins, respectively. Whenever Coin Symbols hit, they are collected by the Coin Respin counter. When free spins end, players get the chance to win the total value of the Coin Respin counter multiplied by the Coin Booster.Heart BonusWhenever a Purple Heart symbol lands, it is collected on its respective reel. When 1 heart has been collected on all five reels, the Heart Bonus is activated - again, the Coin Booster multiplier is carried over. This is the Link&Win part of the game, which starts with 3 bonus spins and resets whenever a symbol lands on the reels. If a Coin Symbol lands, it sticks, while 1UP symbols do not. The round ends when all spins have been used or every position on the grid has been filled. If filled, each Coin Symbol turns into a 50x symbol. However the round ends, the values of all Coin Symbols in view are multiplied by the Coin Booster and paid out.Pile 'em Up: Slot VerdictSnowborn Games has made a real course correction lately. What started off with thrillers on the reels like The Vault or The Bounty has seen the studio shift into more adorable territory with games like this one, Coin Bash and Cat Clans. The feel-good approach fits the studio like a glove, and it's nice to see them move away from the scatter jackpot thing of previous slots to do something more their own.On paper, there probably isn't much about Pile 'em Up, which comes across as overly original, though, such as the Fishin' Frenzy style Coin Symbol collection and the Link&Win Heart Bonus. However, Snowborn has put a personal spin on most aspects of the game, so there is an element of individualism. One plus is the progressive Coin Booster, multiplying Coin Symbols when they are collected in the base game, or at the end of the Heart Bonus or free spins.Speaking of free spins, they did prove to be rather difficult to trigger. Not that the Heart Bonus was a frequent event either, but it's in the Heart Bonus where players presumably have the best chance of hitting Pile 'em Up's max win of 7,500 times the bet. This is the precise amount you'd get for filling the grid with 50x Coin Symbols and having an x10 Coin Booster multiplier in your pocket.After the last few Snowborn releases, you get the impression the studio has figured out who their target audience is and is now honing in on them. Those in Snowborn's crosshairs, that is, players looking for a cute game with comfy features and one or two personal touches, then Pile 'em Up would very likely be a match."

title: Golden Osiris
structured_summary:
1. Golden Osiris is an Egyptian-themed grid slot by Play’n GO, featuring iconic ancient symbols without the usual book motif.  
2. The game offers cluster pays, cascading wins, hidden wilds with multipliers, a Pyramid Charger for symbol expansion, and free spins with retriggers.  
3. The reviewer praises its polished design and engaging mechanics, noting it as a top-quality, moderately volatile grid slot with high win potential.  
4. Visually crisp with detailed hieroglyphic pillars and statues, the game pairs pleasing animations with a standard yet fitting Egyptian soundtrack.
review: 7.5,"Golden Osiris: Slot OverviewDeveloper Play’n GO returns to the well-trodden lands of Egypt to find inspiration for their exotically themed slot Golden Osiris. This time there is no book in sight; instead, the studio uses the splendid imagery from this ancient land to host a grid slot, an area Play’n GO has a stellar track record in and continues to dominate. There are a ton of Egyptian games, but only a handful drive grid slots. Play’n GO brings their considerable expertise to bear to redress the imbalance.Golden Osiris has a noticeable crispness that makes the graphics stand out from the get go. Everything is well defined, from the symbols on the large 7x7 grid, to the background image. Okay, it's not exactly a new view, but the hieroglyph rich pillars, as well as the statues and stonework, are all high quality. The result is easy on the eyes and accompanied by some nice animations when tiles drop, cascade, or form clusters. Like the eye candy, the music is pretty standard for an Egyptian slot, yet pleasing all the same.Alongside the high build quality, another thing you can generally depend on from a Play’n GO grid slot is solid stats. Golden Osiris doesn't disappoint, starting with a default RTP of 96.27%. When it comes to volatility, these games tend to be fairly volatile, although rarely brutally so. In this case, Play'n GO has avoided going too crazy, giving it a volatility score of 7/10. Like many of its siblings, the hit rate is probably relatively high which, in theory at least, means wins should drop on every third or so spin on average.Golden Osiris provides 9 pay symbols to cluster up, starting with 4 low pay gems coloured green, blue, yellow, and red. Next are 5 premiums, where you'll find birds, cats, Ankhs, jackals, and scarabs - all well represented icons from the Ancient Egyptian era. Premium clusters made up of 15 or more symbols pay out from 8 to 50 times the total stake.Golden Osiris: Slot FeaturesIt wouldn't be a big, intimidating grid slot without a stack of features, so Play’n GO has filled the game in cascades, hidden wilds, wild multipliers, a Pyramid Charger causing symbol changes, and free spins. At the core of the game play is the cluster pay mechanic where 5 or more matching symbols make up a winning cluster. As usual, they only count if they connect vertically or horizontallyWhen winners form, the cascade feature is triggered which removes the cluster from the grid so new symbols can fill in the gaps. Cascades keep occurring until no new wins land. Then the next spin can take place.Cascades lead directly into wilds which do not land organically as regular symbols do. Instead, up to 6 wilds are added to the grid and hidden beneath symbols. If a symbol pops to reveal a wild, it comes into play to join in the action. Wilds may also have a multiplier of x2, x3, x4, x5, x7, or x10 attached to boost wins. If more than one wild is included in a win, only the highest is applied. That point may cause Golden Osiris to lose a little of its allure, yet the game works exceptionally well regardless.One way Golden Osiris compensates is by the use of the Pyramid Charger feature. This is constantly active throughout the game, requiring 25 winning symbols to fully charge, including wilds. When the Pyramid is full, and all wins have been paid, it arbitrarily opens to pick one symbol. Then, all instances of this type expand by turning an adjacent symbol into the chosen symbol for another win evaluation. The Pyramid is rechargeable, and the first retrigger applies a symbol expansion multiplier of x3. Any subsequent retriggers in the same sequence raise it by 3, up to x30.<keep an eye out for the Eye of Horus symbol which is the scatter - 3 on the board award 5 free spins. Once in, the Pyramid Charger is fully charged upon each spin. Moreover, the Pyramid Charger chooses only high pay symbols to expand. Scatters continue to pop up so free spins can be retriggered indefinitely.The last extra is the Second Chance feature which has been put in place to lighten the tease of almost triggering free spins. It activates when exactly two scatters are in view. Symbols sitting around the scatters are destroyed allowing new ones, and maybe, just maybe, the third scatter to land. Second Chances show up only on paid spins.Golden Osiris: Slot VerdictPlay’n GO has built quite a reputation when it comes to grid slots, having designed some of the most popular titles out there. Golden Osiris manages to hold its head high with the best of them, providing both Egypt and grid slot fans an enjoyable option to fire up. For one, the theme has been deftly handled - looking great at the same time as stepping gracefully aside to allow features to shine.Golden Osiris shines brightly too and is certainly capable of doing what a great grid slot is meant to. That is, pile on cascade wins, which get increasingly potent the more the game progresses. Key elements are the Pyramid Charger changing symbols working hand in hand with progressive multipliers. Running alongside both are wild multipliers. Bringing it all together means Golden Osiris can crank out wins of up to 12,000 times the bet. One of the highest you'll see from Play’n GO, and quite a sight when a solid roll is underway.When the dust clears, Golden Osiris is another top quality grid slot from the Play’n GO team. It builds on such a successful and well-proven formula that you just can't go wrong with it. The only criticism worth mentioning is its strong, almost clone-like, similarities to its siblings. Other than that, Golden Osiris has all the right elements to entertain fans of the format. Also, its less than lethal volatility opens its appeal to casual players while retaining interest from the hardest of hardcores. Last of all, Golden Osiris' big potential should prove alluring, adding up to an all-around class act in Egyptology."

title: Disco Danny
structured_summary: Disco Danny is a 70s disco-themed slot set in a nightclub with a dancing character, offering a nostalgic party vibe. The game features a 3×3 grid, 5 paylines, free spins triggered by silver and golden disco ball scatters, and multipliers up to 50x. The reviewer finds it somewhat basic and derivative but appreciates the funky soundtrack and potential for decent wins through free spins. Visually simple yet bright, the game’s audio leans heavily on authentic 1970s disco beats enhancing the overall atmosphere.
review: High,0.10/250,Out Now,5,"Disco Danny: OverviewGet jiggy on the dance floor in developer NetEnt‘s nightclub infused slot Disco Danny. The theme might be novel, as are images of Danny bopping to a beat; however, the rest of the game is anything but original.Titled ""Disco Monkey"" during the production phase, the game was subsequently rebranded and released as Disco Danny - why, is anyone's guess. Not only that. Disco Danny is also a clone of NetEnt’s football-themed slot Super Striker. Same features, same math model, the only difference is the scenery and the exclusion of the optional Bet Slip feature. The rest remains the same, so let’s get our roller skates, and more importantly, our groove on.The gameplay might have stalled, but the looks have moved on since Super Striker. Disco Danny's look is simpler in some ways, but still manages to make a bigger, brighter statement. Even if you’ve only seen screenshots, there are no second guesses to the soundtrack. You got it, a funky disco beat. There are some house vibes there, but Disco Danny’s music leans hard on the 1970s and is all the better for it.Boogieing takes place on a 3×3 game area with 5 paylines, offering stakes from 10 p/c to $/€250. This is classic/basic fruit slot gaming where only three of a kind combos are possible. The math model remains more or less the same as Super Striker, which means an RTP of 96.04% and high volatility. The hit rate was not available back when we reviewed Super Striker, but it is now. Coming in at only 14.01%, expect significant patches of dead spins while waiting for something interesting to happen. Although the bonus frequency is around 1 in 250 spins, at one point we had to wait over 900 spins for it to drop.On the paytable, you'll find single bars, double bars, triple bars, sevens, roller skates, Disco Danny with black shades, and Danny dressed as Elvis. One point about symbols is that mixed combinations of any bar symbols pay a consolation prize of 0.6x – the lowest on the paytable. At the other end of the spectrum is the disco king who is worth 100 times the stake for a line, or 500x for a full screen. As before there are no wild symbols pulling in combos, so it is up to scatters to unlock the game’s full potential.Disco Danny: FeaturesDisco Danny - free spinsThere might not be a Bet Slip option, but the rest of the features remain the same, which means free spins and two scatters. It wouldn’t be a real party without a disco ball rocking at the centre scattering light everywhere.Disco Danny has things covered in this regard since there are two types of scatters – a silver disco ball and a golden one. A golden disco ball landing anywhere on the reels awards a random cash prize. These little sweeteners appear at any time to mix up the base game.Golden balls also help unlock the free spins feature. If a golden ball lands at the same time as two silver balls, or three silver balls land on their own, then free spins are awarded. The feature starts with 3 spins and only golden balls may appear. Each golden ball which lands brings with it a multiplier of 1x to 50x, and resets spins back to 3. If no disco balls appear within 3 spins, the feature ends.The free spins feature has 5 different levels and each level has a multiplier increasing through x1, x2, x3, x5, or x10, respectively. If golden balls fill the screen, all of their values are added together and multiplied by the level multiplier. Then players move to the next level. Get the feature on a good roll, and it is possible to build some substantial totals.Disco Danny: VerdictSo is Disco Danny an enjoyable 70s groove on the reels? Yes and no. The atmosphere is okay, though the visuals are pretty simple for a NetEnt slot. The vibe is built mainly through a right on soundtrack and a Sesame Street font logo which helps brings da funk.If basic 3×3 gaming is your thing, then yeah, Disco Danny might help scratch the itch. Otherwise, it may be too basic for others. Like the football version, the game can go from nothing to something thanks to an elusive bonus game. It’ll need a good push, but free spins can build up thanks to an abundance of multipliers. However, the biggest win observed during NetEnt’s simulation of 395 billion spins was somewhere between 1,333x-3,333x. Disco Danny has its moments, but it ends up being more jive turkey than Saturday Night Fever.For more disco slots action, have a look at Reel Desire from rivaling developer Yggdrasil Gaming, offering wins of up to 20,480 times your stake."

title: Golden Glyph 2
structured_summary: Golden Glyph 2 is an exotic, cluster pays slot set in a temple-adjacent wadi with an adventurous theme. It features Power Glyphs activating seven Power-Ups, free spins triggered by scatters, multipliers up to x50, and three bonus buy options. The reviewer praises its smooth gameplay improvements and increased winning potential despite some reduced symbol values. Visually, it offers a bright 7x7 grid with temple pillars and cliffs, accompanied by immersive, thematic audio.
review: 2021",8,"Golden Glyph 2: Slot OverviewThe original Golden Glyph game was the first by Quickspin to use a cluster pays mechanic, and to their credit, the team created a great looking slot offering novel gameplay to boot. Whey they cooked up revolved around cluster wins, leaving power wilds in gaps to trigger additional modifiers and eventually free spins. For the sequel, Quickspin has wisely left the core elements that made the first one popular while tinkering with the rest. By tinkering, we mean adding extra features, smoothing out the ride, as well as cranking up potential.Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, and for us, the original beats the sequel in the looks department. Golden Glyph 2 is no duff, however, where we find a light-filled 7x7 grid in a wadi next to an attractive view of pillars, cliffs, and an airy temple. There's also a chap on camelback with a rifle in the foreground presumably guarding the temple players are planning to ransack? It is exotic, though not as much as the first one's sunrise over the majestic pyramids scene was.Certain stats have seesawed, while others have rocketed out of the stratosphere. The default RTP is one that has dropped a bit, coming in at 96.09% (compared to 96.19% of the original). However, Golden Glyph 2 now has three feature buy options, and each one has a higher theoretical payout than before of 96.3%-96.6%. Volatility, on the other hand, has been increased to 4 out 5. Not a huge change, on paper at least, but coupled with far greater potential can make Golden Glyph 2 a challenging beast to ride. Quickspin also claims the hit rate has increased, though they haven't provided figures to compare the two.A similar set of pay symbols have been used this time as well. On the low-value portion of the paytable are water symbols, eyes, Ankhs, plus serpents, then come the higher value characters of the Pharaoh, Queen, and a Horus looking symbol. The biggest clusters are made up of 15 or more matching symbols, carrying payout values of 75 to 150 times the stake. This is a tad lower than in the original, which eagle-eyed viewers are bound to note, yet features have been expanded to compensate. One other symbol is the regular winged 'W' tile, which is wild. It basically substitutes for any regular pay symbol to help complete a cluster.Golden Glyph 2: Slot FeaturesIf you've played the original Golden Glyph, the core concepts presented here will be familiar, but Quickspin has revamped them to increase potency. It starts with the Power Glyph symbol, which appears in one of the winning locations when a cluster is removed from the grid. Power Glyphs function like a wild, and when they are removed, the next Power-Up on the tracker bar below the grid is activated.Each spin displays 7 Power-Ups. In the base game, the 7th one is always a 2x3 sized Gigantic Wild, and in free spins, it is always a Golden Glyph. The first 6 power-ups are either Golden Scarabs, which add 4-11 wilds to the grid, or one of the 6 Patterns of Horus. When patterns are triggered, they remove certain symbols from the grid in pre-set patterns called Cross, Ankh, Bird, Eye, Hourglass, and Snake.Should 3 scatters land in the base game, 7 free spins are coming your way. If 3 land during free spins mode, then +5 extra spins are awarded. A Golden Glyph symbol is awarded on the first free spin, which stays on the grid for the rest of the feature, moving to a new spot between free spins. The Golden Glyph is wild and has a multiplier starting at x1, rising by one when involved in a winning cluster, up to a maximum of x50. If more than one Golden Glyph is used in a win, their multipliers are added before being applied. It is possible to have up to 4 active Golden Glyphs on the reels at once.The final extra is a bonus buy feature, of which there are 3 options. Forking out 50x, 150x, or 275x the bet buys you entry to free spins with 1, 2, or 3 starting Golden Glyphs, respectively.Golden Glyph 2: Slot VerdictThe first Golden Glyph offered some fine clusters pays gaming, made even more impressive since it was Quickspin's first foray into the genre. Instead of copying another studio's success stories, the team came up with a Power Glyphs leading to modifiers and free spins system in its place. Quickspin has lived up to its word for the sequel by smoothing out the gameplay and giving players more of everything.It's not all plain sailing to bigger piles of riches, though, as other areas have been nipped to provide balance. For one, symbol values have been reduced in certain areas, most noticeably in the case of the Horus premium, leading to considerable spin cycles that don't amount to a whole lot. There is a longer line of Power-Up features to work through on each spin too - 7 compared to 5, and swapping out some of the modifiers of the first Golden Glyph for symbol removal patterns is arguably less exciting.Fortunately, you don't need to unlock free spins from the Power-Up panel this time. Using scatters to the bonus game will probably be a better set up for some players. Gone are those lengthy wins sequences of the first that almost got you there, only to be denied at the last hurdle. Now all you need is to land 3 scatters on a spin, and you're in, or just buy them if you are not in the mood to wait around. As before, the Golden Glyph symbol is the game-changer, and now you can have 4 of them bouncing around the mix at once Jammin' Jars style, rather than just one. In total, more than twice the Golden Glyph multiplying power is available now, leading to wins worth up to 29,500 times your stake.Fans of the first should be very pleased with the upgrade, as will any grid slot buff after a solidly built game. It's got the recognisable Quickspin shine, the features are cleverly done, and the performance specs easily surpass the original. If you're looking for a slot that doesn't require you to collect winning symbols to trigger features, it's well worth a spin."

title: Bone Raiders
structured_summary: Bone Raiders is a tomb-raider themed slot featuring skeleton characters and a unique blend of respins and a coin-collecting bonus round. The game offers respins with rising multipliers in the base game and an expanding 7x7 grid bonus where feature symbols destroy blockers and double coin values. The reviewer finds the respin mechanic engaging and the bonus round potentially rewarding, though volatility can lead to variable outcomes. Visually, the game sports a charming, top-down view with amiable skeletons and immersive stone and earth textures, complemented by a playful audio atmosphere.
review: 2024",7,"Bone Raiders: Slot OverviewBone Raiders, who exactly raids bones? Are we talking about people who illegally acquire fossils and sell them on the black market or tomb raiders? We're assuming the second definition is a closer fit for Bone Raiders (or something else altogether), which comes from Kindred owned software provider Relax Gaming, vaguely blurring the lines between online slot and video game - very vague, we're being generous with the definitions here. It's also a slot which mixes respins and a rising multiplier in its base game before transitioning to coin accrual mode for the bonus phase, where a multiplying element once again plays a key role.The Relax Gaming team must have been in a cute mood when it designed Bone Raiders' front end, which has a look reminiscent of Snake Arena, Mega Heist, and Marching Legions. For this one, players look down on the action as if riding on the back of a winged creature. What you can see from this height is a grid surrounded by moat, walls, and dry cracked earth. Trigger the bonus round, and the camera pans downwards to a more indoor, stone-encrusted location. It's all cutely done, from the neatly designed little objects littered about the place to the amiable skeleton characters.Bone Riders slot - base gameBone Raiders draws a clear distinction between its main game and its bonus round. For the main game, the action takes place on a 5x3 matrix, while in the bonus, it occurs on a 3x3 expandable up to 7x7 grid. In terms of volatility, you're looking at a medium-high volatile machine, while the max RTP when betting 10 c to $/€100 per spin is 96.1%.In the base game, eight regular symbols land across the reels, there for the purpose of creating wins via a Pay Ways mechanic. The first 4 symbols on the list are diamonds, clubs, hearts, and spades, turning out payouts of 0.3x the bet for 5 OAK. Next are four skeletal characters, worth 10 to 100 times the bet for a five-matching symbol win. There are no wild symbols in Bone Raiders, but a respin-rising multiplier combo makes up for the exclusion.Bone Raiders: Slot FeaturesBone Riders slot - free spins introBone Raiders beefs up its base game with the use of respins on each win, doubling the win multiplier in the process. Hit enough scatters or fork out a cash payment, and the bonus round with its coin accrual action activates.Respin MultiplierIn the base game, any win triggers a respin and doubles the win multiplier. Respins continue like this until no more wins are awarded from a respin. All symbols drop off the reels for respins, not just non-winning spins. Each new spin always starts with an x1 multiplier.Bonus GameLanding 3 scatter symbols on reels 2, 3, and 4 triggers Bone Raiders' bonus round. The active space expands to a 7x7 grid, though only the centre 3x3 area is active at first. The rest of the area is made up of blockers. The triggering scatter symbols convert into feature symbols and play out their effects. Feature symbols target other positions according to their effect. If the targeted position contains a blocker, it is destroyed, becoming an active area where symbols may land. If the targeted position contains a coin, the coin's value is doubled. The feature starts with 2 spins, which reset whenever a feature symbol lands. Every 20 blockers destroyed increases the spin reset value by +1 spin. The feature symbols list is this:Magic Staff - targets one symbol 3 to 7 times.Bomb - targets the surrounding area, with the bomb sitting in the centre of a 3x3 to 7x7 sized area.Cannon - shoots a random number of targets from 1 area to all areas.Compass - targets a set pattern such. This could be row, column, diagonal, row + column, both diagonals.After a feature symbol has performed its action, it transforms into a coin with 1x the bet value. It might be worth repeating that when feature symbols hit coins, their values double.Feature BuyBone Raiders' bonus round can be bought from the feature buy for the cost of 70 times the base bet. The feature buy RTP is 96.5%.Bone Riders slot - free spinsBone Raiders: Slot VerdictBone Raiders is a slot that feels both slightly old, though mainly new. The older parts are the respin feature, which has a Jack Hammer meets DoubleMax thing going on. However, Bone Raiders' respin system isn't exactly like either of those features, making it a quite unique combo that is worth a few spins to scope how it works. In short, it's a sweet feature which is able to meander, bob about, do little, or… maybe pop dramatically. Whatever the outcome, on the whole, its inclusion only adds to the main game, despite a possible drop in hit rate to compensate. The hit rate stats weren't on hand to verify this supposition, but Bone Raiders didn't seem to suffer from huge amounts of dead spins.Players leave the base game mechanics far behind when triggering or buying their way into Bone Raiders' bonus round. This one's quite a bit different. Two spins are not a lot, huh? Meaning there isn't much room for error unless blocker demolition goes well. If so, it is possible to increase the reset spin amount to a maximum of 4, providing a tad more breathing space. During the review, smashing loads of blocks actually was not super difficult to achieve at all. Then, it's a matter of hitting as many feature symbols as possible, boosting and creating coin symbols. It's a system that's not difficult to imagine, in the right circumstances, feature symbols teaming up to hit coins, causing their values to quickly double up into something special. Possibly.When Bone Raiders is doubling up like a nutter, it can theoretically reach as high as its 10,000x the bet win cap. It's a slot where you can visualise this potentially happening. Or not; we're talking about a fairly volatile Relax Gaming machine, so less-than-wow returns are a possibility as well. But stirring in the cute skeleton crew with a fun core base game feature and a multiplicative bonus round means a significant amount of raiding may be on the cards."

title: Book of Destiny
structured_summary: Book of Destiny is an Ancient Egypt-themed slot inspired by the classic Book of Ra format. It features expanding symbols in free spins, a gamble wheel to add extra expanding symbols, and options like Scatter Boost and bonus buy. The reviewer finds it a solid, well-designed debut with a high max win potential of 10,823x but without major innovations. The game offers clean, airy visuals with hieroglyph pillars and statues, creating a pleasant, polished aesthetic.
review: 8,"Book of Destiny: Slot OverviewSoftware developer Print Studios was launched in 2020 by a team of industry vets with the goal of designing slots for players 'in search of deeper gameplay.' Their first game is titled Book of Destiny, and as you might expect, is built around the ever-popular Book of Ra format. It's by no means a straight copy, though the principal features and gameplay will be completely familiar to a lot of players. As part of the 'deeper gameplay' concept, Print Studios has expanded the gambling opportunities for players willing to take risks for potentially greater rewards while altering the notorious expanding symbol free spins feature.With a light, airy look, Book of Destiny presents a pleasant view of Ancient Egypt. We get the clean lines of hieroglyph covered pillars, background stonework, and a couple of impressive statues sitting on either side of the 5-reel, 10-payline game grid. Obviously, this is something experienced 'book of' players will have seen loads of times in the past, but the quality is high and makes a positive first impression for what's to come.Statistically, Book of Destiny throws up a couple of surprises. Okay, they aren't through the looking glass, secret government document revelations, yet a couple of talking points all the same. The biggest is potential, which is a lot higher than regular Ra-style games. A fairly volatile game, RTP is decent at 96.5%, increasing to 96.72% when buying the bonus rather than triggering it organically. Available on any device, Book of Destiny comes with base stakes of 10 p/c to $/€80 per spin.With 10 fixed paylines, wins hit when 2 or 3 of a kind land left to right from the leftmost reel. Card royals 10-A sit at the lower end of the paytable, while the higher value tiles are Anubis, Thoth, Horus, and an explorer, slightly more mature than the ones you usually stumble across in these games. Landing a five of a kind premium combination will get you a payout of 75 to 500 times the stake, meaning 5,000x for a full screen of expanded explorers. As is tradition in book slots, the book symbol doubles as both scatter and wild, replacing any other symbol to complete a line win. Wilds also pay out when forming combinations of themselves, possessing the same value as the top-paying explorer.Book of Destiny: Slot FeaturesExpanding symbols in free spins remain Book of Destiny's main feature, but in this one, you get to 'Choose your destiny and start printing' - to a degree. It kicks off when 3 or more scatter symbols land to trigger the free spins bonus round. Landing 3, 4, or 5 scatters awards 10 free spins plus a payout of 2, 20, or 200 times the stake.Before free spins start, players pick one of the pay symbols to be the Expanding Symbol in the feature. Expanding Symbols fill all positions on the reel, paying all lines, even in non-adjacent positions. You can then go straight to the bonus round or gamble for the chance to add extra Expanding Symbols. If gambling, you spin a Destiny Gamble wheel divided into white and black segments. Land on white to pick another symbol, up to 3 in total, or landing on black reverts a second or third Expanding Symbol back to normal. If you only have one Expanding Symbol, the free spins are lost.If 3 or more scatter symbols land on a single spin during the bonus game, +10 extra free spins are awarded, and another Expanding Symbol is randomly selected.Book of Destiny also comes with two additional gambling options. One is the Scatter Boost which increases the current bet by 50%. Activating it means you get more scatters on the reels, theoretically getting players to the bonus game quicker. The other option is the bonus buy, which gets you to free spins straight away for the cost of 75x the bet.Book of Destiny: Slot VerdictBook of Destiny is a competently designed 'book of' slot with a few extra bits for connoisseurs to rummage through. Everything in Print Studio's first slot is neatly wrapped up, so there are no disappointments, or major wow moments either for that matter. Kind of like competitor studio Lucksome's debut not long ago, though now they're up to their third release at the time of writing. There's no telling how long it will take Print Studios to reach their third. The company states it is 'Going against the trend of churning out games at a rapid pace, they will deliver games that are meant to be played for years...' This echoes a similar approach Push Gaming tends to make, which makes sense since Print Studios' team comprises some ex-Push employees.Will Book of Destiny be played several years down the track? There's no reason why it won't be, though since it resides in a category of slots that is phenomenally large and growing, it'll most probably end up smothered at some stage by upstarts flaunting new features to spark life into the age-old format. For now, Book of Destiny is one of the better Book slots. It has a nice look, nails all the essentials while adding a couple of semi-innovative features to help it stand out.These are mainly additional gamble features, so if you're not keen on pushing fortune to the limit, many of them won't apply. Gambling with free spins is a tough call. Get it right, and you've got extra expanding symbols, get it wrong and, oh well. You can see the interplay between the reasonably priced bonus buy and tempting fate on the Destiny Gamble wheel. Some may love it; some may find it a bit too risky. It is totally optional, of course, so players choice. The final cherry on top and the thing that may well put Book of Destiny ahead of much of its competition is its max win figure of 10,823x the bet – more than double what you find in most of these games. All up, a safely solid debut from Print Studios, possessing a build quality that tees up anticipation for future releases."

title: Sisters of the Sun
structured_summary: Sisters of the Sun is an Ancient Egypt-themed slot featuring the sun goddess sisters Sekhmet, Hathor, and Bastet on a 5x5 grid. It includes cascading wins, win multipliers via Eye of Ra positions, and a Goddess Power feature with unique symbol modifiers. The reviewer finds it a high-volatility, challenging game with greater winning potential than its predecessor Moon Princess, appealing to risk-tolerant players. The visuals blend fiery desert and cosmic skies with an exotic, less cartoonish style, accompanied by thematic audio enhancing the immersive experience.
review: 2021",7.5,"Sisters of the Sun: Slot OverviewAccording to the Law of Polarity, everything in the universe has an opposite - commonly known as yin and yang. An old text called the Kybalion builds on this by saying, 'opposites are identical in nature, but different in degree, extremes meet, all truths are but half-truths; all paradoxes may be reconciled.' That brings us to Sisters of the Sun by Play'n GO which is the yin to Moon Princess' yang. The two games have more similarities than opposites, though. What's different is the theme and a couple of feature tweaks which have tripled the older game's winning potential.You could say the opposite of the moon is the sun, and Sisters of the Sun takes place in one of the sunniest spots on earth. We are talking about the hot sands of Ancient Egypt, where the sisters of the tale are three daughters of the Sun God Ra – Sekhmet, Hathor, and Bastet. The gaming occurs on a 5x5 sized grid where winning combinations are formed when three or more matching symbols land adjacently, horizontally or vertically. Egypt is a common theme, as you are no doubt aware, though Sisters of the Sun's representation of it isn't quite so typical. The Pyramids are there, yet the view alternates between a fiery canyon on Mars-like scene to a cloud-filled sky. It doesn't have the fun cheesy anime feel Moon Princess had, but it is an exotic entry into the grid slot genre.Play'n GO has tinkered with the math model while changing the looks, where potential has received the biggest change. Default RTP is slightly lower than Moon Princess at 96.2%, while volatility remains high at 8 out of 10. Be aware as RTP varies depending on the market, so it can be set to lower levels than the default value. Playable on most devices, stakes range from 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin.Checking up on the paytable reveals seven paying symbols, a wild and a scatter. Starting with the lower value pay symbols, you'll come across leaves, cats, jewellery, and snakes at the bottom end. Bastet, Hathor, and Sekhmet are the three premium symbols; these are all worth 10 times the stake for a line of five. You can mix the premiums as well to trigger a reward of up to 5 times the stake of five if any of the characters line up.Worth even more, at 30x the bet for five of a kind is the dual snaked wilds symbol. As well as being the most valuable tile, it substitutes for all symbols except the scatter. Wilds only appear from the cascading feature covered below.Sisters of the Sun: Slot FeaturesOverall, the features in Sisters of the Sun are similar to those available in Moon Princess. However, there aren't exact copies, and the changes can now lead to much more lucrative results. When players land a winning line, the respective symbols are removed from the grid, and the remaining symbols drop down to potentially create new hits. The cascading mechanism continues as long as new wins continue to land.When a combination of 3 symbols is removed, a wild symbol is placed in the empty middle position. If the grid is cleared of symbols, then 50x the bet is awarded (except in the Sisterhood feature, explained below) and is multiplied by the active win multiplier.On each spin, 5 random positions on the grid are marked with the Eye of Ra. If a win occurs over an eye position, the win multiplier increases by one. In the base game, the win multiplier resets between each paid spin.Next is the Goddess Power feature, triggered randomly on non-winning spins. Whichever sister is displayed on screen unleashes her modifying abilities:Sekhmet – converts a set of one symbol type into another symbol type.Hathor – adds 1 or 2 wilds to the grid.Bastet – removes two symbol types from the grid.Keep an eye out for the glowing scroll symbol. This is the scatter and landing just one triggers the Sisterhood feature. One free round is awarded, and the win multiplier is reset. During the Sisterhood feature, a Goddess Power is awarded on each non-winning symbol drop until all three goddesses have performed their modifier. Moreover, clearing the grid during this feature triggers free spins.Before the bonus begins, players choose Sekhmet, Hathor, or Bastet to collect 4, 5, or 8 initial free spins, respectively. As is the case with Moon Princess, the option with fewer spins means higher risk/rewards, and vice versa. The win multiplier carries over from the Sisterhood feature and does not reset until the feature is over. In addition, extra Eyes of Ra appear on the grid, now 10 are used. Whichever goddess is chosen, her power is triggered on every non-winning spin. The scatter symbol still appears too, so landing one in the Sekhmet, Hathor, or Bastet round awards +4, +3, or +2 free spins, up to a maximum of 150.Sisters of the Sun: Slot VerdictLike its predecessor, there is a lot going on in Sisters of the Sun, and it gets outrageously manic at times – increasingly so due to the updates. Sisters of the Sun is a tougher, more volatile game because of the changes, and some players will relish the challenge, while others might prefer the technically 'softer' option of Moon Princess since both offer a similar style of gameplay.One of the big challenges is triggering free spins. Now it can only be done by clearing the grid during the Sisterhood feature, compared to at any time in Moon Princess. There is a consolation prize of clearing the grid outside the Sisterhood. Yet even that has been reduced to 50x the bet from the 200x you can collect for doing so during Moon Princess' free spins.Rule changes like this, as well as needing Eyes of Ra to increase the multiplier, make Sisters of the Sun harder to get up to speed, but once it gets going, it'll power past Moon Princess and leave it in the dust. For one, you can win a lot more free spins this time – 150 compared to 20, plus there is no mention of the win multiplier being capped at x20 like it was before. Add these changes together, and players can now win up to 15,000 times their stake, triple the princesses.Play'n GO has increased the risk/reward quotient for Sisters of the Sun, but it doesn't automatically eclipse Moon Princess, though. The original blended chaotic action with an equally off the wall theme, all Bandai, Moon Sailor rolled into a shojo manga bonanza. Sisters of the Sun is arguably better suited to a different type of gambler, one keen to take on a more challenging game to potentially reap greater rewards - should it shift out of second gear.Don't MissPlay'n GO has also created a Christmas version of this game titled Moon Princess Christmas Kingdom. Based on the original Moon Princess slot released back in 2017, it offers wins of up to 15,000 times your stake."

title: Cats of the Caribbean
structured_summary:
Cats of the Caribbean is a pirate-themed slot featuring a crew of adventurous cats sailing the Caribbean seas.  
Key features include free spins with guaranteed wilds, wild multipliers from the Wild Cannon, and a Cats Pot Bonus with four jackpot prizes.  
The reviewer found it charming and enjoyable, though simpler and less innovative than Snowborn’s previous cat slot, with moderate win potential.  
The game boasts colorful, high-quality visuals with a cute feline pirate aesthetic, complemented by engaging audio that enhances the playful theme.
review: 2022",7,"Cats of the Caribbean: Slot OverviewIf people could be classed as dog or cat lovers, Snowborn Games must fall into the latter group. Once again, the Swedish software provider has used a clowder of cats to give a game a cute, fluffy, feline touch. The previous one was Cat Clans, a slot where clans of cats battled in the Scottish Highlands, for what wasn't made clear, the closest spot to the heater? This time, a quartet of kitties are hitting the high seas in a piratical adventure called Cats of the Caribbean, where features include free spins with guaranteed wilds and a Cats Pots Bonus.Cats might have an aversion to water but not the ones in this tale, who have taken to the azure seas of the Caribbean in search of loot. This is why players find themselves on board a wooden ship, all rope rigging, a cannon, and a box of cannon balls in view. There is a long history of cats onboard boats, in part to help keep the rat population down, in part for crew morale. Take Peebles, for example, the ship's cat about the HMS Western Isles, an intelligent sort who would shake strangers' hands as they entered the wardroom. Or what about HMS Amethyst's cat Simon, who attained the rank of 'Able Seacat' and was buried with full Naval Honours. Such is the affection these furry little fuzzballs inspire.Cats of the Caribbean slot - base gameCute is certainly the angle Snowborn has gone for in Cats of the Caribbean, which has a very close Cat Clans feel. Snowborn Games undoubtedly has a strong visual team who are able to create colourful and rich games of high quality that are able to catch your attention and Cats of the Caribbean certainly is no exception. Like the four cats, the game comes with four RTP settings ranging from 86.89% to 96%, depending on the market. Volatility is high, and stakes can be set from 20 p/c up to $/€25 per spin.Reels and paylines grow for free spins, but in the base game, 20 paylines angle their way across a 5-reel, 3-row grid. One task is to land winning combinations of three to five matching symbols on a payline, starting from the first reel onwards. For the low pay symbols, there are barrels, hooks, bottles, pistols, octopi, and parrots, paying 2-3 times the stake for a five of a kind win. Cats make up the high pays, where we meet Big Tabby, Captain Claw, Captain Catnip, and Captain Red, who are all worth 5 times the stake for five of a kind. Wilds are critical to Cats of the Caribbean as they are used extensively in most of the features. They are worth 10x the bet for a line of five and can substitute any normal paying symbol.Cats of the Caribbean: Slot FeaturesCats of the Caribbean slot - free spinsAs mentioned, wilds pop up all over the place in Cats of the Caribbean, appearing in the Wild Cannon extra and the three free spin bonus rounds. They don't show up in the Cats Pot Bonus, though, which four cash prizes can be won.Wild CannonThe Wild Cannon can trigger randomly on any base game spin. When it does activate, 2-15 wild symbols are blasted onto the reels in any position. If a wild is placed on top of a wild, it becomes a wild multiplier, increasing by +1 for each additional wild added to it.Free SpinsFree spins are triggered when free spins scatter symbols land on reels 1, 3, and 5. There are three types of free spin rounds, determined by the scatter landing on reel 5. Landing the red, green, or purple scatter on the fifth reel triggers Captain Red Free Spins, Captain Catnip Free Spins, or Captain Claw Free Spins, respectively. Here's what you get:Captain Red Free Spins – 15 free spins with 90 guaranteed wilds.Captain Catnip Free Spins – 12 free spins with 40 guaranteed wilds.Captain Claw Free Spins – 10 free spins with 25 guaranteed wilds.For free spins, an extra row is added to the grid, and paylines increase to 30. Throughout the feature, the cannon blasts wild symbols onto the reels in random positions. If wilds land on wilds, they get multipliers, as in the Wild Cannon feature, up to a maximum of x5.Cats Pot BonusLanding 3 Cats Pots symbols on reels 2, 3 and 4 grants one spin on a wheel of fortune. Here you will win one of four local jackpot prizes. This could be the Mini, Midi, Major, or Mega, worth 20x, 50x, 500x or 10,000x the bet, respectively.Buy Free SpinsIf you are able and willing, it is possible to buy either the Captain Catnip Free Spins for 55x the bet or Captain Red Free Spins for the cost of 200x the bet.Cats of the Caribbean slot - bonus buy optionsCats of the Caribbean: Slot VerdictPirates are popular in slots, as are domesticated animals, so it makes sense to mash the two together and see what sort of pranks they'd get up to. Snowborn did a good job with Cat Clans, so we had optimistic expectations of what might wash up in Cats of the Caribbean. For the most part, Cats of the Caribbean was a positive experience. It's hard to hate on kitties with names like Captain Catnip and Big Tabby, so the cats live up to their end of the bargain, helping to make a slot as adorable as Cat Clans was but simpler on the gaming side of things.Much simpler, really, as for much of the time, Cats of the Caribbean boiled down to slinging wilds at the grid and seeing what would happen. This is technically possible in the base game when the Wild Cannon starts blasting, then even more regularly so in free spins. Increasing the reels is a bit of a double-edged sword as, yes, there are extra ways to win and all, but also a larger pitch to shoot wilds at. If the reels had stayed 3 rows high, would it have resulted in more wilds doubling up, thereby creating more multiplier wilds? We can only wonder, and there were times when wilds did pile up on the screen, and single spin wins maxed out at around 90-100x the bet during the test sessions. Symbol values aren't massive for this sort of reel/payline set-up, so there is a suspicion it will be hard to make major ground without winning the top Cats Pot 10k prize, which is incidentally the game's max win figure as well.All in all, Cats of the Caribbean was a cute game to play through. It does one or two interesting things with wilds and wild multipliers, though it's not as innovative as Snowborn's previous cat game was. However, anyone keen on moggies dressed up as pirates might be thrilled by the opportunity to do a spot of potential plundering alongside them."

title: Victoria Wild
structured_summary: Victoria Wild is an action-adventure slot featuring a desert explorer on a treasure hunt. It offers unique features including three types of wilds, a collection system, Sandstorm and Tornado Respins, plus multiple free spins modes. The reviewer praises its engaging gameplay variety and solid win potential, despite moderate volatility. Visually, the game impresses with thematic desert graphics and a dramatic orchestral soundtrack enhancing the adventurous atmosphere.
review: 2020",7,"Victoria Wild: OverviewDeveloper TrueLab takes players on an adventure with a dashing young explorer in the action-themed slot Victoria Wild. Powered by Yggdrasil Gaming courtesy of their YGS Masters program, Victoria Wild is decked out in three different wilds, a collection system, and several unique free spins locations.Before diving into the game, TrueLab provides a backstory to help broaden the experience. The hero of the tale, Victoria, has the task of conquering a drought-ridden desert, on her hunt for treasures. Okay, that’s about it, but despite the scant details, TrueLab has crafted quite an enjoyable world for players to immerse themselves in. Victoria is a likeable sort, while the map on what would be the sixth reel provides a certain sense of exploration.The game refers to ‘the desert’ though there are no clues as to where in the world it might be. A vulture bobs away on the right side of the screen, while the grid is surrounded by dead trees, bricks and old timber. One clue could be the buildings in the back which look like those mud structures in Mali with the sticks poking out. But still, we could be anywhere hot and dusty. Not that it really makes a whole lot of difference.The soundtrack is one of the game’s highlights. Players are treated to an orchestral piece that brought to mind the Sci-Fi film Stargate which was incidentally set on a desert world. The music piles on the drama, completing the action-adventure feel.Playable across all devices, its 5-reel, 3-row game area is glued together by 15 fixed paylines. Players choose the value of each line from 0.01 to 12 coins, resulting in total stakes of 15 p/c to $/€180 per spin. Continuing our investigation under the hood reveals a medium volatile math model and a fairly generous RTP rating of 96.55%.TrueLab has split the 9 regular symbols into 4 low, 4 medium, and 1 high pay. All are exploration-based, starting on the low pays which are the four points of a compass – N, E, S, and W. Each one has the same value of 3x the bet for five of a kind, rising to 15x for six. The mediums consist of a canteen, boots, a motorbike, and a handgun. This lot is worth up to 9x the bet for a line of five, or 45x for six of a kind.Lastly, Victoria is the high symbol worth 24x for five of a kind, 120x for six of a kind. We’re only mentioning both values since for the majority of the time five reels are in play, yet an extra reel is added during Oasis Free Spins to see the comparison. The standard tornado wild has the same value as the Victoria symbol, while also being able to substitute for any regular pay symbol.Victoria Wild: FeaturesVictoria Wild - free spinsVictoria Wild is built around a collection system that culminates in Oasis Free Spins. Along the way, players benefit from a Sandstorm feature, Tornado Respins, and Lost Temple free spins.Whenever 2 or more wilds are present on the reels during the base game, the Sandstorm feature is triggered. Here, 2, 3, 4 or 5 wilds in view award 5-8, 9-12, 13-15, or 15 Sandstorm spins respectively. On each of these spins, a jumping tornado wild leaps from position to position. Keep in mind these spins are not free.If a jumping tornado wild lands on a regular tornado wild the Sticky Wild Respin feature is triggered. During the respin, all wilds hold their places, including the jumping wild. If a new wild appears, it holds its place as well, and another respin occurs. The sticky wild respin feature ends when no new wilds appear.Next up is Temple Free Spins, triggered when 3 or more temple scatters appear on the reels. The more the merrier, so 3, 4, 5, or 6 scatters award 8, 10, 12 or 15 Temple Spins respectively. What you want to see during this bonus round are wild lamp symbols. If 7 or more lamps are collected, the Secret Treasury bonus is activated when free spins end.In the Secret Treasury feature, a wheel spins, awarding one prize. This could be a 250 – 2,500 coin win, or a multiplier of x2 – x25 applied to the total amount won during Temple Free Spins. There is also a pretty lame booby prize on the wheel where you win nothing if you land on it.Lastly, is the Oasis Free Spins round. During the game, a map next to the reels displays Victoria’s progress. Each Oasis symbol that lands moves her one step closer to her goal. When 25 symbols have been collected, 10 Oasis Free Spins are awarded.A 6th reel is added for Oasis Free Spins expanding the grid to 6x3, though the number of paylines remains the same. During this feature, waterfall wilds appear on reels 2, 3, 4 or 5. When they land, they expand to cover the whole reel.Victoria Wild: VerdictThere is quite a lot to like about this heroine-led slot. Victoria Wild is a game with a lot going on from low-level wins to mid-grade modifiers to larger bonus games. This helps keep your mind off the map as you plod towards triggering the mythical Oasis Free Spins. To be honest, during testing we had more luck during Temple Free Spins due to a surprisingly good multiplier from the Secret Treasury bonus wheel. The multiple winning opportunities ensure solid wins are possible in Victoria Wild whichever way you cut it.Get Vicky swinging over ravines, fending off cobras, dodging tornadoes, or whatever it is an adventuress does and wins of up to 20,000 times the stake are possible. A figure most players will be able to get on board with, though the math model might be a less savoury prospect for some.As well as impressive numbers, TrueLab has made good use of the theme. It’s easy to bang on about going on a quest to build hype, but Victoria Wild does have a certain spirit to it. On a sensory level, the attractive graphics mixed with the stirring soundtrack imbue a healthy dose of adventure. From Sandstorms to respins and free spins, Victoria Wild offers plenty of sightseeing along the way.So while the volatility or the 15 payline format that TrueLab seems to favour may be off-putting for some, others will enjoy the visuals, the variety of features, and the quest-based nature of Victoria Wild, not to mention its massive potential.Don't MissThere is also an upgraded version titled Victoria Wild Deluxe, offering a bonus buy option as well as some feature tweaks."

title: Max Megaways 3
structured_summary: Max Megaways 3 is a spy-themed slot set in a snowy mountainous villain's lair, continuing the adventurous Max Megaways series. It features the Megadozer mechanic, reaction wins, free spins with modifiers, and a bonus buy option, offering up to 117,649 ways to win. The reviewer finds the Megadozer feature more fitting here than in past titles, praising the solid winning potential despite it being the least impressive in the trilogy. The game boasts immersive visuals and audio that complement its secret agent theme and high-stakes gameplay.
review: "February 19, 2025",7,"Max Megaways 3: Slot OverviewAustralian-based provider Big Time Gaming has recalled its secret agent for duty to appear in a game that is 'Shaken, stirred, and stacked with coin-dropping action!', to use the developer's words. The coin-dropping action in this instance is made possible by the studio's Megadozer mechanic, which debuted in Bonanza Falls before popping up again in the 'okay, but kind of not' follow-up slot Danger High Voltage 2. Will it fare better in Max Megaways 3? The dozer is attached to various modifier-triggering properties like one of Q's gadgets, so how about we take a secretive wee look and see.Spy novels and films are famous for sending readers and viewers to far-flung destinations, and the Max Megaways range is no exception. Released in 2022, the original Max Megaways took place on a secluded island before Max Megaways 2 sent players into space. In Max Megaways 3, we're back on Earth, presumably, where a snowy mountainous region is where the current villain does his or her plotting. This has come up before, but if these villains can afford to build high-tech lairs in such isolated locations, don't they have enough cash and clout to just chill out? Guess they wouldn't be villains if they weren't content with anything less than world domination. Fortunately, we've got heroes like Max Megaways to put a stop to their evil-doing.Max Megaways 3 slot - base gameMax Megaways 3 is played on a 6-reel gaming grid that lands 2 to 7 symbols on each reel. Utilizing the Megaways engine, ways to win vary, depending on the number of landed symbols, up to 117,649 when all reels have been filled. Several RTP configurations are available, so if you want the highest, that will be the 96.35% version. Math model volatility is 'very high' in all cases, and the stake range is 20 c to $/€8.BTG looking 9 to A card ranks are Max Megaways 3's low pays, awarding 0.3x to 0.5x the stake when a 6 OAK win hits. Up from them are green, blue, red, and purple-coloured biohazard containers, paying 0.6x to 1x the bet for a 6 OAK hit. Wild symbols may land on reels 2, 3, 4, and 5, substituting any symbols except scatters.Max Megaways 3: Slot FeaturesMax Megaways 3 slot - free spins feature pickAs well as a reaction system that removes and replaces winning symbols from above(not scatters), Max Megaways 3 has a modifier dropping Megadozer, free spins, and bonus buys.MegadozerThe swinging back and forward Coin Dozer situated above the reels may drop in one or more Bonus Coins during any spin, including reactions. Bonus Coins in the base game can be either Gold or Silver. When a Gold Coin drops in, all reels are pushed to display the full 7 symbols each. Silver Coins trigger one of these bonuses:A win multiplier for the current spin increases by +1. All wins for the rest of the current spin are multiplied by the win multiplier.A low-pay symbol is revealed, and all instances on the reels are upgraded to a higher-paying symbol.A random symbol counting as multiple instances is added to the reel.Each symbol on a reel is replaced by wilds.Free SpinsThe game has 2 scatters: a regular Gold scatter and a Diamond Megascatter. Gold scatters appear on the leftmost and rightmost reel. Diamond Megascatters are present only on the rightmost reel. Hitting 2 scatters anywhere awards 10 free spins. If one of the triggering scatters is a Diamond, 15 free spins are awarded. Players get +2 extra free spins for each triggering scatter beyond the second. Once the round is activated, players open 2 doors to reveal modifiers:Bonus Wild - a wild is added to a reel, and it may have a multiplier of up to x10. Wins with a multiplier are multiplied.Multiplier Symbol - a random symbol is added to the reel, which counts as multiple instances, as shown. If the reel already displays 7 symbols this bonus has no effect.Increase Multiplier - increases the win multiplier by +1.Extra Spins - every third Extra Spins coin awards +2 free spins.Increase Ways - the reel increases to have 7 symbols. If it already has 7 symbols, no effect occurs.During the round, the 2 revealed modifiers are delivered when the relevant Bonus Coins fall onto the grid. Free spins have an unlimited win multiplier starting at 1 and increasing after each reaction. Landing 2 scatter symbols awards a further +2 free spins, plus 2 free spins are granted for each additional scatter beyond the second.Bonus BuyPlayers can fast forward the mission to the bonus round by buying 10 free spins for 100x the bet or 15 free spins for 200x their bet. The RTP when buying the bonus round is 96.36%.Max Megaways 3 slot - free spinsMax Megaways 3: Slot VerdictPlayers may well have mixed feelings about the return of the Megadozer. It might be great for anyone who likes the arcade references, Meh-gadozer for the haters. Since this feature is so central to Max Megaways 3, it could end up being a make-or-break moment. Its inclusion didn't exactly cause Danger High Voltage 2 to shine any brighter, after all. The Megadozer felt more relevant to the rest of what Max Megaways 3 does than it did in DHV2, though. Perhaps titanically unmet expectations over the sequel to the beloved Danger High Voltage contributed to much of the negative response to the dozer effect in that game.Whilst the mechanic is still unlikely to take over the world like a particularly successful supervillain, in Max Megaways 3, the dozer-dropping effect wasn't bad. During free spins, it helps deliver a similar set of modifiers as Bonanza Falls, with the addition of the Increase ways symbol. Dozing is available in the base game, too, which is no bad thing. It adds depth, especially since the features are not limited in number as they are in free spins. The overall gameplay fits the series quite well since the previous Max Megaways games were also all about base game bonuses and picking doors to reveal free spin bonuses. Just now the delivery system has been altered.What hasn't been altered is the chance to tap into some serious winning potential, though Max Megaways 3 is the least impressive of the trio. Still, 86,800x in the base game and 101,830x in the bonus round are impressive numbers (on paper, at least) that help give the 'Max' part of the title extra heft while providing wannabe secret agents with a big round target to aim at."

title: Masters Of Olympus
structured_summary: Masters of Olympus is an Ancient Greek mythology-themed slot by Snowborn Games, following their Nordic-themed predecessor. review: "January 24, 2023",7.5,"Masters of Olympus: Slot OverviewNordic studio Snowborn Games previously mastered Valhalla, or attempted to at least, and has now turned its attention from Norse Mythology to Mythology of an Ancient Greek nature. In other words, the follow-up to Masters of Valhalla is upon us in the form of Masters of Olympus, an online slot which borrows much from its predecessor while changing up one or two bits. Suitable for players that are into volatile gaming, players get a stake range of 10 p/c to $/€25 per spin. In the base game, Masters of Olympus' conducts business on a grid consisting of 5 columns of 4 symbols, with 1,024 ways to win.To create a win, three to five matching symbols must land from the leftmost side across adjacent reels. Doing so with five of the card suit symbols - diamonds, clubs, spades, or hearts triggers a payout of 1.1 to 1.2 times the stake. Hitting a five-of-a-kind premium win awards 2 to 3 times the bet when made up of Aphrodite, Apollo, Ares, or Athena. Lightning bolts also appear on the wild symbols, which substitute for all symbols except the bonus, to help create winning ways.Masters of Olympus: Slot FeaturesMasters Of Olympus slot - respin featureWhen wild symbols land, they are collected, granting a chance of triggering the Zeus Respins feature. When it is triggered, wild symbols on the reels expand the full reel down, and a respin takes place. On each new respin, the wild moves one position on the grid. If extra wild symbols land during this feature, they expand as well. The feature ends when no more wild symbols are in view.Zeus Respins – Coin CollectionCoin symbols landing during the feature are collected in a meter. Collecting 3 coin symbols during the feature awards the Olympus Bonus. However, if the Spartan Booster is full, the Spartan Bonus is instead awarded.Bonus SymbolAlternatively, another way of triggering the bonus round is by landing 3 bonus symbols on reels 1, 3, and 5. This will also trigger the Olympus Bonus or the Spartan Bonus if the Spartan Booster has been filled.Spartan BoosterBonus symbols landing on reels 1 and 3 are collected by the Spartan Booster. When filled, the next time the bonus is triggered, players will be awarded the Spartan Bonus rather than the Olympus Bonus. The difference is in the Olympus round, players get 3 respins; in the Spartan one, they get 4 respins.Olympus Bonus/Spartan BonusThis is a hold 'n win style bonus where the initially awarded number of respins are reset whenever a new symbol lands. title: Regal Streak
structured_summary: Regal Streak is a classic, straightforward slot with a simple fruit-themed style and a green, star-patterned backdrop. review: 2021",6.5,"Regal Streak: OverviewMysterious Red Tiger partners R7 go back to basics for their classically styled slot Regal Streak. Taking the less is more line; the game isn’t exactly stimulating in the theme or looks department. Regal Streak takes an unapologetically simple approach, padding out a straight forward base game, with a multiplier filled round of free spins which can drum up some surprisingly large wins.Regal Streak - base gameThe design of the game is plain, especially the visuals which use an emerald green, star-patterned background, similar to the felt top of a pool table. The grid isn’t much more elaborate. A gold bar wraps around a 5-reel, 3-payline slot, displaying a bunch of bright chunky symbols. Rounding off the experience is what sounds like a jazzy, disco version of Foster the People’s hit Pumped up Kicks. Okay a very jazzy version, while the remaining sound effects are the common bleeps that accompany this sort of game.Playable on any device, Regal Streak offers stakes ranging from 10 p/c to $/€10 per spin. Not exactly high roller friendly, but the potential is high, so bets have possibly been reigned in to minimise exposure. RTP is slightly below average on 95.71%, while volatility is high. A little surprising given the number of features hit during testing. Perhaps we caught Regal Streak on a good day, but it didn't appear to be as tight-fisted as other games in the Red Tiger stable can sometimes be.Despite essentially being a standard fruity-inspired slot, Regal Streak has one or two things which might surprise. The first is the pay anywhere mechanic - 3 or more matching symbols on a payline trigger a payout. Whether the combination starts from the first reel, or whether winning symbols are adjacent, or not, it doesn’t matter. Using this system squeezes more mileage out of the limited number of paylines and feels more dynamic than spending the majority of the time staring at just the first three reels.There are not many surprises on the paytable though where it’s generic icons from start to finish. 10 to Ace royals make up out the bottom end of the scale, followed by cherries, four-leaf clovers, bells, and lucky 7s. Full lines of premium symbols are worth 13.5 to 45 times the stake. There is no wild, and the only other symbol is the scatter, covered in the next section.Regal Streak: FeaturesRegal Streak - free spinsBesides the pay anywhere mechanic there isn’t much jazzing up the base game besides Regal Nudges. The bonus game, however, can go crazy if wound up tight enough. There you will find Regal Spins and several multiplier related features.During the main game, if 2 scatters land on a line, there is a chance the crown on the logo flies down to nudge the reels. This is the Regal Nudge feature, and when active, a third scatter may appear to trigger free spins.Keep an eye out for the regla spins symbols as 3, 4 or 5 of them anywhere in view award 15, 20, or 25 Regal Spins respectively. Before entering Regal Spins free spins, one of the pay symbols is randomly selected to be the multiplier symbol. This chosen symbol then has its respective multiplier bar placed above the reels. Higher paying symbols display larger values on the bar. For example, if the lucky seven symbol is chosen, the values on the multiplier bar are x7, x14, x21, and x28.Now, the round starts on x1, and each win involving the multiplier symbol moves progress along the bar, unlocking multipliers in the process. Any active multiplier is applied to each win line during the feature. The feature is further enhanced when 3 or more Regal Spins symbols appear on a payline - 3, 4 or 5 Regal Symbols on a line add 10, 15 or 20 free spins respectively. Also, they increase the Multiplier Bar values by +1 for each Regal Spins symbol on the line. For example, the lucky 7s multiplier bar increases to x10, x17, x24, and x31 when 3 bonus symbols land on a line.Regal Streak: VerdictWith Regal Streak, R7 has designed a game which isn’t really trying to be special or innovative in any way. The game does what it says on the label, and for the most part that’s about it. Things do get a little busier during Regal Spins when the win multiplier comes into play, but still, the gameplay remains uncomplicated throughout. What might prevent Regal Streak from being a write off is its potential, where wins of up to 9,545 times the stake are technically possible.When it comes to the overall design, Regal Streak is about as basic as it gets which might be a draw for some players after an older Reel King style vibe. The bonus game too has a vaguely ‘Book of’ feel to it due to the chosen symbol mechanic, though the rest of the rules are quite different. There’s not too much else to say about Regal Streak, either you dig the rudimentary gameplay, or it will bore you to tears.If you’re in the mood for a stripped-back classic slot with a quick pace and potentially big returns, then it might worth taking Regal Streak for a spin. Anyone else who prefers a bit more sophistication will feel like they’re dialling up a friend on a landline phone – one of those old rotary dial ones."

title: Judge and Jury Megaways

Parade feature. Getting 3, 4, 5, or 6 cell symbols in view awards 1, 2, 3, or 4 picks, respectively. For the parade, four suspects are displayed on-screen. If there, clicking it lets you pay 80x the bet to receive 10, 15, or 20 free spins.Judge & Jury Megaways: Slot VerdictSkywind has really taken to Megaways with gusto. The studio started with an older game upgrade called Big Buffalo Megaways and a clever 'book of' version in Book of Gems Megaways before moving on to be more creative with the format. Judge & Jury Megaways is another good example. It's not just a case of stuffing a ton of features onto a Megaways reel-set either, though there are plenty of extras to be found in Judge & Jury. Megaways bubble with a positive spirit, as if Skywind actually had fun while making them and dreaming up what sort of gameplay to include.Skywind has certainly gone to town with the features, as a lot of them have wedged their way into Judge & Jury Megaways. From the base game randoms to a free spins round with a progressive multiplier and I.D. Parade pick 'n clicks, to the universal Wanted Posters system, there is rarely a dull moment. However, that's more of a personal issue rather than a deal-breaker since players value different aspects when playing slots.Needless to say, if you've got the slightest interest in Megaways, then putting Judge & Jury Megaways through its paces makes perfect sense. title: Prime Zone

review: 6.5,"Prime Zone (Quickspin): OverviewIn Quickspin's latest offering, we're whipped back to Las Vegas during its glory days, a place of decadence and the sinful relinquishment of one's monetary reserves. With 7 free spins awarded, you're given the option to choose between four different bonuses ranging from lower to higher risk. These are your options:Option 1: medium variance and with all wins subject to a 1x multiplier, 3 wild symbols are randomly added inside the zone covering reels 1, 2 and 3.Option 2: medium variance and with all wins subject to a 2x multiplier, 3 wild symbols are randomly added inside the zone covering reels 2, 3 and 4.Option 3: high variance and with all wins subject to a 3x multiplier, 3 wild symbols are randomly added inside the zone covering reels 3, 4 and 5.Option 4: varying in volatility, the zone shifts between reels on each spin and will boost your winnings with a multiplier between 1x and 4x.Remember, these multipliers are added on top of the line-win wild multipliers, which means you can land wins of up to 1000 times your stake per single spin if you opt for the Mystery Shifting bonus. This, however, makes the game seem much more potent than it really is.Prime Zone (Quickspin): Final VerdictPrime Zone is undoubtedly a throwback to the classic Quickspin we know from before, both in terms of visual production and mathematical design. Now, it's not the worst number we've seen in a slot machine, and a lower max win should theoretically give you a more realistic chance to win big as the wins can be distributed over a larger number of players, but for hardcore gamblers that get a kick out of chasing monster wins, this won't suffice. title: Carnival Queen

review: Out Now,8,"Carnival Queen (Thunderkick): ReviewIt's been a while since we've heard anything from Thunderkick, something that is not all too unusual for the Swedish developer that has a tendency to take good time crafting its slots. Most importantly, the increasing multiplier will not revert back to zero on a losing spin, something that boosts the big win potential significantly. Furthermore, following a losing spin, a wild symbol will eliminate all standard symbols from its position, both vertically and horizontally, thus giving you a second chance to land a winning combination and trigger a cascade as well as the increasing multiplier.Carnival Queen (Thunderkick): ConclusionCarnival Queen is without question one of the better slots produced by Thunderkick, although it's quite obviously Bonanza-inspired and an attempt to keep up with current trends. With that said, it's undoubtedly a competent and entertaining medium variance slot capable of producing wins of up to 22,700 times your stake. Despite being a rather basic cascading-type slot, Carnival Queen does in no way come across as a clone or rip-off. With fine-tuned maths, outstanding visuals and a sprinkle of Thunderkick magic, Carnival Queen is a captivating and thrilling game worthwhile."

review: 7.5,"Sword of Khans (Thunderkick): OverviewHere is today’s odd fact. Under the ambitions Khans, the Mongol Empire grew to be one of the biggest the world had ever seen. On a side note, their bows could fire arrows twice as far as their enemies could which provided an enormous advantage. Even more so considering how well they could shoot from a moving horse. Anyway, back to the sword, which is both the wild and the scatter. Wherever they are on the grid, they form winners.Now the 'new' twist comes about from retriggers - more than one symbol can be selected special at the same time. Yes, we saw that with Book of Ra Magic, Magic Mirror Deluxe, Legacy of Dead and Rise of Merlin which could have up to 9 expanding special symbols once. Thunderkick has taken it one step further by adding a multiplier. If a symbol gets chosen that is already special, a multiplier of up to x3 will be added to it. Fill the grid with 5 expanded symbols and the multiplier on max and the game is capable of dishing up 10,000 times the stake in one spin. So you don’t lose track, the game has a handy bar along the bottom of the reels which displays the symbols that are special and any multipliers.Sword of Khans (Thunderkick): VerdictThunderkick are one of those software companies that consistently turn out well-crafted slots. Sword of Khan’s graphics are on point without being amazing, and the gameplay is guaranteed to entertain. Partly because its Book of Ra style spinning that has stood the test of time, partly because the extra twists make it a desirable alternative. Sword of Khans proves once again that slots don’t have to be completely novel, but one original feature can make a well-used idea feel relatively fresh. We are talking of course about the additional multiplier during the free spins which take the game’s payout capability to the next level.On the not so positive side is that RTP which is a little on the low side. It’s not a deal-breaker, but it is lower than we are accustomed to from Thunderkick. What will make up for it is an epic Mongol haul of up to 10,000 times the stake. On the whole, what is on offer here will provide enough thrill and reward to keep most hardcore gamers happy. No it’s not completely new, but that’s okay. What made Ra great was the expanding symbols during free spins which Thunderkick has retained while adding enough novelty to give Sword of Khans relevance."

title: Zeus II
structured_summary: Zeus II is a Greek mythology-themed slot set on the reels above Mount Olympus. It features 5 reels, 4 rows, 50 paylines, a Hot Hot Super Respin mode, and free spins with retriggers. The reviewer finds the game disappointing due to low payouts and tedious respins, advising players to avoid it. The slot’s standout aspect is its powerful classical soundtrack, while visuals closely resemble earlier Zeus titles.
review: "Zeus II: IntroductionMention Zeus to any veteran casino player and they might just have an anecdote or two to share with you in regard to their battles with classics Zeus or Zeus III. Mention Zeus II, however, and you'll be looking at a question mark. As it turns out, you haven't missed out on much.At first glance, it doesn't appear to be much different from the original Zeus but look closer, and you'll notice an extra row of symbols and more paylines. Having been available in land-based casinos for years already, it's anything but a new creation and was likely produced in quick succession following Zeus in order to cash in on its success.In Zeus II, the Greek God Zeus returns on a 5-reel, 4 row reel set with 50 paylines armed with a Respin feature and an empty wallet. Looking at the paytable, it appears as though Mr Zeus lost his mojo, unfortunately. Available on all devices from 60 cents up to a shocking 1000 EUR per spin, this old-school gambling machine unfolds in the skies above the lands of Ancient Greece, possibly just over the peaks of Mount Olympus. When it comes to the actual production, the only really memorable aspect of this slot is the soundtrack - a surprisingly powerful classical piece.Zeus II: FeaturesVisually, it shares the same layout as the other Zeus titles so if you're already familiar with the originals; there's nothing new to this game. On the reels you will find scrolls, laurel wreaths, gold, silver and bronze coins, Greek vases, harps, trojan helmets, warships and Pegasus horses. The most valuable symbol, however, is Zeus who appears stacked on the reels and will give you 3.75 times the stake for 5 of a kind. You heard us right. The wild symbol is represented by a temple and appears on reels 2, 3, 4 and 5.Central to this slot is the Hot Hot Super Respin feature. When a full stack of  Zeus symbols appears on reel 1, the game goes into respin mode, giving you 2 respins while reel 1, as well as any Zeus or wild symbols landing, are held in place for the duration of the feature. It's triggered quite frequently and can do so both in the base game and the free spins.The free spin feature is triggered when 3 scatter symbols appear on reel 1, 2 and 3.
