title: Sails of Fortune
structured_summary: Sails of Fortune is a pirate-themed slot set on a clean, bright ship with a jaunty soundtrack, shifting to a darker atmosphere during free spins. Its features include Mystery Map Respins and Treasure Hunt Free Spins with expanding mystery symbols increasing ways to win up to 7,776. The reviewer finds the base game somewhat dull but praises the high-volatility free spins for big win potential. Visuals are clean and simple, with lively audio enhancing the pirate party vibe.
review: "May 19, 2021",8,"Sails of Fortune: Slot OverviewDeveloper Relax Gaming turns its attention to the high seas for a piratical game called Sails of Fortune. At first glance, it might look like a fairly traditional slot, but this being Relax, interesting things occur during free spins when mystery symbol stacks and increased ways to win enter the fray. Both are fundamental in cracking the bigger payouts here which can be considerable. Pirating is one of the more populous categories out there, so let's see what wizardry Relax Gaming has done to make theirs stand out from the bunch.Played using 5 reels and 243 ways to win, the grid sits atop what has to be one of the cleanest pirate ships ever to sail the seven seas. Maybe the crew nicked a brand new boat, or the captain is a stickler for swabbing the decks. Whatever the reason, this ship is so squeaky clean it borders on being plain. Some studios get mean when designing pirate slots, others, like Relax, take the words 'Jolly Roger' literally. The icing is the jauntiest soundtrack this side of Jamaica, resulting in a pirate ship experience closer to an Ayia Napa party boat than a deadly galleon bristling with cannons, and swabs lusting for plunder. The atmosphere improves when the sun goes down for free spins - then the game adopts a dark Monkey Island feel.Highly volatile, Sails of Fortune relies on several features to assemble as one to dish out the big wins. But before we take a closer look at the features, it's worth mentioning that RTP comes in two forms, starting with a default value of 96.17%, as well as an increased figure of 96.65% when the bonus buy is active – more on this below. Players may select stakes from 10 p/c to $/€50 per spin, on any device, to begin the treasure hunt.Prising open the paytable we find 9 regular symbols to knock together wins with. This occurs when at least 2 captains or 3 of every other symbol type form a combination left to right, from the first reel. On the low side of things are 4 card suits, set into planks of wood, then we get more valuable fish bones, messages in bottles, harpoons, a lady, and a gentleman pirate. Should 5 premium symbols line up for a win, their reward is a payout worth 1.5 to 8 times the stake. Sails of Fortune continues the trend for omitting wild symbols, relying on mystery symbols instead to increase winning potential.Sails of Fortune: Slot FeaturesFeatures in Sails of Fortune are made up of Mystery Map Respins available at any point in the game, and Treasure Hunt Free Spins. Free spins are where the game can drastically increase its reel heights and ways to win.Question marks are the Mystery Map symbols, and landing 1 or more on any reel awards a Mystery Map Respin. On each respin, mystery symbols convert into the same pay symbol, then move one reel to the left until they fall off the first reel. Until that happens, respins persist as long as a Mystery Map Symbol is present on the reels.Despite the presence of Mystery Map Respins occurring at any time, Sails of Fortune is very much all about its bonus game. Known as Treasure Hunt Free Spins, the bonus starts when 3 or more skeleton key scatters land anywhere on the reels to award 8 free spins (+1 additional spin is awarded for every extra key).As well as awarding Respins and walking left as described above, when mystery symbols land during the bonus they have the added benefit of expanding to fill the whole reel they are on. Also, keep an eye out for Treasure chest coin symbols which may appear on reel 5. Every 3 coins collected upgrades the mystery symbol, adding an extra position up to a maximum of 6 symbols in height. Should mystery symbols be present on all reels, 7,776 ways to win will be in play. Whenever the mystery symbol expansion is upgraded, +1 free spin is awarded.There may also be a feature buy available where these things are permissible. For a cost of 70x the total stake, players are taken straight to the Treasure Hunt Free Spins. Entering the bonus round this way has the added benefit of being played with a slightly higher RTP of 96.56%.Sails of Fortune: Slot VerdictOverall, the positives outweigh the negatives, but there is a feeling of unfulfillment after playing Sails of Fortune. One of the issues is the base game isn't hugely entertaining. Perhaps it's the overabundance of wood from the ship and the low pay symbols, combined with the lifeless background. Or possibly it's because Mystery Symbols are just 1x1 size in the base game, rarely adding up to much in their non-expanded form. Anyway, the main game can grind, making the bonus buy a major temptation as it often is in a Relax title.Once free spins are active, the game shifts into another gear. It's quite literally like night and day, where even the background gets interesting. One thing to keep in mind about Mystery Symbol stacks is that they are mystery symbols, not wilds, so it takes a fair amount of luck for them to pull off something special. If there is more than one in action, unless they are adjacent to each other, they don't tend to be super effective at producing big hits. In other words, it's a highly volatile feature that saves itself for the big hits.What helps is having a win-all-ways system rather than a few set paylines. It's also technically possible for all 5 reels in free spins to display mystery symbols, though the most was 3 during testing. Should the dream scenario occur and 5 fully expanded mystery stacks reveal the highest paying captain symbols, an immense treasure of 25,000x the bet waits. A lot has to come together in just the right way for that to happen.All in all, Sails of Fortune does offer something different for pirate fans. It lacks something to make it a really great slot, perhaps the base game is a little too sanitary, but great things are possible during free spins."

title: Riches of Robin
structured_summary: Riches of Robin is a Robin Hood-themed slot featuring the legendary outlaw’s quest to redistribute wealth. The game includes free spins with multipliers, Heist Respins, and a Quick Hit feature offering instant cash prizes up to 1,000x the bet. The reviewer praises its engaging gameplay and strong bonus rounds but ranks it just below Play'n GO’s top fantasy slot, The Sword and the Grail. Visually, it boasts vibrant, character-filled symbols set against a medieval Nottingham backdrop, complemented by fitting Middle Ages-themed audio.
review: 7.5,"Riches of Robin (Play'n GO): OverviewEveryone’s favourite hooded man is back to rob the rich and share the wealth with the needy. It’s a popular theme, and Robin Hood constantly pops back up from time to time. We even got a female version from Bally recently called Lady Robin Hood. It’s one of those endearing tales that has stood the test of time – good guy takes money from bad people and gives it to good people. Acts of charity like that in the Middle Ages could mean the difference between life and death. Play'n GO took on the fantastical past with The Sword and the Grail not long ago which was a cracking take on the Arthurian legends. Now it’s Robin Hood’s turn on the reels, and the question is, will it be as successful?Officially, the game comes with 15 reels laid out in 5 columns and 3 rows. Each position, or tile if you will, spins independently, a concept similar to that seen in Double Lucky Line from Just For The Win. In practice, it boils down to a 5x3 slot with 20 fixed paylines. Wannabe knights select bets from 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin – manual or auto. Wins come from landing 3 or more similar symbols in a combination while waiting for features to drop of which there are several. RTP swings from a chivalrous 96.65% to a dastardly 94.43% or even lower. This can be adjusted according to the operator’s whims, so make sure to double-check the setting before piling in coins. Volatility has been given a 10 rating which is Play'n GO’s highest level so prepare for some all or nothing sessions. With a solid potential up for grabs, this stat will either be a good or bad thing.Graphically the game is a bit of a knock out with bright symbols full of personality bursting off the reels. The background is set in ‘ye olde’ Nottingham. Spires poke out above reels and dwellings, with Sherwood Forest off in the distance. The soundtrack is suitably Middle-Aged, and the audio/visual effect is of a high standard. When it comes to symbols, there are 9 regulars joined by several special symbols. The low pay ones start with card suits - diamonds, hearts, clubs, and spades fashioned in a stone and gem design. The premiums are made up of five famous characters from the story. We get Friar Tuck, Alan A Dale, Little John, King Richard and Maid Marian who is worth the most at 20 times the stake for five across a full payline. Robin Hood, who looks strikingly similar to Cary Elwes in Mel Brooks comedy hit Robin Hood: Men in Tights, is wild and substitutes for any regular pay symbol. He too is worth 20 times the stake for a five of a kind combination.Riches of Robin (Play'n GO): FeaturesWhen it comes to features, Riches of Robin has several quivers in its bow such as free spins, a Heist Respins bonus, and Quick Hit feature.The Quick Hit feature revolves around money bags which are instant prize symbols. If a spin occurs which does not have a winner, then the Quick Hit may be triggered. Here, instant prize symbols on any reel will be awarded. Each money bag can contain prizes of 20x, 100x, or 1,000x the bet.If four money bags are in view on the reels then they trigger the Heist Respins feature. This feature starts with 3 respins and money bags are the only symbols that can appear on the reels. When a money bag lands, it resets spins back to 3. The feature ends when respins run to zero, or the reels are filled with Money Bags. Either way, all instant prizes get totaled up and paid out at the end.The target symbol is the scatter which only appears on the middle row of columns 2 and 4. Just two are needed to trigger the Free Spins bonus round. There is no standard number of spins. Instead, a random amount is awarded that could be 8, 10, 12, 14, or 20 free spins. There is also a random multiplier of x2, x3, x4, or x5 applied to all wins during the bonus round. The Heist Respins, as well as the Quick Hit, can still be triggered during free spins. Not just that, but if 2 scatters land they award 2 more free spins and increase the multiplier by +1. If the multiplier reaches x10, then each new retrigger awards 4 more free spins.Players are technically able to trigger Heist Respins and Free spins on the same spin. If this happens, then Heist Respins are played first, followed by a round of free spins.Riches of Robin (Play'n GO): VerdictPlay'n GO has done a great job of bringing the Robin Hood story to life through attractive graphics and amiable characters used for symbols. Throw in some great features and the result is a very playable slot. The free spins round is a highlight, but plenty can still happen during the base game to keep players on their toes. After Free spins, the standout is the Quick Hit which can drop that 1,000x prize at any moment, with Heist Respins a close second.What is more, during free spins, a full grid of wilds and Marian symbols, along with the 10x multiplier will result in a payout of 4,000 times the stake from a single spin. Max payouts are capped at a respectable 10,000 times the stake which matches what we got with The Sword and the Grail.Overall, Riches of Robin hasn’t quite pushed The Sword and the Grail off the podium as Play'n GO’s best fantasy-themed slot of the year. But, that doesn’t stop it from being a highly entertaining slot. Riches of Robin provides plenty of excitement during base and bonus games, high volatility and potential, all bundled up in an appealing wrapper. It is certainly one of the better Robin Hood themed slots out there."

title: Victoria Wild Deluxe
structured_summary: Victoria Wild Deluxe is an adventurous desert-themed slot featuring the female explorer Victoria on her motorbike. The game offers features like random Sandstorm Wilds, two types of Free Spins with added wild mechanics, and a buy option for Temple Free Spins. The reviewer finds it a decent but minor upgrade from the original, best suited for fans who want quicker access to bonuses. Visuals showcase desert ruins with a see-through reel grid, complemented by a rousing, fitting soundtrack that enhances the adventurous atmosphere.
review: 7,"Victoria Wild Deluxe: Slot OverviewThe original Victoria Wild slot was released by TrueLab mid-2020 and starred a female adventurer making her way across sandstorm deserts to Temple Free Spins or Oasis Free Spins. It was an Yggdrasil Exclusive that garnered a measure of success for the up-and-coming team at TrueLab. So much so, the brave lady is back in a second slot titled Victoria Wild Deluxe. Deluxe is a word that usually means something of superior quality. Victoria Wild Deluxe isn't vastly superior since TrueLab has chosen to basically re-release the same game. However, this deluxe version does have a feature buy option, and a slight, yet handy alteration has been made to one of the free spins bonus games.This semi-loose use of the word deluxe means players essentially get the same Victoria Wild encounter as before. This is no bad thing because the game has a number of positives going for it. In the base game, the activity takes place on a see-through 5-reel, 15-payline game grid located in the middle of desert country, ruined buildings, piles of sand, and gnarled dry trees. Vic's there too, on her motorbike, ready to spring into action when called on. Just as importantly, the soundtrack is as rousing as before. Well, it's the same one as before, but it's as rousing as ever and fits the game's adventurous spirit like a charm.Numerically, there have been a few changes, some rising, some falling. One that has dipped is RTP, now coming in at 96.22%, or 96.24% when buying free spins, down from 96.4% found in the original. RTP is variable, by the way, so be sure to check, though volatility remains unchanged on its medium setting. As before, the deluxe version may be played on any device, where stakes vary from 15 p/c to $/€150 per spin.On to the paytable where nine regular symbols may be used to form winning combinations when three or more line up across the 15 fixed paylines. Four of the symbols are low pay N, S, E, W compass points; four are medium pay canteens, boots, bikes, and revolvers, plus one high pay symbol. This is Victoria - she is worth 40x the bet for five of a kind or 160x the bet for six of a kind in bonus games when an extra reel is added. Several types of wilds hit the reels at various phases, possessing the same value as the Victoria high pay symbol. Wilds land anywhere to substitute regular pays to help complete line wins.Victoria Wild Deluxe: Slot FeaturesYou won't find many additional features in the deluxe, which is fine since there was already plenty on tap. The base game benefits from a Sandstorm feature triggered randomly on any paid spin. When active, 2 to 6 Tornado Wilds drop onto the reels.If at least one added Tornado Wild collides with another Tornado Wild, Sticky Tornado Respins are activated. During respins, all wilds are locked in place while reels respin. If a new wild appears, it is held alongside the other sticky wilds for another respin. The Sticky Tornado Respin feature ends when no new wilds appear.Temple Free Spins are next, triggered when 3 or more scatter symbols land. The number awarded is 8, 10, or 12 free spins when 3, 4, or 5 scatters hit. In free spins, a 6th reel is added to the grid, and whenever a Lamp Wild symbol lands, Victoria collects it. If, at the end of free spins, at least 7 lamp wilds have accrued, the Secret Treasury feature activates. This awards 1 Wheel of Desire spin, where players win a payout of 15 to 160x their stake, or a multiplier of x2 to x25, which is applied to the total amount won during Temple Free Spins. Beware the one skull segment on the wheel awarding 'no win'.The second bonus game is Oasis Free Spins. Next to the grid, a map has been placed over the 6th reel. Collecting 25 Oasis symbols in the base game moves you along the map's path and triggers 10 Oasis Free Spins. In this round, the 6th reel is activated, and Waterfall Wilds appear. These wilds cover all positions on their respective reel when they land. In Victoria Wild Deluxe, Waterfall Wilds can land on all 6 reels instead of reels 2-5 in the previous game.Players who aren't in the mood to wait for Temple Free Spins can now buy them. The cost is 56x the bet for at least 3 Temple Scatters to land on the next spin. Just to be clear, it is not possible to buy Oasis Free Spins.Victoria Wild Deluxe: Slot VerdictPlayers who were entertained by the previous non-deluxe version of Victoria Wild will be just as thrilled by this one – provided they're into bonus buys. If you're looking to get some Victoria action in your life and aren't bothered with the feature buy, the previous one does have a more favourable return to player value. Well, there are Waterfall Wilds on all reels in Oasis Free Spins now too, which is appreciated, but most of the time, you can't really tell one game from the other.As such, there isn't much to add to the previous slot's verdict. Victoria Wild Deluxe is a fun, medium volatile game, with an adventurous nature, supplied by the Indiana Jones visuals and excellent soundtrack - plus the features are pretty good. Strangely, during the review, the best wins came from Sticky Tornado Respins rather than free spins – despite repeatedly hammering the bonus buy for Temple Free Spins. Winning potential remains impressive, and Victoria Wild Deluxe has a built-in win cap of 25,000x the bet. It might not be needed, though, since the most TrueLab coaxed out over a billion simulated game rounds was 16,130 times the bet.Victoria Wild Deluxe would have been a more intriguing prospect if TrueLab had made a completely new slot for Vicky to star in. But it's a decent enough upgrade for followers of the first to skip straight to Temple Free Spins while benefiting from more modifiers in Oasis Free Spins. Of course, if the first Victoria Wild failed to spark your imagination, this one will blow past like sand on a lonely desert breeze as well."

title: Into The Storm
structured_summary: Into the Storm is a Viking-themed slot set aboard a longship braving storms for treasure. It features walking wild respins, Kraken-triggered bonus rounds with Hot Zones, and a buy pass option for direct bonus access. The reviewer finds it a solid, volatile streak respin game with unique mechanics but less explosive than top competitors. The aesthetics are sturdy and pleasant with subtle sound effects enhancing the action, though somewhat plain overall.
review: 2022",7.5,"Into the Storm: Slot OverviewBoard a Viking Longship and find fortune on the seas (hopefully) in a feature fest of a game titled Into the Storm from developer SG Digital. Even landlubbers are well aware of the need to avoid storms when traipsing about the ocean, especially so in a boat built in the days of yore. Not to worry, if lightning and bad weather strike in Into the Storm, it generally hails the approach of features such as respins with walking wilds and streak respins with a clever Kraken Hot Zone element.However the rest of the session might turn out, SG Digital has picked a stellar day to set sail. The sky is mostly blue, a hale wind fills the sails, and the sea is slight, making it an ideal day for some virtual pillaging. Set aboard a sturdy wooden ship sits a 5-reel, 3-row game panel armed with 20 fixed paylines. Sonically, there isn't a whole lot going on, but the occasional effects do enhance the action when they fire, so all in all, a pleasant beginning, a touch plain, though with just a hint of the potential cyclogenesis to come.Matching both the weather and the Viking temperament, Into the Storm is a highly volatile game that can switch moods in a moment. The game comes in three RTP settings, maxing out at 96% before dropping to 94% or even 90%, depending on the jurisdiction. It offers a range of stakes, starting at 20 p/c, going as high as $/€20 per spin, and there is a suspicion the max bet has been kept fairly modest to account for the solid potential on tap for lucky raiders.The looting begins when at least three matching symbols land in view, starting from the grid's left most side. A collection of five runes have been used for the low pays, firing off wins of 1-2x the bet when a line of five of them is formed. Next up, high pays consist of three Viking characters and a random helmet, paying 4-20x the bet for a five of a kind win line. Wilds perform a variety of functions, as covered in the features section, but their core duty is to substitute for all of the normal pay tiles and only appear in the base game or during respins.Into the Storm: Slot FeaturesSG Digital has packed plenty of features for this voyage, so settle in as we cover Walking Wild Respins, Krakens, and the Into the Storm Bonus.Wild RespinsThe respins feature triggers at random on any base game spin. When activated, 2, 3, or 4 Walking Wilds appear on the reels and move one position to the left or right (they stick to the same direction) on each respin. If a Walking Wild lands over a regular wild symbol, a +1 multiplier is added for the rest of the feature. When no more Walking Wilds are in view, respins end.Into the Storm BonusKraken Bonus symbols land on regular base game spins, and 3, 4, or 5 of them in view triggers the bonus game with 1, 2, or 3 Kraken Hot Zones, respectively. The Into the Storm Bonus is played on a 9x5 sized grid with 3 starting spins. Each position spins to reveal blank spaces, multipliers of x1-x3, or modifier symbols, and if any of the latter two hits, the spin counter resets to 3. Multiplier or modifier symbols lock in place and reset the spins count. Three of the modifiers act like so:Hammer – lightning doubles a random number of multipliers.Treasure Chest – collects the values of all current gold multipliers.Viking Coin – increases the number of lives to 4.The fourth modifier is the Kraken Hot Zone. Kraken symbols either land or are awarded at the start of the feature, depending on the number of triggering scatters. Each Kraken creates a Hot Zone by placing multipliers of x2-x5 in all of the adjacent spaces. These are not multiplier symbols, by the way. If Hot Zones overlap, their multipliers are multiplied together. When an actual multiplier symbol lands in a Hot Zone position, it is multiplied by the current multiplier value it lands on. When spins run out, the total of all multiplier symbols is awarded, or, if the grid is filled, players win 10,000x their stake.Buy PassThe Buy Pass feature allows players to buy direct access to the bonus round. It is possible to buy 3+, 4+, or 5 scatters for the cost of 105x, 145x, or 185x the bet.Into the Storm: Slot VerdictSo are we dealing with the Viking Money Train 2 here? Well, not quite, but Into the Storm is a sturdy streak respin game with one or two intriguing innovations. It kind of feels like it was designed by the division of SG Digital that came up with Rise of the Mountain King or made in the same spirit, which is highly positive. It might remind you a bit of Relax Gaming's Sails of Fortune at first glance, yet Into the Storm has more than enough going to stand on its own two feet and thrill players keen on the streak respin format.It's not all calm sailing in the base game, either, thanks to the walking wilds respin feature. A sideshow to the main event, to be sure, but an appreciated one, regardless. The storm doesn't reach full force till the three (or more) required Krakens hit, thereby triggering the central bonus game. There's some good stuff going on here; the Kraken Hot Zone idea, for one. Hot Zone's ability to increase standard multiplier symbols is critical to scoring decent returns for the simple reason that without them, multiplier symbols are only worth 1-3x the bet. Still, Kraken Hot Zone multipliers aren't massive either, and the best case, really, is two x5s overlapping to create an x25. This led to some furious calculator tapping and the realisation that one of Into the Storm's weaker points is that outside of full-grid wins, runners up are highly unlikely to get anywhere near 10,000x. Once clocked, a slight feeling of limited constriction did settle in - there certainly isn't the same anything-goes feeling of a Money Train 2 bonus round when a special symbol can drop from nowhere and blast the game into orbit.With the right frame of mind though, Into the Storm offers some nice hold & win gaming with a Viking twist. It might help to tone down expectations of scoring runaway bonus rounds, aside from full grid hits, that is. Into the Storm might not be vying for the top spot, but there is plenty here for streak respinners to attempt plundering."

title: Reign of Rome
structured_summary: Reign of Rome is a militaristic Ancient Rome-themed slot highlighting warfare and legacy. It features 5 reels, 19 paylines, cascading wins, Tribute symbols, LootLines, and three escalating bonus rounds including Path To Power, This Is Rome, and Fight For Glory. The reviewer praises the innovative LootLines mechanic and engaging bonus rounds, noting a 15,000x win cap and challenging hidden features. The game’s gritty, dense visuals and intense audio evoke a no-nonsense, warlike atmosphere reminiscent of Gladiator Legends.
review: 2025",8,"Reign of Rome: Slot OverviewThe reign of the Western Roman Empire may have ended in the year 476, but its legacy continues to cast a long, illustrious shadow down to the present day. From architecture, art, literature, law, and online slots, wide swathes of our lives feel the Roman touch. To have a little pretend dabble in the militaristic side of Ancient Rome, how about we take a tour of Hacksaw Gaming's Reign of Rome, a slot that brings back the studio's LootLines concept and connects it to a trio of bonus rounds of ascending levels of potency.Ancient Rome didn't exactly ease its way to the top of the pile through peace, love, and harmonious diplomacy. There was a lot of warfare involved, and Reign of Rome revels in this side of the ancient civilisation, where two armed legionnaires face each other across the active play area in a game world heavy on reds, blacks, and greys. The gritty artwork had a feel reminiscent of Gladiator Legends, Rise of Ymir, and Wanted Dead or a Wild - heavy, dense, no-nonsense stuff that feels like you're not just taking on an online slot but going to war.Reign of Rome slot - base gameReign of Rome is a 5-reel, 5-row slot awarding winning combinations of 3 OAK or more matching symbols along 19 paylines. Rated 4 out of 5, Reign of Rome is a medium-high volatile slot, with a maximum RTP of 96.27% when betting 10 c to $/€100 in the base game; the value alternates when buying bonus features.On the table of symbols, we find J-A card ranks, cups, swords, helmets, lions, and eagles. Hitting 5 OAK card royal wins pays 2.5 times the bet, while a line of 5 picture symbols pays 5 to 10 times the bet. However, one thing you won't see on the reels is wild symbols. Reign of Rome has a cascade win mechanic, though, removing winning symbols from the reels and dropping symbols in to replace them, repeating as long as wins continue to form.Reign of Rome: Slot FeaturesReign of Rome slot - Path to Power free spinsReign of Rome's features are Tribute symbols, the return or LootLines, a Path To Power bonus, a This Is Rome bonus, a Fight For Glory bonus, and bonus buys.Tribute Symbols and LootLinesTribute symbols land in 4 variations. Adding Tribute symbols have values of 1x to 10x, Revealing Adding Tribute symbols reveal values of 15x to 500x, Multiplying Tribute symbols have values of x2 to x5, and Revealing Multiplying symbols have values of x6 to x25. They award a cash prize based on the combined value of the Tribute in a LootLine.A LootLine is formed when there is a winning payline of Tribute symbols on the grid. The Tribute Multipliers are combined one by one from right to left. Adding Tributes are added while Multiplying Tributes multiply the value. Multiplying values in the leftmost position of LootLine are treated as Adding values.Bonus Game - Path To PowerLanding 3 FS scatters in the base game awards this feature with 10 free spins. The mechanics are the same as the base game, but there is an increased chance of hitting Tribute symbols with higher values. It's fun, busy, and packed with enough features to keep even the most jaded players mildly entertained. Whether you're here for the features or just to see a raccoon shout “Bonjour!” while wielding an axe, Le Viking delivers the goods. Just don't expect it to reinvent the wheel - or the longship."

title: Bugsy's Bar
structured_summary:

review: 2023",6,"Bugsy's Bar: Slot OverviewStep right up and get an eye load of the roaring 20s, 30s, or thereabouts in this crime-ridden online slot from casino game maker Red Tiger called Bugsy's Bar. Bugsy's Bar caps it all off with a soundtrack that plods through the base game before launching into swing mode when free spins trigger. Fairly dense atmospherically, all things considered, without doing anything exceptional or particularly non-cliched with the theme.Bugsy's Bar slot - base gameTo gain entrance to Bugsy's Bar, players pick a stake of 10 p/c to $/€2 per spin and may use any device to play the game. The action occurs on a game panel of 5 reels and 4 rows of symbols, where 30 paylines cross the grid to land winning combinations on.Three, four or five-of-a-kind winning lines can land in Bugsy's Bar, made up of J-A Art Deco fonted card royals, then a cash bag, and three nefarious-looking characters as the four high pay symbols. Lending a helpful hand, wild symbols appear on all reels to substitute any regular pay symbol. Should five wilds land along a payline, they award 10 times the bet for doing so.Bugsy's Bar: Slot FeaturesBugsy's Bar slot - pre bonus feature spinsBugsy's Bar's got nothing in the base game aside from line wins, so it's not until free spins are triggered that the action gets the chance of really hotting up. This lands a combination of three of these modifiers:Bonus Spins – 1, 2, or 3 additional free spins are added to the awarded tally.Remove Small-Time Symbol – J, Q, K or A symbols are removed from the reels for free spins.Locked Wilds – all wilds that land during the round remain locked until the feature ends.Super Wild – up to two 1x4-sized Super Wilds can possibly land on a free spin on reels 2 and 4.Wins Multiplier – awards a multiplier of x2, x3, or x5. Multipliers apply to all wins during the round.It is possible to win the same modifier more than once, though there are limits which are detailed in the extensive rules section of the paytable. For example, multipliers stack when they are awarded more than once but up to a maximum of x10. Landing 3 scatters on the final free spin of the feature retriggers 7 free spins, and a retrigger of Bugsy's Special. If the Win Multiplier, Locked Wilds, Super Wilds, and Remove Small-Time Symbols have maxed out, Bugsy's Special only awards additional free spins.Bugsy's Bar slot - free spinsBugsy's Bar: Slot VerdictHey ho, there you go, not a bad wee speakeasy, bootleggin', crime in the earlier part of the 20th-century style slot to while away a bit of time on. It's easy, handsomely presented, and potentially lucrative should the shot glasses pour their bounty just so. That probably won't happen in the base game since it's modifier-free. Oh sure, technically, a decent line win or two might trundle along, but no modifiers means it might be a fairly uneventful journey. If you like the theme, though, Bugsy's Bar's main game shouldn't be too dull, thanks to the jazzy looks and sounds. It's all a little livin' on the wrong side of the law and having a bit of fun while doing so spirit of the age thing.Since the base game can be pretty uneventful, making it to the bonus round is that little bit more exciting when it finally does trigger. Then, Bugsy gets the chance to flex his hospitality skills by pouring some modifiers onto the reels. For Bugsy's Bar, this means wins as high as 26,670x the bet, which is quite a haul, a metaphorical full swag bag, if you will.Back in the day, Alan Parker wrote and directed 'Bugsy Malone', a humorous musical gangster film starring Scott Baio and Jodie Foster, where everyone in it was a kid, and the guns fired whipped cream instead of bullets. Sounds bizarre, but it actually made number 353 on Empire's 500 greatest movies of all time list. Perhaps it's a complete coincidence that Bugsy's Bar shares a similar name, perhaps not. What's our point? Not sure, but while the test run went okay, and Bugsy's Bar came across as a textbook Red Tiger release with sizable winning potential, it's arguable how high up any top 500 lists it would make."

review: "October 5, 2023",6.5,"Gem Fire Frenzy: Slot OverviewAlong with creating fire to help us digest food a lot quicker, inventing circular objects for transportation purposes, and attaching sharpened rocks to bits of wood to hit annoying people with, another thing humans began doing early on is adorning their bodies with extravagant items. title: Beat the Beast: Kraken's Lair
structured_summary:
- Beat the Beast: Kraken’s Lair centers on a mythical sea monster theme, featuring the legendary Kraken as the fearsome beast.  
- The game offers high volatility, a 5x3 reel setup with 9 paylines, and key features like Expanding Win symbols and retriggerable free spins.  
- The reviewer finds it a solid, thrilling slot with good payout potential, though not entirely original, serving as a strong series opener.  
- Visually appealing with high-definition symbols and an atmospheric underwater setting, complemented by a fitting audio backdrop.
review: 7.5,"Beat the Beast: Kraken’s Lair (Thunderkick): OverviewSwedish provider Thunderkick is planning to release a collection of five classic slots designed to take players on a thrilling and highly volatile journey. Described by the provider as slots ‘made for the brave’ - that's not only due to the volatile nature of the games, but because each slot also features a terrifying beast. What is more, the volatility is matched by solid potential and coming from Thunderkick, high production values can be expected as well, which certainly helps with the allure.So the first beast to beat in Thunderkick’s series is the mythical Kraken, the octopus-like guardian of the deep. This is the third slot to feature the denizen of the sea so far this year, which has blunted its visceral impact somewhat. Still, the series looks promising, and the Kraken’s Lair online slot has been equipped with a modern twist that Thunderkick claims to set it apart. We'll see about that.Thunderkick describe their Beat the Beast range as a collection of classic slots. First impressions confirm this with a conventional 5 reel, 3 row set up that uses 9 fixed paylines. Thunderkick has quite a knack at making slots that look both basic, yet visually appealing at the same time. Beat the Beast: Kraken’s Lair keeps up the tradition with functional, yet pleasing visuals. This is pulled off by the high-def symbols, and an atmospheric underwater background replete with sunken ships. No doubt these ships and their crew were dragged to their doom by the beastly hero of the story.Taking on the beast comes with stakes that start at 10 p/c and go up to $/€100 per spin. The rules are simple. Like we got with Sword of Khans, three low pays, or two premiums on a payline award a win. The low pays are made up of 10 – A royals, which have a metallic/stone look to them. The premiums include a trident, a pendant, a chest, and two Kraken symbols. There is a big difference in values of the two. The Gold Mid-Kraken is like the baby version and is worth 50 times the stake for five. The purple daddy Kraken is ten times better at 500 times the stake for a five of a kind combination. There is a Kraken styled wild symbol that also doubles as a scatter so we will go over that in the next section.Mathematically, the game comes with a rock solid RTP rating of 96.12% so no complaints with the key stats. Designed to be highly volatile, there are dry spells to expect during the base game. Offsetting that are decent value combos that crop up now and then as well as feature drops. The good thing is that features can occur during the base game which helps the flow and keeps player engagement up.Beat the Beast: Kraken’s Lair (Thunderkick): FeaturesFree spins game in actionBeat the Beast: Kraken’s Lair contains some high-value symbols, but the key to the most profitable outcomes is the Kraken Emblem. This golden symbol proves its worth as both the wild and the scatter. As a wild, it can substitute for any other symbol in the base game and the bonus game. When the Kraken Emblem is used as part of a winning combination, it triggers the Expanding Win feature. With this feature, the regular symbols that were used in the combination expand to cover the full reel to create even more winners. This effect is possible in both the base and bonus games.When 3 or more Kraken Emblems land they trigger the bonus game which comes with 10 Free Spins. On top of the feature 3, 4, or 5 Emblems also award 2x, 20x, and 200x the stake respectively. In the bonus game, you will benefit from a Kraken Emblem being placed on the reels at random at the beginning of every spin. If 3 or more scatters land during the bonus game, they trigger 10 more free spins. Excellently, there is no limit to how many times free spins can be retriggered.Beat the Beast: Kraken’s Lair (Thunderkick): VerdictWith its high volatility and fairly high rewards, Beat the Beast: Kraken’s Lair is a satisfying introduction to the series. Thunderkick has pretty much fulfilled what they set out to accomplish with it. Namely, to build a classic slot that possesses a modern twist. No, it’s not an entirely original slot, nor does it possess entirely original twists. The scatter/wild combination cropped up in Sword of Khans for one example, as did the expanding symbols mechanism. Though admittedly, the expanding symbol rules here have been changed slightly due to effect of the Kraken Emblem. Then there is the potential, which at 7,777 times the stake is good, but again, that level of potential is not exactly unheard of when it comes to Thunderkick's portfolio of games.Still, the final product might not be completely new or novel, but the overall result is a thrilling and fast-paced slot with good payout potential nonetheless. In addition, it is still early days with the first release in the Beat the Beasts series. With four more follow up monster filled titles to come, the series could go anywhere. The overall impact will become more apparent when we can combine the later releases for a full assessment. For now, players have another solid Kraken driven slot to spin.Be sure to take a look at Thunderkick's second instalment in the Beat the Beast series, Mighty Sphinx - a 5-reel, 9-payline slot with potential for wins of over 4,000 times your stake."

title: Book of Dead

review: 10,"Book of Dead Slot: OverviewFar be it for us to state that there are many (some may say too many) online slots that centre themselves on the Ancient Egypt theme. title: Taco Brothers Derailed
structured_summary: Taco Brothers Derailed is a Western-themed slot set in the gold rush town of Santa Maria, featuring the mischievous Taco Brothers and the villainous Captain Diaz. The game includes 6 reels, 466 paylines, Walking Wilds with multipliers, a Taco Train Heist bonus, and a Taco Smash N' Grab Super Bonus round. The reviewer praises the game's evolved features and higher volatility, offering exciting gameplay and up to 10,000x max wins. Visually darker than its predecessors, it combines gritty aesthetics with an upbeat Spanish soundtrack.
review: 2022",7.5,"Taco Brothers Derailed: Slot OverviewAs the saying goes, 'during a gold rush, sell shovels', and there is a lot of wisdom to the maxim. However, selling mining supplies can be a time-consuming business, so there are always those, like Evil Captain Diaz, who would rather just steal people's gold – and their freedom. This brings us to Taco Brothers Derailed from software provider ELK Studios, the third slot in the series and the biggest, tacoiest one so far.The original Taco Brothers slot took place in the sleepy village of Santa Maria, which is where we return for Derailed. Only this time, a gold rush is on, bringing 'gold, tacos, and trains for everyone.' Sounds alright, but beware, Captain Diaz also returns with his dastardly ways to ruin the party. It's the player's job to team up with the three brothers and the mysterious Señorita to help out and hopefully win a few coins along the way. Derailed is darker looking than the original sunshiny slot, and Santa Maria doesn't really feel like a town in the middle of a gold boom. It's like a grimmer version of Wild Toro 2, lacking the original game's feel-good visuals, though the soundtrack is a bouncy, upbeat Spanish sensation.Amazingly, Taco Brothers part one came out in 2015, so there's no surprise to see one or two statistical u-turns have taken place. Max win is the most obvious one, but other things like volatility have been increased to 'High' (7 out o 10), while RTP has headed in the opposite direction, coming in at 95%. This value applies whether you play in the regular mode, where paid spins cost 20 p/c to $/€100, or when one of the five X-iter modes is activated.The grid's gown too. Now the game area consists of 6-reels, 4-rows and is crossed by 466 connecting paylines. Winning combinations begin on the leftmost reel and pay left to right on adjacent reels but must be touching either horizontally or diagonally to do so. The three brothers make up the highest paying symbols, worth 5-50x the bet for six of a kind, then below them are shakers, whistles, skulls, lanterns, and safes, slinging wins worth 0.5-2x the bet for a line of six. There is a stack of wild action to be found in Taco Brothers Derailed, including a plain regular one. All of which substitute for any pay symbol.Taco Brothers Derailed: Slot FeaturesSeveral of Derailed's features have direct links to the original slot, though, on the whole, the game has had a major overhaul. Let's start with Walking Wilds and Walking Multiplier Wilds. All Taco Brother pay symbols can land as Walking Wilds. They move one space to the left, and each step triggers a respin. Respins end when Walking Wilds fall off the leftmost side. Walking Wilds also turn any corresponding Taco Brother pay symbol wild. The Walking Multiplier Wild is a little different and appears on the top row only. It carries a multiplier, and all regular wilds in view are given the same multiplier. Like the Brothers, these wilds generate respins for each step left they take.Taco Train HeistBonus symbols are present on reels 2, 3, 4 or 5, and landing exactly 3 of them triggers the Taco Train Heist bonus round. All three Walking Wild Taco Brothers are guaranteed to land during the bonus game. Each brother is added to reel 6 one at a time, and they move left one position per spin, carrying a multiplier that changes on each step.Pico lands first on the bottom row, generating a respin for each step left he takes. When Pico walks off the grid or is imprisoned, the second brother Pepe lands on the right-hand side of the second row. Once Pepe has walked off or been imprisoned, Paso appears on the third row. The bonus round ends when all brothers are locked and/or have fallen off the grid. When a brother walks off the grid, his multiplier is added to the multipliers of remaining Walking Wild Taco Brothers in view.There are two more key symbols. One is Captain Diaz, who lands only on the first reel. When he hits, he imprisons the brother closest to the first reel, turning him into a locked, valueless blocker tile. The second is the Señorita, landing on the rightmost reel. When she hits, she either unlocks a locked Taco Brother or sends the one closest to the first reel back to the sixth reel.Taco Smash N' GrabThis feature is awarded when 4 bonus symbols land in the base game. This feature starts with all three Walking Wild Taco Brothers plus a walking wild symbol stacked on reel 6. They all move in sync, one step left, triggering a respin as they move. In this Super Bonus round, Captain Diaz is wild and cannot lock any of the Walking Wild Taco Brothers. Should the Señorita hit, she pulls a Walking Wild Taco Brother to reel 6. The feature ends when Walking Wild Taco Brothers walk off the grid.X-iterThe second way of playing Taco Brothers Derailed is in feature buy mode by clicking the X-iter button, if present. This provides these five options:Bonus Hunt – 2x the bet to double the chance of triggering the bonus game.Walking Wild Taco Brother – 10x the bet for one spin with a guaranteed Walking Wild Taco Brother.Walking Multiplier Wild – 25x the bet for one spin with a guaranteed Walking Multiplier Wild.Bonus – 100x the bet to trigger the bonus game.Super Bonus – 500x the bet to trigger Taco Smash N' Grab.Taco Brothers Derailed: Slot VerdictAround seven years have passed since the first Taco Brothers game dropped, and some things have changed, some things have stayed the same. ELK has used the time to hone their development chops, and Taco Brothers Derailed is evidence of the studio's willingness to constantly evolve. This is a slot that returns many of the first game's best bits, conducts a set of major feature tweaks, and incorporates a few lessons learned from slots like Wild Toro 2. Derailed is once again about getting those Walking Wild Taco Brothers onto the reels, avoiding the Captain, and looping as many respins together as possible. This time, there are even more incentives to keep the Taco Brothers in view as long as possible.These incentives include multipliers and the way Walking Wilds turn corresponding Taco Brother symbols wild. Both are useful on their own but are something else when combined in the Super Bonus Round. Since all three brothers are active in the Taco Smash N' Grab, they can transform a lot of symbols into wilds. They also can't be imprisoned, which might be irritating when dead symbols are clogging up the grid in the regular bonus round. Interestingly, while the Super Bonus was more exciting, we tended to get better returns relative to the X-iter cost from the regular bonus round. Strange when you consider there's usually just one Walking Wild Taco Brother at a time unless the Señorita steps in to let bros out of prison, blasting extra life into the non-Super round. At max taco-ness, payers can win up to 10,000 times their stake in Taco Brothers Derailed.Taco Brothers Derailed has more dramatic ups downs than the less volatile, less potentially lucrative previous Taco Brothers slots and is an outstanding continuation of the series. It's a demonstration of ELK's onwards and upwards trajectory, as the team brings together the best parts of the original slot while jacking the gameplay, tease, and excitation to more extreme levels."

title: Lure of Fortune
structured_summary: Lure of Fortune is a sea-themed slot offering a fresh take on underwater adventure with three volatility modes that change gameplay dynamics. Key features include cluster wins, escalating multipliers, a unique bonus round with modifier symbols, and a bonus buy option. The reviewer praises its originality, depth, and replayability, highlighting the strategic choice of modes and engaging bonus mechanics. Visually, the game boasts detailed, vibrant graphics with changing weather effects across modes and a fitting audio backdrop enhancing the aquatic atmosphere.
review: 2023",8.5,"Lure of Fortune: Slot OverviewAhoy players, due to the abundance of salty sea themed slots bobbing around, it can sometimes feel like we've seen every possible way of dragging bounties from the water. However, Relax Gaming begs to differ and has come up with Lure of Fortune, which provides a brand new way of trying your luck amongst denizens of the deep. It is not a money symbol collector game following the blueprint laid down by Fishin' Frenzy all those many moons ago. Instead, it's stocked with features that echo other games, brand new ones, as well as an extensive bonus round, while also letting players experience the game in three different modes, which significantly alter the way Lure of Fortune may perform.Might as well deal with the modes first, and clicking the Mode button lets you change them. The options are medium, high, and extremely high volatility. Not only does the volatility change but the max win and the maximum base game multipliers do as well – more info on these soon. Lure of Fortune's appearance alters depending on the mode, as well. In medium mode, the sun beams down on a clear day, causing the water to sparkle. Flipping to highly volatile means the rain starts to fall, while the highly volatile mode takes place in the snow. No matter the mode, the graphics are very nicely done, highly detailed, with a neat mix of personable characters thrown in.Lure of Fortune slot - base gameWe've mentioned the alterable volatile, which is an interesting touch, though no matter the mode, the RTP remains constant at 96.1%. Bet selection changes, though. The minimum is 10c per spin, while the maximum is $/€20, $/€50, or $/€200 for the extremely high, high, and medium volatility modes, respectively. The goal of the base game, aside from hitting scatters, is to land winning clusters made up of 4 or more identical symbols next to each other in vertical or horizontal directions. This sparks a cascade sequence where the winning symbols are removed and replaced with others falling in from up top. Lure of Fortune's base game takes place on a 5x5 gaming grid before shifting to something different when the bonus round is triggered.Nine regular pay symbols appear on the 5 base game reels. These are shell-like items as the 4 low pays, 4 sea creatures as the mids, and a fisherman as the high pay symbol. Landing 4 OAK clusters awards 0.2 to 1 times the bet, increasing to 11 to 30 times the bet for a 25 symbol cluster win. Lure of Fortune does not have a wild symbol, but it has a ton of extra symbols when the bonus round activates.Lure of Fortune: Slot FeaturesLure of Fortune slot - volatility optionsBefore getting to the bonus round, however, there is one more base game feature to cover. This is the Multiplier Upgrade. Each pay symbol has a multiplier associated with it. These are clearly listed next to the grid. Multipliers are applied to wins of the applicable symbol type. Multipliers start at x1 and are doubled after each win on the symbol. The game can assign random upgrades of multipliers to a random number symbol at the start of a new spin. The maximum multiplier values are 32x, 64x, or 128x on the medium, high, or extremely high volatile modes, respectively.Bonus GameThe bonus game is activated when 3 scatter symbols land in the base game. When this occurs, 3 spins are awarded and landing any symbol on reels 1 to 6 resets the counter. It's played on a different grid than the base game, where all of the regular pay symbols are removed. Five symbols are placed along the second row from the bottom of reels 1 to 5, revealing multipliers of the bet. Reel 6 is a ladder of multiplier values which apply to symbols on the rows at the end of the bonus game. Reels 1 to 5 may land these modifier symbols on each spin:Fish – reveals a value and pushes up any symbols which are already on the reel it landed on.Hammer – pushes all symbols on the reel up one spot.Payer – reveals a value that is added to all symbols on its reel.Doubler – doubles the values of all symbols on its reel.Spawner – copies a symbol and its value on the reel, then places the copy one step below the original.On reel 6, the multiplier ladder, these modifier symbols may appear:Golden Hammer – pushes all symbols up by one spot.Payer – increases all multipliers on the ladder by +1.Doubler – doubles all multipliers on the ladder.Bonus – spin counter resets to 4 instead of 3.Persistent Hammer – pushes all symbols on a random reel up one spot at the end of each spin.Persistent Payer – pays its value to all symbols on a random reel at the end of each spin.Persistent Spawner – picks a random reel, then places a copy of a symbol and its value below the original.If symbols reach the top row, they may not get pushed off. If more than one symbol would be on the top row, the values are added. When the spin counter reaches zero, all of the values on the reels are multiplied by the row multiplier they are on, and the total is awarded.Buy FeaturePlayers are able to buy the bonus game for the cost of 50x, 100x, or 150x the bet on the medium, high, or very highly volatile modes, respectively. No matter the mode, the RTP for feature buys is 96.5%.Lure of Fortune slot - free spinsLure of Fortune: Slot VerdictHmm, interesting. While there are smatterings of other games here – the symbol multipliers of Banana Town, the hold 'n win extravaganza of a Money Train slot, and a Mega Heist feel to the bonus round, there is no doubt Lure of Fortune is its own game. One thing that sets it apart is its configurability, and picking modes seriously alters major aspects of the game, so it's maybe not a decision which should be taken too lightly. To sum up the differences between modes, what changes are things like volatility, max win, max base game multiplier, and bonus buy cost. For many, the most important number will be the max win, equating to 5,000x on the medium, 20,000x on the high, and 50,000x on the very high volatile mode. The temptation to play for the biggest potential possible is likely to be great, but there are benefits to picking the other options. Bonus buys of 50x the bet, for example, might win certain gamblers over, plus the medium mode's sunshine is inviting.No matter the mode, Lure of Fortune's mix of gameplay is unique, especially for a slot related to fish and other creatures of the sea. One good thing about the bonus game is that the fish symbols do not have to reach the top of the grid to award their values. Memories (or nightmares) of Mad Cars awoke at the first look at the bonus round, where values big or small were absolutely worthless until they crossed the finish line, or not, which could be devastating. Anyway, this effect is absent from Lure of Fortune, where everything in view is awarded at the end, not to mention boosted by row multipliers.Of course, not every bonus game was a stunner, and the feature didn't have the same immediate paciness to it as Bones & Bounty as a possible comparison, but it is original and more than capable of exciting when the going's good. To conclude, Lure of Fortune is a slot packed with interesting ideas, customizable elements, and fun gameplay. Whether it ultimately frustrates or delights, Lure of Fortune's base and bonus game has the sort of depth that provides high levels of entertaining replayability."

title: Christmas Tree 2
structured_summary: Christmas Tree 2 is a festive slot featuring a Christmas tree-shaped grid and seasonal symbols. review: 2021",7,"Christmas Tree 2: Slot OverviewWe hadn't had a Christmas slot for a few days, so it seemed like the Xmas rush might have been over for the year. But no, here comes another one from TrueLab Games called Christmas Tree 2. As you can no doubt tell, this is the sequel to the original game Christmas Tree, released roughly a year previous just in time for the season. So, what's changed? Not a whole heck of a lot. Amongst a few things, a new Snowman Bet feature has been jammed on, and the new RTP is quite heart-warming, definitely more so than the previous one. Let's look at them all in the review and see how much Xmas-ness we can squeeze out.The graphics have had a minor spruce up for one. Squint, and you'll miss it, but the baubles on the tree-shaped game grid appear more defined than they were before. Hey, we did say minor. The layout remains the same, so from top to bottom, symbols are arranged in a 2-3-4-5-6-7 formation which might have been more confusing if TrueLab hadn't incorporated a cluster pays system. On the left, dipping and diving, the Snowman chap is as chipper as ever and ready to lob snowballs onto the game panel to trigger a modifier. Overall, the game has a certain amount of Christmas cheer going on; there's trees, snow, and decorations, good enough.Opposite the Snowman, on the right-hand side of the screen, is one of the new bits. This is the Snowman Bet feature which makes a massive difference to the cost of each spin. Without it, stakes can be set from 40 p/c to $/€400, or, when the Snowman Bet is activated, the cost rockets to a mind-bending $/€8 to $/€8,000 per pop (although this number is likely to be limited on most casinos). Another mind-bender is the new RTP value of 98.03% in the default mode, or 98.07% when Snowman betting.On this tree, you need at least 5 matching symbols to land in connecting positions to create a winning cluster, thereby activating the cascade mechanic in the process. Regular symbols are all baubles ready to hang on a tree, such as three various coloured low pay balls, mid pay canes, sweets, bells, then high pay angels, and Santas. The most valuable clusters are comprised of 27 symbols and are worth a monstrous 3,000 to 15,000x the base bet. One more symbol to keep an eye out for is the snow globe wild which substitutes for anything except mystery symbols or scatters.Christmas Tree 2: Slot FeaturesChristmas Tree 2 - Snowman feature activatedFeatures to look forward to while playing Christmas Tree 2 include cascades, the Snowman extra, Blizzards, and Miracle Spins.SnowmanEvery so often, the Snowman chucks snowballs at low and medium symbols at the beginning of a random spin. All current and future instances of hit symbols transform into Golden wilds. There is nothing special about Golden wilds, despite the name. They are simply wild versions of regular symbols. If the Snowman Bet is active, the Snowman feature triggers on every spin.BlizzardWhen no winning clusters are left, a Blizzard may sweep the board, leaving 3-9 mystery symbols behind. Mystery symbols all turn into the same symbol, which can be anything, including wilds or scatters. Blizzards blow through in the base game or in free spins.Miracle SpinsMiracle Spins are triggered when 3 gold star scatters land on the reels. Just to be clear, scatters only appear when they are revealed by the Blizzard feature. Also, every additional scatter in view after the third awards an extra free spin. The Snowman is active on each Miracle Spin and, after every cascade payout, a progressive win multiplier increases by +1.Christmas Tree 2: Slot VerdictWell, it's not hugely different from Christmas Tree part one, but there have been a few changes. One of the less popular decisions was axing the Christmas Present feature, which used to be awarded for scoring at least three consecutive cascading wins. Sure, Christmas isn't only about presents, yet they do make up much of the fun. As a compensator, TrueLab has dialled up the RTP to eye-catching proportions. It's been a while since we last saw such a high figure, and fitting that it should occur in a Christmas themed slot of all things.The other major alteration is the new Snowman Bet which might be easy to get carried away with. Lobbing snowballs onto the tree on every spin does boost excitement levels, fair enough. Yet, you pay the price, and increasing the bet by x20 is particularly noticeable when trying to stretch a budget since the lowest base stake of 40 p/c now equates to $/€8 per spin. A colossal price difference, but hey, it's totally optional and provides players who like to go large a potential outlet. On the topic of potential, Christmas Tree 2 isn't as rosy as the original. This time around, TrueLab has capped things at 15,000x the bet, still substantial, though far shy of the 25,000x the first one boasted.Despite the few changes, Christmas Tree 2 was largely on par with the original release. The triangular grid is a novelty worth test running if you're into cluster paying grid slots, and the new betting options might prove enticing for high rollers to get stuck into. Other than that, Christmas Tree 2 is as good as most other Xmas slots. Playable on one day of the year, perhaps not so much on the others."

title: Book of Inferno
structured_summary: Book of Inferno is a dark, diabolical slot themed around Dante's journey into the fiery underworld, featuring demonic beasts and lava-filled landscapes. The game offers a 5x3 grid with 10 fixed paylines, expanding Marked symbols, symbol upgrades, free spins, and a buy feature for bonus rounds. The reviewer praises its bold theme, skillful design, and solid gameplay tweaks that refresh the classic 'Book of' formula. Visually, it impresses with striking, heavy artwork and immersive, ominous audio that enhance the menacing atmosphere.
review: 2023",8,"Book of Inferno: Slot Overview'I have come to lead you to the other shore; into eternal darkness; into fire and into ice', wrote one of the towering intellectuals of the Middle Ages, the Italian poet Dante Alighieri in his magnum opus The Divine Comedy. There's something about Dante and his guide Virgil's trip into the abyss that has left a lasting impression on readers ever since it was released in the early 14th century. It's this sort of fiery, beast-filled world players are unloaded on in Book of Inferno from developer Quickspin. Yes, this is another 'Book of' slot for sure, but one which mixes a few rule tweaks with hair-raising audio-visuals to lift it into a newer, terrifying plane of existence than most manage to reach.In Book of Inferno, developer Quickspin sends players to the underworld, the nether regions, the lake of fire, or however you would like to reference it. As such, we get demonic beasts, lava pools, jagged rock formations, scary sculptures, and a heavy, ominous dark sky. Not everyone's definition of a fun place to hang out, but one which offers a stack of striking artwork. Quickspin's audio team has done an equally good job of adding an additional layer of depth, heaviness and horror with the sounds. We're not alone down here, though. Thankfully, the studio has populated Book of Inferno with a heroine called Anna the Demon Huntress, and with a name like that, she's definitely in the right place. We are a long way from Ancient Egypt, the progenitor theme of the 'Book of' genre, and if the visuals or setting aren't too terrifying, Quickspin has designed a game which makes a bold statement from the moment it loads.Book of Inferno slot - base gameWhile the looks might make a statement, Book of Inferno keeps things pretty regular in terms of setup. This translates to a 5-reel game grid, each reel holding 3 rows and crossed by 10 fixed paylines. A highly volatile gambling machine, the game may be found with alternative RTP models, the highest one having a value of 96.15%, increasing to 96.65% if buying free spins. Any device may be used, and bets start at 10 p/c per spin, topping out at $/€100.Ten pay symbols are present on the reels, split into low pay 9-A card royals and four high pay characters symbols. These characters are the Commander of Hell, the Lady of Hell, the Lord of Hell, and Anna the Demon Huntress. Hitting a five-of-a-kind winning line awards payouts of 8 to 12 times the bet for the low pays or 75 to 500 times the bet for the premiums. There's a book symbol here too, which is wild, so it replaces any normal pay symbols and the scatter. Books can create wins of themselves, too, worth up to 500x the bet for a line of five of them.Book of Inferno: Slot FeaturesBook of Inferno slot - free spins special expanding symbolFor the most part, Book of Inferno follows the usual 'Book of' MO of expanding, pay anywhere, all lines special symbols in free spins. However, it also uses the concept at times in the base game, as well as a Marked symbol upgrade element, as well.Marked SymbolsWhenever a Marked symbol lands (in the base or bonus game), if there are enough of them to create a win, they expand to cover the whole reel. These expanded symbols pay anywhere, and on all paylines, they do not need to be adjacent to each other or anything like that. If a Book lands at the same time as a Marked symbol, the Marked symbol is upgraded to the next highest value symbol type, possibly creating more Marked symbols and expansion. If the Marked symbol is upgraded beyond the highest paying symbol, the lowest paying symbol is converted into the highest one.Free SpinsLanding 3, 4, or 5 books awards, 10, 15, or 20 free spins with an x2, 20x, or 200x the bet win on top, respectively. The same number of free spins are triggered if this occurs while the bonus round is active. At the start of free spins, a highly detailed grimoire of a book flips its pages to randomly pick a pay symbol to be marked for the round.Buy FeaturePlayers with access to this feature can pay 125x the bet to buy free spins triggered by 3 or more books. The RTP when buying free spins is 96.65%.Book of Inferno slot - free spinsBook of Inferno: Slot Verdict'Book of' slots are a dime a dozen, so it takes something pretty special to make any sort of impact with yet another one. Play'n GO, for example, is adept at tweaking some of the settings, covering them in quality art and rolling them out again and again. Book of Inferno felt like Quickspin had pushed that idea to the next level. The game has a great look if you're into this sort of heavy diabolical thing, and Quickspin has been rather daring with their choice of topic. Even the smaller details, like the book animations when features trigger, have been skillfully pulled off, and everything contributes to a slickly designed, imaginative 'Book of' slot, the likes of which haven't really been seen much before, if ever.On the gaming side, Book of Inferno delivers the sort of rock-solid helping of expanding symbol action fans of this style would expect, with some new stuff tacked on for good measure. The newer bits being Marked symbols in the base game, while not completely original, is uncommon enough to feel a little bit special, as well as the way Books can upgrade Marked Symbols. They aren't major innovations, but when combined with the eye-catching visuals and the heavy sounds, they're good enough tweaks to help elevate the game further. At its fiery core, Book of Inferno is all about hitting those Marked symbols, getting them to expand and pay all ways from all positions. In this way, Book of Inferno is another in a long line of Book of Ra descendants, albeit one that looks and sounds very different to the original.As mentioned, there are a ton of these sorts of games floating around the market, though few conduct themselves the way Book of Inferno does. Book of Shadows kind of went dark, yet Book of Inferno rams the concept even further. For those who like their games menacing, heavy, and just a little bit scary, Book of Inferno could be an ideal go-to."

title: Monopoly Megaways
structured_summary: Monopoly Megaways blends the classic Monopoly board game theme with Big Time Gaming’s Megaways slot mechanics. It features Cascading Reels, the innovative Reel Adventures system with Mr. Monopoly navigating the board, and a free spins bonus with multipliers and property-building elements. The reviewer praises its well-integrated features, high volatility, and strong payout potential, calling it the standout Monopoly slot. The game boasts familiar Monopoly symbols, vibrant visuals, and engaging audio that complement the immersive gameplay experience.
review: Out Now,7,"Monopoly Megaways: OverviewTwo of the biggest titles in the entertainment world are set to collide thanks to software house Big Time Gaming. Monopoly, the board game which has sold millions of copies since the 1930s, is the newest slot to get the Megaways treatment. What this means for players is a familiar looking game, which not only offers up to 117,649 ways to win, but the Reactions and Reel Adventure systems are also thrown in for good measure.Ideal for casual gaming with spins starting at 10 c/p, higher rollers can take that up to $/€20 for bigger stakes. Playable on virtually any device and screen size makes this a democratic experience that is likely to appeal to most fans of Big Time Gaming. Add in an enticing blend of free spins, multipliers, and the generous antics of Mr Monopoly, and the result is a solid mix of fun gaming with big potential payouts.The numbers look good too. The game’s 6 reels alternate the number of symbols on each, up to 7, which is how it hits that huge number of pay ways that the Megaways engine is famous for. Highly volatile, the RTP comes in at 96.39% which is well within the acceptable range. When it comes to payout potential, the good news keeps on coming. During base game, top prizes come in the range of several thousand times the stake while during free spins, this could be as high as 15,000 times the stake.Symbols combine classic 9 to Ace card royals at the lower end of the paytable, with icons of Monopoly at the higher end such as the dog, battleship, top hat, and race car. At the top, we get a capital ‘M’ in a jazzy jewel-encrusted gold symbol worth 50 times the stake. As with many Megaways driven slots, don’t expect too much in the way of lucrative symbols. Concurrent winning combinations pep them up, as do the numerous extra features that Monopoly Megaways possesses.Monopoly Megaways: FeaturesMonopoly Megaways main gameBeing a Megaways slot, the game comes with Cascading Reels. When winning combinations are formed, the winning symbols vanish off the screen to allow for new symbols to land in their vacated spots. This can lead to more winning combos, and the procedure repeats until no more combos appear. In this way, multiple wins can stack up from just one spin.At the core of Monopoly Megaways is the Reel Adventures mechanic, used only once before in Holy Diver Megaways. Instead of a brave knight, it's Mr Monopoly that plays the key role in this game. The spritely wee chap makes his way around the Monopoly board, and the squares he lands on have a direct effect on the gameplay like so:Landing on ‘Go’ gifts the next spin with the maximum number of Megaways.Landing on utilities and railway stations makes them yours and will come into play during the bonus game.Landing on chance sends you to a random street with 1 to 4 houses added. It can also launch free spins or max out the Megaways on the next spin.Community chest results in being sent to a random street while adding 1 to 4 houses.Landing on streets on consecutive reactions populates them with an additional house.Get 5 houses on a street, or land on chance, and you can trigger the Free Spins feature. The base level is 8 free spins, but this is increased by the number of railway stations or streets with 5 or more houses you own. Additional bonus game triggers result in 3 free spins added to the original 8, and multipliers for utilities owned. Landing on a property will increase the multiplier by 1x for each house vacating the property.Once again, Mr Monopoly continues his travels around the board during free spins with each square contributing multipliers, free spins, max Megaways, and properties. When the free spins round ends, the visited streets lose their houses along with railway stations and utilities, though they can be won back up during the base game.Monopoly Megaways: VerdictThere are several slots on the market that builds on the famous Monopoly board game, but Big Time Gaming's offering is likely to establish itself as the stand out slot of the genre. Several factors contribute to its success.The first is the successful amalgamation of Megaways, the Reaction system, and the Reel Adventure. It doesn’t feel gimmicky; instead, each part works to enhance the positive aspects of the others. Although it can seem complex in writing, the end product is a slot that manages to have a lot going on without being overwhelmingly complicated. An achievement in itself, and the inclusion of the Monopoly board with its myriad extras has been extremely well thought out and executed.The icing on the cake is definitely the bonus game. Once triggered, the sky is the limit when it comes to multipliers and free spins. Well, there is a limit, but with potential for wins of up to 15,000 times the stake, not many players will be complaining. It's not unlikely that Monopoly Megaways will appeal to all sorts of players - from those that are just looking for something to wind down to after work, to the thrill-seekers looking for a high value, high volatility slot. Not to mention those players looking for a more engaging slot experience.With all that having been said, if you felt that Holy Diver and the Reel Adventure concept wasn't your cup of tea, it's unlikely that Monopoly Megaways will win you over, and while we don't expect it to become Big Time Gaming best performing game, it does undoubtedly stand head and shoulders over most other Monopoly titles available on the market."

title: Lions GigaBlox
structured_summary: Lions GigaBlox is an African savanna-themed slot featuring majestic lions and wildlife. The game includes Gigablox oversized symbols, cascading wins (explosions), and free spins with an increasing win multiplier. The reviewer finds it familiar yet somewhat bland, offering solid but uninspired gameplay and features. Visually and audibly, it presents a typical savanna backdrop with standard graphics, lacking standout aesthetics or audio.
review: 2024",5,"Lions Gigablox: Slot OverviewLions are known as the kings of the jungle, but how exactly were they elevated to this regal status? They aren't the biggest or the strongest beasts out there, nor do they really live in jungles. Eh, you know how it is: dry yellow grasslands, towering trees like huge umbrellas acting as shields from the sun, a meandering river, distant mountains, wide blue skies, that sort of environment. As mentioned, nice, but nothing special.Lions GigaBlox slot - base gameRaging like a semi-ticked off lion is a medium-high volatile math model available in several RTP configurations.
