review: 2022",4,"Rock'N'Lock: Slot OverviewBetter bust out an extra dollop of hair grease or curled bangs for this one, folks; developer Red Tiger is shaking, rattling, and rolling in an online slot called Rock'N'Lock - a stylistic representation of an earlier time when things were supposedly simpler, cleaner, and safer than they are today. Or is that just an example of Golden Age Fallacy thinking? Anyway, for a blast of guitar-riffed action and a Lock the Records respins bonus round, let's take Rock'N'Lock for a spin.Rock'N'Lock's load screen sets the mood displaying a James Dean-type sliding shades along his nose before launching into the game. It appears to be located in Los Angeles, circa the 1950s-1960s, or is it a modern part of town that's turned uber-hipster after extensive gentrification? Whatever the case, the sun dips over a palm tree-lined street, muscle cars hit the tarmac, and it's easy to imagine coins piling into jukeboxes while burgers sizzle on grills in diners throughout the city. A jangly rockabilly track makes up the aural part of the bargain, and the scene is set for some rocking and, hopefully, locking.Rock'N'Lock slot - base gameAvailable on any device, Rock'N'Lock accepts bets of 10 p/c to $/€40 per paid spin and is played on a 5-reel, 4-row game area. The grid has 25 paylines to land winning combinations of 3 to 5 of a kind on - regular symbols pay from left to right on adjacent reels. Medium volatile, players can expect a theoretical return value of 95.69% while getting their rock and or lock on.There's a neon/muso thing happening when we get to the paytable, which has nine normal pays and a couple of special symbols. Brightly lit 10-A card rank symbols start us off, paying 0.8 to 2 times the stake for five of a kind, building to 5 to 12 times the bet for five premium guitars, headphones/microphones, stereos, and car symbols. Jumping in to substitute for all paying symbols is the wild symbol. When one or more wilds participate in a winning line, the payout value is tripled.Rock'N'Lock: Slot FeaturesRock'N'Lock slot - Lock the Records featureLanding anywhere on the reels are Gold, and Platinum Record scatter symbols. These symbols do not contribute to win lines, but display multiples of the bet instead. Gold Records have values of 1 to 5 times the stake, whereas Platinum Records come with values of 7x, 10x, 12x, 15x, 20x, or 25x the bet. In the base game, Gold, and Platinum Records may also have a number on their top left corner of 1-5. This number represents how many paid spins the symbol will lock to the reels before falling off to help trigger the feature.Lock The RecordsWhen at least 3 record symbols land, the Lock the Records feature starts. Hitting 3, 4, or 5 records awards 3, 4, or 5 free respins, respectively. The triggering record symbols are locked into position for the duration of the feature. When new record symbols land, they lock as well and reset respins back to their original amount. In addition, when new record symbols hit, they add their values to the record symbols which were already on the grid. If more than one new record symbol lands on a spin, they do not improve each other's values. When the feature ends, the values of all record symbols on the screen are awarded. If the grid is full, the awarded amount is doubled.Rock'N'Lock slot - platinum tilesRock'N'Lock: Slot VerdictThe first impression of Rock'N'Lock was of the sort of online slot Sandy Olsson or Danny Zuko might play in an attempt to boost their street cred. There's a level of attitude going on, while also bringing to mind Monica Geller's gig at the Moondance Diner, where she wore a blonde wig and zipped around on roller skates, singing to patrons when certain songs played on the jukebox, making Laverne and Curly fries.Like a 50s-themed diner, Rock'N'Lock won't be for all tastes, and there isn't much to comment on concerning the gameplay. The base game spun on, rotating round and round like a record on a turntable, accompanied by a toe-tapping distorted guitar backing track. Occasionally, at least three record scatters hit, pushing play into the Lock The Records bonus round. Again, there's not much to say about the bonus round either. It's a straightforward hold 'n win game with the goal of landing new scatters to reset the spin count and keep the round going. The only innovation is new scatters add their values to those already on the reels. To be fair, that was actually quite a neat touch, and it wouldn't be the worst thing in the world if it got adopted elsewhere. Other than that, though, there are no special symbols, no special extras apart from doubling the payout if the screen is filled. As such, Lock The Records is far from being the most exciting hold 'n win bonus out there; even potential is relatively hey-ho at 2,340x the bet.For a game alluding to muscle cars, rock 'n' roll and rebelling without a cause, Rock'N'Lock felt lacking in the vigour department. The sights and sounds have a pleasant level of rockin' to them, but after settling in, the action fell short of the rockabilly 'tude, the chromed outer shell losing much of its sheen as the game went through its paces."

title: Avatars: Gateway Guardians

review: 6.5,"Avatar Gateway Guardians (Yggdrasil Gaming): OverviewThe LeoVegas Originals Series continues to expand with the addition of Avatar Gateway Guardians. The game saw a lot of test time – it was hard to put down, and that symbol showed up once, if that. The return to player rating sits at a respectable 96.3% which is above average. Players can also set up to 1000 auto spins, which might come in handy for powering through dead spins.Avatar Gateway Guardians (Yggdrasil Gaming): FeaturesFree spins featureAlong with the unusual game dynamic there are two extra features to help bolsters wins – the Hot Spot and Free Spins. During base and bonus games, there are highlighted sections of the grid which are called Hot Spots. There is 1 during the bonus game and up to 8 during free spins. If a full symbol lands within a Hot Spot it triggers a Multiplier Wheel. The multiplier starts at x1 and the Multiplier Wheel, which is located underneath the grid, spins horizontally. The number it lands on gets added to the multiplier. This process continues to rack up multipliers until the Multiplier Wheel lands on the payout symbol, or it reaches its capped limit of x101. Then the win is calculated and paid out.Free spins are triggered when the 3 free spins parts land on the grid. They do not need to land in one whole piece like pay symbols though. Just anywhere in view is enough to launch 8 free spins. However, the way they land effects the bonus round. If 0, 1, 2, or 3 parts land in the base game Hot Spot then 2, 4, 6, or 8 Hot Sots come into play during Free Spins respectively. If a free spin results in more than one symbol landing on a hot spot, each symbol has a turn with the multiplier wheel one after the other. Obviously, you want 8 because it means every winner that lands will trigger the Multiplier Wheel.Avatar Gateway Guardians (Yggdrasil Gaming): VerdictAvatar Gateway Guardians has a lot going for it as well as a couple of niggles that let it down. First, the good news. It's unique. You have to give it that. There is an alien quality to its look and feel, which is intriguing. The imagery is phenomenal and the background is subtly sinister. It definitely looks like an Yggdrasil game, just set on another planet. The gameplay is decent too and actually quite basic once you get the hang of what is going on. It's got the right dash of x-factor without being gimmicky which gives it a 'just one more spin' effect. Demoing it is great, just how much of your bankroll you would spend on it is another question.That brings us to the room for improvement area. Now, every player probably wishes their game paid out more, but it would have made a significant difference to Avatar Gateway Guardians. At 2,525 times the stake, its max potential isn't awful, but it could have been a lot more enticing. What makes that figure irritating is that the game is mathematically capable of coughing up a lot more. For example, if the top symbol landed in combination with the x101 multiplier, it would be worth 4,040 times the stake right there. Getting multiple symbols on Hot Spots during free spins is already exciting, but it could have been epic. Wins could technically go much higher but for whatever reason they have been capped. It's a shame and would have boosted the game’s overall appeal.So is the LeoVegas Original Series doing enough to persuade new players to sign up? Well, Avatar Gateway Guardians is certainly a game that will stimulate your curiosity. It' s after all a unique and beautiful creation. But go the whole hog and register to plough cold hard cash into it? That’s a harder choice."

The strange thing is when you're up to your neck in the mining themed gaming, less seems to separate the two games in practice. In some ways, it's kind of fun, unlocking them one by one; in others, the system locks you into playing. You feel like you have to commit to a session rather than dip in and out. You don't see feature collections like this in Megaways often, so there's that for completists to experience. title: Astro Pug
structured_summary: Astro Pug is an Asian-themed slot featuring an 8-reel setup with a pug mascot inside a traditional Chinese temple. The game includes a complex REELFECTA win system and free spins with locked wilds and bombs, but limited multipliers only on reel 2. The reviewer found it slow, confusing, and low-paying, calling it one of the worst slots played this year. A traditional Chinese soundtrack accompanies basic visuals, with the dog's celebratory sound being the only amusing aspect.
review: 1.5,"An Initial RantWhat is it with these collaborations in the iGaming industry anyway? We are yet to see a decent outcome as the result of an established provider taking an obscure studio under its wing. Microgaming, in particular, has taken this new antic too far, having crashed and burned several times working with Triple Edge while dragging its own brand in the dirt at the same time. It seems nice and all for a successful company to help the little guy along, but the cynic in us suspects it's just a cheap, lazy way of churning out more slots. Quantity over quality being the new motto.Lightning Box is no exception to this rule. In their case, however, a collaboration is more intelligible as they've never managed to produce one single decent slot in the 14 or so years they've been active. A couple of years ago, Lightning Box teamed up with Incredible Technologies, a US-based company producing casino and coin-operated video games, to release Astro Cat. The result was a freak of a game that no sane player would ever touch. Lightning Box, on the other hand, must have considered it a success, because, with Astro Pug they've decided to do it all over again.Astro Pug IntroductionAstro Pug is an 8-reel, 1296 payline slot with geometric reels (similar to NetEnt's Jumanji) that are 3-3-4-4-4-4-3-3 symbols high from left to right. It's playable on all devices from €0,50 to €250 per spin, which may be slightly too high for some low-rollers, and a max bet that is just ridiculous for a low-quality game like this. The 95.7% theoretical return to player is slightly below our acceptable limit of 96%. Not terribly low, however, considering most classic Novomatic slots are somewhere in the 95.1% area.The Pug, for those of you who don't know, is a small breed of dog with distinctive features of a wrinkly face and curled tail. It was brought to Europe from China in the 16th century and eventually turned into an online slot. Astro Pug has an Asian theme with the reel set positioned inside a traditional type Chinese temple. No far eastern slot is complete without a Chinese restaurant type soundtrack which you will find here as well. The best thing about this slot, sadly, is when the doggo pops up in celebration of a big win (crap win to be honest) to make quite a comical sound.Astro Pug SymbolsOn the reel set you will find 5 low-value symbols alongside 5 premiums represented by various Chinese animal artefacts and a kid hugging a golden nugget (?), which is also the most valuable, giving you 0,8 times the stake. Possibly one of the most pathetic 5 of a kind returns we've seen this year. To make up for the ridiculous payouts, the so-called Bone Multiplier has been included. When appearing, it will become a 2x, 3x or 4x multiplier for any combination it is substituting in. Unfortunately, the Bone Multiplier only appears on reel 2.The paytable displays payouts in coins. Having to calculate coin value relative to bet value to figure out the potential is plain stupid and meant to confuse players. The majority of providers use this trick which we'd like to see the regulatory bodies forcefully have removed!Moving on to the pay lines and setup of the reels which needs some explaining of its own. The middle section of the reel set is the so-called REELFECTA reel, a derivative of Trifecta - a system of betting where the bettor must pick winners in a correct sequence, and is comprised of 16 individual positions (3 reels with 4 rows each). In short, it allows for a winning combination even if the same symbols line up on reel 1, 2 and 5. As long as the corresponding symbols connect on reel 1 and 2 it can then go on to connect with a 3rd symbol anywhere on reel 3, 4, 5, or 6. However, the downside is that each symbol can be used only once per winning combination. A bit hard to comprehend until you actually play the game, but think of it more as one big reel rather than the visual 4 reels you see inside the box.Astro Pug Free SpinsFree spins mode5 or more scatter symbols inside the REELFECTA box triggers the free spins. During each free spin, starting at the top left corner and moving clockwise on the outer positions of the REELFECTA reel, a specific reel will display either a +1 WILD PUG or BOMB symbol. If a +1 WILD appears it will be locked in place and award an extra free spin up to a maximum 12 free spins.If a BOMB appears, free spins end and bomb pays 2x total amount bet. If all 12 outer positions have locked wilds, 1 Mega Spin is awarded. The Mega Spin expands to cover all 16 positions within the REELFECTA making all 16 positions wild. This way its possible to land the maximum win which is less than 1000 times the stake according to our calculations when taking into account that the premiums do not appear stacked and that the multiplier only appears on reel 2.Astro Pug ConclusionNot only is this a slow, annoying, and ugly freak of a slot. Lightning Box has overcomplicated things far too much. It's difficult to keep track of what's going on in the free spins and it all just seems like one big mess. Moreover, the win ways are confusing, and the REELFECTA comes across as a bit of a scam. Unfortunately, we have nothing positive to say about this slot which is possibly one of the worst we've played this year.Lightning Box, if you're reading this, here is some advice from us players - keep it simple and stupid, make sure there is some decent potential, increase the RTP for god's sake, and make the gameplay smoother. There's nothing worse than a tardy slot in combination with low payouts. Makes you want to rip your eyes out in frustration."

title: Divine Drop
structured_summary: Divine Drop is a vibrant slot themed around Ancient Greek gods, set between Mt Olympus and Hades' domain. It features Wild Multipliers with Vitality, special symbol-triggered bonuses, free spins, and a feature buy option. The reviewer praises Hacksaw Gaming for a fresh, engaging take on Greek mythology with solid, exciting gameplay and big win potential. The game boasts colorful, snappy cartoon-style graphics and playful audio, including an adorable pug-inspired Cerberus.
review: 2024",7,"Divine Drop: Slot OverviewInteresting when you think how popular Ancient Greek Gods are in the gambling industry and how productive the studio Hacksaw Gaming is, that the two haven't really met before, not in the typical online slot manner at least. The closest, perhaps, till now, was the high brow EchoSpins repeat slot Itero with its unusual busts in a darkened museum look and ponderous piano plinking. Roaring in from the other end of the audiovisual spectrum comes a bright Greek God slot from the team. Where Itero was the more dour of the two, Divine Drop is a colourful celebration of Greek deities with features some are linked to while looking good when they pop on the reels.Despite the huge number of Ancient Greek slots, Hacksaw Gaming has managed to give Divine Drop a visual identity of its own. The base game takes place in a Mt Olympus-type area showing columns and the like, while the bonus rounds are held in a domain dominated by the God of the Underworld, Hades - and the adorable-looking Cerberus. Zeus is an absolute beefcake, holding a lightning bolt in hand, while Aphrodite rocks a very revealing outfit, beautifying the right-hand side of the screen.Divine Drop slot - base gameDivine Drop is a medium volatile slot, rated 3 out of 5 by the studio, with four RTP configurations available, maxing at 96.25%. It is played on a 5-reel, 4-row game grid where 14 paylines are used to evaluate winning combinations. Players can pick skates as low as 10 cents or as high as $/€100 per spin, and 4 choices are available from the feature buy menu.Greek-style 10 to A card ranks make up Divine Drop's low pay symbols, awarding 1 times the bet for landing a 5 OAK winning combination. Then, there is Cerberus, a golden-helmed character, Aphrodite, Hades, and Zeus as the highs, worth 3 to 10 times the bet for a 5 OAK hit.Divine Drop: Slot FeaturesDivine Drop slot - free spinsDivine Drop's bag of tricks includes Wild Multipliers with Vitality (lives), two special symbols, a Tricks of Hades bonus game, a Triple Tricks of Hades bonus game, and bonus buys.Wild MultipliersThe Wild Multiplier symbol substitutes for all other symbols on the paytable and multiplies any winning combination it is part of. Wild Multipliers land with a value of x2 to x200. When more than one Wild Multiplier is used in a win, the multiplier values are added together before being applied. Wild Multipliers may land with up to 3 Vitality represented by red hearts. While a Wild Multiplier has Vitality, it stays sticky on the grid and awards respins. For each respin, 1 Vitality is removed from each visible Wild Multiplier. When Vitality reaches 0, the Wild is removed on the next spin or respin.Aphrodite's LoveWhen the Heart symbol lands, it triggers Aphrodite's Love and restores 1 to 3 Vitality to all Wild Multipliers on the reels.Zeus's ThunderWhen the X symbol lands, it activates Zeus's Thunder and calls down a bolt of lighting, doubling the multiplier values of all Wild Multipliers on the reels.FS CollectLanding 3 or 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game triggers one of the bonus games. In addition, players can trigger one of the bonuses by collecting FS scatters during respins. If 1 or 2 FS symbols land, they are collected by the Bonus Meter if there is at least 1 Wild Multiplier with 1 or more Vitality. When the Bonus Meter reaches 3 or 4 collected FS symbols, the corresponding bonus game is triggered at the end of the round or any respins. FS scatters do not appear in the bonus games.Tricks of HadesLand or collect 3 FS symbols to activate 8 Tricks of Hades free spins. During this feature, there is an increased chance of landing Wild Multipliers and special symbols.Triple Tricks of HadesLanding or collecting 4 FS scatter symbols awards 8 Triple Tricks of Hades free spins. During this feature, there is an increased chance of landing Wild Multipliers and special symbols; plus, the minimum value of the Wild Multipliers is x3.Feature BuyDivine Drop provides these feature buys:BonusHunt FeatureSpins - 3x the bet, each spin is 5 times more likely to trigger the bonus.Wild Divinity FeatureSpins - 50x the bet, each spin guarantees at least 5 Wild Multiplier symbols land with a total of at least 1 Vitality.Tricks of Hades - 100x the bet.Triple Tricks of Hades - 250x the bet.Divine Drop slot - free spinsDivine Drop: Slot VerdictDivine Drop goes to show why Hacksaw Gaming is one of the industry's masters of the multiplier. The studio is intimately linked to full reel/expanding reel multipliers, having used them in numerous past slots, the most recent to Divine Drop being Orb of Destiny, though Hacksaw has plenty of others if you're interested. It was refreshing to see Divine Drop take a break from the full reel/expanding wild multiplier mechanic, but the upside is that the features Hacksaw Gaming has armed this slot with are no less effective or exciting to experience.Another thing in Divine Drop's favour is the way Hacksaw Gaming has presented everything. Greek Gods are one of slots' most populous mainstays, returning again and again to the reels on a regular basis. Points to Hacksaw Gaming, then, for making them come across rather freshly in Divine Drop through snappy cartoon graphics which exude personality. Making a cute pug version of Cerberus, for example, was an excellent idea and evidence of a studio willing to be continually creatively offbeat. The features aren't exactly super offbeat creative, but what's here is absolutely solid stuff that plays well individually and even better when working together.In all phases of play, Divine Drop's extras can pull together wins of up to 10,000x the bet, showing that at any moment, Divine Drop can swing something big. In lesser hands, Divine Drops' use of Greek Gods and wild multipliers might have ended up a fairly average blend, but thanks to the talented bunch at Hacksaw Gaming, the game exceeded expectations and turned out to be a rather potent slot with a vibrant identity."

title: Valley of the Dead
structured_summary: Valley of the Dead is a dark, Egyptian-themed slot with a spooky, deathly atmosphere. It features respins triggered by wins, BoltLock symbol removal to increase ways to win, multipliers, extra lives, and OnlyWins betting modes. The reviewer finds it a moodier but solid update with similar winning potential to its predecessor, though with a lower RTP. The game’s eerie visuals and haunting audio create a chilling, immersive experience.
review: "November 21, 2024",6,"Valley of the Dead: Slot OverviewOne of Yggdrasil Gaming's back-in-the-day hits was the Ancient Egyptian themed Valley of the Gods, a slot that rolled consecutive winning respins together with expanding grid space, extra lives and a growable multiplier. A few years later, Yggdrasil was back with Valley of the Gods 2, a slot which received a rearranged reel set but retained the infectious respin idea. And there it lay, as the winds of time blew and sand piled up. Till now, that is, since the studio has returned to the original Valley of the Gods slot, slipped on a different skin and some new betting options and transferred the game into the spine-chillingly named Valley of the Dead.Where Valley of the Gods was a light and bright Egyptian slot, Valley of the Dead goes somewhere darker and broodier altogether. Guess it kind of had to with a name like that. With an atmosphere close to something Hacksaw Gaming might have done in one of its gloomier moods, Hand of Anubis, for example, Valley of the Dead, is held in an eerily glowing space, displaying a lot of skulls. Skulls appear on symbols, on meters, and as glowing items which fly about the place. As a result, Valley of the Dead oozes death, spirits, and menace.Valley of the Dead slot - base gameA diamond shape of active symbols lands on the grid's 5 reels at the start of each new spin. This 1-3-5-3-1 formation provides 243 ways to win, but as BoltLock symbols (the greyed out skull symbols) are removed, this number increases up to a maximum of 3,125. With the industry having changed a lot since the release of the original, Valley of the Dead drops the highest possible RTP down from Valley of the Gods' 96.2% to the current value of 94%, while volatility sits at the same medium-high part of the spectrum. Bets of 25 c to $/€100 may be wagered, plus OnlyWins and Multi OnlyWins can be selected for a set price.Six coins take the place of the lower value symbols, paying 1 to 1.6 times the bet for a 5 OAK winning combination. Following the coins are 4 character symbol high pays, awarding 10-20 times the bet for a combination of 5 identical symbols. Wild symbols do not land in Valley of the Dead at any time.Valley of the Dead: Slot FeaturesValley of the Dead slot - Only Wins spinsEach winning combination in Valley of the Dead triggers a respin. Before the respin occurs, each winning symbol releases a Skull that removes a BoltLock symbol from the grid, creating more ways to win. Respins continue like this as long as new winning combinations continue to land. At the end of a spin, all BoltLock symbols return for the next game round.Multipliers and Extra LivesWhen full ways to win have been unlocked by removing all of the BoltLock symbols, an x2 upgradable multiplier and Extra Lives become available. When all ways are unlocked, cold coloured winning symbols release Blue Skulls. Collecting 5 Blue Skulls upgrades the multiplier by +1 for further respins.When all ways are unlocked, players are awarded +1 extra life. From then on, warm-coloured symbols release Red Skulls when they are part of a win. Collecting 5 Red Skulls awards +1 extra life. Each Extra life triggers a respin on a losing respin to keep the feature moving. Extra lives are consumed when they are used in this way. Respins end when there are no more winning combinations and no lives left.OnlyWins ModeTurning the OnlyWins Mode on costs 4.4x the bet per spin. Doing so makes every spin a winning spin. It is also possible to buy a set of Multi OnlyWins spins at 44x for 10.Valley of the Dead slot - Only Wins spinsValley of the Dead: Slot VerdictWhen you're outside a studio's inner circle, it can be about as difficult to deduce how certain slots came into existence as it is trying to work out how relevant the anthropic principle is to cosmology. As such, let's leave Valley of the Dead's birthing justifications to the side and concentrate on the work at hand. One obvious observation is that this is a heavier atmosphered slot than before, which, at the least, helps Valley of the Dead make a break from the past. The new betting options help in this regard as well.For the record, there is no mention of either OnlyWins or Multi OnlyWins having a different RTP value. So, players are neither penalised nor rewarded for activating one or the other, or neither. Using OnlyWins is basically a case of potentially burning through a balance a bit quicker in order to ensure every spin turns up a winner. Maybe not quicker, though, since a winning combination triggers the respins feature, which might snowball into a lengthy sequence of events, including BoltLock removal, a ways increase, extra lives and multiplier accrual. Winning potential remains on par with Valley of the Gods at 5,800 times the stake.A lot remains on par as before, aside from the RTP drop and the moodier audiovisuals. If that sounds neat or you can't say no to the new betting opportunities, then Valley of the Dead should provide a blast from the past. Otherwise, players are probably just as well served by sticking to the original."

title: Cloud Princess
structured_summary: Cloud Princess is an anime-themed slot inspired by popular titles like Gates of Olympus and Twilight Princess, featuring a cloudy fantasy realm and a manga-style princess. The game includes a 6x5 grid with cascading wins, three types of multiplier symbols, two free spin bonus rounds, and multiple bonus buy options. The reviewer finds Cloud Princess somewhat derivative but acknowledges its unique multiplier mechanics and overall enjoyable gameplay. Visually, it impresses with glittering anime aesthetics, an icy white themed grid, and immersive, dreamy music enhancing the fantasy atmosphere.
review: 2024",7,"Cloud Princess: Slot OverviewIn the popular scatter paying slot category, it can seem like if you can't beat 'em, heck, join 'em. The 'em, in this case, has to be the current top dog, Pragmatic Play's popular Gates of Olympus 1000, with Sweet Bonanza 1000 trailing not far behind. Many a time have we seen copies of Gates or slots that use the gaming concepts found within Gates as a basis to build and divert from. In the latter scenario, we bump, surprisingly, into Cloud Princess. Surprising because it was designed by scratch card to online slot wonderkids Hacksaw Gaming, a studio famous for leading the herd rather than following it. Anyway, for Cloud Princess, the studio has taken several of GOO's core parts, pushed them in different directions, and bundled the result up in a glittering anime tiara.Regardless of your thoughts on Cloud Princess, its anime influences are undeniable. It's also a game which appears to have drawn notable inspiration from Twilight Princess 1000, not just thematically, but mechanically as well. The princess hovers to the side of the gaming grid, looking both provocative and demure at the same time, while her realm is indeed very cloudy. The reel set is housed in an icy white edifice, covered in theme-related carvings, and the music is such that if you close your eyes, lean back, you can pretend you're floating away on a cloud into a fantasy land of romance, adventure, and big-eyed characters. Put simply, Cloud Princess looks and sounds the business if a manga/anime slot is on your to-do list.Cloud Princess slot - base gameA 6x5 gaming grid is where the symbols fall, and when 8 or more identical pay symbols are in view in any position, a win is formed. Behind all those clouds is a medium volatile math model linked to four different RTP configurations. When shopping around for the best deal, that would be the 96.24% version. Stakes are the usual 10 c to $/€100 per spin, and four bonus buys are on hand.Ten pay symbols appear in Cloud Princess. Five are jewel-type objects as the low pays, while the highs are 5 more elaborate random objects. Combined, they give off strong anime vibes. A scatter win made up of 8 matching symbols awards 0.2 to 2 times the bet, while at the upper end of the scale, a 19+ scatter win pays 50 to 400 times the bet. Cloud Princess drops no wild symbols on the reels in any game phase.Cloud Princess: Slot FeaturesCloud Princess slot - free spinsAs well as a cascading wins system, which removes winning symbols and performs a drop to replace them, Cloud Princess has 3 types of Multiplier symbol, a Cloud Surge bonus round, a Divine Boost bonus round, and bonus buys.Multiplier SymbolsIf there has been at least one win on a spin, and a multiplier symbol is also present, the multiplier symbol applies its value to the total win at the end of the spin. If more than one multiplier symbol is present in this situation, then the values are combined. The maximum multiplier symbol value possible is x10,000. There are three types of Multiplier symbols:Normal multiplier symbol - lands with a visible value of x2, x3, or x4 which increases by +1 with each new cascade.Super multiplier symbol - lands and reveals a value of x5, x10x, x15, or x20 when it activates, increasing by +2 on each new cascade.Epic multiplier symbol - lands with a visible value of x5, x10, x50, or x100, and doubles on each new cascade.Cloud SurgeHitting 3 FS scatter symbols in the base game triggers 10 free spins in this feature. On each spin, all wins are collected above the reels as a pending win amount. This amount is updated after each cascade that produces a win. If one or more multipliers land, their values are added together and applied to the total win at the end of the spin. Hitting 2 FS scatter symbols awards +2 free spins, or 3 FS scatter symbols awards +4 free spins.Divine BoostLanding 4 FS scatter symbols in the base game triggers this feature with 10 free spins. This round has a progressive Divine Multiplier that collects all multiplier symbol values which are part of a win. Multiplier values are stored in the progressive Divine Multiplier, which increases with each following winning spin containing multiplier symbols. Multiplier values are first added to the Divine Multiplier before being applied to the total win at the end of a free spin.To be clear, if there is a win but no multiplier symbol on the reels, the Divine Multiplier is not applied. If there are multipliers on the grid but no wins, the multipliers are not added to the Divine Multiplier, and it remains inactive. Hitting 2 FS scatter symbols awards +2 free spins, or 3 FS scatter symbols awards +4 free spins.Bonus BuyThe bonus buy options in Cloud Princess include: BonusHunt FeatureSpins - 3x the bet, each spin is 5 times more likely to trigger a bonus game, Heavenly FeatureSpins - 50x the bet, each spin guarantees at least one win and one multiplier symbol, Cloud Surge - 100x the bet, and Divine Boost - 200x the bet.Cloud Princess slot - free spinsCloud Princess: Slot VerdictHacksaw Gaming has dabbled in scatter pays before, Dragon's Domain, for example, but it's not a mechanic the studio has extensively used. Perhaps, then, a certain timidity is why Cloud Princess borrows so many ideas from elsewhere. Then again, timid is not a word one would usually associate with a studio that has proven to boldly innovate in the past, so there is likely another reason for Cloud Princess spawning into existence. It's rare for a Hacksaw Gaming to be so derivative. Cloud Princess has Pragmatic Play written all over it, with shades of Play'n GO's Moon Princess (which kind of started the trend) in there for good measure. Okay, the theme you can kind of let slide since no developer has exclusive rights to anime or manga, but the gameplay, well, it's a little too close for comfort in many ways. Scatter pays, multiplier symbols, and a building total multiplier in the free spins round? Hmm, and the way these features interact, double hmm. Cloud Princess is very Sweet Bonanza, Gate of Olympus, etcetera, etcetera.As said, it's rare for Hacksaw to imitate someone else so obviously. It usually doesn't need to since the studio itself brims with fantastically original ideas. To be fair, some of the supplementary ideas Hacksaw has squeezed into Cloud Princess provide a smidge of originality. One of the most striking of Cloud Princess' rules was the ridiculous maximum Multiplier symbol value of x10,000. This number incidentally is also the game's max winning potential of 10,000x the bet. Getting a multiplier of this size is bound to make the heart skip a beat should one ever reach such a level. You'd think the best chance of that occurring is hitting an x100 Epic Multiplier symbol and doubling the daylights out of it. The increasing multiplier symbol element is one of Cloud Princess' more ingenious touches, but again, we saw this already recently in 4ThePlayer's 2 Sweet 4 U. Though, Cloud Princess has more potentially potent growing powers.Perhaps one of the most singular things about Cloud Princess is simply the way the game feels. Cloud Princess might have similar features, but they behave that little bit differently here, so Gates fans, for instance, might not instantly be turned on by Cloud Princess. You need 4 scatters to get to the progressive multiplier bonus, multiplier symbol value growth adds a new dimension; it all just feels and performs like a Hacksaw Gaming slot. So, yes, Cloud Princess fails to throw off every one of the imitation accusations, but it ultimately manages to be a fetching addition to the scatter pays/multiplier symbol slot collection."

title: Wolfkin

Should 2 scatters hit on reels 1 and 5, then +3 additional free spins are awarded.Feature BuyWolfkin's buy function lets players directly buy two of the game's features. These are a guaranteed Wolfkin super wild for 10x the bet or free spins entry for 80 times the bet.Wolfkin slot - feature buy optionsWolfkin: Slot VerdictAfter an initially pleasing first look, interest in Wolfkin went into a rapid decline. This occurred following a browse-through of the game's paytable and seeing what it could do when in action. Interestingly, despite the fantasy/wolf subject matter, Wolfkin sparked mental connections with several previous Red Tiger slots like Trillionaire, Hammer of Gods, Ancient's Blessing, 1942 Sky Warrior, Agent Royale, War of Gods, a few games, really. What they tend to share in common is a lack of major depth and firepower once we saw past their uber-glossy outer shells. Games that tickled the senses, to begin with, but failed to capitalize on the initial rush of intrigue with much in the way of chunky substance.So it was with Wolfkin where whatever level of intrigue it started with evaporated faster than dog slobber on a scorching hot pavement. It does look quite nice, and if the mysterious lady amongst the wolves idea appeals, then Wolfkin might be the vehicle that whisks willing players off to a fantasy realm for a while. Have to say these wolves don't actually have a lot of treasure, though, despite what the game blurb might say. Get this beast a howling, wild transforming and whatever else it might be capable of doing at full strength and the best it'll muster up is a surprisingly meagre 784.4 times the bet.With a figure like that, if you're not completely smitten with Wolfkin's world, there's not much left over to hook players in. It relies heavily on wilds and wild conversions to provide the bulk of the thrills, but they didn't possess much in the way of heavy-duty firepower to really light the board up. Wolfkin looks pretty good while it's doing what it can and presents an interesting concept, but was ultimately a rather toothless in the end, all things considered."

title: Battle Royal
structured_summary: Battle Royal is a historically themed slot centered on King Henry VIII and his six wives, featuring Tudor England’s royal intrigue. It offers a highly volatile gameplay with random base game features, free spins where wives may be beheaded to turn wild, and a pick bonus involving dungeon escape and multipliers. review: 0.20/100,Out Now,7,"Battle Royal IntroductionHeads will roll! This new Play'n GO creation is a throwback to the days when the Tudor monarchs ruled the Kingdom of England. With a historical theme, it centers around King Henry the 8th and his infamous 6 wives. Coincidentally, Henry was an avid gambler and dice player and it's mind boggling to think what his reaction would be seeing himself featured in an online slot centuries later. But it is his six marriages he is best known for, in particular the beheading of two of them - Anne Boleyn and Catherine Howard, which is also central to the story in this slot.Battle Royal is a highly volatile slot, listed as 10 out of 10 by Play'n GO, and comes with a random base game feature as well as a free spin feature that includes the possibility to trigger a bonus picking game.Visually, it's a slot easy to identify as a Play'n GO creation with it's characteristical interface and graphics. Set in what appears to be a castle, it has a medieval feel with the reel set flanked by red lion drapes. The visual production is relatively simplistic, at least when it comes to the base game and although there are some interesting new features at play, it still comes across as quite a traditional slot with it's 5-reel, 3-row and 20 paylines setup. Nothing wrong with that.Battle Royal Symbols & PaytableBattle Royal includes the King Henry 8th Wild symbol, a Coat of Arms Scatter, Henry’s infamous 6 Wives as the high-paying symbols, and classic card suits as the low-paying symbols. The paytable is displayed in cash value relative to your current bet which is a big plus, making calculations easy and straight-forward. In other words, there's no confusion about its potential. Very nice Play'n GO.The high-paying symbols, the wives that is, come in two sets - one in normal mode as seen in the screenshot above, and one in their beheaded state where they are turned into wilds. It will make more sense if you keep reading.Battle Royal Features & Free Spin ModeFree spin featureThe Royal Flush feature can trigger at random on the base game and convert all low paying symbols into the same symbol.If a Scatter lands on both the first and last reel a feature choice is triggered. The player is invited to select one of the winning Scatters to find out which feature they will be awarded – Free Spins or Long Live the King (pick bonus).In Free Spins, the player must choose which of Henry’s Wives will survive the guillotine. On each spin one of the guillotines on the reels will drop. If one of the Wife symbols are visible either fully, or the top half on that reel they lose their head and that symbol becomes Wild for the rest of the Free Spins round. If only the bottom half of the symbol is visible on the top row, the symbol is not eligible to be beheaded and turn Wild. Free Spins continue until 1 Wife character symbol is left alive. If the player’s chosen wife survives, an additional instant prize is awarded.The last surviving Wife from Free Spins must then have her fate decided by the guillotine reels. The player must select a guillotine reel for the Wife. One guillotine will then fall. If it is the reel the Wife is on, she is beheaded, and the Long Live the King pick bonus is also triggered. If it falls on a different reel, she survives, and the player returns to the base game.In the Long Live the King bonus feature the player must help King Henry collect loot and escape his haunted dungeon. Select chests to collect instant prizes. After every pick, a ghost of one of Henry’s wives will move across the screen, over one row of chests. If Henry is in the way of a ghost, he dies, and the bonus feature ends.One chest contains a key. Once the key is obtained the player can choose to escape the dungeon and collect a mystery multiplier for their total winnings, or they can risk continuing to open chests and collect more instant prizes. If the feature ends due to Henry being caught by a ghost, the total round win so far is awarded. Multiplier is only awarded if the player chooses to escape. If the player has entered bonus via Free Spins, the multiplier is applied to total win from Free Spins and bonus feature.The optimum strategy when the Long Live the King bonus feature is triggered from the Free Spins is to escape as soon as you find the Key. If the Long Live the King bonus feature is triggered from the base game, the optimum strategy is to leave after picking four chests.Battle Royal ConclusionIn spite of the somewhat innovative free spin feature and original backstory it still comes across as a typical Play'n GO creation. It doesn't feel like there was too much ambition invested in making it stand out or for it to break new ground. Even the max win potential of 5000 times the stake is standard, which by the way you have a 1 in 100,000,000 chance in landing. Good luck with that. To be fair though, triggering the max exposure on any slot is nearly as impossible.It's not a bad slot in any way, but ultimately we can't help to feel like we're playing a re-skin rather than something fresh and brand new. It's one of those slots that will be played for a week or two and then fall into oblivion, a little bit like Gold King or Sizzling Spin."

title: Zulu Gold
structured_summary: Zulu Gold is an African-themed slot centered on Zulu culture, featuring the explorer Kane in an exotic setting. The game offers Avalanches, multiple wild types, big symbols, Zulu Stacks, progressive multipliers, and a free spins feature with retriggers. Visually, it impresses with detailed symbols, a palace backdrop, and an epic traditional soundtrack enhancing the immersive experience.
review: 0.20/100,"September 7, 2021",8.5,"Zulu Gold: Slot OverviewAfter braving the icy Himalayan winds of Katmandu, our man Kane is back in another exotic adventure. Slightly older, this time he finds himself in Africa amidst the Zulu people. With a population of around 11 million, the Zulu people are the largest nation in South Africa, which were united by the legendary Shaka and his exceptional military prowess. Once again, ELK Studios has chosen a topic you rarely come across while playing slots and made it a playground for players to try their luck. Zulu Gold is drenched in a bunch of great features from Avalanches, several wild types, big symbols, Zulu Stacks, and free drops, plus progressive multipliers that integrate seamlessly to produce some stunning moments.ELK clearly missed the memo on how these games are meant to be designed. Technically an African themed slot, ELK has presented it in a unique way, delving into Zulu culture rather than jamming a set of reels in the middle of a dusty savannah like most do. One thing that keeps with the Gold tradition is the 6-reel game grid, providing 4,096 ways to win. Though, if you've played one of these games before, you'll know reel expansion shenanigans aren't far away. Around the grid lie shields, weapons, decorated pillars, and a wooden throne visible behind the grid when symbols drop, as if in the palace of some high ranking chief. An epic traditional soundtrack backs up the action, which is so well made it should win the Grammy of slots if there ever was one.Tripping to KwaZulu-Natal is possible on any device, where players may set bets ranging from 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin. It's a highly volatile game too, where a feast of features are on hand to blow the grid open at any moment and string together some really nice long win sequences. The RTP, on the other hand, isn't quite so amazing on 95.0% and possibly the only real letdown of the game, though it's nothing to start a war over.Payouts are made up of three to six matching symbols, landing in any row, left to right from the first column. All have been used to further the theme, starting with 4 rock paintings as the low pays and 4 more colourful designs as the mids. Moving on to the premium symbols, buffalo, rhinos, elephants, and Kane have been used, pulling in wins of 2 to 5 times the stake for six of a kind combinationsThere are several wild types to be found in Zulu Gold, all substitute for any of the pay symbols. One is a regular wild; another type is the Charged Wild, which has extra lives. It stays on the board, consuming lives only when it contributes to a win. The third is the Wild Walker that moves and leaves a trail of wild symbols behind. Wild Walkers are persistent between Avalanches – these are explained next.Zulu Gold: Slot FeaturesZulu Gold - free dropsAs well as the aforementioned Avalanche feature, Zulu Gold comes with Big Symbols, Zulu Stacks, Multiplier Free Drops, and several bonus buy options from the X-iter menu.As an effect of the Avalanche mechanic, all symbols in a winning combination explode to make space for remaining symbols to drop - then another row is added. Avalanches continue as long as new winning combinations appear, with the grid maxing at 8 rows in height, where 262,144 ways to win are active.Low, mid, or high-value symbols, as well as wilds, exist in 4 sizes – 1x1, Super 2x2, Mega 3x3, or Epic 4x4. All big symbols count as the number of 1x1 tiles making them up. If there is a space below a big symbol, it is filled with instances of the same type. When Big Symbols drop, they smash everything out of their way, except similar-sized symbols, wilds, or bonus symbols.A Zulu Stack is a stack of 2-4 identical pay symbols that can drop at any time, potentially adding additional rows of symbols.Landing 3 or more scatter symbols triggers the Multiplier Free Drops feature, which can be retriggered. The number of drops you get is 10, 15, 20, or 25, when 3, 4, 5, or 6 scatter symbols are in view. Several nifty things happen in free drops. One is the introduction of a progressive win multiplier. When 3 or more multiplier symbols are in view, their values are activated and added to the progressive. Additional multiplier symbols on the same free drop reactivate all multiplier symbols in view and sum them again. Unactivated multiplier symbols remain sticky between free drops, but inactive ones drop out between free spins.The safety level feature makes a return in Zulu Gold too. Following a payout in free drops the safety level increases by +1 – up to 8 rows high. Free drops always reach the height of the safety level.One final feature is the X-citer selection of options, of which there are 5:5x the bet gets you 1 spin guaranteed to win something.25x the bet is for 3 drops with Zulu Stacks on each.100x the bet buys a guaranteed bonus entry.250x the bet buys you 3 drops with Wild Walkers on each one.500x the bet is the Super Bonus cost where multiplier symbols are persistent – they never fall off the grid so can repeatedly be reused.Zulu Gold: Slot VerdictKane might have reached a peak during Katmandu Gold, but Zulu Gold is every bit as good, if not better. As always, the game's theme was an inspired choice, and ELK has put it to splendid use. Kane often trips to parts of the world uncommon in online slots, and the land of the Zulu people is one of them. It could have been a complete cultural nightmare, yet ELK has highlighted just the right elements while holding back on others. As far as African themed slots go, there are none out there like this. It breathes culture and class.The gameplay builds on goodwill instilled by the theme too, and Zulu Gold has a fantastic way of blending features together to squeeze the most out of them. Modifiers, multipliers, or Walking Wilds have a knack of dropping in to push the current phase to the next level. One case in point was the three Wild Walker drops option from the X-citer, which went on to trigger then retrigger free spins on the second drop, pulling in multipliers that took in age to complete. Each element built on the other to produce a highly satisfying 2,000x+ win.Naturally, Zulu Gold won't always go your way, yet when it does, it is outstanding. Another example is the 500x Super Bonus. This is definitely not for everyone, but the way multiplier symbols pile up and may be reused again and again when new multiplier symbols land can create magical moments at later stages of the round. Hitting Zulu Gold's win cap means walking off with a 10,000 times the bet prize.Previous Gold games generally came with an excellent collection of individual features, and Zulu Gold does as well. However, this time it excels at bringing them together in a more collective manner, evidencing the ongoing evolution of the series and ELK's design talents. An aesthetic delight, Zulu Gold plays exceptionally well, so if you have even a passing interest in anything related to Kane or Zulu culture, this is well worth a go."

title: Christmas Plaza DoubleMax

review: 2022",8,"Christmas Plaza DoubleMax: Slot OverviewHey folks, it's time for developer Yggdrasil Gaming to leap on the Christmas clone wagon with an entry titled Christmas Plaza DoubleMax. If 7 or 10 free spins were awarded, players can choose to gamble them for the chance to win more – or collect and go straight to the bonus round. To gamble, players pick one of two gift boxes. There is no mention if the Golden Bet or buying free spins affects RTP.Christmas Plaza DoubleMax slot - free spinsChristmas Plaza DoubleMax: Slot Verdict'When Alexander saw the breadth of his domain, he wept for there were no more worlds to conquer.' He might have been a despicable homicidal thief, yet it's hard to deny Hans Gruber operated with a level of style. And so does Christmas Plaza DoubleMax. However, Christmas Plaza DoubleMax remains capable of delivering every inch of its predecessor's white-knuckle gaming when it has a solid roll-on.This is probably most likely to occur in free spins since that's where the win multiplier does not reset. Loads of games offer a vaguely similar sort of thing in theory; progressive multipliers are de rigueur in a significant number of Megaways slots, for example. However, few go down the doubling route, and this method can be a real sight when it's in motion, posting big multiplier numbers. However, the DoubleMax mechanic has the technical capabilities of blasting off as well, where the original game packed a max win figure of 20,000x the bet.Christmas Plaza DoubleMax would make a fine Xmas choice for players after a highly volatile slot with one of the more insane multiplier features on the market. It's not quite as satisfying as the original, perhaps, but it felt like it still flowed better than Florageddon, Yggdrasil Gaming's follow-up to the feature. title: Vampire Senpai

review: 6.5,"Vampire Senpai: OverviewDeveloper Quickspin is the creative talent behind this interesting mash-up of ideas. Vampires we know, but Senpai? Vampire Senpai is a little light on regular symbols, just seven are used, though they are bulked up by a number of wilds of varying abilities.On the low pay side are J-A royals, in a brushstroke font common to Asian themed slots. Next is what Quickspin called the mediums – three humanoid characters, all worth the same from 1 to 10 times the stake. There is a green matron type, a red female, and a purple chap. The high payers are the special symbols, the three wilds which are worth 1x – 20 times the stake in the base game, or up to 40 times the stake during free spins.Vampire Senpai: FeaturesVampire Senpai - free spinsVampire Senpai’s features are heavy on wilds and transformative powers. For one, when a Vampire Wild symbol lands on the reels, it bites any adjacent human symbols, transforming them into Turned Wild symbols.
