review: and a pair of maracas. The premiums are represented by a group of animal performers - a cat acrobat, a monkey clown and strongman mouse. Symbols do not appear stacked on the reels and there are no other special symbols involved aside from the scatter and wild which we will cover in the features section below.Respin Circus (ELK Studios): FeaturesFree Spins feature screenshotAside from the standard symbol set, Respin Circus also includes a wild symbol which is represented by a rabbit with some special magical powers. Appearing on all reels but the first, it not only performs the typical substituting duties, it will also boost your wins with the help of 2x, 3x or 4x multipliers. If really in the mood to showcase his tricks, the rabbit may even turn into a fully stacked wild reel.As the title suggests, a lot of the focus in this slot is on the Respin mechanism. Triggered whenever you land a winning combination, it can come into play in both the main game and the free spins round. When activated, all triggering symbols are held in position as the remaining reels spin again. If additional symbols appear and connect with matching held symbols, they'll stick as well and another respin round is played. Moreover, if a different symbol of higher value appears on a winning payline, it will activate the Symbol Upgrade feature, thus transforming all your held symbols into the more valuable one instead. The respin feature ends when you either land a full screen of your designated symbol or if no more matching symbols appear in view.Expect to get more of the same in the Free Spins feature which is played when 3 or more scatters appear anywhere in view. Having been awarded your golden ticket to the great show, you'll see the same respin mechanism played out here as well - your triggering scatter symbols are locked in position while the remaining reels spin again. Each scatter represents a free spins, which means that if you collect all of them during the pre-bonus respin game, you could potentially kick off with a maximum of 24 spins in the actual free spins round.Once underway, every scatter symbol that hits will award an extra spin and, just like in the main game, the respin feature will activate upon any win. Furthermore, the wild rabbit can turn up in the free spins round to boost your wins by up to 4x and give you wild reels too. There's a maximum payout of 2500 times your stake to be won here, though to keep it more realistic you should expect to see wins of around 200 to 500 times your stake during a good run.Respin Circus (ELK Studios): Final VerdictRespin Circus is an entertaining and colourful slot that will cater mostly to recreational players while hardcore gamblers are more likely shy away due to the relatively low payouts on offer. One specific thing to note here is the exceptionally low bonus frequency where you can expect to trigger the bonus once every 2100 spins! It's not as bad as it sounds, however, as a large chunk of the RTP is allocated to the main game with its frequently activated respin feature to balance it all out.Either way, the free spins feature is more or less just an extension of the main game and, in our opinion at least, it could have been made a bit more exciting with the addition of a whole new feature. Kudos to ELK Studios, by the way, for being transparent with their stats. It's definitely not something most providers will share with us.Respin Circus is not a slot that will make headlines, and it's certainly not one that will kick new doors open. Though an overall decent slot of good quality that will do a good job of keeping ELK's core audience entertained, Respin Circus feels more like a run-of-the-mill when compared to Ecuador Gold and its follow up sibling Tahiti Gold."

title: Jungle Mega Moolah
structured_summary: Jungle Mega Moolah is a jungle-themed slot reboot of the classic Mega Moolah, featuring realistic yet cartoonish animal symbols. It offers 5 reels, 25 paylines, a progressive Jackpot Wheel, and free spins with tripled wins but no jackpot triggers. The reviewer sees it as a faithful, slick upgrade with improved graphics, maintaining the original's jackpot appeal despite losing some charm. The game's aesthetics include a dense jungle backdrop and subtle jungle sounds in the base game, with intensified audio during free spins.
review: "Jungle Mega Moolah: Slot OverviewDeveloper Microgaming has parcelled out design duties to several partner studios to bulk up the range connected to the famous Mega Moolah network. This time, it's a small independent developer going by the name Aurum Signature Studios that's been assigned the duty of giving the original a well needed face-lift.  The original Mega Moolah is getting on a bit in years, and it shows. The reboot, Jungle Mega Moolah, is a huge improvement graphically speaking where everything has been refined. The animal symbols are interesting, they’re more realistic than before, yet at the same time, they retain a cartoony look which lends personality and link back to the original.Played using the original 5-reel, 25-payline set up, the backdrop is made up of a thick jungle background, making a shift from the parched savannah surrounds from before. Microgaming has largely done away with music during the base game, opting for low-level jungle sounds instead. Make it to free spins though, and the backing band kicks it up a gear.Players can try their luck on any device, by selecting bets from 0.25 p/c to $/€6.25 per spin. Betting on Jungle Mega Moolah is slightly more strategic than it usually is. Not only do you have to keep your bankroll in mind, but also consider that the higher the bet, the greater your chance of triggering the Jackpot Wheel. As before, the game hovers on a medium volatility, producing an RTP value of 88.12% which also includes 5.30% as jackpot contribution.Most players will spin Jungle Mega Moolah for the Mega Jackpot, but let’s look at regular line wins while we are here. This occurs when three or more matching symbols land adjacently, made up of 10-A royals for the low pays, then a bunch of animals including frogs, lemurs, leopards, bears and the game’s logo as the highs. Hitting five of a kind lines from the premium lot are worth payouts from 10 to 30 times your stake. Making the rest of the symbols look like chump change is the wild where five on a line will net you 600x the bet. As well as being worth the most, the wild replaces any pay symbol to complete a win.Jungle Mega Moolah: Slot FeaturesJungle Mega Moolah - free spinsIf you’ve ever tried your luck on the originally Mega Moolah game, then nothing we say here will be new. Aside from the monster jackpot, players get a round of free spins to build up a few secondary wins along the way. To access them, you’ll need to land 3 or more scatters to be awarded 15 free spins. As well as getting to the bonus round, a consolation prize of 2x, 3x, 20x, or 100x the bet is added on top when 2, 3, 4, or 5 scatters are in view. Two important rules govern free spins - one good the other not so much. First, the value of all wins during free spins is multiplied by x3. Secondly, it is not possible to win jackpots from a free spin.That makes the base game more desirable than it normally is since only paid spins can trigger the Jackpot Wheel. Activated randomly on any spin, the game cuts to a different screen displaying a 20 part wheel covered in prizes. There are 4 up for grabs – the Mini, Minor, Major, and the Mega which has one solitary red segment. The next part is easy in theory - the wheel spins and what it lands on is yours. Because the jackpots are progressive, they are constantly growing players feed the pot and can reach several millions of Euros in value.Jungle Mega Moolah: Slot VerdictIt seems Microgaming has stuck to the template when designing Jungle Mega Moolah. It reads like the original, from stats to features, making it pretty much a clone. The main difference aside from the higher resolution graphics is the new herd of animals and the wetter location. For most jackpot chasers that’s good news because the main event, the tremendous stack of credits, is as alluring as ever.They might have taken the easy road yet it’s hard to knock Microgaming really. The Mega Moolah formula has suited them fine for over a decade now. On the other hand, was there much point in a reboot? Sure, the production is slicker, yet it loses some of the raggedy charm of the past. But hey, it’s hitting the million Euro prizes that count around here, the rest of the game is basically a sideshow anyway. And to be fair, despite all the other additions to the Mega Moolah network, the original (therefore Jungle Mega Moolah as well) has one of the better bonus games attached to keep players entertained when it triggers.So if you’re going to chase the dream it's better to do it on this one or the original? The choice boils down to whether you want the slapstick antics of the older one, or the more professional environment of the jungle version. Since players have the same chance of striking it rich on both, it doesn’t make much, if any, difference."

title: Knight's Life
structured_summary: Knight’s Life is a medieval-themed slot that immerses players in the knightly training and dedication of the past. It features 5 reels, 3 rows, 5 fixed paylines, a wizard wild that doubles wins, and a scatter-triggered free spins round with escalating multipliers and transforming wild knights. The reviewer finds it a straightforward yet engaging game with solid bonus potential and appeal for hardcore players. The graphics are retro and somewhat basic, with a blurred castle background, complemented by fitting medieval symbols and sounds.
review: 8,"Knight’s Life (Merkur): OverviewToday, knights aren’t really something that are thought of so much. Other than being depicted in television series and films, the life of a knight is somewhat of a forgotten relic of the past so to speak. Fortunately, there are various online slot games that aim to centre themselves on knights, and this Merkur product is one of them. Knight’s Life will transport you back in time to the medieval age, where the training and dedication of men who wish to become knights is apparent. Granted, the imagery here isn’t the greatest in existence, but Knight’s Life still remains a go to slot for many players, both online and in land-based casinos.Should you decide to play the game, you will see everything is laid out on a standard video slot layout. This consists of a set of 5 reels and 3 rows in total. Across this layout, you’ll also see that Merkur has added a set of 5 paylines. In comparison to other video slot releases of recent years, this is quite a minimal number of lines, which are also fixed in position. While you may not be able to customise the active pay lines, you can still alter your overall wager. If you click on the button with the coins on it at the bottom of the reels, you can choose from a bet between 0.05 c/p and 10 €/$ per spin.There isn’t really much in terms of a background when it comes to Knight’s Life. Well, it’s fairly clear to see that things are taking place at a medieval castle, but the background is blurred out on quite a high level, which does work as a bit of a downfall in our opinion. As far as the symbols in the game are concerned, these start out with the regularly used playing card icons. They are the green J, orange Q, red K and purple A. You’ll then see some symbols that are more relative to the overall theme. There’s the sword hilt, the knight’s helmet and his breastplate. A medieval castle can also be seen as a symbol upon the reels. The higher paying symbols of the game come in the shape of three different knights, all of which are able to pay a maximum of 150 times your stake for a five of a kind combination.Knight’s Life (Merkur): FeaturesWhile spinning the reels, Knight’s Life may also introduce a wild Symbol into proceedings. This one comes in the form of the magical wizard, and he is able to substitute for all of the other symbols in the slot. This will help you with forming one or more winning combinations, and if he does participate in a win, he will also double the payout that you receive for it. The only one of the game’s symbols that it won’t stand in for is the scatter. What’s more, if five of the wizards come into view on a winning pay line, you stand to win up to 1,000 times your stake.As far as the slot’s scatter symbol is concerned, this is present in the form of the noble steed. Unlike all other symbols, the Scatter has the ability to show up in any position on the reels and still reward you with a pay-out. As long as two of them are present after a spin, then you’ll receive a pay-out from them. Five of them showing up will grant you with a larger reward of up to 500 times your stake.It’s also the scatter symbol that operates as the trigger for its Free Spins feature - 3, 4, or 5 scatters will grant you 10, 15, or 30 free spins respectively. During this round, you can win an extra spin whenever two or more scatters come into view. Meanwhile, throughout spins 6 through to 10, all wins are doubled. And from free spin 11 and onwards, the wins are tripled. Something else to mention about the bonus round, is that the three knight symbols become wilds step by step. At the top of each reel, you’ll see which knight is wild for that free spin.Knight’s Life (Merkur): VerdictIt may seem as though Knight’s Life is something quite standard when you first access it, and for the most part, it is. There’s a basic main game, a standard video slot layout and retro style graphics throughout. With the triggering of the free spins round, things heat up significantly with the transformation of knights into wilds step by step.We also appreciate the addition of the wizard wild for the base game, and the fact that this one will also double payouts when forming a win. Plus, you’re able to win up to 2,000x per spin in the bonus, which is not bad. On the whole, it’s a simple enough game with one or two additional features included in it. The slot makes for a nice addition to the collection from Merkur and being such a stripped down, straightforward all or nothing gambling machine, it's not hard to see why it has become so popular with hardcore gamers."

title: Temple of Nudges
structured_summary: Temple of Nudges is a jungle-themed slot inspired by ancient Mesoamerican civilizations, set in a stone temple with snake motifs. The game features a Nudge mechanic triggering consecutive wins and a Re-Spin feature that locks winning symbols for extra chances. The reviewer finds it a basic, low-potential slot lacking excitement and prefers to skip it. Visually, it boasts lush jungle scenery, detailed stone carvings, and a tranquil wilderness soundtrack.
review: "Temple of Nudges (NetEnt): ReviewVenture deep into the jungle and explore the ancient Temple of Nudges in this 5-reel, 243 bet ways video slot powered by NetEnt. With heavy emphasis on the Nudge feature, you'll see winning combinations trigger chain reactions of consecutive wins. There is also a Re-Spin feature where winning symbols stick while remaining symbols re-spin. Available across all devices from as little as 0.25 Eur up to 250 Eur per spin, Temple of Nudges is a strikingly beautiful but basic slot as you will see.Influenced by ancient Mesoamerican civilisations and set within a stone temple structure flanked by two snakes, the reels spin along to a tranquil soundtrack and the hum of the wilderness. In the backdrop you'll see lush jungle scenery with vegetation swaying in the wind and as usual with NetEnt, no expenses have been spared on the visual design.The value of the symbols is surprisingly low we have to point out. While there are only 8 symbols sharing space on the 243 bet ways reel set, it still doesn't quite even things out. Either way, on the reels you will find stone carved snakes, temples, birds, suns, monkeys, sloths, anteaters and jaguars, the latter being the most lucrative giving you 0.36x for 5 across a payline, or 87.48x for a full screen. That is all there is to it. The game includes no scatter symbols or wilds.Temple of Nudges (NetEnt): FeaturesNudge feature in actionThere is no free spin feature to trigger here. Instead, it's all about the Nudge feature which triggers every time you land a winning combination of 3 or more matching symbols in any position on adjacent reels, starting from the leftmost reel. This will in turn set in motion a chain reaction where you'll see all the reels move one symbol down followed by another payout if there are still matching symbols connecting to form a win. Since the symbols appear fully stacked on the reels (possibly 2 reels high), the nudge feature often leads to consecutive wins.But that is not all there is to it. You will also benefit from a Re-Spin feature that comes into play if the Re-Spin symbol appears in combination with a winning spin. When initiated, all winning symbols remain sticky on the reels while the game carries out a Re-Spin for the other symbols. Only 1 Re-Spin is awarded unless you land another Re-Spin symbol in which case the feature retriggers. Furthermore, the Nudge feature may also continue upon finishing the Re-Spin round to stack up additional wins.Temple of Nudges (NetEnt): ConclusionAt heart, Temple of Nudges is a basic slot that relies on recycled features that's been in use since the birth of video slots. That's not necessarily a bad thing, but to pull off a slot like this, it has to be properly balanced and, more importantly, it needs more punch and less nudge. Unfortunately, the potential on offer is horrendous to tell the truth and without the thrill of knowing a monster win could be waiting around the corner, you just end up running in circles.Sure, not EVERY slot has to be of extreme volatility, but to churn out yet another low paying game after having had to suffer through a hailstorm of critisism for this exact reason is either brave or stupid. We'll pass on this one and save our gambling budget for Dead or Alive 2 instead."

title: Warrior Ways
structured_summary: Warrior Ways is a futuristic Japan-inspired slot featuring four clans battling for street supremacy. Key features include Clan Duels with random multipliers, and two bonus rounds—Clash and Conquest—offering dynamic gameplay and symbol removal mechanics. The reviewer praises its imaginative design and intertwined features, though notes a slower base game pace and occasional frustration. Visually, it boasts a neon-lit urban Asian aesthetic with a fitting exotic soundtrack enhancing the immersive atmosphere.
review: "March 29, 2022",8,"Warrior Ways: Slot OverviewEver seen those movies or tv shows where the hero sticks to traditional means of warfare like bows and arrows but still manages to win out over baddies packing machine guns? If that sort of entertainment gets you going, then Warrior Ways from Hacksaw Gaming might just do so as well. This is a game set in an 'alternate Japan-inspired futuristic city' where four clans battle it for supremacy over the streets. The four clans literally defeat each other in a Duel feature, winning multipliers as well as glory, while continuing the squabble into two bonus games called Clash and Conquest.Warrior Ways is a return trip to Asia for Hacksaw Gaming, having visited before in Toshi Video Club. This one is a lot different, though. Gone are the adorable sushi references, replaced with ninja-style warriors in a street scene lit by the pink and purple light of dawn or dusk. Alternatively, the 5x4, 1024 ways wins game grid might simply be bathed in the light pollution generated by a major metropolitan city. It's a cool scene, with a Warlords - Crystals of Power meets Bladerunner look and feel. An exotic soundtrack finishes things off by reinforcing the futuristic urban Asian culture approach Hacksaw has taken.Players can get to clashing on any device, where stake options range from at 10 p/c to $/€100. Overall, Hacksaw has rated the volatility 4 out of 5; however, when buying bonuses, the two options have been rated 'high' and 'medium', so players have some influence. RTP is variable, maxing at 96.33%, before dropping to 94.42%, 92.30%, or 88.39%, depending on the configuration and market. The theoretical return does change too when buying a bonus game.The current population of Tokyo, including all three prefectures, is around 35 million people, so there's no telling how many people populate the futuristic city in Warrior Ways. We know four of the inhabitants, though, as they appear on some of the symbols. The groups in Warrior Ways are the plainly named Red Clan, Blue Clan, Green Clan, and Orange Clan - each Clan has a high paying and low paying symbol. The four low pays are worth 0.5x the bet for five of a kind, doubling to 1x the bet for five high pays. There's a wild symbol, too, landing anywhere to replace all regular pays. The wild is also worth a hefty (compared to the others) 50x the bet for a five symbol winning way.Warrior Ways: Slot FeaturesFour competing Clans are bound to clash eventually, and in Warrior Ways, they actually fight quite often via a Duel feature. Duels are central to Warrior Ways as they can be found in the base game and the two bonus rounds.DuelsA Duel is activated when a VS symbol lands right between two premium warrior symbols from different Clans. VS symbols appear on reels 2, 3, or 4. When triggered, the two warriors are each given a random multiplier of x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x15, x20, x25, x50, or x100. When the Duel ends, the winning Clan's premium symbol replaces all instances of the losing Clan's symbol. This could be the lows, the highs, or the low and high losing clan symbols. Also, the VS symbol transforms into the winning Clan's high symbol. If the winning Clan's symbols result in a win, its multiplier is applied to it.ClashThis is triggered when 3 Clash symbols land anywhere on the grid. The first part of Clash is the Collect phase. During this phase, 3 spins are awarded, which are reset whenever a VS symbol or Clan Multiplier symbol lands. Reel 1, 2, 4, and 5 corresponds to a Clan and starts with an x1 multiplier above it. When a Clan multiplier symbol with a value of x2 to x100 hits, it is added to the reel multiplier. There is a chance an Epic Clan Multiplier lands on reel 3, which multiples all other reel values by x2 when it hits. When spins run out in the Collect phase, the bonus switches to the Clash phase. The number of VS symbols collected equals the number of spins awarded for the Clash, and a Duel is guaranteed on each spin. Battling Clan members take the multipliers achieved during the Collect phase.ConquestLanbding 3 Conquest symbols in the base game awards 10 free spins. Whenever a Conquest symbol lands during the feature, an extra free spin is awarded. Four Clan banners sit beside the reels for Conquest, and whenever a Clan loses a Duel, the banner takes damage. When a Banner has been destroyed by damaging it twice, the respective high and low symbols of that Clan are removed from the reels for the rest of the feature. Moreover, +1 extra free spin is also awarded when this happens.Buy BonusHitting the Buy Bonus button, if it is there, let's players buy either bonus round. Clash costs 100x the bet, is highly volatile and has a maximum RTP of 96.44%. Conquest has a price tag of 400x the bet, is medium volatile and has a max RTP of 96.51%.Warrior Ways: Slot VerdictHacksaw Gaming slots tend to be simpler than Warrior Ways, though still outrageously fiendish in their design. Often, there'll be a clever feature in the base game which gets amplified during a bonus round. Warrior Ways has a bit more depth than that, putting it on a par with games like Wanted Dead or a Wild or The Bowery Boys. The Duel feature is the central concept running through it all, tying everything together into one big Clan showdown.Warrior Ways' pace can be quite placid much of the time, despite the fairly frequent Clan Duels taking place. They're fun enough, though the base game lacks a collection/progression element of a battle slot like Yggdrasil's Vikings Go range or the variety of modifiers available in Warlords – Crystals of Power. What made this noticeable was the amount of time it took to trigger the two bonus rounds.So which bonus round to pick? Both were solid performers, starting with Clash and its Collect phase, which played out a bit like Chaos Crew, where the goal is to stack as many multipliers and VS spins as possible. Unlike Chaos Crew, you then have to put the acquired multipliers to work in the Clash phase, adding an extra layer of complexity. Conquest is the significantly more expensive buy option and generally resulted in 1 or 2 sets of Clan symbols being removed from the reels. Since Hacksaw armed the game with ways instead of paylines, symbol removals can be rather potent. Dominate these means streets, and players can walk away with wins of up to 10,000x their bet.Warrior Ways is an imaginative game, with a gang warfare in the streets story, a level of atmosphere, and a set of features that have been neatly intertwined with each other. This being a Hacksaw production, Warrior Ways can be exasperating at times, but it's also got all the parts necessary to hack and slash with the best of them on its day."

title: Dream Destiny
structured_summary: Dream Destiny is a luxury-themed slot centered on wealth and opulence, featuring mansions, yachts, and high-end symbols. The reviewer finds the game somewhat tongue-in-cheek but ultimately underwhelming due to low max wins and frequent ineffective multipliers. review: 2021",5,"Dream Destiny: Slot OverviewPlayers, if you've ever wanted to 'Enjoy the feeling of being excessively wealthy' or felt the need to acquire 'Mansions, yachts, and private jets to show your power', then Red Tiger may well have the slot you're looking for. Made in collaboration with Max Win Gaming, Dream Destiny is a money-themed slot focused on the luxury consumer items side of things. It isn't going to do all the heavy lifting, however. To get the most out of this fantasy requires a healthy dose of imaginative thinking, and due to limited potential, a recalibration of what the term 'excessively wealthy' means.Played using 5 reels and 20 paylines, the reel-spinning action takes place on the steps of a modern villa, all sharp lines and floor to ceiling windows to take in the million Euro views of somewhere like the Med, presumably. Next to the game grid is a couple of fly whips of the Porsche/Ferrari variety, while on the left, nothing says class like topiary trimmed into the shape of a dollar sign. It's the sort of place perfect for snapping some envy-inducing Instagram pics as much as kicking back and unwinding after the effort it took to accrue the cash needed to pay for it all.If you're planning to take on the dream machine, prepare for a medium volatility math model - rated 3 out of 5. Slightly higher is the hit rate of 4 out of 5, while the default RTP has been clocked at 95.88% during simulated spins. None of these numbers mean much in a wealth themed slot compared to the max win figure. Here, Dream Destiny comes up short. More on that soon but just brace for a number that really won't be covering a dream home or a supercar if hit. Maybe some labelled kicks and a fancy handbag for the missis, though.Wins arise when three or more matching symbols line up left to right from the leftmost reel. Most are emblems of wealth, such as four gemstone designed card suits – clubs, diamonds, hearts, and spades. Then come cigars and whisky, pearls in an oyster shell, a suitcase stuffed with cash, followed by a glazed eye lady presumably overwhelmed by the display of affluence, and a trophy wife type as the highest paying tile. Values for the four higher paying symbols in a five of a kind win range from 7.5 to 30 times the stake.Two wild symbols appear at various points in the game, one a credit card from VIP Bank, the other one a slick Larry Laffer looking mofo with one thing on his mind, living it up. Both substitute for any pay symbol to complete wins and are worth 2, 10, or 30 times the bet for 3, 4, or 5 on a payline.Dream Destiny: Slot FeaturesA rotating Dream Wheel means multipliers on every spin with the chance of activating one of 4 features. We say multipliers, but the most common is an x1 multiplier which won't alter the outcome of spins most of the time. The 4 modifiers are mystery symbols, stacked reels, random wilds, and free spins;The Private Jet feature sends a plane over the grid, dropping mystery high pay symbols onto the reels in random positions for the current spin.The Champagne Feature transforms between 2 - 5 reels into fully stacked high paying symbols for the current spin.The Credit Card feature plants credit card wilds across the grid in arbitrary positions.Lastly, hitting Free Spins on the wheel awards 10 free spins or retriggers 10 free spins if the feature is already in play. A tad disappointingly, the rules during free spins are the same as they are in regular base game spins; nothing changes.Dream Destiny: Slot VerdictDream Destiny comes across as tongue in cheek without even trying. At times, it's hard to tell if Dream Destiny is being serious or just trolling. If the former, it walks a dangerous line of becoming a parody of itself. Sure the game's all a bit of a laugh, a bit of wishful thinking, but Dream Destiny might have been more palatable if it used a dash of humour instead of being so serious about flaunting riches.The Destiny Wheel is a bit of a gip when you realise for the majority of the time, all it slings out are x1 multipliers which do nothing. Like, what's the point of teasing like that? Every so often, you get a bigger multiplier, say x5, in conjunction with a decent line win, that's alright. So are the other features when they deign to trigger. However, another disappointing realisation is scoring a full line of five trophy wife symbols, boosted by an x5 multiplier, leads to a payout of 150x the bet, which is roughly one-tenth of Dream Destiny's full potential. Max this credit card out, and you are looking at a win of 1,539 times your stake. That might be better than paying full price for a fake Rolex, yet the top win fails to live up to the game's hype.For a wealth-based slot, there just isn't enough wealth being tossed around to make dedicated gamblers or adherents to avarice take notice. Maybe if the makers turned down the cheese, cranked up the max win, and loosened the multipliers on the wheel, Dream Destiny might have been more fun to play. But hey, they didn't, so it ends up being a miserly game that is all front with little substance backing up the boast."

title: Scales of Dead

review: 2023",7,"Scales of Dead: Slot OverviewFittingly in some ways, Scales of Dead, an online slot from developer Play'n GO was reviewed during a time in 2023 when a ferocious heat wave was baking parts of Southern Europe. It might not end up being the only heat wave of the year either, as the World Meteorological Organization confirmed that El Niño is back. It's to this country players are led when sampling the online slot Scales of Dead. They do not have to be next to each other or anything like that.Sandstorm Free SpinsDuring free spins, should 2 or more Tomb Scatters land, 3 Sandstorm Free Spins are triggered. More than one Sandstorm Free Spins can be triggered during free spins. The same Expanding symbol is used in Sandstrom Free Spins. What changes during them is that an x2, x3, or x4 multiplier is applied to each special Expanding symbol. The multiplier value is randomly picked after triggering a new Sandstrom Free Spins. Also, while Sandstorm Free Spins are active, landing 2 or more Tomb scatters awards +2 additional Sandstorm Free Spins up to a maximum of 30 for each Sandstorm Free Spins trigger.Gamble FeatureIn the main game, the Gamble feature gives players a chance to multiply the total prize. Correctly guessing the colour of a face-down card doubles the win, whereas correctly guessing the suit of a face-down card quadruples the win. The gamble round can be played up to 5 times in a row.Scales of Dead slot - paytable infoScales of Dead: Slot VerdictIf any slot format has captured the imagination of both players and developers alike, it's the 'Book of' format. On the con side, well, there are just so many of these it's hard to shake off a feeling of 'shoot, here we go again' when another comes along.Scales of Dead didn't start off on the greatest foot either, simply because it looked kinda plain. No doubt, Scales of Dead has the glossy appearance often associated with an accomplished outfit like Play'n GO, but the view of the desert with pyramids in the distance is a bit plain. From there, we come to the gameplay, and Scales of Dead is in possession of the requisite twist. Interestingly, Play'n GO has not axed symbol values to accommodate the additional multiplier, so a full non-modified screen of the top premium remains at 5,000x the bet. title: Dragonz

title: IO
structured_summary: IO is a space-themed slot set on Jupiter's moon, combining a jovial sci-fi narrative with ELK Studios' Gravity mechanic. It features Avalanches with gravity-driven symbol shifts, three types of wilds including Charged and Forge Wilds, a Laser feature, and free drops with sticky wilds on an expanding grid. review: 0.20/100,Out Now,7.5,"Io Slot: OverviewThe cosmically named Io is the second slot from developer ELK Studios to use their Gravity mechanic. The first, Cygnus, was another mysterious slot based in Egypt, but with an eye towards the stars. Io takes it one step further by locating the action up there amongst the celestial bodies. As well as the Gravity mechanic causing symbols to tumble randomly left or right, players get a host of features to accompany them on their trip off-world.The voyage takes us to Jupiter where Io is one of its moons. This is no diplomatic mission to the stars though. It's actually a lot more amusing, described by ELK as a casino space station embarking on a journey to the frontiers of the solar system. Kind of like Captain Kirk on the Starship Enterprise, except the task here is to collect valuable minerals from the moon. It's all a bit of a laugh really, setting a jovial mode on the proceedings.On each spin, 24 symbols fall into a grid made up of 6 columns, 4 rows, and 4,096 ways to win. Winning combinations form when three or more matching symbols land consecutively from the first column onwards. They can appear on any row and yet be a winner, hence the large number of win ways. Before getting started, players choose regular bets of 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin, or plump for one of ELK's four betting strategies.Whenever a winner hits, the symbols involved in the combo vanish off the screen thanks to the Avalanche mechanic. When this occurs, symbols gravitate into the gaps, potentially creating more winning combos. Unlike most slots, the columns do not sit flush, so when symbols slink downwards, they can fall either left or right depending on gravity.Avalanches also add an extra row, maxing out at 8 in height. Should you reach this level, then an uncountable 262,144 win ways come into play. Avalanches also mean long chains of wins can occur as gaps are plugged by the appropriate symbols to keep the procedure going. Once no new winners appear, then the next new spin begins.As to symbols, the paytable has 8 regulars, divided into high and low pays. All are round disks, displaying classic slot icons such as J-A royals, stars, clovers, diamonds, and lucky sevens. Lucky sevens are worth the most at 5 times the stake for six of a kind, dropping to 0.20x for six Js. Helping cobble together combos, Io offers three wilds; one is a standard, the other are the Charged and Forge Wild covered below. Despite each one playing different roles, all wilds can substitute for any of the regular pay symbols.A minor case of déjà vu flashed up when investigating the math model since it is almost identical to the one used before. That's not necessarily a bad thing though, because it produces some solid numbers to back up the gameplay. Roll on volatility which has been rated at 8/10, putting it in the medium to high range. Hit frequency is slightly higher than before on 24.6%, though RTP takes a tiny nudge downwards to 96%. Overall, players who like a bit more variance in their gaming will be satisfied, as they will be by the equally solid potential.Io Slot: FeaturesIo - free drops triggeredAs mentioned, there are 2 special wilds working alongside the standard wild. First is the Charged Wild which starts with 4 lives. It remains on the game area throughout a full reaction sequence and each time a Charged Wild is used as part of a win, it loses a life. When all 4 lives are gone, it vanishes off the grid.Next, is the Wild Forge symbol eagle-eyed players may recognise in an altered form from Tahiti Gold or Voodoo Gold. In Io, when a Wild Forge appears, it fills an empty space below it with a multiplier wild. The value of the multiplier increases each time the Wild Forge is used with no set limit on how high it can go. If the Wild Forge falls to the bottom of the grid, it becomes a wild multiplier.Getting to the big bucks, or precious minerals as they are known around here, requires harnessing the features. To help you on your way, ELK has included the Laser feature. When the laser  symbols land, they shoot a beam of light, destroying itself as well as any regular symbols in its path, letting new ones slip into the empty spaces. If the beams from two laser symbols intersect, the symbols along the beams up to the intersection point become wilds.Keep an eye out for the bonus symbols - 3 or more in view trigger the free drops bonus game. At least 7 free drops are awarded, up to 15 for 6 bonus symbols in view - keeping in mind free drops can be retriggered too. During the feature, the grid expands to its full 8x8 size, and any Charged Wilds or Wild Forge symbols remain sticky at the bottom of the grid between spins for the full duration.Io Slot: VerdictWe might have traveled to the frontiers of space, but there isn't a huge amount players won't have seen before if they've played Cygnus. Aside from Jupiter out of the viewport, and some feature alterations, it's a whole lot like its predecessor. Even the math model is virtually the same as before, aside from a teensy drop of 0.1% in RTP. Potential has remained the same too on 5,000 times the stake, so no complaints there.Graphically, Io is not as striking as Cygnus, nor as atmospheric, so if that's a concern, then the original wins out as the best one to go for. Otherwise, it comes down to feature preference. Io doesn't have the progressive multiplier quite like the first, but Forge Wilds go a long way to making up for it. Not to mention sticky wilds during free drops which can do some serious damage.In a way, the Gravity mechanic series is looking like it might pan out like the Gold series. That means, retaining core stats and mechanics while making tweaks to features and scenery - and why not? It's a formula that has served Kane in the Gold series well, so there is no reason why it won't work in the Gravity range too.The biggest difference really is the general approach to the theme. Whereas Cygnus was all about the mysticism, Io has a more light-hearted back story, and it is kind of fun pretending to be on a space casino revolving around an exotic moon, collecting precious minerals. Of course, a nice story is nothing in a slot without the gameplay or potential backing it up. Fortunately, Io comes up trumps in those regards, so while it's not exactly a brand new experience, it's a satisfying one all the same."

review: 2021",6,"Crystal Falls MultiMax: Slot OverviewBulletproof Games is a UK based studio located in the cathedral city of Lichfield, a few miles north of Birmingham. By sucking up every studio that isn't tied down has seen the quality become a bit of a mixed bag. There are the hits, to be sure, but lower grade games slip the net at ever-increasing rates. Still, when you trace Crystal Falls MultiMax' roots, it's hard not to come away with the impression it's a less attractive, less lucrative version of Multifly. While some claim time is merely an illusion, Wild O'Clock is built around the handy device used for measuring the stuff – the humble clock. It's ticking mechanism not only provides the theme but drives the tempo of the game. Some physicists argue time could just as easily have moved backwards as forward, yet since we are stuck with the latter, let's move on and delve into the abstract world of Wild O'Clock.The action takes place on a 6-reel, 4-row slot with 30 paylines to land winners on. If you've played these sorts of Red Tiger games before it will feel familiar immediately. There is plenty of gold trim, and the spacious grid is full of nice-looking symbols. The location of the game appears to be the inside of a clock or a clock maker's studio perhaps? It's not super obvious, but it's mysterious wherever it is. Adding to the scene is a music box soundtrack adding an extra layer of mystery.Players take part by selecting stakes from 10 p/c to $/€40 per spin, on any device. As noted in the Lord of the Wilds review, RTP appears to be on a downward creep in these Red Tiger fillers. In Wild O'Clock, players get a default rate of 95.69%, coupled with medium/high volatility. As is often the case, this can lead to extended bouts of base game naval-gazing before the slot deems you worthy of entry to the bonus. Like an exclusive club event, you haven't got an invite to.Before reaching the inner sanctum, here are a few base game rules. Number one, winning combinations are formed of three to six matching symbols on a payline, starting at the first reel. The symbols involved in the game are neatly designed for the most part. They start with jewel-like clubs, spades, diamonds, and hearts where six of a kind is worth 0.6x to 1.2x the stake. Next are five rather intricate timepieces, including pocket watches and sundials. Land six of a kind from this group for payouts of 2.5x to 10x the stake.The standard wild looks pretty neat too, designed as an esoteric sun and moon worth the same as the highest paying symbol. There are two wilds; this one appears on any reel in 1x1 size to substitute for all paying symbols.Wild O’Clock: FeaturesWild O'Clock - free spinsWild O'Clock doesn't have a ton of features, but the way they are set up means something regularly happens, like, um, clockwork. This is chiefly due to the Lucky O'Clock feature, but Multiplier Wilds also pop up, while the game climaxes during the triggered batch of Clock Spins.Just as there are 12 hours on a clock, every 12 spins the Lucky O'Clock feature kicks in. A clock mechanism displayed above the reels increases by one hour on each spin. When it strikes 12 a random number of Super Wilds are added to the reels. Super Wilds are 1x4 sized wilds that always cover a full reel, substituting for all pay symbols. Up to 6 Super Wilds may appear for a full-screen win of 300x the stake.When wild symbols participate in a win, there is a chance they randomly become Multiplier Wilds. If they do, a multiplier of up to x8 appears and is applied to any combos on the win line.The coup de grace is the round of Clock Spins, triggered when 3 clock spins scatters are in view - 12 bonus spins are awarded with a global multiplier that is applied to all wins. Every time a wild is used in a win, it reveals a value which is added to the global multiplier. On the 12th Clock Spin, a random number of Super Wilds are added to the reels for a potentially final big win. If the added Super Wilds do not produce a win, there is a chance the feature may trigger again to make it a win.Wild O’Clock: VerdictOnce again Red Tiger has crafted another slot that does what it does quite well, but could have been better. There are positives, such as the pleasing graphics and a base game made more appetizing by the Lucky O'Clock feature kicking in every 12 spins. This feature makes it easier to wait for Clock Spins, causing time to travel a little faster than normal. Still, when you study the stats, goodwill starts to eke away like sands in an hourglass as it often does in a Red Tiger filler.The bonus round isn't a bad one either, though it can be as temperamental as the rest of the game. Some bonuses were a let-down; others went well as long as the global multiplier grew steadily throughout the feature. The best result during testing was an x14 multiplier on the final spin which coughed up a handy win of around 700x the stake. Not bad, until you consider it is almost 1/3 of the game's maximum potential of 2,079 times the bet.To sum it up, Wild O'Clock is a competent enough slot, which has its moments, yet its limitations make it hard for the game to progress further than so-so status."

title: Joker Split
structured_summary: Joker Split is a medieval-themed slot featuring court jesters and a 6x6 cluster pays grid set in an empty town square. Key features include splitting joker wilds triggering respins, free spins with stored wilds, and a risky bonus buy option. The reviewer finds it decent with exciting wild mechanics but somewhat overshadowed by Relax Gaming’s stronger titles. Visually, it combines charming Middle Ages buildings with retro-style sound effects and meandering background music.
review: 2023",7,"Joker Split: Slot OverviewPrepare for some potential side-splitting as we join Relax Gaming on a trip back to the Middle Ages to be entertained by jokers, those jesters of the court in the online slot Joker Split. Splitting is an apt verb, too, because Joker Split is all about splitting its joker wild symbols then flinging them back onto the board through respin sequences. It's also got free spins, a bonus buy, and a tightrope of a post-bonus round feature that can really make or break a day. And so, for a joker-filled peek at an earlier time period before mobile phones and penicillin, come take a look at Joker Split with us.Depending on the source, in the year 1,000, the population of Europe has been estimated to be approximately 40-60 million people. Whatever the exact number, there were significantly fewer people than now - a reality reflected by Joker Split's empty town square setting. The game's visuals reinforce the journey back to the Middle Ages, where a 6x6 grid sits in the middle of an urban location surrounded by charming Middle Agey buildings. It's hard to put a finger on, yet there was something a little retro about Joker Split. Not so much in the graphics, but some of the sound effects, perhaps, or the constant meandering of the music? It's nothing like Hellcatraz or Banana Town, obviously, but there's a touch. Maybe it's got something to do with the sound wild symbols make when they don't do anything and turn grey or some of the UI button sounds. A small touch, anyway.Joker Split slot - base gameJoker Split is a cluster paying slot which means wins are created when clusters of at least 5 identical pay symbols land, connected in horizontal or vertical directions. The game does not use ways or paylines. Nor does it use any sort of tumble feature. A highly volatile game, Relax Gaming has rated the volatility as 5 out of 5, whilst also offering two RTPs. One is 96.1% when wagering 10 p/c to $/€50 on individual spins, the other is 96.5% when buying free spins, which cost 100 times the bet.The game lists 7 regular pay symbols on its pay table. For its low pays, it's got a red gem, a blue gem, and a green gem, then balls, juggling instruments, and dice as the mids, then a crown as the high pay symbol. Landing a winning cluster consisting of 5 identical symbols pays from 0.3 to 1 times the bet, while a 15+ cluster win awards 10 to 30 times the bet. The joker wild symbol substitutes for all pay symbols on the gaming board. Wilds may have multiplier values which are applied to any cluster win the wild is involved in. If more than 1 wild is involved in a win, then the multiplier values are added together before being applied to the cluster win.Joker Split: Slot FeaturesJoker Split slot - free spinsA few more features remain to be covered – Splitting Wild Respins and free spins with a special buy extra spin feature.Splitting Wild RespinsAny wild symbol that is part of a winning cluster jumps out of the reel area, duplicates itself, and triggers a respin. On a respin, the wilds from the previous spin jump back onto the gaming area. If a wild jumps onto a position that already contains a wild, their multipliers are added together.Free SpinsScatter symbols are collected when they land. Collecting 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols awards 5, 6, or 7 free spins, respectively. Respins can be triggered in free spins. In free spins, any wild not used in a winning cluster is stored outside the reels. On the first respin of each free spin, all stored wilds become regular wilds and jump back onto the reels. Landing a scatter symbol awards an extra free spin.Buy Extra Free SpinWhen free spins end, players may buy an extra free spin for the cost displayed on the screen. This is possible as long as the total multiplier of the stored wilds is less than x200. When bought, one free spin is played where the stored wilds from the last free spin round remain and are reactivated by landing a new wild that forms a win. Any wilds stored from the bought extra spin are kept. The theoretical RTP for buying extra free spins is 96.5%.Joker Split slot - free spinsJoker Split: Slot VerdictIt's interesting, whilst total faith remains in Relax Gaming's ability to turn out some of the most frighteningly good slots ever made, the studio's releases have been a little patchy of late. Perhaps Money Train 4 looming on the horizon (at the time of review) was hoovering up the lion's share of Relax Gaming's resources and ideas, so supporting acts like Joker Split ended up getting less love than they might have done. Of course, this speculation might be way off the mark, but just a thought.Joker Split has its moments, though, when stacks of wilds are flying around the gaming board, landing on top of each other, increasing multipliers and creating winning clusters and so on. It's got some good ideas, and the action can get hectic at times. Joker Split is helped along in free spins since non-used wilds are collected off-screen, just waiting to be flung back onto the reels. The buy extra free spin is a double-edged sword, similar in spirit to the one found in Wild Yield. Excellent when it all pans out, potentially expensive when it doesn't, and tempting to hit the 'Yes' button to buy it to see what happens in any case. Maybe tread carefully with it, as the price could quite quickly ratchet up, and the limit kick in rather soon, too.Gamblers who liked the way they could push their luck at the end of a round of free spins in Wild Yield might have their interest piqued by Joker Split, which offers a similar ride. Its splitting wilds idea has positives, and few would complain about the 20,000x the bet max win. And so, Joker Split has its upsides, but it also feels like it's struggling to step out of the shadows cast by Relax Gaming's finer stuff."

title: Primal Spirits
structured_summary: Primal Spirits is a nature-themed slot centered on Spirit Animals, Thunder Birds, and enchanted gems, inviting players to connect with sacred rituals. It features Tumbling Reels, Totem Trance symbol transformations, Colour Multipliers, and a Thunder Free Spins bonus with a buy option. The reviewer found the game intriguingly unique yet somewhat puzzling, appreciating its innovative mechanics but noting its ambiguous overall impact. Visually, the game offers a rural night setting with totem symbols, combining atmospheric graphics and sound that enhance its mystical vibe.
review: 2022",7.5,"Primal Spirits: Slot OverviewIf games are a reflection of the teams that make them, then whoever was behind Primal Spirits at Quickspin could well have been trying to get deeply in tune with nature. Primal Spirits is an online slot which zones in on things like Spirit Animals, Thunder Birds, and Enchanted Gems. These sorts of things may or may not be your cup of chai, but if they are, then Primal Spirits is a game where 'you can immerse yourself in their sacred rituals and reconnect with Mother Earth while being rewarded with untold riches.'The first thing that came to mind when Primal Spirits appeared on screen wasn't spirits, enchantments, or anything like that, however. It was wondering whether Quickspin had poached an artist or two from competitor studio Peter & Sons. In Primal Spirits, things like the higher-value animal symbols, fonts, and general look, could easily pass for a P&S game. Whether there is a link or not, who knows? Let's press on.Primal Spirits slot - base gamePrimal Spirits is located in a rural space, at night, as a crescent moon shines down on grassy fields, swaying trees, and a Totem-lined 5-reel, 3-row game panel with 25 ways to win. The slot comes with three RTP configurations, topping out at 96.02% or 96.53% when buying free spins. Playable on any device by picking stakes of 25 p/c to $/€100 per paid game round, be prepared for some highly volatile action, rated (5 out of 5) by the Quickspin themselves.Three to five matching symbols create winning ways, where four high-pay Spirit Animals and four low-pay Enchanted Gems are grouped into colour types. This means there is a high-pay animal version and a low-pay gem version in blue, green, purple and red. Why it is done this way will become clear shortly. Landing a five of a kind win awards 2-5x the bet for the high pays, or 1.2x the bet for five low pays. Wilds land on any reel to substitute all paying symbols and trigger out payouts of up to 5x the bet when making wins solely of wild symbols.Primal Spirits: Slot FeaturesPrimal Spirits slot - free spinsPrimal Spirits is not a complicated game, but it's not entirely straightforward either. It takes a few spins and a bit of paytable study to fully grasp what's going on.Tumbling ReelsThe first piece of the puzzle is Tumbling Reels, which removes winning symbols from the grid. Existing symbols drop-down and new symbols from up above fill the gaps.Totem TranceAfter a tumble, if the top part of the Totem on the left is blue, green, purple, or red, then any low pay symbols of this specific colour on the reels are transformed into its high pay counterpart. If the Top left Totem is golden, it upgrades all low-pay symbols in view. After the transformation takes place, if a new win is created, the Tumbling Reels is triggered.Colour MultiplierWhen the Totem Trance transforms a symbol and a win or free spin will follow, it adds +1 to its respective Colour Multiplier on the right-side Totem. Transformations from a golden Totem symbol in the same situation increases all Colour Multipliers.Thunder Free SpinsThe bonus game is accessed when 3 scatter symbols land to award 10 free spins (+5 additional free spins are awarded for each extra scatter present on the triggering spin). While the bonus round is active, free spins can be retriggered in the same way as in the base game. Any multipliers accrued in the base game triggering spin are transferred over to the free spins bonus round. What changes is that Colour Multipliers are progressive, meaning they do not reset between free spins.Buy FeatureThe bonus buy feature can be activated from the main game, where available. Paying 150x the bet triggers the Thunder Free Spins feature.Primal Spirits slot - free spinsPrimal Spirits: Slot VerdictPrimal Spirits was a peculiar game to review. Subtly peculiar. When all was said and done, it was hard to tell whether the experience had been a fulfilling one or not. In some ways, more questions were raised after the test drive was complete than before it. The first puzzle was whether someone from Peter & Sons had had a hand in the game's development or not or whether it was a complete coincidence. The thing is, Peter & Sons' games are so distinct that if anyone copied them, whether by accident or design, a counterfeit would stick out like a sore thumb. Not pointing any fingers, just saying.The enigma flowed into the mechanics and features underpinning Primal Spirits. Are they good or not? We flip-flopped from one side of the question to the other, unable to definitively answer it. When Tumbles trigger Totem Trances, feeding Colour Multipliers leading to something decent at the end, then great, what an innovative trip. When it doesn't, the transformations and multipliers sort of meander. It is unusual, though, so anyone interested in trying an alternative version of the popular Tumbling mechanic might appreciate Primal Spirits's unique take. Perhaps it'll help if you're down with the subject matter? Not sure; Primal Spirits was a slippery one to pin down. There shouldn't be too many misgivings over the max win, though, Quickspin having recorded a win of 8,623x the bet during 100 million simulated spins.Hey, there's sure to be plenty of open-mind players out there, keen to sample the wide, varied, and at times downright weirdness served up by a creative industry. Primal Spirits isn't bizarre in the way a game like Karen Maneater is, but there's something about its mix of theme, mechanics, and overall vibration that came over as a little odd. For the most part, it's a good odd, and odd's alright anyway, so while some may struggle to grasp what Primal Spirits is getting at, it might play right into the hands of others."

title: Mighty Griffin Megaways
structured_summary: Mighty Griffin Megaways is a fantasy-themed slot centered on the mythical griffin set against a medieval backdrop. It features up to 117,649 ways to win, Mystery Symbols, Free Spins with an unlimited multiplier, and a Jackpot King wheel bonus. The reviewer finds it essentially a Wolf Legend Megaways clone with a lower RTP, offering big potential but lacking originality. The game combines classic medieval visuals with dramatic audio, though the mix of themes feels somewhat jarring.
review: "November 20, 2019",6,"Mighty Griffin Megaways (Blueprint Gaming): OverviewFueling the fantasy-themed slot renaissance we seem to be experiencing at the moment comes Mighty Griffin Megaways from Blueprint Gaming. It’s not dragons this time; instead, we get the mythical griffin which was part lion, part eagle. It was revered in the middle ages as both animals were considered the kings of their respective domain. And it is back to the middle ages we go with Mighty Griffin – for the most part. Juxtaposed with all the castles and crags and ancient heraldry are extra gambling features such as prize ladders and dream wheels. The two worlds are jarring when you see them side by side, but let’s not judge too early. Instead let’s dive into the lost world of chivalry, knights, maidens, adventure, mythical beasts, and Reno style gaming.Powering Mighty Griffin is the ubiquitous Megaways engine on loan from Big Time Gaming. This thing must have been used with just about every theme by now? Oh wait, we haven’t had a Keeping Up With the Kardashians: Megaways yet, right? Give it time. Anyway, Blueprint has maxed out the engine with 6 vertical reels which can hold up to 7 symbols each, as well as the 1x4 horizontal reel that runs along the top. This provides up to 117,649 win ways and all the mayhem that brings such as cascade wins.Bet levels are relatively low but typical for these types of slots at 10 p/c to $/€10 per spin. With the kind of high potential on offer and winning caps it makes sense. RTP is a little trickier due to the Jackpot King feature and is a little on the low side at 95.46% + JP 0.08% + 0.41% Reserve. Volatility is suitably high, and, apologies for this list of stats, so far we could be describing any Megaways powered slot.Symbol wise things start to get more diverse. Other than the 9 – A low pay card royals that is. Following them is a stash of gold symbols – a golden feather, a golden ring, a gold crown, and the griffin himself who pulls in 50 times the stake for 6 of a kind. The book is the wild and can only land on the 1x4 reel above the main grid. It helps form more winners by substituting for any of the base pay symbols.Gameplay during the base game is what you would expect from Megaways. Winning symbols vanish off the screen to make way for new ones to fall in and (hopefully) lead to a long chain of winners. Mighty Griffin also has a long list of extra features to make to make the mythical creature perform.Mighty Griffin Megaways (Blueprint Gaming): FeaturesFree spins feature in actionThe features in play here are fairly standard with few surprises on offer. First out is the Mystery Symbol - when a spin comes to a stop, any orb mystery symbols in view will transform into one matching symbol at random which can be anything but the scatter.The blue and gold griffin is the scatter which can land anywhere except on the 1x4 reel. Scatters reward cash prizes and award free spins when at least 3 of them land at once. When the Free Spins feature is triggered you first get a shot at the Golden Streak feature - it starts by spinning reels with only bonus symbols and free spaces on it. It will continue to spin until no more bonus symbols land, or the reels are full. Each symbol is worth a certain number of free spins which are tallied up. Then, before free spins launch, players are offered the chance to gamble them for more, or, lose them and head back to the main game. During the round, there is an unlimited multiplier that increases by 1 with every winning cascade. Scatters continue to appear, and 3 of them award 5 more spins, while 4 awards 10 additional spins.Depending on how the operator has configured Mighty Griffin, non-UK players may also have access to the Legend Free Spins Bonus Bet. This is a buy feature that costs 75 times the stake to guarantee at least 3 scatters will fall on the next spin.Last but not least is the Jackpot King Promotional Pot System. Again, this depends on operator configuration and is triggered by landing 4 Jackpot King overlay symbols. The action shifts to a different set up where players try to land at least 15 crown symbols to climb a ladder and unlock the Wheel King. After any spin, players choose one of three options:Spin – spin the reels to potentially collect more Crown symbols to add to the win ladder.Collect – ends the feature by awarding a Bonus Win that is calculated using the multiplier of the stake reached on the win ladder.Wheel King – go directly to the Wheel King Round.The Wheel King is a dream wheel style device divided into several segments. Players spin the wheel to win a Promotional Jackpot or a Big Total Bet Multiplier. If one of the jackpots is won, it is reset and begins to build again.Mighty Griffin Megaways (Blueprint Gaming): VerdictAs veteran players may have already figured out, Mighty Griffin Megaways is heavily based on Wolf Legend Megaways. In fact, they're essentially the same slots bar the jackpot system. Given the fact that Mighty Griffin was created as an exclusive release, it comes as no big surprise as exclusives often tend to be clones.Either way, Mighty Griffin Megaways is one of those games that has a lot going on. Like a wedding cake baked by a demented chef who couldn’t stop adding layers. Sure it has plenty of ways to win and big payouts on offer, but at its heart, it is indeed a Wolf Legend Megaways clone, with a lower RTP. If that floats your boat and you have a hankering for yet another Megaways extravaganza to fire up it may be worth a look.For some reason, probably because we’ve seen this sort of thing several times already, it hard to get overly excited. Still, Mighty Griffin Megaways boasts big numbers and is more than capable of providing some entertaining gaming."

title: Grand Melee
structured_summary: Grand Melee is a medieval fantasy-themed slot set on a raised stage with a castle backdrop, evoking a European Middle Ages melee tournament. It features a highly volatile sticky winning symbol respin mechanic, special symbol upgrades, expansions, and a free spins bonus round with up to 5,000x bet wins. The reviewer found the game innovative but requiring patience due to frequent dead spins and a low-action pace, making it less compelling for frequent play. Visually, the game has a low-key, pleasant aesthetic with a crowd of spectators and subtle audio, lacking the usual Thunderkick flair.
review: "August 17, 2023",6.5,"Grand Melee: Slot OverviewPlay a fantasy video game or RPG, and there's a good chance your character will be armed with a ranged weapon or a melee weapon, or a mixture of both. Ranged weapons, like a bow, for example, are good because you can pick enemies off before they get within striking distance. Unless, of course, they've got a weapon with a greater range than yours. But you also can't beat getting stuck in with a hearty melee weapon like an axe or mace and just cracking some pixelated heads. Today we're getting stuck into Grand Melee, an online slot from software designer Thunderkick. This is a sticky winning symbol respins-type slot that bends the rules of how these games usually go. Something new(ish) to sample then, so why don't we gear up for a bit of melee-ing and see how it fares?The first impression was surprisingly low-key for a Thunderkick game. Not that there's anything off-putting about Grand Melee's looks or sounds, but it didn't leap off the screen like a Thunderkick slot often does. Down the bottom, we've got a crowd of spectators watching the show, which takes place on a gaming matrix up on like a raised stage or something, with a couple of striped pavilions and trees to the sides of it. Even further into the background, a castle rises up, reinforcing the idea players have travelled back in time to somewhere like Europe in the Middle Ages to take Grand Melee on.Grand Melee slot - base gameDescribed by its maker as a highly volatile slot, Grand Melee produces a default theoretical return to player of 96.17%. Its game grid consists of 5 reels holding 4 symbols each, utilising an unusual connected pay ways system. Basically, wins begin on the leftmost reel and must be connected to each other across at least 3 adjacent reels, flush or corner to corner. If this sounds confusing, the paytable has a handy picture of how it all works.The paytable also has value information on its 10 regular paying symbols. The lower value 5 are 10-A card symbols, worth 1 to 1.5 times the bet for a 5 OAK win, while the 5 higher value bunch are characters of varying colours and looks. Hitting a win made up of 5 matching premium symbols pays 3 to 10 times the bet.Grand Melee: Slot FeaturesGrand Melee slot - respin featureGrand Melee does not have wild symbols, but it has a scatter, and several special symbols can land during the respins feature. The other feature to look out for is free spins.Sticky Respin FeatureWhen randomly triggered, the Sticky Respin feature picks an arbitrary symbol (though not Symbol Upgrade, Symbol Expansion, or Game Area Expansion symbols) and displays it above the reels. If at least 5 of these chosen symbols land anywhere on the grid, they turn sticky and lock into position. During the respin feature, landing new chosen symbols also locks them in place, while the other positions respin. When no new chosen symbols hit, a win evaluation of the sticky symbols takes place and the feature ends. During respins, special symbols may also land:Symbol Upgrade feature – this symbol may appear to transform all instances of the sticky symbols into more valuable sticky symbols.Symbol Expansion feature – this symbol may appear to transform into the sticky symbol type then expand to vertically cover the whole reel.Game Area Expansion feature – this symbol may land to transform into the sticky symbol type and add a new row to the top of the grid. At most, the grid can be 7 rows high.Bonus GameLanding 5 or more scatter symbols triggers the bonus game. This may also occur during the Sticky Respin feature if the scatter symbol is shown in the area above the reels, meaning it is sticking during respins. Respins continue in this case until no new scatter symbols land. The number of free spins awarded is equal to the number of scatter symbols in view when the round is triggered, and the bonus game can be retriggered. The bonus meter below the reels can be used to track progress. The meter resets between each spin and free spin. Presumably, symbols are chosen to be sticky more often, but this is not mentioned in the game info.Grand Melee slot - free spinsGrand Melee: Slot VerdictPat on the back to Thunderkick for trying something different with the sticky winning symbol respin device, but it probably won't be for everyone. Compared to, say, NetEnt's Jack Hammer, one of the originators of the feature, Grand Melee requires more patience. In some cases, a lot more patience. Since these sorts of games can blow up during their respin feature, there seems to be a greater number of dead spins compared to a 'regular' slot. Grand Melee seemed to push this further than normal and delivered a lot of dead spins. Like Homer Simpson sort of said, welcome to dead spin city, population you. Something along those lines.So yeah, not every win triggers the respins feature; that's important for players to wrap their heads around before tackling Grand Melee and worth repeating. You gotta wait for the game to randomly pick a symbol first, then land at least five of them. Even then, sticky symbols don't guarantee a win is going to result. They say every dog has its day, and patience might pay off, should fortune be smiling, as Sticky Respins could cobble together a lifeline that boosted the balance. What's strange is despite what felt like fairly low-action gaming much of the time, the balance remained surprisingly buoyant. Not saying Grand Melee can't go the other way, of course. Those special symbols are handy, too, and are a nice way of expanding the respins feature further. Then there are free spins too, where strangely, nothing new officially occurs, which is not in the base game. Still, despite this, Grand Melee is good for wins of up to 5,000x the bet.Grand Melee possesses an interesting and unique take on the winning respin feature that resurfaces every so often but is not super frequently used. However, after seeing how Grand Melee's version of it functioned a few times, clocking the nothing new in free spins aspect and the generally pleasant yet low-key vibe meant Grand Melee wasn't one that had us rushing back like charging into a virtual melee armed with a level 9000 bastard sword would."

title: Beasts of Fire Maximum

review: High (7/10),0.10/100,"October 24, 2024",7,"Beasts of Fire Maximum: Slot OverviewBeasts of Fire Maximum is a sequel to Play'n GO's stampeding 2021 release Beasts of Fire, a slot which technically, theoretically, could charge quite hard. title: Alice Cooper and the Tome of Madness

Every feature, symbol value, and stat is bang on the same. The difference is the decorative layer, which okay, is a bit unusual.3 Devils Pinball isn't exactly an intense emotionally charged monster of a game aimed at dedicated gamblers, quite the opposite. It's more of a chilled, atmospheric mix of old cartoons like Steamboat Willy or Silly Symphonies Skeleton Dance with a Betty Boop devil sort of thing. In short, it has character, so those who enjoy the oddball factor Crazy Tooth brings won't be let down.What it doesn't bring is a whole lot of potential or big thrilling wins. However, its PIGGYWAYS system has merit, so if you like collecting things in slots, Adventure PIGGYPAYS El Dorado is worthy of grabbing a virtual machete and hacking on in for some further exploration.
