It might sound easier to accomplish on paper than in practice, but potential is here, to the tune of over 20,000x the bet.That number might not be the fulfilment of the El Dorado legend, but it's a solid amount and helps legitimise the whole Adventure PIGGYPAYS El Dorado experience. Without it, the odd porcine/El Dorado mash-up would have been tougher to swallow, and the game would have likely even struggled to catch anyone's attention."

title: Wanted Wildz Extreme
structured_summary:
Wanted Wildz Extreme blends a futuristic cyberpunk vibe with a Wild West theme, creating a unique sci-fi Western setting.  
Key features include Random Wilds Multipliers, free spins with sticky wilds and escalating multipliers, plus two bonus buy options.  
The reviewer appreciates the thematic overhaul and solid gameplay, though notes the wild multipliers don’t stack and the base game lacks excitement.  
Visually, the game combines neon and dusty frontier elements with fitting audio, crafting an engaging, atmospheric experience.
review: 2023",7.5,"Wanted Wildz Extreme: Slot OverviewWild heavy Western slots have proven their worth over the years, with NetEnt's Dead or Alive 2 arguably the MacDaddy of them all. Around the mid to tail end of 2022, Red Tiger compadres Max Win Gaming laid down a gauntlet with the release of Wanted Wildz, a game which could produce some serious sticky multiplier wild action during its free spins bonus round. Wanted Wildz didn't manage to push DoA2 off the top spot, lacking the same level of firepower, but Max Win Gaming is back, and it has tightened the screws to come up with Wanted Wildz Extreme. For the most part, Wanted Wildz Extreme does indeed live up to its name, being a more formidable slot than the original. If you'd care to find out how, then it's Stetson time, y'all.For one thing, the theme has had a major reboot. Where the original served a traditional Wild West scene, Wanted Wildz Extreme has cyberpunk overtones, as if the Wild West took place in Shinjuku rather than the United States of America. Futuristic Wild West is no new thing, turning up in movies like Cowboys vs Aliens, series like Firefly, and slots such as Lucksome's 6 in the Chamber. The two different genres make for an entertaining synthesis, and Max Win Gaming has brought both together in an enticing mix of dust and neon.Wanted Wildz Extreme slot - base gameAs before, Wanted Wildz Extreme is a highly volatile online slot, though its RTP has risen to a default value of 96.21%. That is the value when wagering 20 c to $/€4 per spin, rising further to 96.25% when buying features, of which there are two to choose from. Technically capable of producing hails of bullets, Wanted Wildz Extreme is nevertheless an uncomplicated slot in most regards, played on a standard 5x3, 20 payline gaming setup.Line wins occur when matching symbols hit from the left side of the grid on consecutive reels. Western fonted 9-A card ranks are the low pays, giving players 1.5 to 2 times their stake when 5 OAK wins appear, or 5 to 25 times the bet for landing 5 boots, hats, bitcoins, or badges. The skeletal chap from the first game returns on the wild symbol, present on all reels. As well as substituting all normal pay symbols, the wild pays out 100x the bet for a 5-wild hit.Wanted Wildz Extreme: Slot FeaturesWanted Wildz Extreme slot - free spinsWanted Wildz Extreme's features shouldn't require too much mental input to get a handle on. They include the Random Wilds Multiplier, free spins, and bonus buys.Random Wilds MultiplierThis feature triggers at random in the base game. When activated, for the current spin, wilds multiply any winning lines they are part of by x2, x5, x25, or x100. If more than one wild participates in a winning line, the wild multiplier values do not accumulate. The total multiplier value is always equal to the current multiplier level shown on the Wild Multiplier Ladder, no matter how many wild symbols participate in a single winning line.Free SpinsGetting 3 or more scatters triggers the free spins bonus round. When wild symbols hit, they are locked in position for the entire round. Wilds multiply any winning lines they are in by x2, x5, x25, or x100, depending on the Wild Multiplier Ladder value. Each scatter that lands is collected on the ladder, activating higher multiplier values when certain levels are reached. The round starts with 5 free spins, and +5 free spins are awarded each time a new level is reached – the new higher multiplier values apply in the retriggered batch of free spins. In addition, hitting 3 or more scatters awards +5 free spins on the current level.Buy FeatureWanted Wildz Extreme has two buy features, both costing 100 times the bet. The first choice is a regular round of free spins, while the second choice is 10 spins, where the Random Wilds Multiplier is guaranteed to trigger on each spin.Wanted Wildz Extreme slot - free spinsWanted Wildz Extreme: Slot VerdictFirst off, there is a lot to like about Wanted Wildz Extreme. It's not a game that trips over itself trying to be ultra-innovative, but its features are interesting while possessing the ability to be highly effective. Part of the progression from Wanted Wilds to Wanted Wildz Extreme is its thematic makeover, which has worked like a charm. Max Win Gaming has crafted a neat futuristic Western for its skeleton cowboy to run amok in. To put it into terms gamblers should be familiar with, the shift from Wanted Wildz to Wanted Wildz Extreme is similar to Money Train's regular Western world transforming into the Steampunk environs of Money Train 2. It makes you wonder about the way fashions come in, float out, morph, and become something else, and it's not hard to visualise a world like Wanted Wildz Extreme, a sort of William Gibson's Neuromancer on the frontier free for all, fighting it out for cryptocurrency rather than bars of gold.Moving beyond the absorbing visual revamp, Wanted Wildz Extreme's gameplay has remained more or less faithful to the previous release, with little in the way of mechanical upgrades to bear in mind. Actually, the new bits mainly consist of the two feature buys, which should please buyers of bonus rounds. The rest is basically the same – wait till the Random Wilds Multiplier feature triggers in the base game for some possible multiplicative action or free spins for potentially even more multiplicative action. Like before, the way wild multipliers do not multiply or add to each other when more than one wild participates in a win might initially seem about as fun as wearing assless chaps on a cold day. But even though you get just the one multiplier value, no matter how many wilds are involved, Wanted Wildz Extreme comes with a sizable win cap of 25,000x the bet (compared to 15,000x before).So there are good things to uncover here for sure, yet Wanted Wildz Extreme isn't without one or two warts. We touched on the biggest downer, the non-accumulating properties of the wild multipliers, but in addition, the reel-spinning action felt strangely undramatic, especially in turbo mode (if available), and the count-up sequences could have been more exciting. Still, the numbers are strong, the theme has been nicely dealt with, and in a dusty street shoot-out, Wanted Wildz Extreme would be an intimidating opponent."

title: Fire In The Hole
structured_summary:
Fire in the Hole xBomb is a mining-themed slot that reinvents the classic trope with a gritty, explosive twist.  
It features Nolimit City's new xBomb mechanic, Collapsing Mine cascades, Wild Mining, and an engaging Lucky Wagon Spins bonus with multiple modifiers.  
The reviewer praises its extreme volatility, massive win potential, and innovative gameplay, solidifying Nolimit as a top-tier developer.  
A dark mine shaft setting with glowing lanterns and a heavy, plodding soundtrack creates an immersive, intense atmosphere.
review: Out Now,9.5,"Fire in the Hole xBomb: Slot OverviewContinuing their unstoppable roll, developer Nolimit City set their sights on one of the more populous, some might say clichéd, slots themes - the humble mining game. Characteristically, Nolimit City was not content following someone else's script to do so. Instead, they've torn it up and let the team loose to conjure up something new. It might not seem wholly new if you only read the principle attributes on paper. In practice, however, Fire in the Hole xBomb is a big, gruff, no-nonsense machine that can blow sky high at any moment – much like a stick of dynamite, or the dwarven character who pops up at key moments throughout the game.Play begins on a game area set up using 6 reels, 3 rows, and 486 ways to win. You can see this is only half of the grid, as below the active area lie 3 dormant rows holding empty positions. At first, the location comes across as a little more subdued than usual for a Nolimit title. There is no prison scene, punk angst, or vicious wastelands setting the mood. A heavy plodding soundtrack layers on the atmosphere while glowing lanterns illuminate an old mine shaft propped up by timber support beams, betraying few clues of the intensity possible when Fire in the Hole xBomb is firing. If you close your eyes, it's easy to visualise caverns full of muscle-bound, sweaty dwarves going about the business of smashing rocks to reveal treasure or beating metal into blades.Offering stakes from 20 p/c to $/€50 per spin, Fire in the Hole xBomb is another Nolimit City slot throwing around big numbers. One to be wary of is volatility, rated 10 out of 10 – not just high according to its maker, but extreme. As per usual, the RTP is variable; that's something to look out for before shouldering your imaginary pickaxe, where the preferred one uses a configuration of 96.06%. Other stats of interest include a hit rate of 1 in 4 and big potential - covered in the verdict.Fire in the Hole xBomb pays out on winging symbols left to right, irrespective of row, from the first reel. Symbols start with 5 boxed 9-K symbols, unorthodoxly dropping the usual A from the pile. Then we get the premiums consisting of pickaxes, rope, boots, a satchel, and a lantern - 6 of a kind premiums will get you a prize worth 1.75 to 7.5 times the stake.Fire in the Hole xBomb: Slot FeaturesFire in the Hole xBomb is the first slot to showcase Nolimit City's new xBomb feature. As part of the full package, players also get Collapsing Mine, Wild Mining, Lucky Wagon Spins, and feature buy functionality where these sorts of things are permissible.The Collapsing Mine feature is best to cover first and is more or less an elaborate cascade system. Each spin starts with 3 active rows, and when a collapse occurs, an additional row becomes active – up to 6 in total at the most. Collapses are triggered when winning combinations land, when an xBomb Wild explodes, or by the Wild Mining feature. Winning symbols are removed before triggering the next collapse, causing all symbols to fall downwards. This creates empty spaces for new symbols to fall into, possibly leading to consecutive wins. When all 6 rows are active, 46,656 ways are in play.Sadly, there is no connection between xBombs and the Tom Jones hit song. Anyway, xBomb Wild symbols substitute any symbol except scatters to complete wins. When xBomb Wilds explode, they remove all adjacent regular pay symbols and increase a win multiplier by x1 for the next collapse. xBomb Wilds explode when there is a win, even if it was not part of it. xBombs also explode to trigger a collapse if there is no win, as long as Wild Mining (covered below) is not triggered.Wild Mining triggers when 3, 4, or 5 of the same matching symbol type land in a horizontal line, but there is no winning combination. Triggering symbols are removed, and 1, 2, or 3 wilds, respectively, are added to the middle of the alignment. All other positions in the active area explode, except scatter or wild symbols; then, a new collapse is triggered.The highlight of the show is the Lucky Wagon Spins bonus feature. Played on a new grid, the number of starting rows correlates with the number of scatters that landed to trigger the bonus - so 3, 4, or 5 scatters gives you 2, 3, or 4 starting rows respectively. Now, you get 3 spins to start with, which reset back to 3 every time a coin symbol lands in the game area. Along the top of the grid, 6 carriages displaying different prizes and modifiers appear on each spin. When a coin lands, whatever prize or modifier displayed above it is awarded. This can be:A coin value ranging from x1-x100.A multiplier applied to all coins below it.Dynamite symbols, which add a value to the coin, unlock blocked row positions and activate collect chests on the bottom row.Bag symbols collect all coins on the corresponding reel and deposit them on the triggering coin.Chest symbols collect all values on the reel and clears all occupied positions in the reel area except the dwarf symbol.Dwarf symbols collect all values on the reel and place them on the triggering coin. It will do this on each following spin.When collect chests are active on the bottom row, they collect the value of all coins above them on each spin. There is a lot to take in, so just think of it as a completely overblown hold-and-win feature, with loads of modifiers.For players itching to skip the base game and get straight to the bonus, Nolimit has attached a feature buy to do so. There are 3 options costing 60x, 157x, or 500x the bet. For that, the game serves up 3, 4, or 5 bonus symbols, and ups the RTP to 96.07%, 96.2%, or 96.96%, respectively.Fire in the Hole xBomb: Slot VerdictAfter a huge start to 2021, which saw the release of San Quentin xWays and East Coast vs West Coast, Nolimit City has kept their foot on the gas by dropping another banger. We're talking about the extremely volatile, massive potential gaming that continues to cement Nolimit's reputation as a heavyweight studio in the gambling community. You might think the momentum has to give at some point, that it's just not feasible for a studio to keep knocking it out of the park.Judging by Fire in the Hole xBomb, that’s not an issue they have to worry about at the moment as the team's creative juices continue to bubble, laying down another challenge to their competitors. Hat's off to Nolimit City for breathing life back into the mining category, for one. Through a mix of pleasing audio-visuals, big potential, and cunning gameplay, Nolimit has designed a unique mining experience. It's a testament to a studio's design capabilities when they can reanimate a theme so prosaic, as well as craft unique settings elsewhere.As to the new feature, xBomb Wilds are ideal for a mining game and are similar to xNudge Wilds in that they produce multipliers while playing a major part in scoring bigger wins. As will be obvious to most experienced players, Lucky Wagon Spins have a dose of Money Train 2 about them. They might be less intense without all the gunfire going on, but Lucky Wagon Spins do come with a higher payoff to balance out the scale. You might only start with three spins, but they have the potential to snowball like a volatile freight train. Special symbols and Collect Chests play a crucial role in getting the most out of the bonus game, which, when strained to capacity, is as high as 60,000x the stake. Critically, max win is achievable in any game phase, including the base game, though it is more likely to occur in Lucky Wagon Spins triggered by five scatters.There's no reason why players won't take to Fire in the Hole xBomb in droves. There is a thriving market for mining themed games, as well as plenty of hardcore gamers itching to wave red flags at whatever raging beast Nolimit City unleashes. Best be clear though, Fire in the Hole xBomb is no laid-back roller coaster ride through a warmly lit mine shaft. This is one of those rickety old pits in danger of collapsing and crushing the unwary at any moment. There ain't no canary down here, let's put it that way. However, it's also a mine stuffed with rich stuff ready to be tapped by those who can withstand the pressure.Don't MissNot sick of mining yet? Then have a look at Nolimit City's 2022 sequel Misery Mining which is built to offer a phenomenal audiovisual experience and great potential."

title: Out of the Ice
structured_summary: Out of the Ice is an Arctic fantasy slot featuring merfolk with a cultural twist. It offers expanding reels, random Merfolk multipliers, respins, and three selectable free spin modes on a dynamic 5-reel grid. The reviewer finds it balanced with decent thrills and a max win of 6,000x, though somewhat less visually striking than other titles. The game’s icy visuals and gentle, trippy soundtrack create a relaxing, immersive atmosphere.
review: "May 18, 2022",7,"Out of the Ice: Slot OverviewBrrr, better put an extra layer on for this one players; Print Studios is getting all Arctic in an online slot dubbed Out of the Ice, which is a fantasy-themed game revolving around the people of the water - better known as merfolk. What's worth noting is that Print hasn't slapped a bunch of chesty mermaids on a grid and called it a day. No, they've gone deeper, more cultural, into the subject matter while coming up with equally singular gameplay, which involves things like expanding reels, random multipliers, respins, and free spins.According to NASA, the Earth's polar ice caps are melting at a rate of 9% per decade, which is a bit frightening. At this rate, the Arctic will be completely ice-free by the year 2040. If the planet ever reached Kamino status, it'd be hard for future generations to conceive of scenes like the one found in Out of the Ice. In this game, a 5-reel game grid, laid out in a 3-3-4-4-5 pattern, sits in a kind of icy floe scene decorated with some pretty winter flowers and frigidly cold water. If you've ever played the 2017 Quickspin classic Wins of Fortune, you will probably feel at home with the mechanic. Hidden, for now, are the game's most exciting parts, namely, expanding reels, and Merfolk multipliers, which are ready to break the calm serenity of the wintery scene at any moment.Serenity isn't quite the right word to describe Out of the Ice's math model, but Print Studios has in some ways dialled back the intensity compared to previous releases. However, once the bonus round is triggered, players are given the option to choose between three different bonus rounds, ranging from medium to highly volatile. When it comes to the return to player value, Print Studios have been forced to abandon their fixed RTP policy due to market factors, now offering three ranges at 96.55%, 94.X%, and one for the German market. On a positive note, players won't have to second guess which version they are playing as it will be clearly displayed on the splash screen, making them the first studio to ever do so.Playable from 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin, the game starts with 76 winning ways, which can grow to 259 when the grid is expanded by the Freezing Respin feature. All symbols have been custom-designed, and the pay symbols include green shells, purple shells, gold shells, blue crabs, green snails, purple fish, blue dragons, green dragons, and purple dragons, paying 0.5 to 10 times the stake for five of a kind.Out of the Ice: Slot Features﻿As for features, the first on the block is the Freezing Respin feature, triggered when winning combinations hit. The leftmost reel is removed, and a new 5 position reel is added to the right-hand side. The winning symbols are locked in place while all non-winning symbols respin. This process repeats until there are no more winning combinations or free spins are triggered.Merfolk MultipliersWhen a winning combination is formed, up to 2 Merfolk symbols may bust through the Ice and apply a multiplier. Multiplier values vary from x2 to x40 and are applied independently when more than one is used in a win.Free SpinsWhen 4 consecutive respins occur, the free spins bonus round is awarded. Here players can choose from 10 Multiplier Free Spins, 8 Sticky Multiplier Free Spins, or 4 Sticky Multiplier Retrigger Free Spins. All free spin options are played on a 5x5 grid. As before, when winning combinations land, the winning symbols are locked while the others respin. When no more winning symbols land on a respin, the payment evaluation takes place. Moreover, random multipliers may apply to any win during the free spins bonus. In Sticky Multiplier Free Spins, multipliers remain overlayed on their position for the rest of the feature, multiplying any winning symbol in that position. In Sticky Multiplier Retrigger Free Spins, multipliers also add an additional free spin the first time they are applied to a win.Out of the Ice: Slot VerdictAs readers are undoubtedly well aware, there is a tendency amongst many designers to create the biggest, chunkiest, in some cases scariest slots they can. The good news is, there is a stack of outstanding beasts out there in the wild to fulfil this itch. Even better, there is plenty of room in the market for the sort of niche Out of the Ice is aiming to occupy. Out of the Ice is by intention not the most brutal game, but it offers plenty in the way of thrills, spills, and chills. Pun sort of intended.So if not gunning to be the biggest, what is Out of the Ice's life purpose? For one, its set-up is exceedingly pleasant. As mentioned, mermaids might not be complete strangers to slots, yet they rarely, if ever, show up like this. It might not be the prettiest slot ever designed, that has to be said, but visually it does get the job done. Compared to Royal Potato, which completely blew our minds with its strong personality, rich visuals and excellent music, Out of the Ice, by contrast, comes across as slightly generic.Players who are not into hold & spin type gameplay are at risk of quickly growing impatient, but those keen on dynamic reels should be intrigued by Out of the Ice's version, which seamlessly melds respins and expanding ways. The frequency with which it does so is nicely balanced, but don't worry, there is bound to be plenty of teasing, almost triggering free spins moments to provide a challenge. Balanced is an excellent word for Out of the Ice, which dangles both decent potential of 6,000x the bet and a max win frequency of 1 in 282,000. When you're used to seeing one in a billion, or what can seem at times like one in a googolplex, these look like comparatively favourable odds.After Book of Destiny, the three slots which followed have all possessed fun fantasy elements, and Out of the Ice is arguably Print's dreamiest one so far. The mythical creature visuals and the gentle, almost trippy soundtrack create a really nice place to chill out for a bit and see how fortune fares."

title: Diamonds of the Realm
structured_summary: Diamonds of the Realm is a medieval Arthurian-themed slot by Play'n GO centered on reclaiming stolen diamonds from Morgan and Mordred. The game features a 5-reel, 20-payline setup with random multipliers up to x100, and multi-level free spins that increase multipliers and spins. The reviewer praises its polished gameplay and high volatility, noting it as a solid but familiar follow-up with bigger win potential. The aesthetics are dark and brooding, complementing the medieval theme, with atmospheric visuals and audio enhancing the immersive experience.
review: 8.5,"Diamonds of the Realm: Slot OverviewDeveloper Play'n GO squeeze more mileage out of the Arthurian legends in their medieval themed slot Diamonds of the Realm. This one isn't just a follow up to the two previous releases titled The Sword and the Grail and The Green Knight; it practically is the same game, though with a few statistical modifications. We've lost count of the number of times Arthur and the lads have populated a Play'n GO release by now. Fortunately, they have a knack for being rather good, and if not always a raging inferno of innovation, can be depended on to deliver entertaining gaming regardless.A few paragraphs of text on the game sheet help set the mood. In this iteration of the Arthurian story, a dark shadow has fallen on Camelot in the form of Morgan and Mordred. In their drive for vengeance, or whatever it is that motivates them, the duo have nicked the Diamonds of the Realm. It's the player's job to get them back during free spins, which can provide substantial rewards for successful service.Whether the diamonds have special powers or just look pretty, getting them back is a good enough excuse to revisit Arthur and his knights one more time if ever there was one. Play'n GO has a soft spot for these sorts of games, and quite a number has built up in their collection by now. Diamonds of the Realm is one of the grimmer looking ones, which makes sense with all this talk of dark shadows and so forth. Mighty Camelot sits in the background behind a 5-reel, 20 payline game panel, while above it is the multiplier trail, ready to drop in the base game, and later, on every single free spin.Mathematically, there have been a few changes. The theoretical return, for one, has dipped slightly, now measuring 96.23% in the default configuration. The volatility, meanwhile, remains sky-high, with a full 10 out of 10 rating, making Diamonds of the Realm as unpredictable as its predecessor 'Grail' was. As before, bets range from 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin, so no changes there.While you're trying to save the realm, regular wins occur when three to five matching symbols line up from the left-hand side of the reels. Symbols include coins stamped with J, Q, K, A, and T, as the low pays, while Mordred, Morgan, Queen Guinevere, and King Arthur are the 4 premium symbols. Hit a line of five premiums to collect a win worth 7.5 to 100 times your stake. A wild symbol also pops up in the game on any reel to substitute for all symbols except diamond scatters. In the same manner as the King, wilds are worth up to 100x the stake for a line of five of them.Diamonds of the Realm: Slot FeaturesDiamonds of the Realm has two closely related features, one which livens up the base game, the other, is a number of triggered free spins. At any point in the main game, the Win Multiplier feature may trigger. When it does, multiplier values of x2, x5, x10, or x100 appear over the reels. If a win occurs on this spin, its value is bolstered by whatever multiplier was randomly selected.To access free spins, you'll need at least 3 diamond scatters symbols to land in view. The reward is 5 free spins with the multiplier always active, so all wins during the bonus are subject to a starting multiplier of x2.Diamond scatters remain desirable symbols during free spins and are collected whenever they land. Gathering enough of them moves players through 3 more levels, like so:Level 2 – collecting 6 diamonds awards +5 free spins and increases the win multiplier to x5.Level 3– collecting 12 diamonds awards +5 free spins and increases the win multiplier to x10.Level 4 – collecting 18 diamonds awards +5 free spins and increases the win multiplier to x100. Once reaching level 4, diamonds are removed from the reels, so additional free spins cannot be won.Diamonds of the Realm: Slot VerdictIf you liked The Sword and the Grail, then you'll no doubt be up for Diamonds of the Realm as well, as it's the same game but with increased potential. In fact, if you went in for any of the Arthurian inspired slots from Play'n GO, you'd do well to give Diamonds of the Realm a crack as well. Each has something similar to offer, revolving around big multipliers in all facets of play. It's a little formulaic, though not a bad formula at all. These slots tend to look great, pack in loads of brooding atmosphere while doling out solid as a rock gameplay.The gameplay in question means a big bonus game that follows in the footsteps of 300 Shields while offering the occasional multiplier in the base game to balance things out and keep you alert. Play'n GO do like to toss the odd random multiplier into the main game, but they don't usually go as high as x100, which can do some serious damage, should it show up. Free spins are just as intense in Diamonds of the Realm as they ever were in The Sword and the Grail. It all starts with a short blast of just five spins to start cranking out diamond scatters in the hopes of progressing through the various levels to the fabled x100 round.The difference between this game and the previous one is that the rewards for successfully guarding the realm, or getting the diamonds, or whatever, are double that of what the two precious titles in the series had to offer at 20,000 times the bet. The probability of doing so is actually slightly better as well, though at 1 in 90 million or so spins, don't expect it to happen anytime soon.There is a feeling that we probably could have done without Diamonds of the Realm since it doesn't do much the original didn't do. However, players up for some more highly polished, highly volatile Arthur driven action are unlikely to be complaining, especially with the larger max win capabilities thrown into the bargain."

title: Beast of Wealth

title: Fruit Shop Frenzy
structured_summary: Fruit Shop Frenzy is a vibrant fruit-themed slot set in a charming European-style urban shop environment. review: 2023",7.5,"Fruit Shop Frenzy: Slot OverviewOne pivotal moment in the Robin Williams classic movie Hook was when Peter Banning, the mild-mannered lawyer, opened up his imagination and could see food on a table which was previously empty. What proceeds from there is a food fight of epic proportions, a frenzy of food throwing, if you will. Fruit Shop Frenzy, by contrast, tells something of a story. What that story might be isn't explicitly expounded on, so players get to fill in the blanks as they see fit. What looks like delightful bistros or ristoranti line a cobbled street populated by scooters and pleasant plant life. You can imagine wandering around town baguette under one arm, whistling a tune, catching up with friends, living la dolce vita.Fruit Shop Frenzy slot - base gameAnd back to the game, which takes place on a 5-reel, 3-row gaming panel with 15 paylines awarding wins left to right from the first reel onwards. These are 10 to A card ranks paying 3 to 9 times the bet for a 5 OAK hit, then watermelon, oranges, a lemon, a plum, and cherries as the 5 premium symbols. Wilds appear on reels 2, 3, and 4, substituting for all paying symbols.Fruit Shop Frenzy: Slot FeaturesFruit Shop Frenzy slot - free spinsWhilst a simple-looking game, Fruit Shop Frenzy is slightly more sophisticated than you might suspect. Not in the base game as such, since it's basically feature free, but landing a fruit win kickstarts Fruit Shop Frenzy's chain of events.Free SpinsWhen one or more winning combos made up of fruit symbols hits, 2 free spins with increasing multipliers are triggered. The multiplier increments on the multiplier bar are x1, x2, x3, x4, and x5. Each winning round awards +1 free spin and moves the multiplier bar forward +1 step.Helper FeatureDuring free spins, a Helper symbol may land on the rightmost reel. When the Helper lands, it randomly activates one of these three modifiers – the multiplier values increase by +1, advancement to the next multiplier, or Frenzy mode is triggered.Frenzy ModeWhen Frenzy mode activates, 3 additional free spins are awarded, and the multiplier bar increases from 5 to 10 steps – so x1, x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, and x10. The progress of the achieved multiplier in free spins is carried over to Frenzy mode. Each winning round in Frenzy mode awards +1 free spin and furthers the multiplier bar by +1 step. Now, while Frenzy mode is active, landing a Helper symbol on the rightmost reel randomly activates one of these features – the multiplier values increase by +1, advancement to the next multiplier, 1 to 6 random wilds are added to the middle three reels, or Double X triggers which doubles the values of the multipliers on the multiplier bar.Bonus BuyDue to the nature of Fruit Shop Frenzy's free spins feature, it triggers fairly frequently already, but if it's not frequent enough, players can buy direct access to Frenzy Mode for the cost of 20x the bet.Fruit Shop Frenzy slot - free spinsFruit Shop Frenzy: Slot VerdictIf you've been having images of NetEnt resting on its laurels, content squeezing extra mileage out of its back catalogue rather than flexing its creative muscles and dazzling a new generation of gamblers with its design talent and dazzling innovation, then Fruit Shop Frenzy is only going to reinforce those thoughts. A Megaways upgrade of an old classic made sense because, shoot, it seems like every studio and its dog are doing those, so why not get in on the action? Doing number 3 so long after the first might have seemed a bit dubious if NetEnt hadn't wedged in some new stuff to tempt players back for a third go.The new stuff isn't half bad, either. Where the previous 2 games triggered free spins and left it about there, Fruit Shop Frenzy pushes things to the next level should the game progress to Frenzy mode. A little tricky, perhaps, cos you'll need help from the Helper symbol to do so. After playing games like Bounty Hunters recently with its 850x Showdown Spins buy feature, 20x feels like small change by comparison. Totally different bonus rounds, of course, so we are admittedly not comparing apples with apples, as it were. What makes things interesting here is that while the feature is modestly costed by modern standards, Fruit Shop Frenzy's max win of 10,868x is nevertheless a substantial target to aim for, though about half of Fruit Shop Megaways, if you were wondering.As far as being the third slot in a series goes, Fruit Shop Frenzy is not a bad game by any means. It's got the spirit of the previous two slots while packing in extra personality and more features. Still, it might make one wonder whether NetEnt's heart is really in the game at the moment, what with all the remakes and so-so slots it had released around the time of writing, but that doesn't stop Fruit Shop Frenzy from being an amusing diversion."

These are collected, granting a chance of triggering the jackpot wheel. When activated, players are presented with a 12 segment wheel, guaranteeing 1 of the 4 prizes - Mini, Minor, Majoir, or Mega jackpots worth 15x, 50x, 500x, or 10,000x respectively.Sisters of Oz Jackpots: VerdictThey say a scantily clad woman can sell anything. The studio has done a decent enough job of creating an attractive, adult version of Oz to spin in.The gameplay is average though. Jumbo symbols on the middle three reels are nothing new, and the low payline to grid size counts against it. However, players into the presentation of the theme and a possible 10,000x payday probably won’t be too bothered about that. Wins are frequent enough to keep the game moving, and free spins are there with their synchronised reels to display the full talents of the premium symbols.Sisters of Oz is an okay option for players keen on chasing a fixed 10,000x payout, possessing attributes that will charm some, while being completely over the top for others. structured_summary:
1. Scarab Kingdom by Just For The Win is an Ancient Egypt-themed slot focusing on scarab beetles linked to Egyptian mythology.  
2. Key features include the Wild Scrolls that create wild reels, a scarab-collecting Bonus Bar triggering Cleo's Bonus pick-and-click, and Pharaoh's Free Spins with increasing multipliers.  
3. The reviewer finds the game offers steady hits and engaging token collection, with decent volatility and rewards comparable to popular Egyptian slots, though big wins require hitting the bonus.  
4. The game boasts lush green Egyptian landscapes, detailed temple scenes during free spins, and an Arabic-inspired soundtrack enhancing the immersive atmosphere.
review: 2021",7.5,"Scarab Kingdom: Slot OverviewWith a name like Scarab Kingdom, it will be no surprise to know developer Just For The Win is shipping players to the warm world of Ancient Egypt on a quest for potential riches. For some reason, scarab beetles were all the rage in Ancient Egypt by 2,000 BCE, appearing on amulets, seals, and jewellery. The scarab hieroglyph was used to write the god Khepri's name, and it is this connection that probably accounts for its rise from humble dung beetle status to one of the most numerous amulets of Middle Kingdom Egypt. In Scarab Kingdom, scarabs are used to trigger both the Wild Scrolls feature and Cleo's Bonus. As well as these two extras, players also have free spins to contend with.Scarab Kingdom is played over a 5-reel, 30-payline game grid that doesn't have a pyramid in sight. Instead of Giza, Just For The Win has painted a greener version of Ancient Egypt than we are used to seeing. A canal runs through the middle of the screen towards ancient architecture, while a sphinx-like statue has been placed on the right-hand side, so players don't forget where they are. An Arabic inspired soundtrack reinforces the geography, and the overall presentation is of a high standard. Especially so when free spins trigger, then the action moves inside a temple or palace complex, guarded by a bunch of ominous statues.Any device is suitable for the scarab collecting to take place, where bets of 20 p/c to $/€25 per spin may be selected. RTP is variable, with a default value of 96.13%, dropping to 94.11% or less, depending on the market. In all cases, Scarab Kingdom remains a highly volatile slot, offering decent, Book of Dead level rewards - as a comparison. It's pretty fast-paced too, with features kicking off at a regular rate, assisted by a hit frequency of 30.99%, so roughly a win every three spins or so.Scarab Kingdom dishes up a few coins when at least three of the low-mid pay symbols hit or two premiums. Lows are J-A tiles, while mids are lotus flowers, eyes, and Ankhs – these are all 1x1 size only. The other two premiums can land anywhere from 1x1 to 1x4 in size and are worth up 10x the bet if a full line of five stretches across the grid. One is a Cleopatra type, the other, a Pharaoh. Wilds also cover from one to four positions on a reel and have the same value as the premiums. They also substitute any paying tile in the game.Scarab Kingdom: Slot FeaturesScarab Kingdom - Cleo's BonusDuring the base game, you'll notice a Bonus Bar located above the grid. Also, each reel has a three-segment Scarab Holder located above it. Whenever a scarab symbol lands, it is added to both the Bonus Bar and its respective Scarab Holder.When a Scarab Holder is filled, a Wild Scrolls feature is awarded on the reel, turning it completely wild. These Wild stacks move down a position on each spin before falling off the reel.When 100 scarabs have been collected on the Bonus Bar, Cleo's Bonus is triggered. The regular reel set is replaced with 12 face down coins. Players pick one at a time until 3 matching symbols are revealed, awarding an appropriate prize. There are four up for grabs, worth 15x, 40x, 200x, and 5,000x the bet. When the feature ends, the bonus bar resets. Should players switch their bets, any progress is saved.On the middle three reels, scatter symbols may appear. Landing 3 awards an indefinite number of Pharaoh's Free Spins, which start with Wild Scroll on reel 3, and a multiplier of x1. On every spin, regardless of the outcome, the multiplier increases by 1, and whenever wilds land, they activate Wild Scrolls. The feature ends when no Wild Scroll is present on the visible reel area.Scarab Kingdom: Slot VerdictIt was writer Alvin Toffler in his 1970 book, Future Shock, who coined the term 'overchoice' to describe a cognitive impairment brought about by people having so many choices they struggle to make one. Not many would have predicted this situation to be quite so rampant decades later in the iGaming sphere in regards to Ancient Egyptian themed slots. There is a ton out there, but many tend to be quite good, and Just For The Win's Scarab Kingdom isn't bad either.One positive aspect of Scarab Kingdom is its flow, ideal for players who like steady hits as they collect tokens to trigger features. The nice thing about collecting scarabs is you get the short term dopamine hit from the Wild Scrolls feature, as well as a longer-term payback when 100 of them have racked up, leading to Cleo's Bonus. Wild Scrolls are useful for keeping you in the game, yet the relatively low symbol values coupled with the number of paylines don't produce many massive results.Cleo's Bonus is a simple pick n' click, though the good thing about it is there is no game over symbol to strike you out. Make it to the bonus, and you are guaranteed to win something. It's during Cleo's Bonus, where the game's top prize of 5,000x the bet may be won. There is no mention of whether this amount is available or not during free spins, where the progressive multiplier comes into play. We saw a similar feature used recently in IGT's Cleopatra 2, but that one could be retriggered and lead to much larger payouts if you're shopping around for a big win Egyptian game.For Egypt fans up for a bit of collecting then, Scarab Kingdom presents something new to try out. It's a bit different, certainly more complex than a regular 'book of' slot, while offering the same level of rewards if you can pick the right tokens."

title: Jungle Gorilla
structured_summary: Jungle Gorilla is a nature-themed slot centered around a cheerful gorilla in a lush rainforest setting. The game features a single wild multiplier mechanic with progressive reel multipliers triggered by golden gorilla scatters, capped at x5. The reviewer finds it a basic, "fire and forget" slot with modest wins and some enjoyable moments, but lacking depth or bonus rounds. Visually, it offers vibrant jungle animations and a soothing African synth soundtrack blended with natural jungle sounds.
review: 5,"Jungle Gorilla: OverviewDeveloper Pragmatic Play takes players on a spot of wildlife watching in the nature-themed slot Jungle Gorilla. There are no guesses as to who the lead character around here might be. The fearsome (in this case cheerfully grinning) gorilla has turned up in a fair number of slots by now.Visually, there is little doubt that the developers have allowed themselves to be inspired by NetEnt's smash hit Jungle Spirit. Even the name, Jungle Gorilla, hearkens back to NetEnt’s classic slot. Coincidence? Maybe, maybe not. Only a few spins are all it takes for the two slots to quickly diverge though. Putting its trust into one solitary feature to keep players entertained, Jungle Gorilla is far more rudimentary.Playable from 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin, Pragmatic Play has set Jungle Gorilla up using 5 reels and 3 rows, crossed by 20 fixed paylines. It’s an attractive game set deep in a lush rain forest full of ruins, animated butterflies, and falling leaves. The soundtrack is nice too, made up of a soothing African synth track overlaid by natural sounds of the jungle. You could almost use it for a relaxation/mediation practice to the clear the mind and draw in positive vibes from the universe if you’re into that sort of thing. It definitely wouldn’t be out of place in a crystal shop.As usual from Pragmatic Play, and rather handy this too, volatility is clearly displayed, so players know exactly what they are signing up for. In the case of Jungle Gorilla, the 3/5 rating puts it in the medium spectrum of things whilst the default RTP is decent enough without being a standout on 96.57% - so no complaints there.The paytable includes 10 regular pay symbols, a golden gorilla scatter, plus a wild. Pay symbols start with stone J-A icons draped in ivy, followed by chameleons, parrots, elephants, tigers, and gorillas. This is a game that relies heavily on multipliers, so payline values are modest. When it comes to premiums, a line of five ranges from 2x for the chameleons, up to 4.5x for the gorillas. There is a wild included in the package as well which substitutes for anything except the scatter. It also gets a boost from the game’s feature so let’s take a look at it.Jungle Gorilla: FeaturesJungle Gorilla - multiplier featureIt feels like we’ve been saying this a lot recently, but there aren’t a whole lot of features in Jungle Gorilla. In fact, there is only one which Pragmatic Play hasn’t even bothered to name. Let’s call it, the wild multiplier feature. Here's how it works:Above each reel is a progressive multiplier that begins on x1. Whenever one of the golden gorilla scatter symbols lands, it flicks upwards, increasing its respective reel multiplier by +1. These multipliers don’t rise forever though; each one is capped at x5 – even if a ton of gorilla scatters appear before it is used.Whenever a wild hits as part of a win, the respective reel multiplier is assigned to the symbol. If there is more than one wild multiplier on a win line, then their values are multiplied together rather than added. After the win is awarded, any used reel multipliers are reset back to x1. Moving to a new bet level starts the multipliers on x1, but any progress made will be saved when switching between the bet levels.Jungle Gorilla: VerdictPlaying Jungle Gorilla caused several older slots to flashback. Another NetEnt one, Gorilla Kingdom, also came to mind after a few spins. Of course, much of it due to the Harambe lookalike leading the action. Also, the scatters floating around Jungle Gorilla are reminiscent of Gorilla Kingdom’s bonus game. There, the two completely end in comparison though. Jungle Gorilla is the more basic slot which is no doubt Pragmatic Play’s point as it's been designed for those who like to fire and forget, sit back and watch the scatters fly.The feature itself has merits, but is it missing something? Maybe a bonus round where the multipliers weren’t capped at x5? Sometimes you get an x5 on a reel that sits through a stack of spins, being battered by extra scatters that add nothing. Imagine if it could rack up an impressive multiplier while you waited, to be unleashed for a solid win.There were positive moments when the odd 100 to 250x hit would appear out of nowhere. However, a lot of the time testing felt like a relentless downward slide into bankroll oblivion. ‘Be fickle, fortune’, said Juliet, and satisfying rewards can be found in Jungle Gorilla. Single line wins are capped at 500x while Pragmatic Play quotes overall potential of up to 2,800 times the stake. An ok figure when you consider what you have to work with.If you are going to play Jungle Gorilla, then it might be best done so at a slow pace. That way you can savour the build-up of multipliers and the tingling anticipation of waiting for them to be used. On the other hand, if you’re the kind of player who wants to get on with things, or prefers more sophistication, then steer a wide berth around Jungle Gorilla."

title: Starburst XXXtreme
structured_summary:
1. Starburst XXXtreme revitalizes the classic cosmic-themed Starburst slot with a high-volatility, 5-reel, 3-row format featuring 9 paylines.  
2. Key features include powerful Starburst Wilds with expanding multipliers, respins, random wild additions, and two costly XXXtreme Spins betting options.  
3. The reviewer praises the game’s intense gameplay and massive win potential, noting it targets high-risk players unlike the original’s low volatility style.  
4. Visually and audibly, it closely mirrors the original with familiar cosmic graphics and sound, adding only subtle light-speed effects behind the reels.
review: nan,"July 15, 2021",8,"Starburst XXXtreme: Slot OverviewIconic is one of those words which gets thrown around a lot, but if ever an online slot was deserving of the term, it is NetEnt's classic Starburst. Released in 2013, Starburst remains an immensely popular go-to game for many. It is getting on in years, however, and comes across a little dated, not least due to a general shift towards more volatile, more rewarding games. In a drive to keep the brand relevant perhaps, or to thrill fans who have moved on to bigger slots, NetEnt has gone back to the classic in their 2021 release Starburst XXXtreme, kept a few things to retain a link while tearing out the innards and dropping in a vastly different set of maths.When it comes to visuals, you can spot the Starburst heritage a mile away as the remake looks very much the same. The cosmic inspired action takes place over a 5-reel, 3-row game grid with 9 rather than 10 fixed paylines. Players looking for major innovation will be happy to know, dropping a payline is the least of the changes found in Starburst XXXtreme. Audio visually, there's not much else to note; Starburst XXXtreme displays a travelling at light speed effect behind the reels at certain points, but fans of the first will feel right at home with the XXXtreme version.Playable from 10 p/c to $/€50 per spin, the math model has been completely revamped as well, with volatility now sitting at the opposite side of the spectrum, rated as 'high'. The pay-both-ways has been axed as well, so winning combinations only hit when at least three identical symbols land from the leftmost reel. If you're playing the game with XXXtreme Spins activated (more on that below), you don't notice this as much since there are constant fireworks going off, but the change is more obviously felt in the default betting mode.The game returns to familiar territory for the paytable, where the same 7 pay symbols have been used. This means 5 sparkling gems as the lower value symbols, topped by 7s and Bars. These latter two are worth a payout of 20 to 50 times the stake for a five of a kind combo. As before, wilds play a critical role in collecting coins; let's look at those below.Starburst XXXtreme: Slot Features﻿NetEnt has removed a bet line and restricted the others to pay in one direction only, so there must be something potent on board to justify the 'XXX' in the title? As it happens, NetEnt has added multipliers to the fray as compensation. That might sound a bit simplistic, but simplicity lies at the heart of the Starburst experience, and the effects can be extraordinary.First of all though, when booting up the game you will notice there are 2 XXXtreme Spins betting options available:One is 1 guaranteed Starburst Wild on each spin, increasing the stake by x10.The other is 2 guaranteed Starburst Wilds per spin, powering up the cost to 95x the base bet.If you're baulking at those numbers, know that it is possible to land just as many wilds on regular spins; they just won't show up as often. Betting strategy affects RTP slightly, where the return value hovers around 96.26-96.45%.As before, gameplay centers around the Starburst Wilds, which appear on reels 2, 3, or 4. When they land, they expand to cover all positions on their reel and award a respin. Wilds are locked for respins, and if a new one hits, it is also locked while awarding another respin.The new part is that each Starburst Wild also awards a multiplier of x2, x3, x5, x10, x25, x50, x100, or x150. If more than one wild lands, the multipliers are added together during a respin sequence, and the value is applied to any bet line wins from the current spin or following respins.One last extra is the Random Wilds feature. This can be randomly activated after a spin or a respin, adding 1-3 Starburst Wild symbols to the middle three reels.Starburst XXXtreme: Slot VerdictPlaying the two Starburst games is a real night and day experience. At first, the alterations aren't apparent since NetEnt has left the graphics and the soundtrack more or less intact. There is an upgrade, but the purpose wasn't to reproduce Starburst with modern visuals. It was to make a game which appealed to a completely different breed of gambler altogether, to fire a broadside at critics who might be claiming NetEnt's gone soft. In these regards, NetEnt has definitely met its goals. It's like the team took the old four-banger out of Lada then dropped in the sort of engine Koenigsegg would be envious of. It is possible to cruise as before and enjoy the starlit background when betting at regular levels, but XXXtreme Spins are a game-changer, drastically heightening the tension on every single spin – they are pricey, however, so beware.Starburst XXXtreme doesn't just provide outsized betting options for players who like to go large. The addition of multipliers which some readers astutely predicted provides a wholly different experience. If Starburst Wild respins were fun before, knowing that a total multiplier of up to 450x is possible adds a completely new dimension. It's not just increased thrills either, potential has blasted through the roof, reaching insanely stratospheric heights. NetEnt has slapped on a win cap of 200,000x the bet – technically possible with a combination of max multipliers, stacked Bars, and respins.Triple 'X' has certain connotations, and they might not be the most appropriate letters for a game title, but at least it's not a case of false advertising. Starburst XXXtreme is indeed extreme in many respects. While the spirit of the original remains, this one is for a totally different gambling temperament than the gentle, low volatile, 'stepping into online slots for the first time' of the original. Exploring everything Starburst XXXtreme has to offer doesn't come cheap, but for players after a challenge, they've got a new way of tackling an old favourite."

title: Thunder Hawk
structured_summary: Thunder Hawk is a Native American-themed slot centered around the mystical Thunderhawk symbol. It features instant cash prizes, free spins with random power-ups, Super Free Spins with sticky symbols, a Golden Bet, and bonus buys. The reviewer finds it a visually attractive, moderately unique take on the popular 9 Masks-style gameplay but notes some gameplay quirks and limited top prize potential. The game boasts detailed outdoor visuals with tepees and rocky backdrops, complemented by pleasing sound design typical of Peter & Sons.
review: 2023",6,"Thunder Hawk: Slot OverviewArmenian software provider Peter & Sons heads out of doors for its Native American-themed online slot Thunder Hawk. First things first was working out what the title means, and when browsing the game info page and cross-referencing the words 'thunder hawk' online, we came across something called a 'Thunderbird', which Wikipedia describes as a 'supernatural being of power and strength.' Thunder Hawk the slot leans towards this mystical concept, and for features, it's got instant cash prizes, free spins with power-ups, Super Free Spins with power-ups, a Golden Bet and bonus buys.Thunder Hawk might not have the 'pure' Peter & Sons look we used to expect in each and every release, but it remains an attractive game with a distinctive look. For setting, the wood-lashed game board has been placed in an outdoor spot, with tepees to the side and rocky outcroppings in the background. As mentioned, it's a nice view, but for the more money-minded, the most eye-catching part of Thunder Hawk might be the prize ladder displaying 10 different values. This 9 Masks of Fire-style ladder could be the very thing that either turns some players off while it entices others in for a crack.Thunderhawk slot - base gameA highly volatile slot, Thunder Hawk generates a return to player value of 96%, which seems to apply whether betting 20 p/c to $/€50 per spin, when activating the Golden Bet or when buying either free spins option. The Golden Bet ups the stake by 50%, increasing the chance of hitting the bonus game. Played on a 5x3 gaming grid, Thunder Hawk has 20 fixed paylines for landing winning combinations of 3 to 5 OAK across.Pay symbols in Thunder Hawk are J-A card ranks as the 4 low pays, and 4 Native American characters as the high pay symbols. Lows award a payout of 2.5 to 5 times the bet for landing a line of 5 matching symbols, or 7.5 to 25 times the bet is paid for hitting 5 matching premiums. Skull wilds are present on all reels as well. Wilds can substitute for any pay symbols or award up to 50 times the bet when 5 wilds make a winning line.Thunder Hawk: Slot FeaturesThunderhawk slot - free spinsThunder Hawk has two bonus rounds – free spins and super free spins. In both bonuses and in the base game, players are able to win cash from the prize meter.Thunder Hawk Prize MeterThe Thunderhawk symbol is the key to winning instant cash prizes. When 3-12 Thunderhawk symbols land, they award from 1x up to 10,000x the bet.Free SpinsLanding 3 scatter symbols triggers the free spins round. On every free spin, a random feature is awarded. Features are:Multiplier – multiplies the win amount with an x2 to x4 multiplier.Extra free spins – 1 to 3 extra free spins are awarded.Additional Thunderhawks – 1 to 3 Thunderhawk symbols are added.Super Free SpinsEach time the free spins round is unlocked, the meter beneath the reels progresses. When the meter is filled, Super Free Spins are triggered. For this bonus round, 5 free spins are awarded where only Thunderhawk symbols or blanks land. Thunderhawk symbols are sticky, and when spins end, a prize is awarded from the meter depending on how many Thunderhawks are in view. It is possible to receive 1 to 3 additional spins or extra Thunderhawk symbols on every spin.Bonus BuyClicking the Buy button opens up a menu with two bonus options. One is regular free spins round for 50 times the bet, and the second option is Super Free Spins for 150x the bet.Thunderhawk slot - feature buy optionsThunder Hawk: Slot VerdictYep, it's another 9 Masks kinda game, but coming from Peter & Sons means it manages to stand out from the crowded bunch to a degree. Being a Peter & Sons production means attractive artwork and pleasing sounds have combined to create a unique-looking slot. Not as striking as some of the studio's memorable works like Monster Blox to give an example, but still, Thunder Hawk looks like little else out there.The same can't quite be said about the gameplay, though, which revolves mostly around landing Thunderhawk symbols to scoop instant cash wins from the prize ladder. It sometimes feels like you can't move two steps in the online slot biz without tripping over one of these sorts of games sooner or later. Peter & Sons has added features you don't usually find elsewhere, though, such as features on free spins, including win multipliers. Interestingly, during the two bonus rounds, the top prize on the meter was covered over by a piece of red cloth, indicating that perhaps it can only be won in the base game? Or maybe it is altered this way on account of the multipliers to keep the game within its 5,000x the bet max win limit? Either way, 5,000x is Thunder Hawk's top prize. Also, Super Free Spins did not drop a feature on each spin. Either the demo needs a tweak, or the game rules do. Something to keep an eye out for in the future.So, did the world really need another one of these 9 Masks-style games? Maybe not, but there are arguably loads of things we don't necessarily need that continue to pour forth from the capitalist/consumerist production line on a daily basis. And so, taken from the standpoint that more choices are a positive thing for discerning consumers, then even if Thunder Hawk feels like it's behind the ball, it's a nicely designed scatter symbol/instant prize-win game with a few original touches to potentially entertain players hot on this style."

title: Rainbow Riches Megaways
structured_summary: Rainbow Riches Megaways features a classic Irish folklore theme with the iconic Leprechaun and a pot of gold. The game offers up to 117,649 ways to win, cascading reels, a Super Gem Bonus, and a Free Spins round with an unlimited win multiplier. The reviewer finds it a solid, medium to high variance Megaways slot with great potential and the best in the Rainbow Riches series. Aesthetics stay true to the original with gold-encased reels, lush green backdrops, and primitive yet charming sound effects.
review: Out Now,7,"Rainbow Riches Megaways: ReviewThe first encounter we had with Barcrest's famous Leprechaun now seems like ages ago. Looking for something different to try, other than the usual 243 ways slots that we were playing with consistent regularity back in the days, Rainbow Riches seemed contrasting enough. Aside from having a fantastic session on it, which included a free spins round with a ridiculous amount of retriggers, what stuck to mind was the oddly primitive, but seducing sound effects and visuals. It wasn't until later that we became aware of the iconic status of the game, especially in the UK, where soon after its release it became one of the most popular slot machines in recent times.The time has now come for the Leprechaun to take a step into the modern era in a slot that preserves the classic feel of the original, but also benefits from the captivating action that the Megaways engine has to offer. Following a long series of Rainbow Riches games, this one utilises 6 reels and a random number of symbols per reel on each spin that can result in up to 117,649 ways to win when fully expanded. It comes with cascading reels, a Super Gem Bonus feature that turns all visible gems into matching symbols, and a Free Spins round with an unlimited win multiplier. You can play Rainbow Riches Megaways on all devices from between 20 cents to 20€ per spin.In terms of creative direction, the developers have made sure to keep the final design true to the original formula. This goes for all aspects of the game - sound, look and feel. With an Irish folklore theme, the reels are encased in gold coupled with a picturesque lush green countryside backdrop. Just below the unmistakable logo, a rainbow shoots out of a pot of gold filled to the brim with gold coins. On the reels you'll see the usual A to 10 royal values as well as blue, green, purple and orange gems. The most lucrative is the diamond with 6 of a kind giving you 50 times your stake. The wild symbol is represented by a horseshoe and substitutes for all regular symbols.Rainbow Riches Megaways: FeaturesMost people reading are likely already familiar with the Megaways game engine by now. Originally developed by Big Time Gaming, the concept of Megaways revolves around its shape-shifting reels that, in this particular game, can give you an outcome of between 2 to 7 symbols on reels 1 and 6, and between 2 and 6 symbols on the remaining reels, every time you hit the spin button. With some simple mathematical calculations, it means that each spin can bring about between 324 to 117,649 ways to win. Above reels 2, 3, 4 and 5, you'll also see a horizontal reel that delivers additional symbols, contributing to adjacent wins, as well as special symbols that only appear on this reel.Moreover, the Megaways concept is usually combined with cascading reels mechanics, which is also the case here - all symbols part of a winning combination explode to make room for new symbols. This chain effect repeats until no more winning combinations appear in view.Rainbow Riches Megaways comes with the Super Gem Bonus feature. It's quite similar to Blueprint Gaming's mystery symbols feature, but instead of appearing as a question mark across the reel set, it triggers when a Super Gem appears on the horizontal reel. When it does, all high-value gemstone symbols in view are transformed into one matching randomly chosen gemstone.Though offering excellent potential even in the base game, the Free Spins feature is the key to land the truly substantial wins. It comes into play when 4 or more scatter symbols land in view anywhere on the main reels and will give you 12 starting spins. For each additional scatter in view, 5 extra Free Spins are awarded. As is the case with all these Bonanza-type games, it's all about the unlimited win multiplier which increases by 1 on each winning cascade without ever reverting. During the free spins round, +1, +2 and +3 symbols may appear on the top reel to give you additional spins.If you don't want to wait for the free spins feature to drop organically, you can opt for the Buy Pass feature. For a cost of 100 times your stake, you'll gain direct access to the free spins. If you're feeling a bit more adventurous, you could go for the Take a Chance option instead. Hoping that the arrow lands on the green segment of the circle, you're odds of triggering the feature depends on the chosen stake - for a cost of 25, 50 or 75 times your stake, you will get a 25%, 50% or 75% chance of triggering the bonus respectively.Finally, there is the Bonus Bank feature, which reduces the price of the free spins bonus. 'Bank Off Wins' adds all wins to balance, 'Bank All Wins' adds all wins to the 'Bonus Bank', and 'Bank Small Wins' adds wins 3x stake or less to the 'Bonus Bank'.Rainbow Riches Megaways: Final VerdictAside from a couple of minor deviations, Rainbow Riches Megaways is a rather typical Megaways offering. For example, it's not too common for these slots to have different reel height settings as is the case here where the middle reels will give you no more than a maximum of 6 symbols as opposed to 7 on the first and last reels. Moreover, we found the RTP to be slightly lower than what you normally see in other Megaways slots, but being Barcrest, whose slots are usually around the 95% mark, we're not too surprised.Medium to high variance, it offers outstanding potential reaching well over 10,000 times your stake. High roller should take notice, however, that the game is capped at a maximum payout of 250,000€. Overall, it's a Megaways game as good as any other and will appeal to all players that enjoy these types of slots that are known, not only for their great potential, but also the extended and entertaining gameplay they have to offer. Rainbow Riches Megaways is, in our opinion at least, by far the best game in the Rainbow Riches series.If you're a fan of the Megaways game mechanic we suggest you take a look at Barcrest's second Megaways slot and their first ever branded release Beetlejuice Megaways. For more Big Time Gaming related mechanics, there's also Slot Vegas Megaquads."

title: Dragon Horn
structured_summary: Dragon Horn is a medieval fantasy-themed slot featuring elves, orcs, and knights on a 5-reel, 243-ways-to-win setup. The game includes mystery Dragon Fire symbols, an escalating free spins bonus with multiple levels, and potential wins up to 8282x the stake. The reviewer praises its balanced math, exciting bonus build-up, and overall fun despite high volatility. Visually simple but charming, the game offers solid audio and a cohesive medieval atmosphere.
review: 8.5,"Dragon Horn (Thunderkick): ReviewDragon Horn is the latest in a string of, what you could call conventional slots, to migrate from Thunderkick, a studio that defiantly remains unaffected by the current Megaways trend. And they hold up well, we might add. Dragon Horn is a solid slot that will satisfy your primal instinct; the potential is appealing, the maths are well balanced, and the build-up during the free spins is outstanding.Main gameWith a medieval fantasy theme, you'll embark on an epic journey involving elves, orcs and knights in this 5 reel, 243 ways to win slot from Thunderkick. Highly volatile, you can take it on from 10 cents to 100€/$ per spin across all compatible desktop computers, tablets and mobile devices. Dragon Horn comes with a mystery symbol that transforms into a random symbol as well as a bonus game with different levels that will take you through 5 kingdoms on your way to the dragon's lair where great treasures await.Dragon Horn isn't a graphical powerhouse but presents itself with enough confidence that its simple appearance never becomes an issue. Set in a medieval town, on the reels you will see lower value red, blue, green, purple and brown shields as well as medium value orcs, dwarves, elves and knights. You'll also see queens and dragons, the latter being the most lucrative with 5 of a kind giving you 20 times your stake. The wild comes in the shape of a big W symbol and substitutes for all symbols except the scatter, appearing on all reels but the first.Dragon Horn (Thunderkick): FeaturesThere's a special symbol included in the game known as the Dragon Fire symbol which plays a significant role as you will see. The functionality is simple and one you've likely seen before - all instances of the Dragon Fire symbol that appears in view transforms into a randomly chosen character symbol, including the scatter, thus significantly increasing the winning potential.The Dragon Fire symbol comes to even better use in the Bonus Game which is triggered when you land 3, 4 or 5 scatters anywhere on the reels, giving you 7, 9 or 11 free spins respectively. Once in, each scatter that appears in view will advance the Dragon Horn meter by 1 and award you +1 spin.If you collect 3 scatters, a map will present itself to visualise your progress to the next level. Moreover, upon advancing one level, one of the shield symbols, starting with the one of lowest value, will turn into a Dragon Fire symbol for the remainder of the feature. Effectively, this means all lower value symbols can become mystery symbols, helping you land wins of up to 8282 times your stake in the bonus.Dragon Horn (Thunderkick): VerdictDragon Horn is a classic Thunderkick slot of exceptional quality that makes for an excellent adventure thanks to the escalating nature of the free spins bonus. title: Aztec Ascent
structured_summary: Aztec Ascent is an Aztec-themed slot centered around treasure hunting with a historical backdrop.
