The reviewer finds it initially understated but rewarding with its volatile gameplay and potential for big wins. The game offers a mostly brown color palette with panpipe and percussion sounds, creating a low-key yet pleasant atmosphere.
review: 7.5,"Aztec Ascent: Slot OverviewAfter the Spanish conquistadors, led by Hernan Cortes, squeezed Montezuma and his people for gold in 1519, they quickly had to flee the Aztec capital, Tenochtitlan. The Aztecs rose in rebellion following a shocking massacre, and the Spanish had to dump a load of rich stuff in a lake to hasten their escape. It would become known as Montezuma's Treasure, and according to popular theory, has eluded treasure hunters ever since. We are happy to say you won't need to shake down ancient civilizations in Relax Gaming's slot Aztec Ascent, but thanks to multipliers of up to x100 in both base and bonus games, players have the chance to collect some substantial treasure all the same.With shades of Mega Masks, Aztec Ascent shifts the action next door from Guatemala to a more central American location where the Aztec nation was located. The view is agreeable yet not remarkable; Relax going for a predominantly brown palette similar to Sails of Fortune. It's not a dull view at all due to the quartet of promising meters located above and to the sides of the 6-reel, 40-payline game grid. A pleasing soundtrack jangles away in the background, made up of panpipes and percussive instruments, punctuated by triumphant blasts when wins hit or features trigger. As is often the case, these cute touches conceal the lethal game engine Relax has laid beneath.One of the precursors of things to come is the multiplier trail above the reels, a telltale Aztec Ascent is capable of some big win potential. It's paired with a highly volatile math model, though, so this is no walk through the Yucatan being gifted precious metals from friendly locals. Determination, plus a healthy dose of luck, will be required. RTP is quite generous, as it typically is when it comes to Relax, at 96.36%, and the game can be played on any device, where bets of 10 p/c to $/€10 per spin may be set.Lining up three or more identical symbols left to right from the leftmost reel constitutes a winning combination. The symbols on the paytable are an odd mix of low-value card royals, stars, and high pay Aztec icons, something like birds, snakes, crocs, jaguars, and a warrior's head all carved in stone tiles. Should you land a win line of six premiums, a payout of 4 to 10 times the stake is headed your way. Interestingly, there are no wild symbols, so it's down to the two features to build value.Aztec Ascent: Slot FeaturesThe two extras on hand are a Relic Random feature and Ascension Free Spins. The Relic Random may trigger at any moment in the base game. When it lights up the screen, a random multiplier of x2, x5, x10, or x100 is chosen, and 1 to 4 high pay symbols become mystery symbols for the current spin. All mystery symbols in view transform into the same matching symbol for a win evaluation. The selected multiplier is then applied to any winning total.Ascension free spins are triggered when 3, 4, 5, or 6 gold disc scatters land to award 8, 10, 12, or 15 free spins, respectively. What you want in the bonus round is as many red or blue jewel icons to appear, which land randomly on top of regular pay symbols. These jewels are collected in the two meters on the side of the reels.For every 5 red symbols collected, the multiplier increases through its trail from x1 to x2, x5, x10, and then x100. These values are applied to all wins that occur from then on. Every 5 blue symbols collected will convert high paying symbols to mystery symbols, from lowest to highest, increasing the number of mystery symbols on the reels. Also, for every 5 blue or red symbols collected, +1 additional free spin is awarded.Aztec Ascent - free spinsAztec Ascent: Slot VerdictAztec Ascent is one of those slots that initially comes across as an unobtrusive wallflower, hanging back at a party terrified someone will ask them to dance. But get it going, and an uncharacteristic wild streak emerges. Thematically, it's not the Central American feast a game like 3 Secret Cities was; Relax preferring the low key, friendly presentation they do so well. As you often find in these unassuming Relax games, the math model is quite vicious, and the features on hand can produce some fine gaming.Aztec Ascent certainly powers up during free spins when the collecting is going well. If you can get a great roll on, build a decent multiplier and knock out a few symbols for the mystery reveal, wins as high as 40,000x the bet are technically possible. It is quite a convoluted process and plays in a similar way to Yggdrasil's Valley of the Gods. This goes without saying, but you've really got to land red or blue symbols early to improve the modifiers and draw out the bonus round by winning extra free spins. Starting with the most common number of free spins, 8, doesn't leave a huge amount of time to accomplish much. It does get exciting when the collecting is going your way, yet it's generally not the hard and fast hit of adrenaline, something like Top Dawg$ is, by comparison.One slight downer is the base game is a tad sleepy. Maybe if there was more of a celebration when the Relic Random triggered or energetic animations to break the slumber. Anything to add some zing to the main game, where players are going to spend the vast majority of their time. It's also interesting that Aztec Ascent doesn't have feature buy options, which would have come in handy for some since the base game isn't a major thrill fest, more a quiet Central American hike. Aztec Ascent isn't just admiring the old architecture, though, and can technically blow up, provided the collection system plays ball."

title: Tiki Fruits Totem Frenzy
structured_summary:
Tiki Fruits Totem Frenzy is a tropical beach-themed grid slot featuring exotic fruits and island motifs.  
Key features include cluster pays, waking wild Tiki masks, Totem symbol removals, and free Tiki Spins with symbol collection.  
The reviewer finds it a charming, enjoyable upgrade with fun consecutive wins but modest payout potential.  
The game boasts sharper graphics, a dreamy island backdrop, soothing waves, and an upbeat soundtrack enhancing the relaxed vibe.
review: 7.5,"Tiki Fruits Totem Frenzy: Slot OverviewDeveloper Red Tiger isn’t exactly massively renowned for grid slots, but there are a few playable numbers lurking in their back catalogue. One of them is the sunshine-drenched beach slot Tiki Fruit - a competent grid slot that didn’t quite have the goods to make a major impact. Several years have passed, and the crew is back for another beachside break in Tiki Fruits Totem Frenzy. Some things have changed, some things have stayed the same, let’s find out which.Graphically, the game is a bit sharper, the island location a tad dreamier. Three things immediately stand out. One, the symbol collection meters are initially missing from the side of the screen; secondly, 4 Tiki symbols sit snoring on the grid. The grid itself is the next new bit, where Red Tiger has removed a reel and a row, thereby shrinking it from an 8x10 size down to a 7x9 one. The screen feels much more open, less claustrophobic than before, so players can take in the golden sand, turquoise water, and mountainous background. Waves lap against the shore as boats buzz by, and the upbeat soundtrack provides a neatly positive vibe to lead the grid slot capering.Tiki Fruits Totem Frenzy is built to run on any device, giving players the chance to set bets as low as 10 p/c or as high as $/€20 per spin. The previous Tiki Fruits was a highly volatile game with a high hit frequency, and players can expect more of the same in the Totem Frenzy version as well. Two key stats have flipped in either direction. One which has seen a slight drop is RTP, now resting on 95.68%. Potential, however, has seen a clear increase, though it’s still nothing to go crazy over.Using a cluster pays system, you get a win in Tiki Fruits Totem Frenzy when 5 or more identical symbols connect vertically or horizontally. When this occurs, the successful cluster disappears, and symbols above fall into place, so consecutive wins on each spin are possible. When no new clusters form, the spin comes to an end.The fruit on offer in Totem Frenzy is pretty exotic, and most aren’t what you usually associate with a classic fruit slot. Making up the lower-paying tiles are pomegranates, guava, bananas, coconuts, and dragon fruit – all staples of exotic island life. Higher value symbols include dice, stars, bells, diamonds, and 7s, worth 50 to 777 times your stake for a cluster made up of 25+ symbols.Tiki Fruits Totem Frenzy: Slot FeaturesDuring the base game, the extras revolve around the Tikis and the Totems. However, trigger free spins, and the symbol removal system from the first Tiki game is reintroduced.The 4 Tiki masks on the grid remain locked in the same position at all times; they never move or disappear when used in a win. If a win occurs next to them, they wake up, turning into wild symbols, and the nearest Totem heads on the side of the reels become active (covered below). Wilds substitute for all paying symbols, and winning clusters can awaken more than one Tiki symbol if they are touching.When 2 Totem heads on the same side of the grid are active, there is a chance they remove one type of fruit symbol from the reels. For the remainder of the spin, that particular symbol will not drop in to fill gaps left behind by winning clusters. Alternatively, when 2 Totems on the same side are active, they might remove all symbols on the reels, refreshing the whole screen.If all 4 Tiki heads turn wild on a spin, then 10 Tiki Spins are awarded, with the chance this is bumped up to 15. Tiki masks stay wild throughout, and a symbol collection feature comes into play, scooping up fruit symbols when they form winning clusters. Collect 35 of a single type removes them completely from the reels for the remainder of the feature.Lending the occasional helping hand, there is a chance when 3 Tiki symbols are wild, the 4th is randomly turned wild, thereby activating Tiki Spins.Tiki Fruits Totem Frenzy: Slot VerdictSlight graphical improvements and gameplay tweaks mean Tiki Fruits Totem Frenzy isn’t hugely different from what came before, yet the changes have enhanced the overall experience. Its biggest attraction, a laid-back island charm, remains, making Totem Frenzy as delightful as ever.Tiki Fruits Totem Frenzy isn’t a major evolution over the original, but that’s not a bad thing. The sheer fun factor of popping a ton of consecutive winning clusters off the board remains the main attraction. Pop they do, and removing all low pay symbols from free spins wasn’t the challenge you might think it would be. However, don’t expect major windfalls just because this happens, though. The absence of game-changing modifiers - multipliers, for example, means there is no way of boosting smaller-sized cluster values which tend to be quite low. After working through a significant chain of wins, the resulting payout is usually on the small side.Having some sort of win value-boosting device on board would have pushed Tiki Fruits Totem Frenzy up a level. Then again, if the game had something like a multiplier, then what makes the game so much fun, namely, blasting through loads of winning clusters, would probably have been reduced to compensate. As it is, wins can reach 3,319 times your stake, which is noticeably higher than the original, though not massive by contemporary grid slot standards.Add it all up, and Tiki Fruits Totem Frenzy isn’t a game that pushes you to your limit while holding back epic rewards for the lucky. Instead, it’s a pleasant trip to the seaside with lively characters pushing out satisfyingly lengthy win chains for so-so returns."

title: Magician's Secrets
structured_summary: Magician's Secrets is a mystical-themed slot that explores the fantasy side of magic rather than stage illusions. It features expanding and sticky wilds, two free spin options, and random multipliers, offering player choice and solid volatility. The reviewer finds it a competent but uninspired game, with smooth mechanics but limited innovation and impact. Visually, it boasts bold, glossy graphics set in a scholar’s book-filled room under a cloudy night sky, complemented by smooth effects.
review: "January 6, 2022",7,"Magician's Secrets: Slot OverviewMention of the word 'magician' brought to mind images of an illusionist cavorting around on stage alongside a dedicated yet silent assistant for several minutes, hyping a trick that ends up lasting about 10 seconds. However, stage tricks weren't on Pragmatic Play's mind when they designed their online slot Magician's Secrets. This one delves into the more mysterious elements of the craft, shifting reality to fantasy as they put it. Accomplishing this reality shift will take harnessing one, or both, of its two free spins features where sticky or expanding multiplier wilds appear as if from the ether.Located in what must be a room in the magician's abode, it looks like a well conducive place to explore the mystical side of life. A large game grid takes up much of the space, but around its edges loads of books can be made out, while a neat glass-domed roof allows a cloudy night sky to peek through. On a side note, when you see rooms stacked to the rafters with books like this, do you ever wonder how many of them have actually been read? Maybe all, maybe none, who can say, however, the masses of books help create a 19th-century gentleman scholar's hang out effect.Moving on to the technical aspects, and Magician's Secrets is played on a 6-reel, 4-row game panel, providing 4,096 ways to win. It's a highly volatile slot, where the base game can feel like patiently stirring a cauldron before the brew can be released during free spins. Playable on any device, stakes range from 10 p/c to $/€100, while the variable RTP has a most optimal setting of 96.5%.Clicking on the paytable info reveals ten regular pay symbols, a wild and a scatter. Pays start with four card suit tiles (diamonds, clubs, hearts, spades), orange gems, and potions which are worth 0.8 to 4 times the bet for a six-symbol winning combination. These are superseded by premium swords, chalices, shields, and book symbols which payout 6 to 100 times your stake for a six of a kind win. The magician is displayed on the wild symbol, appearing on all but the first and last reels to replace any other symbol except the scatter. The wild is also central to each of the three features covered next.Magician's Secrets: Slot FeaturesAs mentioned, wilds are the key ingredient in Magician's Secrets' broth, expanding at random in the base game while possessing two special powers in the free spin bonus rounds.Expanding WildsWhen wilds land in the base game, there is a chance they expand to cover all positions on their respective reel. Also, the wild will add a random multiplier of x2 to x10 to the total win if it expands.Free SpinsScatter symbols appear on all reels, and landing 3 or more of them at once triggers free spins. In addition, when 4, 5, or 6 scatters are in view, players collect a payout worth 20x, 200x, or 2,000x their stake. Once free spins are triggered, players can pick from one of two options:Expanding Wilds - Choosing this option awards 10 free spins. In this bonus round, respins are triggered when wild symbols hit on reels 3 or 4 and expand. For each respin, a multiplier of x1 is added to the expanding wild and applied to any wins. Landing 3 or more scatters during the round awards an extra 10 free spins.Sticky Wilds - Picking this bonus round awards 8 free spins. At the beginning of the feature, one symbol is randomly selected, and if it lands on reels 2, 3, 4, or 5, it transforms into a wild symbol. Not only that, but these symbols also remain on screen for the rest of the feature. When a whole reel is full of wild symbols, +3 additional free spins are awarded.Bonus BuyIf Magician's Secrets comes equipped with this option in your jurisdiction, players can buy free spins at any time from the base game for the cost of 100x their total stake.Magician's Secrets: Slot VerdictSo, have you figured out what the magician's secrets are by now? No, neither did we, though we didn't have a disagreeable time trying to figure them out. As usual from Pragmatic Play, Magician's Secrets possesses a glossy sheen we've come to expect, its visuals bold, with effects as smooth as you like. The studio hasn't gone to town on the theme, choosing to skim the surface rather than really dig in and get under its skin. Regardless, Magician's Secrets is an attractive game, possessing a reliable list of stats, typical of a Pragmatic Play slot – provided you play the version offering the most generous RTP.Features follow the same pattern as the rest of the game in that they function well without being highly inventive. Players benefit from random expanding wilds and multipliers in the base game, though it kind of felt like Magician's Secrets was built with bonus buyers, aka the streamer crew, in mind, and having the choice of two free spins rounds is always welcome. Each bonus round has its merits, so it's players' choice whether they prefer the longer and less volatile (presumably) expanding wild option or the shorter and sharper sticky wild one. Both have been limited as to how much magic they conjure up, with a 5,000x the bet win cap being placed on them. Hit the cap, and whatever bonus round you are in comes to a close.In the end, Magician's Secrets came across as a decent choice for some magic-ish gaming. It capably does what it does, throwing a measure of player choice into the bargain, though a lack of imagination meant the game failed to make much of a lasting impression. All told, Magician's Secrets felt like a mid-rank illusionist happy to perform tricks rather than a student of the arcanum tearing open the fabric of existence to extract its mysteries."

title: Sugar Twist
structured_summary: Sugar Twist is a candy-themed slot set in a pink and purple sugary world, closely resembling Pragmatic Play's earlier hit Sugar Rush. review: 2023",8,"Sugar Twist: Slot OverviewThe candy-focused Willy Wonka of the online slot world, Pragmatic Play, is back at it with another tooth-busting game going by the name of Sugar Twist. While the free spins feature is active, multiplier values are not removed from the reels when they appear. Only when the round ends are they cleared. Free spins can be retriggered, too, so when 3, 4, 5, 6, or 7 scatter symbols hit an additional 10, 12, 15, 20, or 30 free spins are added to the remaining amount. When players buy the bonus round, a random number of 3, 4, 5, 6, or 7 scatter symbols will land to trigger it.Sugar Twist slot - free spinsSugar Twist: Slot VerdictPlayers who have been keeping tabs on what Pragmatic Play has been busy releasing should be well-clued up on what Sugar Twist is all about. However, Guarana Eyes of the Amazon doesn't have the stellar RTP that Sugar Twist possesses, which is one of the game's biggest draws. In fact, since practically everything else about Sugar Twist is the same as Sugar Rush, the 98% return value, if you can get it, is about the most compelling selling point.The rest of Sugar Twist was a case of seen it, done it all before, but that's no bad thing. The point we're trying to make is that Sugar Rush was a game Pragmatic Play got the mix just so, and through the procedure of cloning, the same sweet mix has been transferred over to Sugar Twist. This includes the same win cap of 5,000x the bet.Since so much else is the same, it wouldn't have been horrendously bad if Pragmatic Play had boosted Sugar Twist's winning potential to provide extra incentive to play. However, even if Pragmatic Play's decision to remake Sugar Rush with a higher return value might be up for discussion, as it stands, the larger-than-normal RTP is quite a sweetener in its own right and makes deciding whether to play this one or Sugar Rush an easy choice."

title: Jungle Jim: El Dorado
structured_summary: Jungle Jim: El Dorado is a South American jungle-themed slot inspired by the legend of El Dorado, featuring the adventurous character Jim. Critical stats produced by the game’s math model include an above-average RTP of 96.31%, and a medium volatility. Theoretically, this means smaller more frequent payouts augmented by Rolling Reels and The Multiplier Trail, with the whole dynamic shifting into high gear during the bonus game.Jungle Jim El Dorado: Features﻿Along with Rolling Reels, the other principal feature is a round of Free Spins which is activated with the help of the scatter symbols. This desirable symbol, styled in the likeness of an Aztec Calendar, can land on reels 1, 2, and 3 - when all 3 are in view, they award 10 Free Spins along with a 5x payout on top for good measure.There isn’t a huge difference between the base game and bonus round, but the one change is a significant one. This is because the default multiplier starts at x3 whilst subsequent Rolls increase the Trail in increments of +3 to x6, x9, x12 until it reaches x15 at the most.Jungle Jim El Dorado: VerdictThere is a lot to like about Microgaming’s Jungle Jim: El Dorado slot. Okay, for some that might not quite be the city of gold that El Dorado made out to be, but decent returns are possible all the same.At the end of the trek, if you are going to imitate a popular slot, then you may as well do it in style. That’s exactly how Microgaming has approached the development of Jungle Jim: El Dorado, and the result is a slot that continues to entertain players via its look, excellent gameplay, and respectable potential.In 2020, Microgaming partner Stormcraft Studios released a sequel titled Jungle Jim and the Lost Sphinx. Played using 5 reels and up to 50 paylines, it involves many of the mechanics found in the original such as the Rolling Reels feature and Multiplier Trail. It can also prove to be much more lucrative as it offers payouts of up to 6,250 times your stake."

title: 101 Candies

During each Avalanche, the leftmost wild symbol on the Wild Conveyor moves to the grid, replacing a symbol on the reels, and all wilds on the Wild Conveyor shift to the left – a new wild is added to the rightmost side. Wilds will not replace another wild or a scatter on the reels. In the base game, the Wild Conveyor resets at the start of each spin. Wilds replace any regular pay symbol, and their value multiplies the cluster win. If more than one wild is part of a win, multiplier values are added before being applied.Feature Coin SymbolsA random Feature Coin may appear on the gaming grid during an Avalanche, triggering its corresponding feature. Feature Coins activate, then disappear from the reels in an Avalanche before a wild symbol moves from the Wild Conveyor to the reels.The Upgrade symbol increases the multipliers of all wild symbols by 1 up to a maximum of x101.The Destroy symbol removes 5 wild symbols from the Wild Conveyor.The Scramble symbol shuffles all wild symbols on the Wild Conveyor.The Transform symbol picks a random symbol on the reels and replaces all instances of it with another symbol. It does not choose scatters or wilds.Free SpinsScatters can appear on initial spins in the base game and during Avalanches. When 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, or 8 scatters hit, players win 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, or 15 free spins, respectively. When bought, 10 to 15 free spins will be awarded.101 Candies slot - free spins101 Candies: Slot VerdictIf we didn't know better, it might have been easy to think 101 Candies came from an up-and-coming studio rather than one that has been in the business as long as NetEnt has. Despite the stiff competition, titans of the industry NetEnt have hacked their way into the South American jungle with their new slot Rise of Maya.You expect this, but it is still good to say that NetEnt has crafted an attractive looking game. Bright, rich symbols fill the screen and the game bursts with colour. Partly what gives it a South American flourish is the heavy use of serpents which the Mayans symbolised as vehicles for traveling the cosmos. Symbols sit in 3 rows on 5 transparent reels, set in a dark smoky temple adorned with burning fire pits, and big toothy carvings. NetEnt has kept some elements simple such as the 10 fixed paylines, but there are plenty of features which add extra layers of sophistication.Available across all devices, wannabe explorers can control bet levels from 10 p/c up to a maximum of $/€150 per spin. Meanwhile, the volatility is somewhere in the medium/high range whilst the RTP ranges from 96.12% at the base level, which can be increased to 96.42% when the Bonus Bet: Second Chance Scatter Feature is engaged. More on this shortly.Symbols are pretty much all in theme. This includes the low pay 10 - A royals which are crafted in suitably Mayan flavoured stone designs. The five high pay symbols are all Mayan ceremonial masks of various colours and gruesome design. The flamboyant deer skull looking one is worth the most at 250 times the stake for five of a kind. When it comes to winning combinations, low pay symbols require three on a payline, while the high pay symbols just two. The returns might not be much for two of a kind, but it does provide a higher number of wins. The overall hit rate with Rise of Maya is around 1 in 4, which means fairly frequent wins, and there are plenty of features on hand to heat up the action.Rise of Maya (NetEnt): FeaturesFree spins featureThere's a lot of focus on the wilds in Rise of Maya, but it comes bundled with other features as well to keep you entertained. During the base game or free spins, the Scatter Nudge feature can be randomly activated. It only shows up in a no-win situation where it nudges wild or scatters symbols onto the reels.Why have one wild when you can have 4 wilds? Players get a single wild symbol, 2 expanding Serpent Wilds, and Serpent Stacks. All substitute for any of the base pay symbols. As well as this, the 2 expanding Serpent Wilds expand up or down which may or may not cover a whole reel. The Serpent Stack Wild only shows up during Free Spin on hot reels and will always cover an entire reel.Free Spins are triggered when 3 or more scatter or wild symbols land in any combination anywhere in view. This process awards 15 free spins, and the reels that hosted the scatters or wilds that triggered the feature become Hot Reels. These hot reels allow for full reel Serpent Stack wilds to land and do their thing. Moreover, extra free spins can be won during the feature to give you up to 24 in total.The last feature is the Bonus Bet: Second Chance Scatter & Second Chance Scatter Respin – say that one five times fast. For this feature to come into play, players must activate it during the main game. It doubles the stake and provides greater chances of landing extra scatters and wilds to trigger the Free Spins bonus round and those hot reels. It gets its name from the fact that when 2 scatters or wilds appear in view, the remaining reels that do not possess a scatter or wild are re-spun. This provides a valuable second chance to launch free spins and unlock the games full potential.Rise of Maya (NetEnt): VerdictRise of Maya is a respectable offering from NetEnt. It is neither their finest work, nor their best looking game but it is still above average in the wider slot world. What makes it work is the deft handling of the theme without going overboard, while incorporating it well with a wide range of features.Like most slots, the free spins are where the game hits its stride and provides the pinnacle of thrills and payouts, but there is still a fair amount left over for the main game. This is partly because you only need two high pay symbols to win a few coins which keeps the game ticking along. As does the Scatter Nudge feature which randomly shows up to help create some tense moments. High pay symbols also contribute by offering substantial rewards in their own right, and while five of the top paying symbol might be a rare occurrence, it can be a session-changer.As far as these South American/Mayan/Aztec slots go, Rise of Maya holds its own when it comes to entertainment and potential. Get those famously whimsical gods on your side and you are looking at up to a max win potential of over 6,000 times the stake which is quite decent. Rise of Maya is far from groundbreaking, but it's an attractive and fairy simple game with a decent set of features and gameplay that should keep most fans of NetEnt entertained for a while, at least."

title: Pop Cop
structured_summary: Pop Cop is a 1990s-inspired Asian anime/manga-themed slot set in a quirky city with a curvy policewoman protagonist. It features a 6x5 reel layout with scatter pays, cascading wins, area multipliers up to x50, free spins, and a buy feature. The reviewer finds it a surprising and risqué departure for Peter & Sons, with unique mechanics but a polarizing style. review: 2024",4,"Pop Cop: Slot OverviewHave you ever peeped yourself in the mirror and been so unexcited by what you saw you ran out that very day to buy a new wardrobe of clothes, cut your hair a different way, maybe get a tattoo, all in an effort to change your style? It feels like this is what happened to developer Peter & Sons before the studio designed the online slot Pop Cop. Now, it's possible the game is solely aimed towards the Japanese market, but having said that, Pop Cop is a game that is so out of character that if you went in not knowing, Peter & Sons would be one of the last studios you'd think were responsible. If you're ready to see a studio publicly flirting with a totally different style, come take a look.How to describe Pop Cop? It looks like a hardcore Asian anime/manga extravaganza that has leapt right out of the 1990s. Think Rototom drums, a lot of pink and cyan, a palm tree beach, and unusual characters, including a very curvy cop lady. The location is Neopolis, where the aforementioned policewoman, scantily clad for big count-up scenes, has gotten bored with her routine and now zips about on her motocompo through thug-infested streets, thwarting heists, claiming the spoils for herself. This is the game's paraphrased backstory, a fitting one, too, since it's about as odd as everything else found in Pop Cop. Not bad weird, necessarily, just a bit baffling considering the studio's prior tendency for creating cute, cartoony slots in its very distinctive graphical style.Pop Cop slot - base gameFor the demo at least, perhaps this will change in a live setting; bets of 10 to 5,000 per spin may be set, and whether that's in coins or Yen was not clear. For an extra 20% per spin, players can activate the Golden Bet, which increases the chance of triggering free spins. When the Golden Bet is active, Pop Cop's RTP is 96.1%, whereas when it is switched off, the RTP is 96.3%. In this highly volatile slot, the action is carried out on a 6-reel, 5-row reelset, which uses a scatter-paying mechanism to create wins.The cascading wins mechanic takes the symbols from a scatter win off the board, causing other symbols to drop down and fill the gaps. This provides another chance to win on the same spin and cascades end when a new win is not created after a drop. When 8 or more identical symbols are in view on the reels, in any position, a win is formed. Written characters make up Pop Cop's low pay symbols, followed by 4 actual characters as the 4 high pays. When hitting an 8-symbol winning scatter, the payouts are 0.25 to 10 times the bet, or 2 to 50 times the bet is paid for landing 11+ matching symbols.Pop Cop: Slot FeaturesPop Cop slot - free spinsThe features populating Neopolis are cascades, area multipliers, free spins, and a free spins buy.Area MultiplierMarked areas of various sizes may randomly appear on the grid with a multiplier value up to x10 in the base game associated with it. The multiplier value is attached to certain symbols within the marked area, including scatters. If, for example, 8 matching symbols are in view, and 3 of them are in the area showing an x15 multiplier, then an x45 multiplier will be applied to the win.Free SpinsHitting 4 scatters awards 10 free spins, plus 5 extra spins are awarded for each scatter beyond 4. In addition, payout values for 3, 4, or 5+ scatters in view are 3x, 5x, or 100x the bet, respectively. During the round, landing 3 or more scatters grants an extra 5 free spins. Areas appear to trigger more frequently in free spins compared to the base game, though this isn't officially stated in the game rules. Area multipliers in free spins can be x5, x10, x15, x20, or x50.Buy Free SpinsPlayers can click the shopping trolly button to buy 10 to 20 random free spins for the cost of 160 times the bet.Pop Cop slot - free spinsPop Cop: Slot VerdictReviewing Pop Cop was like walking along the high street and seeing a friend you thought was starchily straight-edged darting out of an 'adult' shop with a suspicious brown package under their arm. Hey, they're a grown up, and what is consensually and legally done in the privacy of their home is their business, but who saw that one coming? The point is that Pop Cop is a rather risqué release for Peter & Sons. Is it a one-off experiment, like a do-it at college where everyone's on an experimental buzz, or is this evidence of the studio's new design path? As mentioned at the beginning of the review, the game might have been created primarily for the Japanese audience, which would explain its design and features more clearly.As for the gameplay, well, it's not terrible. Scatter-paying slots have really blown up, and Pop Cop's area multiplier mechanic brings something a little unusual to the party. Multiplier values, since they are tallied up from the individual symbols carrying one, might technically get quite chunky, assisting players attack the game's 10,000x the bet win cap.It's been a while since a slot came along that created so many 'wtf?' moments. Even now, with the review complete, it's hard to know what to make of Pop Cop. Like a piece of confusing modern art, Pop Cop feels like one of those creative endeavours a tight-knit clique of players will go weak at the knees over while others sit there going 'huh?'"

title: True Kult
structured_summary: True Kult is a cult-themed slot that subtly unfolds a dark, psychological narrative beneath a seemingly benign exterior. It features expanding reels, symbol splitting, stacked wilds, multiple bonus modes including The Seance and Sacrifice Spins, and collectible Tarot Multipliers. The reviewer finds it a cleverly designed, highly volatile game with thrilling moments but acknowledges its challenging gameplay and mixed impressions. The aesthetics combine eerie cult imagery with a grassy outdoor setting, while the audio intensifies from ambient to metal-infused during bonus rounds.
review: 2023",8.5,"True Kult: Slot OverviewIt has been said that not all new or unusual groups are necessarily a cult. However, there is no such beating around the bush in the case of True Kult, an online slot from the diabolical minds at Nolimit City. Or something along those exaggerated lines. Once again, the music is right on point, accelerating from the slow sonic base game burn to extra intensity in The Seance to full-on metal meets The Omen during The Sacrifice bonus round.True Kult slot - base gameWhat might be scary is knowing True Kult's volatility has been rated 'Extreme', getting a 10 out of 10 rating from its maker. When the sixth reel is unlocked, a 6 symbol winning hit awards 1.5-2.5x for the cards and 2.75 to 5 times the bet for the Devotees. Wilds appear at various twists and turns, as will be seen in the features section. Wilds can be used to replace regular paying symbols.True Kult: Slot FeaturesTrue Kult slot - Seance spinsTrue Kult stacks this section with Baptism of Fire, scatters, True Believer Wilds, Tarot Multipliers, The Seance, Sacrifice Spins, and the Nolimit Bonus.Baptism By FireThese are stacked symbols that reveal a high-pay Devotee symbol of the same type or scatter symbols in the base game. Skull Wilds may be revealed during the bonus rounds.ScattersScatter symbols land on reels 2 to 5. Landing 2 scatter symbols opens up reel number 6, expanding ways to win to 729. Hitting 3 scatter symbols triggers The Seance bonus mode, while hitting 4 scatters activates The Sacrifice bonus mode. Also, landing a scatter on reel 6 during The Seance activates the Sacrifice bonus mode.True Believer WildsThe 3 stacked True Believer symbol lands only on reel 6 – only activating if the sixth reel is opened. True Believer symbols randomly turn low pay card symbols on reels 2-5 into wilds. Tarot symbols reveal one of the Devotee symbols and a ways multiplier of x5 to x99. These multipliers are collected in the bonus modes if not used when they land. The collected multiplier is sticky throughout The Sacrifice bonus mode.True Kult slot - Sacrifice spinsThe SeanceLanding 3 scatter symbols awards 7 free spins in The Seance bonus mode. Here, 3 All Seeing Eye frames are active at the start of the round. They move randomly across reels 2-5 on each spin, and each symbol that lands within a frame splits into two symbols. The sixth reel remains open during this feature, holding True Believer symbols and Tarot multipliers. Tarot Multiplier symbols turn into a Devotee symbol with an additional symbol multiplier. If the multiplier is not used, it is saved for the next time the same symbol lands. Once transferred to the reels, the multiplier is removed. If an extra Tarot Multiplier lands and reveals the same Devotee symbol as already collected, the highest multiplier will be collected and the multiplier count updated. The count signifies how many of that symbol may be upgraded by the Tarot Multiplier. Landing a Skull Wild symbol awards an extra free spin, plus an extra All Seeing Eye frame. If a Skull symbol lands in a frame, it turns into a double wild but does not award an extra All Seeing Eye.Sacrifice SpinsLanding 4 scatters awards 10 free spins in The Sacrifice bonus mode. Most of the rules of The Seance apply to this round, with a couple of exceptions. For one, this feature starts with 4 All Seeing Eye frames rather than 3. Also, as before, the sixth reel opens, holding True Believer symbols and Tarot Multipliers. However, the symbol multiplier will be sticky and saved for the remainder of the round, transferred to the reels when the symbol lands.Nolimit BonusFrom the Nolimit Bonus, players may buy 7 free spins in The Seance bonus mode for 68 times the bet (RTP 96.19%) or 10 free spins in The Sacrifice bonus mode for 400 times the bet (RTP 96.3%). The third option is a lucky draw for 234x the bet with a 50/50 chance of triggering either bonus mode (RTP 96.32%).True Kult slot - Sacrifice spinsTrue Kult: Slot VerdictFrom a thematic perspective, True Kult has been cleverly designed. It doesn't shock with overtly brutal cultish images of, say, bloody rituals or anything like that. Rather it insidiously burrows beneath the skin as more of the game is revealed. A drip-drip of weirdness, like an actual cult situation presumably, until by the end, users may be unaware of being caught up in the whole situation before it's too late…. Nah, True Kult isn't like that, but it is full of excellent animations, bizarre cultish imagery, and a touch of the dark side. Maybe not as dark as Serial, Mental, Disturbed or some of those NLC Westerns, perhaps, yet there are moments. Big win count-ups for one.The gameplay is such that it can serve moments, rather thrilling ones, though as we know from past experience, Nolimit City games can be hard going as well. With a free spins hit frequency of 1 in 219, bonus modes might not be super common, yet they're not Halley's Comet regularity either, theoretically speaking, at least. It is interesting how close the two bonus modes are, yet how far as well due to the differences. One is the extra starting frame. The other is the stickiness of the symbol multiplier, which is arguably the greater difference. Tarot Multipliers had no problem simply being slung onto the reels when the matching symbol hit but not linking into a win, ending up being discarded. So much handier when multipliers can be reused over and again until the round ends.As can happen in an extremely volatile slot, True Kult might be hugely all or nothing. From a base game plod to explosive meetings of split symbols and symbol multipliers in the bonus rounds – and anything in between. True Kult didn't strike one as being Not Nolimit City's finest work, nor at 23,237x the bet its biggest, but once again, the studio has turned out a game which mixes the old, the new, and the weird into one unique concoction."

title: Orbitfall
structured_summary: Orbitfall is a retro-themed slot inspired by the classic Space Invaders arcade game, featuring spaceships and alien blockers in a sci-fi setting. The game includes cluster pays, multiple levels with blocker-clearing mechanics, avalanches, multipliers, and unique features like laser boosts and alien attacks. The reviewer appreciates its nostalgic appeal and creative twists but notes the challenging gameplay might deter some players. The aesthetics combine old-school pixel art style with a bleep-heavy, arcade-inspired soundtrack enhancing the retro vibe.
review: 2024",8,"Orbitfall: Slot OverviewIt might not have been the first video game, but Space Invaders is said to have been the first shoot 'em up and the first to feature endless gameplay since there was no final level. Released in Japan in 1978, Space Invaders set a benchmark for the genre as it sent wave after wave of invaders creeping down the screen while players blasted them to smithereens with a horizontally moving laser. Archaic by modern standards but huge at the time, Space Invaders' DNA permeates the gaming industry, and its influence can be felt in ELK Studios' online slot Orbitfall.Orbitfall tweaks the formula in some ways, though, since the spaceship symbols in this game move upwards, though blocker symbols do drop down. Spaceships land in a 6-columned, 6-8 row gaming area beneath rows of blocker tiles and a malevolent, multi-eyed entity from beyond the stars. Orbitfall might look a lot more advanced than the early Space Invaders game, but a cracking bleep-heavy soundtrack and an overall old-school vibe reinforce its retro credentials. A comparison could be made with Nolimit City's Space Donkey and Inspired's slot Space Invaders.Orbitfall slot - base gameLike slotting a coin into an arcade game, players stake 20 c to $/€100 per game ground with the goal of blasting blockers and levelling up. Rated 7 out of 10 by ELK, Orbitfall is a medium-high volatile slot bearing the studio's favoured 94% RTP. Orbitfall is a cluster pays slot, so wins are created when 5 or more identical pay symbols are connected in horizontal or vertical directions.Eight pay symbols appear in the game. Little versions of blue, green, yellow and red spaceships are the low pays, while larger versions of the blue, green, yellow, and red spaceships are the higher pays. Clusters of 5 OAK award 0.25x to 1x, while clusters of 10 OAK pay 2 to 50 times the bet. The wild substitutes for everything except the bonus symbol, and a payline of wilds has the same value as the highest payout symbol. Wild symbols and regular pay symbols may land in standard 1x1, super 2x2, or mega 3x3 size, counting as the number of 1x1 symbols they consist of. Empty spaces above big symbols are filled with 1x1 symbols of the same type.Orbitfall: Slot FeaturesOrbitfall - bonus gameIn Orbitfall, all symbols that were part of a winning cluster are removed from the gaming area, and empty spaces are filled by symbols zooming upwards, with new ones coming in from the bottom. Avalanches repeat as long as new wins appear. Cluster wins destroy blockers. All winning symbols shoot upward towards the blocker symbols. One blocker symbol per column per cluster is destroyed.Orbitfall's first level has 5 rows of symbols and a row of blockers above. The second level has 2 rows of blockers, the third level has 3 rows of blockers, and the final level has 1 row of blockers. Play advances to the next level when all blockers at the current level have been destroyed. When going into level 2 or 3, remaining symbols carry over, and each level increases the chance of feature symbols.Each symbol drop in the final level causes the blockers to move downwards one step, adding another row of blockers at the top. The final level ends when a blocker symbol reaches the bottom symbol row. The current active multiplier and potentially remaining redrops are brought into the final level when it is triggered.Feature SymbolsBlocker symbols may contain a feature symbol, which is released when the blocker is destroyed. These are:Redrops - increases the redrop count. A redrop is triggered and consumed at the end of the game round when there are no more wins or at the end of a free drop. All symbols are replaced in a redrop, but current blockers remain.Level Clear - removes all other blockers, triggering them to release their symbols and advancing the game to the next level.Multiplier symbol - increases the global multiplier. The global multiplier is applied to all subsequent wins in the current round.Lazer FeatureA normal 1x1 pay symbol may drop in carrying a lazer feature. It charges the lazer when part of a winning combination. A lazer charge is consumed at the end of the game round when there are no more wins or at the end of a free drop; then, an entire column is removed.Alien AttackAn alien attack may occur at the end of a game round when there are no more wins or at the end of a free drop. When triggered, 1 to 6 randomly chosen columns have all payout symbols removed.Free DropsA bonus symbol reaching the top symbol row triggers the bonus game and 5 free drops. The current active multiplier and potential remaining redrops are brought into the bonus round. The bonus game cannot be retriggered.X-iterThe X-iter has Bonus Hunt spins, which cost 3x the bet each and make triggering the bonus game more than 4 times more likely. Fleetcall costs 10x the bet to start the game round on level 2, while Play Among the Stars starts the game round on the final level for 75x the bet. The bonus round can be bought for 100x the bet, or 500x buys Endless Annihilation, guaranteeing entry to the final level with a boosted start with multiple features.Orbitfall slot - bonus gameOrbitfall: Slot VerdictRetro nostalgia continues to ripple through the gambling industry like a cool new pair of sneakers, and numerous studios have gotten on board. The appeal isn't hard to spot either, as there is something wholesomely enjoyable about a slot that isn't trying to be cutting-edge radical but heads in the opposite direction, taking inspiration from the past. The old-school phenomenon is alive and kicking in the video game industry, and thanks to slots like Orbitfall, it's a growing force in slots as well.Having links to a big-name classic of the past, such as Space Invaders, doesn't hurt the appeal either. And while Orbitfall's action isn't exactly the same as that classic, the spaceships, the shooting, and the upwards/downwards movement make it hard not to connect them. ELK Studios, being the creative force it is, has made sure Orbitfall belongs wholly to them, however, and the slot contains numerous twists and thrill spikers. Some of these are the trio of feature symbols, which help by clearing blockers and providing a free life. Others are the alien attack and lazer boost. Feature symbols are also able to increase the multiplier, which is a critical piece of the puzzle. Levelling up bestows the game with a mission element, giving players an incentive to keep hitting spin, and like actual Space Invaders, it could get frustrating. Achieving the objective and blasting organically into the final level might be so challenging it kills the motivation to continue, but who knows? The blasting may prove fruitful, and Orbitfall has a win cap of 7,500 times the bet to fly your ship towards.Whether the up, down, space invaderery thing floats your boat or not, it's hard to deny ELK Studios has once again got all creative when designing Orbitfall. It might end up being a winsome novelty instead of a chart-busting hit, but there is more than enough room in the pudgy, overfed online gambling space for original slots like Orbitfall."

title: Hugo Legacy
structured_summary: Hugo Legacy is a charming cartoon-themed slot celebrating the 30th anniversary of the beloved Hugo the Troll character. review: 0.10/100,"August 10, 2023",7.5,"Hugo Legacy: Slot OverviewIt's funny; you wouldn't think a cartoonish character originally aimed at kids would make the best subject matter for use in an online slot. Leaves drift to the ground, butterflies flit about, and the sun is shining, making Hugo Legacy as emotionally buoyant, if not more so, than any other slot in the Hugo range.Hugo Legacy slot - base gameThe central focus in Hugo Legacy from a gaming perspective is a 7x7 cascading grid matrix. A win is formed when matching symbols land connected to each other in vertical or horizontal directions. Winning clusters are removed from the reels, and symbols cascade down to plug any visible gaps. If a new win forms after the cascade, then the process repeats, ending when no new winning clusters are created. All of this cascading action is governed by a medium volatile math model (6 out of 10), available in a wide range of different RTP configurations, defaulting at 96.2%. When picking a bet, the options are 10 p/c to $/€100 per paid drop.Hugo Legacy's regular pay symbols are a mix of miscellaneous items and characters. The rewards for landing a 5 symbol cluster are 0.1 to 2.5 times the stake, rising to a maximum of 40 to 1,000x the bet for hitting a 20+ sized cluster. A big sparkly diamond is Hugo Legacy's wild symbol, used for the purpose of substituting any regular pay symbol.Hugo Legacy: Slot FeaturesHugo Legacy slot - free spins feature gambleEach winning symbol counts as +1 charge on the Telephone meter. At certain charge levels, a modifier is triggered, while a free spin with various strengths can also be won. When 15 or more charges are achieved, a random character modifier is awarded:Hugo – adds 5 to 8 wilds to the grid.Scylla – protects 1 or 2 symbol types and wilds and destroys all others.Don Croco – transforms 2 to 5 symbol types into different symbol types.Fernando – turns a single symbol type wild.Jean Paul – selects a symbol and builds a winning cluster.Free SpinsA free spin activates if there are at least 35 charges on the Telephone meter. At 35 charges, the default free spin is activated, but if 40, 45, or 50 charges are achieved, then a stronger free spin is triggered:35 charges in the Telephone awards 2 character modifiers.40 charges in the Telephone awards 3 character modifiers.45 charges in the Telephone awards 4 character modifiers and 5 wilds collected.50 charges in the Telephone awards 5 character modifiers and 30 wilds collected.When the free spin is triggered, players have the option of gambling to reach higher levels. Losing a gamble awards a single character feature only. Free spins feature a wild collector. All winning wilds are collected in the first phase, and the wilds are added back to the grid in the second phase after all the character modifiers play out. Only 5 to 10 wilds are used at once, and more will be added after extra wins. This continues until all of the wilds have been used up. Any wilds landing in the second phase are not collected.Hugo Legacy slot - free spinsHugo Legacy: Slot VerdictPlay'n GO's lineup of Hugo slots has leapt about the place, and the jump from the previous release, Hugo Carts, to this one, Hugo Legacy, is substantial. Where Hugo Carts was a highly volatile game with a massive 25,000x the bet max win, Hugo Legacy goes in the opposite direction, easing back the math model as well as the max win, which now tops out at 3,000x the bet. You might think then that Hugo Legacy would be a better match for a mellower sector of the gambling community. Fair dues, yet it's open for anyone in the mood for something which doesn't grind along, instead firing off features with a fair amount of regularity. 'Only' 15 winning symbols are needed to trigger a random character feature, after all, and at least 35 for a free spin. Sure, 'a' free spin, but the gamble option is there for a chance of getting a more powerful free spin if you haven't already got extra charges on the Telephone. Plus, the Wild Collection element might help elongate a free spin session.For any cartoon character to last three decades, it has to have touched the hearts of a good number of viewers. And so, the magic of Hugo the Troll lives on in one of the most unlikely places, online gambling. Hugo Legacy really caters for the fans too. From its selection of characters to its heavy use of Hugo to the telephone element, which may not make a lot of sense to players who never used their phones to interact with the tv video game. Not that it's really necessary to know the full lore and history of the Hugo concept to get a few kicks out of Hugo Legacy, but it's like learning about the place you live in. Knowing more about the history, the people who lived there before you, plus the events that shaped the area and its people can help deepen the connection to a place.However, as mentioned, you don't need to really know much about the Hugo phenomenon to enjoy Hugo Legacy. If what you're after is a relatively light, charming game with a rolling, fairly pacey set of features, then Hugo Legacy might fit the bill."

title: Monster Catch
structured_summary: Monster Catch is a nostalgic fishing-themed slot inspired by classic arcade vibes. It features low volatility gameplay, free spins with expanding reels, fish symbols with cash values, and a Gamble feature. The reviewer finds it a modest, niche addition to the crowded fish slot genre with limited big win potential. The game has retro-style visuals reminiscent of Fishin' Frenzy, with simple sea-floor scenes and thematic audio enhancing the home-play experience.
review: 4,"Monster Catch: Slot OverviewSome gamblers may recall the joy of being a youth and seeing their favourite arcade games made playable on consoles or personal computers. Examples abound from Street Fighter 2, Double Dragon, Bubble Bobble, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, to Rampage, and on and on. It's in this spirit of taking a joyful public experience into the privacy of the home that developer Light & Wonder has released the online slot, Monster Catch, which is probably bigger news for British betters, but let's cast off and see if we can catch a buzz.Visually, Monster Catch gives off strong Fishin' Frenzy vibes, being all retro, somewhat aged-looking and all that. Like pretty much everything Monster Catch does, players will probably know ahead of time whether they're going to be thrilled by the artwork or not. We've got white coated reels in the middle, a fisherman chappie top left, and scenes of the sea floor making up much of the rest of the view. Whether Monster Catch is a looker or a beast, let's let players decide in order to avoid getting overly harsh.Monster Catch slot - base gameFor those keen to reel or try to reel in something, Monster Catch provides a bet range of 10 c to $/€10 a pop. The math model is low volatile, while the maximum RTP sits on 96.17%. Monster Catch's 5-reel grid usually holds 3 rows per reel, but in the free spins feature, it is possible to have up to 6 positions on each reel. When 3 positions are active, 10 paylines are provided. When 6 positions on each reel are available, the number of paylines doubles to 20.The pay symbols are 10-A card rank lows, which are worth 10 times the bet for a five-of-a-kind winning combinations, no matter the type, then anchors, floats, worms, and seagulls are the highs, worth 50 to 200 times the bet for 5 OAK. The fish money symbols also pay when they make line wins, up to a value of 20x the bet.Monster Catch: Slot FeaturesMonster Catch slot - bonus wheelMonster Catch has 4 different fish symbols - small, medium, large, and XL. Fish symbols land on any reel and the different sizes can be involved in the same winning line. Each fish also has a cash value of 2x to 50x that is collected by the Fisherman or the Gold Fisherman symbols in free spins only.Free SpinsHitting 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols awards 10, 15, or 20 free spins, respectively. Free spins come with Mighty Reels, meaning the reels are 6 rows high, though the upper 3 rows are inactive. The Fisherman and Gold Fisherman symbols are added to the free spins round, and both substitute for any regular paying symbol. The Fisherman's other job is to collect the Cash value of Fish money symbols.When one or more Gold Fisherman symbols land, Mighty Reels are activated, and the upper 3 rows open, plus 2 free spins are awarded. Any visible Fisherman and/or Gold Fisherman symbols collect the cash values from any Fish symbols on the active reels. The upper reels become inactive on the next spin. When Mighty Reels are open, it is not possible to land 5 OAK Fish wins on the upper 3 rows.Gamble FeatureWhen the Gamble button is active, and wins of 5x the stake or over occur, the Gamble feature triggers. If Premium Play is also active, the Gamble feature triggers at 2.5x the Premium Play stake. The Gamble feature has two options - Gamble Cash value and Gamble entry into free spins. Gambles take place on red and green segmented wheels.Premium PlayWhen switched on, Premium Play adds 50% to the bet. Then, when there is a single base game win of 2x or more, when not triggering free spins, players get one spin on the Bonus Wheel with a Bonus Guarantee. The Bonus Wheel has multipliers of x1 to x5 and 8 to 20 free spins. If a multiplier is awarded, it is applied to the cash win. If free spins are awarded, players win the indicated amount. Premium Play has an RTP of 96.1%.Monster Catch slot - free spinsMonster Catch: Slot VerdictIf you weren't (or aren't) there to witness and enjoy Monster Catch in a physical setting, it'll probably be hard to get even remotely excited about it in its virtual, online form. Fish slots, shoot, where to begin? There are a lot of them, like golly gee, a lot. From the pillars of the genre, Fishin' Frenzy and Big Bass Bonanza, to the myriad of offshoots and contributions from countless other studios. Even casino game makers that have a tendency to turn their backs on fads in order to do their own thing, like Nolimit City, have dropped slots such as Ugliest Catch in order to elbow in on the fish phenomenon. Amongst the immense commercial trawling, sucking up every life form in the seas that is the online slot fish craze, Monster Catch is an absolute minnow.Then again, there is something heartwarming about playing a game from the comfort of your own home that you've enjoyed out and about in public. So it is with video games, so it might well be with Monster Catch, too. Gamblers who like the idea of having access to Monster Catch 24/7 on their personal computer, tablet, laptop, or mobile phone get that with this release. There's no need to pop down to the bookies, arcade, or wherever to have a turn; now, it's possible to play anywhere, from the bus ride to work to sitting on the khazi. Better yet, the top win has increased over what the physical box could deliver to a new max of 736x.Hate to state the obvious, but 736x is not a big amount in this day and age, yet that is hardly likely to be a deciding factor. Either the thought of playing Monster Catch at home gets your excitement levels bubbling, or it causes last night's lasagna to bile up in the back of your throat."

title: Big Win 777
structured_summary: Big Win 777 by Play'n GO is a neon-lit slot themed around classic Las Vegas and prize wheels. It features 15 paylines, a Booster Spin to increase free spin chances, a Chance Wheel for cash or free spins, and a unique diamond wild that clones itself. The reviewer finds it a visually appealing but niche, high-volatility game with limited long-term appeal. The game boasts upbeat game show music, neon aesthetics, and a dimly lit background evoking a retro Vegas vibe.
review: 6.5,"Big Win 777 (Play'n GO): OverviewCasinos love colourful prize wheels, and so do players it seems. Possibly inspired by the Roulette wheel, these alluring wheels have been around ever since the modernization of land-based casinos began, and analogue devices came into the picture. It's this tradition that Big Win 777 from Swedish provider Play'n GO builds upon, a game that, in a modern context, will take you on a virtual tour back to the glitzy and luxurious days of classic era Las Vegas.Played using a setup of 15 fixed paylines spread across 5 reels, Big Win 777 is a highly volatile 96.50% RTP slot that can be played from 0.15 to €/$90 per spin on your desktop computer, tablet or mobile phone. Of course, it comes with a couple of built-in features designed to keep things interesting, such as the randomly triggered Booster Spin feature which increases your chances of triggering the Free Spins round, and the glorious Chance wheel where cash prizes can be won as well as direct access to the free spins.In terms of presentation, the designers have turned to the neon-lit world of Las Vegas for inspiration with some game show elements thrown in as well. It's got that typical upbeat game show music going on and even a speaker calling out highlights of the game. With a dimmed background illuminated only by disco pillars and neon stripes, symbols on the reels include single, double and triple bars, double red 7s, triple golden 7s, and the diamond wild - the latter being the most rewarding, giving you 66.67 times your stake for a 5 of a kind combo.Big Win 777 (Play'n GO): FeaturesBonus wheel in actionOn any spin in the base game, the Booster Spin feature may come into play. When initiated, it increases the odds of triggering the free spins feature. You can also gain access to the free spins through the Chance Wheel feature which activates when 3 Chance Wheel symbols appear on reels 1, 3, and 5 simultaneously. A massive wheel will then present itself and spin once. When it comes to a stop, you will have won either a cash prize of between 5 - 777 times your stake, or an invitation to the free spins round.Having been granted access to the Big Win Free Spins feature through any of the previously mentioned access points, you will start with 12 free spins. These spins are not written in stone, however, as 1 or 2 additional spins will be added to your total should you land 1 or 2 scatters respectively during the round. Better yet, if you land all three of them, 5, 10 or 20 more spins will be added. There are no limits to how many times you can re-trigger the free spins.So what's to it more than just the re-triggers then? Well, if a diamond wild hits on any of the reels, it will remain in position for the two subsequent spins while cloning itself up or down during these two spins. In theory, you could get 2 spins with only diamond wilds present on the reels to reward you payouts of 1,000 times your stake per spin.Big Win 777 (Play'n GO): VerdictSomewhat jaded by all the generic wheel-based slots released throughout the years, we weren't exactly jumping up and down with excitement to see yet another one being added to the list. Being niche slots, they simply don't appeal to all players and the developers likely know this better than anyone else. With that said, an attempt has been made to capture a wider audience by adding a couple of extra reels and more paylines than what you usually get, not to mention the 5000x win potential and high volatility that is in such high demand these days. The outstanding visual appearance, of course, also does an excellent job of catching your interest.We don't expect Big Win 777 to become a long-lasting hit. Once the novelty of it settles (give it a week or two), it'll morph into its intended role as a 'filler', a slot that every developer needs to have in their catalogue simply to make sure they have something on offer for everyone."

title: Dueling Jokers Dream Drop
structured_summary: Dueling Jokers Dream Drop is a neon-themed, funk-inspired slot featuring joker iconography on an 8x8 cluster grid. It boasts numerous features including Wild Joker multipliers, a Joker Meter, free spins with Bonus Booster and Fortune Maker, plus a Dream Drop Jackpot with multiple prize tiers. The reviewer praises its feature-rich gameplay and immersive experience, highlighting it as a fun and rewarding slot for both casual and long-term players. Visually, the game offers a retro-futuristic neon aesthetic paired with funky, toe-tapping audio.
review: 2022",7,"Dueling Jokers Dream Drops lot - base gameDuelling Jokers Dream Drop: Slot OverviewAs if Relax Gaming wasn't already doing a stand-up job of filling the Dream Drop slot category at a prodigious pace, the studio has enlisted the help of partners Four Leaf Gaming to lend a hand. The result is Duelling Jokers Dream Drop, a neon delight of funky sounds and joker iconography. Whilst spinning these sorts of games for the chance to win the Mega Jackpot is likely the main goal, Duelling Jokers Dream Drop packs a long list of supporting features. So many that listing them all here might nuke any sort of word limit. So, instead, why don't we just leap in and see how it all works?As mentioned, Duelling Jokers Dream Drop is a funkified online slot, banging out a head-nodding, toe-tapping tune while the action takes place on an 8 by 8 game grid. Duelling Jokers Dream Drop is a cluster paying slot where wins are created when five or more identical symbols land in adjacent spaces, touching horizontally or vertically. Wins trigger the cascade feature, which removes winning symbols and fills empty spaces by dropping symbols down from above. It's a little like Amped meets Jammin' Jars, but Duelling Jokers Dream Drop manages to forge its own personality, a rather fun one at that.Playable on any device, Duelling Jokers Dream Drop offers stakes of 20 p/c to $/€20 per spin - the higher the bet, the bigger the chance of triggering a jackpot. A highly volatile game, RTP is lower than usual due to the immense Jackpot Network it is wired into. When playing normally, the theoretical return comes in at 94%, or when Nitro Spins are enabled, this value drops to 93.7%-93.64% (when playing with coins, otherwise the RTP remains at 94%).Lit up like signs in the night are six regular pay symbols. These are cherries, lemons, clovers, horseshoes, diamonds, and sevens. Hitting a five-symbol cluster triggers a payout of 0.1 to 0.6x the bet, rising to 3-10x the bet for 15+-sized clusters. One other token to be aware of is Fortune Coins. They are collected when they land and can be used to buy features or reduce the cost of buying features. Collected coins may also trigger the Super Spinner. All of this is covered next.Duelling Jokers Dream Drop: Slot FeaturesDueling Jokers Dream Drop slot - free spinsIf the goal was to bung Dream Drop onto a bright grid slot and leave it at that, Four Leaf Gaming clearly missed the memo. Duelling Jokers Dream Drop is stacked with features; let's take a look.Wild JokerThe first one is the Wild Joker, which substitutes for all symbols barring free spins symbols. If the wild is used in a winning cluster, it moves to a random empty space before the next cascade. In addition, each time the joker is part of a win, its win multiplier increases by +1. When Joker Wilds land next to each other, they may duel, boosting each of the multipliers by +1.Joker MeterEach winning cluster fills a segment of the Joker Meter. Filling the meter adds Wild Jokers to the grid. During a regular spin, Jokers are added after the first, fourth, and seventh winning clusters. If Nitro Spins are active, Jokers are added after the first, third, and sixth winning cluster.Free SpinsLanding 3 scatter symbols awards 6 free spins. The round begins with 3 Joker Wilds in random positions, each one with a starting multiplier of x1. Each winning cluster fills a segment of the meter, which accumulates through the feature and does not reset. After the tenth, twentieth, and thirtieth winning cluster, +2 free spins are awarded. Where available, free spins may be bought for the cost of 600 coins.Bonus Booster - This feature allows players to gamble all or some free spins for the chance to win 1, 2, or 3 extra free spins. The more free spins gambled, the higher the chance of winning. The gamble can be repeated, but the max number of free spins won is limited to 25. When 23 or more are won, they are instantly collected.Fortune Maker - A free spins win over a certain level triggers the Fortune Maker, where players may choose how much they would like to gamble. They then drop a ball, and if it lands in a Winning Ring, players climb a Prize Ladder. Of the 16 rings, 12 are winners, and 4 will lose. Money not played with is collected automatically. Landing in a losing ring returns players to the base game with no prize. Clicking collect at any time ends the feature at the current prize level.Bonus Replay - Winning under a certain amount in free spin triggers a Bonus Replay. Players are able to gamble the free spins winnings for a chance to replay them. To gamble, a wheel spins. Winning spins award a new round of free spins without previous winnings carried over. Losing the spin returns players to the base game.Dream Drop JackpotWhen triggered, a Jackpot Spin is played before the regular spin, and if 4 Dream Drop Joker symbols land, the Dream Drop Bonus is triggered. For the Dream Drop Bonus, 5 Jackpot Zones appear on the game grid. Each zone represents one of the jackpots – Rapid, Mini, Maxi, Major, and Mega. Now, 4 jokers jump around until they land in one of the Jackpot Zones. When a joker lands in a Jackpot Zone, one segment is filled, and a new joker is added randomly to the grid. The first Jackpot Zone to have all four segments filled awards its respective prize. As an indicator of prize values, the starting amounts for the Rapid, Mini, Maxi, Major, and Mega are €1, €5, €100, €25,000, and €500,000.Super SpinnerAny time a coin is collected, the Super Spinner may be triggered. This can award cash prizes of 80 to 5,000x, 8-14 free spins, 10x to 25x Fortune Maker, or 10-25 Nitro Spins. A Super Spinner spin can be bought for 500 coins.Nitro SpinsActivating Nitro Spins reduces the number of clusters needed to fill the Joker Meter, increases free spins scatters, collects coins more frequently, and triggers the Super Spinner more often. Nitro Spins increase the stake by 50% or cost 4 coins per Nitro Spin.Dueling Jokers Dream Drop slot - Dream Drop jackpot gameDuelling Jokers Dream Drop: Slot VerdictAbout Duelling Jokers Dream Drop, Four Leaf Gaming writes, 'We've packed even more features into Duelling Jokers than any of our previous releases.' After going through the list, it would be hard to argue with that statement as Duelling Jokers Dream Drop is indeed packed to the rafters with bits. Sure, the main event might be the Dream Drop Jackpot, but while players are waiting, or hoping, for it to trigger, there is a lot more to do than just tap your feet to the funky beats. Even the visuals are spot on, the retro yet futuristic approach creating a real neon wonderland for players to get their groove on. It all adds up to a fun spot to get immersed in while attempting to access the Jackpot round.As well as the Jackpots, there's plenty to keep players occupied. The previous Four Leaf Gaming slots, Clover Fortunes and Wild Buccaneers Megaways, have been absolute feature-fests as well, and there seems to be a pattern forming here. Basically, players who like to really dig into a game, collect coins, try their luck at almost every moment, ante bet, and so on should be able to appreciate what Four Leaf Gaming is getting at. Of course, it's possible to dip in and out of a game like Duelling Jokers Dream Drop like any other, but it's also set up so that long-term play can lead to Golden Coin collections which can be used to buy or offset the cost of buying features.The non-jackpot features have been well thought out as well. Walking progressive wild multipliers often go down a treat wherever they turn up and can be highly effective. In Duelling Jokers Dream Drop, it's no different, which has a 'Biggest Win' stat of 50,000x and a 'Max Single Win' stat of 45,362x the bet. To date, this has to be the largest non-Jackpot potential on the Dream Drop network.To sum up, it's nice to see Relax Gaming hand the Dream Drop reigns over to another studio to see what they can do, and Four Leaf Gaming has made the most of the opportunity. Duelling Jokers Dream Drop is a fun cluster-paying grid slot in its own right, with the electrifying presence of the Dream Drop Jackpots looming in the background."

title: Gold King
structured_summary: Gold King is a straightforward 5-reel slot with a classic gold treasure theme reminiscent of Play'n GO’s Book of Dead. Key features include Super Spins, Golden Spins, stacked wilds, and an unlimited retriggerable free spins bonus. The reviewer appreciates its simple gameplay and strong winning potential, especially for fans of similar titles. The game sports traditional symbols with clean visuals and stacked wilds, though specific audio details were not highlighted.
review: 7,"Gold King IntroductionGold King is a fairly simple game from Play'n GO with a layout quite typical of the Swedish slot provider. In some sense it even reminds us a bit of their flag ship game Book of Dead. Gold King is a slot with 5 reels, 3 rows and 20 fixed paylines. It features Super Spins, Golden Spins and Super Stacks which we will look at later on in the review.There are only 3 premium symbols in the game. These are made out of Gold Bars, an Amulet and a King's crown. The low value symbols are represented by the classical A, K, Q, J and 10. There is also a Wild Symbol represented by a Rose and that appears in stacks of 6 or 7 on each reel. A wild line pays 125 times the bet and in case you would land a full screen of wilds the award would be 2500 times the bet.3 Scatter symbols activate the Super Spins feature. 10 Free Spins are awarded initially, which can be retriggered.Gold King FeaturesThe game is quite straight forward without complicated features which makes it easy to get into. On any base game spin, the slot may randomly pick a symbol to fill 12 consecutive spaces on each reel and on any spin a so called Golden Spin can occur. The Golden Spin is essentially a heart stopper that happens when the same symbols appear stacked on reels 1, 3 and 5. Reel 2 and 4 will then go into a slow spin and hopefully award the player with a full screen of the symbol.The Super Spins is the Free Spins game that will activate if 3 Scatter symbols (Kings) appears on reel 1, 3 and 5. 10 Free Spins will initially be awarded, but up to 10 additional Free Spins can be retriggered during any one spin.1 Scatter symbol will award the player with 1 additional Free Spin2 Scatter symbols will award the player 2 additional Free Spins3 Scatter symbols will award the player 10 additional Free SpinsThere is no limit to how many Free Spins can be reactivated.During each Super Spins round, one random A-K-Q-J-10 symbol is super stacked, filling 8 consecutive spaces on each reel. The wilds also appear stacked on the reels by taking up 6 or 7 consecutive spaces.During Super Spins, the high paying Crown, Amulet and Gold Bar symbols expand to fill the entire reel. These symbols will only expand if doing so will create a winning combination. Before the symbols expand, any wins involving A-K-Q-J-10 symbols are paid out, as well as any wins involving only Wild symbols.Gold King ConclusionGold King is as already mentioned a fairly simple game which you can just jump straight into without having to figure out any complicated features. If you like games such as Book of Dead, chances are high that you will enjoy this one as well. There is some really good potential here with the unlimited Free Spins feature and stacked wilds."
