title: Tarzan and the Jewels of Opar
structured_summary: Tarzan and the Jewels of Opar is a jungle-themed slot inspired by Edgar Rice Burroughs' novel, featuring Tarzan's adventures in a lush, wild setting. The game includes features like a Random Wild drop, free spins with a Feature Wheel multiplier up to x10, and a boosted scatter jackpot up to 5,000x the stake. The reviewer sees it as an enhanced, more conventional follow-up to 9 Masks of Fire, with improved math and bigger win potential. Visually, it offers detailed jungle graphics and animations, moving away from the minimalist look of its predecessors.
review: 2020",7,"Tarzan and the Jewels of Opar: Slot OverviewTarzan and the Jewels of Opar is the fifth book in the jungle man series from American writer Edgar Rice Burroughs. If you're familiar with it, you'll know it's a pretty bizarre story. Opar was a mine used to provide gold for the lost city of Atlantis; Tarzan hits his head, loses his memory, gets romanced by La, a priestess for the Flaming God, while her priests try to sacrifice him. In short, an entertaining setting for Microgaming partner Gameburger Studios’ follow up to their popular 9 Masks of Fire.It must be hard not to milk a hit for all its worth, and Gameburger squeezed hard with 9 Pots of Gold. That one was basically a replica of the original, rolled up in a jolly Irish theme. This time, Gameburger has attempted to make a break while keeping a lot of what players liked about 9 Masks. What it means is a similar game in many ways, but one where key elements have been enhanced. An obvious change is that the 5-reel, 20-payline grid is set in a lushly drawn jungle this time around. Behind the scenes, the studio has altered several of the settings as well.Gameburger's stated aim was to build on a smash hit math model. That's not just sales talk either - 9 Masks of Fire was Gameburger's high water mark, partly due to its user-friendly mathematics. 9 Pots of Gold used the same engine, whereas a few tweaks have been made for Tarzan and the Jewels of Opar.First, the RTP has been raised slightly to 96.38%, not as drastically different as the jackpot prize, but an uptick is always welcome. Heading the other way is the hit rate, which has dropped to 33.26%, yet still around one hit every three spins. What has remained the same, is the volatility, coming in again at a medium setting. So yeah, there have been a few prods and pokes to the math model, but it will be tough to spot much of a difference when the game is in action.The vine-swinging antics are available on any device, where players choose stakes from 20 p/c to $/€20 per spin. Getting a winner means landing three or more of a kind on one of the 20 fixed paylines. There are 8 pay symbols to do so - 4 are low pay J-A royals designed in a nicely overgrown style, then the premiums which are The Belgian, Jane, La, and Tarzan at the top. Five Tarzans on a line are worth quite a lot at 37.5x the stake, while the remaining premiums payout 5 to 20 times the bet.The remaining symbols are 2 scatters, covered below, and the panther wild appearing on any reel. Not only does it substitute for any pay symbol to make a combination, it is also worth up to 62.5x for a line of five.Tarzan and the Jewels of Opar: Slot FeaturesThe Feature WheelTarzan and the Jewels of Opar comes with several features mixing up the pace. They're all pretty straight forward, most having appeared in the previous 9 Masks/9 Pots games. One new addition is the Random Wild feature. On any spin, Tarzan may swing over the game one or more times, dumping at least 2 wild symbols onto the reels. Usually, this would produce 2 or 3 wilds during testing, but it can technically add up to 15, filling the reels for a 1,250x win.Next are free spins, triggered when 3 scatter symbols land on reels 2, 3, and 4. When this happens, the Feature Wheel is activated, which is quite different this time around. The same number of spins is up for grabs 10-30, except this time the accompanying win multiplier can be as high as x10. This multiplier is applied to all wins during free spins except jackpot scatter wins.The final feature is the one that helped put 9 Masks on the map – the scatter jackpot. Landing three or more purple jewel scatters instantly rewards a respective prize. The payout for getting 9 scatters now is 5,000 times the stake, more than double than before.Tarzan and the Jewels of Opar: Slot VerdictWhile there is no '9' in the title, for all intents and purposes, Tarzan and the Jewels of Opar is still 9 Masks of Fire at its heart. title: Jaguar Drop

review: 2024",6,"Jaguar Drop: Slot OverviewScatter-paying slots continue to mushroom through the online gambling realm like an unstoppable ooze, and its popularity has caught the attention of numerous casino game makers. One of those developers is Push Gaming, which first gave the mechanic a whirl in the retro-designed, pixelatedly presented scatter wins slot Rat King. Push Gaming has put on a pleasing view, even if it's the sort of thing experienced players will have seen many times before. But, as mentioned, it's pleasing, and players are free to let their eyes wander over misty foliage, Aztec-style stonework, and, what is it, a sloth, maybe, hanging upside down from a tree branch; a nice touch.Jaguar Drop slot - base gameJaguar Drop is played on a 5x5 gaming grid with scatter wins and a cascade mechanic. With the Push Bet off, Jaguar Drop has an RTP of 96.31% and is mathematically medium volatile.Jaguar Drop creates a winning combination when at least 6 matching symbols are visible on the grid in any position. Winning symbols are removed and are replaced by dropping symbols as part of the cascade feature. For lows, Jaguar Drop has clubs, hearts, spades, and diamonds; for mediums 3 gem in stone shapes; and for highs, a frog, a monkey, and a jaguar. Scatter wins of 6-7 OAK award 0.3 to 2.5 times the bet, while a 15+ OAK gets you 20 to 500 times your bet. Wild symbols are present in the base game only, substituting for anything except Coin symbols.Jaguar Drop: Slot FeaturesJaguar Drop slot - free spins splash screenOne main point of Jaguar Drop is to drop on into its free spins round, which is a hold 'n win game with twists, extra bells and whistles.Coin Symbol & Second ChanceThe Coin symbol is a scatter symbol. Hitting 6 or more Coin symbols in the base game triggers the free drops round. Coin symbols are also bet multipliers carrying values of 1x to 1,000x. When 4 or 5 Coin symbols are in view in the base game, the Second Chance feature may trigger at the end of the spin. When activated, the Second Chance feature removes all pay symbols and wilds from the reels and cascades again.Free DropsThe Free Drops feature is triggered when 6 or more Coin symbols land in the base game. The round always begins with 6 free drops and contains Coin, Boost, Heart, and Collector symbols. All of the triggering Coins start the bonus at the bottom of the reels. On each free drop, one Coin, Boost, Heart, or Collector symbol is dropped onto the reels. These symbols are available only in the Free Drops round:Boost Symbol - applies a multiplier of x2, x3, or x5 to adjacent Coins. Each multiplier acts independently of each other.Heart Symbol - awards an extra life, retriggering the feature when the free spins count goes to 0. After a life is awarded, the Heart turns into a random Coin.Collector Symbol - becomes the total value of all other Coin symbols that form part of a complete row. Collectors are also Coin symbols and cannot land if an entire row has not been completed.Completing a whole row with symbols resets the free drop count to 6. Completing 4 full rows activates an x2 multiplier, which increases as more rows are completed. The possible multiplier values are x2-x5, x8, x10, x15, and x20. When the free spins count reaches zero, and no extra lives have been awarded, the total of all Coin symbols in completed rows is awarded along with the highest achieved multiplier. When the grid has symbols in all available positions, the max win is awarded.Jaguar Drop slot - free spinsJaguar Drop: Slot VerdictJaguar Drop might start off fairly conventionally, that is, as a scatter wins slot with a basic base game covered in a Central/South American theme, albeit a pleasant-looking one. As an aside, the sound symbols make as they drop on the reels like bricks clinking together is particularly satisfying, too. And for a while, that's how it is. The base game is quite vanilla, though Jaguar Drop does have wild symbols, which are often omitted from scatter-paying slots, so it's a case of hacking away through regular spins on the hunt for a 6+ Coin bonus round trigger. The Push Bet came in handy here since, on an unofficial eyeball basis, the Free Drops round did seem to trigger quite often when it was switched on.Then you're in, and the Free Drops round brought back thoughts of previous Push Gaming slots like DJ Cat or DJ Fox with their Push-Up mechanic working its way up the reels and pulling in multipliers. There were also memory links to Nailed It! Games' climbing the reels slots Rome Supermatch or Grim Reaper Supermatch. Though to be clear, Jaguar Drop is by no means a copy of any of those games. Pushing the metaphor further, Jaguar Drop delivers a Tetris-type bonus round, except you don't want to clear symbols off the reels but rather grow them ever upwards, not only building a larger Coin win pot but accessing higher multipliers (when rows are complete) in the process. Make it all the way to the top, filling all positions, and the 10,000x max win payout is yours.According to the docs, Jaguar Drop is targeted at UK players, which would explain why it's so light on gambling options compared to a lot of Push Gaming slots. Bonus buys are gone, pre-feature gambles are non-existent, and so on. Jaguar Drop isn't exactly one of Push Gaming's genre-defining releases, but what it's got is a simple base game bolstered by a uniquely enjoyable bonus round."

title: Wild Portals Megaways

review: "May 25, 2022",8,"Wild Portals Megaways: Slot OverviewPlayers! Gear up for a bit of oontz-oontz in the futuristically funky Wild Portals Megaways from the device's own maker, Big Time Gaming. This is where The Final Countdown-esque free spins come into play since the Wild Portal is present on every spin, and its multiplier persists until the feature ends.If damage is going to be done, free spins are where it is most likely to occur, and the results when Wild Portals Megaways is firing can be staggering. Such is the potential power of having a big wild and even bigger multiplier on board.In some ways, Wild Portals Megaways is classic BTG. Fair dues, satisfying gaming can be found in Wild Portals Megaways; it just might take a bit of luck coupled with serious dedication to extract it."

title: Of Sabers and Monsters
structured_summary: Of Sabers and Monsters is a Cossack adventure-themed slot inspired by Yggdrasil's Vikings Go series. review: "August 25, 2022",7.5,"﻿Of Sabers and Monsters WildFight: Slot OverviewEvery culture has its heroes, hardy men and women who have stepped up, whether on purpose seeking glory or who have been thrust forward by circumstance. Four of them star in Yggdrasil's Of Sabers and Monsters, an online slot which sees the studio taking much of the good stuff from its Vikings Go range and shifting it over to a Cossack adventure-themed game. Don't get the impression this is a clone, however, as Yggdrasil has made one or two tweaks to the blueprint while equipping Of Sabers and Monsters with Hero Battles, Ardent Respins, free spins, Tempest Free Spins, Feather Symbol rewards, and bonus buy.Of Sabers and Monsters is set in an evocative scene of yellow fields, intriguing buildings, a crow, and swiftly flowing clouds. Trigger free spins, or buy them, and the action scrolls right to a new location, which is darker, spookier, more skullish, and is presumably where the monsters come from. There's a story to be told here, and it's too bad Yggdrasil didn't go into detail about it, but the rich audio-visuals do the theme justice, and players have plenty of inspiration to concoct a tale of their own if they need one.Of Sabers and Monsters slot - main gamePlayed on a 6-reel, 4-row game grid, one of the differences in Of Sabers and Monsters is that Yggdrasil has replaced the fixed paylines of the Vikings Go range with a 4,096 ways to win system. Wins occur when at least three matching symbols land in consecutive reels from the leftmost side at a theoretical frequency of 20.26%. Another theoretical value is RTP which has a highest value of 96%, though the game may come with three lower settings. Highly volatile, Of Sabers and Monsters is playable on any device, where stakes vary from 20 p/c to $/€50 per spin.Taking a look at the regular paying symbols, clubs, diamonds, hearts, and spades make up the low pays, all worth 0.5x the bet for five of a kind win, while four Heroes make up the four premium symbols, paying 1-1.5x the stake for a five-symbol winning way. Wilds are central to Of Sabers and Monsters, as you will see. One of the things they do is substitute for any regular pay symbols to help complete winning ways. Wilds can also turn sticky at certain moments, covered next.Of Sabers and Monsters WildFight: Slot FeaturesOf Sabers and Monsters slot - free spins gambleWhen a premium symbol win hits, it contributes Focus Points to the respective Focus Meter. There are four Focus Meters, each one connected to one of the four high pay Hero symbols. When the game starts, one of the Focus Meters is half filled with 50 points. When any of the meters is completely filled with 100 points, the Hero gets Arden Mode status and Ardent Respins are awarded.Ardent RespinsDuring Ardent Respins, when high pay symbols land on the middle 4 reels, they battle the Golden Monster. If the heroes win, they transform into Sticky Wilds. High-pay symbols that have full Focus Meters always win their battle and turn into Sticky Wilds. Respins come to an end when no new battles are won or if Sticky Wilds fill the reels. Ardent Respins are played with the average bet size used when points were collected.SkirmishShould any of the middle four reels fill with high pay symbols in the base game, a Skirmish is triggered. All high pay symbols on the middle four reels fight the Monster, and if they win, they become wild.Feather SymbolThe Feather Symbol only appears on the rightmost reel and awards a random prize when it lands. From the base game, this could be a 4-200x the bet cash prize, 8-20 regular free spins, or Tempest Free Spins. If a Feather hits in free spins, it awards a 4-200x the bet cash prize, 2-4 extra free spins, a random Wild Reel, or an extra wild. When a Feather lands in the Tempest Free Spins feature, it awards a 4-200x the bet cash prize or 2-4 additional free spins.Free SpinsGetting 3, 4, 5, or 6 scatter symbols awards 8, 12, 16, or 20 free spins, respectively. Before they begin, players can gamble to win more if they do not win 20. Successful gambles increase free spins to a higher amount, while unsuccessful gambles lose all of the free spins. Players enter free spins with one random extra. This could be one high pay symbol in Ardent mode, 1-2 extra free spins, a random Sticky Wild, a random Sticky Wild Reel, or extra Feathers on reel 6. In free spins, high pay symbols fight the Monster when they land on the middle four reels and transform into Sticky Wilds if they win their battle. Sticky Wilds remain on the reels for the duration of the feature.Tempest Free SpinsWhen triggered by the Feather Symbol, players win 8 Tempest Free Spins. In this bonus, all high-pay Hero symbols are in Ardent Mode, so they always win their fights and become Sticky Wilds. As before, Sticky Wilds remain on the reels for the duration of the feature. The bet value for this bonus round is the same as the triggering spin.Buy BonusPlayers can pick two buy bonus options if the opportunity is there. One is regular free spins for 80x the bet or Tempest Free Spins for 500x the stake.Of Sabers and Monsters slot - tempest free spinsOf Sabers and Monsters WildFight: Slot VerdictWhen they want to, the Yggdrasil team can certainly craft a pretty scene, and Of Sabers and Monsters is undoubtedly well crafted. Was Yggdrasil inspired by Foxium's Cossacks the Wild Hunt? We could be reaching here simply because the two games are based on Cossacks, but they both have exceptional production values and an excellent set of features to match. Yggdrasil did get a helping hand when making Of Sabers and Monsters, though, since much has been brought over from the Vikings Go range of slots. However, we're not complaining. The gameplay has a lot to commend about it and has made a seamless transition from the hardy Vikings to a group of battle-ready Cossacks.And Monsters, let's not forget those since they are critical to some of the game's best moments. That is, when Heroes defeat Monsters when they battle, then morph into Sticky Wilds. There are a number of instances when this can happen, such as in free spins, Ardent Respins, and Tempest Free Spins. If you're going to do it organically, then patience may well be required. High-pay Hero wins didn't happen super often during testing, so filling a Focus Meter might take time. Otherwise, free spins triggers or Feather awards are a possibility, as is buying a bonus round if doing so is an option.Of Sabers and Monsters was an entertaining slot very much in the same vein as the successful Vikings Go range. There aren't the random multipliers of Vikings Go Berzerk Reloaded, but with so many more ways to win, the results can potentially be impressive. Should the game go nutty, a maximum win of 18,350x the bet is technically possible. In short, for anyone looking for a rugged Viking slot alternative that packs a decent wallop, Of Sabers and Monsters could be worth a grapple."

title: Wings of Horus

review: "November 7, 2024",7,"Wings of Horus: Slot OverviewThe Egyptian deity Horus was associated with things like the sky, healing, and protection, so it's interesting that in Hacksaw Gaming's slot Wings of Horus, the Ancient Egyptian god is on a mission of vengeance. A revenge party if the game info is anything to go by, which not only sounds scary but also a bit out of character for such a malevolent god. Four RTP configurations have been designed to keep your eye out for, and the highest return figure is 96.33%, while the bet range is 10 c to $/€100.Instead of royals or card suits, Wings of Horus' lower paying symbols are the letters H, O, R, U, and S. They pay 0.3 to 0.5 times the bet for a 5-symbol winning combination. Next up are the 5 higher pays consisting of 5 themed connected symbols. Hit a 5 OAK winning way for them to collect 0.8 to 2 times the bet. Wilds appear in the game to substitute for any regular paying symbols. In the base game, though, wilds only appear through the Orb of the Moon and Orb of the Sun feature. A 5 wild win pays 3x the bet, and only 1 Orb may land per reel.Wings of Horus: Slot FeaturesWings of Horus slot - free spinsNestled within these wings are Orb of the Moon and Orb of the Sun symbols, which upgrade other symbols, a Sacred Scripture instant win, then 2 bonus rounds - Revenge of the Pharaoh and Rise of the Falcon. Last but not least are four bonus buys.Orb SymbolsOrb Of The Moon - When an Orb of the Moon symbol lands, it selects all instances of a random symbol on the reels. Next, it replaces all positions of the selected symbols and itself with a higher-value symbol or a wild.Orb Of The Sun - When an Orb of the Sun symbol lands, it selects all instances of 2 random symbols on the reels. Next, it replaces all positions of the selected symbols and itself with a higher-value symbol or a wild.Sacred ScriptureIf the low symbols land in formation to spell 'HORUS' horizontally, a cash payout of 500 times the bet is paid.Revenge Of The PharaohHitting at least 3 FS scatters in the base game triggers this feature with 10 free spins. Here, 2 progression bars are displayed beside the grid for the feature. The purple Orb progression starts at level 1. The golden progression bar increases when there is a new win on the grid. Each time the golden bar is completely filled, the purple Orb progression bar increases by 1 level. When the purple Orb progression bar has increased by 1, the golden progression bar is reset to 0.Before the final spin of the feature, the purple Orb progression bar activates. The number of levels that are filled in the purple Orb bar equates to the number of Orbs, either Moon or Sun, that land on the final spin. Up to 5 Orbs can land at the same time. Hitting 2 FS symbols grants +2 free spins, while hitting 3 FS symbols grants +4 free spins.Rise of the FalconWhen triggered by landing 4 FS scatters in the base game, 10 free spins are awarded. The rules are the same as Revenge of the Pharaoh, except the purple Orb profession bar starts at level 2.Bonus BuyClicking on the bonus buy button displays these four choices up on the screen: BonusHunt FeatureSpins (3x the bet) - each spin is 5 times more likely to trigger free spins, Orby FeatureSpins (50x the bet) - each spin lands at least 2 Orb of the Moon or Orb of the Sun symbols, Revenge of the Pharaoh (100x the bet), or Rise of the Falcon (250x the bet).Wings of Horus slot - free spinsWings of Horus: Slot VerdictLike its jackal-headed forebear, Wings of Horus is a rock-steady Ancient Egyptian slot that dwells at the darker end of the scale than the bright, cartoon-friendly, burning brazier in a stately temple affair these sorts of slots often are. Hacksaw Gaming excels at making gloomy, psychological thriller-type games that are just as likely to trigger a subconscious psychological frisson as an obvious visceral thrill - with a splash of neon thrown on top. As well as the games already mentioned, maybe check out Wanted Dead or a Wild, Itero, or Cash Crew if this presentation style tickles your fancy.On the gaming side of things, despite the reappearance of Orbs, Wings of Horus provides an alternative pathway to potential wins than Hand of Anubis did. Multipliers are out. Neither do they show up on Orbs nor at the bottom of the reels, as in the Underworld feature, which was a real doozy when it was blowing up. The main focus now is on transforming symbols and hopefully getting enough of the same type on screen to make the most of the huge 7,776 ways to win. It's a sweet feature, but one which took a little bit longer to click with than the multipliers from Hand of Anubis. One reason is that when multiple Orbs are on the screen, they may or may not interact with each other. As in, they can pick totally unrelated symbols to convert rather than guarantee stacking conversions on top of each other.However, it is possible for one Orb to upgrade one symbol type, followed by another Orb upgrading the just converted grouping. Then, it's a matter of brute force ways (hopefully) linking up a good number of matching symbols to turn out a chunky result, and when Wings of Horus is going gangbusters, it can produce payouts of 15,000x in any game phase. After viewing the package, Wings of Horus felt more one-dimensional than Hand of Anubis, lacking the older game's variety. However, it's a potentially explosive game nonetheless that can easily turn on a dime, if it wants to."

The triggering coins remain on the reels, but all other symbols vanish, and 3 spins are awarded. If the Link&Win is triggered from the base game, normal coins carry values of 2x to 15x, while Bronze, Silver, Gold, or Diamond coins are worth 20x, 100x, 500x, or 2,500x the bet, respectively.Free SpinsShould 3, 4, or 5 scatters symbols land, players collect a payout of 1x, 10x, or 100x the bet plus 15 free spins. During free spins, all wins are multiplied by x2. In addition, if the Link&Win is triggered from free spins, all coin symbols have their values doubled.Leprechaun Links: Slot VerdictThis might be early days, but after Game of Thrones Power Stacks, Links of Ra, and Leprechaun Links, it feels like Slingshot Studios has uncovered their raison d'être, which is creating Link&Win powered games. No issues with that necessarily, except they've all basically been the same slot. Game of Thrones Power Stacks set the bar quite high, though much of the enjoyment was due to the theme, particularly the excellent use of the show's soundtrack and familiar faces. Since then, Slingshot's subsequent Link&Wins have been clones. Using the same features dilutes desirability, and instead of the eye-catching Game of Thrones theme, we got commonplace Egyptian and Irish ones. Hardly an evolution, and since capturing GOT Power Stacks on the reels, it's been largely downhill.In a vacuum, Leprechaun Links isn't a bad option if you're after some Celtic infused streak respin gaming. Like Links of Ra, Leprechaun Links is also a sleek production, serving straightforward hold and win style gaming while boasting massive numbers. Jackpot-wise, the 5,000x Diamond award, if triggered from free spins, is something to shoot for, though the max win is claimed to be as high as 25,000x the bet. How someone might crack this is an interesting question – from multiple Diamond prizes, a colossal round of free spins, or maybe a combination of both is needed to get anywhere close.After playing Game of Thrones Power Stacks, then Links of Ra, then finding out Leprechaun Links offers the same features and stats, enthusiasm wasn't exactly running hot. Maybe it's three times the charm, and if there's a fourth, Slingshot will pick a more creative theme or tweak the gameplay to act in a different manner. It seems a little unlikely, as if Slingshot have stumbled upon an ideal formula to suit their needs. That's great for them, all they have to do from now on is shuffle the visuals, but for players who like an iota of originality in their games, Leprechaun Links will be as neutral as Links of Ra was. On the other hand, it functions fine, so players after a perfectly adequate hold and win game should be able to find thrills here, provided the Irish theme doesn't feel overdone."

title: The Choice Is Yours Megaways
structured_summary: The Choice Is Yours Megaways is a 1970s-inspired game show-themed slot offering a funky, disco vibe. It features a Megaways mechanic with up to 200,704 ways to win, mystery symbols, and free spins with selectable volatility levels. The reviewer found it enjoyable but somewhat generic and lacking deeper game show immersion. The aesthetics include a retro funk soundtrack and colorful visuals reminiscent of a vintage talent show stage.
review: "June 29, 2022",6,"The Choice is Yours Megaways: Slot OverviewIn this modern world, does it sometimes feel like we are bombarded with an ever-increasing number of choices? Never before have we had so many options when it comes to buying a car, choosing what to watch, picking holiday destinations, where to eat out, or which shampoo to wash our hair with. In some ways, this might be a consumer paradise. However, according to psychologist Barry Schwartz, when 'everything is possible' it leads to paralysis rather than freedom, and decreases satisfaction. It's good then that while Iron Dog Studios' online slot, The Choice is Yours Megaways offers certain choices, there aren't too many and mainly revolve around picking three volatility options in free spins.Though not explicitly stated, we're wondering if Iron Dog found inspiration for their game from an unsold 1970s game show pilot called 'The Choice is Yours', hosted by Bill Cullen. Of course, it could be a complete coincidence, fair enough. But the font used for the show and the game are kind of similar, and the slot has a vaguely 1970s feel to it, largely expressed through a funk disco number. Whatever the case, The Choice is Yours Megaways does have a game show vibe, like one of those talent programs where contestants strut their stuff on stage in front of judges who hit a buzzer to advance or deny the acts they like or dislike.Taking centre stage is a standard Megaways game grid of 6 reels holding 2-7 symbols each and a 4 symbol horizontal tracking reel. On each spin, this highly volatile game can produce anywhere from 324 to 200,704 ways to win. The average RTP value is 96% which may change depending on whether you play normally at 10 p/c to $/€50 per spin, or buy the bonus round, if available in your jurisdiction. Stats for the latter were not up at the time of review, though.Regular wins occur when at least two of the most valuable symbol type land left to right from the first reel, or at least three of any other pay symbol. When a winning way lands, it is destroyed and cleared from the grid in typical Megaways fashion. Symbols left on the reels tumble down to replace them, and if a new win forms, the tumble feature triggers again.. Starting from the less valuable end of the paytable are 10-A playing card icons, worth 0.4-0.5x the bet for six of a kind, followed by microphones, buzzers, two female characters, and a host. Landing a six of a kind win made up of the five higher value symbols triggers a payout of 1.5 to 20 times the stake. Lastly, wild symbols can appear on all but the first and last reels in the base or bonus round to substitute for any non-special symbol.The Choice is Yours Megaways: Slot FeaturesThe Choice is Yours Megaways has several features to look out for - mystery symbols, free spins with a volatility picker, and potentially a bonus buy.Mystery SymbolsIn the base game, mystery symbols can land on reels 2, 3, 4, 5, or 6 and transform into either wilds or pay symbols. In the base game, mystery symbols only land on the initial spin, not on tumbles.Free SpinsMoving from the main game to the bonus round occurs when 4 scatter symbols are in view on reels 2, 3, 4, and 5. When this happens, players get to choose one of three options for the bonus round, depending on their volatility preference – low, medium, or high. In all options, free spins have a win multiplier that increases by one following winning tumbles.In free spins, the mystery box can appear on all reels, except the top horizontal reel – on spins or tumbles. When mystery boxes hit, they reveal wilds, pay symbols, +2 to the win multiplier, or +2 free spins. If the mystery box lands on a reel holding 7 symbols, there is a chance it will lock that reel at 7 high for the rest of the feature. Another way of extending the bonus round is with the help of consecutive tumbles. A minimum of four consecutive tumbles are needed to win an extra +2 free spins.Buy Free SpinsHit the star in the upper right part of the screen, if it's there, to open the bonus buy menu. Here players can pay 85x the bet for 8 low, medium, of high volatile free spins. Or 128x the bet for 12 low volatile free spins, 164x the bet for 12 medium volatile free spins, or 168x the bet for 12 high volatile free spins. The 12 spin options come with Bonus Upgrader though no specific details are provided over what this entails.The Choice is Yours Megaways: Slot VerdictGame show to slot crossovers have tended to be highly successful, as the Deal or No Deal/Who Wants to Be a Millionaire franchises are a testament to. Admittedly, those slots are backed by massive tv shows, so they've got audiences ready-made to tap. The Choice is Yours Megaways, on the other hand, will likely struggle to attract as many players without a massive household name behind it. Where it also differs from DOND or Who Wants to Be a Millionaire is that it doesn’t really incorporate game show elements in its features. Players do get to choose volatility for free spins, but there's no hot seat or dealer situation as in the other games, so it’s a less immersive game show slot experience. It's funky and all, yet The Choice is Yours might have been more absorbing if Iron Dog had embedded a few stronger game show references.Having three volatility options for free spins is a nice touch, giving players some influence over the proceedings and justifying the game's title. It would have been nice if they'd explained what made one option more or less volatile than the others, though. Like slots that provide multi-choice bonus rounds of varying volatilities by awarding a different number of free spins and win multiplier. Here it's not obvious what the difference is, and extra clarity would have been appreciated. From an anecdotal perspective, it seemed there were more mystery boxes in the high volatile option, but we got better returns from the low volatile one. Of course, studios calculate these things after running millions and billions of simulated spins, so these are just observations we came up with during test runs. Whatever choice players select, the win cap appears to remain a sizeable 20,000x the bet.All in all, The Choice is Yours Megaways was a fairly enjoyable if unexceptional game. Its positive aspects include a bubbly atmosphere, free spins volatility options, and a decent win cap. It does feel a little generic without major branding behind it, so let's see if The Choice is Yours Megaways performs the online slot version of making it past the pilot stage or remaining unsold like its 70s game show namesake."

title: Tales of Asgard Loki's Fortune
structured_summary: Tales of Asgard Loki's Fortune centers on Loki's mythological mischief as he tries to thwart Thor's coronation in a tasteful Asgardian throne room setting. review: 0.10/100,"October 28, 2021",7.5,"Tales of Asgard Loki's Fortune: Slot OverviewIt was just the other day while reviewing Lucksome's Loki Lord of Mischief that we were ruminating on the lack of Loki themed slots. Sure, the so-called trickster god pops up in supporting roles in games where the focus is on Thor or Odin, but rarely is Loki the main character. Now fans of less predictable deities have another slot with Loki in the lead. This one from Play'n GO is called Tales of Asgard Loki's Fortune and features splitting symbols to create up to 100,000 ways to win, Loki's Mischief modifiers, and free spins, all capped off with some sizeable rewards.The game is set in Loki's throne room, which is surprisingly tasteful. Loki might be keen on creating a bit of mischief for other people, particularly his extended family members, yet he clearly has a well-balanced eye for interior design. Taking up most of the space is a 5x5, 3,125 ways game grid, while around it are subdued, beige coloured support pillars, angular walling, spiralling decorations, and presiding over things on the right is Loki himself, staff in hand sitting on his throne. According to the game's story, Loki isn't too pleased. Thor is about to be crowned the King of Asgard, but Loki is prepared to use every trick he can muster to stop that from happening. You have to feel for Loki a bit. He's regularly set up like Wile E Coyote chasing Road Runner in his attempts to thwart Thor. We know it's just not going to happen, no matter how many times he tries.Playable on desktop, tablet or mobile device, Tales of Asgard Loki's Fortune allows stakes of 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin to be set. The theoretical return value is Play'n GO's go-to figure of 96.2%, yet this is configurable, so the game may be set to less generous levels. Potential is high, though some may debate the likelihood of seeing it ever struck, while volatility is also fairly high, rated 8 out of 10.The symbols used in Tales of Asgard Loki's Fortune are just as mutedly tasteful as the rest of the throne room and consist of 10 paying tiles, a wild, a scatter, and mystery symbols. Amongst the paying symbols are four runic inscribed low pays, then ravens, wolves, horses, and serpents as the mid pays. The most valuable are the high pay Thor and Odin symbols which are worth 1-2x the bet for a five of a kind combination. Loki is wild, appearing anywhere to substitute for any paying symbol. Loki wilds payout too if five land across the grid, the value is 2x the bet.Tales of Asgard Loki's Fortune: Slot FeaturesThe game's look and features give it a faint cluster pay/grid slot feel, but it doesn't play out like that at all. Instead, Tales of Asgard Loki's Fortune is all about splitting mystery symbols to ramp up ways to win, alongside Loki's Mischief modifiers and free spins.Mystery SymbolsOne critical element in all this is the mystery symbol. Mystery symbols land in any position, and initially, they are inactive blocker tiles. However, if a wild symbol also lands, then mystery symbols are converted into the same paying symbol type.There are 2 kinds of mystery symbols – one converts into a single pay symbol, the other is a split mystery symbol which converts into 2 pay symbols. If a full screen of mystery symbols land, they all reveal themselves without needing a wild in view. Split symbols increase ways to win, up to a maximum of 100,000.Loki's Mischief ModifiersOn any spin, Loki's Mischief may randomly trigger, awarded one of 3 modifiers:Adding Wilds – Loki creates an illusion of himself adding 1-3 wilds to the reels.Adding Scatters – Loki throws 2 emerald scatters symbols onto the reels, increasing the chance of triggering free spins.Splits Mystery Symbols – Loki throws daggers onto the reels, splitting all mystery symbols.Free SpinsLanding 3, 4, or 5 emerald scatter symbols triggers the bonus game, awarding 8, 12, or 20 free spins, respectively. More wilds and mystery symbols appear during free spins, but the scatter symbol is removed so the feature cannot be retriggered.Tales of Asgard Loki's Fortune: Slot VerdictPlay'n GO do paint a pretty mythological picture and have starred Norse Gods in a number of their slots by now. As well as heavyweights like Thor, we've also had less common figures such as Freya in The Faces of Freya, now Loki gets to star in his own slot. Play'n GO has loads of experience making these sorts of games, and it shows. Tales of Asgard Loki's Fortune is another tight production that looks the part while being loaded with interesting features.Free spins might be a teensy bit disappointing at first since nothing new really happens. However, finding glory in Tales of Asgard Loki's Fortune is tied to its split mystery symbols, which open up reels to increase the paying ability of regular symbols. On their own, pay symbols, even premiums, aren't worth a king's ransom, so landing them in great numbers in conjunction with as many expanded ways is, literally, the way. Since free spins bolster the occurrence of wilds and mystery symbols, that's where the best chance lies. Possibly upping the difficulty factor, the bonus game is not retriggerable, nor is it possible to pick up any additional free spins, so here's hoping Loki is in a benevolent mood when they are active. Get it right, and the game advertises wins as high as 20,000 times the bet - in theory, at least.As mentioned, Play'n GO has built up an impressive collection of Norse Mythology slots, and Tales of Asgard Loki's Fortune holds its head up high amongst them although it could be considered more a shelf filler rather than a title that pushes this particular genre of slots forward. It has a pleasing look, decent features, an interesting character, and impressive winning opportunities, so it is difficult to fault."

title: Golden Dragons
structured_summary: Golden Dragons is an Asian-themed slot featuring dragon wilds and traditional motifs. review: 2023",5.5,"Hammertime is an up-and-coming software provider from South Africa which has hooked up with one of the most well-established outfits in the online slot biz, Games Global (formerly known as Microgaming). Time to ride the dragon?Some Asian-themed slots are held in a richly designed setting full of things like mountains, pagodas, and sweeping natural settings; others, like Golden Dragons, are much plainer. Golden Dragons has a crimson background covered in simple line-drawn patterns, a traditional soundtrack, and that's about it for ambience. Having seen this style used before on multiple occasions and Golden Dragons bringing nothing overly new to the table in terms of base game audio-visuals, the initial impression did lean toward boringly plain.Golden Dragons slot - base gameBehind the Asian-inspired outer parts lies Golden Dragons' beating mathematical heart. This is a game that is available in four return to player configurations from a high of 96% to a low of 86.89%, and two settings in between. On the 96% version, the math model is highly volatile and spits out a hit rate of 32.87%, so roughly 1 in 3 spins produces a win. Bet levels vary from 30 p/c to $/€42 per spin, whilst the game is played on a grid matrix with 5 reels and 3 rows of symbols.Along the grid, players are provided with 243 ways to land winning combinations of 3 to 5-of-a-kind. Wins begin from the leftmost reel and pay left to right on adjacent reels. Low pays include 9 to A playing card royals, worth around 3.33 to 6.67 times the bet, while the high pays are 2 lion statues, a turtle statue, and a box of treasure, awarding 10 to approximately 26.67 times the bet. A dragon appears on the base game wild, present on all reels. Wilds substitute for any pay symbol and are worth up to 40x the bet when 5 wilds create a winning line. Wild symbols in free spin also award random wild multipliers.Golden Dragons: Slot FeaturesGolden Dragons slot - free spins optionsHammertime has padded out Golden Dragons' base game with a bonus scatter feature, while its main event is a free spins round where players pick 1 of 5 options.Bonus ScatterThe red envelope symbol is the bonus scatter, present on reels 1 and 5. When red envelopes hit on both reels in the base game, a cash prize of up to 88 times the bet is awarded.Free SpinsThe gold sycee scatter may land on any of the reels. Landing 3, 4, or 5 of these scatter symbols awards 5, 10, or 50 times the bet, respectively, as well as triggering the free spins bonus round. Once triggered, players pick their preferred choice to play out:18 free spins with x2 to x5 wild multipliers.12 free spins with x3 to x6 wild multipliers.10 free spins with x3 to x8 wild multipliers.8 free spins with x5 to x10 wild multipliers.5 free spins with x8 to x18 wild multipliers.All of the free spins bonus round features can be retriggered.Golden Dragons slot - free spinsGolden Dragons: Slot VerdictIf someone is new to the Asian sector of the online slot market, then Golden Dragons might appear quite exotically alluring. The dragon wilds look neat, all 6 of them, the music sets a mood, and the visuals, while not especially intricately designed, evoke the theme quite well. On the other hand, players who have seen their fair share of Asian-themed slots might find Golden Dragons, well, kinda boring. Aside from some of the symbols, the artwork, in general, is unimaginatively generic, and the background feels like a copyright-free PNG file that's popped up in numerous Asian-themed slots to make players feel like they're gambling in a swanky Macau club.Golden Dragons' gameplay is a little plain as well. The base game benefits from the 243 ways pay system, and the instant cash prize feature is there, occasionally slinging out a few coins. The latter feature gave Hammertime to throw in a few extra number '8s' as well, which is a highly favourable number in games like this since it is the luckiest number in Chinese culture and all. Free spins are capable of picking up the pace since that's where wilds get those multipliers, and being able to choose the number of free spins as well as the possible multiplier values is a nice touch. Although, the multi-choice free spins/multiplier idea in an Asian slot isn't new either, having been seen before, such as in the classic game Eastern Emeralds and its follow-up release Eastern Emerald Megaways.Here, the system is good for wins of up to 5,230x the bet, which is hard to complain too loudly about but is totally eclipsed by the two Quickspin slots if you're looking for a game like Golden Dragons with a bit of extra oomph. After all that, Golden Dragons was an okay game, custom-made for a specific audience. Like a decent pub band doing a cover song, Golden Dragons hits a certain spot, but it's far from being a deeply original experience which rocks audiences with freaky originality."

During free spins, the win multiplier increases by +1 after each cascade win, and landing 3 or 4 scatters on the tracker reel awards an extra 5 or 10 free spins, respectively.Buy BonusFrom the buy bonus, it is possible to buy 8, 12, 19, or 27 free spins for 32x, 70x, 175x, or 350x the bet, respectively. The multiplier starts at x1 for all four options. After buying free spins, players have access to the 3 gamble wheels they would have if the feature triggered naturally.Bison Rising Rising Reloaded Megaways slot - free spinsBison Rising Reloaded Megaways: Slot VerdictJust like Vikings Unleashed Reloaded, for a lot of the time, Bison Rising Reloaded Megaways is not much different to the older, non-Reloaded version. However, for gamblers who are looking to push their luck for the chance to jack a free spins round, then Bison Rising Reloaded Megaways' pre-feature gambles are able to provide frustration and possible glory like few other games can.Users do have some control over the risk/reward levels since there are options when deciding what to shoot for. Potentially wallet-busting as well, and speaking of potential, Bison Rising Reloaded Megaways' max win is capped at 25,000x.Engaging in pre-feature gambles is entirely optional, but they're also Bison Rising Reloaded Megaways' whole point of being, really. So, for the chance to engage in some more Reloaded heroics, or attempt to at least, Bison Rising Reloaded Megaways provides a buffalo-infused non-Viking alternative with all the same cautions."

review: "October 20, 2023",7,"The Sorcerers Shuffle: Slot OverviewWould it be neat if you could wiggle your hands in a mysterious way, chant certain words, or mix the right concoction of ingredients to accomplish things that defy the scientific laws of nature - in other words, perform magic? Obviously, there are bigger, punchier slots in Relax Gaming's repertoire, and while The Sorcerers Shuffle isn't one of the studio's major standout titles, it is technically capable of producing flourishes of illusion and moments of magic."

title: Cash Quest
structured_summary: Cash Quest is a fantasy-themed grid slot set in a magical forest with swords, skulls, and treasure. It features cluster pays, cascades, a unique Boostbar with modifiers, and free spins, plus a bonus buy option. The reviewer finds it a solid, enjoyable slot with frequent free spins and rewarding gameplay, though less distinctive than some Hacksaw titles. The game sports a low-key visual style with a cheerful medieval soundtrack and popping sound effects.
review: 2021",7,"Cash Quest: Slot OverviewHear the word 'quest' in other entertainment forms, and protagonists are often chasing grails, philosopher's stones, or healing the land from evil. In slots, quests are generally better suited to money motivated individuals. A prime example is Cash Quest, a fantasy-themed game from grid slot experts Hacksaw Gaming. In this one, players are transported to a sword and magic type world on a quest to collect cash, utilising such features as cluster pays, cascades, a trademarked multi-modifying Boostbar, and free spins.In Hacksaw's words, Cash Quest is a 'magnificent adventure game set in a magical forest with swords, skulls and great treasure…' That nicely sums up the view greeting players when they load the game. The studio hasn't gone overboard with the visuals, nor have they been as stylistically individual as they often are, think of games like Toshi Video Club, for example. Instead, they've kept Cash Quest refreshingly low key. A jolly middle ages inspired soundtrack is accompanied by cheerful popping sounds as symbols land to get players in a questing mood.Played on a 6 row by 6 column game grid, winning clusters are created when at least 5 identical symbols land connecting vertically or horizontally. Wins are removed by the cascade feature, filling spaces with new symbols, and continuing until no new wins hit. Mathematically, Cash Quest is a medium volatile adventure, while the RTP comes in two forms. One is when playing the game naturally at 96.32%; the other is when buying free spins, which nudges it up ever so slightly to 96.36%.Playable from 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin, 10 cute sprites appear on the table as the game's paying symbols. From low to high are bones, skulls, boots, meat, shields, bottles, gold tokens, swords, dragons, and gold jewellery. Clusters top out at 26+ symbols, and values for landing this number vary from 15 to 25 times your stake. A blue stone 'W' is the wild symbol, landing in any position on the board to substitute all other symbols except the free spins icon.Cash Quest: Slot FeaturesCash Quest uses something called a Boostbar to inject various modifiers onto the game panel. This feature is available in the base game and when free spins have been triggered.BoostbarWhen the 'BB' book symbol appears on the reels, it triggers the Boostbar feature. Above the grid, the game's logo moves out of the way to reveal 4 special modifier symbols on the Boostbar:Blocking Stones – these are like dead symbols that take up space on the Boostbar.Magic Lantern – this symbol leaps onto the board and clears all symbols from it, allowing new ones to drop in.Splitter Symbols – these can be any of the paying symbols with a green number on them from 5 to 30. When triggered, the respective number of symbols leap onto the grid.Wilds – 5 to 30 wild symbols are added onto the game board.Symbol Multipliers – this can be added to any pay symbol. A multiplier between x2 to x30 is displayed in the top right corner. If a matching symbol cluster hits, its value is multiplied by the applicable number.Global Multipliers – these are values of x2 to x100, which are applied to all wins occurring in the current game round. If there is more than one Global Multiplier in view, the values are added together before being applied.Cash Quest - free spinsFree SpinsLanding 3 scatter symbols in the base game awards 10 free spins. There are more Boostbar activator symbols in free spins than in the main game, though the round cannot be retriggered. Also, there are slight changes to the values awarded from the various Boostbar modifiers.Feature BuyIf buying the bonus round is a possibility, then 10 free spins can be bought for 119 times the total bet. Doing so instantly triggers the free spins round and increases the RTP from 96.32% to 96.36% for the round.Cash Quest: Slot VerdictWhile Cash Quest isn't one of those Hacksaw games that really gets under your skin, it's a successful grid slot by most measures. If any studio has their grid slot production line running red hot, it's these guys. Hacksaw's formula has been well-honed after several excellent releases, and Cash Quest is another good example of the team's ability to meld graphics, sounds, features with their own playable x-factor. Hacksaw slots make it easy to keep hitting the play button, and while Cash Quest might not be the most compelling slot the studio has done, it's still easy to justify having one more spin.It's too bad Hacksaw doesn't provide information like bonus game frequency, thereby making comparisons between games easier. Anecdotally, one of the nice things about Cash Quest was that it seemed to trigger free spins organically more often than some others the studio has released. Let's not point any fingers here, yet certain Hacksaw bonus games have been tricky to trigger in the past, making them arguably better suited to bonus buy players. Cash Quest was not quite so challenging by comparison. In addition, the same Boostbar features appearing in free spins appear in the base game as well, albeit at a lower frequency.Most probably, it's the Boostbar that will lead to Cash Quest's best moments. This isn't one of those Hacksaw games where you steadily construct a multiplier or collect wilds, then blast them on the screen amidst a build-up of tense expectation. Instead, big wins come from throwing out a large number of high pay symbols or popping a multiplier or two. All spur of the moment stuff which can drop from nowhere. One benefit is this can happen at any moment, no matter what phase you are in. Get on a good run, and Cash Quest offers rewards of up to 7,500x the bet.To sum up, Cash Quest is another rock-solid grid slot from Hacksaw Gaming. It might not haunt your dreams like their heavyweighs, but Cash Quest's pleasant presentation, features, and potential rewards make it as playable as any other."

title: Arcane Reel Chaos
structured_summary: Arcane Reel Chaos is a dark superhero-themed slot featuring a team of unique metahumans battling a villain in a ruined cathedral setting. review: 7,"Arcane Reel Chaos (NetEnt): ReviewThe city is under attack from a supervillain and it's up to our group of mysterious metahumans to stop him. Fundamentally, Arcane Reel Chaos may have a cliché superhero narrative, but the characters are anything but classic superheroes. Here, you'll join our peculiar band of hero mutants, better known as Psyop, Flare, Zero.x and Chronos, in the battle against evil nemesis Deep Pockets. This marks NetEnt's second superhero-themed slot in little over a month, although Arcane Reel Chaos is a much darker and more grown-up story compared to the childish looking Disney-inspired Wild Worlds.Despite its stylish and complex looks, the slot comes with a basic 5-reel, 3-row and 20-payline setup that is as predictable as the superhero plot. Playable from on all devices from 20 cents to 200 Euros per spin you'll benefit from a set of randomly triggered mini-features in the base game where the heroes will appear to grant you Overlay Wilds, Stacked Wilds, Multipliers and Respins that can boost your wins with multipliers up to 10x. Designed to deliver a more streamlined, simple way to play, the new interface will be fully implemented into all new games later in the year. Going forward, the paytable will now be displayed in cash value instead of the more confusing coin value (although the option to play with coins will remain), a welcome change and one we hope will spread to all providers.The excellent visual design should come as no surprise if you know NetEnt. Set within the ruins of an old cathedral (which is almost uncanny knowing there's a fire raging at iconic cathedral Notre-Dame as we write this), you'll see A, K, Q, J and 10 royal values as well as the 4 previously mentioned superheroes. It is the nefarious Deep Pockets that is the most rewarding, however. Land 5 of him on a full payline and you will get 50 times your stake. Included in the symbol set is also a wild which performs the usual duties of substituting all symbols bar the scatter.Arcane Reel Chaos (NetEnt): FeaturesFree spins featureOn any spin the base game, the superheroes can appear at random to bring their superpowers to the reels. With each feature being based on one of the superheroes, here's what you can expect:Psyop (Super Power: Stacked Wilds) - can give you between 2 and 3 fully stacked wild reels.Zero.x (Super Power: Overlay Wilds) - when zero.x appears you can look forward to 3 to 5 wilds randomly placed on the reels.Flare (Super Power: Multiplier) - this strong woman will boost your wins by x3, x4 or x5.Chrono (Super Power: Respin) - only appears following a non-winning spin. All reels will respin, continuing to do so until a winning combination occurs. With each respin, a multiplier meter increases by 1 up to a maximum of x10.The battle against Deep Pockets culminates in the Free Spins bonus which is activated when you land 3 scatter symbols on reels 1, 3 and 5 simultaneously. Here, you'll take him on in up to 4 different levels accordingly:Level 1 - the villain has 2 health points + a x1 multiplierLevel 2 - the villain has 4 health points + a x2 multiplierLevel 3 - the villain has 5 health points + a x3 multiplierLevel 4 - the villain has 6 health points + a x4 multiplierIf you pass the final level, you'll be awarded an additional prize known as the Victory Bonus.Arcane Reel Chaos (NetEnt): VerdictSurprisingly, the biggest potential here is found in the base game and not in the free spin feature which is otherwise typically the case. While most features are quite mediocre in terms of payouts (around 500x), the most powerful one is found in Chrono's Respin feature where you can achieve wins of up to 1212.5 times your stake.We like the narrative here and the well-developed characters. Design-wise, it's exquisitely crafted and rich in features, coming together elegantly to convey the story. Admittedly, we're a little bit disappointed with the relatively low potential, but seeing as the random features tend to activate quite frequently, it's possible NetEnt's plan here was to make it a more balanced game by distributing the wins more evenly.Also worth noting is that the mechanics at play are suspiciously similar to South Park Reel Chaos, an old NetEnt title that has been pulled from the market. In other words, it's not unlikely that NetEnt has found new use for an expired game."

title: King of Samba
structured_summary: King of Samba is a carnival-themed slot set amidst vibrant Rio street scenes, capturing the lively spirit of Carnival. It features a 3x3 grid with 5 paylines, Walking Wilds with additive multipliers up to x20, and a special Wild Spree mode that can fill the reels with high-value wilds. review: 2025",5,"King of Samba: Slot OverviewOnce upon a time, you could practically set your watch by developer AvatarUX's reliability. Each and every new release seemed to be a PopWins device of some description as the studio rode its successful slot formula hard. Those days are over because while the studio still releases PopWins slots, it has branched out far and wide. A perfect example of the experimental spirit pervading AvatarUX HQ is King of Samba, which replaces big, expanding grids, masses of ways to win, eye-grabbing potential, and popping for something smaller and more limited in ability.Vibe is one of King of Samba's main selling points, and it does this quite well. After each spin, Walking Wilds drop by 1 position until they disappear from the reels. Walking Wilds can appear with a multiplier of up to x20, and multipliers are additive if more than one is part of the same payline.Wild SpreeAt random, a spin may contain 9 Walking Wilds, each wild having a multiplier of x2 or higher.King of Samba slot - Wild Spree featureKing of Samba: Slot VerdictAvatarUX continues to smash expectations, leading players in directions the studio was not really traversing down not that long ago. Is the studio exceeding expectations on these journeys? Oftentimes, yes, but with King of Samba, for gamblers thrilled by slots which pile on extra rows, provide a ton of ways to win, and dangle bags of winning potential, in other words, what AvatarUX usually produces, then probably not. King of Samba is for a different kind of punter or gambling mood altogether. It's a game almost as concerned with style as it is with substance, as it sets up an energetic partying scene while its gameplay doesn't go much further than that.Of the actual gameplay, there aren't a lot of things to say. Wild symbols with additive multiplier values offer a leg up in any game, and in King of Samba, they're about all it has to boost the normal run of things. One pinnacle moment would be the jackpot-like occurrence of the Wild Spree feature. It's something for those who play the game to cross their fingers for, at least. title: Magawa VS Mines
structured_summary: Magawa VS Mines is a slot themed around Magawa, a heroic landmine-detecting rat, set in Cambodia's lush countryside. review: 2024",5,"Magawa vs Mines: Slot OverviewIf you were under the impression rats were nothing but pests that steal food and spread disease, it might be time to reassess this thought process. Rats are actually quite clever, and if you need proof to sway your opinion, look no further than Magawa, a giant African pouched rat who won a PDSA Gold Medal for discovering 39 landmines and 28 bits of unexploded ordnance. Magawa was trained by APOPO, an organisation which trains animals to detect landmines and tuberculosis. Rats like Magawa can clear an area the size of a tennis court in half an hour, a deed that would take a human 4 days. Such heroics have not just been recognised by medals and presentations. No, no, this brave rodent has also been honoured by Relax Gaming partner Slammer Studios, a newcomer on the scene, in the online slot Magawa vs Mines.Magawa worked in Cambodia, a country that saw 4 to 6 million landmines laid between 1975 and 1998, causing over 64,000 casualties. Many still remain, making Cambodia one of the most heavily affected countries in the world in terms of landmines and unexploded bombs. It also has a very lush, mysterious countryside, of which Magawa vs Mines has neatly recreated in miniature. In the middle of a grassy clearing is the game's 7x7 grid matrix, bordered by bush and destination-worthy stonework such as giant heads and tree root-wadded structures. Slammer Studios has laid on quite an inviting scene actually, nicely detailed, almost video game-ish. However, the big band 1930s crime spree tune in the base game or the free spins' 1980s German S&M club track didn't feel like they really fit, though music appreciation is in the ear of the beholder.Magawa VS Mines slot - base gameTo accompany Magawa on the hunt for explosives, participants select a stake of 10 c to $/€50 per spin and decide whether or not to activate the ante bet. With the ante bet on, the stake increases by 50%, and the chance of triggering free spins increases by more than 300%. Mathematically highly volatile, Magawa vs Mines is a cluster pays slot, making wins when 5 or more matching symbols are connected in horizontal or vertical adjacent positions. Winning symbols (not wilds) are removed and replaced by a cascade mechanic, while the default RTP comes in at 95.98%, though this changes when buying features or using the ante bet.Slanty rocks with clubs, diamonds, hearts, and spades on them are Magawa vs Mines' 4 low pay symbols, while the 4 highs are cutters, goggles, a tech device, and a PDSA medal. Clusters consisting of 5 to 7 matching symbols pay 0.2 to 2 times the bet, increasing to 100 to 1,000 times the bet for a 40-49 OAK cluster. One or more Magawa Wilds land on every spin. Magawa Wilds substitute for all of the pay symbols, and they do not cascade when part of a win.Magawa vs Mines: Slot FeaturesMagawa VS Mines slot - free spinsWiggling your way to wins in Magawa vs Mines is assisted by Mystery Mine symbols, mystery symbol reveals, a Rat Run feature, Random Mines, Second Chances, free spins, and bonus buys.FeaturesMystery Mines - Mystery Mine symbols are triggered by the Rat Run or by adjacent winning combinations. Mystery Mines place mystery symbols in adjacent areas on the reels when triggered. Mystery symbols all reveal the same symbol.Rat Run - Landing a Magawa Wild and a Mystery Mine on the reels triggers the Rat Run. The Magawa Wild runs to the nearest Mystery Mine leaving mystery symbols on its path, defusing it, causing the Mystery Mine to place more mystery symbols in adjacent positions on the reels. Landing 2 or more Magawa Wilds with Mystery Mines creates a multiplier equivalent to the number of landed Magawa Wilds.Random Mines - When a win from the Rat Run or a general winning combination occurs, the Random Mine feature may trigger. When it does, the Random Mine feature reveals additional Mystery Mines on the grid.Second ChanceScatter symbols are present on all reels. The second chance randomly triggers when 2 scatter symbols land on a non-winning spin. The second chance creates new spaces on the reels for an additional chance of getting scatters, Mystery Mines, Magawa Wilds, and winning combinations.Free SpinsHitting 3 scatters awards 8 free spins. During free spins, all Mystery Mines possess multipliers with values of x2 to x10. Multipliers are additive, and additional Multipliers can land as part of the same sequence. Scatters are collected in free spins. For every 3 scatters collected, a low pay symbol is removed from the Mystery Mine and Rat Run reveals, plus 3 extra free spins are granted.Bonus BuyMagawa vs Mines comes with a bunch of buy options that include: 65x the bet for 8 free spins with 0 symbols removed, 105x the bet for 11 free spins with 1 symbol removed, 185x the bet for 14 free spins with 2 symbols removed, 255x the bet for 17 free spins with 3 symbols removed, or 310x the bet for 20 free spins with 4 symbols removed.Magawa VS Mines slot - free spinsMagawa vs Mines: Slot VerdictFirstly, it's generally a positive when a slot maker uses a theme that you have never encountered before. So it was with Magawa vs Mines, causing a hunt through the Interwebs to find out who or what this Magawa might be. And what do you know, Magawa is a real thing, a rat who proves the saying 'not all heroes wear capes.' On account of Magawa's deeds, there was fervent hope that the slot Slammer Studios had placed the mine-detecting rodent in would be a good one. After a run-through, Magawa vs Mines delivered flashes of entertainment, but it wasn't without one or two fleas.On the less exciting side, whilst wins and free spins triggers were fairly frequent, rarely, if ever, did they feel like they were on the verge of blasting somewhere significant. Rat Run wins are an interesting proposition, though, since when Magawa runs to those Mystery Mines, mystery symbols are placed on his path and at adjacent positions to the Mystery Mine. In the base game, if you're lucky, more than one Magawa Wild symbol hits at the same time as a Mystery Mine because, in that case, a multiplier is injected. Or, scurry into free spins where all Mystery Mine symbols display multipliers. These will be useful since the bulk of mystery symbol reveals were of the lower payout variety. One thing to look forward to is collecting scatters in free spins in order to cut down on those pesky low-pay symbols. Well, low-pay symbols still land; it's just they aren't revealed by mystery symbols.One of Magawa vs Mines' big surprises is that despite giving off low win vibes, it's actually got a cap of 20,000x the bet, so somewhere in there, theoretically, a massive spin, maybe more, lurks, like a deviously hidden landmine. To sum up, Magawa vs Mines is a charming game with a heart-warming storyline, but it is one that might just as easily end in frustration as in triumph."

title: Legacy of Oz
structured_summary: Legacy of Oz is a Wizard of Oz-themed slot that revisits the classic story with a familiar yet refreshed approach. review: 2021",7.5,"Legacy of Oz Hyperspins: Slot OverviewYou'd be forgiven for thinking Microgaming partner Triple Edge Studios has been scooped up by a tornado and deposited in a new world, such is their interest in all things Oz related. Landing a full line of high pay symbols rewards players with a payout worth 60 to 500 times their stake.Legacy of Oz Hyperspins: Slot FeaturesLegacy of Oz - free spinsBack when Book of Oz was released, Triple Edge hadn't coined the term 'Hyperspins' yet. The same concept was used, but then it was simply called a 'Respin feature', though it did the exact same thing. As well as Hyperspins, players benefit from free spins where chosen symbols expand, and retriggers add additional expanding symbols to the round.Say you hit the spin button, and 4 wizards land on reels 2, 3, 4, or 5. Wouldn't it have been so much better if the 5th symbol one had landed on the first reel? With Hyperspins, you can spin individual reels rather than all five. Cost depends on a host of factors, such as what potential outcomes could be, and they do get pricey. It is possible to be sitting on 2 scatters and repeatedly respin a reel until the third one hits. If you change bets between spins, the Hyperspin will automatically change the cost to reflect the different stake level. Also, Hyperspins are only available in the base game.When 3 or more scatter symbols land, the bonus game is activated. Landing 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols awards 8, 12, or 20 free spins, respectively. Before they start spinning, one symbol is randomly selected from a book to be a special expanding symbol, given a yellow brick road background. In free spins, special symbols expand to cover their reels after normal wins have been awarded. Special symbols only expand when a win can be completed, though it helps that they pay from any reel, do not need to be adjacent, or start at the first reel. Expanded symbols pay all lines.Landing 2, 3, 4, or 5 book scatters during the bonus round retriggers 4, 8, 12, or 20 free spins, respectively. In addition, whenever a retrigger occurs, another symbol is selected to be a special symbol, as seen in games like Legacy of Dead. It is possible to have multiple special symbols active at once, and they pay one at a time if more than one win is present on the reels.Legacy of Oz Hyperspins: Slot VerdictLegacy of Oz's core gaming is what you expect from a regular 'book of' game; Triple Edge wasn't quite brave enough to really get stuck in and make changes, which is understandable. Tearing up the 'Ra' rulebook can be tantamount to living on the slots devolvement edge. Instead, they've made a few additions around the edges so as not to go completely against the grain. Yet, while no one part of Legacy of Oz is particularly new, the experience as a whole offers a degree of originality. review: "August 2, 2023",7.5,"Megaways of Rock: Slot OverviewAre you ready to rock? I said, are you ready to rock? No, no, no, we want to hear the wallflowers down the back this time. Megaways of Rock's tunes are actually pretty rocking. Since this isn't a branded slot, the sounds naturally lean to the generic side, but they've got enough verve to get a toe or two tapping. The reason why is Megaways of Rock packs a lot of totally standard features such as mystery symbols, free spins with a rising multiplier and so forth. However, there are also a few new bits. Here's how it goes.Mystery SymbolsMystery symbols can appear in any position. When they land, all mystery symbols in view reveal a matching random symbol, though not scatters or wilds.Free SpinsLanding 4 or more scatter symbols triggers the free spins feature. Before it begins, a wheel spins to guarantee a minimum number of free spins and a starting win multiplier. The number of triggering scatters dictates the options available on the wheel - 4, 5, 6, or 7 scatters award up to 10, 20, 25, or 30 free spins, respectively. The second option costs 100x the bet for a wheel to spin to award free spins and a starting win multiplier.Megaways of Rock slot - free spinsMegaways of Rock: Slot VerdictOne of the dangers of doing a generic music-themed slot is that you run the risk of ending up corporately soulless. It's not for nought a provider like Play'n GO stumps up the resources to join forces with big-name artists when designing its range of branded music slots – Lordi, Testament, Twisted Sister, Def Leppard, shoot even Kiss, one of the biggest bands of all time has had the treatment. It makes a colossal difference as well. Where branded slots have the added oomph of beloved soundtracks driving them, a game like Megaways of Rock has music hovering somewhere between 'actually not bad' and an out-of-the-box Garage Band backing track. It doesn't help Megaways of Rock's cause that many of its features are so common.We're talking about pretty much as bog standard a list as it gets here – cascades, mystery symbols, and free spins with a rising multiplier. This stuff has been done since the dawn of Megaways, and by now, this combo feels about as fresh as that mouldy condiment lurking at the back of the fridge you've been meaning to throw out since you moved in. Technically Megaways of Rock functions well, and the theme, while about as own brand as it gets, has been done to a high standard. As far as music slots go, however, this feels closer to a decent warm-up act other than a festival headliner. To sum things up - it's possible three years ago this type of slot would have scored a solid 8, but times have changed and expectations are a higher."

review: "February 28, 2023",7.5,"Buffalo Mania Megaways: Slot OverviewPlay slots for any length of time, and it quickly becomes apparent that there are a few themes on perpetual rotation. title: Rolling In Gold
structured_summary: Rolling In Gold is a gold mining-themed slot featuring a unique 6-reel layout and classic mining imagery. review: 0.10/10,"March 4, 2021",7.5,"Rolling In Gold: Slot OverviewIf there is one kind of slot which reappears with near frightening regularity it’s the gold mining sort. On a certain level, this makes perfect sense. Chipping away at stone walls in the hope of unearthing gold nuggets is a pretty strong metaphor for playing slots. The two activities share a similar core goal, plus there is plenty of great imagery for developers to make use of. The problem is they use it a lot, and these types of slots can get a bit samey after a while.At first, Rolling In Gold from Blueprint Gaming appears to fall into this category. Aside from the unusual set up using 6 reels in a 3-3-4-4-4-4 configuration, it comes across as your typical, albeit good looking, mining slot. The positive news is the studio has juiced up the hold & win mechanic, which is standard in many of these games, to produce some highly entertaining moments.Mention the words ‘mining slot’, and a bunch of images immediately spring to mind. There’s the old-time miner, sticks of dynamite, gold nuggets, rickety wooden structures, and mining carts. Rolling In Gold has all of that, but to be fair to Blueprint Gaming, they’ve pulled it off with flair. Symbols have a highly defined look, while the gold, whether in bags, carts, or in the form of nuggets, sparkle brightly, making the whole package a pleasant one to look at. A banjo-picking soundtrack adds to the atmosphere as does the prospector who calls out at various points in the game. Add it up, and you’ve got a warm familiar scene to fill a few nugget sacks in.Players can trip down the shaft on any device, selecting bets from 10 p/c to $/€10 per spin along the way. Like actual prospecting, playing Rolling In Gold can take a bit of patience to hit pay dirt. Despite using a 2,304 pay ways system, the hit rate appeared pretty low, and getting to Diamond Spins (by far the best part of Rolling In Gold) will take a healthy dose of luck. It's far from being a tight slot though, possessing an RTP of 96.03% to go with a medium/high volatility.The paytable is a veritable what’s what of mining themed slots. Regular pay symbols start with blue, yellow, red gems; followed by picks, hardhats, and lanterns. Next is a donkey, a bag of gold, a cart of gold, and finally the gold fixated miner. The last two symbols on the list are the most valuable premiums, worth 5-10 times the stake for a six of a kind win.Rolling In Gold: Slot FeaturesRolling In Gold - Diamond SpinsThere are few surprises about the inclusion of a nugget infested hold & win feature in Rolling In Gold; however, this one can take you to some unexpected places. The keys here are the wild and scatter symbols. The dynamite wild is a little different than usual, being responsible for two functions - it substitutes for all symbols in the game except gold nugget scatters, and also plays a part in triggering the Gold Spins when wilds appear on reels 1 and 2 along with a nugget on the third reel.Gold Spins take place on 4x4, 16 position grid which carries over any triggering gold nuggets from the base spin and starts with 3 spins. Each tile here spins individually, landing empty spaces, diamonds, or new nuggets. If nuggets land, spins are reset back to 3. When spins run out and Diamond Spins have not been triggered, the feature ends, awarding the value of all in view nuggets. If you’re lucky enough to collect 3 diamond symbols, then Diamond Spins are awarded.The Diamond Spins bonus is similar to the previous with a few significant differences. One, players are allocated 3 spins only to strike it big – diamond symbols do not reset the amount. On a positive note, Diamond symbols can have much higher values compared to their gold nugget counterparts. In addition, next to the main 4x4 grid there's a giant diamond that spins on its own reel, applying a multiplier of x2, x3, x4, x5, or x10 to the value of diamond symbols in view. When the 3 spins have been played, the total prize amount is paid before heading back to the main game.Rolling In Gold: Slot VerdictDid we really need to dive down one more shaft to dig for precious ore in another gold mining themed slot? Possibly not, yet Blueprint Gaming has nevertheless delivered a fine example of this type of game. Its clever twist on a regular feature elevates Rolling In Gold beyond mediocre status. The graphics are good too and employing a pay all ways system rather than having a limited number of paylines you often see in many mining slots is a plus as well. Not sure exactly why the first two reels had to have fewer symbols than the other four, but it doesn’t detract from the gaming at all. Quite the opposite, and Rolling In Gold’s polished execution gives it a slight Megaways feel.The main event is obviously Diamond Spins which are a riot if you can make it so deep into the game. They transform what is a pretty average hold & win feature into one of the most exciting to play. During testing, the biggest diamond symbols had a base value of 200x, so when combined with the 10x multiplier you’re looking at some big single symbol wins. Of course, getting there isn’t the easiest task to accomplish. However, when Diamond Spins triggered, only twice did they end up on less than 1,000x the stake. Naturally, this is no guarantee of future results, but Diamond Spins could be relied on in test runs to perform well.Fair dues, while Rolling In Gold doesn’t exactly revolutionise gold mining slots, it’s not a bad game at all either – provided Diamond Spins are reached. Failing to trigger them does mean the experience is a lot more conventional. Players who like to lose themselves down mine shafts or favour hold & win features are likely to get a forceful kick out of Rolling In Gold."

title: Heroes Hunt Megaways
structured_summary:
Heroes Hunt Megaways features a cartoon-style D&D theme with heroes, treasures, and dragons in a roleplaying slot adventure.  
The game includes three heroes with unique modifiers, cascading wins, item collection, and a Dragon Free Spins bonus with expanding features.
