Badge 'W's are one of the wild types, substituting for all normal pay symbols. The second wild is the Napoleon Wild symbol, which also substitutes for regular pay symbols. A Napoleon Wild symbol is always on the screen, and it is not removed when used in winning clusters, nor does it cascade.Napoleon vs Rabbits: Slot FeaturesNapoleon vs Rabbits slot - free spins splash screenFor Napoleon vs Rabbits' features, why don't we start with the Rabbit Run feature? When winning clusters include the Napoleon Wild symbol, a rabbit appears on the side of the grid. When the cascade sequence ends, all of the spawned rabbits run towards the Napoleon Wild symbol, transforming symbols in their path into Mystery symbols. Rabbits that overlap the Mystery Rabbit Box symbols unlock them. Mystery symbols transform into the same symbol type.Mystery Rabbit Box SymbolMystery Rabbit Box symbols do not cascade and are unlocked when a winning cluster hits next to them. When a cascade sequence ends, Mystery Rabbit Box symbols release extra Mystery symbols.Free SpinsUnlocking 3 Mystery Rabbit Box symbols in one spin sequence awards 7 free spins. Each unlocked box after the first 3 awards +3 additional free spins and increases the win multiplier by +1. During the free spins round, each unlocked box awards +3 extra free spins and increases the win multiplier by +1. Lastly, if activated on your casino, free spins can be bought for the cost of 50 times the bet. The RTP when buying the bonus is 95.45%.Napoleon vs Rabbits slot - free spinsNapoleon vs Rabbits: Slot VerdictAs mentioned, the 8-bit angle isn't exactly unique in slots, but Blue Guru Games has pushed the approach just about as far as it is possible to go. Perhaps too far because a fresh appreciation for audio-visual progression in all walks of gaming arose by the time the review was done. Blue Guru Games hasn't so much as nailed the retro-ness, as much as over-nailed it. The tinny, albeit cheerful, sounding music gradually lost its charm, and the graphics would've looked average even back in the day when this sort of heavy pixelated look was the norm. Napoleon vs Rabbits delivers a powerful nostalgic hit. However, at the same time, it kind of removed some of the tint from the rose-tinted glasses in the process, as in, maybe the good old days weren't quite so good?Then again, maybe we're being paranoid, so let's not sully the memory of past classic games. Either way, you can get what Napoleon vs Rabbits was going for, but it ended up being just a little too much miss than hit. Everything had a slow-paced, moving-through treacle effect, which okay is probably much of the point, yet it wasn't hugely enjoyable, and after understanding why rabbits run to Napoleon, the comedic value eventually dipped as well. Mix in so-so potential, and by the end, ideas of running amok in some virtual world, sampling all of the delights modern gaming has to offer, arose.To sum up, let's acknowledge the creative thinking that went into making Napoleon vs Rabbits, using an interesting slice of the past as a basis for the game as a whole and then incorporating chase bits into some of the features. It could work for players absolutely head over heels with the clunky, slow-paced old-school execution. Otherwise, Napoleon vs Rabbits may well come across as being a little too clunky, slow-paced, and old-school for a more modern palate."

title: Forge of Gems
structured_summary: Forge of Gems is a gem-themed slot set beside a glowing forge, continuing Play'n GO's popular Gems series. review: "April 14, 2022",7.5,"Forge of Gems: Slot OverviewBilled as 'the hottest game in town', Forge of Gems is the fourth instalment in Play'n GO's popular Gem range of slots. The series kicked off with Perfect Gems, continued with Frozen Gems, then Prism of Gems, and is now up to number four. In Forge of Gems, players get a Forge Reel with special modifying symbols, win multipliers, increasing ways, and Gemboxes, or free spins as they are commonly known.Forge of Gems is located next to an actual forge where the gems are presumably made. On a side note, it would be kind of cool having a forge to create shiny little stones. These days creating gems in a lab is no big deal, and the process produces cheaper stones than those found in nature. There is some disagreement as to whether these human-made items are real gems, despite the fact many, if not most, people could not tell the two apart. Does it matter if the rock on someone's finger was forged in the heart of an asteroid or formed in the earth over aeons, or created by a boffin in a lab? The debate continues.Plonked before the forge is a game grid made up of a 5x3 main panel and a special Forge Reel running along the top. In keeping with tradition, paylines have been dropped in favour of ways to win, ranging from 243 up to 36,288 thanks to splitter symbols. In terms of volatility, Play'n GO has classed Forge of Gems as very high, rating it 10 out of 10, while RTP can vary depending on casino and jurisdiction, with 96.2% being the highest value. Any device may be used to play the game, giving players the option to bet from 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin.As before, gems make up the premium side of the paytable, where the four of them are worth 0.5 to 1 times the stake for a five of a kind win. Lower down, we find 10-A card ranks, worth 0.3-0.4x the bet for a five of a kind win. Diamonds are wild and pay out 3x the bet for five, though they are more likely to substitute for any pay symbols to help complete a winning way.Forge of Gems: Slot FeaturesForge of Gems comes with several features that interact and trigger each other, such as cascades, the Forge Reel and its various modifiers, plus free spins.CascadesEach symbol in a winning combination is removed from the board by the cascade feature. Then, symbols from the Forge Reel cascade down, and any additional gaps are refilled, potentially creating another win. This cascade process is repeated as long as new wins appear.Forge ReelWhen cascades activate the Forge Reel, these special symbols drop down onto the main grid and perform their modifier:Multiplier – increases the win multiplier by one. The win multiplier resets between paid spins.Vertical Wild – turns all symbols except scatters into wilds on the reel.Horizontal Wild – turns matching symbols on the row into wilds.Vertical Splitter – all matching symbols on the reel are split, increasing ways to win.Horizontal splitter – splits symbols on its row, except scatters, and is also wild.Blank symbols – these are removed when cascading.GemboxAppearing on all five reels is a red jewel scatter symbol. Landing 3 of them awards 20x the bet plus 8 or 10 free spins, 4 scatters award 30x the bet plus 10 or 15 free spins, while 5 scatters get you 40x the bet plus 10, 15, or 20 free spins. During the Gembox bonus, blank symbols never appear on the Forge Reel, and a multiplier symbol is guaranteed. The win multiplier does not reset between free spins, and whatever win multiplier was active on the triggering spin is carried over to the bonus round. Lastly, jewel scatters do not appear in free spins, so the feature cannot be retriggered.Forge of Gems: Slot VerdictLike the two previous Gem games, Forge of Gems lacks a little warmth, despite on-screen heat provided by the roaring hot forge. It sits in stark contrast to similarly themed games like Lava Lava or Hammer of Vulcan, which overflowed with personal touches. This isn't necessarily a good or bad thing, depending on personal preference, and does show that Play'n GO has plotted a course for the Gems games and are valiantly sticking to it. It just means that if you prefer the company of virtual chums, like classical Gods or fantastical creatures, then Forge of Gems might come across a little cold, a little generic at times.One benefit is that pretty much all features are available in the base game, and none of the thematic concerns really matter when Forge of Gems is firing. Cascades pull in modifier symbols from the Forge Reel, which in turn piles on wilds, ways, and at times, multipliers. The concept worked well in games like Tropicool or Illogicool, and it works just as well in Forge of Gems. There is a feeling these Gems slots are getting increasingly Nolimit City-ish as the series progresses - now they throw a dash of ELK into the mix. Not so much in a copy and paste way, however, because even though the gameplay feels familiar, Forge of Gems merges everything flawlessly. Should the cascades, Forge Reel and persistent multiplier trio of features be stoked to full capacity, Forge of Gems is capable of turning out wins as high as 20,000x the stake.All in all, Forge of Gems is a well-designed addition to the Gems range, which possesses a bunch of entertaining elements which have the ability to greatly enhance each other. If you're intrigued by the expanding reels/ways, splitting symbols action NLC is up to but not so jazzed by their themes, then Forge of Gems offers a similar style of play in a more staid environment."

Hitting 2 or 3 scatters awards an extra +3 or +5 free spins, respectively.X-iterOpening up the X-iter feature gives players a chance to activate these game modes:Bonus Hunt – 3x the bet where each spin has triple the chance of triggering a bonus.Multiplier Strike – 10x the bet to guarantee the multiplier strike.Persistent Multiplier Feature – 25x the bet to guarantee the persistent multiplier feature.Bonus Game – 100x the betSuper Bonus Game – 500x the bet.Oxygen slot - free spinsOxygen: Slot VerdictSo, is anyone else getting strong Sugar Rush vibes from this one? Thought so, and the two games have a lot in common. Enough to suppose that ELK Studios liked what they saw in Pragmatic Play's candy slot and decided they'd have a crack. ELK Studios being ELK Studios, though, the team didn't just throw some progressive multipliers at winning grid positions and call it a day. The studio has juiced the core multiplier position mechanic so potential values can be much higher, added in some complementary multiplier features, and tuned the math model to make Oxygen a more do-or-die slot than its sugary predecessor. On the do side, Oxygen has winning potential of up to 25,000x the bet, so its sizable position multipliers aren't just for show, though bigger does not automatically equate to better.One reason is when having multipliers of over x1,000 in free spins where nothing decides to connect with them, thereby sitting there teasing your eyes by being both valuable and worthless at the same time. On the flipside, hitting even a modest-sized cluster with a massive multiplier might turn out to be pretty sweet or Oxygenic, as it's called in the game. Multiplier features, the Dealer and the Collector, are excellent additions as well, so there are loads of components which can be used to craft a solid hit. The hope, then, is that they darn well link up to do so. Not always so easy to achieve in practice, of course, and even super bonus buys could be hard-pressed to end in credit.As mentioned, Oxygen is like a more highly strung version of Sugar Rush, with all the bumps, peaks and troughs that equates to. In this well-made game, ELK Studios has taken a popular mechanic and given it a major overhaul so that broadly speaking, compared to Sugar Rush, Oxygen's highs may be higher, the lows may be lower, and the ride, in general, a more turbulent one, for better or for worse."

title: Cupcakes
structured_summary: Cupcakes is a candy and baked goods-themed online slot by NetEnt set in a pastel, dreamy world of sweets. It features a 6x7 grid with scatter pays, Avalanche mechanic, multipliers, free spins, and a Crush feature, plus a bonus buy option. review: 2022",6.5,"Cupcakes: OverviewVeteran casino game designer NetEnt indulges its sweet tooth with a baked goods and candy-themed online slot going by the name of Cupcakes. Sweety slots are a perennial favourite amongst both players and providers, as there's something about the subject matter which brings them back time and again. Kind of like when there's leftover cake in the refrigerator or a packet of biscuits in the cupboard, which is meant to be saved for later, but the temptation is too irresistible to resist. As well as plenty of sugary imagery, this NetEnt release comes with ingredients such as Cupcakes, Gumdrops, a Crush feature, multipliers, free spins, and, where possible, a bonus buy.If you've played one of these sweet-tooth slots before, then there's a good chance you will know the drill. The reason being a lot of them tend to have rather similar looks, and Cupcakes is a prime example, as it's set in a swirly, dreamy world of deliciousness designed to tempt the taste buds. Luckily for your teeth, this thing isn't edible. In the middle of the pastel-coloured wonderland is a 6-reel, 7-row game grid which uses a scatter pays mechanic to create wins. This particular mechanic was popularised by Pragmatic in their Sweet Bonanza slot which has become the template for these kinds of games. The view, while hardly original, is pleasing to the eye and should bring satisfaction to players keen on some candy-based action.Cupcakes slot by NetEntPlayable on mobile, tablet, and desktop devices, Cupcakes accepts bets of 10 p/c to $/€200 per paid game round. In spite of its relatively low potential, it's a highly volatile slot that comes in a trio of RTP settings; the highest value being 96.05%, though be on the lookout for a 94.01% or 88.03% version depending on the market. To win, players collect a payout when at least 8 matching symbols are in view anywhere on the board. Since Cupcakes uses a scatter pays system, winning symbols do not have to land in lines, ways, or be adjacent to each other.Each cluster win triggers the Avalanche mechanic, which removes the winning symbols from the board, allowing other symbols to drop down to fill in the spaces. This system continues to function like this until no new win hits. Then any tallied multiplier is applied to the total prize value accrued during the sequence and paid. Cupcakes' symbols are split into two varieties – Gumdrops and the Cupcakes of the title. Each symbol type comes in 7 different coloured varieties, which can interact with each other as part of certain features. Let's take a look at how they may do so in the following section.Cupcakes: Slot FeaturesCupcakes slot by NetEntGumdrops appear in any position in 1x1 size, while Cupcakes hit in 2x2 size and fall to the bottom of the grid or stack up on top of each other. Gumdrops take part in Scatter Pays; however, when a Cupcake of the same colour hits, gumdrops gather on top of its frosting. The Cupcake's multiplier then adds to the tally when it is filled with at least 10 Gumdrops. Cupcakes come with random multiplier values of x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x25, x30, x50, or x100. The multiplier is reset between spins in the base game.Crush FeatureThe Crush feature is active in the base and bonus game. When 5 or more Gumdrops are part of a winning combination over two reels with at least two Gumdrops on each reel, the Crush feature is triggered. A Cupcake then falls through the reel pair. Note that this feature will not trigger if the reel pair has a scatter symbol, two Cupcake symbols, or if there are four Cupcakes already on the grid.Free SpinsGetting 3, 4, or 5 Cupcake Tub scatter symbols anywhere on the reels awards 10, 13, or 16 free spins, respectively. While free spins are active, it is possible to win 3, 6, or 9 additional free spins when 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols hit. The difference in free spin is that where the multiplier resets in the base game between spins, it does not reset in the bonus round, so it can keep on accumulating. On a final note, for those players who cannot wait to get to the bonus round, paying 100x the bet will get them a guaranteed 10 free spins.Cupcakes: Slot VerdictOne of the positive things about the candy subject matter is that it provides a versatile cover for all manner of math models and features. Cupcakes, despite its heavy calorific count, is in some ways a fairly lighter, mid-level slot, following in the footsteps of games like NetEnt's Cornelius, which came out not long before this one did. Okay, maybe Cupcakes is a little more heavy-duty than Cornelius was; it is a highly volatile game, after all. However, Cupcakes isn't the sort of slot that showcases the sort of envelope-bending NetEnt has displayed in the past.It's not necessarily a write-off either, though, and while it might have candy, scatter pays, and multipliers, it is quite different from, say, Sweet Bonanza – the slot which feels like one of Cupcake's closest competitors and which it, in part, might have been modelled after. One area where Cupcake possibly comes up short when compared to the Pragmatic Play classic is that its winning potential tops out at a so-so 2,762 times the bet. Though, on a side note, there were question marks regarding Sweet Bonanza advertised max win (which we are yet to see), but anyway. Aside from this somewhat disappointing stat, the rest of Cupcakes has been designed to a typically high NetEnt standard. As such, certain candy and cake fans looking for a new way to scratch the sugary slot itch might find their desires satisfied in Cupcakes, for a while at least, until the next one pops from the oven.So, did the world need one more sweet-themed online slot? Not really, but if this sort of thing is a personal preference and the low potential isn't a show stopper, then Cupcakes is like a box of chocolates - it's hard to say no to just one more, even if you're full."

title: Rusty & Curly
structured_summary: Rusty & Curly is a humorous Western-themed slot featuring two quirky cowboy characters and their animals in a playful twist on classic desperado tales. The game offers sticky Wild Poster symbols with multipliers, two distinct free spin bonuses—Stick to the Plan! and Who Shot The Sheriff?—and a bonus buy option for varied gameplay. The reviewer praises its thematic integration, engaging bonus mechanics, and potential for big wins, especially in the Who Shot The Sheriff? feature. Visually, it combines cartoonish, comedic character designs with fitting Western audio elements to create a lighthearted atmosphere.
review: 2024",7,"Rusty & Curly: Slot OverviewWestern slots, there's a lot of them, huh? Software providers are tempted west on a regular basis to see what they can add to the genre. Usually, it's a seriously minded game set in a rickety one-horse town where the tumbleweeds blowing through the streets are only outnumbered by the amount of bullets flying about the place. It's a slot category full of options, some great, some less so. Making a break from the norm, is Hacksaw Gaming's entry into the genre, Rusty & Curly. In this humorous take on cowboys, desperadoes, and whatnot, two unlikely leads are accompanied by their trusty animals, Crispy & Chewy, in a sort of Dork Unit meets The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly knee slapper.Which one is Rusty, and which one is Curly? Good question, and at a guess, Curly is the one standing to the left of the reels on account of the curlier hair, while Rusty is the slim-limbed, pot-bellied, dad-bod dude on the right. Could be wrong, apologies Rusty & Curly, if we are. The two characters are just chilling out in the middle of nowhere through the roads of Dorkville, one trying to look bow-legged menacing, the other one possessing the sort of glazed expression one might form if the creator of the universe had just downloaded the meaning of everything into their mind but their brain lacks the processing power or RAM to compute all the data. A couple of unlikely heroes, in other words, who set a humorous tone before launching into the action.Rusty & Curly slot - base gameBetween the two 'funslingers', as the game info calls them, is Rusty & Curly's 5-reel, 4-row gaming panel. It has 14 paylines, that award wins when 3 to 5 matching symbols land along them, beginning from the leftmost reel. On the default RTP model, players can theoretically expect a return value of 96.29%, though some of the feature buys affect this figure. With a medium volatile math model, rated as 3 out of 5 by the Hacksaw team, players are able to select stakes from 10 c per spin, up to $/€100 at the most.Jack to Ace card ranks are Rusty & Curly's low pay symbols, shooting off wins of 1 times the bet when landing a line of 5 identical royals. Then there's a skull, a hat, a bottle, a horseshoe, and a sheriff's badge as the highs, worth 3 to 10 times the bet for a 5 OAK winning line. Wild Posters are present on all reels, substituting any regular pay symbol and worth 10x the bet for a line of 5 of them.Rusty & Curly: Slot FeaturesRusty & Curly slot - Stick to the Plan bonusRusty & Curly makes excellent use of the theme and characters to bring life to its features, which include Wild Poster symbols, leading to respins and multipliers, a Stick To The Plan! bonus, which boosts the base game mechanics, while Who Shot The Sheriff? brings the gang together for a multi-cycle collect and payout experience.Almost Sticky Wild PostersWild Posters can land with hearts, a multiplier, or both. They stay on the reels and grant respins as long as at least 1 heart remains. Each Wild Poster can have up to 3 hearts, and a heart is lost per respin. When no hearts remain, the Wild Poster is removed on the next respin. Wild Posters may land with multipliers of x2 to x10. During respins, any landed FS scatter symbols are collected on the progress bar above the reels.Stick to the Plan! BonusHitting 3 FS scatter symbols in the base game activates 6 free Stick to the Plan! spins. This bonus round increases the chance Wild Posters land with a greater number of hearts and bigger multipliers where the value can now be x2 to x100. While there is at least 1 Wild Poster on the reels with 1 heart or more, players are given respins which do not count towards the awarded free spins. FS scatters do not land during this feature.Who Shot The Sheriff? BonusWhen 4 FS scatters hit in the base game, players get 12 free Who Shot The Sheriff? spins divided into 3 Cycles. One Cycle consists of 1 Collect Phase spin and 3 Payout Phase spins. In the Collect Phase, Rusty, Curly, or both land and expand to a wild reel on a random reel. They shoot 1 to 6 times at the multipliers on the grid. The total value of the multipliers they shoot at is added to the wild reel for the Payout Phase. Possible multiplier values range from x1 to x200.The Payout Phase has 3 spins with paying symbols. The Rusty & Curly wild reels are sticky, holding the multipliers from the Collect Phase. After 3 Payout Phase spins, the game goes back to the Collect Phase again. During the Payout Phase, Crispy & Chewy symbols may land and expand to wild reels but do not have multipliers. They are not sticky, either. Landing 3 FS symbols in the feature awards +1 extra Cycle, landing 4 FS symbols awards +2 extra Cycles.Bonus BuyFrom the bonus buy menu, players can choose different ways they'd like to take Rusty & Curly on. All are highly volatile, except Stick-Up FeatureSpins, which are medium.BonusHunt FeatureSpins – 3x the bet, each spin is 5 times more likely to trigger a bonus game. (RTP 96.4%)The Stick-Up FeatureSpins – 50x the bet, each spin guarantees at least 5 Wild Poster symbols. (RTP 96.29%)Stick To The Plan! Bonus – 100x the bet (RTP 96.29%).Who Shot The Sheriff? Bonus – 300x the bet (RTP 96.41%).Rusty & Curly slot - Who Shot the Sheriff bonusRusty & Curly: Slot VerdictHey, what can you expect from a game which puts this in one of its free spins round descriptions: 'Come on down to Bonus Town, where the grass is dead and the girls are gritty'? A few rib ticklers that's what, and Hacksaw Gaming has crafted a slot packed with humorous parts. Cast your mind back to Wanted Dead or a Wild – could Rusty & Curly be any more atmospherically different? One of the funnier parts was trying to imagine either Rusty or Curly ever shooting a sheriff before concluding the only way this would likely happen is if one of them accidentally dropped their six shooter on the ground, firing a bullet that ricocheted off the bell in the bell tower, angling downwards into the lawman's office and sadly piercing him through the breast.Hacksaw is Hacksaw, though, so the math in Rusty & Curly is no joke. The game has numerous ways it can tantalise, taunt, and, when lucky, reward. What's cool is how each gameplay element is intricately linked to the theme, such as the Wild Poster almost sticky wilds and the shooting of multiplier values by Rusty & Curly wild reels in phase 1 of the Who Shot THe Sheriff? bonus. That bonus is one of Rusty & Curly's main highlights. It's not the first time Hacksaw Gaming has done a collect and payout multi-phase bonus. Alpha Eagle had one, for example. But not like Rusty & Curly's, and as you might expect, Who Shot The Sherrif? can end up a do-or-die Hacksaw Gaming special. Potentially ace if Rusty & Curly both hit and shoot up a storm of multipliers, sad face when the opposite occurs.Both of Rusty & Curly's bonus rounds are capable of hitting the 10,000x win cap, but the base game apparently is not. This provides even more incentive to trigger (or buy) the bonus rounds, in addition to experiencing the idiosyncratic gameplay they offer, though more so Who Shot The Sheriff?, really, in a uniquely designed Western slot."

title: Wild Chapo Dream Drop
structured_summary:
Wild Chapo Dream Drop is a Mexican-themed slot featuring a playful outlaw vibe set in the desert outskirts.

review: 2022",7.5,"Wild Chapo Dream Drop: Slot OverviewHave you ever seen that thing where people cool off on a hot day by busting open a fire hydrant to let the water come gushing out? That's kind of the sensation Relax Gaming is giving off at the moment as they race through their back catalogue to flush out as many Dream Drop makeovers as possible. Today's one is Wild Chapo Dream Drop, a remake of the 2021 Mexican-themed slot Wild Chapo. As usual, most of the game has remained the same, with the main differences being statistical and the inclusion of the Dream Drop jackpots, which have the potential to reach as high as €10,000,000.On the front end, little has changed apart from the Dream Drop jackpot values ticking away on the side of the screen. The active game panel remains wedged to the side of a bar, located way out in the Mexican boonies. Why Chapo hangs out here may have something to do with a penchant for blowing things up? Even if this isn't the case, players can look forward to lashings of explosions as the game progresses. Wild Chapo might not be one of Relax Gaming's audio-visual feasts, but it has an amiable look, a charming ensemble, and there are stacks of small details to enjoy. There's an excellent soundtrack too, by the way, with just a hint of a Hotel California chord change moment.Wild Chapo Dream Drop slot - base gameThe first casualty in any Dream Drop redo is RTP. In the case of Wild Chapo Dream Drop, players get a value of 94%, including a jackpot contribution of 12%. A big drop, but something to be expected in a game like this. As before, volatility is high (4 out of 5) whilst stakes vary from 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin - the higher the bet, the greater the chance of triggering a jackpot win.Played on a 5x3 game panel, players score a regular win when at least three adjacent matching symbols land along one of the 15 paylines from the leftmost side. Symbols kick off with low-pay diamonds, clubs, hearts, and spades covered in colourful designs, paying 4 times the stake for five of a kind. Payouts rise to 10 to 25 times the stake when landing five doggies, owls, donkeys, or Chapos. When evaluating wins, wilds in view may be used to substitute any normal pay symbol, or they can payout up to 40x the bet for a line of five wilds. It is possible Colossal Wilds land, covering up to four positions on the board.Wild Chapo Dream Drop: Slot FeaturesWild Chapo Dream Drop slot - Dream Drop featureAs well as the main jackpot part of the deal, Wild Chapo Dream Drop has Expanding Wilds, Respins, and Free Spins.Expanding WildsIn the base game, when landing a TNT crate, it will explode if it can form a win, expanding upwards to create wild symbols.RespinsWhen precisely 2 scatter symbols land in the base game, they transform into sticky wild symbols and trigger a respin. Landing new wilds awards an additional respin. When no more respins are won, any win is paid out, and the sticky wilds are removed for the next spin.Free SpinsThis bonus round is triggered when 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols hit, awarding 7, 9, or 11 free spins, respectively. Landing 3 or more scatter symbols during free spins awards an additional +3 free spins. When scatter symbols land during the feature, a small bonus symbol icon is stored at the position it appeared. On the final spin, these stored bonus symbols are converted into wild symbols, with a multiplier that corresponds to the number stored at the specific position. So single stored bonus symbols create a regular wild, whereas if 3 bonus symbols were stored in one position, they would create a wild with an x3 multiplier. When more than one wild multiplier is used in a win, the values are multiplied against each other.Dream Drop JackpotsSingle Jackpot Spins trigger at random in the base game. When activated, 5 special reels appear, landing only DD symbols or blocks. Landing a DD symbol in all five reels grants one spin on the jackpot wheel, leading to either rapid, midi, maxi, major, mega with starting values of €1, €5, €100, €25,000, or €500,000.Wild Chapo Dream Drop slot - jackpot wheelWild Chapo Dream Drop: Slot VerdictIf you've sampled the original Wild Chapo slot, there won't be much here that you don't already know. The Mexican Outback atmosphere remains as sultry as ever, and there are several humorous touches, such as the intro clip where Chapo and his donkey inadvertently blow the bar up after ignoring the 'No Animals' sign on their way in. In short, Wild Chapo Dream Drop is, in many ways, a happy-go-lucky game that's easy to go along with for a spin or two.It's business-minded as well, though, with plenty of explosive (literally) moments on the reels. Various wild elements make their way onto the game board during the base game via TNT crates, Colossal Symbols or the Respins feature, and free spins aren't bad either. Actually, they can be pretty intense when a solid number of bonus symbols have been collected in anticipation for the final, potentially almighty, last spin. Outside the jackpot, Wild Chapo Dream Drop is capable of stirring up wins as high as 10,000x the bet. When including the jackpot, the Dream Drop is said to be capable of building a top prize up to the €10,000,000 mark.And so, the Dream Drop remake machine chugs along, chalking up another successful conversion. The addition of five new jackpots might well add a new level of desirability for fans of the original Wild Chapo, while the game should be suitable for any general jackpot chaser interested in trying their luck in a Mexican-themed environment."

title: Vikings Go To Olympus
structured_summary: Vikings Go To Olympus blends Norse and ancient Greek themes, featuring a clash between Vikings and gods like Poseidon and Zeus. review: 2025",7,"Vikings Go To Olympus: Slot OverviewGosh, those Vikings have gone a lot of places, haven't they? Berzerk, Egypt, Valhalla, Berzerk Reloaded, even hell. Vikings Go To Olympus squeezes in huge personalities and does it quite well, giving the game a satisfyingly heavy Norse meets Greek clash, heaviness being something the Vikings Go series has excelled at for a while now.Vikings Go To Olympus slot - base gameA 5x4 matrix is where Vikings Go To Olympus drops its symbols, creating winning combinations along 25 paylines from the leftmost side. Volatility rests in the medium-high zone, while of the two RTP values available, 96% is the highest possible return. As well as being able to bet 10 c to $/€100 per spin, there are seven bonus buy options available to activate, all have the same RTP value of 96%.Vikings litter the paytable as there are 4 of them as the higher value pay symbols worth up to 6 to 10 times the bet. They are joined by 4 lower paying symbols worth 1 to 1.5 times the bet for a 5 OAK winning combination. When wilds are on the reels, they substitute for any of the regular paying symbols.Vikings Go To Olympus: Slot FeaturesVikings Go To Olympus slot - free spins introOn this trip to Olympus, the Vikings have taken with them WildFights, Rushing Wilds, WildFight Respins, WildFight + Multiplier Respins, Rage Collection, free spins, and bonus buys.WildFightIn the base game and in free spins, Viking symbols fight against Poseidon or Zeus, respectively. If they win, they transform into sticky wilds during respins in the base game or during the entire free spins session. WildFights occur before any wins from the spin are paid.RushingWildsDuring free spins, each new wild that lands increases the multipliers on other wilds. The multiplier on a wild symbol multiplies the payline win it is part of. Multipliers from more than one wild in the same win are added together.WildFight RespinsWildFight Respin - Landing a single scatter triggers a WildFight respin. All high-pay symbols fight, and if they win, they become sticky wilds for one respin.WildFight + Multiplier Respin - Landing 2 scatter symbols trigger RushingWild respins. All high-pay symbols fight with a chance of becoming sticky wilds for the respin. Then, all wilds receive an x2 multiplier, and one respin is awarded.Rage CollectionIn the base game, each high and low pay symbol may land with a corresponding sub-symbol. Each sub-symbol adds a number of points to the collection of its linked Viking. Lows add 1 point, highs add 2 points. When a Viking's collection is full, that Viking goes Berzerk in the next free spins round. Berzerk Vikings always win their WildFights, and the chance of free spins is higher with an active Berzerk. Rage Collection progress is saved between bet levels.Free SpinsHitting 3, 4, or 5 scatters awards 6, 8, or 10 free spins, respectively. In free spins, a WildFight occurs on every free spin. If a high symbol wins, it becomes a sticky wild for the remainder of the round. Each time a new sticky wild appears, all previous wilds add +1 to their multiplier, and multipliers remain for the full free spins session. Landing a scatter awards +1 free spin.Buy BonusVikings Go To Olympus has 7 buy options. They are 6, 8, or 10 free spins costing 40x, 50x, or 65x the bet, respectively, or 6, 8, or 10 free spins with a Random Berzerk for 95x, 195x, or 390x the bet, respectively. The last option is 6-10 free spins with 1 Viking Berzerk at 205x the bet. Berzerk Collection does not apply to free spins when bought.Vikings Go To Olympus slot - free spinsVikings Go To Olympus: Slot VerdictNot only have the Vikings been on quite a journey, but so have players who have followed the Vikings Go series. From the highs of Vikings Go Berzerk/Vikings Go Berzerk Reloaded to the not so highs of Vikings Go To Egypt Wild Fight, players who like to go volatile/big potential or prefer something less extreme have a variety of ways to take a punt. One thing you don't find in Vikings Go To Olympus, surprisingly, is Treasure Chests awarding their various prizes. For whatever reason, Yggdrasil has dropped Treasure Chests from the current game, choosing instead to push the RTP through other channels.One of the newer channels is the Rushing Wilds feature. Since these are games that are built around landing sticky wilds anyway, making new wild symbols increase the multiplier value of wilds already on the reels is quite a good idea. Rage Collection has remained, thankfully. It would have been really odd, almost deal-breaking, if that had been removed as well since knowing Berzerk Vikings always win their fight and convert to sticky wilds is one of Viking Go's sweeter moments. A removal of Treasure Chests is accompanied by a lessening of winning potential (compared to the Berzerk slots), dropping the figure to 6,000x the bet when achieving utmost rage.The Yggdrasil team has clearly invested significant effort into this game, delivering a release with the polish and production value of a blockbuster. Having said that, fans who were hoping the next slot after Vikings Go To Egypt Wild Fight was going to drive the series forward in a significant way may be disappointed, as will anyone who lived for Treasure Chests. Nevertheless, Vikings Go To Olympus has enough fighting, sticky wilds, progressive multipliers, impressive characters, and rage to make it an enjoyable game."

title: Gemix

review: 8,"Gemix: Slot OverviewJoin a wizard, a princess, and a pick axe-wielding miner, in developer Play'n GO’s cute grid slot Gemix. While hitting clusters, players trigger a multitude of features as they travel between mysterious worlds in the hopes of filling a charge meter to unleash a bevvy of features for solid, if not outstanding, winning potential.It might feel like you’re playing a mixture of Candy Crush and My Little Pony at first as the rainbow adorned load screen gives way to the game proper. Here you’ll find a 7 by 7 sized grid, dropping in 49 hard sweet looking symbols to form wins when 5 or more of the same type connect horizontally or vertically. The rest of the view is taken up by various meters we cover below, while background imagery is dependent on the world you happen to be in. Certain features are only available in each world, which changes location when certain criteria are met. Before getting deep into the features, let’s take in the light-hearted cartoon surroundings for a moment.Don’t get taken in too far though, Gemix might look cute on the outside, yet beneath the surface lies a medium volatility (6/10) math model that can still nip the unwary. Keep an eye out for variable RTP too, where the default value is quite generous at 96.83%, especially so compared to the 94.79% or less found elsewhere. Bet selection is wide too, where stakes from 10 p/c to $/€100 per spin are available.Whenever a win hits in Gemix, it is removed and replaced by a bunch of new symbols. This means consecutive wins are possible on the same spin, only halting when no new wins cluster up. As mentioned, hard candies make up the paytable - 4 for the lows, 4 for the higher paying flowers, moons, hearts, and star-shaped ones. The most valuable clusters are made up of 15 or more identical symbols, and should this be of premiums, then a payout of 100 to 1,000 the stake is coming your way.Gemix: Slot FeaturesAs clusters are hitting, the number of symbols used in each one is collected on the crystal charge meter. When the meter is fully charged, one of the following Crystal Charge effects is triggered when there are no more cascades:Chain Lightning – two opposite corner symbols shoot an electrical arc, destroying any symbols it touches.Light Beam – light rays shoot vertically and horizontally from a symbol on the grid, transforming all symbols it hits.Crystal Warp – One symbol is selected, and all instances of it on the grid warp to other symbols.Nova Blast – one symbol on the grid explodes, removing adjacent symbols in an explosion. It then creates a core of matching symbols.If 40 symbols are collected in the charge meter, a Super Charge feature is awarded. This is one of the 4 Crystal Charge features from above, with the addition of an x3 multiplier. This can only happen once per game round.To move through the worlds, you will need to hit cluster wins on top of highlighted grid patterns. Clearing a pattern moves you to the next world. Each world has a unique wild feature that triggers randomly on non-winning spins.Miner’s World – up to ten wild symbols may be added to the grid.Princess’ World – wilds appear from one edge of the grid to the other.Wizard’s World – up to 8 sticky wilds may appear, remaining on the grid even when used in a win.Wilds substitute for any pay symbols and are removed if part of a winning combination if they are not of the sticky variety.Gemix: Slot VerdictGemix has a lot going on, but it’s by no means a complicated game. The main goal is stringing consecutive winning combinations together in hopes of filling the Crystal Charge Meter to blast the game grid with a selection of features. Despite not offering a round of free spins, you tend not to notice they are missing after a while, so frequently do Crystal Charge features trigger and the lengthy nature of solid win runs. Only twenty symbols are needed for a standard charge which is lower than many other of its grid slot competitors require.The other compelling element to Gemix is its World Pattern feature, making the game fun for two reasons. First, it adds an interesting challenge on each spin to complete, doubling the incentive to hit consecutive clusters. Secondly, changing worlds means you get three different wild features to experience, each one bringing an individual benefit. Rotating through patterns and worlds keeps the gaming fresh and engaging. Gemix might not look or act overly hardcore, yet its effortlessly enjoyable gaming is hard to put down and is capable of decent payouts as well. Potential is certainly not a disappointment since wins of up to 4,513 times the stake are possible from its gem-encrusted worlds.Released in 2014, Gemix is starting to age a little around the edges, especially when compared to the sequel, Gemix 2. Not so much its looks which still hold up quite well, but it has been eclipsed by latter grid slots built to meet the demand for highly volatile games. Still, for something a little more forgiving than others, in a game more likely to drop a bunch of features to keep the flow going, Gemix is as fun as ever."

title: Twisted Sister
structured_summary: Twisted Sister slot features an 80s heavy metal theme centered on the iconic band Twisted Sister. review: 7,"Twisted Sister Slot: OverviewAre you going to take it, gamers? No? Well, neither are hair rockers Twisted Sister, who literally wrote the book on defying authority. As luck would have it, we get it in a grid slot format which is a territory that is very much dominated by Play'n GO and that has been perfected by them.Even if you're not too familiar with the band, there's still a good chance that you've heard their super hit ""We're Not Gonna Take It"" which has been ranked the 47th greatest 80s song by VH1. Although the band has enjoyed a long career, spanning nearly four decades and six albums, it's their third studio album Stay Hungry that stands out as their best work. Released in 1984, it includes hits such as ""Stay Hungry"", ""We're Not Gonna Take It"", ""I Wanna Rock"", and mighty power ballad titled ""The Price"".So, firing up the game, what is the first impression? Admittedly, it could have been a bit more in your face visually, but the palette, the towering speakers and the band's music bring the 80s screaming back to life. Consecutive high pay wins also trigger features we will cover in the next section.Before then, we’ll dissect the math model, which isn’t quite as hardcore as you might expect from a bunch of rockers. Taking a few moments to check the rules before firing up is a sound idea since RTP can be found a few points lower.Interestingly, the first slot that sprang to mind during testing was Black Mamba; another a cluster pays slot by Play’n GO. Both games are band-centric, but it’s the symbols that rang the bell. They both have similar looking low pays made up of badges, and guitar picks, with five premiums depicting the original band members. As you’d expect, lead singer Dee Snider is the most valuable in the rabble worth 250 times the stake for a cluster of 25 or more symbols. The pink wild is handy here, substituting for any pay symbol to help pull together a cluster.Twisted Sister Slot: FeaturesBase gameAmplifying the effects of clusters are a collection of features. For starters, all winning band member symbols fill the Guitar Charge meter by 1, which can hold up to 15 charges at the most. Band features are unleashed one by one if there are at least 5 charges in the meter after wins are calculated and there are no more cascades. This is what each modifier has to offer:Scream destroys all of the non-band symbols around the selected symbol type.Go Wild turns the selected symbol type into wilds.Unite transforms symbols into the selected symbols.Remember the angry dad from the video to the song We’re Not Gonna Take It? Take a look above the Guitar Charge Meter to find the Angry Dad Meter. The meter has 4 segments that are filled one by one whenever an Angry Dad wild scatter is used as part of a win.When the meter is full, the We’re Not Gonna Take It feature is triggered. Any additional Angry Dad scatters overcharges the meter and bumps up the win multiplier by +1. The grid then clears, and a new round begins with a 2x2 Mega Band symbol attempting to throw off the Angry Dads. The round continues until all the Angry Dads are taken out and there are no more wins.Twisted Sister Slot: Verdict’I Wanna Rock’, sang front man Dee in the classic Twisted Sister track, so players are no doubt wondering just how hard the slot version rocks. Well, it rocks, but it could have rocked harder truth be told. If you like the band or the era though, it’s hard not to crack a smile over what Play’n GO has done here.Twisted Sister is one of the more recognisable bands to hit slots and that factor alone is sure to pull some punters through the gate. From a purely gaming standpoint, however, it's a less volatile version of the Black Mamba slot in many ways whilst also being a far cry from their best work in the genre Reactoonz. Needless to say, Twisted Sister is a game that will cater to a very specific audience.Those looking for big volatility and massive payouts probably won’t find them with Twisted Sister. Potential weighs in at 4,500 times the stake, which is a little less than we normally find from this developer, but pretty decent still. With that said, big wins are a bit rare here as the volatility is lower than what many will be used to when it comes to Play'n GO grid slots. Since the bonus is guaranteed to pay, it doesn't collect those large jackpots as effectively as more volatile slots tend to do.So yes, Play’n GO has gone for the middle ground in regards to the math model. Put it this way; if you went to this Twisted Sister slot concert, you’d be seated to watch the spectacle rather than banging around a mosh pit. That’s cool though, you don’t have to slam up against sweaty bodies to have fun. It’s nice to kick back in a comfy chair to enjoy a show, which is more the vein Twisted Sister the slot taps into.Overall, Twisted Sister is yet another excellent grid slot release from Play'n GO who have become one of the best producers in the genre. Those who will get the most enjoyment of this title, of course, are all the fans of the band. Us included.Don't MissIf you like the rock music series of slots coming from Play'n GO, be sure to have a look at ZZ Top Roadside Riches as well which comes with two different free spin modes and two special wild base game features."

title: Raptor Doublemax

review: 2021",9,"Raptor DoubleMax: Slot OverviewFor Raptor DoubleMax, developer Yggdrasil is time machining back to a 'lost land before time' where 'creatures roam the earth, contesting for supremacy.' Wilds are integral to the features which feed off each other to create some dramatic results.Raptor DoubleMax: Slot Features﻿At all points in Raptor DoubleMax, a cascading mechanism called the Dropdown feature is active. It is joined by a Golden Bet, free spins, a free spins gamble, and a doubling multiplier.After every win, all winning symbols are removed from the reels via the Dropdown feature. Then, a wild symbol appears in one of the empty spaces while the rest are filled by new symbols cascading in from above. Every Dropdown win also doubles the win multiplier, starting at x1. The multiplier is applied to any current win and resets between paid spins.Landing at least 3 scatter symbols triggers the free spins game. Before they begin, players can choose to collect or gamble what they have won for a higher amount (7, 10, or 13 free spins) – unless you start from 13. Be aware if you lose the gamble, you lose the free spins. The rules of free spins are the same as the base game, with the exception that the win multiplier does not reset. Since it doubles on every Dropdown, it can technically reach dino-sized proportions.Players may have a couple of ways of boosting their chance of triggering free spins. One is the Golden Bet which is an optional extra you can choose to engage or not. When activated, the chance of triggering free spins doubles, the cost of doing so increases the stake by 25%. Alternatively, where available, players can just buy the bonus straight away for the cost of 100x the stake.Raptor DoubleMax: Slot VerdictThere's a lot about Raptor DoubleMax to get players keen on big volatile games frothing in anticipation. It shares the same graphics and focus on multipliers as Multifly, making it in many ways a follow on. However, Raptor DoubleMax is a different species altogether and has been expertly put together, so each feature blends with the others to create some exceptional moments. That's if everything works as you want it to. Let's not forget this is 'super volatile' after all, so Raptor DoubleMax can feel like a brontosaurus has stood on your foot at times.To bring some balance, the 243 ways of Multifly have been replaced by a lower number of fixed paylines. Some might lament the change, but it works fine in conjunction with Dropdowns and added wilds – just as it did in the previous game. Big multipliers are fortunately paired with decent potential as well, and Raptor DoubleMax can hit wins as high as 20,000x the bet. Although Yggdrasil states the 'highest multipliers in the industry can be achieved', Raptor DoubleMax would have made a stronger statement if the studio had gone as wild and crazy with the max win.In some ways, Raptor DoubleMax is rather understated. It's not a game that tries to dazzle with some wacky, innovative feature or impress by using reel dynamic trickeries or the like. However, what it does do is pushed to the extreme, and for the lucky ones who catch Raptor DoubleMax on a good day, its multiplier doubles up in a way few other slots, if any, can match."

title: Dragon's Treasure

review: 7.5,"Dragon’s Treasure (Merkur): OverviewWhat seems to be the case with this Merkur slot, is that a dragon has been running rough shod on a nearby medieval town. Whenever 3 or more of the dragon symbol come into view, you’ll receive 10 Free Spins in total as a reward.During the free spins round, you will also see a special symbol come into play. It's massive success with hardcore gamers can mainly be attributed to its high volatility, which at the time of its release was quite unusual for a slot machine, along with the hefty payouts of up to 5,000 times your stake in a single spin during the free spins round.Dragon's Treasure is an all or nothing, no-nonsense slot machine. If you do trigger it, however, there's a good chance that you will walk away with a great reward. As long as you are aware of what you're up against and accept its relentless volatility, you'll eventually start to see why it has become so popular with slots enthusiasts."

review: 2022",6.5,"Disco Dawgs: Slot OverviewThe disco scene might have peaked during the 1970s, but it's been kept alive in various places, and one of them, for whatever reason, is in online slots. As well as substituting pay symbols, these wilds come with x2 or x3 multipliers, increasing any win they are part of. The final wild is the Dax wild which only appears on reels 2, 3, or 4 in free spins to substitute pay symbols. Dax wilds have multipliers of x3 if 8 or 12 free spins are triggered or x4 when 15 free spins are triggered. When more than one is used to help complete a win, the values are multiplied together before being applied to any payouts.Free SpinsLanding 3, 4, or 5 disco bonus symbols awards players with 8, 12, or 15 free spins. In the feature, whenever a Dax wild lands on the reels, it remains on the grid, moving to a new position on the middle three reels between each free spin. Up to 9 Dax wilds are permitted. Lastly, disco bonus symbols are removed from the reels in the bonus round so free spins cannot be retriggered.Buy PassInstead of organic bonus round triggers, eligible players can buy free spins for 200x the bet. Doing so lands 3, 4, or 5 disco bonus symbols to launch the feature.Disco Dawgs: Slot VerdictIt's no wonder developers use cute animals in slots to help endear them to players, because how long can you really hold a grudge against cartoon canines for? Jokes aside, there is a sense that Disco Dawgs is a little too close to The Dog House for comfort, and the games do have several things in common. Free spins certainly hold promise with the chance of wild multipliers creating combined values of up to x64. All this gear means Disco Dawgs manages to beat out both The Dog House and The Dog House Megaways when it comes to maximum payout capabilities, tipping the scales at 17,413x the bet. Solid, but pipped by Relax Gaming's Top Dawg$ if you are looking for a canine filled slot with sticky multipliers and a bit more bite.Disco Dawgs might not become a smash hit, and it does have a somewhat dated feel to it, but there are plenty of positive things about it to be fair. The doggie characters are easy to like, there's wild symbol variety, and the persistent roaming wild multipliers in free spins have the potential to go ballistic as they have in past games. Even if disco isn't on your playlist, it's still possible to enjoy Disco Dawgs all the same."

title: Napoleon 2
structured_summary: Napoleon 2 FatStacks is a historical-themed slot centered on Napoleon Bonaparte's battlefield exploits. review: "November 23, 2023",8,"Napoleon 2 FatStacks: Slot OverviewYou know someone has made their mark on the world when they are known by just a single name, or mononym, as it's called. Pop culture's got Madonna, Zendaya, Beyonce, Adele, or Drake, for example, while history has figures such as Confucious, Plato, Socrates, Voltaire, and the subject of this review, Napoleon. Napoleon Bonaparte made his name on the battlefield, putting the fear into Europe before finally losing the Battle of Waterloo and later being exiled to the island of Saint Helena. Napoleon is experiencing something of a renaissance in the gambling world (see Napoleon Vs Rabbits or Mighty Empire Hold & Win, for example) and is the headliner in Napoleon 2 FatStacks, an online slot from developer Lucksome.Napoleon 2 FatStacks follows on from Napoleon: Rise of an Empire, released by developer Blueprint Gaming some years prior. It's also the second time we've crossed paths with Lucksome's FatStacks mechanic, too, after its debut in FatStacks Miami Cash. Obviously, it is a long way from the steamy streets of Miami to the smoky, boggy battlefield players find themselves on for Napoleon 2 FatStacks. The game shares visual similarities to the previous release, such as the game grid framed like a fancy painting, the intense tunes, and general background imagery, but a satisfying modern upgrade has taken place, matching the mechanical renovations Lucksome has provided.Napoleon 2 slot - base gamePart of the upgrade was transforming the grid into a 6-reel, 4-row gaming area with 4,096 ways to win. To take on Napoleon or join forces, players select a stake of 10 c to $/€10 per spin, with a bonus buy on hand to skip the skirmish part of play and charge right into battle. Well, trigger free spins, that is. Mathematically, Napoleon 2 FatStacks is a medium-high volatile slot, producing a return to player value of 96.24%, or 96.33% when buying free spins.Royals and images of war make up Napoleon 2 FatStacks' pay symbols. Ten to Ace card ranks are the lower paying lot, worth 1 to 3 times the bet for a 6 OAK hit. Then we've got a cannon, a horse, a soldier, and a ship as the 4 high pays. Hitting a 6 OAK high pay win awards 4 to 15 times the bet. Winning symbols are removed from the reels when they hit and replaced by new symbols falling in from above. Cascades continue until no new win or no new FatStacks are possible. Scatters do not create cascades, though. Also, winning symbols do not create cascades during a Napoleon Mega Steak.Napoleon 2 FatStacks: Slot FeaturesNapoleon 2 slot - free spinsOnto features where, if you're lucky, you'll run into FatStacks, two types of wild symbols, Napoleon Mega Streaks, Battle Cry Modifiers, and free spins.FatStacksWhen 2 or 3 identical single symbols are on the same reel, they consolidate into double or triple symbols called FatStacks - falling through other symbols if need be. This means double or triple the ways to win on a single symbol. Any pay symbols can become FatStacks, but not wilds or scatters. Up to 3 FatStacks can be on each reel, so at full capacity, FatStacks can create up to 1 million ways to win.WildsNapoleon 2 FatStacks has 2 types of wilds – regular Napoleon Wilds or Golden Napoleon Wilds. Both appear on reels 2-6 to substitute for any regular pay symbols, and both display Monsieur Bonaparte on them. Wild symbols are also a win multiplier. When 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 wilds substitute on a winline, they multiply the win by x2, x4, x8, x16, or x32, respectively.Napoleon Mega StreakWhen the Golden Napoleon Wild is part of a win, it triggers a Napoleon Mega Streak. All winning symbols or scatter symbols are held on the screen, while non-winning symbols are removed, allowing more symbols to drop in. Creating FatStacks increases the ways to win. Landing new winning symbols or scatters locks them in place, repeating the process until no new ones appear in view.Battle Cry ModifierOn any spin, Napoleon may appear to trigger one of two modifiers. This could be adding scatter symbols to the reels or adding wild symbols to the reels.Free SpinsGetting 4, 5, or 6 scatter symbols on the grid awards 10, 12, or 15 free spins, respectively. During free spins, all wilds are golden, and any wins with the Golden Napoleon Wild trigger the Mega Streak feature. Also, at the end of a Mega Streak, wild multiplier values are upgraded for the rest of the round, as displayed on the screen - up to 5x, 10x, 20x, 40x, and 80x. Hitting 4+ scatters awards an extra 10 free spins with the upgraded multiplier trail.Bonus BuyFor 150 times the bet, players can buy their way into the free spins round. Bought bonuses have a 30x the bet or less second chance retrigger guarantee.Napoleon 2 slot - free spinsNapoleon 2 FatStacks: Slot VerdictA fair amount of time passed between Napoleon: Rise of an Empire from Blueprint Gaming and Napoleon 2 FatStacks from Lucksome, and a lot has changed. Indeed, a lot has changed between this and FatStacks Miami Cash. Where FatStacks Miami Cash emphasised hitting Luxpots to win rewards from a ladder of prizes, Napoleon 2 FatStacks has a focus on stacking winning symbols during Napoleon Mega Streaks, preferably while loading wilds to bump the multiplier value up. This latter feature creates a neat link between Napoleon 2 FatStacks and the original game, which used a similar, more wilds-more multiplier dynamic, though in a less evolved way as it is here.What unites the two mentioned Lucksome slots is, of course, the FatStacks gaming mechanic, which is a potential Megaways challenger. Working hand in hand with the wild multiplier, FatStacks make a great accompaniment to the sticky snowball effect of a solid Mega Streak run. With 20,000x the bet to play for, Napoleon 2 FatStacks certainly has plenty of room to run amok and exciting tools to work with. As a comparison, one thing working in Megaways' favour is that its effect is immediately apparent, not to mention active on every single spin. Dropping FatStacks on each spin would possibly mess with the maths fair dues. But lowering the frequency that FatStacks appear makes them more of a special side feature rather than a main event mechanic running the show. A good one that is able to gel well in Mega Streaks.All in all, Napoleon 2 FatStacks makes for an excellent progression in the Napoleon series, being a more modern experience in practically every regard. Of course, players who preferred the classic feel of Blueprint Gaming's Napoleon slot might feel a little frigid at all the new-fangled gadgetry this new one tosses in. But, broadly speaking, advanced weaponry can provide an edge in combat, so players interested in pounding the battlefield with some of the latest goings on in slot design can get a taste of that in Napoleon 2 FatStacks."

title: Luck of Ra

review: 4,"Luck of Ra: Slot OverviewSlotting into the growing 'book of' with a twist sub-genre comes Luck of Ra from Microgaming partner Plank Gaming. Luck of Ra utilises expanding symbol free spins as its central feature, plus a few extras, including a couple of Modes to play around with. For those in the mood for some bantamweight Ra-inspired action, and want a bit of novelty at the same time, Luck of Ra could be the go. Let's check out if it's the right fit.After sitting through a load screen focusing on the falcon-headed god Horus, players are whisked to an Ancient Egyptian setting. Instead of pyramids we get two titanic statues flanking the reels; their size can be determined by trees which are dwarfed in the foreground. On the mathematical side of things, expect high volatility coupled with a somewhat low hit rate of 16.91%, but decent 96.06% RTP. It offers a shallow range of stakes starting at 10 p/c on the lower side, rising to $/€10 at the upper end.Where Luck or Ra starts to diverge is via its three different modes - including a Standard Mode which is the normal way to play. The others are Super Mode and Mega Mode - both disable the 5 reels from spinning when activated. Instead, when in Super Mode, hitting the play button spins a needle on a tiny wheel with red and green segments. If it lands on green, the reels synchronise for one spin. If in Mega Mode, landing on the green segment triggers free spins. All modes have the same spin cost.Line wins occur when two or three identical symbols land on a payline, starting from reel one. They definitely don't possess the value of the upper echelon 'book of' slots. High pays consist of just three symbol; Anubis in jackal form, a Pharaoh and a Liz Taylor-like queen. These symbols need only two to pay out, giving you 20 to 30 times your stake for five of a kind. Lower down the scale are 10-A card royals worth 5x to 10x the bet for five of a kind. The most lucrative symbol is actually the Horus wild. It substitutes for all symbols except the scatter, worth 75x for a combination of five.Luck of Ra: Slot FeaturesLuck of Ra - free spinsAs well as the extras Modes to tinker around with, other features include synced reels, mega symbols and free spins. Synced reels happen at random either in the base game, free spins or from getting lucky in Super Mode. Any 3 adjacent reels will synchronise and spin with the same symbols. Mega Symbols pop up at random as well. These are 3x3 sized symbols which can land partially or fully in view.Free spins are triggered from a successful Mega Mode spin or when one of the scroll symbols is fully in view. This results in 8 free spins. Before free spins begin, 2 different symbols are chosen to be special expanding symbols. If these symbols are present anywhere on the reels and there are enough to trigger a win, they expand to cover all positions on their respective reels, paying all ways. This process occurs after any regular wins are paid. The bonus can be extended too if a 3x3 sized scroll lands fully in view to award 8 extra free spins.Finally, one more way of accessing free spins is via the bonus buy. This method costs 85x the total bet, shifting the action straight to the special symbol selection screen when selected.Luck of Ra: Slot VerdictAs mentioned, Luck of Ra can be nutshelled as a 'book of' style slot with a twist, or two. Some of the twists are definitely worth trying before buying though. It's nice to see studios trying something new, but it's unclear how popular some of these extras will be. We are referring specifically to the Modes, with mixed feelings about both non-Standard options. The Super Mode is arguably the least exciting since all you get is one spin of the synced reels feature when you win, which may or may not even produce a payout.Even Mega Mode's prize of free spins can be tiresome as there is a very real chance you'll end up spending more money bashing the spin button than you would have done just shelling out the 85x and cutting to the chase. Of course, you might get lucky on the first Mega Mode spin, who knows? However, Mega Mode and Super Mode tended to be more trouble than they were worth in testing, not to mention dull since you're squinting at a tiny wheel, rooting for a needle the whole time. Each to their own of course.As to potential, there are no official figures, yet Luck of Ra doesn't come across as a big win game. A dead giveaway is that the most you can win from a single spin is 750x the bet, and that's if 15 wild symbols miraculously land which doesn't seem like it's going to happen any time soon. One pinprick of hope is wilds can be selected to be special expanding symbols in free spins. Still, wins in Luck of Ra are nothing to write home about at the best of times.Overall, Luck of Ra is a game that will struggle to satisfy higher end 'book of' fans of games like Book of Dead. The two slots are competing in completely different divisions. It's like Muggsy Bogues trying to dunk on Shaq; it ain't going to happen broheme. Luck of Ra's core gameplay produces some bite-sized 'book' moments, but the extra Modes are a little dubious."

As if all that cash wasn't enough, he's now done a deal with Swedish workaholics Play'n GO for a branded slot using his name and imagery. Nyjah Huston - Skate for Gold doesn't just use his name, animated Nyjah's turn up all over the place, integrating with a range of features.Nyjah hails from Southern California which is where the game is set. The face shot is the most valuable since 5 on a line add up to a 25x win.Nyjah Huston – Skate for Gold: FeaturesNyjah Huston - free spinsGetting Nyjah to do his thing is the key to much of the games features, such as Combo Meter Tricks, Wildboard Respins, and SKATE free spins. On any base game spin, the Combo Meter may become active. This meter shows up above the reels, displaying a trick. If the corresponding trick symbol appears anywhere on the reels, then a Wildboard Respin is triggered.During a Wildboard Respin, two wilds plus one expanded wild (which covers a full reel) is added to help hit a winner or two. It is possible for the expanded wild to turn into a special Golden Wildboard bringing into play a multiplier of x2, x3, x5, or x10. Wilds can substitute for any other symbols except golden SKATE symbols. Also, a line of 5 wilds is worth 40 times your stake.Lastly is the free spins round. The current set of tricks is then reset with a new batch.It is possible to trigger SKATE free spins and a Wildboard Respin on the same spin. In this case, the Wildboard Respin plays first before transitioning to the free spins.Nyjah Huston – Skate for Gold: VerdictThere is always a danger when corporates use a subject like skateboarding. Perhaps not so much nowadays where it feels like everything has been corporatized and nothing is sacred - but back in the day more so. The risk is doing something that smacks of cashing in on a pastime that, for many, should remain pure. Of course, 'pure' is an extremely subjective word.So is Nyjah Huston – Skate for Gold a cynical cash grab by a board room of suits trying too hard to be hip, or is it all just a harmless bit of fun? Well, we'll let you decide. For now, let's stick to judging Nyjah on its slot merits and whether or not it's a good game.There are moments for sure, but Nyjah doesn't completely shake off the corporate taint. The game also suffers from Play'n GO-itis. This is where a competent, above-average slot, might have been outstanding if more time, passion, or love had been poured into it. Perhaps Nyjah Huston- Skate for Gold did get the full treatment, but it's hard to imagine, considering how frequently Play'n GO release slots.Of course, high frequency doesn't automatically equate to low quality, and somehow the Play'n GO wizards manage to consistently produce solid games. But a project like Nyjah Huston could have been all-time in the hands of a skate fanatic. For an action sport themed slot, however, Nyjah Huston comes out on top when directly compared to Yggdrasil Gaming's Nitro Circus slot, even if not as daring in its execution.As things stand, Play'n GO has pushed out another playable slot, with decent features, and potential. Nyjah Huston is unlikely to appeal to 'core gamblers since it’s far less volatile than their slots tend to be. This makes it one for skate/ Nyjah fanatics, or those who gamble in metaphorical knee pads perhaps."

title: Friends
structured_summary:
1. Friends is a slot themed around the iconic TV show, featuring characters and memorable symbols from the series.

review: "Friends IntroductionDo you remember when WMS was a respected developer creating some of the best slots ever made? Remember Montezuma and Raging Rhino? That was a long time ago. Nowadays, this former American pinball producing company is owned by SG Gaming, and it's been on a steady decline ever since. It's hard to remember when they last came up with a decent slot, so when we heard the news of WMS releasing a branded slot we didn't accept to review it because we thought it was going to be great, we already had a feeling it wouldn't, but because the branding itself might attract some interest. After all, that's how we single out slots to review since we can't possibly review them all.The first thing you will notice when firing up this thing is the somewhat unusual design. You have the reel set in the middle of the screen, which seems unnecessarily small, and a whole lot of space on the sides. Part of the explanation lies in the fact that it's based on the physical cabinet machine version that's been around for a few years now. The group photo on top of the reel set serves as a ""tv-screen"" where you'll see cutscenes from the series as well as an interactive bonus wheel.As exciting as it may seem to some, the setup is nothing out of the ordinary. This is a 5-reel, 4-row slot with 40 fixed paylines. Players can bet between €0.50 and €100, making it unsuitable for many low-rollers unfortunately although they're not really missing out on anything. It comes with loads of features, and we'll go through them all one by one, but the developers have definitely overworked things here even if the focus is more on entertainment rather than potential.As you would expect, the original theme ""I'll Be There For You"" by Rembrandts is playing on loop in the background. It's an instrumental version so you'll be able to sing along to it whilst losing your money. We found it a bit exhausting after a few minutes, however, and had to turn down the volume. Maybe we're just getting old.Visually, it's quite mediocre. You have the New York skyline serving as backdrop and the gameplay itself is a bit choppy as you have to wait a second between every spin. Particularly annoying as it also happens with every single low paying win which you can't skip past.Friends Symbols & PaytableSymbols on the reels include a Central Perk coffee cup, Phoebe's acoustic guitar, the Central Perk coffee house logo, Joey's ducks, the turkey Monica once wore on her head, Monica & Chandler talking on the phone, Ross & Rachel making out, the three guys (Joey, Chandler and Ross), all three ladies (Monica, Phoebe and Rachel) and all six cast members. The latter is the most lucrative giving you 0.80 times the stake for 5 on a payline.A wild symbol is also included represented by all the Friends which replaces all symbols except the Bonus Wheel symbols and the Jackpot Wild. 5 wilds on a payline will give you 10 times your stake. Should you land a full stack of Jackpot Wild symbols on reels 2, 3 and 4, you will trigger the 2000x Jackpot.There is also a Mystery Stacks feature that comes into play in both the base game and the free spin features. What it does is that it acts as a replacement symbol to enhance the winning potential. Since the main game potential is excruciatingly low, however, you will barely even notice a difference.Friends Slot FeaturesBonus WheelIf you decide to play this awful slot you need to understand that you will have to trigger the Bonus Wheel to be able to get anything out of it at all. Now, landing the fully stacked Bonus Wheel symbols on the three middle reels required to trigger the wheel is not easy, and it often took us a ridiculous amount of spins. Even then you're not guaranteed to get a bonus has half of the entries on the wheel are nonsense cash prizes. If you do, however, this is what you can look forward to:Thanksgiving Bonus - 10 free spins with a x3 multiplier.Wedding Bonus  -  10 free spins with sticky wilds.Party Bonus - 11 free spins with walking wilds that expand to cover one or two reels.Bamboozled Bonus - Picking bonus with potential to trigger a 2000x jackpot.Friends ConclusionWhile the show was great, the slot is most definitely not. Some review sites will likely recommend all fans of Friends to ""give it a try"", but we say hell no. If you're a fan, save your money and by a Rachel poster or a Friends coffee cup. Don't even think about giving it a spin unless you desperately want to sing along to the instrumental, which you can do in demo mode.The game is choppy, slow and the payouts are weak to say the least. There is no single good reason to play this awful thing, neither as an online slot or in a live casino environment. I guess you could say we're no friends of Friends."

title: WWE Legends Link & Win
structured_summary: WWE Legends Link & Win is a pro wrestling-themed slot featuring iconic WWE superstars and a stadium atmosphere. review: "October 19, 2021",6,"WWE Legends Link & Win: Slot OverviewPro wrestling is one of those activities that gets stranger the more you think about it. Get a bunch of oiled up men in tights grappling with each other, throwing each other around a ring, leaping off the top rope, with the aim of three counting their opponents on the mat. By the way, it's all fake, the outcomes of each fight planned and choreographed. A lot of people just don't get it. However, many do, and pro wrestling is huge. Few leagues are bigger than the WWE, or World Wrestling Entertainment, headed by showman extraordinaire Vince McMahon, who at last count was worth $3 billion. WWE is a big business, full of even bigger personalities. Four of the most memorable wrestlers of all time have made their way into a slot from Microgaming partner All41 Studios titled WWE Legends Link & Win. As well as wrestling stars, the game comes with features such as free spins, Link&Win, and HyperSpins.Set in the middle of a stadium full of spotlights and cheering crowds is the game's 5-reel, 3-row, 20 payline game grid.
