review: 2022",8.5,"MexoMax!: Slot OverviewAs Fred Durst asked in the Gen-X jingle My Generation –'Do you know where you are? Welcome to the jungle…' The Limp Bizkit front man's greeting is as good as any other to welcome players to MexoMax!, an online slot its maker describes as a 'Mayan quest deep into the Aztec jungle'. MexoMax! is an addition to Yggdrasil's collection of MultiMax slots and the first of them to use a cluster paying mechanic for generating wins. As well as cascades creating wild symbols, each reel can have its own multiplier, and when more than one is used in a win, they multiply each other's values. In other words, like its predecessor, MexoMax! is capable of going all sorts of bananas in the right circumstances. Let's see how it works.On the subject of predecessors and sibling slots, MexoMax! shares a similar graphical look to both Multifly! and Raptor DoubleMax. That means players land in a verdant outdoor spot full of exotic flowers, shivering plant life, and if snakes give you the willies try not to look at the right side of the screen where one slithers through the undergrowth on practically a never-ending loop. If Yggdrasil was going for a mysterious angle, they've achieved it, not just with the vibrant graphics, but the music also adds a slight sense of menace to the scene.MexoMax! slot - base gamePlonked in the middle of it all is the game's 6-reel, 6-row panel, which displays 36 symbols on each new drop. Normal spins cost 20 p/c to $/€100 each, though there may be a chance of activating the Golden Bet as well. The Golden Bet increases the stake by 25% to have extra scatter symbols present on the reels, increasing the chance of entering the bonus round. A 'Super High' volatile game, MexoMax! comes in several RTP forms, with 96% being the highest. At this level, hits come at a frequency of 21.28%, occurring when five or more matching symbols are adjacent to each other in vertical or horizontal directions.There are parts of Mayan or Aztec culture that were, well, a bit macabre by modern standards, and there is a hint of this in MexoMax!'s paytable. Mainly the wild as it depicts a beating heart, pulsating when it sits on the reels. Wilds substitute for any pay symbol and raise the reel multiplier by +1, more on this in a moment. The regular pay symbols consist of four lower value stone carvings and four higher value facial objects. Landing five of a kind wins are worth 0.25 to 1.5 times the stake, all the way up to 4-9.25x the bet for 14+ matching symbols. Lastly, the Chest is a bit of a random one. When Chest symbols land, they award a cash win, wilds or even free spins.MexoMax!: Slot FeaturesMexoMax! slot - free spins gamble wheelMexoMax! is a game where features trigger other features which feed each other to potentially produce better results. The first one to tackle is the Dropdown feature, which removes winning symbols from the grid, letting new and existing symbols fall down to fill any gaps. If another win is created after the symbols drop, the feature triggers again until no new win occurs.Wilds and MultipliersDuring a Dropdown, a wild symbol is placed in an empty space before the gaps are filled, and the Reel Multiplier above it increases by +1. Multipliers are applied to any future wins on that reel, and when more than one Reel Multiplier is part of a win, the values are multiplied. Multipliers reset between paid spins.Free SpinsLanding 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols in the base game awards 7, 9, or 11 free spins, respectively. They don't start straight away but instead allow players to gamble on a wheel to win more if the gamble is successful or lose the lot if not (up to 18 free spins). During free spins, Reel Multipliers do not reset until the feature ends. If you'd prefer to buy free spins and the option is there, the cost for doing so is 75x the bet for at least 3 scatters to land or 125x the bet for 5 scatters (11 free spins).MexoMax! slot - free spinsMexoMax!: Slot VerdictAt this point in time, it would be hard to say that MultiMax slots are flying off the production line in great quantities, yet they do tend to be good when they arrive. Multifly! led the charge back in early 2020, and partner studio Bulletproof Games had a crack with the mechanic in Crystal Falls MultiMax, which had its charms but was hampered by one or two limitations. Raptor DoubleMax, by comparison, is like the bigger, older cousin of the group, who knows a bit more about how the world works. Multifly! and Raptor DoubleMax were rock steady releases that could weave multiplicative magic, and so can MexoMax! when its jungly bits are firing.It goes without saying, but Reel Multipliers multiplying each other are the key to MexoMax! Don't get us wrong, this doesn't always happen, yet it was astonishing how a bonus round could roll through a few poor spins, then rack up a set of Reel Multipliers before bringing them together to produce something decent. Individual Reel Multipliers never really rose to great heights during testing, but the power is in combining them where their cumulative effect can be surprising. MexoMax! doesn't have the same march of the multiplier effect that Raptor DoubleMax has, and max win bears this out. Where the dino one could reach 20,000x the bet, MexoMax! taps out at the lower yet still desirable level of 10,000 times the stake.It's a little peculiar that more than two years passed between Multifly! and MexoMax!, with a break in between them by Crystal Falls Multimax. You might think such a potent tool in the Yggdrasil arsenal would've seen the light of day more often. Well, the drought has eased, and the result is a thumping good Mayan/Aztec-themed slot which demonstrates again how exciting stacked multipliers can be."

title: Stockholm Syndrome
structured_summary: Stockholm Syndrome is a crime-themed slot inspired by the 1973 hostage crisis in Stockholm, exploring the unusual psychological bond between captor and captive. review: 2024",7,"Stockholm Syndrome: Slot OverviewIn August 1973, convicted criminal Jan-Erik Olsson attempted to rob Kreditbanken at Norrmalmstorg Square in Stockholm, Sweden and ended up holding four employees hostage. It was the first crime covered by live TV in Sweden, and in an unusual turn of events, when the hostages were released, none of them testified against their captors (Olsson and friend Clark Olofsson) but instead raised money for their defence. And so was born the term 'Stockholm syndrome', to describe a positive psychological bond a captee forms towards their captor. Olsson later said, 'Why didn't any of them attack me? They made it hard to kill. They made us go on living together day after day, like goats, in that filth. There was nothing to do but get to know each other.' With that, we come to Nolimit City's slot, Stockholm Syndrome, which explores this unusual connection between hostage and captor.The last few Nolimit City reviews have been outpourings of colour, from the anarchic Punk Rocker 2, the end of society as we know it Apocalypse, to a back to the neon 90s of Outsourced. Stockholm Syndrome bucks the trend by being quite drab on the colouration side of things. Players get an onlooker's eye view of a bank at night, where law enforcement people have pointed their guns in the hopes of hostages being released and an end to the standoff. The audiovisuals, while getting the job done just fine, aren't the sensory explosion they often are from Nolimit City, nor as monochromatically memorable as Tombstone RIP or Deadwood RIP.Stockholm Syndrome slot - base gameStockholm Syndrome's base game is played on a 3-4-3-4-3 reel area with 432 ways to win. Winning symbols explode off the reels, and new symbols fall in, which provides extra chances to win. In addition, during a game round, a randomly selected character symbol may get a win multiplier of x2, x3, x4, x5, or x10. Above them are 4 hostage character symbols and 1 captor symbol as the highs, worth 0.9x-2.5x for 5 OAK or 2.7 to 7.5 times the bet for 6 OAK. An extra reel is added for Syndrome Spins to explain how 6-of-a-kind wins are possible.Stockholm Syndrome: Slot FeaturesStockholm Syndrome slot - POLIS featureA lot of guns, a lot of crime, and a lot of features are present in Stockholm Syndrome. The latter is made up of Con Man Wilds, xBomb Wilds, the POLIS feature, the SOS feature, the PISS feature, respins, Hostage Spins, Syndrome Spins, and bonus buys.Con Man WildWhen the Con Man Wild lands fully stacked on reel 3, the bottom position of the reel is unlocked and becomes part of the Con Man Wild. A random character symbol (not the highest symbol) is picked, and all instances are transformed into wilds. In the main game, when the Con Man Wild lands partly from the top it is not removed by winning combinations.xBomb WildxBomb Wilds substitute for any symbols except scatters. In the main game, exploding xBomb Wilds remove adjacent symbols except for wilds or scatters, increasing the win multiplier by +1 for the next collapse. All xBombs explode before the next collapse. During bonus modes, xBomb Wilds only increases the win multiplier.POLIS FeatureThis is triggered in the base game only when P, O, L, I, S symbols land in the same row in sequential order. The first four positions get locked coin values of 5x, 10x, 25x, 100x, 250x, 1,000x, 5,000x, or Max Win. The fifth position can get up to 3 keys. Each key unlocks one of the locked coin values or the Max Win. All unlocked coin values are added together and awarded.SOS FeatureTriggered when S, O, S symbols land sequentially in the same row. The O symbol transforms into an xBomb Wild. The SOS feature only triggers in the main game when there is no win and no avalanche. In bonus modes, it always triggers.PISS FeatureTriggered when P, I, S, S symbols land sequentially in the same column. All of the PISS symbols transform into xBomb Wilds. The PISS feature only triggers in the main game when there is no win and no avalanche. In bonus modes, it always triggers.Stockholm Syndrome slot - free spinsRespinHitting 2 scatters with no avalanche triggers a respin on the bottom position of the third reel, where a scatter may land.Hostage SpinsLanding 3 scatter symbols in the main game awards 7 Hostage Spins. title: The Haunted Circus
structured_summary: The Haunted Circus is a Victorian-era circus-themed slot with subtle spooky elements and a mysterious atmosphere. review: Out Now,6,"The Haunted Circus: OverviewMalta based developer Hacksaw Gaming rolls out another slot to diversify their portfolio of games. The company that started out creating online scratch cards made a pleasing leap into the slots arena with the charming debut Stick ‘Em. Since then, Hacksaw has really gone large, developing some of the largest fixed jackpots on the market to date. Moreover, their last release, Cubes, turned out to be something of a hit for the studio.Following in this tradition comes The Haunted Circus where its selling proposition is sure to be the huge fixed jackpot. While it might not being the largest, it is still impressive and sure to attract plenty of hopeful punters. So, does the rest of the game measure up, or fade away in comparison?Viewed on a desktop, or mobile on landscape mode, the 5-reel, 4-row grid is seen as if viewed through a mysterious keyhole. That, or you’re getting tunnel vision as you’re slowly blacking out. The perimeter of the screen is blanked out and what you can see looks like an old Victorian-era circus. The kind where strongmen in leopard print tights sporting massive twirly moustaches lift weights over their heads on the tip of a finger.At first, it is a little difficult to detect much haunting. The Haunted Circus isn’t a slot that makes you jump; the creep is more subtle. Actually, there isn’t much spooky stuff going on during the base game at all aside from the eerie music, and symbols which animate into things like eyeballs. The spookiness picks up a bit during the bonus game when the game shifts into another gear. Overall though, the presentation value is high, a little simple initially perhaps, but the combination of unusual theme and fantastic audio does grow on you.For a game boasting some impressive figures, let’s take a look at the more regular stats. Because this is a jackpot slot, brace yourself for an RTP clocking in at 94.83%. It’s low, but not outrageously so, given the top prize on offer. Volatility, meanwhile, is in the medium/high range, Hacksaw themselves rating it 4 out of 5, along with a surprisingly high hit frequency of 36.35%.Getting started in this sinister soiree is done by setting bets that range from 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin. The base game rules see players lining up winning combinations from left to right, starting at the first reel. Any row is fine, providing 1,024 ways to win.The symbols we get to play with are a curious mix of 10-A royals done in a circus/Wild West font that undergo neat transformations when part of winning combination. Four premiums follow, populated by a bearded lady, a green clown, a snake-charming lady, all topped off by a strongman. Values are a little unorthodox since all low pays are worth the same, as are all of the high pays (0.5x – 2.5x).Symbol values are low partly due to the way the wild works. Whenever a wild is used as part of a winning way, it changes into a multiplier of x2, x3, x4, or x5. More than one multiplier can be active in a win too. When this happens, the values are multiplied together instead of added, up to a maximum of 625x. Now let’s see what other features are lurking behind the curtain.The Haunted Circus: FeaturesThe bonus game in actionThe circus might be a laugh, but it’s what happens beyond its borders is the main attraction. Land 3 or more bonus scatter symbols to be taken outside to some gnarly treed environment where you’ll find the bonus wheel.The bonus wheel is made up of 3 tiers offering prizes of increasing value. The tiers award free spins, a cash win multiplier, or an arrow. Land on an arrow and you progress to the next tier. If you hit 3 arrows in a row, then congrats, you have just won the €2.5 million jackpot prize. Triggering the bonus game in the first place carries odds of 1 in 93.If you hit a multiplier, a fixed win is paid, then play moves back to the main game. Hit free spins though, and you return to the reels in free spin mode. Free spin mode adds more wild multipliers and an extra scatter symbol. Land 3 scatter symbols to win 5 more free spins, which can be retriggered up to 10 times. The odds of triggering free spins in the bonus wheel is around 1 in 247.The Haunted Circus: VerdictWell, it’s a long way from scratch cards to producing the largest fixed payouts in the business. The €2.5 million fixed jackpot might not be the very largest, but it’s enough to make you question going into work the next day if you won. That fact on its own is bound to be reason enough for keen jackpot hunters to pull back the tent flap to give The Haunted Circus an optimistic whirl.If your only concern is hitting the jackpot then it might not matter too much what else is going on in the game. That is probably a good thing because the rest of the experience isn’t an overly enthralling one. The base game ticks along with its two win values, and the multiplying wilds are nice, but it’s not super exciting gaming nor very innovative. In fact, The Haunted Circus is probably the most conventional and least quirky game we've seen from Hacksaw Gaming to date.On a more positive note, wins of up to 10,000 times the stake are possible which we have to say is outstanding for a relatively small developer. The Haunted Circus is a real or nothing experience. You either smash it out of the park or have a pretty low key time. In saying that, the potential is pretty stellar and the execution is very strong, so for those only concerned with chasing after dream money, it’s as good an option as any other major jackpot slot."

review: "September 28, 2021",7.5,"Heroes Hunt 2 Megaways: Slot OverviewFor players who appreciate slots with a dose of video gaming or roleplaying mixed in, then 2020s' Heroes Hunt Megaways from Swedish studio Fantasma Games might well have fit the bill. There are no wilds included, but a compass scatter symbol appearing on all reels that will help you trigger the various features.Jackpot Raiders (Yggdrasil Gaming): FeaturesTreasure Hunt Bonus game in actionCentral to the game is the compass scatter symbol. If 2 of them appear in view anywhere on the reels, the Pick-and-Click Chest Game is activated. Here you will be presented with 5 chests and asked to pick one of them. Potential prizes include 20 to 80 coins, Jackpot Free Spins, the Treasure Hunt Bonus game, or 1 random Map towards your Map collection.If you land 3 compass scatter symbols (5 of them will award 500x), on the other hand, you'll trigger the Compass feature in which either the Jackpot Free Spins or the Treasure Hunt Bonus game is awarded. Visually, the compass gives you the impression of there being a 50/50 chance to activate either of the features, but in reality, we found it to be in favour of the bonus game.If you're awarded the Treasure Hunt Bonus game, you'll have the choice to play either as Bear or Sam in this mini-game. Bear is the less volatile option, offering a higher success rate, but lower prizes, while Sam is the exact opposite. Once the feature gets underway, your character will have 3 attempts to cross the river and open the chest you have aimed for. There are 3 levels and each time a chest is opened, the game proceeds to the next level with higher awards on offer. Depending on which character, prizes can include wins of up to 1800 coins (90x), as well as collection maps, and relics.If the Jackpot Free Spins round is activated, 10 spins will be played with a 3x multiplier. Most importantly, however, it's about collecting 5 gems of the same colour to trigger one of the 5 jackpots.Pay attention to the Map spaces below the reels. There are 5 different maps to collect: the Summit Shrine Map, the Highland Gate Map, the Jungle Ruins Map, the Desert Tomb Map and the Templar Grave Map. Each Map only appears on its own reel and pertain to the fixed jackpot prizes above the reels. All new players get 2 Summit Shrine Maps and 1 of all the other maps to start their journey with. These maps can also be collected in the Treasure Hunt Bonus game and the Pick & Click Chest game. When a collection is filled with 5 matching maps, the Jackpot Free Spins is triggered with one gem head start towards that reel's Jackpot collection.Significantly harder to trigger is the Sunken City Free Spins game which requires you to collect 5 relics in the Treasure Hunt Bonus. The rewards, however, are much higher - instead of a 3x multiplier, you get a 10x multiplier. Furthermore, you also get one of each gem head start added to the collection to increase your odds of triggering the jackpots.Finally, and being a jackpot slot, most importantly, we have the 5 Jackpots which you can land in the Jackpot Free Spins round only. It should be mentioned that the probability to win the Jackpot in each spin is proportional to your bet size. The jackpots are progressive and always have the following starting values:Forgotten Jackpot - €40Rare Jackpot - €200Mythical Jackpot - €600Ancient Jackpot - €1 500Legendary Jackpot - €15 000Jackpot Raiders (Yggdrasil Gaming): Final VerdictWith all the features included in the game, it's easy to forget that it's primarily a progressive jackpot slot. To play it as a regular slot, however, is useless as the payouts are extremely low, so unless you're in it to win it, you'd be better off playing a non-jackpot slot. Then again, that is an obvious point to make and one that could be made for nearly every progressive jackpot slot out there. Not counting the jackpots, the most you can win is 600 times your stake per single spin in the regular free spin feature and 2000 times your stake in the Sunken City Free Spins game, although just to trigger it could be considered somewhat of a feat in itself. In the end, all the features are just smoke and mirror to entice you to help fill up the progressives.While the overall production quality is high and the game appears well balanced, we eventually grew a bit tired of the repeated Treasure Hunt Bonus animations with its usesless prizes, leading us to click frantically all over the screen to skip it. The Free Spin feature is much more rare and usually pays nothing while often teasing you with close call jackpot triggers, so be prepared to get burnt.Both Holmes & the Stolen Stones and Ozwin's Jackpots seems to have worked well for Yggdrasil, two games we personally tend to avoid. The rare times we're struck by a sudden onset of jackpot mania, we usually tend to go for the classic massive ones such as Mega Fortune and Mega Moolah, but with the growing number of jackpot slots available on the market, it's getting increasingly hard to make a choice. Jackpot Raiders might get a few spins here and there, but there are far more interesting, fun and better built options out there in our humble opinion."

title: Tippy Tavern
structured_summary: Tippy Tavern is a cheerful leprechaun-themed slot featuring classic Irish symbols like clovers, harps, and pots of gold. Its key features include coin collection with a Coin Booster multiplier, free spins with scatter-triggered extras, and a hold & win Happy Hour Bonus round. The reviewer finds the game enjoyable but notes it is a close clone of Snowborn's earlier slot Pile 'em Up, offering familiar mechanics without major innovations. Visually, the game sports Snowborn's simple, friendly graphics and upbeat audio that suit its lighthearted tavern atmosphere.
review: 2023",7,"Tippy Tavern: Slot OverviewTop of the morning to you players; here's a jolly ol' online slot from Games Global partner Snowborn, full of all sorts of coins, leprechauns and other assorted larks. The name of the game is Tippy Tavern, which does have a chipper ring to it indeed. It's also a clone of a prior Snowborn game going by the name of Pile 'em Up. If you've played that one, you'll be aware of the coin symbols collection feature, free spins with more coin collecting, and a hold & win round called The Happy Hour Bonus. If you haven't, well, why not come hit the tavern to see what it serves.Snowborn had been on something of a cuteness binge for a while, releasing games like Cat Clans, Cats of the Caribbean, and Peaky Pigs. This one doesn't feature animals, though it does headline a leprechaun; presumably, his name is Tippy, but don't quote us on this assumption. It also has a stack of iconography that often appears in a leprechaun game, namely beer, pipes, clovers, harps, and pots o' gold. The visuals have a trademark Snowborn amiable simplicity, are easy on the eyes and are cheerfully arranged. A positive, if somewhat cliched, first step is successfully achieved.Tippy Tavern slot - base gameAfter busting out the magnifying glass and having a close peep at the stats, we couldn't find anything that differed from the mould slot Pile 'em Up. Not a terrible thing since the max RTP comes in at 96.22% (though lower configurations are available), whereas the math model would suit players who like things on the highly volatile side. Some of Tippy Tavern's features are saved at current bet levels, so maybe spend a little extra time working out the appropriate stake where options range from 20 p/c to $/€30 per spin.Tippy Tavern is played on a 5-reel, 3-row gaming matrix with 20 paylines. It is possible for regular pays to create wins of three to five-of-a-kind in length, and the lower four on the table are purple, blue, green and red bottle caps with J, Q, K, and A on them paying 1-3.75x the bet for a line of five. Next are more traditional items - a pipe, four-leaf clover, harp, and a dice worth 12 to 20 times the stake for five-of-a-kind. Wilds pop up in the base game and free spins. They are on all five reels and either substitute for any pay symbol or create wins of their own up to 111x the bet for five wilds on a line.Tippy Tavern: Slot FeaturesTippy Tavern slot - bonus roundTippy Tavern comes with several happy hours, so to speak, in the form of Coin Symbols & Collect, Coin Booster, Free Spins, and an actual Happy Hour Bonus round.Coin Symbols & CollectCoin symbols land in the game with values of 0.2 to 50 times the bet. If coin symbols land at the same time as a collect symbol on reel five, their values will be awarded.Coin BoosterThe Coin Booster is a multiplier that starts at x1. Whenever a 1UP frothing beer mug symbol lands, it increases the Coin Booster up to a limit of x10. When coin symbols are collected, as noted above, the Coin Booster is first applied to their total value before being awarded. After coins have been paid out, the Coin Booster resets to x1. The Coin Booster multiplier is stored per bet level and is available in all facets of play.Free SpinsThe scatter symbol appears on reels 1, 3, and 5. Landing all 3 of them triggers 9 free spins, and the current Coin Booster multiplier is moved over. While the feature is running, landing 2 or 3  scatters gives players +3 or +9 extra free spins. All coins in the round are collected in the Respins Pot, and when the round ends, players get a chance to win the total Pot value multiplied by the Coin Booster.Happy Hour BonusCollecting a bonus symbol on each reel over several spins triggers the Happy Hour Bonus, with the current Coin Booster moved over. Bonus symbol collection is also stored at the bet level. The feature comes with 3 initial spins, which reset when a symbol lands. Coins stick to the reels until the feature ends, but 1UP symbols are not sticky. When the spins have been used, the total value of the sticky coins has the Coin Booster applied and paid. If all positions are filled, the round ends, but all coins are transformed into 50x coins. The total value then has the Coin Booster applied and awarded.Tippy Tavern slot - free spinsTippy Tavern: Slot VerdictWhat is this, the season of the clone? Seriously, at the time of reviewing Tippy Tavern, it felt like every second or third review was of a copy, clone, or reskin. Tippy Tavern is one of the purest clones of the lot, as just about everything about its predecessor Pile 'em Up has been copied over, barring the audio-visuals. It didn't make Tippy Tavern a chore to play as such, though it might have been nice if Snowborn had rammed in something new to freshen the gaming up a bit, add a bit of curiosity to the second go around, and all that.What's here is pretty good, though, and there's plenty going on as well. Instead of just having a straight coin collection feature, building a Coin Booster Multiplier adds a dimension and, hopefully, better wins in the process. The same applies to the Happy Hour Bonus, as the Coin Booster helps expand it too. Not to extraordinarily great lengths, neither this nor the last slot are major groundbreakers, but they are fun, with winning potential of 7,500x the bet. Neither slot is exactly an all-timer, yet there's a light-hearted warmth to them, which is easy to go along with. Tippy Tavern is arguably the more crowd-focused slot due to its theme choice.All up, Tippy Tavern was no less fun to play than Pile 'em Up was, which is kind of a given since it's a straight reskin. However, if leprechauns are a personal fave, and judging by the number of leprechaun slots on the market, there must be quite a few enthusiasts, then Tippy Tavern might just pip Pile 'em Up in the enjoyment stakes."

title: Sword of Ares
structured_summary: Sword of Ares is a mythologically themed online slot centered on the Greek god of war, featuring Ancient Greek imagery and a cloudy, ancient architecture backdrop. The game includes tumble mechanics, scatter pays, bomb symbols, and a unique multiplier collection system unlocking multipliers by collecting winning symbols. The reviewer finds it a satisfying follow-up to Gates of Olympus, with effective mechanics and an extended win cap of 10,000x the bet, though not radically original. Ares is animated beside a plain 6x5 grid, set in a dreamy realm with mossy columns, complemented by fitting thematic audio.
review: 2022",7.5,"Sword of Ares: Slot OverviewStrap on some sandals, sharpen your blades and prepare to take on Sword of Ares, a mythologically minded online slot from software provider Pragmatic Play. The studio is no stranger to the mythological side of life, and in fact, Sword of Ares is a follow-up to an earlier game titled Gates of Olympus. Like its predecessor, Sword of Ares is full of Ancient Greek imagery and uses a scatter pays system to award wins alongside growing multipliers. However, the way multipliers are unlocked is different than before. Is it better? Let's see if we can find the answer.Like Gates of Olympus, the main character in Sword of Ares stands by the reels, quite animatedly actually, when certain events happen on the grid. In this game, the main character is Ares, the Greek god of war (amongst other things) and the son of Zeus and Hera. Ares is hanging out in a cloudy realm that's arguably not as celestial as Gates of Olympus but is a dreamy one full of mossy columns and ancient architecture. The six-reel game grid is quite plain by comparison, though; maybe some sort of pattern will be added later, like Gate of Olympus had to break up the monotony.Sword of Ares slot - base gameStatistically speaking, the return to player value has taken a knock compared to the previous game, though not drastically so. Available in three RTP settings, the highest being 96.4%, and functions with a highly volatile math model which Pragmatic Play has rated 5 out of 5. There are two ways of playing the game, the normal default mode or by buying free spins. In the first instance, individual paid spins can be wagered on for 20 p/c to $/€100, and any device may be used. When buying free spins, the RTP drops slightly, to 96.39%.Sword of Ares makes use of a scatter system where wins are formed when at least 8 matching symbols land anywhere on the 6x5 game grid. On the lower paying side, five gems appear, whereas the highs are swords, shields, chariots, and helmets. Clusters of 8-9 of a kind pay 0.5 to 8 times the stake, rising to 2-40x the bet for clusters of 12-30. Wild symbols do not land on the board at any time.Sword of Ares: Slot FeaturesEach winning cluster triggers the Tumble feature. This mechanic removes all winning symbols from the reels, letting symbols from above drop down to fill the empty positions. If a new cluster win hits after the symbols have filled the gaps, they are removed and replaced as well. When no new cluster win occurs, the sequence ends, and the total win is paid.Multiplier Collection FeatureSword of Ares comes with multipliers, but the way they function is different than before. On top of the reels is a meter displaying 3 multiplier values in the base game, 6 values in free spins. These multiplier values start each new spin in a locked state. Following tumbles, the number of winning symbols or exploded symbols is collected. At set collection points, the multipliers are unlocked. At the end of a tumble sequence, the winning total is multiplied by the highest unlocked multiplier. In the base game, this could be:First multiplier – could be x2, x3, or x4, unlocked when 20 symbols are collected.Second multiplier – could be x5, x6, x7, or x8, unlocked when 50 symbols are collected.Third multiplier – could be x9, x10, x11, x12, x13, x14, or x15, unlocked when 100 symbols are collected.Sword of Ares slot - free spinsBombsPresent on all reels are four types of Bomb symbols in the base game and in free spins. When a Bomb hits, it stays onscreen until there are no more winning scatters. Then they explode, removing all symbols from the board in a horizontal, vertical, cross, or X configuration. Removed symbols are collected by the multipliers, and new symbols drop down from above. In the base game, Bombs only explode if at least one tumble has occurred.Free SpinsLanding 4 or more scatters in the base game awards 15 free spins. In free spins, the multiplier meter is extended like so:First multiplier – could be x2, x3, or x4, unlocked when 15 symbols are collected.Second multiplier – could be x5, x6, x7, or x8, unlocked when 27 symbols are collected.Third multiplier – could be x9, x10, x11, x12, x13, x14, or x15, unlocked when 39 symbols are collected.Fourth multiplier – could be x16, x17, x18, x19, x20, x22, or x25, unlocked when 55 symbols are collected.Fifth multiplier – could be x26, x28, x30, x32, x35, x40, or x50, unlocked when 85 symbols are collected.Sixth multiplier – is always x500, unlocked when 235 symbols are collected.If available, players can buy free spins for the cost of 100x the total bet. Whether bought or triggered organically, the bonus round cannot be retriggered.Sword of Ares slot - free spins with bomb symbol in actionSword of Ares: Slot VerdictIf you've played Gates of Olympus, you'll see how Pragmatic Play has left some things the same while tinkering around with others. The changes aren't clear cut better or worse; as such, some things will be a better match perhaps, while others might grate. Having to collect symbols to unlock multipliers for one has more of a goal-based challenge to it than just having random multiplier symbols show up on the board like before. It was hard to decide whether collecting winning symbols, rather than racking up random multiplier symbols as in Gates of Olympus, was better, worse, or simply different. For the curious, this particular method might have to be experienced to form a strong opinion about.In some ways, the bonus game had a faintly 300 Shields Mighty Ways feel to it, due to the Hellenic references and the way you can build multiplier values. Here they reset between spins, whereas in Light & Wonder's game, multipliers have a more persistent quality. Having said that, the intermediate values in Sword of Ares can be quite high, so it is a case of swings, roundabouts, and personal preference. However, this method is clearly effective, and Pragmatic Play has stretched the win cap, pushing it out to 10,000x the bet. Gear up for some crazy tumbling, symbol collections to get to that level.In the end, Sword of Ares was a satisfying scatter-paying game to review. Pragmatic Play has married scatter wins to the tumble mechanic while tying in symbol collections and unlocking multipliers menagerie of mechanics quite well. Sword of Ares doesn't have the same level of fresh originality the first one had, which is understandable, being a follow-up, but the extended win cap and the new bits should be warmly received by players excited by this style of action."

title: Fortune Cats Golden Stacks
structured_summary: Fortune Cats Golden Stacks is a playful, cartoonish slot inspired by cheerful Asian culture and good fortune themes. It features mystery symbol transformations and a bonus with up to three simultaneous 5x4 reel grids, plus a Golden Stacks cloning mechanic. The reviewer finds it average and niche, appealing mainly to kawaii fans, with modest winning potential capped at 2,500x the bet. Visually, it offers bold salmon pink and greenish-blue patterns with cute cartoon vibes, though the cutesiness may overwhelm some players.
review: 5.5,"Fortune Cats Golden Stacks: Slot OverviewTaking a breather from designing slots filled with questing, mythological characters, or battling beasts, Thunderkick turns to a lighter, cuter topic for their online slot Fortune Cats Golden Stacks, a cartoonish game aimed at players with a soft spot for a more playful side of Asian culture. The one where everyone is smiling, happy, and appears to be reaping good fortune. As to features, Fortune Cats Golden Stacks comes with mystery symbol transformations and a bonus game that is played on up to three separate grid matrices.Thunderkick is adept at creating adorable cartoon vibes in their games, and Fortune Cats Golden Stacks pushes this tendency to an extreme. Colour-wise, there's lots of greenish-blue patterning in the background contrasting the bold salmon pink design covering the game grid. This isn't a slot that's trying to cater to the masses; it's aiming for a specific market. If you're into the subject matter, then Fortune Cats Golden Stacks is the slot equivalent of a hug from Cinnamoroll. On the other hand, the amount of cutesiness is bound to hit overload for other players.While three game grids may be available during the bonus round, as you will see, the base game makes do with just one, arranged in a 5x4 formation, holding 40 fixed paylines. Wins occur when matching symbols hit adjacently, left to right, starting from reel number one. With a medium volatile math model running the show, Fortune Cats Golden Stacks produces a default theoretical return value of 96.14%, though alternative RTP versions may be found.Playable from 10 p/c to $/€100, eight regular paying symbols appear on the table, split into four low pays and four high. The lows are metallic looking card ranks – clubs, diamonds, spades, and hearts, followed by mid pay fish, calabashes, and lanterns, then topped by high pay Golden Cats. Rewards for landing five mid to high paying symbols across the reels are 2 to 7.5 times your stake. Lastly, we've got wild symbols appearing on reels 2, 3, 4, or 5 to replace any other regular paying symbol.Fortune Cats Golden Stacks: Slot FeaturesNot much occurs in the base game, other than random mystery symbols, so the focus is on free spins, where players can unlock up to three simultaneously spinning game grids.Mystery SymbolsMystery symbols can appear on any base or bonus game spin and land in any position. Displaying a fan on them, mystery symbols turn themselves and one other randomly chosen pay symbol type to transform into the highest value cat symbol.Bonus GameLanding at least 3 scatter symbols in the base game awards 10 free spins. The more scatter symbols that trigger the feature means more game areas during the bonus. So, when 3, 4, or 5 scatters are in view the bonus round starts with 1, 2, or 3 active game areas, respectively.Even if you start with 1 or 2 game areas, you can collect scatters to unlock more. Collecting 3 scatters unlocks the second game area, while collecting 5 further scatters unlocks the third game area (8 in total). Once additional game areas are activated, they stay that way for the rest of the bonus round. Additionally, each scatter symbol awards an extra free spin, and every time a new game area is activated, +2 extra spins are awarded.When more than one game area is active, a Golden Stacks feature becomes possible. How it works is when any reel completely covered by the highest paying cat symbol hits on one game area, it is cloned and added to the corresponding reel on all other game areas.Fortune Cats Golden Stacks: Slot VerdictUnless you are a hardcore kawaii fanboy or girl, Fortune Cats Golden Stacks is unlikely to generate a whole lot of interest. It is a pretty average game and far from Thunderkick's best. There are sure to be some players who lap up the all-happy, all-smiling, good fortune vibe, which is cool, but it made no great impression on us.The features are as so-so as the presentation. Unlocking multiple game areas seems to be on the rise recently, though it's hardly a widespread phenomenon, so there is still a whiff of novelty when it pops up. The problem in Fortune Cats Golden Stacks is there isn't a huge benefit of having three game areas instead of one. Or better put, there is no major benefit of diluting the gaming across three grids rather than piling more into just a single game matrix and blowing it up instead.There is the Golden Stack feature, of course, and this is a common tactic used when additional game areas are up on the screen. We saw similar tricks being used fairly recently in Brawl in the Red Cap Inn and Alice in Wildland. If you liked either of those games, then maybe, consider Fortune Cats Golden Stacks as Thunderkick has made pretty good use of the concept. Then again, don't consider Fortune Cats Golden Stacks if you're chasing big potential paydays, though. The most players can collect here is 2,500x their bet per game round, no matter how many game areas have been activated or how many Golden Stacks are leaping between them.If you've been battling your way through something heavy-duty, playing Mental or watching Squid Game let's say, Fortune Cats Golden Stacks could be just the light, breezy, jejune activity needed to clear your head before bed. Outside this scenario, Fortune Cats Golden Stacks struggles to appeal."

title: The Ultimate 5
structured_summary: The Ultimate 5 is an African plains-themed slot featuring iconic "big five" animals. It offers Hold & Spin Super Boost and free spins with symbol removals as key features. The reviewer finds it moderately innovative with enjoyable bonus rounds but not a major evolution in the genre. Visually, it boasts bright savannah scenery with a lively soundtrack that adds a physical slot feel.
review: 2022",7,"The Ultimate 5: Slot OverviewOn the outside, a hold & win game set on the African plains doesn't sound like a festering bowl of originality, and for a lot of the time, The Ultimate 5 is pretty average. However, Pragmatic Play has been doing this for a while and has added a few elements that provide a certain measure of novelty. On this savannah sojourn, players bump up against a Hold & Spin Super Boost, free spins with symbol removals, and a pretty neat five animal winning combination extra.The view will be familiar when The Ultimate 5 lights up the screen, where a five-reel game panel takes centre stage in a grassy part of Africa full of trees, a stream, mountains, and the like. On the right are five different prizes that can be won in the Hold & Spin feature, giving the game a slight Wolf Gold feel. Obviously, the setting and animals have been switched up this time around, from wolves to the big five. The Ultimate 5 would be pretty trite, and it still kind of is, but Pragmatic has squeezed in a bouncy physical slot feel through the soundtrack and bright visuals, so there's sure to be appeal for players keen on this style.Numerically, The Ultimate 5 is another stand up Pragmatic Play piece, where a default RTP value of 96.5% gets things off on a positive footing. Note that RTP may be found at lower levels, though volatility remains high throughout. The action takes place on a 5-reel, 3-row matrix providing 20 fixed paylines to win on. This generally happens when three or more matching symbols land from the leftmost side in adjacent reels.Playable from between 20 p/c to $/€100, the paytable is divided between low pay 10-A card symbols and the big five African animals. These are buffalos, rhinos, elephants, leopards, and lions. Landing a line of five low pays is worth a win of 1-2x the bet, rising to 4-20x the bet for five premium symbols. However, players collect a win worth 100 times their stake if all five animals land in any order on a payline. Lastly, an acacia in the sun symbol is the wild, substituting for any pay symbol, though not for the 100x all animal wins.The Ultimate 5: Slot FeaturesTwo bonus rounds have been included with The Ultimate 5. They are free spins where a symbol removal function is used, and a hold & win feature with upgrades.Free SpinsDiamond scatters land on all reels, and having 3, 4, or 5 of them in view awards a payout of 5x, 25x, or 50x the bet plus 8, 10, or 12 free spins, respectively. During free spins, the reels randomly level up by removing the lowest value symbol from them. It is possible to remove all of the low-value symbols after the fifth random level up. Every time a random level up occurs, a wild symbol is guaranteed to hit. On a final note, the bonus game can be extended by landing little diamond symbol overlays. Having 2, 3, 4, or 5 of them in view at the same time awards 2, 4, 6, or 8 additional free spins.Hold & Spin Super BoostIt gets hot in certain parts of Africa for sure, but the burning hot sun money symbol perhaps overstates the intensity? Nevermind, money symbols land on reels 2, 3, or 4 in the base game and all reels during the Hold & Spin feature. Money symbols possess random values of 1-10x the bet or one of the five prize values. These are the Mini, Minor, Major, Maxi, or Mega, worth 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, or 500x the bet. Hitting at least 3 of them triggers the Hold & Spin Super Boost feature where all symbols are removed except the triggering money symbols, which move to the centre of the grid.The bonus game starts with 3 respins, which are reset when new money symbols hit. When a money symbol hits and is adjacent to another money symbol vertically or horizontally, they link to form a group. All existing symbols in the group have their value increased when a new one is added. For example, an 8x becomes 10x, the 10x becomes Mini, a Maxi would become a Mega, and so on.The round continues until respins run out or all positions are filled. Any money symbols that hit but don't link do not pay at the end of the round. If all positions are filled and linked, the value of all money symbols on screen are boosted to the Mega.The Ultimate 5: Slot VerdictAt first glance, The Ultimate 5 doesn't really seem to evolve the genre much, and after playing it for a while, the original assessment still stands. However, The Ultimate 5 does have a few tricks tucked away up its sleeve that connoisseurs might appreciate. This applies to the base game and its bonus rounds, though free spins, which triggered at a noticeably less rate than the Hold & Spin, did tend to be the less exciting of the two.The symbol removal is there in free spins, yet its random nature meant it wasn't as engaging as a collection/upgrade system as found in, say, Pink Elephants. Removals either happen or they don't; there's no real rhyme or reason to them. Also, only low pay symbols may be removed, which can be a good thing if it helps produce five animal 100x payouts. These occurred with greater frequency than originally suspected, though they weren't common by any means, though.The Hold & Spin twist feature could be quite exciting if you can get a good flow of upgrades happening. The ultimate would be filling the board, of course, where all positions become Mega prizes. It's a little odd because technically, a full grid of Megas would be worth 7,500x, but Pragmatic has capped winnings at 5,000x, so the payout would be clipped.The Ultimate 5 ended up being a decent enough slot with an element of novelty going on, despite the mass-produced theme and look. It might be far from a game-changer, but there is value here for players who like a slickly presented Pragmatic Play release with a couple of new-ish ways to win."

title: Serpent Shrine
structured_summary: Serpent Shrine is a fantasy-themed slot set in an ancient forest guarded by a giant snake, continuing Fantasma Games' atmospheric storytelling tradition. Visually, it offers a cartoonish yet slightly sinister style with gnarled trees and glowing flora, accompanied by an enticingly atmospheric environment.
review: Out Now,7,"Serpent Shrine: OverviewWith Serpent Shrine, Fantasma Games has stuck to the fantasy theme that has served them well in their previous releases such as Heroes Hunt Megaways, and Hades River of Souls. review: "May 18, 2021",8,"Tropicool: Slot OverviewIf you work in the travel industry, you'll be used to people coming in asking to be taken somewhere hot. On top of that is ELK's X-iter menu, which provides 5 bonus game modes.The avalanche feature blasts winning symbols off the board, so new ones tumble into the gaps, potentially causing consecutive wins. As all of that is going on, keep an eye on the feature reel located above the reels; when cascades occur, if there is a space below a special symbol on this reel, it drops onto the reels. This could be a regular wild, a wild multiplier of x2-x5, a locked wild which stays on the grid for a set number of wins, or a row swap symbol. The row swap symbol picks one of the symbols (wilds and bonus symbols excluded) in its row and turns all others into the chosen one.The big' B' is the bonus symbols, and when 3, 4, 5, or 6 are in view, players are awarded 10, 15, 20, or 25 free drops, respectively. The build quality is as high as we've come to expect from ELK, meaning crystal clear high-definition graphics, seamless animation, and silky smooth audio. It might be clear from some, but it's just something to be aware of to avoid any potentially costly mistakes.In short, there is nothing overly negative to report about Tropicool, which turns out to be a well-designed, singular game. One of the early video game titans was Donkey Kong, created by Shigeru Miyamoto and released in 1981. The game was a hit and went on to spawn numerous sequels, spin-offs, and franchises; and was the first time Mario appeared on screen before going on to find his own mega success. Tapping into the look and feel of an earlier Donkey Kong inspired age is an online slot called Banana Town from Relax Gaming. Banana Town is a game that uses a scatter pays system in combination with cascades, symbol specific progressive win multipliers, and free spins.Relax Gaming has evoked the spirit of an earlier age of video gaming by using an 8-bit approach to style Banana Town. This isn’t the first time the studio has done so, so we’re guessing someone on the team has a soft spot for classic video games. Similar releases from Relax Gaming have been the Christmas slot Santa’s Stack and the outstanding celebration of all things old-school in Hellcatraz, though the game that might actually have started the trend was Thunderkick with Flame Busters. It means chunkier than normal graphics, jerkier than usual animations, and bleepy sounds. Modern gamers might find it a tad old fashioned, but perhaps not, since games like the Mr Hopp’s Playhouse trilogy, and Baldi’s Basics are popular at the time of writing, all having an old-school flavour about them.Banana Town slot - base gamePlayed on a 6-reel, 5-column panel, Banana Town uses a scatter pay system to generate wins. As long as at least 8 matching symbols are in view, anywhere on the grid, a payout is made, similar to popular games like Sweet Bonanza. Wins occur at a frequency of 18.45%, leading to a total return value of 96.12%, or 96.16%, when buying free spins. Regular bets range from 10 p/c to $/€50 per spin, which should satisfy most players.Normal pay symbols consist of four lower value bananas coloured in blue, green, red, and yellow, plus five gangster looking monkey symbols. Landing 8-9 matching symbols is worth 0.5x for the low pays, rising to 1-4x for the high pays, while 12+ symbol wins pay 2-3x for the lows and 4-12x for the premiums. No wilds are used in Banana Town at any time.Banana Town: Slot FeaturesBanana Town slot - splash screenThe features in Banana Town are quite simplistic and include a progressive multiplier system in the base game, which gets a persistent factor when free spins are active. Firstly though, when a scatter win hits, the winning symbols are removed from the grid and symbols left on the reels fall down to close the gaps. If a new winning scatter is formed, the cascade feature is repeated again until no new win appears. In addition, wins are collected by a meter located on the right side of the grid. Each winning symbol type increases its corresponding win multiplier. The multipliers start at x1 and double after each symbol win, up to a maximum of x64.Free SpinsA total of 8 free spins are triggered when 3 dollar sign symbols land, plus an extra spin is granted for each additional dollar sign in view. While free spins are active, individual dollar sign symbols may add +1 free spins to the remaining amount. One important difference in the bonus round is that each symbol’s win multiplier is persistent, so they do not reset back to x1 as they do in the bonus round.Bonus BuyRather than wait for the requisite number of dollar sign bonus symbols to hit, applicable players can pay 100x the bet to trigger free spins right away. Before bought free spins begin, win multipliers can be randomly increased.Banana Town slot - free spinsBanana Town: Slot VerdictIf you’re keen on a bit of back in the day gaming, then Banana Town should be a delight when it opens up. It doesn’t have the immediate pull Hellcatraz had, and the gameplay isn’t as in-depth either, but the bright, sunny use of the limited colour palette is pleasing to the eyes and no doubt heart-warming as well if you grew up playing video games that looked like this. Donkey Kong is an absolute legend, being a platform-based paradigm shift that boosted both Nintendo and the video game industry as a whole. He sits up there alongside luminaries like Pac-Man, Ms Pac-Man, Mario, Sonic, Pikachu, and Link, as entertainment royalty.In many early video games, figuring out patterns can lead to glorious moments, but until then, the learning curve can be quite frustrating. Do you ever remember playing older games and feeling like they weren’t just difficult, but the console or computer was actively working against you to make you lose? How many controllers have been smashed on the ground in fits of exasperation…? We’re not saying Banana Town has much of a learning curve. On the contrary, it’s a simple game, really. Land wins, build multipliers, and hopefully land more wins to benefit from said multipliers. It can happen in the base game during better cascade sequences, though free spins are where the magic is probably more likely to happen since multipliers are persistent. Hitting the buy free spins option was where frustration was highest, as it seemed rather difficult to end a round with a positive result.Of course, we might have hit a poor run, fair dues, and there were times when a sizable multiplier met with a decent scatter win for a satisfying payout. Banana Town is not one of Relax Gaming’s massive slots, though, with a modest (for them) max win of 10,000x the bet. It also didn’t feel as explosive as other slots they’ve done. In Banana Town, landing 12 or more of the top premium symbols at the same time as an x64 multiplier leads to 768x the bet payout. Few would say no to a hit like that, but again, it’s kind of modest by Relax Gaming standards.The good news is that Relax Gaming standards are exceptionally high, and even if Banana Town might not be one of their key releases, it’s still an enjoyable, potentially exasperating, exploration of an earlier era of gaming with a simple yet at times thrilling set of features."

title: PopRocks
structured_summary: PopRocks is an Asian-themed slot set in a murky underworld with a Fire Tribe kingdom vibe. review: 0.10/30,Out Now,7.5,"PopRocks Slot: OverviewNo, this is not a slot based on the candy that pops in your mouth, PopRocks is the latest title from Hong Kong based studio Avatar UX. A collaboration with Yggdrasil’s Masters Program, PopRocks comes with an intriguing game design based on their new trademarked PopWins feature. It also boasts some pretty big numbers when it comes to both paylines and potential as you will see.Avatar UX creates Asian themed games for the European market, and it shows with PopRocks – more so than with their previous slot, Lilith’s Inferno, despite the characters and the martial arts fighting. Along with expanding reels and popping symbols is innovative game mechanic which plays out like a grid slot at times. Sounds confusing? All will be revealed.The game world is a little like the popular Netflix show Ice Fantasy. If you missed that one, it was a full-blown Asian good vs evil tussle, and PopRocks looks like it's set in the Fire Tribe’s kingdom. It’s a murky underworld with an ominous castle visible through the game’s transparent reels. If you like a high drama soundtrack while you spin, then PopRocks will appeal. It’s like a chase scene from a Disney action movie that will either entertain or annoy. It's worth mentioning, however, that the game still was in development during testing and that there was still some work to be done on the sounds.Visually, PopRocks doesn't exactly arouse awe but it gets the job done even if it has a slight generic feel to it. The grid is expandable and starts with a default 5 reel, 3 row arrangement along with 486 win ways - the game pays both ways which is why you get 243 win ways x 2. To get popping, stakes from 10 p/c up to $/€30 must be set first. One positive stat to mull over in the meantime is a rather generous RTP of 96.8%. Nice to see in a time when RTP is creeping downwards. PopRocks is insanely volatile though and sessions required sitting through stacks of dead and low pay wins until the expanded reels and features were unleashed.Moving on to the paytable, the symbols leave no doubt about the games origins and theme and are split into four categories – low, medium, high, and the appropriately named super high. The lows are a bunch of Asian infused 10-A royals which make up the bulk of the wins. Next up are the medium pays, which are four gems – green, blue, purple, and red. More personality has been injected into the high pays, which include gems clasped by dragons in blue, purple, green, and golden hues. Just one symbol earns the tile of super high and 5 of them are worth 100 times the stake.Low pay symbols are low value indeed, but when the features take off, they can have a huge effect on payout values. Wilds complete the paytable and can substitute for any other pay symbols. One thing to keep in mind is that high and super high symbols do not appear organically from spins, but only from Pops – let’s look at what that means.PopRocks Slot: FeaturesBonus mode in actionPopRocks is a slot that works best when the features are firing on all cylinders. Central is the PopWins feature which is similar to a cascade wins system with a few different rules. Firstly, symbols from winning combos are Popped off the reels, and each one is replaced by two new symbols. Obviously, more space is needed for the extra symbols, so the game extends reels to do so – each reel can expand 7 symbols high at the most.The right hand side of the reels displays the number of current win ways in play while the left-hand side has a multiplier meter that lights up when symbols are Popped. Each batch of 7 Popped symbols increases the multiplier by +1.When each reel has been expanded to 7 rows high, the Bonus Mode is triggered. In this mode, a wild is added to the game, the multiplier increases in increments of +2 rather than +1, and only one new symbol appears from each pop. Also, the win ways hit 33,614 – due to lines paying both ways.PopRocks Slot: VerdictPopRocks brings enough novel features to the party to make it worth checking out. If you like grid slots with high inertia, you might appreciate what PopRocks can do. It’s hard to get going, but once it does, it can power on and on, racking up wins in the process. Without free spins, respins, or any sort of bonus games, it relies solely on its big runs to provide the major thrills and rewards. Because these runs can be quite profitable, the rest of the game tends to putter along not doing a whole lot and when you hit that dry spell, the repetitive low win pop cycles can really test your patience. On the other hand, the fact that the game can skyrocket on any spin and go berserk undoubtedly adds a compelling element.If you don’t manage to get it on a good roll, not much else happens. Symbol values are so low that without a ton of consecutive winners blowing up all of the features, wins remain too small to do anything else expect drain accounts. Even when Pops chain together, you also need the high pay symbols to play their part in getting close to that fabled 72,188x potential. Of course, that is easier said than done.PopRocks is certainly worth a look, maybe a demo to get a feel for what it can do. Avatar UX has done a respectable job overall, it looks ok, plays well, and the features can be quite absorbing. Tread carefully though, PopRocks defines what all or nothing gaming is all about.If you enjoy the PopWins feature, take a look at WildPops which is the second slot from Avatar UX to utilise PopWins."

review: "November 2, 2023",6.5,"4 Fantastic Lobsters: Slot OverviewLobsters huh? title: Tropicool 3
structured_summary:
Tropicool 3 blends a quirky tropical-meets-Antarctic theme set in a snowy Vegas-like environment.  
It features tilted columns, a gravity-driven Avalanche mechanic, Cool Reel with feature symbols, free spins, and multiple bonus buy options.  
The reviewer sees it as a mostly successful fusion of Tropicool and Cygnus mechanics, offering satisfying gameplay with improved win potential.

review: High,0.20/100,"April 25, 2024",7,"Tropicool 3: Slot OverviewSwedish software provider ELK Studios is a creative lot, and one of the more out-there game worlds it has come up with is one originally populated by two birds known as Tony Toucan and Fiona Flamingo. Both were fed up with migrating each year, so they created their own little beachside paradise… in Antarctica. Not sure about the icy weather, but it would be a good place to go if you like avoiding crowds. Tropicool 2 introduced a sloth named Elmo, and we've now got part three in the series to contend with. Tropicool 3 is the name, and it keeps to the cold theme while bringing in a different set of mechanics.We say different, yet the tilted columns of symbols and the gravity effect have been lifted straight out of ELK's Cygnus range. The scene has changed too. There's still loads of snow about the place, and the overall sensorial effect is a chilly one, but it looks like we're in Las Vegas this time around rather than the southernmost parts of the world. No doubt there is a back story that explains everything, except it was not available at the time of review. Players are free to make one up. Maybe Tony and Fiona came to get hitched? Maybe Elmo snaked Fiona away from Tony, and the two of them eloped to Vegas for a shotgun wedding? Hey, feel free to go wild with the story.Tropicool 3 slot - base gameHitting the spin button drops 6 columns onto the grid, each column holding 6 symbols, where there are up to 46,656 connecting paylines. Wins pay when matching symbols are in at least 3 adjacent columns starting from the leftmost side, and an Avalanche feature triggers when wins appear. Tropicool 3 is a medium-high volatile slot, carrying ELK Studios' goto RTP figure of 94%. This return value remains the same whether activating bonuses from the X-iter or straight wagering 20 c to $/€100 per game round.Symbols time, and for low pays, Tropicool 3 has four fruits encased in ice worth 0.25x the bet for 6 OAK, then a lizard, a snake, a scarab, and birds icons as the higher paying symbols. Hitting 6 matching high pays awards 0.5 to 5 times the bet. Two wild symbols appear in the game – regular wilds, and locked wilds, both substitute any regular pay symbols. The difference is a locked wild lasts for 3 wins before it is removed by the Avalanche mechanic.Tropicool 3: Slot FeaturesTropicool 3 slot - free spinsTropicool 3's list of extras includes the Cool Reel, Elmo's Revenge, feature symbols, a free spins bonus game, a super free spins bonus game, and X-iter feature buys.Cool ReelThe Cool Reel on top of the grid has 3 rows with feature symbols, scatter symbols, and empty symbols. Feature symbols are activated when they drop into the main grid. A game round starts with new symbols dropping onto the main grid and new feature symbols sliding in from the right on the Cool Reel. Each winning combination on the main grid is paid, and the symbols (not unspent Locked Wilds) are removed from the reels; then, the remaining symbols drop vertically with gravity. The symbols from the first row on the Cool Reel above the winning columns drop onto the main grid and roll as far left or right as possible. Gravity also applies to the Cool Reel, which gets refilled from the right. Any new wins are paid, and the Avalanche process repeats until no more wins occur.Elmo's RevengeWhen an Elmo symbol reaches the leftmost column, the Elmo's Revenge feature triggers by dropping the complete Cool Reel onto the main grid. If the Elmo symbol ends on the bottom of columns 2-6, it is removed and dropped down again in the column one step to the left if possible.Feature SymbolsThe feature symbols available in the game are these:Multiplier Symbol – increases the win multiplier by x1 to x25 when dropping down from the Cool Reel.Row Swap – replaces payout symbols on a line with the same symbol.Mystery – all reveal a common pay symbol at the end of a drop.Bonus GameHitting 3, 4, 5, or 6 bonus scatter symbols awards players 6, 9, 12, or 15 free spins, respectively. During free spins, the Cool Reel is repopulated with new feature symbols for each free drop, and the win multiplier is sticky between drops. Locked wilds remain on the grid between drops till fully used. Getting Extra Drop symbols from the Cool Reel adds +1, +2, or +3 extra drops. In the base game, when 3 or more scatters are in view at the same time as an Elmo symbol, the super bonus game is awarded. In this round, 1 Elmo symbol is always in play on the main grid.X-iterFrom the X-iter menu, players have access to these bonus modes:Bonus Hunt – 3x the bet buys a game round with more than triple the chance of triggering the bonus game.Locked Wilds – 25x the bet buys a game round with 3 locked wilds dropping on the grid.Elmo's Revenge – 50x the bet buys a game round with a guaranteed Elmo symbol.Bonus Game – 100x the bet.Super Bonus Game – 500x the bet.Tropicool 3 slot - free spinsTropicool 3: Slot VerdictPretty much all of Tropicool 3's features have a familiar ring to them, but ELK Studios has made tweaks and alterations around the edges to bring something relatively new to the table. The gameplay, in general, feels like the studio has sewed together parts of the Tropicool line with parts of the Cygnus range into one odd, oddly good at times slot. Thematically, Tropicool 3 makes for an unusual break from the previous two games, adding quirk to a series that was already pretty out there. Frozen Vegas or a Vegas-like location with Ancient Egyptian overtones, huh? Okay, why not.Shame the animal characters don't really make much of an appearance on the screen or grid like they did in the original release, yet Tropicool fans are compensated by a new way of mechanically experiencing the game. It's not entirely new-new, obviously, since we've seen this mechanism power the Cygnus range. But it gels well with the Cool Reel and the goodies the feature reel is able to unload onto the grid. Elmo's Revenge becomes one of the most desirable outcomes then, and adds fire to the super bonus game since an Elmo symbol is visible the whole time. Yes, the gravity effect can be frustrating when it gravities in annoying ways, yet potentially highly satisfying when chains of symbols plop around the grid just the way you wanted them to. Hitting full satisfaction levels would mean achieving Tropicool 3's maximum winning potential of 25,000x the bet - this is a lot higher than it was in the first release, though the same as Tropicool 2.All in all, the meeting of Tropicool and Cygnus was, for the most part, a success. Each component brings its particular way of tantalising and/or rewarding to the mix, making for not exactly a raging hotbed of innovation but original in that the combination of mechanics gives players hungry for novelty an option to try. Tropicool was a fine game, though the blending of two forms rather than emphasising one or the other, at times, threatened to dilute rather than enhance the final product, losing some individuality in the process."

title: King of 3 Kingdoms

review: 6.5,"King of 3 Kingdoms (NetEnt): OverviewLooking to strengthen their position in the Far East, NetEnt has put together a batch of games with themes they hope will appeal to Asian players. title: Wild Tundra

review: 2022",7.5,"Wild Tundra: Slot OverviewGrab a woolly hat and scarf for this one players, Red Tiger has rewound the clock a few thousand years to when temperatures were decidedly chillier than what they are now. Landing five premiums across the reels pays out 0.6 to 3 times your stake.Wild Tundra: Slot FeaturesYou'll notice Wild Tundra makes do without a wild symbol, relying on things like super symbols, a cascade wins system, and symbol replacements in free spins to pick up any slack.Super SymbolsAll symbols have a super symbols variation that comes with a multiplier based on its size. Only one symbol type may appear in super symbol form on each spin. Super symbols landing in 1x2 size have an x3 multiplier, 1x3 sized tiles have an x5 multiplier, while the 1x4 super symbols have an x8 multiplier.Chain ReactionAny symbols forming wins are removed from the reels, making way for new ones to drop into the gaps. At the start of free spins, one pay symbol (not the mammoth) is randomly selected for the symbol transformation feature. Whenever the chosen symbol hits, it transforms into the mammoth. Moreover, when 3 scatters land during the bonus, +3 extras free spins are awarded, plus one spin for each additional scatter on the reels. Also, another symbol will randomly be selected to transform into the mammoth when it hits. The final good thing about the bonus round is the win multiplier which starts at x1 and increases by +1 following any win up to a maximum of x20.Wild Tundra: Slot VerdictBefore leaping into Wild Tundra, let's mull over the thought that everyone reading this review is directly related through countless generations to the hard men and women who survived the ice age. Assuming that science is correct, of course. The DNA of those brave souls who fought off wild animals, endured hunger, conflict with rival warbands, not to mention the inhospitable weather to thrive and reproduce, still flows through our veins. Weird thought. It's also interesting to wonder what the surface of our planet will be like in the next 40,000 years or so and whether we modern bipeds are up to facing down our own specific challenges, or will we wither away like the untold number of species ground down by nature and the endless competition for survival. Like Bill Hicks said, 'Evolution did not end with us growing opposable thumbs.'Oh yeah, Wild Tundra. You know how Red Tiger casts the net wide with their games, offering low vola/low potential slots up to the gruntier lot, and just about everything in between? Wild Tundra falls on the upper portion of the spectrum, offering big potential on top of a fairly well-equipped vehicle to possibly deliver it. There's nothing particularly sophisticated going on, yet what did occur during testing was rather entertaining. It was also kind of refreshing to play a relatively higher performing slot that didn't need a guidebook to figure out what was going on. It's a simple case of landing super symbols, in conjunction with a cascade feature in the base game, while a win multiplier livens the bonus round. Simple yet satisfying gaming capable of paying out up to 10,484.7x the stake.There is a sneaking suspicion we might not see Wild Tundra's max win hit in this epoch but knowing it's out there somewhere like a last living Dodo offers a level of reassurance. For some ice age era gaming that fired thought processes as much as imagination, Wild Tundra was an enjoyable catalyst."

title: Vikings Go To Vegas
structured_summary: Vikings Go To Vegas transports Viking warriors from ancient conquests to the flashy, neon-lit casinos of modern-day Las Vegas. review: 2025",5,"Vikings Go To Vegas: Slot OverviewSo what's a victorious gang of Vikings going to do to blow off steam after a successful campaign of conquest and pillaging? In the imagination of software provider Yggdrasil, they hit the neon-lit hedonistic pleasure centre of Las Vegas, Nevada, to 'take their biggest gamble yet.' Are they, though? In some ways not, since Vikings Go To Vegas is a reskin of a previous trip abroad in the form of Vikings Go To Egypt, meaning players can expect the same gaming components, just wrapped in contemporary skin where its main characters have been updated for the modern era.Unless you stay at the Luxor, then Las Vegas obviously looks a lot different to Ancient Egypt. Instead of mysterious tombs, temples dedicated to divine beings, and awe-inspiring monuments that have survived the elements for aeons we've got hotels and casinos dedicated to the accumulation of cash and the worship of mammon. Sin City is not to all tastes then, but it appears to have tickled the fancy of the four Vikings who have donned hats and glasses in order to blend in with 21st-century tourists. Vikings Go To Vegas is one of the studio's lower RTP slots, maxing out at 94%, with an even lower return model also available, while the volatility sits at medium. They are J to A card royals on the low side and 4 Viking character symbols on the higher side. Landing a line of 5 matching royals pays 1.6x to 2.8x the bet, while a winning line of 5 matching premiums is worth 6x to 10x the bet. Wilds, or more specifically sticky wilds, are one of Vikings Go To Vegas' critical elements, and they are able to substitute for any regular paying symbol.Vikings Go To Vegas: Slot FeaturesVikings Go To Vegas slot - free spinsVikings Go To Vegas piles on Silver and Golden chests, free spins, Ragnarök Free Spins, Rage meters, Berserk Vikings, and bonus buys.ChestsSilver chests may appear on the fourth reel and contain one of these prizes in the base game - 2x-40x the bet, or 7, 14, or 21 free spins. During free spins, Silver chests may award 2x-40x the bet, +2, +3, or +4 free spins, a wild reel, 1 extra wild, or 2 extra wilds. Moreover, Golden chests appear on the rightmost reel and contain one of these prizes in the base game - 10x-400x the bet, 7, 14, or 21 free spins, Rage Boost +25%, or a Ragnarök Free Spins trigger. During free spins, the Golden chest may award 10x-400x the bet, +2, +3, or +4 free spins, 2 extra wilds, or a wild reel. If a chest lands on a sticky wild, both are active.Free Spins & Ragnarök Free SpinsHitting 3, 4, or 5 scatters awards 7, 14, or 21 free spins, respectively. Before entering free spins, one of the following features is selected: Ragnarök Free Spins, +1 to +3 free spins, an extra sticky wild on the reels, a sticky wild reel, or +5 Silver chests and +5 Golden chests added to the reels.Ragnarök Free Spins may be won from the Golden chest or from the random bonus before regular free spins. In Ragnarök Free Spins, all Vikings are Berserk, so they always turn into sticky wilds.Vikings Berserk ModeWhen a Viking becomes Berserk, they always transform into a sticky wild. Vikings can become Berserk by filling their rage meter or by winning Ragnarök Free Spins.Viking Rage & Welcome RageEach winning Viking combination in the base game collects Rage for its corresponding Viking meter. Bigger combinations generate more Rage. When a Rage meter is filled, players trigger free spins with that Viking in Berserk mode, but no additional free spins bonus is awarded. Viking meters require 700 points to fill, and a 3 OAK win adds 4 points, a 4 OAK adds 12 points, whereas a 5 OAK win adds 36 points. Trigger free spins this way, and they are played at a bet level, which is the average of the bet levels used when collecting the Rage points. When entering Vikings Go To Vegas for the first time, one of the Vikings has its Rage meter filled to more than 50%.Buy Free SpinsPlayers are able to buy 7 free spins for 40x the bet, 14 free spins for 120x the bet, or 21 free spins for 260x the bet. All come with one random feature.Vikings Go To Vegas slot - free spinsVikings Go To Vegas: Slot VerdictVikings Go To Vegas makes you wonder, what would a Viking transplanted from the year 1000 into present-day Sin City make of the whole thing? Would they be stunned into silence by the sensorial onslaught, impressed by our ability to build tall buildings, or be disgusted by what they saw? Or something else? Who knows, but we can have a little ponder about the possibilities while playing Vikings Go To Vegas. One thing you can't do while playing the game is marvel at the brand-new gaming devices since there aren't any. Pretty much everything bar the skin has been bought over from Vikings Go To Egypt, a slot that did not score highly the first time around.One of the downers was the way Vikings Go To Egypt failed to add anything substantial to the series, and this impression is exacerbated by Vikings Go To Vegas being a reskin and all. It's a shame because Yggdrasil came up with a pretty interesting idea: picking a bunch of berserk Vikings off their longships and dropping them into a world that people back then would probably never even have been able to dream about inhabiting. Humorous interactions between peoples of the past and present are sadly absent, and in their place is a glitzy, if shallow, Vegas event.The theme's uniqueness was more exciting than an Egypt repeat, and fans who enjoy collecting enough Rage to send Vikings Berzerk get that, plus a max win of 4,375x in Vikings Go To Vegas. All in all, Vikings Go To Vegas gives the series a thematic twist, but initial interest provided by the bold change of scenery was squandered by the low level of effort poured into the features."

title: Silicon Spinners
structured_summary: Silicon Spinners immerses players in a tech-themed slot inspired by Silicon Valley and its digital innovators.
