review: "March 14, 2025",7,"Silicon Spinners: Slot OverviewSoftware provider AvatarUX's dive into the digitization of life continues with the online slot Silicon Spinners. Made in conjunction with Mr Wu, it joins the likes of Tik Talkers as it explores a world that is blurring the lines between the physical and the digital. In the case of Silicon Spinners, the game shines a spotlight on tech titans who have or are in the process of reshaping life as we know it, either through social networking, operating system dominance, interstellar travel, or shopping online.If you've got a wild tech idea that is screaming to be brought to life, then there are few places like Silicon Valley that let such thoughts manifest in the physical realm, no matter how outrageous. Located in the San Francisco Bay Area, Silicon Valley hosts heavy hitters in the tech industry, such as Apple, Alphabet, and Meta, making it a hub of innovation. For some, this might sound like a modern-day tech Nirvana; for others, it might be considered a major contributor to humanity's slide into mindless, soulless, bent neck, screen staring, zombification. Silicon Spinners sits somewhere between those extremes, using humour rather than condemnation to give the game spirit.Silicon Spinners slot - base gameSilicon Spinners' expandable gaming grid starts each base game spin by landing 3 symbols on each of its 6 main reels. Winning combinations are formed when matching symbols land on 3 or more adjacent reels starting from the leftmost or the rightmost reel, meaning the game pays both ways. The grid is able to reach 6 rows high at the most, where 46,656 ways to win are active. 10 cents to $/€300 may be staked per spin, which runs a highly volatile math model, producing a default RTP of 95.92%-96.07%. In addition, players may activate the ante bet at 1.5x the stake to triple the chance of entering free spins.Nine to Ace card ranks start the symbol hierarchy off as the lows, then 3 symbols of digital bliss or despair are the mediums, followed by 4 parodies of tech titans as the high-pay symbols. Six-of-a-kind winning combinations pay 0.6x for the lows, 1.5x for the mediums, and 2.5x for the highs, bearing in mind that 6 OAKs pay from one side only. Wild symbols may only land on the leftmost and rightmost reels, substituting for any regular paying symbols.Silicon Spinners: Slot FeaturesSilicon Spinners slot - free spinsSilicon Spinners sees the Zap Reel make another appearance, joined by PopWins, Zap Reel Rewards, a gamble wheel, free spins, and Xpress bonus buys.PopWinsEach winning symbol pops off the gaming area and is replaced by 2 symbols, increasing the reel height. This repeats until no new win is created. When reels reach their full height in the base game, 2 free spins are granted. Reels reset to their default size for the start of a new base game spin.Zap ReelOn top of the main grid is a 6-position Zap Reel. The leftmost and rightmost positions start locked, and landing a wild symbol on the leftmost or reel unlocks them for the duration of the spin. The Zap Reel cascades right to left on each spin, landing a new set of symbols, including regular symbols as well as Zap Reel Rewards.Sync Reels - syncs 2 to 4 reels below the feature symbol till the end of the spin, so all affected reels land the same set of symbols.Mystery Reel - affects 1 to 4 reels below the feature symbol, filling these reels with copies of any random regular symbol. If these symbols form a win, the new symbols appearing will also be copies of 1 random regular symbol.Win Multiplier - activates if there is a win below it, adding its multiplier (x2 to x100) to the winning combination that triggered it. Multipliers are multiplied together when combined.Symbol Multiplier - can be any regular symbol with a multiplier attached that applies to matching symbol wins below its position.Bonus & Super BonusThe leftmost and rightmost positions on the Zap Reel are initially locked by Hot Bonus blockers. Landing a wild on the leftmost, rightmost, or both reels unlocks these positions, and any symbol or feature reward can then appear. Bonus and Super Bonus symbols can only appear under the unlocked Hot Bonus blockers. Hitting 2 of them triggers free spins.Gamble WheelBefore playing free spins, it is possible to have a punt on the gamble wheel in an attempt to win more free spins and guaranteed wild symbols. Losing a gamble spin sends players back to the base game.Free SpinsLanding 2 bonus symbols in view triggers 8 free spins. Landing a bonus symbol + a Super bonus symbol in the base game triggers 10 free spins and 1 wild symbol guaranteed to land on each free spin. Landing 2 Super bonus symbols in the base game triggers 12 free spins with 2 wild symbols guaranteed on each free spin.The reels start the free spins round at 4 symbols high, and the progress of unlocking (growing) the reels does not reset between free spins. It only resets to the lowest achieved reel height. In this feature, landing a bonus symbol awards +1 to +3 extra free spins. Landing a Super bonus symbol grants +2 to +4 free spins. Fully unlocking all reels to their full height grants +4 extra free spins.XpressHere is where players may pay 100x the bet to gamble on the wheel, 100x the bet for 8 free spins, or 400x the bet for 12 free spins with 2 wilds guaranteed on each spin.Silicon Spinners slot - free spinsSilicon Spinners: Slot VerdictThese AvatarUX and Mr Wu matchups have so far ended up producing rather imaginative, out-there slots such as FloridaMan and DonKey & the GOATS. As a result, there were expectations that Silicon Spinners would be a bit further out there than how it turned out to be. It definitely has its moments, though. The audio effects are neat, very Nolimit City-ish, and the character symbols have a certain Spitting Image touch to them, which was all very humorous. The game's main audiovisual letdown was the somewhat dull background image, a sizable chunk taken up by a blank tablet screen and brown bits 'n pieces on the sides.Silicon Spinners' gameplay gives the show a boost, though, and the Zap Reel proves its worth once again. AvatarUX has the PopWins, growing reels thing down pat by now, so that combination of mechanics runs about as smoothly as anyone could ask for. Layered over the top are a useful bunch of Zap Reel Rewards, and seeing multipliers able to multiply each other is more thrilling than when they add to each other. Multiplier values can be quite high, too, as is the game's 20,000x the bet win cap, so while Silicon Spinners doesn't attain tech billionaire status, it's fairly up there.All in all, Silicon Spinners turned out to be another entertaining Mr Wu/Avatar UX production. It wasn't as exhilarating as initially hoped for, and the creatively chosen theme ended up a double-edged sword in some ways. On one hand, the funny moments, as well as the overall topic handling, create a humorous atmosphere. On the other hand, the gameplay and mechanics, while totally fine, lacked the sort of killer feature that really reflects the 'move fast and break things' ethos Silicon Valley is famous for."

title: Win-A-Beest

review: Out Now,7,"Win-A-Beest: OverviewThose who go to Africa for hunting or animal watching generally don’t have wildebeests high up on their must-see or must kill lists. Not just that, but all standard symbols are removed to make way for wilds, scatters, wild multipliers and Win-A-Beests land during Beest Mode.Should 3 or more scatters appear in Beest Mode, then Beest Mode Spins are triggered - 3, 4, or 5 scatters awards 4, 6, or 8 Beest Mode Spins respectively. Moreover, scatters remain on the reels where it is possible to retrigger the feature without limit.Win-A-Beest: VerdictWin-A-Beest might not appear as sophisticated as it is at first glance, but there are some pretty nifty features on board. Beest Mode tears up the grid at any time, totally opening the board in the process. Even better is a batch of Beest Mode Spins, increasing the chances of a metaphorical stampede occurring. Stampeding Spins take it one step further with the chance of combining all three features in a sequence.Win-A-Beest’s volatility might not be high, but this is a slot that can go insane whilst also being able to offer a decent amount of play time. A quick calculation turns up a figure of 5,120x for a grid of Win-A-Beests when all win ways are active. It gets even juicier when an x2 wild multiplier shows up on the screen. During a billion simulated spins, wins of up to 10,240 times the stake were achieved. Not a bad figure for a medium volatility slot, and a higher than usual one from Play’n GO in general.Win-A-Beest is yet another Play’n GO slot that is hard to detect many faults in. It looks great, the features can go ballistic, and potential lurks in the long grass, like some big game target. Adds the multiplier value to all other multipliers on the reels.3rd Enhancer – reveals a multiplier value of 2x to 80x. Doubles the multipliers on the reels.4th Enhancer – reveals a multiplier of x2 to 100x. Collects the values of other symbols on the reels.A total of 3 spins are awarded for the Cash Bonus feature. Mayan Rush, for example, was one slot which was close to Yggdrasil Gaming's classic Valley of the Gods game. As soon as Money Track 2 rumbled into view, the only way it won't remind people of Relax Gaming's smash hit Money Train 3 is if they haven't gotten around to playing it yet. The look, the vibe, the name, all are shockingly similar. Dig a little deeper, and the gameplay between the two games is admittedly very different. But it is worth spending a few moments to digest the breath-taking audacity Stakelogic has displayed by copying one of the biggest slots in the business.As mentioned above and detailed in the features section, Money Track 2 and the Money Train slots diverge sharply in the gameplay department. Money Track 2 uses the Train Heist feature to add a bit of spark to the base game and is complemented by collecting Train Heist symbols in an effort to unleash more powerful Enhancers when free spins trigger. For that matter, it is different to most other hold & wins out there, so worth a crack if this kind of feature is of interest. It might not seem as explosively devastating as its competitors, yet Money Track 2 comes with a max win figure of 50,000 times the bet.Maybe not the biggest total ever to be found in a train game, but Money Track 2 puts up a good fight when it comes to winning potential. The numbers are impressive, and the gameplay is innovative enough to make Money Track 2 an attractive game for players keen on big, puffing hold & wins. Strange then that instead of giving the game a strong individual personality to match, Stakelogic felt the need to hitch Money Track 2 to the Money Train franchise's coattails. In the end, the most memorable thing about Money Track 2 was the odd way it tries just as hard to be itself as something else."

title: Beellionaires Dream Drop

review: 2024",6,"2 Sweet 4 U: Slot OverviewWith a name like something a teenager might write on their pencil case, 2 Sweet 4 U is developer 4ThePlayer's foray into the world of candy-coated scatter wins slots. Ah well, if that's not an issue, then players looking for a candy-coated scatter pay extravagance with chocolaty extras to indulge in can find them in 4ThePlayer's 2 Sweet 4 U."

title: Pandora's Box of Evil

review: 0.05/100,"March 2, 2023",6,"Pandora's Box of Evil: Slot OverviewAccording to Ancient Greek belief, Pandora was the first woman, who's jar was opened, unleashing evils over the earth with just Hope remaining locked inside. In other tellings of the story, opening the jar actually released blessings rather than evil, which humankind would have received had they not been unloosed. Otherwise, it's tough to find faults in the way Pandora's Box of Evil functions. For some Mystery symbol action with one or two twists, it could be worth being curious about.In the end, as we mentioned, Pandora's Box of Evil is another one of these slick-as-you-like-it releases Play'n GO excels at dropping at regular intervals. It's easy on the eyes, makes use of a fascinating cover story, and its thematic elements have been neatly woven into the gameplay. The only minor concern, if we can call it that, is the game didn't really come with massive amounts of x-factor. It looks the part and performs well, but felt like Pandora's Box of Evil might end up being swept away with any number of good yet not great Play'n GO slots the studio often lets loose into the world."

title: Volatile Vikings 2 Dream Drop
structured_summary: Volatile Vikings 2 Dream Drop is a Viking-themed slot set in a cozy stone structure, shifting from the original's eerie Norse mysticism. It features cascades, Multiplier Reveals, free spins with persistent multipliers, and a Dream Drop jackpot offering prizes up to €10,000,000. The reviewer finds it a playable slot with a cheerful vibe but less mysterious and rewarding than the original, mainly appealing for its jackpots. The game boasts crisp graphics and a jolly tune, maintaining some thematic audio charms from its predecessor.
review: 2022",7.5,"Volatile Vikings 2 Dream Drop: Slot OverviewThese are coming thick and fast, with Volatile Vikings 2 being the third slot to be included in Relax Gaming's Dream Drop jackpot network. The first Volatile Vikings slot was indeed a volatile machine with a vibe that was as eerie as it could be thrilling. The second slot follows in much the same footsteps as the original, with the majority of the gaming based around cascade wins triggering multiplier symbols which build a persistent multiplier in free spins. The major difference is the addition of the Dream Drop jackpots, with the Mega reaching as high as €10,000,000.Another difference between the two games is a location switch, from the icy lands of Volatile Vikings' base game or fire of its bonus round to the decidedly more agreeable confines of Volatile Vikings 2. Now the main game action occurs in a sturdily built stone structure with chic circular windows letting in glowing shafts of light. The slot doesn't feel as mystical as before, but it does feel cosier, the graphics are noticeably crisper, and the jolly tune is inspiring, as is the rest of the comfy décor.Volatile Vikings 2 Dream Drop slot - base gameDon't get too cosy, though; this game isn't called Volatile Vikings 2 for nothing. The math model might be highly volatile, as before, yet the RTP is significantly different. To account for the Dream Drop aspect, the return to player value now comes to 94.8%, with 12% going to the jackpots. Any stake level is technically capable of triggering the Jackpot feature, which goes as low as 20 p/c or as high as $/€100 per spin. Just as democratically, the game can be played on mobile, tablet, or desktop devices.Reaching the Jackpot round might be the goal, yet most of the time, the gaming takes place on a 6-column, 5-row matrix. The game uses a scatter pays system to award wins, paying out when 8 or more matching symbols are in view, anywhere on the board. Low pay symbols are four runic items, while the high pays are four Viking-ish faces and what looks like a boar. Landing 8 matching low pay symbols is worth 0.4-0.5x the bet, rising to 3-6x the bet 12+ in view. Having 8 high pays in view is worth 1-10x the bet or 10-50x for landing 12+ premiums.Volatile Vikings 2 Dream Drop: Slot FeaturesVolatile Vikings 2 Dream Drop - Dream Drop jackpot game in actionFeatures in Volatile Vikings 2 Dream Drop include cascades, Multiplier Reveals, free spins, and the Dream Drop jackpot round - let's dive right into it.CascadesWhen a scatter win occurs in the game, the winning symbols explode off the board. New and/or existing symbols fall down into the empty spaces. If a new scatter win appears from the symbol drop, the cascade feature triggers again.Multiplier RevealIn the base game, wins can be boosted by the Multiplier Reveal feature. How it works is that on every spin, 2 Multiplier Reveal symbols land on reels 3 and 4. Each Multiplier Reveal symbol has two numbers displayed on it – a counter and a multiplier value. The counter value decreases by 1 following cascades on the same spin. When the counter reaches 0, its multiplier is activated, and it destroys any adjacent symbols, letting new symbols drop. One of the new cascading symbols will be another Multiplier Reveal symbol. At the end of the spin, the sum of all achieved multipliers is applied to the total win amount.Free SpinsLanding 3 scatter symbols in the base game awards 6 free spins, plus 1 additional free spin for a 4th scatter and beyond. In free spins, the game conducts itself as it does in the main game with one key difference. When the Multiplier Reveal triggers, the values are added to a persistent multiplier. This multiplier is applied to wins at the end of each free spin. In addition, every Bonus symbol landing in the bonus round awards +1 extra free spin.Dream Drop BonusThe Dream Drop Bonus round can be randomly triggered before any normal spin. When it activates, 5 reels appear on the screen, with one of the jackpots listed above each reel. Once underway, only crates or DD symbols land on the reels. Crates are destroyed while DD symbols remain stuck to their reel. Once one of the reels is filled with DD symbols, its corresponding prize is awarded. Jackpot seed values are €1, €5, €100, €25,000, or €500,000 for the Rapid, Midi, Maxi, Major, or Mega jackpots, respectively. The Mega is guaranteed to fall before reaching a million Euros the first two times. Its level is increased at certain intervals until reaching €10,000,000. There it will remain from then on.Volatile Vikings 2 Dream Drop slot - free spinsVolatile Vikings 2 Dream Drop: Slot VerdictVolatile Vikings 2 as the third Dream Drop entry came as a pleasant surprise. The previous game was a unique Norse-themed slot which mixed scatter wins with growing multipliers to excellent effect. In theory, all of that has returned for Part 2; however, in a watered-down form. Sure, it has some potentially enormous prizes attached, which is the prime reason for choosing to play it. Yet, strip the jackpots away for a moment and what's left is kind of disappointing in some ways.For one, the mysteriousness has been dialled back a notch, making Volatile Vikings 2 Dream Drop more mainstream than its predecessor. Maybe that was the point and one way of drawing a wider audience to the Dream Drop jackpots. The new vibe isn't a deal-breaker by any means; quite the opposite, really, as the graphics are more defined, and the tune is exceptionally jolly. It just wasn't as arresting as part one's deep Norse mysticism. Crucially, the premium symbols still chant when they create a win in Volatile Vikings 2 Dream Drop. Not as hauntingly as before, but at least that excellent touch is still there. A number of other things have been dialled back as well. The RTP has naturally taken a hit, but so has the non-jackpot max win, which at 10,000x is half of what it was before. In terms of gameplay, the free spins frequency appears to be rather low too which is a natural consequence of a large portion of the RTP being allocated to the jackpots.In the end, Volatile Vikings 2 is a playable Dream Drop slot with a delightfully cheerful disposition, though one which pales in comparison to the original from a non-jackpot standpoint. No doubt plenty of players will pick this one for the chance to have a crack at an eye-watering jackpot, yet Volatile Vikings part one remains a more holistically satisfying game in most other regards."

title: Reptoids
structured_summary: Reptoids is a sci-fi themed slot inspired by 'Men in Black' and 'They Live,' featuring undercover reptilian characters and retro-style symbols. The game’s key feature is a moving detector frame that turns high pay symbols into wilds and triggers free spins with potential for extra spins. The reviewer finds it visually impressive and moderately entertaining but critiques the base game as too repetitive and low on excitement. Aesthetically, it boasts outstanding visuals with a mix of relaxing and thrilling vibes, complemented by retro audio elements.
review: 6,"Reptoids (Yggdrasil): OverviewThe whole idea of slots from an operator perspective is to make money although providers such as Yggdrasil are quite good at giving you some entertainment and value at least - they rarely fail to amaze us in that area. But great looks isn't all that counts as we've come to learn, something Merkur and Novomatics are good examples of. Let's see how the game performs.Reptoids is a Video Slot with 5 reels and 20 paylines oriented from left to right. The game has ten regular symbols that win if three or more are lined up in sequence on a payline, beginning from the leftmost position. The 6 high pay symbols are represented by human characters (undercover Reptoids). The 4 low pay symbols are different medals. There is also a Scatter symbol that pays scattered if 2 or more appear anywhere on the reels. The narrative is a cross between 'Men in Black' and 'They live', featuring retro style symbols and buttons.Reptoids (Yggdrasil): FeaturesThere is a detector frame that moves to random position each spin in the base game and in Free Spin mode. When any high pay symbol lands inside the detector frame, it along with all identical symbols on the reels change into wilds. When the Scatter symbol lands inside the detector frame, the Free Spin mode is triggered.Landing a Scatter symbol inside of the detector frame in the base game triggers the Free Spin mode with 7 Free Spins. In Free Spin mode, all high pay symbols that are changed into wilds by the detector frame remain wild until the end of the Free Spins. The detection panel in Free Spin mode displays the amount of Reptoids (high pay symbols) already detected There are no Scatter symbols in the Free Spin mode. Free Spins are played with the same bet and lines that activated them.Changing every 2 High symbols into Wilds in the Free Spin mode awards 2 extra Free Spins. Up to 6 extra free spins can be awarded by changing all 6 High symbols into Wilds.Reptoids (Yggdrasil): ConclusionReptoids is a medium variance slot played with a 96.1% RTP. It accepts stakes from between 0.10 to 100€. It's a reasonably entertaining game with outstanding visuals that is going to be appreciated by the majority of players. Moreover, the game has a tendency to swing between a relaxing kind of vibe and thrilling action.With that said, the base game is a bit too relaxing for our taste and there's really not much going on except for that detector field flying around on the screen. It becomes a bit too repetitive after a while and the feature never quite won us over. Possibly, Yggdrasil could have left out the detector field in the base game to raise the excitement level even more in the bonus. All in all, Reptoids is a great production, but won't position itself in the top of the Yggdrasil tier. Reptoids is available across all Yggdrasil casinos, including Rizk and Guts."

title: Tik Talkers

review: 2024",7,"Tik Talkers: Slot OverviewAt the time of writing, China's richest man was Zhang Yiming, the founder of mega-popular app TikTok, having amassed a fortune of $50 billion. TikTok might not be the subject of today's online slot, but with a name like Tik Talkers, well, you know. It's been designed by AvatarUX with the help of Mr Wu, and is an online, virtual, social media, AI, digital nomad, hooking up on apps, life's just another window type thing.Tik Talkers manages to look both contemporary and futuristic at the same time. The contemporary side of things was largely down to the character symbols swarming the game board, while the background has a tinge of the future about it. Maybe a retro-future, if that makes sense. Given our already huge fondness for being online now, imagine what the future will be like… Mainlining the internet directly into our neural centres, while intravenous drips feed us nutrients so we never have to physically move.Tik Talkers slot - base gameTo get a Tik talking requires picking a stake of 10 c to $/€300 per base game spin and deciding whether to use the ante bet or not. Activating the ante bet increases the stake by 50%, thereby tripling the chance of entering free spins. Players can expect a theoretical return value of 96.058%; AvatarUX is rather precise when it comes to RTP, as well as a low volatile math model which is something you don't see all that often these days. Symbols spin on a 5-reel, 5-row gaming area with possible paylines from 7 to 85.Tik Talkers' low symbols are J, Q, K, and A, awarding 0.8 times the bet for 5-of-a-kind. Its high pays are 5 character symbols (AI made?), awarding 1.6 to 2.4 times the bet for 5 OAK. The wild symbol substitutes for all symbols except the scatter symbol.Tik Talkers: Slot FeaturesTik Talkers slot - free spinsTik Talkers' features include an Evolving Payline Levels mechanic, Expanding Wilds, Colossal Wilds, a Global Multiplier, free spins, and Xpress bonus buys.Evolving Payline LevelsBy default, Tik Talkers has 7 paylines. In the base game, when landing a Thumbs-up symbol, the number of paylines can increase for the number of paid spins as displayed on the symbol. If a second Thumbs-up symbol lands, the payline level goes up to level 3. The symbol cannot land again if the max payline level is active. Level 4 has 85 paylines and is only possible by landing the MAX Lines Colossal Wild.WildsExpanding Wilds - Expanding Wilds may land on reels 2, 3, or 4. Each time an Expanding Wild lands, it covers the reel in wilds and grants a respin. If 2 or more wilds land at the same time, only 1 respin is granted. Landing 3 Expanding Wilds on all 3 middle reels creates a Colossal Wild.Colossal Wild - When the Colossal Wild is activated, 1 additional respin is granted, and the 3 middle reels spin with colossal symbols. The Colossal Wild can increase the Global Multiplier, grant extra respins, or unlock the 4th payline level. Multipliers that can drop are x2, x5, x10, x20, x50, or x100.Free SpinsCollecting Thug Spins scatter symbols in the base game activates free spins. In the bonus round, when the Thumbs-up symbol hits, the number of spins added by the symbol is awarded as extra free spins, and levelling up can occur. In free spins, the Global Multiplier and payline level are persistent through the bonus round.XpressXpress is the feature buy section, where players can trigger the 10 free spins Bonus, 15 free spins Bonus Plus, or the 20 free spins Bonus Max for 50x, 200x, or 500x the bet, respectively.Tik Talkers slot - free spinsTik Talkers: Slot VerdictMaybe this is looking at the past through rose-tinted glasses, but back in the day, wasn't it more likely that someone achieving a major life milestone would be visited or called up by acquaintances, compared to these days where a thumb emoji is enough to fulfil social convention? Of course, responses depend on the relationship and all that, but still, it is currently possible to follow someone's life on social media, someone you haven't even chatted with for decades, and keep the link alive via thumbs and hearts.Ah well, no biggie; humanity seems pretty happy with the situation, and Tik Talkers was a game that elicited waves of happiness as well. It was unusual to see a paylines slot from AvatarUX rather than one using ways, which the studio tends to go for, but since Tik Talkers relies on full reel wilds for a sizable chunk of its thrills, this switch makes sense. Hopefully, you can level up quick and often, though, because 7 default paylines really are not a lot for a gaming grid of 5x5 dimensions. The game played though in definite waves, where, at best, bonus rounds rained down Thumbs-up symbols like the thing went viral pumping out extra spins, and in those moments, the point of Tik Talkers became apparent. The pinnacle was having a Global Multiplier in place, an increased number of paylines, and a big stripy wild symbol strapped to the middle 3 reels. That was cool, and at those times, the 10,000x win cap seemed like a possibility.All in all, Tik Talkers is another successful collaboration between AvatarUX and Mr Wu. So far, after also running through previous games like DonKey & the GOATS, Nugget, and FloridaMan, you just never know where the duo are going to take players next, but if past record is anything to judge them by, it'll be somewhere unique and entertaining."

title: 3 Lucky Leprechauns
structured_summary: 3 Lucky Leprechauns is a Celtic-themed slot featuring three charming leprechaun characters, allowing players to choose their preferred wild symbol. Visually, it boasts colorful, bubbly Emerald Isles backgrounds and jaunty Irish-themed audio enhancing its cheerful atmosphere.
review: 2023",7,"3 Lucky Leprechauns slot - base game3 Lucky Leprechauns: Slot OverviewOh, would you look at that now? More precisely, hitting 3 bonus symbols starts players at the bottom of the Trail, a 4 bonus symbol trigger starts players on the 7th level of the Trail, while a 5 bonus symbol triggers start players all the way up on level 12.On each level, a random pick is made, either moving players to the next level up or awarding the current level's prize. Once a prize has been won, the Leprechaun Trail bonus ends. Players can win:Cash prizes of 7x to 5,000x the bet4-15 Win Spins which are free spins with a guaranteed win each time and an x5 win multiplier.1-5 chest picks from the Pick-A-Win feature. Each chest contains a cash prize.If you win Win Spins or Picks, you get the chance to take them or a cash prize which is said to typically be the average win amount of the bonus. These values are displayed on the Trail.Buy FeatureWhere available, opening up the bonus buy lets users pick three buy options. 35x the bet lands 3 to 5 scatters to trigger the Trail, 75x the bet buys 4-15 Win Spins, while 330x bet buys 1-5 picks for cash prizes.3 Lucky Leprechauns slot - feature buy options3 Lucky Leprechauns: Slot VerdictSometimes, when a leprechaun slot hits the review desk, it's a bit like a niece or nephew telling you they want to be a YouTuber when they grow up. However, 4ThePlayer is a creative outfit, refusing to do things the typical way, so a hearty measure of curiosity surrounded 3 Lucky Leprechauns, as well. And, in the creative department, 3 Lucky Leprechauns has a few tricks up its sleeve.Still, 3 Lucky Leprechauns might not be as wild as they sometimes are from this studio; 9K Kong in Vegas or 60 Second Heist are two that sprang to mind as being slightly more out there, mechanically. And while you can pick the leprechaun you want on the wild symbols; it isn't as elaborate as the highly experimental 7 Elements was. However, instead of blowing minds with off-the-charts originality, 4ThePlayer has focused on creating a rather active player experience. In 3 Lucky Leprechauns, bonus triggers have an average frequency of 1 in 75 of occurring, which is a lot more frequent than they usually are. It means, in theory, plenty of opportunities to light the Leprechaun Trail up and collect one of its three types of prizes.Cash prizes, win spins or pick 'n clicks might not offer new ways of winning dough, but they can be depended on to thrill when the going's good, and they fit the rest of the game like a charm. Stir it all together, and 4ThePlayer has created a decent leprechaun slot with pacey activity, bright visuals, and all the Irish charm players would expect to come bursting forth like a shower of shamrocks in an online slot like this."

title: Hotline 2
structured_summary: Hotline 2 is a 1980s Miami Vice-themed crime slot set against a pastel sunset beach backdrop. It features a 5-reel, 243 ways format with expanding wilds, a Hotline mechanic affecting RTP, free spins with expanding reels, and a bonus buy option. The reviewer praises its simple, fun gameplay and solid feature set, though notes it closely follows the original. The game's retro visuals and sublime 80s soundtrack create a nostalgic and immersive vibe.
review: 653 spins",Medium,0.10/150,"August 24, 2020",8.5,"Hotline 2: OverviewDeveloper NetEnt takes players back to Miami in a follow up to the scorching hot crime-themed slot Hotline. Like its predecessor, Hotline 2 remains firmly implanted in the 1980s and just as full of Miami Vice references. At first glance, it might not appear much has changed. However, Hotline 2 is a slot that stands on its own two feet via a few feature changes and a cosmetic upgrade. Let's check the new alterations while busting out a white Armani suit (without tie or socks of course), and take to the blazing Miami streets.Hotline 2 - free spinsLet's start by getting reacquainted with the two heroes, styled after iconic Miami Vice duo Sonny and Rico. First up is the moustached metrosexual Quinn, played by Danny Champion, followed by the Jheri curled Riviera played by Robert T. Grier. Of course, we can't forget the fabulous guest star, Karoline Wagner, who plays Kitty Weiss. All of these theatrics are completely overblown like two-story shoulder pads, but the world-building is part of the series' charm. You don't just play Hotline 2; you lose yourself in it.Part of the trip is due to the audiovisual's. They might not make the full use of modern graphics cards, but are ideal for the theme nonetheless. The game is all pastels at sunset by the beach which looks like a dreamy postcard. The next, more convincing factor is the sound. Here we have to take a moment to acknowledge what the team has crafted. The soundtrack is quite sublime. If you're a 80s movie buff or TV show enthusiast, memories and nostalgia are bound to come flowing back. Several times during play, a certain saxophone note, or Roto Tom beat made us pause to savour a reawakened memory. As well as spinning reels, the music would make a perfect soundtrack for a range of activities – kung fu training, cruising Ocean Drive with the top down, a house party, sailing, getting jiggy. It's as versatile as it is enjoyable.When it comes to the nuts and bolts of the game, Hotline 2 utilizes a 5-reel, 243 win ways format which means you won't have to keep track of paylines. Playable from 30 p/c to $/€150 per spin, the RTP is down a bit from the first, but still nicely average at 96.05% while volatility rides medium.The crime-busting duo return to the paytable as two of the premium symbols. They are joined by a dude wearing a mic, while Kitty Weiss is the most valuable symbol. Like before, the six low pay symbols are all jewellery related items. Values aren't high on their own; you have been pre-warned. As an example, landing a line of 5 Kitties returns just 2.66 times the bet.Hotline 2: Features﻿Hotline 2 keeps things relatively simple when it comes to features, serving up regular doses of Expanding Wilds while Free Spins crop up less so. Like the first, Hotline 2 includes a Hotline mechanic, but it works a little differently this time. Instead of rows, the middle three reels make up the Hotline zone which can be activated individually. Messing around with the Hotlines will also affect the base game RTP as such: 94.51%, 95.35%, or 96.05% with 1, 2, or 3 Hotlines activated.In the base game, any wild symbol that lands within the Hotline zone expands to cover the whole reel. There's also a randomly activated Hotline feature which is a bit similar to the Wild Desire feature in Immortal Romance. When activated, the scene turns to nighttime and 1 to 3 reels inside the Hotline zone are transformed into fully stacked wilds.Keep an eye out for the Neon pink flamingo scatters which are the key to the Free Spins - 3 of them appearing on the middle three Hotlines awards 7 free spins. During free spins, a wild symbol on a Hotline always expands to cover the entire reel whilst also expanding the actual height of the reel by 1 symbol. At most, the three Hotline reels can expand to 6 rows in height, creating 1,944 bet ways. When a Hotline reel reaches its maximum height, 2 additional free spins are awarded.If you don't care waiting for the bonus to drop, NetEnt has included a bonus buy option. For a price of 20x, 40x, or 60x, players can choose to play the bonus with 1, 2, or 3 Hotlines activated respectively.Hotline 2: VerdictHotline 2 turned out to be quite a hoot. It's simple, fun, straight forward gaming with a few features nestled in for good measure. There may be critics who think part 2 is too close to the original, served cold like last night's leftovers. Yes, there is merit to that argument. Hotline 2 isn't a massive shift, but things have moved on. Give it a few spins and the changes become apparent, for good or ill depending on personal preference.Fans of the first probably won't be able to help but become fans of Hotline 2. Expanding rows during free spins also work well, as they have done in Dragon Maiden or White Rabbit, leading to an all-round competent slot. One thing to mention is that expanding wilds do hit quite frequently - to the detriment of free spins frequency.Whilst not very innovative as such, every single aspect of Hotline 2 comes together incredibly well to offer an all around solid slot - from the RTP and the satisfactory flow of the gameplay, to the features and audiovisual production. So yeah, the gameplay is good, yet it's the bitchin vibes the game musters up that make it extra compelling, particularly the epic sounds. Mixing in potential of 5,184 times the stake, makes it hard not to wrap on a pair of Ray-Bans and pretend you're part of the squad."

title: Star Joker

title: Bandit Megaways

title: Build the Bank
structured_summary:

review: "November 15, 2022",4,"Build the Bank: Slot OverviewAt the time of writing, the cryptocurrency industry had tanked hard, exchanges were going under, rug pulls were on the rise, and the dream of using crypto to bank the unbankable was under threat. Perhaps, in the future, instead of digital assets filling the gaps, people will build their own bank instead. This is one takeaway from developer Crazy Tooth Studio's online slot Build the Bank. Here players are accompanied by a construction-minded robot in a game where the main feature is a hold n' win style round called Mega Pile.Build the Bank takes place in the not-too-distant future in a city experiencing a raging building boom. Assisting the inhabitants with raising skyscrapers, and the bank, are robots, like the one hovering next to the game grid, like a sort of hard hat version of Clippy the Paper Clip. He points out scatter symbols when they land and generally provides companionship throughout all phases of the game. The overall atmosphere is a sort of futuristic, industrious world, with a touch of Art Deco in places and a touch of EDM in others. A place that's constantly looking forwards and building upwards, John Galt would possibly feel right at home here. Being a Crazy Tooth Studio production, there's a uniqueness to the whole show that has to be seen in person to form a full impression.Build the Bank slot - base gameAvailable on any device, Build the Bank's base game is played on a 5-reel, 5-row grid with 3,125 active ways. It uses an Any Adjacent Pays system to award wins, where three or more matching symbols on adjacent reels trigger a payout – wins do not have to start from the left side of the grid, in other words. It's medium volatile and comes with a trio of RTP settings of 96.09%, 94.18%, and 92.16, while stakes of 25 p/c to $/€50 per spin may be selected.Certain Crazy Tooth Studio games of the past have come with unusual symbol values, and Build the Bank is another one of them. For the lows, it has J-A royals paying 0.08x the bet for five of a kind, bumping up to 0.12x the bet for five of the premium shovel, gold bars, hammer, and helmet symbol types. Wilds are not used in Build the Bank.Build the Bank: Slot FeaturesBuild the Bank slot - Mega Pile feature with Respins UpgradeBuild the Bank is divided between its base game which possesses no features or modifiers, and its Mega Pile bonus round. The Mega Pile comes in two forms; both are played on a 5x7 game board. If it is triggered by 3 scatter symbols that do not contain a Respins Upgrade, then 3 Mega Pile spins are awarded. If one of the triggering scatter symbols is the Respin Upgrade, the Mega Pile round will continue to play until there are 3 consecutive spins that do not land active symbols.Triggering scatters display Credit Awards, Multiplier Symbols, Special Awards, or the Respins Upgrade. They carry over to the Mega Pile, where they drop to the bottom of the reels. On each spin, new active symbols may or may not hit. When they land, they also fall as low as possible on their reel. This continues until the round ends, then all values in view are awarded.Credit Awards have values of 0.04x to 20x the bet, whereas Multiplier symbols get values of x2, x3, x4, x5, or x10, applied to Credit Awards symbols in the direction they display. Special Awards place Credit Awards in adjacent positions in the directions the symbols indicate.Also, filling the bottom three rows awards the Mini Bank prize, filling the bottom four rows awards the Midi Bank Prize, and filling the bottom five rows awards the Max Bank Prize. Bank Prizes are periodically increased, but the base value for the Mini, Midi, or Max is 25x, 250x, or 2,500x the bet, respectively.Build the Bank slot - Mega Pile feature with Upgrade triggeredBuild the Bank: Slot VerdictIt's been a while since the last Crazy Tooth Studio review, and Build the Bank did not disappoint. This is one studio you really have no idea where they will lead players next. Where online slots often focus on breaking banks and so on, Crazy Tooth does the total opposite and bases a slot around building a bank. This might be going against the grain, but, like a lot of what Crazy Tooth does, there are niggles, as well. Are they enough to be deal breakers? In some ways, yeah.One gripe was the ludicrously low prize values. In Build the Bank, they appear on the Credit Awards blocks with their minuscule 0.04x and up, or the meh 0.12x for five of the premium symbols. Sure, Build the Bank has a lot of ways. However, even a full screen of the most valuable symbol in the game comes out at 375x; the paytable specifically notes this. As a comparison, it's less than a five-of-a-kind hit in a regular 'Book of' game, where just one payline is needed. Max win in Build the Bank might be circa 4,000x the bet, but it constantly felt like a low win, low thrill game.And yet, even after applying cold mathematics, there was something strangely interesting about Build the Bank as well. So often, online slot makers stick to using tried, true, hackneyed, stiflingly unoriginal, safe ideas in their games, so it is so refreshing to know some have a creative spirit that can't be kept in check. Such are the slots Crazy Tooth Studio turns out on a regular basis, Build the Bank being one which sits proudly among its siblings.Moreover, does anyone load up the latest Crazy Tooth Studio creation in the hopes of finding some bland three-line joker game? Unlikely. Crazy Tooth Studio is like the ruffled-haired scientist running their experiment for the 10,000th time, hoping it will work, the eccentric hatter at the slot designer tea party, the friend who doesn't speak much yet when they do totally blow your mind with their singular slant on reality. The world has plenty of room for dreamers and makers like Crazy Tooth Studio. The games it makes, like Build the Bank, might not be amazing or overly playable, but it's nice to know there are creative types out there tacking against the wind of conformity."

title: Raging Reindeer
structured_summary:

review: Out Now,6.5,"Raging Reindeers: OverviewIt has begun people. The calendar has just flicked over to November and already the Christmas season is upon us. No, it’s not the Christmas lights in the middle of town, or the seasonal shopping specials, or carol singers knocking on doors. The levy has officially broken on the Christmas themed slot deluge. Okay, a deluge is a slight exaggeration, but still, brace yourselves slots fans because they are on the way. The latest one to grace the screen is Raging Reindeers from iSoftBet. The title, of course, is a witty word play on Raging Rhino, and like most Christmas themed slots, it's also a clone of an older title, namely Jumbo Stampede.First looks are promising, with crisp graphics full of personality and a festive rock 'n roll soundtrack to top it off. The action is set a long way away from Jungle Stampede’s African Savannah. Now we’re right in the midst of Santa’s patch on top of the world at the North Pole. If you usually play 5 reel slots, the extra reel you get with Raging Reindeers can feel a little disorientating at first. Not in a bad way at all, it is more interesting to see the change just one reel can make. Each reel can hold four symbols, and the whole set up provides 4,096 ways to win. How it works is that symbols payout for adjacent symbol combinations. For example the same two symbols on reel one and three on reel two results in 6 winning ways.The symbols are a standout feature of Raging Reindeers. Well, the high pay ones at least. They might be all animals, but these are animals with an attitude, particularly reindeer with the fake red nose to look like Rudolf. He happens to be the highest paying symbol in the game at 7.5 times the stake. He is useful during the base game, but the fiery guy really comes to life during the bonus game. He is followed in descending order by a wolf, coyote, owl, and stoned looking bunny playing. They are not exactly traditional Christmas wildlife, but who’s complaining? The wild bursts into the game with an explosive kick, literally, and appears on reels 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6. It substitutes for any symbol except the Raging Reindeer logo symbol. Finally, we get 9 - A card icons that look like they have been carved from different coloured bits of wood. RTP is a hairs breath on the wrong side of the industry standard at 95.94% which is fine, as is the medium volatility.Raging Reindeers: FeaturesJingle Spins feature in actionThere isn't a whole lot going on in terms of features here and it all comes down to the Jingle Spins Bonus game really. The Logo is the scatter which can land anywhere. When 3, 4, 5, or 6 land they award 8, 15, 20, or 50 Jingle Spins respectively. During these free spins, when the wild lands as part of a winning combination it morphs into a x2 or x3 multiplier while still acting as a wild on its reel.The wild also boosts the power of the reindeer symbol. Any wilds and Rudolph symbols will pay out as winning combos even if they sit on non-adjacent reels. This means that a wild on reel 3 and a reindeer on reel 1 forms a winner, for example. Jingle Spins can be extended by the scatter which continues to show up durung the round. As before, up to 50 free spins can be added which can result in a healthy 100 free spin round.Raging Reindeers: VerdictRemember that feeling of being a kid, sitting by the fire on Christmas eve, watching telly while it snowed outside, knowing that Santa would be visiting soon because you’d been good that year. Oh dear, we are getting caught up in the magic of the season already… Fine, Raging Reindeers doesn’t hit those emotional heights, but it's a feel-good Christmas slot in its own right. Will you still be playing it on December 26th? Probably not, but until then it is a good accompaniment to the season.What makes it successful is the high fun factor, with just the right mix of payout rate and features. The game oozes personality, provided predominately by the raging reindeer of the title. This guy is good when he lands in numbers during the base game. But get him during the free spins and he can turn a session around. The key is not having to land side by side, and the boost from multiplying wilds. Having non-adjacent winners isn’t exactly new. It has been done before, famously in the Ra/Book series, but it works so well it’s a wonder it doesn’t show up in even more slots.Raging Reindeers does the big things right, but it also contains subtle touches that make it that little bit more special. An example is when two scatters fall. Like a million other slots, if you have two scatters it builds tension on each reel as you wait and hope for the third one. As it does so it dumps a well animated wad of snow. Yes, a little thing, but you appreciate the thought that goes into details like that.When you are testing a clone, and don’t find yourself constantly comparing it to the original you know on some level a good amount of effort has been invested into it. Raging Reindeers easily stands on its own four feet. Potential wise it offers solid returns of up to 4,332 times the stake which is not bad at all. If Raging Reindeers was a present it would tend towards being a stocking filler rather than Santa’s main gift, but sometimes that's all you need."

title: Candy Fall

review: 3,"Candy Fall: Slot OverviewThis game has likely been cancelledAlong with literature and manned space flight, one of the greatest things to come out of Russia has got to be the game Tetris. Created by Soviet software engineer Alexey Pajitnov, Tetris is one of those easy-to-learn hard-to-put-down games which took the world by storm. It's even shown up in the gambling industry courtesy of SG Digital/Red7 in Tetris Extreme, which included the famous Tetris Song 'Korobeiniki', and its core ideas have been used again, sort of, in Candy Fall by developer Blueprint Gaming. There might be a sneaking suspicion that mixing gambling with Tetris will result in something gimmicky, but you never know. Care to test the hypothesis?In the manner of Geralt of Rivia, 'hmm' was the reaction after viewing Candy Fall for the first time. Despite the use of a common theme where players find themselves in a sweety, candy-filled world of sugary items and a landscape that bobs up and down repeatedly and somewhat distractedly, for some reason, Candy Fall manages to throw a curveball. Instead, the box on the left displays individual shapes, while the 6x6-sized box on the right is initially filled with shapes all neatly packed together to fill the entire space. Or, you can click Reveal All to bypass the click-by-click process and speed things up.Displayed at the top of the right-hand box are 6 prize values. Values vary between game rounds, and it is possible to win more than one prize per game. On each game round, players are able to stake 10 p/c to $/€10. While doing so, they can expect a theoretical return value of 95% and volatility on the lower side of things.Candy Fall slot - base gameCandy Fall: Slot FeaturesLike shaking the last Skittle out of the packet and devouring it in a moment, Candy Fall's features won't take time to digest. If the 'Bonus' prize reaches the bottom of the box, then the bonus feature is triggered. For the bonus, players pick one of 3 chocolate bombs to reveal a prize. That's it.Candy Fall slot - bonusCandy Fall: Slot VerdictEver been neck deep in an epic game of Tetris with shapes raining down at breakneck speeds where your conscious mind has switched off, handing controls over to an instinctual link between eyes and fingers as you nip a square here, a four-position line there, rotate an 'L' shaped block over there, so that somehow, somehow, despite the ludicrous pace, you keep making lines to prevent blocks reaching the top, thereby ending the game, all the while sweat pours from your brow, and your hands are moving about like Yngwie Malmsteen's during a particularly speedy guitar solo?Candy Fall isn't quite like that. In addition, it might be better to brace yourself for a buttload of dead spins or low-value wins, as well. As for clicking shapes one by one… who's got time for that? Scroll to the bottom, where the max win from a single game is 250,000 units of currency or 251x the bet – whichever comes first. Since the max bet is $/€10, we're guessing the 251x will be coming first.Okay, Blueprint Gaming has come up with an original experience, and good on the team for being experimental. It was something of a surprise since the last two Blueprint Gaming releases we'd reviewed were pretty much cookie-cutter Megaways slots. But, like the extreme fringes of the fashion world, original doesn't always mean good. So, while some players may appreciate the snail's pace and low win potential of Candy Fall (more power to them if so), it was one of the least fun, least exciting, and low-thrill games we've come across for a while."

title: Our Days

review: "Our Days (Microgaming): ReviewWhen it comes to terrible slots, and we don't mean bad, mind you, but phenomenally grotesque slots, a disproportionately large number released in recent years have been sanctioned by Microgaming and released by its partnering studios. In fact, not even Microgaming themselves seem to remember how to create a decent slot anymore, something that has led the company to become utterly irrelevant and overrun by its contenders.In an age where shaky Microgaming titles have become a sad norm, this latest offering entitled Our Days, makes most abysmal slots seem as polished as the floors of Versailles. With 5 reels and 243 ways to win, it's playable in the barest sense of the word in those situations you might be stuck in a region with little to no other options at your disposal. Now, there are a few things that seem to suggest that this slot was initially developed for the Asian market, in which case the rather cheesy narrative could be a cultural thing that just doesn't go down too well in our part of the world. When activated, all symbols that are part of a winning combination are held while reels without winning symbols respin - they will continue to do so as long as you keep landing winning combinations.There's a Free Spins game included as well which is played when you land 3 or more scatters simultaneously anywhere on the reels - 3, 4 or 5 will earn you 8, 10 or 12 free spins respectively. Once in, you'll benefit from the removal of all lower value symbols, meaning bigger wins and significantly better odds of winning. Furthermore, the Respin feature is active here as well. Potentially, you could pocket up to 729 times your stake per spin should you land a full screen of the top symbol, although mostly you'll have to suffer through dreary rounds where you collect a bunch of micro-wins.Our Days (Microgaming): VerdictQuite frankly, Our Days is one of the most tedious slots we've ever had to play and one that has nothing much going for it. While the theme might work in Asia (we doubt so), to most Europeans it will likely come across as odd and cheesy. Moreover, the game engine has a strange quirk to it as the Respin feature refuses to respin losing tiles that are on the same reels as winning tiles.Overall, it's just an incredibly bland, dull and boring slot that offers no excitement at all as the payouts are nonsensical, the respins excruciating to watch and the visual design thoroughly unimaginative. In fact, we're left given the impression that it was created by people who are entierly disconnected from the gambling community. At the time of writing, we have no info on which one of all the Microgaming partners that's responsible for this nonsense, nor are we interested in finding out. The fact that Microgaming allows games like this to pass its quality control is offensive enough."

This time it comes with an outer shell steeped in concepts such as magic, Djinn, and desert exploration.Whether exploring lost cities is preferable to avoiding fangs sinking into your neck, we'll leave to personal preference. Because while Thunderkick might have flipped the view, the features have remained the same, and these are pretty good. As is usually the case with these sorts of bonus rounds, normal symbols can drum up and okay win, helped along by special symbols which can make a real difference.In terms of special symbols, Lost City comes up a little short when compared to the big hitters it's going up against, namely MT2 et al., since there are just two of them, and they are pretty basic. However, basic can still be effective; plus, when factoring in the Pattern Collect feature, Lost City of the Djinn can go bananas in the right set of circumstances. It was a little surprising to find out the studio hadn't added anything in the way of innovation, so, no twists, turns, or clever new features. However, the lack of gameplay originality doesn't stop Lost City of the Djinn from being a well-made free spin/respin machine with masses of volatility and potential for players drawn to this style."

title: Steam Squad
structured_summary: Steam Squad is a steampunk-themed slot blending 19th-century steam power with futuristic tech in an underwater-to-clouds game world. review: 2023",5.5,"Steam Squad: Slot OverviewSteampunk's fusion of past and future, advanced technology with a 19th-century steam-powered influence, provides excellent visuals, which some online slot makers have been keen to make use of. Depending on your definition, slots that could be lumped with the Steampunk label could be certain entries in Relax Gaming's mega Money Train franchise, Coils of Cash from Play'n GO, Yggdrasil Gaming's Cazino Zeppelin Reloaded, and the most iconic of them all, NetEnt's 2015 hit Steam Tower. Red Tiger is a developer which feels ideally positioned to make one of these sorts of games, as its slots often possess a sort of science meets mysticism effect already. When a reel is filled with winning symbols, the respective multiplier is awarded and applied to the total of the win at the end of the spin. If more than one multiplier is awarded, the values are added up.Power UpAt random, after non-winning symbols are destroyed, a winning symbol may power up. When this happens, the symbol clones itself, filling the whole reel.Booster RowAlso at random, on a spin, a metal frame may appear on one of the rows. If this row is filled with winning symbols, a booster is activated. The booster triggers after no more winning symbols land after a winning wipeout. The booster may create a winning symbol in place of a non-winning one and continue the wipeout, or if a multiplier is activated, it will increase the multiplier by +1, +2, +3, +4, or +5. After the booster is applied, the metal frame moves to a higher row, which is not filled with winning symbols.Free SpinsLanding 3, 4, 5, or 6 scatters on a base game spin awards 8, 10, 12, or 15 free spins, respectively. During the feature, landing 3, 4, 5, or 6 scatters awards an extra 3, 5, 7, or 10 free spins, respectively. In free spins, the booster row is always active, and it may move between spins. Multipliers are incremented until the end of the round.Buy FeaturePlayers may buy the free spins feature for 70x the bet, and doing so comes with an increased return value of 96%.Steam Squad slot - free spinsSteam Squad: Slot VerdictWith Steam Squad, do we have a studio holding two red hot tropes in their hands – Steampunk and scatter pays, then bringing them together to create something wildly experimental, or is this a desperate bid to leap on two separate trends at the same time? Debatable as the end result has its ups and downs. Scatter-paying mechanics have really taken off recently, helped along by slots like Pragmatic Play's Gates of Olympus, Gates of Olympus 1000 and its many follow-ons. Red Tiger itself has dabbled in the past; Sugar Monster is an example, and it has dabbled again for Steam Squad, where a number of features work alongside the scatter-paying mechanism.It's not a bad mix either. You can picture the boffins at Red Tiger, Steampunk goggles resting on foreheads, cogs flying about the place, sizzling bolts of electricity lighting up the workshop. It's a bit slow and sluggish at times, and the max win is a tad disappointing. In a game with so many sizable reel multipliers, topping out at 3,235.4x the bet seems a bit contradictory. Perhaps the game's maker was running on Victorian exchange rate values when it was coming up with win numbers. If that figure doesn't dampen your enthusiasm, then there's enough going on in Steam Squad regarding scatter-paying activity to warrant a look.If Steam Squad was a rickety airship cobbled together using cogs and dials and pistons and so on, a question remains over how reliable it would be for flying high above the planet through the clouds. In the end, Steam Squad felt like a contraption that would probably provide willing participants with an interesting ride if they aren't hugely picky about the final destination."

review: 0.20/125,"September 30, 2024",7,"Wisdom of Athena 1000: Slot Overview'Knowledge is power', so says the main character in today's game, repeatedly, and she would know, being Athena, the goddess of wisdom, amongst other things. This is unlikely to happen super often, so don't be expecting a game that rains down eye-watering multiplier symbols like a broken candy toss.But it's there, lurking, just waiting to break into the game and boost a win with its x1,000 multiplier hammer. As we've come to expect by now, these 1000 slots blow the potential wide open, and the win cap in Wisdom of Athena 1000 is double the previous game at 10,000x the bet. Wisdom of Athena 1000 is another one that makes excellent use of tumbles and multiplier symbols before turning the heat up further in free spins due to the persistent grid unlocking progress and, more importantly, the persistent total multiplier. With Wisdom of Athena 1000, Pragmatic Play has taken an already highly playable scatter-paying slot and significantly increased what the game is capable of."

title: Gravity Bonanza

review: 2023",7.5,"Gravity Bonanza: Slot OverviewJust like Vegas - 'what happens in a black hole stays in a black hole'. title: Dave Lame Bad Magician

review: 4.5,"Dave Lame Bad Magician: Slot OverviewHave you noticed when magicians perform their routines, they often spend a lot longer on the build-up than on the actual trick itself. That's the question formed after playing Dave Lame Bad Magician from SG Digital: a magic-themed slot set on stage at a theatre, complete with drum rolls, big top music, and a look that makes you wonder if SG was going for some sort of retro thing. When he does, win lines pay both ways for 2-5 respins, and wins on multiple lines are added together.Keep an eye out for the bonus symbol, it appears on reels 1, 3, or 5 in the base game, and landing 3 at once gains you entry to the Pick A Pot feature. When gambling, 2 pots are shuffled, and players pick one to move up or down the feature list. If the bottom feature was initially won, it is possible to pick a cup containing a consolation prize. If you get this one you win 10-15x the bet and go back to the base game.The following bonus games are available in the game:The Knife Throw bonus game displays a spinning wheel with an assistant tied to the middle and 10 balloons around the wheel's edge. Players pick 3 balloons for Dave to throw knives at, each one revealing a bet multiplier. The possible values are x2, x3, x5, x8, x10, x20, x30, or x50. When 3 balloons have been popped, the values are added together and awarded. If you were wondering, Dave won't throw the knife at the lady, only at balloons.Rabbits out of Dave's Hat awards 6 free spins. During the feature, when cards land on the grid, they lock in place, then all values are added up and awarded when the free spins end. If a joker card lands, Dave reveals one of the multiplier cards – if it matches the card you initially selected, then it is increased by its original value.Winning the Escapology feature awards an unlimited free spins bonus game. During this one, whenever a special tap symbol lands, it adds an extra row, +10 ways to the existing grid, and increases the win multiplier by +1. Free spins end when the reel set reaches a total of 9 rows high.The final feature is the Sawing a Reel in Half bonus. When winning this one, Dave cuts the grid so players get either 2, 3, or 4 separate reel sets. When wilds land, they are transferred onto all other reel sets. Also, landing 3 bonus symbols on a reel set awards +2 additional free spins.Dave Lame Bad Magician: Slot VerdictLike The Shitty Beatles in Wayne's World, Dave Lame Bad Magician isn't just a clever name. If SG was going for a retro look they have done better to push the clock back a few extra years. Maybe if they'd worked the very early days of illusion, or used an Edwardian/Harry Houdini angle, or even done the 80s thing other studios are doing, it might have worked better than the Freddi Fish era looking game we got. Dave's got a friendly Mr Bean vibe, yet it’s hard to get past the feeling that, yeah, it is all a bit lame.This applies to other parts of the game too, the animations, for one, are pretty sluggish, the pace might have benefited from an extra push to get it going, and the features are amusing yet come across underpowered. Dave Lame Bad Magician follows on from other SG related slots like Cluedo Cash Mystery, being jam-packed with a large number of bonus games and features. Like Gremlins, SG has used a concept Blueprint Gaming has made famous of spinning a reel to win bonus games, which can then be gambled for potentially better ones. It shows you how much Blueprint Gaming has honed its craft. For example, The Goonies Return, to pick just one feature fest, is a master class in execution by comparison.As to rewards, Dave Lame Bad Magician isn't going to set the world of illusions alight, but they aren't bad. The slot's home page touts payouts of up to 5,000x the bet, though the game sheet lowers the 'Maximum Win' to 4,048x the bet. Interestingly, despite the name, Dave Lame's Disappearing Act provided the biggest win during the review. Not to say Dave can't step it up in the bonus games, but it didn't pan out that way for us during testing.To conclude, Dave Lame Bad Magician's title set the bar pretty low from the outset, which the rest of the game never really managed to lift it. To sign off with a cultural reference, the experience was akin to Gob's disappearing yacht act from the show Arrested Development. 'Where once there was a yacht, now there is not', he proclaims, before sinking the family's $700k boat to the tune of The Final Countdown."

review: "September 12, 2023",6,"Hercules 10K Ways: Slot OverviewHercules, son of the god Jupiter and the mortal Alcmena is the Roman adaptation of the Greek hero Heracles, who is probably most well known for his 12 Labours. Hercules appears on the top reel only during the base game, where he can be used to substitute for all symbols except Golden Apples.Heracles 10K Ways: Slot FeaturesHercules 10K Ways slot - free spins splash screenHercules 10K Ways' base game relies on cascades as its main feature, only really kicking up a gear when at least 5 Golden Apples land to trigger the Hercules Battle Spins Feature.CascadesEach symbol in a winning way is removed by the cascade mechanic and replaced by symbols from above or to the side (on the top reel). This process repeats until no new win is created after a cascade.Hercules Battle Spins FeatureEach triggering Golden Apple symbol awards its displayed value, and each one of them gives Hercules +1 life point, up to a maximum of 10. The first opponent appears on the opposite side of the grid to Hercules, and its life points are also displayed. The order of the opponents is Boar, Hydra, Cerberus, then Lion, each starting with 3, 4, 5, or 6 life points, respectively.Now, 3 respins are initially awarded, making up a Battle Round. Only the current monster's symbols, Hercules symbols (displaying a prize value), or blanks land during a Battle Round. When Hercules or monster symbols land, they are sticky until the end of the Battle Round. When a Monster symbol is processed, it reduces Hercules' Life points by 1. review: "Epic Joker IntroductionOk, so our header might have been a bit harsh, nonetheless we can't help to feel the title is a bit of a ridiculous statement for a simple fruit machine with little to no potential. title: Dragon Tiger
structured_summary: Dragon Tiger is an Asian-themed slot centered on revered Chinese creatures, dragons and tigers. The game features a 5x4 grid with 1,024 ways to win, a free spins bonus with wild multipliers, and a highly volatile math model. The reviewer found it balanced but unremarkable, appealing mainly to fans of Asian themes. Visually, it offers striking sculptures and a dramatic percussion-heavy soundtrack, though overall it feels standard for the genre.
review: "November 5, 2020",5.5,"Dragon Tiger: Slot OverviewDeveloper Pragmatic Play is back on comfy ground in their Asian themed slot Dragon Tiger. Before the game loads, players will have a good idea of what they are getting into from the name alone. Dragons and tigers are two of the most highly revered creatures in Chinese mythology. Consequentially, they are also two of the most common creatures to be found in Asian themed slots and play starring roles in Dragon Tiger.Dragon Tiger struggles to shake off a generic feeling the moment it hits the screen. The 5x4, 1,024 win ways game area has rather striking tiger and dragon sculptures draped along its edges, while the background shimmers like the world's biggest firecracker has just gone off. For your ears, a percussion-heavy Asian soundtrack blasts away, which gets pretty dramatic at times. Overall, the audio/visuals are quite good, though standard stuff for the theme.Dragon Tiger is available on mobile, tablet or desktop, offering bets from 20 p/c to $/€100 per spin. The Asian inspired gaming comes with a highly volatile math model, not as volatile as it gets from Pragmatic Play, but a 4.5/5 rating all the same. To its credit, Dragon Tiger felt quite well-balanced during testing. Its bonus game triggered frequently enough to make things interesting, sporadically turning out solid wins. However, that is playing the 96.50% RTP version, so expect lower settings to perform with less generosity. Without the free spins, Dragon Tiger would be in danger of being completely avoided because the rest of the game is pretty basic.Another part of Dragon Tiger that works in its favour is the 1,024 ways to win. Starting from the first reel, as long as three matching symbols land left to right, you've got a winner. One exception is the white tiger symbol. It was said a tiger's tail turned white on its 500th birthday, making a fully white one mythical indeed.Anyway, the white tiger pays out on two of a kind. The other symbols, from top to bottom, include turtles, frogs, rabbits, fish, and A-9 royals. Given the pay system and wild multiplier action in free spins, the values aren't huge. Premium five of a kind wins are worth 3-7.5 times the bet. Dragons make their appearance as the wild symbol, on reels 2, 3, or 4. Wilds replace any symbol except the scatter to help make winning combinations.Dragon Tiger: Slot FeaturesDragon Tiger - free spinsDragon Tiger keeps it simple by including just one feature, a triggered round of free spins. The game's logo is the scatter, appearing on all five reels. Landing 3, 4, or 5 scatters awards 8, 15, or 20 free spins as well as a payout of 2x, 10x, or 20x the bet respectively.During free spins, the action shifts up a gear, predominantly due to the wild change. As before, the dragon wild only lands on the middle three reels. Now though, when wild symbols land, they carry a random multiplier of x2, x3, or x5. When used as part of a win, the wild's multiplier is applied to the amount. If more than one wild is used in a win, the multipliers are multiplied to produce some pretty good results. A meter above the reels displays the current multiplier value active on each spin. The music steps it up in the feature too where the drums become extra passionate.Free spins can be extended when just two or more scatters land. Get lucky, and land 2, 3, 4, or 5 scatters to add 5, 8, 15, or 20 extra spins to the remaining total.Dragon Tiger: Slot VerdictWith many of these sorts of slots under their belt, Dragon Tiger feels like another unremarkable notch in the bedpost for Pragmatic Play. A game that doesn't do anything wrong, nor anything particularly memorable either. Unless you're a major fan of Chinese slots, there is little to no reason for giving the game a second glance. If on the other hand, you like a bit of uncomplicated gaming, an abundance of tigers, dragons, and zithers, Dragon Tiger does have a few highlights.One of them is a bonus game that can bring it all together to produce some fine moments, seemingly from nothing. Case in point, occurred during testing, when a number of white tigers landed at the same time as a couple of multipliers resulting in a satisfying single spin win, with plenty of room to spare. Sure, nothing extraordinary, but it did provide enough of a jolt to pull us out of a slumber. Before then, glazy eyed drowsiness had set in, induced by the lack of anything remotely new or interesting occurring in the base game.Another pleasant surprise was how often free spins triggered. Dragon Tiger didn't turn out to be a slot you wait an age for the bonus game to hit. This is good because there is nothing else in the base game mixing up play. It does mean bonus games can be highly hit or miss as well. Decent wins are possible, though unusually for Pragmatic Play, they haven't stated what the max potential in Dragon Tiger might be.Dragon Tiger is certainly better suited to Asian fans, but it proved to be quite an enjoyably simple game. Perhaps if Pragmatic Play had bravely chosen a different theme, it might have made more of an impression although it's clear that the product is aimed towards the Asian market. As it is, Dragon Tiger does its rudimentary thing, and there are moments during free spins; but there's not a lot here to entice players who aren't huge on the Asian thing in otherwise."

title: The Mafiosi

review: 2023",6.5,"The Mafiosi: Slot OverviewWhy not come indulge your inner crime boss fantasies with developer Peter & Sons in the online slot The Mafiosi? The Mafiosi has a default RTP of 96% and is highly volatile with decent winning potential to boot.Casino chips with spades, clubs, diamonds, and hearts on them are The Mafiosi's low-pay symbols, while a car, jewellery, pistol, and three character symbols are the higher-paying group. When landing a winning combination consisting of 5 casino chips, players collect 0.4 to 0.5 times the bet, rising to 1.25 to 5 times the bet for a 5 premium symbol hit.The Mafiosi: Slot FeaturesThe Mafiosi slot - free spinsThe Mafiosi doesn't just have free spins and super free spins, but it also has mega free spins. In all phases of play, including the base game, expanding wilds and multipliers are another feature adding an edge to the proceedings.Expanding Wilds SymbolsWild symbols appear on the three center reels and substitute for all other symbols in the game except the scatter. When a wild appears in the base game, it expands to cover the whole reel. For each wild that appears, the multiplier increases by +1. However, if there is no win, the wild will not expand.Free SpinsLanding 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols triggers the free spins, Super free spins, or Mega free spins bonus rounds, respectively, awarding 10 free spins.Free Spins - the same mechanic as in the base game applies. That is, wilds expand to cover the whole reel and each additional wild increases the multiplier by +1. In free spins, at least 1 wild is guaranteed on each free spin.Super Free Spins - the same as free spins except the grid expands to 4x5.Mega Free Spins - the same as Super free spins except the multiplier increases by +2.The Mafiosi slot - free spinsThe Mafiosi: Slot VerdictJust for the record, this isn't Peter & Sons' first flirtation with the wrong side of the law. One prior example was Animafia, a humorous take on the Cosa Nostra, which used animals as hardened criminals instead of their human counterparts. It's not a majorly heavy-hitting game in general, really, where much of its bigger thrills rely on the expansion of wild symbols across whole reels, increasing the multiplier in the process. The not-so-good news is that triggering free spins with more than the entry-level number of scatters is not always the easiest of tasks in any game. Not saying it can't happen, but it might have been handy if The Mafiosi offered clear ways of upgrading bonus rounds from regular to Super to Mega by, say, landing a special symbol or whatever. As it stands, The Mafiosi achieved max wins of 7,000x the bet (its win cap) during Peter & Sons' 100 million simulated spins, though one wonders whether this occurred in Mega free spins or if it's possible in other modes, too. You'd think technically yes, though it is not specifically mentioned.All in all, The Mafiosi is a decent, somewhat lighter-toned Mafia slot which performs interesting things with expanding wilds and multipliers. Wannabe-wiseguys should be able to get a kick out of it, but The Mafiosi didn't stand out enough to really push it past mid-levels in the hierarchy."

title: Vikings Fight For Honour
