Cacti can also be seen one either side of the reels, providing quite the scene.Then, on the six reels, you’ll find the slot’s different symbols. They begin with the playing card symbols of the green 9, red 10, aqua J, yellow Q, orange K and purple A. You’ll also see a symbol of a pickaxe and spade crossed over, a miner’s lantern and also the aforementioned bearded miner himself. Yet, it’s the symbol of the glistening diamond that acts as this game’s highest paying standard addition, multiplying your stake by up to 50 times your stake. The diamond sticks symbol is the wild, it only appears in the horizontal reel above reels 2 through to 5.Diamond Mine Megaways (Blueprint Gaming): FeaturesDiamond Mine also incorporates a Mystery Symbol into its reels. This is present in the shape of the barrel with the letters “TNT” written on it. This one is able to show up on any reel, and when it does, it will transform into any of the other standard symbols, except for the slot’s scatter. Therefore, you can really benefit from multiple Mystery Symbols showing up across the screen.As far as the scatter symbol is concerned, this comes in the shape of the bag of gold. Scatters have the ability to show up anywhere on the reels and will still reward you with a pay-out. However, you need to spin at least four of them into view in any location to activate the slot’s Free Spins function. You’ll be awarded with 12 Free Spins in total for every additional scatter on top of the triggering four, an extra five spins are given on top of the 12. Furthermore, during this feature round, there is an Unlimited Win Multiplier in operation. This multiplier starts at 1x and then increases with every Reaction. One final perk of this round is that the appearance of three scatters during it will add five more spins on to your total, while four will give you 10 extra Free Spins.And speaking of the Reaction feature, this occurs whenever you form a win in the base game or the free spins round. Basically, every symbol that makes up part of a winning combination will disappear from the reels, leaving space for new symbols to fall into play. Should more wins form, the process takes place again. This continues until no additional wins can be created from a Reaction.Diamond Mine Megaways (Blueprint Gaming): VerdictWe can’t give enough praise to the Diamond Mine slot game from Blueprint Gaming. Yes, it does feature the Megaways wins that occurs in several other slots from this developer. However, it was the first one release by the studio and still has a special place in the hearts of many gamers. Today, it might not stand out as much as it did when it first came out, but it definitely stands the test of time. In fact, it's better than most Bonanza clones being released today.Overall, Diamond Mine is an excellent slot that offers a lot of value in terms of play time in spite of its relatively high volatility. It's not as explosive as their other Megaways offerings when it comes to the 10,000x max win. But then again, it's highly unlikely you're ever going to see a max win over 3,000x although, of course, there is a slim chance."

title: Cygnus
structured_summary: Cygnus is an Egyptian-themed slot with a cosmic twist, inspired by the Cygnus constellation and pyramid alignments. It features a unique avalanche mechanic with gravity-based symbol drops, multipliers, free spins, and expanding reels up to 262,144 ways to win. The reviewer praises its novel gameplay and high engagement despite some low-value spins, highlighting its high volatility and potential big wins. Visually, Cygnus offers classic Egyptian aesthetics with a calming soundtrack, creating an immersive and appealing experience.
review: 0.20/100,Out Now,9,"Cygnus Slot (ELK Studios): OverviewAt first glance, Cygnus is obviously an Egyptian themed slot. It is, however, quite different from what we usually get in this category. Let’s start with a clarification to begin the break down. Cygnus is the name of one of the stars that make up the Northern Cross in the night sky. This constellation is apparently aligned with frightening accuracy to the pyramids in Giza. The game sheet claims this is no coincidence, that the alignment creates some sort of cosmic connection. Some online theorists have taken this idea a step further and suggested that aliens from Cygnus are responsible for building the pyramids. Whatever the truth might be, Cygnus is the title of ELK Studios latest slot, and it combines Egyptian and galactic themes with a bunch of compelling features.The look and sound of the game are classically Egyptian. The game grid is set before the entrance to a pyramid, with palm trees framing the scene and a constellation in the night sky. It’s a pretty scene and one that is not completely unremoved from the Gold series of slots. What creates that impression is the 6 reels sitting between two pillars, stacked 4 rows high. It looks intriguing, and the multiplier on the right pillar is encouraging.Initially, the game has 4,096 win ways. Symbols need to land in three or more on any row from the 1st reel onwards. Cygnus uses Avalanche game mechanics, but again, this feature is a little different than before. Because the rows and reels are not aligned flush, when winning symbols are removed, the gravity mechanic lets them drop naturally. Imagine round symbols bouncing down a flight of stairs rather than dropping straight down. Usually, symbols here fall left to right, but not always. It is a nice touch and can lead to some intense moments as you watch the symbol you want slowly make its way down to the right position, or not. Another aspect is that rows can be added after winners are cleared. This can lead to 8 rows of symbols on each reel boosting win ways to 262,144.This win system integrates with the symbols well too. The highest paying symbol in the game, for whatever reason, is the lucky 7 symbol. These usually land in a bunch on the right-hand side of the grid. Through the new and highly innovative gravity mechanic, they can get pulled into play when winning symbols on the left are cleared out of the way to let them roll in. Other symbols in the game include 4 low pay gems, and 3 more high pay symbols – an ibis, camel, and cat. The symbols look like they were designed at the last minute and don’t offer spectacular value which you would expect with an avalanche feature. The exception is the 7 which returns 30 times the stake for 6 of a kind.The nuts and bolts of the game include setting bet levels from between 10 p/c and $/100 a spin across all devices. Alternatively, players can engage one of four betting strategies in combination with up to 100 auto spins. ELK has rated the volatility at 8 of 10, which is high, but it can feel even higher at times. Cygnus comes with an RTP of 96.1% and a hit rate of 23% so theoretically it is not tight when it comes to payouts.Cygnus Slot (ELK Studios): FeaturesWorking hand in hand with the game mechanics are the extra features. Up first is the ‘X’ symbol. If this symbol makes it to the bottom row, it engages the Multiplier on the right pillar. Each consecutive ‘X’ moves it higher from x2, x4, x16, x32, until x64. The golden W symbol is wild and can land anywhere to substitute for any regular pay symbols.As always, the elusive bonus game is the one you want, and it sounds easier to land than it actually is. How it works is that when the bonus symbol enters the game it needs to be moved left until it touches the left pillar. If it does so 7 Free Drops are awarded. The bonus round uses the full 8 rows on every drop, and multiplier symbols that enter the game become sticky. This feature can also be retriggered.Cygnus Slot (ELK Studios): VerdictOn paper, the features sound a lot like ELK's Gold series of slots. Even in action, you can’t deny there are similarities. But ELK has done enough alterations to make Cygnus something of a standalone slot. Sure, some elements at their core have been used before, but Cygnus does them all a little differently, and the result feels novel. It is also massively playable. The way symbols fall left or right using the new gravity mechanic makes you want to see what happens next. Cygnus has the kind of x-factor that when you say, 'just one more spin', half an hour can pass by without noticing.While entertaining, Cygnus can also be unforgiving with a lot of dead or low-value spins. You need to get on a good run where avalanche wins pull in multipliers, ideally during free spins, for any chance of significant returns. Speaking of returns, the game has a top prize of $/€500,000. You will need to bet at max level to reach that amount due to the potential of 5,000 times the stake. Again, a similar figure to what we got with slots in the Gold range, the better ones at least.Overall, ELK has come up with a pretty good game here. The soundtrack sets the mood, and it is certainly easy on the eyes. When it comes to features, the individual parts might not be completely original. But when everything is brought together the result is something fresh. It is also easy to get lost in. And once immersed, any comparison to other slots fades away by its very playable nature."

title: Odin's Riches
structured_summary:
1. Odin's Riches is a Norse mythology-themed grid slot featuring Odin’s legendary exploits.  
2. The game includes cluster wins, a collection meter unlocking mini-features, cascading Rolling Reels, and free spins with increasing multipliers.  
3. The reviewer finds it a solid, highly volatile slot with engaging gameplay but modest 5,000x max win potential.  
4. A plain yet tasteful visual design is enhanced by a dynamic, dramatic soundtrack that heightens player immersion.
review: 7.5,"Odin's Riches: Slot OverviewOnce again, the one-eyed divinity Odin leaves Asgard for a trip to the iGaming realm in Just For The Win's first-ever grid slot Odin's Riches. The All-Father has gone on this journey so many times by now; most players probably know all about his exploits. Such as how he gave up an eye in return for seeing everything that happens. Or how he hung himself, stabbed himself, and didn't eat or drink for nine days in order to discover the runes. What to say? Odin liked learning new things. What's not quite so new is the game’s core mechanic, where a winning symbol collection system leads to the release of modifier extras, and, potentially, free spins.Powered by Microgaming, it all starts when 49 symbols drop onto a 7x7 sized grid with the goal of forming clusters of 5 or more matching symbols. Visually, Odin's Riches isn't the extravaganza you usually associate with Just For The Win, having a slightly generic feel about it where runes and basic symbols make up the grid. To the left, we find a collection meter, while the right side displays a Viking ship and a pile of gold. The rest of the view is a plain burgundy wall displaying a stylish Celtic design in the upper right quadrant. It's rather plain-looking, yet some might argue it's been tastefully done. The winning factor is a brilliant soundtrack that marches in step with the intensity level of the action taking place on the grid.If Just For The Win received criticism from some quarters about their games being a little mathematically tame, they've come back swinging in recent times. Odin's Riches is not only highly volatile but 'very highly' volatile, meaning the game needs a good push to really get going. Once it is, then mounting wins lead to copious mini-features and even free spins. Winning Odin's favour is possible on any device where bets from 20 p/c to $/€50 may be set. Potential isn't enormous, though respectable enough at 5,000x, as is the RTP value of 96.07%.There are 8 pay symbols on hand to make clusters out of. The first 4 are lower-paying runes Tiwaz, Othalan, Dagaz, and Mannaz, worth 5 to 12.5 times the bet for a cluster of 15+. Animals make up the remaining 4 high pays, where we find ravens, serpents, wolves, and dragons. These are worth a payout of 25 to 300x the bet for clusters of 15 or more. Symbol values are relatively low compared to some grid slots, and you notice this too when you land a decent-sized cluster only to end up with a disappointing return. Good thing then there are several features available to augment win values.Odin's Riches: Slot FeaturesOdin's Riches - free spinsLike many grid slots, the goal of Odin's Riches is to hit as many consecutive clusters as possible to fill a collection meter to win various set-point modifiers. Collect enough wins, and you'll be rewarded with a round of free spins, which make use of a progressive win multiplier.How it works is that each winning cluster is removed via the cascading Rolling Reels feature allowing new symbols to fall into the gaps. In addition, every reaction creates a wild symbol which substitutes for all pay symbols. Rolling Reels continue to function until no new clusters form.Winning symbols are collected and tracked on a meter. For every 25 collected, a mini-feature is queued, and when no more wins appear, queued features are released onto the grid. These are:Dragon Riches – 5 or more of the same symbol form a win regardless of their position on the grid.Wolf's Hunger – all low pay symbols are removed, triggering the Rolling Reels feature.Serpent's Wisdom – 1 low symbol is randomly upgraded.Raven's Flight – diagonal rows of symbols from each corner of the grid are removed and replaced with 3-5 wilds, also triggering Rolling Reels.It takes 125 symbols to fill the meter, and when full, 7 free spins are awarded. In free spins, one random mini-feature is always put at the front of the queue. Also, a win multiplier starting at x1 is added to the round, rising by +1 whenever a mini-feature triggers. Should 125 symbols be collected on a single spin, +3 more spins are added to the remaining total, extending the round.Odin's Riches: Slot VerdictOdin's Riches follows a common Play'n GO-inspired grid slot pattern of hitting consecutive wins, filling a meter, winning modifiers, and climaxing with free spins. This sort of system has been put to good use in a number of great games and is successful in Odin's Riches as well. The game comes off a bit basic initially, but its positive aspects steadily build until you're comfortably engrossed in the flow.Music plays a key role in player immersion, which gets increasingly dramatic as consecutive clusters build on top of each other. When wins are popping and the meter is filling, the soundtrack wouldn't be out of place in a high fantasy series chase scene or when a crucial stage in a storyline has been reached. Sound is certainly a strong counterpoint to the relatively basic graphics.Odin's Riches is further evidence of the ongoing evolution taking place at Just For The Win. Not long ago, their games were usually graphically rich while being relatively light on the mathematical side. Odin's Riches is the complete opposite. The team has eased up on the visual feast to fine-tune its math model instead. There's no doubt Odin's Riches is 'very highly' volatile as the creator states, so patience is required to push through the base game.Despite an abundance of features and a high hit rate of 49.44%, your balance can take significant hits before the game gets a chance to go crazy. When it does, it's quite a sight as queued modifiers line up to do their thing. title: North Guardians
structured_summary: North Guardians is a Viking-themed slot featuring a 5x5 grid and a unique pattern-based Wild Pattern Wheel that adds wilds to the reels. review: 2022",7.5,"North Guardians: Slot OverviewOne of the interesting things about our brains is that they are rather good at finding patterns where none actually exist. There is a name for this condition, pareidolia, and examples include seeing animal shapes in clouds or finding faces in a bush. Perceiving real patterns is pretty important in online slots as they can be the difference between winning and not winning. Fortunately, slot patterns such as clusters or win lines are pretty straightforward, well, until certain developers start slicing everything up, aka Nolimit City. However, this time, it's Pragmatic Play's turn to throw a few shapes in a game called North Guardians, which uses an unusual pattern-based feature to add wild symbols to the main game board.We say unusual rather than unique because the studio did something similar recently in Eye of Cleopatra which used a concept called random wild patterns. When certain lights on a device were lit, they indicated where wild symbols would be placed on the board. North Guardians is similar, but has been tweaked to function in slightly different ways. Here the device is called the Wild Pattern Wheel, and it may be activated at any time, though its full power is more likely to be observed in free spins.Pragmatic Play has chosen a Viking theme to drive the action and has presented rather nicely. There's nothing revolutionary about the audio-visuals, yet everything from the carved framed game grid to the glowing braziers to the snowy outdoor scene has a satisfying Viking feel. You won't find hordes of berserkers piling into the action, but the two characters who do show up are charismatic enough on their own to carry the game.North Guardians is a highly volatile slot played over a 5x5 aligned grid with 50 fixed paylines. The RTP can chop and change depending on operators' settings, so if you're looking for the most benevolent version, that would be the 96.38% one. Interestingly, buying free spins slashes the return value down a notch to 96.29%. Base bets begin at 50 p/c per spin before rising to a maximum of $/€100 a pop.Eleven regular pay symbols appear on the reels, all paying left to right in adjacent reels from the leftmost side. Low-value symbols are represented by five runic objects, worth a very precise 0.48 to 0.8 times the stake, then come mid-value axes, horseshoes, horns, and coins worth 1.2 to 3.6 times the stake for five of a kind. Lastly, the two premium symbols are a female and male Viking, paying 6-10 times the stake for five of a kind. What looks like Odin is the wild, which lands in any position to replace regular pay symbols. Landing five wilds on a line triggers a payout of 15x the bet.North Guardians: Slot FeaturesThe Wild Pattern Wheel is North Guardian's main selling point, so let's start there. In the base game, two halves of what the game calls a 'marking rectangle' appear on the main grid beneath the regular symbols, changing positions on every spin. When both halves land in the same position, the wheel next to the reels spins. It may land on 'Level Up', in which case it spins again at the next level, or it may land on a pattern. The pattern on the wheel translates to a pattern of wild symbols added to the game grid. The higher the level, the better the pattern will be. There are five levels, and it is possible to fill the reels with wilds.Free SpinsHitting 3, 4, or 5 scatter symbols awards 5 free spins plus a cash win of 2x, 10x, or 100x the bet, respectively. In the bonus round, the Wild Pattern Wheel is active on every single spin. The wheel starts on level 1, and following a Level Up result, it does not reset. Also, when progressing to Levels 2, 3, or 4, players get +2 additional free spins each time. When reaching the fifth level, +1 free spin is awarded.Buy Free SpinsWhere this option presents itself, players may instantly trigger the main feature by hitting the bonus buy button. The cost for this is 100 times the total bet, and has mentioned earlier, doing so slightly lowers RTP by 0.11%.North Guardians: Slot VerdictNot a lot of time passed since reviewing Eye of Cleopatra, and we got the impression both games might have been conceived around the same time as there wasn't a major advancement between the two. As a comparison, the previous game tended to spread the thrills out, whereas North Guardians felt a lot more bonus round focused. There just wasn't much going on in the base game, and it was easy to zone out the regular symbols and fixate on the two halves of the rectangle dancing around the grid. In the first couple of hundred spins, the rectangle came together twice to jump-start the Wild Pattern Reel, which produced little to no result.Not saying good things can't happen in the base game, but free spins were a heck of a lot more action-packed. Again, they could be quite all or nothing as well. Five initial spins don't leave much room for error, so hopefully, the Wild Pattern Wheel is in a liberal mood with levelling up or pops some solid wild patterns in advantageous positions across the board. It's a bonus round that gets exponentially better, theoretically, the further you can progress until, at its limit in Level 5, full-screen wilds are a possibility. That would be worth 750x, while North Guardians has full potential of 5,000x the bet. Hit this payout level in the bonus round, and any free spins remaining are forfeited.All told, North Guardians is an interesting pattern-based game that might find a warm reception in the right hands. It seems like North Guardians' finer moments have been condensed into a smaller space, which is perhaps harder to reach, but unlocking higher levels with their generous helping of wild symbols has the potential to be quite a ride."

title: Santa Express

review: 2022",7,"Santa Express: Slot OverviewHo ho ho, hey we go, folks, it's another Christmas slot to thicken the stocking as the holiday season rolls around. Cascades creating wild symbols had a faint Moon Princess 100 ring to them, with the exception that in Santa Express, they have the ability to toss multipliers into the run of things. It's since gone on to appear in a slot from Bulletproof Games and is scheduled for use by at least one other studio, but now it's the chance for Bang Bang Games to let it shine.Despite any possible connotations, Shadow Raiders MultiMax has nothing to do with Blackbeard's zombie officers from Pirates of the Caribbean: On Stranger Tides, officially speaking, at least. Nor is it linked to Quickspin's outstanding hold 'n win 2022 hit Cash Truck, despite the familiar font and gonzo attitude. When the action begins, the ship has yet to set sail, so players find themselves dockside, next to a boat and a thatched structure, all tatty flag bedecked, while bones appear on either side of the board. It's an intriguing scene, and while the gambling industry is awash with pirate slots, the undead angle and general mayhem make stepping into Shadow Raiders MultiMax's world a tempting proposal.Shadow Raiders MultiMax slot - base gameBefore leaping on board and raising the gangplank, users pick a wager of 20 p/c to $/€40 per spin and decide whether or not to switch the Bonus Boost on (if available). All pay symbols can be substituted by the golden skull wild symbol.Shadow Raiders MultiMax: Slot FeaturesShadow Raiders MultiMax slot - splash screenThe extras padding out Shadow Raiders MultiMax include a Dropdown feature, the MultiMax, Booty Bombs, Raiders Free Spins (with a pre-feature gamble option), and, where available, a bonus buy optionDropdown FeatureThe Dropdown feature removes winning symbols from the board whenever they land. A wild symbol is placed in one of the empty spaces, while a symbol drop fills the rest. This procedure repeats consecutively, only stopping when no new win is created.MultiMaxAbove the main reels, a line of skulls represents a multiplier row. Each Dropdown win adds +1 to the reel multiplier – which resets after losing spins or dropdowns in the base game.Booty BombAs part of the Dropdown feature, after a wild has been placed in an empty position, the remaining empty spaces may drop Booty Bombs. Gambles take place on a wheel divided into red and green segments. MultiMax, or Crystal Falls MultiMax, for example.One big point of difference is Shadow Raiders MultiMax's outer casing, and the zombie pirate idea was a fun one that the design team has pulled off well. Shambling hordes of zombies, all flesh dripping and whatnot, might be a terrifying thought, but in online slots, they can work like a charm, often in a humorous setting. Picking zombified pirates rather than regular flesh and blood buccaneers gives the game a load of personality, which not only brought Cash Truck to mind but, interestingly, slots like Florageddon! and Granny vs Zombies, as well. So, while the gameplay is similar to others in the MultiMax range, Shadow Raiders MultiMax ironically feels fresh.Another relatively fresh part is the Booty Bomb, which is good for some (hopefully multiplied) cash prizes or some matching symbol action. Not a monumental innovation, but a clever one that fits neatly with everything else Shadow Raiders MultiMax has to offer. When Shadow Raiders MultiMax is pulling everything together, it's capable of generating wins of up to 15,000x the bet - the highest in the franchise so far. title: Cash in Transit
structured_summary: Cash in Transit is a crime-themed slot set on London’s streets, focusing on a cops and robbers heist scenario. review: 2025",5,"Cash in Transit: Slot OverviewIn slots as in life, when you hit pay dirt you gotta be hitting it again and again. And again. One would presume this is the getaway vehicle, idling while accomplices perform the smash-and-grab before piling in and zipping away to a hiding spot. So, instead of trains, Cash in Transit is a cops 'n' robbers game of dastardly criminals and brave lawmen.Cash in Transit is a high volatile slot that takes bets of 10 c to $/€100 per spin and comes shipped with 96% RTP. Special symbols contribute to triggering the respins feature.Cash in Transit: Slot FeaturesCash in Transit slot - free spinsLanding 3 or more bonus symbols triggers the respins round where 3 respins are awarded. Landing any new symbol resets the count back to 3. When a reel fills with symbols, an additional reel opens up. This can occur twice. During the game round, it is possible to land these symbols, which stick to the reels:Cash Bag - reveals a value of 1 to 10 coins.Bag Man - collects all values in view and adds them to its own value.Bag Man/Money Man - selects 3 to 5 symbols, adds their values to its own and pays out the updated value to each of the targeted symbols.Lock Smith - doubles the value of 3 to 8 other symbols. Can act on the same symbol more than once.Gov'Nor - brings 2 to 7 used non-persistent symbols to life again (Bag Man, Bag Man/Money Man, Lock Smith, Detective, or Constable). Can act on the same symbol more than once.Pawn Broker - gathers all cash bags and removes them from the reels, including other Pawn Brokers, freeing up space on the reels. Feature symbols remain on the reels.Detective - selects a random symbol and doubles its value 2 to 6 times.Constable - reveals a coin value of 5 to 100, then adds the revealed value 3 to 10 times to a random symbol.Persistent Bag Man - collects all values in view and adds them to its own value at the end of the spin and all following spins. Does not collect its own value.Persistent Lock Smith - doubles the value of 3 to 8 other symbols at the end of the spin and all following spins. Can act on the same symbol more than once.Persistent Bag Man/Money Man - selects 3 to 5 symbols at the end of each spin, then adds their values to its own and pays out the updated value to each of the targeted symbols.Persistent Gov'Nor - brings 1 to 7 already used non-persistent special symbols to life again (Bag Man, Bag Man/Money Man, Lock Smith, Detective, or Constable). Can act on the same symbol more than once.Persistent Attack Dog - turns into a different special symbol after every spin (Bag Man, Bag Man/Money Man, Lock Smith, Detective, or Constable).Cash in Transit slot - free spinsCash in Transit: Slot VerdictIt's funny, a while back, a new Money Train or Money Cart slot was big news; now, eh, not so much. If Relax Gaming went back to the drawing board to craft Money Train 5 it would possibly be their best shot at saving a studio that is in free fall currently. However, Relax Gaming seems more concerned with firing out Dream Drop releases in between slots that, in general, just haven't been very impressive for a while. Cash in Transit is another one which didn't generate much excitement. Having said that, it's not without its moments. The cops 'n' robbers theme has carved out its own space in the online slot biz, and it can be fun when not taken too seriously. However, Cash in Transit's presentation didn't have anywhere near the same screen presence as a 1,000-ton train covered in skulls and pipes.Ah well, a different angle it is and who knows? Maybe non-train folk will prefer the law-breaking approach as they attempt to make their way into the series' famous hold 'n' win round. Once in, well, there's just no telling what's going to happen. A round could be a cash bag only session; it might be one that drops several special symbols which play off of each other to a rising crescendo. Such is the breadth of experiences Money Train/Money Cart slots are able to pull off. Again, persistent symbols are everything; get a few of those interacting, and it's just good stuff.A quick word on winning potential. Where the game touts wins of up to 100,000, this is measured in coins. Since a coin is worth 0.1 of the stake, the max win in this slot is 10,000x the bet. All in all, Cash in Transit provides an alternative way to have the Money Cart experience, however, it just didn't have the same level of punch as its train-themed cousins."

title: Book of Ra - Temple of Gold
structured_summary:

review: 7.5,"Book of Ra – Temple of Gold (Novomatic): OverviewIf there is one slot series that needs little introduction it is the Book of Ra series. One of the most popular lines of games, both online and offline. A seemingly simple-looking slot has captured the hearts of countless players ever since it was released well over a decade ago. Ra fans will most likely be relieved to see that Novomatic partners, Winfinity Games, have hit upon just the right combination of new and old features.There are two obvious alterations. Gone is the Indiana Jones lookalike character, replaced with an Indiana Jane style female lead on this adventure. The second, we have left Egypt! Hopefully, this isn’t the case here because the update has breathed some life into Book of Ra and anyway, at its core, it remains a faithful Book of Ra slot.The look has that golden sheen that we have come to expect, and the reels sit on a suitably mysterious jungle looking background. In the middle of the pay range is three golden statues/treasures worth from 0.5x (for two) up to 200x the stake for five of a kind. Combine the solid symbol values with the games high volatility and you have the recipe for some real all or nothing slots action. And if that isn’t enough to get the adrenaline up, players have the option of hitting the gamble button after wins to really go all in.As you may be aware of, Novomatic allow operators the opportunity to choose from a set of different RTP values, from as low as 88% up to 97%. Most commonly, operators will choose an RTP setting of 95%, but it's always a good idea to have a look for yourself in the help file of the game.Book of Ra – Temple of Gold (Novomatic): FeaturesFree spins feature in actionOnce again, the book is the key to the extra features and plays several roles. It serves as both wild and scatter and is worth 2x, 20x, and 200x the stake for 3, 4, and 5 of a kind. The more scatters that land, the more extras come into play during the free spins as such:3 books – 1 special expanding symbol.4 books – 2 special expanding symbols.5 books – 3 special expanding symbols.When Free Spins are triggered, the applicable number of books will flick open and randomly choose one special symbol each. When these special symbols land during the bonus round, they expand to cover the whole reel. The payout frequency is also significantly helped because the expanded symbols do not need to land next to each other to create a winning combo. If you have followed the Book of Ra series, you have probably seen videos (or experienced) this feature leading to huge wins and is easily the most exciting and nail-biting part of the slot. Over time, free spins are expected to land every 170-210 games.And that’s it. A short but sweet list, which is typical of the Ra series. On many other slots, you might feel short-changed with such a simple list, but it just works with Book of Ra – Temple of Gold. It always has with the Ra series which is concerned more with fast paced big wins rather than intricate details.Book of Ra – Temple of Gold (Novomatic): VerdictNovomatic are onto another winner with Book of Ra – Temple of Gold. The female hero takes players on a slot adventure that is every bit as exciting and colourful as previous versions, perhaps more so. The pace is outstanding, and the game rips through spins at breakneck speed. With a hit frequency of around 30% with 10 lines in play, there are plenty of thrills from smaller wins while waiting for those bigger ones to land. And big wins come courtesy of up to 5,000 times your stake and a top prize of €500,000 at the maximum bet level.For fans concerned about the change in location and main character there really is nothing to worry about. A few spins in and you won’t even notice the difference. The action is classic Book of Ra combined with elements of Book of Ra Magic, and your attention will be consumed by the high volatility action on the reels rather than on some fringe graphics.Like all good sequels, it has retained the heart and soul of previous releases while containing enough tweaks to make it a solid standalone title in its own right. Book of Ra – Temple of Gold will certainly appeal to fans of the series, no doubt about that. It also suits players looking for a no-nonsense high volatility slot where you can take it all, or, leave it all on the table."

title: Nunchucks Chicken
structured_summary: Nunchucks Chicken is a quirky farmyard-themed slot featuring martial arts-armed animals in a cartoon rural setting. review: 2022",7,"Nunchucks Chicken: Slot OverviewEver heard of a Googlewhack? If not, it's the phenomenon of entering two words into a Google search and having it return a single result. Examples of this have been 'demurrable insufficiencies' and 'maladroit wheezer'. When Nunchucks Chicken landed on the review desk, the two-word title felt like a prime candidate for a Googlewhack. However, when plugging 'Nunchucks Chicken' into a query search, several pages of results emerged, including images of actual nunchucks crafted in the shape of chickens.If chicken-shaped weapons sound enjoyably silly, then Nunchucks Chicken from developer Skywind Group might be right up your alley. This is a farmyard bound online slot that upends the rule book by adding headbands to animals and arming some of them with nunchucks, shurikens, and bombs. If you're ready to 'Witness the Power of Cluck-Fu', let's do it. Nunchucks Chicken is based in a rural setting and initially came across as an Angry Birds meets Big Bad Wolf mash-up. Images of chickens wielding nunchucks enhance the positive vibes, encouraging a spin or two to see where the ludicrousness might lead.Putting silliness aside for a moment, let's get serious and plough through the numbers. Landing across it are nine normal paying symbols, starting with wood designed 10-A card royals as the low pays. Lows are worth 1.2 to 2 times the stake for five of a kind, while the five high-value animal symbols pay 4 to 10 times the bet for a line of five. A nunchucks tile is wild, appearing on all five reels. Nunchucks wilds substitute for all symbols except the scatter and pay 40x the bet for a line of five of them.Nunchucks Chicken: Slot FeaturesSo we've seen where the nunchucks come in; the other part of the puzzle is the chicken which appears on the scatter symbol. Scatters appear on reels 2, 3, or 4, and having 2 scatters in view triggers the Ninja Respins feature, or having 3 scatters in view triggers the Shuriken Showdown.Ninja RespinsBefore the respin begins, a starting multiplier of x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20, or x50 is awarded. If no win occurs on the respin, the multiplier increases by +1, and the reels are respun again. The reels respin, and the multiplier increases until a win is eventually produced.Shuriken ShowdownTriggered by landing 3 scatters in the base game, Shuriken Showdown is played on a 6x6 grid where normal symbols are removed from the reels. In their place, special symbols appear. These are foxes, chickens, crates, or numbers.Crates are basically blocker tiles, which do nothing except take up space. Numbers are collected in a meter located above the grid, and foxes carry bombs. When a fox appears, the bomb it carries explodes, removing all of the crates in view.Chickens can do one of two things. If a chicken lands holding nunchucks, it first destroys all surrounding crates. Then any numbers surrounding the chicken are collected, and the summed total is placed in the position below. Finally, nunchucks chickens add a value of +3 to +100 to the summed number they just placed. When chickens land holding shurikens, they do the same thing, except, instead of adding a value, they multiply the consolidated number by x2 to x100.Now, a row of random symbols is added to the grid on each spin. When crates are destroyed, symbols in the rows above them fall down into the empty gaps. There is no set number of free spins. Instead, the feature ends when no more symbols can be added to the top row, Tetris style. Then, the bet is multiplied by the number in the multiplier box and awarded.Not in the mood to trigger the Shuriken Showdown organically? If the option is available in your jurisdiction, you can instead pay 100x the bet to buy the bonus instantly.Nunchucks Chicken: Slot VerdictIs it just us, or has Skywind Group been pushing the boat out a further lately in terms of creativity and original ideas? Despite having hundreds of slots in their arsenal, it wasn't till they started dabbling in Megaways that they really popped up on our radar. Now they're here, it's nice to see them deviating from the norm. One of the first examples of this was Alive! Megaways which made a huge break from the Asian, Buffalo, Fruit slot fusions they seemed to be stuck turning out. If anything, Nunchucks Chickens is just as quirky as the Frankenstein's Monster's B-movie extravaganza was, and it's nice to see Skywind expose more of their light-hearted side.So Nunchucks Chicken wears its theme well, how about the gameplay? Well, the bonus game is an interesting one, made up of as many elements found within online slots as outside them. As well as the Tetris dimension, what makes Shuriken Free Spins pop is the 2048 game element. The way chickens combine numbers into one, then whack on another value, or even better, multiply them, can grow number values exponentially. One minute you've got a bunch of crates and numbers on screen doing nowt, then the next minute, a couple of chickens have flocked in to lay a decent result. When all those the ninjas, nunchucks, bombs, and shurikens are flying, wins of up to 10,000x the bet is a possibility.The cute, anthropomorphic animal category of slots is full of oddball entries, and Nunchucks Chickens certainly qualifies as one of these. The venture largely works too, as Nunchucks Chicken brims with charm, charismatic critters, and a unique bonus round that has the ability to harness the power of repeat growth to pile up decent returns."

title: Coin Quest
structured_summary: Coin Quest is a Central America-themed cluster slot featuring an Aztec temple setting. review: 0.20/40,"April 27, 2022",8,"Coin Quest: Slot OverviewUp for a bit of trekking through nature on a coin hunt? Software provider Slotmill is, and the team is taking interested players to the well-trod ground of Central America in an online slot titled Coin Quest. A cluster paying grid slot with an Avalanche win system, Coin Quest comes bundled with a collect system, three types of bonus rounds, and several feature buying options. So, while the theme might not be the most original, Coin Quest has plenty to get stuck into, so slap on some mosquito repellent and join us if you're up for it.Coin Quest gets off to a positive beginning by presenting a clean, pleasantly rendered, if a little clinical view of an Aztec temple setting. It's got a bit of jungle, some chunky stonework, and more than enough Aztec inspired imagery to set the mood. It didn't inflame passions right away yet is agreeable looking enough to prompt further investigation.Played on a 5x5 game grid, Coin Quest is a highly volatile slot that provides eligible players with a number of ways of approaching the game. When playing in the normal mode, the RTP can be found at two settings – 96.12% or 94.36%, while stakes range from 20 p/c to $/€40 per spin. Other modes are covered below in the features section, where players in certain jurisdictions can find three bonus buys and the unusual Burst Mode to choose from.Getting the wins rolling begins when at least five matching symbols land adjacent to each other in vertical or horizontal directions. Winning clusters trigger the Avalanche feature, and there are seven regular paying symbols to work with. These start with three lower value red, green, and blue tiles paying 0.25-0.3x for five of a kind, rising to 6-10x the bet for clusters of 12+ symbols. Then we get three animals and a skull as the four higher paying symbols, worth 0.3-1x the bet for 5 of a kind, up to 12.5-40x the bet for 12+ sized clusters.Coin Quest: Slot FeaturesA lot of the big thrills in Coin Quest begin with the Avalanche feature. This removes winning clusters from the grid to make way for a symbol drop to fill the gaps. If a new cluster is created after the symbol drop, the Avalanche feature triggers again. In addition, before symbols drop, a wild symbol is added to one of the empty spaces.Collect MeterAvalanches feed into the Collect Meter, which is available in the base and bonus game. Each symbol removed in an Avalanche progresses the Collect Meter by +1. When 25 symbols have been collected, the Sun God feature triggers, adding Coins and Wilds to the game panel. At the end of each base game spin, the meter resets.Coin ClustersAs well as normal symbols, Coin symbols can land bearing values of 1x to 500x. When Coins land in clusters of five or more, their values are added together and multiplied by the bet. The win is paid out, then the cluster explodes, and an Avalanche occurs; however, one of the empty spaces is filled with a new Coin symbol carrying the total multiplier of the Coin cluster.Coin Quest BonusCoin Quest Bonus symbols appear on reels 1 or 5, and landing 2 of them at once triggers this feature. When you do, 5 free spins are awarded, where the collect meter does not reset until the bonus round ends. During the Coin Quest, Coin symbols remain on the grid, dropping to the bottom of the reels between spins. There they can potentially accumulate into larger clusters and values. Landing a +1 Spin symbol awards one additional free spin. Landing 3 Bonus symbols on reels 2, 3, or 4 upgrades the feature to Super Free Spins and awards +4 additional free spins.Free SpinsLanding 3 Bonus symbols on reels 2, 3, or 4 in the base game awards 8 free spins. During free spins, whenever the collect meter is filled, it adds random Wilds and Coins to the grid as normal, but it also increases the win multiplier by +1, up to a maximum of x20. Landing the +1 Spin symbol awards an additional free spin, or landing Coin Quest symbols on reels 1 and 5 upgrades the bonus to Super Free Spins, whilst also awarding +4 extra free spins.Super Free SpinsAs well as the two ways mentioned above, landing Coin Quest symbols on reels 1 and 5, plus Bonus symbols on reels 2, 3, and 4 triggers 8 Super Free Spins. Super Free Spins is a mix of Coin Quest and Free Spins.Fast TrackIf this option is visible on screen in your jurisdiction, clicking it opens up three ways of playing Coin Quest. These are:Coin Quest – 40x the bet buys a Coin Quest trigger with an RTP of 96.21%.Free Spins – regular free spins trigger for 100x the bet with an RTP of 96.36%.Super Free Spins – buy the super version of free spins for the cost of 480x the bet. RTP is 96.58%.Burst ModeAnother way of possibly playing Coin Quest is in Burst Mode. This is a hyper-fast, no-frills mode that removes the grid, then lets the math model do its thing unhindered. Players select the number of spins they want, plus the stake. Then any wins simply appear on screen as bare numbers.Coin Quest: Slot VerdictSlotmill games often feel like the stereotypical nice guy at an office everyone gets along with. The dude who doesn't talk smack behind peoples' backs and always has a pencil to borrow. These are games which are also easy to get along with, yet their all-around nice disposition and lack of edge mean they tend to fall in the middle of the slot hierarchy, being neither outcast nor one of the cool crew. That's fine, though we don’t think Slotmill is aiming for average. This is a studio that turns out perfectly playable slots, with fine features and decent winning totals, but there's a feeling they could do so much more if given a little push.Coin Quest is a classic example. In Coin Quest, Slotmill has nailed the basics, given the game an attractive look, and included some interesting features. As a thought experiment, let's cast our minds to Print Studios as a comparison, which started out relatively safe with a Book slot before diving into uncharted territory. Not saying all studios have to be daring innovators every single time, but to break into the top clique, that might be the sort of spirit Slotmill will have to adopt.For now, we're fine playing games like Coin Quest. It's a well-made cluster paying slot with a fun use of symbol collections, multipliers, and coin features, capable of cranking out wins worth up to 10,000x the bet. There's not much more you could ask for, nor little that warrants a major overhaul. Slotmill has made an inoffensive game, but again, one lacking the sort of glittering star quality which would likely make it the first pick in a line-up.Perhaps, and it feels like we've said this before, Slotmill might do well to put their well-honed design chops to use in a braver theme. It doesn't have to be a psychological thriller set in a Victorian-era psychiatric institute or be too out there. However, perhaps by picking something a little bolder the team might be inspired to step up to the next level?"

The session turned into masses of Wild Respins respinning to nowhere, multipliers screaming out for operators, and badgers who could have put as much effort into being productive as they do in being cute.No doubt, good things can happen in this badger hole when everything lines up; the game does have a max win of 10,000x the bet and all. This game does not have a cascade/reaction/tumbling mechanic in either the base game or in free spins. It does have nine regular paying symbols, though; 5 are lows, and 4 are highs. The lows are 10 to A card ranks, while the highs are an eagle, a cougar, a bear, and an elk. When 6 elks or 8 of any of the others create a win, the payout equates to 0.1 to 0.5 the bet, increasing to 1.5 to 5 times the bet for a 12+ sized scatter win.Elk Hunter: Slot FeaturesElk Hunter slot - free spinsIn the spirit of decluttering in nature, Elk Hunter is not the most feature-filled scatter pay slot around. Its extras are Multiplier Wild symbols, free spins, and a bonus buy.Multiplier Wild SymbolsMultiplier Wild symbols with values of x2, x3, x5, or x10 may appear anywhere on the grid in the base game and in free spins. What's interesting is how the neatly developed game world goes with how simplistic the features are. Perhaps this was done in the spirit of getting back to nature and living a simpler existence while minimising stress, responsibilities, mental taxation, contact with humanity and all that.The weaponry Elk Hunter does have on hand is pretty nifty. Few would argue with the inclusion of wilds with multipliers in a scatter-paying slot, though the multiplier values are nothing when compared to a benchmark scatter pays slot like Gates of Olympus. They are wild, let's not forget, which adds an exciting dimension to a slot like this. The omission of a cascading wins mechanism is felt, though, and may play a part in Elk Hunter's modest max win figure of 2,035 times the bet. This figure and the overall vibe the game gave off would suggest it is aimed at the recreational segment of the gambling crowd. As such, it is tough to critically crush Elk Hunter too much if it is setting out to be a pleasant nature game with elk rather than a paradigm-shifting hot rod of a slot. This would follow the pattern NetEnt has followed of late in slots like Don't Eat the Candy, 101 Candies, or Crab Trap.If you dig the natural setting but crave a bit more grunt, then Print Studio's nature slot Huntress Wild Vengeance might be a better match. title: Dragon Stone

review: "Dragon Stone (iSoftBet): OverviewIrrespective of how well-received their creations are by casual players, many game developer dream of having a hit with the casino community; to win over the hearts of those picky hard-core gamblers and experience the pleasure of seeing their game age like a fine wine, slowly morphing from hit to classic. When activated, the ""O"" in the logo directly above the reels will start to flash and eventually stop on one of the four colours representing the four dragons. This is what's on offer:Flaming Wilds (red) - the fire dragon will breathe fireballs to give you a random amount of fire wilds.Ice Storm Spins (blue) - the ice dragon will freeze winning symbols into place and reward re-spins as long as new winning symbols are added.Earthquake Reels (green) - the earth dragon will raise rocks from the earth that will turn entire reels wild.Winds of Winnings (purple) - the wind dragon will blow in a random number of mystery symbols to replace 3 - 15 symbols.The tension increases even more when you trigger the Free Spins which is accomplished by landing 3, 4 or 5 dragon stone scatter symbols anywhere on the reels (giving you 10, 15 or 20 free spins respectively). The game is incredibly well designed and the sounds are just outstanding. Mathematically, on the other hand, we're not quite as impressed. Medium variance, you can win up to 698 times your stake on each spin, although you'd be happy to hit it even once in your lifetime. Moreover, the randomly triggered modifiers mostly seem to involve lower-value symbols, which gets a bit tedious after a while and will make you stop hoping for any win over 20x.In spite of its flaws, Dragon Stone is a fascinating slot that manages to come out on top. While the volatility and potential is too low to appeal to hard-core gamblers who generally love the thrill of chasing massive hits, it will gain lots of fans among those who are looking for something new and fresh to keep them entertained."

title: Ms Robin Hood
structured_summary: Ms Robin Hood is a playful slot themed around a female Robin Hood and animal characters set in Sherwood Forest. The game features symbol splits, random wilds, nudging wilds, and free spins with locked wilds enhancing win potential. The reviewer finds it enjoyable with a solid max win of 12,574x bet and well-integrated features. Aesthetics include charming, animal-themed visuals and lively, jovial music creating a friendly, festive atmosphere.
review: "October 15, 2024",7,"Ms Robin Hood: Slot OverviewYou might have seen Robin Hood hit the reels on numerous occasions, but have you ever seen a Ms Robin Hood before? Okay, maybe if Light & Wonder's Lady Robin Hood has flashed up on your playlist, yet by and large, the legendary outlaw generally comes in a male form - as he originally did, when tales begin spreading from the 13th/14th century onwards. Well, we live in the 21st century (at the time of writing), where, for some, gender is a hot (and divisive) topic. Let's not go into that, but try and keep an open mind as we attempt to take from the rich and give to the poor in NetEnt's online slot, Ms Robin Hood.Many moons ago, not quite the Middle Ages, but in 1973, Walt Disney released the animated film 'Robin Hood', where all the characters were animals rather than humans. Robin was a fox, Prince John a lion, and the Sheriff of Nottingham was a wolf. It's a bit of a classic film and worth watching with kids on a rainy Sunday afternoon, perhaps. The point is, Ms Robin Hood follows in the act of using animals as its characters instead of hoomans. Doing so provides a friendly, borderline comedic touch, which works perfectly in Ms Robin Hood, as it's a game better suited to gamblers who are not after a raving savage of a game.Ms Robin Hood slot - base gameLashed between two gnarly trees in the middle of Sherwood Forest is Ms Robin Hood's gaming grid. It holds 5 reels, 4 rows, and a counter to the top left displays the number of ways to win. The default number is 1,024 ways, yet symbols can be split, increasing the ways to win value when they are sliced up. With volatility on the higher side, Ms Robin Hood's RTP at its highest setting is 96%, and the game accepts bets of 10 c to $/€80 a game round.As for pay symbols, 10 to A card ranks displayed on circular coin-like objects are the lower value lot, while villainous animal characters depicted by birds, wolves, crocodiles, mice, and pigs are the highs. When wilds are on the screen, they substitute for any of the regular paying symbols.Ms Robin Hood: Slot FeaturesMs Robin Hood slot - free spinsMs Robin Hood plays a part in all of the features, from the Robin Nudge, Robin Wild, Random Wilds, and Symbol Splits to free spins; she dips her arrows in each of them.Robin Nudge & Robin WildA partially visible 'Robin in disguise' symbol on the leftmost reel is always nudged to be fully stacked and transforms into a Robin Wild symbol. The Robin Wild substitutes for all other symbols except the scatter. A fully visible Robin Wild activates either the Random Wild feature, the Symbol Split feature, or both features in that order:Random Wilds - When triggered, up to 6 arrows land on the reels, transforming the symbols they hit into wilds. Robin Wilds and scatters cannot be transformed into normal wilds.Symbol Split - When triggered, up to 6 arrows land on the reels, transforming the symbols they hit into 2 halves of the same type. Robin Wilds and scatters cannot be split. Halved symbols act the same as non-halved symbols.Free SpinsWhen a scatter symbol and a Robin Wild symbol land together in the main game, players win 10 free spins. The Robin Wild locks and stays on the leftmost reel for the duration of the free spins round. When a scatter symbol and a Robin Wild symbol land together on a free spin, players win +5 free spins.Ms Robin Hood slot - free spinsMs Robin Hood: Slot VerdictA certain mood or frame of mind, or both, might have to be cultivated for some to enjoy what Ms Robin Hood has to offer, thought the relatively high max win potential of 12,574x the bet is certainly a solid incentive to give it a shot. Charming looks can be deceiving in a slot, but Ms Robin Hood isn't really one of those. What you see is more or less what you get. A playful reworking of the Robin Hood legends with a lady Robin in the driving seat and animals as characters, strutting their stuff in a jolly, almost village fete environment.Within the confines of their limitations, Ms Robin Hood's features were quite pleasant. The actual Ms Robin Hood symbol is the star of the show easily, and it's nice she always nudges to cover the reel when she hits partially in view. The shower of arrows that follow will either split symbols or chuck a few wilds up there. Since she makes the leftmost reel wild, wins are not assured, but they are encouraged. Furthermore, with Ms Robin Hood locked in place for free spins, which triggered at a fair frequency, flurries of arrows and, therefore, features make the bonus round a busy event.Ms Robin Hood might be a relatively small game in some ways, yet it's still enjoyable for what it is. The whole show has been slickly put together; the visual effects couple perfectly with the jolly music to produce a convivial atmosphere, amplified by the cheeky critters and a main character who fires masses of arrows in the face of convention. For the most part, everything works out well, and it's hard to see Ms Robin Hood being anything but received positively by the players it's aiming to win over."

title: The Runemakers DoubleMax
structured_summary: The Runemakers DoubleMax is a fantasy-themed slot set in a dark forest ruled by mystical Runemakers. It features a 6x6 cluster pays grid combined with the DoubleMax multiplier mechanic, cascading wins, mystery symbols, free spins with gamble options, and a bonus buy. The reviewer praises its innovative blend of cluster pays and DoubleMax features, calling it a refreshing and solid addition with high volatility and a 15,000x max win. Visually, the game presents cold blues and pastel purples with transparent reels bordered by ivy, accompanied by fitting atmospheric audio.
review: 2024",7,"The Runemakers DoubleMax: Slot OverviewWhen a DoubleMax slot comes along, often one of the first thoughts is how close it will be to the Raptor DoubleMax template - a wannabe, mildly similar, or, gasp, something more original? Especially when the slot has been designed by one of Yggdrasil Gaming's partners, in this case, Bang Bang Games, which tinkered with the features in its previous DoubleMax slot, Pharaoh's Gaze. However, today's game in question, The Runemakers DoubleMax, is something different altogether as Bang Bang Games has made the first cluster paying grid slot that also happens to have the multiplying power of DoubleMax on board.The mechanical side of The Runemakers DoubleMax is pretty inventive, which is more than can be said for the storyline side. Okay, it's a slot, not an MMORPG, but the call to action for players here inviting them to 'Journey into a mysterious realm set against a dark forest ruled by THE RUNEMAKERS' is a little thin. No matter, The Runemakers DoubleMax makes up for it by looking and sounding pretty decent when in action. A 6x6 gaming grid is where the activity occurs, bordered by creeping ivy, and is transparent, too, so players get a clear view of the cold blues and pastel purples of the fantasy world. It made for a good start, piquing interest in how cluster pays would work with DoubleMax.The Runemakers DoubleMax slot - base gameBefore beginning the adventure, players decide whether they want to bet 20 c to $/€50 per spin, activate the Bonus Boost, or buy the free spins round. When activating the Bonus Boost, the stake increases by 50% to have double the chance of triggering free spins. Since the info pages do not say otherwise, it would appear the RTP, no matter how The Runemakers DoubleMax is played, is 96% (with lower versions available), while the volatility is 'super high'. That's pretty high.To create a winning cluster, you will need at least 5 matching symbols to land on the grid, connected in horizontal or vertical directions. From lowest value to highest, the paytable displays 4 runes carved into differently coloured stones as the lows, then 4 runes carved into gems as the highs. Hitting a 5-matching symbol cluster pays 0.2 to 1.5 times the bet, whereas the most valuable 14+ clusters are worth 5 to 10 times the bet. Not much for a cluster pays slot, so DoubleMax is useful for stepping in to pep the payouts. Wilds help, too, by substituting for all regular pay symbols.The Runemakers DoubleMax: Slot FeaturesThe Runemakers DoubleMax slot - free spins gambleCascading wins, or as they're called here Dropdowns, are critical in a DoubleMax game due to the way they increase the win multiplier and are joined by Mystic Mysteries, free spins, a free spins gamble, as well as a bonus buy.Dropdown FeatureThe Dropdown feature means winning symbols disappear from the reels, making room for other symbols to drop down, providing another chance to win. Each time players get a Dropdown win, 1 to 5 wild symbols are added to empty positions before the rest of the spaces are filled. Dropdown win chains continue until there are no more wins.DoubleMaxEach Dropdown win doubles the total win multiplier. In the base game, the multiplier resets after a losing spin or Dropdown, whereas in free spins, the multiplier which starts at x1 does not reset until the bonus session ends.Mystic MysteriesDuring symbol replacements, Mystic symbols may appear. After a win, all new symbols may drop in as Mystery symbols. When in view on the reels, all Mystery symbols reveal the same matching symbol – this excludes scatters or wilds.Runemaker's Free SpinsIn the base game, landing at least 3 scatter symbols awards 7 free spins. Before the round begins, players have the chance to gamble for more free spins on a wheel. When successful, the number of free spins goes from 7 to 9 on the first gamble, then 9 to 11 on the second gamble, with 11 free spins being the most you can win. If the gamble is lost, players lose their free spins and go back to the base game.Buy BonusIt is possible to buy 7 free spins for 125x the bet. After buying free spins, players are able to gamble for more if they would like to try.The Runemakers DoubleMax slot - free spinsThe Runemakers DoubleMax: Slot VerdictWell, that was an unexpected bolt out of the blue. You get so used to something being done a certain way that any deviation from the normal run of things comes as quite a jolt. DoubleMax games till now have tended to be quite technically similar, generally played out on a 5x3 gaming grid with 20 or so paylines up to 243 ways to win, broadly speaking. So, to see the mechanic stretched to perform on a larger gaming space with cluster pays rather than lines or ways was a breath of fresh air.Putting the cluster element to the side for a moment, The Runemakers DoubleMax does function very closely to a lot of other DoubleMax slots - namely, hit cascades, add wilds, double the multiplier. Repeat and win, hopefully. The Runemakers DoubleMax mixes things up by dropping in mystery symbols and, of course, cluster pays, but in a certain sense, it's a familiar formula by now. A solid formula, though, if slightly brute force, which relies on repeat cascading wins to rip through the multiplier to potentially obscene levels rarely found outside a DoubleMax game. Moreover, since cluster pay slots tend to rely on chains of cascading wins to provide their bigger entertainments anyway, pairing cascades with a doubling-up multiplier makes perfect sense.As a result, The Runemakers DoubleMax presents an interesting proposal for both cluster pay players and DoubleMax fans to try out. It might be hard to wind the game up at times, but get it on a roll, and the Dropdown/DoubleMax multiplier combo might be quite a ride. With a 15,000x the bet max win figure, there's plenty to play for, too, in a game that charges the DoubleMax range into brand-new territory."

title: Rhino Rilla Rex
structured_summary: Rhino Rilla Rex is a quirky, jungle-themed slot blending futuristic and Jurassic Park vibes with a unique animal hybrid concept. It features an Any Adjacent Pays system, Team Up and Team Up Bonus Spins, plus progressive Beast Prizes with multipliers and cash rewards. The reviewer found it entertaining but noted very low symbol values and a slow build toward bigger wins, requiring patience. The game offers a jungle soundtrack with sci-fi effects and a distinct, unusual visual style typical of Crazy Tooth Studios.
review: "April 21, 2022",5,"Rhino Rilla Rex: Slot OverviewReady with an open mind players? Good, because we are about to delve into the world of Crazy Tooth Studios, a veritable rabbit hole in terms of online slot design. The good thing about Crazy Tooth is they tend to take you on some kind of bizarre Kafkaesque journey to someplace you've never been in a slot before. The not so good thing is that it rarely, if ever, works, or at best, works weird. Next on the dissection table is Rhino Rilla Rex, a classic Crazy Tooth romp full of strange ideas, finicky rules, and one-off presentation.The game starts pretty harmlessly, it should be said. At first glance, it would seem the studio has gone for a quasi-futuristic approach, with hints of Jurassic Park going on. There are four Beast Prizes on the left-hand side, some Isla Nublar like flora in the background, and a jungle-y soundtrack interspersed with sci-fi sound effects. So far, so fairly normal, with just an unusual mix of animals to contend with.Rhino Rilla Rex is playable on any device, offering stakes of 25 p/c to $/€12.50 per spin. It comes with three RTP configurations, so it's worth keeping an eye out for those if you're tempted by the prospect, maxing out at 96.2%. In each RTP case, volatility is high, and players get a hit rate of 28.92%. On paper, max exposure is rather decent, but the way Rhino Rilla Rex is set up makes it difficult to see how it could ever achieve it.Now for a few curveballs. One rule easy to get to grips with is the Any Adjacent Pays system which creates winning combinations of three or more of a kind, starting in any position. As long as matching symbols are adjacent, they pay. This provides players with 3,125 ways to win on a game board made up of 5 reels and 5 rows. What's not great is the minuscule symbol values, like minuscule to the point you think they might be typos. First up are the four lower value tiles, these are green, red, blue, and purple icons that pay 0.04x the bet for 3, 4, or 5 of a kind. Next are the animal premiums, landing in 1x2, 1x3, or 1x4 in size for the rhino, gorilla, or dinosaur, respectively. These aren't much better, all paying 0.08x the bet for 3, 4, or 5 of a kind. There is a wild symbol, landing on reels 1 or 5 to replace any pay symbols, and hopefully, the features are able to pick up some of the considerable slack.Rhino Rilla Rex: Slot FeaturesTo get to the potentially bigger bucks in Rhino Rilla Rex, there are several extras on hand. These are the Team Up Feature, Team Up Bonus Spins, and Beast Prizes.Team Up FeatureLanding any combination of premium beast symbols fully in view triggers the Team Up feature. For this one, the triggering symbols create a new game board, where cash prizes, multipliers, or tokens may land. Players get one spin and win the sum total of all cash prizes in view, increased by multipliers if one or more land. These could be x2, x3, x4, or x5, depending on which animal symbols triggered the feature. On an amusing note, the game combines the triggering beasts into a hybrid, such as a Rhino-Rilla, for example.Team Up Bonus SpinsThis is quite similar to the previous feature with slight changes. If a combination of at least 3 beast symbols lands fully in view, and at least one of them has a golden 'bonus' frame around it, then Team Up Bonus Spins are awarded. As before, the triggering symbols create a new game board. On its reels may land cash prizes, multipliers, or extra spins. Players win any prizes that land, win multipliers, or extra spins to keep the feature going.Beast PrizesOn the left of the screen are four progressive Beast Prizes. Whenever a premium animal symbol lands fully in view, its respective Beast Prize increases in value. Beneath each prize is a meter with a different number of slots. Each token won from the Team Up feature, or Team Up Bonus Spins fills one of the slots. Collecting all of the required tokens awards the applicable Beast Prize, which have seed values of 5x, 25x, 100x, or 500x the bet for the Rhino, Rilla, Rex, or Rhino Rilla Rex prize, respectively.Rhino Rilla Rex: Slot VerdictWell, Rhino Rilla Rex didn't disappoint. It's got Crazy Tooth's unique brand of entertainment stamped all over it, with bits that aren't bad, other bits which baffle. The first 'what the' moment was when we discovered how much, or how little, the symbols are worth. It's not a major shock to see modest symbol values in a Crazy Tooth game, yet even then, Rhino Rilla Rex stands out. 8c for a five-symbol premium win (at €1 stake)? And here's us thinking the xRIP feature from Tombstone RIP was severe. Even Nolimit City could learn a thing a two about harsh brutality from Rhino Rilla Rex. Symbols did tend to land stacked at times, but still, ouch.So this meant the review cycled between patches of small to no thrill base game spins, broken up by the Team Up feature. We'd like to include Team Up Bonus Spins as well, but that extra was noticeably less common. The Team Up was okay, there are cash prizes and multipliers up for grabs, so it's one way of winning some money back, maybe more. The other is the Beast Prizes, which like the pay symbols, possess modest seed values. And while the help docs mention a 5,000x cap on each of the Beast Prizes, we're guessing it would take a significant amount of time to build the prizes to anywhere near that level.The collection system and growing Beast Prize values would suggest high levels of patience are required in Rhino Rilla Rex. But how much patience are players willing to put into a game like this? While potential might technically be quite good, it feels like you're constantly fighting over pennies which has an amusing, shock value at first yet quickly gets old."

title: Safari Sun

review: 2023",7.5,"Safari Sun: Slot OverviewHigh up on many travellers' bucket lists is visiting Africa to take part in one of the many safaris on offer there. Fantasma Games is no slouch with the pixelated paint brush, and its art department has outdone itself by crafting a pleasant vision of this part of the vast African continent. The soundtrack is about as laid back as you could ask for, and with a bit of mental input, it's not hard to imagine lounging about in a high-end safari lodge while giraffes wander past your window, and elephants come to drink at the river.Safari Sun slot - base gameIn the base game, Safari Sun is played on a 5-reel gaming grid, the reels lined up in 3-4-4-4-3 formation. More specifically, that means 10-A card ranks as the low pays, worth 1 times the bet for a 5 OAK winning way, whereas the highs are a toucan, meerkats, a baboon, a rhino, and a lion worth 1.5 to 5 times the bet for a 5 symbol winning way. Hopefully, wild symbols aren't high on your must-see list of things for a safari, as Safari Sun does not make use of them at any stage.Safari Sun: Slot FeaturesSafari Sun slot - pick screenWhat you will or may see on this trip, though, are an Expanding Symbol feature, a Mystery Sun feature, and free spins with a bonus buy option.Expanding Symbol FeatureSometimes symbols may land with a sun-mark on them. If sun-marked symbols take part in a winning combination, they expand to cover all positions on their reel.Mystery Sun FeatureThis feature triggers at random in the base game during a win situation. The sun marks 1 to 3 symbols on reels 2, 3, and 4 that take part in a winning combination. The sun-marked symbols then expand to cover their entire reels. Free spins cannot activate during the Mystery Sun feature. This feature has a theoretical hit frequency of 1 in 145.Free SpinsScatter symbols land on reels 2, 3, and 4 in the base game. Hitting 3 scatters awards the free spins bonus round. For free spins, the grid grows to 6 reels wide in a 3-4-4-4-4-3 formation. When entering free spins, players pick 1 of 5 options – the lion with 4 free spins, the rhino with 8 free spins, the baboon with 12 free spins, the meerkat with 16 free spins, or the toucan with 20 free spins. During free spins, the chosen high pay symbol is the only high symbol that will land in the feature. Free spins trigger at a frequency of 1 in 170, theoretically.Buy Free SpinsTo buy the free spins feature, the cost is 50 times the bet. When buying free spins, the RTP is slightly higher at 96.06%.Safari Sun slot - free spinsSafari Sun: Slot VerdictFor big game enthusiasts who happen to enjoy taking a punt, joining this safari potentially provides the opportunity to spot a few interesting sights. For starters, it looks good, though a lot of African wilderness slots do, which is probably why so many games use this particular subject matter, and the music's pleasant, making it fairly easy to immerse yourself in Safari Sun's setting. It's more realistic than a lot of what Fantasma Games turns out, if you cast your minds back to games like Fortune Llama, Magikspell, or Rich Raptors, for example, though Safari Sun retains a certain dreamy quality. Equally important, if not more so, Safari Sun piles on some decent gaming through features that work well in both phases of play.One thing to attempt clearing up. The Mystery Sun feature mentions marking symbols on the middle three reels only, and while it doesn't specifically state this in the game info, it appears sun symbols never land on the outer two reels. The closest we saw to stacking the first reel in free spins, for example, was landing two premium symbols on it. Even though premiums don't appear able to be fully stacked on the outer reels, the game's max win remains rather sizable at 18,792x. To have a chance of achieving that figure, Safari Sun's expanding symbol feature is an entertaining extra, and having just one premium symbol land in free spins is a great idea, too.In some ways, Safari Sun's free spins round is a bit like those games that level up via a collection mechanic, upgrading lesser symbols until all that's left is the highest-paying symbol - Pink Elephants, being one such example - except in Safari Sun, you can dive right into the round with the symbol/volatility you prefer. This system provides plenty of room to manoeuvre, from max volatility alongside the lion to more 'cautious' options, players may choose, making Safari Sun an interesting option in the busy African countryside slot genre."

If Taco Wilds land beneath one of these Wild Explosion symbols, the special symbol drops onto the Taco Wilds, triggering their respective modifier, like so:Orange Wild – increases its win multiplier by 1 and adds a Taco Wild on each adjacent reel.Red Wild – increases its win multiplier by 1 and adds a Taco Wild above and below it.Purpler Wild – increases its win multiplier by 1 and adds 2 to 3 Taco Wilds to random positions on the grid.Re-spinsOnce the Wild Explosion has finished adding or upgrading Taco Wilds, chains appear, wrapping them into place on the grid. Okay, so the XXXtreme part refers more to the bonus buy menu, but still, slap a word like that on an online slot title, and there was a certain assumption which Taco Fury XXXtreme failed to meet.On the positive side, Taco Fury XXXtreme has a neat look and a zombie serving brain-filled tacos… who saw that one coming? Clearly, NetEnt funnelled a healthy dose of creativity into Taco Fury XXXtreme during its design.
